chunks.chineseText:
第12章

最后是拐进了一个隐蔽的死角，白粼粼才被“解救”出来。

鸟坐在人的掌心，两个爪子朝外伸着，头顶圆滚滚的，羽毛蓬松。

有点呆。

“……”

“……”

其实是有一点尴尬的。

白粼粼很快反应过来了，灵活地蹦跶起来，开始伸展翅根，歪头梳理羽毛。

故技重施。

假装什么事情都没有发生过。

但人其实并没有太在意鸟心里的小九九，宋郁只是抬手把鸟头微微圈住了，蹙眉去看了看那个喙。

色泽光滑，结实有力。

看起来没有受伤。

也就在这时。

宋郁的指腹传来一阵钝钝的夹痛感。

他垂眸看过去，但鸟已经迅速地把短喙收回去了，然后把脑袋咻得一下卡进人手指围成的圈里。

开始自闭。

“……”

白粼粼叨人叨习惯了，一下子也没太反应过来，只好赶在对方看过来，缩起来。

不过高中生好像耐咬一些。

宋郁又抬手把他放到了肩头，只是轻声道：

“这次不要摔了。”

白粼粼鸟脸一红，调整好站姿，再也不动了。

那家店里的鸟纯不正经。

贴来贴去的，它们怎么没从栖杆上掉下去！

宋郁其实没有觉得小鸟叨人有什么坏处，毕竟它力气不大，指腹上还残留着点微弱的触感。

不过想到这里。

少年脚步一停。

腰部被戳的感觉好像又席卷过来，有点……奇怪。

“啾啾？”

宋郁闻声回了下神，侧头解释了下，“没事。”

一人一鸟步行回了家。

-

白粼粼回到家就把刚才那档子事给抛之脑后了，开始琢磨今天吃点什么好东西。

宋郁似乎有事，回来给他添完粮后就上楼了，独留给鸟一片自由空间。

白粼粼非常熟练地用喙拨了拨“五谷杂粮”，让它看上去又被叨过的痕迹。

随后大摇大摆地去了厨房。

但一无所获。

由于家里阿姨不在了，冰箱不再成为稳定的物资刷新点，白粼粼铩羽而归。

岛台上盘子里还装着粮食，白粼粼站过去叨了两口。

报吃。

他扑棱了下翅膀，决定去楼上找宋郁。

让人去点外卖！

卧室门是虚掩着的，或者说是从来没关过，因为宋郁后面发现只要一关，鸟就在门口努力地制造噪音，爪子扒拉半天。

况且鸟还要睡在卧室里的纸巾盒里的，一来二去人就养成了“留门”的习惯。

白粼粼此刻俨然一个走地鸡，拱着鸟头塞进门缝里，啪嗒啪嗒走进来了。

卧室里没人，只有不远处的洗手间有水流的动静。

洗澡？

今天怎么白天洗？

鸟往浴室门那里走了走，探头看了看里面，磨砂玻璃上全是雾气，人也不出来。

白粼粼想了想，只好扑棱翅膀去了桌子上，思索着要不要开一局游戏。

但时间应该不太够。

鸟最终决定放弃，打算继续回门口蹲人，但是刚一转头，余光看到了个东西。

四四方方，屏幕有着纯正的黑，但却泛着光泽。

俗称：手机。

白粼粼实在是很难抵抗这种诱惑，他扭头看了看浴室，很好，宋郁还在洗澡。

鸟走了过来。

探了探头。

手机屏幕上倒映着一个圆滚滚的鸟头。

白粼粼有些心虚，他记得宋郁的手机是没有密码的，他看起来也不太像是会看软件使用记录的。

那他……偷偷玩一下……

那塌方明星的瓜他还没有吃完，这么长时间过去了，吞了几个亿应该查出来了吧？

互联网的世界丰富多彩，对鸟的吸引力是不言而喻的。

白粼粼心里咳咳了两声，然后伸了下鸟腿，刚想准备动作——

但就在这时。

手机屏幕突然亮了。

鸟给吓了一跳，战术后撤，不过他定睛一看，发现原来是弹过来一条微信消息。

噢噢。

白粼粼放松了下来，他又往前走了几步，低头看了看，锁屏只是有微信提示，不显示内容。

鸟松了一口气，他只要不点到这个就可以了。

但或许是怕什么来什么，白粼粼用爪子往上一滑，结果页面直接给跳转了。

“……”

鸟腿悬停在半空中。

白粼粼已经来不及收回鸟眼了。

[江芮：转账60000]

[江芮：宋郁，你已经很大了，你要体谅妈妈。]

[江芮：你妹妹那个样子，我当然要再生一个，不然让宋启明看笑话吗？]

白粼粼还保持着金鸡独立的状态，他心想完了完了，这是隐私，不能看不能看。

鸟开始掩耳盗铃，闭着眼睛，伸腿试图切走这个页面。

但也就在这时，手机又嗡嗡震动了声。

又来了一条消息。

白粼粼滑页面的爪子抖了下。

与此同时，南城另外一处的别苑里，身着丝绸睡衣的女人在看消息。

秀眉微蹙。

手机页面上一条是她最新发的消息：

[那个小鸟真的不能给妈妈吗？小予她认准了那只。]

对方回复的是……

[宋郁：。。？]

江芮判断不出来这是什么意思，但难免有些烦躁，本来这段时间事情就多。

抑郁症……

那能是什么病？

才十几岁能有什么人生烦恼？

江芮实在是无法理解，尚美那里还有一大堆事等着她处理，下周还约了小予的医生。

自己都没有崩溃。

他一个孩子能出什么问题？

说到底还是宋启明个丧良心的。

江芮一想到前夫就胸口发闷，他能春风得意多久，华秉这几年很明显有下坡路的意思。

老爷子一醒，他和那狐狸精的好日子就到头了。

江芮把手机扔到了床上了，面色相当不愉，也就在这时，门口传来一顿哐哐乱砸的声音。

还伴随着些鸟类的嘶哑声。

外头保姆似乎是在哄，但像是无济于事。

江芮只能深呼吸一口气，调整了下面部表情，转而朝门口那里走去。

卧室里点有熏香，旁边的床头柜那里还摆着昂贵的珠宝，光线暗沉但奢靡。

门缝里有些透光，外面的场景很是温馨。

女人似乎在弯腰哄，一句一句道：

“哥哥会给你送过来的，为什么不喜欢这几个？”

“很好看的呀，也是蓝色的。”

断断续续的声音从门口传进卧室里，保姆的影子在靠近墙边的一侧，似乎在清扫什么东西。

-

白粼粼把这个页面切走后松了一口气，丝毫不知道自己误触了什么。

不过原来宋郁的妈妈叫江芮，刚才的消息好像还转钱了……

那这个关系是？

鸟想不通，后面也就不想了，开始正儿八经地去找短视频app，但翻了半天居然没找到。

手机屏幕自带的主题，没有游戏，没有娱乐软件。

“……”

白粼粼退而求其次，转而点开了淘宝，里面花花绿绿的商品一下子就弹出来了。

鸟的眼睛微微放大。

薯片！

奥利奥！

鱿鱼丝！

……
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 12

It wasn't until he turned into a secluded dead-end that Bai Linlin was finally "rescued."

The bird sat in the palm of the person’s hand, both claws stretched outward, his head round and fluffy.

A bit dazed.

"…"

"…"

Actually, it was a little awkward.

Bai Linlin quickly reacted, hopping up nimbly, starting to stretch his wing roots and tilt his head to preen his feathers.

Using the same old trick.

Pretending nothing had happened.

But the person didn't really care about the little schemes in the bird’s heart. Song Yu just raised his hand to gently encircle the bird’s head, frowning to check the beak.

The color was smooth, sturdy, and strong.

It didn't look injured.

And just at that moment.

Song Yu felt a dull, pinching pain on his fingertip.

He lowered his eyes to look, but the bird had already quickly retracted its short beak and then *whoosh*, tucked its head into the circle formed by the person’s fingers.

Starting to self-isolate.

"…"

Bai Linlin was used to pecking people, and he hadn't reacted in time, so he had to shrink back before the other person looked over.

*Though, this high schooler seems a bit more bite-resistant.*

Song Yu raised his hand and placed him back on his shoulder, only whispering:

"Don't fall again this time."

Bai Linlin’s bird face turned red. He adjusted his stance and didn't move again.

*The birds in that shop were purely indecent.*

*Cuddling here and there, how did they not fall off the perch!*

Song Yu didn't actually feel that the little bird pecking him was a bad thing; after all, it didn't have much strength, and a faint sensation still lingered on his fingertip.

But thinking of this.

The youth’s footsteps paused.

The feeling of being poked in the waist seemed to wash over him again, which was… a bit strange.

"Chirp chirp?"

Song Yu came back to his senses at the sound and turned his head to explain, "It’s nothing."

The human and the bird walked home.

-

As soon as Bai Linlin got home, he threw the previous incident to the back of his mind and began to ponder what good things he should eat today.

Song Yu seemed to have something to do; after returning and refilling the bird’s food, he went upstairs, leaving the bird to its own devices.

Bai Linlin very skillfully used his beak to nudge the "grains and cereals," making it look like they had been pecked at.

Then, he swaggered into the kitchen.

But he found nothing.

Since the housekeeper was no longer there, the refrigerator was no longer a stable source of supplies, and Bai Linlin returned in defeat.

There was still food in the plate on the island counter, so Bai Linlin stood there and pecked at it twice.

*Tastes bad.*

He flapped his wings and decided to go upstairs to find Song Yu.

*Make him order takeout!*

The bedroom door was ajar, or rather, it was never closed, because Song Yu had discovered that whenever he closed it, the bird would try to make noise at the door, scratching for a long time.

Besides, the bird had to sleep in the tissue box in the bedroom, so over time, the person had developed the habit of "leaving the door open."

Bai Linlin was now like a free-range chicken, arching his bird head into the door crack and walking in *patter-patter*.

There was no one in the bedroom, only the sound of running water from the bathroom nearby.

*Taking a shower?*

*Why is he showering during the day today?*

The bird walked toward the bathroom door and peeked inside. The frosted glass was covered in steam, and the person wasn't coming out.

Bai Linlin thought for a moment, then had to flap his wings and go to the desk, wondering whether to start a game.

But there probably wasn't enough time.

The bird finally decided to give up and planned to go back to the door to wait for him, but just as he turned his head, his peripheral vision caught something.

Square, with a pure black screen, yet shimmering with luster.

Commonly known as: a mobile phone.

Bai Linlin found it very hard to resist such temptation. He turned his head to look at the bathroom. *Good, Song Yu is still showering.*

The bird walked over.

He poked his head out.

The phone screen reflected a round bird head.

Bai Linlin felt a bit guilty. He remembered that Song Yu’s phone didn't have a password, and he didn't look like the type to check app usage history.

*Then… I’ll play secretly for a bit…*

*I haven't finished eating the gossip about that disgraced celebrity. So much time has passed; surely they’ve found out about those hundreds of millions embezzled, right?*

The world of the internet was rich and colorful, and its attraction to a bird was self-evident.

Bai Linlin coughed twice in his heart, then stretched his bird leg, just about to make a move—

But just then.

The phone screen suddenly lit up.

The bird was startled and performed a tactical retreat. However, when he looked closely, he realized it was just a WeChat message popping up.

*Oh, oh.*

Bai Linlin relaxed. He walked forward a few more steps and looked down. The lock screen only showed a WeChat notification, not the content.

The bird breathed a sigh of relief. *As long as I don't click on this, it’ll be fine.*

But perhaps because he feared what might happen, Bai Linlin swiped upward with his claw, and the page jumped directly.

"…"

The bird’s leg hung suspended in mid-air.

Bai Linlin was too late to look away.

[Jiang Rui: Transfer 60,000]

[Jiang Rui: Song Yu, you are already grown up; you have to be considerate of your mother.]

[Jiang Rui: As for your sister’s condition, of course I have to have another one, otherwise should I let Song Qiming make a joke of us?]

Bai Linlin was still in the "golden rooster" stance. He thought, *It’s over, it’s over. This is privacy; I can't look, I can't look.*

The bird began to deceive himself, closing his eyes and extending his leg, trying to swipe away from this page.

But just at this moment, the phone vibrated with a buzz.

Another message came in.

The claw Bai Linlin was using to swipe the page trembled.

At the same time, in a villa elsewhere in Nancheng, a woman wearing silk pajamas was looking at her messages.

Her delicate eyebrows were slightly furrowed.

One message on the phone screen was the one she had just sent:

[Is that little bird really not for Mom? Xiao Yu has her heart set on that one.]

The reply was…

[Song Yu: ..?]

Jiang Rui couldn't judge what that meant, but she couldn't help feeling a bit annoyed. Things had been busy lately anyway.

*Depression…*

*What kind of illness could that be?*

*What kind of life troubles could a teenager have?*

Jiang Rui really couldn't understand. There were a pile of things waiting for her to handle at Shangmei, and she had an appointment with Xiao Yu’s doctor next week.

*Even I haven't had a breakdown.*

*What kind of problem could a child like him have?*

*In the end, it’s all because of that heartless Song Qiming.*

Whenever Jiang Rui thought of her ex-husband, her chest felt tight. *How long can he be so smug? Huabing has clearly been on a downward trend these past few years.*

*Once the old man wakes up, his good days with that vixen will be over.*

Jiang Rui threw the phone onto the bed, her expression quite unpleasant. Just then, a loud, crashing sound came from the doorway.

Accompanied by the hoarse cries of a bird.

The nanny outside seemed to be coaxing, but it was to no avail.

Jiang Rui could only take a deep breath, adjust her facial expression, and turn to walk toward the door.

The bedroom was scented with incense, and expensive jewelry was displayed on the bedside table nearby. The light was dim but luxurious.

Light shone through the crack in the door, and the scene outside was very warm.

The woman seemed to be bending over to coax, saying sentence by sentence:

"Brother will send it to you. Why don't you like these ones?"

"They are very pretty, they are blue too."

The intermittent sounds drifted from the doorway into the bedroom. The nanny’s shadow was near the wall, seemingly cleaning something up.

-

Bai Linlin breathed a sigh of relief after swiping away from that page, completely unaware of what he had accidentally touched.

*But so, Song Yu’s mother is named Jiang Rui. The message just now seemed to involve a transfer of money…*

*So what is this relationship?*

The bird couldn't figure it out, so he stopped thinking about it and began to seriously look for a short-video app, but after flipping through for a long time, he couldn't find one.

The phone’s built-in theme had no games, no entertainment software.

"…"

Bai Linlin settled for the next best thing and clicked on Taobao. The colorful products popped up immediately.

The bird’s eyes widened slightly.

*Potato chips!*

*Oreos!*

*Shredded squid!*

*…*

chunks.chineseText:
琳琅满目，鸟看得着了迷、忘了情，甚至开始丝滑地用鸟腿刷主页，还自动把看中的东西加入了购物车。

等到准备付款的时候才一下子反应过来，他密码都快要输完了。

[4-5-3-2-8-6]

白粼粼记得牢固无比，觉得羞愧难当，最后赶紧取消了支付页面。

在桌子上蹦跶了两下。

！

什么时候鸟可以拥有一部手机！

白粼粼有点沮丧，他不应该对别人的钱有这么大的占有欲。

但如果，就是说如果，宋郁可以给他买一台iphone最新版呢？

鸟畅想着未来。

不过现在还有另外一件事，白粼粼歪头看了看浴室，里面的水声已经停了。

完事了？

鸟扑棱扑棱翅膀，非常安全地降落。

“啾啾？”

宋郁蹙眉看了下门口，磨砂玻璃的外侧有个圆滚滚的身影，他抬手拿了下毛巾。

简单擦了下脸，修长的手指穿插过发丝，往上捋了下，露出光洁的额头。

“啾啾啾啾。”

外面还在催促。

宋郁有些轻微的怔然，但还是收拾得快了些，换好衣服后打开了门，低头看了过去。

果不其然门口站着一只板板正正的小鸟，在仰头看他。

并且由于地板上有水汽，鸟腿还在匀速地劈叉。

“怎么了？”

宋郁蹲下身子，开口问道，面容在逆光下显得轮廓分明，他伸了手指过去。

鸟立马抬腿上来了。

白粼粼的目标只有一个，他也要洗澡！

鸟很爱干净的，每天都兢兢业业地梳理羽毛，雷打不动。

但白粼粼总觉得这不算真正地洗澡，他也要进大浴缸，也要用香波波。

“啾啾！”

心动不如行动，鸟扑棱翅膀飞了起来，叼着宋郁的衣服，往里扯。

人虽然不解，但还是跟着走了。

直到鸟站在了淋浴的把手那里，开始抖了抖身子，羽毛一点点地蓬松。

最后成了个炸毛球。

宋郁愣住了。

-

最后还是给黎笙拍了照片，那边回复倒是很快。

[黎笙：鹦鹉会洗澡的，和尚这个品种本来就很爱玩水的，你可以给它弄个小小的‘浴缸’？]

[黎笙：流动的水也可以，它自己会蓬毛的。]

宋郁侧眸看了下淋浴把手上的那只，已经圆滚滚的，成了两倍大了。

白粼粼歪了歪头，他其实是想要人给他放水，但不知道宋郁怎么拿手机了？

鸟有些紧张，在淋浴把手上又调整了下站姿。

他购物车好像忘记删了……

“要洗澡？”

白粼粼闻言松了一口气，“人”看来没有发现，于是鸟点了点头。

羽毛又蓬了一个度。

抖了抖身子。

宋郁再度有种奇怪的感觉，原本冷白的脸上泛起些红晕，他从来没有照顾过……人或者动物洗过澡。

这是比较亲密的行为。

只发生在信任与被信任的关系下。

但也就在这么愣神的时候，耳边再度传来“啾啾”的声音。

圆滚滚的鸟已经伸出了爪子。

歪头看过来了。

宋郁身体先一步行动，反应过来的时候，手指上已经托着一个沉甸甸的小鸟，爪子包裹得很紧实。

羽毛也软软的。

“啾啾啾！”

[要洗澡。]

白粼粼又仰头看了看淋浴头，这次人终于反应过来了。

给开了。

不过调整了好长时间的水温。

宋郁其实在反应过来鸟要在他手上洗的时候，气血都有些上涌，他很难不不去想：

小鸟都这么聪明的？

还会找人？

而后又自己纠正：

不是。

是只有他的小鸟是聪明的……

宋郁几乎有些走神，直到虎口传来点微微的戳感，回头一看，鸟正专心致志地叨着。

白粼粼咬得很爽。

很解压。

但一抬鸟头——

“……”

“……”

最后还是如愿洗上澡了，淋浴开得很小，白粼粼一点点地往水流那里挪。

开始伸了伸翅膀，羽毛蓬松极了，一秒，两秒……鸟开始沉浸甩水。

哗啦啦。

鸟一开始还有些拘谨，后面就完全沉浸了，水温适宜，抖起来更是不知天地为何物。

最后甚至有些重心不稳。

啪唧翻了。

但好在“人”一直看着，稳当当地托着了，鸟的短喙正好插在两个手指之间。

白粼粼有点缺氧，爪子一伸，直接躺板板。

但被很轻松地提了起来。

宋郁在说话：

“还洗不洗了？”

“你洗得很好。”

鸟不解，这有什么可夸奖的，但还是很骄傲地挺了下身躯。

“啾啾！”

[当然！]

白粼粼最后迷迷糊糊地爬上了人的肩头，闭上了眼睛，后面的事情就不太清楚了。

宋郁在发现鸟在他肩头睡着了之后，就没有怎么大动过。

小鸟脑袋歪着，短喙就这么戳着他的脖子。

歪歪地贴着人。

宋郁大脑一片空白，甚至觉得皮肤里血液都在流动，很热。

他几乎没有什么犹豫，拿起来手机打开了购物软件。

买了些东西。

[鹦鹉小澡盆。]

[鹦鹉专用沐浴露。]

[鹦鹉保温箱。]

这些都还算是正常的，后面几乎就是全部买了些相关的东西，宋郁只是觉得或许……或许它喜欢呢？

[鹦鹉奶粉。]

[鹦鹉迷你小窝。]

[鹦鹉针织小围兜。]

[鹦鹉小秋千。]

[……]

买到最后，宋郁又看到了些新的东西。

[鹦鹉钥匙扣。]

[鹦鹉相框。]

[鹦鹉木头雕塑。]

人有些走火入魔，直到肩头有轻轻的咂巴声才回了回神。

宋郁这才没有继续再挑下去了，只是侧头看了看鸟，好在是没有吵醒，还在睡。

他垂眸准备付款，购物车上面全部是鹦鹉的用品，因而也就没有往下滑。

直接全部结算了。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：不费吹灰之力清空购物车！
chunks.englishText:
The sheer variety was dazzling. The bird was so mesmerized and lost in the moment that it began to silkily scroll through the homepage with its bird-leg, even automatically adding items it liked to the shopping cart.

It wasn't until it was time to pay that it suddenly snapped back to reality, having almost finished inputting the password.

[4-5-3-2-8-6]

Bai Linlin remembered it with absolute clarity and felt incredibly ashamed, hurriedly canceling the payment page.

It hopped around on the table a few times.

!

When would a bird be able to own a mobile phone!

Bai Linlin felt a bit dejected; he shouldn't have such a strong sense of possessiveness over someone else's money.

But what if—just saying, what if—Song Yu could buy him the latest version of the iPhone?

The bird daydreamed about the future.

However, there was another matter at hand. Bai Linlin tilted his head to look at the bathroom; the sound of water inside had stopped.

Was he finished?

The bird flapped its wings and landed safely.

"Chirp?"

Song Yu frowned as he looked toward the doorway, where a round, fluffy figure stood behind the frosted glass. He reached out to grab a towel.

After a quick wipe of his face, his slender fingers ran through his hair, slicking it back to reveal a smooth forehead.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp."

The urging from outside continued.

Song Yu was slightly dazed, but he finished getting ready quickly. After changing his clothes, he opened the door and looked down.

Sure enough, a prim and proper little bird was standing at the threshold, looking up at him.

And because there was moisture on the floor, the bird's legs were doing a slow-motion split.

"What's wrong?"

Song Yu squatted down and asked, his features sharp and well-defined in the backlight. He extended a finger.

The bird immediately lifted a leg and stepped onto it.

Bai Linlin had only one goal: he wanted to take a bath too!

Birds are very clean; he groomed his feathers diligently every day, rain or shine.

But Bai Linlin always felt that didn't count as a real bath. He wanted to get into the big tub and use the fragrant shampoo too.

"Chirp!"

Action is better than hesitation. The bird flapped its wings, took hold of Song Yu's clothes in its beak, and tugged inward.

Though the human was puzzled, he followed along.

Until the bird stood on the shower handle and began to shake its body, its feathers fluffing up bit by bit.

Finally, it turned into a fluffy ball of fur.

Song Yu was stunned.

-

In the end, he took a photo and sent it to Li Sheng, who replied quite quickly.

[Li Sheng: Parrots can take baths. The Monk parrot breed is naturally very fond of playing in water. You could get it a small 'bathtub'?]

[Li Sheng: Flowing water works too; it will fluff its feathers on its own.]

Song Yu glanced sideways at the one on the shower handle, which was already round and twice its normal size.

Bai Linlin tilted his head. He actually wanted the human to turn on the water for him, but why was Song Yu holding his phone?

The bird felt a bit nervous and adjusted its stance on the shower handle.

It seemed he had forgotten to delete his shopping cart...

"Want to take a bath?"

Hearing this, Bai Linlin breathed a sigh of relief. The "human" didn't seem to have noticed, so the bird nodded.

Its feathers fluffed up another degree.

It shook its body.

Song Yu once again felt a strange sensation; a flush rose on his pale, cold face. He had never taken care of... a person or an animal taking a bath before.

This was a rather intimate act.

It only happened in relationships built on trust.

But just as he was lost in thought, the sound of "chirp, chirp" came to his ears again.

The round, fluffy bird had already extended its claws.

It tilted its head and looked over.

Song Yu's body moved before his mind did. By the time he realized it, his finger was already supporting a heavy little bird, its claws gripping tightly.

The feathers were soft, too.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[I want to take a bath.]

Bai Linlin looked up at the showerhead again, and this time, the human finally reacted.

He turned it on.

Though he spent a long time adjusting the water temperature.

Song Yu actually felt his blood rushing when he realized the bird wanted to bathe on his hand. It was hard not to think:

Are little birds this smart?

They even know how to ask people?

Then he corrected himself:

No.

It's just that his little bird is smart...

Song Yu was almost distracted until he felt a slight poke in the web of his hand. Looking down, he saw the bird pecking away with focused intensity.

Bai Linlin found the biting very satisfying.

Very stress-relieving.

But when he lifted his bird head—

"..."

"..."

In the end, he got his wish and took a bath. The shower was turned on very low, and Bai Linlin inched toward the stream of water.

He began to stretch his wings, his feathers extremely fluffy. One second, two seconds... the bird began to immerse itself in shaking off the water.

Splash, splash.

The bird was a bit reserved at first, but later it was completely immersed. The water temperature was perfect, and as it shook itself, it forgot the world around it.

Eventually, it even lost its balance.

Plop, it flipped over.

But fortunately, the "human" was watching the whole time and caught it steadily. The bird's short beak was stuck right between two fingers.

Bai Linlin was a little oxygen-deprived; he stretched out his claws and just lay flat.

But he was lifted up very easily.

Song Yu was speaking:

"Still want to wash?"

"You washed very well."

The bird didn't understand—what was there to praise about that?—but it still puffed out its chest with pride.

"Chirp!"

[Of course!]

Bai Linlin finally climbed onto the human's shoulder, dazed and sleepy, and closed his eyes. He wasn't quite sure what happened after that.

After Song Yu discovered the bird had fallen asleep on his shoulder, he didn't move much.

The little bird's head was tilted, its short beak poking against his neck.

It leaned crookedly against the person.

Song Yu's mind went blank. He even felt the blood flowing through his skin; it was very hot.

Almost without hesitation, he picked up his phone and opened the shopping app.

He bought a few things.

[Parrot bathtub.]

[Parrot-specific body wash.]

[Parrot incubator.]

These were still considered normal, but afterward, he basically bought everything related to it. Song Yu just felt that perhaps... perhaps it would like them?

[Parrot milk powder.]

[Parrot mini nest.]

[Parrot knitted bib.]

[Parrot small swing.]

[...]

By the end of his shopping spree, Song Yu saw some new items.

[Parrot keychain.]

[Parrot photo frame.]

[Parrot wooden sculpture.]

The human was somewhat obsessed, only coming back to his senses when he heard a light smacking sound on his shoulder.

Only then did Song Yu stop picking items. He turned his head to look at the bird; fortunately, it hadn't been woken up and was still asleep.

He lowered his eyes to prepare for payment. The shopping cart was filled entirely with parrot supplies, so he didn't scroll down.

He checked out everything at once.

Author's Note:

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Clearing the shopping cart without any effort!

chunks.chineseText:
第13章

大约是过了几天，宋郁在家里收拾快递的时候，接到了来自S州的电话。

“小郁，最近还好吗？你的小鸟取名字了没？”

陈开鹤此刻在S州大学提供的公寓里，电脑屏幕上还有些有关鸟类迁徙的数据曲线，他整个人精气神都非常足，想着同宋郁联系一下。

毕竟医院这里有了好情况，老宋说不定过几个月就清醒了，这宋启明总算是没完全丢了良心。

不过他也不敢冒昧地告诉宋郁这件事，万一又是上次那样空欢喜一场就不好了。

孩子也快高考了……

电话那头传来了温和的问好，而后才回答了问题：

“粼粼，它叫粼粼。”

陈开鹤抬了抬眉头，语气很是慈祥，拿着手机道：“‘林林’，树木丛生，不错不错，五行属木，耐活。”

但电话那头沉默了下，还是解释道：

“是波光粼粼的粼粼。”

“应该……属水？”

陈开鹤怔了下，随即就是大笑起来，说自己搞错了，不过他倒是认真想了想：

“属水，我想想啊，金利水，爷爷家里正好有个小金锁，给小鸟拿着玩吧？”

“我让小齐给你送过来！”

后半句老头子越想越好，像是自我肯定了一样。

宋郁听完就蹙了蹙眉，放下了手上的裁纸刀，只是婉拒道：

“那太贵重了，它……就是个小鸟。”

白粼粼正在茶几上勤勤恳恳地叨快递盒子，捕捉到关键词之后停了动作，歪头看了过来。

宋郁今天穿着很是简约，一件普通的白色衬衫，袖口微微往上挽了挽，显得很青春洋溢。

不过还在打电话。

“您早些休息吧，齐思扬肯定也很忙，陈爷爷，这也不太好……”

但话还没说完，宋郁肩头就一沉，侧眸一看，黑松石一样的鸟眼正圆圆地盯看着自己。

鸟也要听。

“哎，小郁不会的！小齐这学期没那么忙的，我和那孩子处得不错，他女朋友还是我这老头子撮合的。”

“送个东西而已，不必担心。”

宋郁这才回了回神，但眉毛还是蹙着，金子有点太过了。

白粼粼见人没有让他下去，于是就靠里挪了下位置，鸟头也往那边歪了歪，靠近手机的听筒。

电话那头是个老头子的声音：

“欸，这又不贵，小动物可比孩子好伺候多了，给个小金锁戴戴怎么了？”

“噢不过太重的话，你挂在它的小房子里，图个好兆头嘛！”

白粼粼愣了下，鸟脑加载中，金子……给鸟吗？

但就在这时，宋郁还在婉拒，声音很透彻：

“陈爷爷，它就是个小鸟，要金子其实也没——”

白粼粼着急！

“啾啾啾！”

“啾啾啾啾啾！”

鸟甚至开始扑棱翅膀，叨了下宋郁的手指，意图不言而喻。

[要要要！]

[鸟要小金锁！]

[给鸟戴！]

宋郁根本说不了多少话，对面的人更是高兴了，说小鸟叫起来真有劲。

最后更是压根不听“拒绝”的说辞了。

老爷子只顾输出：

“噢噢，时间不早了，我要睡觉了，对了，我让小齐再给你带本书。”

立马挂了。

宋郁深吸一口气，最后也没什么办法，只是抬手接了下半空中的鸟，也是奇怪，电话一挂，它就不啾啾了。

此刻很是乖巧地站在他的掌心，仰头看人。

脑袋圆圆，鸟腿一个直立，一个斜着，看起来有种拽拽的感觉。

“饿了吗？”

“。”

宋郁把鸟又放到了茶几上，接着拆快递，东西其实不少，物业那里从早上就上门送了一次，待会估计还要送。

白粼粼心里美美的，在茶几上啪嗒啪嗒走了几步，心心念念着自己的小金锁。

嘿嘿嘿。

不过就在这时——

“我买这个了么？”

少年喃喃自语，几乎有些不太明白，因为那是一袋卫龙辣条。

白粼粼闻声扭头一看，鸟眼都亮了亮！

往前啪嗒啪嗒又走了几步，扑棱翅膀飞到人肩头了。

低头去看快递。

！

鸟爱吃！

宋郁俯身半蹲着，面色有些困惑，但他看了盒子的地址，是自己家没错。

他之前加购物车了？

还是app自动加的？

肩头沉甸甸的，鸟又站过来了，不过宋郁的担心自己姿势太靠下，用手往上托了托鸟。

但也就是这个动作——

碰到鸟的胸脯了。

人有点微愣，因为手指传来的触感非常……舒服，一层层的羽毛，很厚实，非常软，还回弹。

宋郁没怎么碰过这里，不过鸟没太在意，只是用喙撑了下人的手指，稳稳当当地站好了。

“啾啾！”

宋郁这才收回了手，把那袋子卫龙辣条放桌上了，心想可能是自己之前误点了。

但很快事情就不对了起来……

乐事薯片一箱。

劲仔小鱼一箱。

无骨凤爪四袋。

白桃乌龙气泡水一提。

拆一个，困惑一个。

宋郁整个人都有些恍惚，因为后面拆的全是零食，什么干果、酸奶、肉脯、辣条、饼干……全品类了。

他被大数据杀熟了？

白粼粼整只鸟都美了，飞到茶几上走来走去的，心想真是美梦成真了，低头就开始叨叨叨。

不过就在快要把辣条包装袋撕开个口子的时候，上方传来少年不解的声音。

“我什么时候加购物车这么多零食……”

鸟的动作一顿。

白粼粼非常谨慎地没再叨包装袋了，而是战略性地后挪了下，咳咳，这个这个这个……

都和鸟没有关系！

宋郁觉得很奇怪，他本来就不怎么热衷购物，零食……怎么会添加这么多？

或许是鬼使神差，他看了眼桌子上的鸟。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼仰着头，圆滚滚的，有些拘谨。

“怎么可能？”

宋郁蹙眉自言自语道，觉得自己异想天开，它只是个小鸟……

但这个思绪刚一过去。

——小鸟还会打游戏。

宋郁总是会选择性忽略那些不合理的事情，以至于现在强制性地回顾起来了，整个人都有点宕机。

少年微微俯身蹲下，和茶几上的某只视线齐平。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼胸膛挺立，歪了歪鸟头，咳咳咳。

不过也就在这时，门铃响了。

-

齐思扬是来送东西的，不过看到门口物业人员还是吃了一惊，一堆快递，甚至用的小推车。

宋郁开门先是打了招呼，而后给了物业人员上门费，言行举止都很礼貌，看着状态好了很多。

不过就是肩头那只存在感实在太强了。

一会低头看手机屏幕。

一会歪头梳理羽毛的。

一会……

好的，现在抬头看他了。

齐思扬收回了视线，同宋郁点了下头，不过还是问了下，“你买这么多东西？”

他顺手拿了些，替人搬了进去，低头看了看箱子标签，全部都是鹦鹉相关的。

“……”

行吧。

“也还好”，宋郁停顿了下，最后纠正道，“只是一些必需品。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 13

About a few days later, while Song Yu was tidying up his deliveries at home, he received a call from S Province.

"Xiao Yu, how have you been lately? Have you named your little bird yet?"

Chen Kaihe was currently in an apartment provided by S Province University. On his computer screen were data curves related to bird migration. He was in high spirits, thinking of reaching out to Song Yu.

After all, there had been good news from the hospital; Old Song might wake up in a few months. Song Qiming hadn't completely lost his conscience after all.

However, he didn't dare to rashly tell Song Yu this news, just in case it turned out to be another empty hope like last time.

The child was also approaching the college entrance exams...

A gentle greeting came from the other end of the phone, followed by an answer to his question:

"Linlin. It's called Linlin."

Chen Kaihe raised his eyebrows, his tone very kind as he held the phone: "'Linlin,' like a forest of trees. Not bad, not bad. The Five Elements favor wood; it'll be hardy."

But there was a silence on the other end before Song Yu explained:

"It's the 'Lin' from 'rippling waves' (bo guang lin lin)."

"Should it... be water?"

Chen Kaihe was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter, saying he had gotten it wrong. However, he thought about it seriously:

"Water, let me think... Gold generates water. I happen to have a small gold lock at home, why don't I let the little bird have it to play with?"

"I'll have Xiao Qi send it over to you!"

The old man liked the second half of the idea more the more he thought about it, as if confirming it to himself.

Song Yu frowned after hearing this. He put down the paper cutter in his hand and politely declined:

"That's too expensive. It's... just a little bird."

Bai Linlin was diligently pecking at a delivery box on the coffee table. Upon catching the keyword, he stopped and tilted his head to look over.

Song Yu was dressed very simply today in an ordinary white shirt, the cuffs slightly rolled up, making him look full of youthful vitality.

But he was still on the phone.

"You should rest early. Qi Siyang must be very busy too. Grandpa Chen, this really isn't appropriate..."

Before he could finish, his shoulder sank. He glanced sideways to see black turquoise-like bird eyes staring roundly at him.

The bird wanted to listen too.

"Hey, Xiao Yu, it's not like that! Xiao Qi isn't that busy this semester. I get along well with that kid; I even played matchmaker for his girlfriend."

"It's just sending a small item, don't worry about it."

Song Yu finally came back to his senses, but his brows were still furrowed. Gold was a bit too much.

Seeing that the human didn't make him get down, Bai Linlin shifted his position inward, tilting his bird head toward the phone's receiver.

The voice on the other end was that of an old man:

"Eh, it's not expensive. Small animals are much easier to take care of than children. What's wrong with wearing a little gold lock?"

"Oh, but if it's too heavy, you can hang it in its little house for good luck!"

Bai Linlin was stunned, his bird brain loading. Gold... for a bird?

But just then, Song Yu was still declining, his voice clear:

"Grandpa Chen, it's just a little bird, it really doesn't need—"

Bai Linlin was anxious!

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!"

The bird even began to flap its wings and pecked at Song Yu's finger, its intention self-evident.

[Want, want, want!]

[The bird wants the little gold lock!]

[Put it on the bird!]

Song Yu couldn't get much of a word in, and the person on the other end was even happier, saying the bird sounded so energetic.

In the end, he didn't listen to any "refusal" at all.

The old man just kept outputting:

"Oh, oh, it's getting late, I need to sleep. By the way, I'll have Xiao Qi bring you a book as well."

He hung up immediately.

Song Yu took a deep breath. In the end, there was nothing he could do. He just reached out to catch the bird in mid-air. It was strange; the moment the call ended, it stopped chirping.

It was now standing very obediently on his palm, looking up at him.

Its head was round, one bird leg standing straight, the other slanted, looking somewhat cocky.

"Hungry?"

"."

Song Yu put the bird back on the coffee table and continued to unpack the deliveries. There were actually quite a few items; the property management had already made one delivery in the morning, and they would probably be delivering more later.

Bai Linlin felt wonderful inside, walking pitter-patter on the coffee table, his heart set on his little gold lock.

Hehehe.

But just then—

"Did I buy this?"

The youth murmured to himself, looking quite confused, because it was a bag of Weilong spicy strips.

Hearing this, Bai Linlin turned his head to look, his bird eyes brightening!

He took a few more pitter-patter steps forward and flapped his wings to fly onto the human's shoulder.

He looked down at the delivery.

!

The bird loved to eat this!

Song Yu bent down into a half-squat, his expression puzzled, but he checked the address on the box, and it was indeed his home.

Had he added it to his cart before?

Or did the app add it automatically?

His shoulder felt heavy; the bird had stood back on it. But Song Yu was worried about his posture being too low, so he used his hand to support the bird.

But it was this very action—

He touched the bird's chest.

The human was slightly stunned because the sensation transmitted through his fingers was very... comfortable. Layer upon layer of feathers, thick, very soft, and resilient.

Song Yu hadn't touched this area much, but the bird didn't mind, just using its beak to prop up the human's finger, standing steadily.

"Chirp!"

Song Yu then withdrew his hand and placed the bag of Weilong spicy strips on the table, thinking perhaps he had clicked it by mistake earlier.

But soon, things started to feel wrong...

A box of Lay's potato chips.

A box of Jinzai small fish.

Four bags of boneless chicken feet.

A pack of white peach oolong sparkling water.

He unpacked one, and was puzzled by one.

Song Yu was in a daze because everything he unpacked later was snacks—dried fruits, yogurt, meat jerky, spicy strips, cookies... the whole category.

Had he been "slaughtered" by big data?

Bai Linlin was in bird heaven, flying to the coffee table and walking back and forth, thinking that his dreams had truly come true. He lowered his head and started pecking, pecking, pecking.

However, just as he was about to tear open the packaging of the spicy strips, the youth's puzzled voice came from above.

"When did I add so many snacks to my cart..."

The bird's movements paused.

Bai Linlin very cautiously stopped pecking at the packaging and strategically moved backward. Ahem, this, this, this...

It had nothing to do with the bird!

Song Yu felt it was very strange. He wasn't keen on shopping to begin with, and snacks... how could he have added so many?

Perhaps out of a whim, he glanced at the bird on the table.

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin was looking up, round and fluffy, looking a bit reserved.

"How is that possible?"

Song Yu frowned and muttered to himself, feeling that his imagination was running wild. It was just a little bird...

But as soon as this thought passed.

—The little bird could also play video games.

Song Yu always selectively ignored those unreasonable things, so now that he was forced to look back on them, his whole person felt like it was crashing.

The youth bent down slightly, leveling his gaze with the one on the coffee table.

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin puffed out his chest and tilted his bird head. Ahem, ahem, ahem.

But just then, the doorbell rang.

-

Qi Siyang had come to deliver things, but he was taken aback when he saw the property staff at the door—a pile of deliveries, even using a small cart.

Song Yu opened the door, greeted them first, and then gave the property staff a tip. His manners were very polite, and he looked much better.

However, the one on his shoulder had too much presence.

One moment it was looking down at the phone screen.

One moment it was tilting its head to groom its feathers.

One moment...

Okay, now it was looking up at him.

Qi Siyang withdrew his gaze and nodded at Song Yu, but still asked, "You bought so many things?"

He reached out to take some, helping to move them inside, and looked down at the box labels. They were all parrot-related.

"..."

Fine.

"It's alright," Song Yu paused, then corrected, "Just some daily necessities."

chunks.chineseText:
齐思扬进到客厅后看到还有一堆箱子后直接愣住了，不过里面这些好像不是鹦鹉用品，他松了口气。

这凡事都有度。

太溺爱了也不好。

不过想起来自己来送什么东西的时候，还是沉默了。

盒子里放着一个小金锁，黑绳串着，看着很是精美。

齐思扬其实很难控制得住，“我也不知道我老师怎么想的，这……这不沉吗？”

“我说过了，但他老人家不听。”

二人在这么闲聊着，鸟已经从宋郁的肩头飞下来了，啪嗒啪嗒走到那个盒子那里。

观察ing。

“噢，对了，老师还让我给你带本书，鹦鹉学舌的，他听说你的小鸟不太爱说话，特地找的。”

齐思扬递了过去，环着臂膀看了下茶几上的箱子，上头还放着一袋软糖。

青年的确有些意外，但后来想想也正常，宋郁也就是个高中生。

“给我一袋呗？”齐思扬转头看向宋郁，开玩笑道。

“当然可以。”

宋郁在低头看那本书，头也不抬地道。

但就在这时——

齐思扬弯腰的时候，发出了点困惑的声音。

“嗯？”

宋郁顺着视线看过去，鸟正站在旁边，爪子按着那个糖的包装袋，仰头看着人。

羽毛蓬松，身姿挺立。

脖子上套着金坠子。

“……”

然而白粼粼没有捍卫成功，被宋郁一下子捞起来了，放到了人的肩头。

“我回头给你买新的。”少年不由自主地就说出来了，低头看着鸟，自己都愣了下。

白粼粼刚刚专心套金坠子，没太认真听人讲话，不知道齐思扬获得了“允许”。

思考了下。

点了点头。

齐思扬不知道为什么，他总觉得自己不应该在这里。

但鸟似乎反应过来了，歪头看了过来，扑棱翅膀飞到茶几上，叼着那袋子东西过来了，一个用力甩。

人，送你。

-

齐思扬实在很难形容自己现在的感受，他的肩头也多了只东西，没太敢动。

白粼粼歪头看了看这个人，多大了，还要吃糖？

但他很有品味，这是鸟最喜欢的一个口味，宋郁原来买过的，限量而且贵贵。

吃吧吃吧！

但这个“人”不吃。

鸟观察了下，攀爬到对方的手臂上，认真地给包装袋咬出来个口子，又歪头去看齐思扬。

这怎么还不吃？

但是他还没观察多久，整只就被捞走了，宋郁微微蹙了下眉，不过也就那么一秒。

“它平常很乖的，不随便上别人身上。”

“不好意思。”

鸟再度回到了原来的领地，调整了下位置，开始专心致志地梳理羽毛。

还打个哈欠。

齐思扬听到宋郁的解释后连忙点了点头，不过还是很难不被那只小鸟吸引。

金坠子……它自己戴的？

宋郁：“老师还有让你转告些什么吗？”

齐思扬回了回神，把视线收回来了，“啊？”

“没有了。”

齐思扬像是反应过来什么，确实时间不早了，下午还有个学术会议。

他低头看了这袋子糖，说实话一开始只是想拿一块，没想着带一整袋的。

但是现在……

鸟都拆开了。

齐思扬想了下，举着那袋子糖同宋郁晃了晃，笑着道：

“那多谢了。”

“……”

终于走了。

-

白粼粼心里还是美美的，在那人走了之后，就从宋郁肩头飞下来了，开始站在茶几上“走秀”。

小金锁是实心的。

沉甸甸的。

鸟死活不愿意放下。

宋郁弯腰试图给摘下来，但每次都被叨了指腹，钝钝的夹感，不痛的那种。

他垂眸看着，手指还是没有收回来。

白粼粼走两步，被挡一步，最后气得叨住不放开了。

然后就被提起来了。

鸟爪晃晃悠悠的。

最后安稳地落在了“人”的掌心，宋郁面色平和，手指这才被放开，已经叨出来个红印。

很有劲。

也就在这时——

“喜欢金子？”

“我给你买。”

作者有话说：

ps：那金锁是比较迷你的，陈老银行老客户，送的。
chunks.englishText:
After Qi Siyang entered the living room and saw the pile of boxes, he was stunned, but it seemed these weren't all parrot supplies, so he breathed a sigh of relief.

Everything should be done in moderation.

Too much pampering isn't good either.

However, when he remembered what he had come to deliver, he fell silent.

Inside the box was a small gold lock, strung on a black cord, looking quite exquisite.

Qi Siyang actually found it hard to control himself. "I don't know what my teacher is thinking. This... isn't this heavy?"

"I told him, but the old man wouldn't listen."

As the two chatted idly, the bird had already flown down from Song Yu's shoulder and walked pitter-patter over to the box.

Observing.

"Oh, right, the teacher also asked me to bring you a book. It's about parrot mimicry. He heard your little bird doesn't like to talk much, so he specifically looked for it."

Qi Siyang handed it over, arms crossed as he looked at the boxes on the coffee table, on top of which sat a bag of gummy candies.

The young man was indeed a bit surprised, but later thought it was normal; Song Yu was just a high school student.

"Give me a bag?" Qi Siyang turned to Song Yu, joking.

"Of course."

Song Yu was looking down at the book, not even lifting his head.

But just then—

As Qi Siyang bent over, he made a sound of confusion.

"Hmm?"

Song Yu followed his gaze. The bird was standing nearby, its claws pressing on the candy packaging, looking up at the person.

Its feathers were fluffy, its posture upright.

A gold pendant was around its neck.

"..."

However, Bai Linlin didn't succeed in defending it; Song Yu scooped him up in one motion and placed him on his shoulder.

"I'll buy you new ones later." The youth said it involuntarily, looking down at the bird, and was stunned by his own words.

Bai Linlin had been focused on the gold pendant just now and hadn't listened carefully to the conversation, not knowing that Qi Siyang had received "permission."

He thought about it.

He nodded.

Qi Siyang didn't know why, but he always felt he shouldn't be here.

But the bird seemed to react. It tilted its head, flapped its wings, flew onto the coffee table, grabbed the bag of snacks in its beak, and gave it a forceful toss.

Human, here you go.

-

Qi Siyang found it hard to describe how he felt right now. There was also something on his shoulder, and he didn't dare to move much.

Bai Linlin tilted his head to look at this person. How old are you, and you still want to eat candy?

But he had good taste; this was the bird's favorite flavor. Song Yu had bought it before; it was limited edition and expensive.

Eat it, eat it!

But this "human" wouldn't eat it.

The bird observed for a moment, climbed onto the other person's arm, and seriously bit a hole in the packaging, then tilted its head to look at Qi Siyang.

Why aren't you eating it yet?

But before he could observe for long, he was scooped away. Song Yu frowned slightly, but only for a second.

"He's usually very well-behaved and doesn't just climb onto other people."

"Sorry."

The bird returned to its original territory, adjusted its position, and began to groom its feathers with focus.

It even let out a yawn.

After hearing Song Yu's explanation, Qi Siyang nodded quickly, but it was still hard not to be attracted by that little bird.

A gold pendant... did it put it on itself?

Song Yu: "Did the teacher ask you to pass on anything else?"

Qi Siyang came back to his senses and withdrew his gaze. "Huh?"

"No."

Qi Siyang seemed to realize something; it was indeed getting late, and there was an academic conference in the afternoon.

He looked down at the bag of candy. To be honest, he had only wanted to take one piece at first, not the whole bag.

But now...

The bird had already opened it.

Qi Siyang thought for a moment, held up the bag of candy, shook it at Song Yu, and smiled:

"Then, thank you."

"..."

Finally, he left.

-

Bai Linlin still felt wonderful. After that person left, he flew down from Song Yu's shoulder and began to "walk the runway" on the coffee table.

The little gold lock was solid.

Heavy.

The bird refused to let it go no matter what.

Song Yu bent down, trying to take it off, but every time he was pecked on the fingertip—a dull pinching sensation, not painful.

He looked down, his finger not pulling back.

Bai Linlin took two steps, was blocked by one, and finally got so angry he bit down and wouldn't let go.

Then he was lifted up.

The bird's claws dangled.

Finally, he landed steadily in the "human's" palm. Song Yu's expression was calm, and only then was his finger released, already showing a red mark.

He was quite strong.

Just then—

"Like gold?"

"I'll buy it for you."

Author's Note:

PS: The gold lock is quite mini; it was a gift from the bank for being a long-time client, Old Chen.

chunks.chineseText:
第14章

白粼粼鸟眼蹬得浑圆，身子都往上一拱，站得笔直笔直的。

“啾啾？”

[真的？]

宋郁不知道为什么，大抵猜出来它在说什么，于是就道：

“真的。”

白粼粼立马扑棱翅膀飞起来了，开始叨着宋郁的衣服往楼上扯，少年起初不解，最后跟着上楼了才明白了。

它要打字。

开了电脑。

宋郁面色恍惚，只是垂眸看着在键盘上忙忙碌碌的鸟。

那毛绒绒的一团先是啪嗒啪嗒走过去，然后用喙戳开了屏幕显示键，动作相当之熟练。

“……”

白粼粼压根就没有什么别的想法，他只是觉得这个机会千载难逢，金子固然好，但是鸟不能单独出去倒卖。

不如买点其他的。

鸟打算新建个记事本，给列个清单目录。

美滋滋。

但鼠标放得太远了，白粼粼像往常一样伸自己的鸟腿，压根没碰到。

“啾啾？”

宋郁面无表情地给挪了过去，鸟成功扣住，操作了一下。

卧室里光线明亮，窗外还有绿茵茵的树，倒是显得风景宜人。

宋郁后面就拉开椅子坐下了，眼皮微微垂着，只是看着在键盘上动来动去的小鸟。

它现在长大了点，体型约等于大半个保温杯。

尾羽长长的，很漂亮。

宋郁其实什么也没有想，他只是就这么看着。

直到肩头一沉。

鸟完成了，他侧眸看了过去，一个圆滚滚的鸟头凑了过来，几乎要碰到他的睫毛。

宋郁：“写好了？”

“啾啾！”

鸟的回应铿锵有力。

宋郁闻声抬眼看了下屏幕，沉默了一会。

“你是说。”

“你要一台iphone17？”

-

白粼粼压根没有想过宋郁会这么容易地接受一切，也就看了那么一次医生，后面就完全不管了。

也没有把鸟捉去研究。

！

好人！

白粼粼这段时间过得很是不错，因为宋郁真的说到做到，不仅购置了清单上的所有东西，还再次请人装潢了下二楼的那个房间。

原来里面有些鸟类的攀爬支架，还有树窝，还有几个小秋千。

宋郁让人往里放了几个柜子，设计是比较现代风的那种，有灯带，然后还有透明亚克力板制的匣子。

鸟当时有些不解。

直到宋郁把那个金坠子放了进去，侧头看了下鸟。

似乎是在教。

鸟举一反三，从和宋郁睡觉的那个卧室叼来了小围兜、几包辣条、脚环……总之是些鸡零狗碎的玩意儿。

一个一个放进去了。

白粼粼觉得简直完美！

宋郁那天甚至还抽空帮鸟设置了下手机的功能，给鸟插了电话卡，垂眸改了下手机名称：

——粼粼的iphone。

鸟特别高兴，站在人的肩头啾啾，以表愉悦。

宋郁只是头也不抬道：

“粼粼。”

像是在自言自语。

鸟不解，“啾啾？”

宋郁只是侧头看了下，没让鸟的话落地上，很温和道：

“嗯。”

手机甚至还可以支付，宋郁直接转了五万过去，不过关于密码这个，人觉得麻烦，就用的自己的，把购物软件开成为了免密。

白粼粼感觉自己像是到了天堂，一连好几天都兴奋地睡不着，直到一天午夜——

鸟在纸巾盒里打滚，反正也睡不着，就开始叨叨叨自己的“床”，咬成均匀的条条。

手机设置了“早睡锁机”。

鸟不能熬夜。

不过就在白粼粼快把自己的床给拆没了的时候，听到了被子掀开的动静。

宋郁起来了？

脚步声似乎靠近了点。

鸟装死。

短喙里还有着没咬断的纸条。

白粼粼本来还想着“人”起来干什么的，下一秒他就被“拿”起来了，那根没咬断的纸条被很轻地拨开了。

！

鸟丝毫不敢动，躺板板。

但宋郁只是给他换了个新的纸巾盒，白粼粼这才后知后觉，原来他的“床”不是耐造，而是换得勤……

鸟回到了新的床后就偷偷地滚了下身子，而后试图瞅瞅人在干什么。

宋郁没有接着睡觉，只是在椅子上坐着，也不像是梦游，就是醒了。

少年似乎察觉到一点视线感，又往纸巾盒这里撇了一眼。

鸟立马闭上。

白粼粼其实不太知道宋郁为什么会割腕……至少他现在看不出来什么具体的事。

江芮，他妈妈。

上次不小心看到消息了。

宋启明，这个是那次偶遇江芮听到的，再往前推就是通电话那次……宋郁提到了自己爷爷。

没见过。

白粼粼不由自主地开始梳理信息，不过它也偷偷打了个哈欠，总觉得最近身体怪怪的。

怎么一点也不困？

都持续好几天了。

不过就在这时，桌子的抽屉发出点动静，人似乎拿出来个东西。

白粼粼起初还不知道是什么，但后面闻到一股血腥味。

-

宋郁其实不清楚为什么鸟最近这么粘人，他已经走到门口了，但它还是没从身上下来。

“今天周五，我会早点回来。”

宋郁侧眸同鸟解释道，还伸了下手指。

肩头的某只小鸟像是又不聪明了一样，只是歪了歪头，一个劲地看“人”。

“啾啾。”

人，鸟很担心你。

白粼粼其实也没什么办法，他不知道为什么宋郁要自残，并且白天看起来非常正常。

抑郁症……

“我尽快好么，但是我需要去上学。”

“再上一个月。”

宋郁想了想，又解释道，但始终保持着伸手的姿势。

最终小鸟才伸爪站了过来，被安稳地放到了地板上。

只是还在仰头看“人”。

宋郁最后还是关门了，鸟往前啪嗒啪嗒走了几步，偌大的别墅此刻显得空荡荡的。

白粼粼照理来说没有什么烦心事的，有好吃的，有好玩的，宋郁周末还会带鸟去散步。

“……”

就是这样，鸟才觉得郁闷。

为什么不开心？

不过很快他就知道原因了。

因为当天上午别墅就来了不速之客。

门口一开始是有乱按的指纹声，还有些很明显的男童吵闹的动静。

“开门开门！”

“宋郁！”

“他不在家吗？”

“他有病嘻嘻，妈妈，他为什么不去精神病院啊？”

鸟冒火了。

但此刻门开了，有个穿着干练西服的女性牵着男童的手，边打电话边进门。

“嗯进来了进来，启明，你放心，小郁就是闹脾气。”

“他不是故意把我们的指纹删掉的，这毕竟是……老宅么，我理解，反正当年爸爸也不同意我们……你看我说这些干什么？”

女人语调拿捏的很好，眉毛低垂着，在玄关那里站着，就等着电话那头的回应。

白粼粼站在隐蔽的吊灯里侧，伸着鸟头视察。

“嗯，我知道的，你这么些年辛苦了。”

“爸爸那边怎么样？醒来的概率大不大？我上周还去祈福了呢。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 14

Bai Linlin’s bird eyes widened into perfect circles. It arched its back and stood as straight as a ramrod.

“Chirp chirp?”

[For real?]

Song Yu didn’t know why, but he could more or less guess what it was saying, so he replied:

“For real.”

Bai Linlin immediately flapped its wings and took flight, tugging at Song Yu’s clothes to pull him upstairs. The young man was confused at first, but once he followed it up, he understood.

It wanted to type.

He turned on the computer.

Song Yu looked dazed, his eyes cast downward, watching the bird bustling about on the keyboard.

The fluffy little ball first walked over with a *pitter-patter*, then used its beak to poke the screen display button with practiced ease.

“……”

Bai Linlin didn’t have any other thoughts; it simply felt this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Gold was certainly nice, but a bird couldn’t go out and flip it for profit on its own.

Better to buy something else.

The bird planned to create a new notepad file and list out a catalog of items.

Delightful.

But the mouse was placed too far away. Bai Linlin stretched out its bird leg as usual, but couldn’t reach it at all.

“Chirp chirp?”

Song Yu expressionlessly moved it over. The bird successfully hooked it and performed an operation.

The bedroom was bright, and the lush green trees outside the window made for a pleasant view.

Song Yu pulled up a chair and sat down behind it, his eyelids drooping slightly, just watching the little bird moving back and forth on the keyboard.

It had grown a bit larger now, about the size of three-quarters of a thermos cup.

Its tail feathers were long and beautiful.

Song Yu wasn’t really thinking about anything; he was just watching.

Until his shoulder sank.

The bird had finished. He turned his head to look, and a round bird head leaned in, almost brushing against his eyelashes.

Song Yu: “Finished writing?”

“Chirp chirp!”

The bird’s response was sonorous and powerful.

Hearing this, Song Yu raised his eyes to look at the screen and fell silent for a moment.

“You mean…”

“You want an iPhone 17?”

-

Bai Linlin had never expected Song Yu to accept everything so easily. He had only taken it to the doctor once and then completely stopped worrying about it.

He hadn’t even tried to capture the bird for research.

!

A good person!

Bai Linlin had been living quite well during this time because Song Yu really kept his word. Not only did he purchase everything on the list, but he also hired someone to redecorate that room on the second floor.

Originally, it had some climbing perches for birds, a tree nest, and a few small swings.

Song Yu had them put in several cabinets with a more modern design, complete with LED strips and boxes made of transparent acrylic.

The bird was a bit confused at the time.

Until Song Yu placed that gold pendant inside and tilted his head to look at the bird.

It seemed he was teaching it.

The bird learned by analogy, bringing over its little bib, a few packs of spicy gluten snacks, and its leg ring from the bedroom where it slept with Song Yu... in short, all sorts of odds and ends.

It placed them inside one by one.

Bai Linlin thought it was absolutely perfect!

That day, Song Yu even took the time to set up the phone’s functions for the bird, inserted a SIM card, and lowered his gaze to rename the phone:

——Linlin’s iPhone.

The bird was overjoyed, chirping on the man’s shoulder to express its delight.

Song Yu just said without looking up:

“Linlin.”

It was as if he were talking to himself.

The bird was puzzled, “Chirp chirp?”

Song Yu just turned his head to look, not letting the bird’s words fall to the ground, and said very gently:

“Yeah.”

The phone could even be used for payments. Song Yu transferred 50,000 yuan directly, though he found the password part troublesome, so he used his own and set the shopping apps to免密 (password-free) payment.

Bai Linlin felt like it had arrived in heaven. It was so excited that it couldn’t sleep for several days, until one midnight—

The bird was rolling around in a tissue box. Since it couldn’t sleep anyway, it started pecking at its “bed,” tearing it into even strips.

The phone was set with a “bedtime lock.”

The bird couldn’t stay up late.

However, just as Bai Linlin was about to finish dismantling its bed, it heard the sound of a quilt being lifted.

Song Yu was up?

The footsteps seemed to approach.

The bird played dead.

There was still an unbitten strip of paper in its short beak.

Bai Linlin had originally been wondering why the “human” was up, but the next second it was “picked up,” and the unbitten strip of paper was gently brushed away.

!

The bird didn’t dare to move at all, lying flat as a board.

But Song Yu just changed it into a new tissue box. Only then did Bai Linlin realize belatedly that its “bed” wasn’t durable; it was just changed frequently…

After returning to its new bed, the bird secretly rolled over and tried to peek at what the human was doing.

Song Yu didn’t go back to sleep; he just sat in the chair. It didn’t look like sleepwalking; he was just awake.

The young man seemed to sense a gaze and glanced toward the tissue box again.

The bird immediately closed its eyes.

Bai Linlin didn’t really know why Song Yu had slit his wrists… at least it couldn’t see any specific reason right now.

Jiang Rui, his mother.

It had accidentally seen the message last time.

Song Qiming, it had heard that name during that chance encounter with Jiang Rui, and tracing it back further, it was from that phone call… Song Yu had mentioned his grandfather.

It had never seen him.

Bai Linlin couldn’t help but start organizing the information, though it also secretly stifled a yawn, feeling that its body had been acting strange lately.

Why wasn’t it tired at all?

It had been like this for several days.

However, just then, the desk drawer made a sound, and the man seemed to take something out.

Bai Linlin didn’t know what it was at first, but then it smelled a scent of blood.

-

Song Yu didn’t actually understand why the bird had been so clingy lately. He had already walked to the door, but it still hadn’t come down from his body.

“It’s Friday today, I’ll be back early.”

Song Yu tilted his head to explain to the bird and even extended a finger.

The little bird on his shoulder seemed to have lost its intelligence again, just tilting its head and staring intently at the “human.”

“Chirp chirp.”

Human, the bird is very worried about you.

Bai Linlin actually had no way to help; it didn’t know why Song Yu would self-harm when he looked perfectly normal during the day.

Depression…

“I’ll be as quick as I can, okay? But I need to go to school.”

“Just one more month.”

Song Yu thought for a moment and explained again, but he kept his hand extended the whole time.

Finally, the little bird extended its claws and stood on his hand, being safely placed on the floor.

It just kept looking up at the “human.”

Song Yu eventually closed the door. The bird took a few *pitter-patter* steps forward, and the large villa suddenly felt empty.

Bai Linlin shouldn’t have had any worries; it had good food, fun toys, and Song Yu would take it for walks on the weekends.

“……”

That was exactly why the bird felt depressed.

Why wasn’t he happy?

But it soon found out the reason.

Because that very morning, an uninvited guest arrived at the villa.

At the door, there was the sound of frantic fingerprint scanning, along with the noisy clamor of a young boy.

“Open the door, open the door!”

“Song Yu!”

“Is he not home?”

“He’s sick, hehe. Mom, why doesn’t he go to the mental hospital?”

The bird was incensed.

But just then, the door opened. A woman in a sharp business suit was holding the boy’s hand, entering the house while on the phone.

“Yes, we’re in, we’re in. Qiming, don’t worry, Xiao Yu is just throwing a tantrum.”

“He didn’t delete our fingerprints on purpose. After all, this is… the old family home, I understand. Besides, Dad didn’t agree with us back then… look at me, why am I saying all this?”

The woman’s tone was perfectly measured. Her eyebrows were lowered as she stood in the foyer, waiting for the response on the other end of the line.

Bai Linlin stood on the inner side of the hidden chandelier, craning its bird head to observe.

“Yes, I know, you’ve worked hard all these years.”

“How is things on Dad’s side? Is the probability of him waking up high? I even went to pray for him last week.”

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼仔细看了看这女人的表情，觉得很奇怪，说的话是“希望”，但眉毛却控制不住地往下走，神态分明是厌恶。

“宋阳！哎，不要乱跑，那是你哥哥的房间！”

“弄乱了哥哥要生气的。”

白粼粼：“……”

那孩子压根就没上楼，装什么？

好了，知道你是后妈了。

-

宋启明此刻就在S州那里，他刚和医生交谈完，心情还算好，他父亲的生命体征指标最近都很好，也就和自己妻子打了电话，不过听到对面的声音后就蹙了蹙眉，替人打抱不平：

“什么叫乱跑，自己家里想去哪里就去哪里！”

“宋郁今年高考完我就送他去英国读书，锦园这里到时候就让阳阳住，正好上他哥哥的高中。”

李长韵很温婉地笑了下，不过还是问了下电话那头，“是英国什么学校啊？小郁的成绩会不会跟不上？”

语气里是满满的担忧。

宋启明闻言其实愣了下，怎么会这么问？

“那怎么会跟不上？宋郁成绩一直都是校前几，托福雅思我早让他考过了，学校那边老师我都联系着呢，没什么问题。”

“我考虑过了，就让他去牛津或者剑桥，学点东西回来正好管管公司。”

李长韵有点维持不住笑容了，但电话那头还在说话，还扯到了她儿子：

“不过宋阳的成绩也要抓一抓，年纪小归小，也不能太落后了，宋郁小时候就……”

“那小郁的病不用看吗？前段时间庄大夫可是和我说了，连着一个月都没来了，估计断药很久了。”李长韵很温温柔柔地打断道，把话头给引了过去。

她还顺带环顾了四周。

锦园这地段，寸土寸金的，住的可都是南市有头有脸的人物，要是以后真住进来，小阳日后的路会好走很多。

随便一个邻居家的女孩都不错。

李长韵已经为自己七岁的儿子谋划起了婚事。

但白粼粼此刻在战术后仰，鸟爪都在用力，这人怎么突然看天花板啊？

不过好在这回那男童又跑回来，一下子扑到他妈身上，抢走了手机。

“爸爸！”

李长韵也就没再仰头看了，只是佯装生气道：“阳阳——”

手机免提开了。

“怎么啦？想爸爸没有？”

“想！”

白粼粼觉得真是晦气，但是也多亏了那孩子开了免提，才让他听到了后面的话。

“不用管宋郁，他这段时间真是无法无天了，养了个鸟，大白天和鸟自言自语的，真是离疯不远了。”

鸟躯一震。

白粼粼惶恐，这个家里没有其他人，对方怎么知道宋郁和他说话的？

有监控？

白粼粼很快冷静下来，不对，没有说他打游戏，那就说明卧室里的事对方不知道。

客厅安了？

“那要不要送医院啊？抑郁症也不是小事，学业总比不上孩子身体健康重要？”

李长韵此刻蹲下身子，拿着手机同电话那头说道，面色故作担忧。

但那头还是犹豫了：

“不用，犯不着去医院，前些年不还有幻觉什么的，估计这段时间又严重了，他吃点药就好了，不用担心他。”

李长韵闭了闭眼，她就知道是这样，把电话挂了后，面色很是难看。

说得冠冕堂皇，不过是怕抑郁症的档案被留存，从头到尾都是单独请的医生。

宋郁今年都十八了，可宋阳才七岁。

这怎么争？

抑郁症……抑郁症。

怎么不去——

李长韵意识到自己有些偏激了，深吸了一口气，起身站了起来。

宋阳在旁边扯她的衣服，李长韵只好安抚了下：

“好了好了，今天有正事的，我们要……”

“要量窗帘的尺寸！到时候装修新房子！”

男童抢答道。

但李长韵却摇了摇头，摸了摸儿子的脑袋，慢悠悠地道：

“你知道哥哥有个可爱的小鸟吗？”

白粼粼：“……”

作甚？

“要不要找它玩一玩呀？”

宋阳眼睛亮了亮，很是大声地道：

“要！”

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：是时候让黑恶势力见识下老虎钳的威力了！

Chapter 14 (Part 2)

Bai Linlin carefully observed the woman’s expression and found it very strange. The words she spoke were of “hope,” but her eyebrows couldn’t help but droop, and her demeanor was clearly one of disgust.

“Song Yang! Hey, don’t run around, that’s your brother’s room!”

“Your brother will be angry if you mess it up.”

Bai Linlin: “……”

The kid hadn’t even gone upstairs, what was she pretending for?

Alright, I know you’re the stepmother now.

-

Song Qiming was currently in S-Province. He had just finished talking to the doctor and was in a fairly good mood; his father’s vital signs had been very good lately. He had been on the phone with his wife, but upon hearing the voice on the other end, he frowned and spoke up for the person being wronged:

“What do you mean by running around? It’s his own home, he can go wherever he wants!”

“After Song Yu finishes the college entrance exam this year, I’ll send him to study in the UK. Let Yangyang live here in Jinyuan then; it’s just right for him to attend his brother’s high school.”

Li Changyun smiled very gently, but she still asked the other end of the line, “Which school in the UK? Will Xiao Yu’s grades be able to keep up?”

Her tone was filled with concern.

Song Qiming was actually stunned upon hearing this. Why would she ask that?

“How could he not keep up? Song Yu’s grades have always been among the top in the school. I had him take the TOEFL and IELTS long ago, and I’ve already been in contact with the teachers at the school. There’s no problem at all.”

“I’ve considered it; I’ll let him go to Oxford or Cambridge. Learning something will be just right for him to manage the company later.”

Li Changyun couldn’t quite maintain her smile, but the voice on the other end was still talking, even bringing up her son:

“But Song Yang’s grades need to be pushed too. Young as he is, he can’t fall too far behind. When Song Yu was little, he…”

“Then doesn’t Xiao Yu’s illness need to be looked at? Dr. Zhuang told me a while ago that he hasn’t been there for a whole month. I suspect he’s been off his medication for a long time.” Li Changyun interrupted very gently, steering the conversation away.

She even took the opportunity to look around.

The Jinyuan area was worth its weight in gold, and all the people living here were prominent figures in Nanshi. If they really moved in later, Xiao Yang’s future path would be much smoother.

Any girl from a neighbor’s family would be a good match.

Li Changyun was already planning a marriage for her seven-year-old son.

But Bai Linlin was currently leaning back tactically, its bird claws gripping hard. Why was this person suddenly looking at the ceiling?

Fortunately, the boy ran back again, threw himself onto his mother, and snatched the phone away.

“Dad!”

Li Changyun didn’t look up anymore, just feigning anger: “Yangyang—”

The phone was on speaker.

“What’s wrong? Did you miss Dad?”

“Yes!”

Bai Linlin thought it was truly bad luck, but thanks to the child turning on the speakerphone, it was able to hear what followed.

“Don’t worry about Song Yu. He’s been lawless lately, raising a bird and talking to it in broad daylight. He’s really not far from going crazy.”

The bird’s body shuddered.

Bai Linlin was terrified. There was no one else in the house, so how did the other party know Song Yu talked to it?

Were there cameras?

Bai Linlin quickly calmed down. No, they didn’t mention it playing games, which meant they didn’t know about what happened in the bedroom.

Was the living room bugged?

“Then should we send him to the hospital? Depression is no small matter. Schoolwork is never more important than a child’s health, right?”

Li Changyun squatted down, holding the phone and speaking to the other end, her face feigning concern.

But the other end still hesitated:

“No, it’s not worth going to the hospital. He had hallucinations and such a few years ago; I suspect it’s flared up again during this time. He’ll be fine after taking some medicine; don’t worry about him.”

Li Changyun closed her eyes. She knew it would be like this. After hanging up the phone, her expression was very ugly.

They spoke with such high-sounding rhetoric, but it was just fear that a record of depression would be left behind. From beginning to end, they had only hired private doctors.

Song Yu was eighteen this year, but Song Yang was only seven.

How could he compete?

Depression… depression.

Why doesn’t he just—

Li Changyun realized she was being a bit extreme. She took a deep breath and stood up.

Song Yang was tugging at her clothes, so Li Changyun had to soothe him:

“Alright, alright, we have business today, we need to…”

“Measure the curtains! For decorating the new house!”

The boy answered preemptively.

But Li Changyun shook her head, stroked her son’s head, and said slowly:

“Do you know your brother has a cute little bird?”

Bai Linlin: “……”

What are you doing?

“Do you want to go find it and play?”

Song Yang’s eyes lit up, and he said very loudly:

“Yes!”

第15章

白粼粼站在玄关那里的吊灯那里，没空搭理那一对母子，只是梳理了下目前得到的信息。

江芮，也就是宋郁妈妈，已经组建新的家庭，孩子都有两个了。

至于只在电话中出现的宋启明，应该就是宋郁的父亲，看样子也是一样，早就再婚生子了。

鸟爪子搭在灯管上，白粼粼神情严肃，心想怪不得他见不到除了阿姨之外的“成年人”。

原来都美美投入小家了。

艹！

白粼粼磨了磨喙，身上的羽毛都炸了炸，心想这都是什么不负责任的家长！

鸟歪头往客厅那里看。

女人牵着那男童，两人有说有笑的，一来一回地说话：

“哥哥房间里的东西不要弄乱噢，我们就去看看小鸟。”

“好啊好啊，它会飞是不是！”

“是呀，不太好抓呢。”

……

还真想去宋郁的卧室？

白粼粼身躯下压，整个鸟都威风凛凛，开始蓄力。

李长韵同自己儿子说完话后，温和的面色就消散了差不多，边上楼梯边盘算着事情。

华秉不能动的股份说到底就是老爷子手底下的人在干涉。

这次要是醒了……也好。

她早就看不惯那个遗产分配书了。

这次正好。

但就在这时，手边的儿子突然哭叫出了声。

“啊！妈妈！”

-

与此同时，南市一高正在举行三模考试，但宋郁却不在座位上，他被老师叫走了。

“宋郁，你最近状态很不好。”

办公室的老师坐在椅子上，抬头看了过来，眉毛微微蹙着，又认真补了句：

“老师支持你的意愿，高考你当然可以参加，你父亲毕竟还在国外，他管不到这里来的。”

宋郁面色平静，只是想起来自己的鸟，它自己在家会不会无聊。

“我没事，老师。”

班主任听到这话就直皱眉，不由自主视线下移，少年的手腕内侧有新的划痕，深浅交错，一看就是控制好力道的，她叹了口气，斟酌道：

“这样，你下午回家休息，现在的话……”

“去心理咨询室一次？你余老师也有些挂念你。”

宋郁蹙了下眉，刚想说什么，但班主任上了最后一层筹码：

“那总比你那个后妈给你找的医生好吧？”

“他还打小报告。”

“你放心，余老师不可能乱说的，他要是这么做，我早和他离婚了。”

宋郁仍然觉得自己没有什么需要咨询的，他刚想要婉拒，但下一秒——

“你难道没有什么困惑的事吗？”

-

有。

他分不清现实和幻觉，需要疼痛来刺激一下。

自秋水巷那次际遇后，他一成不变的生活有了起伏，带回来的小鸟非常聪慧。

它会点头，会开门，还会站在他肩头看自己打游戏。

但是……

“养了小鸟啊，那很好啊，怎么还状态不好了？”

这道声音很是温文尔雅。

宋郁已经来到了心理咨询室，流程是差不多的，就是闲聊，他说了自己这段时间发生的事。

余老师问完也不着急等回答，只是在整理书架，翻出来个铁盒子才走了过来，大手一挥道：

“豆豆的，都给她吃完！”

“……”

铁盒上印着大白兔，很明显是一罐奶糖，是一名叫豆豆的小朋友的。

宋郁其实不知道他的两个老师为什么性格差异这么大……却还是一对。

很奇怪。

但就在这时——

“小鸟取名字了吗？”

余老师拍了拍手，坐在了桌子对面，他相貌端正，很温和地问道。

“它有名字，粼粼。”

余老师闻言点了下头，然后自顾自地讲：

“噢，那不是你取的。”

宋郁微微怔了下，有些意外。

此刻对面的老师也在推断，心想这难道是被遗弃的小鸟，前主人过来要了？

孩子由此情绪消沉？

有太多这样的病例了，大多都是捡到流浪猫猫狗狗的，原本以为被治愈了，结果这些小动物一旦碰见原主人，立马就会扯断绳子，飞奔过去。

舍弃掉新主人。

即使旧主人遗弃了它们。

但这几乎是个死胡同，没有办法找到最优解。

余老师想了想，抬眸看向宋郁，耐心道：

“不要过于焦虑。”

“小鸟也是需要时间相处的，你和它朝夕相处，它肯定也会——”

“不是。”

宋郁眼眸垂着，修长的手指微微蜷了下，重复道：

“不是老师。”

或许是长久的无人倾诉，抑或是说了别人也不信。

宋郁那些茫然的思绪再度涌了上来，他不自觉地说了真实的情况：

“它打字告诉我名字的。”

空气一阵沉默。

余老师愣了下，身子往椅子背靠了靠，中午太阳从窗户往里照，本来暖暖的。

但他心里拔凉。

这有点棘手。

-

“我知道这很荒谬，或许是我自己看错了。”

余老师听到宋郁再度恢复成冷静的口吻就反应过来，这已经在自我保护了，他连忙肯定道：

“老师相信你。”

“那你确实看到了对吗？”

“所以手上的伤口……是想用疼痛来帮助自己确认对吗？”

宋郁神色平静，垂着眼眸，语气很轻道，“是。”

他的确尝试了。

“那分清了吗？”

宋郁听到这句话后，先是一愣，而后就是混乱，因为他……分不清。

有些时候他很容易沉浸进去，觉得一切都很正常，或许就是小鸟聪慧一些。

但有的时候，他抽离出来的时候，又觉得自己可能出现了幻觉。

鸟怎么会打游戏，怎么会买手机……

是真实的么？

还是自己想象出来的。

宋郁整个人被分成两半，一半维持岌岌可危的理智，一半开始自动合理化。

甚至分明觉得不对，但他还是买了各种各样的电子设备，还办了电话卡。

宋郁从未经历过来自外界长久的陪伴，他总是一个人，因而很容易就沉溺进去了。

鸟又没有错。

是他生病了。

金子只是个装饰品，手机也只是它想玩，airpods定制款也不贵，它只是个小鸟，为什么不能满足？

宋郁反反复复地想。

最后只是绕到原点。

是自己的问题。

和鸟无关。

“宋郁？宋郁？”

少年回了下神，最后整理了情绪，只是抬眸看向老师，平静道：

“老师，我没事的。”

“可能就是我这段时间——”

余老师连忙伸手，“打住。”

他没想到这件事的起因是一只小鸟，而且还是没有什么负面信息的好幻觉。

宋郁一直自己住。

也不知道这持续多久了……

余老师想了想，盲目否认也不合适，倒不如多问问情况。

“你的小鸟性格如何？”

宋郁愣了下，但还是很如实说道：

“很乖。”

“它很乖。”

……

此刻在锦园的鸟正在征战沙场，专门叨那男童的脸，破皮流血那都是轻得了。

诅咒哥哥去精神病院是吧？

先送你去！

鸟又一个俯冲。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 15

Bai Linlin stood on the chandelier in the foyer, having no time to deal with that pair of mother and son, and instead sorted through the information it had gathered so far.

Jiang Rui, Song Yu’s mother, had already started a new family and had two children.

As for Song Qiming, who only appeared on the phone, he must be Song Yu’s father. It looked like he was the same, having long since remarried and had children.

With its bird claws hooked onto the light fixture, Bai Linlin wore a serious expression, thinking it was no wonder he never saw any “adults” other than the auntie.

So they had all gone off to enjoy their own little families.

Damn it!

Bai Linlin ground its beak, its feathers bristling. It thought, what kind of irresponsible parents were these!

The bird tilted its head to look toward the living room.

The woman was holding the boy’s hand, and the two were laughing and talking as they walked:

“Don’t mess up the things in your brother’s room, okay? We’re just going to go see the little bird.”

“Okay, okay! It can fly, right!”

“Yes, it’s not very easy to catch.”

…

They really wanted to go to Song Yu’s bedroom?

Bai Linlin lowered its body, the entire bird looking majestic as it began to gather strength.

After Li Changyun finished talking to her son, her gentle expression faded away. As she walked up the stairs, she calculated her plans.

The shares that Hua Bing couldn’t touch were, in the final analysis, being interfered with by the old man’s people.

If he woke up this time… that would be fine too.

She had long been displeased with that inheritance distribution document.

This time was perfect.

But just then, the son at her side suddenly cried out.

“Ah! Mom!”

-

At the same time, Nanshi No. 1 High School was holding its third mock exam, but Song Yu was not in his seat; he had been called away by a teacher.

“Song Yu, your state of mind has been very poor lately.”

The teacher sat in her chair, looked up, frowned slightly, and added earnestly:

“The school supports your wishes. You can certainly take the college entrance exam. After all, your father is still abroad; he can’t control things here.”

Song Yu’s expression was calm; he was just thinking about his bird and whether it would be bored at home alone.

“I’m fine, teacher.”

The head teacher frowned deeply upon hearing this, her gaze involuntarily dropping. There were new scratches on the inside of the young man’s wrists, overlapping in depth; one could tell he had controlled the force. She sighed and said cautiously:

“How about this? Go home and rest this afternoon. As for now…”

“Why don’t you go to the psychological counseling room? Teacher Yu is also a bit concerned about you.”

Song Yu frowned, just about to say something, but the head teacher played her final card:

“That’s still better than the doctor your stepmother found for you, right?”

“He’s a snitch.”

“Don’t worry, Teacher Yu wouldn’t talk nonsense. If he did that, I would have divorced him long ago.”

Song Yu still felt he had nothing to consult about. He was just about to politely decline, but the next second—

“Don’t you have anything that confuses you?”

-

He did.

He couldn’t distinguish between reality and hallucinations and needed pain to stimulate himself.

Since that encounter in Qiu Shui Lane, his unchanging life had had its ups and downs. The little bird he brought back was very intelligent.

It could nod, open doors, and stand on his shoulder to watch him play games.

But…

“You raised a little bird? That’s great, why is your state of mind still poor?”

This voice was very gentle and elegant.

Song Yu had already arrived at the psychological counseling room. The process was much the same—just casual chatting. He told him about what had happened during this time.

After asking, Teacher Yu wasn’t in a hurry to wait for an answer. He was just tidying up the bookshelf, and after digging out an iron box, he walked over and waved his hand:

“It’s Dou Dou’s, let her eat them all!”

“……”

The iron box had a White Rabbit candy logo on it; it was clearly a tin of milk candies belonging to a child named Dou Dou.

Song Yu actually didn’t know why his two teachers had such different personalities… yet were still a couple.

Very strange.

But just then—

“Did you name the little bird?”

Teacher Yu clapped his hands, sat down across the table, and asked in a very gentle, upright manner.

“It has a name, Linlin.”

Teacher Yu nodded upon hearing this, then spoke to himself:

“Oh, so you didn’t name it.”

Song Yu was slightly stunned, feeling a bit surprised.

At this moment, the teacher across from him was also deducing, wondering if this was an abandoned bird and the former owner had come to claim it?

And the child had become depressed because of this?

There were too many such cases. Most were about people picking up stray cats or dogs. They originally thought they had been healed, but once these little animals met their original owners, they would immediately break their leashes and run toward them.

Abandoning their new owners.

Even if the old owners had abandoned them.

But this was almost a dead end; there was no way to find an optimal solution.

Teacher Yu thought for a moment, looked up at Song Yu, and said patiently:

“Don’t be overly anxious.”

“Little birds also need time to get along. You spend your days and nights together, it will definitely also—”

“No.”

Song Yu’s eyes were cast down, his slender fingers curled slightly, and he repeated:

“No, teacher.”

Perhaps it was because he had no one to confide in for so long, or perhaps because others wouldn’t believe him even if he spoke.

Song Yu’s bewildered thoughts surged up again, and he spoke the truth involuntarily:

“It typed its name to tell me.”

The air fell into silence.

Teacher Yu was stunned, his body leaning back against the chair. The noon sun was shining in through the window, which should have been warm.

But his heart felt cold.

This was a bit tricky.

-

“I know this is absurd. Perhaps I saw it wrong.”

Teacher Yu reacted when he heard Song Yu return to a calm tone—this was already self-protection. He quickly affirmed:

“Teacher believes you.”

“So you really saw it, right?”

“Therefore, the wounds on your hands… you want to use pain to help yourself confirm it, right?”

Song Yu’s expression was calm, his eyes lowered, and his tone was very light: “Yes.”

He had indeed tried.

“Then have you distinguished it?”

After hearing this question, Song Yu was stunned at first, and then fell into chaos, because he… couldn’t distinguish it.

Sometimes he easily immersed himself in it, feeling that everything was normal, perhaps the bird was just a bit smarter.

But sometimes, when he pulled himself out, he felt he might be having hallucinations.

How could a bird play games, how could it buy a phone…

Was it real?

Or was it something he imagined?

Song Yu was split into two halves: one half maintained a precarious sanity, and the other half began to automatically rationalize everything.

He clearly felt something was wrong, yet he still bought all kinds of electronic equipment and even got a SIM card.

Song Yu had never experienced long-term companionship from the outside world; he was always alone, so it was very easy for him to sink into it.

The bird hadn’t done anything wrong.

It was he who was sick.

The gold was just a decoration, the phone was just something it wanted to play with, the custom AirPods weren’t expensive—it was just a little bird, why couldn’t he satisfy it?

Song Yu thought about it over and over again.

In the end, he just circled back to the starting point.

It was his own problem.

It had nothing to do with the bird.

“Song Yu? Song Yu?”

The young man came back to his senses, finally organized his emotions, looked up at the teacher, and said calmly:

“Teacher, I’m fine.”

“Maybe it’s just that during this time—”

Teacher Yu quickly reached out his hand, “Stop.”

He hadn’t expected the cause of this to be a little bird, and a “good” hallucination with no negative information at that.

Song Yu had always lived alone.

He didn’t know how long this had been going on…

Teacher Yu thought for a moment. Blindly denying it wasn’t appropriate; it would be better to ask more about the situation.

“What is your little bird’s personality like?”

Song Yu was stunned, but he still answered truthfully:

“Very well-behaved.”

“It’s very well-behaved.”

…

At this moment, the bird in Jinyuan was fighting on the battlefield, specifically pecking at the boy’s face. Scratches and bleeding were the least of it.

Cursing my brother to go to a mental hospital, are you?

I’ll send you there first!

The bird dove again.

……

“那它怎么和人互动的？是只和你亲近吗？”余老师又问。

宋郁闻言摇了摇头，很认真地道：

“它很懂事的。”

……

锦园这里乱成一片了，白粼粼在半空中灵巧地盘旋，一个迫降，爪子勾住女人的头发就往后扯。

在对方伸手的时候，立马松开飞走。

哎，打不着！

私闯民宅的小偷！

……

宋郁这边还是风平浪静，一直到心理咨询完毕，余老师用手撑着下巴思索着，好奇地问了问：

“那老师可以去家里看看那只小鸟吗？”

后面的事就很自然，班主任本来就给宋郁批假了，得知丈夫的打算后也点了点头，在办公室还给了宋郁手机。

三模考试，需要学生上交手机。

不过就在这时，一通跨国电话打了过来，对面劈头盖脸就是一顿骂。

但是不巧。

接电话的是班主任。

“宋先生，注意言辞。”

宋启明一下子尴尬了，连忙解释了事情的来龙去脉，并且问了下这个时间不应该是放学了么？

班主任蹙眉道：“就算是放学了，也不能和孩子这么讲话。”

那头一下子熄火了。

宋启明是在军区大院长大的，小时候没少被老师批评，因而现在也保留着对这个职业的尊重，在电话里老老实实地说“是是是”。

直到宋郁接了电话过来，那头才低声呵斥道：

“你的鸟怎么回事？是疯了吗？你李阿姨被咬得手臂都是口子，小阳都破相了！”

“快点回家把那东西处理了，物业逮也逮不住的……”

宋郁面色骤然变了，甚至来不及同老师告别，直接把电话挂了。

他立即往家里赶。

锦园——

白粼粼站在高处的吊灯上，身姿挺立，雄赳赳气昂昂的。

客厅有几个物业人员，拿着杆子戳，但其实很敷衍，动作慢就不说了，还离鸟很远。

“你们怎么弄得啊！”

“打下来啊！”

李长韵气得发抖道，她头发乱糟糟的，旁边的孩子脸上都是血点，旁边助理赶过来处理，勉强用棉签消了消毒。

物业人员其实都知道住户的信息，有的都是老人了，更是知道这里面的内情。

谁不知道这女的当年未婚先孕，还挺着肚子来这里要名分，那时候宋家门都不带开的，现在倒是真成“主人”了。

但是，锦园这处房产还真不是她的。

是宋郁的。

当年私生子传闻沸沸扬扬的，宋峥国气得直接绕过儿子来培养孙子，给年仅十一岁的宋郁名下添了很多不动产。

锦园就是其中之一。

但谁也没想到老爷子后面住院了，那女人真成正宫了，这现在一下变成了“家事”，搞得物业也很难处理。

敷衍几下得了。

物业人员其实也看不惯，但面上还是得说得过去，安抚了那女人几句：

“快了快了。”

“这已经在尽力了。”

白粼粼觉得，鸟一点错都没有！

这都是垃圾！

鸟替天行道而已。

不过它在吊灯上站着也有点无聊，看着那个杆子挪来挪去的，不知道怎么了，有点跃跃欲试。

伸爪子站上去了。

更高了。

物业人员一开始愣住了，后面就是此起彼伏的惊叹。

“我去，拍照拍照。”

“你别动别动。”

“嚯，它平衡性真好！”

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：我站得最高！

...

"Then how does it interact with people? Is it only affectionate toward you?" Teacher Yu asked again.

Upon hearing this, Song Yu shook his head and replied very earnestly:

"It is very sensible."

...

The scene at Jin Yuan was in total chaos. Bai Linlin circled nimbly in mid-air, then performed a forced dive, its claws hooking into the woman's hair and yanking backward.

The moment she reached out to grab it, it immediately let go and flew away.

*Hah! You can't catch me!*

*A thief trespassing in a private residence!*

...

Things were calm and peaceful on Song Yu’s end. It wasn't until the psychological consultation concluded that Teacher Yu rested his chin on his hand, lost in thought, and asked with curiosity:

"May I go to your home to see that little bird?"

What followed happened quite naturally. The homeroom teacher had already granted Song Yu leave, and upon learning of her husband's intentions, she nodded and even returned Song Yu’s phone in the office.

Students were required to hand in their phones for the third mock exam.

However, just at that moment, an international call came through, and the person on the other end launched into a barrage of insults.

But, unfortunately.

The person who answered the phone was the homeroom teacher.

"Mr. Song, please mind your language."

Song Qiming was instantly mortified. He hurriedly explained the ins and outs of the situation and asked if it wasn't past school hours by now.

The homeroom teacher frowned and said, "Even if it is after school, you cannot speak to a child like that."

The voice on the other end was suddenly extinguished.

Song Qiming had grown up in a military compound and had been scolded by teachers plenty of times in his childhood, so he still retained a deep respect for the profession. He obediently replied, "Yes, yes, yes," over the phone.

It wasn't until Song Yu took the phone that the voice on the other end hissed in a low, angry tone:

"What is wrong with your bird? Is it rabid? Your Aunt Li’s arms are covered in gashes, and Xiao Yang’s face is disfigured!"

"Hurry home and deal with that thing. Even the property management can't catch it..."

Song Yu’s expression shifted abruptly. He didn't even have time to bid his teacher farewell before hanging up the phone.

He rushed home immediately.

Jin Yuan—

Bai Linlin stood atop the high chandelier, its posture upright, looking heroic and high-spirited.

Several property management staff were in the living room, poking at it with poles, but they were clearly just going through the motions—not only were their movements sluggish, but they also kept a safe distance from the bird.

"How are you handling this?!"

"Knock it down!"

Li Changyun trembled with rage. Her hair was a mess, and the child beside her had blood spots all over his face. An assistant rushed over to tend to him, barely managing to disinfect the wounds with a cotton swab.

The property staff actually knew the residents' backgrounds. Some of them were older and knew the inside story.

Who didn't know that this woman had gotten pregnant out of wedlock years ago and had come here while heavily pregnant to demand status? Back then, the Song family wouldn't even open the door for her. Now, she had truly become the "mistress of the house."

However, this property at Jin Yuan was not actually hers.

It belonged to Song Yu.

When rumors of the illegitimate child were rampant, Song Zheng-guo had been so furious that he bypassed his son to cultivate his grandson, adding many real estate assets to the name of the then eleven-year-old Song Yu.

Jin Yuan was one of them.

But no one expected the old man to be hospitalized later, and for that woman to truly become the "legitimate wife." Now that it had turned into a "family matter," the property management found it very difficult to handle.

Better to just go through the motions.

The property staff didn't like the woman either, but they had to keep up appearances, so they placated her:

"Almost there, almost there."

"We are doing our best."

Bai Linlin felt that the bird had done absolutely nothing wrong!

These people were all trash!

The bird was merely acting on behalf of the heavens.

However, standing on the chandelier was getting a bit boring. Watching the pole move back and forth, for some reason, it felt a bit eager to try something.

It stretched out its claws and stepped onto the pole.

It was even higher now.

The property staff were stunned at first, followed by a chorus of exclamations.

"Whoa, take a picture, take a picture."

"Don't move, don't move."

"Wow, its balance is incredible!"
