[Pigeon][Pigeon]: I am standing the highest!

chunks.chineseText:
第16章

宋郁进门得很急，面色很冷，门口的助理见到了人还想打招呼，但被一把推开了。

“让开！”

鸟稳稳当当地站在杆子最上方，正在接受“朝拜”，下面的物业人员还在举着手机拍。

李长韵是后知后觉才发现的，起身刚想要去抓那个杆子，但已经来不及了。

白粼粼看到宋郁了，直接扑棱扑棱翅膀下来了，站在“人”的肩头，胸膛挺立。

“你没事？”

宋郁怔了下，原本因为赶路而造成的呼吸急促也被压下去了，他侧眸看向自己的肩头，很恍惚地问。

“啾啾！”

“啾啾啾啾！”

[哪里的话！]

白粼粼很是骄傲地仰了仰鸟头，然后歪歪扭扭地往靠近“人”的方向挪，贴贴，不过也就是这个距离，鸟近距离地看到了宋郁眼尾的红痣。

欸？

鸟探头。

鸟好奇。

白粼粼想叨一口，但是又想到自己叨了脏东西，有些小小的犹豫，但这个很好看。

也就在这时，对面的女人突然起身，一个猛冲过来，作势要抓——

鸟甚至都没有反应过来。

但宋郁抬手就扣住李长韵的手腕，借力打力，往后一甩。

对方几乎很是狼狈地撞上沙发边，脸上露出吃痛的表情。

宋郁一字一句地道：“请离开我家。”

高中生的力气是不小，身高也占据优势，甚至在场的几个物业和助理都没有到一米八。

氛围变得剑拔弩张。

但就在这时，一道亮光快速地闪了下。

“……”

“……”

人群中举杆子的大叔此刻正捏着手机，对着鸟拍，但他没想到闪光灯没关，脸色瞬间红了。

“咳咳咳，我我接个电话！”

大叔试图逃离现场，但客厅的女人像是彻底崩溃了，大声地指责道：

“你们就是故意的！我家孩子才多大，脸上被弄成这样，一个小畜生都抓不住……”

宋郁面色变了，他面无表情地往前走，但鸟一看局势不对，立马伸了一边翅膀拦住。

莫动。

宋郁愣住了，连带着脚步都停了，他的感官完全被唇角传来的触感占据了。

顺滑，温暖，干燥。

负面情绪都被卡住了。

直到余光看到一抹冲出去的蓝影。

一时间客厅里再度成了战场，李长韵的头发被扯得乱糟糟的，手臂又多了一道血痕，她开始拿东西砸，尽管一次也没有命中。

宋郁根本就忍不了了，刚想要动手，鸟一个迫降，又回了身边，压制住了。

“啾啾。”

下巴被鸟头顶了下。

似乎是安抚。

砰——

花瓶被摔得稀巴烂，李长韵几乎气得发抖，但她刚想再发作，玄关那里来人了。

宋郁的老师们来了，班主任蹙了蹙眉，基本问了些情况。

“受伤了去医院。”

“待在学生家里做什么？”

班主任很是不客气地对着那些围着男童的不相干人说道。

而后她才将视线移向那位“后妈”，很客套地道：

“是这样，现在是高三的关键时期，刚才宋先生也和我通了电话，我来家访。”

“不知道您有没有时间——”

李长韵当然不可能有，她面色难看地拒绝了，牵着自己的孩子走了，连带着那些华秉跟过来的人。

物业人员也自然散开了。

余老师在旁边站着，不由得吐槽了句，“这人看着就不可能同意……”

“所以让她走。”

班主任没想到宋郁家里这么多事，她蹙眉问了下：

“锦园这边不是你自己住吗？”

“你后妈怎么会来？”

别墅里乱糟糟一片，宋郁到最后也没有真的动手，闻言回了回神，只是说：

“我不知道。”

班主任想了想，“没事，我去和你父亲联系。”

其实这是不太合适的，毕竟宋家是实打实的权贵，公职人员没有必要去插手这些。

“老师，您不用——”

“我爸是你爸老师。”

班主任面无表情地道。

鸟都震惊了。

怎么还有这一层关系？

-

最后家访还是进行下去了，只不过班主任开车先走了，因为要接豆豆放学。

余老师来看看……传闻中的鸟。

碎掉的花瓶已经收拾起来了，茶几上放着新鲜的水果，还有刚泡上的热茶。

宋郁似乎是觉得还不行，又想起身去拿些东西，但被拦住了。

“好了好了，老师不是来打劫的。”

余老师语气很是无奈，不过就在好不容易把人劝着坐好了，耳边传来一阵有节奏的叨叨叨……

鸟此刻正站在那个大白兔奶糖罐子上，爪子踩在边边上，专注地用自己的喙去撬盖子。

“……”

是不是忘记自己踩在盖子上了？

余老师觉得也不是很聪明的嘛。

宋郁顺着视线看过去，没有什么犹豫，抬手就把鸟拿下来，随后打开罐子。

解决问题。

白粼粼很满意很满意，低头叼起来一块糖，刚打算给宋郁，就听到他们在说话。

“其实最近还是压力大是不是？”

“高考是可以去的，可以做两手准备，这个你不用担心。”

“你成绩一直都很好……”

鸟叼着糖，低头保持不动，打算继续听。

现在是宋郁在说话：

“我没事的老师。”

“我没有打算出国。”

鸟震惊，鸟从来不知道人有可能要出国，以至于刷得一下就抬头看过去了，叼着的奶糖也滚地上了。

“啾啾？”

脆脆的声音响起。

打断了这场对话。

宋郁怔了下，但还是心领神会地对着茶几的方向道，“我不出国。”

鸟在茶几上啪嗒啪嗒走，靠近人的身边，站定。

歪头开始看旁边的“新”人。

余老师：“……”

他还是不太相信，以至于就直接说了：

“小宋，其实我觉得鸟不太能听懂人说话。”

“它就算是鹦鹉也——”

白粼粼直接扑棱翅膀飞了起来，稳稳地站在这个中年人的肩膀上，伸着鸟头看过去。

你再说？

余老师正襟危坐，毕竟他进门的时候看到了那位“后妈”脸上的豁口。

“……”

这也是乖吗？

不过好在他学生救了他，肩头一轻，那只小鸟被拿走了。

宋郁很自然地把鸟放在了自己肩头，认真地道：

“不能这样。”

余老师微微颔首，对的，即使是宠物，也要有规矩的。

但下一秒。

“不安全的。”

“……”

余老师其实有点无奈，这不安全的是鸟吗？难道不是他吗？

那喙尖尖的，简直是一戳一个窟窿。

那么多人都抓不住。

简直是空中战斗机。

不过这都不是什么重点，余老师抬眸仔细看了下那只小鸟。

体型中等。

上他肩头还有点沉。

看样子还能听懂人话。

“……这样。”

“宋郁，我们去书房。”

-

鸟被歧视了。

白粼粼站在书房的门口，仰望着门把手，然后像个走地鸡一样来回转。

啪嗒啪嗒。
chunks.englishText:
第16章

Song Yu entered the door in a rush, his expression icy. The assistant at the door wanted to greet him, but was pushed aside.

"Move!"

The bird stood steadily at the very top of the pole, receiving "worship," while the property staff below were still holding up their phones to film.

Li Changyun only realized what was happening a beat late. She stood up, wanting to grab the pole, but it was already too late.

Seeing Song Yu, Bai Linlin flapped its wings and flew down, landing on the "human's" shoulder, its chest puffed out.

"You're okay?"

Song Yu paused, the rapid breathing caused by his rush home subsiding. He tilted his head to look at his shoulder, asking in a daze.

"Chirp!"

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!"

*[What are you talking about!]*

Bai Linlin tilted its bird head with great pride, then waddled crookedly toward the "human," pressing against him. At this distance, the bird saw the red mole at the corner of Song Yu’s eye up close.

*Eh?*

The bird poked its head forward.

The bird was curious.

Bai Linlin wanted to give it a peck, but remembered it had been pecking at something dirty, so it hesitated slightly. But it looked so good.

Just then, the woman opposite suddenly stood up and lunged forward, making a move to grab—

The bird didn't even react in time.

But Song Yu raised his hand and clamped onto Li Changyun’s wrist, using her own momentum to fling her backward.

She stumbled, crashing against the edge of the sofa, a look of pain crossing her face.

Song Yu said, word for word: "Please leave my house."

A high school student’s strength was not insignificant, and he had the height advantage; even the property staff and assistants present were not yet six feet tall.

The atmosphere became tense.

But just then, a bright light flashed quickly.

"..."

"..."

The uncle in the crowd holding the pole was currently pinching his phone, filming the bird, but he hadn't expected the flash to be on. His face turned red instantly.

"Cough, cough, cough, I—I'm taking a call!"

The uncle tried to flee the scene, but the woman in the living room seemed to have completely broken down, pointing and accusing loudly:

"You did this on purpose! How old is my child? His face is ruined like this, and you can't even catch a little beast..."

Song Yu’s expression changed. He walked forward expressionlessly, but the bird, sensing the situation, immediately stretched out one wing to block him.

*Don't move.*

Song Yu was stunned, his footsteps coming to a halt. His senses were completely occupied by the sensation on the corner of his lips.

Smooth, warm, dry.

All his negative emotions were jammed.

Until he saw a flash of blue darting out in his peripheral vision.

In an instant, the living room became a battlefield again. Li Changyun’s hair was pulled into a mess, and her arm gained another scratch. She began throwing things, though she didn't hit a single target.

Song Yu couldn't take it anymore and was about to intervene, but the bird performed a forced dive, returned to his side, and suppressed the situation.

"Chirp."

His chin was nudged by the bird's head.

It seemed to be a comfort.

*Bang—*

A vase was smashed to pieces. Li Changyun was trembling with rage, but just as she was about to lash out again, someone arrived at the entryway.

Song Yu’s teachers had arrived. The homeroom teacher frowned, basically asking about the situation.

"If you're injured, go to the hospital."

"What are you doing staying in a student's home?"

The homeroom teacher spoke very bluntly to the irrelevant people surrounding the young boy.

Then, she shifted her gaze to the "stepmother," saying quite formally:

"It's like this: this is a critical period for the third year of high school. Mr. Song just spoke with me on the phone, and I am here for a home visit."

"I wonder if you have the time—"

Li Changyun, of course, did not. She refused with an ugly expression, taking her child and leaving, along with the people who had followed from Hua Bing.

The property staff naturally dispersed as well.

Teacher Yu stood by, unable to help but mutter, "That person didn't look like she would agree..."

"So let her leave."

The homeroom teacher hadn't expected so much drama in Song Yu’s home. She frowned and asked:

"Don't you live here at Jin Yuan by yourself?"

"Why did your stepmother come here?"

The villa was a mess. Song Yu hadn't actually laid a hand on anyone in the end. Hearing this, he regained his focus and only said:

"I don't know."

The homeroom teacher thought for a moment. "It's fine, I will contact your father."

Actually, this wasn't very appropriate, as the Song family were bona fide power brokers, and public servants had no need to meddle in such affairs.

"Teacher, you don't have to—"

"My father is your father's teacher."

The homeroom teacher said expressionlessly.

The bird was shocked.

*How is there this layer of connection?*

-

In the end, the home visit proceeded, though the homeroom teacher drove away first because she had to pick up Dou Dou from school.

Teacher Yu stayed to see... the legendary bird.

The shattered vase had been cleaned up, and fresh fruit and hot tea were placed on the coffee table.

Song Yu seemed to feel it wasn't enough and wanted to get up to get something else, but was stopped.

"Alright, alright, the teacher isn't here to rob you."

Teacher Yu’s tone was helpless. However, just as he finally persuaded the boy to sit down, a rhythmic *tap-tap-tap* reached his ears...

The bird was currently standing on the White Rabbit candy tin, its claws stepping on the edge, focused on using its beak to pry at the lid.

"..."

*Did it forget it was standing on the lid?*

Teacher Yu didn't think it was very smart either.

Song Yu followed his gaze, and without hesitation, reached out to take the bird down, then opened the tin.

Problem solved.

Bai Linlin was very, very satisfied. It lowered its head to pick up a candy, and just as it intended to give it to Song Yu, it heard them talking.

"Actually, the pressure has been high lately, hasn't it?"

"You can go abroad for college; you can have two plans. You don't need to worry about that."

"Your grades have always been very good..."

The bird held the candy, keeping its head down and staying still, intending to keep listening.

Now it was Song Yu speaking:

"I'm fine, Teacher."

"I have no plans to go abroad."

The bird was shocked. The bird had never known that humans might go abroad, so it jerked its head up, and the milk candy it was holding rolled onto the floor.

"Chirp?"

A crisp sound rang out.

It interrupted the conversation.

Song Yu was stunned, but he understood the intent and said toward the coffee table, "I am not going abroad."

The bird walked *patter-patter* across the coffee table, approached the human, and stood still.

It tilted its head and began to look at the "new" person beside him.

Teacher Yu: "..."

He still didn't quite believe it, so he said directly:

"Little Song, actually, I don't think the bird can really understand human speech."

"Even if it's a parrot, it—"

Bai Linlin immediately flapped its wings and flew up, landing steadily on the middle-aged man’s shoulder, stretching its bird head over.

*Say that again?*

Teacher Yu sat up straight; after all, he had seen the gashes on that "stepmother's" face when he walked in.

"..."

*Is this also 'sensible'?*

Fortunately, his student saved him; his shoulder felt lighter, and the little bird was taken away.

Song Yu naturally placed the bird back on his shoulder and said earnestly:

"You can't do that."

Teacher Yu nodded slightly. *Right, even if it's a pet, there must be rules.*

But the next second.

"It's not safe."

"..."

Teacher Yu was actually a bit helpless. *Is it the bird that's unsafe? Isn't it him?*

That beak was sharp; it could poke a hole in anything.

So many people couldn't catch it.

It was practically an aerial fighter jet.

But that wasn't the point. Teacher Yu raised his eyes to look carefully at the little bird.

Medium size.

It was a bit heavy on his shoulder.

It looked like it could understand human speech.

"...I see."

"Song Yu, let's go to the study."

-

The bird was being discriminated against.

Bai Linlin stood at the door of the study, looking up at the doorknob, then paced back and forth like a chicken.

*Patter-patter.*

chunks.chineseText:
他试图去偷听，但是无济于事，书房很大，还有里侧套间。

根本就听不到。

“……”

鸟沮丧。

与此同时——

“我觉得不要用伤害自己的方式来得到所谓的‘正确’。”

“身体机能的健康是很重要的，如果这一点做不到，精神状态会更加走下坡路。”

余老师其实并不打算用一些很专业的心理知识来开导，他只是以一个长辈的身份来给出建议。

“宋郁。”

“很多人都会有弄不清楚的事，ufo，龙……或者通俗意义上的鬼怪，人们都是辨别不清楚的。”

“科学家也不能佐证真假，但他们会用伤害自己的方式来证实这些未知的存在吗？”

“不会。”

余老师很是循循善诱地给出了答案，见人又听进去的意思，更进一步道：

“就算这世界上真的有无法解释的事，那就让它存在就好了。”

“不必要争个真假，过好你当下的生活就可以了。”

宋郁微微垂着眼眸，手指往上勾了下。

……

鸟在门外等的实在无聊，回了客厅的茶几，开始自己给自己剥奶糖。

正专心致志的时候，不远处传来说话的声音。

“没事，老师这就走了。”

“中午记得吃饭。”

“我给你叫个饭吧？”

余老师很是温和，边走边和旁边的宋郁说话。

其乐融融的。

就是到客厅的时候，和剥奶糖的鸟对视了。

男人脚步一顿。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼身子下压，扑棱翅膀就飞了过来，余老师几乎是本能地往后退了一步。

但这一幕全部被鸟看到了。

？

干什么？

白粼粼稳稳当当地站在宋郁的肩头，歪头看着对面的老师。

直视我。

“啊，这小鸟确实挺通人性。”

余老师实在是找不出合适的话来夸奖，毕竟乖巧……实在是半分沾不上边。

敬畏敬畏。

“嗯，它很可爱。”

“……”

余老师到底也是没什么话说了，只是把话头转到宋郁身上，让人好好照顾自己。

大约交谈了几句。

一人一鸟这才把客人送走了。

-

与此同时。

江芮正在工作室办公，正是烦闷的时候手机收到了一条消息。

她看完之后就眉目舒展了。

狐狸精，活该遭报应。

不过宋郁那个鸟……看起来还挺聪明？

江芮像是终于想起来自己还有儿子的联系方式，切了个页面，手指在屏幕上滑动，翻到了最底部。

她微微蹙了眉，因为上次的聊天框还停留在那一串不知所以的标点符号。

这孩子误触了怎么也不知道回消息？

越大越不懂事。

江芮看了看上面的转账，也是过期了。

她面色有些不好看，但是想到小予这几天一直在闹……那些送过来的鸟都不听话，多半应付不了几天。

宋郁的这只，看起来会护主，这孩子还挺有能耐的。

江芮神色好了些，自顾自地打字：

［江芮：小郁看到妈妈消息了吗？你把你的小鸟送给妹妹好不好？］

［江芮：妈妈给你买新的，你妹妹她不太会驯小鸟。］

但此刻锦园——

人在给鸟剥恰恰瓜子，原味的，手机被随意地放在茶几上，屏幕亮着。

白粼粼很急，因为宋郁的速度很慢，鸟甚至想自己叨过来。

但是人不让。

他只能鸟爪子搭上去，但宋郁的手指一直在动，连带着鸟也在动。

差点要翻了。

白粼粼歪歪扭扭，另外一只爪子不知道什么时候按上屏幕了，弹出来的消息被误打误撞打开了。

“只能吃一点点。”

“啾啾！！”

一人一鸟辩论着，但与此同时，手机屏幕的键盘不知道什么时候被调出来了。

……

江芮那边收到了新的消息。

［宋郁：？。！？］

［宋郁：你，病？］

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：不用谢！
chunks.englishText:
It tried to eavesdrop, but it was to no avail. The study was large and had an inner suite.

It couldn't hear a thing.

"..."

The bird was dejected.

Meanwhile—

"I don't think you should use self-harming methods to achieve what you call 'correctness'."

"Physical health is very important. If you can't maintain that, your mental state will only spiral further downward."

Teacher Yu didn't actually intend to use professional psychological knowledge to guide him; he was simply offering advice as an elder.

"Song Yu."

"Many people have things they can't figure out. UFOs, dragons... or ghosts and monsters in the colloquial sense. People can't distinguish the truth."

"Scientists can't prove whether they are real or fake, but would they use self-harming methods to prove the existence of these unknowns?"

"No."

Teacher Yu gave the answer in a very persuasive manner. Seeing that the boy was listening, he went a step further:

"Even if there are things in this world that cannot be explained, just let them exist."

"There is no need to fight over what is true or false; just live your life well in the present."

Song Yu lowered his eyes slightly, his fingers curling upward.

...

The bird was so bored waiting outside the door that it returned to the coffee table in the living room and began peeling a milk candy for itself.

Just as it was concentrating, the sound of voices came from not far away.

"It's fine, Teacher is leaving now."

"Remember to eat lunch."

"Should I order some food for you?"

Teacher Yu was very gentle, talking to Song Yu as they walked.

It was a harmonious scene.

That was until they reached the living room and locked eyes with the bird peeling the candy.

The man’s footsteps halted.

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin lowered its body and flapped its wings, flying over. Teacher Yu instinctively took a step back.

But the bird saw this entire scene.

*?*

*What are you doing?*

Bai Linlin landed steadily on Song Yu’s shoulder, tilting its head to look at the teacher opposite.

*Look me in the eye.*

"Ah, this little bird is indeed quite human-like."

Teacher Yu couldn't find the right words to praise it; after all, "well-behaved"... was not a word that applied to it in the slightest.

*Awe, awe.*

"Yes, it's very cute."

"..."

Teacher Yu really had nothing left to say, so he turned the conversation back to Song Yu, telling him to take good care of himself.

After a few more exchanges, the man and the bird finally saw the guest out.

-

Meanwhile.

Jiang Rui was working in her studio, feeling annoyed, when her phone received a message.

After reading it, her brows smoothed out.

*That vixen, she deserves the retribution.*

*But Song Yu’s bird... it looks quite smart?*

Jiang Rui seemed to finally remember she had her son’s contact information. She switched pages, her fingers sliding across the screen until she reached the very bottom.

She frowned slightly, as the last chat box was still stuck on a string of inexplicable punctuation marks.

*How did this child not know how to reply after accidentally touching it?*

*The older he gets, the less sensible he becomes.*

Jiang Rui looked at the transfer above; it had expired.

Her expression was somewhat unpleasant, but thinking of Xiao Yu throwing a tantrum these past few days... the birds sent over were all disobedient, and most couldn't last more than a few days.

Song Yu’s bird looked like it could protect its owner; this child actually had some capability.

Jiang Rui’s expression improved, and she typed to herself:

[Jiang Rui: Xiao Yu, did you see Mom’s message? Why don't you give your little bird to your sister?]

[Jiang Rui: Mom will buy you a new one. Your sister doesn't really know how to tame birds.]

But at this moment, at Jin Yuan—

The human was peeling sunflower seeds for the bird—original flavor—with his phone lying casually on the coffee table, the screen lit up.

Bai Linlin was anxious because Song Yu’s speed was too slow; the bird even wanted to peck them over itself.

But the human wouldn't let it.

It could only rest its bird claw on the phone, but Song Yu’s fingers kept moving, and the bird moved along with them.

It almost flipped over.

Bai Linlin wobbled, and its other claw accidentally pressed onto the screen, causing the pop-up message to be opened by mistake.

"You can only eat a little bit."

"Chirp!!"

The human and the bird were debating, but at the same time, the phone’s keyboard had somehow been brought up.

...

On Jiang Rui’s end, she received a new message.

[Song Yu: ? . ! ?]

[Song Yu: You, sick?]

chunks.chineseText:
第17章

宋郁垂眸看着鸟认真地叨那一个瓜子仁，圆滚滚的脑袋一动一动的，爪子还在抵住他的手指。

是让人不要动的意思。

“……”

宋郁就这么伺候着，其实后面也想通了，他不再思考那些关于鸟的“不合理”事件了。

没有意义。

余老师说的没错，与其非要执着地将事情分个对错，倒不如完全地接纳，允许生活中出现杂乱的线头。

不去探究根源。

不去辨别真假。

像那些平行空间的际遇，那些发帖人总会讲述自己遇到的无法解释的事，但他们整体的感受是负面的么？

不是。

大多是震惊和惊奇。

甚至认为这是人生中绝无仅有的经历。

宋郁很客观地自我开解，他垂眸看着茶几上毛绒绒的小鸟，面色平静，心里只有一个想法。

那是不是。

他遇见了绝无仅有的一只小鸟……

与此同时，工作室那里的江芮看到消息后一下子站了起来，面色变得很难看。

这是不是故意的？

这孩子现在是能耐了，学着拐着弯来骂人……女人当即就打算拨电话过去。

但就在这时，门口秘书说有人来了。

江芮深吸一口气，只能先作罢，毕竟工作重要，但她没想到来的人是江连成，自己的父亲。

……

“爸！你来干什么，你不知道我很忙吗？”

江芮其实是有点不满的，环着手臂看着会客沙发上的父亲，对方虽然老了，但仍然穿得文质彬彬的。

江连成闻言很是不满，还是抬头指责了几句，“你妈去世得早，我没有多管过你，但是下次不能这样。”

“你让小郁去什么满月酒？”

“你陈叔叔都直接找到我这里了！”

江芮闻言面色变得难看，“和他有什么关系？我生的孩子我为什么不能叫人过来？”

“都是我生的，宋郁的弟弟，他来看看怎么了？”

“我哪个月没给他零花钱？我亏待他了？”

“我生他也是丢了半条命的！”

气氛一下子僵住了。

江连成闻言闭了闭眼，他只是压着声音斥责道：

“那为什么还生！你就真是昏了头，那个制片人就真的——”

江芮像是气急了，转了头就打断道，“不要说了！”

房间里一片死寂，最后女人冷冷地丢出来一句。

“我不可能让宋启明看笑话。”

-

宋郁其实后面有看到了江芮的信息，但那已经是一周后了。

少年垂着眼睫看着那些聊天记录，面上没有什么情绪，只是抬手往上翻。

零星的几条对话。

每次对话前面都有转账。

五万、六万、十万。

不发钱，似乎就不能聊。

宋郁总是觉得她很忙，幼年时期他去找过江芮很多次，但每次都被扔给助理。

离婚之后，江芮创办了尚美工作室，做影视剧的后期制作，甚至还签了几个艺人。

宋郁见过江芮身边有好几个男模，不过那时候也是没空。

——妈妈很忙，等妈妈事业好起来好吗？

——小郁最乖了。

那些记忆如风一样地飘过，灰色的，在小巷子里，身着亮丽长裙的女人蹲着身子抱着自己的孩子，眉眼都是温柔的。

时过境迁。

江芮再婚，事业蒸蒸日上，怀孕，在医院里奔波。

宋郁几乎见证了他母亲的变化，从温和到戾气不止，婚姻毁了她。

但她还要生……

仿佛有密不透风的黑墙压过来，一点点地把人吞噬。

宋郁想到那个孩子的名字就作呕，以至于捏着手机的手指都收紧了。

屏幕外缘有些变色。

但就在这时，一个爪子稳稳地落在了手机上端，宋郁一下子抽离出来了。

“啾啾？”

鸟仰头，看着人。

白粼粼本来是在外头溜达的，因为宋郁让人给换了一扇门，玄关那里有挺大的一块可视屏幕。

鸟特别好奇。

因为原来的门禁系统是有人脸识别的，那新的……

有没有鸟脸识别？

白粼粼在玄关那里研究了半天，后面才反应过来门是只能识别外头的，他在里面。

“……”

遂来找人。

鸟想要录入一下鸟脸，再不济录入一下爪子上的纹路也可以。

科技应该发展到这个水平了吧？

白粼粼很是期待地想着，当然如果没有的话也不要紧，鸟有备选方案，让宋郁上大学研究这个……

那句话怎么说。

选择大于努力。

白粼粼对于自己选中的“人”非常满意，尽管“人”生了点小病，但这完全掩盖不了他的优点。

瑕不掩瑜！

对，就是这样。

不过他也不要什么别的，就想要个可以刷脸的入户门。

这样鸟就可以自由自在地出去溜达了。

“饿了？”

宋郁伸了伸手，等着鸟伸爪子过来，温和地问了下。

白粼粼：“……”

才没有。

但鸟还是屈尊降贵地伸爪子过来了，不过就是由于这段时间吃得太好了，导致他平衡有点受影响。

扑棱了几下翅膀。

宋郁蹙眉就打算把鸟拿起来，但动作进行到一半，手指被抵住了。

是鸟的一边翅膀。

“……”

白粼粼有点稍微的尴尬，不过还是稳稳地站在了人的手指上，收回了翅膀，若无其事地梳理了下羽毛。

宋郁似乎接受度变高了，看到这副场景也只是有些愣，随后把鸟放在自己肩头了。

“我要复习一下。”

“要去房间玩吗？”

宋郁换了个说辞，看着肩头的小鸟，觉得它是不是无聊了。

隔壁的房间有秋千。

小鸟应该会喜欢？

“啾啾。”

[不要。]

白粼粼拒绝了，他本来是上来拽人给他介绍新门的，但这会儿又给忘了，只是低头看了下书桌。

看书？

他还没见过宋郁学习。

鸟飞下了肩头，端端正正地站在那本要复习的书上头，羽毛蓬松。

“你要陪我？”

白粼粼一下子愣了，他是这个意思的吗？

但是已经来不及解释了，宋郁似乎完全接受了这个结论，从抽屉里拿出来个椰子壳。

挪向了鸟。

白粼粼：“……”

他还是钻进去了，然后在里头转个身子，探头看宋郁看书。

少年垂眸看得很快，也不用笔，仿佛是在扫什么课外书一样。

白粼粼震惊。

有这么复习的吗？

事实证明不仅有，宋郁效率还很快，翻完半本之后就没有再看了。

高考会出一些选拔的题目，比较难，但解题思路记住就可以了。

万变不离其宗。

宋郁把书放到一旁去，侧眸看了下椰子壳，鸟已经睡着了，羽毛蓬松，犹如一个毛绒挂件。

他没有太打扰，只是把书收了起来，不过就在这时，宋郁看到了上次齐思扬送过来的那本书。

《保姆级教程：让你的鹦鹉妙语连珠！》

封皮很是花花绿绿的。

宋郁低头看了下出版信息，发现居然没有，只有印刷的日期。

里头的内页也是花花绿绿，有的直接用的视频的截图。

“……”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 17

Song Yu lowered his eyes, watching the bird earnestly pecking at a sunflower seed. Its round, fluffy head bobbed back and forth, its tiny claws braced against his finger.

It was a gesture telling him not to move.

“……”

Song Yu humored it, serving as its perch. In truth, he had come to a realization; he no longer bothered to ponder the “irrational” events surrounding this bird.

It was meaningless.

Teacher Yu was right: rather than obsessively trying to categorize things as right or wrong, it was better to simply accept them, to allow the messy, tangled threads of life to exist as they were.

Do not probe for the root cause.

Do not distinguish between truth and falsehood.

Take those encounters in parallel dimensions—the posters always recounted inexplicable events they had experienced, but were their overall feelings negative?

No.

Mostly, they were shocked and amazed.

Some even considered it a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Song Yu objectively consoled himself. He looked down at the fluffy little bird on the coffee table, his expression calm, with only one thought in his heart.

Was it possible?

That he had encountered a one-of-a-kind little bird…

At the same time, over at the studio, Jiang Rui stood up abruptly after seeing the message, her face turning ghastly.

Was this intentional?

The child had grown capable now, learning to use backhanded remarks to insult people… The woman immediately intended to call him back.

But just then, her secretary at the door announced that someone had arrived.

Jiang Rui took a deep breath and had to let it go; work was important, after all. However, she did not expect the visitor to be Jiang Liancheng, her own father.

…

“Dad! What are you doing here? Don’t you know I’m busy?”

Jiang Rui was actually somewhat displeased. She crossed her arms, looking at her father on the guest sofa. Though he was old, he still dressed with a refined, scholarly air.

Jiang Liancheng was quite dissatisfied at these words and raised his head to reprimand her. “Your mother passed away early, and I didn’t manage you much, but you cannot do this next time.”

“Why did you let Xiao Yu go to that full-month banquet?”

“Your Uncle Chen came directly to me about it!”

Jiang Rui’s expression darkened. “What does it have to do with him? It’s my child; why can’t I have him come over?”

“They are both my children. He’s Song Yu’s younger brother—what’s wrong with him coming to see him?”

“Which month have I missed his allowance? Have I ever mistreated him?”

“I nearly lost half my life giving birth to him!”

The atmosphere turned icy.

Jiang Liancheng closed his eyes, his voice low as he scolded:

“Then why did you have him! You were truly muddled. That producer, he really—”

Jiang Rui seemed to be in a fit of rage; she turned her head and interrupted, “Don’t say another word!”

A deathly silence filled the room. Finally, the woman threw out a cold sentence.

“I will not let Song Qiming see me as a joke.”

-

Song Yu did eventually see Jiang Rui’s message, but that was a week later.

The young man lowered his lashes, looking at the chat history. There was no emotion on his face; he simply scrolled upward.

A few sporadic exchanges.

Every conversation was preceded by a bank transfer.

Fifty thousand, sixty thousand, one hundred thousand.

If money wasn’t sent, it seemed there was nothing to talk about.

Song Yu always felt she was very busy. In his childhood, he had gone to find Jiang Rui many times, but each time he was tossed to an assistant.

After the divorce, Jiang Rui founded the Shangmei Studio, doing post-production for film and television, and even signed a few artists.

Song Yu had seen several male models around Jiang Rui, but back then, she was also “too busy.”

—Mom is very busy. Can you wait until Mom’s career improves, okay?

—Xiao Yu is the best.

Those memories drifted by like the wind—gray, in a small alley, a woman in a bright, beautiful dress squatting down to hug her child, her eyes filled with tenderness.

Times had changed.

Jiang Rui remarried, her career flourished, she became pregnant, and she rushed about in hospitals.

Song Yu had witnessed his mother’s transformation, from gentle to filled with relentless hostility. Marriage had ruined her.

But she still wanted to have another child…

It felt as if an airtight black wall was pressing in, swallowing people bit by bit.

Song Yu felt nauseated just thinking about that child’s name, so much so that his fingers gripping the phone tightened.

The edges of the screen began to discolor.

But just then, a claw landed firmly on the top of the phone, and Song Yu snapped out of his trance.

“Jiu-jiu?”

The bird tilted its head, looking at him.

Bai Linlin had been wandering outside because Song Yu had someone replace the door, and there was a large visual screen in the entryway.

The bird was particularly curious.

Because the original access system had facial recognition, and the new one…

Did it have bird-face recognition?

Bai Linlin had studied the entryway for a long time before realizing the door only recognized people from the outside, and he was on the inside.

“……”

So, he came to find someone.

The bird wanted to register a bird-face, or at the very least, the patterns on his claws would do.

Technology should have reached this level by now, right?

Bai Linlin thought with great anticipation. Of course, if it hadn’t, it didn’t matter; the bird had a backup plan: have Song Yu go to college and research this…

How did that saying go?

Choice is more important than effort.

Bai Linlin was very satisfied with the “human” he had chosen. Although the “human” had a minor illness, it couldn’t overshadow his merits.

The flaws did not obscure the virtues!

Yes, that was it.

However, he didn’t want anything else; he just wanted an entrance door that could scan his face.

That way, the bird could go out for strolls freely.

“Hungry?”

Song Yu reached out, waiting for the bird to extend its claw, asking gently.

Bai Linlin: “……”

Not at all.

But the bird still condescended to extend a claw. However, because he had been eating too well lately, his balance was slightly affected.

He flapped his wings a few times.

Song Yu frowned and intended to pick the bird up, but halfway through the motion, his finger was blocked.

It was one of the bird’s wings.

“……”

Bai Linlin felt a slight embarrassment, but he still stood steadily on the person’s finger, retracted his wings, and preened his feathers as if nothing had happened.

Song Yu seemed to have a higher tolerance now; seeing this scene, he only paused for a moment before placing the bird on his shoulder.

“I need to review.”

“Do you want to go to the room to play?”

Song Yu changed his phrasing, looking at the little bird on his shoulder, wondering if it was bored.

There was a swing in the next room.

The little bird should like that, right?

“Jiu-jiu.”

[No.]

Bai Linlin refused. He had come up to drag the person to introduce him to the new door, but he had forgotten again. He just looked down at the desk.

Reading?

He hadn’t seen Song Yu study before.

The bird flew off his shoulder and stood squarely on the book that needed reviewing, its feathers puffed up.

“You want to keep me company?”

Bai Linlin was stunned for a moment. Was that what he meant?

But it was too late to explain. Song Yu seemed to have fully accepted this conclusion and took a coconut shell out of the drawer.

He moved it toward the bird.

Bai Linlin: “……”

He still crawled inside, turned around, and poked his head out to watch Song Yu read.

The young man lowered his eyes and read very quickly, not even using a pen, as if he were scanning some extracurricular book.

Bai Linlin was shocked.

Is that how you review?

Facts proved that not only was it possible, but Song Yu’s efficiency was also very high. After finishing half the book, he didn’t look at it anymore.

The college entrance exam would have some selective questions that were quite difficult, but one only needed to remember the problem-solving logic.

All changes stemmed from the same source.

Song Yu put the book aside and glanced sideways at the coconut shell. The bird had already fallen asleep, its feathers puffed up like a fluffy ornament.

He didn’t disturb it, just put the books away. However, just then, Song Yu saw the book Qi Siyang had sent over last time.

*Nanny-Level Tutorial: Make Your Parrot Speak Eloquently!*

The cover was very flashy and colorful.

Song Yu looked down at the publication information and found there wasn’t any, only a printing date.

The inner pages were also colorful, some directly using screenshots from videos.

“……”

chunks.chineseText:
靠谱么？

-

与此同时，S州。

宋启明没有想到自己都一把年纪了，还能半夜接到来自小学老师的电话，整个人都有些不好。

当年军区大院，下来的老师基本都是战场上通讯员之类的，有的还是作战指挥部那里的。

上学的时候挨批评就算了。

但没想到现在还——

“启明，不是我说你，你就算是再婚了，也不能不管小郁。”

“孩子一个人住在锦园就算了，怎么能不通知就让他的后妈后弟弟过去，现在正是关键时期你知道不知道！”

电话那头的老爷子中气十足，身体看起来硬朗得很。

旁边的班主任闲着没事干，抬手给自己倒了杯茶。

宋启明只能解释道：

“我知道，我知道。宋郁他小时候闹脾气，不让长韵进家门，长韵怀着孕呢，我也没说什么，后面就搬出去了。”

“宋郁他不过来和我一起住，我也由着他了。不过是这回小阳也该上附小了，我就想着这边比较近……”

电话那头一顿批：

“荒唐！锦园那是峥国留给小郁的，他妈妈在那里住过，你让外人进去那能行吗！”

宋启明额头都有青筋了，他一把年纪了，电话那头的人更是一把年纪。

更何况对方的身份……

不能得罪。

他就不明白了，自己再婚这件事怎么就这么多人反对？

多少年了都还有偏见。

“是是是，我知道了。”

宋启明耐着性子解释，同时也为自己辩白了几句：

“老师你不用担心他上学的事，我没打算让他在国内读，外头的商科不错，英国那边的学校——”

话还没说完，对面又给否了。

“你晕头啊，华秉现在这么动荡，你把孩子送外头？这不明摆着给外界传信号呢？什么意思，这产业全给你那小的？”

“舆论造势你是一点都不顾啊！”

宋启明整个人都脑子嗡嗡的，他根本就不会和这些从过政的人打交道，一句里藏着十句的信息。

乱糟糟的。

“我没这么想，我爸这里……”

电话那头更是一顿说，甚至提及了当年宋峥国晕倒在家里的事。

“老师就教你那么几年，但实话说，三岁看大，七岁看老，启明，你要上点心，知人知面不知心。”

后面的话其实很有暗示意味了，说完就挂了。

宋启明面上没有什么表情，但其实心里已经一团乱麻，他深呼一口气，给国内打了个电话。

大约等了有好一会，电话才接。

“怎么这么久？”

对面的女声似乎是刚刚在运动，有点喘气，只是道：

“在爬楼梯，电梯坏了。”

宋启明蹙了蹙眉，“公司的？后勤是怎么管的？我现在就去问。”

但就在这时，电话那头人又立马道：

“欸好了，没事没事，不用问了，我到地方了。”

宋启明刚想再说几句，但是对方似乎很忙，说是要开会，只是匆匆补了句“爱你”。

S州的夜里很冷。

没有人陪着说话显得空荡荡的。

宋启明这会儿想起来了自己的大儿子，拨了一通电话，尽管有些许的愧疚，但眉毛已经提前蹙起来了。

他觉得还是要教育几句。

养着个会咬人的鸟干什么？

但是，没接。

而此时的锦园。

宋郁在和鸟一起看书，手机设了勿扰模式，被随意地扔在桌子的一旁。

“你要学吗？”

宋郁侧眸问了下，其实他也不太确定自己的小鸟喜不喜欢说话。

毕竟从上一次撞见打游戏……他就没怎么见过鸟说话了。

所以还是要尊重一下意见。

鸟刚睡醒，迷迷瞪瞪的，低头看着花花绿绿的书页精准提取到了一个加深的对话框。

那是网络热梗。

鸟歪了歪头，仿佛被基因代码给控住了，蹦哒了一下，语气抑扬顿挫地学舌：

“你老婆跟人跑了。”
chunks.englishText:
Is this reliable?

-

Meanwhile, in S Province.

Song Qiming never expected that at his age, he would receive a phone call from an elementary school teacher in the middle of the night. He felt quite unwell.

Back in the military compound, the teachers who retired were mostly former communications officers from the battlefield, and some were even from the operational command headquarters.

Being criticized back in school was one thing.

But he didn’t expect that now—

“Qiming, it’s not that I’m lecturing you, but even if you’ve remarried, you cannot neglect Xiao Yu.”

“It’s one thing for the child to live in Jinyuan alone, but how could you let his stepmother and younger brother go over without notice? Do you know that this is a critical period right now!”

The old man on the other end of the line was full of vigor, his body appearing quite robust.

The homeroom teacher next to him, having nothing better to do, poured himself a cup of tea.

Song Qiming could only explain:

“I know, I know. Xiao Yu was throwing a tantrum when he was young and wouldn’t let Changyun into the house. Changyun was pregnant, and I didn’t say anything, so he moved out later.”

“Xiao Yu doesn’t want to come live with me, and I’ve let him be. It’s just that this time, Xiaoyang is also starting at the affiliated elementary school, so I thought it was closer…”

The other end of the line erupted in a lecture:

“Absurd! Jinyuan was left to Xiao Yu by Zheng Guo; his mother lived there. How can you let outsiders go in!”

Song Qiming had veins popping on his forehead. He was old, and the person on the other end was even older.

Moreover, the other person’s status…

He couldn’t afford to offend them.

He just didn’t understand why so many people opposed his remarriage.

How many years had it been, and there was still such prejudice.

“Yes, yes, I know.”

Song Qiming explained with forced patience, while also defending himself a bit:

“Teacher, you don’t need to worry about his schooling. I didn’t plan on having him study domestically. Business schools abroad are quite good, the schools in the UK—”

Before he could finish, he was rejected again.

“Are you muddled? With Huabing being so unstable right now, you’re sending the child abroad? Isn’t that clearly sending a signal to the outside world? What does that mean? That all the assets are going to your younger one?”

“You don’t care about public opinion at all!”

Song Qiming’s head was buzzing. He simply didn’t know how to deal with these people who had been in politics; every sentence contained ten layers of meaning.

It was a mess.

“I didn’t think that way, my father here…”

The other end of the line continued to lecture, even mentioning the time Song Zhengguo fainted at home years ago.

“I only taught you for a few years, but honestly, ‘at three, one sees the adult; at seven, one sees the old.’ Qiming, you need to be more mindful. You can know a person’s face, but not their heart.”

The subsequent words were quite suggestive. After saying this, the caller hung up.

Song Qiming’s face was expressionless, but his heart was in a state of chaos. He took a deep breath and made a call back to the country.

He waited for quite a while before the call was answered.

“Why did it take so long?”

The female voice on the other end sounded like she had just been exercising, a bit breathless, and she only said:

“Climbing the stairs, the elevator is broken.”

Song Qiming frowned. “The company’s? How is the logistics department managing things? I’ll go ask right now.”

But just then, the person on the other end immediately said:

“Eh, it’s fine, it’s fine, no need to ask. I’ve arrived.”

Song Qiming just wanted to say a few more words, but the other person seemed very busy, saying she had to go to a meeting, and only hurriedly added, “Love you.”

The night in S Province was very cold.

Having no one to talk to made it feel empty.

Song Qiming remembered his eldest son at this moment and dialed a number. Despite a hint of guilt, his brows were already furrowed.

He felt he still needed to lecture him a bit.

Why keep a bird that bites people?

However, there was no answer.

Meanwhile, at Jinyuan.

Song Yu was reading with the bird, his phone set to Do Not Disturb mode, tossed casually to the side of the table.

“Do you want to learn?”

Song Yu asked, glancing sideways. In truth, he wasn’t sure if his little bird liked to talk.

After all, since he caught it playing games… he hadn’t really heard the bird speak much.

So, he still had to respect its opinion.

The bird had just woken up, dazed. It looked down at the colorful book pages and accurately extracted a bolded dialogue box.

It was an internet meme.

The bird tilted its head, as if controlled by genetic code. It hopped once and mimicked the speech with rhythmic intonation:

“Your wife ran off with someone else.”

chunks.chineseText:
第18章

宋郁听到后怔了下，抬手把鸟从肩头拿了下来，由于担心它栽倒，甚至是用两个手捧下来的。

上下虚虚拢着。

刚挪到了膝上的书上，宋郁的虎口就被“挤”开了。

一个圆滚滚的鸟头正好卡在那里，歪头看过来，对视。

“……”

“不能学这种话，不礼貌。”

宋郁垂眸认真说道，眉毛微蹙，并不太赞成。

但鸟只是低了低头，好似不太在意，它的爪子稳稳地踩在人的掌心，时不时还会稍稍挪动下。

宋郁看着动来动去的小鸟头，其实有些走神，它到底有没有在听？

不过就在这时。

掌心的爪子一个用力。

“……”

白粼粼非常努力地往外拱自己的鸟头，他被卡在人的虎口中间了，缩也缩不回去，出也出不来。

叨了两口人肉。

发现人在走神。

再次使劲。

宋郁愣了下，因为他甚至能感觉到鸟的爪子在他掌心里打滑。

很用力了。

人有些抱歉，把自己的手给挪开了，鸟的“五指山”也终于消失了。

但白粼粼一个没控制好力度，直接啪唧平地栽倒了宋郁的掌心。

“……”

从哪里摔倒，就在哪里躺着。

鸟伸着鸟腿。

直接闭眼。

就在这时，上方传来一声轻笑。

-

时间很快就来到了六月，白粼粼隐约觉得自己好像是忘了一件重要的事。

但是他怎么也想不起来。

宋郁参加高考的那两天，鸟在家里非常自由，时不时去厨房叼上次网购的零食，偶尔也会在客厅里到处走动。

闲得没事就开电视看。

主要频道是国防军事，因为里面的飞机让鸟觉得有隐隐的亲和感。

都会飞。

考试最后一天下午，白粼粼照旧叼着一包薯片飞到了茶几那里，随后用爪子按住遥控器，打开了电视。

这个是番茄味道的。

好吃。

鸟低头咬住包装袋，然后往上一扯，稳当当地打开了。

随后开始品鉴。

如此美妙的生活。

鸟很满意，鸟还有一部手机，啪嗒啪嗒在茶几上走两圈，用爪子操作了下。

给下单了一杯元气啵啵奶茶。

白粼粼在门口等了一会，确定东西到了才飞到门把手上，努力用自身的重量往下墩墩。

直到门开了个缝隙。

鸟头鬼鬼祟祟地探了出去，确定没人之后才伸了伸喙，叼着那包装袋子往家里拖。

与此同时——

宋启明正在s州的公寓里接电话，电脑屏幕上正在加载新传输过来的监控画面，不过或许是网络不好，还在加载中。

“喂，到底又怎么了？”

宋启明其实心情不怎么样，原本父亲状态不错的时候，他是真的很高兴，今早医生说了预估的醒来时间后，他又有点担心。

会不会又骂他不成器？

宋启明接到公司那边的电话也没什么好态度，华秉现在就是个烂摊子，财务那里一直在出问题，要么是税务，要么是银行的账。

他就不知道手底下的人怎么干的！

电话那头是个年轻声音，支支吾吾地道：

“公司主楼的电梯坏了，但是后勤那里迟迟不修，财务也说……”

宋启明闻言整个人都要气炸了，他的衬衫都是皱巴的，下巴也有泛出来的青茬。

他在国外守着他老子。

公司就乱成这个样子？

宋启明完全就是震怒，这是开玩笑还是真的，他的私人电话是拿来说这些鸡毛蒜皮的事？

厉峰是怎么替他管的！

让个实习生过来打他的私人电话？

但就在这时——

“厉总说是他在忙，财务那边他管不着……您的私人电话是董事会那边……”

宋启明也不想听了，他反正过几天就要回国，到时候再处理这些乱七八糟的事。

不过他还是很在意一个点，拧眉道：

“电梯又坏了？”

“我先前吩咐过人去后勤通知全检了。”

但那边似乎是一愣，只是如实说：

“后勤那边说没有检查过……”

宋启明人有些恍惚，他心一下子静了下来，从小他就被父亲说转不过来弯，现下停了一会。

才问：

“谁告诉你我的私人电话的？”

“董事会的林董。”

电话挂了，公寓里安安静静的，宋启明自顾自站了一会，随后拧眉拿起手机改签了机票，没告诉现在身边的助理。

他深呼一口气，觉得真是乱糟糟一片，大半夜的，突然想起来大儿子了。

宋郁割腕过。

他其实一直都不知道具体抑郁原因，但说到底老师那通电话让他有了点愧疚之心，大半夜过来调监控。

宋启明拉开椅子，刚抬眼去看屏幕，神色一愣。

摄像头是安在电视屏幕的下方，很隐蔽，广角的，几乎可以看到整个客厅的全貌。

而此刻……

镜头里只有一个活物在行动，是那只鸟，明晃晃地站在茶几上，用爪子按着遥控器，似乎在换台，一边按来按去的，一边歪头把喙戳进奶茶薄膜里，在啜饮。

可那奶茶，和那鸟一样高。

宋启明整个身子都往后退了下，这很诡异。

是他要猝死了？

男人抬手就把屏幕给关了。

与此同时，白粼粼在用爪子换台的时候，突然发现电视下方有个红点闪了下。

欸？

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走过去。

这边。

宋启明深呼吸一口气，觉得又不像是猝死前的幻觉，毕竟他感觉还好，没有心悸。

大约缓了一会。

他本来打算准备去休息了，但是又想要确定一下，于是就又打开了监控。

估计是看错了。

宋启明还在这么想着，此刻的电脑页面还在加载中，在夜里发着幽幽的光。

一秒，两秒。

黑屏的屏幕突然闪了一下。

然后出现了个巨大的鸟头。

“啊啊——”

宋启明被吓得脸色惨白，心脏快速地跳动，他硬撑着把电脑给关了。

呼吸都变得急促。

在他的视角下，先前那鸟还在茶几那里，结果这次直接突脸了。

这是什么东西……

怪物，怪物。

-

鸟不知道自己成了什么可怖的存在，只是歪头盯着那个小红点。

非常隐蔽。

白粼粼甚至试图去叨一口，后面才反应过来这应该是微型摄像头。

啊。

他给忘了这件事了。

白粼粼：“……”

那闪了红灯是什么意思，对面有人开机了么？

宋郁的爹？

“……”

鸟回头看了下茶几上的一堆东西，沉默了一会，随后扑棱翅膀飞了过去。

开始愤愤不平地叼着包装袋扔垃圾桶。

如此循环往复。

越想越气。

可恶的宋启明，知不知道不经他人允许安装监控是违法的？

侵犯人权！

还有鸟权！

白粼粼看电视的好心情都没了，砰砰跳跳地站在了垃圾桶的盖子上，把茶几恢复了原貌。

“……”

应该不会有事吧？

当天晚上宋郁就接到了父亲的电话，那时鸟和人正在卧室的书桌前看书。

是与填报志愿相关的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 18

Song Yu was stunned when he heard this. He reached out and took the bird off his shoulder, even using both hands to cup it for fear it might tumble.

He held it loosely.

Just as he moved it onto the book on his lap, Song Yu’s thumb-web was “squeezed” open.

A round bird head was wedged right in there, tilting to look at him, eye to eye.

“……”

“You can’t learn words like that. It’s impolite.”

Song Yu lowered his eyes and said earnestly, his brows slightly furrowed, clearly not approving.

But the bird just lowered its head, seemingly indifferent. Its claws stepped firmly on the person’s palm, occasionally shifting slightly.

Song Yu looked at the bobbing little bird head, actually losing focus. Was it even listening?

But just then.

The claws in his palm exerted force.

“……”

Bai Linlin was trying very hard to push his bird head out. He was stuck in the web of the person’s hand, unable to shrink back or get out.

He pecked at the human skin twice.

He realized the person was distracted.

He pushed again with all his might.

Song Yu was startled, because he could even feel the bird’s claws slipping in his palm.

It was using a lot of strength.

The man felt a bit apologetic and moved his hand away, and the “Five Finger Mountain” finally disappeared.

But Bai Linlin, failing to control his force, plopped flat onto Song Yu’s palm.

“……”

Where he fell, he stayed.

The bird stretched out its legs.

And closed its eyes.

Just then, a light chuckle came from above.

-

Time quickly arrived in June. Bai Linlin vaguely felt that he had forgotten something important.

But he couldn’t remember it no matter what.

During the two days Song Yu took the college entrance exam, the bird was very free at home, occasionally going to the kitchen to snatch the snacks he’d ordered online, and sometimes walking around the living room.

When bored, he would turn on the TV.

The main channel was National Defense and Military, because the planes inside gave the bird a faint sense of affinity.

They could all fly.

On the afternoon of the last day of the exam, Bai Linlin flew to the coffee table with a bag of potato chips as usual, then used his claws to press the remote control and turned on the TV.

This one was tomato flavored.

Delicious.

The bird lowered its head, bit the packaging, and gave it a tug, opening it steadily.

Then he began to savor it.

Such a wonderful life.

The bird was very satisfied. The bird also had a phone; he walked around the coffee table with a *patter-patter*, operated it with his claws, and ordered a cup of milk tea with boba.

Bai Linlin waited at the door for a while, and once he confirmed the item had arrived, he flew to the doorknob, trying hard to use his own weight to press down on it.

Until the door opened a crack.

The bird head poked out sneakily, and after confirming no one was there, he stretched out his beak, dragging the packaging bag into the house.

At the same time—

Song Qiming was answering a phone call in his apartment in S Province. The computer screen was loading a newly transmitted surveillance feed, though perhaps due to a bad connection, it was still loading.

“Hello, what’s wrong again?”

Song Qiming wasn’t in a good mood. When his father was in good condition, he was truly happy, but after the doctor mentioned the estimated time for him to wake up this morning, he became worried again.

Would he scold him for being incompetent again?

Song Qiming didn’t have a good attitude when receiving calls from the company either. Huabing was a mess right now; the finance department kept having issues—either tax problems or bank account discrepancies.

He didn’t know how the people under him were working!

The voice on the other end was young and stuttering:

“The elevator in the main building of the company is broken, but the logistics department keeps delaying the repairs, and finance also says…”

Song Qiming was furious upon hearing this. His shirt was wrinkled, and there was stubble on his chin.

He was guarding his father abroad.

And the company was in such a state?

Song Qiming was completely enraged. Was this a joke or for real? Was his private number meant for these trivial matters?

How was Li Feng managing things for him?

Letting an intern call his private number?

But just then—

“President Li said he’s busy, and he can’t control the finance side… Your private number is from the board of directors…”

Song Qiming didn’t want to listen anymore. He was going back to the country in a few days anyway, and he would deal with this mess then.

However, he was still concerned about one point, and he frowned:

“The elevator is broken again?”

“I previously ordered someone to notify logistics for a full inspection.”

But the other side seemed to pause, only saying truthfully:

“Logistics said they haven’t inspected it…”

Song Qiming felt a bit dazed. His heart suddenly went quiet. Since he was a child, his father had said he couldn’t turn a corner, and now he paused for a moment.

Then he asked:

“Who told you my private number?”

“Director Lin from the board.”

The call hung up. The apartment was quiet. Song Qiming stood there for a while, then frowned and picked up his phone to change his flight, without telling the assistant currently with him.

He took a deep breath, feeling it was all a mess. In the middle of the night, he suddenly thought of his eldest son.

Song Yu had slit his wrists.

He actually never knew the specific reason for his depression, but in the end, the teacher’s call had given him a sense of guilt, so he came to check the surveillance in the middle of the night.

Song Qiming pulled out the chair, and as he looked up at the screen, his expression froze.

The camera was installed under the TV screen, very hidden, wide-angle, almost capturing the entire living room.

And at this moment…

There was only one living creature moving in the frame. It was that bird, standing brightly on the coffee table, pressing the remote with its claws, seemingly changing channels. While pressing back and forth, it tilted its head and poked its beak into the milk tea film, sipping.

But that milk tea was as tall as the bird.

Song Qiming’s whole body recoiled. This was very eerie.

Was he about to die of a sudden heart attack?

The man reached out and turned off the screen.

At the same time, when Bai Linlin was changing channels with his claws, he suddenly noticed a red dot flashing under the TV.

Eh?

The bird walked over with a *patter-patter*.

Here.

Song Qiming took a deep breath, feeling it wasn’t a hallucination before death; after all, he felt fine, no palpitations.

After calming down for a while.

He had intended to go rest, but he wanted to be sure, so he opened the surveillance again.

Probably saw it wrong.

Song Qiming was still thinking this, and the computer page was still loading, emitting a ghostly light in the night.

One second, two seconds.

The black screen suddenly flashed.

And then a giant bird head appeared.

“Ahhh—”

Song Qiming was scared pale, his heart beating rapidly. He braced himself and turned off the computer.

His breathing became rapid.

From his perspective, the bird was just on the coffee table, but this time it was directly in his face.

What is this thing…

Monster, monster.

-

The bird didn’t know he had become such a terrifying existence; he just tilted his head and stared at that little red dot.

Very hidden.

Bai Linlin even tried to peck at it, only realizing later that this should be a micro-camera.

Ah.

He had forgotten about this.

Bai Linlin: “……”

What did the flashing red light mean? Was someone on the other side turning it on?

Song Yu’s dad?

“……”

The bird looked back at the pile of things on the coffee table, was silent for a while, then flapped his wings and flew over.

He began to indignantly pick up the packaging bags and throw them into the trash can.

Repeating the cycle.

The more he thought about it, the angrier he got.

Detestable Song Qiming, did he know that installing surveillance without others’ permission was illegal?

It violated human rights!

And bird rights!

Bai Linlin lost his good mood for watching TV. He hopped onto the lid of the trash can and restored the coffee table to its original state.

“……”

Nothing should happen, right?

That night, Song Yu received a call from his father. At that time, the bird and the person were reading at the desk in the bedroom.

It was related to filling out college applications.

chunks.chineseText:
“我说了我不出国。”

宋郁再度重申道，面色没有什么情绪，他手边还站着一只圆滚滚的鸟，此刻正全神贯注地偷听。

爪子都紧了紧。

白粼粼是有点担心的。

毕竟“人”还很小，万一听了家长的建议，真的不要他了怎么办？

“小郁，爸爸不是说这个的，你想在国内读，可以，都可以。”

“但你要听爸爸说，你养的那个鸟真得不能留了。”

因为是晚上，所以房间格外得安静，听筒里的声音也很清楚。

白粼粼听到了。

鸟低着头，磨了磨喙。

要是有机会见面非得叨他一口！

不，两口！

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，很直截了当地问：“有别的事么？我挂了。”

但那边却很急，甚至直接坦白了客厅那里装了监控的事，很耐着性子道：

“小郁真的，听爸爸的，你把那鸟送人也行，卖了也行，无论如何不要留了。”

“它成了精的。”

本来氛围还是很严肃的，但是在电话里传出来那句压着语气、很谨慎的话之后。

“……”

宋郁愣了下，也不知道该说什么，甚至监控那件事引起的厌恶感都被压下去了些。

“你不要不信啊，爸爸今天看监控了，你那鸟，它会开电视！”

“……”

宋郁没有回复，但那边却像是激动了起来，怕他不信，又列举了其他的。

“会用遥控器。”

“……”

“它还喝奶茶。”

“……”

白粼粼整个鸟都要黑化了，它不止要叨两口，它要叨四五六七八口！

乱说什么呢！

但他还是有点担心，仰头去看宋郁，巴巴地往人的手臂那里挪了挪。

人似乎是察觉到了目光，垂眸看了过来，刚想说些什么，但听筒那里还在继续。

“我想了想，你爷爷也和我说过类似的事，说是从军那会儿在山里遇到的……总之这肯定是妖邪！”

宋郁面色变得不愉，只是一字一句道：

“你看错了。”

“它就是个普通的小鸟。”

在挂断电话的最后一秒——

“有病就去治。”

原话还了回去，曾经宋启明也这么同他说过这句话，当着医生的面。

有些时候真奇怪，父亲这个角色总是扮演着背景板的作用，所谓的“关怀”永远是口头上的，实际上的行为是没有的。

宋郁有些时候会被宋启明骗过去，觉得他其实还爱自己，但后来才发现。

这种人的爱犹如街边的宣传单，人手一份，拿着碍事，丢了污染环境。

他不再是个孩子了。

-

房间里安安静静的，鸟说不感动是不可能的，啪嗒啪嗒在人的胳膊上走了几步。

深情对视。

宋郁回了回神，第一句就是；

“你喝奶茶了？”

鸟立即掉头，尾羽长长，一往上翘就是要起飞。

宋郁抬手就在半空中握住了。

白粼粼：“……”

为什么为什么为什么！

鸟腿无力里挣扎了两下。

最后认命了。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：啪嗒啪嗒走过来，低头——

啵啵。
chunks.englishText:
"I told you, I’m not going abroad."

Song Yu reiterated, his expression devoid of emotion. Beside him stood a round, chubby bird, currently listening in with rapt attention.

Its claws tightened slightly.

Bai Linlin was a little worried.

After all, this "human" was still very young. What if he listened to his parents' advice and really decided to abandon him?

"Xiao Yu, that’s not what Dad meant. If you want to study in the country, that’s fine, anything is fine."

"But you have to listen to me—that bird you’re keeping really cannot stay."

Because it was nighttime, the room was exceptionally quiet, and the voice coming from the receiver was very clear.

Bai Linlin heard it.

The bird lowered its head and ground its beak.

If he ever got the chance to meet him, he’d definitely give him a peck!

No, two pecks!

Song Yu frowned and asked very bluntly, "Is there anything else? I’m hanging up."

But the person on the other end was anxious, even going so far as to confess that they had installed surveillance in the living room. They said with great patience:

"Xiao Yu, really, listen to Dad. You can give the bird away, or sell it—just don’t keep it no matter what."

"It’s become a spirit."

The atmosphere had been quite serious, but after that cautious, hushed sentence came through the phone—

"..."

Song Yu was stunned. He didn't know what to say; even the disgust he felt regarding the surveillance was somewhat suppressed.

"Don't just brush me off! Dad checked the surveillance today; that bird of yours, it knows how to turn on the TV!"

"..."

Song Yu didn't reply, but the person on the other end seemed to grow agitated, fearing he wouldn't believe them, and began listing other things.

"It knows how to use the remote control."

"..."

"It even drinks milk tea."

"..."

Bai Linlin felt like his entire bird soul was turning dark. He didn't just want to give him two pecks anymore; he wanted to give him four, five, six, seven, eight pecks!

Talking nonsense!

But he was still a little worried. He tilted his head to look at Song Yu, and with a pitiful air, he shuffled closer to the human's arm.

The human seemed to notice the gaze and looked down, just about to say something, but the voice on the receiver continued.

"I’ve thought about it. Your grandfather once told me something similar, about something he encountered in the mountains when he was in the army... In short, this must be some kind of evil spirit!"

Song Yu’s expression turned unpleasant. He said, word for word:

"You saw it wrong."

"It’s just an ordinary little bird."

In the final second before hanging up—

"If you're sick, go get treated."

He threw the original words back at him. Song Qiming had once said this very thing to him, right in front of a doctor.

Sometimes it was truly strange. The role of "father" always played the part of a backdrop; so-called "care" was always just lip service, with no actual actions to back it up.

There were times when Song Yu would be fooled by Song Qiming, thinking that he actually still loved him, but later he realized:

The love of such a person was like a flyer on the street—everyone got one, it was a nuisance to hold, and it polluted the environment if you threw it away.

He was no longer a child.

-

The room was quiet. It would be impossible for the bird to say he wasn't touched. He walked patter-patter along the human's arm.

A soulful gaze was exchanged.

Song Yu collected his thoughts, and his first sentence was:

"You drank milk tea?"

The bird immediately turned around, his long tail feathers flicking up, ready to take flight.

Song Yu raised his hand and caught him in mid-air.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Why, why, why!

The bird's legs struggled weakly.

In the end, he resigned himself to his fate.

Author's Note:

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Walks over patter-patter, lowers head—

*Smooch.*

chunks.chineseText:
第19章

宋郁低头看着掌心的鸟，鸟头倔强地歪着，颇有几分骨气。

“你能喝奶茶么？”

宋郁换了个问法，他其实也只是担心，但奈何这段时间来鸟做出来的“出格”事太多了，一时半会他居然也没有太震惊。

只是觉得。

奶茶，不太健康。

宋郁抬手把鸟放回了自己肩头，自顾自地开始看手机，搜了些相关问答。

白粼粼这才活动了下身躯，他伸了伸翅根，很认真地反思了下自己。

怎么每次都被抓住！

这不合理！

鸟在人肩头挪了挪位置，又去低头看手机。

屏幕上显示人在打字输入：

[鹦鹉误喝了奶茶……]

宋郁看到弹出来的页面其实也很混乱，有些五花八门的视频，不过都是各种小鸟偷吃人类食物的。

没有确切地说会不会出问题。

他只好又切了软件。

白粼粼很是认真地在旁边看，发现“人”找出了微信的联系人，然后在打字。

上面显示的姓名。

——黎笙。

！！

那个讨厌的人类。

白粼粼刚想一顿啾啾啾，但没想到宋郁手指停顿了下，随后把所有输入的字全部删除了。

？

少年坐在书桌前面，暖黄的灯光打下来，显得面容少了些冷郁，眼尾的痣也若隐若现的。

宋郁只是侧头看了过来，“我不问了。”

“没事。”

人好似在和鸟说话。

又好像在和自己说话。

白粼粼确实是有些安心的，毕竟没有什么比可以“做自己”更有诱惑力了的。

他是一只有秘密的小鸟。

而“人”，看起来是可以共享秘密的对象。

白粼粼在人肩头挪了挪位置，歪头看了过去……

“啾啾。”

-

第二天一早。

宋郁就请了专业的人上门，里里外外把家里检查了一边。

最终也只是在客厅电视那里找到一个摄像头，其余位置并没有探测到。

宋启明倒是没有在这件事上骗人。

就在这时。

“你这小鸟……会说话吗？”

上门检查的人本来都在地板上收拾工具包了，但是又仰头看了好几眼雇主肩头的那只，还是没忍住问。

或许是担心被误解，这位中年人立马道：

“我女儿也想养小鸟，我看了看，应该也是鹦鹉，就是不是孩子你这种的颜色的……”

宋郁刚从冰箱里拿出一瓶水，抬手很自然地递给对方了，闻言很平和地道：

“鹦鹉需要陪伴，养宠并不能一时兴起，还是需要好好考虑。”

对面男人似乎是有些脸红，但是他搓了搓手，还是不好意思地解释：

“我知道我知道，就是我女儿一直在医院化疗，这段时间好了点，医生说能回家一段时间了，她看视频看到了鹦鹉了，说要，我就想着帮她买一个。”

“会好好养的，会好好养的。”

宋郁愣住了，他没有想到会是这样的事，但还没来得及回话，对方又自顾自地道：

“要是能说话就好了。”

“乐乐在家里也不会太无聊。”

宋郁张了张口，最后还是说了句，“抱歉，我不知道。”

对面男人也一愣，笑了，挠了挠头，“没事没事，我家孩子很乐观，医生说很有希望能配型成功的。”

“谁没个不顺心的事呢？”

男人抬手把工具包背在身上，肩背硬朗，面容宽和，临走前目光不经意地朝下看了一眼，同宋郁道：

“你也要好好生活，这么年轻，身体素质正是好的时候。”

“外头有不少好风景呢。”

或许是太久没有应对过这种纯粹的善意，宋郁几乎怔住了，只是顺着对方的视线看了下自己的手腕。

他忘了，夏天了。

遮不住。

最后还是鸟接上了话头，板板正正地学舌：

“祝你全家身体健康，无病无灾，万事顺意，天天开心！”

语气抑扬顿挫的。

很有劲儿。

男人很明显眼睛亮了起来，甚至还对小鸟作了作揖，朗声笑了笑，很感谢道：

“好好好，承小鸟吉言了！”

宋郁此刻也回了神，送人到了玄关门口，对方似乎心情不错，挥了挥手：

“那再见了？”

“再见。”

这世界上总是有形形色色的人，有自私、懦弱、卑劣的人……但也有无私、勇敢、赤诚的人。

长久地待在阴影里，偶然被拉了出来，最先感受到的不是阳光的温暖，其实是不适应。

宋郁在那人走了之后，在原地站了一会，而后抬起了自己的左手。

凌乱的疤痕。

还有细碎的划痕。

宋郁其实不是单纯地因为那个男人的话而触动，他只是恍惚地发现……自己不知道什么时候，完全忘记了疤痕。

是从哪里开始？

是几月？

正在他很混乱地思考着的时候，唇边有毛绒绒的东西顶了过来。

宋郁低头看了过去，小鸟正持之以恒地往这边贴贴，注意到自己转头后，还歪了歪头。

“啾啾？”

此刻外面日头上升，蝉鸣开始奏乐。

夏天，到了。

-

宋郁的高考成绩非常好，是在当天查分发现被屏蔽了那种，后续才得知是考了七百分以上。

不仅班主任很满意，就连宋启明都很高兴，打电话说是要大办一场升学宴。

但宋郁对此反应平平。

仿佛那是一场与他无关的狂欢。

江芮也打来了电话，言语之间也是满意，也忘了前段时间的矛盾，只是问了句：

“宋启明只是说给你办宴么？”

此刻锦园这里，宋郁在书桌前剥开心果，眉眼平静，手机就在那里放着，开了免提。

“是。”

“他没承诺别的？”

宋郁动作慢了半拍，心想又是这样，但就在这时，他的虎口处传来很痒的触感。

鸟在伸爪子上来，准备自己叨。

稳当当的。

但刚低头准备——

“没有，怎么了？”

宋郁抬手把果壳挤掉，习惯的把果肉捏到了另外一个手里，而这导致鸟伸头叨了个空。

！

白粼粼又费劲巴拉地在宋郁的手上挪动，准备到那只手去，还伸了伸翅膀以维持平衡。

与此同时。

“呵，借宴会来拉商业合作吧，老一套。”

“妈妈送你一套房子！”

江芮那边似乎是舒坦多了，连带着还有了点温情了，多问了几句宋郁的近况。

——吃没吃饭？

——有打算出去玩么？

——交朋友了么？

好似他们中间没有任何隔阂，是天底下最正常的一对母子。

宋郁垂着眼眸，都如实回答了，但面色并没有什么大的波动。

他想要等等。

看江芮还能找出什么话题。

但是没有了。

因为那边的保姆已经在叫她了，大抵是那个孩子又发病了。

两分三十秒。

挂断了。

宋郁看了下手机屏幕，没有什么意外，江芮找他永远是有事的。

总是绕不开宋启明。

永远在比。

尽管这场比赛没有奖品。

“啾啾！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 19

Song Yu looked down at the bird in his palm. The bird’s head was tilted stubbornly, showing quite a bit of backbone.

"Can you even drink milk tea?"

Song Yu changed the way he asked. He was actually just worried, but given the many "outrageous" things the bird had done recently, he wasn't even that shocked for the moment.

He just felt that...

Milk tea wasn't very healthy.

Song Yu lifted his hand and placed the bird back on his shoulder, then proceeded to look at his phone, searching for related Q&As.

Only then did Bai Linlin stretch his body. He extended his wing roots and reflected on himself very seriously.

Why does he get caught every single time!

This is unreasonable!

The bird shifted his position on the human's shoulder and leaned down to look at the phone.

The screen showed the human typing:

[Parrot accidentally drank milk tea...]

The pages that popped up were actually quite chaotic, filled with all sorts of videos of various birds stealing human food.

There was nothing definitive about whether it would cause problems.

He had no choice but to switch apps.

Bai Linlin watched very intently from the side and discovered that the "human" had pulled up his WeChat contacts and was typing.

The name displayed above.

—Li Sheng.

!!

That annoying human.

Bai Linlin was just about to let out a flurry of chirps, but to his surprise, Song Yu’s fingers paused, and then he deleted everything he had typed.

?

The youth sat in front of the desk, the warm yellow light casting down, making his face look less cold and gloomy, the mole at the corner of his eye appearing and disappearing.

Song Yu just turned his head to look over. "I won't ask."

"It's fine."

The human seemed to be talking to the bird.

And also seemed to be talking to himself.

Bai Linlin was indeed somewhat relieved. After all, nothing was more tempting than being able to "be himself."

He was a little bird with secrets.

And the "human" seemed like someone he could share those secrets with.

Bai Linlin shifted his position on the human's shoulder and tilted his head to look over...

"Chirp, chirp."

-

The next morning.

Song Yu hired professionals to come over and inspect the house from top to bottom.

In the end, they only found one camera by the living room TV; no others were detected.

Song Qiming hadn't lied about that, at least.

Just then.

"This little bird of yours... can it talk?"

The inspector, who had been packing up his tool bag on the floor, looked up at the one on the employer's shoulder several times before finally unable to resist asking.

Perhaps worried about being misunderstood, the middle-aged man immediately added:

"My daughter wants to keep a bird too. I took a look, it should be a parrot, just not the same color as yours..."

Song Yu had just taken a bottle of water from the fridge and handed it to the man naturally. Hearing this, he said calmly:

"Parrots need companionship. Keeping a pet shouldn't be a whim; it’s still best to consider it carefully."

The man across from him seemed to blush, but he rubbed his hands together and explained sheepishly:

"I know, I know. It’s just that my daughter has been in the hospital for chemotherapy. She’s been a bit better lately, and the doctor said she could come home for a while. She saw parrots in videos and said she wanted one, so I thought I’d help her buy one."

"We'll take good care of it, we really will."

Song Yu was stunned. He hadn't expected such a situation, but before he could reply, the man continued on his own:

"It would be great if it could talk."

"Lele wouldn't be so bored at home."

Song Yu opened his mouth, but in the end, he only said, "I'm sorry, I didn't know."

The man was also taken aback, then laughed and scratched his head. "It's fine, it's fine. My child is very optimistic. The doctor said there's a high hope for a successful match."

"Who doesn't have their share of troubles?"

The man hoisted his tool bag onto his back. His shoulders were broad, his face kind. Before leaving, his gaze inadvertently swept downward, and he said to Song Yu:

"You should live well, too. You're so young, your physical health is in its prime."

"There's a lot of beautiful scenery out there."

Perhaps it had been too long since he had dealt with such pure kindness, but Song Yu was almost frozen, merely following the man's gaze to look at his own wrists.

He had forgotten. It was summer.

He couldn't hide them.

In the end, it was the bird who picked up the conversation, mimicking the man’s tone perfectly:

"Wishing your whole family good health, free from illness and disaster, may everything go as you wish, and may you be happy every day!"

The tone was full of cadence.

Very spirited.

The man’s eyes clearly lit up. He even bowed to the little bird and laughed heartily, thanking him sincerely:

"Good, good, good! I’ll take the little bird’s kind words!"

Song Yu finally came to his senses and saw the man to the entryway. The man seemed to be in a good mood and waved his hand:

"See you then?"

"Goodbye."

There are all kinds of people in this world. There are selfish, cowardly, and despicable ones... but there are also selfless, brave, and sincere ones.

Having stayed in the shadows for so long, being pulled out suddenly, what one feels first isn't the warmth of the sun, but rather, discomfort.

After the man left, Song Yu stood in place for a while, then raised his left hand.

Messy scars.

And fine scratches.

Song Yu wasn't moved simply because of the man's words; he was just dazed to discover... he had completely forgotten about the scars at some point.

Where did it start?

Which month was it?

Just as he was thinking in a confused state, something fluffy nudged against his lips.

Song Yu looked down. The little bird was persistently pressing against him, and noticing that he had turned his head, the bird tilted his head as well.

"Chirp?"

Outside, the sun was rising, and the cicadas began their symphony.

Summer had arrived.

-

Song Yu’s college entrance exam scores were excellent. He found out on the day he checked them that his results had been "shielded," and only later learned he had scored over seven hundred points.

Not only was his homeroom teacher satisfied, but even Song Qiming was overjoyed, calling to say he wanted to throw a grand graduation banquet.

But Song Yu’s reaction was lukewarm.

As if it were a carnival that had nothing to do with him.

Jiang Rui also called. Her words were full of satisfaction, having forgotten their recent conflicts, and she simply asked:

"Did Song Qiming only say he was throwing a banquet for you?"

At the Jin Garden, Song Yu was shelling pistachios at his desk, his expression calm. The phone was lying there on speaker.

"Yes."

"He didn't promise anything else?"

Song Yu’s movements slowed by half a beat. He thought, *Here we go again.* But just then, he felt a ticklish sensation on the web of his hand.

The bird was reaching out with his claw, preparing to grab a nut himself.

Steady as a rock.

But just as he lowered his head to prepare—

"No, why?"

Song Yu raised his hand to flick away the shell, habitually pinching the nut meat into his other hand, which caused the bird to stretch his head and grab at nothing.

!

Bai Linlin struggled to move across Song Yu’s hand, preparing to go to the other one, even stretching his wings to maintain his balance.

At the same time.

"Hmph, using the banquet to pull in business deals, as usual."

"Mom will buy you an apartment!"

Jiang Rui seemed much more at ease on the other end, even carrying a hint of warmth as she asked a few more questions about Song Yu’s recent life.

—Have you eaten?

—Do you have plans to go out and play?

—Have you made any friends?

As if there were no barriers between them, as if they were the most normal pair of mother and son in the world.

Song Yu lowered his eyes and answered truthfully, but his expression didn't show much fluctuation.

He wanted to wait.

To see what other topics Jiang Rui could find.

But there were none.

Because the nanny on the other end was already calling her; presumably, that child was having another episode.

Two minutes and thirty seconds.

She hung up.

Song Yu looked at his phone screen. It was no surprise; Jiang Rui only ever had a reason when she looked for him.

It always revolved around Song Qiming.

Always comparing.

Even though there was no prize for this competition.

"Chirp!"

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁回了回神，低头看向了桌面，这才发现自己把果仁捏在掌心了，旁边的鸟正在仰头看着自己，一副到底要怎样的表情。

“……”

“不好意思。”

其实时间久了，宋郁也能发现点问题，他的小鸟会学舌，但是不太爱说话。

于是“人”问了下。

鸟正在沉浸式进食，圆滚滚的脑袋动来动去的，像个小和尚。

“可以和我说话的。”

宋郁又轻声道。

白粼粼吃完了，扑棱扑棱翅膀就准备——

这次甚至还没有起飞。

直接被握住了。

“……”

宋郁是真的不明白，小鸟上次分明对那个上门的服务人员说话了，还是吉祥话。

为什么不和他说话？

“啾啾啾。”

白粼粼伸了伸鸟腿，试图往上拱，拱不出去，往下缩，缩不出去。

这到底是怎么逮的！

“是不喜欢我么？”

宋郁垂眸看着鸟，很平静地问。

白粼粼：“……”

不是！

不是不是！

其实是因为鹦鹉学舌的声音有点“瓜”，闷闷的，而且有种莫名其妙的“抑扬顿挫”。

白粼粼觉得和自己原来的“人声”有点差别。

显得笨笨的。

况且在宋郁面前打游戏那次……他辱骂了人机队友，这虽然是正义之举，但严重损坏了鸟的正面形象。

简而言之。

鸟有包袱。

但现在来不及解释了。

“宋-郁。”

少年眼底泛起了些涟漪，抬眼看着手里的小鸟，它知道自己的名字。

“喜-欢。”

白粼粼实在是没办法了，只能很认真地说话，闷头闷脑的，鸟爪都缩成一团了，有点羞耻。

但就在他觉得这总不会有问题了的时候——

“听不到。”

“……”

人，不要太过分了。

-

而江芮这边则是带着“女儿”去了躺医院，旁边还是那个保姆，总之又是做了一趟检查。

医生蹙了蹙眉，问了下：

“孩子父亲呢？”

江芮面无表情地道：“他没空，母亲在不就行了？”

医生只好叹了口气，很诚恳地劝道，“这个基本治疗不了，这孩子暴虐的性子是基因里带着的，同时，几乎是板上钉钉了。”

“应当是遗传父亲那里的。”

“我是建议不要再要孩子了。”

就诊室内一片死寂。

保姆在后面的椅子上，抱着那个好不容易睡着的孩子，一直低着头。

医生拿着报告解释：

“不然很可能还出现些类似的问题，隐性基因是不好筛出来的，有很多疾病是有潜伏期的。”

“我知道了。”

江芮面无表情地道，似乎没怎么在意，只是提着自己的包出了就诊室。

等到回了家中。

保姆还是照常去隔壁房间照看孩子，江芮在卧室换了睡袍，低头看了看那封请柬。

——升学宴。

日期都定下来了。

宋启明终于舍得回国了？

-

半个月后。

白粼粼这段时间莫名觉得很困，有时候站在宋郁肩头都会栽下来。

羽毛本来就蓬松。

在掌心更是成了个“球”。

鸟不知道是自己吃了太多垃圾食品了还是怎么的，最近胃口也变差了。

QQ糖也不吃了。

奶酪棒也不啃了。

形势实在是很严峻，以至于宋郁在发现后立即给带到了黎笙所在的异宠医院，但检查结果却是一切正常，甚至还长胖了几克。

“……”

宋郁没有什么办法，只能猜测是鸟前几天打游戏太晚了的缘故，不过还是一直守着，大多是放在肩头，偶尔会滑到衣襟上，鸟头就卡在人的锁骨那里。

圆滚滚的，睡梦里还在咂巴咂巴喙。

而此时另一边的南市小巷里。

一只灰扑扑的信鸽飞得是有气无力，最后在路边的高压线上停下来了，脖子上还挂着个小包袱，整个鸟都怨气冲天。

它迷路了。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu collected his thoughts and looked down at the tabletop, only then realizing he was still holding the nut meat in his palm. The bird beside him was looking up at him, wearing an expression that seemed to ask, *Well, what exactly is going on?*

"..."

"Sorry."

Actually, after a long time, Song Yu could also notice some issues. His little bird could mimic speech, but he didn't really like to talk.

So the "human" asked.

The bird was immersed in eating, his round head bobbing back and forth like a little monk.

"You can talk to me."

Song Yu said softly again.

Bai Linlin finished eating, flapped his wings, and prepared to—

This time, he hadn't even taken off yet.

He was caught directly.

"..."

Song Yu really didn't understand. The little bird had clearly spoken to the service worker who came over, and even said auspicious words.

Why wouldn't he talk to him?

"Chirp, chirp, chirp."

Bai Linlin stretched his bird legs, trying to push upward, but couldn't get out; he tried to shrink downward, but couldn't get out.

How on earth does he catch me like this!

"Do you not like me?"

Song Yu looked down at the bird and asked calmly.

Bai Linlin: "..."

No!

No, no, no!

Actually, it was because the parrot's mimicry sounded a bit "goofy," muffled, and had an inexplicable "cadence" to it.

Bai Linlin felt it was a bit different from his original "human voice."

It made him seem stupid.

Besides, that time he played games in front of Song Yu... he had cursed at his AI teammates. Although that was an act of justice, it had severely damaged the bird's positive image.

In short.

The bird had an ego.

But there was no time to explain now.

"Song—Yu."

Ripples appeared in the youth's eyes as he looked at the little bird in his hand. It knew his name.

"Like—you."

Bai Linlin really had no other choice. He had to speak very seriously, his head tucked in, his bird claws curled into a ball. It was a bit shameful.

But just when he thought there wouldn't be any problems this time—

"I can't hear you."

"..."

Human, don't go too far.

-

Meanwhile, Jiang Rui took her "daughter" to the hospital, accompanied by the same nanny. In short, they went through another round of check-ups.

The doctor frowned and asked:

"Where is the child's father?"

Jiang Rui said expressionlessly, "He’s busy. Isn't it enough that the mother is here?"

The doctor could only sigh and advise sincerely, "This is basically untreatable. The child's violent nature is in her genes, and at the same time, it’s almost a certainty."

"It should be inherited from the father's side."

"I suggest not having any more children."

The examination room fell into a dead silence.

The nanny sat on a chair in the back, holding the child who had finally fallen asleep, her head bowed the entire time.

The doctor held the report and explained:

"Otherwise, it's very likely that similar problems will appear. Recessive genes are hard to screen for, and many diseases have incubation periods."

"I understand."

Jiang Rui said expressionlessly, seemingly not caring much, and just picked up her bag and walked out of the examination room.

When she returned home.

The nanny went to the next room to look after the child as usual. Jiang Rui changed into her pajamas in the bedroom and looked down at the invitation.

—Graduation banquet.

The date had already been set.

Song Qiming was finally willing to return to the country?

-

Half a month later.

Bai Linlin had been feeling inexplicably sleepy lately. Sometimes he would even fall over while standing on Song Yu’s shoulder.

His feathers were already fluffy.

In the palm of a hand, he became even more of a "ball."

The bird didn't know if it was because he had eaten too much junk food or what, but his appetite had been poor recently.

He didn't eat his QQ gummies anymore.

He didn't gnaw on his cheese sticks either.

The situation was truly dire, so much so that after Song Yu discovered it, he immediately took him to the exotic pet hospital where Li Sheng worked. However, the check-up results showed everything was normal, and he had even gained a few grams.

"..."

Song Yu had no other choice but to guess it was because the bird had stayed up too late playing games a few days ago. Still, he kept a constant watch over him, mostly keeping him on his shoulder, occasionally letting him slide into his collar, where the bird’s head would get stuck near his collarbone.

Round and chubby, he would still be smacking his beak in his sleep.

Meanwhile, in a small alley in Nanshi on the other side of the city.

A dusty carrier pigeon was flying listlessly, finally stopping on a high-voltage wire by the roadside. It had a small bundle hanging around its neck, and the entire bird was filled with towering resentment.

It was lost.

chunks.chineseText:
第20章

信鸽在高压线上歇了一会脚，四处探头看了看，这地方的路是怎么修的？

歪歪扭扭的。

中央那里就横平竖直的，信鸽扑棱了下翅膀，又试着去闻了闻味道，这是它导航的一个重要参考因素。

严肃jpg.

“烤肉烤肉！一块五一串！走过路过不要错过！”

“蓝莓冰沙摇摇乐，九块九超值五百毫升，送南市古楼冰箱贴！”

“芋泥奶油小蛋糕，免费品尝……”

街边的声音此起彼伏，伴随着各种交错的香气，美食街这里车水马龙的，人员流动非常大。

信鸽：“……”

事已至此，先吃饭吧。

风尘仆仆的信鸽伸了伸翅膀，飞到了一个非常隐蔽的拐角处，过了一会，里面出来一个穿着邮局制服的青年，很熟练地来到了摊子面前。

“老板，我要免费品尝的芋泥小蛋糕。”

“……”

-

与此同时的锦园，白粼粼终于睡醒了，在宋郁的衣襟边边挂着，张了张肉色的小短喙。

打了个哈欠。

有点懵。

晚上了？

宋郁垂眸看到鸟醒了，用瓶盖接了点水，低头去喂，他的视角下只能看到圆滚滚的鸟头。

动来动去的。

看着总算是有点精神了。

白粼粼这才发现自己睡到宋郁身上去了，鸟爪子都在对方的衣服里，唯一露出来的就是个鸟头。

“……”

他努力地往上拱了拱，想要出来，但是看到“人”递过来水之后，又发现确实是有点渴了。

开始老老实实地小口啜饮。

是白开水。

鸟品鉴了一会，咂巴咂巴喙，然后斜眼看到了桌子上一瓶饮料。

“啾！”

当即就是仰着鸟头。

宋郁其实有点不解，但在低着头看鸟，怎么不喝了？

直到——

“脉-动。”

板板正正的声音传来。

鸟眼圆圆的，很是睿智。

“……”

宋郁最后给鸟开了那瓶功能饮料，抬手倒在了瓶盖里，他看了眼瓶身。

水蜜桃味的。

鸟似乎很喜欢，刚被放到桌上就啪嗒啪嗒走了过去，低头一顿喝。

还伸了伸翅根。

很满意了。

宋郁面色温和，只是抬手拿了手机发了个消息。

那边很快就回了：

[黎笙：醒了？那让它吃点东西，补充点营养。]

[黎笙：不过也真是奇怪，体征很是正常，这么爱睡觉的一只小鸡。]

鸟丝毫不知道自己又被讨厌的人类说了“小鸡”，只是非常认真地在喝水，尾羽长长的，随着低头的动作一动一动的。

宋郁本来是打算起身去楼下拿点滋养丸的，那是鹦鹉的主食，比较健康，他觉得还是要吃那个。

不过人还只是刚起身，衣角就传来一阵阻力，他低头一看，鸟在用力地叼着自己的衣服。

往反方向拽。

爪子都在桌面上打滑。

宋郁愣了下，是不想他走么……

少年心里有一阵暖流淌过，不由得停下了动作。

但就在这时，鸟确认“人”不走了之后，就松开了喙，转身啪嗒啪嗒走到一袋子夏威夷果面前。

伸了鸟腿。

踩上面。

宋郁：“……”

-

不过好在最后是恢复了正常，鸟除了那天吃得东西多了点，没有什么异常。

宋郁这才放下心来，不过另外一件事又来了，是关于那个“升学宴”。

宋启明甚至一大早过来打电话：

“待会八点你陈叔去接你，有备好的衣服，你也长大了，宴会上都是有头有脸的人物……”

总之是说了一堆。

少年面色冷淡，甚至在漫不经心地想着，如果现在拒绝，宋启明会不会就虚伪不下去了。

这分明是一场商业宴会。

“升学”只是装饰。

但就在这时——

“不能给你爷爷丢脸。”

宋郁其实后面没有在听了，只是觉得手腕有些生疼，他侧眸看了眼窗外。

阴雨绵绵。

天气也不好。

手机里面还有断断续续的声音：

“宋郁，时间很紧的，你收拾齐整点，林董记得不记得……”

“定制的衣服给你送到临近的酒店了，陈叔过来接你。”

“……你妈妈今天也过来，搞不好还要带那个制片人……我真是服了她了。”

分明是隔着电话线，但是宋郁却好像看到了宋启明那张不耐烦的脸。

他的父母，提及对方，永远都是互相诋毁。

宋郁闻言笑了下，“你不也要带李长韵？”

何必这么双标。

电话那头愣了下，随即就是低声的斥责：

“宋郁，你怎么说话的？”

“你知不知道我这次回国——”

话音倒是停下了，对面似乎很忙，最后甚至没来得及生气，只是重新强调了下时间。

挂了。

三分零一秒。

外面天色还是阴沉沉的，雨线在玻璃上划出一道道痕迹，像是凌乱的伤疤。

宋郁看了下外面的天空，神色平静，不知道在想什么。

就在这时。

“啾啾啾。”

门口传来一阵催促的鸟叫声，还伴随着爪子在门板上划拉的动静。

宋郁转身看过去，这才发现卧室门不小心关了，于是快步走了过去。

门刚开了缝隙，一个毛绒绒的鸟头就挤了进来，顺带伸进来一个爪子。

啪——

很有劲了。

宋郁俯身蹲下，其实蹙了蹙眉，因为鸟不知道从哪里又叼过来一袋子零食。

松子。

“……”

白粼粼真是越来越觉得“人”好用了，现在连拆封包装袋这种活都不想干了，通通都给“人”来做。

人很聪明的。

鸟低头松开了喙，那袋子半斤重的松子就躺在地板上。

“……”

“……”

对视ing。

鸟又伸了伸鸟腿，示意了一下，然而人不为所动。

？

白粼粼索性直接用头去拱，把零食又推到人跟前，还啪嗒啪嗒走了几步。

人，去剥。

宋郁实在没有办法，只能同它解释，“我今天要出门，时间不太够。”

“晚上回来再吃行么？”

白粼粼还在仰着头，心里还有些小小的失望，他是计算好了的，这么些松子，刚好够人早上剥完。

下午还有核桃的。

排满了。

宋郁把手伸了过去，鸟歪了歪头，还是抬腿上来了，顺带点了点头。

很宽容大度了。

“时间不会太长，我下午就回家，到时候再——”

“啾啾。”

宋郁的话被打断了，下巴有很顺滑的触感，鸟很用力地顶了过来。

与之伴随的还有干燥谷物的味道。

像小鸡。

宋郁侧眸看了过去，才发现鸟正在看地板上的那袋子松子。

“我的错。”

“我忘记了。”

人道了歉，这毕竟是鸟从一楼叼上来的，很费劲的，应该拿起来，而不是让零食躺在地上。

宋郁抬手把东西拿了起来，这才获得了肩头这只的点头，随后去了书桌那里。

本来是想要交代一些事项的，但是后知后觉也就离开几个小时。

好像也没必要。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 20

A carrier pigeon rested for a moment on a high-voltage line, tilting its head to look around. How were the roads in this place built?

They were all crooked and winding.

The central area was at least straight and orderly. The pigeon flapped its wings and tried to sniff the air—an important navigational reference for it.

*Serious face.*

"Barbecue! Barbecue! One-fifty a skewer! Don't miss out as you pass by!"

"Blueberry smoothie shake-up, five hundred milliliters for a super-value nine-ninety, comes with a Nanshi Ancient Tower fridge magnet!"

"Taro cream mini-cakes, free samples available..."

The sounds from the street rose and fell, accompanied by a chaotic blend of aromas. The food street was bustling with heavy traffic and a constant flow of people.

The pigeon: "..."

*Since things have come to this, I might as well eat.*

The travel-worn pigeon stretched its wings and flew into a very secluded corner. A moment later, a young man in a postal uniform emerged, walking quite naturally toward a stall.

"Boss, I'd like a free sample of the taro mini-cake."

"..."

-

Meanwhile, at Jin Garden, Bai Linlin finally woke up. He was hanging onto the lapel of Song Yu’s shirt, opening his small, flesh-colored beak.

He let out a yawn.

He felt a bit dazed.

Is it night already?

Song Yu lowered his eyes and saw the bird wake up. He used a bottle cap to catch some water and lowered his head to feed it. From his perspective, he could only see a round, fluffy bird head.

It was bobbing around.

It looked like it finally had some energy.

Bai Linlin realized he had fallen asleep on Song Yu, his bird claws tucked inside the other’s clothes, with only his head exposed.

"..."

He tried to wiggle upward to get out, but after the "human" offered the water, he realized he was indeed quite thirsty.

He began to drink obediently in small sips.

It was plain boiled water.

The bird appraised it for a moment, smacked his beak, and then glanced sideways at a bottle of beverage on the table.

"Chirp!"

He immediately tilted his bird head back.

Song Yu was actually a bit confused, but he was looking down at the bird—why did it stop drinking?

Until—

"Mai-Dong."

A crisp, clear sound came from the bird.

His bird eyes were round and looked very wise.

"..."

In the end, Song Yu opened that bottle of functional drink for the bird and poured some into the cap. He glanced at the bottle label.

Peach-flavored.

The bird seemed to love it. As soon as he was placed on the table, he waddled over and began to drink heartily.

He even stretched his wing roots.

Very satisfied.

Song Yu’s expression was gentle, though he simply raised his hand to take his phone and send a message.

A reply came back quickly:

[Li Sheng: Awake? Then let it eat something to replenish its nutrients.]

[Li Sheng: Though it really is strange. Its vitals are perfectly normal, yet it’s such a sleepy little chick.]

The bird had no idea that the annoying human had called him a "little chick" again. He was just drinking his water very seriously, his long tail feathers twitching with every downward motion.

Song Yu had originally intended to get up and go downstairs to get some nutritional pellets—the staple food for parrots, which was healthier. He felt the bird should eat that.

But just as he started to rise, he felt resistance at the hem of his shirt. He looked down and saw the bird biting his clothes hard.

Pulling in the opposite direction.

Its claws were slipping on the tabletop.

Song Yu paused. *Is it not wanting me to leave?*

A warm current flowed through the young man’s heart, and he couldn't help but stop his movements.

But just then, once the bird confirmed the "human" wasn't leaving, it let go of its beak, turned around, and waddled over to a bag of macadamia nuts.

It stretched out a bird leg.

And stepped on it.

Song Yu: "..."

-

Fortunately, things returned to normal. Aside from eating a bit more than usual that day, the bird showed no other abnormalities.

Song Yu finally set his mind at ease, but another matter arose: the "Graduation Banquet."

Song Qiming even called early in the morning:

"Your Uncle Chen will come to pick you up at eight. There are clothes prepared. You’re grown up now, and the banquet will be full of people of status..."

He went on and on.

The young man’s expression was cold. He was even thinking, with a sense of detachment, whether Song Qiming would drop the hypocrisy if he refused right now.

This was clearly a business banquet.

"Graduation" was just a facade.

But just then—

"Don't embarrass your grandfather."

Song Yu hadn't really been listening after that, only feeling a dull ache in his wrist. He glanced out the window.

A drizzling rain.

The weather was bad, too.

The voice continued intermittently through the phone:

"Song Yu, time is tight. Get yourself cleaned up. Do you remember Director Lin..."

"The custom-made clothes have been sent to the nearby hotel. Uncle Chen is coming to get you."

"...Your mother is coming today, too. She might even bring that producer... I really can't stand her."

Even though they were separated by a phone line, Song Yu could almost see Song Qiming’s impatient face.

His parents—whenever they mentioned each other, it was always mutual disparagement.

Song Yu laughed upon hearing this. "Aren't you bringing Li Changyun?"

Why the double standard?

There was a pause on the other end, followed by a low reprimand:

"Song Yu, what kind of tone is that?"

"Do you have any idea how much—"

The voice trailed off. The person on the other side seemed very busy; in the end, he didn't even have time to get angry, merely emphasizing the time once more.

He hung up.

Three minutes and one second.

Outside, the sky remained gloomy. The rain streaks traced lines across the glass like messy scars.

Song Yu looked at the sky outside, his expression calm, though it was unclear what he was thinking.

Just then.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp."

A series of urgent bird calls came from the doorway, accompanied by the sound of claws scratching against the door panel.

Song Yu turned to look and realized the bedroom door had been closed by accident, so he walked over quickly.

As soon as the door cracked open, a fluffy bird head squeezed in, followed by a claw.

*Plop.*

Very energetic.

Song Yu leaned down and frowned slightly, because the bird had dragged over another bag of snacks from somewhere.

Pine nuts.

"..."

Bai Linlin was finding the "human" more and more useful. Now he didn't even want to do the work of opening packaging bags; he left it all to the "human."

The human was very smart.

The bird lowered his head and let go of his beak. The half-catty bag of pine nuts lay on the floor.

"..."

"..."

*Staring at each other.*

The bird stretched out his leg again to signal, but the human remained unmoved.

?

Bai Linlin simply used his head to nudge the snack back toward the human, then waddled a few steps.

*Human, peel them.*

Song Yu really had no choice but to explain, "I have to go out today. I don't have enough time."

"Can you eat them when I get back tonight?"

Bai Linlin was still tilting his head, feeling a little disappointed. He had calculated it all—this many pine nuts were just enough for the human to finish peeling in the morning.

There were walnuts for the afternoon.

It was all scheduled.

Song Yu reached out his hand. The bird tilted his head, stepped onto it, and gave a small nod.

Very magnanimous.

"It won't take long. I'll be home this afternoon, and then—"

"Chirp, chirp."

Song Yu’s words were interrupted. There was a smooth sensation against his chin as the bird pushed against him with force.

Accompanying it was the scent of dry grain.

Like a little chick.

Song Yu glanced sideways and realized the bird was looking at the bag of pine nuts on the floor.

"My fault."

"I forgot."

The human apologized. After all, the bird had dragged it up from the first floor with great effort. He should have picked it up instead of letting the snacks lie on the ground.

Song Yu picked up the items, which finally earned him a nod from the one on his shoulder, before he headed to the desk.

He had originally wanted to give some instructions, but he realized he would only be gone for a few hours.

It didn't seem necessary.

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁肩头一轻，鸟在桌子上伸了伸翅膀，又开始歪头梳理羽毛。

蓝羽长长。

很好看。

也就在这时，门口有汽车的引擎声，外面的雨似乎还有点下大的征兆。

白粼粼看了看外头，心想这个天气出去？

是那个升学宴？

“……”

选的都是什么日子？

不过鸟也听到了院子外面汽车引擎的声音，他啪嗒啪嗒站在窗台上，倒是认真地往下看了看。

库里南。

我去！

白粼粼是一个物质的小鸟，他立马扑棱翅膀飞到宋郁的肩头，表示自己也要出门。

鸟要坐豪车。

谁同意，谁反对？

白粼粼自己给自己“全票通过”，但是在走到玄关的时候被宋郁“一票否决”了。

“外面下雨了，在家等我好么？”

“我很快就回来了。”

门最后还是关上了。

-

宴会的地址在南市一家有名的五星级酒店，地点在琅山，风景秀丽，且实行的是会员制。

车子在盘山公路上开着，宋郁在副驾上坐着，面色没什么表情。

“小郁有想好报考什么大学吗？”

司机其实也觉得氛围有点沉闷，试图找个话题聊聊。

他原来是负责接送碧波湾那对母子的，其实很少来锦园这里，上次见这孩子还是好几年前。

也是有些感慨。

原配孩子就是优秀。

“没有。”

宋郁没有什么兴致聊天，只是侧眸看着窗外，还在下雨。

“啊，那慢慢考虑，这事也急不得。”

司机也很理解，虽然有些尴尬，但还是很温和地道，顺带打了个方向盘。

右转。

但就在这时——

挡风玻璃突然传过来一阵闷响，一道灰扑扑的影子被甩了出去。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，车子也急刹了。

司机其实有点慌张，毕竟这不是他的车，解开安全带的时候还在自言自语：

“这撞到什么了，车窗不会……”

宋郁没有过多思索也下了车，外面的风不算太大，但有些雨丝，衬得人面容更加冷白。

“不用检查车，我会和我父亲说。”

“看下周围有没有小动物。”

司机愣了下，随即就照做了，其实刚才的动静不算小，约莫是个鸟之类的。

但挡风玻璃上也没有血，所以也找不到具体的痕迹。

大约耽搁了五分钟左右，车子还是开走了，因为实在找不到。

而与此同时——

盘山公路上多了一只“走地鸡”，信鸽被撞得头昏眼花的，啪嗒啪嗒地在马路牙子上走。

“……”

没事的。

怎么可能会有鸟一直倒霉呢？

下一秒。

呜呜呜呜！

它要告到中央！

-

锦园。

白粼粼实在是闲的没事，就在别墅里乱溜达，最后还是回到了宋郁的卧室。

本来是打算开一局游戏的，但是站在书桌上的时候莫名想起来第一次进来的场景。

欸……

这个桌子上？

鸟左右环顾了下，爪子啪嗒啪嗒地响，后来终于发现问题了。

那张合照不见了。

白粼粼其实并不知道宋郁好了没有，鸟看了看窗外，发现还在下雨，想去看看楼下。

几个小时的话？

应该很短？

白粼粼扑棱了下翅膀，打算站在那个书立上，那个位置正好能看到路边的车。

要是库里南回来了。

宋郁就到家了。

鸟等待ing。

但出师不利，白粼粼刚扑棱翅膀腾飞起来，爪子还没有站稳那个书籍的角，那书直接往外翻了。

？

难道是鸟太沉了吗？

不可能！

但那本书已经从竖着变成横着了，两个铁制的书立中间显得很是突兀。

白粼粼试图复原，叼着那个书角，本意是往上提一下，结果一下子扯出来了。

页面都翻了出来。

2013年5月6日，阴。

……

白粼粼立马抬爪盖住，把鸟头一撇。

不能看不能看。

日记这种东西就应该锁在柜子里！

干什么放在桌面上啊？

但随着时间一点一滴地推移，鸟头正在以十分缓慢的速度下移……

2013年5月6日，阴。
