Song Yu stood up in the bedroom, his expression very serious, though he was just thinking about what excuse to use...

The bird was right beside him, slightly lifting its wing root.

Just as it wanted to tilt its head to preen its feathers, it heard—

"It's hatching eggs."

Bai Linlin: "..."

Human, you are being presumptuous.

-

Over in S Province.

It was half an hour later when Song Zhengguo hung up the phone. He had been warm and kind during the conversation, but his expression darkened after hanging up.

"He's lost weight."

Chen Kaihe had no choice when he heard this and took back his phone:

"Forget it, the video function on this phone isn't very good anyway; at most, the lens distorted it."

Song Zhengguo didn't say anything, but in his heart, there was still a lingering worry. This child had been sensitive since he was young, and he had gone through such a huge ordeal himself.

How had he been living...

"Xiao Yu hasn't been to S Province?"

Chen Kaihe’s movements paused when he heard this. In the end, he had no choice but to tell the truth:

"His father confiscated his passport earlier, saying it was useless to come, and he might as well stay in Nan City to study."

"By the time I came over, the child was almost at the college entrance exam, and after thinking it over, I didn't tell him the location..."

Song Zhengguo frowned and said in a deep voice: "I understand, but if I hadn't woken up, would you not have let him come?"

There was a dead silence in the ward.

Song Zhengguo finally just sighed, saying neither lightly nor heavily:

"Foolish."

...

In the bedroom.

The giant bird began to face the wall, looking as if it wanted to draw a line between itself and the human.

*You* are the one hatching eggs.

Your whole family is...

Oh, retract, retract.

Bai Linlin was keeping a mental note in his little book; Song Yu’s grandfather seemed like a good person for now.

He couldn't take him.

The bird was principled in its anger.

Just then, a voice came from behind:

"I was wrong."

The bird remained as immovable as a mountain.

"I shouldn't have said that."

The bird tilted its head, *humph*.

"What can I do to make you forgive me?"

Bai Linlin finally waited for these words. His bird eyes were round, and he took out the phone he had been tucking under his wing earlier.

The page was Taobao.

Song Yu was actually very worried that the bird wouldn't pay him any mind, his expression already looking poor, but he froze when he saw the sturdy, powerful flight feathers holding out an iPhone.

He took it and looked.

It was the shopping cart.

The human reacted quickly and cleared it all out in a few seconds.

The bird was looking down, checking.

"Buying anything else?"

Song Yu looked up and asked again, feeling that the previous items weren't that many.

Bai Linlin: !!

The bird immediately moved toward the human, snuggling up, and poking the screen with its wing.

This one.

This one.

And this one.

chunks.chineseText:
后半夜几乎全在购物，鸟买得忘了情发了狠，看到结算金额后还有点不好意思，但是宋郁代付的太快了，他也没看清到底多少钱。

大约在凌晨两点的时候，人给鸟绑了张卡，很认真地交代道：

“密码你记一下。”

“是******”

白粼粼在心里默念：

「453286」

“记住了吗？”

鸟面不改色地点头。

-

早上的太阳一升起来，卧室里就被照亮了。

少年靠着墙睡，眉眼优越，只是衣襟里挂着一只小鸟，圆滚滚的脑袋卡在人的锁骨上，还咂巴咂巴了喙，像是做了个美梦。

场景很是和谐。

宋郁的肩头微微滑了下，连带着头也不由自主地栽了下，他醒了过来，抬手盖了盖眼睛。

鸟的翅膀有很好的遮光作用。

但是它状态不稳定。

要么白天变大，要么晚上变大。

持续时间也长短不一，总之就是没有规律。

宋郁实在担心，从一开始就没有去床上睡过，一直是陪着的，鸟变大的时候靠着休息，鸟变小了就放怀里。

此刻锁骨处的小鸡睡得正香。

但由于昨天没休息好，人忘记了鸟的存在，撑着手臂坐起来了。

而就是这个动作直接让鸟呲溜滑下去了。

白粼粼醒过来的时候，视野里很是昏暗，有衣服透光的感觉，他一个弹跳，爪子踩在腹肌上，滑滑的，然后还有点弹性。

？

难道又——

“粼粼？”

宋郁没敢再动了，只是用手撑着地毯，另外一只手试图拢住衣服里的凸起，会动的那种。

“你不要动，我把你拿出来。”

白粼粼压根没当回事，上次在路上那次只顾得扑棱翅膀了，体验感非常不好，但是这次……

外头太阳很好，夏天的衣服隔光性一般，所以其实能看清里面是什么样子的。

鸟啪嗒啪嗒走了几步，低头观察。

一块、两块、三块……

白粼粼还想再往上数一数，但是人毕竟还是坐着的，所以有斜坡。

鸟往上拱了拱，但是感受到了阻力，人手在扣住他的鸟头。

白粼粼丝毫不怕，只是爪子先一步行动，去了右边位置，然后开始用力地拔鸟头。

宋郁：“……”

少年蹙了蹙眉，他只能松手，刚想直接站起来，但鸟的速度更快，已经在往上走了。

宋郁在地毯上的手指按压的力度紧了紧。

骨节分明。

鸟在里面攀爬，爪子的触感痒痒的，走过的地方有点麻……

宋郁闭了闭眼。

其实时间不长，也就半分钟左右，鸟就成功地踩着鼓鼓的肌肉钻了出来，毛绒绒的。

很骄傲地挺了挺胸膛。

探索成功！

一共八块！

但白粼粼直接被“握”住，拿下，一气呵成。

人起身去洗澡了。

-

最后关于形态变化这件事，也没有找到合适的解决办法，但是发现了几个稳定的时间节点。

上午的八点到九点，是小鸟。

晚上的六点到凌晨两点，是大鸟。

其余时间则是大小都有。

宋郁在卧室里擦头发，肩头站着小鸟，此刻正一本正经叨头发。

“遂安区倒是有……”

“但没有槐河路。”

少年垂眸自言自语，最后发现一件事，鸟根本就没有在听，只是在捣乱。

他微微蹙了下眉，刚转头过去。

白粼粼直接叨到人的唇瓣上去了。

“……”

“……”
chunks.englishText:
The latter half of the night was spent almost entirely shopping. The bird had lost itself in the frenzy, and upon seeing the final checkout total, it felt a twinge of embarrassment. However, Song Yu had settled the payment so quickly that the bird hadn't even caught a glimpse of the actual amount.

Around two in the morning, the human tied a card to the bird and instructed it very earnestly:

"Memorize the password."

"It's ******"

Bai Linlin recited it silently in his heart:

"453286"

"Did you memorize it?"

The bird nodded, its expression unchanging.

-

As soon as the morning sun rose, the bedroom was flooded with light.

The young man slept leaning against the wall, his features refined and handsome. Tucked inside his shirt collar, however, was a little bird, its round head wedged against his collarbone. It smacked its beak, as if lost in a sweet dream.

The scene was remarkably harmonious.

Song Yu’s shoulder slipped slightly, causing his head to loll forward involuntarily. He woke up, raising a hand to shield his eyes.

The bird’s wings made for excellent blackout curtains.

But its state was unstable.

Sometimes it would grow large during the day, other times at night.

The duration varied as well; in short, there was no pattern to it.

Song Yu was truly worried, so from the very beginning, he hadn't slept in the bed, choosing instead to stay by the bird's side. When the bird grew large, he would rest against it; when it shrank, he would tuck it into his embrace.

At this moment, the little chick at his collarbone was sleeping soundly.

But because he hadn't rested well the previous night, the human forgot about the bird's existence and pushed himself up with his arms.

That very movement caused the bird to slide right down.

When Bai Linlin woke up, his field of vision was dim, with the sensation of light filtering through fabric. He sprang up, his claws landing on something smooth and elastic—the human's abdominal muscles.

?

Could it be that—

"Linlin?"

Song Yu dared not move further. He braced himself against the carpet with one hand, while the other tried to cup the bulge inside his shirt—the kind that moved.

"Don't move, I'll get you out."

Bai Linlin didn't take it to heart at all. The last time, on the road, he had been too busy flapping his wings, and the experience had been terrible. But this time...

The sun outside was bright, and summer clothing offered little opacity, so he could actually see what it looked like inside.

The bird took a few pattering steps, lowering its head to observe.

One, two, three...

Bai Linlin wanted to keep counting, but since the human was still sitting up, there was a slope.

The bird nudged upward, but felt resistance; the human’s hand was pinning his bird-head down.

Bai Linlin wasn't afraid in the slightest. His claws acted first, moving to the right side, and then he began to pull his head upward with all his might.

Song Yu: "..."

The young man frowned. He had no choice but to let go. Just as he was about to stand up, the bird was faster, already climbing upward.

The fingers Song Yu pressed against the carpet tightened.

His knuckles were prominent.

The bird was climbing inside, the touch of its claws ticklish, and the places it traversed felt a bit numb...

Song Yu closed his eyes.

It didn't take long—about half a minute—before the bird successfully stepped over the bulging muscles and climbed out, all fluffy.

It puffed out its chest with great pride.

Exploration successful!

Eight of them in total!

But Bai Linlin was immediately "grasped," taken down, and moved in one fluid motion.

The human got up to take a shower.

-

In the end, no suitable solution was found for the shape-shifting, but they did discover a few stable time nodes.

From 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM, it was a little bird.

From 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM, it was a big bird.

The rest of the time, it was a mix of both.

Song Yu was in the bedroom drying his hair, the little bird standing on his shoulder, currently pecking at his hair with great seriousness.

"There is a Suian District..."

"But there is no Huaihe Road."

The young man lowered his eyes, muttering to himself, only to realize that the bird wasn't listening at all; it was just causing trouble.

He frowned slightly and just as he turned his head—

Bai Linlin pecked directly onto his lips.

"..."

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
第23章

白粼粼以往虽然也叨过唇角，但那都是不小心创过去的，没有像现在这样……

叨在唇珠上。

好似亲了一口。

鸟愣了下。

人也怔住了。

一秒，两秒。

一人一鸟同时偏开头。

宋郁其实脸上有点可疑的红晕，鸟也低着头有点不知所措，最后试图歪着头梳理羽毛。

咳咳。

当没发生过好么？

“我们去一趟遂安区吧？”

最终还是人递了台阶过来，鸟收了收翅膀，屈尊降贵地接受了。

“啾啾。”

[ok。]

-

宋郁其实也不清楚是不是相处久了的缘故，他已经能辨别出来不同的“啾啾”是什么意思。

临出门的时候，他还问了下为什么不直接说人话，但肩头的某只歪了歪头，鸟眼圆圆：

“你不会猜吗？”

宋郁：“……”

揣测圣心。

白粼粼其实就是单纯地懒，既然有人能完全理解自己的需求，那为什么还要说复杂的话。

啾一声就好了。

驯服人类进行时。

“啾啾？”

[不是吗？]

“是。”

宋郁说完就从玄关那里拿了迷你的遮阳帽，扣在了鸟头上。

上次网购买的。

蓝白条纹相间的款，人侧眸看了看，觉得刚刚好。

宋郁又给鸟扣上脚环，低头轻声道：

“这次早上是小的状态，那应该在下午之前都是安全的，我们先去找一下地方。”

白粼粼其实根本没空听，他伸着鸟腿，只是歪着头去看玄关的等身镜。

小帽子尺寸非常合适，戴着着实很潮流。

鸟满意。

等到一人一鸟出门后，宋郁身后的玄关置物架上才完整地显露了出来。

四排四列，不同色系的遮阳帽。

下面是多巴胺色系小围兜。

再下面是各种超轻金属的脚环和出门的背带……

琳琅满目。

-

宋郁在路边用手机叫了个车，肩头的小鸟正在专心致志地低头看。

此刻天空蔚蓝，阳光也很好。

但鸟看到高德的页面后十分沮丧，伸了伸鸟腿，坐下了。

“库里南……”

宋郁打完车后察觉到肩头的爪子移动轨迹，刚想转头就听到了这句话，面色茫然。

什么意思？

戴着帽子的鸟似乎察觉到了视线，仰头看过来了，闷声闷气地道：

“我也想坐。”

人反应过来了，应该是升学宴那次，宋郁也就愣神了几秒，随后抬手在手机上操作了下。

取消了订单。

联系宋家司机。

鸟想要，鸟得到。

白粼粼在看到路边一辆高大的SUV车型缓慢地驶来的时候，立马就站好了，伸着鸟头往那边看。

小金人！

星空顶！

车子缓缓地停了下来，司机也下来简单地打了招呼，而后就给开了门。

宋郁全程都没有什么大的情绪波动，只是关注着肩头的某只。

鸟四处环顾。

鸟伸爪子勾了勾高级皮。

鸟仰头看星空顶。

“啾啾啾！”

宋郁微微垂着眼眸，靠着座椅，只是得出了一个事实。

它很喜欢。

少年漫不经心地又记住一件事，随后伸了伸手指，便于鸟站上去四处看。

前面的司机接了个电话，很明显是宋启明的，一连说了好几个是是是。

最后还是问了后排：

“先生问要不要一起去吃一家粤菜？”

宋郁就在后面坐着，交叠着双腿，没什么情绪地道：

“没空。”

想也知道是因为什么事。

大约十五分钟的车程，抵达了遂安区的一条商业街。

白粼粼站在人的肩头，此刻才觉得戴帽子真是明智的选择。

他整只鸟都热热的。

宋郁下了车之后就在看地图，猜想着“槐河路”会不会是一个旧名？

在这片居住的人或许可能了解。

少年在手机查了一些县志，但是完全匹配的名字还是没有。

得问。

宋郁正在低头看路线，鸟在不务正业，四处看旁边的摊子。

“蛋堡蛋堡！三块一个，五块钱俩！健康美味！”

“脆香猪肉脯，真材实料……”

“芋泥奶油小蛋糕，免费品尝……”

白粼粼完全被吸引走了，立马就想让人给自己买，扭头刚准备催促——

“你、你好，能加个微信吗？”

一个女生站在宋郁的面前，面色有些泛红。

白粼粼：“……”

终归是鸟多余了。

“不好意思，我没有那个打算。”

白粼粼一听这话就摇了摇头，不行不行，怎么能这么直白地拒绝？

没有绅士风度。

但就在这时——

“啊，那好吧，但你的小鸟好可爱的，我、我能和它合个影吗？”

白粼粼：！

鸟一点都不多余！

宋郁闻言其实微微蹙了下眉，但还是很客套地道：

“那要看它同意不……”

话还没说完，肩头就一轻，鸟已经飞到了陌生人的肩头。

年轻女生更是一阵惊叹，立马拿出来大耳狗手机开始合照，边拍边夸：

“你好可爱！”

“你怎么这么聪明呀？”

“你的小帽子也好好看……”

白粼粼整个鸟都神气了起来，爪子站得稳稳当当的，挺胸抬头，一连拍了十来张。

区区人类。

拿下！

宋郁就站在对面，唇角微微压直了，无名指缠着的红线也紧了点。

女生似乎是察觉到了什么，偷偷往这边看了一眼，然后立马收了手机。

“好了好了，我拍好了。”

“谢谢你！”

白粼粼还有些意犹未尽，他还会大鹏展翅的，鸟很有才艺的。

“不客气。”

宋郁语气冷淡，视线都没有移动过。

白粼粼结束了营业，美美地飞了回去，刚站好位置就看到女生冲他挥了挥手。

鸟也高兴，抬起来翅膀就要——

宋郁侧眸看了过来。

“……”

白粼粼不知道为什么，硬生生地把动作改成梳理羽毛了，很心虚地把鸟头歪了歪。

理……理一下毛。

“饿不饿？”

宋郁垂着眼眸问，肩头的小鸟立马就抬头了，很精神的样子。

-

最后买了不少摊子的小吃，但想着没有地方吃，就去了附近的一家麦当劳。

鸟就在大号可乐杯后面炫薯饼。

不过就在这时遇见了熟人。

是班主任。

还有她的女儿豆豆。

白粼粼非常丝滑地飞到了宋郁的肩头，同那孩子保持一个安全距离。

没办法。

遇见的前两个纯纯魔童来着的。

班主任穿得很文雅，一席白色缎面裙，头发是用簪子盘起来的，看到宋郁就走过来了，索性拼了个桌。

“出来吃饭了？”

班主任很温和地问了问近况，顺带把女儿抱到旁边的椅子上，温和地道：

“乖乖的，一会就有儿童餐了。”

豆豆点了点头，然后仰头直勾勾地看鸟。

专注ing。

宋郁还在和老师交流着，顺带说了自己的打算：

“专业这方面我想过了……另外家里这段时间变动很大，我觉得还是不能去外省。”
chunks.englishText:
第23章

Although Bai Linlin had pecked at the corners of Song Yu's lips before, those had always been accidental brushes. It had never been like this...

Pecking right on the cupid's bow.

It was as if he had kissed him.

The bird froze.

The human was also stunned.

One second, two seconds.

Both human and bird turned their heads away at the same time.

Song Yu actually had a suspicious flush on his face, and the bird also lowered its head, feeling somewhat at a loss, eventually trying to tilt its head to preen its feathers.

*Ahem.*

Let’s just pretend that didn't happen, shall we?

"Shall we take a trip to Suian District?"

In the end, the human offered a way out, and the bird tucked its wings, condescendingly accepting.

"Chirp chirp."

[OK.]

-

Song Yu wasn't sure if it was because they had spent so much time together, but he could already distinguish what different "chirps" meant.

Before leaving, he asked why the bird didn't just speak human language, but the creature on his shoulder tilted its head, its bird-eyes round:

"Can't you guess?"

Song Yu: "..."

Trying to fathom the imperial mind.

Bai Linlin was actually just lazy. Since someone could fully understand his needs, why bother with complicated speech?

A single chirp was enough.

The taming of the human was currently in progress.

"Chirp chirp?"

[Isn't that right?]

"It is."

After Song Yu finished speaking, he took a miniature sun hat from the entryway and placed it on the bird's head.

He had bought it online last time.

It was a blue and white striped style. The human glanced sideways and felt it was just right.

Song Yu then fastened an anklet on the bird and whispered, lowering his head:

"Since it's in the small state this morning, it should be safe until the afternoon. Let's go find the place first."

Bai Linlin wasn't actually listening at all. He stretched out his bird leg, just tilting his head to look at the full-length mirror in the entryway.

The little hat was the perfect size; wearing it was truly trendy.

The bird was satisfied.

Only after the human and bird left did the storage rack in the entryway fully reveal itself.

Four rows and four columns of sun hats in different color schemes.

Below that were dopamine-colored little bibs.

And below that were various ultra-light metal anklets and harnesses for going out...

It was a dazzling array.

-

Song Yu hailed a car on the side of the road with his phone, the little bird on his shoulder focused intently on looking down.

The sky was blue, and the sunlight was lovely.

But when the bird saw the Gaode map page, it became very dejected, stretched out its bird leg, and sat down.

"Cullinan..."

After Song Yu finished booking the car, he noticed the movement of the claws on his shoulder. Just as he was about to turn his head, he heard this word and looked blank.

What did that mean?

The bird wearing the hat seemed to sense his gaze, looked up, and said in a muffled voice:

"I want to ride in that too."

The human realized what it meant; it must have been from the graduation banquet. Song Yu was stunned for a few seconds, then raised his hand and operated his phone.

He canceled the order.

He contacted the Song family driver.

If the bird wanted it, the bird would get it.

When Bai Linlin saw a tall SUV slowly approaching from the side of the road, he immediately stood up straight, stretching his bird head to look over.

The little golden hood ornament!

The starlight ceiling!

The car pulled over slowly, and the driver got out, greeted them briefly, and opened the door.

Song Yu didn't show any major emotional fluctuations throughout, focusing only on the creature on his shoulder.

The bird looked around.

The bird stretched out a claw to hook the high-end leather.

The bird looked up at the starlight ceiling.

"Chirp chirp chirp!"

Song Yu lowered his eyes slightly, leaning against the seat, and reached a conclusion.

It liked it very much.

The young man nonchalantly memorized another fact, then extended his finger to make it easier for the bird to stand on it and look around.

The driver in the front received a call, clearly from Song Qiming, saying "yes, yes, yes" several times.

Finally, he asked the back seat:

"Sir asks if you would like to go have Cantonese food together?"

Song Yu sat in the back, legs crossed, and said without much emotion:

"No time."

One could guess why.

After a drive of about fifteen minutes, they arrived at a commercial street in Suian District.

Bai Linlin stood on the human's shoulder, only now feeling that wearing the hat was a wise choice.

His whole bird body was hot.

After Song Yu got out of the car, he looked at the map, wondering if "Huaihe Road" might be an old name.

People living in this area might know.

The young man checked some county records on his phone, but there was no perfectly matching name.

He had to ask.

Song Yu was looking down at the route, while the bird was neglecting its duties, looking at the stalls nearby.

"Egg burger, egg burger! Three yuan each, five yuan for two! Healthy and delicious!"

"Crispy pork jerky, made with real ingredients..."

"Taro cream cake, free samples..."

Bai Linlin was completely drawn in and immediately wanted the human to buy him some. He turned his head, just about to urge him—

"H-hello, can I add you on WeChat?"

A girl stood in front of Song Yu, her face slightly flushed.

Bai Linlin: "..."

In the end, the bird was redundant.

"Sorry, I don't have that intention."

When Bai Linlin heard this, he shook his head. No, no, how could he refuse so bluntly?

No gentlemanly demeanor.

But just then—

"Ah, alright then. But your little bird is so cute. C-can I take a photo with it?"

Bai Linlin: !

The bird was not redundant at all!

Upon hearing this, Song Yu frowned slightly, but still said politely:

"That depends on whether it agrees..."

Before he could finish, his shoulder felt light; the bird had already flown onto the stranger's shoulder.

The young girl gasped in admiration, immediately taking out her Cinnamoroll phone to take photos, praising it as she snapped:

"You're so cute!"

"How are you so smart?"

"Your little hat is so good-looking too..."

Bai Linlin felt quite spirited, his claws standing steady, chest puffed out, head held high, posing for over a dozen photos.

Mere human.

Conquered!

Song Yu stood opposite, his lips pressed into a straight line, the red string wrapped around his ring finger tightening slightly.

The girl seemed to sense something, stole a glance over here, and immediately put away her phone.

"Okay, okay, I'm done."

"Thank you!"

Bai Linlin was still somewhat unsatisfied; he could also spread his wings like a roc—the bird was very talented.

"You're welcome."

Song Yu’s tone was cold, his gaze not having shifted once.

Bai Linlin finished his "business" and flew back beautifully. Just as he stood in position, he saw the girl waving at him.

The bird was happy too, raising its wing to—

Song Yu glanced over.

"..."

Bai Linlin didn't know why, but he forced himself to change the action to preening his feathers, tilting his bird head with a guilty conscience.

Pre... preening his feathers.

"Are you hungry?"

Song Yu asked with his eyes lowered, and the little bird on his shoulder immediately raised its head, looking very spirited.

-

In the end, they bought a lot of snacks from the stalls, but thinking there was no place to eat, they went to a nearby McDonald's.

The bird was showing off a hash brown behind a large cola cup.

However, they ran into an acquaintance.

It was his homeroom teacher.

And her daughter, Doudou.

Bai Linlin flew onto Song Yu's shoulder very smoothly, keeping a safe distance from the child.

No choice.

The first two he met were pure demon children.

The homeroom teacher was dressed elegantly in a white satin dress, her hair pinned up with a hairpin. Seeing Song Yu, she walked over and simply joined their table.

"Out for a meal?"

The homeroom teacher asked about his recent situation very gently, taking the opportunity to pick up her daughter and place her on the chair next to her, saying softly:

"Be good, you'll have your kids' meal in a moment."

Doudou nodded, then looked up, staring straight at the bird.

Focusing.

Song Yu was still talking to the teacher, mentioning his plans:

"I've thought about the major... Besides, there have been big changes at home recently, and I don't think I can go to another province."

chunks.chineseText:
班主任点点头，转而问道：

“那怎么来到遂安区了？你家不是在平湖区吗？”

“是因为……”

两人正在交谈着，全然没有关旁边的一孩童一鸟。

白粼粼收了收翅膀，很高傲地仰了仰头，区区一个薯饼而已。

豆豆见鸟不为所动就把薯饼拿了回来，自己乖乖地吃了。

鸟着急了。

那、那宋郁给他买的！

豆豆抬眼看鸟，又很认真地拿出来一块，这次想了想，沾了沾番茄酱，伸手递了过去。

“……”

白粼粼仍然保持战略定力，他不可能轻而易举地下去，休想抓住他。

豆豆只好自己又吃掉了。

鸟：！！

豆豆再次伸手去拿薯饼，这次只剩下一块了，她抬眼看了看鸟。

对视ing。

豆豆准备放入自己嘴巴里，动作慢慢的。

白粼粼真着急了，翅膀都伸起来了。

但就在这时——

豆豆笑了起来，唇边抿出一对梨涡，像是猜中了什么，用力地伸出来了那块完好的薯饼。

小女孩比了比口型：

[你吃。]

-

班主任闻言倒是有点意外，“槐河路？”

“遂安这边前几年改过很多地名，是当时的区长搞什么经济发展区，合并了好几个。”

班主任说到这里拿出来了手机，边低头找联系人边问：

“你确定你找的卖家给的是这个地址？什么古籍这么重要？”

宋郁点了点头，面不改色地道：

“是，我有个爷爷是做研究，他缺这本书，我帮忙找找。”

宋郁小时候经常去陈开鹤家里，看过那里的书，有的就是孤本，现下正好用了名字。

他倒是也没想到这么凑巧，班主任就是遂安区的，祖父辈都在这里。

“噢，找到了。”

“不过我爸的意思是槐河路现在已经不是路了，它成了……一条小巷。”

班主任抬手把位置发了过去，顺带捋了下耳边的发丝。

宋郁拿起手机看了下位置，愣了下，因为那条小道甚至没有名字，定位都是定在了旁边的一家居民楼里。

“他说零几年南市搞什么道路规划，槐河路那一块居民楼搬迁，盖工厂，后来工厂也拆了，又想着安置外来务工人员，又盖起来了居民楼。”

“道路越修越窄，楼也越挤越深，那块现在成了人口流动的密集区。”

班主任蹙了蹙眉，最后还是建议道：

“别去。”

“这不对劲，你和那卖家的沟通记录呢？老师看看。”

宋郁一下子愣住了，他没有想到还要检查这个，不过就在这时——

可乐翻了。

鸟不动声色踹了一脚。

场面一时有些混乱，班主任蹙眉把豆豆给抱起来了，鸟也被人给拿了起来了。

桌面上乱糟糟的。

此刻服务员又来上餐了，班主任只能中断了原来的谈话，开始商量着换位置。

鸟冲人眨了眨眼。

宋郁立刻反应过来了，连忙说：

“老师我想好了，我不去，我跟我那个爷爷说清楚，您放心。”

“但我刚刚已经吃过了，那我就先不打扰您和孩子用餐了。”

班主任本来是蹙眉教育孩子的，闻言才转过头来，再次嘱咐道：

“对，和你那个长辈说清楚，没有人会用很多年前的旧地址的，不知道是什么目的。”

“现在要走了么？真是不好意思，这孩子以前不这样的。”

班主任又低头看了下自己女儿，轻声教育道，“给哥哥道歉。”

宋郁其实刚想说不用的，但是豆豆脆生生地仰头道：

“对不起。”

“我不是故意的。”

宋郁没办法，只能顺着道：

“没关系的。”

就在这时服务员也找好了桌子，班主任抬手把孩子抱起来了，很温和地说了几句“手指是不是黏黏的”、“妈妈带你去洗手”之类的话。

最后回头对宋郁道：

“行了，你有事就先走吧。”

“老师不留你了。”

宋郁很礼貌地点了下头，但就在准备离开的时候——

豆豆趴在妈妈的怀里，眼睛又黑又亮，盯着宋郁的肩头，大声地道：

“坏小鸟！”

白粼粼鸟躯一震。
chunks.englishText:
The homeroom teacher nodded and then asked:

"Then why did you come to Suian District? Isn't your home in Pinghu District?"

"It's because..."

The two were conversing, completely ignoring the child and the bird beside them.

Bai Linlin tucked his wings and raised his head arrogantly. A mere hash brown, that's all.

Seeing the bird unmoved, Doudou took the hash brown back and ate it herself, obediently.

The bird grew anxious.

Th-that was bought for him by Song Yu!

Doudou looked up at the bird, then very seriously took out another piece. This time, after thinking for a moment, she dipped it in ketchup and reached out to offer it.

"..."

Bai Linlin maintained his strategic composure. He couldn't just go down easily; don't even think about catching him.

Doudou had no choice but to eat it herself.

Bird: !!

Doudou reached out to take a hash brown again. This time there was only one left. She looked up at the bird.

Staring at each other.

Doudou prepared to put it into her own mouth, moving slowly.

Bai Linlin was truly anxious, his wings even stretching out.

But just then—

Doudou smiled, a pair of dimples appearing at the corners of her lips. As if she had guessed something, she forcefully extended that intact hash brown.

The little girl mouthed the words:

[You eat.]

-

The homeroom teacher was a bit surprised when she heard this. "Huaihe Road?"

"Many place names in Suian were changed a few years ago. The district mayor at the time was pushing for some economic development zone and merged several of them."

The homeroom teacher took out her phone as she spoke, looking for a contact while asking:

"Are you sure the seller you found gave you this address? What kind of ancient book is so important?"

Song Yu nodded, his expression unchanging:

"Yes, I have a grandfather who does research. He needs this book, so I'm helping him look for it."

Song Yu often went to Chen Kaihe's house when he was a child and had seen the books there; some were unique copies, so he just happened to use that as an excuse. He hadn't expected it to be such a coincidence that his homeroom teacher was from Suian District, with her grandparents having lived here.

"Oh, found it."

"But my father's meaning is that Huaihe Road is no longer a road now; it has become... a small alley."

The homeroom teacher sent the location over and tucked a strand of hair behind her ear.

Song Yu picked up his phone to check the location and was stunned, because that path didn't even have a name, and the location was pinned to a residential building nearby.

"He said that in the early 2000s, Nanshi was doing some road planning. The residential buildings around Huaihe Road were relocated to build factories. Later, the factories were demolished, and they thought about housing migrant workers, so they built residential buildings again."

"The roads were built narrower and narrower, and the buildings were squeezed deeper and deeper. That area has now become a densely populated area with high mobility."

The homeroom teacher frowned and finally advised:

"Don't go."

"This isn't right. What about your communication records with that seller? Let the teacher see."

Song Yu was taken aback. He hadn't expected her to want to check that, but just then—

The cola spilled.

The bird had kicked it over, unperturbed.

The scene was a bit chaotic for a moment. The homeroom teacher frowned and picked up Doudou, and the bird was also picked up by someone.

The table was a mess.

At this moment, the waiter came to serve the meal, and the homeroom teacher had to interrupt the original conversation to start discussing changing tables.

The bird winked at the human.

Song Yu immediately reacted and quickly said:

"Teacher, I've thought about it. I won't go. I'll explain it clearly to that grandfather of mine. Don't worry."

"But I've already eaten, so I won't disturb you and your child's meal any longer."

The homeroom teacher had been frowning while disciplining her child, and only then did she turn her head, urging him again:

"Right, make it clear to that elder of yours. No one would use an old address from many years ago; who knows what their purpose is."

"Are you leaving now? I'm so sorry, this child isn't usually like this."

The homeroom teacher looked down at her daughter again and said softly, "Apologize to your big brother."

Song Yu actually wanted to say it wasn't necessary, but Doudou looked up crisply and said:

"I'm sorry."

"I didn't mean to."

Song Yu had no choice but to go along with it:

"It's okay."

Just then, the waiter had found a table. The homeroom teacher picked up her child and said a few gentle things like "Are your fingers sticky?" and "Mom will take you to wash your hands."

Finally, she turned back to Song Yu and said:

"Alright, if you have things to do, go ahead."

"Teacher won't keep you."

Song Yu nodded politely, but just as he was about to leave—

Doudou, lying in her mother's arms, her eyes dark and bright, stared at Song Yu's shoulder and shouted:

"Bad little bird!"

Bai Linlin’s bird-body shuddered.

chunks.chineseText:
第24章

鸟东张西望，鸟歪头梳理羽毛，鸟低头调整站姿。

“豆豆，不可以这样说话。”

班主任低头看着怀里的女儿，很是不赞同地道。

不过她还是关注到了小朋友的情绪不对劲，抬手摸了摸女儿的额头，耐心问：

“哥哥的小鸟不可爱吗？”

“怎么会是坏小鸟呢？”

“告诉妈妈原因好不好？”

豆豆像个小牛犊一样顶开了妈妈的手掌，不哭不闹的，只是直勾勾地看着对面的鸟。

白粼粼还在低头看爪子，伸了伸鸟腿，噢，今天的脚环是银色的欸……

鸟表面若无其事。

实则冷汗直冒。

但好在豆豆最后也没有说出来“可乐是鸟踹翻的”这种话，只是看到鸟回避视线后，扁了扁嘴巴，也有样学样地歪头：

“哼！”

友谊的小船说翻就翻。

班主任见状也有些不好意思，只是回头同宋郁解释了几句：

“这孩子她今天闹小脾气，你不要介意。”

“没事的，它在家也顽皮的。”

宋郁很自然地说出了口，后知后觉这有点像监护人的口气。

不由得怔了下。

班主任闻言笑了下，抬手护着女儿的脖颈道：

“这样也好。”

“看你状态好多了。”

-

后面总算是出了麦当劳，鸟如释重负，但也有一丢丢的愧疚。

“……”

那、那下次请她吃薯饼吧！

鸟很认真地思考着，爪子稳稳地站着，还仰了仰头。

“问到了地址，但是现在快下午了，我们得回家。”

宋郁侧眸同鸟商量道，顺带又问了下：

“还要买东西吗？”

大约二十分钟后。

库里南后座已经放满了东西，大大小小的包装袋，一层摞着一层，犹如个金字塔。

塔尖尖站着鸟，正在非常认真地品鉴。

宋郁只是还在低头查路线，从锦园到槐河路大概需要半个小时左右……那地方停车的位置似乎很少。

那应该坐地铁。

不过就在这时。

车子拐了个弯，金字塔尖上的鸟一个重心不稳——

宋郁头也不抬地伸手，掌心往下一沉，一只圆滚滚的小鸡翻了个身。

立正了。

白粼粼咂巴咂巴喙，回味了一下刚刚的芋泥小蛋糕。

好吃！

鸟扭头一看，发现人在看手机，左右摇摆着就往这边攀爬了。

宋郁眼眸微动了下，但没有阻止，只是放任鸟在他的小臂上走路。

有种痒痒麻麻的感觉。

拿手机的是左手，接鸟是用的右手，其实距离本来就很短。

飞一下就可以了。

但是白粼粼晃晃悠悠地走到宋郁的手肘那里后，认真目测了一下宽度，收紧翅根，开始伸鸟腿……

试图跨过去。

“……”

宋郁直接抬手把鸟给拿了起来，放到了自己腕骨处，便于它看屏幕。

但正当他打算继续滑动屏幕的时候，车子已经稳稳地停了下来。

到家了。

宋郁其实也就愣神了那么一秒，他的手指被一个软软的爪子踩了下，鸟试图上来。

“啾啾。”

伴随着鸟叫之外，还有手指往下压的动作，这导致人无意识地滑了下屏幕。

宋郁低头过来看的时候，地图app的页面已经被滑走了，取而代之的是手机主页。

而此刻，壁纸露了出来，是一张巨大的鸟头怼脸照。

“……”

“……”

鸟一个迅速抬头，但人更快，立马侧了过去。

宋郁甚至心跳有些快，有种莫名其妙的心虚。

但就在这时。

“小郁，下车吧。”

司机已经从驾驶位下来了，但刚拉开车门就愣住了。

因为后座的少年正偏着脸，面色有点微微泛红。

这怎么了？

不过他也没来得及问什么，因为少年下来得很快，几乎立马就要走。

司机只能提醒小吃没拿。

一人一鸟又折返，抱走了那一大摞东西。

-

锦园。

白粼粼正板板正正地站在大理石餐桌上，仰头看着人。

“……”

“……”

宋郁只能道：“是上次和阿姨视频截图的。”

鸟还在仰头看。

“不可以吗？”

鸟摇了摇头。

宋郁面色微微沉了下来，但已经想好了，不换。

不过就在这时——

“要重拍！”

少年闻言怔了下，但还是自动地拿出来了手机，打开了摄像头，非常行云流水的动作。

鸟立马扑棱翅膀站在了那堆小吃盒子上方，收了收翅膀。

微微侧头。

摆pose。

白粼粼刚看到那张照片的时候，其实是有点羞涩的，毕竟他从来没有被人设过壁纸。

这还算是头一遭。

但是！

那张实在是太丑了，是截图，甚至还有残影。

白粼粼抱着必出神图的决心站在了“金字塔”尖尖上，矜持道：

“拍吧。”

昂首挺胸的一只小鸡。

-

中午的时间就这么过去了，下午也没出去，宋郁回了卧室就打开了Photoshop。

肩头的小鸟在指挥：

“这个这个，把我的喙上的奶油擦了。”

“对对对。”

“后面背景要深一下。”

“我的羽毛是不是不太顺啊？”

宋郁坐在椅子上，修长的手指在鼠标上不断地点按，全部按照要求去P。

但是最终的成果是……

一只超绝长腿、二倍大鸟眼，同时身体瘦了一圈的神奇物种诞生。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼在仔细观摩，后面不得不承认：

“要不还是改回最开始那一版吧。”

宋郁松了一口气，操作了下，屏幕上是一只朴实无华的小鸟。

鸟眼圆圆，在歪头看镜头。

“那……那你设这个成壁纸吧。”

白粼粼站直了身子，还仰了仰头，很是屈尊降贵地道。

宋郁轻笑了下，但还是温声道：

“好。”

-

最终选择去槐河路的时间其实是凌晨，主要原因有两个：

一是晚上人流量少，就算形态不稳定也还可以及时控制。

二是宋郁也不想拖太久了，毕竟不知道频繁地切换形态会不会对他的小鸟有伤害。

于是在凌晨两点一过，一人一鸟就出现在了玄关这里。

白粼粼有点困，张了张喙，顺带伸过去了鸟腿。

“晚上有点冷，不戴脚环了，换成背带吧。”

白粼粼点了点头，都困得睁不开眼了，还是开始“大鹏展翅”。

宋郁垂眸给鸟套上，其实背带比脚环也就多了胸前的一小块布料，但他觉得应该会保暖一些。

一分钟过后。

鸟穿着一套西部牛仔风格的背带，看着着实洋气不少。

宋郁只是加了个外套，把玄关门带上之后就叫了车。

地铁这个时间不可行。

家里的车更不行。

还是打车比较稳妥。

大约是半个小时的车程，一人一鸟来到了目的地。

白粼粼也睡够了，此刻精神了一点，环顾看了看四周。

在他们面前的是一条很窄的小巷，两侧是破旧不堪的居民楼，外墙甚至还缠着电线。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 24

The bird looked left and right, tilted its head to preen its feathers, and lowered its head to adjust its stance.

"Doudou, you mustn't speak like that."

The homeroom teacher looked down at her daughter in her arms, her expression one of disapproval.

However, she still noticed that the child’s mood was off. She reached out to touch her daughter's forehead and asked patiently:

"Isn't Big Brother's little bird cute?"

"How could it be a bad little bird?"

"Won't you tell Mommy the reason?"

Doudou pushed her mother’s hand away like a stubborn little calf. She didn't cry or make a scene; she just stared straight at the bird across from her.

Bai Linlin was still looking down at its claws, stretching its bird leg. *Oh, the leg band is silver today, huh...*

The bird appeared nonchalant on the surface.

In reality, it was breaking out in a cold sweat.

Fortunately, Doudou didn't end up saying something like, "The bird knocked over the Coke." Seeing the bird avoid eye contact, she pouted and tilted her head in imitation:

"Hmph!"

The ship of friendship had capsized just like that.

Seeing this, the teacher felt a bit embarrassed and turned to explain to Song Yu:

"The child is having a bit of a tantrum today; please don't mind it."

"It's fine. It’s mischievous at home, too."

Song Yu said this naturally, only realizing afterward that it sounded like a guardian's tone.

He couldn't help but pause for a moment.

The teacher smiled upon hearing this and reached out to shield her daughter's neck, saying:

"That's good, then."

"You look much better."

-

They finally made it out of McDonald's. The bird felt a sense of relief, but also a tiny bit of guilt.

"..."

*W-well, I'll treat her to a hash brown next time!*

The bird thought about it very seriously, standing firmly on its claws and tilting its head up.

"I got the address, but it's almost afternoon now. We need to go home."

Song Yu glanced sideways to discuss it with the bird, adding:

"Do you need to buy anything else?"

About twenty minutes later.

The backseat of the Cullinan was filled with items—bags of all sizes stacked layer upon layer, like a pyramid.

Perched at the very peak of the tower was the bird, inspecting the goods with great seriousness.

Song Yu was still looking down, checking the route. It would take about half an hour from Jin Yuan to Huaihe Road... and parking there seemed to be quite scarce.

*Maybe I should take the subway.*

But just then.

The car made a turn, and the bird at the peak of the pyramid lost its balance—

Without looking up, Song Yu reached out, his palm sinking downward, and a round little chicken flipped over.

It stood at attention.

Bai Linlin smacked its beak, savoring the aftertaste of the taro cake from earlier.

*Delicious!*

The bird turned its head and saw the human looking at his phone, so it waddled over, swaying from side to side.

Song Yu’s eyes flickered, but he didn't stop it, letting the bird walk along his forearm.

It felt ticklish and tingling.

He was holding the phone in his left hand and catching the bird with his right; the distance was actually quite short.

It could just fly over.

But after Bai Linlin waddled to Song Yu’s elbow, it carefully measured the width, tightened its wing roots, and began to stretch its bird leg...

Attempting to step across.

"..."

Song Yu simply picked the bird up and placed it on his wrist so it could see the screen.

But just as he intended to continue scrolling, the car came to a steady stop.

They were home.

Song Yu was actually stunned for a second. His finger was stepped on by a soft claw; the bird was trying to climb up.

"Chirp."

Along with the chirp, there was a downward pressure on his finger, which caused him to scroll the screen unconsciously.

When Song Yu looked down, the map app page had been swiped away, replaced by the phone's home screen.

And at that moment, the wallpaper was revealed: a giant, close-up photo of a bird's head.

"..."

"..."

The bird quickly looked up, but the human was faster, immediately turning his head away.

Song Yu’s heart was even beating a bit fast; he felt an inexplicable sense of guilt.

But just then.

"Xiao Yu, let's get out."

The driver had already stepped out of the driver's seat, but he froze the moment he opened the door.

Because the youth in the backseat was looking away, his face slightly flushed.

*What’s wrong with him?*

But he didn't have time to ask, as the youth got out quickly, almost immediately walking away.

The driver could only remind him that he hadn't taken the snacks.

Man and bird turned back, carrying away that large pile of things.

-

Jin Yuan.

Bai Linlin was standing straight as a board on the marble dining table, looking up at the human.

"..."

"..."

Song Yu could only say: "It was a screenshot from the video call with the auntie last time."

The bird was still looking up.

"Is it not allowed?"

The bird shook its head.

Song Yu’s expression darkened slightly, but he had already made up his mind: he wasn't changing it.

However, just then—

"Need to retake it!"

The youth was stunned for a moment, but he automatically took out his phone and opened the camera, his movements smooth and practiced.

The bird immediately flapped its wings and stood atop the pile of snack boxes, tucking its wings in.

It tilted its head slightly.

Striking a pose.

When Bai Linlin first saw that photo, it was actually a bit shy; after all, it had never been someone's wallpaper before.

This was a first.

But!

That one was just too ugly; it was a screenshot, and it even had motion blur.

Bai Linlin stood at the peak of the "pyramid," determined to produce a masterpiece, and said with reserve:

"Shoot."

A little chicken, head held high and chest puffed out.

-

The afternoon passed just like that. They didn't go out; Song Yu returned to his bedroom and opened Photoshop.

The bird on his shoulder was directing:

"This, this, erase the cream on my beak."

"Yes, that's it."

"The background needs to be darker."

"Are my feathers not smooth enough?"

Song Yu sat in the chair, his slender fingers clicking the mouse repeatedly, editing everything according to the demands.

But the final result was...

A miraculous creature with super-long legs, eyes twice their normal size, and a body that had been slimmed down.

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin studied it carefully, and eventually had to admit:

"Maybe we should just change it back to the first version."

Song Yu breathed a sigh of relief and operated the software. On the screen was a simple, unadorned little bird.

Its eyes were round, tilting its head to look at the lens.

"Then... then set this as your wallpaper."

Bai Linlin stood tall, tilted its head up, and said with great condescension.

Song Yu chuckled softly, but said gently:

"Alright."

-

The time they finally chose to go to Huaihe Road was in the middle of the night. There were two main reasons:

First, there was less foot traffic at night, so even if his form was unstable, he could still control it in time.

Second, Song Yu didn't want to drag it out too long; after all, he didn't know if frequently switching forms would harm his little bird.

So, just past two in the morning, man and bird appeared in the entryway.

Bai Linlin was a bit sleepy, opened its beak, and stretched out its bird leg.

"It's a bit cold at night. We won't use the leg band; let's switch to a harness."

Bai Linlin nodded. Even though it was too sleepy to keep its eyes open, it still started to "spread its wings like a roc."

Song Yu lowered his eyes to put it on. The harness actually only had a tiny bit more fabric over the chest than the leg band, but he felt it would be warmer.

A minute later.

The bird was wearing a Western cowboy-style harness, looking quite stylish.

Song Yu simply added a jacket, closed the entryway door, and called a car.

The subway wasn't an option at this hour.

The family car was even less of an option.

Taking a taxi was the most reliable choice.

After about a thirty-minute ride, man and bird arrived at their destination.

Bai Linlin had slept enough and was feeling a bit more energetic now, looking around at its surroundings.

Before them was a very narrow alleyway, flanked by dilapidated residential buildings with electrical wires tangled along the exterior walls.

chunks.chineseText:
不过出乎意料的是，这里并不冷清，反而是挺热闹的。

有边走边打电话的加班族，还有骑着摩托送外卖的小哥，楼里窗户也有外放综艺的声音。

宋郁就站在马路牙子上，这是个丁字路口，司机刚刚把他们放在这里了。

鸟也探头探脑的，心想这怎么找到那个24号，这全部都是楼房啊？

“欸让一让……”

宋郁靠边站了下，一个外卖小哥开了进去，电摩的声音也渐行渐远。

“我们进去看看？”

白粼粼闻言点了点头，往人的脖子那里贴了贴，好奇。

这条小巷虽然窄，但是一侧好歹还是有个人行道，旁边的围墙上长着攀爬的藤曼，偶尔看见几朵挂着的花。

宋郁就在这么走着，偶尔会有几个行人路过，有年轻人，有抱着孩子的夫妻，都是来谋生的。

鸟甚至都困了。

但就在快要走到小巷的尽头的时候，周遭的声音突然全部消失了。

是一瞬间。

宋郁蹙了下眉，但还是站在原地不动了，就在这时身后一阵细细簌簌的动静传来。

-

S州这边。

宋峥国已经修养了几天，虽说身体状况恢复到以前是不大可能的，但托人调查一下他不在这段时间发生了什么事，还是很可以的。

陈开鹤在病房里照顾着，其实面色有点担忧，这才过去几天，光电话都打了多少个……

“峥国，我觉得你还是先放一放手头的事，身体还是第一位的。”

陈开鹤还是没忍住劝道。

但病床上的人神色平静，只是在翻了医院心理科给的相关杂志，面色冷淡地道：

“不要担心，我既然醒了，就不会再像当年一样……”

宋峥国似乎是想起了什么，微微皱了眉，还是问了句：

“我那个混账儿子到了么？”

陈开鹤本来是打算用手机问下的，但是就在这时，门口传来了动静。

宋启明风尘仆仆的，西服都起了皱，脸上也是一脸憔悴，进门就道：

“爸。”

但下一秒就是——

“跪下。”

-

小巷里漆黑一片，只有路灯开着，原本零零散散开着灯的住户此刻全部灭了。

或者说，两侧的居民楼里的人像是瞬间清空了。

身后的东西还在靠近……

鸟害怕，鸟头都埋进了人的衣领里，丝毫没有注意到他的翅膀边缘有流动的金纹。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，直接回头看了，但是目光所及空荡荡的，细细簌簌的声音也停了。

与此同时肩头突然一沉。

白粼粼突然控制不住地变大，翅膀开始扩展，爪子也随之在路面上划出痕迹。

当然最主要的还是身躯。

刺啦——

寂静的夜里，鸟的小背带被撑破了

也就在这时，空气里传来一阵阵尖细的议论声：

“哈哈哈哈……”

“它还穿小背心！”

“羞死人了。”

宋郁震惊，不知道这声音是从哪里出来的，直到低头一看。

西部牛仔风格背带孤零零地躺在地上，四分五裂。

而它的后面——

站着一排排西服革履的花枝鼠。

此刻正在仰头看过来。

“……”

“……”

宋郁面色有些茫然，张了张口，不知道说些什么。

白粼粼看到地面后也宕机了，甚至忘记反击了，心想这什么小卡拉米？

就在这时这队伍里传出来一句话：

“那个，劳烦让一下。”

宋郁不由自主地往旁边撤了撤，然后就看着这一队花枝鼠排排地往前走，然后开始朝着围墙拐弯。

可那里没有——

为首的一只花枝鼠在墙上凭空拉开了一扇小门，里面闪出了夺目的光芒。

鸟也懵了。

然后就是一排排鼠往里进，其中一只还扎着小绷带，宋郁莫名觉得熟悉。

这是黎笙医院的那只皮皮？

等到都快进完的时候，最后一只贼兮兮地扭头，上下打量了下宋郁和鸟。

“多大了还让监护人跟着来。”

“啧啧。”

啪嗒——

小门关上了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 24 (Part 2)

Unexpectedly, it wasn't quiet here; rather, it was quite lively.

There were office workers on the phone while walking, delivery riders on motorcycles, and the sounds of variety shows drifting from the windows of the buildings.

Song Yu stood on the curb at a T-junction where the driver had just dropped them off.

The bird was also poking its head around, wondering how they were supposed to find number 24 when everything was just apartment buildings.

"Hey, excuse me..."

Song Yu stepped aside as a delivery rider drove in, the sound of the electric scooter fading into the distance.

"Shall we go in and take a look?"

Bai Linlin nodded at this, pressing against the human's neck, feeling curious.

Although the alley was narrow, there was at least a sidewalk on one side, with climbing vines growing on the adjacent wall and the occasional flower hanging down.

Song Yu walked along. Occasionally, a few pedestrians would pass by—young people, couples holding children—all just trying to make a living.

The bird was even getting sleepy.

But just as they were about to reach the end of the alley, all the surrounding sounds suddenly vanished.

In an instant.

Song Yu frowned but stayed where he was. Just then, a rustling sound came from behind them.

-

Over in S Province.

Song Zhengguo had been recuperating for a few days. While it was unlikely his physical condition would ever return to what it once was, he was still quite capable of having people investigate what had happened during his absence.

Chen Kaihe was taking care of him in the hospital room, though he looked a bit worried. It had only been a few days, and the number of phone calls he’d made...

"Zhengguo, I think you should put these matters aside for now. Your health comes first."

Chen Kaihe couldn't help but advise him.

But the man on the hospital bed remained calm, merely flipping through a magazine provided by the hospital's psychology department, his expression cold as he said:

"Don't worry. Since I've woken up, I won't let things happen like they did back then..."

Song Zhengguo seemed to recall something, frowning slightly, before asking:

"Has my good-for-nothing son arrived?"

Chen Kaihe had been planning to use his phone to check, but just then, there was a commotion at the door.

Song Qiming arrived, dusty and travel-worn, his suit wrinkled and his face haggard. He walked in and said:

"Dad."

But the next second came the command:

"Kneel."

-

The alley was pitch black, with only the streetlights on. The residents who had previously had their lights on now had them all extinguished.

Or rather, it was as if the people in the residential buildings on both sides had been cleared out in an instant.

The thing behind them was still closing in...

The bird was terrified, burying its head into the human's collar, completely unaware that golden patterns were flowing along the edges of its wings.

Song Yu frowned and turned around to look, but his gaze met only emptiness, and the rustling sound had stopped.

At the same time, his shoulder suddenly sank.

Bai Linlin suddenly lost control and grew larger, its wings expanding, its claws carving marks into the road surface.

Of course, the main thing was its body.

*Rip—*

In the silent night, the bird's little harness was torn apart.

And just then, a series of high-pitched, gossiping voices came from the air:

"Hahahaha..."

"It’s even wearing a little vest!"

"How embarrassing."

Song Yu was shocked, not knowing where the voices were coming from, until he looked down.

The Western cowboy-style harness lay lonely on the ground, torn to pieces.

And behind it—

Stood rows of fancy rats in suits.

They were currently looking up.

"..."

"..."

Song Yu’s expression was dazed; he opened his mouth, not knowing what to say.

Bai Linlin also froze upon seeing the ground, even forgetting to counterattack, thinking, *What kind of small fries are these?*

Just then, a voice came from the ranks:

"Excuse me, please move aside."

Song Yu couldn't help but step to the side, and then he watched as this line of fancy rats marched forward in a row, then began to turn toward the wall.

But there was nothing there—

The lead fancy rat pulled open a small door out of thin air on the wall, and dazzling light flashed from within.

The bird was also bewildered.

Then, row after row of rats went inside. One of them was even wearing a small bandage, which Song Yu found strangely familiar.

*Is that Pipi from the Li Sheng Hospital?*

When almost all of them had entered, the last one turned its head sneakily, looking Song Yu and the bird up and down.

"How old are you, still letting a guardian follow you."

"Tsk tsk."

*Clack—*

The small door closed.

chunks.chineseText:
第25章

此刻巷子里一片安静，路灯下只余庞大的鸟与懵掉的少年。

宋郁不由自主地去看这个围墙，灰扑扑的，甚至还有些掉灰。

他抬手去敲了下，是实心的，这……哪里来的门？

不过就在这时，身后的鸟反应过来了，羽毛都炸了炸，左右摇摆地走到围墙那里，踹了一爪子，怒斥道：

“出来出来！”

“一群小卡拉米！”

白粼粼这会儿一点也不害怕了，爪子都在围墙上划出来痕迹来，但是四周仍然是静悄悄的。

宋郁仰头看了下这个围墙，面色微微怔了下。

因为在那些藤蔓的覆盖之下，墙壁上隐隐约约显露出来两个数字：

24号。

仿佛是个坐标。

也就在这时，身后又有了动静，一人一鸟都回了头。

三只系着领带的柯尔鸭正在往这边走，伴随着此起彼伏的“嘎嘎”声。

“刚刚鼠二跟我发消息，它说门口见到个巨婴哈哈哈哈……”

“长那么老大只，还要家里人——”

为首的柯尔鸭抬头一看，正好撞上一人一鸟的视线里。

尤其是那只巨鸟。

路灯的光线全被它挡住了，三只柯尔鸭正好全处在阴影中。

“……”

“……”

柯尔鸭也没想到这只巨鸟还没进去，说闲话正好说到正主面前。

“咳咳，那个，你是新来的呀？我没见过你啊。”

柯尔鸭正了正色道，好似刚才笑得最大声的不是它。

白粼粼怒气冲冲的，刚想要辩论一二，宋郁就先一步开口了：

“这怎么进去的？”

“我的小鸟好像进不去。”

柯尔鸭仰着头，其实还是有些意外的，它啪嗒啪嗒走到靠近围墙的地方，身后的两只也紧紧地跟着。

“就这样。”

柯尔鸭伸了下翅膀，羽毛在接触到墙壁的瞬间，水泥材质突然像是变成了波纹状，很轻松地拉开了“门”。

里面再度闪出来强烈的光。

甚至还能听到里面传来的音乐……

一人一鸟再次看呆。

但就在此时。

柯尔鸭撇了一眼人，赶在对方开口之前，就立马左右摇摆地进去了，速度快快的。

砰——

中号门再度关上了。

一片寂静。

“……”

“……”

鸟觉得遭到了歧视，但是他还是也有样学样地走到了围墙那里，开始伸翅膀……

场景犹如慢动作。

人也相当期待，甚至不自觉摒住了呼吸。

就在长长的羽毛接触到围墙的一瞬间——

打了个弯。

扑簌扑簌。

围墙上的水泥皮掉下来不少，在安静的夜里显得十分明显。

白粼粼：“……”

搞什么歧视！

宋郁也蹙了蹙眉，为什么进不去？

地址就是这里，而且他的小鸟已经收到了“通行证”。

没道理进不去的。

这个时间气温其实已经凉了，天空还是黑沉沉的，宋郁低头看了下手机。

意外地发现没有信号了。

并且时间也不早了。

少年在寒风中立着，觉得事情有些难办。

但就在这时，身侧的冷风却突然停了，宋郁不由得侧眸去看……

是张开的翅膀，羽毛紧密扎实，此刻正虚虚拢着他。

宋郁愣住了，转而回头去看鸟。

但白粼粼莫名有点羞涩，偏开了头。

路灯还在那里孤零零地站着，照着下面的一人一鸟。

夜里静悄悄的。

后面大约又等了十几分钟。

先是来了一对猫，三花和狸花，脖子上戴着皮质的项圈，走路优雅。

看到一人一鸟后也只是停了下脚步，没有要攀谈的意思。

只是拉开门的时候说了句：

“怎么带着监护人来……”

“它不怕人类抛弃它么？”

“不过那个监护人长得不错。”

白粼粼：“……”

到底要说多少遍？

这一晚上几个了？

鸟很是不忿，宋郁就是要陪他，你们的监护人不来是因为没有吗？！

不过就在这时，门从里侧打开了，出来了一只身着蓝色制服的杜宾犬。

是……站着的。

宋郁以为自己接受度很高了，但是在看到这个人模人样的杜宾犬之后，还是沉默了。

是人形。

但是狗头。

制服紧紧的，看着很有肌肉，还……挺合身的。

白粼粼见状也惊呆了，这怎么还有制服？

那他穿的背带岂不是和情趣内衣一样？

“……”

那还不如不穿！

不过就在这时，杜宾看了看对面的人和鸟，蹙了下眉，拿出来一张照片。

进行比对。

照片有A4纸那么大，主人翁是一只站在餐桌上的鸟，正在哐哐炫糖醋排骨，爪子都朝两边滑开了。

不过是从外面拍的，因而只能看到圆滚滚的背影。

杜宾很严肃地举了照片过去，问：

“这照片是你吗？”

宋郁还是头一次看到自己不曾见过的鸟，这是在一楼的餐厅，它……是在吃排骨？

这是什么时候的事？

“不是！”

鸟一口咬定不认，顺带想要用翅膀盖住人的眼睛，但已经来不及了。

宋郁只是侧头问：“你那时候就在吃？”

“……”

杜宾一看就知道怎么回事了，收回了照片，很是严肃地教育道：

“中央发补助的时间很早，怎么现在才来报道？”

“你知道这样多危险吗？万一不小心被人类拍到了怎么办？不仅会引起社会舆论，更重要的是你的生命安全都受到了威胁！”

白粼粼：“……”

为什么有种熟悉的感觉。

杜宾刚想再说几句，但是旁边的“监护人”说话了：

“可我的小鸟找不到路。”

“槐河路在地图上甚至都没有标，它还不到一岁。”

白粼粼：！！

人，你是最好的人。

杜宾闻言皱了皱眉，很认真地道：

“通行证是中央发的，对于基层路况的更新不太及时，这个我会反映。”

“但是，关于路线指引这里，文字基本上是不需要的，而是……”

杜宾刚想接着说，但却看到了鸟翅膀上流动着的金纹，很暗，甚至断断续续的。

？

怎么会贫困到这个地步。

“这样，你再看一眼。”

杜宾伸过来了手，掌下有流动着金色线，来回缠绕，好似有生命力一样。

放置在了那个人类口中的“小”鸟身上。

“顺带让你的监护人也看看……”

白粼粼本来还不懂什么意思，但在被触碰的一瞬间，他的整个身躯都像是充满了力量，翅膀也的纹路里都有了流动的金纹。

宋郁也怔住了，他的腕骨上缠了一圈“金线”，来回游动，像是活了一样。

但还来不及多观察几秒——

“闭眼。”

这句话一说完，宋郁就感觉自己眼前变黑了，没有任何征兆，但下一秒，脑海里突然多了一片宽广的视野。

还是那个小巷，但是与之前不同的是，地面铺陈着非常千丝万缕的金线，犹如一整条金河……

绵延不绝。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 25 (Part 1)

The alley was quiet once more, with only the massive bird and the bewildered youth remaining under the streetlights.

Song Yu couldn't help but look at the wall; it was gray and dusty, with some of the plaster even flaking off.

He reached out to knock on it—it was solid. *Where... where did the door come from?*

But just then, the bird behind him reacted. Its feathers bristled, and it waddled over to the wall, kicked it with a claw, and scolded:

"Come out, come out!"

"A bunch of small fries!"

Bai Linlin wasn't afraid at all now; its claws were carving marks into the wall, but the surroundings remained deathly silent.

Song Yu looked up at the wall, his expression slightly stunned.

Because, hidden beneath the covering vines, two numbers were faintly visible on the wall:

Number 24.

It was as if it were a coordinate.

Just then, there was movement behind them again, and both man and bird turned their heads.

Three Call ducks wearing ties were walking toward them, accompanied by a chorus of "quack-quack" sounds.

"Rat Two sent me a message just now; it said it saw a giant baby at the entrance, hahaha..."

"So big, and still needing family to—"

The lead Call duck looked up and happened to meet the gaze of the man and the bird.

Especially that giant bird.

The streetlight's glow was completely blocked by it, leaving the three Call ducks entirely in the shadows.

"..."

"..."

The Call ducks hadn't expected the giant bird to still be outside, and they had happened to gossip right in front of the subject.

"Ahem, well, are you new here? I haven't seen you before."

The Call duck straightened up, acting as if it hadn't been the one laughing the loudest just a moment ago.

Bai Linlin was furious and just about to argue, but Song Yu spoke first:

"How do you get in?"

"My little bird doesn't seem to be able to enter."

The Call duck tilted its head, actually quite surprised. It waddled over to the wall, the two behind it following closely.

"Just like this."

The Call duck stretched out a wing. The moment its feathers touched the wall, the cement material suddenly seemed to turn into ripples, and it pulled open a "door" with ease.

Intense light flashed from within once more.

They could even hear music coming from inside...

Man and bird were stunned again.

But just then.

The Call duck glanced at the human and, before he could speak, immediately waddled inside, moving very quickly.

*Bang—*

The medium-sized door closed again.

Silence.

"..."

"..."

The bird felt discriminated against, but it still followed suit, walking to the wall and beginning to stretch out its wing...

The scene was like slow motion.

The human was also quite expectant, even holding his breath unconsciously.

The moment the long feathers touched the wall—

They bent.

*Rustle, rustle.*

A significant amount of cement plaster fell from the wall, appearing very conspicuous in the quiet night.

Bai Linlin: "..."

*What’s with the discrimination!*

Song Yu also frowned. Why couldn't it get in?

The address was correct, and his little bird had already received the "pass."

There was no reason it shouldn't be able to enter.

The temperature had already turned cold at this hour, and the sky was still dark and heavy. Song Yu looked down at his phone.

He was surprised to find there was no signal.

And it wasn't early anymore.

The youth stood in the cold wind, feeling that the situation was becoming difficult.

But just then, the cold wind beside him suddenly stopped. Song Yu couldn't help but look to the side...

It was the spread wings, the feathers dense and solid, currently loosely shielding him.

Song Yu was stunned and turned to look at the bird.

But Bai Linlin was inexplicably shy and turned its head away.

The streetlight stood there alone, illuminating the man and bird beneath it.

The night was quiet.

They waited for about another ten minutes.

First came a pair of cats, a calico and a tabby, wearing leather collars and walking elegantly.

Seeing the man and bird, they only paused for a moment, with no intention of chatting.

But as they pulled open the door, they said:

"Why bring a guardian along..."

"Isn't it afraid humans will abandon it?"

"Though, that guardian looks pretty good."

Bai Linlin: "..."

*How many times do I have to say it?*

*How many have there been tonight?*

The bird was very indignant. Song Yu was just accompanying it; your guardians aren't here because you don't have any, right?!

However, just then, the door opened from the inside, and a Doberman in a blue uniform stepped out.

It was... standing.

Song Yu thought his acceptance level was quite high, but after seeing this human-like Doberman, he still fell silent.

It was a human form.

But with a dog's head.

The uniform was tight, looking very muscular, and... it actually fit quite well.

Bai Linlin was also stunned at the sight. *How is there even a uniform?*

*Doesn't that make the harness I was wearing like sexy lingerie?*

"..."

*That would have been better off not worn!*

But just then, the Doberman looked at the man and bird opposite, frowned, and took out a photo.

It compared them.

The photo was as large as an A4 sheet of paper. The protagonist was a bird standing on a dining table, frantically devouring sweet and sour pork ribs, its claws sliding out to both sides.

However, it was taken from the outside, so only a round, chubby back could be seen.

The Doberman held the photo up very seriously and asked:

"Is this photo you?"

It was the first time Song Yu had seen a bird he didn't recognize. This was in the first-floor dining room; was it... eating ribs?

When did this happen?

"No!"

The bird insisted on denying it, trying to use its wing to cover the human's eyes, but it was too late.

Song Yu just turned his head and asked: "You were eating then?"

"..."

The Doberman knew what was going on at a glance. It put the photo away and lectured very seriously:

"The central government issues subsidies very early; why are you only reporting now?"

"Do you know how dangerous this is? What if you were accidentally photographed by a human? Not only would it cause social repercussions, but more importantly, your own life safety would be threatened!"

Bai Linlin: "..."

*Why does this feel so familiar?*

The Doberman was just about to say a few more words, but the "guardian" beside it spoke up:

"But my little bird couldn't find the way."

"Huaihe Road isn't even marked on the map, and it's not even a year old yet."

Bai Linlin: !!

*Human, you are the best human.*

The Doberman frowned upon hearing this and said very seriously:

"The pass is issued by the central government; updates for local road conditions aren't very timely. I will report this."

"However, regarding route guidance, text is basically unnecessary; instead, it is..."

The Doberman was just about to continue, but it saw the golden patterns flowing on the bird's wings—very faint, and even intermittent.

?

*How could it be impoverished to this extent?*

"Like this, take another look."

The Doberman reached out a hand. Beneath its palm, golden threads flowed, winding back and forth as if they had a life of their own.

It placed its hand on the "little" bird the human spoke of.

"Let your guardian take a look, too..."

Bai Linlin hadn't understood what it meant at first, but the moment it was touched, its entire body felt filled with power, and the patterns on its wings were now filled with flowing golden lines.

Song Yu was also stunned. A circle of "golden thread" was wrapped around his wrist, moving back and forth as if alive.

But before he could observe it for more than a few seconds—

"Close your eyes."

As soon as these words were spoken, Song Yu felt his vision go black without any warning. But the next second, a vast field of vision suddenly appeared in his mind.

It was still the same alley, but unlike before, the ground was paved with countless golden threads, like an entire river of gold...

Stretching on endlessly.

chunks.chineseText:
而此刻意识又像是突然升空，宋郁甚至可以俯瞰整个南市，千丝万缕的金线流动在不同的大街小巷里，通往各个住户，而其中一个……指向平湖区的一栋别墅里。

像是城市的毛细血管。

-

与此同时，S州。

宋启明双膝下跪，面色很是颓废，即使再不情愿也得老实听训。

但他没想到的是，迎面就是一巴掌。

甚至不是用手打的。

是那本心理研究杂志。

宋启明脸上瞬间变得火辣辣的，低头看到了那本掉在地上的杂志，抬手捡起来了，压着情绪道：

“爸，您刚醒。”

“还是少动气为好。”

此刻病房里只有父子二人，宋峥国本来年轻的时候就血气方刚，老了更是不遑多让，见这孽子不服的样子，拿起旁边的康复拐杖就轮了过去。

砰——

陈开鹤在病房外面一咯噔，心里直着急，连忙双手合十求观音菩萨保佑老友不要再一下子撅过去。

不过后面他又仔细想想，这是在S州，为了入乡随俗，老头儿又开始比划十字。

这个时候有护士过来，很担忧地问里面发生了什么，想要进去。

陈开鹤连忙劝道：

“不用不用。”

“他们是父子，你知道的，中国文化里‘打是亲骂是爱’，他们在表达自己的亲近。”

护士：“……”

病房内。

宋启明最后还是跪得很直，手臂穿着衣服看不出来什么，但里面肯定是有了淤青。

他一声不吭。

“混账东西，里外不分，是非不辨！”

宋峥国很是生气地斥责道，最后反问了句：

“我死了有什么好处？你以为华秉是什么‘天朝上国’吗？这么着急上位？”

“你真是昏了头了，这不是宋家的一言堂！”

“我在的时候公司的董事对你还算是有所照拂，我不在这段时间，你看看你整成了什么样子！”

“业务停摆，舆论大起，税务也有问题！”

宋启明面色变得煞白，但是一句他都反驳不出来。

“公司这里，我原本对你也没什么指望……”宋峥国闭了闭眼，只是很怒其不争地道，“但你怎么连个父亲都当不好呢！”

“三心二意，听尽谗言，被一对不上大雅之堂的男女蒙骗七年！”

“你让小郁受了多少苦？”

宋峥国低着头，呼吸都变得急促，试图为自己辩白：

“爸，离婚官司打了，不会把家产分出去的。”

“厉峰我也处置了，不会让他好过的，我我……”

话还没说完，床头柜的茶杯摔了过来。

砰——

“我怎么会生出你这么个蠢货！”

-

国内仍然是午夜。

“可是为什么我的小鸟看不到这些指示线？”

宋郁回了回神，还是问了下面前的这只制服杜宾犬。

对方蹙了蹙眉，看向这只“大鸟”，很严肃地道：

“吃人类食物太多了。”

“气息都浑浊了。”

白粼粼：“……”

不过这只杜宾也没有再多说什么，只是说让进去报道，顺带提醒了句：

“247，你确定要带你的监护人进去？”

宋郁闻言脚步一停，面色很是平静，侧眸看向鸟，很是直白。

白粼粼莫名被盯得有些紧张，收了收翅根，虽然刚刚被那些卡拉米嘲笑了……

但是！

“我就要带！”

杜宾点了点头，在灰扑扑的墙壁上拉开了一道门。

里面闪着夺目的光。

而与此同时，外世界却是另一幅景象。

“喂您好，外卖给您放楼下了。”

外卖小哥用手臂夹着耳边的电话，借着路灯看单子。

身边恰好经过一对早起出门的父子。

“英语怎么能只考20分呢？”

“哎……你到学校多吃点吧。”

此刻单元楼前也有下来的工薪族，边走边抱怨道：

“我服了，还没睡多久又要上工，不过你看那个电视剧了没？小奶狗和大姐姐，要我说真是绝配！”

天空泛起鱼肚白，外卖小哥把东西放下，打了个哈欠，低头看了下手机。

——四点三十分。

-

里世界仍然是静悄悄的，一阵风吹了过来，藤蔓被刮起来点。

[24号]的字样是凿刻上去的，有流动的金纹。

下方还有一行小字：

——南市妖怪管理总局。

此时围墙之内：

入目而来是宽敞的大厅，棕色的地板泛着光，吊顶也是挂着水晶灯，折射出来彩色的光。

像是人类的偏好。

但唯一不同的是，这里到处都是小动物，有戴着墨镜开啤酒的黑猫，也有站在舞台上唱歌的一对珍珠鸟，还有围着打牌的花枝鼠……

里面被分成了不同的娱乐区。

不过更引人注目的，还是一个滚动着大屏幕，上面正在滚动一些字：

编号/姓名/物种/地理位置

012，咖啡，白猫，桃源小区垃圾分转站……

013，来福，黄狗，和平路与新河街交叉口……

014，球球，玉米蛇，兰苑小区12栋楼花丛……

……

白粼粼不太懂这是什么，但是看到了有各种各样的动物在排队。

手里还拿着小牌子。

？

不过就在这时，周遭似乎是注意到了来人，开始有了一些骚动。

“监护人？”

“它带监护人进来？”

一只豹纹守宫很是震惊地道，肉肉的爪子撑着垫子，它正在做瑜伽。

旁边的花枝鼠立马插了一句：

“是吧是吧，谁会让监护人来啊？”

“这里全都是妖怪。”

“监护人不来才正常。”

周遭聚在一起的小妖怪们都点了点头，是这样的，人类是很脆弱的，不能见到这种画面，会被吓到的。

而且，人还要睡觉。

白天都要去上班的。

它们要体谅监护人的。

由此得出结论：

是这只鸟太巨婴！

一点都不懂事。

但就在这时——

一只缠着绷带的小鼠轻轻地道：

“可是我好想我的监护人来看一看。”

“这样她就相信我说的是真的了。”

场面一时安静了下来。

不知道从谁开始，突然说了句：

“我家的人很忙的，总是加班很晚，他确实没空……但是他每次都给我带烤肠。”

“我家的也是，最近她还被老板骂哭了，抱着我睡着的……我有点想她了。”

“我家的……”

众妖怪开启了一场监护人交流会，本来都是挺好的心情，说到最后还有些emo。

“他们太忙了，这不是他们的错。”

后面一句话出来，得到所有妖怪的认可。

“是的，是的。”

“我们应该体谅。”

……

不过就在这时，杜宾已经引着编号247和他的监护人来到了指定的窗口。

对面是只穿着正装的丹顶鹤，见到人类还是有些意外的，不由得说了句：

“你不害怕？”

宋郁虽然觉得自己走入了一个怪诞的世界，但是毕竟他的小鸟在这里，他不可能走。

“不害怕。”
chunks.englishText:
At this moment, his consciousness felt as if it had suddenly ascended into the sky. Song Yu could even overlook the entire Nan City; thousands upon thousands of golden threads flowed through various streets and alleys, leading to different households, and one of them... pointed toward a villa in the Pinghu District.

It was like the capillaries of a city.

-

Meanwhile, in S Province.

Song Qiming was kneeling on both knees, his expression utterly dejected. Even though he was reluctant, he had to listen to the lecture honestly.

But what he didn't expect was a slap across the face.

It wasn't even delivered by a hand.

It was that psychology research journal.

Song Qiming’s face instantly burned with heat. He looked down to see the magazine that had fallen to the floor, reached out to pick it up, and suppressed his emotions as he said:

"Dad, you just woke up."

"It’s better to avoid getting worked up."

At this moment, only the father and son were in the hospital room. Song Zhengguo had been hot-blooded in his youth, and he was no less so in his old age. Seeing this unfilial son’s defiant look, he grabbed the rehabilitation crutch nearby and swung it over.

*Bang—*

Outside the room, Chen Kaihe jumped in shock. Anxious, he quickly pressed his palms together, praying to Guanyin Bodhisattva to ensure his old friend wouldn't just keel over right then and there.

However, after thinking about it, he realized they were in S Province. To "do as the locals do," the old man started making the sign of the cross.

Just then, a nurse came over, looking very worried, asking what was happening inside and wanting to enter.

Chen Kaihe hurriedly dissuaded her:

"No, no, there’s no need."

"They are father and son. You know, in Chinese culture, 'to beat is to love, to scold is to care.' They are just expressing their closeness."

Nurse: "..."

Inside the room.

Song Qiming eventually knelt very straight. His arms were covered by his clothes, so the bruises weren't visible, but there were certainly welts underneath.

He didn't say a word.

"You scoundrel! You can't distinguish between inside and outside, right from wrong!"

Song Zhengguo scolded him angrily, finally retorting with a question:

"What benefit is there for me if I die? Do you think Huabing is some 'Celestial Empire'? You’re in such a rush to take the throne?"

"You’ve truly lost your mind. This isn't a one-man show for the Song family!"

"When I was around, the company directors still gave you some face. Look at what you’ve turned things into while I’ve been away!"

"Operations are stalled, public opinion is in an uproar, and there are even tax issues!"

Song Qiming’s face turned deathly pale, but he couldn't refute a single word.

"As for the company, I never had much hope for you anyway..." Song Zhengguo closed his eyes, saying with a sense of disappointment, "But how can you even fail at being a father!"

"You’re fickle, you listen to slander, and you’ve been deceived by a pair of shameless people for seven years!"

"How much suffering have you caused Xiao Yu?"

Song Zhengguo kept his head down, his breathing becoming rapid as he tried to defend himself:

"Dad, the divorce lawsuit has been filed. The family assets won't be divided."

"I’ve also dealt with Li Feng. I won't let him have it easy, I, I..."

Before he could finish, the teacup on the nightstand was hurled at him.

*Bang—*

"How did I ever give birth to such an idiot!"

-

It was still midnight in the country.

"But why can't my little bird see these indicator lines?"

Song Yu collected his thoughts and asked the Doberman in uniform standing before him.

The other party frowned, looked at this "big bird," and said very solemnly:

"Too much human food."

"The aura is murky."

Bai Linlin: "..."

However, the Doberman didn't say anything more, only telling them to go inside and report, adding a reminder:

"247, are you sure you want to bring your guardian inside?"

Song Yu paused at these words, his expression calm. He glanced sideways at the bird, very straightforward.

Bai Linlin felt inexplicably nervous under the gaze and tucked in his wing roots. Even though he had just been mocked by those small fries...

But!

"I’m bringing him!"

The Doberman nodded and pulled open a door on the dusty, gray wall.

Inside, a dazzling light shone.

At the same time, the outside world presented a different scene.

"Hello, I’ve left your takeout downstairs."

The delivery rider held his phone between his shoulder and ear, checking the order by the streetlamp.

A father and son walking out early in the morning passed by.

"How can you only get 20 points on an English test?"

"Sigh... just go to school and eat something."

At this moment, office workers were also coming down from the apartment building, complaining as they walked:

"I’m done for, I haven't slept long and I have to go to work. But did you watch that drama? The 'little milk dog' and the 'big sister'—I’m telling you, they’re a perfect match!"

The sky turned a pale, fish-belly white. The delivery rider put the food down, yawned, and looked down at his phone.

—4:30 AM.

-

The Inner World remained quiet. A breeze blew, causing the vines to flutter.

The inscription [No. 24] was chiseled into the wall, filled with flowing golden patterns.

Below it was a line of small text:

—Nan City Bureau of Monster Management.

Inside the walls:

A spacious lobby came into view. The brown floor gleamed, and crystal chandeliers hung from the ceiling, refracting colorful light.

It was like human preferences.

But the only difference was that there were small animals everywhere: a black cat wearing sunglasses and drinking beer, a pair of Java sparrows singing on a stage, and harvest mice gathered around playing cards...

The space was divided into different entertainment areas.

However, what was more eye-catching was a large scrolling screen displaying text:

ID / Name / Species / Location

012, Coffee, White Cat, Taoyuan Residential Area Waste Sorting Station...

013, Laifu, Yellow Dog, Intersection of Heping Road and Xinhe Street...

014, Qiuqiu, Corn Snake, Flowerbed of Building 12, Lanyuan Residential Area...

...

Bai Linlin didn't quite understand what this was, but he saw all kinds of animals lining up.

They were even holding small placards in their hands.

?

Just then, the surroundings seemed to notice the newcomers, and a commotion began.

"A guardian?"

"It brought a guardian inside?"

A leopard gecko said, shocked, its fleshy paws propping up its mat as it did yoga.

A harvest mouse next to it immediately chimed in:

"Right? Who would bring a guardian here?"

"This is a place for monsters."

"It’s normal for guardians not to come."

The small monsters gathered around nodded. That was true; humans were fragile and couldn't see scenes like this; they would be scared.

Besides, humans had to sleep.

They all had to go to work during the day.

They had to be considerate of their guardians.

Conclusion reached:

This bird was too much of a "giant baby"!

Not sensible at all.

But just then—

A small mouse wrapped in bandages said softly:

"But I really want my guardian to come and see."

"That way, she would believe that what I said is true."

The scene went quiet for a moment.

Someone started, and suddenly others followed:

"My human is very busy, always working late. He really doesn't have time... but he brings me a roasted sausage every time."

"Mine too. Recently, she was scolded by her boss and cried, falling asleep while holding me... I miss her a little."

"Mine..."

The monsters started a "Guardian Exchange Meeting." They had all been in a good mood, but by the end, they were feeling a bit emo.

"They are too busy; that’s not their fault."

The final sentence was agreed upon by all the monsters.

"Yes, yes."

"We should be understanding."

...

However, at this moment, the Doberman had already led No. 247 and his guardian to the designated window.

Opposite them was a red-crowned crane in a formal suit. Seeing a human, it was somewhat surprised and couldn't help but say:

"Are you not afraid?"

Although Song Yu felt he had walked into a grotesque world, his little bird was here, and he couldn't leave.

"Not afraid."

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼闻言说不感动是不可能的，刚想要贴贴，身后就传来窃窃私语的声音。

“他的监护人好好啊。”

“有点羡慕。”

“我也想我的监护人来……”

鸟全听到了！

鸟神清气爽！

丹顶鹤看了看相关文件，微微点头，对宋郁道：

“那你是第一个亲自前来签署监护协议的。”

“这实在是具有历史意义，这样，我们来做个见证。”

宋郁面色有些茫然，鸟也有些不懂，直到被拉到了一个公开的平台上。

丹顶鹤脖子上系着丝巾，非常优雅地走到了一人一鸟面前，认真地对下面的小妖怪道：

“诸位，大家也融入人类社会很久了，相信大家都知道人类社会中有很多恶劣分子，但即使如此，我们仍然选择信任我们的监护人，这本身就是一种矢志不渝。”

“现在，居然有一名监护人亲自前来……”

总之都是些慷慨陈词的话，人与鸟均是有些慌乱了，因为这实在很……奇怪。

宋郁冷白的面色上泛出些粉，鸟也尴尬极了，爪子在这个平台上扣出了很深的坑。

但偏偏下不去了，因为下面全是五花八门的妖怪，有巴西龟，有玉米蛇，有刚才见过的鼠鼠大军，还有盘着很高一个蟒蛇……

都很星星眼地看上面。

“……”

“……”

人与鸟被架在上面了。

但丹顶鹤还在继续，并拿出了小本本，宣读：

“那么监护人。”

空气里一阵寂静。

宋郁反应了下，道：

“我在。”

丹顶鹤很满意，随后看向白粼粼：

“我们鸟界的新成员，247。”

“……在。”

仿佛是某种直觉，人与鸟都不由得紧张了下，果不其下一句是：

“监护人，你是否愿意此生此世永远陪伴在247身边？无论贫穷还是富有、疾病或健康、美貌或失色、顺利或失意，都愿意爱它、安慰它、尊敬它、保护它？并愿意在你有限的生命里永远对它忠贞不渝？”

宋郁整个人都无措了起来，他眼尾的红痣几乎要滴血了……

台下的妖怪们都在期待。

“我愿意。”

白粼粼鸟脸一红，但很快就轮到他了。

“247，你是否愿意此生此世都永远陪伴在你的监护人身边？无论贫穷还是富有、疾病或健康、美貌或失色、顺利或失意，都愿意爱他、安慰他、尊敬他、保护他？并愿意在你漫长的一生里永远选择他，即使你的监护人老去、病故……变成墓碑。”

台下的妖怪们都泪眼朦胧了。

白粼粼其实也怔了下，他其实从来没有想过这件事，宋郁现在才十八……后面会长大，还会……

“247。”

丹顶鹤又叫了一声。

“我愿意。”

台下的妖怪们开始欢呼，甚至有只鼠鼠还拿出来了礼花筒，空气中都是彩色的纸条。

好似那些影视剧里的大结局，人和鸟被拉到一起，拍了张合影。

“真不错啊，以前都是它们自己拿着合影来登记的，你们还算是头一对当场拍的。”

“好了，你们来放个见证物。”

丹顶鹤已经带着一人一鸟重新来到了窗口，边说边拿出来一个红色的本本，翻开递了过去。

宋郁脸上的红还没有消退，抬手接了过来，他垂眸看了过去，发现是鸟的一些基本信息：

物种：和尚鹦鹉（鸟）

编号：247

名字：粼粼

出生年月：2024年10月。

妖力等级：F

终身监护人：宋郁(人类)

“见证物是什么？”

丹顶鹤对此解释了下，说是之前的监护人大多很忙，或者是潜意识里否认这些事，无法签字，所以上面为了灵动处理，就允许妖怪们选择监护人给予它们最亲密的东西。

有各种各样的东西。

最多的就是监护人给的毛绒玩具，但也有漂亮的小衣服，小项链之类的。

“我们十分理解，毕竟人类社会中签名是很重要的东西，但这个证件只是……”

宋郁很平和地打断了，“我来签。”

身后的妖怪们又都围了上来，发出此起彼伏的惊叹声。

丹顶鹤看到后更满意了，妖怪一辈子就应该认定一个人，这才符合鸟类核心价值观。

等到人签完了，就轮到鸟了。

白粼粼看到旁边利落的两个字，伸了伸翅膀，沾了沾印泥。

摁过去了。

丹顶鹤这才拿了过来本子，抬手给压了钢印，递了过去：

“好了，你的报道完成了。”

“之后定期参加培训和考核就行。”

白粼粼有种上学报道完成的感觉，不过就在这时宋郁开口了：

“可是我的小鸟的形态怎么解决，它还不太会化形，这样是不是对它不好？”

丹顶鹤很是悠闲地在窗口里面喝了口茶，抬手指了指大厅外面的大屏幕：

“上头已经下达了通知，号召妖怪不能只依赖中央的补贴，而应该切切实实为妖界社会服务，以此来换取津贴。”

“所以。”

“去领任务。”

一人一鸟来到了那个大厅，上面的屏幕还在滚动着，但是此刻里面的内容像是轮换了下。

性别/姓名/年龄/地理位置

男/王小文/12岁/福田小区……

女/秦艺/25岁/云河花园……

女/于夏/30岁/锦绣公馆……

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，不太明白这是什么意思，直到发现余光里有个米色的身影闪过。

“皮皮？”

它是这里唯一的熟人。

宋郁其实已经想追上去了，但是鸟更快，立即伸了爪子。

啪叽——

人愣住了，鸟也后知后觉不对。

“……”

“……”
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin couldn't help but feel moved by these words. Just as he wanted to nuzzle up, whispers came from behind him.

"His guardian is so good."

"I’m a bit envious."

"I want my guardian to come too..."

The bird heard it all!

The bird felt refreshed and invigorated!

The red-crowned crane looked over the relevant documents, nodded slightly, and said to Song Yu:

"In that case, you are the first to come in person to sign a guardianship agreement."

"This is truly of historical significance. Let’s have a witness ceremony."

Song Yu looked bewildered, and the bird didn't understand either, until they were pulled onto a public platform.

The red-crowned crane, wearing a silk scarf around its neck, walked up to the human and the bird with great elegance and spoke earnestly to the small monsters below:

"Everyone, you have all integrated into human society for a long time. I believe you all know there are many malicious individuals in human society, but even so, we still choose to trust our guardians. This in itself is a form of unwavering devotion."

"Now, a guardian has actually come in person..."

In short, it was a grand, impassioned speech. Both the human and the bird were a bit flustered because this was truly... strange.

A flush appeared on Song Yu’s pale, cold complexion, and the bird was also extremely embarrassed, his claws digging deep holes into the platform.

But there was no way down, because below were all sorts of monsters: red-eared sliders, corn snakes, the mouse army seen earlier, and a python coiled up very high...

They were all looking up with starry eyes.

"..."

"..."

The human and the bird were stuck on stage.

But the red-crowned crane continued, taking out a small notebook and reading:

"So, Guardian."

A silence fell over the air.

Song Yu reacted and said:

"I am here."

The red-crowned crane was very satisfied and then looked at Bai Linlin:

"Our new member of the bird world, 247."

"...I am here."

As if by some intuition, both the human and the bird couldn't help but tense up. Sure enough, the next sentence was:

"Guardian, are you willing to accompany 247 for the rest of your life? Whether in poverty or wealth, sickness or health, beauty or decline, success or failure, are you willing to love it, comfort it, respect it, and protect it? And are you willing to be forever loyal to it throughout your limited life?"

Song Yu was completely at a loss. The red mole at the corner of his eye looked as if it were about to bleed...

The monsters below were all waiting in anticipation.

"I do."

Bai Linlin’s bird face turned red, but soon it was his turn.

"247, are you willing to accompany your guardian for the rest of your life? Whether in poverty or wealth, sickness or health, beauty or decline, success or failure, are you willing to love him, comfort him, respect him, and protect him? And are you willing to choose him forever throughout your long life, even when your guardian grows old, falls ill... and becomes a tombstone?"

The monsters below were teary-eyed.

Bai Linlin was actually stunned for a moment. He had never thought about this. Song Yu was only eighteen now... he would grow up later, and he would...

"247."

The red-crowned crane called out again.

"I do."

The monsters below began to cheer. One mouse even took out a party popper, and the air was filled with colorful paper strips.

It was like the finale of a movie; the human and the bird were pulled together and took a group photo.

"That’s really nice. In the past, they always brought their own photos to register. You two are the first to take one on the spot."

"Alright, come and place your witness token."

The red-crowned crane had already led the human and the bird back to the window, taking out a red booklet as it spoke and handing it over.

The flush on Song Yu’s face hadn't faded. He raised his hand to take it, lowered his eyes, and saw the bird’s basic information:

Species: Monk Parakeet (Bird)

ID: 247

Name: Linlin

Date of Birth: October 2024.

Monster Power Level: F

Lifetime Guardian: Song Yu (Human)

"What is the witness token?"

The red-crowned crane explained that most previous guardians were very busy or subconsciously denied these things, unable to sign. So, to handle things flexibly, the Bureau allowed monsters to choose the most intimate item given to them by their guardian.

There were all sorts of things.

The most common were plush toys given by guardians, but there were also pretty little clothes, small necklaces, and the like.

"We fully understand. After all, a signature is a very important thing in human society, but this certificate is just..."

Song Yu interrupted calmly, "I will sign."

The monsters behind them crowded around again, letting out gasps of amazement.

The red-crowned crane was even more satisfied. A monster should commit to one person for life; this was in line with the core values of the bird world.

Once the human finished signing, it was the bird’s turn.

Bai Linlin saw the two neat characters next to him, stretched out his wing, and dipped it in the ink pad.

He pressed it down.

The red-crowned crane then took the booklet, stamped it with the official seal, and handed it over:

"Alright, your reporting is complete."

"Just participate in the training and assessments regularly from now on."

Bai Linlin felt like he had finished school registration. Just then, Song Yu spoke up:

"But what about my little bird's form? It doesn't know how to shapeshift yet. Isn't this bad for it?"

The red-crowned crane sipped tea leisurely inside the window and pointed at the large screen outside the lobby:

"The higher-ups have issued a notice calling on monsters not to rely solely on central subsidies, but to genuinely serve the monster society in exchange for allowances."

"So."

"Go and accept a mission."

The human and the bird came to the lobby. The screen above was still scrolling, but the content seemed to have rotated.

Gender / Name / Age / Location

Male / Wang Xiaowen / 12 / Futian Residential Area...

Female / Qin Yi / 25 / Yunhe Garden...

Female / Yu Xia / 30 / Jinxiu Mansion...

Song Yu frowned, not quite understanding what this meant, until he noticed a beige figure flash by in his peripheral vision.

"Pipi?"

It was the only acquaintance here.

Song Yu actually wanted to chase after it, but the bird was faster, immediately extending its claw.

*Plop—*

The human was stunned, and the bird realized too late that something was wrong.

"..."

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
第26章

空气中一阵沉默。

不过就在这时下方传来了一阵闷闷的呼声：

“喂，让我出来，让我出来……”

白粼粼松了一口气，很斟酌地抬起了爪子：

地板甚至都砸出来个坑，里面躺着一只奄奄一息的鼠，胳膊上的绷带此刻全散掉了。

鸟有些不知所措。

但宋郁很快就把那只鼠拿了出来了，立即开始道歉：

“对不起，我的小鸟不是故意的。”

皮皮：“……”

确定小鸟吗？

并非故意吗？

-

最终还是找了个地方坐下，一人一鸟很拘谨地坐在小沙发上，对面是一只米色皮毛的鼠，爪子里还捧着一杯热气腾腾的茶。

“我没事的，不用再道歉了。”

“你们要问什么？”

皮皮坐的位置很远，鼻头都被热气熏得红红的，很是好奇地看着这边道。

它上次在医院就见到这个监护人和他的鸟了，当时它听到了什么“打游戏”之类的话，后面几乎就肯定了。

是同类。

没想到这次真的在局里见到了。

“我想知道这个任务是什么意思，主厅屏幕上滚动着的信息是……”

宋郁还是先开口问着，他的小鸟年纪很小，初来乍到什么也不懂，他要多问问。

“并不是所有小动物都可以变成妖怪的。”皮皮低头喝了一口茶，舒服地喟叹一声，垂在沙发上的爪子还往上抬了抬。

“绝大多数都是没有开智的。”

“它们游走在人类的城市里，有的运气好些，从小就是被抱养的；有的运气差些，在街头流浪，甚至吃不上饭。”

皮皮说到这里也是叹了口气，不过接着又道：

“因为这种情况很多，管理局就规定了，所有登记在册的妖怪都需要领任务，去定点帮扶受到困难的同族。”

说完这句话，鼠就抬手指了指屏幕，“就是这个，滚动的小动物名单就是帮扶对象。”

白粼粼扭头看了下，没想到这么专业。

“那后面替换的人类名单呢？”

宋郁又接着问。

“那是管理局经过长达一年的考察得出的监护人名单，综合考量因素有很多，但最主要的还是富有责任心。”

皮皮又很认真地回复，弯腰把茶杯给放在桌子上了。

问到这里其实已经清楚了，管理局的政策还是挺周到的，既安置了这些开了智的妖怪，又切实地帮助了城市里处在困境中的小动物。

宋郁不得不承认，它们很有智慧，而且很团结。

但就在这时，皮皮从沙发上跳了下来，对着身后的一人一鸟招了招手：

“跟我来。”

宋郁只好起身，带着自己的小鸟。

大厅的空间很大，前面的鼠在引路，光滑的地板上倒映出来它的身影，尾巴短短的。

白粼粼在后面看了好久，又去撇了下不远处打牌的花枝鼠队伍，这才发现了微妙的区别。

皮皮个头小，并且尾巴也短，而且也不去打牌。

？

不过鸟也没有时间思考太多，因为对方又说话了。

“到了，你们看。”

皮皮伸手指了指另一块屏幕，这块同样是滚动着的名字，但是颜色却是灰色的。

编号/姓名/物种/地理位置

023/无/郊狼/xxx自治区国道307……

024/无/黑熊/xx自治区凤阳村……

027/无/狐狸/xx省梁云山……

“这些都是高危对象，它们也是妖怪，但游荡在外，以人类为食，且数量惊人，已经上了通缉名单。”

宋郁微微一愣，对此十分意外，原来吃人的……

但就在这时，身前多了个圆滚滚的躯体，鸟站在前面了，还伸了翅膀挡住。

宋郁垂着眼眸，觉得身体里的血液都是热的，可爱。

“你不要反应这么大。”

皮皮有些无语，不过它还是站在大屏幕前等了一会，果然上面的内容又开始轮换。

性别/姓名/年龄/地理位置

男/陈望山/21/南市城市管理学院……

男/江阳/19/南市铁道管理学院……

男/王哲平/27/南市xx有限公司……

“而这些，全部都是虐杀小动物的人。”

皮皮很是沉声道。

-

此时S州。

陈开鹤其实在外面等了好一会，心想这还没打完？

不过好在是里面没有什么哐哐当当的动静了，老头儿这才拿出来手机，看宋郁给他发的照片。

一共64张。

全是一只站在纸盒子上的小鸟，各种角度的拍摄。

仰拍、俯拍、侧拍。

小鸟端正站着、小鸟伸翅根、小鸟金鸡独立、小鸟斜腿站着……

各种pose。

陈开鹤看着图片就笑吟吟的，心想真不错，这长得多精神！

他又往下翻了好几张，发现也有很多废片，大多都是重复的以及一些局部照。

鸟的脑袋瓜、鸟的翅膀、鸟的眼睛、鸟打哈欠、鸟眯眼睡、鸟起飞残影……

这孩子怎么全发过来了？

不过陈开鹤看得还是很乐呵，顺带给算了算时间，觉得国内应该是白天了，于是打字过去：

“小郁，早起吃饭了吗？”

陈开鹤还等了一会，但是对面迟迟没有回复，他不由得蹙了蹙眉，时间不早了的。

出什么事了？

-

而此刻大厅中。

“所以在这里接灰色任务的大多都是能力比较强的妖怪，它们要么同人类的749局展开合作，要么独立行动。”

皮皮很认真地介绍着，顺带补充了下：

“不过如果是合作的话，那说明事态很严重了，甚至要出差跨省的。”

“基层这边领得大多都是独立任务，主要是让那些虐杀小动物的人类得到应有的惩罚。”

宋郁感觉进入了一个很奇幻的场景，面前的小鼠直立着，西服革履，虽然胳膊上的绷带掉了，衣服也灰扑扑的，但看着着实很像个讲师。

“培训的主要目的就是让妖怪有明辨是非的能力，人有好坏，妖也有要好坏，能和谐相处就是最好的了。”

皮皮最后这么说道。

宋郁看了下这边排队领任务的妖怪，有进来见到的那只戴着墨镜的猫，还有穿着制服的德牧……神色看着都是挺严肃的。

“好了好了，我已经介绍的差不多了，津贴就是妖力补助，每次完成任务来窗口兑就可以。”

“可以化形，也可以领相应的人类货币。”

皮皮边说边朝着原来的茶水桌那里走，小小一只，见到迎面而来的鼠鼠大队愣了下。

立马掉头换了个方向。

白粼粼眯了眯眼，跟着皮皮走的时候，看了下那队花枝鼠……

分明就长得不一样！

皮皮走到一个角落里才松了口气，还好没看到它。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，“它们欺负你？”

“那倒不是，我比较不太喜欢路上见到熟人，还要打招呼，很麻烦的。”

白粼粼：“……”

原来是只i鼠。

不过他还是问了问长相的事，皮皮这才说道：
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 26

A silence hung in the air.

But just then, a muffled cry came from below:

"Hey, let me out, let me out..."

Bai Linlin breathed a sigh of relief and lifted his claw with great caution:

A hole had even been smashed into the floor, and lying inside was a dying mouse, the bandages on its arm completely unraveled.

The bird was at a loss.

But Song Yu quickly picked up the mouse and immediately began to apologize:

"I’m sorry, my little bird didn't mean it."

Pipi: "..."

Are you sure it’s a "little bird"?

And not on purpose?

-

In the end, they found a place to sit down. The human and the bird sat stiffly on a small sofa, opposite a beige-furred mouse holding a steaming cup of tea in its paws.

"I’m fine, you don't need to apologize anymore."

"What did you want to ask?"

Pipi sat quite far away, its nose reddened by the steam, looking at them with great curiosity.

It had seen this guardian and his bird at the hospital last time. It had heard something about "playing games" and had been almost certain then.

They were of the same kind.

It didn't expect to actually see them at the Bureau this time.

"I want to know what this mission means. The information scrolling on the main hall screen is..."

Song Yu asked first. His little bird was very young and didn't understand anything as a newcomer, so he needed to ask more.

"Not all small animals can become monsters." Pipi took a sip of tea, sighed comfortably, and even lifted the paw resting on the sofa.

"The vast majority are not enlightened."

"They wander through human cities. Some are lucky and are adopted from a young age; others are less fortunate, wandering the streets, unable to even get a meal."

Pipi sighed again at this point, but continued:

"Because this situation is so common, the Bureau has stipulated that all registered monsters must accept missions to provide targeted assistance to their kin in difficulty."

After saying this, the mouse pointed to the screen, "That’s it. The list of small animals scrolling by is the list of those in need of assistance."

Bai Linlin turned his head to look, surprised by how professional it was.

"Then what about the list of humans that replaces it?"

Song Yu continued to ask.

"That is the list of guardians compiled by the Bureau after a year of observation. There are many factors considered, but the most important one is a sense of responsibility."

Pipi replied earnestly, bending down to place the tea cup on the table.

By asking this, it was clear that the Bureau’s policies were quite thoughtful. They not only settled these enlightened monsters but also effectively helped the small animals in the city that were in distress.

Song Yu had to admit that they were very wise and very united.

But just then, Pipi jumped off the sofa and beckoned to the human and bird behind it:

"Follow me."

Song Yu had to stand up, taking his little bird with him.

The lobby was very large. The mouse led the way, its short tail reflected on the smooth floor.

Bai Linlin watched for a long time, then glanced at the harvest mouse team playing cards not far away, and finally discovered a subtle difference.

Pipi was small, had a short tail, and didn't play cards.

?

But the bird didn't have time to think too much because the other party spoke again.

"We’re here. Look."

Pipi pointed to another screen. This one also had scrolling names, but the color was gray.

ID / Name / Species / Location

023 / None / Coyote / National Highway 307, xxx Autonomous Region...

024 / None / Black Bear / Fengyang Village, xx Autonomous Region...

027 / None / Fox / Liangyun Mountain, xx Province...

"These are all high-risk targets. They are also monsters, but they wander outside, feeding on humans, and their numbers are alarming. They are already on the wanted list."

Song Yu was slightly startled, very surprised. So, those who ate humans...

But just then, a round, chubby body appeared in front of him. The bird stood in front, even extending its wings to block him.

Song Yu lowered his eyes, feeling his blood run hot. It was cute.

"You don't need to react so strongly."

Pipi was speechless, but it still waited in front of the large screen for a while. Sure enough, the content began to rotate again.

Gender / Name / Age / Location

Male / Chen Wangshan / 21 / Nan City Urban Management College...
