Male / Jiang Yang / 19 / Nan City Railway Management College...

Male / Wang Zheping / 27 / Nan City xx Co., Ltd...

"And these are all people who abuse and kill small animals."

Pipi said in a very deep voice.

-

Meanwhile, in S Province.

Chen Kaihe had been waiting outside for quite a while, wondering why the beating hadn't stopped yet.

Fortunately, there were no more crashing sounds inside. The old man took out his phone to look at the photos Song Yu had sent him.

There were 64 in total.

All of them were of a little bird standing on a paper box, shot from various angles.

Looking up, looking down, from the side.

The bird standing straight, the bird stretching its wing roots, the bird standing on one leg, the bird standing with one leg tilted...

All kinds of poses.

Chen Kaihe smiled as he looked at the pictures, thinking it was great—it looked so spirited!

He scrolled down further and found many "failed" shots, mostly duplicates and some close-ups.

The bird’s head, the bird’s wings, the bird’s eyes, the bird yawning, the bird squinting in sleep, the bird’s motion blur as it took off...

Why did the child send all of these?

However, Chen Kaihe was still enjoying it. He calculated the time, thinking it should be daytime in the country, so he typed:

"Xiao Yu, did you wake up and eat?"

Chen Kaihe waited for a while, but there was no reply from the other side. He couldn't help but frown; it wasn't early anymore.

Did something happen?

-

At this moment in the lobby.

"So, those who take on gray missions here are mostly monsters with strong abilities. They either cooperate with the human 749 Bureau or act independently."

Pipi introduced it very seriously, adding:

"But if it’s a collaboration, it means the situation is very serious, and they might even have to travel across provinces."

"The grassroots level mostly takes independent missions, mainly to ensure that humans who abuse and kill small animals get the punishment they deserve."

Song Yu felt like he had entered a fantasy scene. The small mouse in front of him stood upright, dressed in a suit and leather shoes. Although the bandages on its arm had fallen off and its clothes were dusty, it really looked like a lecturer.

"The main purpose of the training is to give monsters the ability to distinguish right from wrong. There are good and bad humans, and there are good and bad monsters. Living in harmony is the best."

Pipi said this at the end.

Song Yu looked at the monsters queuing up to accept missions here. There was the cat wearing sunglasses he had seen earlier, and a German Shepherd in uniform... their expressions all looked quite serious.

"Alright, alright, I’ve introduced almost everything. The allowance is a monster power subsidy. You can come to the window to redeem it every time you complete a mission."

"You can shapeshift, or you can receive the corresponding human currency."

Pipi walked toward the original tea table as it spoke. Being so small, it froze when it saw a mouse team coming its way.

It immediately turned around and changed direction.

Bai Linlin squinted. When he followed Pipi, he looked at that team of harvest mice...

They clearly looked different!

Pipi only breathed a sigh of relief when it reached a corner. It was glad it hadn't been seen.

Song Yu frowned, "Do they bully you?"

"That’s not it. I just don't like meeting acquaintances on the road and having to say hello. It’s very troublesome."

Bai Linlin: "..."

So it was an "introverted" mouse.

However, he still asked about the difference in appearance, and Pipi then explained:

chunks.chineseText:
“我是金丝熊，我们不喜欢出来活动，但上头说了得有代表，今天我当值，就过来了。”

“花枝鼠它们很神经病的，就喜欢聚在一起打牌，天天来基地。”

白粼粼突然也很好奇自己有没有伙伴，于是就四处环顾了下。

“局里对于妖怪种类的划分其实比较宽泛，对于鹦鹉，我不是很了解，但我知道你们鸟界，有一位常年领灰色任务的大佬……”

皮皮说了一路了，甚至都有些口干舌燥，宋郁俯身弯腰，伸了下手。

鸟：？？

宋郁很平和地道：

“谢谢你告诉我们这么多，辛苦了，我送你吧。”

皮皮其实确实有点累，更何况它还被这个监护人的鸟踩了一爪子，于是没有过多思索，抬爪子就要上去。

但是余光一扫——

那只巨大的鸟此刻直直地盯着这里。

“……”

就要上。

你的监护人全场最帅，不上白不上。

皮皮站在人的手上，指挥了下方向，很快就到了领取红色任务的地方，于是又伸了伸爪子，解释道：

“这个要去那个机器那里去牌子，排队。”

宋郁顺着对方的爪子去看，发现角落里有个一米多高的机器，有只穿着夹克的垂耳兔正在耐心等待。

没过一会那机器就吐出来一个木牌子。

“然后拿到之后就去窗口这里，牌子会被收上去，然后正面是帮扶对象的信息，反面就是需要联系的监护人信息。”

“我们要做的就是帮助流浪的同族找到真正的家。”

皮皮站在人的手上，很是认真地道。

“你们去吧，拜拜！”

宋郁掌心一轻，小家伙跳走了，短短的尾巴一动一动的，看着很灵动。

人松了口气。

还好没踩出问题来。

“哼。”

宋郁闻声回头看了下，果不其然鸟有些不高兴，收了收翅膀，侧着头。

“只是送送而已，这样皮皮日后不好意思为难你……”

但就在这时——

“我可以送！”

“放我头上。”

鸟很认真地道，并且觉得自己才没有错。

宋郁怔了下，随即想象了下画面，不由得笑了下。

但鸟很着急，人怎么能这么不严肃，上次在秃头老板店里有只牡丹几乎是明晃晃地相中宋郁了。

这次在管理局他也是广受欢迎。

白粼粼非常认真地教育道：

“你是我的监护人。”

“你不能和其他妖怪亲密接触。”

宋郁从来没有被人这么画圈归属过，听到这话的一瞬间不是不舒服，而是一种极度的满意。

“好。”

他轻轻地道。

最后终于来到了领取任务的环节，一人一鸟非常顺畅地走完了全过程。

刚想要看一下木牌上具体信息的时候，原来的杜宾找了过来，说是忘了给东西。

——是一个由绳子串着的“金属”环。

“这个，A级以下的妖怪出门最好戴上这个，可以稳定形态。”

白粼粼用翅膀接过的一瞬间，体型一下子快速缩水，也就是几秒的功夫……

地面上多了一只小鸡。

仰头看了看宋郁。

伸了伸翅膀。

“啾啾。”

杜宾见到后还有些懵，心想这为什么不直接沟通，直到它看到247的监护人俯身蹲下，伸出手指。

鸟很从善如流地上来了。

随即少年又抬手给放到了自己肩头了，侧眸轻声道：

“要站好。”

鸟仰了仰头，翅膀很利索地收了下，同时看向旁边的杜宾，鸟眼圆圆，很骄傲的样子。

“……”

总之杜宾送完东西就走了。

宋郁这时才有空看了看那个牌子的信息，他微微往上抬了抬，好让鸟一起看。

正面的信息是：

016，球球，虎皮鹦鹉，平湖区南心公园。

反面的信息是：

066，乐乐，12岁，南市第一人民医院重症监护室。

宋郁看到乐乐这个名字，莫名觉得有些熟悉……

-

等到从管理局出来的时候，外面的天都大亮了，晴空万里。

宋郁脱了外套，简单理了下，在手臂上搭出来个小遮阳棚，让鸟钻了进去。

就在这时，手机传来嗡嗡的震动声，少年抬手拿了起来，打开屏幕才发现几乎有十多个未接电话。

全部都是来自S州。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，立马接了，电话那头传来陈开鹤的声音，不过第一句不是对他说的，像是在对身边的人说：

“接了接了，孩子没事啊。”

“你别急。”

宋郁反应过来了，立马开口解释道：

“我手机不小心设成勿扰了，爷爷今天状态怎么样？”

怀里的鸟还在仰头看，打了个哈欠，也是有点困，不过鸟又想要看看街边有没有小吃摊子，探了探鸟头。

不过就在这时——

和从阴影处出来的三只柯尔鸭对上了。

“……”

“……”

此时宋郁还在打电话，身姿挺立，眉眼轮廓很是出色。

“那要过半个月才能回国吗？”

“那样也好，您好好休养，我没事的爷爷。”

“小鸟？”

白粼粼本来都已经做好了战斗的准备，但是就在这时却被捏了捏鸟头。

“它在我身边，嗯，很乖的。”

鸟还没有怎么反应过来，一个手机屏幕就怼了过来，鸟的眼神一下子从好斗变为了纯良。

看着镜头里的老者很给面子地啾啾了几声。

柯尔鸭目睹了全程。

“嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎”

三只一队，再次光速溜走。

宋峥国其实很欣慰，他并不打算问那些不好的事，只是眉眼温和地道：

“听你陈爷爷说，是叫粼粼？”

“对，波光粼粼的粼粼。”

宋郁已经走到了围墙的阴影处，把自己的外套重新整理了下，鸟就在他的胳膊上站着，稳稳当当的，就是在探头看屏幕。

镜头面前出现一个硕大的鸟头。

电话那边立马打招呼：

“你好啊，粼粼。”

鸟也很满意：“啾啾啾。”

宋郁很温和地道：

“它八个月了。”

视频那头的陈开鹤倒是算了算，笑着道：

“那还小呢。”

宋峥国只是又问：“你陈爷爷送了一块小金锁？”

宋郁愣了下，不知道为什么提这个，但还是点了点头，顺带把手机抬高了。

鸟一看没有自己的镜头了，仰头看了看人的下巴，开始很努力地往上攀爬……

宋郁余光看到了，没有阻拦，但是把拿着的衣服往外撑了撑，尽可能地当成一个安全平台。

宋峥国只是道：“那我也要备一份礼。”

手机传来这句话的时候，鸟正好抵达人的肩头，登顶！

“啾啾！”

宋郁侧眸看了下，发现小鸟上来了之后唇角微微抿出来个弧度，把手机往上抬了下，让对面的人看到他的小鸟。

“爷爷，它在这里。”

鸟顿时挺胸抬头。

阳光下，面色冷白的少年对着阳光，眉眼轮廓都带着自然的阴影，肩头的蓝色小鸟更是羽毛鲜亮，正在很认真地表演“大鹏展翅”。

夜晚的S州病房里多了些欢声笑语。
chunks.englishText:
"I’m a Golden Silk Bear. We don't usually like to be active, but the higher-ups said we needed a representative. It’s my turn on duty today, so I came."

"The Fancy Mice are complete lunatics; they just love to gather and play cards. They come to the base every single day."

Bai Linlin suddenly grew curious about whether he had any companions of his own, so he looked around.

"The Bureau’s classification of monster species is actually quite broad. I don't know much about parrots, but I do know that in your bird world, there’s a big shot who handles gray-level missions year-round..."

Pipi had been talking the whole way, to the point of getting a dry throat. Song Yu leaned over and held out a hand.

Bird: ??

Song Yu said, very calmly:

"Thank you for telling us so much. You’ve worked hard. Let me give you a lift."

Pipi was indeed a bit tired, and considering he’d already been stepped on by this guardian’s bird, he didn't overthink it. He lifted a claw, ready to hop on.

But then, a glance out of the corner of his eye—

That giant bird was staring straight at them.

"..."

He was going to get on.

Your guardian is the most handsome one here; it’d be a waste not to.

Pipi stood on the human’s hand and directed the way. They soon arrived at the place where red-level mission tokens were collected. He stretched out a claw again and explained:

"You have to go to that machine to get the token. Line up."

Song Yu followed the direction of the claw and saw a machine over a meter tall in the corner, where a Lop-eared Rabbit wearing a jacket was waiting patiently.

Before long, the machine spat out a wooden token.

"After you get it, go to the window. The token will be collected. The front has the information of the person needing help, and the back has the contact info for the guardian."

"All we have to do is help the stray members of our kind find their true homes."

Pipi stood on the human’s hand, speaking very earnestly.

"You guys go ahead, bye-bye!"

Song Yu felt his palm lighten as the little guy hopped away, his short tail twitching—looking quite spirited.

The human let out a sigh of relief.

Glad he didn't cause any trouble with his claws.

"Hmph."

Song Yu turned his head at the sound. Sure enough, the bird was unhappy, tucking his wings in and tilting his head.

"I was just giving him a lift so that Pipi wouldn't feel embarrassed to make things difficult for you later..."

But just then—

"I can give lifts!"

"Put me on your head."

The bird said very seriously, feeling that he hadn't done anything wrong.

Song Yu paused, then imagined the scene and couldn't help but smile.

But the bird was anxious. How could the human be so unserious? Last time at the bald boss’s shop, a Peony Parrot had practically made it obvious that she had her eyes on Song Yu.

This time at the Bureau, he was popular again.

Bai Linlin lectured him very seriously:

"You are my guardian."

"You cannot have intimate contact with other monsters."

Song Yu had never been "claimed" like this before. The moment he heard those words, he didn't feel uncomfortable; rather, he felt an extreme sense of satisfaction.

"Okay."

He said softly.

Finally, they reached the task-collection stage, and the human and bird completed the process smoothly.

Just as they were about to check the specific information on the wooden token, the Doberman from earlier found them, saying he’d forgotten to give them something.

—It was a "metal" ring strung on a cord.

"This, monsters below A-rank should wear this when going out. It can stabilize their form."

The moment Bai Linlin took it with his wing, his size shrank rapidly. In just a few seconds...

A small chick appeared on the ground.

It looked up at Song Yu.

It stretched its wings.

"Chirp, chirp."

The Doberman was stunned, wondering why they didn't just communicate directly, until he saw the guardian of 247 lean down and extend a finger.

The bird hopped on quite readily.

Then the youth raised his hand and placed it on his shoulder, whispering sideways:

"Stand still."

The bird tilted its head up, tucked its wings neatly, and looked at the Doberman nearby with round, proud eyes.

"..."

In any case, the Doberman left after delivering the item.

Only then did Song Yu have time to look at the info on the token. He raised it slightly so the bird could see it too.

The information on the front was:

016, Qiuqiu, Budgerigar, Nanxin Park, Pinghu District.

The information on the back was:

066, Lele, 12 years old, Intensive Care Unit, First People's Hospital of Nanshi.

Seeing the name "Lele," Song Yu felt a strange sense of familiarity...

-

By the time they left the Bureau, the sky was bright and clear, with not a cloud in sight.

Song Yu took off his jacket, tidied it up, and draped it over his arm to create a small sunshade for the bird to crawl into.

Just then, his phone buzzed. The youth picked it up and saw nearly a dozen missed calls.

All of them were from S Province.

Song Yu frowned and answered immediately. Chen Kaihe’s voice came from the other end, though the first sentence wasn't for him; it sounded like he was speaking to someone nearby:

"He picked up, he picked up. The child is fine."

"Don't worry."

Song Yu realized what was happening and immediately explained:

"I accidentally set my phone to Do Not Disturb. How is Grandpa doing today?"

The bird in his arms was still looking up, yawning—it was a bit sleepy—but it also wanted to see if there were any snack stalls on the street, so it poked its head out.

But just then—

It locked eyes with three Call Ducks emerging from the shadows.

"..."

"..."

Song Yu was still on the phone, standing tall, his facial contours striking.

"So you have to stay abroad for another half a month?"

"That's fine, too. Please take good care of yourself, Grandpa, I'm fine."

"Little bird?"

Bai Linlin had been ready for battle, but at that moment, his head was gently pinched.

"He's right here with me. Yes, he's very well-behaved."

Before the bird could react, a phone screen was shoved in front of him. The bird’s expression instantly shifted from combative to innocent.

He looked at the old man in the lens and chirped a few times, very cooperatively.

The Call Ducks witnessed the whole thing.

"Quack, quack, quack, quack."

The three of them, in a single file, scurried away at light speed.

Song Zhengguo was actually very relieved. He didn't intend to ask about the unpleasant things, just said with gentle eyes:

"I heard from your Grandpa Chen, his name is Linlin?"

"Yes, Linlin, like the shimmering of waves."

Song Yu had walked into the shadow of a wall and rearranged his jacket. The bird stood steadily on his arm, tilting its head to look at the screen.

A giant bird head appeared in front of the lens.

The person on the other end greeted him immediately:

"Hello there, Linlin."

The bird was very satisfied: "Chirp, chirp, chirp."

Song Yu said gently:

"He's eight months old."

Chen Kaihe, on the other end of the video, did the math and laughed:

"That's still very young."

Song Zhengguo just asked again: "Did your Grandpa Chen give you a little gold lock?"

Song Yu was stunned, not knowing why he brought that up, but he nodded anyway and raised the phone higher.

When the bird saw there was no longer a shot of him, he looked up at the human’s chin and began to climb up with great effort...

Song Yu saw it out of the corner of his eye and didn't stop him, but held the jacket out further to provide a safe platform.

Song Zhengguo just said: "Then I must prepare a gift as well."

As those words came through the phone, the bird reached the human’s shoulder—summit reached!

"Chirp, chirp!"

Song Yu looked sideways and saw the corners of his lips curl into a curve once the little bird was up. He raised the phone higher so the person on the other side could see his little bird.

"Grandpa, he's right here."

The bird immediately puffed out his chest and held his head high.

In the sunlight, the pale-skinned youth stood facing the light, his features cast in natural shadows, while the little blue bird on his shoulder had brilliant feathers, earnestly performing a "Great Peng spreading its wings."

The hospital room in S Province was filled with a bit more laughter that night.

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国心情都舒畅了些，不由得想要截个图。

但是不会。

陈开鹤只能过来教。

两个老头儿压着声音摆弄着，全然没看到镜头里的鸟正在打哈欠，并且开始歪头看宋郁。

白粼粼觉得宋郁长得和他爷爷有一点像，眉骨都挺高的，不过眉眼……可能随江芮多些，生的好看。

但最好看的。

还是那颗红痣。

鸟不由自主地就叨了一口。

而此时恰好是宋峥国三指下滑的时候。

截图了。

此时电话两端都其乐融融的，只有在一旁守着的宋启明面无表情，他一直在等，直到父亲把电话挂了。

“爸，江芮是真的过分，没有必要顾及江家，多少年了，她整天就是搞些舆论，我听了您的话没有理会，可是这次——”

宋启明话还没说完就被打断了，病床上的老人只是沉声道：

“闭嘴！”

“你有什么资格说小郁母亲？”

“她早早嫁给你，怀胎十月，受的苦你是完全看不到？”

“一个大男人，成日里推卸责任，还有没有一点担当？”

“无论江芮现在如何，最没有立场说她的，就是你！”

宋启明彻底没话说了。

但这还没完。

因为老爷子下一句就是：

“华秉我不放心交给你，有意见么？”

“……没。”

-

宋郁和鸟本来是打算打车回家的，但是看阳光这么好，于是就打算散散步。

人走路。

鸟看风景。

不过就在准备离开这个槐河路的时候，不远处推过来一个车子，开始叫卖：

“芋泥奶油小蛋糕！免费品尝……”

鸟伸了伸头，没想到摊主来这里摆摊了。

白粼粼刚想让人给他买，但是余光却看到巷子的死角里走出来了什么东西……

人肯定也看到了。

一连串的小动物从围墙入口那里鱼贯而出，有垂耳兔、三花猫、中华草龟……还有爱凑热闹的一队花枝鼠，不过皮皮早早回家了。

一人一鸟就在不远处看着，这些小动物在阴影处还是原来的形态，但一迈出阳光的位置，就很自然地化形了。

垂耳兔是个八岁妹妹的样子，走到摊子面前，给了五块钱纸币，获得一块芋泥小蛋糕。

三花猫是个漂亮姐姐，走到摊子面前，给了十块钱纸币，获得两块芋泥小蛋糕。

中华草龟是个八十多岁的老爷爷，走的巨慢无比，身后跟着一队多胞胎……

后者是花枝鼠变的。

摊主是个小姐姐，非常利落地铲起来小蛋糕，装盒子里，递过去，收钱，一气呵成。

“慢走。”

“慢走。”

“慢走。”

……

卖到最后看到那位老爷爷，摊主思考了下，多给了一块，但又觉得老人吃多了会不会高血糖？

在道德和赚钱的拉扯之下，那位“老人”已经拽走了袋子。

“谢-谢-啊。”

“明-天-还-要-来-啊。”

摊主比了个OK。

白粼粼：“……”

这么受欢迎的？

“啾啾啾！”

[我也要！]

宋郁其实也有些好奇，抬步走了过去，摊主头也不抬地伸手。

宋郁：“……我扫码。”

摊主有些意外，不由得多聊了几句，“这里的顾客都爱给纸币，你还是头一个扫码的。”

“五块钱一个小蛋糕。”

“买几个？”

宋郁想了想，把剩下的给鸟包圆了。

不过在摊主装袋子的时候，他还是忍不住问：

“你怎么发现这里好卖的？”

“啊？”

小姐姐思考一下，很认真地道：

“其实我一开始卖不出去的，总是会有人觉得小作坊不干净之类的……我就打了免费品尝的标语”

“说来也奇怪，我推车来到这里，总是能遇到说‘来一块免费品尝的小蛋糕’的顾客，我就让他们尝了，他们还想吃，我就说得付钱。”

“真奇怪，开头要免费小蛋糕的……后面都会成为回头客。”

“有趣。”

宋郁从头到尾都是倾听，闻言只是眉眼变得温和，不过还是没多说什么，后面同摊主挥手再见。肩头沉甸甸的。

-

与此同时，江芮在公司接到了家里的电话，是保姆，又哭诉着不干了。

她蹙眉道：“一个月五万已经很高了。”

但电话那头只是解释：

“不行太太，我真得太害怕了，我不干了，再多我都不干了。”

“您回家一趟吧。”

江芮闭了闭眼，最终也是没办法了，放下了手头的工作，拿着车钥匙回去了。

进门的时候还很正常，客厅甚至很整洁，也没有摔东西，她不由得蹙了蹙眉，问了下保姆：

“这不没什么事儿？”

保姆面色惨白，也没有多争论什么，只是准备拿工资走人。

江芮一向大方，多给了两个月的工资，平和地道：“这段时间还是辛苦你了。”

“不过这次又是怎么了？”

她还是问了句。

保姆只是有些无法组织语言，只是说，“这孩子他……”

就在这时，儿童房里传来点嘻嘻的笑声。

江芮把包放下了，面色冷淡地走了过去，刚拉开门，瞳孔骤然一缩，随后快步冲了出来，去洗手间就是一阵呕吐。

保姆也没有立即走，只是赶忙过去拍背，很担忧地道；

“太太……实在不行还是送机构吧。”

儿童房的门大开着，里面的小孩拿着小刀在地板上划拉着，周遭有些湿踏踏的痕迹，还泛着一股腐臭味道。

他抬手在地上抓了下，又是一记闷摔，觉得这才高兴了。

这小孩估计觉得有点无聊，浑身脏兮兮的，就着湿掉的手擦了擦脸，拿着小刀就准备出去。

但就在这时，窗外传来一声悦耳的叫声。

他被吸引了，转而停了脚步。

窗户那里有一只体型较小、羽毛黑白棕交错的小鸟，它看到人被吸引过来了。

又模仿了下斑鸠的声音。

“咕咕咕……”

那孩童显然是被吸引到了，又往前走了几步，甚至爬上了飘窗，想要去打开。

窗外的鸟从头到尾都没有动过，只是盯着里面的人，它的脚环是金属制的，上面镌刻着两个字：

——伯劳001。
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo felt much more at ease and couldn't help but want to take a screenshot.

But he didn't know how.

Chen Kaihe had to come over to teach him.

The two old men lowered their voices as they fiddled with the phone, completely missing the fact that the bird in the frame was yawning and starting to tilt his head to look at Song Yu.

Bai Linlin felt that Song Yu looked a bit like his grandfather; both had quite high brow bones. But the eyes... perhaps he took more after Jiang Rui, born with good looks.

But the best part.

Was that red mole.

The bird couldn't help but give it a little peck.

And this happened to be exactly when Song Zhengguo swiped his three fingers down.

Screenshot taken.

At this moment, both ends of the call were filled with warmth and harmony, except for Song Qiming, who stood guard to the side with an expressionless face. He had been waiting until his father hung up the phone.

"Dad, Jiang Rui is truly going too far. There's no need to show consideration for the Jiang family. It's been so many years, and all she does is stir up public opinion. I listened to you and ignored it, but this time—"

Song Qiming was interrupted before he could finish. The old man on the hospital bed said in a deep voice:

"Shut up!"

"What right do you have to speak about Xiaoyu’s mother?"

"She married you early, carried a child for ten months—can you not see the suffering she endured?"

"A grown man, shirking responsibility all day long—do you have any sense of duty left?"

"Regardless of how Jiang Rui is now, you are the last person with the standing to criticize her!"

Song Qiming was left completely speechless.

But it wasn't over.

Because the old man’s next sentence was:

"I don't feel comfortable handing Huabing over to you. Any objections?"

"...No."

-

Song Yu and the bird had originally planned to take a taxi home, but seeing the sun was so nice, they decided to take a walk.

The human walked.

The bird enjoyed the scenery.

However, just as they were about to leave Huaihe Road, a cart was pushed over from not far away, and someone began to shout:

"Taro cream cupcakes! Free samples..."

The bird stretched his neck. He hadn't expected the vendor to set up shop here.

Bai Linlin was just about to ask the human to buy him one, but out of the corner of his eye, he saw something emerge from the dead end of the alley...

The human must have seen it too.

A string of small animals filed out from the entrance of the wall—a Lop-eared Rabbit, a Calico Cat, a Chinese Pond Turtle... and a group of Fancy Mice who loved to join in the fun, though Pipi had already gone home.

The human and the bird watched from not far away. These small animals were in their original forms while in the shadows, but as soon as they stepped into the sunlight, they transformed quite naturally.

The Lop-eared Rabbit was like an eight-year-old girl; she walked up to the stall, gave a five-yuan bill, and received a taro cupcake.

The Calico Cat was a beautiful young woman; she walked up, gave a ten-yuan bill, and received two taro cupcakes.

The Chinese Pond Turtle was an eighty-year-old grandfather who walked incredibly slowly, followed by a group of multiples...

The latter were the Fancy Mice in disguise.

The vendor was a young woman who scooped up the cupcakes, put them in boxes, handed them over, and took the money—all in one fluid motion.

"Take care."

"Take care."

"Take care."

...

By the time she sold to the last "old man," the vendor hesitated and gave him an extra one, though she worried if the old man might get high blood sugar from eating too much.

Caught between morality and profit, the "old man" had already snatched the bag.

"Tha-nk-you."

"Co-me-a-gain-to-mor-row."

The vendor gave an OK sign.

Bai Linlin: "..."

They were that popular?

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[I want one too!]

Song Yu was actually quite curious himself, so he stepped forward. The vendor reached out without looking up.

Song Yu: "...I'll scan the code."

The vendor was a bit surprised and couldn't help but chat a little more. "The customers here all love to pay with paper money; you're the first one to scan."

"Five yuan for one cupcake."

"How many?"

Song Yu thought for a moment and bought the rest for the bird.

However, while the vendor was packing the bag, he couldn't help but ask:

"How did you discover this place was good for business?"

"Huh?"

The young woman thought for a moment and said very seriously:

"Actually, I couldn't sell anything at first. People always thought small workshops weren't clean... so I put up a sign for free samples."

"It's strange to say, but every time I push my cart here, I always meet customers who say, 'I'll have a free sample cupcake.' I let them taste it, and they want more, so I tell them they have to pay."

"It's really weird. Those who ask for free cupcakes at the start... all end up becoming repeat customers."

"Interesting."

Song Yu had been listening the whole time. At these words, his expression softened, though he didn't say much else. He waved goodbye to the vendor, his shoulder feeling heavy.

-

At the same time, Jiang Rui received a call at the company from home. It was the nanny, crying and complaining that she wouldn't do it anymore.

She frowned and said, "Fifty thousand a month is already very high."

But the voice on the other end just explained:

"It's not that, Ma'am. I'm truly too scared. I can't do it. No matter how much you pay, I won't do it."

"You should come home."

Jiang Rui closed her eyes. In the end, she had no choice but to put down her work, grab her car keys, and head back.

Everything seemed normal when she entered. The living room was even tidy, and nothing was broken. She frowned slightly and asked the nanny:

"Doesn't look like anything is wrong?"

The nanny’s face was pale, and she didn't argue, just prepared to take her pay and leave.

Jiang Rui had always been generous and gave two extra months' salary, saying calmly, "It’s been hard on you during this time."

"But what happened this time?"

She still asked.

The nanny couldn't quite find the words, only saying, "The child, he..."

Just then, a giggling sound came from the children's room.

Jiang Rui put down her bag and walked over with a cold expression. As soon as she pulled the door open, her pupils shrank, and she rushed out to the bathroom, vomiting uncontrollably.

The nanny didn't leave immediately, but hurried over to pat her back, saying worriedly:

"Ma'am... if it really doesn't work, maybe send him to an institution."

The door to the children's room was wide open. The child inside was using a small knife to scratch the floor. There were damp, sticky traces all around, and a foul, rotting smell permeated the air.

He reached out and clawed at the floor, then fell down with a thud, feeling quite pleased with himself.

The child probably felt bored. He was filthy, wiped his face with his wet hand, and picked up the knife, preparing to go out.

But just then, a pleasant call came from outside the window.

He was attracted and stopped in his tracks.

At the window sat a small bird with black, white, and brown feathers. Seeing the person was attracted, it mimicked the sound of a turtle dove.

"Coo, coo, coo..."

The child was clearly drawn in, took a few more steps, and even climbed onto the window sill, wanting to open it.

The bird outside the window hadn't moved from start to finish, just staring at the person inside. Its leg band was made of metal, and two characters were engraved upon it:

—Shrike 001.

chunks.chineseText:
第27章

回到家里已经中午十二点多了，鸟吃得饱饱的，在卧室的书桌上翻看红本本。

白粼粼用爪子按住旁边一页，认真地观摩了下拍的照片，其实就是鸟头大了点，要是能P一下就好了。

照片上的合照大多还是上半身，少年在左，鸟在右边。

一个面色泛红，一个收紧了翅根。

下面盖着钢印：

南市妖怪管理局。

白粼粼还是比较满意的，毕竟他选的人看起来是最帅的，那些小妖怪们都星星眼了。

鸟微微仰头，骄傲。

爪子一掀，红本本合上了。

鸟叼着证件就下了桌子，啪嗒啪嗒地朝门口走，偶尔能听到浴室的水流声，宋郁回来先洗澡了。

鸟看了一眼，继续叼着本本走。

先放起来吧。

白粼粼觉得很是幸福，这大别墅，这人，这芋泥小蛋糕，鸟生圆满！

鸟拱了拱了门缝，从卧室里钻了出来，继续行进，直到停下，仰头看着自己房间的门。

扑棱翅膀飞上了门把手。

-

宋郁还在洗澡，等到换好衣服出来的时候才发现鸟不在书桌上，蹙眉唤道：

“粼粼？”

但是卧室里静悄悄的，不在，宋郁环顾了下四周，头发都没有擦干就去找了。

好在是线索很明确，隔壁的房间门是开着缝的，他抬手推开了。

鸟正在叼着本本思考放在哪个亚克力盒子里，走来走去的，欣赏自己的“收藏”。

有那个小金锁。

还有电子设备。

以及一系列鸟类的小窝、小衣服、小玩具。

白粼粼是后知后觉人来了，于是扑棱翅膀飞了过去，稳稳地站在宋郁的肩头。

有个证还是不错的。

宋郁不能养其他的小鸟！

白粼粼已经畅想着以后家里多一个可以刷爪子纹路的门了，对，还要刷鸟脸的。

这样就不错。

“要放起来么？”宋郁发梢还有些潮，侧眸看了过来，面色温和道。

鸟把本本递过去了。

宋郁抬手接了过来，也低头看了下，面色一点点泛红了。

但照片拍得很好的。

鸟非常大，毛绒绒的。

宋郁抬手摸了下照片里的鸟，唇角都微微抿了下。

“要放在这些柜子里？”

“不太安全吧。”

宋郁说完这句话后就带着鸟去三楼了，从储物间拿出来一个保险柜。

家里有不少东西。

宋郁当着鸟的面输入了密码，然后打开，把里面的金条拿了出来。

鸟：！！

宋郁其实不知道这放多久了，很小的时候奶奶买的，都记不太清了，只是把金条放在了书桌上。

肩头的小鸟立马攀爬下来，爪子踩在上面，很警惕地看了看二楼的窗户。

“这个保险柜给你用好不好？”

宋郁在椅子上坐着，又垂眸看了下那个证件，很温和地问道。

“啾啾！”

[ok！]

白粼粼伸着鸟头看过去，人把本本放进去了，要关上保险柜的时候，宋郁犹豫了下，决定换个密码：

“20250417。”

“可以记住吗？”

白粼粼愣了下，后来才反应过来了，是他来家里的那天，于是点了点鸟头。

证件放好了。

宋郁把保险柜放到了鸟的房间，至于原来的金条，则是找了个暗格抽屉放进去了。

反正它喜欢金子。

接下来就是那个“金属”环了，现在正在鸟的脖子上挂着，变小了很多。

宋郁把鸟放在地板上，俯身蹲下，蹙眉问了问：

“脖子痛不痛？”

白粼粼思考了下，诚恳地回答：“好像没什么感觉……”

“那还是不能控制大小？”

其实在管理局的时候问过了，杜宾说妖怪确实有能力把自己弄大一号，不过觉得这很莫名其妙。

宋郁其实还是有点期待的，他的小鸟又不笨，应该是能把握住的。

“要不要试试？”

少年又问。

鸟站在地板上，仰头看着人，脖子上还挂着那个稳定形态的“金属”环，爪子并了并，也不是很确定。

宋郁俯身蹲下，用手指试着勾掉那个小“项链”，但是也就在拿下来的一瞬间——

没有什么反应。

白粼粼也有些意外，伸了伸翅根，在地板上转了个圈。

又仰头看过来。

“那看来是好……”

宋郁这句话还没说完，但就在这时，鸟又砰得一下，变得伟岸了。

踩坏了一块地板。

人仰头看鸟。

“……”

“……”

宋郁其实也不太理解那个妖力F级是高还是低，万一，就是说万一，还有Z级呢？

那他的小鸟是中上游了。

宋郁也不想太让鸟焦虑，于是起身道：

“没关系的，不是有津贴吗？做一个任务就可以领到，到时候就会控制了。”

鸟有些不服。

试图努力去控制……

毕竟管理局那里的“任务”大多都是没有监护人的妖怪去领的，换取人类货币用的，只有极少数是兑换妖力津贴的……因为它们都会化形。

！

白粼粼才不要天天去上班，他已经上够了，他现在是一只小鸟！拥有自己iphone的小鸟！

鸟生气。

开始蓄力。

宋郁在对面站着，表情一点点变得茫然，因为面前的“大鸟”正在逐步……缩小。

还是闭着鸟眼的那种。

有种愤怒的小鸟既视感。

宋郁没忍住笑了下，但这让鸟听到了，刚变小就蹦跶到人的裤腿上，开始四处咬空气。

“对不起对不起。”

人俯身蹲下，抬手把鸟放到了手上。

白粼粼气得收了收翅根，很用力地侧过去了身，只留一个圆滚滚的背影。

“所以你学会了，这很好啊。”

宋郁抬手把鸟拿着转了回来，刚想要再问问，但是鸟爪子刚落地，又一个转身，像个弹跳鸡。

“……”

于是人再次拿了起来，放好。

鸟再次扭头。

宋郁唇角微微往上抿了下，继续重复做，抬手把鸟转回来。

鸟再次扭头。

如此循环几次。

鸟：“……”

白粼粼气得张嘴就要咬人，不过这次出乎意料地咬中了，人的指腹软软的。

扯一下。

欸？

又扯一下。

“不生气了？”

宋郁低头看着掌心的小鸟，任由它专注地叨自己的手指。

鸟叨的专注，压根没有抬头，只有一个圆滚滚的头顶。

宋郁从来没有见过这么有性格的小鸟，不由得说了句：

“粼粼好像人。”

此话一出，鸟躯一震。

白粼粼一下子动作停了，很心虚地站好了，心里咳咳了几声，收了收翅膀，很严谨地道：

“我是一只小鸟。”

小鸟不用上学，小鸟不用打工，小鸟不用早起，小鸟不用装大人。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀走在地板上，溜达了几圈，非常认真地转头回复道：

“你会一直养我吗？”

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，不知道为什么要问这个问题，只是道：

“你要选别的监护人？”

鸟：“……”

他是这个意思吗？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 27

It was past twelve noon when they returned home. The bird, now fully fed, was flipping through the little red booklet on the bedroom desk.

Bai Linlin held down the adjacent page with his claw, carefully admiring the photo. Truth be told, the bird’s head looked a bit large in it; it would have been perfect if he could have photoshopped it.

Most of the photos were head-and-shoulder shots, with the youth on the left and the bird on the right.

One had a face flushed with a faint red, the other had its wing-roots pulled tight.

Stamped below was the official seal:

Nanshi Bureau of Demon Management.

Bai Linlin was quite satisfied. After all, the human he had chosen looked the most handsome—even those little demons had been staring with stars in their eyes.

The bird tilted its head slightly, feeling proud.

With a flick of a claw, the red booklet snapped shut.

Clutching the document in his beak, the bird hopped off the table and waddled toward the door. He could occasionally hear the sound of running water from the bathroom; Song Yu had gone straight to shower upon returning.

The bird glanced over, then continued on his way, beak still clamped firmly on the booklet.

*Time to put it away.*

Bai Linlin felt incredibly happy. This grand villa, this person, this taro paste cake—a bird’s life was complete!

He nudged the door crack with his head, squeezed out of the bedroom, and continued his journey until he stopped, looking up at the door of his own room.

With a flutter of wings, he flew up to the door handle.

-

Song Yu was still showering. When he came out after changing his clothes, he realized the bird wasn't on the desk. He frowned and called out:

"Linlin?"

But the bedroom was quiet. The bird wasn't there. Song Yu looked around, and without even drying his hair, he went to search for him.

Fortunately, the trail was clear; the door to the next room was ajar. He reached out and pushed it open.

The bird was busy carrying the booklet, pacing back and forth as he pondered which acrylic box to store it in, admiring his own "collection."

There was that little golden lock.

And the electronic devices.

As well as a series of bird nests, little outfits, and tiny toys.

Bai Linlin only realized someone had arrived after the fact, so he fluttered his wings and flew over, landing steadily on Song Yu’s shoulder.

Having a certificate was actually quite nice.

Song Yu couldn't keep any other little birds now!

Bai Linlin was already imagining a future where the house would have a door that could scan claw prints—yes, and it would need to scan bird faces, too.

That would be perfect.

"Do you want to put it away?" Song Yu, his hair still damp, tilted his head and asked with a gentle expression.

The bird handed over the booklet.

Song Yu took it, lowered his head to look, and his face gradually flushed a faint red.

But the photo really was well-taken.

The bird was very large and fluffy.

Song Yu reached out to touch the bird in the photo, the corners of his lips curling slightly.

"Should we put it in these cabinets?"

"That might not be very safe."

After saying this, Song Yu took the bird to the third floor and retrieved a safe from the storage room.

There were quite a few things in the house.

Song Yu entered the password in front of the bird, opened it, and took out the gold bars inside.

Bird: !!

Song Yu actually didn't know how long they had been there; his grandmother had bought them when he was very young, and he couldn't quite remember. He simply placed the gold bars on the desk.

The little bird on his shoulder immediately scrambled down, stepped on them with his claws, and looked toward the second-floor window with great vigilance.

"How about you use this safe?"

Song Yu sat in the chair, lowered his eyes to look at the document again, and asked very gently.

"Chirp!"

[OK!]

Bai Linlin stretched his bird head over to look. As Song Yu put the booklet inside and prepared to close the safe, he hesitated for a moment and decided to change the password:

"20250417."

"Can you remember it?"

Bai Linlin was stunned for a moment before realizing it was the day he had arrived at this home, so he nodded his bird head.

The document was put away.

Song Yu moved the safe into the bird’s room. As for the original gold bars, he found a hidden drawer to store them in.

Anyway, the bird liked gold.

Next was the "metal" ring, which was currently hanging around the bird’s neck, having shrunk significantly.

Song Yu placed the bird on the floor, leaned down, and asked with a frown:

"Does your neck hurt?"

Bai Linlin thought about it and answered honestly, "I don't seem to feel anything..."

"So you still can't control the size?"

Actually, he had asked at the Bureau. Doberman had said that demons did have the ability to make themselves a size larger, but he thought it was quite inexplicable.

Song Yu was actually looking forward to it. His little bird wasn't stupid; he should be able to master it.

"Want to try?"

The youth asked again.

The bird stood on the floor, looking up at him, the "metal" ring that stabilized his form still hanging around his neck. He tapped his claws together, not entirely sure.

Song Yu leaned down and tried to unhook the little "necklace" with his fingers, but the moment he took it off—

Nothing happened.

Bai Linlin was also a bit surprised. He stretched his wing-roots and did a circle on the floor.

He looked up again.

"It seems that's goo—"

Before Song Yu could finish his sentence, the bird went *poof* and became imposing once more.

He cracked a floorboard.

The human looked up at the bird.

"..."

"..."

Song Yu didn't really understand if an F-rank demon power was high or low. What if—just what if—there was a Z-rank?

That would make his little bird upper-middle class.

Song Yu didn't want to make the bird anxious, so he stood up and said:

"It’s okay. Don't you have an allowance? You can collect it after completing a task, and you’ll learn to control it by then."

The bird was unconvinced.

He tried hard to control it...

After all, most of the "tasks" at the Bureau were taken by demons without guardians to exchange for human currency; only a very small number were for demon power allowances... because they all knew how to shapeshift.

!

Bai Linlin didn't want to go to work every day. He had worked enough; he was a little bird now! A little bird who owned his own iPhone!

The bird was angry.

He began to gather his strength.

Song Yu stood opposite him, his expression slowly turning blank, because the "big bird" in front of him was gradually... shrinking.

And doing so with his bird eyes closed.

It gave off a vibe of an "Angry Bird."

Song Yu couldn't help but chuckle, but the bird heard it. As soon as he shrank back down, he hopped onto the human’s pant leg and began biting the air in all directions.

"Sorry, sorry."

The human leaned down and lifted the bird onto his hand.

Bai Linlin was so angry he tucked in his wing-roots and turned away forcefully, leaving only a round, fluffy back.

"So you learned it; that’s great."

Song Yu lifted the bird and turned him back around. He was just about to ask more, but as soon as the bird’s claws touched the ground, he turned away again, like a jumping chicken.

"..."

So the human picked him up and set him down again.

The bird turned his head again.

Song Yu’s lips curled up slightly, and he continued to repeat the action, lifting the bird and turning him back.

The bird turned his head again.

This cycle repeated several times.

Bird: "..."

Bai Linlin was so angry he opened his beak to bite the human, but unexpectedly, he actually succeeded this time. The human’s fingertip felt soft.

He tugged.

Eh?

He tugged again.

"Not angry anymore?"

Song Yu looked down at the little bird in his palm, letting him focus on nibbling his finger.

The bird was so focused on nibbling that he didn't look up at all, showing only a round, fluffy crown.

Song Yu had never seen such a spirited little bird, so he couldn't help but remark:

"Linlin is just like a person."

As soon as these words were out, the bird’s body shuddered.

Bai Linlin stopped his movements, stood up looking very guilty, coughed a few times in his heart, tucked in his wings, and said very strictly:

"I am a little bird."

Little birds don't have to go to school, little birds don't have to work, little birds don't have to wake up early, and little birds don't have to pretend to be adults.

Bai Linlin fluttered his wings and walked across the floor, strolling around a few times before turning his head to ask very seriously:

"Will you keep me forever?"

Song Yu frowned, not knowing why he would ask that, but simply said:

"Are you planning to choose a different guardian?"

Bird: "..."

Was that what he meant?

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼往前伸爪子走了几步，刚想仰头解释，但下一秒——

“不可以。”

“我们领过证了。”

空气一阵安静。

宋郁反应过来自己说了什么也愣了下，总之是有点奇怪，他蹙了蹙眉，但又不想解释。

鸟宛若个发条鸟。

不动了。

宋郁刚想要抬手把鸟拿起来，可是就在这时，空气中传来点羽毛磨擦的动静，几乎没过几秒钟……

一只巨大的鸟又站在对面了。

“……”

少年愣了下，刚想要问问怎么了，但鸟已经转了身子，靠着墙去面壁了。

-

后来得出结论，情绪激动也会控制不好，白粼粼最后还是认认真真地戴上那个“金属”环了。

不过还是很害羞。

说得什么话！

鸟的清白都没有了！

不过下午还是要出去，白粼粼站在宋郁肩头看了看玄关的置物架，那里都是一些出行的OOTD的单品和套装。

“因为医院的变数比较大，不确定是否还在重症监护室，我们先去探探位置。”

宋郁侧眸同鸟解释了下，其实这一天是有点劳顿的，上午才从槐河路回来，中午也就休息了一个多小时。

但是这么变大变小恐怕对它不好，还是尽快解决掉为好，只要妖力足够化形就可以了。

及格，就可以。

宋郁是个很开明的监护人。

白粼粼闻言点了点头，他觉得也是，早完成早下班，不过他看了看置物架……

“啾啾啾！”

[要这个！]

宋郁抬眸看了过去，发现是一件蓝色格子披风。

但那个其实有点厚，里面有毛毛。

这是物业中午送过来的快递，刚挂上没多久。

宋郁还是劝了下，耐心道：

“那个会热，要不要换一个？帽子行么？”

“背带也可以。”

白粼粼闻言像是应激了一样，他才不要穿情趣内衣！

好几个带子，还穿过鸟腿……

不要！

“啾啾啾啾啾。”

[不不不不。]

鸟又伸了伸爪子，就要那个蓝色的披风，没办法，宋郁只能给它扣上。

白粼粼有点喘不过气来，但还是去照了照镜子，蓝色正好和他的羽毛颜色一样，很搭得好不好？

披风是带帽子的。

有点像侠客。

宋郁抬眸看着镜子里的小鸟在他肩头转了个圈圈，眉眼温和。

算了。

热了再脱了。

-

最后是坐着车子出门的，鸟戴了脚环，在人的肩头上打哈欠。

空调特地打得很低，司机都在前面冷得直摸手臂，但是没办法，加了一百块。

这个温度刚好适合穿了厚披风的鸟。

大约三十分钟后，一人一鸟抵达南市第一人民医院。

宋郁下了车之后就把挎包拉链打开了，意思不言而喻。

鸟：“……”

“医院人流量大，万一有病毒传染了就不好了。”

“进来。”

白粼粼没有办法，只好扑棱了两下翅膀，他本来打算飞下去的，但是看了看这个高度……

开始伸鸟腿。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼最后还是被放到挎包里了，黑乎乎的，圆滚滚的身体被两根修长的手指禁锢着。

鸟试图挣脱，但是发现人的手指伸到他的胸口了，开始叨叨叨。

但没有用。

黑漆漆的环境下有扣子解开的声音。

白粼粼被脱得干干净净，反应过来的时候身上已经没有披风了。

与此同时，鸟仰头一看，发现人的手正在往上抽，随之而来的是拉链的声音。

宋郁一边抬步往里走，一边单手拉挎包的额拉链，打算留个三指宽的扣子。

但就在走进大厅的时候，掌心突然被顶了下。

宋郁低头一看，包里探出来一颗圆滚滚的鸟头。

正在四处张望。

“……”

鸟被人用手指按下去了。

-

其实来医院也不仅仅只是为了找“乐乐”，还有另外一件事，宋郁想去看看阿姨和她的孩子。

已经提前联系过了，于是直接去的病房楼，顺带在医院的超市里买了些果篮和礼品。

“一共七百五十六。”

宋郁抬手把付款码递了过去，根本就没有关心多少钱，只是时刻用余光看自己的包。

期间还对视了下。

鸟在仰头看，鸟眼圆圆的，爪子似乎是劈了叉，一副蓄力的样子。

“……”

好在是提着东西找到了病房。

阿姨看到后很是高兴，眼眶都是含着热泪的，她甚至都忘了说自己孩子的近况，只是拉着宋郁的手给同病房的人介绍：

“这我带过的孩子，可优秀了，考的是南市的A大！”

病房里的人和陪护的家属都看了过来，也是一阵羡慕。

“多好一孩子啊。”

“真不错！”

“我家孩子要是能考上，那可是烧高香了。”

病房里热热闹闹的，都是祝贺的话，倒是比那个“升学宴”要真诚得多。

宋郁很温和地问，“弟弟怎么样？”

阿姨这才发现自己忘了最重要的事，拉着宋郁的手到了外边，一边擦泪一边道：

“做了手术的，在胸口开的刀……好在是很顺利，医生说在修养几天就能出院了。”

“小宋，阿姨不会忘了你的恩情的，一定会还你的救命钱的。”

白粼粼在包里待着，也想要出来，原来是先来找阿姨。

鸟也在！

鸟也在！

“没事的，孩子身体健康才是最重要的。”

“好，阿姨知道了，那小宋最近怎么样？不要不开心……”

正在交流的时候。

刺啦——

一颗毛绒绒的鸟头冒了出来。

刚想要打招呼。

但是被宋郁给扣住了，掌心拢着，挡得严严实实。

此刻正有人从电梯里出来，手里还提着给病号买的饭，过来的时候，还往这边看了一眼。

“我们病房又出院一个，真好啊。”

“就是说，医院这地方还是少来为好……”

“你家孩子怎么样了？”

有渐渐远去的交谈声音。

宋郁松了口气。

阿姨也有些意外，不过也是等到人走了才说话，垂眸看着少年虎口处探出来的一个肉色短喙，很是高兴地道：

“小鸟也来看我了？”

白粼粼不由得想要啾啾两声，但被人很及时地捏住了喙。

？

打断施法。

最后还是去了楼梯间，阿姨甚至还回了次病房，拿出来了旺仔小馒头。

白粼粼卡着鸟头在包里，很是专注地啃啃啃……

“是，叫粼粼。”

“它八个月了，是前段时间带去体检了。”

宋郁不厌其烦地和每个人介绍他的小鸟，眉眼温和，左手仍然是在围着鸟头，保持着半拢着的动作。

“真好……小鸟也很乖。”

阿姨也是很欣慰，又问了问宋郁最近身体怎么样。

鸟吃完了，闲着也是闲着，钻到包里一顿拱，最后终于顶着披风的帽子出来了。

歪歪的。

人，快看！

阿姨看到后又是一阵惊叹，连说了好几句“好看好看”、“小鸟穿什么都好看”。

不过最后还是蹙了蹙眉：

“这个天气穿有点热了。”
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin stepped forward, his claws clicking on the floor, just about to look up and explain, but the next second—

"No."

"We’ve already gotten our certificate."

The air went quiet.

Song Yu realized what he had said and froze as well. In any case, it was a bit strange, and he frowned, but he didn't want to explain.

The bird was like a wind-up toy.

He didn't move.

Song Yu was just about to reach out and pick the bird up, but at that moment, there was a sound of feathers rustling in the air, and within seconds...

A giant bird was standing opposite him again.

"..."

The youth was stunned, just about to ask what was wrong, but the bird had already turned around, leaning against the wall to face it.

-

They later concluded that emotional excitement could also cause a loss of control. In the end, Bai Linlin dutifully put the "metal" ring back on.

But he was still very shy.

What kind of thing to say!

The bird’s innocence was gone!

However, they still had to go out in the afternoon. Bai Linlin stood on Song Yu’s shoulder and looked at the entryway shelf, which was filled with OOTD items and sets for going out.

"Because the situation at the hospital is quite variable, and we aren't sure if they are still in the intensive care unit, let’s go scout the location first."

Song Yu tilted his head to explain to the bird. In truth, it had been an exhausting day; they had only returned from Huaihe Road in the morning and had only rested for about an hour at noon.

But growing and shrinking like this was likely bad for him, so it was better to resolve it as soon as possible. As long as his demon power was sufficient to shapeshift, that would be enough.

Passing the threshold would be enough.

Song Yu was a very enlightened guardian.

Bai Linlin nodded upon hearing this. He agreed; finish early, get off work early. However, he looked at the shelf...

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[I want this one!]

Song Yu looked up and saw it was a blue plaid cape.

But that was actually a bit thick; it had fur on the inside.

It was a package the property management had delivered at noon, and it hadn't been hanging there for long.

Song Yu tried to persuade him, patiently saying:

"That will be too hot. Do you want to change to another one? How about a hat?"

"Or a harness?"

Bai Linlin reacted as if he had been triggered. He did *not* want to wear a piece of sexy lingerie!

With all those straps, and having to go through the bird’s legs...

No way!

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp."

[No, no, no, no.]

The bird stretched out his claws again, insisting on the blue cape. With no other choice, Song Yu had to fasten it for him.

Bai Linlin felt a bit suffocated, but he still went to look in the mirror. The blue matched his feathers perfectly—didn't it look great?

The cape had a hood.

He looked a bit like a wandering swordsman.

Song Yu looked up at the little bird spinning in circles on his shoulder in the mirror, his eyes gentle.

Forget it.

He could take it off if he got hot.

-

In the end, they went out by car. The bird wore his ankle ring and yawned on the human’s shoulder.

The air conditioning was set specifically low; the driver in the front was so cold he kept rubbing his arms, but there was no help for it—he had been given an extra hundred yuan.

This temperature was just right for a bird wearing a thick cape.

About thirty minutes later, the human and the bird arrived at Nanshi First People's Hospital.

After Song Yu got out of the car, he unzipped his messenger bag, the implication clear.

Bird: "..."

"The hospital has a high flow of people. It wouldn't be good if you caught a virus."

"Get in."

Bai Linlin had no choice but to flutter his wings. He had originally planned to fly down, but after looking at the height...

He began to stretch his bird legs.

Song Yu: "..."

In the end, Bai Linlin was placed into the messenger bag. It was pitch black, and his round, fluffy body was restrained by two slender fingers.

The bird tried to break free but found the human’s fingers pressed against his chest, and he began to chirp and peck.

But it was useless.

In the darkness, there was the sound of a button being undone.

Bai Linlin was stripped clean; by the time he realized what was happening, the cape was already gone.

At the same time, the bird looked up and saw the human’s hand pulling upward, followed by the sound of a zipper.

Song Yu walked inside while zipping the bag with one hand, intending to leave a three-finger-wide opening.

But just as they walked into the lobby, his palm was suddenly pushed from within.

Song Yu looked down and saw a round bird head poking out of the bag.

He was looking around everywhere.

"..."

The bird was pressed back down by the human’s finger.

-

In fact, coming to the hospital wasn't just to find "Lele"; there was another matter. Song Yu wanted to visit the auntie and her child.

He had contacted her in advance, so he went straight to the inpatient building, stopping by the hospital supermarket to buy a fruit basket and some gifts.

"That will be seven hundred and fifty-six in total."

Song Yu handed over the payment code, not caring about the cost at all, but keeping his peripheral vision fixed on his bag.

During this time, they even made eye contact.

The bird was looking up, his bird eyes round, his claws seemingly splayed out in a stance of gathering strength.

"..."

Fortunately, he found the ward while carrying the items.

The auntie was very happy to see him, her eyes brimming with tears. She even forgot to mention her child’s current condition, simply holding Song Yu’s hand and introducing him to the others in the ward:

"This is a child I used to look after. He’s so excellent; he got into A University in Nanshi!"

The people in the ward and the accompanying family members all looked over, filled with envy.

"What a good child."

"Truly impressive!"

"If my child could get in, I’d be burning incense in gratitude."

The ward was lively, filled with congratulations—much more sincere than that "graduation banquet."

Song Yu asked very gently, "How is the little brother?"

The auntie only then realized she had forgotten the most important thing. She pulled Song Yu’s hand outside, wiping her tears as she said:

"He had the surgery; they cut open his chest... Fortunately, it went very smoothly. The doctor said he can be discharged in a few days of recovery."

"Little Song, Auntie won't forget your kindness. I will definitely pay you back for the life-saving money."

Bai Linlin was staying in the bag, wanting to come out. So they had come to find the auntie first.

The bird was here too!

The bird was here too!

"It’s okay. The child’s health is what matters most."

"Alright, Auntie knows. How have you been lately, Little Song? Don't be unhappy..."

While they were talking.

*Zzzip—*

A fluffy bird head popped out.

He was just about to say hello.

But he was caught by Song Yu, who cupped his palm over him, blocking him completely.

At that moment, someone was coming out of the elevator, carrying food for a patient. As they passed by, they glanced over.

"Another one discharged from our ward; that’s great."

"Exactly. It’s best to come to the hospital as little as possible..."

"How is your child doing?"

The sound of conversation faded into the distance.

Song Yu breathed a sigh of relief.

The auntie was also a bit surprised, but she waited until the people had left before speaking. She looked down at the fleshy, short beak poking out from the web of the youth’s hand and said happily:

"The little bird came to see me too?"

Bai Linlin couldn't help but want to chirp a few times, but his beak was pinched shut just in time.

?

Spell interrupted.

In the end, they went to the stairwell. The auntie even went back to the ward and brought out some Wangzai milk buns.

Bai Linlin, with his head stuck out of the bag, began to nibble, nibble, nibble...

"Yes, his name is Linlin."

"He’s eight months old. I took him for a check-up a while ago."

Song Yu introduced his little bird to everyone tirelessly, his eyes gentle, his left hand still cupping the bird’s head, maintaining a half-closed position.

"That’s wonderful... The little bird is very well-behaved too."

The auntie was also very comforted and asked how Song Yu had been feeling lately.

The bird finished eating, and since he had nothing better to do, he burrowed into the bag and wiggled around, finally emerging with the hood of the cape on.

It was crooked.

Human, look!

The auntie exclaimed in wonder when she saw it, saying "Beautiful, beautiful" and "The little bird looks good in anything" several times.

But in the end, she frowned:

"It’s a bit hot to wear this in this weather."

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁这才解释道：

“市面上没有卖鹦鹉夏天穿的小披风，这是冬天保温的，它今天觉得好看才穿的……”

“阿姨给做！”

宋郁很温和地笑了下，顺着话头说了下去：

“那您还愿意来家里工作吗？”

“还是我和小鸟，我聘您，不是我父亲。”

白粼粼后面也是热得发晕，展示完就把披风给弄下来了，仰头看着他们。

阿姨闻言一时半会不知道说什么，只是道：

“不行不行，孩子，我借了你的钱，我再来赚你的钱，这怎么行？”

宋郁垂眸想了想，又道：

“那没办法了，请的新阿姨都不喜欢小动物，我也做不好饭，只能天天点外卖了。”

阿姨闻言又心急：

“不行不行！”

“我给你送！”

少年抬眼看了过去，面色很是诚恳。

“小宋，你这样我是真的很过意不去……”

宋郁垂眸道：

“阿姨，我爷爷醒了他如果知道有这么一个照顾我的长辈也会高兴的，更何况您还对我的小鸟这么好。”

“我已经成年了，有家里分红的，完全付得起您的工资。”

阿姨一下子什么话都说不出来了。

-

鸟又获得了一瓣耙耙柑，在包里自顾自地吃，上面的人还在交谈，不过说到了正事。

“行，这个没问题，叫乐乐是吧，人民医院这里病区也就那么几个，我打听打听就知道了。”

阿姨一口应了下来，之后就是劝人赶紧回家去，医院不是什么好地方，人来人往的。

宋郁这才带着鸟出了医院，算是完成了两件事，道路旁边车水马龙，摆着几个摊子。

等到叫的车来的时候，人手上已经多了两个袋子。

凡是经过，片甲不留。

这个时间已经四五点了，司机估计是有些困乏，打了个哈欠，对后座问：

“去哪？”

“南心公园。”

-

与此同时公寓里。

那个孩童已经爬上了飘窗，抬手打开了窗户，对着外面的小鸟笑了下。

“一起玩。”

外面的伯劳鸟盯了这小孩一会儿，然后跳到了窗户边沿，看着地板上那些被剖了身体的同族。

它也就看了几秒，转而继续看这个孩子。

世界物竞天择，猎人捕猎，圈养牲畜……都是正常的。

未开智的动物之间也有食物链。

它一直都知道。

谁都想生存下去，这无可厚非，可是，为什么要虐杀？

恃强凌弱，很愉悦么？

年纪小就是为非作歹的挡箭牌了么？

圆圆的小鸟看着这孩子伸手过来抓，很轻巧地跳开了。

房门外有大人的声音。

“太太这样下去迟早会出事的，你看我的胳膊……”

“我睡着的时候被刀片划醒的，他已经按住我的脖子了。”

房内这孩子还在慢慢地跟着鸟，手里更是紧紧地攥着工笔刀，有点兴奋的感觉了。

001站定不动，盯着这个满脸黑血的孩子。

管理局守则：

1、为促进人妖和谐相处，灰色任务惩罚力度应该适中，不宜引起人类社会的舆论。

2、一切行动应当优先保证自身安全。

……

那男童抬手就抓住了闯入的小鸟，拿着工笔刀就打算往眼珠子上剜开，从这里可以把躯干弄开。

动物的脑子他知道了……那人的呢？

男童又兴奋了起来，开始粗喘着气，一声不吭的，甚至停了下动作，回头看了看门口。

像是也知道外面有大人。

不过就在他回头的时候——

眼前一片漆黑。

随即就是刺痛。

“啊啊！”

……

夜晚的黄昏很好，南心公园中央已经有了娱乐活动。

一只黑棕白相交的小鸟飞到了不远处的树杈子上，熟练地把叼来的东西叉在一旁的凸起来的木棍上。

两个。

像糖葫芦。

001本来是准备吃了算了的，但是又觉得反胃。

“……”

公园里已经热闹了起来，它扑棱翅膀飞到了另外一棵树上，本来是想看看下面的人在干什么。

结果看到了一个摄像机。

“……”

001出于礼貌没有动。

那老大爷高兴极了，一脸认真地同旁边的观鸟搭子介绍道：

“你看看，这可是伯劳鸟，凶残着呢。”

“有这么厉害？”

老大爷摆摆手，觉得说不通，但刚想举起来摄像机再拍一张的时候，却在树杈子上找不到了鸟的身影。

与此同时，公园一个监控死角处，出来了一身黑的少年，个子不高，约莫就一米七出头。

“他”在很认真地数自己的钱，手指夹着一个破破的布包，闷闷地自言自语：

“五块、十块、二十……”

001觉得很伤心，它又在月底花完了自己的工资，就剩下这点了。

它想吃烧烤。

要吃羊肉、牛肉、大茄子……

还有猪腰子。

黑衣少年很是郁闷，揣着自己的钱四处张望，烧烤摊子这个点应该开了。

001四处张望了下，看到了具体的位置就过去了，一路上反反复复地劝说自己。

就吃十块钱的。

明天再吃十块钱的。

撑到下个月！

但是走到摊子口的时候——

“你来啦？不太巧噢，有个人全买走了，明天来吧。”

老板已经在收摊了。

001震惊。

是谁！

就在这时老板还指了指方向：“真的，要有我肯定给你留着，但那年轻人全买走了，他还带着只鸟，那叫一个吵，啾啾啾不知道在说啥。”

001攥着自己那几张钞票，懵懵地看着不远处的人。

它的串串……

-

宋郁在公园人行道上走着，见周遭没有什么人，才温声劝道：

“不能吃太多了，管理局那边不是说了，会导致气息混浊，对你化形也不是很有助益。”

鸟不服：

“它们都排队吃小蛋糕！”

“……”

监护人：“人家化形了。”

鸟圆滚滚的脑袋一撇，思考了下，反驳道：

“我会变大”

“……”

宋郁正有一搭没一搭和自己肩头的小鸟辩论的时候，余光突然注意到旁边的公共座椅把手上蹲着个黑衣少年。

像是画面断了帧，下一秒突然出现的。

宋郁不由得停了脚步，侧头看了过去。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu then explained:

"There aren't any capes for parrots sold on the market. This one is for keeping warm in winter; it just thought it looked good today, so it wore it..."

"I'll make one for it!"

Song Yu smiled gently and followed the flow of the conversation:

"Then, would you still be willing to come work at my home?"

"It would just be me and the little bird. I am hiring you, not my father."

Bai Linlin was feeling dizzy from the heat as well. After showing off, he took the cape off and looked up at them.

Upon hearing this, the auntie didn't know what to say for a moment, only managing:

"No, no, child. I borrowed your money; how could I then come and earn your money? That wouldn't be right."

Song Yu lowered his eyes, thought for a moment, and added:

"There’s no other way then. The new nannies I hire don't like small animals, and I'm not good at cooking, so I'd have to order takeout every day."

The auntie grew anxious upon hearing this:

"No, that won't do!"

"I'll bring food to you!"

The young man looked up, his expression very sincere.

"Little Song, I really feel terrible about this..."

Song Yu lowered his gaze and said:

"Auntie, if my grandfather wakes up and knows there is an elder like you taking care of me, he would be happy. Besides, you’ve been so good to my little bird."

"I am already an adult and have dividends from my family; I can fully afford your salary."

The auntie was suddenly left speechless.

-

The bird had obtained another slice of citrus and was eating it to itself in the bag. The people above were still talking, but they had moved on to serious matters.

"Alright, that’s no problem. Lele, right? There are only a few wards in the People's Hospital; I’ll just ask around and find out."

The auntie agreed immediately, then urged him to hurry home, saying the hospital wasn't a good place with people coming and going.

Only then did Song Yu take the bird out of the hospital, having completed two tasks. The road was bustling with traffic, and several stalls were set up along the side.

By the time the summoned car arrived, his hands were already full with two bags.

Wherever he passed, nothing was left behind.

It was already four or five o'clock. The driver seemed a bit tired and yawned, asking the backseat:

"Where to?"

"Nanxin Park."

-

Meanwhile, in the apartment.

The child had already climbed onto the bay window, raised his hand to open it, and smiled at the little bird outside.

"Let's play together."

The shrike outside stared at the child for a while, then hopped onto the window ledge, looking at the dismembered bodies of its own kind on the floor.

It only watched for a few seconds before turning its attention back to the child.

In this world, survival of the fittest, hunters hunting, livestock being raised... all of this was normal.

Even among animals without sentience, there is a food chain.

It had always known this.

Everyone wants to survive; that is understandable. But why the torture?

Is bullying the weak pleasurable?

Is being young a shield for committing evil?

The round little bird watched the child reach out to grab it and nimbly hopped away.

Outside the bedroom door, there was an adult's voice.

"Ma'am, if this continues, something will happen sooner or later. Look at my arm..."

"I was woken up by a razor blade while I was sleeping. He already had his hands around my throat."

Inside the room, the child was still slowly following the bird, his hand gripping a craft knife tightly, a sense of excitement beginning to show.

001 stood still, staring at the child whose face was covered in black blood.

Management Bureau Code:

1. To promote harmony between humans and spirits, the punishment for gray-level tasks should be moderate and not trigger public opinion in human society.

2. All actions should prioritize personal safety.

...

The boy raised his hand and grabbed the intruding bird, holding the craft knife, intending to gouge out its eyes to open up its torso from there.

He knew how an animal's brain worked... what about a human's?

The boy grew excited again, starting to breathe heavily without a sound. He even paused his movements to look back at the door.

It seemed he also knew there were adults outside.

But just as he turned his head—

Everything went pitch black.

Followed by a sharp pain.

"Ahhh!"

...

The twilight of the evening was beautiful, and there were already recreational activities in the center of Nanxin Park.

A small bird with black, brown, and white feathers flew to a nearby tree branch and skillfully skewered the item it had brought on a protruding wooden stick.

Two of them.

Like candied hawthorns.

001 had originally intended to eat it, but felt nauseous.

"..."

The park was already lively. It flapped its wings and flew to another tree, originally wanting to see what the people below were doing.

Instead, it saw a camera.

"..."

001 remained still out of politeness.

The old man was overjoyed and introduced it to his bird-watching companion with a serious face:

"Look at that, that's a shrike. They're quite vicious."

"Is it that impressive?"

The old man waved his hand, feeling it couldn't be explained, but just as he wanted to raise his camera to take another shot, he couldn't find the bird on the branch anymore.

At the same time, from a blind spot in the park's surveillance, a young man dressed in black emerged. He wasn't tall, just over 1.7 meters.

"He" was counting his money very seriously, holding a tattered cloth bag between his fingers, muttering to himself gloomily:

"Five, ten, twenty..."

001 felt very sad. It had spent its salary again at the end of the month, and this was all that was left.

It wanted to eat barbecue.

It wanted lamb, beef, big eggplants...

And pork kidneys.

The youth in black was very depressed, clutching his money and looking around. The barbecue stall should be open at this hour.

001 looked around, saw the specific location, and headed over, repeatedly persuading itself along the way.

Just spend ten yuan.

Spend another ten yuan tomorrow.

Make it last until next month!

But when he reached the stall—

"You're here? Not a great time, I'm afraid. Someone bought everything. Come back tomorrow."

The boss was already closing up.

001 was shocked.

Who was it!

Just then, the boss pointed in a direction: "Really, if I had any left, I would have saved it for you, but that young man bought it all. He even had a bird with him; it was so noisy, chirping away, no idea what it was saying."

001 clutched his few banknotes, staring blankly at the person not far away.

His skewers...

-

Song Yu was walking on the park sidewalk. Seeing that there was no one around, he gently advised:

"You can't eat too much. Didn't the Management Bureau say it would cause your aura to become murky? It's not very helpful for your transformation."

The bird was unconvinced:

"They were all lining up to eat cupcakes!"

"..."

The guardian: "They have already transformed."

The bird tilted its round head, thought for a moment, and retorted:

"I can get big."

"..."

As Song Yu was debating with the little bird on his shoulder, his peripheral vision suddenly caught a youth in black squatting on the armrest of a nearby public bench.

It was as if the frame had skipped, and he had appeared in the next second.

Song Yu couldn't help but stop and turn his head to look.

chunks.chineseText:
第28章

宋郁其实有点意外，因为他没有见过有人能蹲在公共座椅把手上的，还保持平衡得这么好。

鸟也好奇，这谁？

但就在这时，对面的少年灵巧地跳了下来，走到了一人一鸟跟前。

001个子不高，需要仰视，直直地盯着人。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼眯了眯鸟眼，他虽然没有什么当妖怪的经验，但是就凭那个闪现，足以证明这人不太正常。

鸟刚想叼着人的衣领让他走开。

“它，是妖怪。”

少年伸了伸手，指着宋郁肩头的这只圆嘟嘟的肥鸟道。

白粼粼：“……”

宋郁环顾了下四周，刚想要确定下有没有人听到，但是回头的时候却发现那少年不见了。

低头。

黑衣少年蹲在他面前，盯着那个烧烤袋子。

专注ing。

宋郁有些无所适从，但他还是问了句：

“呃，你要吃吗？”

黑衣少年刷得一下抬头，眼睛像是骤然亮了起来。

“可以吗？”

001话虽然是这么说，但是手已经伸到了袋子里，抓住了一根竹签。

宋郁：“……”

最后找了没人的公园石椅坐下了，对面的少年似乎是饿了很久了，拿着串就开始吃了起来，再次确定了下：

“不要钱吧？”

白粼粼此刻站在桌子上，来回啪嗒啪嗒地走，非常好奇这“人”是什么身份，怎么会一眼看出来他是妖怪的？

宋郁抬手把鸟拿了回来，放到肩头，这才同对面的少年道：

“不要。”

“但你为什么那么说？”

他其实有些戒备，毕竟管理局那边是夜晚活动，白天那些妖怪大多是在监护人身边，或者是不化形。

这少年什么身份？

001头也不抬地伸手，指了指旁边的鸟，确切地说是脖子上的“金属”环。

“不是管理局发的吗？”

“……”

宋郁没话说了，他没想到是这个“项链”的事，不过就在这时，那黑衣少年似乎是觉得吃得不方便，皱了皱眉头。

下一秒。

一只羽毛蓬松的小鸟出现在桌面了，眼周的羽毛是黑色的，翅膀则是上棕下深，短喙尤为锋利，此刻它正在一个爪子固定木棍，然后用喙卖力地撕羊肉。

孜然味的。

小鸟吃得非常专心。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼也很好奇，于是扑棱翅膀从人的肩头下来了，站在了那只吃串串的鸟旁边，立正。

低头打量。

“啾啾？”

[你是什么品种的？]

白粼粼其实有些想法，这只鸟看起来比自己小一点，个头也不太大的。

是妖怪……

那收了当小弟如何？

鸟心里越想越觉得合适，还伸了伸爪子把烧烤袋子推了过去，他很大方的。

“你为什么不说人话？”

001吃完了烧烤里的所有肉，然后又化形成了黑衣少年，低头看着桌上的那只同族道。

白粼粼：“……”

他现在是只鸟！口吐人言很违和好不好？更何况是复杂句。

但他还没来得及解释——

“你不会化形吗？”

“你戴的那个稳定器，是幼鸟才会用的。”

001非常直白地指了指，面色很是平静，但是唇边全是酱料。

白粼粼：“……”

吐出来！给我吐出来！

“它就是幼鸟，它还不到一岁。”

宋郁很平和地补充道。

001不解：“不对。”

“鸟类的岁数不是这么算的，它十个月的话，就可以交｜配了。”

“找对象。”

石桌上的鸟石化了，宋郁也愣住了，但这还没完，因为少年的下一句是：

“你是它的交配对象吗？”

-

南市急救中心。

江芮面色惨白，听着医生的话更是觉得胆战心惊，对方也是匪夷所思：

“这……没有见过这种情况，一般八九十年代的时候有过野鸟进房间啄食刚出生没多久的小孩眼睛的案例。”

“但你家这个……年纪很大了。”

“按道理来说是完全可以挣开的，鸟才多大？”

医生觉得邪门，但是也确实没什么办法，只能告知术后的注意事项。

但就在这时病房里传来一阵惨叫，是一个护士的声音，很快许多人都围了上去。

医生赶过去的时候，那实习的护士的手臂已经被那孩子咬得很深了，都渗出来血了。

江芮愣愣地站在门口，只是觉得可怕，她不该生的……害人害己。

-

南心公园。

“这有什么？我们鸟类不看物种的。”

001不能理解面前的一人一鸟，丹顶鹤就喜欢的它的饲养员，这有什么的？

喜欢就是喜欢。

宋郁被噎得不知道说什么，但到底是硬生生岔开话题了，只是道：

“那你可以和我的小鸟交朋友，它刚到管理局报道……”

白粼粼已经石化很久了，不过这个时候恢复了，他没忘记正事，于是啪嗒啪嗒走到这只鸟的面前，认真问：

“你要当我的跟班吗？”

人震惊，刚想捂住鸟嘴。

但对面的少年只是面色茫然，问：“什么是跟班？”

白粼粼反应了下，心想也是，当老大是需要给跟班好处的。

鸟低头环顾了四周，发现也没有什么好东西，突然看到了空的烧烤袋子。

Bingo！

白粼粼伸了爪子过去，仰头看向这个黑衣少年，很正经地道：

“咳咳，这个，当跟班的话，有免费的烧烤吃……”

鸟话都没有说完。

001很自然地变成了那只小雀的模样，爪子啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，眼神专注，抬头问：

“真的吗？”

鸟：“……真的。”

001立即道：“好的，我是你的跟班。”

宋郁其实几次都想要打断，他总觉得这样不太对，但是看着石桌上的两只鸟毛绒绒的样子，还是忍了。

当老大……也没什么。

行。

后面的事就很自然了，两只鸟约定了下周去管理局培训的时候见面，顺带交流了下吃烧烤的心得体会。

宋郁：“……”

001临走前还有些不放心，又啪嗒啪嗒地走到那只大一点的蓝羽小鸟面前，嘱咐道：

“一定要记得给我带。”

“要加麻加辣的。”

宋郁就这么看着他的小鸟挥了挥翅膀，还仰了下头，很是打包票的样子。

“没问题！”

-

最终这个小插曲才算过去，南心公园这个时候人已经很多了，大多是中老年人，估计是要跳广场舞。

宋郁其实等了有一会儿，但是还是没有发现售卖鹦鹉的鸟贩子，于是只好先去附近的一家24小时营业银行了。

鸟说拿手机有些不方便，它要钞票。

红色的那种。

宋郁简单取了一万，觉得大概是够用一个月的，于是在二十分钟后回到了南心公园。

而这时，公园雕像的左侧那里已经围起来了人。

还有阵阵喝彩的声音。

一人一鸟走了过去，这才看到了中间的情形：
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 28

Song Yu was actually a bit surprised, as he had never seen anyone capable of squatting on the armrest of a public bench while maintaining such perfect balance.

The bird was also curious: Who is this?

But just then, the youth opposite jumped down nimbly and walked up to the person and the bird.

001 wasn't tall, so he had to look up, staring straight at the man.

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes. Although he didn't have much experience being a spirit, that "teleportation" was enough to prove that this person wasn't normal.

The bird was just about to grab the man's collar to make him go away.

"It is a spirit."

The youth reached out and pointed at the round, chubby bird on Song Yu's shoulder.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Song Yu looked around, wanting to make sure no one had heard, but when he turned back, the youth was gone.

He looked down.

The youth in black was squatting in front of him, staring at the barbecue bag.

Focusing.

Song Yu felt a bit awkward, but he asked anyway:

"Uh, do you want to eat some?"

The youth in black looked up in a flash, his eyes seemingly lighting up instantly.

"Can I?"

Although 001 said that, his hand was already in the bag, grabbing a bamboo skewer.

Song Yu: "..."

Finally, they found an empty stone bench in the park to sit on. The youth opposite seemed to have been hungry for a long time and started eating the skewers, confirming once more:

"It's free, right?"

Bai Linlin was currently standing on the table, pacing back and forth, very curious about what this "person's" identity was and how he could tell at a glance that he was a spirit.

Song Yu reached out, took the bird back, and placed it on his shoulder before saying to the youth opposite:

"Yes."

"But why did you say that?"

He was actually a bit guarded. After all, the Management Bureau operated at night; most spirits during the day were either with their guardians or didn't transform.

What was this youth's identity?

001 reached out without looking up and pointed at the bird beside him, specifically at the "metal" ring on its neck.

"Isn't that issued by the Management Bureau?"

"..."

Song Yu had nothing to say. He hadn't expected it to be about this "necklace." But just then, the youth in black seemed to find it inconvenient to eat and frowned.

The next second.

A small bird with fluffy feathers appeared on the table. The feathers around its eyes were black, its wings were brown on top and dark on the bottom, and its short beak was particularly sharp. It was currently holding a wooden stick with one claw and tearing at the lamb with its beak with great effort.

Cumin-flavored.

The little bird was eating with great focus.

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin was also curious, so he flapped his wings, hopped down from the man's shoulder, and stood next to the bird eating the skewers, standing at attention.

He lowered his head to inspect it.

"Chirp chirp?"

[What breed are you?]

Bai Linlin actually had some thoughts. This bird looked a bit smaller than him, and not very big in size.

It's a spirit...

How about taking it in as a lackey?

The more the bird thought about it, the more appropriate it seemed. He even stretched out his claw and pushed the barbecue bag over; he was very generous.

"Why don't you speak human language?"

001 finished all the meat in the barbecue, transformed back into the youth in black, and looked down at the fellow spirit on the table.

Bai Linlin: "..."

He was a bird right now! Isn't it awkward to speak human language? Especially complex sentences.

But before he could explain—

"Can't you transform?"

"The stabilizer you're wearing is only used by fledglings."

001 pointed it out very bluntly, his expression calm, though his lips were covered in sauce.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Spit it out! Spit it out for me!

"It is a fledgling; it's not even a year old yet."

Song Yu added peacefully.

001 was puzzled: "That's not right."

"Bird ages aren't calculated like that. At ten months old, it can already mate."

"Find a partner."

The bird on the stone table was petrified, and Song Yu was stunned, but it wasn't over, because the youth's next sentence was:

"Are you its mating partner?"

-

Nan City Emergency Center.

Jiang Rui's face was pale, and hearing the doctor's words made her feel even more terrified. The other party was also baffled:

"This... I've never seen such a situation. Generally, there were cases in the 80s and 90s of wild birds entering rooms and pecking at the eyes of newborn infants."

"But yours... it's quite old."

"Logically speaking, it should have been able to break free. How big is a bird, anyway?"

The doctor felt it was sinister, but there was really nothing to be done, so he could only inform her of the post-operative precautions.

But just then, a scream came from the ward—a nurse's voice—and soon many people crowded around.

When the doctor rushed over, the intern nurse's arm had already been bitten deeply by the child, and blood was seeping out.

Jiang Rui stood blankly at the door, only feeling terror. She shouldn't have given birth to him... harming others and herself.

-

Nanxin Park.

"What's wrong with that? We birds don't care about species."

001 couldn't understand the man and the bird in front of him. A red-crowned crane liked its zookeeper; what was wrong with that?

If you like someone, you like them.

Song Yu was choked for words, but he eventually managed to change the subject:

"Then you can be friends with my little bird. It just reported to the Management Bureau..."

Bai Linlin had been petrified for a long time, but he recovered by this point. He hadn't forgotten his business, so he waddled over to the bird and asked seriously:

"Do you want to be my lackey?"

The man was shocked and wanted to cover the bird's beak.

But the youth opposite just looked blank and asked, "What is a lackey?"

Bai Linlin reacted, thinking that was true; being a boss requires giving benefits to lackeys.

The bird looked around and didn't find anything good, then suddenly saw the empty barbecue bag.

Bingo!

Bai Linlin reached out his claw, looked up at the youth in black, and said very seriously:

"Ahem, this... if you become my lackey, there's free barbecue to eat..."

The bird hadn't even finished speaking.

001 naturally transformed into that little sparrow, walked over with a pattering sound, eyes focused, and looked up to ask:

"Really?"

The bird: "...Really."

001 immediately said: "Okay, I'll be your lackey."

Song Yu had wanted to interrupt several times, feeling that something wasn't quite right, but looking at the two fluffy birds on the stone table, he held back.

Being a boss... it wasn't a big deal.

Fine.

The rest followed naturally. The two birds agreed to meet when they went to the Management Bureau for training next week, and they took the opportunity to exchange insights on eating barbecue.

Song Yu: "..."

Before leaving, 001 was still a bit worried, so he waddled over to the larger blue-feathered bird and instructed:

"Remember to bring some for me."

"Make it extra spicy."

Song Yu just watched his little bird flap its wings and tilt its head, looking very confident.

"No problem!"

-

In the end, this little interlude passed. By now, there were many people in Nanxin Park, mostly middle-aged and elderly people, likely preparing for square dancing.

Song Yu had actually waited for a while, but still hadn't found any parrot vendors, so he had to go to a nearby 24-hour bank first.

The bird said carrying a phone was inconvenient; it wanted banknotes.

The red kind.

Song Yu withdrew ten thousand, thinking it would probably be enough for a month, and returned to Nanxin Park twenty minutes later.

By this time, a crowd had already gathered to the left of the park statue.

There were bursts of cheers.

The man and the bird walked over, only then seeing the situation in the middle:

chunks.chineseText:
一只虎皮鹦鹉在走滚轮，喙里还叼着一个小秤砣，摇摇晃晃的，好几次脑袋都往下坠了，硬生生抬起来的。

“好！好！”

“真厉害呀！”

周遭的人都是看客，绝大多数是中年男人，凑热闹的，有几个注意到了身后的少年，不由自主地看向对方肩头的蓝羽鹦鹉。

“欸，这儿也——”

宋郁面无表情地看了过去，表情很冷。

那男人这才讪讪地扭头了，不自在地搓了搓手。

不过这里人多眼杂的，宋郁还是拉开了自己的挎包，这会鸟也很乖，立马飞进去了。

和人民币贴贴。

鹦鹉表演还在继续，那是个穿着不修边幅的男人，手里拿着一个小棍，一边点烟一边冲旁边的人炫耀：

“瞅瞅，这我驯得不错吧！”

“这小玩意儿真不错。”

话音刚落下，场地里的虎皮鹦鹉就累得不行，直接翻了，周遭的人立马“嘘”了一声。

有个带着孩子的妈妈蹙了蹙眉，还是拉着走了，低声说了句，“造孽……”

那男人一看就蹙了眉，抬手拿小棍子就去敲，虎皮鹦鹉躲不开，身上的羽毛也很稀疏，捱了两下后，又去站那个滚轮了。

周遭的人又留下来不少。

到了最后的环节。

鹦鹉踩着滚轮走到了靠近人群的外围，伸着脑袋学舌：

“恭喜发财，红包拿来！”

“恭喜发财，红包拿来！”

……

身后有个男人拿着盒子就走过来了，有的人借口说没带钱，男人就拿出来了二维码。

五块十块的，人数一多，约莫也是有三位数的。

宋郁站在人群后面，冷眼看着这一切，包里的小鸟乖乖的，只是在把鸟头贴在布料上，在听外面的动静。

“小兄弟，也赏个脸呗？”

宋郁无动于衷。

男人立马道：“你瞅瞅，球球也辛苦一天了，它要是赚不够的话，晚上连水都没得喝嘞。”

语气是非常调侃的，这人还叼着半截烟，伸手指了指后方的鸟。

不远处有个要走的中年男人大声笑道：

“真是胡扯！吓小孩啊！”

面前的男人眼睛狭长，个子偏矮，闻言对着不远处的人大声道：

“万一我没骗呢，瞧你说的！”

宋郁从包里拿出来了钱，一张一百块的。

这男人立马喜笑颜开，连带着刚才那点微妙的恶意都消散了，“成成成，赏脸啊。”

正在他要转身收拾东西走的时候，身后的少年说话了：

“我能买了你这只鹦鹉么？”

宋郁走了过来，很平静地商量。

但男人却头也不抬地摆手，含糊不清地道：

“不卖不卖，老子好不容易驯好的。”

“五百。”

男人闻言动作顿了下，仰头看了过来，笑着道：

“你出五百？虎皮鹦鹉市场价知道吗？这东西值不了这么些钱。”

宋郁蹙眉：“所以卖么？”

“你不会心疼那鸟吧？”

男人觉得可笑，摆了摆手，“就一小畜生。”

但是宋郁坚持道：“我买。”

此时公园天色已经暗下来了，男人闻言也是觉得有意思，没再收拾东西了，只是站了起来，叉着腰吊儿郎当地道：

“我-不-卖！”

“多少钱都不出，告诉你吧，我不差钱，就乐意看别人捧场。”

“该干什么就干什么去。”

男人翻了个白眼，抬手扯了下手里的链子，尽头那里的小鹦鹉根本就没有反应过来，直接一顿滚，灰头土脸的。

宋郁面色愈发地冷了，没有要让开的意思，只是道：

“一千。”

男人愣住了，但还是皱眉：“说了不卖，我驯鸟也是有时间成本的。”

“两千。”

男人手里的动作停了，不可置信地看了过来，眯了眯眼，道：

“不卖。”

“五千。”

男人心脏都有点加速了，但他还是迟疑地道：

“我还是不卖，我看你能加到哪里去。”

宋郁很平静地看过去，“六千。”

男人这次真是吞了口口水，真不少了，他再驯一只也不是不行，但是他又觉得对面这小孩可以再出高价，眯了眯眼，迟疑道：

“不卖……”

宋郁转头就打算走了。

不过就在这时，这男人急了，上去就拦住了，开始道：

“六千成成成，别走啊。”

宋郁转而看了过来，很平和地告知：

“这个价我不买。”

男人真是觉得后悔，他试着问：

“那……那五千也行。”

“不买。”

形势颠倒。

男人服了，他又不想错过这个机会，伸了伸手指，比了个数：

“四千，四千行吧？”

宋郁很平静地看向地上的虎皮鹦鹉，面无表情地道：

“我不太懂行情，但你不说了么，它不值这个价。”

“你养得羽毛也不好，眼神看着也呆……”

这男人此刻是真急了，弯腰拿着那鹦鹉起来了，很认真地反驳：

“我这日夜不停地驯的，它聪明得很好不好？小孩，你要是真有钱就付过来，别整这一套一套的。”

宋郁抬眸看了过去，平静地道：

“两千。”

价格其实相当高了，那男人也是见好就收了，把拴着鹦鹉的脚链递了过去，然后一脸不耐烦地扯自己脖子上的收款码。

“我给现金。”

男人其实有点愣，谁出门带一堆现金，但他还真看到了少年从包里拿出一沓人民币，数了二十张。

宋郁递过去的时候神色淡淡的，看着对面的人用车钥匙的蓝光灯照纸钞真假，问了句：

“我能走了么？”

男人一边叼着根新烟看钱，一边朝外摆了摆手，还喃喃了几句：

“真有实力……”

-

南心公园里照样还是热热闹闹的，这会儿甚至有唱戏的班子过来了，吹拉弹唱的，也围起来了人。

男人刚赚了不少钱，心里正是飘着的时候，围着看了过去，腰包里放着一沓钱。

天黑了，公园的灯老旧，照明范围也不大，因而谁也没有注意到后面有一只走地鸡悄悄靠近。

“哎唱得真不错啊。”

“你别说，就是！”

……

鸟左右环顾，有点紧张，但又很兴奋的感觉，小心地飞了起来，爪子扣住那个腰包，在嘈杂的弹唱中把拉链给弄开了。

全是成卷的钞票，男人还用皮筋绑了下。

白粼粼：好！

鸟叼着钱就出来了，沉甸甸的，鸟一顿飞。

宋郁其实很担心，在不远处一直看着半空中，虽然是妖怪不错，可他的小鸟目前只会变大用翅膀扇人而已。

还是很弱小的。

但是看了好一会，人也没看到鸟飞回来的迹象，本来都要着急了，直到在路灯下看到一个伸着翅膀狂走的“小鸡”。

左右摇摆，一顿冲刺。

叼着一沓人民币。

宋郁立马俯身蹲下，刚伸过去手，鸟就啪嗒啪嗒走了上来，一路攀爬至肩头。

“啾！”

挺胸抬头。

宋郁正好接过那一沓钱，低头看了下，除了那两千块，还有好多五块十块的……

“……”

还有意外收获。
chunks.englishText:
A budgerigar was running on a wheel, a small lead weight clamped in its beak. It swayed unsteadily, its head dipping low several times, only to be forced back up by sheer effort.

"Good! Good!"

"How impressive!"

The surrounding crowd consisted mostly of middle-aged men looking for a bit of entertainment. A few noticed the teenager standing behind them and couldn't help but glance at the blue-feathered parrot perched on his shoulder.

"Hey, this one also—"

Song Yu looked over, his expression icy and devoid of emotion.

The man immediately turned his head away, awkwardly rubbing his hands together.

Given the crowded and chaotic nature of the place, Song Yu unzipped his crossbody bag. The bird inside was well-behaved and immediately hopped back in.

*Snuggling with the RMB.*

The parrot performance continued. The man in charge, dressed in disheveled clothes, held a small stick in one hand while lighting a cigarette with the other, boasting to those nearby:

"Look at that, I trained this little guy well, didn't I?"

"This little thing is really something."

No sooner had the words left his mouth than the budgerigar in the arena collapsed from exhaustion. The crowd immediately let out a chorus of "boos."

A mother holding a child frowned, pulled her child away, and muttered under her breath, "What a sin..."

The man’s expression darkened. He raised his small stick and struck the bird. The budgerigar, its feathers sparse and ragged, couldn't dodge in time. After taking two hits, it scrambled back onto the wheel.

Many of the onlookers stayed behind.

The final segment arrived.

The parrot pedaled the wheel to the edge of the crowd, stretching its neck to mimic human speech:

"Wishing you prosperity, bring on the red envelope!"

"Wishing you prosperity, bring on the red envelope!"

...

A man behind the performer walked over with a box. When some people made excuses about not having cash, the man promptly produced a QR code.

Five yuan, ten yuan—as the crowd grew, the total was likely reaching triple digits.

Song Yu stood behind the crowd, watching it all with cold eyes. The little bird in his bag was quiet, pressing its head against the fabric to listen to the commotion outside.

"Little brother, care to show some appreciation?"

Song Yu remained unmoved.

The man immediately added, "Look, Qiuqiu has been working hard all day. If it doesn't earn enough, it won't even have water to drink tonight."

His tone was mocking, and as he spoke, he gestured toward the bird behind him with the half-smoked cigarette dangling from his lips.

A middle-aged man nearby who was about to leave laughed out loud:

"What a load of nonsense! Trying to scare the kid!"

The man in front, who had narrow eyes and a short stature, shouted back at the person nearby:

"What if I'm not lying? Look at you!"

Song Yu took a hundred-yuan bill from his bag.

The man’s face instantly lit up, and the subtle malice from moments ago vanished. "Alright, alright, thanks for the support."

Just as he was about to turn around to pack up his things, the teenager behind him spoke:

"Can I buy this parrot from you?"

Song Yu walked over, his tone calm and businesslike.

The man didn't even look up as he waved his hand, mumbling:

"Not for sale, not for sale. I worked hard to train this one."

"Five hundred."

The man’s movements paused. He looked up, laughing:

"You're offering five hundred? Do you know the market price for a budgerigar? This thing isn't worth that much."

Song Yu frowned: "So, are you selling?"

"You aren't feeling sorry for the bird, are you?"

The man found it ridiculous and waved his hand dismissively. "It’s just a little beast."

But Song Yu insisted: "I'm buying."

By now, the park had grown dark. The man found the situation amusing and stopped packing, standing up with his hands on his hips, acting like a rogue:

"I-am-not-selling!"

"No matter how much you offer, I’m not selling. Let me tell you, I’m not short on cash; I just enjoy watching people cheer for me."

"Go do whatever you were doing."

The man rolled his eyes and yanked the chain in his hand. The little parrot at the end of it hadn't reacted in time and tumbled over, landing face-first in the dirt.

Song Yu’s expression grew colder. He didn't move aside, simply stating:

"One thousand."

The man froze, but still frowned: "I said not for sale. There’s a time cost to training birds, you know."

"Two thousand."

The man’s hands stopped. He looked over in disbelief, squinting his eyes:

"Not for sale."

"Five thousand."

The man’s heart began to race, but he still hesitated:

"I’m still not selling. Let’s see how high you can go."

Song Yu looked at him calmly. "Six thousand."

This time, the man actually swallowed hard. That was a significant amount; he could train another one if he had to. But he felt this kid might pay even more, so he squinted and hesitated:

"Not selling..."

Song Yu turned to leave.

At that moment, the man panicked. He rushed over to block his path:

"Six thousand, fine, fine! Don't go."

Song Yu turned back and informed him calmly:

"I’m not buying at that price anymore."

The man truly regretted it. He tried to ask:

"Then... five thousand is fine too."

"Not buying."

The tables had turned.

The man was defeated. Not wanting to miss the opportunity, he held up his fingers to signal a number:

"Four thousand, how about four thousand?"

Song Yu looked calmly at the budgerigar on the ground and said expressionlessly:

"I don't know much about the market, but didn't you say it wasn't worth that much?"

"And you haven't kept its feathers in good condition, and its eyes look dull..."

The man was truly anxious now. He bent down to pick up the parrot and argued earnestly:

"I trained it day and night! It’s very smart, alright? Kid, if you really have the money, just pay up. Don't play these games."

Song Yu raised his eyes and said calmly:

"Two thousand."

The price was actually quite high, and the man decided to quit while he was ahead. He handed over the chain attached to the bird and then impatiently ripped the QR code off his neck.

"I'll pay in cash."

The man was a bit stunned—who carries a stack of cash around? But he watched as the teenager pulled a thick wad of RMB from his bag and counted out twenty bills.

Song Yu’s expression was indifferent as he handed the money over. He watched the man use the blue light of his car key to check the authenticity of the bills and asked:

"Can I go now?"

The man, biting on a new cigarette while counting the money, waved his hand toward the exit, muttering:

"Truly got some real power..."

-

Nanxin Park remained lively. A troupe had even arrived to perform, with people gathering around the singing and music.

The man, having just made a good sum of money, felt like he was walking on air. He stood in the crowd, his waist bag stuffed with the wad of cash.

It was dark, and the park’s old lights didn't provide much illumination. Thus, no one noticed a "walking chicken" quietly approaching from behind.

"Wow, that singing is really good."

"You're telling me! It really is!"

...

The bird looked left and right, feeling nervous but also incredibly excited. It carefully took flight, its claws hooking onto the waist bag, and amidst the noisy music, it managed to unzip the zipper.

It was full of rolled-up banknotes, which the man had secured with a rubber band.

Bai Linlin: *Good!*

The bird snatched the money and flew off. It was heavy, and the bird struggled to stay airborne.

Song Yu was actually quite worried, watching the sky from not far away. Although the bird was a *yaoguai*, his little bird could currently only grow larger and flap its wings at people.

It was still very weak.

But after waiting for a while, he didn't see the bird returning. Just as he was about to get anxious, he saw a "little chicken" walking frantically under a streetlamp, wings outstretched.

It swayed from side to side, sprinting in bursts.

It was carrying a wad of RMB in its beak.

Song Yu immediately bent down. As soon as he reached out his hand, the bird waddled over and climbed up to his shoulder.

"Chirp!"

It puffed out its chest and held its head high.

Song Yu took the wad of money, looked down, and saw that besides the two thousand yuan, there were also many five and ten-yuan bills...

"..."

*An unexpected bonus.*

chunks.chineseText:
夜色朦胧，一人一鸟在相互贴着，边走边说话：

“啾啾啾！”

[快夸我！]

“粼粼真棒。”

“那是！”

-

最后回到家里已经是晚上八点半了，路上还去了趟黎笙的医院，稍微检查下那只虎皮鹦鹉，好在是一切没事。

这才提着笼子回了家。

鸟很大方，让球球去他的房间，里面有非常豪华的爬杆和秋千。

宋郁在门口俯身蹲下，把手机屏幕对着自家小鸟，温声道：

“烧烤没有吃成，再点一次，嗯？”

白粼粼非常满意！

就说选择大于努力！

人根本就不用调。

鸟在门口伸着爪子一顿操作，给自己点了两百块钱的，然后才去了自己房间。

……

这只虎皮鹦鹉正站在一个栖杆上，爪子在推一个挂着的编织球，一直来回推，像是刻板行为一样。

鸟扑棱翅膀飞了过去，端端正正地站在球球跟前。

球球：“……”

挡到球了欸。

“啾啾啾啾啾啾。”

[你好，我是粼粼。]

球球低着头，往旁边挪了挪，没有吭声。

“啾啾啾啾！”

[我是粼粼。]

鸟又往那边挤了挤，歪着头去再次介绍自己。

虎皮鹦鹉偏了偏头，很郁闷的样子。

把脑袋抵住了旁边的铁笼子，羽毛被弄成一捋一捋的。

“啾啾啾啾……”

[你家好大。]

白粼粼愣住了，他忘记了，不是所有小鸟都像他这么幸运。

鸟有些拘谨地在栖杆上调整了下爪子，解释了下：

“啾啾啾……”

[我是后来才遇见的我的……“人”的，最开始我也过得不好。]

球球歪头看了过来，好奇地道：

[真的？]

白粼粼：[真的，我一开始都要被贱卖了，让我配种来着的……]

鸟真诚。

鸟实在。

鸟很认真地安慰道：[所以一切都要向前看，下一站的风景或许不错呢？]

[我的人可以帮你找到个不错的主人。]

房间里响起此起彼伏的啾啾啾。

球球渐渐的也没有那么自卑了，它只是不解地问：

[不是主人吗？你为什么叫人？]

白粼粼：[……他就是我的人。]

[好吧。]

[怪怪的，我在电视剧里看到狂徒是这么喊的。]

球球直言不讳。

大约过了十多分钟，宋郁过来了，很温和地把自己的小鸟接了回来，然后看向那只小虎皮：

“这边有鸟粮，这个地方是水，你好好休息。”

球球看了看这个人，觉得确实长得好看，感叹了下：

[你的人不错。]

鸟超有面子：[是吧！]

[你不吃饭吗？]

[……我、我外面吃。]

这么一来一回的，宋郁一句也听不懂，只知道两只小鸟在叽叽喳喳。

他神色淡了下来，但还是等着，终于过了几分钟，球球自己飞去吃饭了。

人和鸟这才离开这个房间。

-

等到吃完烧烤，已经晚上十一点多了。

宋郁想了想，还是睡前洗了个澡，顺带帮鸟也洗了，这次他有经验得多。

用买的小澡盆，大概就三十多厘米，还有个迷你淋浴头，鸟立马羽毛蓬松了，在里面认真地扑棱。

像个打湿了的毛球。

不过就在人去拿恒温箱的时候，鸟又出去了。

白粼粼抽空去看了下球球，鸟头从门缝里挤开，观察了下，那只虎皮鹦鹉正在站着睡觉。

鸟安心了。

宋郁看到的就是鸟圆滚滚的后半身，长长的尾羽，爪子都还有着潮气，在地板上打了个滑.

“……”

白粼粼正在专心致志地拔出来自己的鸟头，但还没怎么用力就腾空了，反应过来的时候已经被毛巾包住了。

“回去睡觉。”

卧室——

白粼粼的纸巾盒已经殉了。

接下来面临一个问题，睡哪里？

鸟看了看小小的椰子壳，又看了看人宽阔的大床。

鸟的心中自有判断。

于是就在宋郁擦完头发转身的时候，看到了床上仰躺着的某只。

两个爪子朝天，鸟眼已闭上。

好似睡着了。

“……”

宋郁只能撑着手臂过去，很温和地道：

“不行，你现在太小了，我会压到你的。”

白粼粼充耳不闻，侧了身子，继续闭眼。

像个甜筒躺在枕头上。

宋郁没有办法，抬手就握住了鸟，刚想拿起来就察觉到掌心有爪子滑动的触感，鸟非常用力地在蹬，最终一个弹射——

像小炮弹一样摔在了软软的枕头上。

鸟一定要睡床！

白粼粼一个弹跳，站得板板正正的，据理力争道：

“我压不死的，我是妖怪！”

“不行的话，我就去其他房间的——”

宋郁没有任何犹豫：“好。”

白粼粼没有想到人这么容易就答应了，还愣了下，不过达成目的就好了。

晚上十一点五十五。

人鸟安寝。

宋郁睡得很是安静，从头到尾都没有动过，枕头旁边是小鸡，在四仰八叉地睡着，爪子把那个小毯子早踹开了。

时间在一点一滴地流逝……

白粼粼无意识地翻身，朦朦胧胧觉得有些硌得慌，伸了伸爪子，一顿乱伸，隐约听见一声闷响。

但鸟没太在意。

翌日清晨，外面阳光正盛，万里无云。

卧室里的少年却迟迟醒不过来，像是梦魇了一样，呼吸都很困难，身体也完全动不了。

宋郁甚至以为自己又犯病了，直到一个用力挣脱，他开始大口大口地呼吸，眼前的场景也逐步从模糊变得清晰。

羽毛……全部都是羽毛。

甚至挡住了卧室的吊灯，人愣住了。

硕大的鸟头压在他的脖子，卡得正正好。

宋郁：“……”

他试图把他的小鸟先推开，但不知道是因为乱动还是怎么的。

轰隆——

床塌了。
chunks.englishText:
The night was hazy. The human and the bird snuggled together, chatting as they walked:
