"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[Hurry, praise me!]

"Linlin is truly amazing."

"That’s right!"

-

They didn't get home until 8:30 PM. On the way, they stopped at Li Sheng’s clinic to have the budgerigar checked. Fortunately, everything was fine.

Only then did they return home with the cage.

The bird was very generous, letting Qiuqiu go into his room, which featured a luxurious climbing perch and a swing.

Song Yu crouched at the door, held his phone screen up to his little bird, and said softly:

"We didn't get to eat the barbecue. Shall we order again, hmm?"

Bai Linlin was very satisfied!

*See, choosing is more important than effort!*

*No need to adjust the human at all.*

The bird tapped its claws on the screen at the door, ordered two hundred yuan worth of food for itself, and then headed to its room.

...

The budgerigar was standing on a perch, pushing a hanging woven ball back and forth—a repetitive, stereotypical behavior.

The bird flapped its wings and flew over, standing upright in front of Qiuqiu.

Qiuqiu: "..."

*You're blocking the ball.*

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp."

[Hello, I am Linlin.]

Qiuqiu lowered its head, shuffled to the side, and didn't make a sound.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[I am Linlin.]

The bird squeezed over again, tilting its head to introduce itself once more.

The budgerigar tilted its head, looking very depressed.

It pressed its head against the side of the iron cage, its feathers becoming ruffled and messy.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp..."

[Your home is so big.]

Bai Linlin froze. He had forgotten that not all little birds were as lucky as he was.

The bird adjusted its claws on the perch, feeling a bit awkward, and explained:

"Chirp, chirp, chirp..."

[I met my... "human" later on. At the very beginning, I didn't have it easy either.]

Qiuqiu tilted its head and asked curiously:

[Really?]

Bai Linlin: [Really. At first, I was almost sold off cheaply, just to be used for breeding...]

The bird was sincere.

The bird was honest.

The bird comforted it earnestly: [So you have to look forward. Maybe the scenery at the next stop will be nice?]

[My human can help you find a good owner.]

The room was filled with alternating chirps.

Qiuqiu gradually felt less inferior, though it asked in confusion:

[Isn't it an owner? Why do you call him "human"?]

Bai Linlin: [...He is *my* human.]

[Alright.]

[It's weird. I saw in a TV show that villains call them that.]

Qiuqiu was blunt.

About ten minutes later, Song Yu came over, gently picked up his little bird, and looked at the little budgerigar:

"There is bird food here, and the water is over there. Get some good rest."

Qiuqiu looked at this human and thought he did indeed look good, sighing:

[Your human is not bad.]

The bird felt super proud: [Right?!]

[Aren't you going to eat?]

[...I, I'll eat outside.]

With this back-and-forth, Song Yu couldn't understand a word; he only knew the two birds were chirping away.

His expression softened, but he waited. After a few minutes, Qiuqiu finally flew over to eat.

The human and the bird then left the room.

-

By the time they finished the barbecue, it was past 11:00 PM.

Song Yu thought for a moment and decided to take a shower before bed, helping the bird wash up as well. He was much more experienced this time.

Using the small bathtub he’d bought—about thirty centimeters wide—complete with a mini showerhead, the bird immediately puffed up its feathers and began to flap around earnestly.

It looked like a wet, fluffy ball.

However, just as the human went to get the incubator, the bird slipped out.

Bai Linlin took the opportunity to check on Qiuqiu. He squeezed his bird head through the door crack and observed that the budgerigar was standing while sleeping.

The bird felt relieved.

What Song Yu saw was the bird’s round backside and long tail feathers. Its claws were still damp, and it slipped on the floor.

"..."

Bai Linlin was concentrating on pulling his head back, but before he could use any force, he was lifted into the air. By the time he realized what was happening, he was already wrapped in a towel.

"Go back to sleep."

Bedroom—

Bai Linlin’s tissue box had already met its end.

Next came the problem: where to sleep?

The bird looked at the tiny coconut shell, then at the human’s wide, spacious bed.

The bird had its own judgment.

So, when Song Yu finished drying his hair and turned around, he saw someone lying flat on the bed.

Both claws were pointed toward the ceiling, and the bird’s eyes were closed.

It looked as if it were fast asleep.

"..."

Song Yu had to lean over, supporting himself with his arms, and said gently:

"No, you’re too small right now. I’ll crush you."

Bai Linlin ignored him, turned on his side, and kept his eyes closed.

He looked like a popsicle lying on the pillow.

Song Yu had no choice. He reached out and grasped the bird. Just as he was about to pick it up, he felt the sensation of claws sliding against his palm. The bird was kicking with all its might, and finally, with a launch—

It landed on the soft pillow like a little cannonball.

*The bird must sleep on the bed!*

Bai Linlin jumped up, stood straight as a board, and argued his case:

"You won't crush me to death, I'm a *yaoguai*!"

"If it doesn't work, I'll just go to another room—"

Song Yu didn't hesitate: "Fine."

Bai Linlin was stunned that the human had agreed so easily, but as long as he achieved his goal, it was fine.

11:55 PM.

Human and bird went to sleep.

Song Yu slept very quietly, not moving from beginning to end. Beside the pillow was the little chicken, sleeping spread-eagled, having kicked the small blanket away long ago.

Time ticked by, second by second...

Bai Linlin turned over unconsciously, feeling vaguely uncomfortable. He stretched his claws, flailing them around, and faintly heard a muffled thud.

But the bird didn't pay much attention.

The next morning, the sun was bright outside, and the sky was cloudless.

However, the teenager in the bedroom couldn't wake up. It was as if he were having a nightmare; his breathing was difficult, and he couldn't move his body at all.

Song Yu even thought his illness had flared up again, until he struggled with all his might to break free. He began to gasp for air, and the scene before him gradually shifted from blurry to clear.

Feathers... feathers everywhere.

They even blocked the bedroom’s ceiling light. He was stunned.

A massive bird head was pressing down on his neck, wedged perfectly in place.

Song Yu: "..."

He tried to push his little bird away first, but whether it was because of the movement or something else—

*Boom.*

The bed collapsed.

chunks.chineseText:
第29章

宋郁下巴微微仰着，呼吸都是张着口的，手还在保持着半举的状态。

也不知道是推还是不推。

只是面色泛红，被压得血气上涌，冷郁的眼睛都有些无措。

但或许是动静太大了，吵到了他的小鸟，胸口处的鸟头动了动，似乎是往他肩窝里又拱了拱。

“……”

宋郁想了想，不动了。

他使劲地抬了抬自己的手臂，去摸鸟的羽毛，用微不可察的语气道：

“睡吧。”

小鸟的羽毛是干燥温暖的，有种天然的谷物味道，宋郁的手在摸的同时，也不自觉地靠近……

白粼粼睡得昏天黑地，梦里像是回到了自己的出租屋，怀里还有那个从孤儿院就一直带着的小熊玩偶。

很喜欢，一直抱着。

白粼粼很久没有梦到过去了，昏黄的房间，他睡得踏实又心安，朦胧中是觉得忘了什么，只是一直在贴着自己的玩偶。

院长会不会想他呢？

还有老师，还有那些他的“弟弟妹妹”们……

鸟很依恋很依恋，拱得愈发投入，直到床的另一角也塌了。

“……”

白粼粼醒了，很震惊地挪开了自己的身躯，低头一看。

人被他压得面色都红了，还喘着气，领口都散了。

鸟做了什么？

宋郁其实还条件反射地护了下硕大的鸟头，后知后觉好像没必要，直到现在——

“你醒了？”

他刚问完这句话，身上的鸟像是突然回神了，伸着翅根就下了床，站在了墙角那里，面壁。

白粼粼是真的脸红了。

鸟愧疚，鸟不安。

宋郁撑着手臂去看不远处，微微蹙了下眉，生气了？

他起身走了过去，没再管身后的废墟，只是顺手捡起了地板上的“稳定器”，走到鸟身边，很认真地道：

“是床质量不好，用得很久了。”

“我的错。”

白粼粼觉得也是，但是爪子还是并了并，有些羞涩。

“饿不饿？”

鸟不由自主得扭了下头。

开饭了?

宋郁面色这才温和了起来，抬手过去，终于看他了。

“没事的，嗯？”

“我让人来换新的。”

白粼粼怔怔的，然后爪子挪动了下，情到深处地把鸟头靠了过去，没太注意到人打了个趔趄。

大鸟依人。

-

最后还是叫了人上门送新的床，红木家具的，不过工作人员安装的时候还有些纳闷……

上次书桌坏了。

这次床坏。

这家人这么激烈？

工作人员不由得多看了宋郁几眼，很快又打消了自己的想法，看着不像是有对象的。

养宠物根本就没这空。

不过他还是抵不住好奇，问了下，“……这是怎么弄坏的啊？”

“没有别的意思，主要是我真没见过坏得这么彻底的床，两三百斤的胖子也不至于……”

鸟：“……”

宋郁咳嗽了几声，其实也不知道怎么解释，好在这个时候手机电话来了。

他正好出门去接电话了，留下鸟在卧室里监工。

来电是阿姨，那边还有些嘈杂，似乎人来人往的。

“小宋，阿姨找到了，我一说人家就有印象，还问了问你的情况。”

“乐乐配上型了，已经转到普通病房了。”

“你要是今天有空……”

宋郁没有想到会这么快，立马回复道：“阿姨我待会就过去。”

等到十五分钟后，卧室的床已经安装好了，相当结实的那种。

宋郁送走工作人员之后就先关上了卧室门，让鸟变大上去试试。

这次的床定制得非常大，很宽，床垫也很软，鸟有些犹豫。

“会不会踩坏？”

白粼粼询问了下，但是已经伸爪子上去了，很矜贵的样子。

“不会，只是原来的那个很旧了，没有粼粼还没有机会换新。”

宋郁非常认真地说。

好在这次的床非常的结实，纹丝不动，鸟的自信心恢复了，很快又变成小号模样，飞上了人的肩头。

“我觉得质量可以的。”

“应该是真的红木。”

鸟质检员如是说。

最后才准备出门，顺带拿了鸟包去带隔壁的球球，那只小虎皮精神状态好多了。

宋郁用手机叫了个车，在十五分钟抵达了南市第一人民医院的地铁口。

那里果然站着原来的大叔，对方仍然是一副宽厚可亲的样子，抱着自己的女儿在说话，见到来人了才道：

“真的是你啊孩子。”

宋郁快步走了过来，气息还有些不稳，视线不由得看向了那个面色苍白的女孩子，约莫也就五六岁的样子。

抱着她爸爸的脖子。

有点害怕。

“我叫宋郁，之前没来得及说，阿姨她……”

大叔温和地笑了笑，“说了说了，我一开始以为客户来医院找我维修了，没想到是这么一回事。”

“鹦鹉我确实还没买，这不孩子前段时间一直在医院么……”

小女孩正贴着爸爸的脸，不太懂为什么来了个陌生人，但是就在这时她突然注意到了那个挎包。

拉链的位置鼓鼓的，像是有什么东西在动。

“对的，因为正好救了一只小鹦鹉，它现在没处可去，有些领养人也不是很好……”

“那真的挺不好意思的，毕竟我们也不是什么熟人……”

成年人在交流，鸟在蓄力一钻，很快黑色的挎包拉链处多了一颗圆滚滚的鸟头。

白粼粼四处张望，看到了小女孩，歪了下头。

“啾啾？”

宋郁低了下头，发现鸟出来后立刻抬手把鸟头按了进去，白粼粼视野一片漆黑，只能听到外面隔了一层布的声音。

“不是这只……”

最后大约是交谈了十多分钟，事情的原委才算是清楚了，大叔也明白意思了，不过他还是道：

“那这只小鸟会不会有心理问题啊？在上一人那里受了欺负。”

小虎皮在鸟包里探头探脑的，伸出喙在透明壳上叨了一下，歪头看外面的人。

“这个我……”

宋郁其实并不太清楚，他有些担心任务上的适配人是不是完全对的，毕竟这个小虎皮不是幼鸟，也有过前主人，即使是受到嫌弃也是正常的。

但此刻大叔却说：“那乐乐以后要好好照顾小鸟啊。”

鸟包放在地上，大叔正抱着女儿蹲了下来，用外套给自己孩子挡风，让她看小鸟。

“爸爸，彩色的，好看。”

白粼粼此刻在挎包里安安分分的，听到这话歪了歪鸟头，低头看自己的翅根。

蓝的也好看的！

后面的事情就很顺利了，大叔坚持要给一百块钱，推拒不得宋郁就接受了，不过顺便把提前准备的棉花娃娃礼物送出去了。

任务完成了。

历时不到两天。

一人一鸟找了个隐蔽的角落，翻出来了那个小木牌，上面的信息果然全部消失了，出现了一个红色的勾。

白粼粼虽然在这件事上没有出什么力，但还是很高兴的，用鸟头拱了一下人的下巴。

“啾啾！”

宋郁侧眸看了过来，也很温和地道：

“我们回家。”

-
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 29

Song Yu’s chin was tilted slightly upward, his mouth parted as he breathed, his hands still held in a half-raised position.

He didn't know whether to push or not.

His face was flushed, blood rushing to his head from being pinned down, and his cold, melancholic eyes held a trace of bewilderment.

Perhaps the movement had been too boisterous, disturbing his little bird; the bird’s head, nestled against his chest, shifted, seemingly burrowing deeper into the hollow of his shoulder.

“……”

Song Yu thought for a moment and stopped moving.

He strained to lift his arm, reaching up to stroke the bird’s feathers, and whispered in a voice barely audible:

“Go to sleep.”

The little bird’s feathers were dry and warm, carrying a natural, earthy scent of grain. As Song Yu stroked them, he found himself unconsciously leaning closer…

Bai Linlin was sleeping soundly, lost in a deep slumber. In his dream, it felt as if he had returned to his old rental apartment, clutching the little teddy bear he had carried with him since the orphanage.

He loved it dearly and had always held it close.

It had been a long time since Bai Linlin had dreamt of the past. In that dim, yellow-lit room, he slept soundly and peacefully. In his hazy state, he felt as if he had forgotten something, yet he kept pressing against his toy.

Would the orphanage director miss him?

And his teachers, and all those “younger brothers and sisters” of his…

The bird was incredibly attached, burrowing even more enthusiastically, until the other corner of the bed collapsed with a groan.

“……”

Bai Linlin woke up, shocked, and shifted his body away. He looked down.

The human beneath him was flushed red, gasping for air, his collar disheveled.

What had the bird done?

Song Yu had actually reflexively protected the massive bird head, though he realized belatedly that it hadn't been necessary. Until now—

“You’re awake?”

The moment he finished the sentence, the bird on top of him seemed to suddenly snap back to reality. It extended its wings, hopped off the bed, and stood in the corner, facing the wall.

Bai Linlin was truly blushing.

The bird felt guilty; the bird felt uneasy.

Song Yu propped himself up on his arms to look at the corner, frowning slightly. Was it angry?

He got up and walked over, ignoring the ruins behind him. He picked up the “stabilizer” from the floor, walked over to the bird, and said very earnestly:

“It was the bed’s quality. It was very old.”

“It’s my fault.”

Bai Linlin thought so too, but he still tucked his claws in, feeling a bit shy.

“Are you hungry?”

The bird couldn't help but turn its head.

Is it dinner time?

Song Yu’s expression softened. He raised his hand, finally meeting the bird's gaze.

“It’s alright, hmm?”

“I’ll have someone come and replace it.”

Bai Linlin was dazed, then his claws shifted, and in a moment of deep affection, he leaned his bird head against the man, not noticing that Song Yu stumbled slightly.

A giant bird leaning on a person.

-

In the end, they called someone to deliver a new bed—a mahogany one. However, the workers were quite puzzled during the installation…

Last time, the desk broke.

This time, the bed broke.

Is this family that intense?

The worker couldn't help but glance at Song Yu a few times, though he quickly dismissed the thought. He didn't look like someone who had a partner.

Raising a pet wouldn't leave time for that.

Still, curiosity got the better of him, and he asked, “…How did this break?”

“No offense, but I’ve really never seen a bed broken this thoroughly. Even a two or three-hundred-pound person wouldn't do this…”

Bird: “……”

Song Yu coughed a few times, not really knowing how to explain it. Fortunately, his phone rang at that moment.

He went out to take the call, leaving the bird in the bedroom to supervise the work.

The caller was the auntie. It was noisy on the other end, as if there were people coming and going.

“Little Song, I found them. As soon as I mentioned it, they remembered, and they even asked about your situation.”

“Lele is a match. She’s already been moved to a general ward.”

“If you have time today…”

Song Yu hadn't expected it to be so fast and immediately replied, “Auntie, I’ll be there in a bit.”

Fifteen minutes later, the new bed was installed—a very sturdy one.

After sending the workers away, Song Yu closed the bedroom door and let the bird transform to test it out.

The custom-made bed was very large and wide, and the mattress was soft. The bird hesitated.

“Will I step on it and break it?”

Bai Linlin asked, though he had already extended a claw onto it, looking quite elegant.

“No, it won't. The old one was just very worn out; I never had the chance to replace it until Linlin came along.”

Song Yu said with great sincerity.

Fortunately, this bed was extremely sturdy and didn't budge. The bird’s confidence was restored. It soon transformed back into its small form and flew onto the man’s shoulder.

“I think the quality is good.”

“It should be real mahogany.”

The bird inspector declared.

Finally, they prepared to leave, taking the bird bag to pick up Qiuqiu from next door. The little budgie’s mental state had improved significantly.

Song Yu hailed a car with his phone and arrived at the subway exit of the First People’s Hospital of Nanshi in fifteen minutes.

The uncle from before was indeed standing there, still looking kind and generous, holding his daughter and talking. When he saw them, he said:

“It really is you, kid.”

Song Yu walked over quickly, his breathing still a bit uneven. His gaze couldn't help but drift to the pale little girl, who looked about five or six years old.

She was clinging to her father’s neck.

A bit scared.

“My name is Song Yu. I didn't have time to say it before, and the auntie…”

The uncle smiled gently. “She told me. At first, I thought a customer had come to the hospital to find me for repairs; I didn't expect it to be like this.”

“I haven't bought a parrot yet, you see, the child has been in the hospital for a while…”

The little girl was pressing her face against her father’s, not quite understanding why a stranger had appeared. But just then, she noticed the messenger bag.

The zipper area was bulging, as if something was moving inside.

“Right, because I happened to rescue a little parrot. It has nowhere to go now, and some adopters aren't very…”

“I’m really sorry about that, after all, we aren't exactly close…”

As the adults talked, the bird gathered its strength to poke out. Soon, a round bird head appeared at the zipper of the black bag.

Bai Linlin looked around, saw the little girl, and tilted his head.

“Chirp chirp?”

Song Yu lowered his head, and upon seeing the bird emerge, he immediately raised his hand to push the bird head back inside. Bai Linlin’s vision went pitch black, and he could only hear the muffled sounds through the fabric.

“Not this one…”

After about ten minutes of conversation, the whole story was clear, and the uncle understood the intent. However, he still said:

“Will this little bird have psychological issues? Being bullied by its previous owner?”

The little budgie poked its head out of the bird bag, tapped the transparent shell with its beak, and tilted its head to look at the people outside.

“I’m not really sure about that…”

Song Yu was actually a bit worried about whether the match for the task was entirely correct. After all, this little budgie wasn't a fledgling and had a previous owner; even if it had been neglected, it was normal.

But at this moment, the uncle said, “Lele, you have to take good care of the little bird from now on.”

The bird bag was placed on the ground. The uncle squatted down, holding his daughter and using his coat to shield her from the wind so she could see the bird.

“Daddy, it’s colorful. Pretty.”

Bai Linlin was behaving well in the bag. Hearing this, he tilted his bird head and looked down at his wing roots.

Blue is pretty too!

The rest went very smoothly. The uncle insisted on giving him a hundred yuan, and since Song Yu couldn't refuse, he accepted it, but he also gave the cotton doll gift he had prepared in advance.

The task was complete.

It had taken less than two days.

The human and the bird found a secluded corner and pulled out the small wooden plaque. The information on it had indeed vanished, replaced by a red checkmark.

Although Bai Linlin hadn't contributed much to this, he was still very happy and nudged the man’s chin with his bird head.

“Chirp chirp!”

Song Yu looked over, his expression gentle.

“Let’s go home.”

-

chunks.chineseText:
管理局培训的时间是在周末，一般开门是午夜，要错开人类的高峰期。

宋郁一直在准备东西，毕竟它的小鸟上次只是报道，这次要去培训，或多或少是要交际的。

他想了想，还是要给其他的小妖怪带点东西，打好关系。

一楼的餐桌上摆满了吃的，剥壳的坚果、百香果味的酸奶、玉米肠、抹茶味奥利奥……

但这些都不是人带的。

是鸟坚持不懈从厨房的零食柜里叼出来的。

宋郁从楼上下来的时候就看到了满桌子的东西，他蹙了蹙眉，觉得这太重了，刚想制止，但就在这时门铃响了。

白粼粼还在桌子上用爪子清点数量，这个这个这个……应该能收七八个小弟吧？

那带的越多，岂不是小弟越多？

鸟又转了个身子，打算再去叼……

但就在刚起飞的时候，被一股神秘力量控制住了，爪子在半空中徒劳地蹬了下。

宋郁把鸟放到另一侧，顺带把外卖放到了桌上，是加麻加辣的烧烤，还额外点了生菜和葱，老板送了点小饼和酱料，很齐全了。

白粼粼站在大理石桌子上，愣了下，他给忘了，不过也没事，反正人记着的。

香气飘飘……

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走了过去，仰头悄咪咪地看了下人，很好，在看手机。

白粼粼一个趁其不备，低头就要——

被虎口卡住鸟头了。

宋郁蹙眉看了下信息，面色微冷，因为短信是宋启明发过来的。

[小郁，是爸爸亏待你了，原谅爸爸好不好。]

[你爷爷说的对，我是无能，不是个好父亲……]

后面一堆废话。

宋郁一看就知道他是喝多了，把手机给按灭了。

他的手指传来一股痒痒的触感，低头看，鸟正在爪子蹬着手指，一个劲地拔鸟头。

“……”

宋郁松开了，鸟一个用力，啪唧坐在了餐桌上，仰头看过来，神色有些拽拽的。

“不能吃这个，你不是要给朋友的么？”

白粼粼本来是想要反驳什么的，但是后面又觉得有损风度，算了，本来想偷偷啃一口的。

鸟一个弹跳站了起来，收了收翅膀，假装无事发生地走开。

不吃就不吃。

宋郁虽说是不让带这么多，但是他想了想毕竟是第一次去那里培训，也就还是拿了包，把桌上的东西装进去了。

坚果，放进去。

酸奶，放进去。

玉米肠，放进去。

卫龙辣条，放……

宋郁侧眸看了过去，发现正在不遗余力地叼新的东西塞包里。

一趟接一趟的。

“……”

白粼粼没过一会就把包塞满了，站在零食尖尖上仰头看人。

鸟眼圆圆。

僵持。

宋郁：“好吧。”

鸟大获全胜。

-

最后出门是开车去的，是请的代驾，宋郁在前段时间已经完全恢复了自由用家里资源的能力。

无非是调一辆车。

很简单的事。

“遂安区xx小区。”

司机缓缓启动了车子，不过他还是好奇地看了下车内后视镜：

一个相貌优越的少年，肩头一只肥鸟，另一侧是一大包零食，至于为什么能确定是零食，主要是因为果冻掉出来了，那只鸟还兢兢业业地往里塞……

午夜，很诡异就是说。

大约二十分钟后。

车子抵达了目的地，司机手机很快就收到了钱，比预计的多了五十，是打赏。

他不由得又问了后座：

“待会还回去吗？我下半夜还接单。”

“不了，谢谢。”

司机只好遗憾地走了。

车内只剩下人和鸟了，宋郁这才侧头嘱咐道：

“管理局的人说了，培训的话我去是不合适的，别的妖怪也不带监护人的，你自己可以吗？”

“我在门口等你。”

鸟点了点头，还挥了下翅膀。

没问题.jpg

宋郁眉眼温和了些，他本来打算下车去送一下的，但是被鸟拒绝了。

“我自己下去吧。”

“上次就被那群小妖怪说了，我才不是巨婴！”

宋郁闻言没什么反应，只是眉目冷了冷，不过还是问：

“那你能拿得动这个包么？”

“很重。”

白粼粼丝毫没有察觉到什么潜台词，只是非常灵巧地站在宋郁的手背上，催促人给自己开车门。

等到打开了。

鸟用爪子把稳定器拿了下来，立马开始变大，很轻松地就叼走了那袋子零食。

“……”

宋郁抿了抿唇，刚想要说走得慢一些，鸟已经转头了，摇摇摆摆的，像个小企鹅。

人是一直看着鸟进门之后才收了目光。

宋郁不知道怎么了，心情有些不好，不过就在这时电话来了，他低头一看直接关机了。

-

与此同时。

宋启明正在S州医院的心理科外徘徊，他这几天都状态不好，倒不是说是被老爷子打的……

主要还是心理问题。

他整个人颓废不堪，眼底乌青一片，只是低头看了看手机，还是没接。

宋启明其实本来也没抱太大指望，他儿子只会觉得他有病。

可是。

可是……

就在这时，一个护士前来提醒轮到他了，宋启明这才进了问诊室。

对面是一个金发碧眼的心理咨询师，本来还是很惬意地喝下午茶，但看到一张亚洲面孔的时候，立马坐直了。

“先生……”

心理咨询师试探地询问道：

“你遇到了什么问题？”

她脑中闪过了一系列网上说的亚洲原生家庭伤痛，已经做好充分的心理准备。

“我一直做噩梦，我睡不好。”

心理咨询师放松警惕，噢，那还好。

但下一秒。

“我的梦里总有一只身高将近两米的巨鸟，它总是日夜不停地追我，用翅膀扇我……”

心理咨询师：“……”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 29 (Part 2)

The Administration’s training sessions were held on weekends, usually starting at midnight to avoid the peak hours of human activity.

Song Yu had been preparing things. After all, his little bird had only reported in last time; this time it was going for training, and it would need to socialize to some extent.

He thought about it—he should bring some things for the other little monsters to build good relationships.

The dining table on the first floor was covered in food: shelled nuts, passion fruit-flavored yogurt, corn sausages, matcha-flavored Oreos…

But these weren't brought by a human.

They were things the bird had persistently fished out of the kitchen snack cabinet.

When Song Yu came down from upstairs, he saw the table full of items. He frowned, feeling it was too much. Just as he was about to stop it, the doorbell rang.

Bai Linlin was still on the table, counting the quantity with his claws. This, this, and this… he should be able to recruit seven or eight underlings, right?

The more he brought, wouldn't that mean more underlings?

The bird turned around, intending to go fetch more…

But just as he took flight, he was controlled by a mysterious force, his claws kicking uselessly in mid-air.

Song Yu placed the bird on the other side and set the takeout on the table. It was barbecue with extra spice and numbing peppercorns, with added lettuce and green onions. The owner had also included some small pancakes and sauces—it was quite complete.

Bai Linlin stood on the marble table, stunned. He had forgotten, but it was fine; the human remembered anyway.

The aroma drifted…

The bird pattered over, tilted its head, and secretly peeked at the human. Good, he was looking at his phone.

Bai Linlin, catching him off guard, lowered his head and was about to—

His bird head was caught by the webbing between the man's thumb and index finger.

Song Yu frowned as he looked at a message; his expression turned cold because the text was from Song Qiming.

[Little Yu, it’s Dad who failed you. Please forgive Dad.]

[Your grandfather was right, I am incompetent, not a good father…]

A bunch of nonsense followed.

Song Yu knew at a glance that he was drunk, so he turned off the phone.

He felt a ticklish sensation on his fingers. Looking down, he saw the bird kicking its claws against his finger, trying its best to pull its head free.

“……”

Song Yu let go. With a burst of effort, the bird plopped onto the dining table, looked up, and acted quite smug.

“You can’t eat this. Didn't you say this was for your friends?”

Bai Linlin originally wanted to retort, but then felt it might damage his dignity. Forget it, he had just wanted to sneak a bite.

The bird stood up with a bounce, tucked its wings, and walked away, pretending nothing had happened.

If I can't eat it, I won't.

Although Song Yu said he couldn't bring so much, he thought about how it was the bird’s first time at the training, so he grabbed a bag and packed the items from the table.

Nuts, in.

Yogurt, in.

Corn sausages, in.

Weilong spicy strips, in…

Song Yu glanced over and found the bird was sparing no effort to fish out new things and stuff them into the bag.

Trip after trip.

“……”

Before long, Bai Linlin had filled the bag and stood on top of the snack pile, looking up at the human.

Round bird eyes.

A standoff.

Song Yu: “Fine.”

The bird won a complete victory.

-

They ended up driving there, having hired a designated driver. Song Yu had fully regained his ability to use family resources some time ago.

Calling for a car was nothing more than a simple matter.

“Sui’an District, XX Residential Complex.”

The driver started the car slowly, but he couldn't help but peek into the rearview mirror:

A handsome youth with an excellent appearance, a fat bird on his shoulder, and a large bag of snacks on the other side. As for how he knew they were snacks, it was mainly because a jelly had fallen out, and the bird was diligently stuffing it back in…

Midnight. It was quite eerie, to say the least.

About twenty minutes later, the car arrived at the destination. The driver received the payment on his phone quickly, with an extra fifty as a tip.

He couldn't help but ask the backseat:

“Are you going back later? I’m still taking orders for the second half of the night.”

“No, thank you.”

The driver had to leave with regret.

Only the human and the bird remained in the car. Song Yu turned his head to instruct:

“The Administration people said it’s not appropriate for me to go to the training, and other monsters don't bring guardians either. Can you do it yourself?”

“I’ll wait for you at the entrance.”

The bird nodded and waved a wing.

No problem.jpg

Song Yu’s expression softened. He had intended to get out of the car to see the bird off, but the bird had refused.

“I’ll go down myself.”

“That group of little monsters talked about me last time. I’m not a giant baby!”

Song Yu didn't react much to this, his expression merely turning cold, but he still asked:

“Can you carry this bag?”

“It’s very heavy.”

Bai Linlin didn't notice any subtext at all. He simply stood nimbly on the back of Song Yu’s hand, urging him to open the car door.

Once it was opened, the bird used its claws to take off the stabilizer, immediately transformed into its larger form, and easily picked up the bag of snacks.

“……”

Song Yu pursed his lips. Just as he was about to say to walk slowly, the bird had already turned around, waddling like a little penguin.

The man kept his gaze fixed on the bird until it disappeared inside.

Song Yu didn't know what was wrong, but he felt a bit down. Just then, his phone rang. He looked down and turned it off immediately.

-

At the same time, Song Qiming was pacing outside the psychology department of an S-State hospital. He hadn't been in a good state for the past few days—not because he had been beaten by the old man…

It was mainly a psychological issue.

He looked completely decadent, with dark circles under his eyes. He glanced at his phone but didn't answer.

Song Qiming hadn't held much hope anyway; his son would only think he was crazy.

But.

But…

Just then, a nurse reminded him that it was his turn. Song Qiming entered the consultation room.

Opposite him sat a blonde, blue-eyed psychologist who had been enjoying her afternoon tea, but she sat up straight the moment she saw an Asian face.

“Sir…”

The psychologist asked tentatively:

“What kind of problems have you encountered?”

A series of online discussions about Asian family trauma flashed through her mind, and she was fully prepared.

“I keep having nightmares. I can’t sleep well.”

The psychologist relaxed her guard. Oh, that’s fine.

But the next second.

“In my dreams, there is always a giant bird nearly two meters tall. It chases me day and night, flapping its wings at me…”

Psychologist: “……”

chunks.chineseText:
第30章

午夜安静，车门外偶尔有蝉鸣的声音，宋郁只是在看着那个围墙处，他还是有些担心。

与此同时大厅里。

鸟叼着一大包东西摇摇晃晃地进来了，很是骄傲。

正在休闲区打牌的花枝鼠回头看了过来；做美甲的三花猫听到动静也抬了抬眼；至于那群在游泳池里的柯尔鸭则是已经聚成一堆开始讨论了。

原因无他，那一大袋子零食实在太扎眼了。

一看就很贵。

它怎么买得起的？

白粼粼走到了鸟类活动区域，这个地方有几个圆桌沙发，还靠近那个灰色任务大屏，此时那边正站着几个“人”.

其中一个就是黑衣少年，它听到动静之后立马回头，此刻鸟正刚把袋子放到桌上，悠闲地伸了伸翅根。

“它是新来的？”

“怎么这么大只？”

“001，你认识吗？”

周遭的一些专门做灰色任务的妖怪侧头询问旁边的黑衣少年，全然是仰仗的态度。

但是下一秒——

黑衣少年立马化成一个小雀，飞到了那只“新来的”面前，站在那个零食袋子上，眼睛亮亮的。

“你给我带串串了？”

白粼粼这个时候也觉得自己有点大，于是带上稳定器了，也成了一只小鸟，扑棱翅膀也飞到了零食袋子上。

两个小鸟挤在一起。

“那当然。”

001非常感动，刚要低头伸爪子拆开袋子，此刻耳边传来一句：

“应该叫我什么？”

鸟收了收翅膀，侧头倾听。

“老大。”

001很自然地就说出来了。

此刻灰色大屏那里的几个“人”震惊了，立马也化成了各色各样的小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒一顿狂冲。

扑棱翅膀站在那个桌子上，仰头看着袋子上那新来的和它们的001。

“001，你怎么能叫它老大？”

“它是个新来的而已。”

“你才是我们的——”

咣当。

桌上掉下来个果冻，为首的那只小雀低头一看，蓝莓味道的。

没过一会，又掉下来个果冻，另外一只小雀啪嗒啪嗒走上前去，爪子拿住，和另外一个交流道：

“我的橙子味的。”

最后的那只鸟有点着急，它还没有，抬头看上去，001已经捞出来一个肉串在炫了，爪子按住签子，鸟头往外一撇，撕肉的动作流畅又利落，全然没关心外界。

而它的旁边，正是那只新来的鸟，意气风发，居高临下，爪子里拿着新的一个果冻。

“……我也要。”

白粼粼居高临下，挺胸抬头的，又伸爪子给了一个果冻。

那只小雀立马接了过来开始讨论：“我的是草莓味的。”

大厅里的妖怪或多或少地都看到了鸟类活动区域的情况，看到那只新来的在分发零食顿时坐不住了。

免费的吗？

一队小鼠过来了，三只柯尔鸭也排队凑热闹了，原来做瑜伽的豹纹守宫也爬去了鸟界活动区域里，不过它看到上面那只正在吃串的小鸟后还是稍稍往后挪了下位置。

伯劳鸟的食谱里有蜥蜴。

001可太残忍了。

白粼粼站在高位，爪子踩在薯片袋子上还有些滑，不过他还是很自信，在清点……

一个两个三个。

管理局的小妖怪全部都收了！

桌上的那几只小雀正在品鉴果冻，完全没有抵抗之意了，只是看了看001正在炫的东西。

灰棕色小鸟正在吃大腰子。

专心ing。

几个小雀也排排在桌子上站好了，仰头看了过去。

……

宋郁在车内看了看手机的时间，凌晨两点四十五，他的小鸟进去有十五分钟了。

不知道它现在怎么样。

……

“要零食很简单的，你们要叫我老大！”

鸟在零食堆上站着，爪子站着一个棒棒糖，对下方五花八门的小妖怪说道。

底下有隐约的质疑声：

“叫老大那岂不是要听它了？”

“可是那看起来很好吃啊……”

“001都当小弟了。”

此话一出，众妖怪一下子有了理论依据，立马都往前挤去，响起来此起彼伏的“老大”声。

……

宋郁觉得时间过得很慢，他坐在车内也没有要睡觉的打算，车窗始终是半开着的，看着不远处的角落。

津贴领了他的小鸟妖力会上升吗？

F级的话……那上面还有五个等级，会不会有妖怪欺负它。

宋郁越想越担心，甚至不自觉地在手机上检索了起来，很快的他的主页面就变成了：

[孩子第一次去幼儿园哭了怎么办？]

[高年级孩子欺负你家孩子这样做！]

[家长，才是孩子最坚强的后盾！]

……

白粼粼后面发起来就有点费劲了，妖怪太多了，他粗略地观察了下，一百多个了。

鸟开始打开脱壳坚果，一妖一个；奥利奥拆开，一妖一块；巧乐兹拆开，一妖一根。

001已经吃完了所有的串串，整只鸟都懵懵的，喙还上还沾着酱料。

它隐约觉得自己踮脚的袋子正在一点点变低，旁边的那只蓝羽小鸟还在分发东西，非常热心肠的样子，用喙叼住包装袋，一个用力甩。

那是旺仔牛奶糖，在光洁的地板上散落开来，像撒玉米粒一样。

001刚想问为什么要免费分发，下一秒——

“老大给你们福利你们是不是应该感谢老大！”

底下齐声声地道：

“是！”

鸟收了收翅膀，微微侧身，非常矜持地道：

“那这样，我每周都给大家带零食，那作为交换，大家……”

底下的一群小妖怪有些紧张，有几个还忍不住窃窃私语讨论道：

“不会让我们付钱吧？”

“我没有钱。”

“我也不多，做任务兑换的比较少……”

白粼粼咳嗽了两下，很正经地道：

“妖力津贴。”

“只需要给老大这个，老大就能每周来带好吃的，是不是很划算？”

众小妖怪顿时一阵喧哗，那是最没用的东西了，它们在城市里住压根用不到什么妖力，做任务就是兑人类货币当零花的。

不用钱就可以吃零食！

一众妖怪挤了过来。

001刚刚吃了好几张小饼，此刻有点晕碳，底下的妖怪把桌子挤得晃了起来它才反应了过来。

爪子抠紧了点桌面。

“快去收，顺带去记一下都有谁。”

旁边的那只鸟……不，是老大，对它这么说道。

001想了想，扑棱翅膀往前站了站，用喙去叼那一个个的“信封”，放在桌面上，然后用爪子稳稳地踩住。

妖力津贴。

以信封的形式发放，拆开即用，不拆即可自行留存。

“叫什么名字？”

“土豆。”

001挥了挥翅膀，示意下一个。

“叫什么名字？”

“李建国。”

001：“……”

没过一会鸟界的活动区域这里就成了一条流水线，桌子上的妖力津贴越来越厚，最后足足有一沓。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 30

The midnight air was quiet, with the occasional sound of cicadas outside the car window. Song Yu just kept watching the wall, still feeling a bit worried.

Meanwhile, in the lobby.

The bird waddled in, carrying a large bag of things, looking very proud.

A fancy mouse playing cards in the leisure area turned to look; a calico cat getting a manicure lifted its eyes at the commotion; as for the group of Call ducks in the swimming pool, they had already gathered in a pile to discuss.

The reason was simple: that large bag of snacks was too eye-catching.

It looked expensive at a glance.

How could it afford that?

Bai Linlin walked to the bird activity area. This place had several round tables and sofas and was close to the gray task screen. At that moment, several “people” were standing there.

One of them was a black-clad youth. Upon hearing the commotion, he turned around immediately. The bird had just placed the bag on the table and was leisurely stretching its wing roots.

“Is that a newcomer?”

“Why is it so big?”

“001, do you know it?”

Some monsters specializing in gray tasks turned to ask the black-clad youth beside them, their attitude one of complete deference.

But the next second—

The black-clad youth immediately transformed into a small sparrow and flew to the “newcomer,” standing on the snack bag with bright eyes.

“Did you bring me skewers?”

Bai Linlin also felt he was a bit too big, so he put on his stabilizer and transformed into a small bird, flapping his wings to land on the snack bag as well.

The two little birds huddled together.

“Of course.”

001 was very moved and was just about to lower its head and extend its claws to open the bag when a voice reached its ears:

“What should you call me?”

The bird tucked its wings and tilted its head to listen.

“Boss.”

001 said it very naturally.

At this moment, the several “people” by the gray screen were shocked and immediately transformed into various small birds, rushing over with a flurry of flapping wings.

They landed on the table, looking up at the newcomer and their 001 on the bag.

“001, how can you call it Boss?”

“It’s just a newcomer.”

“You are our—”

Clatter.

A jelly fell off the table. The leading sparrow looked down—blueberry flavor.

Not long after, another jelly fell. Another sparrow pattered over, grabbed it with its claws, and communicated with the other:

“Mine is orange flavor.”

The last bird was a bit anxious; it didn't have one yet. It looked up, and 001 was already pulling out a meat skewer to feast on. It held the skewer down with its claws, tilted its head, and tore the meat off smoothly and cleanly, completely unconcerned with the outside world.

And beside it was the newcomer, high-spirited, looking down from above, holding a new jelly in its claws.

“…I want one too.”

Bai Linlin looked down from his high position, chest puffed out, and extended a claw to give another jelly.

The sparrow immediately took it and began discussing: “Mine is strawberry flavor.”

The monsters in the lobby had more or less seen the situation in the bird activity area. Seeing the newcomer distributing snacks, they couldn't sit still.

Is it free?

A team of mice came over, three Call ducks lined up to join the fun, and the leopard gecko that had been doing yoga also crawled into the bird activity area. However, seeing the little bird eating skewers above, it shifted its position back slightly.

Shrikes had lizards on their menu.

001 was just too cruel.

Bai Linlin stood in a high position, his claws slipping a bit on the potato chip bag, but he was still very confident, counting…

One, two, three.

All the little monsters of the Administration were recruited!

The sparrows on the table were tasting their jellies, having lost all resistance, only looking at what 001 was devouring.

The gray-brown bird was eating a large kidney skewer.

Concentrating.

The sparrows also lined up on the table, looking up.

…

Song Yu checked the time on his phone in the car: 2:45 AM. His little bird had been inside for fifteen minutes.

He wondered how it was doing.

…

“Getting snacks is very simple. You just have to call me Boss!”

The bird stood on the pile of snacks, holding a lollipop in its claws, speaking to the motley crew of monsters below.

There were faint murmurs of doubt from below:

“If we call it Boss, doesn't that mean we have to listen to it?”

“But that looks so delicious…”

“Even 001 is an underling.”

Once this was said, the monsters suddenly had a theoretical basis and immediately crowded forward, with cries of “Boss” echoing one after another.

…

Song Yu felt time passing very slowly. He sat in the car with no intention of sleeping, the window kept half-open, watching the corner not far away.

Will his little bird’s monster power increase after receiving the allowance?

If it’s F-rank… there are five levels above that. Would any monsters bully it?

The more Song Yu thought, the more worried he became, and he even unconsciously searched on his phone. Soon, his main page became:

[What to do if your child cries the first time they go to kindergarten?]

[What to do if older children bully your child!]

[Parents are the child’s strongest backing!]

…

Bai Linlin found it a bit tiring later on. There were too many monsters—he observed roughly, over a hundred.

The bird started opening shelled nuts, one for each monster; Oreos were opened, one piece for each; Choc-bars were opened, one for each.

001 had finished all the skewers and was completely dazed, sauce still on its beak.

It vaguely felt that the bag it was standing on was getting lower and lower. The blue-feathered bird beside it was still distributing things, looking very warm-hearted, using its beak to grab a package and shaking it with force.

It was Wangzai milk candy, scattering across the clean floor like corn kernels.

001 just wanted to ask why it was distributing them for free, when the next second—

“If Boss gives you benefits, shouldn't you thank Boss!”

The crowd below said in unison:

“Yes!”

The bird tucked its wings, turned slightly, and said very reservedly:

“How about this, I’ll bring snacks for everyone every week, and in exchange, everyone…”

The group of little monsters below was a bit nervous. A few couldn't help but whisper:

“It won't make us pay money, right?”

“I don't have money.”

“I don't have much either; I don't get much from doing tasks…”

Bai Linlin coughed twice and said very seriously:

“Monster power allowance.”

“You only need to give this to Boss, and Boss will bring delicious food every week. Isn't that a great deal?”

The monsters erupted into a clamor. That was the most useless thing; they didn't need monster power to live in the city, and they did tasks just to earn human currency for pocket money.

They could eat snacks without spending money!

A crowd of monsters squeezed over.

001 had just eaten several small pancakes and was feeling a bit carb-loaded. It only reacted when the monsters squeezed the table until it wobbled.

It dug its claws into the tabletop.

“Go collect them, and remember to note down who gave them.”

The bird beside it… no, the Boss, said to it.

001 thought for a moment, flapped its wings to step forward, used its beak to pick up the “envelopes” one by one, placed them on the table, and then pressed down firmly with its claws.

Monster power allowance.

Issued in the form of envelopes, ready to use upon opening, or kept for later if left sealed.

“What’s your name?”

“Potato.”

001 waved its wings, signaling the next one.

“What’s your name?”

“Li Jianguo.”

001: “……”

Before long, the bird activity area had become an assembly line. The stack of monster power allowances on the table grew thicker and thicker, finally forming a full stack.

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼就在后面来回溜达，看着桌子下面排起来的长队，倍感欣慰，偶尔还对下面的小妖怪挥了挥翅膀。

很好很好。

……

宋郁在车里看鸟的照片，有它刚来的时候的照片，两脚朝天睡在纸巾盒里，怎么摇也摇不醒……

还有后面的截图，圆滚滚的鸟头怼着摄像头，像是在歪头质问。

鸟站在他肩头打盹的照片。

鸟洗澡抖毛的照片。

鸟认真摆pose的照片。

很多。

宋郁垂眸一张张地滑了过去，直到那一张红底的证件照出来。

“……”

鸟头大大的，但站得很板正，翅膀是微收的。

在看镜头。

可爱。

宋郁看了很久，甚至不自觉地打算设置成壁纸，但是就在这时电话来了，是来自S州的。

“你看……这孩子他总会接的，你一把身子骨了，就放心白天打吧。”

是陈开鹤的声音，很明显是在对病床上的人说话。

大约过了几秒，电话那头换人了。

“爷爷打扰你了没？”

宋郁眉眼都温和了许多，立马道：“怎么会？”

但是那头一听声音就蹙眉问：

“语气怎么这么精神，你在家睡觉了吗？”

宋郁：“……”

没办法，宋峥国不仅眼神好，听力也不错，当年从政也是左右逢源的一把好手，不过是现在多是用来关心家里人了。

“我……我睡不着，起来吹吹风。”

宋郁只能这么解释道，好在电话那头没有要求视频什么的，只是在温和地讲话：

“爷爷再过一个月后就回国，到时候就能见你了，在家里有没有吃好？”

“我很好的，您别担心。”

宋峥国的声音从听筒那里传来，像是笑了下，不过还是娓娓道来：

“小时候就这样，惯会骗人的。”

宋郁垂了下眼眸，手指微微蜷起来了。

“爷爷想和你商量一件事。”

宋郁闻言直接道：“您说。”

“你父亲他不中用，爷爷想尽快培养你，接手家里的产业，好不好？”

夜里凉风吹起，卷起了地上的一些落叶。

静悄悄的。

-

与此同时，管理局内。

里头已经开启了舞会，花枝鼠在平台上扭来扭去的，彩色的灯光到处闪耀，台下的妖怪在跟着节拍跳舞。

除了小型直立的动物可以穿礼服之外，那些大型的还是倾向于动物头搭配人形。

“为什么是这样子的？”

白粼粼觉得很奇怪，上次见到的杜宾就是兽头人形，为什么选择组合搭配，他开口问了问旁边的首席小弟。

001此刻已经化成了人形，坐在吧台椅子上，很专注地吸酸奶，眼睛亮亮的，头一次喝。

“是因为觉得好看，搭配起来也比较有个性。”

001喝完了才说，不过又仰头认真地去看了看酸奶盒子底部，然后砰得一下变成小鸟……伸爪子把酸奶盒放到，开始用喙去吃掉剩余的酸奶。

白粼粼不解：“那为什么鸟界……”

001此刻又换回了人形，舔了舔唇边的酸奶，然后很不明白地问：

“因为，不好看。”

白粼粼想象了下：“……”

“所以要么就是鸟，要么就是人。”

001好奇地歪头看过来，又问：“你人形长什么样子？”

“……”

鸟在吧台上站着，圆滚滚的，战术后退了下。

咳咳。

不要问一些私密的问题。

但就在这时，001像是想起来什么，很不解地问：

“你不是新注册的妖怪吗？”

“怎么不去培训。”

鸟一怔，鸟给忘了。

鸟下地开始狂奔冲向“教室”。

001又砰得变回了小鸟，钻到了酸奶盒子里，顶着来回走，爪子还打了下滑。

-

车内。

“爷爷我其实没有考虑过……”

宋郁垂着头，他之前根本没有什么活下来的意愿，无非是宋启明斥责他会影响公司的舆论。

华秉，是爷爷一手创建的。

他不能毁了。

志愿的选择也只是为了他的小鸟，他目前的唯一动力也只是这个。

宋郁突然觉得很消沉，侧头看了看外面，空荡荡的街道，没有人。

“小郁不要这么急着拒绝爷爷，你过得不开心，我知道，但是不能困在过去里，你父母是兰因絮果……”

“他们的纠缠不应该到你身上去，做错的人会受到惩罚的。”

宋郁垂眸听着，其实心境已经很平稳了，从那场荒诞的升学宴之后就已经不报任何期待了。

夜色微凉。

“小郁没有想过以后吗？你的伴侣呢？爷爷要是活得久些，或许还能看见你成家，你如果碰见了在乎的人，是不是要给人家提供优渥的条件？”

宋郁回了回神，他没有在乎的人，但是他有在乎的……鸟。

那边还在继续：

“小郁，你长大了，做人做事不能停留在口头。你要是遇见了在乎的人，那是要真金白银打动人的，不要听网上那些毒鸡汤，你奶奶一个歌唱家，年轻的时候就喜欢我给她买金镯子……这就要求你得有能力……”

宋郁懵了下，脑海里全是那只戴着小金锁的小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒在桌子上走秀。

对了……它还喜欢库里南。

“华秉是一个重担子，但是它也是爷爷留给你的一笔财富，或者说是再生财产的钥匙……”

宋峥国其实还在劝，他一方面是觉得心血不能就这么断了，另一方面其实也是想给自己孙子一个持续的动力。

这孩子从小心思沉。

无欲无求，不是个好兆头。

但就在老爷子以为还要劝很久的时候——

电话那头传来一句：

“好。”

没有任何犹豫。

-

而此时管理局内：

白粼粼一路伸着翅膀狂奔，爪子都要磨出火星子了，好在是没有迟到。

教室是仿照人类的设计，有桌子椅子，蛇是自己爬到椅子上盘着的，兔子是蓄力跳上去的。

至于鸟……

鸟在原地蹦了好几下，发现上不去，刚要控诉这是赤裸裸的歧视，旁边的小蛇就吐了吐信子道：

“你好像有翅膀。”

“……”

总之鸟终于顺利地站到了椅子上，很心虚地梳理了下自己的羽毛，不过这个时候门口有了动静。

丹顶鹤照旧是系着一条丝巾，拿着本本上来了。

“体型较小者上桌就好。”

白粼粼：“……”

整个教室五花八门的妖怪都在看他，鸟没办法，只好扑棱翅膀站在了课桌上。

一开始是点了下名。

后面就开始正式的培训了，白粼粼实在是没有想到，还有PPT一样的东西，不过虽然是不插电的那种。

“我们毕竟是生活在城市里的妖怪，所以培训的主要内容就是如何和人类和平共处。”

丹顶鹤拿出来一根教棍，在黑板上指了指，那上面幻化出来一道带图的选择题。

“好，现在为了测试下大家的水平，来看一道题目。”

白粼粼四处环顾了下，没人看他后就伸了伸鸟腿坐下了。

然后才看了下黑板：
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin wandered back and forth behind the scenes, watching the long line forming under the table. He felt a deep sense of satisfaction, occasionally flapping his wings at the little monsters below.

Very good, very good.

……

Inside the car, Song Yu was looking at photos of the bird. There were pictures from when it first arrived—sleeping on its back inside a tissue box, unable to be woken no matter how much he shook it…

There were screenshots from later on, the round bird head shoved right against the camera lens, as if tilting its head to interrogate him.

Photos of the bird napping on his shoulder.

Photos of the bird shaking its feathers after a bath.

Photos of the bird earnestly striking a pose.

There were many.

Song Yu lowered his eyes, scrolling through them one by one until he reached that one ID photo with the red background.

“……”

The bird’s head was large, but it stood very straight, its wings slightly tucked.

It was looking at the lens.

Cute.

Song Yu stared at it for a long time, even unconsciously intending to set it as his wallpaper, but just then, a call came in from S Province.

“Look… the child will always answer. You’re getting on in years, so rest assured and call during the day.”

It was Chen Kaihe’s voice, clearly speaking to someone on a hospital bed.

After a few seconds, the person on the other end changed.

“Did Grandpa disturb you?”

Song Yu’s expression softened significantly, and he immediately said, “How could you?”

But the person on the other end frowned as soon as they heard his voice:

“Why is your tone so energetic? Have you been sleeping at home?”

Song Yu: “……”

There was no helping it; Song Zheng-guo not only had sharp eyes but also keen hearing. Back in his political days, he was a master at navigating all sides, though now he mostly used those skills to care for his family.

“I… I couldn’t sleep, so I got up to catch some air.”

Song Yu could only offer this explanation. Fortunately, the person on the other end didn’t ask for a video call or anything, just spoke gently:

“Grandpa will be back in the country in another month. We’ll be able to see each other then. Have you been eating well at home?”

“I’m doing very well, please don’t worry.”

Song Zheng-guo’s voice came through the receiver, sounding as if he had chuckled, but he continued in a measured tone:

“You were the same when you were little—always good at telling lies.”

Song Yu lowered his gaze, his fingers curling slightly.

“Grandpa wants to discuss something with you.”

Hearing this, Song Yu said directly, “Please, go ahead.”

“Your father is useless. Grandpa wants to train you as soon as possible to take over the family business. How about it?”

The cool night wind picked up, swirling some fallen leaves on the ground.

It was quiet.

-

Meanwhile, inside the Management Bureau.

A dance party had already begun. A fancy mouse was twisting and turning on the platform, colorful lights flashing everywhere, and the monsters below were dancing to the beat.

Aside from small, upright animals that could wear formal attire, the larger ones still preferred a combination of animal heads with human bodies.

“Why is it like this?”

Bai Linlin found it very strange. The Doberman he saw last time was a beast-headed human; why choose that combination? He asked his chief underling next to him.

001 had transformed into human form, sitting on a bar stool, focused on slurping yogurt. His eyes were bright; it was his first time drinking it.

“Because we think it looks good, and it has more personality when combined.”

001 said this only after finishing, then tilted his head to look earnestly at the bottom of the yogurt cup before *poofing* back into a little bird. He extended a claw to tip the cup over and began using his beak to eat the remaining yogurt.

Bai Linlin was puzzled: “Then why does the bird world…”

001 changed back into human form, licked the yogurt from his lips, and asked with genuine confusion:

“Because it doesn’t look good.”

Bai Linlin imagined it: “……”

“So it’s either a bird or a human.”

001 tilted his head curiously and asked, “What do you look like in human form?”

“……”

The bird stood on the bar, round and plump, and performed a tactical retreat.

*Ahem.*

Do not ask such private questions.

But just then, 001 seemed to remember something and asked, confused:

“Aren’t you a newly registered monster?”

“Why aren’t you going to training?”

The bird froze. The bird had forgotten.

The bird hit the ground and began sprinting wildly toward the “classroom.”

001 *poofed* back into a little bird, crawled into the yogurt cup, and walked around with it on his head, his claws slipping once or twice.

-

Inside the car.

“Grandpa, I actually haven’t considered…”

Song Yu hung his head. He had no desire to survive before; it was nothing more than Song Qiming scolding him for affecting the company’s public image.

Hua Bing was a company built by his grandfather’s own hands.

He could not destroy it.

His choice of major was only for his little bird; it was his only current motivation.

Song Yu suddenly felt very depressed. He turned his head to look outside at the empty streets; there was no one there.

“Little Yu, don’t be in such a hurry to refuse Grandpa. I know you aren’t happy, but you cannot remain trapped in the past. Your parents were a case of ‘orchid cause and willow fruit’…”

“Their entanglements should not fall upon you. Those who did wrong will be punished.”

Song Yu listened with lowered eyes. In truth, his state of mind was already quite stable; he hadn’t held any expectations since that absurd graduation banquet.

The night was cool.

“Little Yu, haven’t you thought about the future? What about your partner? If Grandpa lives long enough, perhaps I can see you start a family. If you meet someone you care about, shouldn’t you be able to provide them with comfortable conditions?”

Song Yu regained his focus. He didn’t have anyone he cared about, but he did have… a bird.

The voice on the other end continued:

“Little Yu, you’ve grown up. You can’t just talk about things; you have to act. If you meet someone you care about, you have to impress them with real gold and silver. Don’t listen to those toxic platitudes online. Your grandmother was a singer, and when she was young, she loved it when I bought her gold bracelets… This requires you to have the ability…”

Song Yu was stunned for a moment. His mind was filled with the image of that little bird wearing a tiny gold lock, strutting across the table.

Right… it also liked the Cullinan.

“Hua Bing is a heavy burden, but it is also a wealth Grandpa left for you, or rather, the key to regenerating your assets…”

Song Zheng-guo was still persuading him. On one hand, he felt his life’s work couldn’t just end like this; on the other, he wanted to give his grandson a sustained motivation.

This child had been deep in thought since he was small.

Having no desires and seeking nothing was not a good sign.

But just when the old man thought he would have to persuade him for a long time—

A sentence came from the other end of the phone:

“Okay.”

Without any hesitation.

-

Meanwhile, inside the Management Bureau:

Bai Linlin was sprinting with his wings extended, his claws nearly sparking against the floor. Fortunately, he wasn’t late.

The classroom was designed to mimic human ones, with desks and chairs. The snakes crawled onto the chairs to coil up, and the rabbits gathered strength to jump up.

As for the bird…

The bird hopped in place several times, realizing he couldn’t get up. Just as he was about to complain about this blatant discrimination, the little snake next to him flicked its tongue and said:

“You seem to have wings.”

“……”

In short, the bird finally managed to stand on the chair, preening his feathers with a guilty conscience. But at that moment, there was movement at the door.

The Red-crowned Crane, wearing a silk scarf as usual, walked up with a notebook.

“Those with smaller builds may stand on the tables.”

Bai Linlin: “……”

All the various monsters in the classroom were looking at him. The bird had no choice but to flap his wings and stand on the desk.

First, there was roll call.

Then, the formal training began. Bai Linlin really hadn’t expected there to be something like a PowerPoint, though it was the non-electric kind.

“After all, we are monsters living in the city, so the main content of the training is how to coexist peacefully with humans.”

The Red-crowned Crane took out a pointer and gestured at the blackboard, where a multiple-choice question with pictures had manifested.

“Alright, to test everyone’s level, let’s look at a question.”

Bai Linlin looked around, and seeing no one watching him, he stretched his bird legs and sat down.

Only then did he look at the blackboard:

chunks.chineseText:
[请判断以下哪一个人类善良的概率高？]

A：gif.图：一个女性人类在看着手机，面色从腼腆的笑，逐步变成大笑，最后开始鹅鹅鹅。

B：gif.图：一个男性穿着正常地在街头抽烟。

白粼粼：“……”

底下的小妖怪犯了难，甚至有窃窃私语的现象，不过丹顶鹤一挥翅膀：

“可以讨论。”

鸟才不屑于讨论，这什么弱智选择题，不过他还是偷偷地听了下旁边妖怪的对话：

“A的人笑得好可怕，为什么会笑成这样……”

“人类是不是情绪稳定点是比较善良的，我看B好像稳定一些……”

白粼粼摇了摇鸟头。

丹顶鹤此刻叫停了讨论，开始问有没有人主动说答案，等了两秒就开始点名，最后挑中了那只小兔子。

“你的答案是？”

“我……我选B，他的表情没有那么大……应该稳定点。”

丹顶鹤又问其他的小妖怪：

“还有其他答案吗？”

教室里的妖怪们大多都选了B，丹顶鹤不动声色地叹了口气。

但就在这时。

白粼粼举起来了翅膀：

“我选A。”

鸟心想上学的时候装不过那些后排的“积极分子”，这次不当人一定要装一把大的。

切。

丹顶鹤看到后很是欣慰：“你选A，为什么？”

鸟咳嗽了两下，正儿八经地道：

“B里的人类在公共场所吸烟，本身就是不道德的行为，他对他的同族都造成了伤害，当然不善良。”

“反之，A里的人类只是自己在家里笑而已，她没有影响其他人，虽然面部表情没太控制好，但外向乐观不代表‘情绪不稳定’。”

教室里静悄悄的，而后丹顶鹤拍了拍手，在众妖怪的目光众肯定道：

“答案是A。”

白粼粼燃起来了。

-

而此时外面已经凌晨三点半了，宋郁还在通电话，不过倒不是说公司的事了，而是在谈江芮：

“你妈妈她嫁给你父亲的时候太早，心性还没有定下来……二十一岁就生了你。”

“她父亲江连城也不是个什么得体的人，见你爸爸是我的儿子，便使劲地撮合，你妈妈岁数小，又得了家里人支持，便真的不管不顾了。”

“倒显得我当时阻拦薄情寡义了，后面……你也知道，你父亲先负了她，她年纪小，其实根本没有要当母亲的意识，江家本来就是单亲，想来江连成也没有多看顾过这个女儿。”

宋郁只是垂眸听着，面色平静。

“孩子，我不是让你原谅你母亲，我是让你放下。”

“人是无法改变其他人的，来到这个世界上，就要接受不同，接受差异，接受有很多人……他们其实没有真正地‘成长’。”

“不要因为你妈妈而长久地困住，她先是江芮，而后才是你的母亲，你和她是两个独立的人。”

宋郁眼眸微动了下：

“我知道了。”

不过就在这时，电话那头倒是说了一件事：

“你妈妈有个孩子出事了，是原来有病的那个，眼睛被鸟啄掉了。”

宋郁面色微微变了。

“江芮估计要找你……孩子你听爷爷的……”

槐河路这里安安静静的，宋郁挂了电话才反应过来，原来爷爷这个时间找自己是这么一件事。

那个“小予”出事了？

宋郁没有任何类似“报复”的感觉，他只是觉得很恍惚，那江芮的付出……她这么些年都耗在那个孩子身上了。

或许是老爷子料事如神，在四点的时候，江芮的电话倒是真的来了。

宋郁低头看了下，接了。

“小郁你在家里睡觉吗？妈妈做了个噩梦……你没事吧？”

“你能不能和妈妈视个频？”

“妈妈这几天实在是很想你。”

……

宋郁愣了很久，扯唇笑了下，把头偏开了。

眼眶都有些泛红。

对着电话那里道：

“妈，你叫错了，我是‘郁’不是‘予’。”

电话那头似乎也愣住了。

-

而此刻管理局的“培训”课程也结束了，鸟大放异彩。

不仅活跃度第一名，而且还荣获了“班长”一职。

鸟获得了一个小挎包，妖怪的那种，有无限容量。

白粼粼出了教室就看到了一只黑白棕的小雀在压着那叠“信封”，全是妖力津贴，001在帮他守着。

鸟扑棱翅膀飞了上去，“我培训完了！”

“天快亮了，你是不是得回去了？”

小雀站了起来，用爪子一递，把那叠信封推了回去，不过它还是提醒了下：

“不过这个津贴是有身份信息的，可能给的妖力份额也不太一样，你谨慎一些用。”

白粼粼低头就叼起来那沓信封了，开始往自己的挎包里塞，也就在这时，身后突然传来一句：

“247呀。”

丹顶鹤不知道什么时候出来了，鸟吓了一跳，但好在是急急忙忙地把东西装进去了。

“我在。”

丹顶鹤很优雅地道：“表现不错。”

随后才挥了挥翅膀表示再见，吧台上的这两只也挥了挥，尽管一只淡定，一只心虚。

很快天就要蒙蒙亮了，基地这里也要关门了，很多妖怪都收拾东西准备走了，有几只还要讨论买门口的小蛋糕。

白粼粼也同自己的首席小弟再见了。

-

与此同时。

宋郁的情绪其实很消沉，在挂了电话之后只是在看车窗外面。

阴影处的确有一只只“普通”的小动物鱼贯而出，但是这些都不是——

就在此刻，角落里出来一只蹦蹦跳跳的小鸟，身上还背着一个迷你的小挎包。
chunks.englishText:
[Please judge which of the following humans has a higher probability of being kind?]

A: A GIF of a female human looking at her phone, her expression shifting from a shy smile to a loud laugh, and finally starting to make "honk-honk-honk" sounds.

B: A GIF of a male human smoking on the street, dressed normally.

Bai Linlin: “……”

The little monsters below were troubled, and there was even some whispering. However, the Red-crowned Crane waved a wing:

“You may discuss.”

The bird couldn’t be bothered to discuss; what a moronic question. But he still secretly listened to the conversation of the monsters nearby:

“The human in A laughs so scarily, why would they laugh like that…”

“Is it that humans are kinder when they are emotionally stable? B seems more stable to me…”

Bai Linlin shook his bird head.

The Red-crowned Crane called an end to the discussion and asked if anyone would volunteer the answer. After waiting two seconds, he began calling names, finally picking the little rabbit.

“What is your answer?”

“I… I choose B. His expression isn’t that loud… he should be more stable.”

The Red-crowned Crane asked the other little monsters:

“Are there any other answers?”

Most of the monsters in the classroom chose B. The Red-crowned Crane sighed inwardly, his expression unchanged.

But just then.

Bai Linlin raised his wing:

“I choose A.”

The bird thought to himself that he couldn’t out-perform those "eager beavers" in the back row when he was in school, but now that he wasn’t a human, he had to put on a big show.

*Tsk.*

The Red-crowned Crane was very pleased to see this: “You chose A. Why?”

The bird coughed twice and said in all seriousness:

“The human in B is smoking in a public place, which is an immoral act in itself. He is causing harm to his own kind, so of course, he is not kind.”

“Conversely, the human in A is just laughing in her own home. She isn’t affecting anyone else. Although her facial expressions aren’t well-controlled, being extroverted and optimistic does not mean ‘emotionally unstable’.”

The classroom was silent, and then the Red-crowned Crane clapped his hands, affirming in the eyes of all the monsters:

“The answer is A.”

Bai Linlin was fired up.

-

Meanwhile, it was already 3:30 AM outside. Song Yu was still on the phone, but not talking about company matters; he was talking about Jiang Rui:

“Your mother was too young when she married your father; her character hadn’t settled yet… She gave birth to you at twenty-one.”

“Her father, Jiang Liancheng, wasn’t a decent person either. Seeing that your father was my son, he pushed them together hard. Your mother was young and had the support of her family, so she really didn’t care about the consequences.”

“It made my opposition at the time seem cold-hearted. Later… as you know, your father betrayed her first. She was young and didn’t really have the consciousness of being a mother. The Jiang family was already a single-parent household; I imagine Jiang Liancheng didn’t pay much attention to this daughter either.”

Song Yu just lowered his eyes and listened, his expression calm.

“Child, I’m not asking you to forgive your mother; I’m asking you to let go.”

“People cannot change others. When you come into this world, you have to accept differences, accept diversity, and accept that many people… they haven’t truly ‘grown up’.”

“Don’t let your mother trap you for long. She is Jiang Rui first, and your mother second. You and she are two independent people.”

Song Yu’s eyes flickered slightly:

“I understand.”

But just then, the person on the other end mentioned something:

“Your mother had a child who met with an accident—the one who was sick before. Its eyes were pecked out by a bird.”

Song Yu’s expression changed slightly.

“Jiang Rui will probably come looking for you… Child, listen to Grandpa…”

Huaihe Road was quiet. It was only after Song Yu hung up the phone that he realized this was why his grandfather had called him at this hour.

That “Xiao Yu” had an accident?

Song Yu didn’t feel anything like “revenge.” He just felt dazed. Jiang Rui’s devotion… she had spent all these years on that child.

Perhaps the old man was prescient; at 4:00 AM, Jiang Rui’s call actually came.

Song Yu looked down and answered.

“Little Yu, are you sleeping at home? Mom had a nightmare… are you okay?”

“Can you video call Mom?”

“Mom has really missed you these past few days.”

……

Song Yu was stunned for a long time, curled his lips into a smile, and turned his head away.

His eye sockets were a little red.

He said to the phone:

“Mom, you got the name wrong. I am ‘Yu’ (as in Song Yu), not ‘Yu’ (as in the other child).”

The person on the other end seemed stunned as well.

-

At this moment, the Management Bureau’s “training” course had also ended, and the bird had shone brilliantly.

Not only was he number one in activity, but he also won the position of “Class Monitor.”

The bird received a small messenger bag—the monster kind, with infinite capacity.

As soon as Bai Linlin left the classroom, he saw a black, white, and brown sparrow pressing down on that stack of “envelopes,” which were all monster-power allowances. 001 was helping him guard them.

The bird flapped his wings and flew over. “I’m done with training!”

“It’s almost dawn. Do you have to go back?”

The sparrow stood up, pushed the stack of envelopes over with its claw, but reminded him:

“However, this allowance is tied to identity information, so the share of monster power given might be different. Use it cautiously.”

Bai Linlin lowered his head and picked up the stack of envelopes, starting to stuff them into his bag. Just then, a voice came from behind:

“247.”

The Red-crowned Crane had appeared out of nowhere. The bird was startled, but fortunately, he had hurriedly packed his things away.

“I’m here.”

The Red-crowned Crane said elegantly: “Well done.”

Then he waved a wing to say goodbye. The two on the bar also waved, though one was calm and the other was guilty.

Soon, the sky would be breaking dawn, and the base would be closing. Many monsters were packing up to leave; some were still discussing buying the little cakes at the entrance.

Bai Linlin also said goodbye to his chief underling.

-

Meanwhile.

Song Yu’s mood was actually quite depressed. After hanging up the phone, he just looked out the car window.

"Ordinary" little animals were indeed filing out from the shadows, but none of them were—

Just then, a bouncing little bird emerged from a corner, carrying a tiny messenger bag on its back.

chunks.chineseText:
第31章

宋郁几乎愣了好一会，直到住宅楼的一角露出来了太阳，光线从车窗里照了过去。

少年面色温和，那些消极的情绪仿佛一扫而空，瞳孔里只有不远处那个蹦蹦跳跳的小鸟。

回来了？

白粼粼对于这次的培训相当满意，不仅获得了个小挎包，而且还收获了妖力津贴，对，还有一群小弟。

一举多得！

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地往路口走，其实还没太注意到车停的位置，只是看了下阴影处的那一队小妖怪。

它们又要买小蛋糕？

或许是目光存在感太强，那一队小妖怪回头看了过来，见到是白粼粼后齐声喊了句“老大”。

鸟很矜持地点了点头，挥了挥翅膀。

好好好。

但就在这时不远处有车门开启的声音。

“粼粼。”

一个相貌优越的少年站在街角处，出声朝这边唤道。

阴影处的小妖怪不动了，直直地看着不远处的“人类”，但由于围墙那里的门空间不大，前面的不走后面很快就堵上了。

“干什么呀，站在前面不走是……”

一个西服革履的小鼠在后面抱怨道。

后面还有一大堆小妖怪，眼看着就要吵起来了，但是前面的一只侏儒兔说话了：

“你们快看，老大的人。”

众小妖怪顿时挤成一堆了，都开始纷纷地张望那里，窃窃私语道：

“老大的人？不是叫监护人吗？”

“你懂什么，人类喜欢简略，我这是学到精髓了。”

“好了好了不要说了，快看——”

白粼粼刚同自己的小弟致意完就看到了路口的宋郁，走路的动作一顿，爪子都不自觉悬空了。

一秒，两秒。

一个蓝色小鸟在地面上一顿狂走，啪嗒啪嗒冲刺，最后只剩下一道残影。

角落里的一群小妖怪的头完整地经历了一个直线运动，从鸟的这边，齐齐地转向人的那里。

“啾啾！”

宋郁俯身抬手接了下，热热的爪子踩了上来，他的小鸟非常敏捷地顺着衣服攀爬了过来，最后抵达肩头。

昂首挺胸。

“第一天培训还好么？”

宋郁不由得侧眸去问，眉眼平和，顺带转身拉开了车门。

身后的一堆小妖怪挤在墙角处，都保持着一个后仰的姿势，忍不住讨论：

“那是豪车吧？”

“老大这么厉害……”

“监护人居然来接送。”

“不亏是老大。”

最后这句话一锤定音，引起了无数小妖怪的共鸣，不过就在这时街角处的豪车拉开了窗户。

一个圆滚滚的鸟头露了出来，侧着头的，非常有风范地挥了挥翅膀。

“老大再见！”

“老大拜拜！”

“老大一路顺风！”

宋郁面色有些茫然，但还是用手托着鸟，身子尽可能地靠后，为了不挡住鸟的“镜头”。

“啾啾！”

大约是持续了有个半分钟，鸟才扑棱翅膀飞回了宋郁的肩头，顺带压了压身子，把小挎包给弄下来了。

人很自然地抬手接住。

这个时候代驾也恰好过来了，问了句：

“目的地是？”

“平湖区锦园。”

司机刚要准备启动，就在这时后面又传来了一句：

“隔板升起来。”

司机还有些纳闷，后面不就一个人……还有一只鸟。

这有什么值得升隔板的？

又不是男女。

不过还是操作了，顺带转了下方向盘，帕拉梅拉稳稳地在路上行驶着。

与此同时后座。

宋郁的手机早就关机扔在一边了，那些乱七八糟的信息完全被隔绝在外，留下来的只是一人一鸟相处的空间。

“你从哪里拿的？”

人很轻声地问，车内的隔板有一定的隔音效果，宋郁手指上挂着那个黑色的小挎包。

鸟就站在人的手掌上，收了收翅根，而后伸头用喙去拉开了拉链，期间还有点麻烦，试图伸爪子。

宋郁把手指递了过去，鸟稳稳地扶着了。

拉开了。

白粼粼仰头看过去，然后想了想，在后座环顾了下四周，飞到车后座叼起一袋软糖，晃晃悠悠地又扑棱翅膀飞到了人的手掌心。

开始伸爪子按住挎包，往里装。

宋郁一开始还是蹙着眉，直到那一大包东西真的放了进去。

鸟歪头去看人的反应，鸟眼圆圆的。

“好神奇……”

“啾！”

白粼粼心满意足，伸了伸翅根，毕竟也算是带人见了世面的。

但这还没完。

白粼粼又想起来一件事，开始认真地用爪子踩住挎包的带子，鸟头往里面拱来拱去的，最后终于找到了。

叼出来一张泛着金色流线的纸。

“这又是什么？”

白粼粼在人手里站得板板正正的，终于等到这句话了，然后伸了伸鸟头，把叼着的东西放到了宋郁的手心：

[培训随堂测验成绩单]

编号：247

姓名：粼粼

成绩：100（满分一百）

宋郁眉眼温和地道：“粼粼好棒……”

“啾！”

鸟站得笔挺，还仰了仰头。

-

与此同时，S州。

陈开鹤其实听完老友说的那些话挺不满意的，没忍住道：

“孩子才多大，你让他理解他父母是两个未开化的‘幼儿’，那实在是有些委屈了他。”

“江芮可没在小郁生病的时候过来——”

宋峥国只是平和地讲：

“我知道。”

对面的老头儿蹙眉：“那你说一大堆干什么？”

“反正我是独身主义，没有你为人父母的经验，我是一点也看不惯！”

“江芮的孩子出事，十有八九是天谴！”

宋峥国闻言就笑了，“你怎么还迷信上了？”

此刻s州已经是晚上了，房间内两个老头儿在拌嘴。

“我说真的，要我说小郁大了就应该和他那不着调的爹妈断绝关系！才不给他们养老！”

陈开鹤本来是说出来的气话，但是就在这时，病床上的人很平和地道：

“本该如此。”

陈开鹤：“……”

什么意思？

宋峥国抬手把床头的心理疾病诊疗杂志拿了下来，面色平和地道：

“启明我想好了，他就留在S州这里的分公司，永远不再回国。”

“至于小郁的母亲，开鹤……”

宋峥国抬眸看了过来，很平静地道，“我是个长辈，我不可能去让孩子痛恨他的母亲，我只能去宽慰，去尽可能地开解。”

“小郁是对他母亲有念想的。”

“再者，江芮的那个孩子出事，何尝不是一个契机。”

陈开鹤还是云里雾里的，只是愈发觉得老友有点……老谋深算。

“长痛不如短痛，南市医院里的人同我传了消息，那孩子被送去了机构，江芮必然会想起来小郁……”

说到这里宋峥国冷笑一声，“取得这么相近的名字，是真不怕孩子心里扎针。”

陈开鹤倒吸一口冷气，抬了抬眉，只是猜测：

“你故意的？”

宋峥国只是蹙眉：“我带大的孩子我知道，他性子冷，但很重感情，从小是趴在我肩头要妈妈的。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 31

Song Yu was stunned for a good while, until the sun peeked out from the corner of the residential building and light shone through the car window.

The youth’s expression was gentle, and those negative emotions seemed to be swept away. In his pupils, there was only that little bird bouncing along not far away.

He was back?

Bai Linlin was quite satisfied with this training. Not only did he get a small messenger bag, but he also received a monster-power allowance—and yes, a group of underlings.

Killing many birds with one stone!

The bird pattered toward the intersection. He hadn’t really noticed where the car was parked, only glancing at the group of little monsters in the shadows.

Were they going to buy little cakes again?

Perhaps because his presence was too strong, the group of little monsters looked over. Upon seeing it was Bai Linlin, they shouted in unison, "Boss!"

The bird nodded with great restraint and waved his wings.

Good, good, good.

But just then, there was the sound of a car door opening not far away.

“Linlin.”

A youth with superior looks stood at the street corner and called out in that direction.

The little monsters in the shadows stopped moving, staring straight at the "human" not far away. But because the space at the wall gate wasn’t large, those in front didn’t move, and those behind were soon blocked.

“What are you doing? Standing in front and not moving is…”

A little mouse in a suit complained from behind.

There was a huge crowd of little monsters behind, and it looked like they were about to start arguing, but a dwarf rabbit in front spoke up:

“Look, everyone, it’s the Boss’s human.”

The little monsters immediately crowded together, all craning their necks to look, whispering:

“The Boss’s human? Isn’t that called a guardian?”

“What do you know? Humans like to be brief. I’m learning the essence of it.”

“Alright, alright, stop talking, look—”

Bai Linlin had just finished acknowledging his underlings when he saw Song Yu at the intersection. His walking motion paused, and his claws hovered in the air unconsciously.

One second, two seconds.

A blue little bird went on a wild sprint across the ground, pattering along, leaving only a blur.

The heads of the group of little monsters in the corner went through a complete linear movement,齐齐 (in unison) turning from the bird’s side to the human’s side.

“Chirp chirp!”

Song Yu leaned down and raised his hand to catch him. Warm claws stepped onto his palm, and his little bird climbed up his clothes with great agility, finally reaching his shoulder.

Head held high, chest puffed out.

“How was the first day of training?”

Song Yu couldn’t help but turn his head to ask, his expression peaceful, as he turned to open the car door.

The pile of little monsters behind them huddled in the corner, all maintaining a leaning-back posture, unable to help but discuss:

“That’s a luxury car, right?”

“The Boss is so amazing…”

“The guardian actually came to pick him up.”

“As expected of the Boss.”

This last sentence was the final word, resonating with countless little monsters. But just then, the window of the luxury car at the street corner rolled down.

A round, plump bird head appeared, tilting to the side, and waved its wings with great style.

“Goodbye, Boss!”

“Bye-bye, Boss!”

“Have a safe trip, Boss!”

Song Yu’s expression was a bit bewildered, but he still supported the bird with his hand, leaning back as much as possible so as not to block the bird’s “camera angle.”

“Chirp chirp!”

It lasted about half a minute before the bird flapped its wings and flew back to Song Yu’s shoulder, incidentally pressing down its body to take off the small messenger bag.

The human naturally raised his hand to catch it.

At this moment, the designated driver happened to arrive and asked:

“What is the destination?”

“Jin Yuan, Pinghu District.”

The driver was just about to start the car when another voice came from behind:

“Raise the partition.”

The driver was a bit puzzled. There was only one person in the back… and a bird.

Was there anything worth raising the partition for?

It wasn’t a man and a woman.

But he operated it anyway, turning the steering wheel, and the Panamera drove steadily down the road.

Meanwhile, in the back seat.

Song Yu’s phone had long been turned off and tossed aside. All the messy information was completely isolated, leaving only the space for the human and the bird to be together.

“Where did you get this?”

The human asked very softly. The partition in the car had a certain soundproofing effect. Song Yu had the small black messenger bag hanging on his finger.

The bird stood on the human’s palm, tucked its wings, and then stretched its head to pull the zipper with its beak. It was a bit troublesome, and it tried to use its claws.

Song Yu offered his finger, and the bird held onto it steadily.

It opened.

Bai Linlin looked up, thought for a moment, looked around the back seat, flew to the back seat to pick up a bag of gummy candies, and flew back to the human’s palm, swaying.

He began to use his claws to hold down the bag and stuff them inside.

Song Yu was frowning at first, until that large bag of things was really put inside.

The bird tilted its head to look at the human’s reaction, its bird eyes round.

“How magical…”

“Chirp!”

Bai Linlin was satisfied and stretched his wings; after all, he had shown his human the world.

But that wasn’t all.

Bai Linlin remembered something else and began to earnestly step on the strap of the bag with his claws, his bird head burrowing in and out, until he finally found it.

He pulled out a piece of paper shimmering with golden streamlines.

“What is this again?”

Bai Linlin stood straight in the human’s hand, finally waiting for this question, and then stretched his bird head to place the item he was holding into Song Yu’s palm:

[Training Quiz Scorecard]

Number: 247

Name: Linlin

Score: 100 (out of one hundred)

Song Yu said with a gentle expression: “Linlin is so amazing…”

“Chirp!”

The bird stood straight and even tilted its head up.

-

Meanwhile, in S Province.

Chen Kaihe was actually quite dissatisfied after hearing what his old friend had said and couldn’t help but say:

“How old is the child? Asking him to understand that his parents are two unevolved ‘toddlers’ is really doing him a disservice.”

“Jiang Rui didn’t come when Little Yu was sick—”

Song Zheng-guo just said peacefully:

“I know.”

The old man opposite him frowned: “Then why are you saying all that?”

“Anyway, I’m a celibate; I don’t have your experience as a parent, and I can’t stand it at all!”

“Jiang Rui’s child having an accident is nine times out of ten divine retribution!”

Song Zheng-guo laughed when he heard this, “How did you become superstitious?”

It was already night in S Province, and the two old men were bickering in the room.

“I’m serious. If you ask me, once Little Yu is older, he should cut ties with his unreliable father and mother! Don’t support them in their old age!”

Chen Kaihe was saying this out of anger, but just then, the person on the hospital bed said calmly:

“It should be so.”

Chen Kaihe: “……”

What did that mean?

Song Zheng-guo reached out and took the psychiatric diagnosis magazine from the bedside, his expression peaceful:

“I’ve decided on Qiming. He will stay at the branch here in S Province and never return to the country.”

“As for Little Yu’s mother, Kaihe…”

Song Zheng-guo looked up, his expression very calm, “I am an elder; I cannot make the child hate his mother. I can only comfort him and try to enlighten him as much as possible.”

“Little Yu has a longing for his mother.”

“Furthermore, the accident involving Jiang Rui’s child is, in a way, an opportunity.”

Chen Kaihe was still confused, only feeling more and more that his old friend was… calculating.

“Long pain is worse than short pain. Someone at the Nanshi Hospital sent me news that the child was sent to an institution. Jiang Rui will inevitably think of Little Yu…”

Speaking of this, Song Zheng-guo sneered, “Giving them such similar names—they really aren’t afraid of stabbing the child in the heart.”

Chen Kaihe gasped, raised his eyebrows, and guessed:

“You did it on purpose?”

Song Zheng-guo just frowned: “I know the child I raised. He has a cold temperament, but he is very emotional. Since he was little, he would crawl onto my shoulder and ask for his mother.”

chunks.chineseText:
“旁人要是诋毁他母亲，他会很生气地反驳回去，甚至几周都不说话了，只是等他妈妈来看他……”

“所以不能用那种方式，倒不如温和地劝导，以柔制动，让那孩子自己来判断，去看清楚现实。”

陈开鹤：“……不是。”

宋峥国只是看了下报纸，平静地道：

“如若他母亲是真的悔过了，那我的那番话也仍然受用，这没有问题的。”

“可江芮是你我看着长这么大的，那二十多的时候可以说不懂事，这都三十多了还生——”

陈开鹤说完才反应过来，翻了个白眼，他本来打算出门接个水的，但是转而又回过头来，问：

“照你和那群政客打交道的经验……你下一步要怎么做？”

“国内市场不需要江芮。”

-

锦园。

一人一鸟回了家就开始去看那个妖力津贴，白粼粼十分谨慎，拿出来了自己兑的那张。

是个信封样式，右上角有编号：247。

“等一下。”

宋郁一下子像是想到什么，起身衣帽间拿出来一个毯子，围在自己的小鸟周边。

变人就没有羽毛了。

不知道冷不冷。

白粼粼其实也只是想试验一下，如果一份津贴就能变人的话，那他就可以把剩余的津贴倒卖给新注册的小妖怪。

来一个新妖，多一个小弟。

可持续发展。

“好了，你试试。”

圆嘟嘟的鸟此刻就站在卧室的新床上，叼着那个信封，微微低着鸟头，仿佛是在蓄力。

宋郁其实也很紧张，毕竟他的小鸟第一次尝试化形，不过时间一点一滴地过去了……

人突然反应过来：

“粼粼，要拆开。”

鸟摆pose了这么久，闻言一下子瞪大了鸟眼，而后装作什么都没有发生一样把信封放在毯子上，用爪子按住。

开始用喙叼出来里面的……

信件再度变成“灰烬”，有一层金光绕着毯子中间的小鸟。

宋郁看得愣住了，但是他又后知后觉想起来一件事，化形有……有衣服穿么？

但这个时候来不及了。

少年面色一红，把脸偏开了。

那层金光绕了有好一会，白粼粼闭眼感受，浑身都感觉十分轻盈，翅根都舒服地伸了伸。

“好了吗？”

鸟闻言睁开了眼睛。

人也回了头。

“……”

“……”

一只流光溢彩的小鸡。

白粼粼低头看了看自己的翅膀尖尖，确实有金纹流过，但……也仅限于此。

像是游戏里积分兑的角色特效。

最后实在是想不通，一人一鸟去开了保险柜，把当时的证件拿了出来。

丹顶鹤当时说过这上面的妖力等级是会动态变化的，之前是F级……那做完一个任务之后应该是……

宋郁抬手翻开红本本，肩头某只也扑棱翅膀站在了人的手上，探头去看。

妖力等级：F+

“……”

“……”

鸟就知道！

这和拼夕夕砍一刀有什么区别！

宋郁倒是心态良好，只是安慰道：“没事，我们再多做几个就可以了。”

“培训不是还要一个月吗？”

“慢慢来。”

白粼粼好在是留了一手，但他不能和人说，毕竟这事看起来不是很光彩，万一宋郁觉得不合适怎么办……

不行，鸟是完美的。

“不高兴吗？”

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，不知道他的小鸟为什么一直低着头，出声问道。

“要不要买点东西？”

鸟此刻正一肚子坏水，盘算着下次要一妖收两份津贴，但在听到耳边的话之后，立马抬头看了过来，爪子都并了并，贴了贴人的下巴。

纯良小鸡。

“啾啾！”

-

时间很快推移至八月初。

白粼粼此刻正自己在卧室里数妖力津贴，他已经了解清楚了，A级的妖怪才能化形，B级的妖怪是可以沟通的……至于那些做任务的，是S级。

“……”

鸟这段时间奋发图强，已经在攒了不少妖力津贴了。

他要速成！

一张，两张，三张……

鸟低头用爪子拿一张，再往右边放一张，如此循环往复，默默地数着。

三百六十九张，三百七十张，三百七十一张……

白粼粼觉得应该差不多了，区区一个A级，有什么难得？

鸟用爪子按了下旁边的手机，看了下时间：

上午九点三十分。

宋郁这段时间一直在考驾照，今天刚好是出去拿证的时间，出门的时候人报备了。

说中午十一点半才回来。

很好，开始行动！

鸟低头拆开了一个不属于他的信封，卧室里时不时有金色的光在流动……

-

宋郁此刻正从车管所出来，取回了自己的驾照，原来一直没空学车，每次都要叫代驾。

接送他的小鸟也不方便。

“辛苦了，你回去吧。”

宋郁身高已经隐隐到了一米八三，褪去了些少年模样，垂眸同随行的人说话。

这人西服革履的，看着也很文雅，很平和地道：

“好的，不过宋总来消息，说是让您给他回个电话……”

宋郁蹙了蹙眉：“我知道了。”

这位穿着整齐的人才走了，对方是华秉的人，也是宋峥国的心腹之一，这几天在带着宋郁去公司了解情况。

说白了，是查了一遍宋启明的关系网：

李长韵早就被逐出去了，现在连南市都待不下去了，据说去了一个十八线城市；至于她的姘头，也就是宋启明的好兄弟厉峰，因为职务侵占这个罪名直接坐牢了。

宋郁在看到这些消息的时候面色平平，宋启明本就是个薄情寡义的人，这些“近人”的下场没有什么可意外的。

唯一让他有些困惑的是，整场调查下来……没有任何人关注“宋阳”的去留，甚至信息都没有。

七年父子之情。

倒是脆弱得像纸一样。

宋郁没再关注这件事的后续，只是觉得挺讽刺的。

他打开车门坐到驾驶位，低头看了下手机，很自然地打开了购物软件。

里面全是各种各样的衣服推荐……

有童装。

有少年装。

还有西装。

宋郁不知道他的小鸟会变成什么类型的人，但总觉得应该多买点，以备万一。

这已经是买的第三轮了。

他支付完后看了下时间。

十点四十五。

还有一个小时。

宋郁本来打算开车去附近的一家炒货店里去买些东西，因为鸟最近迷上了吃那个小香菇干。

脆脆的，它喜欢。

不过就在这时，电话来了，宋郁一开始还以为是宋启明，但是低头一看微微怔了下。

江芮。

他不太想接。

挂了。

宋郁有些时候也想通了，他为什么执着于父母？江芮只是江芮，她有她自己的事，有自己选择爱的人，不过是没选择他而已，有什么不能接受的。

这个世界离了谁不能转。

他有他的小鸟。

-

卧室里正在忽明忽暗，一阵阵刺眼的金光闪烁，墙壁上倒映出一个圆滚滚的身躯，时而伟岸，时而迷你。

白粼粼觉得晕晕的……
chunks.englishText:
"If others were to slander his mother, he would retort with great anger, sometimes even refusing to speak for weeks, just waiting for his mother to come and see him..."

"So, you cannot use that approach. It would be better to persuade him gently, to overcome force with softness, and let the child judge for himself and see the reality clearly."

Chen Kaihe: "...That’s not it."

Song Zhengguo merely glanced at the newspaper and said calmly:

"If his mother has truly repented, then my words still hold weight. There is no problem with that."

"But Jiang Rui is someone you and I have watched grow up. You could say she was ignorant in her twenties, but she’s over thirty now and still—"

Chen Kaihe realized what he was saying halfway through and rolled his eyes. He had intended to go out to get some water, but he turned back instead and asked:

"Based on your experience dealing with those politicians... what is your next move?"

"The domestic market has no need for Jiang Rui."

-

Jin Yuan.

One man and one bird returned home and immediately began to examine the 'Demon Power Subsidy.' Bai Linlin was extremely cautious, taking out the one he had redeemed.

It was in the form of an envelope with a serial number in the top right corner: 247.

"Wait a moment."

Song Yu suddenly thought of something, stood up, and went to the walk-in closet to retrieve a blanket, wrapping it around his little bird.

Once transformed into a human, there would be no feathers.

He didn't know if the bird would be cold.

Bai Linlin actually just wanted to test it. If one subsidy was enough to transform into a human, he could resell the remaining subsidies to newly registered little demons.

One new demon, one more underling.

Sustainable development.

"Alright, give it a try."

The round, chubby bird stood on the new bed in the bedroom, holding the envelope in its beak, bowing its head slightly as if gathering strength.

Song Yu was actually quite nervous; after all, this was his little bird's first attempt at transformation. But time ticked away, second by second...

The human suddenly realized:

"Linlin, you have to open it."

The bird, having held its pose for so long, widened its eyes at the words, then pretended as if nothing had happened, placed the envelope on the blanket, and held it down with its claws.

It began to use its beak to pull out the contents...

The letter turned into "ash" once more, and a layer of golden light swirled around the bird in the center of the blanket.

Song Yu watched, stunned, but then he belatedly remembered one thing: when transforming... is there any clothing to wear?

But it was too late for that.

The young man’s face flushed, and he turned his head away.

The golden light swirled for quite a while. Bai Linlin closed his eyes to feel it; his whole body felt incredibly light, and he stretched his wing roots comfortably.

"Are you done?"

The bird opened its eyes at the sound.

The human turned back.

"..."

"..."

A shimmering, iridescent little chick.

Bai Linlin looked down at the tips of his wings. There were indeed golden patterns flowing through them, but... that was as far as it went.

It looked like a character special effect redeemed with points in a game.

In the end, unable to figure it out, the man and the bird opened the safe and took out the documentation from before.

The Red-Crowned Crane had said that the demon power level on this would change dynamically. It was F-rank before... so after completing a task, it should be...

Song Yu reached out to flip open the little red book, and the creature on his shoulder flapped its wings to stand on his hand, craning its neck to look.

Demon Power Level: F+

"..."

"..."

The bird knew it!

How was this any different from those "slash the price" scams on shopping apps!

Song Yu, however, had a good mindset and simply comforted it: "It's okay, we can just do a few more."

"Doesn't the training take another month?"

"Take it slow."

Fortunately, Bai Linlin had a trick up his sleeve, but he couldn't tell the human. After all, it didn't seem very honorable, and what if Song Yu thought it was inappropriate...

No, the bird is perfect.

"Are you unhappy?"

Song Yu frowned, wondering why his little bird had been keeping its head down, and asked aloud.

"Do you want to buy something?"

The bird was currently full of mischief, calculating how to collect two subsidies from one demon next time, but upon hearing the words, it immediately looked up, pressed its claws together, and nudged the man’s chin.

A pure and innocent little chick.

"Chirp chirp!"

-

Time quickly moved to early August.

Bai Linlin was currently counting his demon power subsidies in the bedroom by himself. He had already figured it out: A-rank demons could transform, B-rank demons could communicate... and as for those doing tasks, they were S-rank.

"..."

The bird had been working hard during this time and had already saved up quite a few demon power subsidies.

He was going to fast-track this!

One, two, three...

The bird lowered its head, used its claw to pick up one, placed it to the right, and repeated the cycle, counting silently.

Three hundred sixty-nine, three hundred seventy, three hundred seventy-one...

Bai Linlin felt it should be enough. A mere A-rank, what could be so difficult?

The bird pressed its claw against the phone nearby and checked the time:

Nine-thirty in the morning.

Song Yu had been taking his driving test during this period, and today was the day to pick up his license. He had reported his schedule when he left.

He said he wouldn't be back until eleven-thirty.

Very good, time to act!

The bird lowered its head and tore open an envelope that didn't belong to him. Golden light flickered in the bedroom from time to time...

-

Song Yu was currently leaving the vehicle management office, having retrieved his driver's license. He had never had time to learn to drive before, so he had to call a designated driver every time.

It wasn't convenient for the little bird to pick him up either.

"Thank you for your hard work, you can go back."

Song Yu, whose height had now reached nearly 1.83 meters, shedding some of his boyishness, lowered his eyes to speak to his companion.

The man was dressed in a suit and looked quite refined. He said peacefully:

"Understood. However, President Song sent a message saying he would like you to return his call..."

Song Yu frowned: "I know."

The neatly dressed man left. He was from Hua Bing and one of Song Zhengguo's trusted aides, who had been taking Song Yu to the company to learn the ropes over the past few days.

To put it bluntly, they had investigated Song Qiming's network:

Li Changyun had long been cast out and couldn't even stay in Nanshi anymore; it was said she had gone to a third-tier city. As for her lover, Song Qiming's "good brother" Li Feng, he was directly imprisoned for embezzlement.

Song Yu’s expression was flat when he saw this news. Song Qiming was a cold-hearted man by nature; the downfall of these "close associates" was nothing surprising.

The only thing that puzzled him was that throughout the entire investigation... no one paid any attention to the whereabouts of "Song Yang," and there wasn't even any information on him.

Seven years of father-son affection.

It was as fragile as paper.

Song Yu didn't follow up on the aftermath, just finding it quite ironic.

He opened the car door, sat in the driver's seat, looked down at his phone, and naturally opened a shopping app.

It was filled with all kinds of clothing recommendations...

Children's wear.

Teenage wear.

And suits.

Song Yu didn't know what kind of person his little bird would turn into, but he felt he should buy a bit of everything, just in case.

This was already the third round of shopping.

He checked the time after paying.

Ten-forty-five.

One hour left.

Song Yu had originally planned to drive to a nearby roasted nut shop to buy some things, as the bird had recently become obsessed with eating those little dried mushrooms.

Crispy, it liked them.

But just then, a call came in. Song Yu initially thought it was Song Qiming, but when he looked down, he was slightly stunned.

Jiang Rui.

He didn't really want to answer.

He hung up.

Sometimes, Song Yu had come to terms with it. Why was he so fixated on his parents? Jiang Rui was just Jiang Rui; she had her own affairs, her own choice of who to love, and she simply hadn't chosen him. What was there to be unable to accept?

The world wouldn't stop spinning for anyone.

He had his little bird.

-

In the bedroom, the light was flickering on and off. Blinding flashes of golden light illuminated the room, and the wall reflected a round, chubby figure, sometimes majestic, sometimes miniature.

Bai Linlin felt dizzy...

chunks.chineseText:
最后伸着鸟腿坐在了床上，用喙接着去拆信封，感受身体里涌动的力量。

感觉要到了临界值。

但是——

白粼粼还是没有化形，他要气晕了，不过还有一沓妖力津贴，他就不信了。

鸟一股脑地全拆开了。

房间里此刻金光大闪，几乎完全看不到床上的那个身影了。

不知道过了多久，卧室里变得安静了起来，床上也没了动静。

“嗡嗡嗡……”

手机来电，是外卖。

锦园门口那里有个外卖员，估计是第一次来这里，不知道通知物业去送，而是着急地打电话。

但那边始终是没接。

男人低头看了下外卖单子：元气啵啵奶茶超大杯（带一份布丁小料）

这个时候天气还是没有彻底凉下来，外卖员没一会就有点烦躁了，又拨打了一次。

好在这次终于接了。

“喂，你的外卖到了，但锦园这里我不知道——”

电话那头传来一句闷闷的少年音：

“放，物业。”

对面挂了。

外卖员还觉得纳闷，这发烧了？怎么有气无力的？

不过他还是照做了。

而此时别墅的卧室里还是静悄悄的，除了衣柜那里细细簌簌的动静，像是在翻找什么……

不过也就持续了一会，后面又没了动静。

大约十几分钟后。

楼下有门铃声，叮咚叮咚，但里面都没有回应，物业觉得困惑，这不出来取么？

他只好敲了下门，象征性地说了句“放门口了”，然后才走了。

卧室里再次有了动静，这次不是细细簌簌的了，而是脚步踩在地毯上的声音，晃晃悠悠的，好像声音的主人第一次学会走路一样。
