Chapter 34

About thirty minutes later, Song Yu had basically finished the quota of handing out mobile phones to the "demon hands." He had added contact information one by one at the alley entrance, and only then did he feel a bit more at ease.

This kind of thing must not happen a second time.

If he had known about what was happening within the Management Bureau earlier, he wouldn't have let his little bird suffer so much for an entire day.

"Goodbye, Boss!"

"Goodbye, Boss's guardian!"

Groups of little demons waved goodbye from the shadows at the base of the wall, their eyes sparkling. Bai Linlin nodded slightly and waved his wings, looking quite reserved.

*Mm-hmm.*

Song Yu also stood up. He watched as the group of "little animals" lined up in an orderly fashion. As they stepped out of the shadows, they transformed into various "people" and quickly scattered from the alley entrance.

However, a few still persisted in waiting for the small cake stall.

"Shall we go home?"

The young man tilted his head slightly, looking at the bird on his shoulder. The sunlight spilled over, highlighting the straight bridge of his nose and casting a soft shadow across his profile.

Bai Linlin tucked his claws in, shyly wanting to nudge his bird head against the man's chin, but just then—

"247."

A black-clad youth was standing opposite them, though no one knew when he had arrived. He remained expressionless, his gaze fixed on the round, fluffy bird on Song Yu's shoulder after he spoke.

Bai Linlin was forced to cut his movement short. He didn't know whether to nudge or not. He wanted to turn his head to preen his feathers to ease the awkwardness, but perhaps because he hadn't been fully awake for long, his bird leg slipped.

The aftermath was self-evident.

The bird flapped his wings frantically, calculating upward acceleration while falling, and reached out his claws in a desperate bid for support, but the final result was less than ideal:

A "walking chicken" hanging onto a person's clothes, struggling to climb up but failing.

Song Yu raised his hand to gather his little bird. He didn't just grab him; instead, he extended his hand to act as a step. Only then did the bird walk back to his shoulder, step by step, and stand firm.

Bai Linlin tucked in his wing roots, pretending nothing had happened. "What is it?"

001: "..."

The black-clad youth just looked very depressed. "Are you really not coming to the base next week?"

Song Yu hadn't interjected from start to finish; he just watched his little bird communicate with his friend.

"Right, but it's only for a week!"

"Oh."

The blue-feathered bird tentatively asked, "Should I order you some takeout?"

The black-clad youth's eyes brightened.

"But you can also come to my house as a guest!"

After saying this, the bird proudly puffed out his chest and then turned to look at the man. Song Yu’s expression was gentle, showing full support.

001 was a bit surprised. "Really?"

"Of course!"

Bai Linlin gave his word and naturally went to nuzzle the person beside him. Song Yu spoke at just the right moment:

"Didn't you get a phone? I'll give you the address now. Linlin has his own room; you can go there to play."

The small alley was calm yet lively. 001 tilted his head and handed over the phone, watching with curiosity as the "person" downloaded a map app for him and explained how to use the navigation.

Finally, Song Yu thought for a moment and transferred some money—five thousand yuan.

"Thank you for helping Linlin today."

Only after saying this did he return the phone. The black-clad youth even took a small step forward, taking it with both hands.

There was a sense of looking up to someone.

"Boss, you're really amazing."

Bai Linlin felt wonderful again, waving his wings outward to indicate that it was nothing!

By the time the black-clad youth transformed into a small sparrow and flew away, Song Yu realized the alley entrance had become bustling. There were street vendors setting up breakfast stalls and office workers walking by while on their phones...

After a brief rest, the city had begun to operate once more.

Song Yu was dazed for a moment, then belatedly checked the time on his phone, discovering it was already seven o'clock sharp.

"Oh no."

"Chirp?"

-

Jin Yuan.

"Are you saying you drove over ten kilometers away just to buy breakfast?"

Song Zheng-guo said this slowly, taking a sip of soy milk, his expression calm.

"And you brought your little bird along."

The old man added another sentence.

Song Yu: "..."

He had never been able to lie to his grandfather since he was a child because he would always be found out; it was just that the old man occasionally chose not to expose him.

Bai Linlin, suddenly being named, curiously poked his head out. Perhaps because he was no longer acting like a human, he boldly flapped his wings and hopped down.

*Pitter-patter*, he walked to the opposite side of the old man and looked up.

Song Zheng-guo’s movements paused: "..."

"Chirp chirp!"

Song Zheng-guo didn't know what this meant, so he just put down his soy milk and asked, "What do you want to do?"

Song Yu stood to the side, feeling inexplicably like an outsider, but he kept his attention focused there until Song Zheng-guo turned to look at him:

"This child."

"You eat, I didn't say I didn't believe you."

"..."

The young man finally sat down, unwrapping all the breakfast items while keeping his peripheral vision on his bird.

"Birdie, are you feeling better?"

The old man looked down at the blue bird on the table, his eyes gentle, even extending a hand—he had only intended to touch him.

But the bird was very familiar; he lifted a leg and stepped right on.

"Chirp!"

"Oh my, you really have spirit."

Besides bringing basic northern breakfast items, Song Yu had actually gone to "Fu Yun Pavilion" on Deyang Road to buy the Cantonese-style morning tea that his grandfather loved.

Golden lava buns, crispy red rice rolls, steamed pork dumplings, crystal shrimp dumplings... in short, it was overflowing with fresh, savory aromas.

"Grandfather, let's eat."

"I'll take him upstairs."

Song Yu was just about to take his little bird back, but the old man smiled and said very gently:

"It's no trouble."

"Can the bird taste a bit?"

Bai Linlin didn't care about the conversation between the grandfather and grandson at all; he just kept staring at the dishes on the table. *The bird wants to eat this, the bird wants to eat that, the bird wants to eat all of these!*

Song Yu was stunned when he heard his grandfather's words. He hadn't expected this situation, so he had to withdraw his hand, hesitating before saying:

"He can... eat just a little bit."

But just then, the bird had already stepped off the old man's finger, *pitter-pattering* over to a plate with incredible speed, and immediately poked his beak into a soup dumpling.

It was a crab roe bun.

Delicious!

Song Zheng-guo was shocked when he saw this, followed by a hearty laugh. He only said, "The bird is quite a glutton..."

The young man stood up abruptly, reached out, and picked up the bird from the table, quickly organizing his words:

"He... he can't eat too much, there's salt."

"Grandfather, I'll take him upstairs."

The bird was escorted away from the crime scene.

-

Bedroom.

Song Yu still wasn't sure what his grandfather's attitude was. He didn't know if he had successfully bluffed his way through that day or not, or if his grandfather thought he had gone crazy.

Right, and Grandpa Chen.

The man looked solemn, but the bird was *pitter-pattering* on the desk, dragging a bag of pistachios out from the bookshelf and tossing it crookedly in front of Song Yu.

He stood still and looked up.

Song Yu lowered his eyes, saw it, and opened the bag. He peeled several in a row, then pulled out a chair and sat down, saying very gently:

"Isn't it better to be a bit more cautious? I'll take you for morning tea this afternoon, hmm?"

Bai Linlin lowered his head and earnestly devoured the nuts. Hearing this, he looked up, thought for a moment, and nodded.

Song Yu was stunned for a moment, then smiled, reached out to stroke the little bird's head, and peeled several more pistachios.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

[You go downstairs!]

The bird said magnanimously.

Song Yu did indeed go downstairs first, but about ten minutes later, he returned with a complex expression, saying:

"Grandfather told me to go to sleep."

Bai Linlin: "..."

chunks.chineseText:
最后还是拉上了窗帘，人去浴室洗了澡，准备睡觉之前还去书桌那里把一袋子开心果全剥完了。

等到真的躺在床上了，宋郁还是莫名觉得不放心，直到余光看到他的小鸟在桌子上认真地在吃果仁，才疲惫地阖上了眼皮。

昏昏沉沉的。

白粼粼其实也没有炫完，他张了张喙，打了个哈欠，看了下书桌上的电脑。

“……”

鸟最后还是啪嗒啪嗒地走到书桌的边缘，然后扑棱翅膀飞到了人的旁边。

想了想。

伸着鸟爪子上去了……

-

大约是中午。

宋郁醒过来的时候觉得眼皮热热的，甚至有些睁不开眼睛，直到他抬手碰了下——

鸟正趴在他的额头上，翅膀就这么伸着，几乎要盖住他整个脸，软软的羽毛触感很舒服，有种清新的谷物味。

宋郁唇角微微往上抿了点，但还是把他的小鸟拿了起来，白粼粼睡得很舒服，隐约感觉自己升空了，这才睁开了眼睛。

“？”

鸟伸了伸鸟腿，徒劳地在半空中蹬了下。

床上的少年骨相优越，在窗户外阳光照下来的时候，脸庞都是交错不一的阴影。

白粼粼看了一会，觉得怪不得他睡得不舒服，硌得慌。

不过……

一马平川的脸好像不好看。

鸟思索。

“我们下午出去吃饭，好不好？”

宋郁很温和地说道。

-

等到下楼的时候，宋郁才看到了桌上的纸条，这是他爷爷的习惯，出门之前会写纸条告知，从他幼儿园的时候就开始了。

——你陈爷爷有要事商议，约我出门，大约三个小时，不必挂心。

——醒来记得吃饭，记得喂小鸟吃饭。

宋郁看到后面色温和，还是同自己爷爷打了个电话，确定了下具体的位置以及身边的人都有谁才放下心来。

不过就这么几分钟的功夫，鸟已经均匀地把人手里的纸条叨成了齐齐的条子，抽出来几根塞到了自己尾羽上。

觉得好玩。

“走吧。”

鸟这才停止了自娱自乐，扑棱翅膀飞上了人的肩头，啾啾了两声。

这次出门的OOTD有所不同，因为阿姨这段时间抽空给鸟赶制出来了几件夏季套装，分别是轻薄防晒小披风、多巴胺色系小背心、蓝色格纹贝雷帽……

鸟挑选了下，觉得下午估计太阳挺大的，穿上了小披风，这次没有那么热了，反倒是有种魔法师的感觉。

大约二十分钟的车程，一人一鸟抵达了早上的那家粤菜餐厅。

不过这次倒是遇见了个意外的人。

是黎笙。

对方正在穿着工作服送菜，看到宋郁后还愣了下：

“这么巧？”

宋郁其实有些困惑：“你这是……”

黎笙摆了摆手道：“我舅舅的店，我来帮忙啦。”

“……”

“哦，是我另外一个舅舅，我好几个舅舅。”

宋郁确实有些意外，刚想要说什么，对方就已经把视线移开了，很好奇地道：

“小鸡。”

“你真的好了呀？”

白粼粼本来已经在认真后仰躲着了，没想到还是被看到了，听到这话更生气了，一顿啾啾啾！

包厢里吵吵的。

黎笙有点乐，同宋郁说了句“等我一会”，随即就离开了，两分钟后他再过来的时候已经换掉了工作服。

很自来熟地坐到了对面。

“可以拼个桌吗？”

宋郁刚想说可以，身旁的小鸟就开始叫个不停。

“啾啾啾！啾啾啾啾啾！”

对面的青年见状很是“伤心”，撑着下巴看了过去，眼睛眯成了个月牙，控诉道：

“是我给的皮皮主人的联系方式的，你这小鸡怎么不领情呢？”

白粼粼一愣，这是什么事情，他不由得仰头去看旁边的人了。

宋郁很认真地道：“谢谢你。”

“它还小，也才刚好，希望你不要介意。”

黎笙闻言就笑了，觉得很有意思，把视线从小鸟身上移开了，只是问宋郁：

“到底是怎么好的？”

“真的是那只神奇小鼠治疗好的？”

黎笙实在是很好奇，因为当时宋郁的说辞是他的小鸟认识那只叫皮皮的金丝熊，想要见一见……

他甚至都没有听完，立马就联想到了之前的事，很快就同意了。

“皮皮的主人是个老奶奶，岁数大了，喜欢说一些很无厘头的话，有同事反馈过，后来才得知对方得了阿尔兹海默症。”

宋郁闻言怔住了，他不知道这件事，但黎笙还在撑着下巴道：

“她老人家总是向我们介绍她有一只会说人话的金丝熊，说它多么地懂事，还会帮她捶腿……”

“所以我在上次看到你说你家的鸟会打游戏的时候，居然也没有多少惊讶，只是心想又来了。”

黎笙眯了眯眼，解释道：“你知道的，养宠的群体里有很大一部分是打工人，他们的精神支柱甚至全在他们的宠物身上。”

“有些时候熬夜熬大了，有幻觉也正常。”

“但是……”

对面的青年面色有些困惑，坐直了身子，看向宋郁：

“我觉得你不像是有什么问题的，那天我其实还是不太放心，想跟你去的，但你拒绝了。”

“老奶奶事后甚至和我打了电话，说她很高兴皮皮交到了朋友。”

黎笙很不解地问：

“你真的见到了那只会说人话的金丝熊了吗？”

“它帮助你的小鸟治好的？”

包厢里安安静静的。

宋郁一时半会不知道怎么回复，肩头的鸟也尴尬地收了收翅膀，歪头看墙。

“不是。”

黎笙松了一口气，而后一拍桌子，“我就知道。”

“怎么可能嘛。”

宋郁想了想，又道，“是我的小鸟后来自己好了的，它慢慢地退烧了。”

尽管这个说辞漏洞百出，但黎笙还是很自然地相信了，完全忽略了那些不合理的细节，甚至也不追问，只是对着那只小鸟道：

“恢复了就好。”

“回头带你体检一下啊。”

其实黎笙也就在包厢里坐了一会，后面就离开了，不过临走的时候他还是很明显地松了一口气，还喃喃着什么东西：

“自由平等公正法治……”

包厢内的一人一鸟：“……”

-

与此同时，早上那些领到了手机的小妖怪们很高兴地回到了自己的家。

一只侏儒兔就蹦蹦跳跳地回来了，客厅里有到处找兔子的“监护人”，女生甚至脸都没洗，头发也没梳，只是在反反复复地道：

“毛球……毛球？”

“我的兔子呢？我的兔子呢？”

前两句像是喃喃自语，后面就开始自言自语：

“难不成出去社交了？”

就在这时，监护人和自己兔子在门口对上了眼。

监护人：“……”

侏儒兔：“……”

毛球原地蹦跶了几下，保持着站立的姿势，抱着一部手机，试图和自己监护人解释。

但是就在这时。

监护人伸出了手，开始发动神秘咒语：

“不要和我说人话，不要和我说人话。”
chunks.englishText:
Finally, he drew the curtains. He went to the bathroom to shower, and before preparing to sleep, he went to the desk and peeled the entire bag of pistachios.

By the time he actually lay on the bed, Song Yu still felt inexplicably uneasy. It wasn't until he saw his little bird out of the corner of his eye, diligently eating nuts on the desk, that he wearily closed his eyes.

He drifted into a hazy slumber.

Bai Linlin hadn't actually finished them all. He opened his beak, let out a yawn, and looked at the computer on the desk.

"..."

In the end, the bird *pitter-pattered* to the edge of the desk, then flapped his wings and flew to the man's side.

He thought for a moment.

He stretched out his bird claws and climbed up...

-

Around noon.

When Song Yu woke up, he felt his eyelids were hot, and he couldn't even open his eyes until he reached out to touch them—

The bird was lying on his forehead, his wings spread out, almost covering his entire face. The soft touch of the feathers was very comfortable, carrying a fresh, grainy scent.

The corners of Song Yu's lips curled up slightly, but he still picked up his little bird. Bai Linlin had been sleeping very comfortably and vaguely felt himself rising into the air, so he opened his eyes.

"?"

The bird stretched his legs, kicking fruitlessly in mid-air.

The young man on the bed had well-defined features. As the sunlight shone in from outside the window, his face was a mosaic of light and shadow.

Bai Linlin watched for a while, thinking it was no wonder he hadn't slept comfortably; it had been quite hard and bony.

However...

A flat face didn't seem very good-looking.

The bird pondered.

"We're going out to eat this afternoon, okay?"

Song Yu said very gently.

-

When he went downstairs, Song Yu saw a note on the table. This was his grandfather's habit; he would always leave a note before going out, a practice that had started when Song Yu was in kindergarten.

——Your Grandpa Chen had urgent matters to discuss and asked me to go out. It will take about three hours, don't worry.

——Remember to eat when you wake up, and remember to feed the little bird.

Seeing the latter part, Song Yu’s expression softened. He still called his grandfather to confirm the specific location and who was with him before he felt at ease.

However, in just those few minutes, the bird had already evenly shredded the note in the man's hand into neat strips, pulling a few out to tuck into his tail feathers.

He thought it was fun.

"Let's go."

Only then did the bird stop entertaining himself, flapping his wings to fly onto the man's shoulder, chirping twice.

Today's OOTD (Outfit of the Day) for the outing was different, as the auntie had taken the time to rush out a few summer sets for the bird, including a lightweight sun-protection cape, a dopamine-colored little vest, a blue plaid beret...

The bird had picked one out, thinking the sun would probably be quite strong in the afternoon, so he wore the little cape. It wasn't as hot this time; instead, he had the air of a little magician.

After a twenty-minute drive, the man and the bird arrived at the Cantonese restaurant from the morning.

However, they encountered an unexpected person this time.

It was Li Sheng.

The other party was wearing a uniform and serving dishes. He was stunned when he saw Song Yu:

"What a coincidence?"

Song Yu was actually a bit confused: "What are you..."

Li Sheng waved his hand and said, "My uncle's shop, I'm here to help out."

"..."

"Oh, it's my other uncle. I have quite a few uncles."

Song Yu was indeed a bit surprised. Just as he was about to say something, the other party had already shifted his gaze, asking curiously:

"Little Chicken."

"Are you really better?"

Bai Linlin had already been leaning back to hide, but he didn't expect to be spotted. Hearing this, he became even angrier and let out a flurry of chirps!

The private room was noisy.

Li Sheng was amused and said to Song Yu, "Wait for me a moment," before leaving. Two minutes later, when he returned, he had already changed out of his uniform.

He sat down opposite them, acting very familiar.

"Can I share the table?"

Song Yu was just about to say yes, but the little bird beside him started chirping non-stop.

"Chirp chirp chirp! Chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

The young man opposite saw this and looked very "sad," propping his chin up as he watched them, his eyes narrowing into crescents as he complained:

"I was the one who gave you the contact info for Pipi's owner. Why are you being so ungrateful, little chicken?"

Bai Linlin was taken aback. What was this about? He couldn't help but look up at the person beside him.

Song Yu said very earnestly, "Thank you."

"He's still young, and he just recovered, so I hope you don't mind."

Li Sheng laughed when he heard this, finding it quite interesting. He shifted his gaze away from the little bird and just asked Song Yu:

"How exactly did he get better?"

"Was it really that magical little mouse that cured him?"

Li Sheng was truly curious because Song Yu's excuse at the time was that his little bird knew that golden hamster named Pipi and wanted to see him...

He hadn't even finished listening before he immediately associated it with previous events and quickly agreed.

"Pipi's owner is an old lady. She's quite old and likes to say some nonsensical things. Colleagues have reported it before, and later we learned she had Alzheimer's."

Song Yu was stunned when he heard this. He hadn't known about that, but Li Sheng continued, propping his chin up:

"The old lady was always telling us about how she had a golden hamster that could speak human language, saying how sensible it was and how it would even help her massage her legs..."

"So when I saw you say your bird could play video games last time, I wasn't even that surprised; I just thought, 'Here we go again.'"

Li Sheng narrowed his eyes and explained, "You know, a large part of the pet-owning community consists of office workers, and their mental support often rests entirely on their pets."

"Sometimes, when you stay up too late, it's normal to have hallucinations."

"But..."

The young man opposite looked a bit confused. He sat up straight and looked at Song Yu:

"I don't think you have any problems. I was actually worried that day and wanted to go with you, but you refused."

"The old lady even called me afterward, saying she was very happy Pipi had made a friend."

Li Sheng asked, very puzzled:

"Did you really see that golden hamster that could speak human language?"

"Did it help your little bird get cured?"

The private room was silent.

Song Yu didn't know how to reply for a moment, and the bird on his shoulder awkwardly tucked in his wings, tilting his head to look at the wall.

"No."

Li Sheng breathed a sigh of relief and then slapped the table. "I knew it."

"How could that be possible?"

Song Yu thought for a moment and added, "My little bird got better on his own later. His fever slowly went down."

Although this explanation was full of holes, Li Sheng believed it quite naturally, completely ignoring the unreasonable details. He didn't even press further, just saying to the little bird:

"It's good that you've recovered."

"Bring him for a check-up later."

In fact, Li Sheng only sat in the private room for a while before leaving. However, when he left, he was clearly relieved, muttering something to himself:

"Freedom, equality, justice, rule of law..."

The man and the bird in the private room: "..."

-

Meanwhile, those little demons who had received their phones in the morning returned to their homes, very happy.

A dwarf rabbit hopped back. In the living room, there was a "guardian" looking for the rabbit everywhere. The girl hadn't even washed her face or combed her hair, just repeating over and over:

"Furball... Furball?"

"Where's my rabbit? Where's my rabbit?"

The first two sentences sounded like muttering to herself, then she began to talk to herself:

"Could it have gone out to socialize?"

Just then, the guardian and her rabbit locked eyes at the door.

Guardian: "..."

Dwarf Rabbit: "..."

Furball hopped on the spot, maintaining a standing posture, clutching a mobile phone, trying to explain to his guardian.

But just at that moment.

The guardian reached out her hand and began to cast a mysterious spell:

"Don't speak human language to me, don't speak human language to me."

chunks.chineseText:
“我的兔子是全天下无敌可爱宝，我的兔子是全天下无敌可爱宝。”

毛球：“……”

它的监护人很快又恢复了正常，开始伸手迎接：

“宝宝过来！”

侏儒兔立马跑了过来，给了一个熊抱，但就在这时，监护人递过来了一个小瓷碗。

里面全是绿油油的兔粮。

“……”

“快吃吧。”

并不是所有的人接受程度都很高，即使有些人撞鬼了，也依然保持着恐怖片里主角的思维，死活不相信，最后也只是归结为自己感冒发烧了。

监护人也同样如此，他们并不是不能接受，而是需要时间适应……

有的几个月，有的几年。

即使是宋郁，也是怀疑自我了很长的时间，直到现在彻底接受。

而唯一的特例，是宋峥国。

“小郁怎么还不把对象带出来？”

“这孩子真是的。”

陈开鹤在自家客厅里走来走去的，沙发上的老友四平八稳，低头在看带过来的一些公司文件。

他看到就来气，走过去道：

“你这亲爷爷的，怎么不上心啊！小郁现在可是成年了，现在这个社会环境，讨老婆是很难的，这他上来装什么都没发生怎么能行？”

“男子汉大丈夫的，他得负责！”

“这在客厅就……哎呀。”

老头又给自己整红温了，虽说宋郁不是他的亲孙子，但和亲孙子也没差了，这人生大事，他尤为在意。

宋峥国闻言只是笑，“你不是独身主义么？操这个心干什么？”

陈开鹤蹙眉：“你怎么这样？”

“小郁都和人家肌肤之亲了，要我说，就得直接先订个婚。”

“这样才对得起人家。”

宋峥国听到这里翻页的动作顿了下，似乎在思考事情，不过就在这时。

“你见小郁的女朋友了么？”

“有照片吗？”

宋峥国当然没有见过，他只是能看出来他孙子在撒谎，以及别墅里没有其他人的事实。

他想了想，“你说有没有一种可能，那天我们太累了，出现了幻……”

宋峥国说到一半就觉得不行，闭了闭眼，只是道：

“见了。”

陈开鹤一下子兴奋了起来，连刚才老友没说完的话都没顾得分析，只是坐了过来，一个劲地问：

“怎么样怎么样？”

宋峥国犹豫了下，斟酌道：

“喜欢吃蟹黄包。”

-

鸟吃完早茶，确切地说是下午茶，才美美地回了家。

宋郁的爷爷正在餐桌那里等着，晚饭并没有动，听到动静才抬眸看了过来。

“回来了？”

宋郁甚至还没有来得及说话，肩头一轻，鸟已经扑棱翅膀过去了，稳当当地在大理石桌板上来了个完美滑铲。

“不错。”

老人很捧场地拍了拍手。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地在新成员面前走了两圈，展示了下自己的翅膀，表演了一下“大鹏展翅”。

鸟要在新成员面前保持完美形象！

“爷爷，您可以先吃的。”

少年拉开椅子坐下了，很温和地道。

宋峥国只是摇摇头，温和地道：“说的什么话，爷爷和你又不是外人。”

祖孙二人在聊着些琐碎的事，不过大多都避开了宋郁的父母，只是问了下学习上的事以及怎么遇见小鸟的。

白粼粼本来是在餐桌上环视领地的，但是没过一会发现自己跟前多了个小盘子，上面有熟悉的苹果块和旺仔小馒头。

！

“……就是这样，后面阿姨离开了一段时间，不过我返聘回来了。”

“她人也很好，会给我的小鸟做衣服。”

宋峥国其实很欣慰，能够自己做决定并采取行动是很难得的个人素养，这孩子看样子是渐渐地走出来了。

老人回头看了下。

鸟的小披风其实还穿着，就是帽子掉下来了，此刻正专心致志地吃旺仔小馒头。

“衣服好看。”

白粼粼一听，立马抬头了，啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，开始展示。

正面。

侧面。

背面。

宋郁其实有点不好意思，但这个时候鸟已经站在了爷爷的手背上，很认真地仰头看过去了。

鸟眼圆圆的。

顺道还看了下他，啾啾了一下。

宋郁也不知道是相处久了还是怎么的，他一下子领会了意思。

抬手去把鸟身上的披风解开了，露出了本体。

白粼粼很满意，再次展示。

正面。

侧面。

背面。

宋峥国顿时了然，笑着道：

“鸟儿也好看。”

白粼粼大获全胜，骄傲地下来了，啪嗒啪嗒又走到了自己的小盘子上，开始去吃剩余的苹果块儿。

餐厅里其乐融融的。

-

晚上，卧室。

鸟在书桌上认真地看管理手册，用爪子按住了页面，很是废寝忘食。

实际上是因为没事干，宋郁被他爷爷叫去书房了。

白粼粼其实也不知道自己人形是什么样子的，但是按照这个妖怪手册上写的，他现在还是不稳定，需要一步步地来。

通俗地来讲。

先学会对于本体的变化操作。

再练习更为高要求的化形。

厉害的妖怪甚至可以变成不同性别、不同年龄阶段的“人类”。

白粼粼看到这里还特地看了眼脚注。

——这里的“不同性别”仅指化形后的外表，妖怪本身的雌雄是不更正的。

还挺全面。

白粼粼回头看了下卧室门口，安安静静的。

很好。

估计不会立马回来。

鸟把手册一爪子合上，走到了洗手间那里，心里跃跃欲试的。

毕竟上次那是特殊情况，妖力乱窜了，导致他压根不知道自己化形后的样子。

嗯……

鸟低头看了下，本来是想看看那两个脚环的，结果胸前的羽毛太蓬松了，没看到。

于是只能使劲伸了伸鸟腿。

白粼粼思忖，有这个应该没问题了吧？

说干就干。

鸟不知道为什么，很心虚地四处瞅了瞅，然后拱开了浴室的门缝，进去了，一爪子把门给踢关上了。

-

书房。

“爷爷年纪大了，应付起来华秉的事也有些力不从心，这也是上次和你打电话的原因。”

宋峥国很温和地同自己的孙子讲，“但是现在公司的事情已经稳妥多了，这都是爷爷的亲信，他们愿意跟着我，那是当年的情分。”

“可是情分是用一次少一次的，所以还得靠实力说话，你现在是还小，但是总算是过了高考这一关了，不是南市的A大么？这样也可以趁课余时间多去公司看看。”

宋郁坐在老人身侧，垂着眼眸点头，他其实也知道，华秉被他父亲弄得一团糟……

“除了这件事之外。”

“爷爷也想问问你，以后的日子有没有追求？公司的事是很繁杂的，它并不有趣，爷爷当年的想法很简单，就是给家人提供最好的生活，以此为动力。”

“小郁，我是有私心想把心血交给你，但我也不想你只是因为爷爷个人而选择接受，你有没有什么追求呢？”
chunks.englishText:
"My bunny is the most invincible and adorable treasure in the whole world, my bunny is the most invincible and adorable treasure in the whole world."

Maoqiu: "..."

Its guardian quickly returned to normal and began reaching out to welcome it:

"Baby, come here!"

The pygmy rabbit immediately ran over and gave a bear hug, but just then, the guardian handed over a small porcelain bowl.

It was filled to the brim with bright green rabbit food.

"..."

"Eat up."

Not everyone has a high level of acceptance. Even if some people run into ghosts, they still maintain the mindset of protagonists in horror movies, refusing to believe it until the end, eventually attributing it to having a cold or a fever.

The guardians are the same. It’s not that they can’t accept it, but that they need time to adapt...

Some take months, some take years.

Even Song Yu doubted himself for a long time until he finally accepted it completely.

And the only exception was Song Zhengguo.

"Why hasn't Xiao Yu brought his partner out yet?"

"This child is really something."

Chen Kaihe paced back and forth in his living room, while his old friend sat steadily on the sofa, head bowed, looking over some company documents he had brought with him.

Seeing him like this made Chen Kaihe angry. He walked over and said:

"You're his biological grandfather, why aren't you concerned? Xiao Yu is an adult now. In this social climate, it's hard to find a wife. How can he just act like nothing happened?"

"He's a man! He needs to take responsibility!"

"Doing that in the living room... oh my."

The old man had worked himself into a red-faced frenzy. Although Song Yu wasn't his biological grandson, he was no different from one. He took these major life events very seriously.

Song Zhengguo just smiled at this. "Aren't you a proponent of the single life? Why are you worrying about this?"

Chen Kaihe frowned: "How can you be like this?"

"Xiao Yu has already had intimate physical contact with the other person. If you ask me, they should just get engaged immediately."

"That’s the only way to do right by her."

Hearing this, Song Zhengguo paused in his page-turning, seemingly deep in thought. But just then:

"Have you seen Xiao Yu's girlfriend?"

"Do you have a photo?"

Of course, Song Zhengguo hadn't seen her. He could only tell that his grandson was lying, and the fact that there was no one else in the villa.

He thought for a moment, "Do you think it's possible that we were too tired that day and had a hallucination..."

Song Zhengguo felt that wouldn't work halfway through his sentence. He closed his eyes and simply said:

"I've seen her."

Chen Kaihe became excited all of a sudden, not even bothering to analyze what his old friend had just said. He sat over and kept asking:

"How is she? How is she?"

Song Zhengguo hesitated, then carefully replied:

"She likes to eat crab roe buns."

-

The bird finished its "morning tea"—or more accurately, afternoon tea—before happily heading home.

Song Yu's grandfather was waiting at the dining table, having not touched his dinner yet. He only looked up when he heard the commotion.

"You're back?"

Before Song Yu could even speak, his shoulder felt light as the bird fluttered its wings and landed, performing a perfect sliding stop on the marble tabletop.

"Not bad."

The old man clapped his hands in support.

Bai Linlin walked back and forth twice in front of the new member, showing off its wings and performing a "Great Peng Spreading Its Wings."

A bird must maintain a perfect image in front of new members!

"Grandfather, you could have started eating first."

The young man pulled out a chair and sat down, speaking very gently.

Song Zhengguo just shook his head and replied warmly, "What are you saying? You and I aren't strangers."

The grandfather and grandson chatted about trivial matters, mostly avoiding the topic of Song Yu's parents, asking instead about his studies and how he met the little bird.

Bai Linlin had been surveying its territory on the dining table, but after a while, it noticed a small plate had appeared in front of it, filled with familiar apple chunks and Wangzai mini buns.

!

"...That's how it is. The auntie left for a while, but I rehired her."

"She's a very good person; she even makes clothes for my little bird."

Song Zhengguo was actually quite relieved. Being able to make one's own decisions and take action is a rare personal quality. It seemed the child was gradually finding his way out of the dark.

The old man looked back.

The bird was still wearing its little cape, though the hood had fallen off. It was currently focused intently on eating a Wangzai bun.

"The clothes look nice."

As soon as Bai Linlin heard this, it immediately looked up, walked over with a patter, and began to show off.

Front.

Side.

Back.

Song Yu was actually a bit embarrassed, but by this time, the bird was already standing on his grandfather's hand, looking up very seriously.

The bird's eyes were round.

It even took a look at him and chirped.

Song Yu didn't know if it was because they had been together for a long time or what, but he suddenly understood what it meant.

He reached out and unfastened the cape on the bird, revealing its true form.

Bai Linlin was very satisfied and showed off again.

Front.

Side.

Back.

Song Zhengguo immediately understood and said with a smile:

"The bird is also very good-looking."

Bai Linlin won a complete victory, hopped down proudly, and walked back to its little plate to finish the remaining apple chunks.

The dining room was filled with warmth and harmony.

-

At night, in the bedroom.

The bird was studying the management manual on the desk, pressing its claw against the page, completely absorbed.

In reality, it was just because it had nothing else to do; Song Yu had been called to the study by his grandfather.

Bai Linlin didn't actually know what its human form looked like, but according to this Monster Manual, it was still unstable and needed to take things step by step.

In layman's terms:

First, learn to control changes in the original form.

Then, practice more demanding shapeshifting.

Powerful monsters could even turn into "humans" of different genders and ages.

Seeing this, Bai Linlin specifically checked the footnote.

——The "different genders" here refers only to the appearance after shapeshifting; the monster's own biological sex does not change.

Quite comprehensive.

Bai Linlin looked back at the bedroom door; it was quiet.

Very good.

He probably wouldn't be back immediately.

The bird slammed the manual shut with one claw and walked to the bathroom, feeling eager to try.

After all, the last time was a special case where its monster power had run wild, leaving it with no idea what it looked like after shifting.

Hmm...

The bird looked down. It wanted to see those two ankle rings, but the feathers on its chest were too fluffy, and it couldn't see them.

So, it had to stretch its bird legs hard.

Bai Linlin pondered, with these, it should be fine, right?

Action speaks louder than words.

For some reason, the bird peeked around guiltily, then pushed open the bathroom door crack, went inside, and kicked the door shut with one claw.

-

In the study.

"Grandfather is getting old, and I'm finding it increasingly difficult to handle Hua Bing's affairs. That's why I called you last time."

Song Zhengguo spoke very gently to his grandson. "But things at the company have stabilized much more now. These are all my trusted aides; they are willing to follow me because of the bonds we formed years ago."

"But those bonds wear thin every time you use them, so you have to rely on strength. You are still young, but you've finally passed the college entrance exam. Isn't it A University in Nanshi? You can take advantage of your spare time to visit the company more often."

Song Yu sat beside the old man, eyes lowered, nodding. He actually knew that Hua Bing had been left in a mess by his father...

"Besides this."

"Grandfather also wants to ask you, do you have any pursuits for the future? Company matters are very complex and not very interesting. My original idea back then was simple: to provide the best life for my family, using that as my motivation."

"Xiao Yu, I have selfish motives in wanting to hand over my life's work to you, but I don't want you to choose to accept it just because of me. Do you have any pursuits of your own?"
"""

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国是知道宋郁生了病的事的，但是他始终刻意地不去提，只能是以很委婉的方式来问一问，试图了解孩子的想法。

宋郁没有什么活着的目标，可以说在这整整十八年，他总是陷入了一种名为“父母”的泥沼，挣脱不得，为其所困，直到他碰见自己的小鸟。

那些图像记忆在闪回，鸟打游戏，鸟贴贴，鸟为了他冲锋陷阵，鸟伸翅膀让他靠……

“我只想养好我的小鸟。”

宋峥国闻言愣住了，好半天没缓过神来，也不知道说什么。

只是想起来了自己那方面的朋友……

-

宋郁是在十点多回的卧室，他在思忖怎么同自己的小鸟解释未来几天可能白天不会长时间在家的事。

他要去公司。

不过就在推开卧室门的时候，房间里空空荡荡的，宋郁蹙了蹙眉，环顾四周，刚要喊：

“粼——”

浴室里开着灯，里面隐约有个蹲着的少年影子，双手抱着膝盖，很老实的样子。

宋郁立马就要去开门，但里面的“人”死死地抵住了，闷声闷气地道：

“你不要进来！”

“我没穿衣服……”

鸟忘了。

宋郁愣了下，但很快反应过来，蹲下身子道：

“那变回小鸟，好不好？”

里面的少年更郁闷了，瓮声瓮气地道：

“变不回去。”

“我不知道怎么弄了。”

“脚环它不变大，我……戴不上去。”

一开始还是委委屈屈的，后面就是生气了，大声地道：

“宋郁！”

“浴室里为什么没毛巾了！”

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：人，说话！
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo knew that Song Yu had been ill, but he deliberately avoided mentioning it, only asking in a very tactful way, trying to understand the child's thoughts.

Song Yu had no goals in life. It could be said that for these entire eighteen years, he had been trapped in a quagmire called "parents," unable to break free, until he met his little bird.

Those mental images flashed back: the bird playing games, the bird cuddling, the bird charging into battle for him, the bird spreading its wings to let him lean on it...

"I just want to take good care of my little bird."

Song Zhengguo was stunned by these words. It took him a long time to recover, and he didn't know what to say.

He only thought of his friend who was in a similar situation...

-

Song Yu returned to the bedroom after ten o'clock. He was pondering how to explain to his little bird that he might not be home for long periods during the day for the next few days.

He had to go to the company.

However, when he pushed open the bedroom door, the room was empty. Song Yu frowned, looked around, and was just about to call out:

"Lin—"

The bathroom light was on, and there was a faint shadow of a boy squatting inside, hands hugging his knees, looking very well-behaved.

Song Yu immediately went to open the door, but the "person" inside pushed against it firmly, saying in a muffled voice:

"Don't come in!"

"I'm not wearing any clothes..."

The bird had forgotten.

Song Yu was stunned, but quickly reacted, squatting down and saying:

"Then turn back into a little bird, okay?"

The boy inside was even more depressed, his voice muffled:

"I can't turn back."

"I don't know how to do it anymore."

"The ankle ring won't get bigger, I... I can't put it on."

At first, he sounded aggrieved, but then he got angry and shouted:

"Song Yu!"

"Why is there no towel in the bathroom!"

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Human, speak!

chunks.chineseText:
第35章

宋郁其实是愣了一下，因为他没有想到这件事还会有自己的错，但他很快就反应过来了，语气认真地同浴室里的“少年”道：

“是我的错。”

“是我把毛巾拿到楼下洗衣房了。”

里面的“少年”闻言更生气了，一声不吭的，自顾自地把脸侧开了。

宋郁脑海里浮现的全是那只蓝羽小鸟歪头不理人的样子，他唇角微微向上抿了下，只是道：

“我现在去给你拿衣服，好不好？”

“浴室里有浴霸，会开吗？”

“往里走一下，墙上有个开关。”

宋郁很耐心地指导着，但一门之隔的“少年”一动不动，就是这么蹲着。

“怎么了？”

他只能再次问，直到里面传出来闷闷的声音：

“磨砂玻璃的，有影子。”

“你不要看。”

宋郁先是一怔，而后面色都有些泛红了，他不知道鸟是怎么能够注意到这些的，但他还是答应了，立马起身去衣柜那里了。

白粼粼在浴室里蹲着，眼睛圆圆的，确定人走了，才快速地起身去打开那个浴霸开关了。

有暖风吹了过来。

“少年”很满意。

伸了伸翅根……

白粼粼愣住了，觉得自己的动作莫名其妙的，他为什么要伸胳膊？

“……”

不过就在他准备继续在门口蹲着的时候，余光扫到了旁边的镜子，他不由得又看了几眼。

里面的“少年”其实和自己上辈子长得一模一样，要真的说区别的话……

白粼粼抬手扯了下头发，垂眸去看，是浅蓝色的，他拉直，然后又松开，发尾又形成了浅浅的弧度。

像coser。

鸟看向镜子，站定，侧身，然后转了个圈。

好看！

宋郁这会也从隔壁房间拿过来浴巾了，顺带把这几天送过来的新衣服拿了过来，他走到浴室门口，刚想要开口说话。

嘎吱——

门开了个缝，里头伸出一截细白的手腕。

宋郁递过去还是不放心，毕竟他的小鸟第一次当人，恐怕没什么经验，于是他问了下：

“会穿衣服吗？”

白粼粼一听就面红耳赤的，这说的什么话，他当然会！

门咣当一下被关紧了。

宋郁：“……”

大约是四五分钟后。

宋郁本来还在看鸟放在书桌上妖怪手册，但是却听到了身后的动静，不由得回头看了过去。

“少年”穿的是一个很规矩的短袖衬衫，条纹棕色的，下面是配套的西服短裤，系着皮质腰带的那种。

不过因为没有鞋子，是光着脚出来的。

“少年”皮肤白皙，站姿乖巧。

“宋郁！”

白粼粼非常骄傲地仰了仰头，抬起来手，转了两圈。

他化形之后的身高大约是一米七五，比上辈子是要缩水一些的，但是鸟接受良好，因为001化形之后还没有他高！

鸟平衡了。

白粼粼觉得自己第一次亮相还是很不错的，转完圈等待夸奖。

但是人似乎愣住了。

？

宋郁就这么看着“少年”一步步地朝着他走过来，微微抬着下巴，盯着自己，然后又转了一圈。

人反应过来了，哑着声音道：

“好看。”

白粼粼非常满意！

-

后面其实就是去拿过来了那个银色的脚环，很小，约莫就鸟腿那点的宽度。

宋郁在书桌的椅子上坐着，抬手翻了下那本妖怪手册，丹顶鹤既然给了，那这个东西应该不会坏。

“化形后难受么？”

他还是抽空问了下。

“少年”在后面抱着一袋子夏威夷果仁，脚上不仅穿上了拖鞋，还套上了袜子，看着很是有模有样的。

白粼粼摇头，完全没在乎那个脚环的事了，反正宋郁在替他看。

“那就好。”

人放下心，低头又在看那本妖怪手册，觉得应该会有这个“高阶稳定器”的用途说明。

白粼粼吃得差不多了，有点累了，他很自然地就去伸手搭在了宋郁的肩头，想上去……

但是刚做完这个动作。

“人”躯一震。

白粼粼立正了，一下子收回来了自己的手，宋郁也抬眸看了过来，不过他没有察觉到什么，只是看到他的小鸟站得很板正。

“怎么了？练习走路累了？”

宋郁说完这话就伸开了手，很自然地道：“过来吧。”

白粼粼“人”脑风暴，他是个鸟，鸟是不懂伦理的，但他芯子是个人，这样坐过去是不是很奇怪？

鸟挣扎，鸟犹豫。

穿着长筒袜的“人”腿往后挪了下。

宋郁面色微微变了，直接起身了，仍然温和地道：

“怎么了？”

白粼粼其实有些紧张，他心里总觉得是不能让宋郁知道他曾经是人的，万一对方……觉得很奇怪呢？

“我……”

鸟还在思考。

宋郁已经走到跟前了，垂眸看了过去，很直白地问：

“不是累了么？怎么离我远了？”

白粼粼一下子慌了，他都不知道这人怎么走这么快，磕磕巴巴地道：

“想……想上肩……但我现在不是小鸟。”

最终还是说了实话。

宋郁闻言后愣了下，很快那点阴沉的情绪烟消云散，只是伸了伸手，很耐心地道：

“还是可以上的。”

“什么时候都可以。”

白粼粼仰头看了过去：“……”

鸟好像非上不可了。

……

最后是坐到了对方的腿上，白粼粼垂着头，脸颊红了，他为什么要人形上来。

这好怪。

但是又不敢违背鸟设。

宋郁在椅子上看那个妖怪手册，其实一共有几个章节：一、妖怪历史概要；二、妖力的调动和使用；三、如何稳定化形。

非常简单的三部分。

但是没有关于“高阶稳定器”的。

他蹙了蹙眉，直到拿着手册往前匀速地翻，到了“引言”部分，下面有一长串的页下注：

——鉴于贫困、残疾、幼小妖怪能力不足的特殊情况，管理局会下发辅助工具，即“妖力稳定器”，可将其注入妖力收纳，大小随心而定。

白粼粼本来其实就有点累了，他坐上来一开始有点紧张兮兮的，后面就困了，下午吃了“早茶”，晚上又吃好几包坚果……

鸟闭眼。

“要注入妖力。”

宋郁抬眼看过去，手臂很稳地托着怀里的“少年”，耐心地道：

“来试一下，很简单的。”

白粼粼不想动，他反正有衣服穿了，就不能直接睡觉吗？

还有一周的时间的。

鸟厌学。

宋郁想了想，“如果学会化形了，粼粼就可以自己出门了。”

白粼粼抬了抬眼。

“我想办法给你办个身份证好不好？”

“这样可以买房子、买车子……出国也没有问题的。”

宋郁慢慢地说完，眼眸始终是看着怀里“人”的反应。

白粼粼有些动心，撑着手臂往前探了探身子，看向那个妖怪手册了。

学一下？

他又回头看宋郁，张了张唇，刚想开口——

“说到做到。”

鸟满意了。

连带着“人腿”也晃了两下。

-
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 35

Song Yu was actually stunned for a moment, because he hadn't expected that this matter could be his fault, but he quickly reacted and said to the "boy" in the bathroom in a serious tone:

"It's my fault."

"I took the towel to the laundry room downstairs."

The "boy" inside was even angrier when he heard this. He didn't say a word and turned his face away on his own.

Song Yu's mind was filled with the image of that little blue-feathered bird tilting its head and ignoring people. The corners of his lips curled up slightly, and he just said:

"I'll go get you some clothes now, okay?"

"There's a bathroom heater in there, do you know how to turn it on?"

"Walk inside a bit, there's a switch on the wall."

Song Yu guided him very patiently, but the "boy" separated by the door didn't move, just kept squatting like that.

"What's wrong?"

He could only ask again, until a muffled voice came from inside:

"It's frosted glass, there's a shadow."

"Don't look."

Song Yu was startled at first, and then his face turned a little red. He didn't know how the bird had noticed these things, but he still agreed and immediately got up to go to the wardrobe.

Bai Linlin was squatting in the bathroom, eyes round, and only after confirming the person had left did he quickly get up to turn on the bathroom heater switch.

Warm air blew over.

The "boy" was very satisfied.

He stretched his wing roots...

Bai Linlin froze, feeling that his movements were inexplicable. Why did he stretch his arms?

"..."

However, just as he was preparing to continue squatting by the door, his peripheral vision swept over the mirror next to him, and he couldn't help but take a few more looks.

The "boy" inside actually looked exactly the same as he did in his previous life. If there was any real difference...

Bai Linlin reached out to pull his hair and lowered his eyes to look; it was light blue. He straightened it, then let go, and the ends of his hair formed a faint curve again.

Like a coser.

The bird looked at the mirror, stood still, turned to the side, and then spun around.

Beautiful!

Song Yu had also brought over a bath towel from the next room, along with the new clothes that had been delivered over the past few days. He walked to the bathroom door, just about to speak.

Creak—

The door opened a crack, and a slender, white wrist reached out.

Song Yu handed it over, still worried. After all, his little bird was being a human for the first time and probably didn't have any experience, so he asked:

"Do you know how to put on clothes?"

Bai Linlin turned red with embarrassment as soon as he heard this. What kind of question was that? Of course he knew!

The door was slammed shut with a bang.

Song Yu: "..."

About four or five minutes later.

Song Yu had been looking at the Monster Manual the bird had left on the desk, but he heard movement behind him and couldn't help but turn around.

The "boy" was wearing a very proper short-sleeved shirt, striped brown, with matching suit shorts, the kind with a leather belt.

However, because he had no shoes, he came out barefoot.

The "boy" had fair skin and stood in a well-behaved posture.

"Song Yu!"

Bai Linlin lifted his head very proudly, raised his hands, and spun around twice.

His height after shapeshifting was about 1.75 meters, which was a bit shorter than in his previous life, but the bird accepted it well because 001 wasn't even as tall as him after shapeshifting!

The bird felt balanced.

Bai Linlin felt that his first appearance was quite good, and after spinning, he waited for praise.

But the person seemed stunned.

?

Song Yu just watched the "boy" walk toward him step by step, chin slightly raised, staring at him, and then spinning around again.

The person reacted, his voice hoarse:

"Beautiful."

Bai Linlin was very satisfied!

-

Later, they actually went to get that silver ankle ring. It was very small, about the width of a bird's leg.

Song Yu sat on the desk chair and flipped through the Monster Manual. Since the Red-crowned Crane had given it to him, this thing shouldn't be broken.

"Is it uncomfortable after shapeshifting?"

He still took the time to ask.

The "boy" was behind him holding a bag of macadamia nuts, wearing not only slippers but also socks, looking very much like a proper person.

Bai Linlin shook his head, not caring about the ankle ring at all; Song Yu was looking after it for him anyway.

"That's good."

The man felt relieved and lowered his head to look at the Monster Manual again, thinking there should be an explanation for the use of this "high-level stabilizer."

Bai Linlin had eaten enough and was a bit tired. He very naturally reached out and rested his hand on Song Yu's shoulder, wanting to climb up...

But just after doing this action.

The "human" body shook.

Bai Linlin stood at attention and immediately pulled his hand back. Song Yu also looked up, but he didn't notice anything, only seeing his little bird standing very straight.

"What's wrong? Tired from practicing walking?"

After Song Yu said this, he opened his arms and said very naturally: "Come here."

Bai Linlin's "human" brain stormed. He was a bird, and birds don't understand ethics, but his core was human. Would it be very strange to sit over like this?

The bird struggled, the bird hesitated.

The "human" legs in long socks moved backward.

Song Yu's expression changed slightly, and he stood up directly, still speaking gently:

"What's wrong?"

Bai Linlin was actually a bit nervous. He always felt that he couldn't let Song Yu know that he used to be a human. What if the other party... felt it was very strange?

"I..."

The bird was still thinking.

Song Yu had already walked up to him, looked down, and asked very bluntly:

"Weren't you tired? Why did you move away from me?"

Bai Linlin panicked all of a sudden. He didn't know how this person walked so fast, and he stammered:

"Want... want to get on your shoulder... but I'm not a little bird now."

He finally told the truth.

Song Yu was stunned when he heard this, but soon that bit of gloom dissipated. He just reached out his hand and said patiently:

"You can still get on."

"Anytime."

Bai Linlin looked up: "..."

It seemed the bird had to get on.

...

In the end, he sat on the other person's lap. Bai Linlin lowered his head, his cheeks flushed. Why did he have to come up in human form?

This was so weird.

But he didn't dare to go against his "bird persona."

Song Yu looked at the Monster Manual in the chair. It actually had several chapters: 1. A Brief History of Monsters; 2. Mobilization and Use of Monster Power; 3. How to Stabilize Shapeshifting.

Very simple three parts.

But there was nothing about the "high-level stabilizer."

He frowned, until he flipped the manual forward at a steady pace to the "Introduction" section, where there was a long string of footnotes:

——In view of the special circumstances of poor, disabled, or young monsters with insufficient ability, the Administration will issue auxiliary tools, namely "Monster Power Stabilizers," which can be used to store monster power, with the size adjustable as desired.

Bai Linlin was actually a bit tired. He was a little nervous when he first sat up, but then he got sleepy. He had "morning tea" in the afternoon and ate several bags of nuts at night...

The bird closed its eyes.

"Need to inject monster power."

Song Yu looked up, his arms supporting the "boy" in his arms steadily, and said patiently:

"Try it, it's very simple."

Bai Linlin didn't want to move. He had clothes to wear anyway, so couldn't he just go to sleep?

There was still a week left.

The bird hated studying.

Song Yu thought for a moment, "If you learn to shapeshift, Linlin can go out by yourself."

Bai Linlin lifted his eyes.

"I'll find a way to get you an ID card, okay?"

"That way you can buy a house, buy a car... going abroad won't be a problem either."

Song Yu finished speaking slowly, his eyes always watching the reaction of the "person" in his arms.

Bai Linlin was a little tempted. He leaned forward on his arms and looked at the Monster Manual.

Learn a little?

He looked back at Song Yu, opened his lips, and was just about to speak—

"I keep my word."

The bird was satisfied.

Even the "human legs" swayed twice.

chunks.chineseText:
最后还是晚上陪伴学习的，白粼粼的手指流动着金纹，一点点按照教程注入到那个银环上，说实话身体的感受是很……奇妙的。

像是可以自由地调动体内的“金线”。

抬手，对着那个小银环，一点点地注入妖力……

宋郁就这么看着，看着桌上的那个银环悬空，一点点变大，然后哐当一下掉下来。

怀里的“少年”非常高兴，转头就看了过来，很自然地用头去顶他的下巴。

但也就一两秒。

“少年”又愣住了。

白粼粼想给自己几巴掌，他总是忘记自己的形态，现在是“人形”，贴贴会很……很……

就在这时他的后颈被按了过去。

人低头抵了抵鸟的额头，很自然地鼓励：

“真棒。”

白粼粼一下子又美了，但面上还是不好表现得太明显，只是矜持地“嗯”了一声。

-

最后晚上睡觉的时候是戴上了脚环，宋郁抬手扣上的，“少年”躺在床上玩手机。

其实是在加购物车。

白粼粼已经想好了下下周带什么零食去管理局，培训只有一个月，他又不做任务，那岂不是每周都可以去基地开Party？

鸟高兴。

不过就在这时。

砰！

一只蓝羽小鸟水灵灵地站在了床铺上，白粼粼站在iphone屏幕上转了个身子，羽毛蓬松。

“你刚刚自己变了么？”

宋郁很温和地问了下，因为丹顶鹤说了这个新的稳定器没有“压制”，它只是疏导体内的妖力而已，如果掌握成熟了，他的小鸟是可以自由化形的。

白粼粼伸了伸翅膀，然后又收了收翅根，站直，挺胸抬头。

当鸟还是爽！

“啾啾！”

人话也不用说。

宋郁：“……”

-

翌日。

宋郁醒过来的时候，鸟是窝在他的脖子上的，小小一只，毛绒绒的。

那份说好了睡前再看两眼的“妖怪手册”早被一爪子踹下去了。

宋郁撑着身子坐了起来，鸟就这么迷迷糊糊地滑了下去，最后落入一个手掌心。

“粼粼？”

鸟睡得很沉，侧躺着，很文雅。

宋郁垂眸看着他的小鸟，觉得估计是前几天没睡好的缘故，也就没有叫醒，而是自己去洗漱了。

到了七点钟的时候。

白粼粼朦朦胧胧地觉得自己像是被拿了起来，听到了一些什么话，但是他太困了，就敷衍地“啾啾”了几声。

最后就是关门的声音。

人去公司了。

白粼粼睡到了日上三竿，一觉醒来才发现宋郁不在卧室，他在卧室里啪嗒啪嗒地走。

找了浴室，找了卧室门后，找了衣柜，找了床底下……

都没有找到。

最后扑棱翅膀上到书桌才看到了纸条：

——粼粼，白天我需要去华秉一趟，看公司的业务，中午十二点会回来，离开大约四个小时。

——罐子里有果仁，抽屉里有零食，爷爷一般在书房，他不会打扰你。不想学妖怪手册的内容就睡一会……

两张纸条。

鸟伸爪子挪掉一张才发现的，但是后面他又发现了第三张。

——你的朋友或许今天会来，记得看你的手机消息，我给你转了钱，今天可以花掉。

白粼粼好奇地去从床头捞出来自己的手机，点开果然发现了一笔转账，一千。

鸟心里暖暖的。

白粼粼心想自己还是刻苦学习一下，他站到了书桌那里，用爪子拿出来那个“妖怪管理手册”，仔仔细细地看了起来。

……

宋峥国其实在书房里看一些民俗书，大多是山魈鬼魅的事，有好有坏，还有些方术道法的记载。

似真似假，并不清楚。

他叹了口气，只是想起来他那个不争气的儿子说过的事。

一只身高将近两米的大鸟……扇他？

宋峥国摇了摇头，那分明是一只通了灵智的小鸟而已，并无恶意。

但就在这时，门口传来细细簌簌的动静。

宋峥国看书的动作一顿，抬眼看了过去……

书房门的把手在一上一下的，似乎有“人”在外面努力地转，最后终于成功了，门开了个缝隙。

外头有啪嗒啪嗒的动静。

宋峥国微微蹙了蹙眉，然后看到那个缝隙里挤过来一个圆滚滚的鸟头。

“啾！”

[你好！]

-

001此刻正迷茫地站在路边，车水马龙的，很挤，它的手机正在导航。

“绿灯了绿灯了，这孩儿怎么不走啊？”

“哎呀你别说，今天早市的排骨还真不错！”

……

001的身后嘈杂而又热闹，是人类在交谈，它很认真地让出来了道路，然后学着过了斑马线。

它平常是靠飞的，不太懂人类的交通规则。

但是那个“监护人”给的导航是地面的，001只能走一步看一步，每到路口就僵持一下。

分不清转向灯和直行灯。

明明都是一个颜色，为什么人类的车子一会直走一会拐弯。

不开车的人是怎么走的？

灯是绿色的他们会走，灯不是绿色的好像也会走。

这对于一只在天上飞的小雀来说还是太难了。

001费尽千辛万苦终于走到了一个地铁口，然后看到了旁边卖烤肠的摊子，它走了过去。

“三块钱一个，五块钱俩，帅哥要几个？”

001想了想，可以给247带一个，于是它拿出了一张五块钱的纸币：

“两个。”

老板很麻利地做好了，放到了两个袋子里，给递了过去，其实收钱的时候还挺意外的。

这年头还有人习惯用纸币的……

001其实是没学会怎么扫码。

但就在这时，身后又响起了那两位女士的声音：

“要我说那宋启明就是个蠢货，自己亲儿子放着不闻不问，上赶着去照顾那个三儿……现在这样也是活该！”

“那真是，不过小郁好歹是没有随了他那没脑子的爹，这孩子似乎考上A大了……”

“宋郁啊？这孩子长得又高又帅的，就是摊上了个不负责任的爹妈。”

001提取关键信息，愣愣地就跟在她们后面了。

“行了，我走几步路就到锦园了，拜拜！”

其中一位女士很自然地对另一位挥手，在路口两个人分开了。

但不知怎么的，她总觉得背后有个脚步声，女人一个猛回头。

地面上有一只圆滚滚的小雀儿。

“啾啾！”

001很谨慎地叫了两声。

见这个人类没有反应，它有点尴尬，但突然想起来新学的招式，开始把鸟头歪了歪，梳理羽毛。

“……”

-

与此同时，锦园。

宋峥国其实眉毛微微抬了下，他没有想到鸟儿会来找他，老人眉眼温和地看了过去。

地板上的小鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走了过来，站定，仰头看人。

宋郁是说了爷爷不会打扰鸟，但没说鸟不能打扰老人。

白粼粼扑棱了下翅膀，飞到了书桌上，大摇大摆地走了过来，站在一个宣纸的边边。

“啾啾！”

宋峥国也就放下了那本闲书，很和蔼地伸手指了指，解释道：
chunks.englishText:
In the end, it was the evening study session. Bai Linlin’s fair, shimmering fingers flowed with golden patterns, injecting them bit by bit into the silver ring according to the tutorial. To be honest, the physical sensation was... quite marvelous.

It felt as if he could freely mobilize the "golden threads" within his body.

He raised his hand, aiming at the small silver ring, and channeled his demonic energy into it, bit by bit...

Song Yu watched as the silver ring on the table hovered in mid-air, grew slightly larger, and then—*clatter*—fell back down.

The "young man" in his arms was overjoyed. He turned his head and, with a very natural movement, nudged his chin against Song Yu’s.

But it only lasted a second or two.

The "young man" froze again.

Bai Linlin wanted to slap himself. He always forgot his current form; he was in "human form" now, and cuddling like this was... very... very...

Just then, the back of his neck was pressed forward.

Song Yu lowered his head, resting his forehead against the bird’s, and offered some natural encouragement:

"Well done."

Bai Linlin felt wonderful again, though he tried not to show it too obviously on his face, merely letting out a reserved "Mm."

-

When it was time to sleep that night, the ankle ring was put on. Song Yu reached out to fasten it, while the "young man" lay on the bed playing on his phone.

Actually, he was just adding items to his shopping cart.

Bai Linlin had already decided what snacks to bring to the Management Bureau for the upcoming weeks. The training only lasted a month, and since he wasn't doing any missions, wouldn't that mean he could go to the base to party every week?

The bird was happy.

But just then—

*Poof!*

A small blue-feathered bird stood vividly on the bed. Bai Linlin stood on the iPhone screen and turned around, his feathers puffed up.

"Did you transform on your own just now?"

Song Yu asked gently. The Red-Crowned Crane had said that this new stabilizer didn't "suppress" anything; it merely channeled the demonic energy within. If he mastered it, his little bird would be able to shapeshift freely.

Bai Linlin stretched his wings, tucked the roots of his feathers, stood tall, and puffed out his chest.

Being a bird was just so satisfying!

"Chirp chirp!"

No need to speak human language.

Song Yu: "..."

-

The next day.

When Song Yu woke up, the bird was nestled against his neck—a tiny, fluffy ball.

The "Monster Handbook" that they had agreed to look at before bed had long since been kicked off the bed by a stray claw.

Song Yu propped himself up to sit, and the bird slid down in a daze, eventually landing in the palm of his hand.

"Linlin?"

The bird was sleeping soundly, lying on its side, looking very elegant.

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at his little bird, guessing it was because he hadn't slept well the past few days, so he didn't wake him and went to wash up instead.

By seven o'clock.

Bai Linlin felt groggily as if he were being picked up. He heard some words, but he was too sleepy, so he just gave a perfunctory "chirp" or two.

Finally, there was the sound of the door closing.

The human had gone to the company.

Bai Linlin slept until the sun was high in the sky. When he finally woke up, he realized Song Yu wasn't in the bedroom. He began to trot around the room, *pitter-patter, pitter-patter*.

He checked the bathroom, behind the bedroom door, the wardrobe, under the bed...

He couldn't find him anywhere.

Finally, he flapped his wings and landed on the desk, where he saw a note:

—Linlin, I need to go to Huabing today to check on the company's business. I’ll be back at twelve noon, away for about four hours.

—There are nuts in the jar and snacks in the drawer. Grandpa is usually in the study; he won't disturb you. If you don't want to study the Monster Handbook, just take a nap...

There were two notes.

The bird used his claw to move one aside and discovered a third one underneath.

—Your friend might come today. Remember to check your phone messages. I’ve transferred some money to you; feel free to spend it today.

Bai Linlin curiously fished his phone out from the headboard and clicked it open, finding a transfer of one thousand yuan.

The bird felt a warmth in his heart.

Bai Linlin decided he should study hard. He stood at the desk, used his claw to pull out the "Monster Management Handbook," and began to read it carefully.

...

Song Zhengguo was actually in the study reading some folklore books, mostly about mountain demons and ghosts—some good, some bad—along with records of Taoist arts and spells.

Whether they were true or false, it was hard to say.

He sighed, thinking of what his good-for-nothing son had said.

A giant bird nearly two meters tall... slapped him?

Song Zhengguo shook his head. That was clearly just a small bird with a bit of spiritual intelligence; it had no malicious intent.

But just then, there was a rustling sound at the door.

Song Zhengguo paused his reading and looked up...

The handle of the study door was moving up and down, as if someone outside was trying hard to turn it. Finally, it succeeded, and the door creaked open a crack.

There was a *pitter-patter* sound outside.

Song Zhengguo frowned slightly, then saw a round, fluffy bird head squeeze through the gap.

"Chirp!"

[Hello!]

-

001 was currently standing on the side of the road, feeling lost. The traffic was heavy and crowded, and its phone was navigating.

"The light is green, it's green! Why isn't this kid moving?"

"Oh, you know, the pork ribs at the morning market today are really good!"

...

Behind 001, it was noisy and bustling with humans chatting. It carefully stepped aside to let people pass, then mimicked them to cross the crosswalk.

It usually relied on flying and didn't really understand human traffic rules.

But the navigation given by its "guardian" was for ground travel, so 001 had to take it one step at a time, freezing at every intersection.

It couldn't tell the difference between a turn signal and a straight-ahead light.

They were all the same color, so why did human cars go straight sometimes and turn at others?

How did people who didn't drive get around?

They walked when the light was green, but they seemed to walk when it wasn't green, too.

This was still too difficult for a little sparrow that usually flew in the sky.

After much struggle, 001 finally reached a subway entrance and saw a grilled sausage stall nearby. It walked over.

"Three yuan each, five for two. How many do you want, handsome?"

001 thought about it; it could bring one for 247, so it took out a five-yuan bill:

"Two."

The boss efficiently prepared them, put them in two bags, and handed them over. He was actually quite surprised when he took the money.

Hardly anyone used paper money these days...

001 actually hadn't learned how to scan a QR code.

But just then, the voices of the two ladies from earlier sounded behind it:

"I’m telling you, that Song Qiming is a fool. He ignores his own son and goes out of his way to take care of that mistress... He deserves what he gets!"

"That’s for sure. But at least little Yu didn't take after his brainless father. That kid seems to have gotten into A University..."

"Song Yu? That kid is tall and handsome, just saddled with irresponsible parents."

001 extracted the key information and, in a daze, followed behind them.

"Alright, I’m just a few steps from Jinyuan. Bye!"

One of the ladies waved naturally at the other, and they parted ways at the intersection.

But for some reason, she felt like there were footsteps behind her. The woman spun around suddenly.

On the ground was a round, little sparrow.

"Chirp chirp!"

001 chirped twice cautiously.

Seeing the human didn't react, it felt a bit awkward, but suddenly remembered a newly learned trick and began to tilt its head and preen its feathers.

"..."

-

Meanwhile, at Jinyuan.

Song Zhengguo’s eyebrows lifted slightly. He hadn't expected the bird to come looking for him. The old man looked over with gentle eyes.

The little bird on the floor walked over with a *pitter-patter*, stood still, and looked up at him.

Song Yu had said Grandpa wouldn't disturb the bird, but he hadn't said the bird couldn't disturb Grandpa.

Bai Linlin flapped his wings, flew onto the desk, walked over in a swaggering manner, and stood on the edge of a piece of rice paper.

"Chirp chirp!"

Song Zhengguo put down his casual book and, with a kind smile, pointed a finger and explained:

chunks.chineseText:
“这是宣纸。”

白粼粼鸟眼一眯，啪嗒啪嗒走到砚台那里，伸爪子一按。

果不其然老人又道：“那是砚台。”

鸟故技重施，伸爪子搭在毛笔上。

“是毛笔。”

鸟觉得好玩，在桌上转了转，找到了笔筒，再次伸爪子按了过去，鸟眼圆圆地看向宋峥国。

超级期待。

“……是笔筒。”

白粼粼满意得很，扑棱翅膀飞到了宋峥国的肩头，收了收翅膀。

这个位置非常好。

很高！视野还很宽广！

宋峥国倒是有些受宠若惊，心情也有些愉悦，只是问：

“鸟儿要找我玩耍？”

白粼粼：“啾啾啾！”

“那……那我们来写个书法怎么样？”

宋峥国似乎也是起了兴致，这些天要么被公司的事拖累，要么就是那个不争气的儿子，倒是许久没有这么轻快过了。

老人拿起毛笔，在砚台上到了些许墨汁，细细地润了下笔，而后才着墨至宣纸上，行云流水，苍劲有力。

——粼粼。

“是这个名字，对吧？”

白粼粼一下子就高兴了，伸着翅膀就下来了，站在自己的名字边边，仰头看着老人：

“啾啾！”

[是的！]

宋峥国只是觉得小鸟叫的很有劲，倒是问了下，“鸟儿会学舌吗？”

“爷爷还没有见过……”

白粼粼心想这有什么，他扑棱翅膀站到了笔筒上，收了收翅膀，开始展示：

“举头望明月。”

阿姨当时教的，又排上用场了。

宋峥国看到后立马就是鼓掌，“好好！”

鸟很谦虚地侧了侧头。

-

宋郁此刻还在华秉熟悉业务，旁边的林董是他爷爷的亲信，也是当时提点宋启明后院起火的人，此刻正温文尔雅地道：

“小郁可以多来看看。”

“毕竟你的专业不是很前沿的么？到时候双修一下商科就很好了。”

“华秉现在其实比较陈旧了，它做的大多都是实业，虽然说也想要接轨现在的新兴产业，但是也面临着诸多的问题……”

宋郁是在听不错，但也抽出来三分心思在担心他的小鸟。

不知道起床了没有？

会不会无聊呢？

……

此刻书房里很是热闹。

白粼粼很高兴地伸爪子沾了沾墨水，在宣纸上印了下。

完美！

正好在自己名字旁边。

宋峥国看到后难免面带笑意，刚想要执笔给鸟儿画个水墨画，但就在这时——

“宋-郁。”

老人愣了下。

但宣纸边上的小鸟还在重复：

“宋-郁。”

白粼粼很期待地看着老人，直到对方从愣神变为温和一笑，了然道：

“小鸟让我写小郁的名字？”

“好。”

宋峥国心里哪里还有那些乱七八糟的事，他那个儿子指定是自己亏心事做多了才有的噩梦，这怎么可能和面前的小鸟有关系？

老人再次执笔，在“粼粼”的左侧写下了“宋郁”两个字，照样是力透纸背、颇有风骨。

鸟满意了。

啪嗒啪嗒在两个名字下方留下一串爪子印，最后稳稳地伸鸟腿，在“宋郁”这两个字的左侧，又努力地按了个印。

对称了。

老爷子爽朗大笑。

-

而此刻，001也终于“尾随”一个人类来到了锦园，后面的目标就好找多了，那个监护人说了，是12栋。

灰棕色小雀啪嗒啪嗒就要走了。

但那位邻居有些意外，蹲在门口道，“小鸟不是跟我回家的呀？”

001鸟爪还抬着一个。

有些尴尬。

“我还打算喂你点吃的呢。”

001站定了脚步，毛绒绒的身躯看着十分地乖巧，仰头看了过去。

等待。

人，可以喂的。

邻居一下子就笑了，推门喊过来自己的丈夫，分享道：

“哎呦，一只小伯劳跟了我一路了，上次的牛蛙肉有没有了？快给我点！”

001不费吹灰之力获得了食物，扑棱翅膀飞到了一个树杈子上，挑选好合适的位置，给叉到尖刺的凸起上了。

底下那对夫妇还在惊叹：

“小伯劳可真是老吃家……”

“爱串串哈哈。”

“拍个照拍个照！”

001对这种事很熟练了，站直了身躯，毛绒绒的，便于对方拍摄。

“哎呦，给我看看。”

“这小鸟好聪明的。”

但这对夫妇再一抬头看，那个树杈子上已经没有那只灰棕色的小雀了。

-

而此刻书房里还是很温馨。

白粼粼正在挺胸抬头地站着，确切地说是在摆pose，因为宋郁的爷爷还会画国画，对方拿出来了彩墨，寥寥几笔纸上就出现一只栩栩如生的小鸟。

“鸟儿来看。”

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地在书桌上走，避开了宣纸，但在桌面上留下来一个个黑色的爪子印。

“啾啾！”

鸟满意！

不过就在这时，书房的窗外突然传来了闷闷的敲击声。

一人一鸟回头看了过去。

宋峥国倒是有些意外，这是只伯劳鸟，这怎么学起来了啄木鸟？

不过更意外的还在后头，桌面上的这只鸟儿，扑棱翅膀就飞了过去。

对着玻璃一顿啾啾啾。

[你来啦！]

001：[你家好远。]

[对，所以宋郁才接送我的。]

001：[我没有问。]

……

两只小鸟一顿交流，倒是把宋峥国给吸引过去了，弯腰看了过去，问了问：

“鸟儿认识吗？”

白粼粼仰头看了过去，很有劲地“啾啾”了一声。

001其实有点担忧：[你确定我能进去吗？]

但就在这时——

宋峥国把窗户打开了，很温和地道：

“进来吧，鸟儿的朋友。”

-

中午时分。

宋郁还是提前从公司赶回来了，毕竟有些不放心家里，他不知道自己爷爷到底是保持个什么样的态度，但他总觉得那天的事已经被发现了。

不然爷爷不会什么都不问。

他从车上下来的时候还从后备箱拿出来了一袋子小香菇干、一盒子百香果酸奶、一罐子松果仁……

不过这个时候，正好门口也停了一辆车，宋郁抬头看了过去，意外地发现是陈开鹤，人都愣住了。

对方一见面就是道：

“小郁，正好你在，我跟你说，我们得好好商量商量你那对象的事……”

宋郁就知道是这样，陈爷爷耳聪目明的，根本就不像宋启明那么好糊弄……况且也不能用上次的招式。

他其实有点无措。

陈开鹤走近一看，“嚯，这么多零食？给对象买的呀？”

“……”

宋郁只能干巴巴地道：“没，我没对象。”

“这孩子，还骗我？”

“你爷爷都说见过了！”

宋郁闻言脸都白了。

但没办法，他只能先推辞过去，然后提着东西和陈爷爷一起进门，宋郁几乎已经预想到了中午会是什么复杂局面。

可就在进门之后——

客厅处的老人正在提笔写字，肩头一左一右站着两只毛绒绒的鸟。

时不时还啾啾几声。

活像是两个监工。
chunks.englishText:
"This is rice paper."

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes, walked *pitter-patter* to the inkstone, and pressed his claw onto it.

Sure enough, the old man said again: "That is an inkstone."

The bird repeated the trick, extending a claw to rest on the brush.

"That is a calligraphy brush."

The bird found it fun. He turned around on the table, found the brush holder, and pressed his claw onto it again, looking at Song Zhengguo with round eyes.

Super expectant.

"...That is a brush holder."

Bai Linlin was very satisfied. He flapped his wings and flew onto Song Zhengguo’s shoulder, tucking his wings in.

This position was excellent.

It was high! And the view was broad!

Song Zhengguo was a bit flattered, his mood lifting, and he simply asked:

"Does the bird want to play with me?"

Bai Linlin: "Chirp chirp chirp!"

"Then... shall we try some calligraphy?"

Song Zhengguo seemed to have taken an interest. These days, he was either bogged down by company matters or dealing with that good-for-nothing son; he hadn't felt this lighthearted in a long time.

The old man picked up the brush, poured some ink onto the stone, and carefully moistened the tip before applying it to the rice paper. His strokes were fluid, vigorous, and powerful.

—Linlin.

"That’s the name, right?"

Bai Linlin was instantly delighted. He hopped down, stood beside his name, and looked up at the old man:

"Chirp chirp!"

[Yes!]

Song Zhengguo just thought the bird’s chirping was very spirited, and he asked, "Can the bird mimic speech?"

"Grandpa hasn't seen it yet..."

Bai Linlin thought, *What’s so hard about that?* He flapped his wings, stood on the brush holder, tucked his wings, and began to perform:

"Raising my head, I gaze at the bright moon."

The auntie had taught him that back then, and it finally came in handy.

Seeing this, Song Zhengguo immediately clapped his hands, "Good, very good!"

The bird modestly tilted his head.

-

Song Yu was currently at Huabing, familiarizing himself with the business. Beside him was Director Lin, a trusted aide of his grandfather who had been the one to tip off Song Qiming about the "fire in the backyard" back then. He said with gentle elegance:

"Little Yu, you should come by more often."

"After all, isn't your major quite cutting-edge? It would be great to double-major in business later."

"Huabing is actually a bit dated now. Most of what it does is traditional industry. Although we want to align with emerging industries, we are facing many problems..."

Song Yu was listening well enough, but three-tenths of his mind was worried about his little bird.

Had he woken up yet?

Would he be bored?

...

At that moment, the study was very lively.

Bai Linlin happily dipped his claw into the ink and stamped it onto the rice paper.

Perfect!

Right next to his own name.

Seeing this, Song Zhengguo couldn't help but smile. He was just about to pick up the brush to paint a traditional ink wash painting for the bird, but just then—

"Song-Yu."

The old man was stunned.

But the little bird on the edge of the rice paper kept repeating:

"Song-Yu."

Bai Linlin looked at the old man expectantly, until the other’s stunned expression turned into a gentle smile, realizing:

"The little bird wants me to write Little Yu’s name?"

"Alright."

Song Zhengguo no longer had any of those messy thoughts in his heart. That son of his must have had nightmares from doing too many bad deeds; how could it possibly have anything to do with the little bird in front of him?

The old man picked up the brush again and wrote the characters "Song Yu" to the left of "Linlin," the strokes just as powerful and full of character.

The bird was satisfied.

He walked *pitter-patter* and left a string of claw prints below the two names, and finally, he steadily extended a bird leg and, to the left of the characters "Song Yu," tried his best to press another print.

It was symmetrical.

The old man laughed heartily.

-

Meanwhile, 001 had finally "trailed" a human to Jinyuan. The target was easier to find now; the guardian had said it was Building 12.

The gray-brown sparrow walked *pitter-patter* toward it.

But the neighbor was a bit surprised, squatting at the door and saying, "The little bird isn't coming home with me?"

001 still had one claw raised.

It was a bit awkward.

"I was planning to feed you something, too."

001 stood still, its fluffy body looking very well-behaved as it looked up.

Waiting.

Humans could be fed.

The neighbor laughed, pushed the door open, and called her husband over to share:

"Oh my, a little shrike followed me all the way here. Is there any bullfrog meat left from last time? Quick, give me some!"

001 obtained the food without any effort, flapped its wings, flew to a tree branch, chose a suitable spot, and skewered the meat onto a sharp thorn.

The couple below was still exclaiming:

"That little shrike is a real foodie..."

"Loves to skewer things, haha."

"Take a photo, take a photo!"

001 was very used to this. It stood tall, its fluffy body making it easy for them to photograph.

"Oh my, let me see."

"This little bird is so smart."

But when the couple looked up again, the gray-brown sparrow was no longer on the branch.

-

Back in the study, things were still very cozy.

Bai Linlin was standing tall with his chest puffed out—or rather, he was posing, because Song Yu’s grandfather was painting a traditional Chinese painting. The old man brought out colored ink, and with just a few strokes, a lifelike little bird appeared on the paper.

"Birdie, come look."

Bai Linlin walked *pitter-patter* across the desk, avoiding the rice paper but leaving black claw prints all over the desk surface.

"Chirp chirp!"

The bird was satisfied!

But just then, a muffled tapping sound suddenly came from outside the study window.

The human and the bird both looked over.

Song Zhengguo was a bit surprised. It was a shrike; why was it acting like a woodpecker?

But the even bigger surprise was yet to come. The bird on the desk flapped its wings and flew over.

It chirped and chirped at the glass.

[You’re here!]

001: [Your house is so far away.]

[Yes, that’s why Song Yu picks me up.]

001: [I didn't ask.]

...

The two little birds exchanged chirps, which attracted Song Zhengguo. He bent down to look and asked:

"Do you know this bird?"

Bai Linlin looked up and gave a spirited "chirp."

001 was actually a bit worried: [Are you sure I can go in?]

But just then—

Song Zhengguo opened the window and said gently:

"Come in, little bird’s friend."

-

At noon.

Song Yu returned from the company early; he was still a bit worried about things at home. He didn't know what kind of attitude his grandfather held, but he always felt that the events of that day had already been discovered.

Otherwise, his grandfather wouldn't have asked nothing at all.

When he got out of the car, he took a bag of dried shiitake mushrooms, a box of passion fruit yogurt, and a jar of pine nuts from the trunk...

However, at that moment, another car pulled up at the entrance. Song Yu looked up and was surprised to find it was Chen Kaihe. He was stunned.

The moment they met, the other man said:

"Little Yu, it’s a good thing you’re here. Let me tell you, we need to have a good talk about that partner of yours..."

Song Yu knew it would be like this. Grandpa Chen had sharp eyes and ears; he wasn't as easy to fool as Song Qiming... and he couldn't use the same trick as last time.

He was actually a bit flustered.

Chen Kaihe walked closer and looked, "Whoa, so many snacks? Did you buy these for your partner?"

"..."

Song Yu could only say dryly, "No, I don't have a partner."

"This child, still lying to me?"

"Your grandfather said he’s already met them!"

Song Yu’s face went pale at the words.

But there was no help for it. He could only put off the conversation for now and walk into the house with Grandpa Chen. Song Yu had almost anticipated what a complicated situation noon would be.

But after entering the house—

The old man in the living room was holding a brush, writing calligraphy, with two fluffy birds standing on his shoulders, one on each side.

They chirped from time to time.

They looked exactly like two supervisors.

chunks.chineseText:
第36章

宋郁一时半会都没有反应过来，直到旁边的陈开鹤率先说了话，语气相当惊奇：

“哎呦，这两个乖小鸟，峥国你怎么做到的？”

陈开鹤自顾自地走过去了，甚至忘记了来看孙媳妇的目的了，拿起来手机就要准备拍照。

宋郁还在后面站着，回了回神，把车钥匙放到了玄关那边，提着吃的进来了。

白粼粼听到动静就抬起鸟头看过来了，和人对视了……

一秒，两秒。

蓝羽小鸟扑棱翅膀就飞了过去，稳当当地站在了少年的肩头。

陈开鹤不由得惊叹一声，“真有劲呀。”

宋郁侧眸看了过去，眉眼温和，不过就在这时，一只灰棕色的小雀也扑棱翅膀飞了过来，落在了他另一个肩头。

001开启自动跟随。

宋峥国在客厅看到后摇了摇头，只是笑，最后收了毛笔道：

“鸟儿现在看上小郁了。”

这里说的很明显是两只，陈开鹤闻言就有点羡慕，毕竟他是研究鸟类相关的，见了还是很欢喜的。

他不由得走回宋郁面前，很乐呵地道：“鸟儿也上上我的肩头？”

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼收了收翅膀，非常骄傲的样子，矜持地伸了伸鸟腿。

陈开鹤啧啧称奇，真的把肩头靠过去了，这只蓝羽小鸟直接走了过去。

001看了下，无脑跟。

“哎呦哎呦。”

“峥国快给我拍个照。”

陈开鹤全然被幸福冲昏了头脑，连动都不敢动，一个劲地同自己老友要求道。

场面很混乱。

但不是宋郁想象的混乱。

-

白粼粼例行公事地拍完合影之后就又回到了宋郁的肩头，站得稳稳的，001也照旧跟了过来，没有半分犹豫。

“哎呀，就让我拍个照啊。”

陈开鹤是真的羡慕了，连说的话都带着点酸劲儿。

宋郁面色有些茫然，闻言也不知道该说什么话，也就在这时，客厅里传来了解围的声音：

“小郁。”

他回了下神，同陈爷爷简单说了几句，然后快步走到了茶几那里。

宋峥国这会儿刚收了笔，眉眼温和，只是抬眸问：

“今天上午顺利吗？”

宋郁如实地回答：“还好，基本了解公司现在情况，林董他……”

话都还没有说完，鸟已经又扑棱翅膀下来了，站在了笔筒上，爪子正在调整。

那只小雀也跟着下来，不过是站在茶几上，仰头看着蓝羽小鸟，好似对其马首是瞻。

宋郁其实有些走神。

“好了好了，不问你了。”宋峥国只是摆手笑了笑，转而指了指自己的画作，分享道，“看看爷爷画得如何？”

茶几上铺着一张很大的宣纸，侧面摆着调制好的彩墨以及笔架，看着尤为整齐。

画作的背景是竹丛，青色勾勒，寥寥数笔，显得幽静万分。

而细细的竹条上压着两只鸟，挤作一团，墨水晕染开来，显得羽毛蓬松而又自然。

宋郁都要看愣了，但这个时候笔筒那里又传出来点动静。

他不由得看了过去。

圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟在笔筒上已经调整好了位置，爪子扣得紧紧的，往旁边挪动了下，对着桌面上的那只啾啾了一下。

然后那只小雀也扑棱翅膀上来了，很认真地挤了挤，两只毛绒绒的鸟就这么贴着。

注意到了人的目光，两个鸟头还齐齐地回头看了过来。

宋郁：“……”

宋峥国看到后更是爽朗地笑了起来，只是伸手指了指那只灰棕色的小雀，同面前的少年道：

“这是鸟儿的朋友，你知道吗？”

“我……知道。”

就在这时，陈开鹤也背着手走过来了，刚才他编辑了个朋友圈，已经美美发出去了。

“这不是伯劳鸟吗？”

“可凶残了，小鸟不怕吗？”

白粼粼站在笔筒上，有点意外，侧头看了下自己的好朋鸟，啾啾地问：

[你是伯劳鸟？]

001：[是。]

[你凶残吗？]

001：[不凶残。]

鸟觉得也是，伸了伸翅膀，盖住了比它小一号的灰棕色小雀。

陈开鹤直接惊住了，老头又是蹲在地上一顿拍。

宋郁其实对这种场面有些无所适从，毕竟两个都是长辈，他还在想那天的事……

爷爷是知道，还是不知道？

“哎，对了，小郁啊，你那个对象……”

陈开鹤拍完终于想起来这件事了，仰头就直接说了。

白粼粼歪了歪头，什么东西？

但就在这时，宋峥国却出声打断了，只是温和地道：

“小郁，把你的鸟儿先带上楼？”

“我和你陈爷爷说下话。”

宋郁其实是愣了一下的，但很快还是反应过来了，朝着笔筒上的两只伸了下手。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀飞了上来，紧随其后的就是001。

宋郁很顺利地就带走了两只，不过在离开的时候还听到了客厅的一些交谈的声音：

“这不像你的风格啊，峥国……”

“这孩子十八了，真有对象应该负责任了……”

白粼粼：？

什么意思？

-

卧室。

“宋郁！”

“你什么时候有对象了？”

书桌上一只圆滚滚的小鸟仰头质问，肉色的小短喙一张一合的，很是气势汹汹的。

宋郁愣了下，俯身蹲下，让鸟不至于仰着头，只是解释：

“没有，是那天——”

人刚想要解释，但目光看向了旁边站着的灰棕色小雀。

鸟一个伸翅膀挡住，很生气地道：

“不能当着我的朋友讲吗？”

“还是你真的有了——”

宋郁没办法了，只能坦诚地道：

“是你那次发烧提前化形了，在我怀里，被看到了。”

空气一阵沉默。

鸟的小短喙还在张着，翅膀也还在伸着，此刻不知道是收还是放。

“粼粼。”

“我只有你一个小鸟。”

宋郁被误会也不生气，反而是很温和地摸了摸桌上小鸟的头，耐心地道：

“那你和朋友在卧室里玩一玩？爷爷那边我这么一直离开，不太合适的。”

说完人真的就起身走了。

卧室里安安静静的。

白粼粼还保持着这个“雕塑”模样，直到身后传来了啪嗒啪嗒的动静。

001歪头去问：

“你什么时候和你的监护人交配？”

-

宋郁刚从二楼下来，但发现客厅那里已经没人了，猜测两位老人可能去了一楼的茶室。

他本来抬步已经要走了，但是想起来什么，不由自主地走回了茶几那里。

这副画很淡雅，旁边还有题字：

肩头栖雅雀，丹青表意趣。

宋郁唇角微微勾了下。

不过这么一直晾着也不太好，他抬手打算收起来，但就在手伸过去的时候，不知怎么碰到了边缘处的一个“废弃”的卷轴。

直直地打开了。

宋郁垂眸看了过去，怔住了。

宣纸上的两个名字苍劲有力，对称排开，底下有一排排的爪子印，正好围成了个圈，像个爱心。

他的小鸟……

宋郁从前始终暗沉无光的瞳孔里泛出些光彩来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 36

Song Yu didn't react for a moment, not until Chen Kaihe, standing beside him, spoke first in a tone of utter astonishment:

"Oh my, these two well-behaved little birds! Zheng-guo, how did you manage this?"

Chen Kaihe walked over of his own accord, completely forgetting his original purpose of coming to see his grandson-in-law. He pulled out his phone, ready to snap a picture.

Song Yu remained standing behind, finally collecting his thoughts. He placed the car keys on the entryway table and carried the food inside.

Hearing the commotion, Bai Linlin lifted its bird head to look over, locking eyes with the human...

One second, two seconds.

The blue-feathered bird fluttered its wings and flew over, landing steadily on the young man's shoulder.

Chen Kaihe couldn't help but exclaim, "That's quite a bit of strength."

Song Yu glanced sideways, his expression gentle. Just then, a small grey-brown sparrow also fluttered its wings and landed on his other shoulder.

001 activated "Auto-Follow."

Seeing this from the living room, Song Zheng-guo shook his head with a smile. He finally set down his calligraphy brush and said:

"The birds have taken a liking to Xiao Yu now."

It was clear he was referring to both birds. Hearing this, Chen Kaihe felt a twinge of envy; after all, he studied birds, and seeing this scene brought him great joy.

He couldn't help but walk back to Song Yu and asked cheerfully, "Can the birds land on my shoulder too?"

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin tucked its wings in, looking incredibly proud, and primly extended a bird leg.

Chen Kaihe clicked his tongue in wonder. He leaned his shoulder over, and the blue-feathered bird hopped right onto it.

001 observed for a moment and followed suit, no questions asked.

"Oh my, oh my."

"Zheng-guo, hurry up and take a picture for me!"

Chen Kaihe was completely intoxicated by the happiness of the moment. He didn't even dare to move, repeatedly urging his old friend.

The scene was chaotic.

But it wasn't the kind of chaos Song Yu had imagined.

-

After Bai Linlin finished its routine photo session, it returned to Song Yu's shoulder, standing firmly. 001 followed suit without a moment's hesitation.

"Aiya, just let me take one more photo."

Chen Kaihe was truly envious; even his words carried a hint of sourness.

Song Yu looked somewhat dazed, not knowing what to say. Just then, a voice from the living room offered him a reprieve:

"Xiao Yu."

He snapped out of it, exchanged a few brief words with Grandpa Chen, and walked quickly toward the coffee table.

Song Zheng-guo had just set down his brush, his expression gentle. He looked up and asked:

"Did everything go smoothly this morning?"

Song Yu answered truthfully: "It was alright. I have a basic understanding of the company's current situation. Chairman Lin, he..."

Before he could finish, the bird had already fluttered down, landing on the brush holder and adjusting its claws.

The little sparrow followed, landing on the coffee table. It looked up at the blue-feathered bird as if it were its leader.

Song Yu was actually a bit distracted.

"Alright, alright, I won't pester you with questions." Song Zheng-guo waved his hand with a smile, turning to point at his painting to share it: "How does Grandpa's painting look?"

A large sheet of xuan paper was spread across the coffee table, with prepared colored ink and a brush rack set neatly to the side.

The background of the painting was a bamboo grove, outlined in green with just a few strokes, giving it an incredibly serene feel.

Perched on the thin bamboo stalks were two birds, huddled together. The ink had bled slightly, making their feathers look fluffy and natural.

Song Yu was stunned, but just then, there was more movement from the brush holder.

He couldn't help but look over.

The round, blue-feathered bird had found its position on the brush holder, gripping it tightly. It shifted to the side and chirped at the sparrow on the table.

Then, the sparrow fluttered its wings and hopped up, squeezing in very earnestly. The two fluffy birds pressed against each other.

Noticing the human's gaze, both bird heads turned to look at him in unison.

Song Yu: "..."

Song Zheng-guo laughed heartily when he saw this. He pointed at the grey-brown sparrow and said to the young man before him:

"This is the bird's friend, did you know?"

"I... know."

Just then, Chen Kaihe walked over with his hands behind his back. He had just finished editing a post for his social media circle and had already sent it out.

"Isn't this a shrike?"

"They're quite fierce, aren't they? Is the little bird not afraid?"

Bai Linlin, standing on the brush holder, was a bit surprised. It tilted its head to look at its good bird-friend and chirped:

[Are you a shrike?]

001: [I am.]

[Are you fierce?]

001: [I am not.]

The bird agreed, extending its wing to cover the smaller grey-brown sparrow.

Chen Kaihe was stunned. The old man squatted on the ground and started snapping photos again.

Song Yu felt a bit out of place with this scene. After all, both were his elders, and he was still thinking about that day...

Did Grandpa know, or did he not?

"Oh, right, Xiao Yu, that partner of yours..."

Chen Kaihe finally remembered the matter after he finished taking photos and asked directly.

Bai Linlin tilted its head. What partner?

But just then, Song Zheng-guo interrupted in a gentle tone:

"Xiao Yu, why don't you take your birds upstairs first?"

"I have something to discuss with Grandpa Chen."

Song Yu was momentarily stunned, but he quickly reacted and held out his hand toward the two birds on the brush holder.

Bai Linlin fluttered its wings and flew up, followed closely by 001.

Song Yu took the two birds away smoothly, but as he left, he heard some conversation from the living room:

"This doesn't seem like your style, Zheng-guo..."

"The child is eighteen; if he really has a partner, he should take responsibility..."

Bai Linlin: ?

What does that mean?

-

In the bedroom.

"Song Yu!"

"When did you get a partner?"

A round little bird on the desk looked up to question him, its short, flesh-colored beak opening and closing, looking quite aggressive.

Song Yu paused, leaning down so the bird wouldn't have to crane its neck, and explained:

"I don't. It was that day—"

He wanted to explain, but his gaze fell on the grey-brown sparrow standing to the side.

The bird extended a wing to block his view, saying angrily:

"Can't you say it in front of my friend?"

"Or do you really have one—"

Song Yu had no choice but to be honest:

"It was when you had that fever and transformed early. You were in my arms, and you were seen."

The air fell silent.

The bird's short beak was still open, and its wing was still extended, unsure whether to retract it or keep it out.

"Linlin."

"I only have you as my little bird."

Song Yu wasn't angry at being misunderstood; instead, he gently stroked the little bird's head on the desk and said patiently:

"Why don't you and your friend play in the bedroom? It wouldn't be appropriate for me to keep leaving Grandpa alone."

With that, he stood up and left.

The bedroom was quiet.

Bai Linlin remained in that "sculpture" pose until it heard a pattering sound behind it.

001 tilted its head to ask:

"When will you mate with your guardian?"

chunks.chineseText:
“好乖。”

-

卧室。

白粼粼听到001的话就急了，大声地反驳：

“我没有和他交——”

更奇怪了。

001羽毛蓬松，见到蓝羽小鸟一个蹦跶转头，它也啪嗒啪嗒地跟了过去，很认真地道：

“可是你不让他有对象。”

“不就是要留他——”

眼看着那两个字又要出来了，白粼粼彻底红温了，甚至妖力一个没收住，变成了人。

“少年”还是昨天的那副扮相，不过是很高调地蹲在书桌上，双手抱着膝盖，浅蓝色的头发蓬松，就是脸很红。

001有些欣慰，也化形了，不过它是站在了地板上，很认真地道：

“你学会了？”

“很好看。”

白粼粼本来正尴尬着的，但是一听这话，突然想起来什么，下地了，站直。

001：？

“我比你要高哎！”

黑衣少年：“……”

001调动了下妖力，身体开始逐步变高，直接到了一米八左右。

低头看“少年”。

白粼粼震惊：“为什么？”

001又回到了原来的身高，很不解地道：

“我们是妖怪。”

“到了S级，你可以幻化各种各样的人，噢，虽然管理局规定不可以这样，因为灰色名单上通缉的妖怪就是用这个捕杀人类的。”

白粼粼其实根本没太听后面的话，他只是眼睛亮亮地问：

“还可以让自己变高？”

“……”

-

开课了。

001幻化出来从地铁口买的烤肠，两根，一鸟一个。

白粼粼坐在宋郁的椅子上，双腿屈起，一个手抱着膝盖，一个手拿着烤肠。

唇瓣油油的。

桌子上的小雀正用爪子拿着签子，对着一本展开的“妖怪手册”讲解道：

“化形本质上就是意念调动，你只要充足的妖力，脑海中自己是什么样子，那就会变成什么样子。”

白粼粼心想那岂不是完美，他可以随意捏脸、捏身体？

好玩！

“但是，都是有持续时间的，最本质的化形还是要贴合自身的情况，我是小型鸟，化形成少年更轻便，也利于行动。”

说到这里，桌子上就出现了蹲着的黑衣少年，面色冷冷的，但是很认真地伸了伸胳膊，同椅子上吃得满嘴油的“老大”展示。

白粼粼好奇，“那衣服呢？为什么你第一次就有衣服？还有你从哪里带的烤肠？”

砰！

桌上再度恢复成一只小雀，很冷静自持地道：

“第一次实际上没有的。”

“都是后期买了衣服，然后再化形的话，就自带了。”

白粼粼看了下自己的小衬衫，心里放下了心，他以后化形应该不会……

等一下。

椅子上的“少年”坐直了身子，面红耳赤地问：

“妖怪第一次化形……都没衣服？”

“是的。”

-

茶室。

陈开鹤其实说得有些口干舌燥的，最后拿起来一杯茶，一口饮尽了，没有什么文人风度。

“我并不想插手小郁的婚事。”

宋峥国面色平静地道，顺道还给对面的老友又添了茶。

“啊？”

陈开鹤其实是有些意外的，他蹙眉道，“那你不能因为他父母那样就……”

“为什么不能。”

宋峥国的面容虽然已经苍老，但在热茶飘起来的雾气里仍然能看出棱角，他从前就不是个温和的人。

“他父母做成那个样子，两人犹如过家家，一起生的孩子弃之如敝履，再婚生的孩子当成竞争品……这能给小郁什么好的印象？”

“我看到那孩子手腕上的伤就觉得……”

陈开鹤确实也沉默了起来。

“传宗接代更不必提，我没有那个想法，我只有小郁一个孙子，他平平安安的就够了。”

宋峥国垂眸看着茶汤，清澈见底，倒映出来了他的脸。

他想了想：

“其实什么都无所谓，这孩子高兴就好。”

“我替他托底。”

-

宋郁收起来那两幅画之后，就起身准备去茶室，但是刚要敲门，里面就有交谈声响起：

“结不结婚其实没关系的，我赞同，这不能逼孩子……”

“但是，峥国，这小郁的女朋友不能藏着掖着吧？回头让我看看，我给那孩子打一套金饰！”

“货真价实，这肯定能让人家觉得咱们有诚意！”

宋郁：“……”

已经够多了。

不过就在这时。

“进来。”

屋内传来一道沉稳的声音。

宋郁没有丝毫意外，只能推门进去，眼眸微微垂着，已经在思考怎么应对这件事了。

“来坐下。”

宋峥国面容和蔼，只是拍了拍旁边的红木扶手椅。

少年这才坐了下来，没过一会面前有了杯热茶。

同时耳边响起来一句：

“你陈爷爷想要见见你的交往对象……”

宋郁拿茶的动作都顿住了。

但是很快他爷爷又接着道：

“你不是说那孩子最近忙着准备托福吗？来和你陈爷爷解释一下。”

宋郁不可思议地看了过去，但很快就反应过来了，侧头看向陈开鹤，尽可能流畅地说道：

“啊，对，它比我小一级，在备考出国的事。”

“很忙。”

陈开鹤闻言蹙了蹙眉，道：

“出国？那人家只是跟你玩玩呀？”

宋郁：“……”

-

卧室里还在进行一对一教学。

白粼粼在得知第一次化形没穿衣服后整个“人”都emo了，也不知道宋郁替他盖住了没……

不过看现在的情况，那应该是盖住的。

但……盖住了也很羞耻。

“你有在听吗？”

001站在书桌上，仰头看着椅子上的“少年”，面色困惑。

白粼粼深呼吸一口，最终选择翻篇，没关系的，没有人知道那是他！

“在听在听。”

白粼粼从善入流地敷衍道。

但下一秒——

001很高兴地道：“那太好了，你来试一下吧，先恢复原貌，然后再化形。”

“来回两次。”

空气变得沉默了起来。

白粼粼有点心虚了起来，这种情况类似于高中的时候被老师按着翻来覆去对一道题讲了三四遍，你明明还是不会，但看着对方已经要冒火了，只能假装会了，然而老师很期待地让你来捋一遍做题思路。

很绝望。

“咳咳。”

鸟硬着头皮试了下，那什么，意念，对意念，椅子上的少年闭上了眼睛，手指尖有金色纹路在游动。

砰！

椅子上多了一只圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟。

白粼粼震惊，他会了！

001也很高兴，直接从桌子上飞了下来，啪嗒啪嗒走到蓝羽小鸟的身边，也用翅膀搭了下247的身躯。

它刚学的。

“很好，你下来，再试试变人。”

“只要这个会了，后面就可以掌握进阶的技能了。”

001很认真地道，随后率先下到地板上了。

白粼粼说不激动是假的，他也扑棱翅膀下来了，站在001的对面。

两只小鸟相对而站。

“你试试，感受体内的妖力……”
chunks.englishText:
"Good boy."

-

In the bedroom.

Hearing 001's words, Bai Linlin panicked and loudly retorted:

"I am not mating with him—"

That sounded even weirder.

001's feathers were fluffy. Seeing the blue-feathered bird hop and turn around, it followed with a patter-patter, saying very earnestly:

"But you won't let him have a partner."

"Isn't that because you want to keep him—"

Seeing those two words about to come out again, Bai Linlin turned bright red. It even lost control of its demon power and transformed into a human.

The "young man" looked just like he had yesterday, but he was squatting on the desk in a very high-profile manner, hugging his knees. His light blue hair was fluffy, and his face was flushed red.

001 felt a sense of gratification and also transformed. However, it stood on the floor and said very seriously:

"You've learned it?"

"It looks very good."

Bai Linlin had been feeling awkward, but upon hearing this, it suddenly remembered something. It stepped down and stood up straight.

001: ?

"I'm taller than you!"

The black-clad youth: "..."

001 channeled its demon power, and its body began to grow taller, reaching about 1.8 meters.

It looked down at the "young man."

Bai Linlin was shocked: "Why?"

001 returned to its original height and said, looking puzzled:

"We are demons."

"Once you reach S-rank, you can transform into all sorts of people. Oh, although the Management Bureau forbids it, because the demons on the grey list use this to hunt humans."

Bai Linlin hadn't really listened to the latter part; its eyes were shining as it asked:

"You can also make yourself taller?"

"..."

-

Class was in session.

001 conjured up two sausages bought from the subway entrance—one for each bird.

Bai Linlin sat on Song Yu's chair, legs curled up, one hand hugging its knees and the other holding a sausage.

Its lips were oily.

The little sparrow on the desk was holding a skewer with its claws, explaining from an open "Demon Handbook":
