"Transformation is essentially the mobilization of intent. As long as you have sufficient demon power, you will become whatever you imagine yourself to be."

Bai Linlin thought that sounded perfect. It could sculpt its face and body at will?

How fun!

"However, there is a duration. The most fundamental transformation should fit your own circumstances. I am a small bird, so transforming into a youth is lighter and more conducive to action."

As it said this, the squatting black-clad youth appeared on the table, face cold but very serious, stretching its arms to demonstrate to the "boss" who was eating with an oily mouth on the chair.

Bai Linlin was curious: "What about clothes? Why did you have clothes the first time? And where did you get the sausages?"

*Poof!*

The table once again held only a little sparrow, which said calmly and self-composedly:

"Actually, you don't have them the first time."

"It's only after you buy clothes later that they come with you when you transform."

Bai Linlin looked at its little shirt and felt relieved. It shouldn't...

Wait a minute.

The "young man" on the chair sat up straight, face red as he asked:

"When a demon transforms for the first time... they don't have any clothes?"

"That is correct."

-

In the tea room.

Chen Kaihe was actually feeling a bit parched from all the talking. He picked up a cup of tea and downed it in one gulp, lacking any scholarly grace.

"I don't want to interfere in Xiao Yu's marriage."

Song Zheng-guo said calmly, taking the opportunity to refill his old friend's tea.

"Huh?"

Chen Kaihe was actually quite surprised. He frowned and said, "But you can't just because his parents were like that..."

"Why can't I?"

Although Song Zheng-guo's face was aged, one could still see the sharp edges in the mist rising from the hot tea. He had never been a gentle man.

"His parents acted the way they did, treating their marriage like a game of house, discarding the child they had together like trash, and treating the child from their remarriage as a competitor... What kind of good impression could that give Xiao Yu?"

"Whenever I see the scars on that child's wrists, I feel..."

Chen Kaihe fell silent.

"As for carrying on the family line, that's even less of a concern. I don't have that desire. I only have Xiao Yu as my grandson; as long as he is safe and sound, that is enough."

Song Zheng-guo looked down at the tea, clear to the bottom, reflecting his own face.

He thought for a moment:

"Actually, nothing else matters. As long as the child is happy."

"I will be his safety net."

-

After Song Yu put away the two paintings, he stood up, intending to go to the tea room. But just as he was about to knock, he heard voices from inside:

"It doesn't actually matter if he gets married or not. I agree; you can't force the child..."

"But, Zheng-guo, Xiao Yu's girlfriend shouldn't be kept hidden away, right? Let me see her sometime; I'll buy that child a set of gold jewelry!"

"The real deal! That will definitely make them feel our sincerity!"

Song Yu: "..."

That was already more than enough.

Just then:

"Come in."

A steady voice came from inside.

Song Yu wasn't surprised at all. He had to push the door open, eyes slightly lowered, already thinking about how to handle this.

"Come, sit."

Song Zheng-guo's face was kind as he patted the mahogany armchair beside him.

The young man sat down, and soon a cup of hot tea was placed before him.

At the same time, he heard:

"Your Grandpa Chen wants to meet the person you're seeing..."

Song Yu's hand froze as he reached for the tea.

But soon, his grandfather continued:

"Didn't you say that child is busy preparing for the TOEFL lately? Come and explain it to your Grandpa Chen."

Song Yu looked over in disbelief, but quickly reacted. He turned his head toward Chen Kaihe and said as smoothly as he could:

"Ah, yes, she's a year below me, busy preparing to go abroad."

"Very busy."

Chen Kaihe frowned upon hearing this:

"Going abroad? Then is she just playing around with you?"

Song Yu: "..."

-

In the bedroom, the one-on-one teaching continued.

Upon learning that one had no clothes during the first transformation, Bai Linlin felt completely emo. It didn't know if Song Yu had covered it up...

But looking at the current situation, he probably had.

But... even if covered, it was still so shameful.

"Are you listening?"

001 stood on the desk, looking up at the "young man" on the chair, its face full of confusion.

Bai Linlin took a deep breath and finally chose to turn the page. It didn't matter; no one knew that was him!

"Listening, listening."

Bai Linlin perfunctorily agreed.

But the next second—

001 said happily: "That's great, why don't you try it? First return to your original form, then transform."

"Do it twice."

The air fell silent.

Bai Linlin felt a bit guilty. This situation was similar to being in high school, where a teacher would force you to go over a problem three or four times. You still didn't know how to do it, but seeing the other person getting angry, you had to pretend you did. Yet, the teacher would expect you to walk them through the logic.

It was desperate.

"Cough, cough."

The bird bit the bullet and tried. Intent, right, intent. The young man on the chair closed his eyes, and golden patterns swirled on his fingertips.

*Poof!*

A round, blue-feathered bird appeared on the chair.

Bai Linlin was shocked; it had done it!

001 was also very happy. It flew down from the desk, pattered over to the blue-feathered bird's side, and draped its wing over 247's body.

It had just learned that.

"Very good. Now come down and try transforming into a human again."

"Once you master this, you can learn advanced skills later."

001 said very earnestly, then led the way to the floor.

Two birds stood facing each other.

"Try it, feel the demon power in your body..."

chunks.chineseText:
001甚至还一步一步地引导。

鸟闭上了眼睛，垂下了鸟头，翅膀上再次出现了流动的金色纹路。

“想象你化形……”

身躯一点点地变大，有种美妙的舒展感，白粼粼自我感觉良好。

直到睁开眼睛。

伟岸.jpg

鸟甚至看不到001了，胸膛的羽毛实在蓬松，他只好拘谨地往后挪了一小步。

001：“……”

灰棕色小雀很不可思议：

“你为什么又变大了？”

鸟：“……”

001：“你有没有好好地调用妖力？”

鸟：“……有的。”

001：“你怎么想象你化形的样子的？”

鸟：“……想变高来着。”

卧室里一阵沉默。

白粼粼为了不那么尴尬，正色道：“你不觉得变大很酷吗？”

001化成黑衣少年模样，很郁闷的样子：

“为什么我教不会你呢？”

鸟开导：“其实变大也挺不错的。”

黑衣少年面无表情地看了过去。

鸟伸了伸翅膀，宽广，巨大，遮风挡雨。

“真的。”

001只是道：“变大变小是幼鸟才这么玩的。”

白粼粼：“……”

鸟收回了翅膀，鸟眼一眯，决心要拉对方下水，开始劝说：

“你也变一下，真的很酷！”

001仰头看过去，语气有些低落，“可我还没有教会你化形。”

鸟：“你试一下嘛！”

鸟：“我还没有看过你变大。”

001面色茫然，它也要变？

白粼粼再接再厉：

“有一周的时间的，很宽松的，而且我们下午还可以出去玩的。”

鸟开始画大饼。

001砰的一下变成小雀，犹豫了下，不过问了下：

“这样真的很酷？”

鸟点头：“真的真的。”

001闭了闭眼，想象了下，身躯开始一点点地膨大。

……

但就在这时门外有了动静：

“下午还是要去公司，林董是个不错的人，小郁你多多地问他……”

“好。”

“鸟儿你不要担心，我来照顾，你来告诉我一些注意事项就可以……”

门发出嘎吱的动静。

宋郁刚一推开门，映入眼帘的就是两只巨大的鸟，身高将近两米，本来它们是互相对着的，但是听到动静又齐齐地看过来。

“……”

但身后的宋峥国还在往前走，很温和地道：

“也不知道两个小鸟在干什么。”

砰——

宋郁把门一下子给关上了，闭了闭眼，心脏跳得都有些快。

“怎么了？”

宋峥国蹙了蹙眉，索性越过自己孙子，抬手就推开了门。

“爷爷！”

宋郁是想要拦住的，但是来不及了，老爷子手劲不小，直接推开了。

他呼吸都停了，直到：

“这不是挺正常的吗？”

周遭的空气一下子又流动了起来，宋郁这才上前一步去看。

卧室里只有地板上的两只小鸟，正在纯良地看了过来。

“……”

一只蓝羽小鸟，一只小雀，此刻异曲同工地开始歪头梳理羽毛。

-

最后好说歹说是应付了过去，宋郁按照普通小鸟的注意事项告诉了自己爷爷。

但他还是得去公司。

不去会很反常。

毕竟现在没有正面撞见，那四舍五入就是可以维持现状。

妖怪的身份知道的人越少越好，即使是他的亲人。

宋郁临走的时候实在是不放心，在书桌那里又仔仔细细地检查了鸟的脚环。

白粼粼早扣好了，心虚地低着鸟头。

“001，我的小鸟它太小了，如果它控制不住了，麻烦你多帮一下它。”

宋郁还是很认真地道。

001：“……”

247一点也不小。

“好的。”

灰棕色小雀还是答应了。

-

时间推移至下午。

陈开鹤去而复返，顺带拿了两张动物园的门票，他也想清楚了，没有必要干涉小郁的婚事，这孩子健健康康就最好了。

不过老友也不能太沉浸在那些事上，说到底他是植物人了，是真的没有办法去保护小郁……

那孩子腕骨上的刀痕。

“……唉。”

老人到了书房就劝人跟他出去溜达，说南市的动物园值得一看，里面的小动物被养得体格健壮的，让人看了心情就好。

陈开鹤绘声绘色地道：

“你不是说当年从军还见过什么‘山神’，长着角的？南市动物园就有鹿！走走，出去看看！”

宋峥国只是温和一笑，“当年是看错了。”

“我还要替小郁照顾小鸟的。”

书桌上的两只毛绒绒的鸟对视了一下，然后啪嗒啪嗒地走到宋峥国的面前。

“啾啾啾！”

白粼粼立马开始表态。

001有些犹豫地“啾”了一下。

宋峥国抬了抬眉，看向那只蓝羽小鸟，温和地问：

“怎么了？”

白粼粼的字典里就没有“老实”这两个字，他扑棱翅膀飞到另外一个老头手里，叼出来那张门票。

啪嗒啪嗒地在桌子上走。

很认真地塞进了宋峥国的手心里。

人，鸟要去。

两个都要去。

-

宋郁下午眉心一直在跳。

他现在倒是不担心他的小鸟出问题了，他比较担心他爷爷……

“嗡嗡。”

手机传来震动的声音。

宋郁低头看了下，发现是一张照片，鸟包的塑料壳内有两只毛绒绒的鸟，很乖巧的样子。

下一秒短信来了。

——它们要去动物园。

——自己钻进去的。

——爷爷带不带？

宋郁眼皮都在抽。
chunks.englishText:
001 even guided it step by step.

The bird closed its eyes, lowered its head, and the flowing golden patterns appeared on its wings again.

"Imagine your transformation..."

Its body grew larger bit by bit, a wonderful feeling of stretching. Bai Linlin felt quite good about itself.

Until it opened its eyes.

Majestic.jpg

The bird couldn't even see 001 anymore. The feathers on its chest were so fluffy that it had to cautiously take a small step back.

001: "..."

The little grey-brown sparrow looked incredulous:

"Why did you get big again?"

The bird: "..."

001: "Did you properly mobilize your demon power?"

The bird: "...I did."

001: "How did you imagine your transformation?"

The bird: "...I thought about getting taller."

The bedroom fell silent.

To avoid further embarrassment, Bai Linlin said sternly: "Don't you think getting big is cool?"

001 transformed into the black-clad youth, looking very depressed:

"Why can't I teach you?"

The bird offered some guidance: "Actually, getting big is pretty good too."

The black-clad youth looked over, expressionless.

The bird extended its wings—broad, huge, capable of shielding from the wind and rain.

"Really."

001 only said: "Getting big and small is something only fledgling birds play with."

Bai Linlin: "..."

The bird retracted its wings, narrowed its eyes, and decided to drag the other down with it. It began to persuade:

"You try it too, it's really cool!"

001 looked up, its tone a bit dejected: "But I haven't taught you how to transform yet."

The bird: "Just try it!"

The bird: "I haven't seen you get big yet."

001 looked dazed. It had to get big too?

Bai Linlin pressed on:

"We have a week, it's very relaxed, and we can go out to play this afternoon."

The bird began to paint a big picture.

001 *poofed* into a little sparrow, hesitated, but asked:

"Is it really cool?"

The bird nodded: "Really, really."

001 closed its eyes, imagined it, and its body began to expand bit by bit.

...

But just then, there was movement outside the door:

"I still have to go to the company this afternoon. Chairman Lin is a good man, Xiao Yu, you should ask him for advice..."

"Okay."

"Don't worry about the birds, I'll take care of them. You just need to tell me some precautions..."

The door creaked.

As soon as Song Yu pushed the door open, what met his eyes were two giant birds, nearly two meters tall. They had been facing each other, but upon hearing the noise, they both turned to look at him in unison.

"..."

But Song Zheng-guo behind him was still walking forward, saying gently:

"I wonder what the two little birds are doing."

*Bang—*

Song Yu slammed the door shut and closed his eyes, his heart beating quite fast.

"What's wrong?"

Song Zheng-guo frowned. He simply stepped past his grandson and pushed the door open.

"Grandpa!"

Song Yu wanted to stop him, but it was too late. The old man had a firm grip and pushed it wide open.

He held his breath until:

"Isn't this quite normal?"

The air in the room began to flow again. Only then did Song Yu step forward to look.

In the bedroom, there were only two little birds on the floor, looking at them innocently.

"..."

A blue-feathered bird and a little sparrow, both tilting their heads in unison to preen their feathers.

-

Finally, after much effort, he managed to smooth things over. Song Yu told his grandfather the precautions for ordinary birds.

But he still had to go to the company.

Not going would be too suspicious.

Since they hadn't been caught red-handed, it was as good as maintaining the status quo.

The fewer people who knew about their identity as demons, the better, even his own family.

When Song Yu left, he was truly worried. He went to the desk and carefully checked the bird's leg ring again.

Bai Linlin had already fastened it, lowering its bird head in guilt.

"001, my little bird is too small. If it loses control, please help it out a bit more."

Song Yu said very earnestly.

001: "..."

247 was not small at all.

"Okay."

The little grey-brown sparrow agreed.

-

Time moved to the afternoon.

Chen Kaihe returned, bringing two zoo tickets. He had thought it through: there was no need to interfere with Xiao Yu's marriage. As long as the child was healthy, that was the best thing.

However, his old friend shouldn't be too immersed in those matters. After all, he was a vegetable; there was really no way to protect Xiao Yu...

Those knife scars on the child's wrists.

"...Sigh."

When the old man arrived at the study, he tried to persuade him to go out for a stroll, saying the Nanshi Zoo was worth a visit. The animals there were raised to be robust, and seeing them would lift one's spirits.

Chen Kaihe described it vividly:

"Didn't you say you saw a 'Mountain God' with horns when you were in the army? The Nanshi Zoo has deer! Let's go, let's go see!"

Song Zheng-guo just smiled gently, "I must have seen wrong back then."

"I still have to take care of the birds for Xiao Yu."

The two fluffy birds on the desk looked at each other, then pattered over to Song Zheng-guo.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

Bai Linlin immediately began to express its stance.

001 chirped hesitantly.

Song Zheng-guo raised an eyebrow, looked at the blue-feathered bird, and asked gently:

"What's wrong?"

The word "obedient" didn't exist in Bai Linlin's dictionary. It fluttered its wings, flew into the other old man's hand, and snatched the tickets.

It walked across the table with a patter-patter.

It earnestly stuffed them into Song Zheng-guo's palm.

Humans, the birds wanted to go.

Both of them wanted to go.

-

Song Yu's eyelid had been twitching all afternoon.

He wasn't worried about his birds having problems anymore; he was more worried about his grandfather...

*Buzz.*

His phone vibrated.

Song Yu looked down and saw a photo: inside the plastic shell of the bird carrier were two fluffy birds, looking very well-behaved.

A text message followed.

—They want to go to the zoo.

—They crawled in themselves.

—Should Grandpa take them?

Song Yu's eyelid twitched violently.

chunks.chineseText:
第37章

宋峥国发消息的时候其实已经在动物园的门口了，面色也有些犹豫，他也不知道怎么就出来了。

隐约只记得鸟儿在家里引路，啪嗒啪嗒走到客厅的角落，用喙拉开了拉链，两只排排钻了进去。

然后仰头看他们。

“……这小郁要是不同意怎么办？”

宋峥国语气有些担忧，他或许真是年纪大了，让司机开到动物园门口才想起来要和孩子知会一声的。

陈开鹤很是精神抖擞的，在后车门那里对着鸟包里的两只一个劲地拍照，摆了摆手自信道：

“没事没事，就逛两个小时。”

“我们俩老头还看不住两只小鸟？”

宋峥国心想也是，不过还是低头看了下消息，这会儿正好弹出来一条新的短信：

[爷爷，让我视频一下。]

……

宋郁深吸一口气，最终找了个安静的地方拨过去了视频通话，但看到背景画面后就愣住了。

售卖气球的小贩。

印着动物园的牌匾。

人来人往的……

宋郁：“……”

画面闪动了下，很快就变成了宋峥国的脸，老人有些不好意思，还解释了几句：

“小郁，它们站着实在太乖，我当时就叫了家里的司机，路程也比较短，就过来了。”

“要是你不放心，我就让人把它们送回去……”

宋郁还没有说什么，视频里面就传来了非常吵的鸟叫声，听着气势汹汹的，仿佛是在抗议。

“爷爷你把摄像头转一下，我看看小鸟。”

宋郁很温和地道。

手机里的视频页面在晃动，很快就转移到了车内的鸟包上，塑料壳里的两只小鸟安分守己，其中一只尤其乖巧。

“鸟儿？看看你的主人。”

老人的声音在旁边响起，又把手机往前放了下，特地对着那只蓝羽小鸟上，但由于镜头的畸变，屏幕里只有一个圆滚滚的鸟头。

白粼粼爪子有点扣地了。

咳咳。

就不能当没听到吗？

“粼粼？”

白粼粼一下子收紧了翅根，很心虚地挪动了下爪子，想要逃离摄像头，但宋峥国却始终对的很准，手机屏幕也随着他的动作而转动。

“……”

“啾啾！”

鸟意思了一下。

宋郁看到他的小鸟后，什么脾气都没有了，只是耐心问：

“在家里是不是太无聊了？”

“是我没有想到这点。”

白粼粼本来还在心虚着，但一听这话立马就有底气了，顺着杆子就爬上去了，肉色的短喙一张一合的：

“啾啾啾啾！”

[就是就是！]

宋郁就这么看着，眉眼很是平和，顺带操作了下截图，最后才道：

“去动物园要小心，要注意安全。”

“脚环拿了吗？或者是背带？”

人还是很操心的。

白粼粼闻言挺胸抬头的，从镜头外叼出来两个背带，一个西部牛仔，一个棕色格纹。

鸟准备齐全！

宋郁看到手机的画面唇角微微往上抿了下，但就在这时，旁边有了陈爷爷的声音：

“来来来，拍个照小鸟。”

镜头里的蓝羽小鸟不由自主就要偏头，甚至要走出视频的画面了。

“粼粼。”

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，想要合影，索性装没听到。

宋峥国也在低头看老友的手机页面，看到里头的两只也眉眼和蔼了起来，全然忘记挪动自己手里的手机镜头了。

“粼粼。”

第二遍。

白粼粼本来都摆好pose了，伸了翅膀搭在旁边的小雀上，但手机那里又传来一句：

“粼粼，要看我。”

鸟只好转了个头。

陈开鹤哎呀一声，站起来看了下照片，虽说有些遗憾，但还是说：

“这张也不错，待会再拍一下。”

宋郁看到自己的小鸟重新回到手机屏幕里才微微放松了捏着边框的手指，轻声询问道：

“在拍照吗？”

鸟歪了歪头，不知道为什么一直叫他，但还是凑过去，几乎要贴到摄像头上了。

“啾啾！”

“嗯，要玩得开心。”

最后其实也没有交流多少，宋郁后面就在同两位老人说话了，大体就是要注意安全，少去人流量高的地方，避开一些防护设施不全的观赏地点。

-

下午两点半。

两个老人正式进园，同时对工作人员做了说明，而后才提着鸟包进去了。

陈开鹤虽然年纪大了，但是精神头要好很多，拿着园区地图就道：

“峥国，这我们先去看看梅花鹿，然后跟着小道去鸟类园区，让这两只见见不一样的……”

白粼粼已经稳稳地站在了老人的肩头，身上穿得是西部牛仔背带，他的小弟则是穿着那个棕色条纹，非常拉风，回头率非常高。

001其实也很好奇，始终都在四处张望着，它没有来过动物园，但听说这里生活待遇很好的，食宿都是全包的。

宋峥国很是闲适地在路上走着，发觉身边偶尔有加速跑过的男童，微微蹙了蹙眉，对着旁边的那只灰色小雀道：

“鸟儿的朋友？你也到鸟儿那边好不好？”

“那边靠里。”

001歪了歪头，很听话地扑棱翅膀飞到了247的身边，两个毛绒绒的小鸟调整了下位置。

白粼粼很是兴奋，伸了伸翅根，对着旁边的小雀介绍道：

[这个是北极熊，你看，人工打造的冰面，哇哇。]

[这个是卡皮巴拉，噢噢，是水豚，是南美那边的。]

[看这个，澳大利亚袋鼠哎！它们打架老厉害了！]

001一开始还很懵懵的，后面就是认真听讲，了解到了很多不认识的动物，它不由得看向了旁边的蓝羽小鸟。

有崇拜之意。

不过它又有点好奇，歪头问道：

[你怎么知道的？]

白粼粼伸翅膀介绍的动作一顿，开始头脑风暴，最后灵光一闪：

[我在家里看电视看的。]

[就是纪录片那种。]

001点了点头，不过还是问：

[纪录片是什么？]

白粼粼只好简单地介绍了下，就是人类用镜头去记录动物们的生活作息、繁衍后代……

001不解，只是道：

[繁衍？人类还要看交配？]

[……]

与此同时，宋峥国正在抬步走上坡，肩头的两只小鸟叽叽喳喳的，似乎是聊得正开心。

陈开鹤也是走过一个目标点就拍个照，这么十分钟下来倒是拍不少了。

后面两个老头就坐在了长椅上，肩头的两只小鸟稳当当地站着，羽毛蓬松，还在四处扭头张望。

宋峥国从鸟包里拿出来买的矿泉水，倒了一小瓶盖，递到了肩头那里。

两个鸟头就挤了过来，小口小口地喝。

“江芮要离婚了，这个事你知道吗？”

陈开鹤抬手把相机收了起来，很认真地转头问道。

他也是这几天才知道，江连城美术协会副主席没当上多久，被人举报向考生的家长索贿了，不仅职位丢了，名声也差了，前几天联系他说想进高校当老师。

陈开鹤也这么弯弯绕绕才得知他女儿要离婚的事。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 37

When Song Zhengguo sent the message, he was actually already at the entrance of the zoo. His expression was hesitant; he wasn't even sure how he had ended up there.

He vaguely remembered the birds leading the way at home, pattering their way to the corner of the living room, using their beaks to pull open the zipper of their carrier, and both of them hopping inside in a row.

Then, they had looked up at him.

"...What if Xiao Yu doesn't agree?"

Song Zhengguo’s tone was filled with worry. Perhaps he really was getting old; it wasn't until he had the driver pull up to the zoo entrance that he remembered he should have informed the child.

Chen Kaihe, however, was in high spirits. He stood by the rear car door, snapping photos of the two birds in their carrier, waving his hand confidently.

"It’s fine, it’s fine. We’ll just walk around for two hours."

"Can’t two old men like us keep an eye on two little birds?"

Song Zhengguo thought that made sense, but he still looked down at his phone. Just then, a new text message popped up:

[Grandpa, let me have a video call.]

...

Song Yu took a deep breath and finally found a quiet place to initiate the video call. But when he saw the background, he froze.

A vendor selling balloons.

A plaque with the zoo’s name.

People coming and going...

Song Yu: "..."

The screen flickered, and soon it changed to Song Zhengguo’s face. The old man looked a bit embarrassed and offered an explanation:

"Xiao Yu, they were standing there so obediently, so I called the family driver. The distance wasn't far, so we just came over."

"If you're worried, I can have someone take them back..."

Before Song Yu could say anything, a very loud, aggressive chirping came from the video, as if the birds were protesting.

"Grandpa, turn the camera around. Let me see the birds."

Song Yu said gently.

The video on the phone shook, and soon it shifted to the bird carrier inside the car. The two little birds in the plastic shell were behaving, with one of them being particularly well-behaved.

"Birds? Look at your owner."

The old man’s voice sounded from the side, and he moved the phone closer, specifically aiming at the blue-feathered bird. However, due to the lens distortion, all that filled the screen was a round, fluffy bird head.

Bai Linlin’s claws gripped the floor a bit.

*Ahem.*

Could he just pretend he didn't hear that?

"Linlin?"

Bai Linlin immediately tightened his wing roots, feeling guilty, and shifted his claws, wanting to escape the camera. But Song Zhengguo kept the aim steady, and the phone screen turned along with his movements.

"..."

"Chirp!"

The bird gave a perfunctory response.

Seeing his little bird, all of Song Yu’s temper vanished. He just asked patiently:

"Was it too boring at home?"

"It’s my fault for not thinking of that."

Bai Linlin had been feeling guilty, but upon hearing this, he immediately gained confidence and climbed right up the pole, his flesh-colored short beak opening and closing:

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[Exactly, exactly!]

Song Yu watched, his brows peaceful. He took a screenshot before finally saying:

"Be careful at the zoo, and watch your safety."

"Did you bring the leg rings? Or the harnesses?"

He was still very concerned.

Hearing this, Bai Linlin puffed out his chest and raised his head, fishing out two harnesses from outside the camera’s view—one western cowboy style, and one with brown plaid.

The bird was fully prepared!

Seeing this on his phone screen, the corners of Song Yu’s lips curled up slightly. But just then, Grandpa Chen’s voice came from the side:

"Come, come, let’s take a picture, little birds."

The blue-feathered bird in the lens couldn't help but tilt his head, nearly walking out of the frame.

"Linlin."

The bird pattered over, wanting to take the photo, but decided to pretend he didn't hear.

Song Zhengguo was also looking down at his old friend’s phone screen. Seeing the two birds inside, his expression softened, and he completely forgot to move his own phone camera.

"Linlin."

The second time.

Bai Linlin had already posed, stretching his wing to rest on the little sparrow next to him, but the phone transmitted another line:

"Linlin, look at me."

The bird had no choice but to turn his head.

Chen Kaihe let out an "Aiya" and stood up to look at the photo. Although he felt a bit regretful, he said:

"This one is not bad either. We’ll take another one later."

Seeing his little bird return to the phone screen, Song Yu slightly relaxed his fingers, which had been gripping the edge of the frame, and asked softly:

"Are you taking pictures?"

The bird tilted his head, not knowing why he kept calling him, but he still leaned in, almost pressing against the camera lens.

"Chirp!"

"Mm, have fun."

In the end, there wasn't much more conversation. Song Yu spent the rest of the time talking to the two old men, mostly about staying safe, avoiding crowded areas, and steering clear of viewing spots with inadequate safety facilities.

-

Two-thirty in the afternoon.

The two old men officially entered the park, explained the situation to the staff, and then carried the bird carrier inside.

Although Chen Kaihe was old, he had much more energy. He held the park map and said:

"Zhengguo, let’s go see the sika deer first, then follow the path to the bird sanctuary and let these two see something different..."

Bai Linlin was already standing steadily on the old man’s shoulder, wearing the western cowboy harness. His little brother was wearing the brown striped one, looking incredibly dashing and drawing a lot of attention.

001 was actually quite curious, constantly looking around. It had never been to a zoo, but it had heard that the living conditions here were excellent, with all food and lodging provided.

Song Zhengguo walked leisurely along the path. Noticing a young boy running past them at high speed, he frowned slightly and said to the grey sparrow beside him:

"Bird’s friend? Why don't you go over to Bird’s side?"

"It’s safer on the inside."

001 tilted its head, and obediently flapped its wings to fly over to 247’s side. The two fluffy birds adjusted their positions.

Bai Linlin was very excited. He stretched his wing roots and introduced to the sparrow next to him:

[That’s a polar bear. Look, the man-made ice surface, wow.]

[That’s a capybara. Oh, oh, it’s a water pig, from South America.]

[Look at this, an Australian kangaroo! They are super good at fighting!]

001 was confused at first, but then it started listening intently, learning about many animals it had never heard of. It couldn't help but look at the blue-feathered bird beside it.

There was a sense of admiration.

However, it was a bit curious and tilted its head to ask:

[How do you know all this?]

Bai Linlin’s wing-stretching motion paused. He began to brainstorm, and then a flash of inspiration hit:

[I watch TV at home.]

[The documentary kind.]

001 nodded, but still asked:

[What is a documentary?]

Bai Linlin had no choice but to give a simple introduction: it was humans using cameras to record the animals' daily routines, how they reproduce...

001 was puzzled and just said:

[Reproduce? Humans like to watch mating?]

[……]

At the same time, Song Zhengguo was walking up a slope. The two little birds on his shoulder were chirping away, seemingly having a great time.

Chen Kaihe was also taking a photo at every target point; in just ten minutes, he had taken quite a few.

Later, the two old men sat on a bench. The two little birds on their shoulders stood steadily, their feathers fluffy, still twisting their heads to look around.

Song Zhengguo took out a bottle of mineral water he had bought from the carrier, poured a small capful, and held it up to his shoulder.

Two bird heads squeezed over, drinking in small sips.

"Jiang Rui is getting a divorce. Do you know about this?"

Chen Kaihe put away his camera and turned to ask, looking very serious.

He had only found out in the last few days. Jiang Liancheng hadn't been the Vice Chairman of the Fine Arts Association for long before he was reported for soliciting bribes from the parents of examinees. Not only did he lose his position, but his reputation was ruined. A few days ago, he had contacted him, saying he wanted to be a teacher at a university.

It was through this roundabout way that Chen Kaihe learned his daughter was getting a divorce.

chunks.chineseText:
“是么？”宋峥国看着一小瓶盖水见了底，面容和蔼，又抬手准备给倒新的。

“婚姻不是人生的必须项，舍弃也很正常。”

宋峥国从头到尾都没有放在心上，只是再次把瓶盖递了过去，这会两个小鸟不喝了，他才抬手给收了回来。

“你不怕她找上小郁吗？”

“反正我是很担心。”

陈开鹤坐得很板正，双手放在膝上，他先前其实是同情江芮这孩子的，但后面得知她在宋郁割腕的时候都没有回来看过孩子，彻底算是没好印象了。

现在江家这么一团乱，谁知道会不会来打感情牌。

鸟这会已经扑棱翅膀下来了，稳稳地站在椅子的中间，爪子踩着那个园区地图。

灰棕色小雀也紧随其后，虽然不知道干什么，但还是伸了爪子过去，也按住了。

两个老人还在说话。

“小郁长大了，他会分清是非对错的，他母亲找他无非是想证明自己没错。”

陈开鹤一听也觉得是，不然早干什么去了，等孩子病好了再说些有的没的？

“防备着点吧，不过尚美这里……”

鸟光明正大地偷听，甚至鸟头都情不自禁地伸出去一些，他已经知道了这个“尚美工作室”是江芮的产业了，但后面的是什么意思？

商业竞争？

挤兑？

舆论？

“华秉这几年受到的损失其实我都可以不计，但江芮在她二胎满月酒上让小郁过去拍不知所谓的合影，还故意上了头条……我不可能就这么算了。”

“反正我也老了，留个恶名不妨事。”

宋峥国只是心里有气，他这么些年其实算是体谅儿子和前儿媳了，华秉的股份甚至都给了江芮一些，那也撑起来她后面事业的发展了。

可谁知道是这样。

父亲风风火火地重组家庭，母亲开始跟着较劲，没有一个人管他们共同的孩子，好似成了累赘。

宋峥国最后只是道：

“等我死了，也不知道沅清会不会怪我心狠。”

陈开鹤一听这话就直蹙眉，心里也莫名难受，刚想要出声安慰，但就在这时，鸟叫声响起来了。

“啾啾！啾啾啾！”

蓝羽小鸟扑棱翅膀站到了老人膝上，端端正正的，宋峥国看到就笑了下，刚想要弯腰去问问怎么了。

但就在这时。

“长-命-百-岁！”

“寿-比-南-山！”

“福-如-东-海！”

蓝羽小鸟抑扬顿挫地学舌道。

还很骄傲地收了收翅膀。

宋峥国愣了下，而后就是笑了起来，但眼眶其实是有些湿的，最后只是弯腰道：

“谢谢小鸟啊。”

“我们小郁过得不好，多亏小鸟陪着他了。”

陈开鹤见状一下子也很动容，不由得去包里拿了张纸巾。

001：……

人类的感情真是复杂。

为什么会笑着哭？

小鸟不懂。

-

后面还是接着在动物园里逛，两只毛绒绒的小鸟站在一起，遇到一个景点，两个鸟头齐齐地转过去，很认真的样子。

白粼粼的地位早已上升，他在座椅那里已经用爪子按过想去的地点了，现在就是在这条路线上。

宋峥国回头看了下肩头的小鸟，笑着提醒道：

“前面就是鸟的园区了，来看看自己的同类？”

白粼粼很好奇，不由得用身子挤了下旁边的小雀，示意待会好好看。

结果一个用力过猛。

001被挤下去了，只好扑棱翅膀又飞了回来。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼：[说不定有孔雀！]

[会开屏的！]

001不解：[人类好奇怪，又看交配，又看求偶……]

[他们自己不会吗？]

白粼粼：[……]

两个小鸟挤在一团，本来还在叽叽喳喳的，直到旁边传来人声：

“鸟儿，到了，快看。”

两个小鸟顿时不讨论了，立马抬头看了过去——

园区里有一只优雅的丹顶鹤，正在闲庭散步，听到有人的动静后很自然地往这边看。

白粼粼：“……”

001：“……”

一秒，两秒。

两个穿着背带的潮流小鸟立马开始把鸟头插进翅根里，成为两个毛球。

看不到看不到……

宋峥国其实有些意外的，于是就停下了，刚把鸟包放到公共座椅上，就突然发现园区里的那只丹顶鹤不知道什么时候过来了，虽然有栅栏，但此刻正在伸着鸟头在往这边看。

丹顶鹤震惊。

这001，不是说月底没工资了么？

任务不做，游手好闲！

这247，妖怪手册看完了？

这么有闲情雅致？

宋峥国蹙了蹙眉，以为是这只丹顶鹤吓到了两只小鸟，于是起身抬手挥了挥。

丹顶鹤：“……”

它不和人类计较。

扬长而去。

最后两个小鸟坚持要进鸟包，宋峥国虽然觉得困惑，但还是给拉开了拉链，两只乖巧地站在一起。

后面太阳就渐渐落山了。

宋峥国和陈开鹤后面就慢慢地走在小道上，等着待会到园区门口正好回去，只是偶尔会看下鸟包里的两只。

在叽叽喳喳地聊天，看起来精神状态很好。

实际情况是：

白粼粼：[它真的喜欢它的饲养员？]

001：[是的，基地的妖怪其实都知道。]

白粼粼：[我的天。]

白粼粼：[是我刚刚看到的那个男人？]

001：[应该是。]

白粼粼：[啧啧，不过这能修成正果吗？]

001：[你是说交配的问题？]

……

最后正好在四点前回了园区门口，两个小鸟被放了出来，在车子后座的两个老人肩头站着，一边一个，接着聊天：

001：[妖怪没有那么多限制的，变成人不就行了？]

白粼粼：[那万一人不接受呢？]

灰棕色小雀思考一下：[我倒是没有想过这种情况……]

001：[直接压住，人反抗不了的。]

白粼粼：[……]

鸟开了眼了。

后面又开始讨论别的：

001：[你现在是几个月？]

白粼粼心想问这个干什么，不过他还是算了算，然后回答道：

[九个月。]

001沉思：[那你确实是幼鸟。]

白粼粼：[……]

只是说这个吗？

但下一秒。

001：[我上次去查了查资料，你可能要到一岁半的时候才能和你的监护人交配。]

白粼粼愣住了，然后就是红温，能不能不要用这个词！

他要拉黑这两个字！

001：[如果需要帮忙的话，我来帮你压住他。]

白粼粼：“……”

不用了。

-

后面回家之后，001就要走了，白粼粼想了想，带着它去了卧室那里，从柜子里翻出来一堆东西。

果干，酸奶，辣条。

每一份量都很大。

鸟站在柜子口，爪子都有些劈叉，还在往外叼，本来碰到小香菇干了，但是思忖片刻，改去叼牛肉干了。

这个太少了。

鸟还不够吃。

白粼粼努力翻腾着，最后旁边的零食堆成了小山。
chunks.englishText:
"Is that so?" Song Zhengguo watched as the small cap of water was drained, his expression kind as he raised his hand to pour another.

"Marriage isn't a necessity in life. Letting go is quite normal."

Song Zhengguo hadn't taken it to heart from the beginning. He handed the cap over again, and only when the two birds stopped drinking did he pull it back.

"Aren't you afraid she’ll come looking for Xiao Yu?"

"I’m very worried, at any rate."

Chen Kaihe sat very upright, his hands on his knees. He had previously sympathized with Jiang Rui, but after learning that she hadn't even come back to see her child when Song Yu slit his wrists, he had lost all respect for her.

Now that the Jiang family was in such a mess, who knew if she would come to play the emotional card?

The birds had already flapped their wings and hopped down, standing firmly in the middle of the bench, their claws stepping on the park map.

The grey-brown sparrow followed suit. Although it didn't know what they were doing, it still stretched out its claws and pressed them down too.

The two old men continued to talk.

"Xiao Yu has grown up. He can tell right from wrong. If his mother comes to him, it’s nothing more than wanting to prove she wasn't in the wrong."

Chen Kaihe thought that made sense. Otherwise, why wait until now? Why wait until the child had recovered from his illness to say such nonsense?

"Be on your guard, but as for Shangmei here..."

The birds were openly eavesdropping, their heads even stretching out involuntarily. They already knew this "Shangmei Studio" was Jiang Rui’s business, but what did the rest mean?

Commercial competition?

Squeezing out?

Public opinion?

"The losses Huabing has suffered over these years are things I could have ignored, but Jiang Rui made Xiao Yu go over to take some nonsensical photo at her second child’s full-month banquet, and she even deliberately made the headlines... I can't just let that go."

"Anyway, I’m old. Having a bad reputation doesn't matter."

Song Zhengguo was just angry. Over the years, he had actually been considerate of his son and former daughter-in-law. He had even given some of his Huabing shares to Jiang Rui, which had supported the development of her later career.

But who knew it would turn out like this?

The father was busy starting a new family, the mother was busy competing with him, and neither of them cared for their shared child, who seemed to have become a burden.

Song Zhengguo finally said:

"When I die, I don't know if Yuanqing will blame me for being heartless."

Chen Kaihe frowned upon hearing this, feeling inexplicably uncomfortable. He was just about to offer some comfort when, suddenly, chirping erupted.

"Chirp! Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

The blue-feathered bird flapped his wings and stood on the old man’s knee, standing perfectly straight. Song Zhengguo smiled when he saw this, just about to lean over to ask what was wrong.

But then:

"Long-life-hundred-years!"

"Longevity-like-the-Southern-Mountain!"

"Fortune-like-the-Eastern-Sea!"

The blue-feathered bird recited the well-wishes with perfect cadence.

He even puffed out his wings proudly.

Song Zhengguo was stunned, then burst into laughter, though his eyes were actually a bit moist. Finally, he leaned over and said:

"Thank you, little bird."

"Our Xiao Yu hasn't had an easy life; it’s thanks to you for keeping him company."

Seeing this, Chen Kaihe was also deeply moved and couldn't help but reach into his bag for a tissue.

001: ...

Human emotions are truly complex.

Why cry while laughing?

The little bird didn't understand.

-

They continued to stroll through the zoo. The two fluffy birds stood together, and whenever they encountered an attraction, both bird heads would turn in unison, looking very serious.

Bai Linlin’s status had already risen; he had used his claws to press the locations he wanted to visit on the map at the bench, and they were now following that route.

Song Zhengguo looked back at the little birds on his shoulder and reminded them with a smile:

"The bird sanctuary is just ahead. Want to come and see your own kind?"

Bai Linlin was very curious and couldn't help but nudge the sparrow next to him, signaling him to watch carefully.

As a result, he used too much force.

001 was pushed off and had to flap its wings to fly back up.

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin: [Maybe there are peacocks!]

[The kind that can open their tails!]

001 was puzzled: [Humans are so strange. They watch mating, and they watch courtship...]

[Can't they do it themselves?]

Bai Linlin: [……]

The two birds huddled together, chirping away, until a human voice came from the side:

"Birds, we're here. Look."

The two birds immediately stopped their discussion and looked up—

In the enclosure, a graceful red-crowned crane was strolling leisurely. Hearing the movement, it looked over naturally.

Bai Linlin: "..."

001: "..."

One second, two seconds.

The two trendy birds in their harnesses immediately tucked their heads into their wing roots, turning into two balls of fluff.

Can't see, can't see...

Song Zhengguo was actually a bit surprised, so he stopped. Just as he placed the bird carrier on a public bench, he suddenly noticed the red-crowned crane in the enclosure had come over at some point. Although there was a fence, it was currently stretching its head to look over.

The red-crowned crane was shocked.

This 001, didn't it say it had no salary at the end of the month?

Not doing its mission, just idling about!

And this 247, finished reading the Monster Handbook?

So much leisure and elegance?

Song Zhengguo frowned, thinking the crane had frightened the two little birds, so he stood up and waved his hand.

Red-crowned crane: "..."

It wouldn't lower itself to argue with a human.

It strode away.

In the end, the two birds insisted on getting into the carrier. Song Zhengguo felt puzzled but unzipped it, and the two stood together obediently.

The sun gradually began to set.

Song Zhengguo and Chen Kaihe walked slowly along the path, waiting to return to the park entrance. They only occasionally checked on the two in the carrier.

They were chirping and chatting, looking to be in high spirits.

The reality was:

Bai Linlin: [Does it really like its zookeeper?]

001: [Yes, the monsters at the base all know.]

Bai Linlin: [My god.]

Bai Linlin: [Is it the man I just saw?]

001: [Should be.]

Bai Linlin: [Tsk tsk, but can this actually work out?]

001: [Are you talking about the mating issue?]

...

They finally returned to the park entrance before four o'clock. The two birds were let out and stood on the shoulders of the two old men in the back seat, one on each side, continuing their chat:

001: [Monsters don't have that many restrictions. Can't you just turn into a human?]

Bai Linlin: [What if the human doesn't accept it?]

The grey-brown sparrow thought about it: [I hadn't thought of that situation...]

001: [Just pin them down. Humans can't resist.]

Bai Linlin: [……]

The bird’s eyes were opened.

Later, they started discussing other things:

001: [How many months old are you now?]

Bai Linlin wondered why it was asking this, but he calculated it anyway and replied:

[Nine months.]

001 pondered: [Then you are indeed a fledgling.]

Bai Linlin: [……]

Was that all it meant?

But the next second.

001: [I checked the data last time. You probably won't be able to mate with your guardian until you're a year and a half old.]

Bai Linlin froze, then turned bright red. Could it stop using that word!

He wanted to blacklist that word!

001: [If you need help, I can help you pin him down.]

Bai Linlin: "..."

No need.

-

After getting home, 001 was about to leave. Bai Linlin thought for a moment, took it to the bedroom, and dug out a pile of things from the cabinet.

Dried fruit, yogurt, spicy strips.

Each portion was quite large.

The bird stood at the cabinet door, his claws splayed, still pulling things out. He had bumped into some dried mushrooms, but after a moment’s thought, he switched to pulling out beef jerky.

There was too little of that.

The bird wouldn't have enough to eat.

Bai Linlin rummaged hard, and eventually, the pile of snacks grew into a small mountain.

chunks.chineseText:
黑衣少年就在旁边抱腿蹲着，眼睛亮亮的。

“这些你带走！”

圆滚滚的鸟啪嗒啪嗒走了过来，很阔气地伸了下翅膀。

001直接砰的一下变成了原形，仰望这个零食堆，不由得道：

“247，你真厉害。”

“能驯服这么有实力的人类。”

白粼粼沾沾自喜，本来想要分享一下自己当初捡到“人”的事，但后面发觉“碰瓷”好像不太体面，遂作罢。

只是啪嗒啪嗒地往另外一个柜子那里走，很认真地道：

“我给你拿个塑料袋吧，你路上……”

鸟叼着塑料袋，刚转回来。

地板上的零食堆凭空消失。

白粼粼震惊，快步走到001的身边，绕着看了看：

“你藏在哪里了？”

001很不解：“我们是妖怪，物品而已，偷人都是可以的。”

“……”

“只要你的妖力足够熟练。”

鸟再次遭受痛击。

“……”

鸟郁闷了，立马飞到桌子上叼过来自己的小挎包。

“我有这个！”

001：“幼鸟用的。”

“……”

地板上的小雀像是意识到了什么，啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，伸翅膀盖住比它大一码的蓝羽小鸟，认真地道：

“我这周一定好好教你。”

“放心吧。”

“你会成为S级的。”

励志了起来。

-

后面晚上的时候，001就走了。

白粼粼很是废寝忘食地在书桌上看妖怪手册，还用爪子开了台灯。

宋郁回家之后直接就去了楼上，推开卧室门才发现主灯没开，一开始还蹙了下眉，以为鸟不在。

但门大开之后，他才发现书桌那里的情形：

他的小鸟在全神贯注地学习，房间里安安静静的，只有爪子翻动页面的声音，灯光是暖黄色的，它的影子在墙面上放大了几倍，圆滚滚的鸟头一动一动的……

宋郁本来不想打扰的，都要把门合上了，但这个时候鸟似乎才抽离了出来，在桌面上灵巧地转了个身，看到他之后就道：

“你回来了！”

宋郁这才抬步往前走，桌面上的小鸟也扑棱翅膀飞了过来，最后一人一鸟在房间中间“会面”。

白粼粼成功站在了人的肩头。

调整了下爪子，满意！

还是宋郁的比较舒服。

“今天出门累不累？”

鸟摇了摇头，他觉得还是很好玩的。

宋郁想了想，温和地承诺：

“那我年年带你去旅游，好不好？”

白粼粼眼睛亮了亮。

“啾！”

夜色安稳，别墅里也很热闹，两人一鸟在餐厅共进晚餐，最后各自回了房间休息。

宋郁在浴室里洗澡，鸟站在门口，用爪子挠了挠。

他也要洗！

白粼粼本意是催促一下，但没想到门直接开了，雾气扑面而来，地板也变得很滑，但就在鸟腿劈叉的时候……

他被拿了起来。

宋郁已经很高了，隐隐约约超过了一米八这个整数，黑色短袖衬得人尤为有气质，面部轮廓也很分明。

“来。”

有个迷你的小澡盆。

上面还有自动的小花洒。

白粼粼不由自主地伸了伸翅膀，羽毛很快就蓬松了起来，一点点地站到那个浴盆里，还是晃动身体。

很会甩水的一只小鸟。

宋郁就这么守着，他后面看了下浴室的浴缸，想了想，拿过来了旁边的手机。

大约晚上九点半。

一人一鸟洗澡完毕。

宋郁甚至没有先吹他的头发，只是先用毛巾给他的小鸟细致地擦完，然后才问要不要用吹风机，其实是自然晾干比较好。

但鸟执意要用。

白粼粼站在书桌上，爪子都有些扒不稳，羽毛蓬松，齐齐地朝一边歪去。

“啾——啾啾！”

好了。

一只潦草的小鸟。

“好了，困不困？”

白粼粼确实有点，打了个哈欠就扑棱翅膀飞到床上了，很自觉地躺在了里面。

翅根收拢，鸟躯一侧。

安寝。

宋郁心里像是被什么装满了，他看了好一会，之后才把桌上的吹风机收了起来，去了隔壁房间把自己头发吹干了。

但就在他回来的时候。

床铺上躺着一个“人”。

宋郁愣神了片刻，然后在走了过去，撑着手臂去看。

或许是白天出门太累了。

鸟一碰枕头就睡着了。

“少年”皮肤白皙，浅蓝色的头发微微卷翘，唇瓣都微微地张开了。

睡得昏天黑地。

啪嗒——

台灯关了，卧室也暗了下来。

宋郁抬手很细致地给“人”盖上了毯子，不过也就在这时，他的手机震动了下，是爷爷找他。

[小郁，来一楼茶室一趟。]

白粼粼睡得迷迷糊糊的，隐约觉得有人给自己盖了东西，然后就是门轻轻的响动，再之后……就不记得了。

坠进了梦里。

-

茶室。

宋郁很认真地同自己爷爷汇报了下白天的收获，大到公司的管理机制，小到电梯的拥挤程度。

面面俱到，有详有略。

宋峥国说不满意是不可能的，但是他还有另外一件事要说：

“你的那个鸟儿。”

少年几乎面色微微变了，在预想是不是白天出了些差错，爷爷觉得不对劲，还是什么别的原因。

宋郁甚至已经做好了最坏的打算。

有抽屉拉开的动静。

宋郁的面前多了一个黑色丝绒小匣子，他莫名有种直觉——

“很乖，它真是个好小鸟。”

“爷爷托人又打了个新的玩意儿，本来以为明天才能送到，没想到晚上送来了。”

宋郁有些恍惚。

匣子打开了，里面是个金灿灿的长命锁。

老人温声交代道：

“你代爷爷给小鸟。”

“它应该喜欢的吧……”

-

一周的时间其实很快就过去了。

白粼粼很是勤奋刻苦，001偶尔也来指点一二，但是化形这种事，还是看自身的天赋。

鸟学不下去了，就去隔壁房间了，看了看自己的金子。

宋郁爷爷那天给了之后，宋郁白天也去给他买了！

是一套“功夫小鸟”。

白粼粼尤为喜欢，金灿灿的，而且小小的，又很沉，摆在架子上很好看，像手办。

鸟每天都来欣赏一下。

心情愉悦。

直到“培训”的那天到了，白粼粼在车上都在看妖怪管理手册，每分每秒都在复习。

宋郁转了下方向盘，将车子停在一旁，只是垂眸看向副驾的小鸟，温和地道：

“学不会也没事的。”

“粼粼在基地玩得开心也可以。”

白粼粼用爪子按着手册，摇了摇头，相当认真地道：

“不行不行。”

“我要学会化形的。”

宋郁眼眸微微一动，觉得他的小鸟很有上进心。

好乖。

围墙那里陆陆续续有小妖怪进门，甚至快到最后一轮了，白粼粼才慢吞吞地下了车。

进去就要考核了……

宋郁打开了车门，但就在鸟准备下车的时候，被叫住了。

白粼粼回头一看，这才反应过来，他差点忘了。
chunks.englishText:
The black-clad youth crouched nearby, hugging his knees, his eyes sparkling.

"You take these!"

The round little bird waddled over, flapping its wings with a grand, generous air.

001 shifted instantly into his original form. Looking up at the pile of snacks, he couldn't help but remark:

"247, you’re truly impressive."

"To be able to tame such a powerful human."

Bai Linlin preened with self-satisfaction. He had originally wanted to share the story of how he had "picked up" his human, but realizing that "gold-digging" didn't sound very dignified, he let it go.

Instead, he waddled over to another cabinet and said quite earnestly:

"I’ll get you a plastic bag so you can carry them on your way..."

The bird turned back, a plastic bag held in its beak.

The pile of snacks on the floor had vanished into thin air.

Bai Linlin was shocked. He hurried over to 001’s side, circling him to take a look:

"Where did you hide them?"

001 looked puzzled: "We are demons. These are just objects; we can even steal people if we want."

"..."

"As long as your demonic power is sufficiently refined."

The bird suffered another heavy blow.

"..."

Feeling dejected, the bird immediately flew onto the table and dragged over its small cross-body bag.

"I have this!"

001: "That’s for hatchlings."

"..."

The little sparrow on the floor seemed to realize something. It waddled over, stretched out its wings to cover the blue-feathered bird that was a size larger than itself, and said earnestly:

"I will definitely teach you well this week."

"Don't worry."

"You will become an S-rank."

It had become quite motivated.

-

Later that night, 001 left.

Bai Linlin was so engrossed in the Demon Handbook that he forgot to eat or sleep, even using his claws to turn on the desk lamp.

When Song Yu returned home, he went straight upstairs. He frowned upon pushing open the bedroom door and finding the main light off, initially thinking the bird wasn't there.

But once the door was fully open, he saw the scene at the desk:

His little bird was studying with total concentration. The room was quiet, save for the sound of claws turning pages. The lamp cast a warm, yellow glow, enlarging the bird's shadow on the wall several times over, the round little head bobbing back and forth...

Song Yu hadn't wanted to disturb it and was about to close the door, but at that moment, the bird seemed to snap out of its trance. It turned nimbly on the desktop, and upon seeing him, chirped:

"You're back!"

Song Yu stepped forward, and the little bird on the desk flapped its wings and flew over. Finally, human and bird "met" in the middle of the room.

Bai Linlin successfully landed on the human's shoulder.

He adjusted his claws—satisfied!

Song Yu’s shoulder was still the most comfortable.

"Were you tired from going out today?"

The bird shook its head; he thought it had been quite fun.

Song Yu thought for a moment and promised gently:

"Then I’ll take you traveling every year, how about that?"

Bai Linlin’s eyes brightened.

"Chirp!"

The night was peaceful, and the villa was lively. The two and the bird had dinner together in the dining room before returning to their respective rooms to rest.

Song Yu was taking a shower in the bathroom, and the bird stood at the door, scratching with its claws.

He wanted to wash too!

Bai Linlin had intended to urge him along, but to his surprise, the door opened. Steam rushed out, and the floor became slippery. Just as the bird’s legs were about to do the splits...

He was picked up.

Song Yu was already quite tall, slightly over 1.8 meters. His black short-sleeved shirt gave him an air of elegance, and his facial features were sharp and well-defined.

"Come."

There was a miniature bathtub.

It even had an automatic little shower head.

Bai Linlin couldn't help but stretch his wings, his feathers quickly fluffing up. He stood in the basin, shaking his body.

A little bird that really knew how to shake off water.

Song Yu watched over him. Later, he glanced at the bathtub in the bathroom, thought for a moment, and picked up his phone from the side.

It was about 9:30 PM.

The human and the bird finished their baths.

Song Yu didn't even blow-dry his own hair first; he used a towel to meticulously dry his little bird, only then asking if he wanted to use the hairdryer—though, in truth, air-drying was better.

But the bird insisted on using it.

Bai Linlin stood on the desk, his claws struggling to grip, his feathers fluffy and tilted to one side.

"Chirp—chirp chirp!"

Done.

A scruffy little bird.

"Alright, are you sleepy?"

Bai Linlin was indeed a bit tired. He let out a yawn, flapped his wings to fly onto the bed, and consciously lay down inside.

He tucked in his wing roots and curled his body to one side.

Fast asleep.

Song Yu felt as if his heart were filled with something. He watched for a long while before putting away the hairdryer and going to the next room to dry his own hair.

But when he returned.

A "person" was lying on the bed.

Song Yu froze for a moment, then walked over, bracing himself with his arms to look.

Perhaps he had been too tired from going out during the day.

The bird had fallen asleep the moment he touched the pillow.

The "youth" had fair skin, slightly curled light blue hair, and his lips were parted ever so slightly.

He was sleeping soundly.

Click—

The desk lamp was turned off, and the bedroom plunged into darkness.

Song Yu reached out and meticulously covered the "person" with a blanket. However, at that very moment, his phone vibrated—it was his grandfather.

[Xiao Yu, come to the tea room on the first floor.]

Bai Linlin was sleeping groggily, vaguely feeling someone cover him with something, followed by the soft sound of a door, and after that... he remembered nothing more.

He drifted into his dreams.

-

In the tea room.

Song Yu reported his day's gains to his grandfather very seriously, from company management mechanisms down to the crowding in the elevators.

He covered everything, balancing the big picture with the details.

It would be impossible for Song Zhengguo to be dissatisfied, but he had something else to say:

"That bird of yours."

The youth’s expression shifted slightly, wondering if something had gone wrong during the day, if his grandfather felt something was off, or if there was some other reason.

Song Yu had even prepared for the worst.

There was the sound of a drawer opening.

A small black velvet box appeared in front of Song Yu. He had an inexplicable intuition—

"It’s very well-behaved; it really is a good little bird."

"Grandfather had someone craft a new trinket. I thought it wouldn't arrive until tomorrow, but it was delivered tonight."

Song Yu felt a bit dazed.

The box opened, revealing a golden longevity lock inside.

The old man said gently:

"Give this to the little bird on my behalf."

"It should like it..."

-

A week passed by very quickly.

Bai Linlin was very diligent and hardworking. 001 would occasionally come by to offer pointers, but things like shapeshifting ultimately depended on one's own talent.

When the bird couldn't study anymore, he would go to the next room to look at his gold.

After Song Yu’s grandfather gave him that gift, Song Yu had gone out and bought him some too!

It was a set of "Kung Fu Little Birds."

Bai Linlin liked them immensely. They were golden, small, and heavy, and they looked very nice on the shelf, just like figurines.

The bird came to admire them every day.

He was in high spirits.

When the day of the "training" arrived, Bai Linlin was reading the Demon Management Handbook even in the car, reviewing every single second.

Song Yu turned the steering wheel and parked the car, looking down at the little bird in the passenger seat, saying gently:

"It’s okay if you don't learn it."

"It’s fine if you just have fun at the base, Linlin."

Bai Linlin pressed his claws against the handbook, shook his head, and said quite seriously:

"No, no."

"I have to learn how to shapeshift."

Song Yu’s eyes flickered slightly; he felt his little bird was very ambitious.

So well-behaved.

Little demons were entering the gate one after another. It was almost the final round when Bai Linlin finally waddled out of the car.

He had to take the assessment once he went in...

Song Yu opened the car door, but just as the bird was about to get out, he was called back.

Bai Linlin looked back and realized he had almost forgotten.

chunks.chineseText:
鸟啪嗒啪嗒地又走到人的跟前，伸了伸鸟头。

宋郁抬手给他的小鸟戴上了小挎包，很耐心地道：

“我在外面等着。”

“要是被批评了，和我打电话，会不会？”

白粼粼很郁闷地点头。

夜色如水，库里南的车门打开了，里面跳出来一只圆滚滚的小鸟。

先是四处张望了下。

后面就是啪嗒啪嗒地朝着围墙那里走，在拉开门的时候，鸟看了下车的那边。

宋郁还在看着。

鸟背着小挎包，很认真地挥了挥翅膀，进去了。
chunks.englishText:
The bird waddled back to the human, stretching out its little head.

Song Yu raised his hand to put the small cross-body bag on his little bird, saying patiently:

"I’ll be waiting outside."

"If you get criticized, call me, okay?"

Bai Linlin nodded, feeling quite dejected.

The night was like water. The Cullinan’s door opened, and a round little bird hopped out.

It first looked around in all directions.

Then, it waddled toward the wall. As it pulled the door open, the bird looked back toward the car.

Song Yu was still watching.

The bird, carrying its small cross-body bag, waved its wings very earnestly and went inside.

chunks.chineseText:
第38章

八月末天气已经有些转凉了，巷子口安安静静的，地面上有被风刮起来的落叶。

宋郁在车内看着手机，翻开了相册，里面大多都是些小鸟的照片，各种各样的……

在睡觉，在吃饭，在伸翅膀，在梳理羽毛。

几乎全天候的动态捕捉。

宋郁神色都变得柔和起来，直到手指轻微一滑，自动进入了私密相册页面，人脸识别成功。

打开了。

里面只有一张照片，备注是：

[粼粼]

浅蓝色头发的少年脸颊陷在枕头里，面色泛着点湿红，睡得很沉，很安稳。

宋郁看了很久。

最后大约过了三分钟，他才回了回了神，只是立即按灭了手机，然后侧头看向车窗外面，呼了一口气。

巷子尽头的围墙处已经没有小动物再过去了，墙壁上的24号也有些斑驳，风吹着那些藤蔓一晃一晃的，时不时还会蹭下来些墙皮。

宋郁想起来什么，再次把手机打开，切到了微信页面，他的联系人里多了一个分组，备注是[粼粼的朋友]。

里面有一百来号“人”。

备注同样是五花八门的，包括但不限于：乐乐、牛奶、咖啡、毛球、皮皮……

其实他当初是想过批量办理电话卡的，但是一来时间不够，二来电话卡是个长期业务，后面就选择用微信了。

管理局统辖的大多数是城市里的小动物，有监护人的就可以使用监护人的微信号添加副号，这样就可以联系起来了。

这么一周过去，宋郁零零散散已经加了不少了。

他本来是想要给001发个消息的，但是对方好像不是很喜欢玩手机，皮皮也不确定今天当值不当值。

宋郁想了想，随机点进去一个，他垂眸看了下，发现是只叫“毛球”的兔子，又看了看主页，它几乎天天在发朋友圈。

“……”

那应该可以联系得上。

-

管理局内。

侏儒兔正在抱着手机坐在沙发一角，旁边是那两只优雅的小猫，正在涂抹指甲油，偶尔也聊些天。

“我的监护人老是大惊小怪，她明明知道我是妖怪了，但还是不让我说人话。”

旁边的三花很是雍容华贵，伸出山竹一样的爪子看了下，非常满意这个渐变，而后闲聊道：

“正常的，监护人就是很脆弱的，他们接受不了超出认知之外的事，我们体谅就好了。”

三花猫说到这里，又想起来上次的事，不由得道：

“所以上次那个监护人，就是鸟类新入职的247的，他选择亲自来基地登记，真的好难得。”

侏儒兔点了点头，很由衷地认同：

“老大真是厉害！”

三花猫：“……”

不过就在这个时候，走廊那里一阵喧哗，一堆妖怪挤在一块了。

侏儒兔本来是想去凑凑热闹的，但是手机却嗡嗡震动了一声，它只好先去找个地方看看是什么消息……

-

白粼粼此刻正在接受迎接，鸟背着小挎包，大摇大摆地走在大厅的路上，偶尔还会伸出来翅膀挥一挥。

他本来是想说待会就发零食的，但是妖怪堆里有一道声音响起：

“老大！你看管理局的历史回廊了没？又加了新的照片！有你的！”

鸟爪子一停，好奇了，连带着考核的紧张情绪都消散了，只是问：

“我的照片？”

为首的花枝鼠伸着爪子拍了拍胸膛，很有打包票的意思，当即就说了句“老大跟我来！”。

妖怪堆里开了个小道，前面是一个西服革履的小鼠在快速跑动，时不时还回头看一下，后面就是一只圆滚滚的鸟，在啪嗒啪嗒地跟着走。

白粼粼听到了“历史回廊”这个词，心里不由得猜测是不是“名人墙”那种？

鸟有些心潮澎湃。

毕竟他还没有上过学校里的那种“荣誉学生榜”，那很拉风的。

于是大厅里就有了这么一幅画面：

一只小鼠在前面引路，对后面的小鸟毕恭毕敬的，而鸟的后面则是跟着乌泱泱一大堆小妖怪。

颇有种拉帮结派的感觉。

001今天到的有点晚，抵达鸟界活动区域的时候，这里已经没有妖怪了，空荡荡的。

它只好先化了形，四处张望了下，手里还有一份准备好的“小抄”。

247去哪里了？

也就在这时，一个侏儒兔蹦蹦跳跳地过来了，见到了001还问：

“老大去哪里了？”

001：“不知道。”

二妖面面相觑，直到旁边有一只在地板上一顿快速爬行的小蛇路过，口里还念念有词：

“老大老大我来了！”

001：“……”

黑衣少年重新化成灰棕色小雀，扑棱翅膀朝着大厅东南角的位置飞去。

侏儒兔还留在原地，它看了下手机屏幕上的消息：

[不好意思打扰了，可以劳烦你在我的小鸟考核结束后看一下它的状态吗？]

[我的小鸟它年纪小，爱面子，我怕它不同我讲，如果它被批评了，有不高兴的情况，可以立即联系我么？]

[当然，如果一切顺利，就不用打扰它了，你们好好玩就可以。]

侏儒兔捧着手机看了好一会，说实话，它认识的字不多，毕竟朋友圈都是图片为主，主打一个氛围感。

但是，它还是能提取出来关键信息的：

[……我的小鸟……]

[……我的小鸟……]

侏儒兔沉思，不就是监护人想老大了？

摇头……

人类真的是柔弱不能自理。

-

历史回廊，顾名思义是管理局成立以来重要事情的留影墙，上面都有金纹流动，显得非常有格调。

大厅的地板也很光洁，顶部有着折射光彩的水晶灯，底下是一群小妖怪。

花枝鼠站在那墙边就开始介绍，“老大，你看，这些都是特别有意义的场合才拍照的。”

“这个是第一个注册登记的小妖怪，是只动物园里黄鼠狼，它现在出省去做任务了。”

鸟站在地板上仰头观摩，收了收翅膀，有种视察的感觉。

花枝鼠还在伸着爪子讲，一幅照片接着一幅照片，围着的小妖怪也跟在鸟的后面，时不时发出惊叹声。

直到——

“老大，这就是你的照片，快看！”

白粼粼心想肯定是上次课上的抓拍，毕竟他表现那么优异，理应挂在外面让其他小妖怪瞻仰瞻仰。

但鸟刚一抬头。

墙上挂着一张巨大的人鸟合影，红底的，还是一如既往的羞涩样子：人面色泛红，鸟收紧翅根。

白粼粼石化了。

更糟糕的是身后的小妖怪开始欢呼，甚至有只不知名小鼠从角落里拿出来了上次没用完的礼花筒。

鸟目光空洞，视野里还有飘起来了的彩带。

001过来的时候看到的就是这么一幅巨大的“合影”，下面还有备注：

纪念首位监护人亲自前来同妖怪办理证件，历史意义重大，是管理局近年来的一个重大成就，为推动人妖和平相处创下里程碑的进展。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 38

By the end of August, the weather had already begun to turn cool. The alley entrance was quiet, with fallen leaves being swept across the ground by the wind.

Inside the car, Song Yu looked at his phone, flipping through his photo album. Most of them were photos of the little bird, in all sorts of states...

Sleeping, eating, stretching its wings, preening its feathers.

It was almost an all-day dynamic capture.

Song Yu’s expression softened until his finger swiped slightly, automatically entering the private album page, the facial recognition unlocking it.

He opened it.

There was only one photo inside, labeled:

[Linlin]

The youth with light blue hair had his cheeks buried in the pillow, his face flushed with a damp, rosy hue, sleeping soundly and peacefully.

Song Yu looked at it for a long time.

After about three minutes, he finally snapped out of it. He immediately turned off his phone, turned his head to look out the car window, and let out a breath.

At the wall at the end of the alley, no more small animals were passing by. The number "24" on the wall was peeling, and the wind made the vines sway, occasionally brushing off bits of plaster.

Remembering something, Song Yu opened his phone again and switched to WeChat. His contacts now included a new group labeled [Linlin’s Friends].

There were over a hundred "people" in it.

The nicknames were also eclectic, including but not limited to: Lele, Milk, Coffee, Fluffball, Pipi...

Actually, he had considered applying for phone cards in bulk, but firstly, there wasn't enough time, and secondly, phone cards were a long-term commitment, so he chose to use WeChat instead.

The Bureau mostly managed small animals in the city. Those with guardians could use their guardian's WeChat account to add a sub-account, allowing them to stay in touch.

Over the past week, Song Yu had added quite a few scattered contacts.

He had originally wanted to send a message to 001, but the other party didn't seem to like playing on his phone, and Pipi wasn't sure if he was on duty today.

Song Yu thought for a moment and clicked on a random one. He looked down and found it was a rabbit named "Fluffball," and checking its homepage, it posted to its Moments almost every day.

"..."

That should be reachable.

-

Inside the Bureau.

A pygmy rabbit was sitting in the corner of the sofa, holding its phone. Beside it, two elegant little cats were applying nail polish, chatting occasionally.

"My guardian is always making a fuss. Even though she knows I'm a demon, she still won't let me speak human language."

The calico cat next to it was very graceful. She stretched out her paw, which looked like a mangosteen, to check the gradient, looking very satisfied, and chatted idly:

"It's normal. Guardians are just very fragile. They can't accept things beyond their cognition, so we should just be understanding."

As the calico cat said this, she remembered the incident from last time and couldn't help but say:

"So that guardian from last time, the one for the newly hired 247 in the bird department, choosing to come to the base to register in person—that was truly rare."

The pygmy rabbit nodded, agreeing sincerely:

"The Boss is truly amazing!"

Calico cat: "..."

However, just at that moment, a commotion broke out in the hallway, and a crowd of demons squeezed together.

The pygmy rabbit had wanted to join in the fun, but its phone buzzed, so it had to find a place to see what the message was...

-

Bai Linlin was currently receiving a welcome. The bird was walking down the hall with his small cross-body bag, swaggering along, occasionally stretching out his wings to wave.

He had originally intended to say he would hand out snacks later, but a voice rang out from the crowd of demons:

"Boss! Have you seen the Bureau's Corridor of History? They added new photos! You're in them!"

The bird’s claws stopped. He was curious, and the nervousness of the assessment dissipated, replaced by the question:

"My photo?"

The fancy mouse leading the way patted his chest with his paw, looking very confident, and immediately said, "Boss, follow me!"

A small path opened up in the crowd of demons. In front was a mouse in a suit and leather shoes running quickly, looking back from time to time, and behind him was a round little bird, waddling along.

Bai Linlin heard the term "Corridor of History" and couldn't help but wonder if it was like a "Wall of Fame"?

The bird felt a surge of excitement.

After all, he hadn't made it onto the "Honor Student List" at school yet, and that was very cool.

Thus, the hall featured this scene:

A little mouse leading the way, acting respectfully toward the little bird behind him, while behind the bird followed a massive crowd of little demons.

It felt quite like forming a gang.

001 arrived a bit late today. When he reached the bird activity area, there were no demons left; it was empty.

He had to shift into his human form and look around, holding a "cheat sheet" he had prepared.

Where did 247 go?

Just then, a pygmy rabbit came hopping over. Seeing 001, it asked:

"Where did the Boss go?"

001: "Don't know."

The two demons looked at each other, until a small snake slithering rapidly across the floor passed by, muttering:

"Boss, Boss, I'm coming!"

001: "..."

The black-clad youth shifted back into a grey-brown sparrow and flapped his wings, flying toward the southeast corner of the hall.

The pygmy rabbit remained where it was, looking at the message on its phone screen:

[Sorry to bother you, but could you trouble yourself to check on my little bird's status after its assessment is over?]

[My little bird is young and cares about its pride; I'm afraid it won't tell me if it's been criticized. If it’s unhappy, could you contact me immediately?]

[Of course, if everything goes smoothly, there's no need to disturb it. You can just have a good time.]

The pygmy rabbit held the phone for a long time. To be honest, it didn't know many characters, as its Moments were mostly pictures, focusing on the vibe.

However, it was still able to extract the key information:

[...my little bird...]

[...my little bird...]

The pygmy rabbit pondered. Isn't the guardian just missing the Boss?

Shaking its head...

Humans really are weak and incapable of taking care of themselves.

-

The Corridor of History, as the name suggests, was a photo wall of important events since the Bureau's founding. Gold patterns flowed over it, making it look very stylish.

The hall floor was also very clean, with crystal lights refracting colors from the ceiling, and beneath them was a group of little demons.

The fancy mouse stood by the wall and began to introduce, "Boss, look, these are only taken on particularly meaningful occasions."

"This is the first little demon to register. It was a weasel from a zoo. It’s gone out of the province to do a mission now."

The bird stood on the floor, looking up to observe, tucking in his wings, feeling like he was on an inspection tour.

The fancy mouse kept gesturing with his paws, explaining photo after photo, and the surrounding little demons followed behind the bird, occasionally letting out gasps of amazement.

Until—

"Boss, this is your photo, look!"

Bai Linlin thought it must be the snapshot from the last class. After all, he had performed so well; it was only right that it be hung outside for other little demons to admire.

But the moment the bird looked up.

Hanging on the wall was a huge photo of a human and a bird. It had a red background, and the human looked as shy as ever: his face flushed, and the bird had its wing roots tucked in tight.

Bai Linlin turned to stone.

What was worse was that the little demons behind him began to cheer, and some unknown mouse even pulled out a party popper from the corner that hadn't been used last time.

The bird’s gaze was hollow, and in his field of vision, colorful ribbons were floating down.

When 001 arrived, this was the massive "group photo" he saw, with a caption underneath:

Commemorating the first guardian to come in person to process documents with a demon. Of great historical significance, it is a major achievement for the Bureau in recent years, marking a milestone in promoting peaceful coexistence between humans and demons.

chunks.chineseText:
001砰的一下化成黑衣少年，面色懵懵的，往后退了两步，拿出手机。

拍照。

白粼粼彻底红温了，他低着鸟头就要离开，但刚一转身，就看到001在拍……

鸟：！

你也叛变！

侏儒兔此刻也捧着手机过来了，看到这副巨大的合影直接惊叹了，战略后仰，果然是老大。

它蹦蹦跳跳去角落里了。

……

与此同时。

车内的少年还在等消息，直到手机页面传来一张照片。

宋郁点开，愣住了。

为什么……挂在墙上？

很快那边小妖怪还传来了语音，很兴奋地道：

“人，你和老大的合影看到了吗？简直太般配了！”

宋郁一时半会不知道怎么回复，他脑子一片空白，只是在接受这个信息。

他后面退出了聊天页面，本意是想缓一下，但朋友圈却不断地有红点。

宋郁点进去了。

全部都是那张巨幅合影……

备注的文案都是：

[老大赛高！]

[老大威武！]

[老大厉害！]

……

白粼粼被围在正中间，鸟头下压，鸟眼紧闭。

爪子在大厅的地板上深深扣住。

就在这时，丹顶鹤过来了，蹙眉斥责道：

“都围着做什么，回到自己的活动区域！”

“247还要考核，还是你们也想考核？”

周围的小妖怪立马散开了，犹如气氛组到点下班，就是还在窃窃私语交谈着，大体是“拍得真不错”、“老大还是老大”之类的话，就是后面不知道是谁说了句“都上历史回廊了，估计得放几百年吧”……

鸟的爪子都开始滑了。

001在后面一直没走，化成小雀的模样，啪嗒啪嗒地靠近，注意到了丹顶鹤的目光后仰头看过去：

“247没想到合影会被挂上来，我和它聊聊。”

丹顶鹤很是优雅，闻言其实还有些蹙眉，完全不理解这有什么意外的，它还欣赏了下照片，自顾自地道：

“真是不错。”

灰棕色的小雀偷偷瞅了一眼丹顶鹤，凑着鸟头靠近蓝羽小鸟，眼疾手快地把纸条塞进对方的翅根里了，低声道：

“考核不难的。”

“加油。”

白粼粼这才回了回神，夹紧了翅根，闷闷地问：

“如果不难，为什么要给我塞这个？”

001：“……”

-

后面鸟就去考场了，身上就没有小挎包了，托001去把零食给大家分了。

白粼粼闷头闷脑地跟在丹顶鹤的身后，爪子都烫烫的，或者说，整只鸟都很红温。

前面优雅踱步的丹顶鹤斜斜瞥了一眼，出声教育道：

“怎么就这点胆量？”

“人类的寿命何其短暂，247，你的监护人是我见过第一个愿意来管理局里登记的。”

“妖怪，对于人类而言，其实是危险的。”

白粼粼在后面跟着走，身躯圆滚滚的，闻言仰头看了过去。

丹顶鹤只是抬起翅膀推开了门，又道：

“妖怪是数量少，但是对于单个人类来说，杀掉，吃掉，都是轻而易举的事。”

“不然也不会有灰色屏幕滚动的那些信息。”

丹顶鹤让鸟进来之后就去了讲台那里，一边收拾有密封条的考卷，一边语气平和地道：

“所以，你的监护人是我见过最勇敢的。”

一秒，两秒。

“他还给我发了手机。”

鸟本来都感动了。

“……”

丹顶鹤咳咳了两声，总之是拿着卷子来到了讲台下面，一个圆滚滚的小鸟已经站在桌面上了，就位中。

“人类是群居动物，他们有自己的伦理道德和社会规则，很少能够彻底放下原有的思维模式，坚持地认为妖怪……不存在。”

丹顶鹤说到这里也叹了口气，对桌上的小鸟接着讲：

“所以你化形之后，他还带着你过来，我是很意外的。”

“247，要抓住这个人。”

白粼粼伸了伸翅根，鸟头垂下了，毛绒绒的，似乎也在思考。

但就在这时。

一张纸条慢悠悠地飘了出来。

“……”

“……”

鸟仰头看了过去，爪子紧扣桌面。

“247！”

-

宋郁还在调整心绪，后面又抬手点开了那张照片，放大，看的不是墙上合影的内容，而是妖怪堆里那只小小的背影。

管理局也没有提前告知。

他的小鸟很爱面子的……

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，心里还是有些放心不下，只是抬眼看着小巷尽头的那个围墙处。

不过就在这时，他的手机突然嗡嗡震动了下。

消息只有一句话：

[宋郁，你上次托我问的事我弄清楚了。]

……

教室。

鸟正在用爪子握着笔，开始写客观题，他是真的不太会。

题目：全国妖怪管理局一共有多少个？

A：245个

B：678个

C：456个

鸟怎么可能记得，手册上这些内容一看就是引言，谁会看这些？

白粼粼握着笔，虽然是低着鸟头，但很斟酌地抬头看丹顶鹤的反应。

鸟把笔放到A选项。

丹顶鹤蹙眉。

鸟把笔放到B选项。

丹顶鹤闭了闭眼。

鸟选C！

丹顶鹤这才点了点头。

白粼粼就靠着这一招硬生生地写完了选择题，不过到了判断那里就很难了。

题目：体内的妖力核心处在心脏部位，与人类的器官核心类似。

对还是错？

鸟为难，还想抬头看。

“247，我脸上有答案吗？”

“……”

白粼粼只能一顿乱蒙。

-

与此同时，车内。

宋郁面色冷了下来，因为问的是身份证的事，他需要给他的小鸟一个合法身份。

[你要想操作实际上很难，他们看你年轻不会给你机会的。]

[宋爷爷知道吗，不行的话……]

宋郁不可能拿这个事去找他爷爷，这是他的小鸟，他养的。

少年手指在方向盘上微微压紧，他需要快速地成长起来。

四年太长了。

宋郁抿了抿唇，看向车窗外，心里纷乱的思绪一点点压下去。

他要给他的小鸟最好的。

……

考核还在进行中。

白粼粼在讲台那里，看着丹顶鹤现场批卷，看到红叉叉鸟心就一咯噔。

好在最后一顿勾勾叉叉下去，鸟得了六十整。

丹顶鹤蹙眉道：“247，你这理论知识一点都不扎实，这次考得这么差也不要气馁……”

视线一转移。

桌上的小鸟已经开心地伸了伸翅根，仰头看了过来。

“……”

丹顶鹤见状后也不说什么重话了，只是挥挥翅膀，道：

“过来，开始实践考核。”

实践考核很简单，就是评价一个妖怪自主控制形态的能力，包括本体大小变化（成绩占比10%）、本体化人形（成绩占比50%）、人形化本体（成绩占比40%）。

白粼粼闻言啪嗒啪嗒地跟了过去，来到了教室后面的空地，仰头看着丹顶鹤。

有些紧张。
chunks.englishText:
001 transformed into a black-clad youth with a bewildered expression. He took two steps back and pulled out his phone.

Click.

Bai Linlin was completely flushed. He lowered his bird head, intending to leave, but the moment he turned around, he saw 001 snapping a photo...

Bird: !

You’re a traitor too!

The dwarf rabbit also trotted over, phone in hand. Upon seeing the massive group photo, it gasped in awe, leaning back in strategic admiration—truly, their boss was the best.

It hopped away into a corner.

...

Meanwhile.

The youth in the car was still waiting for news, until a photo popped up on his phone screen.

Song Yu opened it and froze.

Why... is it hanging on the wall?

Soon, the little monster sent a voice message, sounding extremely excited:

"Human, did you see the group photo with the Boss? You two look like such a perfect match!"

Song Yu didn't know how to reply for a moment. His mind went blank; he was still processing the information.

He exited the chat, intending to take a breather, but his social media feed was flooded with red notification dots.

Song Yu clicked in.

It was all that same giant group photo...

The captions were all:

[Boss is the best!]

[Boss is mighty!]

[Boss is amazing!]

...

Bai Linlin was surrounded in the very center, his bird head bowed, eyes squeezed shut.

His talons dug deep into the floor of the lobby.

Just then, the Red-crowned Crane walked over, frowning as he scolded:

"What are you all crowding around for? Get back to your designated activity areas!"

"247 still has an assessment to take. Or do you all want to take an assessment too?"

The surrounding little monsters scattered immediately, like a hype squad clocking out at the end of a shift. They were still whispering to each other, mostly saying things like "That was a great shot" or "The Boss is still the Boss," though someone added, "It's on the Corridor of History now, it'll probably be up for a few hundred years..."

The bird's talons began to slip.

001 hadn't left; he had transformed back into a small sparrow. He hopped closer, pattering along, and noticing the Red-crowned Crane's gaze, he looked up:

"247 didn't expect the photo to be hung up. I'll go talk to him."

The Red-crowned Crane, ever elegant, still frowned at the mention, completely failing to understand why this was a surprise. He even admired the photo himself, muttering:

"Truly excellent."

The gray-brown sparrow snuck a glance at the Red-crowned Crane, then leaned his bird head toward the blue-feathered bird. With lightning speed, he tucked a note into the base of the other's wing and whispered:

"The assessment isn't hard."

"Good luck."

Bai Linlin finally snapped out of it. He clamped his wing down and asked gloomily:

"If it's not hard, why did you have to slip me this?"

001: "..."

-

Later, the bird went to the examination room. He no longer had his little satchel, having entrusted 001 to distribute the snacks to everyone.

Bai Linlin followed behind the Red-crowned Crane, head bowed. His talons felt hot—or rather, the whole bird was flushed.

The elegant crane walking in front glanced back sideways and lectured:

"Why such a lack of courage?"

"Human lifespans are so fleeting. 247, your guardian is the first I've ever seen who was willing to come to the Bureau to register."

"Monsters are, to humans, inherently dangerous."

Bai Linlin followed behind, his body round and plump. Hearing this, he looked up.

The Red-crowned Crane simply raised a wing to push open the door and continued:

"Monsters may be few in number, but to a single human, killing or eating one is an effortless task."

"Otherwise, there wouldn't be those messages scrolling on the gray screens."

After letting the bird inside, the Red-crowned Crane went to the podium. While organizing the sealed exam papers, he said in a calm tone:

"So, your guardian is the bravest I have ever seen."

One second, two seconds.

"He even bought me a phone."

The bird had been genuinely moved.

"..."

The Red-crowned Crane coughed twice. Regardless, he brought the papers down to the podium, where a round little bird was already standing on the desk, in position.

"Humans are social animals. They have their own ethics, morals, and social rules. It is rare for them to completely let go of their original mindset and insist that monsters... do not exist."

The Red-crowned Crane sighed at this point, continuing to the little bird on the desk:

"So, I was very surprised when he brought you here after you gained your human form."

"247, you must hold onto this person."

Bai Linlin stretched his wing, his bird head drooping. He looked fluffy and seemed to be deep in thought.

But just then.

A note drifted out slowly.

"..."

"..."

The bird looked up, talons gripping the desk tightly.

"247!"

-

Song Yu was still adjusting his mood. Later, he raised his hand and tapped on that photo again, zooming in—not at the content of the group photo on the wall, but at the tiny back figure amidst the crowd of monsters.

The Bureau hadn't given any prior notice.

His little bird was very concerned about his pride...

Song Yu frowned, still feeling uneasy, his eyes fixed on the wall at the end of the alley.

Just then, his phone buzzed.

The message contained only one sentence:

[Song Yu, I've cleared up the matter you asked me to look into last time.]

...

In the classroom.

The bird was holding a pen with his talons, starting to write the objective questions. He really wasn't very good at this.

Question: How many National Monster Management Bureaus are there in total?

A: 245

B: 678

C: 456

How could the bird possibly remember? These things in the manual looked like an introduction; who would read that?

Bai Linlin held the pen, and although his head was bowed, he carefully looked up to gauge the Red-crowned Crane's reaction.

The bird moved the pen to option A.

The Red-crowned Crane frowned.

The bird moved the pen to option B.

The Red-crowned Crane closed his eyes.

The bird chose C!

The Red-crowned Crane finally nodded.

Bai Linlin relied on this trick to finish the multiple-choice questions, but the True/False section was very difficult.

Question: The monster power core in the body is located in the heart, similar to the core of human organs.

True or False?

The bird was troubled and wanted to look up again.

"247, is the answer on my face?"

"..."

Bai Linlin could only guess wildly.

-

Meanwhile, in the car.

Song Yu's expression turned cold. Because the question was about an ID card, he needed to give his little bird a legal identity.

[It's actually very difficult to operate. They see you're young and won't give you a chance.]

[Does Grandpa Song know? If not...]

Song Yu couldn't possibly go to his grandfather for this. This was his little bird; he was the one raising him.

The youth's fingers pressed tightly against the steering wheel. He needed to grow up quickly.

Four years was too long.

Song Yu pursed his lips and looked out the car window, pushing down the chaotic thoughts in his heart.

He would give his little bird the best of everything.

...

The assessment was still ongoing.

Bai Linlin was at the podium, watching the Red-crowned Crane grade the papers on the spot. Every time he saw a red 'X', his bird heart skipped a beat.

Fortunately, after a final round of checks and crosses, the bird scored exactly sixty.

The Red-crowned Crane frowned and said: "247, your theoretical knowledge is not solid at all. Don't be discouraged by such a poor performance this time..."

As his gaze shifted.

The little bird on the desk had already happily stretched his wings and looked up.

"..."

Seeing this, the Red-crowned Crane didn't say anything harsh, just waved his wings and said:

"Come over, let's start the practical assessment."

The practical assessment was simple: it evaluated a monster's ability to autonomously control their form, including changing the size of their original form (10% of the grade), transforming from original form to human form (50%), and human form to original form (40%).

Hearing this, Bai Linlin pattered over to the open space at the back of the classroom and looked up at the Red-crowned Crane.

He was a little nervous.

chunks.chineseText:
“一般来说，本体大小变化是幼鸟掌握的基础技能，一来可以变小节约体内妖力，二来也可以变大恐吓那些有威胁的人类。”

“247，来试试。”

丹顶鹤很认真地讲解。

然而下一秒。

一个两米高的毛绒绒巨鸟出现在面前，圆滚滚的，等比例放大N倍，鸟眼圆圆，纯良。

丹顶鹤：“这不是和来登记那天一样吗？”

白粼粼拘谨，爪子收了收。

“要变得不一样，变大的话，要狰狞一些，恐吓你懂么？”

鸟理解了下，把短喙张得很开，血盆大口，翅膀也伸开了，俨然摆起来了“凶狠”pose。

丹顶鹤其实还是有些不满意，但后面想了想，还是在手里的评价单上划了个勾。

勉勉强强吧。

“好，那变小。”

白粼粼立马把翅膀收了回来，站得板板正正的，然后开始垂着鸟头，闭眼蓄力。

一秒两秒。

砰！

地板上多了只毛绒绒的小鸡。

丹顶鹤这才温和道：

“不错。”

-

001在外面分发零食，其实有些心不在焉的，它时不时地会去看看那个教室，顺带用爪子递给排队的小妖怪，很平静地道：

“下一个。”

就这么逐步分发完毕。

001最后用鸟头拱起来那个小挎包，替247先拿着了，然后坐在吧台那里耐心等待。

如果这次考核通过的话。

那247就是A级妖怪了。

灰棕色小雀蓬了蓬毛，有些小小的期待，毕竟A级妖怪的话，压住那个监护人简直是轻而易举。

……

“化形吧。”

最终还是进行到了最后一个环节，白粼粼其实很紧张，他总是会在这里出岔子，成功变人的几率和变大鸟的几率五五开。

丹顶鹤说完话还等了一会，低头看了下，催促道：

“247？”

地板上的小鸟爪子都劈叉了，低着鸟头，已经闭上了眼睛，闻言伸了下翅膀。

——莫催。

白粼粼心里复习着001告诉他的诀窍，想象人类肢体伸展的感觉，把自己当成人类……

笑话！

他芯子本来就是人类。

怎么可能掌握不好！

白粼粼一个凝神聚力，周身金纹涌动，一开始还是缓慢流动的，后面就是加速，再之后——

一个身着棕色格纹衬衫、头戴复古贝雷帽、搭配及膝短裤，以及一双英伦小皮鞋的少年出现了。

浅蓝色的头发，面容优越，垂眸看着他的“老师”。

白粼粼其实还转了一圈的，他在找他的手杖，出门的时候搭配好了今天的OOTD的，落在车上了吗？

丹顶鹤其实是愣了下的。

它踱步了几下，绕着面前的“少年”走了一圈，而后在评价单上打下一个大大的勾。

“很好。”

-

001最后等的都犯困了，直到面前一道蓝影冲过，一翅膀把它拍醒了。

两只小鸟在吧台上面对面的。

白粼粼很是骄傲，用喙递过去一张成绩单：

理论知识：60分（占比30%）

实践知识：100分（占比70%）

总分：88分。

001看到后也清醒了，抬起翅膀就去盖住旁边的蓝羽小鸟了，虽然有点费劲，但还是道：

“太好了，你之后还可以升S级，你要是一直往上升的话，会获得很多……”

鸟摇头：“不要。”

“学习很累的。”

“能化形就好了。”

灰棕色小雀很不理解，歪头道：

“为什么，你不想往上升？那为什么这么坚持化形？我看你收了很多津贴，很努力的样子。”

白粼粼条件反射地道：“因为宋郁……”

一下子卡停了。

两只毛绒绒的小鸟对视。

001眯了眯眼。

“我不是。”

灰棕色小雀啪嗒啪嗒凑过去，又对视。

“我说了我不是。”

-

与此同时，巷子口那里还停着车，宋郁还在等，后面就直接下来了。

看了下时间。

果不其然，围墙处的小门开了，有一连串小动物开始往外走。

鸟背着小挎包，挺胸抬头地走出来了，爪子在地面上哒哒的，很有劲。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀飞到了宋郁的肩头，很是矜持地道：

“通过了。”

宋郁这才松了一口气，连带着因为那通消息产生的负面情绪都消散了，只是温声道：

“那我们白天去餐厅吃饭？好不好？”

“啾！”

鸟允了。

后面时间就过得很快了，锦园里安安稳稳的，白粼粼在家里躺平得不知天地为何物。

一三五他在家里打游戏，偶尔去书房视察一下，有概率获得一幅水墨肖像画。

二四六001会来做客，鸟已经逐步教会了对方打游戏，双排开黑指日可待。

至于周末，就是去基地开Party！

美哉美哉。

不过宋郁似乎最近一直很忙，很多时候都是晚上才回来，或许是开学的缘故，他现在公司学校两头跑，晚上还会看一些完全不懂的外文书籍。

但就是这样，他还要周末去接送。

白粼粼其实委婉地表达了自己可以一个鸟去管理局的意愿。

“为什么？”

鸟在当时得到的原话就是这样，他不知道怎么了有点紧张，就说了担心对方身体的事。

宋郁好像才恍然大悟。

后面家里就多了健身房，什么设施都有，非常完备，宋郁更忙了，因为他还要抽出来一个小时去健身。

白粼粼觉得自己帮了倒忙。

不过宋郁确实是个很自律的人，他保持这么高强度的生活已经有一段时间了，非但没有出岔子，反倒是身材越来越好。

身高也远远不止一米八了。

或者说早就过了。

白粼粼焦虑了起来。

他胸膛的毛十分蓬松，甚至看不到鸟爪了。

“……”

躺平是很爽，但旁边有个太自律的人就不好了，会心惊胆战地躺平。

白粼粼一日终于下定决心，他也要健身！

鸟深吸一口气，扑棱翅膀从书桌上飞了下来，走到门口就熟练地用鸟头拱开了卧室的门，坚定不移地走向二楼的健身房。

人太卷了。

鸟不能落后！

白粼粼进去的时候宋郁在做平板支撑，或许是处于锻炼的需要，没有穿上衣，鸟头从门缝里探了出来。

鸟眼圆圆的。

哇。

“粼粼？”

鸟被发现了也不害臊，大大方方地进来了，伸着爪子就走到宋郁的跟前。

对方正在做平板支撑。

“这里有器械，去卧室里睡觉好不好？”

晚上了。

白粼粼假装听不懂人话，他也忘了自己来的目的，看到了人宽阔的脊背，不由得动了点念头。

嘿嘿。

鸟扑棱翅膀上去了，爪子还在上面打了个滑，但还好是稳定住了，伸出鸟腿坐下了。

“……”

“宋郁，快做俯卧撑！”

白粼粼居高临下的，开始发号施令。

人很听话，的确开始做了。
chunks.englishText:
"Generally speaking, changing the size of one's original form is a basic skill mastered by young birds. Firstly, it can be shrunk to conserve the monster power within the body, and secondly, it can be enlarged to intimidate threatening humans."

"247, give it a try."

The Red-crowned Crane explained very seriously.

However, the next second.

A two-meter-tall, fluffy giant bird appeared before him. It was round and plump, enlarged N times in proportion, with round, innocent bird eyes.

The Red-crowned Crane: "Isn't this the same as the day you came to register?"

Bai Linlin was reserved, pulling his talons in.

"It needs to be different. When you get bigger, you have to look ferocious. You understand intimidation, right?"

The bird processed this, opening his short beak wide into a bloody maw and spreading his wings, striking a "fierce" pose.

The Red-crowned Crane was still somewhat dissatisfied, but after a moment's thought, he checked a box on his evaluation sheet.

Good enough, I suppose.

"Alright, now shrink."

Bai Linlin immediately tucked his wings back in, stood perfectly straight, then lowered his bird head, closing his eyes to gather his strength.

One second, two seconds.

*Poof!*

A fluffy little chick appeared on the floor.

The Red-crowned Crane then said gently:

"Not bad."

-

001 was distributing snacks outside, though he was a bit distracted. He would occasionally look toward the classroom, while using his talons to hand items to the queue of little monsters, saying calmly:

"Next."

And so, the distribution was completed step by step.

Finally, 001 nudged the little satchel with his bird head, holding it for 247, and sat at the bar counter, waiting patiently.

If he passed this assessment.

Then 247 would be an A-rank monster.

The gray-brown sparrow fluffed his feathers, feeling a little anticipation. After all, as an A-rank monster, suppressing that guardian would be an absolute breeze.

...

"Transform."

Finally, they reached the last stage. Bai Linlin was actually very nervous; he always hit snags here. His chance of successfully turning into a human was about fifty-fifty with his chance of turning into a giant bird.

After the Red-crowned Crane spoke, he waited a while, looked down, and urged:

"247?"

The little bird on the floor had his talons splayed out, head bowed, eyes already closed. Hearing this, he stretched out a wing.

—Don't rush me.

Bai Linlin reviewed the tips 001 had given him, imagining the feeling of human limbs stretching, treating himself as a human...

What a joke!

He was a human at his core anyway.

How could he not master it!

Bai Linlin focused his energy, and golden patterns surged around his body. At first, they flowed slowly, then accelerated, and after that—

A youth appeared, dressed in a brown plaid shirt, a vintage beret, knee-length shorts, and a pair of British-style leather shoes.

With light blue hair and superior features, he looked down at his "teacher."

Bai Linlin actually turned around once. He was looking for his cane; he had planned today's OOTD before leaving, had he left it in the car?

The Red-crowned Crane was actually stunned for a moment.

He paced a few times, circled the "youth" in front of him, and then put a big checkmark on the evaluation sheet.

"Very good."

-

001 was so sleepy he was about to doze off, until a blue shadow rushed past and slapped him awake with a wing.

The two birds were face-to-face on the bar counter.

Bai Linlin was very proud, using his beak to hand over a report card:

Theoretical Knowledge: 60 points (30% weight)

Practical Knowledge: 100 points (70% weight)

Total Score: 88 points.

001 woke up upon seeing this and raised a wing to cover the blue-feathered bird next to him. Although it was a bit of a struggle, he said:

"That's great! You can be promoted to S-rank later. If you keep moving up, you'll get a lot of..."

The bird shook his head: "No."

"Studying is very tiring."

"It's enough to be able to transform."

The gray-brown sparrow didn't understand, tilting his head:

"Why? You don't want to move up? Then why are you so persistent about transforming? I see you've been collecting a lot of subsidies, you look like you're working hard."

Bai Linlin replied reflexively: "Because Song Yu..."

He suddenly cut himself off.

The two fluffy birds stared at each other.

001 narrowed his eyes.

"I'm not."

The gray-brown sparrow pattered over, and they stared at each other again.

"I said I'm not."

-

Meanwhile, the car was still parked at the alley entrance, and Song Yu was still waiting. Later, he stepped out.

He checked the time.

Sure enough, the small door in the wall opened, and a line of small animals began to walk out.

The bird was wearing his little satchel, walking out with his chest puffed and head held high, his talons clicking rhythmically on the ground with great energy.

Bai Linlin flapped his wings and flew onto Song Yu's shoulder, acting very reserved:

"I passed."

Song Yu finally let out a sigh of relief, and even the negative emotions caused by that message dissipated. He just said gently:

"Then shall we go to a restaurant for dinner during the day? How about that?"

"Chirp!"

The bird agreed.

Time passed quickly after that. Life in Jin Yuan was peaceful, and Bai Linlin lay around at home, oblivious to the world.

On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, he played games at home, occasionally inspecting the study, where he had a chance to receive an ink-wash portrait.

On Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, 001 would come to visit. The bird had gradually taught him how to play games, and a duo-queue session was just around the corner.

As for the weekends, it was time to go to the base for a party!

Life was good.

However, Song Yu seemed very busy lately, often returning only at night. Perhaps it was because school had started; he was running between the company and school, and at night he would read foreign language books he didn't understand at all.

But even so, he still insisted on picking him up and dropping him off on weekends.

Bai Linlin had actually expressed, in a roundabout way, his willingness to go to the Bureau by himself.

"Why?"

That was the original response the bird had received at the time. He didn't know why, but he felt a bit nervous, so he said he was worried about the other's health.

Song Yu seemed to have a sudden realization.

Later, a gym appeared in the house, fully equipped with every facility. Song Yu became even busier because he had to carve out an hour to work out.

Bai Linlin felt he had done more harm than good.

However, Song Yu was indeed a very self-disciplined person. He had been maintaining this high-intensity lifestyle for a while now, and not only did he not slip up, but his physique was getting better and better.

His height was also far beyond 1.8 meters.

Or rather, he had passed that long ago.

Bai Linlin began to feel anxious.

The feathers on his chest were so fluffy that he couldn't even see his bird talons.

"..."

Lying flat was great, but it wasn't good to have someone too disciplined next to you; it made one feel uneasy about lying flat.

One day, Bai Linlin finally made up his mind: he would work out too!

The bird took a deep breath, flapped his wings, flew off the desk, walked to the door, and skillfully nudged the bedroom door open with his bird head, walking firmly toward the gym on the second floor.

Humans were too competitive.

A bird couldn't fall behind!

When Bai Linlin entered, Song Yu was doing a plank. Perhaps due to the needs of his workout, he wasn't wearing a shirt. The bird head poked out from the crack in the door.

His bird eyes were round.

Wow.

"Linlin?"

The bird wasn't embarrassed to be discovered; he walked in openly and stretched his talons, walking right up to Song Yu.

The other was still holding the plank.

"There's equipment here. Why don't you go back to the bedroom and sleep?"

It was night.

Bai Linlin pretended not to understand human speech. He had also forgotten his original purpose. Seeing the man's broad back, he couldn't help but have a thought.

Hehehe.

The bird flapped his wings and climbed up. His talons slipped a bit, but he managed to stabilize himself, stretched out his bird legs, and sat down.

"..."

"Song Yu, do some push-ups!"
