“是的，要知道我们对于监护人的筛选其实很是严格的，像人类的工作时长、生活空间、品性如何……都是列入我们的评估范围的。”

丹顶鹤说到这里，斜斜地撇了一眼旁边的人类，直到对方抬眸看了过来，才接着道：

“相信你也知道人类社会里有很多不负责任的‘养宠人’吧？”

宋峥国只是点头，“对，对，确实有很多人不负责任，还弃养……”

茶室里一片祥和，丹顶鹤见终于引入正题了，这才道：

“我们247是误打误撞被你们家的孩子带走的，原本按照程序来说，我们管理局会有专员去秋水巷的花鸟市场把它带回来的，但……谁知道，被你们孩子抢先了一步。”

宋峥国其实前所未有的无措，他是有很多同人打交道的经验，但是……面前是一只鹤。

他只能很斟酌地回复：

“我们小郁是个负责任的孩子，他一定会养好鸟儿的。”

丹顶鹤闻言再度颔首，但又摇摇头道：

“可人类的承诺实在是太轻飘飘了，就算是婚姻……也不是终身制，总会有些人类会出轨，背叛，甚至抛弃……”

宋峥国蹙了蹙眉，直接替自己孙子保证道：

“请你放心，我们小郁绝对不会背叛鸟儿的！”

一秒，两秒。

老头说完才察觉到好像有点不对。

-

而书房那里的氛围就没有这么好了。

道士只是蹙眉，反复强调道：

“妖怪本身就是个喜怒无常的东西，孩子你不要被蛊惑了！”

宋郁只是平静道：“这与您何干呢？”

剑拔弩张。

白粼粼其实有点担心，他从宋郁身上下来了，化形成人的模样，身上的装扮还是早上的样子，材质很好的白色衬衫，以及扣着腰带的西服短裤，外带一双长筒袜。

“少年”就站在后面，手臂还搭在宋郁的肩头，他只是为自己辩白道：

“我不会蛊惑的。”

“我……我只是会化形，刚学会的。”

道士其实是愣了一下的，干巴老头眯了眯眼，似乎有些不太相信，这是刚才那只圆嘟嘟的鸟变的？

这……天赋吗？

还说不是蛊惑！

白粼粼真没有什么办法，他有点担心这个道士是来收他的，会不会待会就拿出来一个葫芦？

他脑子乱乱的，着急了，鞋子都忘记幻化出来了，只是还想要为自己解释，他是一个好妖的……

但是就在这时，手腕被轻轻一带，白粼粼整个“人”都斜了下，贴在了宋郁的身侧。

“唔。”

宋郁只是抬眸看向对面的道士，坦坦荡荡道：

“蛊惑又怎样？”

白粼粼懵了下，他说了不会这个的。

不过对面的道士像是气晕了，深吸一口气，只是耐着性子同面前的少年道：

“妖是妖，人是人，二者的思维模式都是不同的，虽说南市的妖怪管理局是在运转正常，但它们的妖力提升方式非常奇怪，用津贴就可以，你身旁的这只，已经走了邪路，他现在是A级，隔日呢？”

“你知不知道上了S级的妖怪根本就——”

宋郁蹙眉打断道：“够了！”

白粼粼被握着手腕，安安静静的，其实也不知道怎么办。

不过丹顶鹤在楼下……

应该应该他不会被立马带走吧？

是因为妖力津贴的事？

鸟郁闷，早知道不这么干了。

道士是觉得无可救药了，这毕竟是个涉世未深的孩子，他也闭了闭眼，不知道怎么做。

但就在这时，对面的少年又说话了，语气已经变得平稳：

“您是我爷爷的朋友，我理应尊重，但是，我的小鸟它没有任何害人的意图，您这么一而再再而三地指责它，我不可能不维护。”

“很抱歉，当我没有礼数吧。”

“这与我爷爷无关。”

宋郁已经不想谈下去了，他尽管是生着病的，但思维还算清晰，丹顶鹤都来了，那他的小鸟应该没什么事情，面前这个人……能和管理局的妖怪一起过来。

无非就是那个749局。

少年起身就要走，白粼粼站在旁边，视线直接从低到高，最后仰着头看了过去，有些茫然。

眼看着就要被带走了。

但就在这时，身后那道士站了起来，只是很苦口婆心地道：

“孩子，妖怪的寿命何其漫长，人类却只有百年之久，你这么一路纠缠下去，到时候会两手空空……”

白粼粼怔住了。

他张了张口，觉得手腕被禁锢得都有些疼了。

书房里一片死寂。

白粼粼还来不及仰头去看人，上方就传来一句冷冽的话：

“我不在乎。”

他被一下子拉走了。

-

茶室里还是慢悠悠的节奏。

宋峥国保证完，其实是老脸一红的，这怎么扯到婚姻上去了。

丹顶鹤从从容容地又道：

“我们鸟类向来倡导忠贞不渝，终身伴侣制，监护人也同样如此，一辈子都不能变。”

说完这句话，鹤又撇了一眼老头。

暗示意味很重。

宋峥国深吸一口气，不自觉地就顺着话头说下去了，“这个你放心，我们小郁肯定是忠贞不渝的。”

说完老人又陷入了自我怀疑。

这对吗？

丹顶鹤很满意了，这人比247聪慧多了，它抬起来翅膀，矜持地把茶杯放下，也很有礼貌地道：

“您说的话，我已记下，请看。”

宋峥国眼前被拢了下，一开始是漆黑，后面就是恢复了正常，茶室的布局还是原来的样子，但唯一不同的是，半空中多了一道金色波纹。

那像是一个小型的“屏幕”，里面播放着两段对话，分别是：

“……绝对不会背叛鸟儿……”

“……肯定是忠贞不渝的……”

老头：“……”

丹顶鹤挥了下翅膀，把这份“记录”给存下了，这往后就给247留下来个保障，今日一行也不算白来。

不过它又想起来一件事，很是认真地道：

“247如今还是个幼鸟，它才八个月大，全靠监护人细心照料着，等到它一岁半的时候，管理局会前来赠礼，这是历来的规矩。”

宋峥国愣了愣，但还是也起身了，点头道，“好好好。”

丹顶鹤这才化身成“女士”的模样，优雅自然，脖子上的藏蓝色丝带衬着“人”气色很好，它回头感谢道：

“多谢招待了。”

宋峥国其实在神游，他在这只鹤后头一个劲地想事……

这、这，他是不是把自己孙子给卖了啊？

老头拘谨。

-

两场谈话结束。
chunks.englishText:
"I believe you can see it too; our 247 is just a little bird. It was in a small flower and bird shop in Qiushui Lane. Heaven have mercy, it was born without parents to accompany it, and it was only five months old when your child took it away."

Song Zhengguo’s eyelid twitched slightly, but he felt inexplicably nervous. He rubbed his hands together and said:

"Yes, the bird is indeed still very young. Our Xiao Yu brought it here early on, and he should be responsible."

The red-crowned crane seemed satisfied with this, nodded slightly, and continued:

"Yes, you must know that our screening process for guardians is actually very strict. Things like a human’s working hours, living space, character... all these are included in our assessment."

As the red-crowned crane said this, it glanced sideways at the human beside it, and only when the other party looked up did it continue:

"I believe you also know that there are many irresponsible 'pet owners' in human society, right?"

Song Zhengguo simply nodded. "Yes, yes, there are indeed many irresponsible people who abandon them..."

The tea room was peaceful. Seeing that the topic had finally been introduced, the red-crowned crane said:

"Our 247 was taken away by your child by pure coincidence. Originally, according to procedure, our Bureau would have sent a specialist to the Qiushui Lane flower and bird market to bring it back, but... who would have thought your child would beat us to it."

Song Zhengguo was feeling unprecedentedly flustered. He had plenty of experience dealing with people, but... in front of him was a crane.

He could only reply cautiously:

"Our Xiao Yu is a responsible child; he will definitely take good care of the bird."

The red-crowned crane nodded again, but then shook its head:

"But human promises are far too flimsy. Even marriage... is not a lifelong commitment. There will always be humans who cheat, betray, or even abandon..."

Song Zhengguo frowned and guaranteed on behalf of his grandson:

"Please rest assured, our Xiao Yu will absolutely never betray the bird!"

One second, two seconds.

Only after the old man finished speaking did he realize something felt a bit off.

-

The atmosphere in the study was not nearly as pleasant.

The Taoist just frowned, repeating emphatically:

"Demons are inherently fickle creatures. Child, do not be bewitched!"

Song Yu said calmly, "What does that have to do with you?"

The tension was palpable.

Bai Linlin was actually a bit worried. He climbed down from Song Yu and transformed into his human form. His attire was the same as it had been that morning: a high-quality white shirt, tailored dress shorts with a belt, and a pair of knee-high socks.

The "youth" stood behind, resting his arm on Song Yu’s shoulder. He defended himself:

"I won't bewitch anyone."

"I... I only just learned how to transform."

The Taoist was actually stunned. The withered old man squinted, seemingly unable to believe it. This was what that round, chubby bird had turned into?

This... was this talent?

And he still claimed he wasn't bewitching!

Bai Linlin really had no idea what to do. He was worried that this Taoist had come to capture him; would he pull out a gourd in a moment?

His mind was in a mess, and he was anxious. He had even forgotten to manifest his shoes. He just wanted to explain that he was a good demon...

But just then, his wrist was gently tugged, and Bai Linlin’s whole "person" tilted, pressing against Song Yu’s side.

"Umm."

Song Yu just looked up at the Taoist across from him, open and honest:

"And what if I am bewitched?"

Bai Linlin was dazed. He had said he wouldn't do that.

However, the Taoist across from them seemed to be fuming. He took a deep breath and said with forced patience to the youth:

"A demon is a demon, and a human is a human. The thought patterns of the two are different. Although the Nanshi Demon Management Bureau is operating normally, their method of increasing demon power is very strange—using subsidies. The one beside you has already taken a crooked path. He is A-rank now, but what about tomorrow?"

"Do you know that once a demon reaches S-rank, they simply—"

Song Yu frowned and interrupted: "Enough!"

Bai Linlin was held by the wrist, quiet and still, not knowing what to do.

But the red-crowned crane was downstairs...

Surely, surely he wouldn't be taken away immediately?

Was it because of the demon power subsidies?

The bird felt depressed. If he had known, he wouldn't have done that.

The Taoist felt it was hopeless. After all, this was a child who hadn't seen much of the world. He closed his eyes, not knowing what to do.

But just then, the youth across from him spoke again, his tone now steady:

"You are my grandfather’s friend, and I should respect you. However, my little bird has no intention of harming anyone. Since you have accused it again and again, I cannot help but defend it."

"I apologize if I seem lacking in manners."

"This has nothing to do with my grandfather."

Song Yu no longer wanted to talk. Even though he was ill, his thinking was clear. Since the red-crowned crane had come, his little bird should be fine. As for the person in front of him... being able to come with a Bureau demon...

It was nothing more than that 749 Bureau.

The youth stood up to leave. Bai Linlin stood beside him, his gaze traveling from low to high, finally tilting his head to look up at him, feeling somewhat lost.

It looked like he was about to be taken away.

But just then, the Taoist behind him stood up and said earnestly:

"Child, the lifespan of a demon is so long, while humans only have a hundred years. If you continue to entangle yourself like this, you will end up with nothing in the end..."

Bai Linlin froze.

He opened his mouth, feeling that his wrist was being gripped so tightly it hurt.

The study was deathly silent.

Before Bai Linlin could even look up at the man, a cold, sharp voice came from above:

"I don't care."

He was pulled away in one motion.

-

The tea room still maintained a slow, leisurely pace.

After Song Zhengguo finished his guarantee, his old face flushed red. How did this get dragged into marriage?

The red-crowned crane continued calmly:

"We birds have always advocated for loyalty and a lifelong partner system. The guardian must be the same; it cannot change for a lifetime."

After saying this, the crane glanced at the old man again.

The implication was heavy.

Song Zhengguo took a deep breath and unconsciously followed the line of conversation, "You can rest assured about that; our Xiao Yu is definitely loyal."

After saying this, the old man fell into self-doubt.

Was this right?

The red-crowned crane was very satisfied. This person was much smarter than 247. It raised its wing, set the teacup down with restraint, and said very politely:

"I have noted what you said. Please, look."

Song Zhengguo’s vision was clouded for a moment. At first, it was pitch black, then it returned to normal. The layout of the tea room was the same as before, but the only difference was a golden ripple in mid-air.

It looked like a small "screen," playing two segments of dialogue:

"...absolutely never betray the bird..."

"...definitely loyal..."

The old man: "..."

The red-crowned crane waved its wing and saved this "record." This would provide a guarantee for 247 in the future; today’s trip was not in vain.

However, it remembered one more thing and said very seriously:

"247 is still a fledgling; it is only eight months old and relies entirely on the guardian’s careful care. When it reaches a year and a half, the Bureau will come to present a gift. This is the custom."

Song Zhengguo was stunned, but he stood up and nodded, "Good, good, good."

The red-crowned crane then transformed back into the appearance of the "lady," elegant and natural, the navy blue silk ribbon around its neck making the "person" look very radiant. It turned back to thank him:

"Thank you for your hospitality."

Song Zhengguo was actually daydreaming. He was thinking hard behind the crane...

Did he, did he just sell his own grandson?

The old man felt constrained.

-

Both conversations concluded.

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁把“少年”先是带到了卧室里，抬手把他抱到了床边，然后俯身去拿过来了拖鞋。

捏着脚踝给穿上了。

白粼粼其实觉得有点不自在，他还在想那个寿命的事……他要活多久？

他不会活得和王八一样长吧？

鸟很郁闷，鸟低头看人。

宋郁注意到了目光，只是抬眸看过来，面色温和：

“被吓到了？”

白粼粼双手撑着床单，他点了点头，又摇了摇头。

他也可以装成一只智障鸟的。

这个不难。

“宋郁。”

白粼粼不知道为什么，他就是想叫一声，思绪很乱，如果他活得很久，那……那。

鸟不想找下家。

怪不好的。

“嗯？”

白粼粼回了回神，还是很认真地想了一件事，低头对人道：

“我和你一起死掉吧？”

宋郁闻言瞳孔都微微一缩，甚至连手上的力道都没有控制好，直到“少年”蹙了蹙眉，试图往外抽。

“对不起。”

他立即道歉，同时放轻了力道，抬手把那个脚腕放到自己膝上了。

宋郁只是抬眸看过去，黑沉的目光里只映着一个“人”，轻声道：

“你知道你在说什么吗？”

其实这前后总共就过了十几秒，白粼粼说完才意识到可能有点歧义，他皱了皱眉，重新找补道：

“那个人不是说我会活得很长吗？但我活得长也没有什么用吧？我为社会做不了什么贡献……”

“不是这个。”

白粼粼沉默了，他真没那个意思，他原本就是个“人”芯，只是天然地思考了下，觉得一百年也很长了。

一起死掉也……也没什么……吧？

干什么？

这是干什么？

白粼粼最终还是忍不住了，侧了侧头，面色开始变红了，最后直接砰的一下变成了本体。

地板上站着只毛绒绒的小鸟，仰头看着人。

宋郁垂眸看着它，突然觉得有些口干，只是道：

“粼……”

鸟生气了，蓬了蓬毛，像个蓝色毛球一样啪嗒啪嗒地朝着卧室门口狂走。

很灵活地用鸟头拱开了门缝，长长的尾羽很快消失在了门口。

“……”

-

客厅。

道士偃旗息鼓地坐在沙发的一侧，丹顶鹤则是在另一侧，它优雅地喝了杯茶，交叠着双腿，抬眼看下这个749局来的专员。

“怎么样？我就说了，247的监护人品行是非常好的，怎么可能会因为这些无稽之谈而被煽动。”

丹顶鹤这次率先开战。

但道士却没了心情再去辩论，他只是问了句：

“城市里的所有妖怪都有监护人？”

“他们都心甘情愿？”

丹顶鹤愣了下，把茶杯放下了，很平和地道：

“并不是所有妖怪都有监护人，但大部分有。城市不是郊外，这里的小动物大多都是小型的，而且很多都是还没满月就被抱走的，甚至我们鸟界有的幼鸟完全不认识自己的同族，它们坚定地认为人类是它们的爸爸妈妈。”

“这种情感关系，促使它们产生一种迫切想要沟通交流的想法，变人也是如此，想要和监护人一样。”

道士只是静静地听着，也不知道在想什么。

丹顶鹤抬手理了理自己的丝带，很是认真地讲：

“至于监护人……登记在册有几百位，但这只是我们鸟界的，他们有年轻人的上班族、有奔波的中年人、有孤寡老人……”

“无论职业身份，他们都是很好的人类。即使觉得这些超出了接受范围，并且害怕妖怪，但却始终不抛弃我们，坚定地爱着。”

丹顶鹤最后深吸一口气，只是垂眸看向对面的道士，认真地道：

“是因为爱，小动物想变成人，也是因为爱，监护人才愿意接受，这是一个正向循环。”

道士最后是无话可说，他常年处理的都是恶性妖怪伤人事件，有的甚至很残忍，他难免先入为主的有偏见。

本来他是想道个歉的。

但就在这时——

“呵，像你这种孤寡的人，当然没人爱！”

“……你再说！”

“再说就再说！”

-

宋峥国其实是有些心虚的，他一大把年纪了，分明是知道与人相处不要轻易做承诺，但是他……同妖怪做了保证。

“……”

他其实是想同孩子说明一下情况的，但是刚走到二楼，一只圆滚滚的小鸟刚探出来头。

对视一二。

“鸟儿？”

白粼粼立马扑棱翅膀上来了，稳当当地站在了宋峥国的肩头。

也就在这个时候，宋郁开门了，见状先是说了句“爷爷”，但后面其实一直在看他的小鸟。

鸟避开了目光，在认真地歪头看翅根，偶尔也低头看爪子，不过羽毛太蓬松了，有点费力是真的。

宋峥国本来是想要说几句的，但是楼下却又开始吵了起来，几乎让二楼的两人一鸟同时转移目光。

“……那先送客吧。”

宋峥国只能这么道。

-

丹顶鹤最后是看在人都到了的份上才停下了攻击，切，它并未使出全部力气。

“平云，你不要太过担心，我们心里有分寸……”

“还有就是，你真的在那个局里么？”

两个老头没过一会就走到一块去了，在低声谈论着什么。

丹顶鹤也有自己要交代的话，看了看地板上的小鸟，很认真地道：

“247，你知道不知道你这次怎么被盯上的，妖力提升得太快了！不踏实。”

蓝羽小鸟站得规规矩矩的，低着鸟头。

“不过不必害怕，749局的人也不是坏的，他只是觉得有些问题，我已经处理好了。”

丹顶鹤也宽慰了一下。

白粼粼这下是真的老实了，翅膀都有些不自在地收了收，点了点鸟头。

不过就在这时。

“好了，反正我也要走了。”

“再考核一下，变人。”

鸟：“……”

白粼粼没办法，只能再度调动妖力，一个浅蓝色头发的“少年”再度出现，手腕是背在后面的，面色有些泛红，从头到尾都是低着头的。

丹顶鹤就站在面前。

这会儿客厅的两个老头也不交谈了，看了过来。

丹顶鹤又点了点头，围着247转了一圈，很好奇地问：

“这谁给你买的衣服？”

白粼粼：“……”

他的脸变得很红，闷闷的也不说话。

直到身后传来一句：

“我买的。”

“他搭的。”

白粼粼一下子冒烟了，他立马就要变回本体，但被丹顶鹤看见了，眼疾手快地抬手拍了一下他的额头。

有金线四溅。

“化形不要来回切，容易不稳，你又不是001，保持两个小时。”

丹顶鹤临走的时候这么交代道，顺带又去和监护人说了一些注意事项。

白粼粼站在一侧，整个“人”都不好了，一直看着地板，听着旁边的对话。

“247现在是个幼鸟……它投机取巧上来的，一定要看管好它。”

“有任何情况就联系我，嗯，手机很不错。”
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu brought the "young man" into the bedroom, lifted him onto the edge of the bed, and then leaned over to fetch his slippers.

He pinched the boy's ankles to put them on for him.

Bai Linlin actually felt a bit uneasy; he was still thinking about that lifespan thing... How long was he going to live?

He wouldn't live as long as a tortoise, would he?

The bird felt very depressed, and the bird looked down at the human.

Song Yu noticed the gaze, simply raising his eyes to look over, his expression gentle:

"Were you scared?"

Bai Linlin braced his hands on the bedsheets, nodding, then shaking his head.

He could also pretend to be a bird with a low IQ.

That wasn't hard.

"Song Yu."

Bai Linlin didn't know why, but he just wanted to call out. His thoughts were in a mess; if he lived for a very long time, then... then.

The bird didn't want to find a new home.

That would be quite bad.

"Hmm?"

Bai Linlin collected his thoughts, still thinking about something very seriously, and lowered his head to say to the person:

"Shall I die with you?"

Upon hearing this, Song Yu’s pupils shrank slightly, and he even lost control of the strength in his hands, until the "young man" frowned and tried to pull away.

"I'm sorry."

He apologized immediately, simultaneously lightening his grip, and lifted the ankle onto his own knee.

Song Yu just looked up, his dark, heavy gaze reflecting only one "person," and said softly:

"Do you know what you're saying?"

In reality, only about a dozen seconds had passed in total. It was only after Bai Linlin finished speaking that he realized there might be some ambiguity. He frowned and tried to make up for it:

"Didn't that person say I would live a very long time? But it’s no use living a long time, right? I can't contribute anything to society..."

"That's not it."

Bai Linlin fell silent. He really hadn't meant it that way; he was a "human" at his core, just naturally thinking that a hundred years was already a long time.

Dying together... that also... it wouldn't be anything, right?

What are you doing?

What is this for?

Bai Linlin finally couldn't hold it in anymore. He tilted his head, his face began to turn red, and finally, with a *poof*, he turned back into his original form.

A fluffy little bird stood on the floor, looking up at the human.

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at it, suddenly feeling his throat go dry, and only said:

"Lin..."

The bird was angry, puffed up its feathers, and like a blue fur ball, went pattering wildly toward the bedroom door.

It nimbly pushed the door crack open with its bird head, and its long tail feathers soon disappeared from the doorway.

"..."

-

Living room.

The Taoist sat on one side of the sofa, having given up the fight, while the Red-crowned Crane sat on the other. It elegantly sipped a cup of tea, legs crossed, and raised its eyes to look at this commissioner from Bureau 749.

"How is it? I told you, the guardian of 247 has excellent character; how could he be incited by such nonsense?"

The Red-crowned Crane initiated the battle this time.

But the Taoist had no mood left to debate. He simply asked:

"Do all the monsters in the city have guardians?"

"Are they all willing?"

The Red-crowned Crane paused, set down its teacup, and said quite peacefully:

"Not all monsters have guardians, but most do. The city is not the suburbs; the small animals here are mostly small-sized, and many were taken in before they were even a month old. Some young birds in our bird world don't even recognize their own kind; they firmly believe that humans are their mommies and daddies."

"This emotional bond drives them to have an urgent desire to communicate and interact. It’s the same with turning into humans—they want to be like their guardians."

The Taoist just listened quietly, not knowing what he was thinking.

The Red-crowned Crane raised a hand to adjust its ribbon and said very seriously:

"As for the guardians... there are hundreds registered, but that’s just for our bird world. They include young office workers, busy middle-aged people, lonely elderly people..."

"Regardless of their profession or status, they are all very good humans. Even if they feel this exceeds their acceptance range and are afraid of monsters, they never abandon us and love us firmly."

The Red-crowned Crane finally took a deep breath, lowered its eyes to look at the Taoist opposite, and said earnestly:

"It is because of love that small animals want to become human, and it is also because of love that guardians are willing to accept them. This is a positive cycle."

The Taoist had nothing left to say. He spent his years dealing with vicious monster-inflicted injury cases, some of which were very cruel, so it was inevitable that he would be biased.

He had originally intended to apologize.

But just then—

"Heh, of course someone as lonely as you wouldn't be loved!"

"…Say that again!"

"I'll say it again!"

-

Song Zhengguo was actually feeling a bit guilty. At his age, he clearly knew not to make promises lightly when dealing with people, but he... had made a guarantee to a monster.

"..."

He actually wanted to explain the situation to the child, but just as he reached the second floor, a round little bird poked its head out.

The two stared at each other for a moment.

"Birdie?"

Bai Linlin immediately flapped his wings and flew up, landing steadily on Song Zhengguo's shoulder.

It was also at this moment that Song Yu opened the door. Seeing this, he first said "Grandfather," but his eyes had actually been fixed on the little bird behind him.

The bird avoided his gaze, diligently tilting its head to look at the base of its wings, occasionally looking down at its claws, though its feathers were so fluffy that it was actually quite an effort.

Song Zhengguo had originally wanted to say a few words, but the arguing started up again downstairs, causing the two people and one bird on the second floor to shift their focus simultaneously.

"…Then let's send our guests off first."

Song Zhengguo could only say this.

-

The Red-crowned Crane finally stopped its attack, considering that everyone had arrived. *Tch*, it hadn't even used its full strength.

"Pingyun, don't worry too much, we have a sense of proportion..."

"Also, are you really in that bureau?"

The two old men walked together after a while, whispering about something.

The Red-crowned Crane also had things to explain. It looked at the little bird on the floor and said very seriously:

"247, do you know how you were targeted this time? Your monster power is rising too fast! It’s not stable."

The blue-feathered bird stood properly, its bird head lowered.

"But don't be afraid; the people from Bureau 749 aren't bad. He just thought there were some issues, and I’ve already handled it."

The Red-crowned Crane offered some comfort.

Bai Linlin was truly well-behaved now, his wings tucked in somewhat uncomfortably, and he nodded his bird head.

However, just at this moment.

"Alright, I’m leaving anyway."

"One last test—turn into a human."

Bird: "..."

Bai Linlin had no choice but to mobilize his monster power again. A "young man" with light blue hair appeared once more, his wrists behind his back, his face somewhat flushed, his head lowered from start to finish.

The Red-crowned Crane stood right in front of him.

By now, the two old men in the living room had stopped talking and were looking over.

The Red-crowned Crane nodded again, circled around 247, and asked curiously:

"Who bought these clothes for you?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

His face turned very red, and he stayed sullenly silent.

Until a voice came from behind him:

"I bought them."

"He matched them."

Bai Linlin started smoking from his ears. He was about to turn back into his original form, but the Red-crowned Crane saw it and quickly raised a hand to pat his forehead.

Gold threads splashed everywhere.

"Don't switch back and forth when shapeshifting; it’s easy to become unstable. You aren't 001. Keep it for two hours."

The Red-crowned Crane gave these instructions as it was leaving, taking the opportunity to tell the guardian some precautions.

Bai Linlin stood to one side, the whole "person" feeling terrible, staring at the floor and listening to the conversation nearby.

"247 is currently a young bird... it got here by taking a shortcut, so you must keep a close eye on it."

"Contact me if there are any issues. Hmm, the mobile phone is quite good."

chunks.chineseText:
与此同时，宋峥国那里也在收尾，道士也想开了，是他过于狭隘了，城市里的妖怪也有好的。

不过他还是抽空看了下不远处的“少年”，心里还是有个判断：

——这不是蛊惑是什么？

最后一人一鹤这才离开了锦园，别墅里陷入了谜之尴尬：

宋峥国不知道怎么解释自己把孙子卖了的事。

宋郁只是在想他的小鸟为什么生气。

白粼粼只想变回鸟。

……

就在这时，玄关处传来推门的声音。

陈开鹤提着两条肥美的鱼进来了，还颇为不解地道：

“峥国啊，这怎么家里的门都不知道关，你快来看看，我今天钓了两条十斤重的——”

陈开鹤话都没说完，看到客厅里的一幕愣住了，老头儿眼睛黑亮有神，直直地看着前面的浅蓝色头发的人，然后一拍大腿，定定地道：

“哎呦！小郁对象！”

白粼粼晴天霹雳。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：坏老师！
chunks.englishText:
Meanwhile, Song Zhengguo was also wrapping things up. The Taoist had come to his senses; he had been too narrow-minded. There were good monsters in the city as well.

However, he still took a moment to glance at the "young man" not far away, a judgment forming in his heart:

—If this isn't bewitchment, what is?

Finally, the man and the crane left Jin Yuan, and the villa fell into an awkward silence:

Song Zhengguo didn't know how to explain that he had "sold out" his grandson.

Song Yu was just wondering why his little bird was angry.

Bai Linlin just wanted to turn back into a bird.

...

Just then, the sound of the front door being pushed open came from the entryway.

Chen Kaihe walked in carrying two plump, beautiful fish, looking quite puzzled as he said:

"Zhengguo, why is the door to the house left open? Come quickly and take a look, I caught two ten-pounders today—"

Chen Kaihe didn't even finish his sentence. He froze upon seeing the scene in the living room. The old man’s eyes were dark, bright, and spirited, staring straight at the light-blue-haired person in front of him. Then, he slapped his thigh and said firmly:

"Oh my! Xiao Yu's partner!"

Bai Linlin felt like he had been struck by lightning.

Author's note:

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Bad teacher!

chunks.chineseText:
第42章

场面陷入了非常尴尬的境地，然而这仅仅是别墅内两人一鸟的直观感受，对于门口的陈开鹤则是完全不奏效。

老爷子精神大条，见到对面的“少年”整个人都神采奕奕的，提着鱼就走过来了，神态犹如见到了刚出生的满月婴儿，充满着拘谨和欢喜。

“孩子……你多大啊？”

白粼粼本来就很无措了，听到这话更是本能地往后退了一步，但不知道是因为太紧张还是怎么的，左脚都要绊倒右脚了，也就在这时手肘被身后的人给扣住了。

他还没来得及回头，就已经被轻轻地“带”过去了，人只能往后站，再一抬头，宋郁已经挡住他了。

“陈爷爷，您怎么来了？”

别墅里这会儿的空气才算流动了起来，宋峥国也立马抬步走了过来，故作寻常地问：

“开鹤，你这是从哪里钓来的鱼？”

一老一小，挡得严严实实。

陈开鹤穿着麻布背心，戴着个编织帽，眼睛微微眯了眯，然后以迅雷不及掩耳之势，左移了下。

但宋峥国只是眉心一跳，还是挪了下，正正好地挡住了。

“？”

陈开鹤蹙了蹙眉，有点倔了，开始往右走，但是这边宋郁个子实在高，肩宽背直的，隐约只能看到那孩子一点发尾了。

僵持ing。

老头要生气了。

不过就在这个时候，宋郁开口了：

“陈爷爷，他年纪小，您这么上来找他说话，他不自在。”

“这样，我先带他上楼……”

宋峥国立马跟上，抬步走到陈开鹤的面前，拉住了老友的手，只是耐心地道：

“你不要这么急，不是带了鱼来了？先给孩子做饭？待会肯定能说上话的。”

陈开鹤闻言只是低头看了看自己的鱼，思绪又被带走了，那点显摆心理上来了，开始吹嘘：

“不是我说，你看看，这我从锦园门口一路步行提回来的，你是不知道，多少人回头看我！”

不过他还是不自觉地看向宋郁那里。

但宋峥国已经摆手让他们走了：

“小郁，你们先上楼。”

陈开鹤这下也没办法了，只是有些不死心地看向楼梯那里，试图再看下那孩子的正脸，但宋郁也不知道怎么走的，挡得是密不透风，从头到尾他就只在开门的时候惊鸿一瞥了。

老头摇头。

觉得这孩子不够大气。

宋峥国后面问了句：“那你来做饭？我当帮厨？”

陈开鹤又高兴起来了，反正这次被他堵到了，好说歹说是能吃上一顿饭的，他提着鱼就去了厨房，很乐呵地道：

“成成成，酸菜鱼怎么样？”

“我巨拿手，一定能给那孩子留下好印象！”

-

卧室。

白粼粼面颊还是很红，他被一路扣着手臂带回了卧室，脑子都是乱乱的。

怎么今天这么多事？

他试着调用妖力变会本体，但是金纹在手指尖打个圈就消失了，他得保持人形两个小时。

“……”

白粼粼进门都是蹙着眉的，咬了咬唇，只是觉得胸口闷闷的，有点急，甚至走到哪里都不知道了。

他想变鸟，想变鸟。

也就在这个时候，他的腰突然被揽住了，身体都悬空了，白粼粼有一两秒的闭眼，再睁开眼发现坐到床边了。

宋郁俯身蹲下了，照旧还是牵着手，在仰头看他。

“不要生我的气好么？”

少年的语气温和，眉目轮廓都很优越，看着很是纯良，但或许是因为生病的缘故，他的面色其实很冷白，配上那颗眼尾的红痣，使人不得不坠入那个很沉的眼眸里。

白粼粼其实觉得这算倒打一耙，他又没有说他生气，他偏开了头，试图抽出来自己的手腕，但是弄了半天没弄出来，只能回头去看。

宋郁还在盯着。

“……”

鸟眯了眯眼，鸟沉思。

“我生气了，那是不是，算你错了？”

白粼粼歪头看了过去，很有自己的逻辑道。

“是。”

“我错了。”

宋郁不想他的小鸟不理他，闻言没有任何犹豫，只是抬眼看着上方的“人”，从善如流地下台阶。

白粼粼觉得好玩，这高中生就是年纪小，好逗，他这会儿也不抽自己的手臂了，只是想了想那些网络上的短视频段子，学着问：

“那你错在哪里了？”

宋郁眼眸暗沉了些，只是轻微摩梭了下掌心“人”的腕骨，很听话地道：

“错在当时不该反问你。”

“粼粼说的什么都对。”

白粼粼有些满意，甚至有点伸伸翅根，但是他现在是胳膊，所以只是做了个抬起的动作，有点尴尬。

“嗯嗯。”

鸟原谅了。

白粼粼这次还想抽出来手腕，但是照旧是没有弄开，这才蹙眉道：

“你干什么？”

“所以原谅我了么？”

卧室里安安静静的，两个“人”就这么对视了一会，白粼粼觉得那种奇怪的氛围又起来了，他甚至直接避开了那个眼神，有点敷衍地道：

“原谅了原谅了。”

-

一楼客厅里热热闹闹的。

具体表现在陈开鹤单方面的热热闹闹，宋峥国则是一个劲地捂脸，不知道在想什么，只是时不时地看看楼上。

“哎呀，真好，我叫了祥云楼的外送，一共十个菜！”

陈开鹤美滋滋地道：“然后把我的酸菜鱼摆在正中间！”

“问问那孩子哪个最好吃！”

老头分享自己的小巧思，但宋峥国只是摆了摆手，没空附和，他满脑子都是那只会录像的鹤。

“那什么时候能送过来饭菜？”

宋峥国最后只是问了问这件事。

陈开鹤一摆手，很自信地道：“四十分钟，这我总给够他们独处空间了吧？”

“……”

与此同时，卧室。

“我现在变不回来，丹顶鹤说不能频繁地来回切……”

白粼粼没有在想上午的事了，只是低头闷闷地同对方说了下现状。

“两个小时，我记得。”

宋郁只是出声安抚道，随后才眉眼低垂，像是在想什么，再次抬眸看过去：

“那要不要下楼吃饭？可能陈爷爷他是误会你是我的……”

“吃什么饭？”

“……”

白粼粼其实在理他的妖怪身份被多少人发现了，现在想想看，宋郁和爷爷……这没有什么，今天来的那个道士是749局的，那也不算，丹顶鹤就更不用说了。

那、那还是很安全的。

没事没事。

“可能会做那两条鱼，你喜欢吃什么？”

宋郁最后像是彻底接受了，只是开始问他的小鸟的偏好。

“水煮鱼？”

“烤鱼也可以。”

“鱼片粥也好吃！”

白粼粼最后越说越开心，甚至晃了下自己的腿，完全没有注意到宋郁若有所思的目光。

“好，我记下了。”

-

其实下楼的时候，白粼粼还是觉得要换身衣服，毕竟他现在是假装宋郁的……对象，那么理所应当要体面一些。

虽然一开始在楼下有点慌张。

他还问了问人：“我应该不妨碍你找对象吧？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 42

The scene fell into an extremely awkward state. However, this was merely the intuitive feeling of the two people and one bird inside the villa; for Chen Kaihe at the door, it had absolutely no effect.

The old gentleman was thick-skinned. Upon seeing the "young man" opposite, his entire being was radiant. He walked over carrying the fish, his demeanor like someone seeing a newborn baby, filled with a mix of reserve and joy.

"Child... how old are you?"

Bai Linlin was already at a loss, and upon hearing this, he instinctively took a step back. But whether it was because he was too nervous or what, his left foot nearly tripped over his right. Just then, his elbow was caught by the person behind him.

Before he could even turn around, he had been gently "led" away. He could only stand behind, and when he looked up, Song Yu was already blocking him.

"Grandpa Chen, why are you here?"

The air in the villa finally began to circulate. Song Zhengguo also immediately stepped forward, asking with feigned normalcy:

"Kaihe, where did you catch these fish?"

One old and one young, blocking the view completely.

Chen Kaihe was wearing a linen vest and a woven hat. His eyes narrowed slightly, and then, with lightning speed, he shifted to the left.

But Song Zhengguo’s brow twitched, and he moved as well, blocking him perfectly.

"?"

Chen Kaihe frowned, feeling a bit stubborn, and started to move to the right. But Song Yu was truly tall, with broad shoulders and a straight back, and he could only vaguely see a bit of the child's hair.

Stalemate.

The old man was about to get angry.

But just at this moment, Song Yu spoke:

"Grandpa Chen, he is young. If you come up to him like this to talk, he feels uncomfortable."

"How about this, I'll take him upstairs first..."

Song Zhengguo immediately followed up, stepped in front of Chen Kaihe, grabbed his old friend's hand, and said patiently:

"Don't be so impatient. Didn't you bring fish? Why not cook for the child first? You'll definitely be able to talk later."

Upon hearing this, Chen Kaihe lowered his head to look at his fish, his thoughts diverted. That desire to show off kicked in, and he began to boast:

"It’s not that I’m bragging, look at these! I carried them all the way from the entrance of Jin Yuan. You have no idea how many people turned to look at me!"

However, he still couldn't help but look toward Song Yu.

But Song Zhengguo had already waved for them to leave:

"Xiao Yu, you two go upstairs first."

Chen Kaihe had no choice now, but he still looked toward the stairs with some reluctance, trying to catch another glimpse of the child's face. But Song Yu moved in a way that blocked everything airtight; from start to finish, he had only caught a fleeting glimpse when the door opened.

The old man shook his head.

He felt the child wasn't very outgoing.

Song Zhengguo asked from behind: "Then you come cook? I'll be the sous-chef?"

Chen Kaihe became happy again. Anyway, he had managed to corner them this time, and one way or another, he would get to have a meal. He carried the fish to the kitchen, saying cheerfully:

"Done, done, done. How about boiled fish with pickled cabbage?"

"I'm super good at it; I'll definitely leave a good impression on that child!"

-

Bedroom.

Bai Linlin’s cheeks were still very red. He had been led back to the bedroom with his arm held the whole way, his mind a mess.

Why were there so many things happening today?

He tried to invoke his monster power to turn back into his original form, but the gold patterns circled his fingertips and then vanished. He had to stay in human form for two hours.

"..."

Bai Linlin entered the room frowning, biting his lip. He just felt a tightness in his chest, a bit of urgency, and didn't even know where he was walking.

He wanted to be a bird, he wanted to be a bird.

Just then, his waist was suddenly wrapped, and his body was suspended in the air. Bai Linlin closed his eyes for a second or two, and when he opened them again, he found himself sitting on the edge of the bed.

Song Yu leaned down and crouched, still holding his hands as usual, looking up at him.

"Don't be angry with me, okay?"

The young man's tone was gentle, his facial contours superior, looking very pure and kind. But perhaps because of his illness, his complexion was actually deathly pale, which, paired with the red mole at the corner of his eye, made one unable to help but fall into those deep eyes.

Bai Linlin actually felt this was a case of blaming the victim; he hadn't even said he was angry. He turned his head away, trying to pull his wrist out, but after struggling for a long time without success, he could only look back.

Song Yu was still staring at him.

"..."

The bird narrowed its eyes; the bird pondered.

"If I am angry, then does that mean it's your fault?"

Bai Linlin tilted his head and looked over, stating his own logic.

"Yes."

"It's my fault."

Song Yu didn't want his little bird to ignore him. Upon hearing this, he didn't hesitate at all, just looked up at the "person" above him, following the steps down as expected.

Bai Linlin found it amusing. This high schooler was just young and easy to tease. He didn't pull his arm away anymore, but thought about those short video clips on the internet and learned to ask:

"Then where were you wrong?"

Song Yu’s eyes darkened slightly. He just lightly rubbed the wrist bone of the "person" in his palm and said obediently:

"I was wrong for asking you a rhetorical question at the time."

"Everything Linlin says is right."

Bai Linlin was somewhat satisfied, even wanting to stretch his wing roots, but since he was an arm now, he just made a lifting motion, which was a bit awkward.

"Mm-hmm."

The bird forgave him.

Bai Linlin tried to pull his wrist out again this time, but as usual, he couldn't get it free, so he frowned and said:

"What are you doing?"

"So, have you forgiven me?"

The bedroom was quiet. The two "people" stared at each other like this for a while. Bai Linlin felt that strange atmosphere rising again. He even avoided that gaze directly and said somewhat perfunctorily:

"Forgiven, forgiven."

-

The living room on the first floor was lively.

Specifically, it was Chen Kaihe’s one-sided liveliness, while Song Zhengguo kept covering his face, not knowing what he was thinking, only looking upstairs from time to time.

"Oh, it's great. I ordered takeout from Xiangyun Restaurant, ten dishes in total!"

Chen Kaihe said blissfully: "And I'll put my boiled fish with pickled cabbage right in the middle!"

"Ask that child which one tastes the best!"

The old man shared his little ideas, but Song Zhengguo just waved his hand, having no time to echo him. His mind was full of that crane that could record video.

"Then when will the food be delivered?"

Song Zhengguo finally asked about this.

Chen Kaihe waved his hand, very confidently: "Forty minutes. I’ve given them enough space to be alone, right?"

"..."

Meanwhile, in the bedroom.

"I can't turn back right now. The Red-crowned Crane said I can't switch back and forth too frequently..."

Bai Linlin wasn't thinking about the morning anymore, just lowering his head and telling the other person about his current situation in a muffled voice.

"Two hours, I remember."

Song Yu just spoke to soothe him, then lowered his eyes, as if thinking about something, and looked up again:

"Then do you want to go downstairs to eat? Maybe Grandpa Chen misunderstood that you are my..."

"Eat what?"

"..."

Bai Linlin was actually calculating how many people had discovered his monster identity. Now that he thought about it, Song Yu and his grandfather... that was nothing. The Taoist who came today was from Bureau 749, so that didn't count either. The Red-crowned Crane went without saying.

So, that was still very safe.

It’s fine, it’s fine.

"They might make those two fish. What do you like to eat?"

Song Yu finally seemed to accept it completely and started asking about his little bird's preferences.

"Boiled fish?"

"Grilled fish is also fine."

"Fish fillet porridge is also delicious!"

Bai Linlin became happier the more he talked, even swinging his legs, completely unaware of Song Yu’s thoughtful gaze.

"Okay, I've noted it down."

-

Actually, when going downstairs, Bai Linlin still felt he should change his clothes. After all, he was currently pretending to be Song Yu's... partner, so it was only right to look decent.

Even though he had been a bit panicked downstairs earlier.

He even asked the person: "I shouldn't be getting in the way of you finding a partner, right?"

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁当时没有任何表情，停顿了一两秒，才笑着道：

“怎么这么问？”

白粼粼还在挑选衣服，穿着长筒袜蹲在了地毯上，手里拿着一个浅色的衬衫，旁边还有配套的领带，只是头也不抬地道：

“你上大学了不会找对象吗？”

“到时候你记得和这个陈爷爷说分手了。”

“这样就可以完美规避……”

宋郁只是问：“那为什么之前质问我突然有对象了？”

蓝发少年愣了下，抱着衣服仰头看了过去，像是想起来了什么，有点小小的尴尬，但是他很快找到了理由：

“那不一样，我是家庭成员，你有对象应该告诉我，我当时以为你瞒着我的！”

“少年”的瞳仁亮亮的。

宋郁觉得实在像那个圆滚滚的鸟头一顿啾啾啾。

“这样。”

宋郁很平静地道。

白粼粼也没察觉到氛围的不对，只是自顾自地给自己搭配衣服，衬衫、领带……唔，不要领带。

“少年”只是从旁边的小抽屉里拿出来了一个袖扣，珐琅材质的，很低调的黑紫。

然后就是一条腰部的配饰，垂坠的银色链子。

叮叮咚咚的。

“我有了对象，你觉得很好吗？”

宋郁最后还是直接问了。

但地板上蹲着的“少年”只是回了回头，绮丽的面容上只是有些不解，认真地道：

“为什么会坏呢？”

“不是两份饭吗？”

宋郁闭了闭眼。

白粼粼其实想的很简单，他以前确实是人，但现在是个小鸟，无忧无虑的，实在不用思考那么多，这些都是宋郁带给他的。

他当然不能干扰对方的正常生活。

“粼粼。”

宋郁只是耐着性子道：

“那我的爱会分割掉，一半都给了那个所谓的对象，留给你的有多少？”

白粼粼其实心想这不还有一半的吗？

但是他觉得不能这么说，思考了下，刚想回答，宋郁就又道：

“我给你买的金子、房子、库里南……全部都要给那个对象。”

白粼粼一下子就反应过来了，唇瓣张了张，有点着急道：

“不行……你给我的，你可以拿其他的给那个对象，不能把——”

宋郁只是道：

“那说不准，万一我没钱了。”

“就会把原本给你的东西，全部转移……”

白粼粼自暴自弃地道：“那你先不要有对象了。”

“好。”

宋郁好了。

-

最后一人一鸟其实在楼上还待了很久的时间，主要是在分析穿搭。

宋郁微微倚靠在门框上，尽管身体还是有些不适，但是看着不同装扮的“少年”也会觉得心情好些。

他的小鸟很爱美。

白粼粼其实上大学的时候还是很风华正茂的，但是上了一年班就成了地铁背着双肩包、固定制服打工人了。

他实在是想给自己换换风格。

鸟认真思考，鸟开始实践。

“这个好看吗？”

“我一开始选的。”

“少年”身着宽松衬衫，布料是非常柔软的那种，米色的，下摆收在腰间，形成很漂亮的褶皱。

下身是一件宽松的西服面料裤子，垂坠感很强，腰间环着先前挑好的金属链子，很简约的贝壳造型，是银质的，内里有个很有设计感的皮面内衬，颜色同袖扣的珐琅色彩一致。

鞋子则是一双牛皮亮面布洛克。

走的休闲风。

宋郁就这么看着，目光其实都有些散了，轻声道：

“嗯。”

白粼粼其实很认真地在询问，见状以为是对方觉得哪里不满，于是又抬手去旁边的架子上拿了一个深棕色的贝雷帽，颜色同裤子一致，戴上了。

他很认真地伸开了双手，又问：

“这样呢？”

宋郁喉结微微滚了下，其实还没说话。

“不行不行，怎么可以在屋子里戴帽子。”

对面的蓝发少年又把帽子摘了，重新挂在那个架子上了，最后其实很郁闷地道：

“那要不就这样吧。”

“我刚才在楼下表现得很不好。”

“换一身……应该能让老人家觉得改观吧？”

宋郁只是很自然地伸了过去手，白粼粼立马就搭上去了，停了一秒、两秒……

“少年”反应过来不对了，他太习惯上人的手指了，忘了现在是人的形态。

但是已经晚了。

宋郁只是把“少年”拉了过来，出声安抚道：

“很好看。”

-

楼下已经摆满了菜，陈开鹤整个人都神气得很，对着宋峥国道：

“看看，不错吧？”

祥云楼送来了二十多个菜，传统中式顺序，四个冷盘、两道热汤、六个小炒、三个硬菜、三个山珍海鲜……最后搭配的主食有米饭和馒头，最后是几道中式糕点和甜汤。

陈开鹤尾巴都要翘起来了。

宋峥国只是问：“怎么这么多？你怎么跟祥云楼那边说的，这时间也来不及……规格也太……”

“出高价截得其他桌的。”

老头摆摆手，满是自信，又道：

“婚宴的规格。”

宋峥国闭了闭眼，最终还是什么也没说。

不过这会儿楼梯那里传来了动静，两个孩子下来了。

陈开鹤抬眼看了过去，其实是怔了下的，他不由得站直了身板，微微靠向了自己老友，问：

“小郁怎么认识的，这生的也太……”

宋峥国脑子里全部都是那个“才五个月大就被你们孩子给带走了”的话，循环播放，实在是抽不出来力气回答别的。

陈开鹤还在问：“这……上去换衣服了？”

“啧啧。”

宋峥国这才回了回神，只是反驳道：

“鸟儿它喜——”

陈开鹤皱了皱眉，“啊，你说什么？”

“……”

最后还是逐步走近了餐厅。

白粼粼还是有些不自在，身子有点靠后，但他还是偷偷地看了下桌子上的东西……

狮子头、桂花糕、糖醋排骨、凉拌晶丝……琳琅满目。

“少年”忍不住地探了下头，眼睛亮亮的。

宋峥国见状莫名松了口气，只是很和蔼地道：

“过来吃饭。”

没事的，他们宋家怎么都是能养得起鸟儿的。

不怕那鹤过来考察。

-

最后正式开始了“家宴”。

宋郁只是始终关注着身边的“人”，甚至会担心他拿不好筷子，毕竟他的小鸟以前都是用喙吃饭的……

但是出乎意料，“少年”使用的很顺畅，夹了一块桂花糕，塞进了嘴里，甚至都没有嚼，眼睛圆圆地看着周围。

因为都在看鸟。

“孩子啊，你叫什么名字？”

陈开鹤甚至都看得忘我了，只是很慈祥地询问。

“粼粼。”

鸟如此回复道。

陈开鹤直了直身子，眉目意外，很惊讶地道：

“粼粼？我们小郁有只小鸟也是叫粼粼！一个音的！”

全场沉默。

两人一鸟都有点僵硬，但唯有陈开鹤独自开朗，他自顾自地圆了回来：

“哎呀，那看来我们小郁真的喜欢你，连带着身边的小动物都是你的小名。”

“那大名呢？不能只叫粼粼呀？”
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu remained expressionless, pausing for a second or two before smiling and asking, 

"Why do you ask that?"

Bai Linlin was still picking out clothes. He was squatting on the carpet in knee-high socks, holding a light-colored shirt in his hand with a matching tie nearby. He didn't even look up as he said, 

"Won't you look for a partner when you go to university?"

"When that time comes, remember to tell this Grandpa Chen that you've broken up."

"That way, you can perfectly avoid..."

Song Yu simply asked, "Then why did you question me earlier about suddenly having a partner?"

The blue-haired youth froze. He hugged his clothes and looked up, as if remembering something. He looked a little embarrassed, but he quickly found a justification:

"That's different. I'm a family member; you should have told me if you had a partner. I thought you were hiding it from me at the time!"

The "youth's" pupils were bright.

Song Yu felt it was exactly like that round bird head bobbing up and down with chirps.

"I see."

Song Yu said calmly.

Bai Linlin didn't notice the shift in atmosphere, just continuing to coordinate his outfit—shirt, tie... hmm, no tie.

The "youth" took a pair of cufflinks from a small drawer nearby; they were enamel, a low-key black-purple.

Then came a waist accessory, a dangling silver chain.

*Jingle, jingle.*

"If I have a partner, do you think that's a good thing?"

Song Yu finally asked directly.

But the "youth" squatting on the floor just turned his head, his beautiful face showing only confusion as he said earnestly:

"Why would it be bad?"

"Isn't it just two portions of food?"

Song Yu closed his eyes.

Bai Linlin actually thought very simply. He had indeed been human once, but now he was a little bird, carefree and without the need to overthink things. All of this was provided by Song Yu.

Of course, he couldn't interfere with the other's normal life.

"Linlin."

Song Yu said, exercising his patience:

"Then my love will be divided. If half is given to that so-called partner, how much is left for you?"

Bai Linlin actually thought, *Isn't there still half left?*

But he felt he couldn't say that. After thinking for a moment, just as he was about to answer, Song Yu added:

"The gold, the house, the Cullinan I bought for you... all of it would have to go to that partner."

Bai Linlin reacted instantly. His lips parted, and he said anxiously:

"No... what you gave me is mine. You can give other things to that partner, you can't take—"

Song Yu simply said:

"That's not certain. What if I run out of money?"

"Then I would transfer everything I originally gave you..."

Bai Linlin said in a fit of self-abandonment, "Then just don't have a partner for now."

"Alright."

Song Yu agreed.

-

In the end, the person and the bird actually stayed upstairs for a long time, mainly analyzing outfits.

Song Yu leaned slightly against the doorframe. Although his body still felt unwell, seeing the "youth" in different outfits made him feel a bit better.

His little bird loved beauty.

Bai Linlin had been quite vibrant when he was in university, but after a year of working, he had become a typical office worker with a backpack and a uniform on the subway.

He really wanted to change his style.

The bird thought seriously, and the bird began to practice.

"Does this look good?"

"It's the one I picked at the beginning."

The "youth" wore a loose shirt, the fabric very soft and beige, with the hem tucked into his waist to form beautiful folds.

On his lower half, he wore loose suit trousers with a strong drape, a metal chain wrapped around his waist—the one he had chosen earlier, a simple silver shell design with a stylish leather lining inside, matching the color of the enamel cufflinks.

His shoes were a pair of shiny leather brogues.

He was going for a casual look.

Song Yu watched, his gaze actually drifting slightly, and he said softly:

"Yes."

Bai Linlin was actually asking very earnestly. Seeing this, he thought the other person was dissatisfied with something, so he reached out to a rack nearby, took a deep brown beret—the color matching his trousers—and put it on.

He earnestly spread his arms and asked again:

"How about this?"

Song Yu's Adam's apple rolled slightly, though he hadn't spoken yet.

"No, no, how can I wear a hat indoors."

The blue-haired youth across from him took the hat off, hung it back on the rack, and finally said, feeling quite dejected:

"Then let's just go with this."

"I performed very poorly downstairs just now."

"Changing into a new outfit... should make the old gentleman change his mind, right?"

Song Yu reached out his hand naturally, and Bai Linlin immediately placed his own on it, pausing for one second, two seconds...

The "youth" realized something was wrong. He was too used to perching on the man's finger, forgetting he was in human form now.

But it was already too late.

Song Yu simply pulled the "youth" over and comforted him:

"You look very good."

-

Downstairs, the table was already filled with dishes. Chen Kaihe looked quite proud, saying to Song Zhengguo:

"Look, not bad, right?"

Xiangyun Tower had delivered over twenty dishes, following the traditional Chinese sequence: four cold appetizers, two hot soups, six stir-fries, three main meat dishes, three delicacies of mountain and sea... paired with rice and steamed buns, and finally, several Chinese pastries and sweet soups.

Chen Kaihe looked as if his tail was about to wag.

Song Zhengguo just asked, "Why so many? How did you talk to Xiangyun Tower? There wasn't enough time... and the scale is too..."

"Paid a high price to intercept other tables."

The old man waved his hand, full of confidence, and added:

"Wedding banquet standards."

Song Zhengguo closed his eyes and ultimately said nothing.

Just then, there was movement from the stairs; the two children were coming down.

Chen Kaihe looked up and actually froze. He couldn't help but straighten his posture, leaning slightly toward his old friend, and asked:

"How does Xiao Yu know him? He is born so..."

Song Zhengguo's mind was filled with the repeating phrase, "He was only five months old when your child took him away," and he simply didn't have the energy to answer anything else.

Chen Kaihe was still asking, "So... he went up to change clothes?"

"Tsk tsk."

Song Zhengguo finally came to his senses and just retorted:

"The bird likes—"

Chen Kaihe frowned, "Ah, what did you say?"

"..."

Finally, they gradually approached the dining room.

Bai Linlin still felt a bit uncomfortable and held back slightly, but he secretly peeked at the things on the table...

Lion's head meatballs, osmanthus cake, sweet and sour pork ribs, cold-tossed crystal noodles... a dazzling array.

The "youth" couldn't help but poke his head out, his eyes bright.

Seeing this, Song Zhengguo felt a strange sense of relief and said kindly:

"Come over and eat."

It was fine. Their Song family could definitely afford to raise a bird.

He wasn't afraid of that crane coming to inspect them.

-

Finally, the "family dinner" officially began.

Song Yu kept his attention on the "person" beside him, even worrying that he wouldn't be able to handle chopsticks well, after all, his little bird used to eat with a beak...

But unexpectedly, the "youth" used them quite smoothly. He picked up a piece of osmanthus cake and stuffed it into his mouth, not even chewing, his round eyes looking around.

Because everyone was looking at the bird.

"Child, what is your name?"

Chen Kaihe was so engrossed he asked with great kindness.

"Linlin."

The bird replied.

Chen Kaihe straightened his posture, his expression surprised, and he said with astonishment:

"Linlin? Our Xiao Yu has a little bird also named Linlin! It's the same sound!"

The whole room fell silent.

The two men and the bird were all a bit stiff, but only Chen Kaihe remained cheerful. He rounded it off himself:

"Oh my, it seems our Xiao Yu really likes you, even naming the little animal beside him after your nickname."

"What about your full name? You can't just be called Linlin, right?"

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁觉得这和对幼儿园的小朋友说话是一个语气，他皱了皱眉，想要解围，但就在这时——

“白粼粼。”

宋郁垂着的手指微微勾了下，侧眸看着身旁的“少年”，他的小鸟……有姓？

陈开鹤闻言也是很满意，只是道：

“白姓很好啊，取什么字都好听！”

属于是硬夸。

最后还是宋峥国出声道：

“先吃饭啊，粼粼吃饭。”

“少年”闻言一下子眼睛就弯了弯，点了点头，伸筷子去吃排骨了，很高兴的样子。

别墅里齐乐融融的。

陈开鹤也是过了一会才发现宋郁没有怎么夹菜的，才问：

“小郁也吃呀。”

宋郁只是解释：“我发烧了，有点没胃口。”

宋峥国眼皮一抖，他忘得干干净净。

“……”

反倒是一旁的“少年”闻言回了回头，说了第一句比较长的话：

“你好些了吗？”

陈开鹤又开始冒起来粉红泡泡了。

宋郁侧头道：“没事的，好吃吗？”

“少年”点了点头。

鸟之前都是用喙吃的，还都是偷偷摸摸的，每次都要隔半个小时去吃饭菜，人有些时候都不动一些食物，就像蟹黄包，他们都不吃，全靠鸟。

这还是头一次光明正大地吃食物。

白粼粼很快就忘记那些不自在的情绪了，由内而外的高兴，爷爷也知道他是妖怪了，那就不用那么拘谨了。

“少年”又去夹一个豆皮肉卷，放到了自己嘴里，慢慢地吃着。

宋峥国其实看着也挺高兴的，一连挪了好几次盘子，本意是让鸟儿多吃自己爱吃的，但后面发现好像鸟儿每个都爱吃，也就没再挪了。

只是中途的时候他的手机响了，有来电，旁边的鸟儿抬头问他：

“爷爷，电话。”

宋峥国头一次听到这个称呼，一下子什么也忘了，直接把那通来自国外儿子的电话给挂了，很和蔼可亲地道：

“广告电话，不用管。”

白粼粼整场午饭都吃得顺顺利利的，什么都尝了个遍，他是个妖怪，可以吃很多很多的，不过为了矜持，他还是适时地放下了筷子。

然后侧头去看宋郁。

“那我们先上楼了？”

陈开鹤闻言其实还有点不尽兴，只是道：

“再坐下聊聊也可以的呀，小郁你不要看得太紧呀，人家小姑娘家家的，你一言不合就带去楼上，这怎么能行……”

餐厅再次一阵死寂。

陈老头仍然独自开朗：“粼粼爸妈呢？人家家里人也是要通知的，我和你爷爷得备一份礼，噢不，两份礼，你也得收拾收拾，我们一块上门去。”

宋郁动作都停了，宋峥国在椅子上失去了所有力气，脑子里再度播放那句“才五个月大就被你们孩子给带走了”的话，至于白粼粼则是有些尴尬，但还好，他小时候就被误会过，只是开口道：

“陈爷爷，我是男生。”

陈开鹤还在笑吟吟的，“男生啊，那也很好……啊？”

白粼粼歪头看了看反应，其实蹙了下眉的，他其实没想到他大了还是被误认过性别，是因为头发长了点吗？

“我没有爸爸妈妈。”

白粼粼这说的是实话，他确实没有爸爸妈妈，他有院长老师，有很多孤儿院的弟弟妹妹，但这些现在好像不能说。

但“少年”不知道他这话一出，场上的三个人是怎么的一番心里波动。

宋郁的心弦被扯了下。

宋峥国则是倒吸一口气，觉得这一定要负责……

陈开鹤闻言张了张口，一下子站起来了，正色道：

“孩子，我……我老眼昏花，我没认出来！”

“这原谅爷爷好不好？”

“你真是一好孩子，自己一个人还备考托福……”

白粼粼歪头，他什么时候……

宋峥国只是立马挥手：“先上楼去吧，啊。”

两个孩子这才撤离现场。

-

但餐厅这里就有些沉默了。

陈开鹤蹙眉，托腮，然后又深吸一口气，最后认真地道：

“这生得真的好看。”

宋峥国其实没想到第一句是这个。

他其实也得缓缓了，光是上午的那只鹤就……

宋峥国抬手抚了抚脸，心里的接受度都变高了，以至于旁边老友问出那句：

“这小郁……喜欢男孩儿？”

他条件反射地敷衍道：

“是是是。”

……

卧室里。

白粼粼进门之后就想要去睡觉，但是手腕被握住了，被反方向拉了下，他只能跟着去了书桌那里。

“我困……”

白粼粼又被拦腰往上抱了下，坐在了书桌上，他有点懵，那句话都没有说完。

“等一会好不好？”

白粼粼闻言只好坐下了，不过他还是挺满意的，因为位置很高，宋郁不过是拉开椅子坐下了。

人拿出来了一包松子。

鸟立马就伸手了。

“没剥呢。”

白粼粼只好耐心地等着，宋郁拿出来了那个专门盛果仁的大白兔奶糖罐子，往里丢果仁。

人丢一个，鸟吃一个。

如此搭配，倒也默契。

直到——

“粼粼姓白？”

“少年”愣了下，然后一下子就蹙眉了，抬手就要化形成本体，但不知道是前摇被察觉出来了还是怎么，宋郁直接起身扣住他的手了。

白粼粼躲也躲不开，只是偏了偏头，有些闷闷的。

“为什么不告诉我？”

“粼粼。”

白粼粼张了张口，还是觉得不能说，但宋郁每次都能微妙地把他忽略过去的信息给提出来，搞得他回回都很无措。

“我……”

宋郁垂眸看了好一会，他其实面色还是很不好，有些昏昏沉沉的，只是觉得他的小鸟还有很多的事不告诉他，说不在意是不可能的。

“松开。”

但它不高兴了。

“好。”

人最后只是很温和地道：

“粼粼，如果你活得很久的话，不要和我一起死掉，我把所有的财产都留给你，你自由自在地玩就好了。”

“管理局不是有你的好朋友么？”

“他们会替我照顾你。”

白粼粼其实愣了下，本能地抬了抬手，去抓住了人的肩头，不要，不要。

宋郁其实真的还在发烧，他不是很好，只是撑了半天，见他的小鸟搭过来手臂，想起来什么，抬手抱起来了，侧头轻声道：

“困了是不是？”

“我们去睡觉。”

-

最后两个人确实倒在了床上，不过一开始是宋郁撑着手臂打算给“少年”盖毯子的，但是被“少年”拉了一下，也就躺在了旁边。

白粼粼眼睛圆圆地看着这个少年，看到对方确实昏沉地闭上了眼之后，才立马地打算起身，但是手腕被扣住了。

“去哪？”

“去拿药，倒水，还有湿毛巾。”

宋郁像是想到什么，轻笑了下，松开了，语调很轻地道：

“我的小鸟。”

像是喃喃自语。

白粼粼不知道怎么了，面色有点红，但他还是立即动作了起来，顺带下楼去找爷爷了，大约十几分钟家庭医生就又来了。

说是没有好好休息，又烧起来了。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu felt this was the same tone one would use when speaking to a kindergartner. He frowned, wanting to intervene, but just then—

"Bai Linlin."

Song Yu's hanging fingers curled slightly. He turned his eyes to look at the "youth" beside him. His little bird... had a surname?

Chen Kaihe was very satisfied upon hearing this and said:

"The surname Bai is excellent. Any given name would sound good with it!"

It was a forced compliment.

In the end, Song Zhengguo spoke up:

"Let's eat first. Linlin, eat."

The "youth" curved his eyes upon hearing this, nodded, and reached out with his chopsticks to eat the ribs, looking very happy.

The villa was filled with a harmonious atmosphere.

It was only after a while that Chen Kaihe noticed Song Yu hadn't been picking up much food, so he asked:

"Xiao Yu, you eat too."

Song Yu simply explained, "I have a fever, I don't have much of an appetite."

Song Zhengguo's eyelids twitched; he had completely forgotten.

"..."

Instead, the "youth" beside him turned his head upon hearing this and said his first relatively long sentence:

"Are you feeling any better?"

Chen Kaihe started to bubble with joy again.

Song Yu turned his head and said, "I'm fine. Is it tasty?"

The "youth" nodded.

The bird used to eat with its beak, and always sneakily. Every time, it would wait half an hour to eat the leftovers. Sometimes people wouldn't touch certain foods, like crab roe buns, and they would all be left to the bird.

This was the first time he was eating food openly.

Bai Linlin quickly forgot those uncomfortable feelings, happy from the inside out. Grandpa knew he was a *yaoguai* (demon/spirit), so he didn't need to be so reserved.

The "youth" reached out to pick up a bean curd meat roll, put it in his mouth, and ate it slowly.

Song Zhengguo was actually quite happy watching him, moving the plates several times. His original intention was to let the bird eat more of what it liked, but later he discovered the bird seemed to love everything, so he stopped moving them.

However, halfway through, his phone rang. There was an incoming call, and the bird beside him looked up and asked:

"Grandpa, a call."

It was the first time Song Zhengguo had heard this address. He forgot everything else instantly, hung up the call from his son abroad, and said kindly:

"A telemarketing call, don't worry about it."

Bai Linlin ate smoothly throughout the entire lunch, tasting everything. He was a *yaoguai* and could eat a great deal, but for the sake of modesty, he put down his chopsticks at the appropriate time.

Then he turned his head to look at Song Yu.

"Shall we go upstairs then?"

Chen Kaihe wasn't quite satisfied yet and said:

"You can sit and chat a bit more. Xiao Yu, don't be so overbearing. She's a young girl, and you just take her upstairs at the drop of a hat. How can you do that..."

The dining room fell into a dead silence once again.

Old Man Chen remained cheerful: "Where are Linlin's parents? Their family needs to be notified too. Your grandfather and I need to prepare a gift—oh no, two gifts. You need to tidy up too, we'll go visit together."

Song Yu's movements stopped. Song Zhengguo lost all his strength in his chair, his mind replaying the phrase, "He was only five months old when your child took him away." As for Bai Linlin, he felt a bit awkward, but fortunately, he had been misunderstood like this when he was little, so he just said:

"Grandpa Chen, I'm a boy."

Chen Kaihe was still smiling, "A boy, that's also very good... ah?"

Bai Linlin tilted his head to look at his reaction. He actually frowned slightly. He hadn't expected that even now that he was older, his gender would still be mistaken. Was it because his hair was a bit long?

"I don't have a father or mother."

Bai Linlin was telling the truth. He really didn't have a father or mother. He had the orphanage director and teachers, and many younger brothers and sisters at the orphanage, but it seemed he couldn't talk about those things now.

But the "youth" didn't know what kind of emotional turmoil his words caused in the three people present.

Song Yu's heartstrings were tugged.

Song Zhengguo gasped, feeling that they must take responsibility...

Chen Kaihe opened his mouth upon hearing this, stood up abruptly, and said sternly:

"Child, I... my eyes are failing me, I didn't recognize it!"

"Can you forgive Grandpa?"

"You really are a good child, preparing for the TOEFL all by yourself..."

Bai Linlin tilted his head. When did he...

Song Zhengguo immediately waved his hand: "Go upstairs first, go on."

The two children then withdrew from the scene.

-

The dining room fell into silence.

Chen Kaihe frowned, rested his chin on his hand, took a deep breath, and finally said earnestly:

"He really is beautiful."

Song Zhengguo hadn't expected the first sentence to be that.

He actually needed a moment to recover too. Just the crane from the morning was enough to...

Song Zhengguo raised his hand to rub his face. His capacity for acceptance had increased so much that when his old friend asked:

"Does this Xiao Yu... like boys?"

He reflexively brushed it off:

"Yes, yes, yes."

...

In the bedroom.

After entering the room, Bai Linlin wanted to go to sleep, but his wrist was gripped and he was pulled in the opposite direction. He had no choice but to follow to the desk.

"I'm sleepy..."

Bai Linlin was scooped up by the waist and sat on the desk. He was a bit dazed; he hadn't finished his sentence.

"Wait a moment, okay?"

Bai Linlin had no choice but to sit down, but he was quite satisfied because the position was high. Song Yu just pulled out a chair and sat down.

The man took out a bag of pine nuts.

The bird immediately reached out.

"They aren't shelled yet."

Bai Linlin had to wait patiently. Song Yu took out that White Rabbit candy tin specially used for storing nuts and tossed them in one by one.

The man tossed one, the bird ate one.

This pairing was quite tacit.

Until—

"Linlin's surname is Bai?"

The "youth" froze, then immediately frowned. He was about to transform into his original form, but whether his pre-transformation signs were detected or not, Song Yu stood up and locked his hands.

Bai Linlin couldn't dodge, so he just tilted his head, feeling a bit stifled.

"Why didn't you tell me?"

"Linlin."

Bai Linlin opened his mouth, still feeling he couldn't say it, but Song Yu always managed to bring up the information he subtly ignored, leaving him at a loss every time.

"I..."

Song Yu lowered his eyes and watched for a long time. His complexion was still very poor, and he felt dizzy, but he just felt that his little bird still had many things he didn't tell him. To say he didn't care would be a lie.

"Let go."

But it was unhappy.

"Alright."

The man finally said very gently:

"Linlin, if you live a long time, don't die with me. I'll leave all my assets to you, just play freely."

"Doesn't the Management Bureau have your good friends?"

"They will take care of you for me."

Bai Linlin was actually stunned. Instinctively, he raised his hand to grab the man's shoulder. *No, don't.*

Song Yu was actually still running a fever and wasn't feeling well, but he had held on for a long time. Seeing his little bird reach out an arm, he remembered something, lifted him up, turned his head, and whispered:

"Sleepy, aren't you?"

"Let's go to sleep."

-

In the end, the two of them did collapse onto the bed. At first, Song Yu was supporting himself with his arms, intending to cover the "youth" with a blanket, but he was pulled by the "youth" and ended up lying down beside him.

Bai Linlin watched this youth with round eyes. Only after seeing the other person truly close his eyes in a daze did he immediately intend to get up, but his wrist was caught.

"Where are you going?"

"To get medicine, pour water, and get a wet towel."

Song Yu seemed to think of something, chuckled softly, let go, and said in a very light tone:

"My little bird."

It was like a murmur to himself.

Bai Linlin didn't know what was wrong, his face flushed a little, but he immediately started moving, taking the opportunity to go downstairs to find Grandpa. About ten minutes later, the family doctor arrived again.

He said that because he hadn't rested well, the fever had returned.

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国站在一旁，很是老老实实地说“是，我们一定注意”、“这个药是一天三次是吧”、“好的好的，我一定定时量体温”……

白粼粼在旁边一起罚站。

医生的职业天性如此，眼里只有病人和正常人，一旦看到病人没被照顾好或者不听医嘱的，自动获得“教师”buff，开始进行一些“教育”。

“让他好好睡一觉吧，已经注射了退烧针了，后面有什么别的情况及时联系我。”

“如果没有好转直接去医院。”

家庭医生走了。

-

时隔这么多年，宋郁头一次生病在家里，有人陪着，从中午一直到晚上九点。

昏昏沉沉的，吃了晚饭，暖黄的灯光下，爷爷守在旁边，毛绒绒的小鸟站在被子上，在仰头看他。

“爷爷，您去休息吧，我好些了。”

宋峥国其实还是很愧疚，这孩子不舒服都不讲的，他也是上午光想着那只鹤了……整个人都乱糟糟的。

“小郁爷爷就睡你隔壁的客房，不舒服就打电话啊。”

宋郁闻言笑了笑，“好。”

最后时间确实很晚了，老人这才走了，房间里只剩下一人一鸟。

白粼粼仰头监督着人把药喝了，他扑棱翅膀飞到了床头那里，叼起来那个冲剂，递给人。

宋郁抬手接了过来，本来要撕开的，但是圆滚滚的鸟头已经伸过来了，开始齐齐地把那个封口给咬断了，速度又快又好。

鸟仰头又看过来。

真挚。

宋郁这才把冲剂倒进了杯子里，之后才全部喝了，唇瓣有些微湿，只是低头看了看被子上的小鸟。

鸟还算满意，伸头把冲剂袋给叼过来了，扔进了垃圾桶里。

宋郁其实是坐了一会的，看着不远处的小鸟，问：

“怎么又变回来了？”

白粼粼只好道：“好像化形是有些耗费妖力的，本体是会轻盈一些。”

“我总觉得我妖力不是很多，早起就感觉少少的。”

鸟圆滚滚的，站在床头柜上伸了伸翅膀，有些郁闷。

宋郁只是安抚：“没事的。”

“粼粼会掌握的。”

白粼粼觉得也是，他啪嗒啪嗒地走了过去，站在床边，仰头道：

“你快睡觉。”

“我守着你。”

宋郁只是问：“粼粼不困？”

“我要等你睡了再睡。”

白粼粼很自然而然地答道。

少年闻言更是面容温和。

夜色一点点地变深，最后到了十一点钟，卧室里安安静静的，只开着一盏夜灯，人在床上躺着，鸟就在床头那里蓬着毛，守着。

白粼粼打了个哈欠，用爪子扣住那个测温枪，去给床上的人侧了下，看了下温度。

——37度。

已经开始退烧了。

鸟也松了口气，他把测温枪轻轻地放回了桌上，然后摇摇摆摆地走到了床头，看着床上的人，停顿了有个十多秒。

也不知道在想什么。

最后轻悄悄地绕到了床的里侧，很熟练地走到人的肩窝，把鸟头埋了过去。

贴得紧紧的。

仿佛这样能够安眠。

时间一点点地推移。

大约过了十几分钟，床上的小鸟已经变成了“少年”，与原本的病人互相依偎着。

宋郁如期睁开了眼睛，抬手把“人”给往里拢了下，很细致地给盖好了毯子。

“睡吧。”

-

大约又过了几天。

宋郁的身体彻底恢复了，白粼粼觉得放心了很多，但是他心里……总是觉得有些事情放不下。

那天的事很多。

鸟很郁闷。

寿命……实在是很无解。

白粼粼甚至觉得当一只普通的小鸟也不错了，但是没办法，宋郁还是和往常一样，甚至没有再过多地追问他的姓名。

这次还是半夜开车过来送他。

“去吧。”

宋郁在车里给他的小鸟戴上挎包，很是温和地说道，顺带按开了车门。

鸟这次有心事，扑棱翅膀下了地，啪嗒啪嗒地在路上走着，一步三回头。

“我在这里等你。”

白粼粼当然知道，宋郁一直会等他的，他闻言挥了挥翅膀。

“我去啦？”

“去吧。”

鸟这才背着挎包进了基地。

-

管理局内很是红红火火的，照样都是小妖怪们的狂欢，但只有白粼粼没什么兴致，他把挎包放到一个茶几上，吩咐大家自由去领零食了。

“老大怎么了？”

“老大好像不高兴。”

“老大的事少打听！”

一个领头的鼠鼠在茶几上派发零食，下面的小妖怪们都很有规矩地排成了长队。

白粼粼升到了A级，也通过了考核，他不需要再培训了，于是啪嗒啪嗒地走到了吧台那里，那里其实是有酒的。

不过不售卖给没有成年的小鸡。

“……”

鸟郁闷，鸟不开心。

但就在这时，他像是想起来什么，四处环顾了下，终于在吧台的一个东南角找到了001。

黑衣少年像是喝了酒，脸颊红红的，它很认真地趴在吧台的桌子上，看着面前支架上的手机。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，心想001在看什么，结果刚抬眼看过去……

小马宝莉。

“……”

001醉醺醺的，看到247过来了，砰的一下化成小雀儿，毛绒绒地挤过去，低头问：

“你怎么了？”

白粼粼心想他挂脸有这么严重吗？低了低鸟头，最后只是闷闷地说了自己担心的“寿命”问题。

“啊？这个？”

毛绒绒的小雀儿摇摇晃晃的，显然是意识不清了，但还是有样学样地用身体去挤旁边的蓝羽小鸟，力气有点大。

白粼粼打了个趔趄，爪子都滑了下，心想001怎么了？

不过就在这时，小雀开始低头，用翅膀盖住大一码的蓝羽小鸟，低语道：

“247，你过来。”

白粼粼虽然觉得很奇怪，但还是伸着鸟头过去了。
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo stood to the side, looking very obedient as he said, "Yes, we will definitely pay attention," "So this medicine is three times a day, right?" "Okay, okay, I will definitely measure his temperature at the scheduled times..."

Bai Linlin stood nearby, also being "punished" by standing still.

A doctor’s professional instinct is like this: they only see patients and healthy people. Once they see a patient who isn't being cared for properly or isn't following medical advice, they automatically gain a "teacher" buff and begin to provide some "education."

"Let him have a good sleep. He’s already had a fever-reducing injection. Contact me immediately if there are any other developments."

"If there’s no improvement, go straight to the hospital."

The family doctor left.

-

For the first time in so many years, Song Yu was sick at home with someone to keep him company, from noon until nine in the evening.

Dazed and groggy, he had finished dinner. Under the warm yellow light, his grandfather kept watch nearby, while the fluffy little bird stood on the quilt, looking up at him.

"Grandfather, go get some rest. I’m feeling much better."

Song Zhengguo actually felt quite guilty. This child hadn't even mentioned he was feeling unwell, and he himself had only been thinking about that crane all morning... He felt completely flustered.

"Little Yu, Grandfather is sleeping in the guest room right next door. If you feel uncomfortable, just call me."

Song Yu smiled upon hearing this. "Okay."

Eventually, it was quite late, and the old man finally left. The room was left with only one person and one bird.

Bai Linlin looked up, supervising the man as he took his medicine. He flapped his wings and flew to the head of the bed, picked up the packet of granules, and handed it to him.

Song Yu raised his hand to take it. He was about to tear it open, but the round bird head had already leaned in, biting the seal off with a quick, clean motion.

The bird looked up again.

Sincere.

Only then did Song Yu pour the granules into the cup and drink it all. His lips were slightly damp, and he looked down at the little bird on the quilt.

The bird seemed satisfied; he stretched his head out to pick up the empty granule packet and tossed it into the trash can.

Song Yu had actually been sitting for a while. He looked at the little bird not far away and asked:

"Why did you change back?"

Bai Linlin had no choice but to say, "It seems that transforming takes a bit of demon power. It’s lighter to stay in my original form."

"I always feel like I don't have much demon power. I felt like I had very little when I woke up this morning."

The bird was round and fluffy, standing on the nightstand and stretching his wings, looking a bit depressed.

Song Yu comforted him: "It’s okay."

"Linlin will get the hang of it."

Bai Linlin thought so too. He patted over, stood by the bed, and looked up:

"You go to sleep now."

"I’ll watch over you."

Song Yu just asked: "Aren't you sleepy, Linlin?"

"I want to wait until you’re asleep before I sleep."

Bai Linlin answered very naturally.

The young man’s expression softened even more upon hearing this.

The night grew deeper, and by eleven o'clock, the bedroom was quiet. Only a nightlight was on. The man lay on the bed, and the bird puffed up his feathers at the head of the bed, keeping watch.

Bai Linlin yawned, used his claw to hook the thermometer gun, and measured the temperature for the person on the bed.

—37 degrees Celsius.

The fever had started to break.

The bird let out a sigh of relief. He placed the thermometer gun back on the table gently, then waddled over to the head of the bed, looking at the person on the bed, pausing for about ten seconds.

He didn't know what he was thinking.

Finally, he quietly circled to the inner side of the bed, walked very familiarly into the crook of the man's shoulder, and buried his bird head there.

Pressed tightly against him.

As if he could sleep peacefully this way.

Time ticked by.

About ten minutes later, the little bird on the bed had turned into a "young man," cuddling with the original patient.

Song Yu opened his eyes right on cue, raised his hand to pull the "person" closer, and tucked the blanket in very carefully.

"Sleep."

-

About a few days later.

Song Yu’s body had completely recovered. Bai Linlin felt much more at ease, but in his heart... he always felt there were some things he couldn't let go of.

There were so many things that happened that day.

The bird was very depressed.

Lifespan... it was truly an unsolvable problem.

Bai Linlin even felt that being an ordinary little bird wasn't so bad, but there was no helping it; Song Yu was still the same as always, not even asking too much about his name again.

This time, he had driven over in the middle of the night to drop him off.

"Go on."

In the car, Song Yu put the small satchel on his little bird, saying very gently, and pressed the button to open the car door.

The bird had something on his mind this time. He flapped his wings and landed on the ground, walking along the road, looking back every three steps.

"I’ll wait for you here."

Bai Linlin naturally knew that Song Yu would always wait for him. Hearing this, he waved his wings.

"I’m going now?"

"Go."

Only then did the bird enter the base with his satchel on his back.

-

Inside the Administration, it was bustling and lively, as always a carnival for the little demons. But only Bai Linlin had no interest. He put his satchel on a coffee table and told everyone to help themselves to the snacks.

"What’s wrong with the Boss?"

"The Boss seems unhappy."

"Don't ask about the Boss's business!"

A leading mouse was distributing snacks on the coffee table, and the little demons below were lined up in an orderly fashion.

Bai Linlin had been promoted to A-rank and had passed the assessment, so he didn't need to train anymore. He waddled over to the bar counter, where there was actually alcohol.

However, it wasn't sold to underage chicks.

"..."

The bird was depressed; the bird was unhappy.

But just then, as if he remembered something, he looked around and finally found 001 in the southeast corner of the bar.

The black-clad youth looked like he had been drinking; his cheeks were flushed red. He was lying on the bar table very seriously, looking at the phone on the stand in front of him.

Bai Linlin waddled over, wondering what 001 was watching. But as soon as he looked up...

My Little Pony.

"..."

001 was tipsy. Seeing 247 come over, he turned into a little sparrow with a *poof*, squeezed over with his fluffy body, and lowered his head to ask:

"What’s wrong with you?"

Bai Linlin wondered if his sour expression was that obvious. He lowered his bird head and finally just spoke gloomily about the "lifespan" problem he was worried about.

"Ah? This?"

The fluffy little sparrow swayed, clearly not in his right mind, but he still mimicked the action, using his body to squeeze the blue-feathered bird next to him, with a bit too much force.

Bai Linlin stumbled, his claws even slipping. He wondered what was wrong with 001.

But just then, the sparrow began to lower his head, covering the larger blue-feathered bird with his wings, and whispered:

"247, come here."

Although Bai Linlin thought it was very strange, he still stretched his bird head over.

chunks.chineseText:
第43章

“压-住。”

白粼粼凑过去就听到了这两个字，鸟体有些僵硬，他抬头看了看旁边的小雀，心想这喝多了吧？

鸟试图走开，摇了摇鸟头，但是灰棕色小雀一直挤过来，并且始终伸着翅根，要把他包进去了。

白粼粼：“……”

001羽毛蓬松，旁边手机上的小马宝莉还在播放着，它只是低着鸟头，又压低了声线，很偷偷摸摸地道：

“丹顶鹤它就——”

就在这时，身后有一道黑漆漆的影子，传来了古井无波的声音：

“001？”

灰棕色小雀身躯一僵，而后砰得一下化成黑衣少年，乖巧地蹲在了吧台的椅子上，很认真地接着看支架上的手机。

“小马宝莉”正在播放着精彩画面，一堆五颜六色的小马正在聚在一起商讨大事，屏幕上堪比彩虹。

001的双手放在吧台的桌面上，规规矩矩的，它的脸有些红扑扑的，旁边还放着一杯空了的奶泡酒。

丹顶鹤站在后面，眯了眯眼看了过去。

一秒，两秒。

001打了个嗝。

丹顶鹤：“……”

白粼粼还在桌上圆滚滚地站着，这会一个系着领带的小鼠从大厅中心那里跑过来了，头上顶着个黑色的小挎包，快速地来到了吧台这里，长长的尾巴在桌面反光里还有倒影。

“老大。”

小鼠抬手把挎包给递了过来。

鸟侧头看了下，很自然地伸出爪子取了回来，重新穿戴上小挎包，然后头也不抬地挥了挥翅膀。

那个小鼠这才转身离开了。

抽空对丹顶鹤点了下头。

“……”

丹顶鹤闭了闭眼，真是觉得一个比一个难管教，它刚想要开口说一下247这种拉帮结派的作风问题……

但视线一转移。

蓝羽小鸟还在调整自己的挎包位置，认认真真的，最后放在了右边翅膀的四分之三处，肩带适宜，美观大方。

白粼粼弄好了，毛绒绒的，还收了收翅膀，站得端端正正的，仰头去看丹顶鹤。

“……算了。”

“不是想问寿命问题吗？跟我来。”

丹顶鹤最后只是叹了口气，然后抬步朝着“办公室”的方向走去，不过在经过正在看动画片的黑衣少年的时候，伸出翅膀敲了下001的脑袋。

金线四溢。

椅子上立马出现一只毛绒绒的小雀，就是一直用翅膀捂住鸟头，来回转圈圈，左爪子绊右爪子，最后啪唧一倒，成了一个“球”。

丹顶鹤在前面走，优雅从容，身后坠着一个圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟，那只还担忧地仰头看了看椅子上的灰棕色小雀，停留了几步，本来还是想关怀一下的。

但是前面只是传来了一句催促：

“247？”

鸟立马回头，啪嗒啪嗒地跟了过去，加速了一下下。

-

白粼粼还算是头一次来丹顶鹤的办公室，之前没来过，探头探脑的，这里全都是书架，并且都很厚的样子。

丹顶鹤坐到桌子的椅子上，用翅膀拿起来一杯咖啡，很优雅地道：

“上来。”

蓝羽小鸟这才回过了头，闻言伸了伸翅膀，下压身躯，爪子微微使劲，很顺利地飞了过来。

站在了桌子上。

毛绒绒的，胸膛挺立。

丹顶鹤喝完一口咖啡，把杯子放下了，只是问道：

“你担心你的监护人早早逝去？”

白粼粼不知道为什么，听到这话就有点难过，收了收翅膀，想了想，很认真地点了点头。

丹顶鹤见状其实心里也是暖暖的，247贪玩归贪玩，但还是个好孩子，它只是循循善诱道：

“可是人类的寿命就是这么短的，你总要接受的。”

鸟低了低头，也不知道说什么，只是用爪子刨桌面。

emo中。

丹顶鹤本来还是想出声安慰的，毕竟247还是个幼鸟，但是一低头看到了自己办公桌子上有了一道道的爪痕。

“……”

“行了行了，站好。”

白粼粼懵懵的，闻言这才停了动作，重新站得板板正正的。

“我只问你一个问题，如果说，你的寿命可以给予你的监护人，换言之，你的寿命会减少，他的寿命会……”

丹顶鹤话都还没有说完，桌面上的小鸟就啪嗒啪嗒地走过来了，仰头看着，甚至伸了伸翅根，鸟眼圆圆的。

“真的吗！”

丹顶鹤蹙眉，觉得这孩子怎么有些缺心眼，于是又补了一句：

“你以为这是很随意的吗？一年两年这种根本就不能操作，一看就没好好学习历史课程，古时候就有狐狸报恩，舍弃掉自己千年修为只为救恩人一命。”

“妖怪数十年的寿命，兑到人类身上，可能就一个月。”

鸟愣住了，没有想到通货膨胀这么严重，连伸翅根的动作都停了。

丹顶鹤看到后才算有些满意，好歹是有点正常的反应了，它斜斜瞥了一眼过去，考验道：

“所以说，你还要给你的监护人兑寿命吗？”

白粼粼很是认真地想了想，狐狸千年修为……才换恩人一命，他……三个月修为，延长宋郁寿命三分钟吗？

鸟沉思，鸟做出选择。

“我要不和他一起死掉吧？”

圆滚滚的鸟头上仰，爪子并在一起，很认真地询问道。

白粼粼其实真的觉得一百年挺长了，他当人的时候觉得能活七十顶天了，现在当了妖怪起码稳稳的一百年吧？

鸟也不想进步，他只想当一只小鸟。

宋郁的小鸟。

丹顶鹤震惊，闻言就是相当生气，直接就站起来了，偏偏桌上的那只还没有察觉到情况的不对，歪着鸟头问：

“妖怪自己选择死的话，是不是就不痛？”

丹顶鹤要气晕了，大声地道：

“247！你知不知道你现在还是个幼鸟！你和你的监护人才相处多久！”

“就算他作为人类带着你来基地，那也完全还到不了你去……”

丹顶鹤觉得眼前白茫茫一片，胸口都有点疼，最后伸出翅膀拍了下桌子，接着道：

“殉情的地步！”

蓝羽小鸟有点被吓到了，翅根收得很紧，桌面上的震动让他微微腾空了下。

白粼粼意识到了好像说错话了。

“你都是从哪里学的！你是个幼鸟幼鸟！你才多大！”

“你这一路的艰难修行——”

丹顶鹤说到这里戛然而止，连带着情绪都降下来了，心想还是装过头了。

247什么时候“艰难”过，来报到都是监护人带着的，那个什么津贴任务后面经调查……全部都是监护人一路联系的，247只起到一个吉祥物的作用。

升级更是如此了，直接用监护人购置的小零食收买人心，从而获得无数妖力津贴……直接速通化形。

“……”

丹顶鹤真是心里复杂，最后直接一收翅膀，也不进行这个考验环节了，直接道：

“好了，知道你喜欢你的监护人。”

“接着讲，赠予寿命是一种常规的方式，妖界仍然有很多妖怪为它们的监护人兑换寿命，甚至很积极地去做任务。”
chunks.englishText:
"Press-down."

Bai Linlin leaned in and heard these two words. His bird body stiffened slightly. He looked up at the sparrow next to him, thinking, *Is he drunk?*

The bird tried to walk away, shaking his head, but the grey-brown sparrow kept squeezing over, keeping his wing-root extended, trying to wrap him up.

Bai Linlin: "..."

001’s feathers were fluffy. On the phone nearby, *My Little Pony* was still playing. He just lowered his bird head, lowered his voice, and said very sneakily:

"The Red-Crowned Crane, it just—"

Just then, a pitch-black shadow appeared behind them, and a voice as calm as an ancient well came:

"001?"

The grey-brown sparrow’s body stiffened, and then with a *poof*, he transformed into the black-clad youth, sitting obediently on the bar stool, watching the phone on the stand very seriously.

*My Little Pony* was playing an exciting scene; a bunch of colorful ponies were gathered together discussing major events, the screen looking like a rainbow.

001’s hands were placed on the bar table, very properly. His face was flushed red, and a glass of empty milk-foam wine sat beside him.

The Red-Crowned Crane stood behind them, squinting as he looked over.

One second, two seconds.

001 hiccuped.

Red-Crowned Crane: "..."

Bai Linlin was still standing round and fluffy on the table. At this moment, a little mouse wearing a tie ran over from the center of the hall, with a small black satchel on his head. He quickly arrived at the bar, his long tail casting a reflection on the polished surface.

"Boss."

The mouse raised his hand and handed over the satchel.

The bird tilted his head to look, naturally extended his claw to take it back, put the small satchel on again, and then waved his wings without looking up.

The mouse then turned and left.

He took the opportunity to nod at the Red-Crowned Crane.

"..."

The Red-Crowned Crane closed his eyes. He really felt that these kids were getting harder and harder to manage. He was just about to speak up about 247’s habit of forming cliques...

But his gaze shifted.

The blue-feathered bird was still adjusting the position of his satchel, very seriously, finally placing it at three-quarters of the way down his right wing. The shoulder strap was just right—beautiful and elegant.

Bai Linlin finished adjusting, looking fluffy. He tucked his wings in, stood up straight, and looked up at the Red-Crowned Crane.

"...Forget it."

"Didn't you want to ask about the lifespan problem? Follow me."

The Red-Crowned Crane finally just sighed, then stepped toward the direction of his "office." However, as he passed the black-clad youth watching the cartoon, he reached out a wing and tapped 001 on the head.

Golden threads overflowed.

A fluffy little sparrow immediately appeared on the chair, covering his bird head with his wings, spinning around in circles, tripping his left claw over his right, and finally collapsing into a "ball."

The Red-Crowned Crane walked in front, elegant and composed, followed by a round, blue-feathered bird. That one looked back at the grey-brown sparrow on the chair with worry, pausing for a few steps, originally wanting to show some concern.

But from the front came a urging voice:

"247?"

The bird immediately turned his head, waddled over, and sped up a little.

-

This was the first time Bai Linlin had come to the Red-Crowned Crane’s office. He hadn't been here before, so he poked his head around. It was filled with bookshelves, all of which looked very thick.

The Red-Crowned Crane sat in the desk chair, picked up a cup of coffee with his wing, and said very elegantly:

"Come up."

Only then did the blue-feathered bird turn his head back. Hearing this, he stretched his wings, lowered his body, exerted a little force with his claws, and flew up smoothly.

He stood on the desk.

Fluffy, with his chest puffed out.

The Red-Crowned Crane finished a sip of coffee, set the cup down, and just asked:

"You’re worried that your guardian will pass away early?"

Bai Linlin didn't know why, but hearing this made him feel a bit sad. He tucked his wings in, thought for a moment, and nodded very seriously.

Seeing this, the Red-Crowned Crane actually felt a warmth in his heart. 247 might be playful, but he was still a good child. He just guided him patiently:

"But human lifespans are just that short. You have to accept it."

The bird lowered his head, not knowing what to say, and just scratched the desk with his claws.

*Emo mode activated.*

The Red-Crowned Crane originally wanted to comfort him, after all, 247 was still a fledgling, but as he looked down, he saw claw marks appearing on his desk.

"..."

"Alright, alright, stand still."

Bai Linlin was confused, but stopped his movements upon hearing this and stood up straight again.

"I’ll only ask you one question: if your own lifespan could be given to your guardian—in other words, your lifespan would decrease, and his lifespan would..."

Before the Red-Crowned Crane could even finish his sentence, the little bird on the desk waddled over, looking up, even stretching his wing-roots, his bird eyes round.

"Really!"

The Red-Crowned Crane frowned, feeling that this child was a bit dim-witted, so he added:

"Do you think this is something done casually? One or two years is impossible to operate like that. It’s clear you haven't studied your history lessons well. In ancient times, there were foxes who repaid kindness by sacrificing their thousand-year cultivation just to save their benefactor’s life."

"A demon's lifespan of several decades, when converted to a human's, might only be a month."

The bird was stunned. He hadn't expected the inflation to be so severe, and even the action of stretching his wing-roots stopped.

The Red-Crowned Crane was somewhat satisfied to see this; at least it was a normal reaction. He glanced at him sideways and tested him:

"So, do you still want to trade your lifespan for your guardian’s?"

Bai Linlin thought about it very seriously. A fox’s thousand-year cultivation... only traded for one life? He... three months of cultivation, to extend Song Yu’s life by three minutes?

The bird pondered. The bird made a choice.

"Should I just die with him?"

The round bird head looked up, claws clasped together, and he asked very seriously.

Bai Linlin actually felt that a hundred years was quite long. When he was a human, he thought living to seventy was the peak, and now as a demon, he would surely live at least a hundred years, right?

The bird didn't want to progress; he just wanted to be a little bird.

Song Yu’s little bird.

The Red-Crowned Crane was shocked and became quite angry upon hearing this. He stood up directly, but the one on the desk hadn't realized the gravity of the situation, tilting his head and asking:

"If a demon chooses to die, does it hurt?"

The Red-Crowned Crane was about to faint from anger and shouted:

"247! Do you know you’re still a fledgling! How long have you even been with your guardian!"

"Even if he brought you to the base as a human, it’s nowhere near the point where you should..."

The Red-Crowned Crane felt a white haze before his eyes, and his chest hurt a little. Finally, he slammed his wing on the desk and continued:

"...commit suicide for love!"

The blue-feathered bird was a bit frightened, his wing-roots pulled in tight, and the vibration on the desk made him hover slightly.

Bai Linlin realized he had said something wrong.

"Where did you learn all this! You’re a fledgling, a fledgling! How old are you!"

"Your difficult cultivation journey all this way—"

The Red-Crowned Crane stopped abruptly, his emotions cooling down as well. He thought he had overacted.

When had 247 ever had a "difficult" journey? He was brought to report by his guardian, and as for those allowances and tasks... investigations showed they were all handled by the guardian. 247 only served as a mascot.

His leveling up was even more so; he directly used snacks bought by his guardian to bribe people's hearts, thereby obtaining countless demon power allowances... and speed-ran his transformation.

"..."

The Red-Crowned Crane felt complicated. Finally, he tucked his wings in and didn't continue the test, saying directly:

"Alright, I know you like your guardian."

"Continuing on, gifting lifespan is a conventional method. There are still many demons in the demon world who trade their lifespan for their guardians, and they are even very active in doing tasks."

chunks.chineseText:
”皮皮你知道吗？见你上次和那只金丝熊有沟通的样子。”

丹顶鹤语速很快，甚至没有等对面的回答，直接顺着说了起来：

“它不常来基地，因为大多数时间会做任务，它的监护人年纪大了，而且患有疾病。而皮皮通过赠予寿命的方式，可以让它的监护人延年益寿，同时妖力也能让那些疾病的副作用减轻，趋近于没有，这是普遍妖怪都采取的一种方式。”

一连串话说下来，白粼粼懵懵的，其实也不知道为什么丹顶鹤上一秒那么生气，下一秒直接开始同他解释了。

收放自如。

鸟有些紧张兮兮的，爪子都抠了抠桌面。

丹顶鹤蹙眉，最后一个抬翅膀，勾起来那个小挎包，蓝羽小鸟圆滚滚的，正好能卡住，鸟爪子徒劳地伸了伸。

实心的。

白粼粼被放到了一个杯垫上。

“但这种‘赠予寿命’的方式其实很不划算，先前也说了，兑换的很少，之所以很多妖怪都使用这个，那是因为不想他们的监护人察觉出端倪。”

丹顶鹤说到这里，话锋一转：

“但是你的监护人他知道你是妖怪，所以，你可以用另外一种方式。”

……

此刻小巷外面。

宋郁还在车内等着，看了大约有半个小时的专业书，后面才侧头看了下围墙那里。

空荡荡的。

人从十五分钟看一次，进步到半个小时看一次。

宋郁也并非没有想过那个寿命的问题，当时他的小鸟那么说……他不可能不震动，可是它还那么小，可以交很多很多的妖怪朋友的。

他所能做的，其实就是为他的小鸟铺好以后的路。

宋郁微微垂着头，修长的手指搭在方向盘上，其实是微微收紧了力道的。

说到底。

还是不甘心。

……

管理局内。

鸟听完之后，整个鸟体都在发热。

“不是！我们不是那种关系！”

丹顶鹤闻言眯了眯眼，只是很四平八稳地又端起来咖啡杯，刚想啜饮一小口，结果没太注意是空的，不过好在247没看见，又很优雅地放了回去。

“这有什么可害羞的，妖怪和人类的关系就两种，前者是亲人，后者……就是伴侣。”

“如果你到了S级的话，你完全可以同你的监护人……嗯，双修一下。”

鸟彻底红温了，一边伸着翅根散热，一边扭头朝门口走去，很急，爪子都打了滑，啪嗒啪嗒的。

但是还没走几步，就被一道无形的金线给挡住了，白粼粼直接倒栽了过去，完成了一个后空翻，不过是以“毛球”的形态。

丹顶鹤只是低头看着，慢悠悠地道：

“你害羞什么？谁家监护人天天接送的？”

“你知不知道你监护人在你每次来基地的时候，都会问问我的你的情况，猜猜问的什么？”

鸟刚从桌子上站起来，气鼓鼓的，低着鸟头，爪子都觉得发烫了。

他才不要听！

但是丹顶鹤已经开始说了：

“我的小鸟今天开心吗？”

“我的小鸟最近很认真，它之前被批评了很低落的，或许您可以夸夸它？它很棒的。”

“我的小鸟……”

白粼粼觉得四面八方都是“我的小鸟”，最后甚至也不说人话了，肉色的短喙一张一合的：

“啾啾啾！啾啾啾啾啾啾！”

“啾啾啾！”

鸟炸毛了，不要再学了！

丹顶鹤微微仰了仰头，神清气爽的，心道这247，可算让它找到突破口了，不过它刚低头看过去……

圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟对着个笔筒站好了，开始面壁，爪子还在持续抠地。

丹顶鹤摇了摇头。

还是个幼鸟。

“总之这种方式是最好的，难不成你真要去殉情？”

“这个世界变化这么大，无数的美食和风景……001可能吃到了更美味的烧烤，去各种地方观光，然后回头一看，你在土里。”

白粼粼彻底绷不住了，一个弹跳转身，仰头看了过来。

丹顶鹤见状才笑了下，很有长辈的风范，饶有兴致地看着桌上的蓝羽小鸟。

“‘赠予寿命’的办法是杯水车薪，皮皮那样的妖怪它们并不想影响监护人的社会关系，所以它们会在监护人到了百年之际，停止赠予行为，临终陪伴，之后回归基地生活。”

“你可以选这种。”

丹顶鹤慢悠悠地道，补了一句：

“不过余生只是望着墓碑而已。”

蓝羽小鸟有些着急，不自觉地往前走了几步。

丹顶鹤有时候也想不通，这247，一个幼鸟，堂而皇之地说出来“殉情”的话来，但是却在提及双修的法子后害羞成这个样子。

“我们鸟类的年龄，只有幼鸟和成鸟两个阶段，你一岁半的时候就是成鸟了，完全可以选择……”

白粼粼又不中了，想去笔筒那里面壁，但就在这时，丹顶鹤很是无奈地道：

“行了行了，双修又不是非要那种……才奏效的，其余的行为也可以的，只是那个最好而已。”

“再说了，你监护人现在不是很年轻吗？你反应这么大干什么？难道立马就想……”

鸟生气：“我没有！”

丹顶鹤也不理会桌上的那只跳脚的小鸡，只是也很中肯地把第二种方式的缺陷说了出来：

“你如果采用第二种，你的监护人的容貌都不会有大的变化，虽然可以用妖力遮掩，但这很麻烦，所以会时常切换居住地点。”

白粼粼听到这里倒是情绪回稳了下，啪嗒啪嗒走过来，认真地问了问：

“那多一般多长时间切换啊？”

“三十年？”

“……”

-

001在外面还在等着，它又点了一杯奶泡酒，趴在吧台的桌子上，一会看看动画片，一会抬头喝一口饮品，一会去扭头看那个“办公室”。

247怎么还不出来？

黑衣少年脸颊红红的，过了一会，坐直了身子，开始专心等待了。

247真的是个很厉害的老大。

黑衣少年意识都有些晕晕的，但还是这么坚定地认为，因为它自从这些日子去串门，247教会了它怎么使用手机购物、付款，而且回回都让它带走好多吃的。

老大不愧是老大。

大约就这么直勾勾地等了三分钟，还是没来，黑衣少年就又去趴着看动画片了。

不过奶泡酒已经见底了，001晕晕的，砰得一下化成灰棕色的小雀，扑棱翅膀站到了杯子的边缘，试图伸鸟头进去喝一下底部的液体，就在它努力尝试的时候——

一道蓝影飞了过来。

白粼粼还叼着个新的“手册”，刚准备放下，杯子里的小雀就一个不稳，扑通一下栽进去了，圆滚滚的毛球。

丹顶鹤从后面走过来，更是蹙眉，抬了下翅膀，有金线流动，杯子里的小雀被无形地拎了起来，顺带自动“清洁”了下。

羽毛都蓬松了。

白粼粼震惊，往前走了几步，这么厉害，他不由得仰头去看丹顶鹤。

“没出息的样子，这是最低级的小术法。”

丹顶鹤在一旁这么说道。
chunks.englishText:
"Do you know, Pipi? I saw you communicating with that golden-silk bear last time."

The Red-crowned Crane spoke at a rapid pace, not even waiting for a response before continuing:

"It doesn't come to the base often because it spends most of its time completing missions. Its guardian is elderly and suffers from illness. By gifting lifespan, Pipi can help its guardian live a longer life, while its demonic energy also mitigates the side effects of those illnesses, making them nearly non-existent. This is a method commonly adopted by most demons."

After this barrage of words, Bai Linlin felt dazed. He couldn't quite understand why the Red-crowned Crane had been so furious a second ago, only to start explaining things to him the next.

It really could switch moods at will.

The bird looked a bit nervous, its claws scratching at the tabletop.

The Red-crowned Crane frowned, finally raising a wing to hook the small satchel. The little blue-feathered bird was round and plump, fitting perfectly, though its bird claws reached out in vain.

It was solid.
