Bai Linlin was placed onto a coaster.

"But this method of 'gifting lifespan' is actually very cost-ineffective. As I mentioned before, the exchange rate is very low. The reason many demons use it is simply because they don't want their guardians to notice anything amiss."

At this point, the Red-crowned Crane shifted the tone of the conversation:

"However, your guardian knows you are a demon. Therefore, you can use a different method."

……

Outside the alleyway at this moment.

Song Yu was still waiting in the car. After reading professional books for about half an hour, he finally turned his head to look toward the wall.

It was empty.

He had progressed from checking every fifteen minutes to checking every half hour.

It wasn't that Song Yu hadn't thought about the issue of lifespan. When his little bird had said that back then... it was impossible for him not to be shaken. But it was still so small, and it could make many, many demon friends.

All he could really do was pave the way for his little bird's future.

Song Yu lowered his head slightly, his slender fingers resting on the steering wheel, though he was gripping it with a subtle, tightened force.

When it came down to it.

He was still unwilling to let go.

……

Inside the Administration Bureau.

After hearing this, the bird felt its entire body heating up.

"No! We aren't that kind of relationship!"

The Red-crowned Crane narrowed its eyes at this, calmly picking up its coffee cup again. It intended to take a small sip, but realized too late that it was empty. Fortunately, 247 didn't notice, and it placed the cup back down with great elegance.

"What is there to be shy about? There are only two types of relationships between demons and humans: the former are family, and the latter... are partners."

"If you reach S-rank, you can fully... well, practice dual cultivation with your guardian."

The bird turned completely red. While flapping its wing roots to dissipate the heat, it turned and headed toward the door. It was in such a hurry that its claws slipped, *patter-patter-patter*.

But before it could take many steps, it was blocked by an invisible golden thread. Bai Linlin tumbled forward, completing a backflip, though in his "fur-ball" form.

The Red-crowned Crane just looked down, speaking slowly:

"What are you shy about? Whose guardian picks them up and drops them off every single day?"

"Do you know that every time you come to the base, your guardian asks me about your situation? Guess what he asks?"

The bird had just stood up from the table, puffed up with anger, lowering its head as its claws felt like they were burning.

He didn't want to hear it!

But the Red-crowned Crane had already started:

"'Is my little bird happy today?'"

"'My little bird has been very diligent lately. It was quite down after being criticized before; perhaps you could praise it? It’s doing great.'"

"'My little bird...'"

Bai Linlin felt "my little bird" coming from every direction. Finally, he stopped speaking human language altogether, his flesh-colored short beak opening and closing:

"Chirp chirp chirp! Chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

"Chirp chirp!"

The bird was bristling—stop mimicking it!

The Red-crowned Crane tilted its head slightly, feeling refreshed. It thought that it had finally found a breakthrough with this 247. However, just as it looked down...

The round, blue-feathered bird was standing against a pen holder, facing the wall, its claws still scratching at the surface.

The Red-crowned Crane shook its head.

Still just a fledgling.

"In any case, this method is the best. Don't tell me you actually want to die for love?"

"The world changes so much, with countless delicacies and scenery... 001 might eat more delicious barbecue, go sightseeing in various places, and then look back to find you in the dirt."

Bai Linlin couldn't hold it in anymore. With a spring-like motion, he turned around and looked up.

Seeing this, the Red-crowned Crane smiled, displaying the demeanor of an elder, looking at the blue-feathered bird on the table with great interest.

"The 'gifting lifespan' method is just a drop in the bucket. Demons like Pipi don't want to affect their guardian's social life, so they stop gifting when the guardian reaches the end of their century, accompany them until the end, and then return to the base to live."

"You can choose this one."

The Red-crowned Crane said slowly, adding:

"But the rest of your life will be spent just staring at a tombstone."

The blue-feathered bird felt a bit anxious and involuntarily took a few steps forward.

Sometimes the Red-crowned Crane couldn't understand it either. This 247, a mere fledgling, could talk about "dying for love" so brazenly, yet be this shy when the method of dual cultivation was mentioned.

"In our bird species, there are only two stages: fledgling and adult. When you are a year and a half old, you will be an adult. You can fully choose..."

Bai Linlin couldn't take it again and wanted to go face the wall at the pen holder, but just then, the Red-crowned Crane said helplessly:

"Alright, alright. Dual cultivation doesn't strictly require *that*... to be effective. Other behaviors work too; that one is just the best."

"Besides, isn't your guardian very young right now? Why are you reacting so strongly? Do you want to do it right away?"

The bird was angry: "I do not!"

The Red-crowned Crane ignored the hopping little chicken on the table and objectively stated the flaws of the second method:

"If you adopt the second method, your guardian's appearance won't change much. Although you can use demonic energy to conceal it, it's very troublesome, so you will have to change your place of residence frequently."

Bai Linlin’s emotions stabilized upon hearing this. He walked over *patter-patter* and asked earnestly:

"How often do you have to move, usually?"

"Thirty years?"

"..."

-

001 was still waiting outside. It had ordered another glass of milk-foam wine, lying on the bar counter, occasionally watching cartoons, then looking up to take a sip of its drink, then turning its head to look at that "office."

Why hasn't 247 come out yet?

The black-clad youth’s cheeks were flushed. After a while, he sat up straight and began to wait intently.

247 really is a very impressive boss.

The black-clad youth felt a bit dizzy, but remained firm in this belief, because ever since it started visiting, 247 had taught it how to use a phone for shopping and payments, and every time, it let it take away lots of food.

A boss is a boss for a reason.

After waiting intently for about three minutes and still seeing no sign of him, the black-clad youth went back to lying down and watching cartoons.

However, the milk-foam wine was already at the bottom. 001 was dizzy, and with a *poof*, it transformed into a gray-brown sparrow, flapping its wings to stand on the edge of the glass, trying to stretch its bird head inside to drink the liquid at the bottom. Just as it was struggling—

A blue shadow flew over.

Bai Linlin was still carrying a new "manual" and was just about to set it down when the sparrow in the glass lost its balance and fell in with a *plop*, a round, fluffy ball.

The Red-crowned Crane walked over from behind, frowning even more. It raised a wing, and golden threads flowed; the sparrow in the glass was lifted up by an invisible force, and incidentally, it was "cleaned" automatically.

Its feathers became fluffy.

Bai Linlin was shocked and took a few steps forward. So powerful! He couldn't help but look up at the Red-crowned Crane.

"What a pathetic sight. That’s just the lowest-level minor spell."

The Red-crowned Crane remarked from the side.

chunks.chineseText:
001懵懵的，不过它转头一看，发现是247，立马就啪嗒啪嗒走过去了，挤成一团，再次伸出自己的翅膀，盖住。

很费劲也要盖。

丹顶鹤：“……这什么动作？”

白粼粼：“……”

“它应该喝醉了。”

丹顶鹤闭了闭眼，最后仿佛是接受现状了，挥了挥翅膀，“不妨事。”

“001？”

灰棕色小雀目光坚定，抬着鸟头看向丹顶鹤，用翅膀盖着的动作更用力了点，闷闷地道：

“在。”

丹顶鹤：防备谁呢？

不过它还是通知道：

“247需要升到S级，这样，你带带它。”

-

后面这桩事就算是解决了，白粼粼顺顺利利地拎了一份新的“手册”出来了，开门上车，一气呵成。

宋郁其实还问了下这是什么，但手刚要碰过去，他的小鸟就立马叼走了，啪嗒啪嗒在座椅靠背的里侧一顿操作，塞进了它的小挎包里。

“妖怪手册！”

“我要升到S级！”

白粼粼避重就轻地通知了下自己接下来的安排。

现在外面还是有点黑的，气温也有所降低，宋郁身着黑色的毛衣，显得温润又有气质，只是单手扶着方向盘，蹙眉问：

“怎么突然要升级了？”

“会不会累？”

白粼粼其实有点不自在的，他活动了下爪子，低着头，其实在组织语言，怎么解释？

不过就在这时。

“有其他妖怪说你？还是丹顶鹤对你不满意？”

少年眉目冷了冷。

白粼粼立马顺着杆子爬上去了，扑棱翅膀飞到人的肩头，点了点鸟头：

“啾！”

最后人为了安抚鸟，遵照鸟的指示，驱车去了十公里外的地方一家炒货店，几乎包圆了全部的新品。

-

丹顶鹤给的是一本双修手册，删减版的，临走还说了些注意事项。

白粼粼其实非常心虚，本来是不想拿的，但是它非给，他就只能拿着了。

鸟后面也想通了，丹顶鹤说的没错，宋郁现在还很年轻，他又不着急……

倒不如先升到S级，拥有这个选择权再说，如果真到了需要延长寿命的时候，白粼粼觉得自己是可以牺牲一下，抱抱贴贴的。

这有什么？

鸟有宽广的胸怀。

宋郁上午没什么课，但是去了公司，估计有什么事爷爷也去了，一楼餐桌上有热腾腾的饭菜，还有雷打不动的蟹黄包。

不过白粼粼此刻不在餐桌上，而是背着挎包去了隔壁的房间，他的房间，这里面琳琅满目的，宋郁前些天又让人给他打了个柜子，里面可以放很多饰品，简直像个储藏室。

鸟叼着手册进来了，他的挎包还要用，万一分发零食的时候掉出来这个就不好了……

白粼粼思索了一下，化成了人形，去拿出来了那个保险箱，很认真地打开了密码锁，把这个手册给放进去了。

一秒，两秒。

“少年”站在地毯上，穿着棕色条纹的长筒袜，小腿笔直，上面套着一个咖色的毛衣，还有夹两层的衬衫领。

家里开着恒温空调，温度适宜。

白粼粼抿了抿唇，又偷偷地把手册拿了出来，他其实没有看过。

里面是什么样子的？

他不由自主地掀开了，第一页是图……

有门把手拧动的声音。

“粼粼？”

白粼粼着急忙慌地把东西给塞进保险箱里了，赶在门开的最后一刻装作若如其事的样子。

宋郁进门的时候看到的就是“少年”面色红润地站在地毯上的样子，他愣了下，问：

“怎么脸这么红？”

“爷爷说他这几天不回来，要去琅山那里鱼塘和陈爷爷一起钓鱼，让我来告诉你一声……”

他一边说一边走了过来。

白粼粼脑子乱乱的，仰头看过去，蹙眉道：

“你可以用手机告诉我的啊。”

但对面的人只是眼眸微动，抬手握住了他的手腕，很如常地道：

“是。”

“但我忘了。”

白粼粼觉得奇奇怪怪的，但是他被牵着手走了出去，宋郁倒是问了下：

“不是说很困么？怎么没去睡觉？”

“早饭也没有吃。”

白粼粼只是一路被带到了餐厅，被看着吃完了早饭，然后才放去楼上了。

“拜拜！”

“少年”站在楼梯处，同不远处的人挥了挥手，宋郁微微抬眸，眉眼都是柔和的，也说了句：

“拜拜。”

等到真的出门之后，宋郁在车上其实有点心不静，华秉现在虽然是有起色，但是他年纪还是太轻……不能那么招摇，学校也不行……太多人了。

他什么时候可以时时刻刻带着他的小鸟。

宋郁眉目冷了冷。

只是在思考未来几年的动向。

-

“旅游？”

“真的吗？”

现在是九月末，正好快要到国庆长假，宋峥国还在琅山那里，说是有些细枝末节的东西要处理一下，一来一回费事，宋郁也就同意了。

不过假期实在难得，宋郁就提出了要不要去旅游的计划。

衣帽间里的“少年”眼睛亮亮的，鼻梁上驾着一幅金丝框眼睛，戴着个画家帽，身上还穿着很复古的小马甲，显得腰身很细。

白粼粼在自己新的“衣帽间”里观光，宋郁又给他分了一个房间，整体装潢与别墅基本保持一致，但在内部来看还是有很多设计的，就连那个立身镜，都是带着实木边框的，有复杂的雕纹。

“少年”很是开心，抱着那些新送来的衣服，连忙去问要去哪里。

“温泉度假山庄好不好？”

宋郁又问了问，眉眼都很温和，看着面前洋溢着笑容的“少年”。

“好！”

但下一秒。

“我要带001去！”

-

宋郁没想到事情会是这样，但是总之是出发了，车后座的两只小鸟挤来挤去的，也不知道在说什么。

[任务带了吗？我们完成之后还能去泡泡温泉！]

001从虚空处叼出来一个牌子，灰色任务，编号579，右上注：

——联合指导任务

——S级指导：编号001

白粼粼很安心，挤了挤身子，只是道：

[收起来收起来。]

[反正还有时间，不如我们先泡温泉，后去做任务怎么样？]

001：[……]

最后车子开到了服务区，宋郁听从他的小鸟指示，去买各色各样的零食了，具体包括：百香果味的酸奶、核桃味的花生、蜜桃味的气泡水……

车里现在只剩下两个小鸟。

001眯了眯鸟眼，看了看远去的监护人，最终凑了过来，很认真地询问：

[247。]

[特地让我选这次旅行城市的任务，是有深意对么？]

白粼粼：“……”

没有，想多了。

下一秒：

[什么时候对你的监护人下手？]

白粼粼生无可恋。

-

这次的任务其实算是中等，目标是一个虐杀流浪猫的大学男生。

想要升到S级，必须要做灰色任务，否则对于妖力的使用是达不到完全的熟练的。
chunks.englishText:
001 was dazed, but when it turned its head and saw it was 247, it immediately walked over *patter-patter*, squeezed into a ball, and once again stretched out its own wing to cover it.

It was very difficult, but it insisted on covering it.

Red-crowned Crane: "...What kind of action is that?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

"It must be drunk."

The Red-crowned Crane closed its eyes, finally seeming to accept the status quo, and waved its wing. "It doesn't matter."

"001?"

The gray-brown sparrow’s gaze was firm. It lifted its bird head to look at the Red-crowned Crane, using its wing to cover it even harder, saying in a muffled voice:

"Present."

Red-crowned Crane: Who are you guarding against?

However, it still informed them:

"247 needs to reach S-rank. So, you take it under your wing."

-

The matter was settled. Bai Linlin successfully carried out a new "manual," opened the door, and got into the car, all in one smooth motion.

Song Yu actually asked what it was, but the moment his hand was about to touch it, his little bird immediately snatched it away, scurried to the inner side of the seat back, and after some frantic maneuvering, stuffed it into its little satchel.

"Demon Manual!"

"I want to reach S-rank!"

Bai Linlin downplayed his upcoming plans.

It was still a bit dark outside, and the temperature had dropped. Song Yu was wearing a black sweater, looking gentle and refined, but he just kept one hand on the steering wheel and frowned, asking:

"Why the sudden need to upgrade?"

"Will you be tired?"

Bai Linlin actually felt a bit uncomfortable. He moved his claws and lowered his head, trying to organize his words. How was he supposed to explain?

But just then.

"Did other demons say something to you? Or is the Red-crowned Crane dissatisfied with you?"

The youth’s eyes turned cold.

Bai Linlin immediately climbed up the pole, flapping his wings to fly onto the person’s shoulder, and nodded his bird head:

"Chirp!"

In the end, to appease the bird, the man followed the bird's instructions and drove to a roasted snack shop ten kilometers away, buying almost every single new item they had.

-

The Red-crowned Crane had given him a dual cultivation manual, an abridged version, and had even mentioned some precautions before he left.

Bai Linlin actually felt very guilty. He hadn't wanted to take it, but since it insisted on giving it, he had no choice but to take it.

The bird later thought it through. The Red-crowned Crane was right; Song Yu was still very young, and he wasn't in a hurry...

It would be better to reach S-rank first and have the option available. If the time really came when he needed to extend his lifespan, Bai Linlin felt he could sacrifice a little—hugging and cuddling.

What was the big deal?

A bird has a broad mind.

Song Yu didn't have many classes in the morning, but he went to the company, likely because of some business, and Grandpa had gone out too. On the dining table on the first floor, there were hot meals, including the ever-present crab roe buns.

However, Bai Linlin was not at the dining table at this moment. Instead, he was carrying his satchel into the room next door—his room. It was filled with all sorts of things; Song Yu had someone build him a cabinet a few days ago, where he could store many accessories. It was practically a walk-in closet.

The bird carried the manual inside. He still needed his satchel, and it would be bad if this fell out while he was handing out snacks...

Bai Linlin pondered for a moment, transformed into his human form, took out the safe, and very seriously opened the combination lock to put the manual inside.

One second, two seconds.

The "youth" stood on the carpet, wearing brown striped long socks, his calves straight, with a brown sweater and a two-layered shirt collar on top.

The house had central heating, and the temperature was pleasant.

Bai Linlin pursed his lips and then secretly took the manual back out. He hadn't actually looked at it yet.

What was it like inside?

He couldn't help but flip it open. The first page was a diagram...

There was the sound of a doorknob turning.

"Linlin?"

Bai Linlin hurriedly shoved the thing back into the safe, pretending to be nonchalant at the very last second before the door opened.

When Song Yu entered the room, he saw the "youth" standing on the carpet with a flushed face. He paused and asked:

"Why is your face so red?"

"Grandpa said he won't be back for a few days; he's going to the fish pond at Lang Mountain to fish with Grandpa Chen, and asked me to tell you..."

He said this as he walked over.

Bai Linlin’s mind was in a mess. He looked up, frowned, and said:

"You could have told me by phone."

But the person opposite him just shifted his gaze slightly, reached out to hold his wrist, and said as naturally as ever:

"Yes."

"But I forgot."

Bai Linlin felt it was strange, but he was led out by the hand. Song Yu did ask:

"Didn't you say you were very sleepy? Why didn't you go to sleep?"

"And you didn't eat breakfast."

Bai Linlin was led all the way to the dining room, watched as he finished his breakfast, and was only then allowed to go upstairs.

"Bye-bye!"

The "youth" stood at the stairs and waved at the person not far away. Song Yu raised his eyes slightly, his expression soft, and also said:

"Bye-bye."

After he actually left, Song Yu felt a bit restless in the car. Although Hua Bing was showing signs of improvement, he was still too young... he couldn't be too flashy, and the school wouldn't do either... there were too many people.

When could he keep his little bird with him at all times?

Song Yu’s eyes turned cold.

He was just thinking about his plans for the next few years.

-

"Travel?"

"Really?"

It was now late September, and the National Day holiday was approaching. Song Zongguo was still at Lang Mountain, saying there were some minor details to handle, and it would be a hassle to go back and forth, so Song Yu agreed.

However, since the holiday was truly rare, Song Yu proposed a plan to go traveling.

The "youth" in the walk-in closet had bright eyes. He was wearing a pair of gold-rimmed glasses on his nose, a painter's hat, and a very retro little vest, which made his waist look very slender.

Bai Linlin was sightseeing in his new "walk-in closet." Song Yu had given him another room. The overall decor was basically consistent with the villa, but there were many designs inside. Even the full-length mirror had a solid wood frame with intricate carvings.

The "youth" was very happy, hugging the newly arrived clothes, and hurried to ask where they were going.

"How about a hot spring resort?"

Song Yu asked again, his eyes very gentle as he looked at the smiling "youth" before him.

"Okay!"

But the next second.

"I want to take 001 with me!"

-

Song Yu hadn't expected things to turn out this way, but they set off nonetheless. The two little birds in the back seat were squeezing and bumping into each other, and there was no telling what they were talking about.

[Did you bring the mission? After we finish it, we can go soak in the hot springs!]

001 pulled a plaque out of thin air—a gray mission, number 579, with a note in the top right corner:

——Joint Guidance Mission

——S-rank Guidance: Number 001

Bai Linlin felt very relieved. He squeezed his body and just said:

[Put it away, put it away.]

[Anyway, there's still time. Why don't we soak in the hot springs first and do the mission later?]

001: [...]

Finally, the car drove to a service area. Song Yu followed his little bird's instructions and went to buy all kinds of snacks, specifically including: passion fruit yogurt, walnut-flavored peanuts, peach-flavored sparkling water...

There were only two little birds left in the car.

001 narrowed its bird eyes, looked at the guardian who had walked away, and finally leaned in, asking very seriously:

[247.]

[You specifically asked me to choose the city for this trip for the mission—there's a deeper meaning, right?]

Bai Linlin: "..."

No, you're overthinking it.

The next second:

[When are you going to make a move on your guardian?]

Bai Linlin felt like life was meaningless.

-

This mission was actually considered medium-difficulty. The target was a university student who abused stray cats.

To reach S-rank, one must complete gray missions; otherwise, one cannot achieve complete proficiency in the use of demonic energy.

chunks.chineseText:
001最终还是没有同意先泡温泉后做任务的提议，坚决要带着247出来先出来完成任务，理由是要剩下宝贵的时间干其他的。

白粼粼想也知道是什么。

最后彻底没招了。

不管了。

“过来换衣服。”

酒店的玄关一角，宋郁面色其实有些复杂，看着他的小鸟挥翅膀招呼另外一只小雀，最终两只排排站在他的面前。

灰棕色小雀很是不解：

“为什么还要换衣服？”

蓝羽那只言之凿凿：

“我们不是在晚上行动吗？当然要换，要有仪式感懂吗？”

灰棕色小雀点了点鸟头，觉得也对。

最后两只齐齐仰头看了过来。

宋郁没办法，他只能把手里的东西拿了出来，这还是阿姨前几天赶制出来的……

两套黑色蒙面服。

“来，跟着我学，伸鸟腿。”
chunks.englishText:
001 ultimately did not agree to the proposal of soaking in the hot springs before doing the mission, insisting on taking 247 out to complete the mission first, the reason being to save precious time for other things.

Bai Linlin knew exactly what those "other things" were.

In the end, he had no choice.

Forget it.

"Come over and change your clothes."

In a corner of the hotel entryway, Song Yu’s expression was actually quite complex as he watched his little bird wave its wings to summon the other sparrow. Finally, the two stood side-by-side in front of him.

The gray-brown sparrow was very confused:

"Why do we have to change clothes?"

The blue-feathered one spoke with conviction:

"Aren't we acting at night? Of course we have to change; we need to have a sense of ritual, understand?"

The gray-brown sparrow nodded its bird head, feeling that made sense.

Finally, the two looked up in unison.

Song Yu had no choice. He could only take out the items he had. These were things the auntie had rushed to make a few days ago...

Two sets of black ninja-style outfits.

"Come on, follow me. Stretch your bird legs."

chunks.chineseText:
第44章

在酒店里大约是收拾了约半个钟头，宋郁在玄关处俯身半蹲着，原本偏冷的面庞里显露出些许无奈的神色，眉毛都微微拧了拧。

因为地板上有两只穿着黑色蒙面服的小鸟在照立身镜，挤来挤去的，本来这没什么。

但是……这个款，它是套头的，包住了鸟头，留下来两个孔，方便露出鸟眼。

……有点像劫匪。

“怎么样？我觉得还行吧？”

蓝羽小鸟爪子在地板上滑了下，伸了伸翅膀，觉得活动空间还是够的，阿姨的手工一向好。

灰棕色小雀只是一个劲地往上拱鸟头，因为它有时候对不太准那个窟窿，鸟眼前面就被黑色的布料挡住了，导致它来回原地转圈。

“还、还好。”

001调整了一下，最终是对齐了那个窟窿，然后回复道。

白粼粼觉得可以，啪嗒啪嗒地走到镜子那里又仔细看看，套头设计，然后还有个兜帽，外带一个小披风。

很不错了。

今天的OOTD也达标了。

“宋郁。”

人闻言回了回神，本来想问问怎么了，但是下一秒：

“我们要拍照。”

-

没办法，出门前还是进行了一波留影。

两个刺客小鸟排排站好。

宋郁按照要求拍摄了正面、侧面、背面……

蓝羽小鸟往前走了几步，仰头问：

“拍好了吗？”

灰棕色小雀其实不知道为什么要拍照，但是拍都拍了，它见247走过去了，也啪嗒啪嗒跟上了。

宋郁其实在看效果图，刚切回摄像头那里，下面就有两个圆滚滚的鸟头挤在一块，几乎看不见它们的爪子了。

“……”

人抬手拍摄了一张。

转而把手机翻转，给两只小鸟看，白粼粼当鸟当得相当熟练了，抬爪子就是查看相册，看到两个硕大的鸟头后——

低头蓄力。

001：“好酷啊。”

白粼粼闻言好奇，倒是也有些犹豫了起来，问：

“真的吗？”

“我觉得还可以。”

“那倒是也行，回头pp鸟头就行了，圆一点好看些。”

001：“什么是P？”

白粼粼最后直接敷衍过去了，抬翅膀就是一挥，对着旁边的人道：

“我们出发！”

-

大约十五分钟后，宋郁开着车，肩头一左一右是两只蒙面的小鸟，站得尤为端正。

任务的地点是大学附近的商业街，确切地说是在一家小旅馆中，那位男大学生会固定地在周五来这里登上VPN，去外网进入某些小组，上传这些虐猫的视频，会有同样猎奇的人给他打赏。

宋郁把车子停到了不远处，拿着车钥匙就下来了，他眉毛微微蹙了下，觉得还是有些危险。

虽然已经提前调查过了，周五这个人是不会再去找流浪猫下手的，雷打不动地在这个旅馆，但是对方毕竟是个“人”。

“这样，我先去把他引出来……”

宋郁刚说完这句话，肩头上的这两只就在叽叽喳喳别的：

“带上兜帽好像就看不到路了。”

“怎么会，不是有窟窿吗？”

一只小雀提出疑问，一只小鸟开始实践。

最终发现：鸟眼是长在两侧的，确实是比较阻碍视线。

“那还是先不戴了。”

“反正我们拍完照了。”

宋郁肩头的这两只终于安静了下来，昂首挺胸的，他这会才问了问它们接下来的安排。

001从他的肩头扑棱翅膀下来了，化形成了一个身姿优雅的黑色猫咪，尾巴高高的，只是很专业地道：

“247，这个是S级的一个技能，你好好看。”

“黑色小猫”三两下从地面上跳跃到二楼的空调外机上，然后回了回头，继续看了眼人类肩头的伙伴，确保247在很认真地看着，然后才又灵巧地跳跃到了目标的窗台。

里面很是昏暗，有窗帘拉着，但是通过缝隙还是能看到里面忽明忽暗的光，那个满脸青春痘的男生正在看电脑里没有马赛克的血腥视频。

001的金瞳闪了下，在窄窄的窗沿上踱步，发出了猫叫声。

那里面果然有了动静。

“我去，送上门来了？”

那男生似乎在直播，摘了耳机就要往窗户这边来，001很灵巧地又跳下了窗台，二楼的空调外机算是一个缓冲，最后稳稳地落地，对着楼上又学了一声猫叫。

暗处的一人一鸟在看着，宋郁侧眸看了下自己的小鸟，本意是想要看看它害怕不害怕，但是一侧头：

黑色套头蒙面服。

“……”

001很快就回来了，不过这次是直接化形了，黑衣少年对着宋郁肩头的那只蓝羽小鸟道：

“入室实际上比较难的，风险也很大，不太适合你，所以要学会把人引出来。”

“你看会了吗？”

白粼粼身躯圆滚滚的，完全就是懵懵的，心想这是在问谁？

就是突然从鸟变成猫，然后跳到二楼再折返……

这就教学完成了？

过程呢？

鸟拘谨，爪子都并了并。

不过001倒是没有着急，因为那个目标出来了，那个男生手里还拿着几个劣质的猫罐头，在四处张望着。

现在都午夜了。

真是一次机会也不放过。

“247，跟我来。”

黑衣少年往前一走，身影散掉，重新变成灵动的黑猫。

宋郁肩头一轻，他的小鸟扑棱翅膀飞了过去，还抽空扭了个头。

眨了下鸟眼。

他们说好了。

这次任务优先让鸟自己完成。

不行了，再找人。

宋郁手指微微勾了下，最终还是在暗处看着它们。

“喵——”

黑色小猫拉长了声音，尾巴竖得高高的，街道两侧的灌丛里站着一只圆滚滚的小鸟，因为穿了黑色蒙面服，蓝羽倒是被挡得严严实实的。

那男大学生一听到声音就过来了，立马就把手里的罐头打开了，一股劣质油脂的味道散发开来。

001绕着罐头走了两圈，最后只是迈步朝着一个巷子的死角那里走了，时不时还回头看一下那个男大学生。

“咪咪要带我去哪里呀？”

那人似乎还有些兴奋，甚至拿出来手机开始录制视频了，边拍边说：

“兄弟们，遇见一只黑猫，别说，还真是油光水滑的。”

001金色的瞳孔眯了眯，成了竖瞳，不过它还是回了一次头，这次是看灌木丛，仰了仰头。

示意跟过来。

它毕竟是指导，真正动手还是得247来。

灌木丛里小鸟谨慎地伸出来了鸟腿，白粼粼甚至不敢扑棱翅膀飞，他怕打草惊蛇，最后选择贴着灌木丛的阴影处，一路竞走过去。

这次没有啪嗒啪嗒的动静了，鸟特地垫着鸟爪走的。

001最后抵达了目的地，这里堆着些垃圾桶，是个死角，监控也没有。

根据任务显示，这个人类经常在这里动手弄晕流浪猫，然后带回去……

“小猫咪，来吃罐头吗？”

“你带我过来干什么呀？”

那个男大学生放下了手机，抬手又弄开了他带的罐头，抬手想要去摸小黑猫。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 44

After spending about half an hour tidying up the hotel room, Song Yu crouched at the entryway. His usually cold expression revealed a hint of helplessness, and his brows were slightly furrowed.

On the floor, two little birds dressed in black, mask-like outfits were busy checking themselves out in a full-length mirror, jostling and bumping into each other. That in itself wasn't the problem.

The problem was… the design. It was a pullover style that covered the birds' heads, leaving only two holes for their eyes.

…They looked a bit like bandits.

"How is it? I think it’s not bad, right?"

The blue-feathered bird slid its claws across the floor and stretched its wings, feeling that there was still enough room to move. Auntie’s handiwork had always been top-tier.

The gray-brown sparrow was just frantically pushing its head upward. Because it couldn't quite align its eyes with the holes, the black fabric kept blocking its vision, causing it to spin in circles on the spot.

"It’s… it’s alright."

001 adjusted its outfit, finally aligning the holes, and replied.

Bai Linlin felt it was acceptable. He waddled over to the mirror to take a closer look—the pullover design, complete with a hood and a little cape.

Not bad at all.

Today’s OOTD (Outfit of the Day) was up to standard.

"Song Yu."

Song Yu snapped out of his thoughts. He was about to ask what was wrong, but in the next second:

"We need to take photos."

-

There was no helping it; they had to have a photoshoot before heading out.

The two assassin birds stood in a neat row.

Song Yu followed their instructions, taking photos from the front, the side, and the back…

The blue-feathered bird took a few steps forward and tilted its head to ask:

"Are they done?"

The gray-brown sparrow didn't actually know why they were taking photos, but since they were already doing it and saw 247 walk over, it waddled along behind.

Song Yu was actually checking the preview. Just as he switched back to the camera interface, two round, fluffy bird heads squeezed together at the bottom of the frame, their claws almost completely hidden.

"..."

He raised his hand and snapped a photo.

He then turned the phone around to show the two birds. Bai Linlin had become quite proficient at being a bird; he raised a claw to browse the photo album. After seeing two massive bird heads—

He lowered his head, gathering his strength.

001: "So cool."

Hearing this, Bai Linlin felt curious and hesitated for a moment, asking:

"Really?"

"I think it’s pretty good."

"That works too. We can just Photoshop the bird heads later; rounder looks better."

001: "What is 'Photoshop'?"

Bai Linlin brushed it off with a wave of his wing and said to the person beside him:

"Let’s go!"

-

About fifteen minutes later, Song Yu was driving. On his shoulders, one on the left and one on the right, sat the two masked birds, standing with exceptional posture.

The target location was a commercial street near the university, specifically a small motel. The male college student would come here every Friday to log into a VPN, access overseas websites, enter certain groups, and upload videos of animal abuse, for which he would receive tips from other twisted individuals.

Song Yu parked the car a short distance away and got out with the keys in his hand. He frowned slightly, feeling that this was still somewhat dangerous.

Although they had investigated in advance and knew the man wouldn't go after stray cats on Fridays—staying put in this motel like clockwork—the opponent was, after all, a "human."

"How about this, I’ll go and lure him out first…"

Song Yu had barely finished his sentence when the two on his shoulders started chirping about something else:

"I feel like I can't see the road with the hood on."

"How could that be? Aren't there holes?"

One sparrow raised a question, and the other bird began to experiment.

They eventually realized that since bird eyes are located on the sides of their heads, the hood did indeed obstruct their vision.

"Let's not wear them for now, then."

"Anyway, we already took the photos."

The two on Song Yu’s shoulders finally quieted down, puffing out their chests. Only then did he ask about their plan.

001 fluttered down from his shoulder, transforming into an elegant black cat with its tail held high. It said professionally:

"247, this is an S-rank skill. Watch closely."

The "little black cat" leaped from the ground onto the second-floor air conditioning unit in a few swift motions. It looked back to ensure its partner on the human's shoulder was watching intently, then nimbly jumped onto the target's windowsill.

The room was dim, with the curtains drawn, but through the gap, one could see flickering light. The acne-ridden young man was watching a graphic, unblurred video of gore on his computer.

001’s golden pupils flashed as it paced on the narrow windowsill, letting out a meow.

There was movement inside.

"What the hell? It delivered itself to me?"

The boy seemed to be livestreaming. He took off his headset and headed toward the window. 001 nimbly jumped off the sill, using the air conditioning unit as a buffer before landing steadily on the ground, where it meowed at the window again.

In the shadows, the human and the bird were watching. Song Yu glanced at his little bird, intending to see if it was scared, but when he turned his head:

Black pullover mask.

"..."

001 returned quickly, but this time it transformed back into human form. The black-clad youth said to the blue-feathered bird on Song Yu’s shoulder:

"Breaking and entering is actually quite difficult and carries high risks. It’s not suitable for you, so you must learn to lure people out."

"Did you see how it’s done?"

Bai Linlin’s body was round and fluffy, looking completely bewildered. He wondered who the youth was talking to.

Just suddenly turning from a bird to a cat, then jumping to the second floor and back…

That was the lesson?

What about the process?

The bird felt awkward, pulling its claws together.

However, 001 wasn't in a hurry, because the target had emerged. The boy was holding several cans of cheap cat food, looking around.

It was already midnight.

He really didn't miss a single opportunity.

"247, follow me."

The black-clad youth walked forward, his figure dissipating as he transformed back into the agile black cat.

Song Yu’s shoulder lightened as his little bird fluttered its wings and flew over, taking a moment to turn its head.

It blinked its bird eyes.

They had agreed.

This mission was to be completed by the bird itself.

If it failed, they would find someone else.

Song Yu curled his fingers slightly, ultimately choosing to watch them from the shadows.

"Meow—"

The black cat let out a long, drawn-out cry, its tail held high. In the bushes on the side of the street stood a round little bird, its blue feathers completely hidden by the black mask.

As soon as the college student heard the sound, he approached and immediately opened the cans in his hand. A scent of low-quality grease wafted out.

001 circled the cans twice before walking toward a dead end in an alley, occasionally looking back at the student.

"Where are you taking me, kitty?"

The man seemed excited, even taking out his phone to start recording. As he filmed, he said:

"Brothers, I found a black cat. I’m not kidding, it’s really sleek and shiny."

001’s golden pupils narrowed into slits, though it looked back once more—this time at the bushes, tilting its head.

It was signaling for the bird to follow.

After all, it was the instructor; the actual execution had to be done by 247.

The bird in the bushes cautiously extended a leg. Bai Linlin didn't even dare to flutter his wings for fear of alerting the enemy, so he chose to stick to the shadows of the bushes, race-walking the whole way.

This time, there was no pattering sound; the bird specifically walked on its tiptoes.

001 finally arrived at the destination. It was a dead end piled with trash cans, with no surveillance cameras.

According to the mission data, this human often used this spot to knock out stray cats before taking them back…

"Little kitty, are you here to eat the canned food?"

"What are you bringing me here for?"

The college student put down his phone, reached out to open more of the cans he had brought, and tried to reach out to pet the little black cat.

chunks.chineseText:
但001灵巧地躲开了，它在等247过来，247现在只是个幼鸟，面对的都是好的人类，它必须要获得成长。

白粼粼此刻已经抵达。

宋郁其实压根不放心，在很隐蔽的地方看着，视线根本就不在那个人渣身上，全是在那个穿着黑色蒙面服的小鸟上，其实很隐蔽，还不好看位置。

直到他的小鸟开始扑棱翅膀飞到那个人渣那里。

001甚至让开了一点位置，它在阴影处砰的一下化成了本体，变成了一只套着黑色蒙面服的小雀模样。

白粼粼往前走了走，站在那个男大学生的面前，仰头看了过去，鸟眼坚定。

男大学生懵逼，他甚至直接站了起来，“卧槽！”

现下夜黑风高的，月亮悬挂在墙边，还起了小风。

“什么东西？还套着衣服？”

男大学生从前只是搞猫，因为猫的反应比较好听，但现在……这两只鸟……不是，刚才那只猫呢？

他还是拿过来了手机，打算录一下，这下连房间都不用回了，搞完直接扔垃圾桶里就行了。

不过就在他拿出来小刀的时候——

一道阴影逐步地覆盖了过来。

有布料崩开的动静。

男大学生愣了下，他觉得周遭的空气都停了，直到他一抬头，看到了一只无比巨大的鸟，在伸着翅膀，长长的喙张开着，一爪子一爪子地往这边走，地面都发出震颤来。

他吓得立马就叫了起来。

“啊啊！”

那男大学生觉得见鬼了，屁滚尿流地就要跑，但是晚了，一阵劲风袭来，他身子都腾空了，狠狠地撞在了墙面上。

骨头都要碎了。

直接晕了过去。

白粼粼挺胸抬头的，觉得他这一记平A实在是很强大，区区一招而已。

旁边的小雀化形成黑衣少年，只是在旁边肯定道：

“247，你做得很好。”

白粼粼很高兴，刚想化形成本体，但就在这时——

“但还不够。”

-

宋郁在巷子口那里等着，确定他的小鸟不会受到伤害后松了口气，不过就在这时他的手机嗡嗡震动了几下。

少年低头看了下信息。

怔了下。

[宋郁什么意思？把自己妈妈拉黑很好玩么？我已经到了国外了，我告诉你，你再不给我回电话……]

宋郁其实从来没有经历过江芮连续两次主动找他的经历，如果以前……他可能的确会情绪剧烈地波动。

但是现在。

宋郁只是抬头看了下巷子角，他的小鸟很伟岸地站在里侧，似乎在听从什么指示，用爪子从墙壁上把那个人渣勾衣服勾下来了。

很忙。

他倚靠着路灯，觉得确实没必要逃避，很熟练地打了那个电话：

很快就通了。

简直是前所未有。

宋郁扯唇笑了下，没想到幼年祈求的事这么轻而易举地发生了。

江芮的声音仍然和数年前没有变化，她保养得很好，甚至语调还很轻快了些，上来一句就是：

“小郁，妈妈离婚了。”

宋郁其实是知道这件事的，但是他听到这话后还是微微愣了下，随后就是费解，说这个做什么？

不应该是指责他么？

不懂事，不体谅她。

“妈妈来了欧洲这里，我想好了，正好你也长大了，也不用跟着那宋启明了。这边的大学不错，你收拾收拾申请一下，来剑桥牛津都是可以的……妈妈以后可以照顾你和弟弟……”

宋郁觉得荒谬，最后只是道：

“江芮。”

那边的女人一开始就是蹙眉，先是说了句“怎么说话的”，后面就是诉说自己的不容易，总之是没有停过。

“我长大了。”

电话那头才安静了。

宋郁只是道：“我已经过了需要你的时候了。”

电话那头似乎是深吸一口气，仿佛是彻底装不下去了，最后只能直面他们母子最大的隔阂：

“那我是故意不要你的吗？我这么些年事业一直很忙，后面你弟弟出生我焦头烂额的，宋家虽说不怎么样吧，但是你爷爷不是照顾你了吗？现在好不容易我脱身了，是，我是有错，但妈妈不是——总之，你要不要来欧洲？”

宋郁轻声道：

“不要。”

电话那头一阵死寂。

夜里很凉，地面上有刮起来的落叶，显得萧瑟。

“就这样吧。”

“不必联系。”

电话挂断了。

宋郁删除了这个新的陌生号码，心想这样也好，他的原生父母，一个在欧洲，一个在美洲。

倒也对称。

-

此刻巷子尽头那里。

白粼粼很矜持地用爪子踩断了这个人渣的腿骨和脚踝，时不时地看一下旁边蹲着的黑衣少年。

001面无表情地看着地上的人类，确切地说是看人类的关节处，因为上方悬着一只巨大鸟爪。

在很谨慎地往下压，听到嘎嘣脆的动静就自动停了。

力道轻飘飘的。

001托着下巴看了一会，得出一个结论：

它还小。

很正常。

“骨折了它是不是就不能造孽了？”

“我踩得很用力了。”

001最终站起身来，闻言点了点头：

“可以了。”

“放心，我给你打一百分。”

面前的巨鸟立马砰得一下变成小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒地走过来，仰头道：

“真的！”

“那我们把他放在这里就可以了？”

黑衣少年想了想：“是的。”

蓝羽小鸟很是高兴，当即就要朝着巷子口走，不过注意到身后的“人”没有跟过来，立马就挥翅膀招了招。

001只是歪了歪头：

“我还要和丹顶鹤发一下任务纪要，你能先去帮我买个烤肠吗？”

蓝羽小鸟用翅膀拍了拍自己胸脯，很信誓旦旦地道，“没问题，什么味道的？”

“麻辣的。”

“收到收到。”

蓝羽小鸟蹦蹦跳跳去巷子口了，那里的尽头是它的监护人，一直在守着。

001确定他们离开了之后，才俯身蹲下，看着地面上的这个人类，歪了歪头，瞳孔泛出金色的光泽来。

-

二十四小时便利店。

宋郁一路扫荡，袋子里的东西越来越沉，最后甚至还包圆了关东煮，以及几根五颜六色的水果玉米，噢，还有先前要的各种烤肠。

花了五百多。

营业员很是震惊，甚至是目送这一人一鸟离开的，他其实也想不明白，这大半夜能吃这么多？

这人看起来身材挺不错的……

也就那只鸟圆一点。

奇怪。

白粼粼是在公共长椅上看见001的，对方此刻已经恢复成了灰棕色小雀的模样，还穿着黑色蒙面服，只不过爪子一直压着一件裂开的衣服，它有些懊恼，试图修补。

“247？你的坏了。”

鸟扑棱翅膀飞过去，一看，果然崩了，他一下子觉得有些羞耻，用爪子一勾就扔到了后面，宋郁稳稳地接着了。

“不管这个不管这个。”

“走走走。”
chunks.englishText:
But 001 nimbly dodged him. It was waiting for 247 to arrive. 247 was still a fledgling and had only ever encountered good humans; it had to learn to grow.

Bai Linlin had arrived.

Song Yu was actually not at all at ease. He watched from a very concealed spot, his gaze not on the scum of a human, but entirely on the little bird in the black mask. It was so well-hidden that it was hard to keep track of it.

That was until his bird began to flutter its wings and fly toward the scum.

001 even made some space, transforming into its original form in the shadows—a small sparrow wearing a black mask.

Bai Linlin walked forward and stood in front of the college student, looking up with determined bird eyes.

The student was stunned; he even stood up straight. "What the hell!"

It was dark and windy, with the moon hanging by the wall.

"What is this? It’s wearing clothes?"

The student used to only mess with cats because their reactions sounded better, but now… these two birds… wait, what about that cat from before?

He reached for his phone, intending to record this. He didn't even need to go back to his room; he could just toss them in the trash can when he was done.

But just as he pulled out a small knife—

A shadow gradually loomed over him.

There was the sound of fabric tearing.

The student froze. He felt as if the air around him had stopped. When he looked up, he saw an incredibly massive bird stretching its wings, its long beak agape, walking toward him step by step, causing the ground to tremble.

He screamed in terror.

"Ahhh!"

The student felt like he had seen a ghost and scrambled to run, but it was too late. A gust of wind struck him, and he was lifted off his feet, slamming hard against the wall.

His bones felt like they were shattering.

He passed out instantly.

Bai Linlin puffed out his chest, feeling that his basic attack was truly powerful. A single strike was all it took.

The sparrow beside him transformed into the black-clad youth and affirmed:

"247, you did very well."

Bai Linlin was overjoyed and was just about to transform back into his original form, but just then—

"But it’s not enough."

-

Song Yu was waiting at the mouth of the alley. He breathed a sigh of relief, certain that his little bird wouldn't be harmed. However, his phone buzzed a few times.

The youth looked down at the message.

He froze.

[Song Yu, what is the meaning of this? Is blocking your mother fun? I’ve already arrived abroad. Let me tell you, if you don't call me back…]

Song Yu had never experienced Jiang Rui taking the initiative to reach out to him twice in a row. If it were in the past… he might have had a violent emotional reaction.

But now.

Song Yu just looked up at the corner of the alley. His little bird was standing majestically on the inside, seemingly listening to instructions, using its claws to hook the scum’s clothes down from the wall.

It was very busy.

He leaned against a streetlamp, feeling that there was really no need to avoid this. He dialed the number with practiced ease.

It connected almost immediately.

It was unprecedented.

Song Yu curled his lips in a smile. He hadn't expected that something he had begged for as a child would happen so easily.

Jiang Rui’s voice hadn't changed from years ago. She was well-maintained, and her tone was even a bit lighter. The first thing she said was:

"Xiao Yu, Mom is divorced."

Song Yu actually already knew about this, but after hearing her say it, he was still slightly stunned. Then, he felt puzzled—why was she telling him this?

Shouldn't she be blaming him?

For being unfilial, for not being considerate of her.

"Mom has come to Europe. I’ve thought it over; you’re grown up now, and you don't need to stay with Song Qiming anymore. The universities here are quite good. You should pack up and apply; Cambridge or Oxford would both be fine… Mom can take care of you and your brother in the future…"

Song Yu found it absurd. In the end, he only said:

"Jiang Rui."

The woman on the other end frowned, first saying "Is that any way to talk?", then proceeding to recount her hardships. In short, she didn't stop.

"I’ve grown up."

The other end of the line finally went quiet.

Song Yu simply said: "I’ve already passed the time when I needed you."

The person on the other end seemed to take a deep breath, as if she could no longer keep up the facade, and finally had to face the biggest rift between mother and son:

"Was it intentional that I didn't want you? I’ve been busy with my career all these years, and after your brother was born, I was overwhelmed. Even though the Song family isn't much, didn't your grandfather take care of you? Now that I’ve finally managed to get away—yes, I was wrong, but Mom isn't—anyway, do you want to come to Europe?"

Song Yu said softly:

"No."

There was a deathly silence on the other end.

The night was cold, and fallen leaves were being swept across the ground, looking desolate.

"That’s it then."

"No need to contact me again."

The call ended.

Song Yu deleted the new, unfamiliar number, thinking that this was fine. His biological parents—one in Europe, one in America.

It was quite symmetrical.

-

At the end of the alley.

Bai Linlin was very reserved as he used his claws to snap the scum’s leg bones and ankles, occasionally looking at the black-clad youth crouching nearby.

001 stared expressionlessly at the human on the ground—specifically at the human's joints—because a giant bird claw was hovering above.

It was pressing down very cautiously, stopping automatically whenever it heard a satisfying crunch.

The force was light.

001 rested its chin on its hand and watched for a while, reaching a conclusion:

It was still young.

That was normal.

"If his bones are broken, he won't be able to do evil anymore, right?"

"I stepped on him really hard."

001 finally stood up and nodded at the question:

"That’s enough."

"Don't worry, I’ll give you a hundred points."

The giant bird in front of it immediately transformed into a little bird with a *poof*, waddled over, and looked up:

"Really!"

"Then we can just leave him here?"

The black-clad youth thought for a moment: "Yes."

The blue-feathered bird was very happy and immediately started walking toward the alley entrance, but noticing that the "person" behind him hadn't followed, he immediately waved his wings to beckon him.

001 just tilted its head:

"I still need to send the mission report to the Red-crowned Crane. Can you go buy me a grilled sausage first?"

The blue-feathered bird patted his chest with his wing and said very confidently, "No problem, what flavor?"

"Spicy."

"Copy that, copy that."

The blue-feathered bird hopped and skipped toward the alley entrance, where his guardian was waiting.

Only after 001 was certain they had left did it crouch down, looking at the human on the ground, tilting its head as its pupils glowed with a golden luster.

-

At the 24-hour convenience store.

Song Yu swept through the aisles. The bag grew heavier and heavier, and he eventually bought out all the oden, several colorful fruit-flavored corn cobs, and, oh, the various grilled sausages they had asked for.

It cost over five hundred.

The clerk was shocked, even watching the man and the bird leave. He couldn't figure it out—how could they eat so much in the middle of the night?

The man looked like he was in pretty good shape…

Only that bird was a bit round.

Strange.

Bai Linlin saw 001 on a public bench. The other had already recovered into the form of a gray-brown sparrow, still wearing the black mask, but its claws were constantly pressing down on a piece of torn clothing. It looked annoyed, trying to patch it up.

"247? Yours is broken."

The bird fluttered over and took a look. Sure enough, it had ripped. He suddenly felt a bit ashamed, hooked it with his claw, and tossed it behind him, where Song Yu caught it steadily.

"Forget about it, forget about it."

"Let’s go, let’s go."

chunks.chineseText:
灰棕色小雀想了想，也把自己的脱掉了，现在不一样了，它把衣服用妖力收起来了，啪嗒啪嗒地跟上了前面蓝羽小鸟的步伐。

而在那个逼仄的小巷里，那个生剖了数十只流浪猫的男大学生，双眼是空的，连带着几根手指也是不见了的……

凉风习习，月光皎洁，不远处的树杈子上有一串串的东西。

有蚂蚁顺着树干爬了过去。

-

温泉之旅。

白粼粼非常高兴地开始转移阵地，他们在酒店就休息了半夜，然后就开车来到了温泉度假山庄，这里装潢非常豪华，而且还有主题温泉！

鸟满意极了。

001像个跟班一样挤在蓝羽小鸟的身边，鸟头转来转去的，见见世面。

宋郁在前台登记，旁边的工作人员看到后很是惊叹，提出想要拍照的诉求，宋郁本来是想要征求一下它们两个的意愿，但是一转头。

那只灰棕色的小雀已经把翅膀搭在他的小鸟身上了，两只都很认真地在看镜头。

“……”

最后终于抵达了房间。

白粼粼一开始还以为他们都是在一个房间里，毕竟他和001是小鸟，睡在纸巾盒里就可以了，但没想到是两个。

001独享一个豪华套间，还有落地窗！

鸟也要。

不患寡而患不均。

更何况他是亲小鸟。

白粼粼跟着人来了房间就控诉这个问题，甚至化形了，抬手拉住对方的手臂，还在说：

“我也要大房间。”

“宋郁，宋郁。”

但是人非但不听，还直接握着他的手臂往前一带，“少年”重心不稳，直直地歪了下，但被人托了下腰，站好了。

“你不和我睡？”

宋郁低头看着他的小鸟，蹙眉问。

白粼粼愣住了。

啊？

他以前是……啊，好像确实是。

白粼粼张了张口，一下子有些无措，连带着脸都红了。

话虽是这么说的，但是怎么听起来怪怪的。

白粼粼想要抽出来自己的手臂，但是没成功，试图走掉，但还是没成功。

最后生气了。

仰头看着宋郁。

放肆！

但就在这时，对方笑了下，只是温声道：

“粼粼是小鸟的时候很像人，化形了，又很像小鸟。”

白粼粼顿时心里七上八下的，他确实当鸟当习惯了，毕竟真的很爽，又能飞又能说人话的，还有个二十四小时待命的……男高。

不是不是，宋郁已经上大学了。

男大。

白粼粼目移，他实在是有点心虚，身子还是往后撤，但腕骨的力道越来越紧，他最后放弃了，站定问：

“所以呢？”

“会、会不养我吗？”

宋郁皱眉：“怎么会？”

“那就不要挑三拣四了，你的小鸟就是这样子的，改不了了。”

白粼粼发表重要讲话。

宋郁目光微微动了下，漫不经心的，最后道：

“好。”

-

翌日，正式泡温泉。

鸟美哒哒地趴在边沿处，鸟头上顶着一个小号的毛巾，爪子在里面飘着。

001其实有点不太敢下去，灰棕色的小雀在旁边，只是问了问：

“你的监护人呢？”

白粼粼优雅眯了眯鸟眼，道：

“他有事，公司那边有电话。”

灰棕色小雀心思一动，把自己蓬成毛球，问：

“你昨晚……”

白粼粼一下子睁开鸟眼，神色严肃，翅膀悄悄地放在了池子下面，已经开始蓄力，待会他就——

“噢，我忘了你还没成年。”

“不过丹顶鹤的事我和你说了没？”

灰棕色小雀歪头道。

白粼粼立马精神了，也不准备泼水了，只是拍拍旁边的水，很认真地道：

“快和我讲！”

“它和它的饲养员！”

灰棕色小雀伸了伸鸟爪，觉得温度适宜，也学着247下去了，爪子飘着，用翅膀固定住自己。

在池子边开始说小话：

“它的饲养员一开始是不同意的。”

“啊？”

“双修这个，在我们妖界是这么叫的，但其实……就没有人类主动同意过，所以一般要提前控制住他们。”

“……”

蓝羽小鸟叼起来个压缩毛巾，示意旁边的灰棕色小雀低低头，对方照做了，然后鸟就把这个小方块放上去了。

一起顶着。

优雅。

“我听说了具体的情况，就是得直接上，把人类给****”

“然后强制交配”

白粼粼瞠目结舌。

“这样妖力就可以过渡了。”

001非常有经验地道，尽管它从来没有过对象。

白粼粼斟酌地道：

“那饲养员事后……”

001挥了挥翅膀：

“当然是妥协了，毕竟还有好几百年日子要过呢。”

白粼粼：“……”

鸟有些良心难安。

001只是道：

“不过丹顶鹤的饲养员对它很好，见过它的丝带吗？听说是个什么牌子的，人类社会很贵的，叫香什么……”

白粼粼：“香奈儿？”

001：“对！”

“它的饲养员买的，每周换一个，不重样的。”

001沉思：

“所以人类很好拿捏的，就先交配了再说，感情可以后续培养。”

白粼粼：“……”

不过他还是想起来别的什么，往旁边挤了挤这只小雀，眯了眯鸟眼，问：

“你怎么不找对象？”

-

宋郁在外面其实接了个电话，是他爷爷的，主要说了两件事，一是告知他老人家已经回家，二是问鸟儿什么时候回来。

“……”

“当然，你们在外面多休息一下也是好，但鸟儿毕竟还很小，那鹤上次不是来家里了吗？”

“你、你要看护好它。”

宋郁后来确实同自己爷爷坦白了管理局的一些事，再加上他老人家和那个749局的好友又聊了很久，大体应该是全知道了。

但是他不明白为什么他爷爷总是提丹顶鹤……

这怎么了？

“我会的。”

宋峥国后面才提及了正事，主要是关于他的那个道士朋友：

“平云，爷爷那个朋友叫李平云，他这个人性格古怪，不知道同你和鸟儿说了什么。”

“但他心是不坏的，大体是有些误会，他让我代他道个歉。”

宋郁愣住了，而后就是觉得不该，毕竟那只是一场误会。

“我本来是想着让你们吃一顿饭的，但他离开南市实在是太快，也没来得及问问去哪里，以后也是有缘再见吧。”

后面就没有说什么了，电话也就先挂了。

-

白粼粼这才把001给挖了个底朝天，爪子在水里飘着，悠哉游哉地刨了两下。

001是初始编号，它没有监护人，一开始就在基地，但年龄不是很大，也就两岁，认真做任务是为了换取人类货币，购买各色各样的烧烤。

但由于吃得太勤快，总是会在月底花光。

“我钱不是很多，为什么要找对象？”

001很认真地道。

“我不是包了你的烧烤了吗？”

白粼粼很认真地探头问。

但下一秒。

“那对象不会分走我的烧烤吗？”

“……”
chunks.englishText:
The grey-brown sparrow thought for a moment, then took off its own clothes as well. Things were different now; it used its demonic power to tuck the clothes away, then followed the blue-feathered bird’s footsteps with a rhythmic *patter-patter*.

Back in that cramped, narrow alleyway, the male college student who had vivisected dozens of stray cats now had vacant, empty eyes, and several of his fingers were missing...

A cool breeze rustled, the moonlight was bright and clear, and on a tree branch not far away, there hung a series of things.

Ants crawled along the tree trunk, passing by.

-

The hot spring trip.

Bai Linlin began to relocate with great excitement. They had only rested for half the night at the hotel before driving to the hot spring resort. The decor here was incredibly luxurious, and they even had themed hot springs!

The bird was extremely satisfied.

001 squeezed in beside the blue-feathered bird like a little follower, its bird head swiveling left and right, taking in the sights.

Song Yu was registering at the front desk. The staff member nearby was amazed when they saw them and asked if they could take a photo. Song Yu had intended to ask for the two birds' consent, but when he turned his head—

The grey-brown sparrow had already draped its wing over his little bird, and both were looking at the lens with great seriousness.

“……”

Finally, they arrived at their room.

Bai Linlin had initially assumed they would all be in one room—after all, he and 001 were small birds and could just sleep in a tissue box—but he hadn't expected there to be two rooms.

001 had a luxury suite all to itself, complete with floor-to-ceiling windows!

The bird wanted one too.

*One should not worry about scarcity, but about inequality.*

Besides, he was the "favorite" bird.

Bai Linlin followed the human into the room and voiced his complaint, even shifting into his human form. He reached out to grab the man’s arm, still saying:

“I want a big room too.”

“Song Yu, Song Yu.”

But the human didn't listen; instead, he gripped his arm and pulled him forward. The "youth" lost his balance and tilted straight toward him, but was steadied by a hand supporting his waist.

“You aren't sleeping with me?”

Song Yu looked down at his little bird, frowning as he asked.

Bai Linlin froze.

Ah?

He used to... ah, it seemed that was indeed the case.

Bai Linlin opened his mouth, suddenly feeling at a loss, his face turning red.

Although that was how it was, it sounded a bit strange.

Bai Linlin tried to pull his arm away but failed. He tried to walk away, but failed again.

Finally, he got angry.

He looked up at Song Yu.

How audacious!

But just then, the man smiled, his voice gentle:

“When Linlin is a bird, he looks very much like a person; when he shifts into human form, he looks very much like a bird.”

Bai Linlin’s heart skipped a beat. He was indeed used to being a bird; after all, it was truly wonderful—he could fly, speak human language, and had a twenty-four-hour on-call... high schooler.

No, no, Song Yu was already in college.

A college student.

Bai Linlin looked away, feeling quite guilty. His body still leaned back, but the grip on his wrist grew tighter. Finally, he gave up, stood still, and asked:

“So?”

“Will, will you not raise me anymore?”

Song Yu frowned: “How could that be?”

“Then don't be so picky. Your little bird is just like this; it can't be changed.”

Bai Linlin delivered his important declaration.

Song Yu’s gaze flickered slightly, looking nonchalant, before he finally said:

“Alright.”

-

The next day, they officially soaked in the hot spring.

The bird lay gracefully on the edge of the pool, a small towel perched on its head, its claws floating in the water.

001 was actually a bit afraid to go in. The grey-brown sparrow stayed to the side, simply asking:

“Where is your guardian?”

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes elegantly and said:

“He’s busy. There’s a call from the company.”

The grey-brown sparrow’s mind stirred. It puffed itself up into a fur ball and asked:

“Last night, you...”

Bai Linlin immediately opened his bird eyes, his expression serious. He quietly placed his wings under the water, already beginning to build up power, and in a moment he would—

“Oh, I forgot you haven't reached adulthood yet.”

“But have I told you about the Red-crowned Crane?”

The grey-brown sparrow tilted its head and said.

Bai Linlin immediately perked up. He stopped preparing to splash water and instead patted the water beside him, saying very seriously:

“Tell me quickly!”

“It and its zookeeper!”

The grey-brown sparrow stretched out a bird claw, felt the temperature was just right, and followed 247 into the water. Its claws floated, and it used its wings to anchor itself.

It began to whisper at the edge of the pool:

“Its zookeeper didn't agree at first.”

“Ah?”

“‘Dual cultivation’—that’s what we call it in the demon realm—but in truth... no human has ever actively agreed to it, so usually, you have to control them in advance.”

“……”

The blue-feathered bird picked up a compressed towel and signaled for the grey-brown sparrow to lower its head. The other complied, and the bird placed the little square on top.

They wore it together.

Elegant.

“I heard the specific situation; you have to just go for it and [redacted] the human.”

“And then force a mating.”

Bai Linlin was dumbfounded.

“That way, the demonic power can be transferred.”

001 said with great experience, even though it had never had a partner.

Bai Linlin deliberated and asked:

“Then, after the fact, the zookeeper...”

001 waved its wing:

“Of course they compromised. After all, there are still several hundred years of life to live.”

Bai Linlin: “……”

The bird felt a bit of a guilty conscience.

001 simply added:

“But the Red-crowned Crane’s zookeeper is very good to it. Have you seen its ribbon? I heard it’s some brand or other, very expensive in human society, called... Chanel?”

Bai Linlin: “Chanel?”

001: “Yes!”

“Its zookeeper bought it, changing it every week, never repeating.”

001 pondered:

“So, humans are very easy to manipulate. Just mate first and talk later; feelings can be cultivated afterward.”

Bai Linlin: “……”

However, he still remembered something else. He nudged the sparrow aside, narrowed his bird eyes, and asked:

“Why don't you find a partner?”

-

Song Yu was actually taking a call outside from his grandfather. It covered two main points: first, informing him that the old man had returned home, and second, asking when the bird would be back.

“……”

“Of course, it’s good for you to rest outside for a while, but the bird is still very young. Didn't that crane come to the house last time?”

“You, you must take good care of it.”

Song Yu had indeed confessed some things about the Management Bureau to his grandfather later on, and with the old man chatting with his friend from the 749 Bureau for a long time, he likely knew the general gist.

But he didn't understand why his grandfather kept mentioning the Red-crowned Crane...

What was wrong with that?

“I will.”

Song Zheng-guo only then brought up the real business, which was mainly about his Taoist friend:

“Pingyun—Grandpa’s friend is named Li Pingyun. He has an eccentric personality. I don't know what he said to you and the bird.”

“But his heart isn't bad. It was mostly a misunderstanding. He asked me to apologize on his behalf.”

Song Yu was stunned, then felt it wasn't necessary, as it had just been a misunderstanding.

“I had intended for you all to have a meal together, but he left Nanshi too quickly, and I didn't get to ask where he was going. Perhaps we shall meet again if fate allows.”

Nothing else was said, and the call ended.

-

Bai Linlin had finally dug into 001’s background. His claws floated in the water, paddling leisurely.

001 was an initial-model serial number. It had no guardian and had been at the base from the start. It wasn't very old—only two years. It worked hard on missions to exchange for human currency to buy all kinds of barbecue.

But because it ate so frequently, it always spent it all by the end of the month.

“I don't have much money, why would I need a partner?”

001 said very seriously.

“Didn't I cover your barbecue?”

Bai Linlin leaned in to ask earnestly.

But the next second.

“Wouldn't a partner take away my barbecue?”

“……”

chunks.chineseText:
无敌了。

两个小鸟在池子里泡着，很是悠哉游哉，不过就是头顶的小毛巾快被水蒸气泡发了，有点沉。

把鸟脖子都压短了。

“那你岂不是没名字？”

白粼粼凑了过去，鸟眼圆圆的，生成一个鬼点子。

001：“是这样的。”

“我给你取个。”

灰棕色小雀很不设防地凑过去，好奇地问：

“真的吗？”

“什么名字？”

蓝羽小鸟咳咳了两下，最后定定地道：

“白一一。”

“……”

灰棕色小雀扭头，闷闷地道：

“不好听。”

“我要皮皮球球那种的。”

-

最后两个鸟也没能达成共识，白粼粼拐带大法没能成功，最后自己在池子里泡着。

001觉得一直湿着也挺不舒服的，它抖了抖羽毛就回房间去了，因为点了烧烤，可以开炫了。

白粼粼泡着泡着就困了，后面伸翅膀趴在了岸边，不知道自己慢慢地化形了。

宋郁过来的时候看到的就是下巴微湿的“少年”，眼皮都泛着粉，身上的衣服也湿哒哒，它还是不太会切换形态。

“粼粼？”

朦朦胧胧的，“少年”像是听到了有人叫自己，眼皮动了动，但还是没醒，只是觉得唇瓣有什么东西滑过，带着点清香。

白粼粼一口咬住了。

果汁爆开，脆甜脆甜的提子，还有一个不太好咬……

池子里水波荡漾，“少年”眼皮终于掀开了，抬手就抓住了岸边的人，含住了那根手指。

白粼粼隐约察觉到口感不对，但睁开眼睛的时候已经为时已晚，朦胧的雾气里只有宋郁若隐若现的面庞。

“粼粼。”

“……”

顿时间水花四溅，“少年”彻底绷不住了，推开那个手臂就要往水里钻，他在干什么？

但宋郁一下子脸色变了，抬手就去抓住那截手臂，但就这么一顿拉扯下来，白粼粼硬生生把宋郁给拉下来了。

水声咕嘟咕嘟……

白色的衬衫在水下显得轻薄又透，露出了柔韧的腰肢，“少年”在水里停滞了一两秒。

浅蓝色的头发妖冶美丽，挡住的那张脸更是惊艳绝伦，但就在这时，水里有个气泡。

白粼粼被一把捞了出来，他浑身湿哒哒，下巴是靠在宋郁的肩头的，一个劲地咳嗽。

呛到了。

“咳咳咳……”

白粼粼真是觉得倒霉死了，温泉池子本来就浅浅的，他还在里面摔了，还呛了一口……

呸呸呸！

宋郁抬手护着那个脖颈，抬手拍了拍背，刚侧头想问问好些没有，唇边擦过了“少年”的耳垂。

但怀里“人”没太在意，只是一个劲地咳嗽，最后唇瓣都给弄红了。

温泉里的水纹一层层地散开。

不过就在这时，外头有服务人员敲门进来，问了下：

“先生，请问需要再加个钟吗？”

场面一时安静。

相拥的两个人，一个抱着安抚，一个在咳嗽，唇瓣还那么红。

“不好意思打扰了。”

服务人员速速撤离。

-

大约十几分钟后。

宋郁才带着“人”回了他们的房间，白粼粼在床边坐着，手臂被握着，因为对方在用毛巾擦。

“下次不要往水里埋。”

“噢。”

“001呢？它不应该陪着你的么？”

“它去吃烧烤了。”

“那应该给我发消息。”

“忘了。”

白粼粼在完成这么一场对话之后，后知后觉哪里不对，他为什么要给宋郁发消息？

他是个妖怪！

妖怪！

“得去浴室简单冲一下，泡完温泉不要用沐浴露，自己可以吗？”

宋郁的想法很简单，他的小鸟还很小，带回来的时候就五个月，现在也还不到一岁。

“我会！”

“你走吧走吧。”

白粼粼觉得那种奇怪的感觉又上来了，尤其是抽自己的手臂抽不出来的时候，宋郁还在低头看他。

“我还要吃提子……”

最终是这个借口把人支走了。

-

宋郁出了房间门就看了看自己的手，上面残留的温度还在，他微微抬起……又放下了。

转而用手机发了个消息。

这次是用的语音。

[妖怪认得清楚葡萄和提子吗？]

侏儒兔在家里看穿戴甲教程，正在准备手工给自己监护人搓一个，抽空看了下消息。

它眯了眯眼，这不纯纯小看妖怪吗？老大的人最近越来越放肆了，它刚想反驳一下，下面传过来两张图。

“……”

有意思吗？

宋郁只是想验证一个想法而已，但是他刚收下手机，却在转角处看到了一个“熟人”。
chunks.englishText:
Invincible.

The two birds soaked in the pool, feeling quite leisurely, though the small towel on their heads was almost waterlogged and heavy.

It pressed their bird necks down until they looked short.

“Then you don't even have a name?”

Bai Linlin leaned over, his bird eyes round, a mischievous idea forming.

001: “That is the case.”

“I’ll give you one.”

The grey-brown sparrow leaned in, completely off-guard, and asked curiously:

“Really?”

“What name?”

The blue-feathered bird coughed twice, then said firmly:

“Bai Yiyi.”

“……”

The grey-brown sparrow turned its head and said sullenly:

“That doesn't sound good.”

“I want something like Pipi or Qiuqiu.”

-

In the end, the two birds couldn't reach a consensus. Bai Linlin’s "abduction" strategy failed, and he ended up soaking in the pool by himself.

001 felt that being wet all the time was uncomfortable, so it shook its feathers and went back to the room, as it had ordered barbecue and was ready to feast.

Bai Linlin grew sleepy as he soaked. Later, he stretched his wings and rested them on the edge of the pool, not realizing he was slowly shifting into his human form.

When Song Yu arrived, what he saw was the "youth" with a slightly wet chin, his eyelids flushed pink, and his clothes soaked through. He still wasn't very good at switching forms.

“Linlin?”

Dazed and hazy, the "youth" seemed to hear someone calling him. His eyelids fluttered, but he didn't wake up; he only felt something brush against his lips, carrying a faint, fresh fragrance.

Bai Linlin took a bite.

Juice burst forth—a crisp, sweet grape—and something else that wasn't easy to bite...

The water in the pool rippled. The "youth" finally opened his eyes, reached out to grab the person on the bank, and bit down on that finger.

Bai Linlin vaguely sensed the texture was wrong, but by the time he opened his eyes, it was too late. In the hazy mist, only Song Yu’s looming face was visible.

“Linlin.”

“……”

Suddenly, water splashed everywhere. The "youth" completely lost his composure, pushed away the arm, and tried to dive into the water. What was he doing?

But Song Yu’s expression changed instantly. He reached out to grab that arm, but in the ensuing tug-of-war, Bai Linlin pulled Song Yu down into the water with him.

The sound of water *gurgled*...

The white shirt looked thin and translucent underwater, revealing a supple waist. The "youth" paused in the water for a second or two.

His light blue hair was bewitchingly beautiful, and the face it framed was stunningly gorgeous, but just then, a bubble appeared in the water.

Bai Linlin was fished out in one go. He was dripping wet, his chin resting on Song Yu’s shoulder, coughing incessantly.

He had choked.

“*Cough, cough, cough*...”

Bai Linlin truly felt his luck was terrible. The hot spring pool was shallow, yet he had fallen in and even choked on a mouthful of water...

*Ptooey, ptooey, ptooey!*

Song Yu reached out to protect the back of his neck and patted his back. Just as he turned his head to ask if he was alright, his lips brushed against the "youth’s" earlobe.

But the "person" in his arms didn't notice, only coughing continuously until his lips were bright red.

The ripples in the hot spring spread out in layers.

Just then, a service staff member knocked on the door and entered, asking:

“Sir, would you like to extend your time?”

The scene went quiet.

The two people embracing—one holding the other in comfort, the other coughing, their lips so red.

“Sorry to disturb you.”

The staff member retreated quickly.

-

About ten minutes later.

Song Yu finally brought the "person" back to their room. Bai Linlin sat on the edge of the bed, his arm being held as the other person wiped it with a towel.

“Don't bury yourself in the water next time.”

“Oh.”

“Where is 001? Shouldn't it be accompanying you?”

“It went to eat barbecue.”

“Then you should have sent me a message.”

“Forgot.”

After finishing this conversation, Bai Linlin realized belatedly that something was wrong. Why should he send Song Yu a message?

He was a demon!

A demon!

“You need to go to the bathroom and rinse off briefly. Don't use body wash after a hot spring. Can you do it yourself?”

Song Yu’s thinking was simple: his little bird was still very young. When he brought it back, it was only five months old, and now it wasn't even a year old yet.

“I can!”

“You go, go away.”

Bai Linlin felt that strange sensation rising again, especially when he tried to pull his arm away and couldn't, while Song Yu was still looking down at him.

“I still want to eat grapes...”

In the end, this excuse was what got the person to leave.

-

As soon as Song Yu stepped out of the room, he looked at his hand. The lingering warmth was still there. He raised it slightly... then put it down.

Instead, he sent a message on his phone.

This time, he used a voice note.

[Can demons tell the difference between grapes and table grapes?]

The dwarf rabbit at home was looking at a tutorial for making armor, preparing to craft one for its guardian by hand, and checked the message in its spare time.

It narrowed its eyes. Isn't this just looking down on demons? The boss’s human had been getting more and more audacious lately. Just as it wanted to retort, two pictures were sent below.

“……”

Is this fun?

Song Yu just wanted to verify a thought, but just as he put his phone away, he saw an "acquaintance" around the corner.

chunks.chineseText:
第45章

对方也看过来了，道士这次倒是没穿道袍，只是套着个白色老头衫，手里拿着一杯冰可乐，面色俱是意外。

“……”

道士心想自己出差期间消遣怎么还撞上熟人了，这整的，老头低头喝了一口可乐，浑身舒爽。

然后假装看不见掉头就走。

反正这小孩肯定不乐意看到他。

“前辈。”

宋郁出声喊道，然后快步往前赶了过去，站在了道士的对面。

毕竟他上次也不是很礼貌，更何况爷爷还特地打了电话来代为道歉，那说明这老人家当时也只是热心肠而已，反倒是他不够冷静。

“没想到在这里见到您，上次在家里……我可能有些冲动，向您道个歉。”

宋郁很诚恳地道。

道士手里拿着冰可乐，眼睛里一开始还是意外，后面就弯成了一条缝，摆了摆手道：

“这有什么，我当时也是着急，后面一想，那鸟儿是你一直养着的，你爷爷也说了你这几年都自己住……我是个老顽固才对。”

“我应当向你道个歉。”

道士也丝毫不内耗，大大方方地鞠了个躬，宋郁愣了下，连忙抬手要拦，但对方已经伸出手掌阻拦了，顺带利落地起身了。

穿着汗衫的老头儿好奇地问了下：

“你怎么来H市了？自己出来还是？”

宋郁怔了下，而后回答道：

“我自己一个人。”

道士：“……”

你以为我听不懂潜台词吗？

但此刻闲着也是闲着，道士思索了下，这毕竟是个好孩子，他不如多说两句，于是问了问：

“要不要和我去聊聊？”

最后二人去了一个小的包厢，里头有着瓜果饮料，空调温度适宜，墙上还挂着一个很大的液晶屏幕。

道士进来后很自然地拿遥控器给打开了个频道，音量调整到背景音的程度，然后转头解释道：

“待会说的话要是被外人听到了，他们会觉得我们是神经病的。”

“……”

道士搞完这个就坐下了，顺带招手让宋郁过来，还抬手递过去一个橘子，顺带吐槽道：

“你是不知道，这里别看条件好，服务人员那叫一个虎，敲门那就是通知，下一秒就进来了。”

“我差点被看光！”

宋郁有些茫然，因为这和之前他想象的“道士”样子不太一样，现在这种生活化的吐槽……看起来对方也就是个普通的小老头。

少年本来要抬手剥橘子，但是想了想，拿着了。

“是，确实服务态度不太好。”

宋郁很自然地接了话头，然后就听到对方终于步入了正题：

“其实自从那天之后，我就去了那丹顶鹤口中的猫咖、狗咖……甚至还有鸟咖。”

道士看着虚空，只是感叹，“现在的人……真的是不生孩子了，很多人都是围着那群小动物打转。”

“我原来一直在郊区处理一些……总之是在山里居多，不怎么来城市，倒是不知道社会已经变化这么大了。”

宋郁闻言倒是也没说什么，只是轻声附和了一句。

道士这才转头看了过来，很看开地道：

“所以这么来看，我倒是也理解你了，那毕竟是你的小鸟，我一个外人无权干涉。”

宋郁几乎以为这就是话题的结束了，但是道士话锋一转，只是问：

“孩子，你了解妖怪吗？”

-

与此同时，房间里。

床上躺着一个晃着双腿的“少年”，他刚洗完澡，浅蓝色的头发像是水墨画的颜色，一点点晕开，发尾处像是一个完美的勾锋。

啪唧——

沉甸甸的手机一下子砸到了脸上，白粼粼痛得说不出来话，最后只是把那个破手机给拿了下来。

“……呜呜呜。”

床上的“少年”盘腿坐了起来，双手捂住自己的鼻梁，最后很是生气地调用妖力，砰得一下化成小鸟了。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地走到手机面前，用爪子狠狠地踩了几脚，然后又假装无事发生一样去用爪子翻开了手机正面。

继续欣赏自己的照片和视频。

第一张是出门的时候照的，两个挺胸抬头的蒙面小鸟；第二张是抓拍的两个齐齐仰着鸟头的怼脸照；第三张是在温泉那里自拍的，鸟头都顶着一个小压缩毛巾块；第四张……

完全够拍一个vlog视频了。

白粼粼说干就干，他最近给自己开了个社交媒体的账号，也不求成为什么百万博主，他就是纯粹地想要记录一下。

鸟收了收翅膀，非常骄傲地开始伸爪子操作，添加图片、图片……

找个bgm。

白粼粼思索一下，觉得整点高级的，挑了个英文的小调，然后配文的话。

有了！

——和好朋鸟一起出去玩了。[太阳][太阳]。

白粼粼还特地加上了几个定位，别说，还真有那个感觉。

发布！

鸟在床上很是挺胸昂首地站着，一日不过，他必然火爆全网！

白粼粼说是不在意，但实际上站在手机边待了好几分钟，伸着鸟头看屏幕，时不时用爪子往下划拉两下，刷新刷新。

“……”

浏览量都是个位数。

鸟有些郁闷，这不可能的吧？

白粼粼想了想，直接用爪子滑开微信，去找了自己的联系人，给001打了个语音电话。

那头倒是很快就接了。

鸟直言不讳：

“给我点赞。”

-

隔壁房间。

桌上其实有个小雀在用爪子把着签子，喙上全部都是蘸料，它在听着手机里的要求，歪了歪鸟头。

不太明白。

但那边最后放弃了解释，只是道：

“你来我房间。”

001很自然地化成了人形，站在了桌边，手里还捏着那个签子，然后认真地吃掉了最后一块肉肉。

它本来打算直接去找247的，但是就在这个时候，窗外的玻璃发出了有规律的震动，黑衣少年微微侧头，看到了几十米外的金线涌动。

管理局的通知。

它直接抬手，往侧边一滑，面前多了个流动着的金色屏幕，里面是丹顶鹤，对方开口问道：

“系统显示任务完成了，247表现得怎么样？”

001：“很好。”

屏幕里的丹顶鹤正在办公室里，俨然是过来加班了，闻言有些怀疑，眯了眯鸟眼：

“真的？”

001：“真的很好。”

丹顶鹤只是道：“少来这一套，你就和我老实说说怎么完成的任务，以及有没有影响到社会舆论。”

“管理局的章程告诉它了吗？”

黑衣少年面色平静：

“不会引起社会舆论的，背调显示那个人类一共地铁偷拍女乘客被抓四次，在校内倒卖色情资料盈利五千元，作弊处分三次，最后一次因为乔装宿管阿姨进女生寝室被开除学籍。”

“749局总能找到这些人类……奇怪。”

丹顶鹤知道这话题跑偏了也没太在意，只是头也不抬地教育道：

“这里毕竟是城市，人类的主地盘，灰榜那里的人员筛查当然要经过他们的手，妖怪那里的名单也要经过我们的手的。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 45

The other person looked over as well. The Taoist wasn't wearing his robes this time, just a white undershirt, holding a cup of iced cola, his face full of surprise.

“……”

The Taoist thought to himself, *How did I run into an acquaintance while on a business trip? This is something else.* The old man lowered his head and took a sip of cola, feeling refreshed all over.

Then he pretended not to see him and turned to leave.

In any case, this kid definitely wouldn't be happy to see him.

“Senior.”

Song Yu called out, then hurried forward to catch up, standing opposite the Taoist.

After all, he hadn't been very polite last time, and since his grandfather had specifically called to apologize on his behalf, it meant the old man had only been acting out of kindness back then; it was he who hadn't been calm enough.

“I didn't expect to see you here. Last time at home... I may have been a bit impulsive. I’d like to apologize.”

Song Yu said sincerely.

The Taoist held the iced cola, his eyes showing surprise at first, then crinkling into slits. He waved his hand and said:

“What’s this about? I was anxious at the time, too. Thinking about it later, that bird is one you’ve been raising all along, and your grandfather said you’ve been living on your own these past few years... I’m the one who’s a stubborn old fool.”

“I should be the one apologizing to you.”

The Taoist didn't dwell on it at all, bowing generously. Song Yu was stunned and quickly raised his hand to stop him, but the man had already blocked him with his palm and stood up neatly.

The old man in the undershirt asked curiously:

“Why did you come to H City? Did you come alone, or?”

Song Yu paused, then answered:

“I’m by myself.”

The Taoist: “……”

*Do you think I don't understand the subtext?*

But since he was idle anyway, the Taoist thought about it. This was a good kid, after all; he might as well say a few more words, so he asked:

“Do you want to go chat with me?”

The two eventually went to a small private room. Inside, there were fruits and drinks, the air conditioning was at a comfortable temperature, and a large LCD screen hung on the wall.

After entering, the Taoist naturally picked up the remote to turn on a channel, adjusted the volume to background level, and then turned to explain:

“If what we say in a moment is heard by outsiders, they’ll think we’re crazy.”

“……”

After finishing this, the Taoist sat down, beckoned for Song Yu to come over, and handed him an orange, complaining as he did so:

“You wouldn't know, but despite the good conditions here, the service staff are fierce. A knock is just a notification; the next second they’re inside.”

“I almost got seen in the buff!”

Song Yu was a bit dazed, as this was different from the "Taoist" image he had imagined. This kind of mundane complaining... made the other person look like just an ordinary little old man.

The youth had originally been about to peel the orange, but after a moment of thought, he just held it.

“Yes, the service attitude is indeed not very good.”

Song Yu naturally picked up the conversation, and then he heard the other person finally get to the point:

“Actually, since that day, I’ve been to the cat cafes, dog cafes... even bird cafes that the Red-crowned Crane mentioned.”

The Taoist looked into the void, sighing, “People nowadays... they really don't have children. Many people just hover around those little animals.”

“I’ve always been in the suburbs dealing with some... well, mostly in the mountains. I don't come to the city often, so I didn't know society had changed so much.”

Song Yu didn't say anything to that, just softly echoed a sentiment.

The Taoist then turned his head to look over, saying quite openly:

“So, looking at it this way, I understand you. After all, that is your little bird; I, as an outsider, have no right to interfere.”

Song Yu almost thought this was the end of the topic, but the Taoist changed the subject, simply asking:

“Child, do you understand demons?”

-

Meanwhile, in the room.

A "youth" lay on the bed, swinging his legs. He had just finished showering, and his light blue hair looked like the color of an ink wash painting, bleeding out bit by bit, the ends curling like a perfect hook.

*Thwack—*

A heavy phone suddenly slammed onto his face. Bai Linlin was in too much pain to speak, and finally just pulled the damn phone off.

“...*Wuwuwu*.”

The "youth" on the bed sat up cross-legged, covering the bridge of his nose with both hands, and finally, in a fit of anger, channeled his demonic power and *poof*—shifted into a bird.

Bai Linlin *patter-pattered* over to the phone, stomped on it hard with his claws a few times, then pretended nothing happened and used his claws to flip the phone over.

He continued to admire his photos and videos.

The first one was taken when they left, two masked birds with their chests puffed out and heads held high; the second was a candid close-up of both birds tilting their heads; the third was a selfie at the hot spring, both birds with little compressed towel squares on their heads; the fourth...

It was enough to make a vlog video.

Bai Linlin said he would do it, and he did. He had recently opened a social media account. He didn't aspire to be a millionaire blogger; he just purely wanted to record things.

The bird tucked his wings and began to operate with his claws, feeling very proud. *Add image, image...*

*Find a BGM.*

Bai Linlin pondered for a moment, deciding to go for something sophisticated. He picked a small English tune, then for the caption.

Got it!

——Went out to play with my best bird-friend. [Sun][Sun].

Bai Linlin even specifically added a few location tags. Don't say it, it really had that vibe.

*Publish!*

The bird stood on the bed with his chest puffed out and head held high. In less than a day, he would definitely be trending across the internet!

Bai Linlin said he didn't care, but in reality, he stood by the phone for several minutes, stretching his bird head to look at the screen, occasionally using his claws to swipe down and refresh, refresh, refresh.

“……”

The views were in the single digits.

The bird was a bit depressed. *This can't be right, can it?*

Bai Linlin thought for a moment, swiped open WeChat with his claws, found his contact, and made a voice call to 001.

The other side answered quickly.

The bird was blunt:

“Like my post.”

-

In the next room.

There was a sparrow at the table using its claws to hold a skewer, its beak covered in dipping sauce. It listened to the request from the phone and tilted its bird head.

It didn't quite understand.

But the other side gave up on explaining and just said:

“Come to my room.”

001 naturally shifted into human form, standing by the table with the skewer still in its hand, then earnestly ate the last piece of meat.

It had originally planned to go straight to 247, but at that moment, the glass outside the window vibrated rhythmically. The black-clad youth tilted his head slightly and saw golden lines surging a few dozen meters away.

A notification from the Management Bureau.

He raised his hand and swiped to the side, and a flowing golden screen appeared in front of him. Inside was the Red-crowned Crane, who asked:

“The system shows the mission is complete. How did 247 perform?”

001: “Very well.”

The Red-crowned Crane in the screen was in the office, clearly working overtime. Hearing this, it was suspicious and narrowed its bird eyes:

“Really?”

001: “Really very well.”

The Red-crowned Crane just said: “Cut that out. Just be honest with me about how you completed the mission and whether it affected public opinion.”

“Did you tell it the Management Bureau’s regulations?”

The black-clad youth’s expression was calm:

“It won't cause public opinion issues. The background check shows that the human was caught four times for taking upskirt photos of female passengers on the subway, made five thousand yuan selling pornographic materials on campus, was disciplined for cheating three times, and was finally expelled for disguising himself as a dorm auntie to enter the girls' dormitory.”

“The 749 Bureau can always find these humans... strange.”

The Red-crowned Crane knew the topic had drifted but didn't pay much attention, just educating him without looking up:

“This is a city, after all, the humans' main territory. The personnel screening on the Grey List naturally has to pass through their hands, and the list of demons has to pass through ours.”

chunks.chineseText:
“记得把章程告诉247，对了，还没和我说怎么完成的？它怎么行动的？”

空气一时安静了下。

001有些犹豫，但最后还是如实地说了，具体内容是：

“247……先膨大……起到一个震慑的作用……掀起阵阵劲风……任务目标惊恐万分……最后晕厥。”

丹顶鹤：“……”

也、也行。

丹顶鹤本来是想要直接收了视讯的，但是刚一抬头，看到了黑衣少年身后的装潢。

这什么地方？

“你去哪了001？”

黑衣少年闻言一愣，然后砰得一下变成小雀，半空中的妖力屏幕为了照到对象，只能视角往下。

丹顶鹤的屏幕里只剩下地板了。

“……”

这001，越来越像247了。

丹顶鹤摇摇头，最后也没说什么，只是要求道：

“让它好好的学习，最近749局的人到处巡视，少出去闲逛……”

最后那块浮在半空中的波纹屏幕消失了，房间里安安静静的，地板上的灰棕色小雀松了一口气，然后才啪嗒啪嗒地朝着门口走去。

-

白粼粼已经等了好长时间了，他本来都打算去隔壁找001了，扑棱翅膀从床上下来，啪嗒啪嗒地走到门口，刚用爪子扒拉开一个门缝，一个灰棕色的鸟头就拱了进来。

成功会面。

“过来过来。”

蓝羽小鸟说完就朝着里面走，对着门外的那只小雀挥了挥翅膀。

“快看我发的vlog！”

白粼粼说完这话就扑棱翅膀飞到了桌上，用爪子推了推手机，示意对方过来看。

灰棕色小雀低着鸟头仔细看，伸着爪子尝试去碰屏幕，但是又悬着，觉得有点新奇……

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒绕着小雀走了几步，歪头去看反应，鸟眼圆圆的。

震惊了吧！

不过就在这时，001好奇地问：

“怎么没有你的监护人？”

白粼粼咳咳了两下，很认真地解释道：

“不行，他是人类，他不能露脸。”

“我们是鸟，鸟无所谓的。”

001不理解，蓬了蓬毛，问：

“为什么？”

白粼粼想了想，又补充道：“我们如果化形了，最好也不要放到社交媒体上。”

001有些困惑，化形成人类的模样也是不能在网上露脸的？

桌上蓝羽小鸟很是认真地教导，啪嗒啪嗒地来回走，以二十三年的做人经验告诉它：

“人类很会扒人类的信息的，你放一张照片，无论配文如何，总会有神经病找茬的。”

“所以最好不要发照片。”

001泡完温泉浑身都很舒服，又蓬了蓬毛，身子下压，胸前得羽毛把爪子盖住了，它很认真地听讲。

“但我们是鸟的话，就完全不同了！”

蓝羽小鸟此刻神采奕奕，开始高谈阔论：

“鸟，会飞但可以选择不飞。”

“鸟，可以穿衣服也可以不穿。”

“鸟，可以抽风也可以安静。”

001不太懂。

但247好像很开心的样子。

“你知道这是什么吗？”

蓝羽小鸟啪嗒啪嗒走过来，很是挺胸抬头地道。

001：“是什么？”

“自由！”

-

包厢。

“妖怪修行的法子你知道吗？”

这么几个问题下来，宋郁拿着橘子的手微微用力了点。

他不知道。

道士见状只是摇摇头，随后又从桌上拿了冰可乐喝了一口，然后才道：

“在历史上的典籍里，妖怪修成人形是相当不易的，一般就两条路子，要么积德行善，要么吃人。”

“所以话本里怎么讲，既有狐狸报恩书生这样的痴情桥段，又有妖怪作祟、全家殒命的剧情。”

宋郁面色平静，只是在听着。

“发展到现在，它们愈发开智了，甚至出现了妖怪管理局，别说，办得是有模有样，甚至它们可以同人类一起协作行动。”

道士说到这里，眯了眯眼，对着少年道：

“你是不是觉得妖怪很好？”

“至少从我说到现在。”

宋郁抬眸看了过去，不太明白意思，但还是讲了自己的想法：

“生命是平等的。”

道士闻言直接一噎，心想这孩子还真是正，和峥国一个样子，从军的时候自己干粮不够了还会喂一些瘦骨嶙峋的野猫。

“对，这没错。”

老头只是叹了口气，最后也不绕弯子了，直接道：

“我是想让你在信任妖怪的同时，也要知道它们客观存在的‘危险’。”

“A级妖怪其实就是化形，目前的数量已经不少了，这其实还比较好管理，因为大多数都是像南市这种有监护人的小型妖怪。”

“但真正可怕的是S级和S级以上的，它们会幻化成各种各样形态，你想一想，你的亲人、朋友……甚至上司，可能是个非人之物。”

“还会拟声、制造幻觉……你知道我们749局处理的都是些什么事件吗？”

宋郁修长的手指转了下掌心的柑橘，只是抬起眼眸道：

“管理局的妖怪没有去帮你们么？”

“……”

这话一出，又一阵沉默。

道士突然觉得口有些干，咳嗽了几下，然后抬手去拿冰可乐，但是低头一看，全是冰块了。

“这这……”

老头又给放回去了，最后才回复道：

“是，确实是来帮的。”

宋郁语气很平和地道：

“那它们不是可怕，是强大。”

道士：“……”

他就不信了。

老头双手放在膝盖上，深吸一口气，最后看向旁边的少年，伸出手指道：

“那总有一个事情你得注意点。”

“这个是管理局的S级妖怪……或者说你认为的好妖怪都会做的事。”

宋郁捏着那个柑橘，转了一圈，面色还是古井无波。

“它们上了S级的妖怪，就不再把人类当成监护人了，而是将其视为择偶的对象。”

宋郁愣了下。

道士见终于有反应了，立马乘胜追击，站在道德制高点上抨击：

“它们妖怪为了一己私欲，甚至会强迫人类同他们一起所谓的‘修行’，这实际上是个骗局！”

宋郁侧头看了过来，暗沉的眼眸里微微动了下，问：

“什么意思？”

道士这下终于挺直腰板了，这孩子果然是反应过来了，他神清气爽的，摆了摆手道：

“孩子我一会儿慢慢和你讲，它们真的是太过分了，我得去和喝个水，口有些干……”

面前的少年直接起身了，拿起来杯子就道：

“我来。”

-

而此刻房间里两只小鸟正齐齐趴在桌面上，爪子往后伸着，探头探脑地看着手机屏幕。

“你不觉得我整的视频很好吗？”

001歪了歪鸟头，闻言很认真地道：

“非常好。”

蓝羽小鸟用翅膀托着鸟头，很不明白地道：

“那怎么不是爆款呢？”

“都没几条评论。”

001只是学着伸出来翅膀，用前面飞羽撑着鸟头，发觉很是舒服……

它是怎么发明的？
chunks.englishText:
"Remember to tell 247 the procedure. Oh, and you haven't told me how it completed the task yet? How did it act?"

The air went quiet for a moment.

001 hesitated, but in the end, it reported truthfully. The details were:

"247... first expanded... to serve as a deterrent... stirred up gusts of wind... the target was terrified... and finally fainted."

Red-Crowned Crane: "..."

W-well, that works too.

The Red-Crowned Crane had originally intended to end the video call, but just as it looked up, it caught a glimpse of the decor behind the black-clad youth.

Where is this place?

"Where did you go, 001?"

The black-clad youth paused upon hearing this, then *poof*—transformed into a small sparrow. To keep the subject in frame, the floating demon-power screen had to tilt its perspective downward.

Now, the Red-Crowned Crane’s screen showed nothing but the floor.

"..."

This 001 is becoming more and more like 247.

The Red-Crowned Crane shook its head and didn't press the matter, only requesting:

"Make sure it studies properly. The 749 Bureau has been patrolling everywhere lately, so tell it to stop wandering around..."

Finally, the rippling screen floating in mid-air vanished. The room fell silent, and the gray-brown sparrow on the floor let out a sigh of relief before pattering toward the door.

-

Bai Linlin had been waiting for a long time. He had actually planned to go find 001 next door. He flapped his wings to get off the bed, pattered to the door, and just as he used his claws to pry a crack open, a gray-brown bird head nudged its way in.

Successful rendezvous.

"Come over, come over."

The little blue-feathered bird said this and headed inside, waving a wing at the sparrow outside the door.

"Look at the vlog I posted!"

After saying this, Bai Linlin flapped his wings and flew onto the table, pushing his phone with a claw to signal the other to come and look.

The gray-brown sparrow lowered its head to look closely, extending a claw to try and touch the screen, but it hovered there, feeling a bit curious...

Bai Linlin pattered around the sparrow a few times, tilting his head to watch its reaction, his bird eyes round.

Shocked, aren't you!

However, at that moment, 001 asked curiously:

"Why isn't your guardian here?"

Bai Linlin coughed twice and explained very seriously:

"I can't. He's a human; he can't show his face."

"We're birds, it doesn't matter for us."

001 didn't understand. It puffed up its feathers and asked:

"Why?"

Bai Linlin thought for a moment and added: "If we take human form, it's best not to put that on social media either."

001 was confused. So, even when taking human form, one shouldn't show their face online?

On the table, the little blue-feathered bird taught earnestly, pattering back and forth, using its twenty-three years of human experience to explain:

"Humans are very good at digging up other humans' information. You post one photo, and no matter what the caption says, some lunatic will always find a way to pick a fight."

"So, it's best not to post photos."

001 felt very comfortable after its hot spring soak. It puffed up its feathers again, lowered its body, and tucked its claws under its chest feathers, listening intently.

"But if we're birds, it's completely different!"

The little blue-feathered bird was radiant now, beginning to hold forth:

"Birds can fly, but can choose not to."

"Birds can wear clothes, or not."

"Birds can be erratic, or quiet."

001 didn't quite get it.

But 247 seemed very happy.

"Do you know what this is?"

The little blue-feathered bird pattered over, chest puffed out proudly.

001: "What is it?"

"Freedom!"

-

In the private booth.

"Do you know about the methods of cultivation for demons?"

After a few such questions, Song Yu’s hand, holding an orange, tightened slightly.

He didn't know.

Seeing this, the Taoist just shook his head, picked up an iced cola from the table, took a sip, and then said:

"In historical records, it is extremely difficult for demons to attain human form. Generally, there are two paths: either accumulate virtue and do good, or eat people."

"That's why stories are written the way they are—there are tales of deep affection, like a fox repaying a scholar's kindness, and then there are plots where demons wreak havoc and destroy entire families."

Song Yu’s expression remained calm as he listened.

"As they have developed to this day, they have become increasingly intelligent. There is even a Demon Management Bureau—and truth be told, it’s run quite impressively. They can even cooperate with humans on missions."

At this point, the Taoist squinted his eyes and said to the youth:

"Do you think demons are good?"

"At least from what I've said so far."

Song Yu looked up, not quite understanding the implication, but he shared his thoughts anyway:

"All life is equal."

The Taoist was choked by these words, thinking to himself that this kid was truly upright, just like Zheng Guo—who, when serving in the military, would feed the scrawny stray cats even when his own rations were running low.

"Right, that's true."

The old man sighed, stopped beating around the bush, and said directly:

"I want you to trust demons, but also to be aware of the 'danger' that objectively exists within them."

"Class A demons are those who have attained human form. Their numbers are quite significant now, but they are relatively easy to manage because most of them are small-time demons with guardians, like here in Nan City."

"But the truly terrifying ones are S-Class and above. They can shapeshift into all sorts of forms. Just think about it: your relatives, your friends... even your boss, could be a non-human entity."

"They can mimic voices, create hallucinations... do you know what kind of incidents we at the 749 Bureau handle?"

Song Yu turned the citrus in his palm with his slender fingers, then looked up and said:

"Did the demons from the Management Bureau not go to help you?"

"..."

Another silence followed.

The Taoist suddenly felt his throat go dry. He coughed a few times, then reached for the iced cola, but looking down, he saw it was nothing but ice cubes.

"This, this..."

The old man put it back and finally replied:

"Yes, they do come to help."

Song Yu said in a calm tone:

"Then they aren't terrifying; they are powerful."

Taoist: "..."

He refused to believe it.

The old man placed his hands on his knees, took a deep breath, looked at the youth beside him, and held up a finger:

"There is one thing you must pay attention to."

"This is something that S-Class demons from the Bureau—or the 'good' demons you think you know—will all do."

Song Yu squeezed the citrus, turned it around, his expression still as calm as a stagnant well.
