The "youth" actually knew he was in the wrong for making people worry. He was scooped up and placed on the table; Song Yu seemed to love this position, keeping him completely surrounded.

Bai Linlin felt he had already explained himself at the alley entrance. He placed his hand on the other man's shoulder, pursed his lips, and said earnestly once more:

"I wasn't going to leave."

Song Yu hadn't actually asked anything. He simply lifted his eyelids to look at the "person" before him and said tentatively:

"My heart hurts."

Bai Linlin froze upon hearing this. He had indeed noticed the other man's complexion when he came to find him; it really hadn't been good.

"Really? Then you need to see a doctor."

The "youth" reached out to press against the other's chest, his expression full of concern. He couldn't help but tilt his head to look at the man's face, his worry plain and direct.

The bird had personally chosen this human.

He couldn't be allowed to have anything happen to him.

"It's somatization. It can't be cured."

Song Yu just stared down at the "youth's" face, watching every minute change in expression. When he saw the other looking up at him, his little finger twitched slightly.

"What should I do?"

The man asked.

Bai Linlin sat on the desk, his hands resting on the other's shoulders. He felt quite helpless hearing this. He wasn't a doctor. Somatization... did that happen whenever he was unhappy?

His mind was in a mess.

Song Yu... Song Yu had only just recovered.

The "youth" didn't hesitate. He looked up and wrapped his arms around him.

He hugged him.

It was the most clumsy of methods.

Song Yu lowered his eyelids slightly, his body pressing down as he returned the embrace, pressing his hand against the "youth's" back as if to knead him into his own bones.

His little bird cared about him.

So obedient.

-

Time moved forward, and the Spring Festival drew closer. Correspondingly, the bird followed 001 to complete tasks as scheduled.

There weren't many gray-level tasks; most humans were good, with only a very few bad apples popping up.

Bai Linlin was basically always picked up and dropped off. The specific procedure was to transform into the target the villain wanted to abuse, lure them to a secluded corner, grow large, flap his wings, and finish it all in one go.

His basic attacks were becoming increasingly powerful.

001 usually transformed into the black-clad youth, guiding him from the sidelines and occasionally handling the aftermath.

Overall, everything went smoothly. Bai Linlin even learned some new skills, and one weekend, he specifically demonstrated them for Song Yu.

The sun was beautiful that day.

"I can turn into other little animals!"

Song Yu sat in his chair, watching his little bird trot back and forth on the table, then transform into a fluffy guinea pig.

One second, two seconds.

*Poof*, he turned back into his original form.

"And this."

The blue-feathered bird trotted back and forth again, and a small black cat appeared on the table, its fur sleek and shiny.

One second, two seconds.

*Poof*, he turned back into his original form.

He transformed into over a dozen different animals like this. Bai Linlin finally felt a bit tired, walked up to the man, tilted his bird head, and said proudly:

"Impressive, right?"

Song Yu lowered his eyes slightly, feeling that his bird's original form was still the best—round and plump.

"Mm, Linlin is the most..."

Before the praise could leave his lips, the bird on the table flapped his wings and hopped down to the floor, standing straight and looking up with round eyes:

"There's more!"

The bird on the floor circled again, as if this were some kind of warm-up, and then, in front of Song Yu, appeared...

His grandfather.

"..."

Song Yu furrowed his brows slightly and said gently:

"Can't you transform into someone else?"

Bai Linlin thought that was fair; he had seen other people, but just then—

"Not Old Chen."

"..."

Bai Linlin *poofed* back into his original form, fluffy and tucking his wings, looking up in frustration.

"But those are the only people I've observed closely."

"Otherwise, I can only turn into you."

Song Yu simply said: "That's fine."

The room was silent for a second, then two.

The bird on the floor went from being confused to looking eager, stretching his wing roots and starting to circle again.

Song Yu looked at the "himself" in front of him and said gently:

"Then Linlin can go use my card."

"That would be much more convenient."

Hearing this, Bai Linlin *poofed* back into a bird, fluffy and digging his claws into the floor.

Humans being too good to birds was also quite excessive.

Outside, the sun was still bright. Inside the bedroom, the conversation between the man and the bird continued:

"Haven't I improved a lot? 001 said I used to only transform at night, but now I've adjusted! And I've learned so many skills!"

"Yes, Linlin is the best."

"And I'm very proficient at transforming into a human now!"

The bird on the floor stretched his wings. This time, he didn't need to circle; he transformed directly into a youth wearing long sleeves and pants. Since it was cold, he was wearing a hoodie, his hair tied into a small bun, his complexion fair and tinged with pink.

The sunlight shone in.

One could even see some faint, soft fuzz.

Song Yu reached out his hand, and the "youth" naturally reached out to meet it, walking over without any resistance.

By the time Bai Linlin realized what was happening, it was too late; his waist was being encircled.

"..."

He wanted to turn back into a bird, but his wrist was caught. A voice came into his ear:

"Why are you embarrassed?"

"I said, Linlin can be however you like, whether you are in human form or your original form."

Song Yu said, his expression unchanged: "Sitting on my shoulder is also fine."

"I only have you as my little bird."

Bai Linlin’s face turned red instantly. He tugged at his wrist, but to no avail. He just said in a muffled voice:

"Humans shouldn't just hug and hold each other randomly."

Don't try to trick a bird.

Song Yu raised his eyebrows slightly and said:

"Right, so if I ever hug or hold other humans, Linlin must stop me. That is very bad behavior."

Bai Linlin was stunned, frowning as he looked over. Why was he taking on such a job?

No, that wasn't it.

"But you are my little bird. I was the one who took you to register at the Bureau. Don't distance yourself from me just because you can transform."

"Okay?"

Song Yu was very direct.

Bai Linlin opened his mouth. A thought flashed through his mind, and he asked directly:

"But won't you get married in the future? What will happen then? I won't be able to transform too often, right?"

After saying this, he even instinctively started to walk away.

Song Yu closed his eyes and pulled the "person" back, holding the "youth's" hand, his expression calm:

"I raised Linlin first."

"Whether I have a partner or not, you are the one who decides."

After saying this, Song Yu reminded him gently:

"Didn't you say last time not to let me find anyone?"

Bai Linlin was speechless. It seemed he had said that, but that was only because he kept talking about how his property would be divided with that partner.

The "youth" frowned, seemingly thinking about something, and finally nodded.

The veins on the back of Song Yu's hand subsided slightly. It was fine; he could teach him slowly.

It was nothing more than a lack of possessiveness toward him.

"Oh, right."

"I learned a new one."

The warmth left Song Yu's arm. The "youth" stood in the center, looking eager, having clearly moved past the previous topic.

Bai Linlin closed his eyes and mobilized his demonic power. Golden threads flowed everywhere, and finally...

A pair of wings manifested from his shoulder blades.

The feathers were a beautiful, pale blue with a gradient, and golden threads flowed through them, making them appear brilliant and shimmering.

chunks.chineseText:
“少年”睁开了眼睛，侧头看了下自己背后，见成功了，非常高兴地伸了伸胳膊。

白粼粼自己独创的！

他转了个圈，身后的翅膀也随着意念而伸开，显得非常的……美丽。

宋郁微微看愣了神，甚至没有做出来即时的反应。

“好看吗？”

“少年”眼睛亮亮地问，见人没有反应，只好又催促道：

“宋郁！”

也就在这时。

“好看。”

“很好看……”

-

春节临近，锦园张灯结彩的，卧室里的窗户都挂上了彩灯。

但是书桌上有一只圆滚滚的小鸟在用灯下复习，非常用功的样子。

由于上次投机倒把，丹顶鹤这次连妖力津贴都不给他了，说是要集中收着，然后在管理局进行“升级”。

白粼粼想到这里其实还有点紧张兮兮的，倒不是因为升S级的事……而是那个双修……升到S级的话，估计还要看看。

乱糟糟的。

他、他回头再搞吧。

鸟伸爪子翻了下妖怪手册的纸张，有点烦闷的，复习复习ing。

今天晚上要去理论考核。

白粼粼叹了口气，这大过年的，宋郁都不上学了！

他还要复习。

就在这个时候，卧室外面有一些轻轻的交谈声：

“鸟儿还在学习？”

宋峥国手里拿了个果盘，上面还都带着签子，脆梨、葡萄、芒果、西瓜……花花绿绿的，老人俨然一幅关怀的样子。

“嗯，它有个考核。”

宋郁手里拿着一盒子经典糕点，是刚从外面回来的，在门口很轻地交流道。

“难不难呐？”

宋峥国其实是有些担忧的，想要推门看看，但是又怕打扰到了鸟儿。

“粼粼很用功的，肯定会取得好成绩。”

一爷一孙在门口窃窃私语的。

其实全被鸟听见了。

白粼粼偷偷地扭头看了下门口，其实有个门缝，他赶在爷爷偷偷看的时候，立马站得端端正正，用爪子把妖怪手册的纸张翻得很是响。

果不其然他们又开始说话了，鸟侧耳倾听：

“这么小……哎呦，过了年也才一岁，这怎么这个时候还要考核？”

“晚上送鸟儿去的时候，记得给它穿厚点。”

“好。”

宋峥国只是又道：“把果盘拿进去吧，动作小点。”

之后就是脚步离开的声音了，门外只剩下宋郁了，过了一会，门发出了轻轻的动静。

白粼粼立马站得板板正正的，挺胸抬头，伸爪子翻页的力道都拿捏得刚刚好，过了一会桌边多了一个果盘和一盒子精致的糕点。

“买到了。”

鸟立马抬头看了过去，眼睛亮亮的。

卧室里安安静静的，不远处还有放烟花的声音，“少年”坐在椅子上，正在用手捧着牛舌饼，小口小口地吃着。

呜呜呜。

幸福！

宋郁靠在书桌旁，垂眸看着椅子上的“少年”，目光就没有移开过。

他怎么都是能养好的。

“你吃吗？”

白粼粼抬手推了推那个盒子，一边咬住糕饼一边抬眼看，很是认真地询问。

“我不爱吃甜的。”

宋郁很是温和地道。

“今天人很多哎，你怎么买到的？”

“出高价截的。”

“……”

卧室里一片祥和，时不时会有几句对话，显得房间里都有了生气。

-

宋峥国其实回了房间后在认真地看日历，眼下临近年关，鸟儿已经过了一岁了，一岁半的时候那鹤过来考察。

嗯……

还有三个月。

宋峥国其实是有些焦虑的，他背着手在房间里走来走去的，心里也有些着急。

他只是有和人相处的经验，知道形形色色的人都想要什么……

但是，妖怪的……他不清楚。

宋峥国最后还是没忍住，同自己的老友打了电话，那边倒是很快就接了。

“怎么了？峥国？”

道士正在道观吃泡面呢，桌子上摆满了些刚写的符，旁边平板电脑放着黄梅戏，咿咿呀呀地唱着。

“平云，你说妖怪喜欢什么？”

道士闻言一愣。

-

卧室。

白粼粼其实早就吃完晚饭了，他只是后面嘴馋，吃了些水果，又去吃糕点。

宋郁就这么陪着，也没有睡觉，毕竟他的小鸟今天晚上有考核，不能耽误。

“复习好了吗？”

“嗯嗯。”

一人一鸟在凌晨一点半的时候开始出发，白粼粼这次穿上了很喜庆的红色小披风，里面是纯白的羊羔绒，看着着实富贵。

鸟站在人的肩头上，顺顺利利地上了车，挎包里还带着那本妖怪手册。

大约三十分钟，很快就送到了。

车门也应声打开。

白粼粼本来啪嗒啪嗒地就要下车，但是身后传来了一句：

“粼粼。”

噢噢，忘记了。

白粼粼在座位上化形成了“少年”，倾身去抱了抱，很自然的样子。

“好。”

“我等你。”

白粼粼这才起身下了车，身上的挎包也自动地放大了，“少年”往围墙那里走，回头看了下帕拉梅拉，挥了挥手。

对角巷这里照旧是安安静静的，角落里出来了一排排的西服革履的小鼠，它们都排着队。

白粼粼想了想，也化成了小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒地跟上了队伍，穿着新年衣服，又看了看车子的方向。

宋郁始终是打开车窗的，一直在看。

鸟挥了挥翅膀。

进去了。

-

宋郁在外面等着，其实心一点都不静，他的小鸟很乖……自从桐城那次，就答应了每次分别就拥抱的事。

是他卑劣。

宋郁觉得自己离不开了，但没有什么很好的办法，即使是来基地几个小时，也有些受不了了。

反倒是，退步了。

但就在这个时候，他的手机来了一条消息：

[小郁，爷爷也过去吧？]

宋郁愣了下。

在四个小时前——

宋峥国没忍住还是和自己老友坦白了一些事，对面的道士一听就绷不住了：

“你你你！这怎么就答应了？”

“妖怪妖怪，是最会蛊惑人心的，它们惯会用一些文字漏洞让人类同它们签下不公平的契约的，口头说了都算！”

老头心里一咯噔。

“你这……这不纯粹是把你孙子给送过去了吗？”

宋峥国试图给自己辩白，只是道：

“这鸟儿当时还不到一岁……”

“……”

道士是觉得没救了，这一家子压根就没有个正常人类。

“妖怪能喜欢什么？喜欢人类，两层意思，要么吃了，要么当成配偶。”

宋峥国眼皮都抽了抽，不知道为什么，得知这个消息后，居然莫名松了口气。

啊……

鸟儿肯定不会吃小郁。

那这么看来，配偶还可以。

那鹤位高权重的，宋家也惹不起，倒是鸟儿可可爱爱，一看就是个好孩子。

老头斟酌了一下，询问道：

“那要是和妖怪成亲，是需要什么聘礼吗？”

道士震撼，一句话说不出来了。
chunks.englishText:
The "youth" opened his eyes and turned his head to look behind him. Seeing that he had succeeded, he stretched his arms with great delight.

It was Bai Linlin’s own original creation!

He spun around, and the wings behind him unfurled in response to his will, appearing incredibly... beautiful.

Song Yu was slightly stunned, failing to even react in the moment.

"Does it look good?"

The "youth" asked with bright eyes. Seeing no response, he had to urge him again:

"Song Yu!"

It was only then that he replied.

"It looks good."

"It looks very good..."

-

With the Spring Festival approaching, Jin Garden was decked out in lanterns and colorful streamers, and the bedroom windows were adorned with fairy lights.

However, on the desk, a round little bird was reviewing under the lamp, looking very diligent.

Because of the previous "speculation and profiteering" incident, the Red-Crowned Crane had even cut off his spirit-power allowance this time, claiming it needed to be held centrally for an "upgrade" at the Management Bureau.

Thinking of this, Bai Linlin felt a bit nervous—not because of the S-rank upgrade... but because of that "dual cultivation"... If he really reached S-rank, he’d have to see about that.

It was all so messy.

He—he would deal with it later.

The bird reached out a claw to flip the pages of the *Manual of Monsters*, feeling a bit annoyed as he continued his review.

He had a theoretical assessment tonight.

Bai Linlin sighed. It was almost the New Year, and even Song Yu didn't have to go to school anymore!

Yet he still had to study.

Just then, there were some soft voices outside the bedroom:

"Is the bird still studying?"

Song Zhengguo held a fruit platter, complete with toothpicks. There were crisp pears, grapes, mangoes, and watermelon—colorful and vibrant. The old man looked every bit the concerned elder.

"Yes, it has an assessment."

Song Yu was holding a box of classic pastries, just having returned from outside. They spoke softly at the doorway.

"Is it difficult?"

Song Zhengguo was actually quite worried. He wanted to push the door open to check, but he was afraid of disturbing the bird.

"Linlin is very diligent; it will surely get a good grade."

The grandfather and grandson whispered at the door.

In reality, the bird heard everything.

Bai Linlin snuck a glance at the door. There was a crack in the frame, and the moment he saw his grandfather peeking, he immediately stood up straight and upright, using his claws to flip the pages of the *Manual of Monsters* quite loudly.

Sure enough, they started talking again, and the bird tilted its head to listen:

"So small... oh my, it’ll only be one year old after the New Year. Why does it have to be assessed at a time like this?"

"When you take the bird tonight, remember to dress it warmly."

"I will."

Song Zhengguo added, "Take the fruit platter in, but move quietly."

After that came the sound of footsteps leaving. Only Song Yu remained outside the door. A moment later, the door made a soft sound.

Bai Linlin immediately stood up perfectly straight, chest puffed out and head held high. The force with which he flipped the pages was perfectly measured. A moment later, a fruit platter and a box of exquisite pastries appeared on the edge of the desk.

"I bought them."

The bird immediately looked up, its eyes shining.

The bedroom was quiet, with the sound of fireworks in the distance. The "youth" sat on the chair, holding a cow-tongue pastry in his hands, eating it in small bites.

*Wuwuwu.*

Happiness!

Song Yu leaned against the desk, his eyes lowered as he watched the "youth" on the chair, his gaze never once wavering.

He could raise him well, no matter what.

"Do you want some?"

Bai Linlin raised his hand to push the box over, looking up with a very serious expression as he bit into a pastry.

"I don't like sweets," Song Yu said very gently.

"There were so many people today, how did you manage to buy these?"

"I outbid them with a high price."

"..."

The bedroom was filled with peace, and the occasional exchange of words made the room feel alive.

-

After returning to his room, Song Zhengguo was actually looking at the calendar in earnest. With the year-end approaching, the bird had already turned one year old. When it turned one and a half, that crane would come for an inspection.

Hmm...

Three more months.

Song Zhengguo was actually quite anxious. He paced back and forth in his room, feeling a sense of urgency.

He had experience in dealing with people and knew what all kinds of people wanted...

But, as for monsters... he didn't know.

In the end, Song Zhengguo couldn't help but call his old friend. The other side picked up quickly.

"What's wrong, Zhengguo?"

The Taoist priest was eating instant noodles in his temple. The table was covered in newly written talismans, and a tablet computer beside him was playing Huangmei opera, singing in a high-pitched, warbling tone.

"Pingyun, tell me, what do monsters like?"

The Taoist was stunned at the question.

-

Bedroom.

Bai Linlin had actually finished dinner long ago. He just had a sweet tooth, so he ate some fruit and then the pastries.

Song Yu accompanied him, not sleeping, as his little bird had an assessment tonight and couldn't be delayed.

"Are you done reviewing?"

"Mm-hmm."

At 1:30 AM, the human and the bird set off. Bai Linlin wore a very festive little red cape, lined with pure white lamb's wool, looking truly opulent.

The bird stood on the man's shoulder, successfully getting into the car, with the *Manual of Monsters* tucked into his satchel.

About thirty minutes later, they arrived.

The car door opened.

Bai Linlin was about to hop out, but a voice came from behind:

"Linlin."

Oh, right, he had forgotten.

Bai Linlin transformed into the "youth" in his seat and leaned over to give him a hug, looking very natural.

"Okay."

"I'll wait for you."

Only then did Bai Linlin get out of the car. The satchel on his body automatically enlarged. The "youth" walked toward the wall, looked back at the Panamera, and waved.

Diagon Alley was quiet as usual. A line of mice in suits emerged from the corner, all marching in a row.

Bai Linlin thought for a moment, then transformed back into a little bird, hopping along to follow the line. Wearing his New Year clothes, he looked back toward the car one more time.

Song Yu kept the window down, watching the whole time.

The bird waved its wings.

He went inside.

-

Song Yu waited outside, but his heart was far from calm. His little bird was very well-behaved... ever since that time in Tongcheng, he had promised to hug every time they parted.

It was his own baseness.

Song Yu felt he couldn't live without him, but there was no good solution. Even being at the base for a few hours was hard to bear.

Instead, he had regressed.

But just then, his phone received a message:

[Little Yu, should Grandpa come over too?]

Song Yu was stunned.

Four hours ago—

Song Zhengguo couldn't help but confess some things to his old friend. The Taoist on the other end couldn't hold back:

"You, you, you! How could you agree to this?"

"Monsters, monsters are the best at bewitching people's hearts! They are used to using loopholes in language to make humans sign unfair contracts—even verbal ones count!"

The old man’s heart skipped a beat.

"You... haven't you just handed your grandson over to them?"

Song Zhengguo tried to defend himself, only saying:

"The bird was less than a year old at the time..."

"..."

The Taoist felt there was no saving them; this family didn't have a single normal human.

"What could a monster like? If they like a human, it means one of two things: either they want to eat them, or they want them as a mate."

Song Zhengguo’s eyelids twitched. For some reason, after learning this, he felt inexplicably relieved.

Ah...

The bird definitely wouldn't eat Little Yu.

In that case, being a mate seemed okay.

That crane was powerful and influential, and the Song family couldn't afford to offend it. But the bird was cute—it looked like a good child.

The old man pondered for a moment and asked:

"Then, if one is to marry a monster, is a dowry required?"

The Taoist was shocked, unable to say another word.

chunks.chineseText:
后面宋峥国挂了电话也是心事重重的，毕竟他那天算是把自己孙子给卖了……这不说一下，心里实在是过意不去。

他失眠了。

最终也选择出门，他也接一接鸟儿放学吧。

……

宋郁本来是要拒绝的，但是下一秒：

[爷爷已经打好车了。]

[上来了。]

宋郁：“……”

宋郁没办法，只能把地址发了过去，但面色还是很恍惚，他最后下了车，在寒风中等自己爷爷。

-

管理局内。

鸟身着一身喜庆的红色小披风，帽子是尖筒的，上面坠着个小毛球，和内里的羊羔绒颜色一致，又保暖又好看。

阿姨手工愈发了得。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地在大厅的地板上走着，照旧一路走，一路挥翅膀，然后点头示意。

最后抵达鸟界的地盘，抬起翅膀把小挎包一扔，旁边的小鼠立马接了过来。

“去分吧。”

“替我祝大家新年快乐。”

白粼粼心情已经调整好了，照旧是神纠纠气昂昂的，没关系，上辈子的事都是过去时了，鸟，要活在当下！

“247？”

丹顶鹤不知道何时出来了，见到了地板上全新小鸟，挥了挥翅膀，很是优雅地道：

“过来考核。”

白粼粼愣了下，而后就是啪嗒啪嗒地转了一圈，开始四处环顾，直到上方传来了悠悠的声音：

“别找了，001被我安排出去做任务了。”

“它这次休想再给你塞小抄。”

鸟：“……”

没办法，丹顶鹤系着丝带往前走，身后跟着一只穿得跟个圣诞老人一样的小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒地小步跟着。

教室——

试卷发下来了，这次甚至都没有什么考前谈话，丹顶鹤只是在垂眸看着。

严肃.jpg

白粼粼已经化形了，“少年”坐在椅子上，手里拿着笔，仰头看了看丹顶鹤，又看了看试卷。

“……”

果然很难。

论述题：请简要分析妖怪管理局中央到地方的系统是什么？并回答它与人类的垂直部门有何区别？

白粼粼：“……”

鸟不会这个，鸟跳过。

论述题：请分析中央下发的“通行证”与人类的“身份证”有何区别？缘何妖怪不能申领“身份证”？

白粼粼低了低头，握紧了笔。

他就不信了。

过，下一题！

论述题：妖怪与人类和谐共生数千年，请问如何看待人类饲养宠物的同时，又开设很多屠宰场？如何理解杀生而不虐生的含义？

白粼粼：“……”

干什么！

但是就在这时，丹顶鹤只是说了一句：

“247，你真的认识字啊。”

白粼粼身体一僵，直接给吓回了本体，毛绒绒的，爪子都并得紧紧的。

仰头看着丹顶鹤。

摇脑袋。

丹顶鹤蹙眉：“这又不是批评你的，001就跟个文盲一样，过来过来。”

考核就这么中断了，丹顶鹤很是优雅地带着身后的小鸟去了办公室，它走到书柜那里，用翅膀拿出来几本厚厚的书。

翻开了。

丹顶鹤对着地板上的小雀伸了伸翅膀，“上来。”

白粼粼还穿着那件红色的小披风，其实是有些紧张的，他不知道现在是什么情况，但还是扑棱了下翅膀，顺着丹顶鹤的大翅膀一路攀爬。

最后抵达书桌。

鸟圆滚滚的，看到了那个厚厚的书。

“过来，念一下。”

白粼粼：“……”

这能念吗？

但是丹顶鹤已经在催促了，很是不理解地道：

“大大方方的啊，这好不容易出一个天资高的，别整天用到歪门邪道上，给管理局做点贡献。”

白粼粼只好站得板板正正的，用爪子按住了那本书的一页，然后开始念：

“章程第384条，管理局内的灰色任务指代人类对于小动物无意义的虐杀行为，而并不是养殖场这种形式的杀生。”

“批注：妖怪不得情绪用事，世界是以人类为主导的，未开智的动物之间也存在自然的食物链，不得干涉。”

白粼粼读了这一条就有些累了，实在是好厚，他只是仰头看了看丹顶鹤，心想这应该可以了吧。

不过就在这时。

丹顶鹤露出了无比欣慰的神色，甚至抬起翅膀摸了摸桌面上蓝羽小鸟的脑袋。

但由于力道没控制好。

白粼粼直接爪子一滑，坐在了桌面上。

“……”

-

与此同时，外面。

宋郁等了大约有半个小时，一辆出租车终于来了，他爷爷从后面下来了，手里提着一个保温盒。

“……这是什么？”

老爷子犹豫了下：“我看家里厨房有昨天定时炖着的猪脚汤……提来了。”

“……”

宋郁拉开了车门，让他爷爷上去了，老人很熟练地把小桌板打开了，保温盒放了上去，只是看了看周遭的环境，然后才问：

“鸟儿什么时候放学？”

或许是福泽心灵，围墙那里倒是真的提前开了门，一个小小的身影啪嗒啪嗒地走出来了，背着小挎包。

宋郁没想到这次这么早，直接开了车门下来了，外面风大，他本来是想让爷爷在上面等的，但老爷子不肯，觉得新奇，也下来了。

一爷一孙就在车边等着接鸟。

白粼粼大摇大摆地往外走着，昂首挺胸的。

但他出来的时候其实是愣了下的。

这怎么爷爷也来了？

鸟微微站定，侧头看了下围墙里面。

很快，丹顶鹤就优雅地迈步出来了，低头看了看地面上毛绒绒的小鸟，很从容地伸着大翅膀给挡着风，从容地带着247走了过去。
chunks.englishText:
After hanging up the phone, Song Zhengguo was filled with heavy thoughts. After all, he had essentially sold his grandson that day... he couldn't help but feel guilty if he didn't say something.

He suffered from insomnia.

In the end, he decided to go out as well. He would go pick up the bird from school.

...

Song Yu originally wanted to refuse, but the next second:

[Grandpa has already called a taxi.]

[I'm on my way.]

Song Yu: "..."

Song Yu had no choice but to send the address. His expression remained dazed as he eventually got out of the car to wait for his grandfather in the cold wind.

-

Inside the Management Bureau.

The bird was dressed in a festive little red cape with a pointed hat, from which hung a small pom-pom that matched the lamb's wool lining—both warm and stylish.

The auntie's handiwork was getting better and better.

Bai Linlin walked *pitter-patter* across the lobby floor, waving his wings and nodding in greeting as he went.

Finally reaching the bird territory, he tossed his little satchel aside, which a nearby mouse immediately caught.

"Go distribute them."

"Wish everyone a Happy New Year for me."

Bai Linlin had already adjusted his mood. He was as high-spirited and vigorous as ever. It didn't matter; the past was in the past. A bird must live in the present!

"247?"

The Red-Crowned Crane appeared out of nowhere. Seeing the little bird on the floor in its new outfit, it waved its wings and said elegantly:

"Come over for the assessment."

Bai Linlin froze, then turned around *pitter-patter*, looking around until a languid voice came from above:

"Stop looking. I’ve sent 001 out on a mission."

"Don't even think about it sneaking you any cheat sheets this time."

The bird: "..."

There was no help for it. The Red-Crowned Crane, tied with a ribbon, walked forward, followed by a little bird dressed like Santa Claus, taking small, *pitter-patter* steps behind it.

In the classroom—

The test papers were handed out. This time, there wasn't even any pre-exam talk; the Red-Crowned Crane just looked down with a serious expression.

*Serious.jpg*

Bai Linlin had transformed. The "youth" sat in the chair, holding a pen, looking up at the Red-Crowned Crane, then at the test paper.

"..."

It was indeed difficult.

Essay question: Please briefly analyze the system of the Monster Management Bureau from the central to local levels. How does it differ from human vertical departments?

Bai Linlin: "..."

The bird didn't know this. The bird skipped it.

Essay question: Please analyze the differences between the "Pass" issued by the central authority and a human "ID card." Why can't monsters apply for an "ID card"?

Bai Linlin lowered his head and gripped his pen tightly.

He refused to believe this.

Skip, next question!

Essay question: Monsters and humans have coexisted harmoniously for thousands of years. How do you view the fact that humans keep pets while also operating many slaughterhouses? How do you understand the meaning of "killing without cruelty"?

Bai Linlin: "..."

What is this!

But just then, the Red-Crowned Crane said:

"247, you actually know how to read."

Bai Linlin’s body stiffened, and he was so startled he transformed back into his original form, all fluffy, his claws pulled in tight.

He looked up at the Red-Crowned Crane.

He shook his head.

The Red-Crowned Crane frowned: "This isn't a criticism. 001 is like an illiterate; come here, come here."

The assessment was interrupted just like that. The Red-Crowned Crane elegantly led the little bird to the office. It walked to the bookshelf and used its wings to pull out a few thick books.

It opened them.

The Red-Crowned Crane extended a wing toward the little bird on the floor: "Come up."

Bai Linlin was still wearing his little red cape and felt quite nervous. He didn't know what was happening, but he flapped his wings and climbed up along the Crane's large wing.

Finally, he reached the desk.

The bird was round and plump, staring at the thick book.

"Come here, read this."

Bai Linlin: "..."

Could he really read this?

But the Red-Crowned Crane was already urging him, saying with a lack of understanding:

"Be generous and open about it. It’s hard enough to find someone with high natural talent; don't spend all your time on crooked paths. Make some contributions to the Bureau."

Bai Linlin had no choice but to stand perfectly straight, press his claw onto a page of the book, and begin to read:

"Article 384 of the Charter: 'Gray tasks' within the Bureau refer to meaningless acts of cruelty by humans toward small animals, and do not refer to the act of killing in the form of livestock farming."

"Annotation: Monsters must not let emotions dictate their actions. The world is human-dominated. A natural food chain exists even among animals that have not gained intelligence; do not interfere."

Bai Linlin felt tired after reading just this one entry—it was so thick. He looked up at the Red-Crowned Crane, thinking this should be enough.

However, at that moment, the Red-Crowned Crane showed an incredibly gratified expression and even reached out a wing to pat the head of the blue-feathered bird on the desk.

But because it didn't control its strength well, Bai Linlin’s claws slipped, and he sat down on the desk.

"..."

-

Meanwhile, outside.

Song Yu had waited for about half an hour when a taxi finally arrived. His grandfather got out from the back, carrying a thermal container.

"...What is this?"

The old man hesitated: "I saw the kitchen had pig trotter soup that was slow-cooking from yesterday... so I brought it."

"..."

Song Yu opened the car door to let his grandfather in. The old man skillfully opened the small table, placed the thermal container on it, looked at the surroundings, and then asked:

"When does the bird get out of school?"

Perhaps it was a stroke of luck, but the door in the wall actually opened early. A small figure walked out *pitter-patter*, carrying a little satchel.

Song Yu hadn't expected him to be this early. He opened the car door and got out. It was windy outside, and he had wanted his grandfather to wait in the car, but the old man refused, finding it novel, and got out too.

The grandfather and grandson waited by the car to pick up the bird.

Bai Linlin walked out swaggeringly, head held high and chest puffed out.

But he froze when he came out.

Why was Grandpa here too?

The bird stood still for a moment and tilted his head to look inside the wall.

Soon, the Red-Crowned Crane stepped out elegantly, looked down at the fluffy little bird on the ground, and calmly extended its large wing to block the wind, leading 247 over with composure.

chunks.chineseText:
第49章

巷子口安安静静的，就是起了点风，天都还没大亮，宋峥国站在路灯那里，看到那鹤后简直是倒吸一口冷气，一个劲地侧头。

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走了过来，身边跟着一个非常优雅的大型涉禽。

丹顶鹤还在伸着翅膀挡着风，看到宋郁很是自然而然地颔了颔首，不过还是瞥了一眼旁边的老头儿，还是有些意外的。

247怪不得无法无天。

两个人来接……

白粼粼板板正正地站在地上，仰头看了看丹顶鹤，然后又去看宋郁，很快就有交谈声了：

“今天粼粼出来得很早，怎么了？是有其他妖怪欺负它吗？”

“……”

“那个，247在家里表现怎么样？”

鸟眯了眯鸟眼，认真倾听。

“非常乖。”

鸟立马伸了伸翅根，神清气爽的。

丹顶鹤闻言一阵沉默，心想这是有多大的滤镜，247在管理局已经成了一堆妖怪的老大了，拉帮结派的，而且就妖力津贴那档子事……这纯粹就是走歪门邪路的。

“……也行。”

丹顶鹤觉得这应该是没救了，也不打算再问下去了，只是回归正题道：

“今天带它出来的早些，主要是想和你说一些事，毕竟你是247的监护人，理应一同商量。”

宋郁站在寒风里，面色平和，从头到尾都没有任何不自在，即使交谈的对象是一只系着丝带的鹤。

反倒是身后的老头儿，从一开始就躲在自己孙子的身后，背了背手，在仰头看旁边的路灯。

这灯，真不错。

这电线杆子，真结实。

……

“妖怪开灵智的时间其实有早有晚，有的从出生起就是小妖怪的，有的则是到垂暮之年才懵懂地步入修行……这个情况下，导致各个妖怪对于人类社会的理解也参差不齐。”

“会认字的妖怪不多，像247这么有天分的更是少见。”

白粼粼站在地面上，鸟眼圆圆的，闻言立马挺胸抬头了起来，很是骄傲。

宋郁还在交流着，语气也很温润：

“是的，它一直都很聪慧。”

“那247是到了家里就会认字的吗？”

白粼粼不由得心虚了起来，翅根都夹紧了，不过好在他们一人一鹤没有太关注这个点，反而是侃侃而谈了起来。

宋郁闻言只是谦逊地道：“它一开始就会，就是那种很复杂的电脑，粼粼也是会开的，看过的密码也能记住。”

“……噢噢，那不得不说，我们鸟界的妖怪就是天资高。”

“我的小鸟确实有天赋。”

一人一鹤彼此暗潮汹涌，最后对视两秒，打成平局。

丹顶鹤只是道：“像247这样有天资的妖怪数量其实很少，按道理是要去中央那里报道培训的，然后直接统辖相应的片区。”

宋郁闻言轻微蹙了下眉。

中央？

“不过它现在年纪太小，我也只是提前告知一下，它今天这个理论考核我打算往后推一推，尽量在247成年的时候再去进行妖力升级，这样更为稳妥一些。”

丹顶鹤的大翅膀一直是盖着地面上的小鸟的，语气也很沉稳。

“主要就是要和你说明一下这件事，并且鸟类不同族群的成年年龄实际上是不同的，像247的话，得一岁半左右……不过它现在是几个月了？”

丹顶鹤说到这里其实也有点困惑来着，快过年了，一堆事堆着，搞得它也有点记不清了。

但就在这时——

“鸟儿还差三个月。”

宋峥国背了背手，很是适时地说了一句，见那鹤看了过来，还咳嗽了几下。

丹顶鹤确实有些意外，这老头子居然记得这么清清楚楚，它瞥了一眼，而后才接着道：

“对，现在是二月了，等到今年五月的时候，247就正式成年了，它的妖力掌控情况我会进行系统的考核，之后我们再进一步地商量它往后的发展。”

宋郁点了点头，垂眸看向地面的小鸟。

白粼粼还穿着红色羊羔绒小披风，圆滚滚的脑袋在帽子里，此刻正仰头看着一人一鹤。

说完了？

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地朝着人的方向走去，转身，站定。

像是完成某种交接仪式。

“行了，那就先这样，别的没什么，带回去吧。”

丹顶鹤在对面说了下，然后就是客套的告别环节，宋郁拉开了车门，宋峥国也低头挥了挥手。

鸟懵懵的，站在地上：“爷爷。”

“你先上。”

宋峥国一把老骨头了，被这么一句话弄得心里暖暖的，但就在这时，不远处就传来一句：

“我们247一直都是很懂事的，别看年纪这么小。”

丹顶鹤意有所指地看了过来。

宋峥国：“是是是。”

之后就是上车环节了，宋峥国没有整那些无用的谦让环节，直接先去车里了，然后伸出来了手，去接地面上的鸟儿。

白粼粼顺顺利利地上了座椅，然后站到了门把手的位置上，用爪子按了下，车窗徐徐落下。

鸟看着外面的丹顶鹤。

挥了挥翅膀。

丹顶鹤抬了抬头，神色温和，敷衍了一下下。

宋郁其实还在外面，侧头看了下车内，很温和地道：

“去坐好，有风。”

车窗被关上了。

白粼粼歪了歪鸟头，心想他们还要说什么，不过就在这时，一股浓郁的香气飘了过来。

鸟立马回头，眼睛亮亮的。

“爷爷给带了猪脚汤，还很热的，要不要驱驱寒？”

“啾！”

-

车外。

“不好意思，我还是想问一下，中央那边的话，应当不是强制性的吧？”

“我想的是，它毕竟还小，可能对于一些事没有什么明确的认知，如果管理局让它任职，它是否有拒绝的权力？”

丹顶鹤其实是愣了下，它没有想到这一层来，不过247那尾巴翘到天上去的样子，也不像是不愿意。

不过它还是很理解人类的顾虑，只是道：

“其实中央选拔还是很严格的。”

“不必焦虑。”

宋郁：“……”

原来是这样。

后面快要分别的时候，丹顶鹤其实也眯了眯鸟眼，想起来一件事，询问了下：

“你觉得我们247怎么样？”

宋郁怔了下：“它很好。”

丹顶鹤优雅地踱步了下，然后看了过来，试探地问：

“我们247化形后的样子……怎么样？”

宋郁莫名觉得有些隐隐的压力，但其实也不清楚从何而来，只是定定地道：

“很好。”

“只是很好？”

“……好看。”

丹顶鹤闻言点了点头，还算有些满意，后面又进一步考验：

“你要知道妖怪是很长情的，我们认定一个人基本就一辈子不会再换，247跟了你……你往后会找另一半吗？”

“虽然有些冒犯，但你也知道……”

“不冒犯。”

丹顶鹤愣了下，看向了对面的人类，破有些期待对方要说什么话。

“我不会找另一半，我只会和我的小鸟在一起。”

宋郁面色平静地道，抬眸看了过去。
chunks.englishText:
The alley entrance was quiet, save for a bit of wind. The sky hadn't fully brightened yet. Song Zhengguo stood by a street lamp, and upon seeing the crane, he gasped and kept turning his head away.

The bird walked over *pitter-patter*, accompanied by a very elegant, large wading bird.

The Red-Crowned Crane was still shielding the bird from the wind with its wing. It nodded naturally at Song Yu, though it glanced at the old man beside him with some surprise.

No wonder 247 was so lawless.

Two people came to pick him up...

Bai Linlin stood perfectly straight on the ground, looking up at the Red-Crowned Crane, then at Song Yu. Soon, voices were heard:

"Linlin came out very early today. What happened? Did other monsters bully him?"

"..."

"Um, how does 247 behave at home?"

The bird narrowed its eyes, listening intently.

"Very well-behaved."

The bird immediately puffed up its feathers, feeling refreshed.

The Red-Crowned Crane fell silent, thinking about how strong the filter must be. 247 had already become the leader of a bunch of monsters at the Bureau, forming cliques, and that whole business with the spirit-power allowance... that was purely walking on crooked paths.

"...That's good."

The Red-Crowned Crane felt there was no saving this, so it didn't intend to ask further, returning to the main topic:

"Bringing him out early today is mainly because I want to discuss some things with you. After all, you are 247's guardian, and it is only right to discuss this together."

Song Yu stood in the cold wind, his expression calm. From start to finish, he showed no discomfort, even though he was conversing with a crane tied with a ribbon.

The old man behind him, however, had been hiding behind his grandson from the start, hands behind his back, looking up at the street lamp.

This lamp was really nice.

This utility pole was really sturdy.

...

"The time it takes for monsters to gain intelligence varies. Some are little monsters from birth, while others only muddle into cultivation in their twilight years... This leads to a disparity in how different monsters understand human society."

"There aren't many monsters who can read. Someone with as much talent as 247 is even rarer."

Bai Linlin stood on the ground, his bird eyes round. Hearing this, he immediately puffed out his chest, looking very proud.

Song Yu continued the conversation, his tone gentle:

"Yes, he has always been very intelligent."

"So, did 247 know how to read as soon as he arrived at your home?"

Bai Linlin couldn't help but feel guilty, his feather roots tightening. Fortunately, the human and the crane didn't focus too much on this point, instead chatting away.

Song Yu replied modestly: "He knew from the beginning. Even complex computers, Linlin knows how to operate them, and he can remember passwords he's seen."

"...Oh, I see. Then I must say, the monsters of our bird world are truly gifted."

"My little bird is indeed talented."

The human and the crane were locked in a subtle, surging undercurrent, and after two seconds of eye contact, it was a draw.

The Red-Crowned Crane simply said: "The number of monsters with talent like 247 is actually very small. By rights, he should report to the central authority for training and then directly govern the corresponding district."

Song Yu frowned slightly at this.

Central authority?

"However, he is still too young, so I am only informing you in advance. I intend to postpone his theoretical assessment and wait until 247 is an adult to conduct the spirit-power upgrade; that would be safer."

The Red-Crowned Crane’s large wing remained covering the little bird on the ground, its tone steady.

"The main point is to explain this to you. Also, the age of adulthood for different bird species actually varies. For 247, it would be around one and a half years old... but how many months is he now?"

The Red-Crowned Crane was actually a bit confused here. With the New Year approaching, a pile of things had piled up, making it lose track.

But just then—

"The bird still has three months to go."

Song Zhengguo said, hands behind his back, at just the right moment. Seeing the crane look over, he coughed a few times.

The Red-Crowned Crane was indeed surprised that the old man remembered so clearly. It glanced at him and continued:

"Right, it is February now. By May of this year, 247 will officially be an adult. I will conduct a systematic assessment of his spirit-power control, and then we can further discuss his future development."

Song Yu nodded, his eyes lowering to look at the little bird on the ground.

Bai Linlin was still wearing his little red lamb's wool cape, his round head tucked into the hood, looking up at the human and the crane.

Are they done?

The bird walked *pitter-patter* toward the human, turned around, and stood still.

It was like completing some kind of handover ceremony.

"Alright, that’s all for now. Nothing else, take him back."

The Red-Crowned Crane spoke, followed by the polite farewells. Song Yu opened the car door, and Song Zhengguo also bowed his head and waved.

The bird was dazed, standing on the ground: "Grandpa."

"You go first."

Song Zhengguo, old bones and all, felt his heart warm at those words. But just then, a voice came from nearby:

"Our 247 has always been very sensible, despite being so young."

The Red-Crowned Crane looked over with a pointed expression.

Song Zhengguo: "Yes, yes, yes."

Then came the boarding process. Song Zhengguo didn't engage in useless displays of modesty; he went straight into the car and then reached out his hand to pick up the bird from the ground.

Bai Linlin successfully got onto the seat, then stood by the door handle, pressing it with his claw. The window rolled down slowly.

The bird looked at the Red-Crowned Crane outside.

He waved his wings.

The Red-Crowned Crane lifted its head, its expression gentle, and gave a perfunctory wave.

Song Yu was still outside. He looked into the car and said gently:

"Sit properly, there's a draft."

The window was closed.

Bai Linlin tilted his head, wondering what else they had to say. But just then, a rich aroma drifted over.

The bird immediately turned around, his eyes shining.

"Grandpa brought pig trotter soup, it's still very hot. Do you want to warm up?"

"Chirp!"

-

Outside the car.

"Excuse me, I still want to ask, the central authority... it shouldn't be mandatory, right?"

"I was thinking, he is still young and may not have a clear understanding of certain things. If the Bureau asks him to take a position, does he have the right to refuse?"

The Red-Crowned Crane was actually stunned. It hadn't considered this layer, but the way 247 held his tail up to the sky didn't look like he was unwilling.

However, it understood human concerns and said:

"Actually, the central selection is very strict."

"No need to be anxious."

Song Yu: "..."

So that was it.

When they were about to part ways, the Red-Crowned Crane narrowed its eyes, remembered something, and asked:

"What do you think of our 247?"

Song Yu was startled: "He is very good."

The Red-Crowned Crane paced elegantly and then looked over, asking tentatively:

"What do you think of... our 247's appearance after transforming?"

Song Yu inexplicably felt a faint pressure, though he didn't know where it came from. He said firmly:

"Very good."

"Just very good?"

"...Beautiful."

The Red-Crowned Crane nodded, seemingly satisfied, and then tested him further:

"You should know that monsters are very long-term. Once we decide on someone, we basically won't change for a lifetime. 247 has followed you... will you look for another partner in the future?"

"Although it is a bit offensive, you know..."

"Not offensive."

The Red-Crowned Crane was stunned, looking at the human opposite, somewhat expecting what he would say.

"I will not look for another partner. I will only be with my little bird."

Song Yu said, his expression calm as he looked up.

chunks.chineseText:
巷子口凉风阵阵的，一人一鹤这么站着，一方坦诚，一方揣摩。

丹顶鹤：“可你的寿命注定没有247长，值得吗？”

它需要进一步地试探。

虽然目前来看，这个监护人是百里挑一的，但是……流程还是要走一下的。

俗话说的好，奋力抵抗远不如欲拒还迎来得妙……如果这个监护人真的对它们247没意思，那压住也变得枯燥无味。

丹顶鹤觉得自己需要考察一下。

但没有说放弃“强制”的意思。

“没有别的办法么？”

宋郁语气平直地问，神色自然。

丹顶鹤一愣，这什么意思？

“有办法吗？我愿意付出所有代价，和我的小鸟厮守一生。”

-

车内。

白粼粼已经化形成“少年”的样子了，拿着汤勺在吃饭，唇瓣都很是水润。

好吃好吃！

“鸟儿在里头都学些什么啊？”

宋峥国进了车里就舒展多了，眼前没有那只鹤了，压力也少了不少，还是他们家的鸟儿可爱些。

白粼粼伸了伸腿，歪头看向旁边的老人，思考了下：

“我会得可多了！”

椅子上砰得一下出现了只毛绒绒的小鸟，低头转圈开始展示：

变豚鼠。

变黑色猫猫。

一样的流程。

“好好好……是学到好东西了，也不枉鸟儿夜里那么认真学习。”

白粼粼仰了仰鸟头，接受夸赞，不过他灵光一闪，想起来一件事：

“爷爷，我还会变其他人！”

鸟又开始啪嗒啪嗒地转圈，不过这个时候车门打开了，外面寒风阵阵，宋郁站在外面，看到后座的场景其实是愣了下的。

里面开了车内灯，小桌板上保温盒还冒着热气，他爷爷在里侧眉目和蔼，他的小鸟在座椅上转圈圈。

“宋郁？”

白粼粼前摇被打断了，于是就没有展示变其他人的表演了，化形成了自己的模样，抬头看了过去。

宋郁这才微微回了回神，他刚想说话，座椅上的“少年”就像是想起来什么一样，伸出来了胳膊。

拥抱。

宋郁身体先一步反应，弯腰，垂眸，抬手揽住，微微埋头。

等到做完这一套，一人一鸟才反应过来什么，纷纷地回头看了过去。

宋峥国：“……”

老头拘谨。

-

一直等到开回锦园，车内还保持着微妙的沉默，白粼粼面色泛红，又不想突兀地变鸟，因为会显得他做贼心虚。

说到底还是不是宋郁的错？

非要求每次分开要抱，回来也要抱，他养成习惯了。

“……”

两人一鸟各有各的心事，但好在是顺顺利利地下了车，进了门，然后宋郁就想拉着“人”上楼去，但被拦住了。

“那个那个，小郁，你过来。”

白粼粼站在楼梯边处，其实有些不知所措，有种很奇怪的氛围，但他并不不清楚自己是扮演的什么角色，只是不由自主地跟着宋郁走了一步。

老头立马解释：

“没事没事，爷爷就是有点事和他说说，现在才五点半，去楼上睡一会？”

“早上是祥云阁的早茶，爷爷待会叫你？”

白粼粼脑子抽了下：

“可是猪脚汤……”

宋峥国一下子反应过来了，立马去餐桌那里把保温盒给拿了过来，自顾自地说：

“是爷爷太粗心了，我给忘了。”

“你自己上楼喝能行吗？”

白粼粼张了张口，其实面色都红了，抬手接了过来。

“我送他上去。”

宋峥国一个没看住，宋郁就直接牵着“人”的手腕上楼了，很是自然与坦荡。

“……”

看得这么紧。

这是随了谁……

-

卧室。

白粼粼其实有点尴尬，进门就说话了：

“我觉得爷爷……对我有误解。”

“我没那么……”

白粼粼被牵到了书桌那里，这次他长记性了，当机立断自己坐在了椅子上，抱着保温盒。

宋郁抬了下眉，不过还是道：

“没事，他觉得你小。”

“可是我——”

“你就是小，不用想别的，爷爷觉得你小，会疼你的。”

白粼粼听到这话，莫名耳根子都红了，侧了侧头。

宋郁唇角微微向上抿了下，随后只是俯身蹲下，握住了“人”的手腕，平和地道：

“现在还早，一会儿困了就去睡觉。”

“我下去和爷爷说些话，嗯？”

白粼粼脑子浑浑噩噩的，耳垂很红，回复了句：

“噢。”

-

十五分钟后，宋郁才从楼上下来了，直接去了茶室。

他其实心里已经有了个估计，爷爷是个传统保守的人，不接受也很正常。

宋郁面色归于平静，抬手推开了门。

老头儿正在里面来回踱步，见到人来了才眼睛一亮，连忙招了招手。

“过来过来，小郁。”

宋郁走了过去，深呼一口气，最后只是抬眸道：

“爷爷，我……”

宋峥国先一步开口了：

“爷爷其实把你给卖了。”

宋郁面色出现了巨大的茫然。

“啊？”

-

宋峥国其实心里惴惴不安很久了，毕竟他年纪这么大了，却一不小心被那鹤给套路了，这说出去也不好听。

其实他想过同孙子坦白。

但一直也没有时机。

这次倒是合适。

“小郁，那鹤我们惹不起，妖怪且不说能力高深，我那老友说了，还有各种各样的机构。”

“宋家是家大业大，但说到底，比不上人家管理局……”

宋峥国蹙着眉，开始认真地分析：

“鸟儿才五个月大就被咱们带回来了，这本来就不占理，我就替你保证了，往后得一直养着鸟儿，绝对不背叛……”

说到这里，老人有点心虚，语调都弱了下来：

“但是这……被那鹤录下来了。”

宋郁面色还是很恍惚，是说的上次丹顶鹤来家里的事？

宋峥国一看孙子没反应，他也有点着急，又补充道：

“但这个情况我也去问平云了，就是爷爷的那个好友，他说了，妖怪对约定是很重视的，基本无法违反，甚至对于违反的人类会……反正就是不大好。”

宋峥国也很是无奈：

“他还说，妖怪喜欢人类，要么是吃了，要么就是当成配偶。”

“但鸟儿估计不吃你。”

宋郁还在状况外，他爷爷原来这么多事都没和他说……

“那、那我估计就是把你卖了。”

“只能当配偶了。”

茶室里一阵安静。

老头也是闭了闭眼，接受审判。

但过了一秒两秒——

“只是这件事吗？”

宋郁调整了一下心绪，拧眉询问。

老头睁开眼，这才斟酌地商量道：

“确切地说，就这一件，但也不知道妖怪那边是怎么看待的这个‘约定’……你往后……还找对象吗？”

“我不找，我要养我的小鸟。”

宋峥国松了一口气，这样还好还好，他不算千古罪人，自己当时也没说错，小郁本来就是个负责任的好孩子。

“……但是爷爷还是有错。”
chunks.englishText:
The alley entrance was filled with gusts of cool wind. One man and one crane stood there—one side candid and sincere, the other probing and calculating.

Red-Crowned Crane: "But your lifespan is destined to be shorter than 247's. Is it worth it?"

It needed to probe further.

Although, from the current perspective, this guardian was one in a hundred, the... necessary procedures still had to be followed.

As the saying goes, putting up a fierce resistance is far less effective than playing hard to get. If this guardian truly had no interest in their 247, then forcing the issue would become dull and tasteless.

The Red-Crowned Crane felt it needed to conduct an assessment.

But that didn't mean it had given up on the idea of "compulsion."

"Is there no other way?"

Song Yu asked in a flat tone, his expression natural.

The Red-Crowned Crane was stunned. What did that mean?

"Is there a way? I am willing to pay any price to spend my life with my little bird."

-

Inside the car.

Bai Linlin had already transformed into his "youth" form. He was holding a soup spoon, eating, his lips glistening and moist.

*Delicious, delicious!*

"What do birds learn when they're inside?"

Song Zhengguo felt much more relaxed once he entered the car. Without that crane in sight, the pressure had lifted significantly. Their own bird was much cuter, after all.

Bai Linlin stretched his legs, tilted his head to look at the old man, and thought for a moment:

"I know so many things!"

*Poof!* A fluffy little bird appeared on the seat, lowered its head, and began to spin around to show off:

Transforming into a guinea pig.

Transforming into a black cat.

The same routine.

"Good, good... You've learned some good things. It wasn't in vain that you studied so diligently at night, little bird."

Bai Linlin tilted his bird head, accepting the praise. However, a flash of inspiration hit him, and he remembered something:

"Grandpa, I can also turn into other people!"

The bird began to patter around in circles again. Just then, the car door opened. Cold wind gusted in from outside. Song Yu was standing there, and he was actually stunned by the scene in the backseat.

The interior lights were on, the thermal lunch box on the small table was still steaming, his grandfather was sitting on the inner side with a kind expression, and his little bird was spinning in circles on the seat.

"Song Yu?"

Bai Linlin’s "pre-performance" was interrupted, so he didn't showcase the transformation into other people. He shifted back into his own human form and looked up.

Song Yu finally regained his composure. Just as he was about to speak, the "youth" on the seat seemed to remember something and reached out his arms.

A hug.

Song Yu’s body reacted before his mind did. He bent over, lowered his gaze, raised his arms to wrap them around the youth, and buried his head slightly.

Only after completing the motion did the man and the bird realize what had happened, and both turned to look over.

Song Zhengguo: "..."

The old man felt awkward.

-

By the time they drove back to Jin Yuan, a subtle silence still hung in the car. Bai Linlin’s face was flushed, and he didn't want to abruptly turn back into a bird, as that would make him look guilty.

When it came down to it, wasn't it Song Yu’s fault?

He insisted on a hug every time they parted and every time they returned, so he had gotten into the habit.

"..."

The two men and one bird each had their own thoughts, but fortunately, they got out of the car smoothly and entered the house. Song Yu wanted to pull "the person" upstairs, but he was blocked.

"That, that, Xiao Yu, come here."

Bai Linlin stood by the stairs, feeling a bit at a loss. There was a strange atmosphere, and though he didn't quite understand what role he was playing, he had followed Song Yu instinctively.

The old man immediately explained:

"It's nothing, nothing. Grandpa just has something to discuss with him. It’s only 5:30 now, why don't you go upstairs and sleep for a while?"

"We’re having morning tea at Xiangyun Pavilion tomorrow, shall Grandpa call you then?"

Bai Linlin’s brain short-circuited for a second:

"But the pork trotter soup..."

Song Zhengguo reacted instantly, hurried over to the dining table to grab the thermal lunch box, and muttered to himself:

"It’s Grandpa being too careless, I forgot."

"Can you drink it yourself upstairs?"

Bai Linlin opened his mouth, his face already flushed, and reached out to take it.

"I'll take him up."

Before Song Zhengguo could stop him, Song Yu had already taken the "person's" wrist and headed upstairs, looking completely natural and open.

"..."

Watching him so closely.

Who did he take after...

-

In the bedroom.

Bai Linlin actually felt a bit embarrassed. As soon as they entered, he spoke:

"I think Grandpa... has a misunderstanding about me."

"I'm not that..."

Bai Linlin was led to the desk. This time, he learned his lesson and decisively sat in the chair, hugging the thermal lunch box.

Song Yu raised an eyebrow, but still said:

"It's fine. He thinks you're young."

"But I—"

"You *are* young. Don't think about anything else. Grandpa thinks you're young, so he’ll dote on you."

Hearing this, Bai Linlin’s ears turned inexplicably red, and he turned his head away.

Song Yu’s lips curled up slightly. He then leaned down, squatted, held the "person's" wrist, and said peacefully:

"It's still early. If you get sleepy later, just go to bed."

"I'll go downstairs and have a word with Grandpa, hmm?"

Bai Linlin’s mind was in a daze, his earlobes burning red, and he replied:

"Oh."

-

Fifteen minutes later, Song Yu came down from upstairs and went straight to the tea room.

He actually had a guess in his heart. His grandfather was a traditional and conservative man; it was normal for him not to accept it.

Song Yu’s expression returned to calm as he pushed open the door.

The old man was pacing back and forth inside. Seeing him arrive, his eyes lit up, and he beckoned him over.

"Come here, come here, Xiao Yu."

Song Yu walked over, took a deep breath, and finally looked up:

"Grandpa, I..."

Song Zhengguo spoke first:

"Grandpa actually sold you out."

A look of utter bewilderment appeared on Song Yu’s face.

"Huh?"

-

Song Zhengguo had been feeling anxious for a long time. After all, he was so old, yet he had been tricked by that crane. It didn't sound good if word got out.

He had actually thought about confessing to his grandson.

But there had never been a right time.

This time, it was appropriate.

"Xiao Yu, we can't afford to provoke that crane. Not to mention the supernatural abilities of a demon, my old friend told me there are all sorts of organizations out there."

"The Song family is wealthy and influential, but when it comes down to it, we can't compare to the Management Bureau..."

Song Zhengguo frowned and began to analyze seriously:

"The bird was only five months old when we brought it back. We were already in the wrong, so I promised on your behalf that we would raise the bird forever and never betray it..."

Speaking of this, the old man felt a bit guilty, and his tone softened:

"But this... was recorded by that crane."

Song Yu’s expression was still dazed. Was he talking about the time the Red-Crowned Crane came to the house?

Seeing his grandson didn't react, Song Zhengguo grew anxious and added:

"But I asked Pingyun about this situation—that’s my old friend—and he said that demons take promises very seriously. They basically cannot be broken, and for humans who break them... well, it’s not good."

Song Zhengguo was very helpless:

"He also said that when demons like humans, they either eat them or take them as mates."

"But the bird probably won't eat you."

Song Yu was still out of the loop. He hadn't realized his grandfather had kept so many things from him...

"Then, I guess I sold you out."

"You can only be its mate."

The tea room fell silent.

The old man closed his eyes, waiting for judgment.

But after one second, two seconds—

"Is that the only thing?"

Song Yu adjusted his mood and asked, frowning.

The old man opened his eyes and then deliberated:

"To be precise, just this one thing. But I don't know how the demon side views this 'promise'... Will you... still look for a partner in the future?"

"I won't. I'm going to raise my little bird."

Song Zhengguo breathed a sigh of relief. That was fine, that was fine. He wasn't a sinner through the ages. He hadn't been wrong at the time; Xiao Yu was a responsible, good child after all.

"…But Grandpa was still wrong."

chunks.chineseText:
他叹了口气，妖怪毕竟是要比人厉害的，宋家有再多的财富都会显得微不足道，这么一个承诺。

算是彻底绑定了。

宋峥国只是认真地道：“今天车里，鸟儿看起来很依赖你……你要对它好，这是一方面。当然主要的是，那鹤会来定期考察。”

“……”

老人家很是担忧，叹了口气讲：

“我其实没有想过什么，只盼着你快乐健康的，但爷爷这次，真是给你添了大麻烦，为难你了……”

一秒，两秒。

“不为难。”

-

年关一过，劈里啪啦的爆竹一响，农历新年就红红火火地来了。

白粼粼这才是真正意义地上发现自己“重生”了，那些过去的灰色日子一去不复返，往后的生活只会是多姿多彩。

鸟一共收到了两百多个红包，此刻正在一一清点着，宋郁的，爷爷的，陈爷爷的，阿姨的……这些都不必说了，是鸟稳定的收入来源。

后面就是管理局那里的，丹顶鹤给了大红包，然后剩余的是妖怪们集体团建，互相给红包，白粼粼发出去不少，但也收了很多，零零散散一百多个，一个里面最高是五块。

噢噢，001给得多，放了九十九块。

鸟眯了眯眼，很好很好。

好朋鸟！

再之后的，就是锦园的邻居们了，宋郁似乎是时隔多年再出来拜年，主要是因为爷爷身体恢复得很好，精气神也不错，几乎每到一家都会聊一会天。

鸟获得了不少夸赞。

当然还有成倍的小红包。

白粼粼用爪子数了数，发现这里有粗略二十多个红包。

宋郁的也是他的。

鸟坦坦荡荡地收下了。

此次新年，收获颇丰。

到了四月份的时候，鸟过了第一个“纪念日”。

宋郁相当重视这一天，甚至还买了蛋糕，上面是个圆滚滚的“蓝羽小鸟”造型，白粼粼在餐桌上啪嗒啪嗒地走着，参观ing。

“粼粼来家里一年整了。”

宋峥国闻言也是欣慰，拿出来了准备好的礼物，正儿八经的金镯子，反正现在鸟儿也会化形了，可以戴的。

白粼粼化形成了“少年”模样，面色红红的，决定开始才艺展示。

他学会了如何让除监护人以外的人看到妖力的涌动。

金线犹如烟花一样在掌心飞溅，像是一个小小的造景。

“我们鸟儿真厉害呀！”

宋峥国很是不吝啬自己的夸奖。

日子一天天地往前推移，不知不觉就到了五月份，天气逐步回暖，万物复苏。

白粼粼越来越有家庭成员的意识了，后面就再也没有问过宋郁找不找对象的事了，反正都是需要鸟把把关的。

本来就应该是这样！

白粼粼后面还蹭了个宋郁的生日，那天其实很寻常，鸟化形之后就在家里帮忙，主要是跟着爷爷在厨房里做长寿面。

长长的一条。

鸟负责吃掉断掉的失败品。

“生日快乐！”

人进门的时候愣了下，而后就是归于平和，他们吃了很简单的一顿饭。

一朝一夕，岁岁年年。

白粼粼完全适应了在宋家的生活，不仅本体变得羽毛顺滑蓬松，就连化形之后的样子也愈发的有气色。

鸟的生活节奏很好，一周去一次基地，其余时间跟着001出去做做任务，练习下新的技能，剩余的时间就是在家里巡视领地。

宋峥国已经画了一整套花鸟图了，这会儿在书房还在动笔，问了下在砚台上梳理羽毛的某只：

“爷爷给鸟儿办个展怎么样？”

白粼粼：“……”

宋峥国越想越觉得合理，然后很是利落地在宣纸上收了下笔锋，又是一幅蓝羽小鸟写生图，浅蓝到深蓝，自然晕染开来，不过相较于最早的几副图，倒是变得蓬松了不少。

“小郁待会回来，我和他商量一下，应该是可行的，都让别人看看我们鸟儿！”

老头儿挥了挥手，很是洒脱道。

白粼粼直接化形成了“少年”，坐在了椅子上，抬起胳膊就趴在了桌面上，很闷闷地道：

“不好吧爷爷，这全部都是我。”

修长的手指蜷了蜷。

有点不好意思。

宋峥国还在欣赏自己的画作，好似是什么很雅的内容，但实际上就是一个砚台上站着只圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟。

“这是鸟儿的画展，当然都要是你的！”

白粼粼闻言一阵沉默，他看了看书房墙上的东西……各色各样的写生，冰箱上的他，盘子上的他，荡秋千的他，站在毛笔上的他……

圆滚滚的，着实不太雅致。

不过爷爷好像画入迷了。

宋峥国看了看时间，提醒道：

“八点了，快去睡觉吧，小郁过会儿要回来了。”

白粼粼在桌面上趴着的，闻言只是叹了口气，宋郁现在除了上课，还要去公司，完了还要……监控他睡觉。

不就是前几天通宵打游戏了。

“……”

“少年”最后砰得一下化成小鸟，毛绒绒地朝着门口走了，拱开门缝的时候还没忘了对里面的老人挥翅膀：

“爷爷，我走了。”

“好好，去吧。”

-

八点半左右，锦园外传来动静。

西服革履的少年推开了门，直接去了书房，看到了满屋子的书画，也只是抬了抬眉，然后才问了句：

“睡了么？”

宋峥国只是收了笔杆，坐在椅子上，笑着摇了摇头：

“才回去。”

“怎么样？”

宋郁成长的速度超乎想象，面色平稳又从容，说了下目前华秉一个业务的展开情况，顺带提及了一些管理上的问题。

“很好，但其实也不用那么累……”

宋峥国其实还是想劝一劝的，但是根本不起作用，这孩子下一句就是：

“那我先走了？我去卧室看看。”

“……”

宋峥国最后只是摇了摇头。

等到门关上的时候，书房才又归于安静，但就在这个时候，窗户那里却传来一阵很有规律的震动。

仿佛由远及近，有什么东西在涌动而来。

宋峥国蹙了蹙眉，不由得转头看了过去，数千条金线穿过了玻璃，交缠在一起，最后堆叠成流动的布帛。

老头儿以为自己老眼昏花了，但下一秒，那个布帛上显露出来了字：

[今夜子时，特来赠礼。]

[——丹顶鹤。]

宋峥国心里一咯噔。

-

卧室里。

宋郁把西服给脱了，搭在了椅子那里，走到了床边，低头看了过去，“少年”它喜欢用人形睡觉，脸颊埋在枕头里，有些清清浅浅的呼吸传来。

大约是看了一会。

“粼粼，成年了。”
chunks.englishText:
He sighed. Demons were, after all, more powerful than humans. No matter how much wealth the Song family had, it would seem insignificant in the face of such a promise.

They were completely bound.

Song Zhengguo just said earnestly: "In the car today, the bird seemed very dependent on you... You must treat it well; that’s one aspect. Of course, mainly, that crane will come for regular inspections."

"..."

The old man was very worried and sighed:

"I actually didn't think of anything else, only hoping for you to be happy and healthy. But this time, Grandpa has really caused you a big problem and put you in a difficult position..."

One second, two seconds.

"It's not a difficult position."

-

Once the year passed and the firecrackers popped and crackled, the Lunar New Year arrived in a blaze of red.

Only now did Bai Linlin truly discover that he had been "reborn." Those gray days of the past were gone forever, and the future would only be colorful.

The bird received over two hundred red envelopes in total. At this moment, he was counting them one by one: Song Yu’s, Grandpa’s, Grandpa Chen’s, the auntie’s... these went without saying; they were the bird’s stable source of income.

Then there were the ones from the Management Bureau. The Red-Crowned Crane had given a big red envelope, and the rest were from the demons’ collective team-building event where they exchanged envelopes. Bai Linlin had given out quite a few, but he had also received many—scattered, over a hundred of them, with the highest being five yuan each.

Oh, oh, 001 gave a lot; he put in ninety-nine yuan.

The bird squinted his eyes. Very good, very good.

Good bird friend!

After that, there were the neighbors in Jin Yuan. Song Yu seemed to have come out to pay New Year’s visits for the first time in many years, mainly because his grandfather’s health had recovered well and he was in high spirits. They would chat for a while at almost every house.

The bird received a lot of praise.

And, of course, double the small red envelopes.

Bai Linlin counted with his claws and found there were roughly twenty-something envelopes here.

Song Yu’s were also his.

The bird accepted them with a clear conscience.

This New Year, the harvest was bountiful.

By April, the bird had passed his first "anniversary."

Song Yu took this day quite seriously, even buying a cake with a round "Blue-Feathered Little Bird" design on it. Bai Linlin was walking *patter-patter* on the dining table, visiting it.

"It’s been exactly one year since Linlin came to our home."

Hearing this, Song Zhengguo was also gratified and brought out the gift he had prepared—a proper gold bracelet. Since the bird could transform now, he could wear it.

Bai Linlin transformed into his "youth" form, his face flushed, and decided to start a talent show.

He had learned how to let people other than his guardian see the surge of demon power.

Golden threads splashed in his palms like fireworks, looking like a tiny landscape.

"Our bird is truly amazing!"

Song Zhengguo was not stingy with his praise.

Days moved forward one by one. Before they knew it, it was May, the weather was gradually warming up, and everything was coming back to life.

Bai Linlin had more and more of a sense of being a family member. Later on, he never asked Song Yu again about looking for a partner; in any case, the bird would have to be the one to vet them.

It should have been like that from the start!

Bai Linlin later also tagged along for Song Yu’s birthday. That day was actually quite ordinary. After the bird transformed, he helped out at home, mainly following Grandpa to make longevity noodles in the kitchen.

Long, long strands.

The bird was responsible for eating the broken, failed pieces.

"Happy Birthday!"

When the man walked through the door, he was stunned for a moment, and then his expression returned to peace. They ate a very simple meal.

Day by day, year after year.

Bai Linlin had completely adapted to life in the Song family. Not only had his original form’s feathers become smooth and fluffy, but his transformed appearance also looked increasingly vibrant.

The bird’s life rhythm was excellent. He went to the base once a week, spent the rest of the time going out on missions with 001 to practice new skills, and used the remaining time to patrol his territory at home.

Song Zhengguo had already painted a whole set of flower-and-bird pictures. Right now, he was still working in the study and asked the one grooming feathers on the inkstone:

"How about Grandpa holds an exhibition for the bird?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

The more Song Zhengguo thought about it, the more reasonable it seemed. He then neatly finished his brushwork on the rice paper—another sketch of the blue-feathered little bird, from light blue to deep blue, naturally blended. However, compared to the first few paintings, it had become much fluffier.

"Xiao Yu will be back later. I’ll discuss it with him. It should be feasible. Let everyone see our bird!"

The old man waved his hand, looking very carefree.

Bai Linlin transformed directly into his "youth" form, sat in the chair, raised his arms, and slumped onto the desk, saying quite gloomily:

"That’s not good, Grandpa. These are all me."

His slender fingers curled.

He was a bit embarrassed.

Song Zhengguo was still admiring his painting, as if it were some very elegant content, but in reality, it was just a round, blue-feathered little bird standing on an inkstone.

"This is the bird’s art exhibition, of course it should all be you!"

Bai Linlin fell silent. He looked at the things on the walls of the study... all kinds of sketches: him on the refrigerator, him on a plate, him on a swing, him standing on a calligraphy brush...

Round and chubby, it really wasn't very elegant.

But Grandpa seemed to be obsessed with painting.

Song Zhengguo checked the time and reminded him:

"It’s eight o'clock, go to sleep quickly. Xiao Yu will be back soon."

Bai Linlin, who was slumped on the desk, just sighed when he heard this. Besides attending classes, Song Yu now had to go to the company, and after that, he had to... monitor his sleep.

It was just because he had stayed up all night playing games a few days ago.

"..."

The "youth" finally *poofed* into a little bird, walked fluffily toward the door, and didn't forget to wave his wings at the old man while pushing open the door crack:

"Grandpa, I’m going."

"Alright, alright, go ahead."

-

Around 8:30, there was movement outside Jin Yuan.

The youth in a suit pushed open the door and went straight to the study. He saw the room full of paintings and calligraphy, raised an eyebrow, and then asked:

"Is he asleep?"

Song Zhengguo just put down his brush, sat in the chair, and shook his head with a smile:

"He just went back."

"How is it going?"

Song Yu’s growth rate was beyond imagination. With a steady and composed expression, he talked about the current expansion of a Huabing business project and mentioned some management issues along the way.

"Very good, but actually, you don't have to be so tired..."

Song Zhengguo actually wanted to persuade him, but it was of no use. The child’s next sentence was:

"Then I’ll go first? I’ll go to the bedroom and check on him."

"..."

Song Zhengguo finally just shook his head.

When the door closed, the study returned to silence. But just at that moment, a rhythmic vibration came from the window.

As if moving from afar to near, something was surging over.

Song Zhengguo frowned and couldn't help but turn his head to look. Thousands of golden threads passed through the glass, intertwined, and finally piled up into flowing fabric.

The old man thought his eyes were playing tricks on him, but the next second, words appeared on the fabric:

[At midnight tonight, I come to bring a gift.]

[——Red-Crowned Crane.]

Song Zhengguo’s heart skipped a beat.

-

In the bedroom.

Song Yu took off his suit jacket, draped it over the chair, and walked to the bedside. He looked down. The "youth" liked to sleep in human form, his cheeks buried in the pillow, and some soft, shallow breathing came from him.

He watched for a while.

"Linlin, you've come of age."

chunks.chineseText:
第50章

床上的“少年”发出了点气音，似乎是被吵醒了，白粼粼隐约觉得额头被抵了下，很亲昵的感觉。

有点像小时候……

夜灯是开着的，暖黄色的光线，他的视野也逐步变得清晰，慢慢发现床边来人了。

对方撑着手臂，在看他。

白粼粼觉得被子很是暖和，本来是想要再缩进去一些的，但是余光里的人影存在感实在太强了。

他瞥了一眼，闷声闷气地道：

“你回来了？”

“嗯。”

宋郁语气温和，只是又轻声问：

“今天在家里……”

但这句话还没有说完，“少年”就直接抬起手臂勾住了他的脖子，语气含糊不清的，似乎是在说：

“抱。”

宋郁身子微微僵住了，偏偏床上的“人”还在半梦半醒地问：

“不是要抱吗？”

卧室里安安静静的。

宋郁的手背微微凸起了些青筋，他身子往下倾，只是顺着“人”的意思道：

“嗯。”

白粼粼完成任务很快就又坠入梦里了，他穿的是睡衣，手臂上的布料早就堆叠到肘关节了，至于环住的人也忘记放开了。

后面迷迷糊糊觉得不舒服了，才抬手去推。

宋郁扣住了那个手腕。

不由得摩挲了两下。

“我不吵你了。”

床上的“少年”也不知道是听到了还是没听到，只是没再蹙眉了，侧了侧头，很快就又睡着了。

宋郁本来是打算再看一会儿的，但是门口这个时候传来了很轻的叩门声，他只好先起身往那边走了。

-

门外是宋峥国，老人家这个时候面色很是凝重，急得团团转。

见到孙子出来先是探头看了下房间内，轻声询问道：

“我没把鸟儿吵醒吧？”

宋郁抬手带上了门，很是平和地道：

“没有，它睡了。”

“怎么了爷爷？”

宋峥国闻言只是深吸一口气，觉得走廊也不是个说话的地方，于是二人转移到了书房。

“坏了。”

宋郁衣服还没有换，上身是服帖的衬衫，正在抬手摘自己的腕表，听到这话蹙了蹙眉，什么事这么严重？

华秉运转一切正常。

就连S州那里他父亲也没有作妖。

按道理是——

“那鹤今晚要过来！”

宋郁闻言动作一顿，面色有些不可思议。

“什么？”

-

妖怪管理局内此刻灯火通明，过年时期的彩灯装置还没有撤，大厅连接各个活动区域的走廊里还泛着流动的金色纹路，有此起彼伏的交谈声。

“你放年假了？”

“对，好不容易回来了，确实是太累了。”

“我也是，自治区那里简直是什么好吃的都没有，749局就知道提供泡面和火腿肠……”

“今年管理局好像收纳了不少小妖怪？”

……

001在沙发上坐着，一身黑，修长的手指拆开了一个棒棒糖，塞进了自己嘴巴里，腮帮子很快鼓起来了。

草莓味道的。

管理局今天很是热闹，因为那些去年出差做任务的妖怪们回来了，它们大多也没有监护人，几乎全部是S级以上的，户籍是在南市，所以度假会回来。

001算是年纪比较小的，它没有出差过，因而也没有什么话可以聊。

不过……

小雀思考，它旅游过。

但就在这时——

“001？”

丹顶鹤的声音从背后传来，黑衣少年立马砰得一下化成原型，毛绒绒的，正襟危坐的，不过爪子还捏着那个棒棒糖的棍子。

“……”

丹顶鹤叹了口气，只是招了招翅膀，对着沙发上的小雀道：

“过来，商量一些事。”

001圆滚滚的，低着鸟头看了看棒棒糖，很斟酌地用喙叼了起来，放到了刚才拆开的包装袋里，收了收翅膀，打算待会回来吃。

……

大厅的历史回廊那里已经有些妖了，大多都是人形，不过有的会额外保留自己喜欢的特征。

灰色头发的“少年”正在仰头看着那副巨大的红底照，手指尖窜出来根根分明的刺；旁边有个正在垂眸整理自己发钗的女士，一身修身黑衣，眼尾有泛着金光的鳞片；而正在和丹顶鹤交流的……是一个狐头人形的妖，穿着古代衣服，眼睛眯成了缝，好似亲和，但又有压迫感。

001是年纪最小的S级，此刻已经化成人形跟了过来，面色认真，听着它们的交谈。

“是吗？那这个小妖看来着实有天赋。”

丹顶鹤也是点头，然后又接着道：

“它年纪是比较小的，原来在秋水巷的花鸟市场那里，不过被一个少年带走了，也就是它现在的监护人。”

“就是照片上的。”

旁边的刺猬妖很是认真地端详，不由自主地想要用手去碰一下，但它忘记了自己化出来刺了，就在这时——

001直接挡了过去，面色认真地道：

“不要弄坏。”

“……”

刺猬妖“切”了下，然后乖顺地站在旁边了，听着旁边的二妖讲话，打了个哈欠。

“它的监护人是南市的首富？独孙么？”

狐狸妖眯了眯眼，颇有些好奇。

“是的，并且749局的专员，是同247的家里人认识的。”

丹顶鹤很是认真地补充了信息，顺带点明了今天的事：

“眼下247刚好成年，我们管理局历来都有赠礼的传统，但这次情况比较特殊，我是想着……”

狐狸妖大致理解了信息，只是悠悠地道：

“我明白。”

“749局的人都和宋家有关系，我们管理局自然是不能落后……和人类有地位的人处好关系，看来是相当有必要的。”

狐狸眼尾弯弯，很是有些邪性。

它歪了歪头。

“赠礼……金银财宝恐是不够，倒不如用法器？”

-

[赠礼]

原本是只出现在有监护人的小妖怪上，管理局历年的传统是赠予一些小东西，大多是驱除灾病的小法器，附着在一些具体的物件上。

玩偶，笔，口琴……

是根据档案里监护人的信息而调整的。

但247现在实际上是个特例。

一来它的妖力等级已经在逐步上升了，现在只差考核了，其实对于S级来说只是临门一脚。

二来它的监护人社会身份相当高，甚至可以说是南市有名的权贵了，社会网络宽泛，甚至同749局的人都有关联，不容小觑。

三来它有着惊人的人类文化天赋，是目前管理局最有希望去中央培训的一个对象，实在是要重视起来。

缘于此。

丹顶鹤慎重地道：

“必须要气派一些，要给247撑撑场面。”

狐妖很自然地招了招手，把管理局内的小妖怪都汇集到了一起，弯腰笑眯眯地道：

“要建言献策。”

底下的小妖怪们窃窃私语的，有几个踊跃发言：

“赠礼……那、那我们可以一起去吗？”

“给老大长长脸！”

“对对对！”

狐妖歪了下头，倒是没有想到历史回廊里圆滚滚的鸟儿居然是个老大。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 50

The "young man" on the bed let out a soft, breathy sound, seemingly stirred from his slumber. Bai Linlin felt a vague sensation of something pressing against his forehead—a feeling of intimate closeness.

It felt a bit like when he was a child...

The night light was on, casting a warm, amber glow. His vision gradually cleared, and he slowly realized that someone had come to the bedside.

The person was propped up on their arms, watching him.

Bai Linlin felt the quilt was incredibly warm and initially wanted to burrow further into it, but the presence of the figure in his peripheral vision was simply too overwhelming.

He cast a glance over and mumbled in a muffled voice:

"You're back?"

"Mm."

Song Yu’s tone was gentle, but he asked softly again:

"At home today..."

Before the sentence could be finished, the "young man" reached out and hooked his arms around Song Yu’s neck, his voice slurred and indistinct, as if saying:

"Hug."

Song Yu’s body stiffened slightly, yet the "person" on the bed was still asking in a half-dreaming, half-waking state:

"Didn't you want a hug?"

The bedroom was quiet.

A faint vein pulsed on the back of Song Yu’s hand. He leaned down, simply following the "person's" wishes:

"Mm."

Having completed his task, Bai Linlin quickly drifted back into his dreams. He was wearing pajamas, and the fabric on his arms had long since bunched up to his elbows. As for the person he was encircling, he had forgotten to let go.

Only when he felt uncomfortable in his dazed state did he lift a hand to push away.

Song Yu caught that wrist.

He couldn't help but rub it twice.

"I won't disturb you anymore."

Whether the "young man" on the bed heard him or not, he stopped furrowing his brows, tilted his head, and was soon fast asleep again.

Song Yu had intended to watch for a while longer, but a very light knock sounded at the door, forcing him to get up and head toward it.

-

Outside the door stood Song Zhengguo. The old man’s expression was grave, and he was pacing back and forth in a flurry of anxiety.

Seeing his grandson emerge, he first poked his head in to look at the room, then asked in a low voice:

"I didn't wake the little bird, did I?"

Song Yu pulled the door shut and said calmly:

"No, it’s asleep."

"What’s wrong, Grandfather?"

Hearing this, Song Zhengguo took a deep breath. Feeling the hallway wasn't the place for a conversation, the two moved to the study.

"It’s a disaster."

Song Yu hadn't changed his clothes yet; he was still in his fitted dress shirt. As he reached up to unfasten his wristwatch, he frowned at these words. What could be so serious?

Everything at Hua Bing was running normally.

Even his father in S-Province hadn't been stirring up trouble.

Logically speaking, it should be—

"That Crane is coming over tonight!"

Song Yu’s movements paused, his expression one of disbelief.

"What?"

-

The Bureau of Monster Management was brightly lit at this moment. The festive lights from the New Year hadn't been taken down yet, and the corridors connecting the various activity areas of the lobby were still shimmering with flowing golden patterns. The sound of chatter rose and fell.

"You’re on annual leave?"

"Yeah, finally made it back. It’s been exhausting."

"Me too. There’s nothing good to eat in the Autonomous Region. The 749 Bureau only knows how to provide instant noodles and sausages..."

"Did the Bureau take in a lot of little monsters this year?"

...

001 sat on the sofa, dressed in black. Its slender fingers unwrapped a lollipop and popped it into its mouth, its cheeks quickly puffing out.

Strawberry flavor.

The Bureau was very lively today because the monsters who had been away on missions last year had returned. Most of them didn't have guardians and were almost all S-rank or higher. Since their household registrations were in Nan City, they returned here for their vacations.

001 was considered quite young; it had never been on a mission, so it didn't have much to talk about.

However...

The little sparrow pondered. It had traveled.

But just then—

"001?"

The voice of the Red-Crowned Crane came from behind. The black-clad youth immediately *poofed* into its original form—fluffy and sitting upright, though its claws were still clutching the lollipop stick.

"..."

The Red-Crowned Crane sighed, merely beckoning with its wing toward the little sparrow on the sofa:

"Come here. Let's discuss some things."

001 was round and plump. It lowered its bird head to look at the lollipop, then very carefully picked it up with its beak, placed it back into the wrapper it had just opened, and tucked its wings, intending to come back and eat it later.

...

There were already some monsters in the Hall of History in the lobby. Most were in human form, though some retained their favorite characteristics.

A "young man" with gray hair was looking up at the massive red-background portrait, sharp, distinct spikes protruding from his fingertips. Beside him, a lady was lowering her eyes to adjust her hairpin; she was dressed in a form-fitting black outfit, with scales shimmering with golden light at the corners of her eyes. And the one communicating with the Red-Crowned Crane... was a monster with a fox head and a human body, wearing ancient robes. Its eyes were narrowed into slits, appearing affable yet carrying an air of oppression.

001 was the youngest S-rank. It had now shifted into human form and followed along, listening to their conversation with a serious expression.

"Is that so? Then this little monster seems to have real talent."

The Red-Crowned Crane nodded, then continued:

"It is quite young. It used to be at the bird and flower market in Qiushui Lane, but it was taken away by a young man—its current guardian."

"The one in the photo."

The hedgehog monster beside them examined it earnestly, instinctively wanting to reach out and touch it, but it forgot it had manifested its spikes. Just then—

001 stepped in to block it, saying seriously:

"Don't break it."

"..."

The hedgehog monster "tched" and then stood obediently to the side, yawning as it listened to the two monsters talk.

"Its guardian is the richest man in Nan City? The only grandson?"

The fox monster narrowed its eyes, quite curious.

"Yes, and he is a specialist at the 749 Bureau. He is acquainted with the family of 247."

The Red-Crowned Crane added the information very seriously, taking the opportunity to point out the matter at hand:

"Now that 247 has just come of age, our Bureau has always had a tradition of giving gifts. But this situation is special, so I was thinking..."

The fox monster roughly understood the information and said leisurely:

"I understand."

"The people at the 749 Bureau all have ties to the Song family. Naturally, our Bureau cannot fall behind... It seems quite necessary to maintain good relations with humans of status."

The corners of the fox's eyes curved, looking quite wicked.

It tilted its head.

"A gift... Gold and silver treasures might not be enough. Why not use magical artifacts instead?"

-

[The Gift]

Originally, this only appeared for little monsters with guardians. The Bureau’s tradition over the years was to gift small items, mostly minor magical artifacts for warding off disaster and illness, attached to specific objects.

Dolls, pens, harmonicas...

They were adjusted based on the guardian's information in the file.

But 247 was effectively a special case now.

Firstly, its monster power level was steadily rising; it was only a step away from the assessment, which for an S-rank was just a matter of time.

Secondly, its guardian had a very high social status—one could even say he was a famous power broker in Nan City. His social network was vast, and he even had connections with people from the 749 Bureau, which could not be underestimated.

Thirdly, it possessed astonishing talent for human culture and was currently the Bureau's most promising candidate for central training. It really had to be taken seriously.

Because of this, the Red-Crowned Crane said cautiously:

"It must be grand. We need to show some support for 247."

The fox monster naturally waved its hand, gathering all the little monsters in the Bureau together, and leaned over with a smile:

"Time to offer your suggestions."

The little monsters below whispered among themselves, and a few spoke up eagerly:

"A gift... C-can we go too?"

"Let's save face for the Boss!"

"Yes, yes, exactly!"

The fox monster tilted its head; it hadn't expected that the round, fluffy bird in the Hall of History was actually a boss.

chunks.chineseText:
它只是想了想，挥手幻化出来了几个木头箱子，上面还绑着红色的绸缎，前后用横木穿着。

大厅里的鼠鼠很是好奇地看了过去，有几只还跑过去试着扛了抗，但没有弄动，爪子在地板上打滑。

狐狸妖很是从容地拢了拢袖子，转而对着丹顶鹤道：

“那小妖要升S级？那是对它的监护人……”

丹顶鹤挥了挥翅膀，很是怒其不争地道：

“上次和我说寿命的事，一岁不到，想好了同它监护人殉情的事……”

狐狸妖闻言一怔，而后就是哈哈大笑。

“有趣。”

“我要见一见。”

001此刻已经化成了灰棕色的小雀，羽毛蓬松，站在那个大箱子上，只是高高兴兴地想着。

待会就可以见到247了。

“那这样，我打个头，我在西部那里淘了些好玩意儿，全当送给小辈一个见面礼。”

原来那个面部有鳞片的女士走了过来，抬手调动妖力，木头箱子自动打开，它扔进去了一些法器，铃铛、短刃、面纱……

“给它玩玩儿。”

狐狸妖许久没回南市，得知管理局出了个有天赋的小妖，也是很满意的，见状也一挥衣袖，琳琅满目的法器就填满了箱子，泛着些金色的光泽。

“那我也送些。”

“毕竟待会是第一次见面。”

管理局里热热闹闹的，连刚才那个刺猬妖也凑了过来，扔进去了一个银色的指虎，然后又翻翻找找，拿出一个布袋子来，悉数倒进去了。

还有一枚狼牙。

灰发的少年看了看旁边的001，抬了抬下巴。

“……”

妖怪们仿佛是有了默契，开始纷纷地排队往里面扔自己的礼物，除了那些出差回来的S级妖怪，普通小妖也认认真真地送东西。

包括最喜欢的小玩偶。

钥匙扣。

领带结。

氛围相当和谐，扔完礼物的小妖怪还挤在一起窃窃私语，大多都是盼望着待会出去能够带上它们。

那可是老大的家！

难得一见！

丹顶鹤也很是满意，从自己的书柜里扔进去了厚厚的一堆典籍，理论知识的，实践操作的，顺带……丢进去一本双修手册，成年版的。

001着实没有什么好东西，它歪头思考了下，走上前去，把自己零钱包扔了进去。

……

与此同时，锦园。

宋郁听完这话其实是皱了皱眉的，赠礼，什么时候的事？

“上次那鹤来家里说过这事，我……我给忘了，没想到是今天。”

宋峥国其实是有些着急的，说完这话又拍了拍大腿，想起来什么，抬眸看向自己孙子。

“对了！你奶奶留了东西的！”

两人最后去了三楼，那是储藏室，宋郁就这么看着自己爷爷拉出来个木头箱子，给轻巧地打开了。

里面全是些金银首饰，均是没有戴过的，意义不言而喻。

宋郁一时半会还没有太反应过来，只是又确定了下：

“爷爷，是今天的子时吗？”

老头儿其实一直在碎碎念，对着木头箱子：

“沅清，这留了大半辈子的东西，到底是派上用场了，小郁是个好孩子，这事儿……说到底还是怪我，不过沅清啊，鸟儿也很好。”

宋郁没办法，只能俯身蹲下，再问了一句：

“爷爷，是子时吗？”

宋峥国这才回了回神，点头道：

“对对对，那'布帛'上写的就是子时。”

“……”

宋郁拿出来了手机，现在时间已经是十一点半了。

时辰到了。

-

邻居此刻正在熬夜看电视剧，毕竟是热播剧场，她打了个哈欠，怀里的猫咪也发出了稳定的摩托声。

[没有什么原因，就是不爱了。]

[不爱了？你说不爱就不爱了？]

男主步步逼近，女主节节败退。

邻居啧啧，这不得亲一口？

然而就在这时，画面突然停了，开始播放了片尾曲，以及演员表……

“！”

天杀的！

天杀的！

邻居震怒，这谁让它们这么断的？

良心在哪里？

“喵……”

怀里的小猫开始伸懒腰，前爪往前伸，屁股撅得高高的，尾巴也竖了起来。

邻居眯了眯眼，开始一阵蹂躏，但就在这时，飘窗那里传来了悠扬的音乐，像是那种古代的……笛子？

还有什么节拍？

现在都是十一点多了，谁在外面啊？

邻居蹙眉，物业没管吗？

但就在这时，怀里的猫一下子跳了出来，站在了飘窗那里，眼睛直勾勾地看着外面。

邻居只好下床走了过去，也跟着看了下窗外，什么都没有，地面上还有些落叶。

但是，那个奏乐声还在响……

邻居皱了皱眉，拿了件外套就打算去门口看一看，这物业怎么回事？

不过就在她走到门口的时候，发现自己的猫没有跟过来，它还在直勾勾地看着外面。

“……”

三分钟后。

邻居抱着自己的大肥猫站在了玄关那里，偷偷打开了门，那道奏乐的声音在不远处，似乎到了拐角处了。

谁啊？

她拿出来了自己的手机，打算待会拍个照发给物业，问问什么情况。

也就在这时，那道奏乐的声音更近了，像是直接走到了别墅门口的那条路。

邻居懵懵的，因为她还是没有看到人，或许是家里还有人的缘故，她完全没觉得害怕，反倒是觉得奇怪。

拿出来手机就打算录个视频。

但就在这时，怀里的猫突然挣脱开了，站在门口对着她就是一个飞踢。

力道出奇的大。

邻居手机都被撞掉了，很恍惚，后面才发现那道奏乐声，停了。

人这会儿才觉得头皮发麻，捞着猫就关上了门，哐哐哐地往卧室里冲。

-

与此同时，别墅外面。

有长长的一行“人”，灯火通明，有小蛇妖盘成人形，扛着那些厚重的箱子，它们还特地换上了古代的衣服，双襟的那种。

管理局的妖怪全部都来了。

粗略估计，有几百号妖，浩浩荡荡的。

一共十个箱子，系着红绸缎，两侧有着各色各样的妖怪走着路，它们手里提着灯笼，妖头人形，此刻正在看着一个方向。

箱子上的鼠鼠还在动情地拉着二胡。

旁边打鼓的那只啪嗒敲了下伙伴的脑袋，示意它注意下情况。

“被看到了吗？”

狐妖眯了眯眼，手在袖子里拢着，并排的还有丹顶鹤，以及它翅膀上的灰棕色小雀。

“没事，一看就是熬夜的。”

“气场弱了而已。”

丹顶鹤很是从容地讲道。

狐妖笑眯眯的，对此不可置否，只是对着后面抬了抬手。

鼠鼠看到号令，立马开始奏乐。

队伍又开始行进了起来。

后排的侏儒兔蹦蹦跳跳的，拿着iphone拍了几张照，抽空又发了个朋友圈。

-

宋峥国其实已经心如死灰，紧张得不知道怎么办，客厅那里摆满了东西，餐桌、茶几上都是些水果糕点……

他还去拿了珍藏的茶叶，都给沏好了。

至于还礼。
chunks.englishText:
With a mere thought, it waved its hand, conjuring several wooden chests bound in red silk and suspended from horizontal poles for carrying.

The mice in the great hall watched with intense curiosity. A few scurried over to try and shoulder the weight, but they couldn't budge them, their claws slipping helplessly against the floor.

The fox demon calmly tucked its hands into its sleeves and turned to the Red-Crowned Crane.

"That little demon wants to reach S-Rank? That’s for its guardian..."

The crane flapped its wings, looking utterly exasperated. "It talked to me about life expectancy last time. Not even a year old, and it’s already decided it wants to die for love with its guardian..."

The fox demon paused, then burst into hearty laughter.

"Interesting."

"I must see it."

001, currently transformed into a small, fluffy grey-brown sparrow, stood atop the large chest, thinking happily.

It would see 247 soon.

"In that case, I’ll start us off. I’ve scavenged some fine trinkets in the West; consider them a welcoming gift for the youngster."

The lady with scales on her face stepped forward. Raising a hand, she channeled her demonic energy, causing the wooden chest to pop open automatically. She tossed in several artifacts: bells, short blades, a veil...

"Let it play with these."

The fox demon hadn't returned to the South City in a long time. Pleased to hear that the Management Bureau had produced such a talented young demon, it flicked its sleeve, filling the chest with a dazzling array of artifacts that shimmered with golden luster.

"I shall contribute as well."

"After all, it is our first meeting."

The Bureau was buzzing with activity. Even the hedgehog demon from earlier joined in, tossing in a silver knuckle duster before rummaging through its belongings to empty out a cloth bag.

It even added a wolf’s fang.

The grey-haired youth glanced at 001 and gave a slight nod of his chin.

"..."

The demons seemed to reach a silent consensus, lining up to toss in their own gifts. Aside from the S-Rank demons who had just returned from business trips, even the ordinary little demons were earnest in their offerings.

Including their favorite little dolls.

Keychains.

Tie knots.

The atmosphere was incredibly harmonious. The little demons who had finished giving their gifts huddled together, whispering—most were hoping to be taken along when the time came.

That was the Boss’s home!

A rare sight indeed!

The Red-Crowned Crane was also quite satisfied. It tossed a thick stack of tomes from its own bookshelf into the chest—theoretical knowledge, practical guides, and, as an afterthought... a manual on dual cultivation, the adult version.

001 didn't have much of value. It tilted its head, thought for a moment, walked forward, and tossed its coin purse inside.

...

Meanwhile, at Jin Garden.

Song Yu frowned upon hearing this. Gifts? When was this arranged?

"That crane came to the house and mentioned it last time. I... I forgot. I didn't realize it was today."

Song Zhengguo was actually quite anxious. After saying this, he slapped his thigh, suddenly remembering something, and looked up at his grandson.

"Right! Your grandmother left something behind!"

The two eventually went to the third floor, to the storage room. Song Yu watched as his grandfather pulled out a wooden chest and opened it with a light touch.

Inside were gold and silver ornaments, none of which had ever been worn. The significance was self-evident.

Song Yu hadn't quite processed it yet, but he confirmed once more:

"Grandfather, is it at the Hour of the Rat tonight?"

The old man had been muttering to himself, addressing the wooden chest:

"Yuanqing, these things kept for half a lifetime are finally coming to use. Xiao Yu is a good child, and this matter... ultimately, it’s my fault. But Yuanqing, the bird is also very good."

Song Yu had no choice but to crouch down and ask again:

"Grandfather, is it the Hour of the Rat?"

Song Zhengguo finally snapped out of his trance and nodded.

"Yes, yes. That’s what was written on the 'silk scroll'."

"..."

Song Yu took out his phone. It was already 11:30 PM.

The time had come.

-

The neighbor was currently staying up late watching a hit drama. She let out a yawn, and the cat in her lap let out a steady, motor-like purr.

[There’s no reason. I just don’t love you anymore.]

[Don't love me? You say you don't love me, so you just don't?]

The male lead closed in step by step; the female lead retreated.

The neighbor clicked her tongue. *Aren't they going to kiss?*

Just then, the screen suddenly froze, and the ending theme began to play, followed by the credits...

"!"

Damn it!

Damn it all!

The neighbor was furious. Who cuts it off like that?

Where is their conscience?

"Meow..."

The cat in her lap began to stretch, front paws extending, bottom high in the air, tail standing straight up.

The neighbor squinted and began to ruffle the cat’s fur, but just then, melodic music drifted in from the bay window—like some kind of ancient... flute?

And what was that rhythm?

It was past 11:00 PM. Who was outside?

The neighbor frowned. Was property management not doing their job?

But at that moment, the cat in her lap jumped out, stood on the bay window, and stared intently outside.

The neighbor had to get out of bed and walk over. She looked out the window, but there was nothing there, just some fallen leaves on the ground.

Yet, the music continued to play...

The neighbor frowned, grabbed a coat, and decided to go to the door to take a look. What was wrong with property management?

However, as she reached the door, she noticed her cat hadn't followed. It was still staring fixedly outside.

"..."

Three minutes later.

The neighbor stood in the entryway holding her fat cat. She peeked open the door. The music was nearby, seemingly just around the corner.

Who was it?

She took out her phone, intending to take a photo to send to property management to ask what was going on.

Just then, the music grew closer, as if it had walked right onto the path leading to the villa.

The neighbor was bewildered. She still couldn't see anyone. Perhaps because there were others in the house, she didn't feel afraid, just strange.

She pulled out her phone to record a video.

But at that moment, the cat in her arms suddenly broke free, stood at the doorway, and delivered a flying kick right at her.

The force was surprisingly strong.

The neighbor dropped her phone, dazed. Only then did she realize the music had stopped.

Only then did her scalp tingle. She scooped up the cat, slammed the door shut, and bolted toward the bedroom.

-

Meanwhile, outside the villa.
