A long line of "people" stood under bright lights. Small snake demons had coiled themselves into human shapes, carrying those heavy chests. They had specifically changed into ancient-style clothing, the kind with double-layered lapels.

Every demon from the Management Bureau had come.

Roughly estimated, there were hundreds of them, a grand and imposing procession.

There were ten chests in total, tied with red silk. Demons of all shapes and sizes walked on either side, carrying lanterns. With demon heads and human bodies, they were all looking in one direction.

The mice on the chests were still playing the *erhu* with deep emotion.

The one playing the drum beside them tapped its companion on the head, signaling it to pay attention to the situation.

"Were we seen?"

The fox demon narrowed its eyes, hands tucked into its sleeves. Beside it walked the Red-Crowned Crane, with the grey-brown sparrow perched on its wing.

"It’s fine. You can tell they were just staying up late."

"Their aura was just weak."

The Red-Crowned Crane said calmly.

The fox demon smiled, neither confirming nor denying, simply raising a hand toward the back.

Seeing the signal, the mice immediately began to play.

The procession moved forward once more.

In the back row, a dwarf rabbit hopped along, taking a few photos with an iPhone and finding time to post them to its Moments.

-

Song Zhengguo was already feeling hopeless, so nervous he didn't know what to do. The living room was filled with items; the dining table and coffee table were covered in fruits and pastries...

He had even taken out his prized tea leaves and brewed them.

As for the return gift...

chunks.chineseText:
则是那一小箱子珠宝首饰。

宋峥国是真的拿出了所有的诚意了，他手心都是汗，生怕待会招待不好。

“爷爷，我去卧室一趟，如果管理局真的来了，粼粼得起床……”

宋郁面色平和，其实还算镇定，不过也换了一身比较正式的衣服，他爷爷更是如此，甚至戴上了百达翡丽的表。

“那、那待会它们要是来了？”

“算了，你快去吧。”

宋峥国深呼吸一口气，说完这话就故作不在意地在客厅里踱步了几圈。

没事，没事。

他见过那鹤的，还说过话。

这次也一样的……

宋郁抬步上楼去了。

-

白粼粼其实睡得很舒服，因而在被单手捞起来的时候还有些懵懵的，浅蓝色的头发都打了弯，“少年”扶着来人的肩头，仰头看了过去，不解地道：

“宋郁……你又回来了？”

“我抱过你了。”

宋郁只是抬手往上一带，把“人”稳稳地抱了起来，手托式的那种。

“我知道。”

白粼粼心想完成任务了，他迷迷糊糊地就要下来，手都开始推了，但就在这时——

“换件衣服？管理局那边可能来人。”

“好不好？”

白粼粼理解了下，很茫然地转过来了头，说了一个字：

“啊？”

-

宋峥国还在自己调理，他时不时地看看楼上，想催促一下，又觉得不好，他毕竟年纪最大，没道理犯怵。

也就在这时，客厅窗外那里突然传来了悠扬的音乐……

由远及近。

宋峥国愣了下，当即就觉得不对，手都抖了起来，连忙给自己孙子打电话。

不过就在这时——

门口传来了叩叩的动静。

……

白粼粼很困地站在衣帽间里，手腕被牵着，迷迷糊糊地看着宋郁手里的衣服，对方只是一边拿，一边问：

“这个？”

“不要。”

“这个？”

白粼粼摇了摇头，他还是有自己的搭配思路的，虽然现在还是很想去床上睡觉。

大约过了四五分钟，挑好了。

“少年”拿着衣服去换了，针织的咖色毛衣，搭配的其实还是短裤，毕竟在家里，温度很合适，然后戴了个格纹的贝雷帽。

“穿好了……它们为什么要来呀？”

白粼粼是真的睡懵了，他前几天通宵，本来就没调好，这次一下子按时睡，反倒是睡不够了，脑子都很晕……

宋郁牵着“人”的手，单手揽住了腰，往床边那里走，拿出来正确的袜子，低头去把穿错的脱了下来，解释道：

“爷爷说管理局今晚给了提示，说要来赠礼，上次丹顶鹤来家里的时候说的，他老人家忘记告诉我们了。”

白粼粼其实左耳朵进右耳朵出，他只是打哈欠，再反应过来的时候，窗户外面已经有了奏乐的声音了。

宋郁的动作一顿，抬眸看了下窗户。

来了？

-

客厅。

宋峥国打开门的时候，瞳孔都放大了下，张了张口，最后只是后退，后退完了又觉得不对，立马鞠躬，鞠躬完了才发现得说话，连忙道：

“啊，欢迎，欢迎。”

门口不仅仅是一只鹤。

而是全门类的妖怪，宋峥国头一次见到兽头人形的……它们还穿着服帖的古代衣服，为首的那个狐妖还了下礼，鞠了一躬。

“人类，你是247的监护人？”

丹顶鹤闻言解释了下：“他不是，他是监护人的爷爷。”

狐妖倒是意外，手腕上的铃铛发出了脆响，很仔细地观察着面前的人。

宋峥国没有任何办法，只能是先拉开门，解释道：

“小郁在楼上，大、大家先进来。”

后面的妖怪跃跃欲试的，侏儒兔还蹦跶了两下，它头一次看这么大的房子，箱子上的鼠鼠也摞成了金字塔的样子，开始瞭望。

老大的家？

于是事情就变成这样了。

宋峥国在门口，一个一个地迎了进来，从一开始看到狐妖的模样震惊……到后面看到一排排拿着乐器的小鼠进来时的面色麻木。

没事的。

没事的。

不到一会，客厅里满满当当的，全部都是非人之物，它们的视线一致且好奇，全部都在看着这个年长的人类。

直到——

楼梯处传来动静。

宋郁牵着“人”下来了，面色从容，低声道：

“粼粼……”

但就在这时，身后的“少年”愣住了，不由自主地往后退了下，困意散得干干净净。

有点，可怕。

白粼粼甚至立马就想要化为本体，但还是硬生生地压住了，走到了客厅的中央，看着五花八门的兽头。

“……”

砰！

地板上出现了一只圆滚滚的小鸟。

狐妖笑眯眯的，以为这是特地给它展示的，抬起来了手，金纹流动，往下一点，白粼粼自动化形了。

“！”

鸟震惊。

丹顶鹤看见247这没出息的样子就闭了闭眼，然后才开口一一给介绍了下，顺带看向了宋家的那老头子。

挥了挥翅膀。

“赠礼都在这里了。”

宋峥国看到十个箱子的时候，天塌了。

狐妖倒是没太在意那个人类，只是将目光看到了旁边的少年，这就是……那个孙子？

相貌倒是的确不错。

它歪了歪头，观察了下。

宋郁坦坦荡荡的，直视过去。

氛围其实有点过于安静了。

但下一秒。

狐妖转头看向诸妖怪，笑眯眯地道：

“不是照骗。”

“……”

最后才算是步入了正题，狐妖许久没回来，头一次过来镇镇场子，也是觉得新鲜极了，抬手幻化出来了一张契，然后才看向丹顶鹤：

“你来吧。”

白粼粼懵懵的，他只是不由得往宋郁那里又贴了下。

这……怎么这么多妖。

都来家里了。

丹顶鹤只是优雅地迈步上前，收了收翅膀，给了面前的“少年”一个眼神，然后抬了抬鸟头。

有金线飘了过去……

白粼粼脑海里多了一道声音：

“站直，站直，这都是给你摇来的前辈……表现好点。”

“少年”立马调整了下站姿，板板正正的，同面前的狐妖鞠了一躬。

狐妖笑眯眯的：“好孩子。”

丹顶鹤心里更是满意了，很谦虚地道：“247还是很懂事的……”

宋峥国就站在一旁，默默的。

-

很快，半空中就多了一道契。

上面有密密麻麻的文字，大抵只有两个主体，分别是妖与人。

最后的八个字是：

[不得违背。]

[不得违背。]

丹顶鹤只是对着宋郁解释道：

“247此后定然会升至S级，之前的事……我们也聊过了，我们妖怪的诚意是非常大的，相信你也能看到。”

白粼粼闻言仰头看着他们，心想聊过了？聊了什么？

他怎么不知道。

直到——

“247都愿意与你同生共死，那你也自然要拿出来诚意，此为双生契，不得背叛，不得欺骗，不得逃避……”

“你愿意吗？”

白粼粼一阵恍惚，什么？
chunks.englishText:
...was that small box of jewelry and accessories.

Song Zhengguo had truly put forth all his sincerity; his palms were slick with sweat, terrified that he wouldn't be able to host them properly.

"Grandfather, I'm going to the bedroom. If the Management Bureau really is coming, Linlin needs to get up..."

Song Yu’s expression was calm, and he was actually quite composed, though he had changed into more formal attire. His grandfather had done the same, even going so far as to wear his Patek Philippe watch.

"Then, then what if they arrive?"

"Forget it, go on, hurry."

Song Zhengguo took a deep breath, and after saying this, he feigned indifference and paced around the living room a few times.

It’s fine. It’s fine.

He had seen that crane before, and had even spoken to it.

This time would be the same...

Song Yu stepped up the stairs.

-

Bai Linlin was actually sleeping quite comfortably, so when he was scooped up with one arm, he was still a bit dazed. His light blue hair was all curled up. The "youth" rested his hands on the shoulders of the person holding him, looked up, and asked in confusion:

"Song Yu... you’re back?"

"I’ve already held you."

Song Yu simply lifted him up, cradling him securely in his arms.

"I know."

Bai Linlin thought he had finished his task and, still groggy, started to push against him to get down, but just then—

"Change your clothes? The Management Bureau might be sending people over."

"Is that alright?"

Bai Linlin processed this, turned his head in a daze, and said one word:

"Huh?"

-

Song Zhengguo was still trying to compose himself. He glanced upstairs from time to time, wanting to urge them on, but felt it wouldn't be right. After all, he was the eldest; there was no reason for him to be nervous.

Just then, melodious music suddenly drifted in from outside the living room window...

It grew from faint to clear.

Song Zhengguo froze. He immediately felt something was wrong, his hands began to tremble, and he hurriedly called his grandson.

But at that moment—

A knock sounded at the door.

...

Bai Linlin stood in the walk-in closet, feeling very sleepy. His wrist was being held, and he looked groggily at the clothes in Song Yu’s hands. The other man simply picked them out while asking:

"This one?"

"No."

"This one?"

Bai Linlin shook his head. He still had his own sense of style, even though he really wanted to go back to bed.

After about four or five minutes, they were chosen.

The "youth" went to change into the clothes: a brown knit sweater paired with shorts—since they were at home, the temperature was just right—and topped off with a plaid beret.

"I'm dressed... why are they coming here?"

Bai Linlin was truly sleep-drunk. He had pulled all-nighters a few days ago and hadn't adjusted his schedule; now that he was sleeping on time, he couldn't get enough rest, and his head felt dizzy...

Song Yu held the "person's" hand, wrapped an arm around his waist, and walked toward the bed. He took out the correct socks, knelt to take off the ones that had been put on wrong, and explained:

"Grandfather said the Management Bureau gave a hint tonight that they were coming to bring gifts. The Red-Crowned Crane mentioned it when it visited last time, but Grandfather forgot to tell us."

Bai Linlin let the words go in one ear and out the other; he just yawned. By the time he reacted, the sound of music was already coming from outside the window.

Song Yu paused, lifting his eyes toward the window.

They were here?

-

Living room.

When Song Zhengguo opened the door, his pupils dilated. He opened his mouth, but ended up just stepping back. After stepping back, he realized it wasn't right, so he immediately bowed. Only after bowing did he realize he needed to speak, so he hurriedly said:

"Ah, welcome, welcome."

It wasn't just one crane at the door.

It was a whole menagerie of monsters. It was the first time Song Zhengguo had seen beasts with human bodies... they were even wearing well-fitted ancient robes. The fox demon in the lead returned the gesture and bowed.

"Human, are you the guardian of 247?"

The Red-Crowned Crane explained, "He is not. He is the guardian's grandfather."

The fox demon was surprised, the bells on its wrists chiming crisply as it carefully observed the man before it.

Song Zhengguo had no choice but to open the door wide and explain:

"Xiao Yu is upstairs. E-everyone, please come in."

The monsters behind were eager to try; a dwarf rabbit hopped twice. It was the first time it had seen such a large house. The mice on the boxes were stacked like a pyramid, starting to scout the area.

The Boss's home?

And so, things turned out this way.

Song Zhengguo stood at the door, welcoming them in one by one. From his initial shock at the appearance of the fox demon... to his numb expression as a line of mice carrying musical instruments filed in.

It’s fine.

It’s fine.

Before long, the living room was packed full of non-human beings. Their gazes were uniform and curious, all fixed on this elderly human.

Until—

Movement came from the stairs.

Song Yu led the "person" down, his expression composed. He whispered:

"Linlin..."

But just then, the "youth" behind him froze, instinctively stepping back, his sleepiness vanishing completely.

It was a little... scary.

Bai Linlin even wanted to transform into his true form immediately, but he forcefully suppressed the urge and walked to the center of the living room, looking at the variety of beast heads.

"..."

*Poof!*

A round, fluffy little bird appeared on the floor.

The fox demon smiled, thinking this was a special performance for its benefit. It raised a hand, golden patterns flowing, and pointed downward. Bai Linlin was automatically forced back into his human form.

"!"

The bird was shocked.

The Red-Crowned Crane closed its eyes at 247’s pathetic display, then proceeded to introduce everyone one by one, while also looking at the old man of the Song family.

It waved its wings.

"The gifts are all here."

When Song Zhengguo saw the ten boxes, he felt as if the sky had collapsed.

The fox demon didn't pay much attention to the human, instead turning its gaze to the youth beside him. This was... that grandson?

His appearance was indeed quite good.

It tilted its head, observing him.

Song Yu was open and honest, meeting its gaze directly.

The atmosphere was actually a bit too quiet.

But the next second.

The fox demon turned to the other monsters and said with a smile:

"Not a catfish." (Note: slang for 'not a fake/catfish')

"..."

Finally, they got to the point. The fox demon hadn't been back in a long time, and coming here to oversee things was a fresh experience. It conjured a contract in its hand and looked at the Red-Crowned Crane:

"You do it."

Bai Linlin was dazed; he couldn't help but lean closer to Song Yu.

This... why were there so many monsters?

They had all come to his house.

The Red-Crowned Crane stepped forward elegantly, tucked its wings, gave the "youth" a look, and lifted its bird head.

Golden threads drifted over...

A voice appeared in Bai Linlin's mind:

"Stand straight, stand straight. These are all the seniors I've brought here for you... behave well."

The "youth" immediately adjusted his posture, standing stiff and straight, and bowed to the fox demon.

The fox demon smiled: "Good child."

The Red-Crowned Crane was even more satisfied, saying modestly: "247 is still very sensible..."

Song Zhengguo stood to the side, silent.

-

Soon, a contract appeared in mid-air.

It was covered in dense text, involving only two main parties: monsters and humans.

The final eight characters were:

[Must not be violated.]

[Must not be violated.]

The Red-Crowned Crane explained to Song Yu:

"247 will certainly rise to S-rank from now on. As for the previous matters... we have already discussed them. The sincerity of us monsters is very great; I believe you can see that."

Bai Linlin looked up at them upon hearing this, thinking, *Discussed? Discussed what?*

He had no idea.

Until—

"247 is willing to live and die with you, so naturally, you must show your sincerity. This is a Twin-Soul Contract. You must not betray, you must not deceive, you must not flee..."

"Are you willing?"

Bai Linlin felt a wave of dizziness. What?

chunks.chineseText:
他是说了要一起死……可是这怎么换个说辞，就这么奇怪？

但就在这时。

“我愿意。”

-

宋峥国很拘谨地站在那堆妖怪里，那堆扛着乐器的小鼠在餐桌上挑挑拣拣的，一鼠拿着一个葡萄，其实都挑选好了，但还是看向了他。

斟酌地问：“人，我们能吃吗？”

宋峥国连忙道：“可以可以，就是给你们的。”

鼠鼠立马品鉴了起来。

然后发出惊叹的声音。

一开始还是一小堆妖怪，后面范围逐步扩大，都会认真地去餐桌、茶几上挑选自己喜欢的东西，然后排队过来询问这个老头子。

“这个能吃吗？”

“可以的。”

“这个也能吃吗？”

“可以的。”

最后别墅里居然一片祥和，小妖怪们从来没有见过这么多的好吃的，有几只已经开始蹦蹦跳跳地参观了。

那些双S级的妖怪们在一起讨论些什么，丹顶鹤特地带着“少年”过去了，很温和地道：

“247过段时间就可以到S级了，到时候我亲自给它把把关，来认识一下。”

001对着一套流程已经很熟悉了，环顾了下四周，决定也去拿个苹果排队去，那个老人看起来很和蔼的样子。

……

狐妖一直都笑眯眯的，只是问：

“这孩子去年八个月才来管理局，现在就快要到S级了？”

丹顶鹤脸不红心不跳地道：

“它天资比较高。”

白粼粼：“……”

反正就是这么交谈了下。

宋郁从头到尾保持一个很低的存在度，但目光始终是在那个“少年”身上的，它的小鸟……很受管理局的欢迎。

他要做的更好。

才可以。

不过就在这时，那位狐妖却看了过来，招了招手，示意人过来。

丹顶鹤其实愣了下，不由自主地道：

“这位监护人也特别的好……”

“我知道。”

狐妖笑眯眯地道。

“……”

白粼粼立马走到了宋郁旁边，抬手牵住了对方的手，其实是有些紧张的。

这里全是……妖。

“你好。”

宋郁面色平静地道，他的手指还划破了个口子，是为了签契。

正当双S级的妖怪都看了过来的时候——

狐妖很认真地询问：

“听说你……给管理局的小妖都发了手机？”

“……”

-

一直到凌晨左右，这堆妖怪才开始成群结队地离开，很认真地对门口的老头子挥手。

要么叼着果冻，要么叼着面包。

总之是扫荡一空。

宋峥国也是兢兢业业地挥手，这些小妖怪数量庞大，但又懂礼貌，他一晚上都在说“可以”。

至于那几个大妖怪，则是在门口同宋郁交代：

“手机内存也不用太大，256G就够我们用了……749局的人用的是那个什么牌子的，我们不要和他们一样的。”

狐妖揣着手，笑眯眯地道。

宋郁点了点头：

“这个您放心。”

狐妖真是越看越满意，丹顶鹤不由得有些骄傲，它就说，这247和247的监护人就是最搭的，历史回廊那照片就得挂着。

瞧瞧！

最后一众妖怪还是离开了，留下了那十个沉甸甸的木头箱子。

-

宋峥国当时准备的回礼其实管理局是拒绝了的，因为狐妖一看就知道怎么回事，只是道：

“给小妖留着吧。”

那天的事如梦似幻，实在是印象深刻。

宋峥国后面就应了陈开鹤的邀约，又出去钓鱼了，他需要平复一下心情。

主要是……那个契的事。

没事，没事。

陈开鹤后面一边挂鱼饵一边问：

“小郁这和那孩子在一起，恐怕也不会传宗接代，你这真的能接受啊？”

宋峥国始终在神游，闻言只是道：

“啊……啊，是，能。”

“……”

-

大约过了几周。

白粼粼正式地通过了S级的考核，他的红本本上的信息也得到了更正，宋郁也提前完成了学校的考试，迎来了暑假。

一人一鸟都有了空。

但就在这时——

丹顶鹤传讯过来了：

[247，你的信息我已上报，中央传来批复，你需在十日内进京……]
chunks.englishText:
He had said they would die together... but why did it sound so strange when phrased like this?

But just then.

"I am willing."

-

Song Zhengguo stood awkwardly among the pile of monsters. The mice carrying instruments were picking and choosing from the dining table. One mouse held a grape; it had actually already made its choice, but still looked at him.

It asked tentatively: "Human, can we eat this?"

Song Zhengguo hurriedly said: "Yes, yes, it's all for you."

The mice immediately began to sample the food.

Then they let out exclamations of wonder.

At first, it was just a small group of monsters, but soon the range expanded. They all began to seriously pick their favorite items from the dining table and coffee table, then lined up to ask the old man.

"Can I eat this?"

"Yes, you can."

"Can I eat this too?"

"Yes, you can."

In the end, the villa was surprisingly peaceful. The little monsters had never seen so many delicious things, and a few had already started hopping around to explore.

The double-S-rank monsters were discussing something together. The Red-Crowned Crane specifically brought the "youth" over and said very gently:

"247 will be able to reach S-rank in a while. I will personally oversee it then. Come, get to know everyone."

001 was already familiar with this process. It looked around and decided to go grab an apple and join the queue; that old man looked very kind.

...

The fox demon kept smiling, simply asking:

"This child only came to the Management Bureau eight months ago, and now it's almost at S-rank?"

The Red-Crowned Crane said without blinking:

"It has high natural talent."

Bai Linlin: "..."

And so, they chatted.

Song Yu maintained a low profile from start to finish, but his gaze was always on that "youth." Its little bird... was very popular with the Management Bureau.

He had to do better.

He had to.

However, just then, the fox demon looked over and beckoned for him to come closer.

The Red-Crowned Crane actually froze for a moment, and couldn't help but say:

"This guardian is also exceptionally good..."

"I know."

The fox demon smiled.

"..."

Bai Linlin immediately walked to Song Yu’s side and reached out to hold his hand; he was actually quite nervous.

There were... monsters everywhere.

"Hello."

Song Yu said calmly. His finger had a small cut on it from signing the contract.

Just as the double-S-rank monsters all looked over—

The fox demon asked very seriously:

"I heard that you... gave mobile phones to all the little monsters in the Management Bureau?"

"..."

-

It wasn't until around midnight that the group of monsters began to leave in droves, waving very earnestly at the old man at the door.

Some were biting into jellies, others into bread.

In short, they had swept the place clean.

Song Zhengguo also waved diligently. These little monsters were numerous, yet polite. He had spent the whole night saying "Yes, you can."

As for the big monsters, they gave Song Yu instructions at the door:

"The phone memory doesn't need to be too big; 256GB is enough for us... The people at the 749 Bureau use that one brand; we don't want to use the same one as them."

The fox demon tucked its hands into its sleeves and smiled.

Song Yu nodded:

"You can rest assured about that."

The fox demon was more and more satisfied the more it looked at him. The Red-Crowned Crane couldn't help but feel a bit proud; it had said that 247 and 247's guardian were the perfect match. That photo in the Corridor of History had to be hung up.

Look at that!

Finally, the crowd of monsters left, leaving behind those ten heavy wooden boxes.

-

The return gift Song Zhengguo had prepared was actually refused by the Management Bureau, because the fox demon knew what was going on at a glance, simply saying:

"Leave it for the little monsters."

That day felt like a dream, truly unforgettable.

Later, Song Zhengguo accepted Chen Kaihe's invitation to go fishing again; he needed to calm his nerves.

Mostly because of... the contract thing.

It’s fine, it’s fine.

Later, as Chen Kaihe was baiting his hook, he asked:

"Xiao Yu is with that child; I'm afraid there won't be any descendants. Can you really accept this?"

Song Zhengguo had been daydreaming, and upon hearing this, he just said:

"Ah... ah, yes, I can."

"..."

-

About a few weeks later.

Bai Linlin officially passed the S-rank assessment, and the information on his red ID card was updated. Song Yu also finished his school exams early and welcomed the summer vacation.

Both the human and the bird had free time.

But just then—

The Red-Crowned Crane sent a message:

[247, I have reported your information. The Central Bureau has replied; you must arrive in the capital within ten days...]

chunks.chineseText:
第51章

白粼粼看到传讯之后就直接啪嗒啪嗒地冲向书房那里，因为宋郁在里面办公，身后的光幕其实是愣了下的，而后就是一路跟着。

最后抵达目的地。

宋郁弯腰伸手，他的小鸟立马攀爬了过来，站在肩头，收了收翅膀。

一人一鸟看向了半空中的“传讯”。

“进京？”

“啾！”

宋郁想到了前段时间丹顶鹤说的事，面色平和，只是侧头看向了自己肩头的小鸟。

白粼粼着实很骄傲。

羽毛蓬松，胸膛挺立。

他这可是头一次被“中央”召见，这妥妥的就是光宗耀祖……理应要昭告天下的。

宋郁的确直接去了一楼的茶室，他爷爷正在里面沏茶，见到来人后立马招了招手，鸟见状扑棱翅膀就飞了过去，稳稳地站在了老人的肩头。

“啾啾！”

“这怎么了？鸟儿找我？”

宋郁：“……”

“爷爷我找您。”

宋郁只好把方才的事情一五一十地说了，顺带说了下他自己的打算。

“那是，你当然要陪着，不过，鸟儿去中央……是要当大官吗？”

宋峥国倒是眉飞色舞了起来，身子微微后仰，朝自己肩头伸了伸手，鸟很矜持地伸爪子上来了。

他又感叹地道：

“那很好啊，爷爷可以教给你不少东西呢？虽说现在我们家里是从商了，原本都没有想过……”

圆滚滚的小鸟挺胸抬头的。

“这也算继承了家里的衣钵。”

“好好好。”

宋峥国是真的很高兴，以至于还从抽屉里翻出来了和田玉的扳指，当成了一个小礼物。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀下来了，很矜持地叼着那个玉石扳指，试图往自己爪子上套。

茶室里还在交谈：

“爷爷，这不是一件小事，管理局的妖怪尚且数量不可知，更何况是中央的，万一把粼粼分配到离家很远的地方呢？”

“那倒也是。”

“还有，您是有从政的经验，但那毕竟是人……粼粼以后管理的话，那就是各种各样的妖怪了……这不能归为一谈”

宋峥国不知道是最近升华了还是怎么的，已经彻底接受了，反而是摆了摆手，乐呵呵地道：

“都一样都一样。”

宋郁：“……”

-

总归是说不到一块去。

整个家里，只有宋郁一个人在担心，他的小鸟也才刚成年，一岁半，这么小就出去管理？

宋郁觉得三五岁才比较合适。

他在衣帽间里看着“少年”跪坐在地毯上挑选衣服，各种各样的上衣，短裤，还有帽子……配饰。

白粼粼其实很跃跃欲试的，他从前上学上班往往都是扮演的“被管理者”，反正没有什么主体参与感。

反倒是现在，每一天都很开心！

他这次可是代表着南市管理局的，一定要认认真真的准备。

“少年”还在挑选自己要带的衣服，其实没注意到宋郁已经俯身蹲下了，对方垂眸看着他，只是问：

“不会觉得累吗？”

白粼粼闻言抬眸看了过去，露出了相当不解的目光。

“……”

鸟已经被自己的前途亮得睁不开眼了。

大约晚上十点钟的时候。

白粼粼已经上床睡觉了，反倒是宋郁还在收拾一些行李，大体是在收尾，不过他还是查看了下京市的酒店，挑选了一下，订了个最贵的。

毕竟是出差。

丹顶鹤说的是培训之类的……希望他的小鸟一帆风顺。

宋郁走到了床边，刚想要抬手去碰一下，但突然发现自己的手背上出现了个圆圈的纹路，还泛着流动的金光。

他蹙了蹙眉，确切地说这不是个普通的图形，而是类似于……花瓣……一层层地往外散开。

宋郁愣了下，刚想要抬手仔细看下，余光却发现床上的少年后颈也有流动着的金纹，它睡得沉，脸颊泛着些湿红。

什么东西？

相同的图案。

宋郁没有吵醒床上的“人”，而是立即拿出来了手机联系丹顶鹤，对方回复得很及时，不过问得却是语焉不详的：

[图案？给我看看，拍照。]

宋郁照做。

[247状态怎么样？]

[它在睡觉。]

手机那边显示“正在输入中”，像是打了又删，总之是过了一会，才回复：

[摸一下它的额头，看看热不热？]

宋郁怔了下，而后就把手机放在了一边，微微倾身弯腰，轻声地道：

“粼粼？”

并不是为了叫醒，只是为了让“人”潜意识里知道是谁过来了。

“少年”脸颊歪了下，察觉到额头有冰凉的手指触感，不由得仰了仰下巴，唇瓣微微张着，呼了一口气。

宋郁拭了拭温，眉眼温和地打算收回来手，但就在这时，“少年”却一把攥住了他的手指，很自然地把脸埋在了他的掌心。

潮热……

有温软的唇瓣拂过。

宋郁有那么一两秒空白，直到手机又传来震动的声音：

[体温升高了没？]

宋郁这才回神，单手打字道：

[是有一些。]

对面那边倒是立马回复了：

[那你呢？]

宋郁其实不太明白，只是抬手扯了扯自己的衬衫领口，刚打字，那边就又弹了消息：

[咳咳，解释两件事，一是那个纹路，是当时你签订的那个血契的印记，它是狐妖特地的赠礼……会促进妖力流转。]

[那个就是修行的事………247不是还没和你修行么？不说这个。二，它亮了的话，其实是……说明……]

没有打完字。

宋郁皱了皱眉，他有些担忧，毕竟他的小鸟之前就发过烧……它很难受的。

不过就在他要抬手打字的时候，聊天页面上方又开始弹出来“正在输入中”的字样，一会出现，一会消失，好似很纠结。

“……”

宋郁看了一会，决定还是再问一下，也就在这时，丹顶鹤回复了：

[247快要发情了。]

-

卧室里一阵寂静。

宋郁体温也变高了，他愣了下，而后只是匆匆地把视线从手机上转移开了，深呼吸了一口气。

手机页面还在不断地弹消息：

[妖怪不像人类一年四季都在……我们是有规律的发情期的，咳咳，247它毕竟刚成年，对于自身控制能力不强，按道理来说是可以自己调整的。]

[但它过几天就要去京市了，教它也来不及了。]

[我给它发过手册的，你们看过吗？]

[247可能有点害羞……]

宋郁闭了闭眼，回头看了下手机，扫过那些信息之后，手背的青筋都微微凸起了，他起身刚要离开。

床上的“人”就被弄醒了，抓住了他的手腕，很不高兴地“嗯”了一声，但眼皮还是没有掀开的。

宋郁只能撑着手臂看过去，眼皮都泛着点热，出声安抚道：

“我不走。”

“没事……”

白粼粼迷迷糊糊的，就这么又靠着那个手背睡着了，贴着脸颊的那种，为了降温。

人心乱如麻。

-

丹顶鹤其实传授了一晚上的经验：
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 51

After seeing the message, Bai Linlin scurried straight toward the study, his little feet pattering against the floor. Song Yu was working inside, and the light screen behind him flickered for a moment before following him all the way.

They reached their destination.

Song Yu bent down and reached out, and his little bird immediately climbed onto his shoulder, tucking its wings.

The human and the bird looked at the "message" in mid-air.

"Go to the capital?"

"Chirp!"

Song Yu thought of what the Red-Crowned Crane had said a while ago. His expression was calm, but he tilted his head to look at the bird on his shoulder.

Bai Linlin was truly proud.

His feathers were puffed up, his chest held high.

This was his first time being summoned by the "Central Bureau." This was clearly a moment to bring honor to his ancestors... it should be announced to the world.

Song Yu went straight to the tea room on the first floor. His grandfather was brewing tea inside. Upon seeing them, he immediately beckoned. The bird flapped its wings and flew over, landing steadily on the old man's shoulder.

"Chirp chirp!"

"What's this? The bird is looking for me?"

Song Yu: "..."

"Grandfather, I'm looking for you."

Song Yu had no choice but to explain everything that had just happened, along with his own plans.

"That's right, of course you have to accompany him. But, the bird going to the Central Bureau... is it going to be a high-ranking official?"

Song Zhengguo became quite animated, leaning back slightly and reaching out to his shoulder. The bird very demurely extended a claw onto his hand.

He sighed with emotion:

"That's great. Grandfather can teach you quite a few things! Although our family is in business now, I never thought..."

The round little bird puffed out its chest.

"This can also be considered inheriting the family legacy."

"Good, good, good."

Song Zhengguo was truly happy, so much so that he dug out a Hetian jade thumb ring from his drawer as a small gift.

Bai Linlin flapped his wings and flew down, demurely biting the jade ring and trying to put it on his claw.

The conversation in the tea room continued:

"Grandfather, this is no small matter. The number of monsters in the Management Bureau is already unknown, let alone those in the Central Bureau. What if they assign Linlin to a place very far from home?"

"That is true."

"Also, you have experience in politics, but that's for humans... If Linlin manages things in the future, it will be all kinds of monsters... That can't be treated the same way."

Song Zhengguo didn't know if he had reached a state of enlightenment recently, but he had completely accepted it. Instead, he waved his hand and said happily:

"It's all the same, all the same."

Song Yu: "..."

-

In the end, they couldn't see eye to eye.

In the whole house, only Song Yu was worried. His little bird had only just reached adulthood—one and a half years old. Going out to manage things at such a young age?

Song Yu felt that three or five years old would be more appropriate.

He watched in the walk-in closet as the "youth" knelt on the carpet, picking out clothes—all kinds of tops, shorts, hats... and accessories.

Bai Linlin was actually very eager. In the past, when he went to school or work, he always played the role of the "managed." He never really had any sense of agency.

But now, every day was so happy!

This time, he was representing the Nanshi Management Bureau, so he had to prepare very seriously.

The "youth" was still choosing the clothes he wanted to bring, not noticing that Song Yu had already leaned down and crouched beside him. He looked down at him and asked:

"Don't you feel tired?"

Bai Linlin looked up upon hearing this, revealing a very confused expression.

"..."

The bird was already so blinded by its own future that it couldn't see anything else.

Around ten o'clock at night.

Bai Linlin had already gone to bed, while Song Yu was still packing some luggage. He was mostly finishing up, but he still checked hotels in the capital and booked the most expensive one.

After all, it was a business trip.

The Red-Crowned Crane had mentioned something about training... he hoped his little bird would have smooth sailing.

Song Yu walked to the bedside, just about to reach out and touch him, when he suddenly noticed a circular pattern on the back of his hand, glowing with flowing golden light.

He frowned. To be precise, this wasn't an ordinary shape, but something similar to... flower petals... spreading outward layer by layer.

Song Yu froze. Just as he was about to raise his hand to look closer, he noticed out of the corner of his eye that the youth on the bed also had flowing golden patterns on the back of his neck. He was sleeping soundly, his cheeks flushed with a damp heat.

What was this?

The same pattern.

Song Yu didn't wake the "person" on the bed, but immediately took out his phone to contact the Red-Crowned Crane. The other party replied very promptly, though the question was vague:

[Pattern? Let me see, take a photo.]

Song Yu did as instructed.

[How is 247's state?]

[He is sleeping.]

The phone showed "typing...", as if the person was typing and deleting. After a while, they replied:

[Touch his forehead, see if it's hot?]

Song Yu was stunned, then put the phone aside, leaned over, and said softly:

"Linlin?"

It wasn't to wake him, just to let the "person" subconsciously know who was there.

The "youth" tilted his cheek. Sensing the cool touch of fingers on his forehead, he couldn't help but lift his chin, his lips slightly parted, exhaling a breath.

Song Yu checked his temperature, his expression gentle as he prepared to withdraw his hand, but just then, the "youth" grabbed his fingers and naturally buried his face in his palm.

Damp heat...

Soft, warm lips brushed against him.

Song Yu went blank for a second or two, until the phone vibrated again:

[Has his body temperature risen?]

Song Yu finally came to his senses and typed with one hand:

[It has a little.]

The other side replied immediately:

[And you?]

Song Yu didn't really understand, so he just reached up to tug at his shirt collar. Just as he started typing, another message popped up:

[Cough, cough. Let me explain two things. First, that pattern is the mark of the blood contract you signed back then. It's a special gift from the fox demon... it will promote the circulation of monster power.]

[That's about cultivation... 247 hasn't cultivated with you yet, right? Never mind that. Second, if it's glowing, it actually means... it means...]

The message wasn't finished.

Song Yu frowned. He was worried; after all, his little bird had run a fever before... it was very uncomfortable for him.

However, just as he was about to type, the "typing..." indicator appeared at the top of the chat window again, appearing and disappearing as if the person was very conflicted.

"..."

Song Yu watched for a while and decided to ask again. Just then, the Red-Crowned Crane replied:

[247 is about to go into heat.]

-

Silence filled the bedroom.

Song Yu’s body temperature rose as well. He froze, then hurriedly shifted his gaze away from the phone and took a deep breath.

The chat window kept popping up messages:

[Monsters aren't like humans, who are the same all year round... We have regular heat cycles. Cough, cough. 247 just reached adulthood, and his control over himself isn't strong. Theoretically, he should be able to adjust on his own.]

[But he's going to the capital in a few days, and there's no time to teach him.]

[I sent him a manual. Have you two read it?]

[247 might be a bit shy...]

Song Yu closed his eyes and looked back at the phone. After scanning those messages, the veins on the back of his hand bulged slightly. He stood up, about to leave.

The "person" on the bed was woken up and grabbed his wrist, letting out an unhappy "Hmm," though his eyelids didn't lift.

Song Yu could only prop himself up and look over, his own eyelids feeling hot. He spoke to soothe him:

"I'm not leaving."

"It's fine..."

Bai Linlin was groggy, leaning against the back of his hand again, pressing his cheek against it to cool down.

Song Yu’s heart was in turmoil.

-

The Red-Crowned Crane had actually been imparting experience all night:

chunks.chineseText:
[但你也不要太担心，它只是有点反应，并不会说突然那什么，247刚成年，在那方面就是个雏鸟。]

[这是有阶段的……现在可能也就是想要拥抱之类的……]

丹顶鹤发完这个消息，话锋一转：

[你也是个‘雏鸟’吧？]

宋郁崩溃，在卧室里打下了一个字：

[是。]

丹顶鹤点头，很是满意地道：

[那我给你们的手册是很有用的，记得去看。]

[现在毕竟时间不够，你注意观察，及时和我联系就行，反正它等级升得太快，妖力蓬勃，也是需要散一散的……]

丹顶鹤在管理局里来回踱步的，也是有些紧张兮兮的，毕竟现在还没有双修……只有真正的“压住”，这才算彻底套牢了。

不行不行。

它还是得当面和247聊聊。

[我还是不放心，这样，你明天带它过来。]

丹顶鹤优雅打字，收了收翅膀。

-

翌日。

白粼粼醒过来的时候还有点懵懵的，睁开眼就发现宋郁在给他穿袜子，他一时半会其实是反应不过来的。

他芯子是人不错，但是当鸟太习惯了，还以为是在戴脚环，很自然地又伸了伸自己的人腿。

宋郁单手扣住那个脚踝，面不红心不跳地问：

“睡得好么？”

白粼粼听到这道声音才回了回神，仿佛一下子有了灵智一样，开始往外抽自己的小腿，但是没弄开。

“……放开呀。”

“少年”面色有些泛红，手指攥着床单，最后就生气了。

“宋郁！”

白粼粼使出了自己的终极绝招，砰得一下化成小鸟，圆滚滚地站在面前人的手指上，爪子被捏着的那种。

金鸡独立.jpg

宋郁：“……”

“好，我错了。”

圆滚滚的鸟矜持地抽出来了自己的爪子，扑棱翅膀就要下地，但是被反手握住了，放到了人的肩头。

白粼粼：！

宋郁已经从善如流地去浴室了，很平和地说了晚上要去管理局一趟的事，被问及原因也只是面不改色地道：

“可能是进京的事。”

白粼粼了然，然后就化形成了“少年”模样，站在旁边看着宋郁。

一秒，两秒。

“怎么了？”

人微微压着呼吸，轻声问。

白粼粼只是不解地道：

“都是我先洗漱的。”

“……”

鸟本位思考模式。

-

大约在晚上两点三十五分，车子抵达了熟悉的巷子口，白粼粼在副驾上睡着了，因为拥抱的约定，导致他现在化人形的时间都比较多了……

“粼粼？”

白粼粼闻言蹙了蹙眉，不知道怎么了，总是有些腰酸……他隐约感觉人在替他解安全带，迷迷糊糊地睁开了眼睛。

抬手抱住了。

敷衍一下。

宋郁抬手按住了“少年”的肩胛骨，抬手把那个安全带的卡扣弄开，什么想法也没有了，只是轻声问：

“还困吗？”

“嗯。”

白粼粼抬手抵住那个肩头，要推开，但是不知道怎么了，使了两下力才推开，后面才下车了。

“拜拜。”

宋郁垂眸看着“人”，压根就没有看他，不过还是温和地道：

“我在外面等你。”

……

管理局内。

丹顶鹤早已恭候多时，见到那只圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟立马就挥了下翅膀，有道金线腾空就飞了过去，结结实实地拍了下到处说闲话的鸟头。

白粼粼懵懵的，转头看了过来，才啪嗒啪嗒地往这边走。

顺带把挎包摘了下来，递给了旁边的鼠鼠。

“001呢？”

白粼粼又没有找到，其实是有点郁闷的，但前面的丹顶鹤只是悠悠地道：

“它出差了，回来估计就是双S了。”

鸟震惊。

鸟一个加速往前走。

“什么时候的事？我怎么不知道？”

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，很是闲庭散步地走着，解释道：

“任务很急，上面调走的。”

“手机都收了的。”

白粼粼仰着鸟头，甚至都还短暂地停了脚步，这么厉害……

“赶紧过来。”

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地跟了上去。

办公室。

白粼粼其实是有点惆怅的，它本来是打算带着001一起去京市的，还可以旅旅游，多好啊……

不过对方回来就是双S了？

鸟一个爪子斜着，一个爪子直着，认真思考。

他觉得还是001的比较好，出去接任务……一看就比在办公室里处理文件要帅……

鸟羡慕，鸟不说。

“正好你问起来001了，它倒是给你留了个东西。”

丹顶鹤走到了书桌那里，抽出来了一本笔记，放到了桌上，又道：

“我看了，全部都是些基础的术法，你可以学一学。”

“通俗易懂的。”

白粼粼感动，扑棱翅膀飞了上来，用爪子掀开了一页。

全是“简笔画”，各种各样的小鸟pose，伸翅根，打坐，转圈……

“……”

确实通俗易懂。

白粼粼调动妖力收了起来，然后认认真真地仰头看向丹顶鹤，对方还在讲：

“……还有另外一件事。”

“关于你和你监护人的血契。”

-

大抵是把那天的事情讲清楚了，但丹顶鹤也是听取了监护人的建议，略去了监护人在场的事。

“所以，你最好是把双修手册带上。”

“争取就在这次出差的时候，拿下。”

白粼粼红温了。

他爪子都开始抠地，不过被一道金线给提了起来，稳当当地落到了一个杯垫上。

“……但是，我应该能控制住的吧？”

鸟不死心地仰头道。

丹顶鹤闻言有些困惑：

“你控制干什么？这不是千载难逢的好机会？凡事都可以推到‘发情期’上，你那监护人奈何不了你的。”

“我就是……咳咳。”

“总之，把握好机会。”

白粼粼其实是想说他只是想让宋郁长生……没有那个意思。

鸟觉得被误会了。

鸟爪子抠了抠杯垫，成功搞出来一对窟窿。

白粼粼深呼吸一口气，仰头把自己的想法全说出来了。

办公室里安安静静的。

一秒，两秒。

丹顶鹤只是问：

“你还搞上了人类的柏拉图？”

白粼粼：“……”

“也就是说，前些日子和我说‘殉情’的不是你？”

鸟翅根夹紧了。

“你的监护人签血契的时候你是不在场？”

鸟拘谨。

“你这么搞，你监护人知道吗？”

鸟开始歪头梳理羽毛。

丹顶鹤在房间里踱步了一会，还是很不理解，甚至自顾自地道：

“一个还是个幼鸟的时候，跑来和我说想要监护人长生，甚至不行的话，还要一起死。”

“一个则是孤身一人来管理局登记，在那道士的面前始终坚定地维护某只小妖……还签了血契，除非他死了，否则是无法违背的。”

“噢……”

丹顶鹤转头看了过来，认认真真地道：

“一妖一人，原来是纯正友谊？”
chunks.englishText:
[But don't worry too much; it’s just having a slight reaction. It’s not like it’s going to suddenly do *that*. 247 just reached adulthood; in that regard, it’s still a fledgling.]

[It happens in stages... right now, it probably just wants things like hugs...]

After sending this message, the Red-Crowned Crane changed the subject:

[You’re a ‘fledgling’ yourself, aren’t you?]

Song Yu felt like collapsing. He sat in his bedroom and typed out one character:

[Yes.]

The Red-Crowned Crane nodded, feeling quite satisfied:

[Then the manual I gave you is very useful. Remember to read it.]

[Since time is tight right now, just pay close attention and contact me in time. Anyway, its rank is rising too fast, and its demon power is surging—it needs a way to vent...]

The Red-Crowned Crane paced back and forth in the Administration Bureau, feeling rather nervous. After all, they hadn't undergone "dual cultivation" yet... only a true "suppression" would completely lock the relationship down.

No, no.

It still needed to talk to 247 in person.

[I’m still not at ease. How about this: bring it over tomorrow.]

The Red-Crowned Crane typed elegantly, tucking in its wings.

-

The next day.

When Bai Linlin woke up, he was still a bit dazed. Opening his eyes, he found Song Yu putting socks on him, and for a moment, he couldn't quite process it.

His core was human, sure, but he was so used to being a bird that he thought he was having a leg band put on. Naturally, he extended his human leg.

Song Yu gripped that ankle with one hand, his face calm and heart rate steady as he asked:

"Did you sleep well?"

Only upon hearing that voice did Bai Linlin snap out of it. As if his wits had suddenly returned, he began to pull his calf away, but he couldn't break free.

"...Let go."

The "youth" flushed, his fingers clutching the bedsheets, eventually getting angry.

"Song Yu!"

Bai Linlin unleashed his ultimate move: *poof*, he transformed into a small bird, standing round and fluffy on the person's finger, his claw still being held.

*Golden Rooster Stands on One Leg.jpg*

Song Yu: "..."

"Alright, my mistake."

The round bird primly withdrew its claw and flapped its wings, intending to hop down, but was caught by the hand and placed on the person's shoulder.

Bai Linlin: !

Song Yu had already moved on to the bathroom, calmly mentioning that they needed to go to the Administration Bureau that evening. When asked why, he replied without changing his expression:

"It’s probably about the trip to the capital."

Bai Linlin understood, then transformed into his "youth" form, standing to the side and watching Song Yu.

One second, two seconds.

"What's wrong?"

The man held his breath slightly and asked softly.

Bai Linlin just asked, puzzled:

"I’m always the one who brushes my teeth first."

"..."

Bird-centric thinking mode.

-

At approximately 2:35 AM, the car arrived at the familiar alley entrance. Bai Linlin had fallen asleep in the passenger seat; because of their "hugging agreement," he had been spending much more time in his human form lately...

"Linlin?"

Bai Linlin frowned at the sound. He didn't know what was wrong, but his waist always felt a bit sore... He vaguely felt someone unbuckling his seatbelt and opened his eyes, dazed.

He reached out and hugged him.

Just to go through the motions.

Song Yu reached out to press against the "youth's" shoulder blades, unclicked the seatbelt, and lost all other thoughts, only asking softly:

"Still sleepy?"

"Mm."

Bai Linlin pushed against that shoulder, intending to shove him away, but for some reason, it took two tries to succeed before he finally got out of the car.

"Bye-bye."

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at the "person," not really seeing him, but still said gently:

"I’ll wait for you outside."

...

Inside the Administration Bureau.

The Red-Crowned Crane had been waiting for a long time. Seeing the round, blue-feathered bird, it immediately flicked its wings. A golden thread shot through the air and landed firmly on the bird's head—the one that loved to gossip.

Bai Linlin was dazed. He turned his head to look, then began to waddle over *patter-patter*.

He took off his crossbody bag and handed it to the mouse-person nearby.

"Where’s 001?"

Bai Linlin hadn't found him, which made him feel a bit depressed, but the Red-Crowned Crane just said leisurely:

"He’s on a business trip. By the time he gets back, he’ll probably be double-S rank."

The bird was shocked.

The bird accelerated forward.

"When did this happen? How come I didn't know?"

The Red-Crowned Crane tucked in its wings and strolled along, explaining:

"The mission was urgent; he was transferred by the higher-ups."

"Even his phone was confiscated."

Bai Linlin tilted his bird head, even pausing for a moment. So impressive...

"Hurry up and come over."

The bird followed *patter-patter*.

In the office.

Bai Linlin was actually a bit melancholy. He had originally planned to take 001 with him to the capital so they could go sightseeing—wouldn't that be nice?

But the other party would be double-S when he returned?

The bird tilted one claw, straightened the other, and thought seriously.

He felt that 001’s path was better—going out on missions... it looked much cooler than processing documents in an office...

The bird was envious, but the bird didn't say it.

"Since you asked about 001, he did leave something for you."

The Red-Crowned Crane walked to the desk, pulled out a notebook, placed it on the table, and added:

"I’ve looked at it. It’s all basic techniques. You can study them."

"They’re easy to understand."

Bai Linlin was touched. He flapped his wings, flew up, and flipped a page with his claw.

It was full of "stick figures"—all sorts of bird poses: stretching wing roots, meditating, spinning in circles...

"..."

Indeed, easy to understand.

Bai Linlin mobilized his demon power to put it away, then looked up at the Red-Crowned Crane earnestly. The other party continued:

"...There is one more thing."

"About the blood pact between you and your guardian."

-

The Red-Crowned Crane had mostly explained what happened that day, but it had followed the guardian's suggestion and omitted the fact that the guardian had been present.

"So, you’d better bring the dual cultivation manual."

"Try to seal the deal during this business trip."

Bai Linlin turned bright red.

His claws began to scratch the ground, but he was lifted by a golden thread and landed steadily on a coaster.

"...But, I should be able to control myself, right?"

The bird asked, looking up, unwilling to give up.

The Red-Crowned Crane looked puzzled:

"Why would you want to control it? Isn't this a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity? You can blame everything on your 'estrus period.' Your guardian won't be able to do anything about it."

"I just... *cough cough*."

"In short, seize the opportunity."

Bai Linlin actually wanted to say that he just wanted Song Yu to have eternal life... he didn't have that kind of intention.

The bird felt misunderstood.

The bird scratched the coaster with its claws, successfully creating a pair of holes.

Bai Linlin took a deep breath and looked up to explain all his thoughts.

The office was quiet.

One second, two seconds.

The Red-Crowned Crane simply asked:

"You’ve even picked up human-style Platonism?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

"So, the one who told me about 'dying for love' the other day wasn't you?"

The bird clamped its wing roots tight.

"You weren't there when your guardian signed the blood pact?"

The bird was restrained.

"If you do this, does your guardian know?"

The bird began to tilt its head and preen its feathers.

The Red-Crowned Crane paced the room for a while, still unable to understand, and even muttered to itself:

"One, while still a fledgling, runs to me saying it wants its guardian to have eternal life, and if that’s not possible, it wants to die with him."

"The other comes to the Administration Bureau alone to register, and in front of that Taoist priest, he steadfastly protects a certain little demon... and even signed a blood pact. Unless he dies, he cannot break it."

"Oh..."

The Red-Crowned Crane turned its head and said earnestly:

"One demon and one human, so it turns out to be a pure friendship?"

chunks.chineseText:
“001上次帮你检测妖力波动……是废了好大功夫，说你和你的监护人天天睡一起……”

白粼粼彻底绷不住了，立马扑棱翅膀就要飞走，但是被一条金线稳稳地拦住了，在桌子上滚了滚，成个毛球模样。

“行了。”

丹顶鹤很是怒其不争的，心想这247整天在管理局大摇大摆的，在和监护人的相处上倒是畏手畏脚。

“反正这次是个好时机。”

“你自己看着办，对了，我给你的双修手册你到底看了没有，我给了你最新的一本。”

白粼粼闻言愣了下，仰着鸟头看了过来，心想什么新的一本？

丹顶鹤还在说：

“原来觉得你小，毕竟还没成年，给你的是删减版的，主要都是人类身体构造的事情，毕竟双修都是人形的……”

白粼粼还在低着鸟头，到处思考什么新的一本？

直到——

“但是这次我给你的是成年版的，附带了图的，就前段时间，放在那木箱子里了。”

“你看了没啊？”

白粼粼只是浑身一震，坏了，今天宋郁去收拾储藏室的东西了。

啊！

-

不到三点，围墙那里就出来一个背着挎包啪嗒啪嗒狂走的小鸟，宋郁看到后就开了车门。

“粼粼？”

鸟扑棱翅膀飞了上来，只是仰着头看过来，想要问什么，但是——

“怎么了？”

宋郁神色仍旧温和。

白粼粼还是很着急，他到底看了没有，看了没有？

这对他很重要！

副驾驶的小鸟化成了少年模样，最终还是直接问了，脸颊都泛起来些红晕，他还是存不下心事。

“手册么？我没有见过。”

白粼粼长舒一口气，还好还好，一切都还来得及。

宋郁始终是垂着眼眸看“人”的，观察着细微的表情，轻声道：

“是很重要的东西么？”

“少年”面颊都是红的，还喘着气，只是仰头看了过来，眼睛圆圆的，摇头。

“不重要。”

“这样啊。”

宋郁很温和地笑了下。

-

大约过了几天，一人一鸟终于要出门了，客厅里很是热热闹闹的。

阿姨其实不太知道具体的情况，只是又提着一袋子小衣服过来了，顺带拿着一包旺仔小馒头。

“小鸟要出远门呐？”

“快来看看阿姨给你做的小衣服。”

白粼粼正在伸爪子品鉴小馒头，闻言就扑棱翅膀飞了过来，仰着鸟头看阿姨。

“啾啾！”

“哎。”

阿姨只是打开了一个小手提箱，里面放着好几层小衣服，光是针织的围兜就有十多个，纯色的、渐变的、卡通图案的……应有尽有。

宋峥国从楼上下来了，见到后也是夸赞，妇人也是有些不好意思，说了句：

“我也就会这点巧活……”

白粼粼圆滚滚的，在餐桌上啪嗒啪嗒地走着，闻言很自然地用鸟头去拱阿姨的手指。

“鸟儿很喜欢你的。”

阿姨也是心里满满的，抬手轻轻地摸了摸小鸟的脑袋。

楼下一片和谐。

直到——

“粼粼。”

鸟立马站直了。

宋郁刚去楼上拿东西了，此刻正在楼梯扶手这里，面色偏冷，语调没什么起伏。

他抬步走了过来，伸出来了手指，白粼粼从善如流地上来了。

稳当当地站在了人的肩头。

宋郁一下子就好了，转而开始同阿姨说了一些事情，主要是家里只有爷爷一个人，不用做太多饭菜之类的。

另外就是谢谢这些小衣服。

“爷爷，那我们先走了。”

宋峥国只是背着手，见状点了点头，不过还是嘱咐了下：

“照顾好鸟儿。”

“我会的。”

-

一人一鸟终于开始了二人之旅。

白粼粼其实后面反思了下，不知道自己为什么心虚，不就是拱了下……

？

难道是因为宋郁当时不在。

为什么有种被捉奸的感觉。

“……”

不过后面他就没空想这个事了，因为车程很长，白粼粼不由得就困了。

要么是挂在宋郁的衣襟上睡，要么是化形成“人”躺在后座上。

身体热热的。

睡得也很沉。

直到中途停了下来。

白粼粼感觉被捞了起来，他攀附着那个手臂，眼皮都掀不开，坐车太长时间了……

“要不要去看海？”

！

白粼粼又精神起来了，其实是中途在一个沿海城市停了，宋郁本来打算的就是这样，沿途带着他的小鸟逛一逛。

没有001。

鸟站在了人的肩头，羽毛蓬松，感受着海风阵阵的吹拂，有种前所未有的自由感。

白粼粼不由得感怀了起来。

海的那边是什么？

但就在这时——

“卖烤肠了，三块钱一个，五块钱……”

鸟获得了随机烤肠礼包。

不再感怀了。

-

大约休整了一天，之后才抵达了京市，宋郁这次就顺利很多，不到一个小时，他们就到了房间。

这是一个套房，像是那种公寓，不仅有阳台、客厅、主卧……还有个小厨房。

总之应有尽有的。

白粼粼就在套房的卧室里复习，趴在床上，小腿在上面晃着，“少年”用手撑着下巴，看着丹顶鹤给他带的复习资料。

“粼粼？”

宋郁其实在收拾那些衣服，抬步走了过来，面色平和。

“嗯嗯。”

很敷衍了。

宋郁抬手握住了那个脚踝，垂眸耐心地给套上了袜子。

“不要看太晚。”

白粼粼在床上翻了个身子，完全忘记挣开了，只是在走神，喃喃地道：

“中央的管理局……会不会很吓人？”

宋郁微微蹙了下眉，刚想要安抚，但是床上的“少年”此刻已经砰得一下化成了圆滚滚的小鸟，此刻正啪嗒啪嗒地走过来。

仰着鸟头道：

“我们一起去。”

是陈述句。

“好。”

-

中央管理局处于景阳大街的广场，至少地址是这么写的。

宋郁带着他的小鸟抵达了目的地，环顾了下四周，其实没有看见确切的入口。

白粼粼今天还特地装扮了一下，穿着一个浅蓝色的防晒小披风，爪子上套着同色系的超轻脚环。

很是靓丽。

广场上的人有不少来夸鸟的。

白粼粼挺胸抬头的。

终于在正午十二点的时候，广场上的人变得很少，周遭安安静静的。

宋郁本来是要侧眸问问他的小鸟具体位置的，但就在这时，面前似乎多了一道水波纹的“墙”。

全部是透明的。

但在一点点地逼近……

-

里面是完全不同的景象，“人”来“人”往的，几乎像是到了另外一个平行世界，大厅的规模是南市管理局的十倍不止，比外面的广场还大……

宋郁站在原地，他肩头的小鸟也是很恍惚，环顾了下四周。

他们似乎站在一个“出入口”，有不少“人”直接往这边走，面色匆匆的，不过在看到旁边的人类的时候，还是眯了眯眼。

也就那么一瞬。

而后就离开了。

宋郁完全辨别不了人和妖了……
chunks.englishText:
"001 went to great lengths to check your demon power fluctuations last time... he said you and your guardian sleep together every day..."

Bai Linlin completely lost his composure and immediately flapped his wings, intending to fly away, but was firmly blocked by a golden thread. He rolled on the table, turning into a ball of fluff.

"Enough."

The Red-Crowned Crane was furious at his lack of resolve, thinking that while 247 strutted around the Administration Bureau all day, he was timid and hesitant when it came to his guardian.

"Anyway, this time is a good opportunity."

"Handle it yourself. By the way, have you actually read the dual cultivation manual I gave you? I gave you the latest version."

Bai Linlin was stunned at the mention, looking up with his bird head, wondering what "latest version" it meant.

The Red-Crowned Crane continued:

"I thought you were young before, since you hadn't reached adulthood, so I gave you an abridged version. It was mainly about human anatomy, since dual cultivation is done in human form..."

Bai Linlin was still hanging his bird head, wondering everywhere what "latest version" meant.

Until—

"But this time, I gave you the adult version, with illustrations included. It was in that wooden box a while ago."

"Did you read it?"

Bai Linlin felt his whole body tremble. Oh no, Song Yu went to clean up the storage room today.

Ah!

-

Not long after three o'clock, a little bird with a crossbody bag came waddling out from the wall. Seeing this, Song Yu opened the car door.

"Linlin?"

The bird flapped its wings and flew up, just looking up, wanting to ask something, but—

"What's wrong?"

Song Yu's expression remained gentle.

Bai Linlin was still very anxious. Had he read it or not? Had he read it?

This was very important to him!

The little bird in the passenger seat transformed into his youth form, and in the end, he asked directly, his cheeks flushing red. He still couldn't keep things to himself.

"The manual? I haven't seen it."

Bai Linlin let out a long sigh of relief. Thank goodness, everything was still in time.

Song Yu had been lowering his eyes to watch the "person," observing his subtle expressions, and said softly:

"Is it something very important?"

The "youth's" cheeks were red, and he was still panting, but he just looked up, his eyes round, and shook his head.

"Not important."

"I see."

Song Yu smiled very gently.

-

A few days later, the human and the bird were finally about to set off. The living room was very lively.

The auntie didn't really know the specific situation, but she brought over another bag of small clothes, along with a pack of Wangzai small steamed buns.

"The little bird is going on a long trip?"

"Come and see the little clothes Auntie made for you."

Bai Linlin was extending his claw to sample the steamed buns. Hearing this, he flapped his wings and flew over, looking up at the auntie with his bird head.

"Chirp chirp!"

"Oh."

The auntie opened a small suitcase, which contained several layers of small clothes. There were over a dozen knitted bibs alone—solid colors, gradients, cartoon patterns... everything one could imagine.

Song Zhengguo came down from upstairs and praised them upon seeing them. The woman was a bit embarrassed and said:

"This is all I’m good at..."

Bai Linlin, round and fluffy, walked *patter-patter* on the dining table. Hearing this, he naturally used his bird head to nudge the auntie's finger.

"The bird really likes you."

The auntie felt her heart full, raising her hand to gently stroke the little bird's head.

Downstairs was a scene of harmony.

Until—

"Linlin."

The bird immediately stood straight.

Song Yu had just gone upstairs to get something and was now at the stair railing. His expression was cold, and his tone had no fluctuations.

He walked over and extended his finger. Bai Linlin followed suit and stepped onto it.

He stood steadily on the person's shoulder.

Song Yu was immediately fine, turning to discuss some matters with the auntie—mainly that since only Grandpa was at home, there was no need to cook too many dishes.

He also thanked her for the little clothes.

"Grandpa, we're leaving now."

Song Zhengguo just stood with his hands behind his back, nodding at the sight, but still instructed:

"Take good care of the bird."

"I will."

-

The human and the bird finally began their journey for two.

Bai Linlin actually reflected on it later. He didn't know why he felt guilty—wasn't it just a nudge...?

?

Could it be because Song Yu wasn't there at the time?

Why did it feel like being caught in the act of infidelity?

"..."

But later, he didn't have time to think about this, because the car ride was very long, and Bai Linlin couldn't help but get sleepy.

He either hung on Song Yu's lapel to sleep or transformed into a "human" to lie in the back seat.

His body felt hot.

He slept very soundly.

Until they stopped halfway.

Bai Linlin felt himself being scooped up. He clung to that arm, unable to even open his eyelids—the car ride had been too long...

"Do you want to go see the sea?"

!

Bai Linlin perked up again. They had actually stopped in a coastal city halfway. That was Song Yu's original plan—to take his little bird for a stroll along the way.

Without 001.

The bird stood on the person's shoulder, feathers fluffy, feeling the gusts of sea breeze, a sense of freedom like never before.

Bai Linlin couldn't help but feel sentimental.

What was on the other side of the sea?

But just then—

"Selling roasted sausages, three yuan each, five yuan for..."

The bird received a random roasted sausage package.

No more sentimentality.

-

After resting for about a day, they arrived in the capital. This time, Song Yu's journey was much smoother; in less than an hour, they reached their room.

It was a suite, like an apartment, with not only a balcony, living room, and master bedroom... but also a small kitchen.

In short, it had everything.

Bai Linlin was reviewing in the bedroom of the suite, lying on the bed, his legs dangling. The "youth" rested his chin on his hands, looking at the review materials the Red-Crowned Crane had brought him.

"Linlin?"

Song Yu was actually tidying up those clothes. He walked over, his expression peaceful.

"Mm-hmm."

Very perfunctory.

Song Yu reached out to hold that ankle, lowering his eyes to patiently put on the socks.

"Don't stay up too late."

Bai Linlin rolled over on the bed, completely forgetting to pull away, just lost in thought, muttering:

"The Central Administration Bureau... will it be very scary?"

Song Yu frowned slightly, just about to comfort him, but the "youth" on the bed had already *poof* transformed into a round, fluffy little bird, now walking over *patter-patter*.

He looked up with his bird head and said:

"We'll go together."

It was a statement.

"Alright."

-

The Central Administration Bureau was located in the square on Jingyang Street, at least that was what the address said.

Song Yu arrived at the destination with his little bird, looking around, but didn't see an exact entrance.

Bai Linlin had even dressed up specially today, wearing a light blue sun-protection cape, with a matching ultra-light leg band on his claw.

Very bright and beautiful.

Many people in the square came to compliment the bird.

Bai Linlin puffed out his chest and held his head high.

Finally, at twelve noon, the people in the square became sparse, and the surroundings were quiet.

Song Yu was about to turn his head to ask his little bird for the specific location, but just then, a "wall" of water ripples seemed to appear in front of him.

It was completely transparent.

But it was closing in, bit by bit...

-

Inside was a completely different scene. "People" were coming and going; it was almost like arriving in another parallel world. The scale of the lobby was more than ten times that of the Nanshi Administration Bureau, even larger than the square outside...

Song Yu stood where he was, and the little bird on his shoulder was also dazed, looking around.

They seemed to be standing at an "entrance/exit." Many "people" were walking directly this way, looking hurried, though they squinted their eyes when they saw the human beside them.

It was only for a split second.

Then they left.

Song Yu couldn't distinguish between humans and demons at all...

chunks.chineseText:
不过很快他们又发现了一件事，出入口旁边有个一米多高的“信箱”，每个“人”出入的时候都会来这里拿个东西。

宋郁不由自主地往旁边站了站，肩头的小鸟也是收紧了翅膀。

这里面实在是太大了。

不过就在这时，一个缠着绷带的灰色信鸽正在啪嗒啪嗒地往这边走，身上还跨这个包裹。

白粼粼瞪大了鸟眼。

或许是心有灵犀，它们对视了。

“……”

“……”

-

与此同时，京市一个老旧的小区里有几个妇人提着大包小包地上了楼，拿着钥匙打开了门。

那是一个七八十平米的房子，很小，但很温馨。

几个老师把新鲜的水果糕点都尽数摆到了桌子上，然后才去了客厅的小桌子那里拆开了泡面，一边等着泡好，一边看着阳台那里。

有个破旧的小熊玩偶。

是从孤儿院带出去的，甚至上面还有其中一个老师缝的补丁。

“这孩子……你说好好的，写什么遗产分配书。”

“他才毕业一年就写这玩意儿。”

“真是不懂事！”

“就是！就是！”

几个老师围着泡面狠狠地批评，但是最后也是沉默了起来，她们也不争气，官司也不好打，那公司改了几次名字了，明摆着利用法律的空子。

她们也有些泄气。

没办法了。

还是先把孩子带回家去吧。

不过就在这时，不知道谁说了一句：

“粼粼现在估计……一岁多了吧？”

“希望我们粼粼下辈子……”

本来气氛很沉闷的，但是有个老师接了句：

“吃香喝辣！”

后面就自然而然地开始了：

“腰缠万贯！”

“锦衣玉食！”

“平步青云！”

“喜结良缘！”

“啊？”

“怎么了？”

“这对吗？一岁多呀！”
chunks.englishText:
However, they soon discovered another thing: there was a "mailbox" over a meter high next to the entrance, and every "person" would come here to pick up something when entering or leaving.

Song Yu couldn't help but step to the side, and the little bird on his shoulder also tightened its wings.

It was simply too big inside.

But just then, a gray carrier pigeon wrapped in bandages was walking *patter-patter* this way, carrying a package across its body.

Bai Linlin widened his bird eyes.

Perhaps it was a telepathic connection; they locked eyes.

"..."

"..."

-

At the same time, in an old residential area in the capital, several middle-aged women were carrying large and small bags upstairs, using their keys to open a door.

It was a seventy or eighty-square-meter apartment—very small, but very cozy.

Several teachers placed the fresh fruit and pastries all on the table, then went to the small table in the living room to open instant noodles, waiting for them to soak while looking at the balcony.

There was a worn-out little teddy bear toy.

It had been brought out from the orphanage, and there was even a patch sewn on it by one of the teachers.

"This child... you say, why would he write an inheritance distribution document when he's perfectly fine?"

"He wrote that thing only a year after graduation."

"Really thoughtless!"

"Exactly! Exactly!"

Several teachers criticized fiercely around the instant noodles, but in the end, they fell silent. They weren't strong enough, and the lawsuit was hard to fight. That company had changed its name several times, clearly taking advantage of legal loopholes.

They were also a bit discouraged.

There was nothing else to do.

Better to just bring the child home first.

But just then, someone said:

"Linlin is probably... over a year old now, right?"

"I hope our Linlin in his next life..."

The atmosphere had been very heavy, but a teacher added:

"Will eat well and live well!"

Then it naturally continued:

"Have wealth to spare!"

"Live in luxury!"

"Rise to great heights!"

"Find a happy marriage!"

"Huh?"

"What's wrong?"

"Is that right? He's only a year old!"

chunks.chineseText:
第52章

中央大厅内。

白粼粼还在人的肩头，低着鸟头看着地板上的信鸽，对方脑袋肿肿的，缠着一圈绷带，只露出了一个鸟眼。

“……”

“……”

信鸽低着鸟头看了看自己的翅膀，又扭了扭身子，小包裹灰扑扑的。

它仰头看了下那只大肥鸟……羽毛顺滑，还穿着制作精良的小披风，鸟爪子上还有个闪着光的超轻金属脚环。

哼！

信鸽掉头就走，真是越想越气。

宋郁其实没太反应过来怎么回事，只知道他的小鸟爪子微微使劲，已经扑棱翅膀下来了，啪嗒啪嗒地跑到了那只信鸽面前。

“等等等等。”

“我们见过的。”

信鸽低着鸟头还在往前走，身子左右摇摆着，很是倔强，颇有风骨。

它可是中央的信使！

清廉得很！

才不像那只鸟，仗着家里富贵就——

信鸽肩头被搭上了一个翅膀，随即视线里就出现了一个果冻，晶莹剔透，还是大牌子，太空人广告那个。

干什么？

信鸽觉得鸟脸一红，刚想挥翅膀推开，但那鸟已经开始说话了：

“我第一次来，人生地不熟的，但我记得你给我送过信封。”

“可以借一步说话吗？”

信鸽收了收翅膀，严肃正色地道：

“你这是做什么，拿这个考验我？”

“你知不知道现在中央抓得紧，愈发要求在职的妖怪要提高自身的妖力纯洁度的，对于这些……果冻之类的东西，那可是严厉杜绝的！”

信鸽说得自己都胸膛挺挺的，不过还是偷偷瞥了一眼，果冻里还有个橘子瓣。

汁水一定很丰富。

白粼粼：“……”

行不通？

鸟看了看四下无人，继续伸着翅膀搭着那只信鸽，咳嗽了两下，很是堂而皇之地道：

“这才不是果冻！”

信鸽歪头看了过来，鸟眼震惊。

“这是妖力果实！”

白粼粼面不改色地看了过去。

信鸽俨然是没有接受过太多人类文化的熏陶，只是不解地问：

“这不就是——”

“我说它是妖力果实，它就是，谁质疑谁取证。”

白粼粼一幅坦然自若的样子。

信鸽从来没有见过这种操作方式，只是伸出来翅膀默默地把“妖力果实”收下了。

-

后面才算交谈了起来。

信鸽带着一人一鸟来到了一个犄角旮旯处，然后才问：

“说吧，要问什么？”

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地跟过来了，环顾了下四周，随后才叼出来了自己的“通行证”。

信鸽看到那个闪着金色纹路的边边就知道怎么回事了，直接开口道：

“你是地方推荐来的学员？那应该去窗口处报到，之后跟着指示去做就可以了。”

“……想不到你还挺厉害的。”

白粼粼闻言不自觉地就收了收翅膀，出门在外，还是要谦虚一些。

信鸽说完这句话就抬起翅膀一挥，一条金线就从飘了出来，犹如游动的小鱼一样往前探，虚空中有不散的残影。

“跟着就到了。”

白粼粼心想这还是挺顺利的，他刚想要开口道谢，但此刻面前的信鸽开口了：

“这是你的人类伴侣？”

这道声音没有半分压低，以至于路边的一些妖怪还侧目往这边看了看。

白粼粼一下子炸毛了，啪嗒啪嗒地走过来，本来是想要用翅膀捂住对方的喙的，但是信鸽只是侧头提醒道：

“是你的话，最好标记一下。”

“人类在这里是不安全的，中央是全国各地妖怪的朝圣地，不同地区的妖怪有不同的习性，甚至还有从749局那里押来的妖怪，你小心他被吃了。”

白粼粼震惊。

什么情况？

宋郁一直都保持着很低的存在感，但是这并不代表他没有听到，少年只是垂了垂眼眸，看着地面上那个圆滚滚的身影。

“啊……怎么标记？”

信鸽闻言像是听到了什么奇怪的话一样，来回看了下面前这只蓝羽小鸟，尤其还扫了一眼对方爪子上那个若隐若现的纹路。

？

搞什么？

信鸽觉得自己被当成了play的一环，立马掉头就走了，这次是真的一去不回头。

-

白粼粼懵懵的，不过好在是那条引路的线还在，他们还是可以找到窗口报到处的。

不过周遭的“人”确实都若有若无地往这边看，有的还在窃窃私语着……

“人类？怎么会来这里？”

“很年轻啊。”

“他是谁的……怎么没有妖……”

宋郁身后窜出来一只圆滚滚的小鸟，几乎炸毛了，伸着翅根就开始挡住了人：

“啾啾啾啾啾！”

白粼粼气死了，他还在呢！他还在呢！

“咦惹，好凶啊。”

“走吧走吧。”

“这么小一个，看得住么？”

那几个“人”匆匆地走了，留下了挑衅的话语。

白粼粼低着鸟头，周遭气场都压低了，什么意思？

鸟不发威，当我是小鸡么？！

宋郁一直保持着较低的存在感，这里毕竟是妖怪的主场，他能做到的就是不给他的小鸟拖后腿。

那几个“人”走了之后，他刚想安抚几句。

但就在这时。

面前的蓝羽小鸟开始……

一点点膨大。

-

“……”

“确定要这样吗？”

宋郁微微抬头看着他的小鸟，其实许久不见这个形态，那种茫然的情绪还是没有消减。

白粼粼毛绒绒的，收了收翅膀，很认真地点头：

“要！”

于是乎，大厅的走廊里就多了一只庞大的巨鸟，以及它旁边的人类。

白粼粼一直在四处环顾，很是兢兢业业的，看谁敢乱看！

宋郁垂着眼眸，心里泛起来一阵涟漪。

很快他们抵达了窗口处，那里的办事员对这副场景司空见惯的，只是快速地伸出来了手，问：

“通行证。”

鸟拘谨地伸出来了翅膀，托着一个泛着金色纹路边边的信封递了过去。

这是丹顶鹤亲自交给他的。

里面的办事员处理得很快，立马就在一旁的光幕上操作信息，顺带把一个空白的本本放到了一个“机器”的下方。

白粼粼几乎要看得入神了，心想这和人类的部门有什么区别？

……不过是不插电的。

“编号247，户籍是南市，基本信息对吧？”

里头的办事员把本本拿了过来，抬头问了下外面的“妖”，巨大的鸟收了收翅膀，然后点头。

“你变这么大干什么？你不是S级吗？可以化形成人。”

“这样很奇怪，像行为艺术。”

白粼粼：“……”

他觉得中央这里的妖真的“人”味十足，不过还是顺着意思化形成了“少年”模样，休闲衬衫和短裤，腰间还挂着叮叮当当的配饰，浅蓝色的头发打了个卷。

办事员：“……”

噢？

它不由得探头又看了一眼。

白粼粼拘谨，变成人就开始往宋郁身后靠了，对方抬手握住了他的手腕。

“啊……没事，坐过来，坐过来。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 52

Inside the central hall.

Bai Linlin was still perched on a person's shoulder, lowering his bird head to look at the carrier pigeon on the floor. The pigeon's head was swollen, wrapped in a circle of bandages, with only one bird eye visible.

“……”

“……”

The carrier pigeon lowered its head to look at its own wings, then twisted its body; its little parcel was dusty and drab.

It looked up at that big, fat bird... its feathers were smooth and sleek, it was wearing a well-crafted little cape, and there was even a shimmering, ultra-light metal anklet on its bird claw.

Hmph!

The carrier pigeon turned and walked away. The more it thought about it, the angrier it got.

Song Yu hadn't really reacted to what was happening yet, only knowing that his little bird had exerted a bit of strength, flapped its wings, and hopped down, pitter-pattering over to the carrier pigeon.

“Wait, wait, wait.”

“We’ve met before.”

The carrier pigeon kept its head low and continued walking forward, its body swaying from side to side. It was very stubborn and quite dignified.

It was a messenger of the Central Bureau!

It was incorruptible!

Unlike that bird, which relied on its family's wealth to—

A wing was placed on the carrier pigeon's shoulder, and suddenly, a jelly appeared in its line of sight—crystal clear, a big brand, the one from the astronaut commercial.

What are you doing?

The carrier pigeon felt its bird face flush. Just as it wanted to flap its wing to push it away, the bird began to speak:

“I’m here for the first time, and I’m not familiar with the place, but I remember you once delivered a letter to me.”

“Could we step aside and talk?”

The carrier pigeon tucked its wings and said with a stern, serious expression:

“What are you doing? Are you testing me with this?”

“Do you know how strict the Central Bureau is now? They increasingly require on-duty demons to improve the purity of their demonic power. For things like... jelly, it is strictly prohibited!”

The carrier pigeon puffed out its chest as it spoke, though it still snuck a glance at the jelly—there was even a segment of orange inside.

It must be very juicy.

Bai Linlin: “……”

Not working?

The bird looked around to make sure no one was watching, continued to extend its wing to drape over the carrier pigeon, coughed twice, and said quite grandly:

“This isn't jelly!”

The carrier pigeon tilted its head to look over, its bird eye wide with shock.

“This is a Demonic Power Fruit!”

Bai Linlin looked over with an unchanging expression.

The carrier pigeon clearly hadn't been exposed to much human culture and just asked in confusion:

“Isn't this just—”

“I say it’s a Demonic Power Fruit, so it is. Whoever questions it must provide the proof.”

Bai Linlin maintained an air of calm composure.

The carrier pigeon had never seen this kind of operation before, but it silently extended a wing and accepted the “Demonic Power Fruit.”

-

Only then did the conversation truly begin.

The carrier pigeon led the human and the bird to a secluded corner before asking:

“Speak, what do you want to ask?”

Bai Linlin pitter-pattered behind it, looked around the surroundings, and then plucked out his “Pass.”

Seeing the edges shimmering with golden patterns, the carrier pigeon knew exactly what it was and said directly:

“You’re a trainee recommended by a local branch? You should go to the window to report, and then just follow the instructions.”

“……I didn't expect you to be quite capable.”

Hearing this, Bai Linlin couldn't help but tuck his wings in; when out and about, one must remain humble.

After saying this, the carrier pigeon waved its wing, and a golden thread drifted out, probing forward like a swimming little fish, leaving lingering, shimmering afterimages in the void.

“Follow it, and you’ll arrive.”

Bai Linlin thought things were going quite smoothly. Just as he was about to open his beak to thank it, the carrier pigeon spoke up:

“Is this your human partner?”

The voice wasn't lowered in the slightest, causing some demons passing by to glance over.

Bai Linlin’s feathers instantly stood on end. He pitter-pattered over, originally intending to cover the other’s beak with his wing, but the carrier pigeon just tilted its head to remind him:

“If it’s yours, you’d better mark him.”

“Humans aren't safe here. The Central Bureau is a pilgrimage site for demons from all over the country. Demons from different regions have different habits, and there are even demons brought in from the 749 Bureau. Be careful he doesn't get eaten.”

Bai Linlin was shocked.

What was going on?

Song Yu had maintained a very low profile, but that didn't mean he hadn't heard. The young man just lowered his eyes, looking at the round, chubby figure on the ground.

“Ah... how do I mark him?”

Hearing this, the carrier pigeon looked as if it had heard something bizarre, glancing back and forth at the blue-feathered bird, especially sweeping a look at the faint markings on the bird’s claws.

?

What the hell?

The carrier pigeon felt like it had been dragged into some weird roleplay and immediately turned around and left. This time, it truly didn't look back.

-

Bai Linlin was dazed, but fortunately, the guiding thread was still there, so they could still find the reporting window.

However, the “people” around them were indeed glancing over, and some were whispering…

“A human? How could he come here?”

“He’s so young.”

“Whose is he... why is there no demon...”

A round, chubby little bird darted out from behind Song Yu, its feathers almost entirely puffed up, extending its wing-roots to block the others:

“Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!”

Bai Linlin was furious. He was still here! He was still here!

“Eww, so fierce.”

“Let’s go, let’s go.”

“So small, can he even keep watch?”

Those few “people” walked away hurriedly, leaving behind provocative remarks.

Bai Linlin lowered his bird head, the aura around him dropping. What did they mean?

If a bird doesn't show its power, do they think I’m a little chick?!

Song Yu had kept his presence low; after all, this was the demons' home turf. All he could do was not hold his little bird back.

After those “people” left, he wanted to offer a few words of comfort.

But just then.

The blue-feathered bird in front of him began to...

Expand, bit by bit.

-

“……”

“Are you sure you want to do this?”

Song Yu looked up slightly at his bird. In truth, he hadn't seen this form in a long time, and that sense of bewilderment hadn't faded.

Bai Linlin was fluffy; he tucked his wings and nodded very seriously:

“Yes!”

And so, the hallway of the hall gained a massive, giant bird, along with the human beside it.

Bai Linlin kept looking around, very diligent, seeing who dared to stare!

Song Yu lowered his eyes, ripples forming in his heart.

Soon, they arrived at the window. The clerk there was accustomed to such scenes and simply extended a hand quickly, asking:

“Pass.”

The bird cautiously extended a wing, holding an envelope with golden-patterned edges and handing it over.

This was given to him personally by the Red-Crowned Crane.

The clerk inside processed it quickly, immediately operating the information on the light screen to the side, and placed a blank booklet under a “machine.”

Bai Linlin was almost mesmerized, thinking, how is this any different from human departments?

...Except it wasn't plugged in.

“Number 247, registered in South City, basic information, correct?”

The clerk inside took the booklet and looked up to ask the “demon” outside. The giant bird tucked its wings and nodded.

“Why are you turning so big? Aren't you S-rank? You can take human form.”

“This is very strange, like performance art.”

Bai Linlin: “……”

He felt the demons here at the Central Bureau were truly full of “human” flavor, but he still complied and transformed into the appearance of a “young man”—casual shirt and shorts, jingling accessories hanging from his waist, and light blue hair styled in curls.

The clerk: “……”

Oh?

It couldn't help but lean forward to take another look.

Bai Linlin was reserved; once he turned into a human, he began to lean behind Song Yu, who reached out and gripped his wrist.

“Ah... it’s fine, sit over here, sit over here.”

chunks.chineseText:
办事员又恢复了正常状态，只是拿过来那个纸质的本本，开始登记一些信息，它只是问了问：

“南市管理局推荐你来中央，将会进行为其半个月的培训？这个知道吧？”

“知道。”

办事员点了点头，而后又说了一些注意事项，主要就是身为公职人员的初心与使命。

原本是一切顺利的，但是办事员余光却扫到了一个微微亮着的印记。

它蹙了蹙眉，道：

“编号247，鉴于你还没有培训，你的这些行为我们可以理解……”

白粼粼懵懵的，这什么意思。

“但现在已经是新时代了，追求人类伴侣要拿出来心意，而不是用术法控制住，你用的什么契？这是封建糟粕知道不知道？”

“我们中央抵制任何包办婚姻。”

白粼粼的手腕还在被握着，但是此刻却不知道怎么了，觉得接触的地方传来一阵一阵的烫意。

什么？

这说的什么？

鸟慌了。

“血契……这是最不公平的那种，你的伴侣是自愿的吗？还是你强迫——”

“我自愿的。”

白粼粼还没从“包办婚姻”里走出来，之后就听到了这么一句话，心脏怦怦的。

但这还没完。

办事员显然是不太相信，只是摇了摇头道：

“你看看你的伴侣多么为你考虑，不过这是在你们老家弄的，我们中央也管不了……”

“但是，我得提醒你一下。”

办事员又侧身从里面拿出来一沓文件，接着道：

“你既然和你的伴侣都做了血契了，那还是尽早标记了。”

“这里全部都是妖怪，大厅人员流动大，很危险的。”

白粼粼再次听到了这个词，他面色都红了，甚至尴尬地想要抽出来自己的手臂，但宋郁面不改色的，只是侧头问：

“怎么了？”

什么怎么了！你还说！

一人一鸟视线拉扯。

也就在这时，窗口里面的办事员又拿出来了那个本本，手里拿着钢印，公事公办地道：

“再确定下信息，这以后将是全国的通行证，去各个城市都可以得到接待的，所以一定要完全准确。”

白粼粼只好没再管自己的手腕，抬眸看向了窗口那里，表示自己在听。

“编号：247”

“对的。”

“户籍地址：xx省南市平湖区锦园。”

“也是对的。”

“状态：已有配偶。”

“对……啊？”

白粼粼真着急了，连忙倾身去看窗口里的本本，宋郁就在后面握着那个手，他们没松开。

“什么情况？”

办事员一脸莫名其妙：

“你血契都签了，他还是你的监护人，你们是伴侣关系，怎么？老家仪式没办吗？”

白粼粼本来想要否认的，但是脑海中却闪过一幕幕的画面，只能是张了张口。

办事员看到后更是不太满意，认真地教育道：

“你被举荐上来的，说不定以后就身担公职了，怎么能……不认呢？”

“当心以后被检举！”

白粼粼是真不知道怎么办了，但是办事员在登记信息的时候还是又问了下：

“他是你的监护人对吧？那现在有个二级身份，你是想要怎么填？”

白粼粼脸颊一直很烫，他莫名也有些晕晕的，不知道怎么了。

“除了伴侣……还有什么？”

办事员：“情夫。”

“……”

-

最后钢印还是压下了，人与鸟拥有了第二个红本本，白粼粼脸颊都泛着红，被牵着往回走。

宋郁的记性很好，即使这是完全陌生的地方，他都能一遍记住路。

“少年”的手腕被牵着，人也晕晕沉沉的，他看到了对方手背上那个若隐若现的印记。

契么？

丹顶鹤那天和他说了，会亮……

那就是。

白粼粼想到了什么，一下子站定了脚步，咬着唇瓣，不知道怎么办了。

腕骨都发烫了。

但就在这时，不远处有个被押着的“犯人”，闻到人类的味道后立马偏头看了过来，金瞳亮了下，面部也开始往外撕裂……

白粼粼看到了，当即就炸毛了。

直接起身挡了过去。

“滚开！”

宋郁微微抬了下眉，最后他们的动作反了过来，变成了“少年”牵着他，一路上风风火火的。

来到了一个隐蔽的角落里，这里没有什么“人”。

白粼粼实在是不放心了，大厅的路很长，这么走也要十多分钟。

他现在就要标记！

-

“少年”面色泛红，后颈的纹路也若隐若现地泛着光，他有点口渴。

“宋郁……对不起，我不知道那个契约那么不公平，但我可以给你匀一些寿命，这样你就可以活得很长。”

白粼粼还是坦白了，他本来升S级也就是这个目的，伴侣什么的……其实没有想太多。

“为什么要我活得很长？”

宋郁垂眸看着“人”，很轻地问道，面色始终保持着稳定。

他步入了异世界，这里的一切装潢几乎与现实世界无异，到处都是“人”，他辨别不出来差别。

丢失了方向。

荒诞，错乱。

……

宋郁却没有什么恐慌的情绪，这里纵然再可怕，他的面前始终有一个“锚点”，视野渐渐清晰，那个毛绒绒的脑袋露了出来。

“就是想。”

白粼粼实在说不出来什么理由，闷声闷气的，他拉着对方的胳膊，拽到了面前，说起了另一件事：

“还有很长一段路，我试着盖下你的味道吧。”

宋郁闻言怔了下，眼眸暗沉，道：

“好。”

角落无人在意，“少年”闭了闭眼，仿佛下定了决心，深呼吸一口气，然后——

砰得一下变成大鸟。

伸翅膀把人盖住。

一气呵成。

“……”

宋郁最后只是无奈地道：“这样可以么？”

白粼粼其实也不太清楚，他又化形成了“少年”模样，为难地道：

“我也不知道，我其实一直在你身边的。”

“它们好像能嗅出来不同。”

白粼粼咬了咬唇：

“我不会标记。”

“少年”是真的很着急，他后颈的印记甚至更亮了，吐出来的气流都是热的。

白粼粼想到了什么，仰头看了过来，眼睛圆圆的：

“我去问丹顶鹤！它肯定会教我怎么标——”

“少年”一把被扣住了后颈，拉了过来。

宋郁垂眸道：“我教你。”

“我看过了。”

白粼粼本来是很懵的，他想问问这句话什么意思，看过……看过什么了？

但是不知道怎么了，他的视线都变得模糊，身体也很热，几乎着急地贴了过去，宋郁身上凉快一些。

做完这个动作之后。

“……”

鸟反应过来了。

不行！

白粼粼抬手就要推开对方的肩头，但是手腕被扣住了，耳边传来一句：

“咬我就可以。”

“我们不是血契么……”

人的声音仿佛是什么魔咒一样，蛊惑妖心，白粼粼本来就觉得口干舌燥的，听到这话之后，瞳孔都泛出来点金。

咬……

咬……

Chapter 52 (Part 2)

The clerk returned to its normal state, picked up the paper booklet, and began to register some information, simply asking:

“The South City Administration recommended you to come to the Central Bureau for a half-month training session? You’re aware of this, right?”

“I am.”

The clerk nodded and then mentioned a few points of attention, mainly regarding the original intention and mission of being a public servant.

Everything was going smoothly, but the clerk’s peripheral vision caught a faintly glowing mark.

It frowned and said:

“Number 247, given that you haven't undergone training yet, we can understand these behaviors of yours...”

Bai Linlin was dazed. What did that mean?

“But it’s a new era now. Pursuing a human partner requires sincerity, not controlling them with sorcery. What kind of contract did you use? Do you know this is feudal dross?”

“We at the Central Bureau resist any arranged marriages.”

Bai Linlin’s wrist was still being held, but at this moment, he didn't know what was wrong; he felt a wave of heat coming from the point of contact.

What?

What was this saying?

The bird panicked.

“A blood contract... this is the most unfair kind. Is your partner willing, or did you force—”

“I am willing.”

Bai Linlin hadn't yet recovered from the “arranged marriage” comment when he heard these words, his heart pounding.

But it wasn't over yet.

The clerk clearly didn't quite believe it, just shook its head and said:

“Look at how much your partner considers you. However, this was done in your hometown, and our Central Bureau can't really manage that...”

“But, I must remind you.”

The clerk turned to the side, pulled out a stack of documents from inside, and continued:

“Since you and your partner have already made a blood contract, you should mark him as soon as possible.”

“Everyone here is a demon, and there is a high flow of people in the hall. It’s very dangerous.”

Bai Linlin heard the term again. His face turned red, and he was so embarrassed he wanted to pull his arm away, but Song Yu remained calm, only tilting his head to ask:

“What’s wrong?”

What’s wrong?! You still ask!

The human and the bird locked eyes.

Just then, the clerk inside the window took out the booklet again, held a steel stamp in hand, and said in a business-like tone:

“Let’s confirm the information again. This will be your nationwide pass in the future, and you will be received in every city you go to, so it must be completely accurate.”

Bai Linlin had no choice but to stop worrying about his wrist and looked up at the window, indicating he was listening.

“Number: 247”

“Correct.”

“Registered address: Jin Yuan, Pinghu District, South City, XX Province.”

“Also correct.”

“Status: Already has a spouse.”

“Correct... wait, what?”

Bai Linlin was truly anxious and hurriedly leaned over to look at the booklet in the window. Song Yu was right behind him, holding that wrist; they hadn't let go.

“What’s going on?”

The clerk looked baffled:

“You’ve already signed a blood contract, and he’s your guardian, and you are partners. What? Did you not hold the ceremony back home?”

Bai Linlin originally wanted to deny it, but scenes flashed through his mind, and he could only open his mouth.

Seeing this, the clerk was even less satisfied and educated him earnestly:

“You were recommended to come here, and you might hold public office in the future. How can you... not acknowledge it?”

“Be careful of being reported in the future!”

Bai Linlin really didn't know what to do, but while registering the information, the clerk asked again:

“He is your guardian, right? There’s a secondary status now; how do you want to fill it in?”

Bai Linlin’s cheeks were burning; he felt inexplicably dizzy and didn't know what was happening.

“Besides partner... what else is there?”

Clerk: “Lover.”

“……”

-

In the end, the steel stamp was pressed down. The human and the bird possessed their second red booklet. Bai Linlin’s cheeks were flushed red as he was led back.

Song Yu had a great memory; even though this was a completely unfamiliar place, he could remember the way after just one trip.

The “young man’s” wrist was being held, and he felt lightheaded. He saw the faint mark on the back of the other’s hand.

A contract?

The Red-Crowned Crane told him that day that it would glow...

That was it.

Thinking of something, Bai Linlin suddenly stopped in his tracks, biting his lip, not knowing what to do.

His wrist bone was burning.

But just then, not far away, a “prisoner” being escorted smelled the scent of a human and immediately turned his head to look over. His golden pupils brightened, and his face began to tear open...

Bai Linlin saw it and his feathers instantly stood on end.

He immediately stood up to block him.

“Get lost!”

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly. In the end, their roles reversed, and it became the “young man” pulling him along, moving like a whirlwind.

They arrived in a hidden corner where there were no “people.”

Bai Linlin was truly worried; the hall was very long, and walking like this would take more than ten minutes.

He had to mark him now!

-

The “young man’s” face was flushed, and the markings on the back of his neck were faintly glowing. He was a bit thirsty.

“Song Yu... I’m sorry, I didn't know that contract was so unfair, but I can share some of my lifespan with you so you can live a very long time.”

Bai Linlin confessed. His goal in reaching S-rank was originally for this; as for being partners... he hadn't really thought about it much.

“Why do you want me to live a long time?”

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at the “person,” asking very softly, his expression remaining stable.

He had stepped into another world. The decor here was almost identical to the real world, and everywhere were “people.” He couldn't tell the difference.

He had lost his direction.

Absurd, chaotic.

……

Yet, Song Yu felt no panic. No matter how terrifying this place was, there was always an “anchor” in front of him. His vision gradually cleared, and that fluffy head was revealed.

“I just want to.”

Bai Linlin couldn't come up with a reason, feeling stifled. He pulled the other’s arm, dragged him to his front, and brought up another matter:

“There’s still a long way to go. Let me try to cover you with my scent.”

Song Yu was stunned, his eyes darkening as he said:

“Okay.”

No one cared about the corner. The “young man” closed his eyes, as if having made a decision, took a deep breath, and then—

With a *poof*, he turned into a giant bird.

He extended his wings to cover the human.

It was done in one smooth motion.

“……”

Song Yu finally just said helplessly: “Is this okay?”

Bai Linlin actually wasn't sure either. He transformed back into the “young man” and said awkwardly:

“I don't know either. I’ve actually always been by your side.”

“They seem to be able to smell the difference.”

Bai Linlin bit his lip:

“I don't know how to mark.”

The “young man” was truly anxious. The mark on the back of his neck glowed even brighter, and the air he exhaled was hot.

Thinking of something, Bai Linlin looked up, his eyes round:

“I’ll go ask the Red-Crowned Crane! It will definitely teach me how to mark—”

The “young man” grabbed the back of his neck and pulled him in.

Song Yu lowered his eyes: “I’ll teach you.”

“I’ve seen it.”

Bai Linlin was originally very dazed. He wanted to ask what that meant—seen it... seen what?

But for some reason, his vision blurred, and his body felt very hot. He almost anxiously pressed against the other; Song Yu’s body was cooler.

After doing this.

“……”

The bird realized what happened.

No!

Bai Linlin raised his hand to push away the other’s shoulder, but his wrist was gripped, and a voice came to his ear:

“Just bite me.”

“Aren't we bound by a blood contract...”

The human’s voice was like a spell, bewitching the demon’s heart. Bai Linlin already felt parched, and upon hearing this, his pupils glowed with a hint of gold.

Bite...

Bite...

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼觉得还是太超过了，他不要，但是来不及了，宋郁扣着他的后颈，往前压。

幼鸟变为成鸟。

第一步，嗅到人类的味道。

第二步，辨别出来监护人的味道。

白粼粼是个妖怪。

“唔……”

“少年”的唇瓣碰到了那个肌肤，其实是想要推开的，但是仿佛是控制不住了，脑海里反复响起来丹顶鹤的话：

“千载难逢的好机会……”

“凡事都可以推到发情上……”

白粼粼咬上去了，眼皮都泛着潮气，很忘我地伸着舌尖去舔舐。

-

大厅里来过来一群“人”，在闲言碎语的。

“不是说有人类吗？”

“这也没有啊？”

“不会是假消息吧……”

很快这些交谈声就慢慢地消失了。

而一个隐蔽的角落里，宋郁在垂眸看着怀里的“少年”，那种微妙的疼痛仿佛完全察觉不到。

取而代之的是另外一种感官。

手背上的印记没有那么亮了。

白粼粼其实还有些意识不清，他只是觉得很舒服……身体没有那么热了，只是还不够。

他还要尝尝。

但是这次被捏住了下巴。

“粼粼，我没办法见人了。”

宋郁的声音是偏沉的，脖子上有着星星点点的痕迹，还有牙印。

很爱磨人。

白粼粼是真的有些晕，唇瓣红润润的，脑子里更是一团浆糊。

浑身都是热的。

他根本听不清人在说什么话。

宋郁见状蹙了蹙眉，直接揽着过来，抵了抵额头，温度很高……

他不由得回想起来丹顶鹤说过的话：

[……反正它等级升得太快，妖力蓬勃，也是需要散一散的。]

那应该没事。

不过就在这时。

“少年”像是突然又有劲了，抬手抵住他的肩头，弄不开，就抬了下巴，也就那么一个动作。

宋郁的唇瓣触碰到了什么。

很湿热，很软。

也就一两秒。

等到他再反应过来的时候，“少年”已经不见了，掌心只是多了一个四仰八叉的小鸟。

“啾……”

-

酒店。

宋郁的记性很好，后面直接带着他的小鸟回来了，原本是打算去浴室处理下伤口的，但还是绕到了床边。

“少年”睡得昏昏沉沉，面色泛红，唇瓣都是微张着的，往外吐着热气，它不舒服……

宋郁面色有些担忧，最后还是联系了下丹顶鹤，但是对面只是还在“正在输入中”，最后扔过来一句：

[247不行，你也不行？]

宋郁有一瞬间的愣神，但这条消息很快就撤回了，很快发过来了官方回复：

[成鸟第一次发情是很长的，断断续续的，不可能一下子就很严重，时间还不到……它不是咬了你么？那可能是有点承受不住，睡一睡就好了。]

宋郁蹙了蹙眉。

承受不住？

最后他还是陪了一夜，顺便看了下南市发来的消息。

[查出来了，根据先前的消息来看，那个服务站存在的时间就是很短，昌平孤儿院才是建了很多年那个，但它的档案不好找。]

[已经合并到了桐城市福利院那里，我为此做了半年的义工……宋郁我服了……]

[总之是给你整出来了，一共128页的pdf……你自己看吧。]

对面是先前分析“身份证”的朋友，上线把东西发了就下线了。

宋郁也不觉得麻烦，一边夜里看顾着床上的“少年”，一边去看那些名单目录。

他不明白桐城那次。

他的小鸟为什么要离他而去。

有什么东西在留恋？

-

时间一点一滴在过去，白粼粼的意识也渐渐地清醒了，不过他睁开眼睛的时候才发现自己在人的怀里。

？

宋郁就靠在床头，他没有睡，察觉到动静后只是低头问：

“醒了？”

“还难受么？”

白粼粼面颊很红，他刚想抬手去起身，但是被稳稳地按住了后颈，耳廓的头发也被捋了下。

宋郁的声音莫名的沉。

“睡觉吧，嗯？”

或许确实困了，听着这话简直像是催眠曲，白粼粼本来是打算阖上眼皮打个盹的，但是下一秒就沉沉地睡了过去。

宋郁还在看信息，修长的手指上下滑动着，最后停到一张学生时期的照片上。

-

翌日。

白粼粼再次活力满满，他非常认真地遵照丹顶鹤的建议，同人道歉：

“我可能生病了……我不知道发生了什么，总之那不是出于我的本意。”

宋郁正带着“人”在超市购物，神色如常，只是故作不知地问：

“什么病？”

旁边的少年扶着那个购物车边边，闻言懵懵的，最后抬步跟了过来，背了背手，眼睛圆圆的，试探地道：

“会控制不住咬人，但其实不太疼的吧？”

宋郁抬手把重复的几包薯片从购物车里拿了出来，它喉咙都是红的，上火了。

白粼粼很是从善如流地把架子上的薯片再丢进来，人拿一个，鸟放一个，从而形成良性循环。

“不疼的吧？”

“少年”有点着急，又抬步走了过来，拦在了宋郁的面前，仰头道：

“宋郁！”

“嗯。”

“你快说不疼！”

……

总之是插科打诨了一会儿，宋郁到底还是说了“不疼”，白粼粼高高兴兴地跟着去结账区了。

他仔细看了下购物车，清点ing。

？

“少年”不解，控诉道：

“我的劲仔小鱼呢？”

宋郁皱眉，还是耐心地道：

“那个太辣了……”

白粼粼看了下队伍的长度，抿了抿唇，立马采取行动，他要拿回来。

“粼粼？”

宋郁面色变得很沉，因为“少年”已经快步走开了，甚至是在他出声之前。

“不好意思，你结账吗？”

后面有个年轻的女士问了下。

宋郁很礼貌地让行了。

-

而与此同时。

白粼粼正在货架里走来走去的，怀里一共有三盒劲仔小鱼，不同口味的。

他环顾了下四周，觉得还可以再多拿几包其他的，不过……挑哪个？

也就在这时。

“粼粼就爱吃小零食，小的时候那是正餐也不吃，巴巴地等着发酸奶。”

“是！他调皮捣蛋的那个劲，写字也不好好写，还想给自己取名叫一一，可把他能耐的呀。”

“你别说，谁想到这孩子整天抱着个旧娃娃睡觉呢？还是我缝的！”

“是是是，给他拿个……”

熟悉的声音越来越近。

白粼粼还在想，怎么会有人的声音这么像他的老师们。

下一秒。

货架拐弯处走出来了几个老师，她们熟悉的面庞一下子映入眼帘，并且抬眸看了过来。

白粼粼整个人都愣住了。

真的吗？

真的……真的吗？

他几乎控制不住地往前走，但就在这时，手腕突然被扣住了，被往后用力地一扯。

白粼粼撞到了一个怀里。

上方传来声音：

“在这里。”
