Bai Linlin said very earnestly: "I’ve already said, I met him in Nan City. He is a very good person."

"I... I am his."

Bai Linlin’s mind was filled with scenes of their encounters: taking photos at the Management Bureau, performing the ceremony, going out on missions, the Hundred Spirits visiting, forming the contract...

One thing after another.

"Partner."

After Bai Linlin said this word, the "person" himself was stunned. He thought it would be very difficult to say, but in reality... it didn't seem that hard.

He and Song Yu were indeed accompanying each other.

That didn't seem wrong at all.

The teachers: "..."

-

After that, a very serious conversation began.

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly. He was ready.

chunks.chineseText:
第55章

小小的出租屋里十分严峻，客厅里的沙发其实很小，但好歹是一个L型的，长的那边全是老师们，短的那边是宋郁。

此刻正在进行审视。

老师们每个都是皱着眉头的，彼此交流了下眼神，传达的意思不言而喻：

男同就是不好惹。

“那个，我们粼粼之前可没有这种倾向的……”

为首的一个老师先开口说了，还咳咳了几声，有些戒备的意思。

白粼粼站在宋郁的身边，闻言一下子面色就红了，他连忙摆了摆手，解释道：

“老师，我们不是你们想的——”

他的手腕被扣住了，往后拉了一下。

宋郁面色很平和地道：

“我会负责。”

老师们听到这话其实反应平平，这年头了，口头上的承诺谁不会？

但下一秒。

“我们签了血契，如果我背叛了，我会死。”

白粼粼的闻言怔怔的，低头看了过去，其实那个契……他了解得不多，只是知道是单向的，自己的同生共死是口头的，但是宋郁的确实会生效。

所以是封建糟粕。

“少年”不由自主地偏开了视线，唇瓣抿了抿。

“啊？那、那……你不后悔？”

老师们实在是不理解，事出反常必有妖，怎么会有人愿意和妖怪签订契约，更何况他们粼粼才和这个人认识多久？

宋郁面色坦坦荡荡的，“我为什么要后悔？”

“这是我的小鸟。”

老师们一时半会没有反应过来，后知后觉这是孩子先前说的“死后经历的事”，粼粼是被这个年轻人养了。

这说的倒是没问题。

但是……

老师们皱了皱眉，也陈述了一句：

“粼粼是昌平孤儿院走出去的，是我们的孩子。”

剑拔弩张。

白粼粼懵懵的，其实不太清楚为什么开始说他的身份，这很重要吗？

“你多大了？”

老师们开始盘问。

白粼粼手腕被拉着，也没有挣，只是很自然地说了句：

“他现在大一，十九了。”

老师们蹙眉看了下一边的“少年”，心说这孩子怎么胳膊肘往外拐？

“这太小了呀。”

宋郁垂着眼眸，一字一句道：

“那我的精力会很好，更能照顾好粼粼。”

白粼粼面色一下子就红了，刚要说什么，对面又开始问了：

“那你家里做什么的？”

“开公司。”

老师们倒吸一口冷气，气势弱了三分，不过她们还是很快想到了另一个问题：

“那你家里这么有钱……我们粼粼就是普通人家出来的，更何况现在他是个妖怪，那你父母……”

宋郁面不改色地道：

“我父母一个在美洲一个在欧洲，基本断绝了关系，不会打扰到我们的生活。”

“我爷爷目前是在家修养，他老人家知道粼粼的事，也很疼它。”

全部说出来了，很诚恳。

老师们还没从那个“断绝关系”中反应过来，立马又听到了个“知道粼粼的事”，她们不由得仰头去看旁边站着的孩子。

“少年”点了点头，还巴巴地说了句：

“爷爷也很好。”

老师们闭了闭眼，心想孩子这纯粹是被养熟了……

带回去的可能性几乎为零。

更何况面前这个年轻人看着着实是不太好相与的，在超市里就那么不避讳，现在……也一直扣着孩子的手。

这、这？

老师们最后深呼吸一口气，问了一件很关键的事：

“我们粼粼变成了妖怪，你怎么可能会和他一直在一起？”

“这件事你考虑过吗？”

不过这句话一出，回答的不是宋郁了，而是旁边站着的“少年”：

“没事的，老师。”

“我可以和他——”

白粼粼一个急刹车，耳根子都有些发烫了，他侧了侧头，硬生生地把话题岔开了。

“总之是有办法的。”

宋郁握着那截手腕，面色平静地坐在沙发上，垂眸看着掌心的那截手腕。

老师们：“……”

“那我们也需要看到你的诚意，我们虽然说年纪大了，但桐城那里始终是有一块地的，粼粼什么时候都是可以回去的。”

出租屋里回复了平和的状态。

老师们很是中肯地说了这一番话，同时也看向了一旁的“少年”，蹙眉道：

“过来过来。”

白粼粼立马就往那里走，但是手腕被扯了下，他回头看了下宋郁，对方神色如常，松开了手。

“老师，宋郁是个好人的。”

“我本来还想再装一下的，是他让我相信你们的……主要这个事我实在是……”

老师们瞪大了眼睛，抬手就是拍了下这孩子的胳膊，打断道：

“小时候那么皮就算了！怎么大了还这么不懂事？”

“老师会害怕你吗？”

“老师恨不得招魂把你招回来！”

“你知不知道我们进京看到——”

几个老师一下子就说不下去了，声音都变得哽咽，“少年”看到后也是很动容，直接蹲下身子了，仰头看着这些带大他的老师，压着情绪，很乐观开朗地道：

“粼粼在的，粼粼在的。”

“我后面过得很好，变成妖怪后可以学很多有意思的法术。”

“特别好，我过得特别好！”

白粼粼仰着头，很亲近地贴过去，伸出来了掌心，有金色的线在跳动，像是一个小小的烟花。

老师们注意力被吸引走了不少，只是擦了擦眼泪，新奇地道：

“这是什么？”

“怎么弄出来的？”

“来来让我拍个照。”

沙发那里其乐融融的，宋郁在不远处就这么看着，身子微微往后靠着，视线始终锁定在那个“少年”的背影。

没事。

不过是叙叙旧而已。

-

后面大约又交谈了十多分钟，宋郁始终保持着一个很低的存在感，直到“少年”回到了他的身边。

白粼粼基本上把他的情况说完了，以及表达了不回桐城的事，没办法，南市已经有了太多的社会关系，001、丹顶鹤、皮皮……还有爷爷和宋郁，他抛不下。

“说完了？”

宋郁把人拉了过来，垂眸看了下“少年”的手臂，顺着去抚了下。

老师们：？

不就是拍了下么？

白粼粼其实压根没有察觉到这个细节，他只是认真地道：

“说完了。”

“老师们在替我打那个官司，不太顺利。”

宋郁很自然地抬手握住了“人”的手，抬眸看了过去：

“不用担心这个。”

“我处理。”

房子实在太小了，以至于老师都听到了，她们摇了摇头，心想这果然还是年纪小，对面那死公司简直是狡兔三窟，完全就是游走在法律的灰色地带上。

很难办的。

这年轻人才多大？父母就不说了，家里只有一个年长的爷爷。

老师们其实说到底还是有些担心的，但这只持续了三分钟。

因为宋郁直接过来了，顺带递过来一张卡，很温和地道：

“密码是250417。”

老师们震惊，后知后觉反应过来了，连忙把那张卡推了过去。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 55

The small rented apartment was filled with a grave atmosphere. The sofa in the living room was actually quite small, but it was at least L-shaped; the long side was occupied by the teachers, and the short side by Song Yu.

An interrogation was currently underway.

Every teacher was frowning, exchanging glances with one another, the meaning behind them clear:

Gay men are just not to be trifled with.

"Um, our Linlin didn't have these tendencies before..."

The lead teacher spoke first, coughing a few times, looking somewhat guarded.

Bai Linlin stood beside Song Yu, his face flushing red at the words. He quickly waved his hands, explaining:

"Teacher, we aren't what you think—"

His wrist was caught and pulled back slightly.

Song Yu said with a calm expression:

"I will take responsibility."

The teachers’ reactions to these words were lukewarm. In this day and age, who couldn't make a verbal promise?

But the next second.

"We have signed a blood contract. If I betray him, I will die."

Bai Linlin was stunned at these words and looked down. In truth, he didn't know much about that contract... he only knew it was one-sided. His own "life and death" vow was just verbal, but Song Yu’s was truly binding.

So, it was feudal superstition.

The "youth" couldn't help but look away, his lips pressed together.

"Ah? Then, then... you don't regret it?"

The teachers truly couldn't understand. When things go against the norm, there must be a demon at play. How could anyone be willing to sign a contract with a spirit? And besides, how long had their Linlin even known this person?

Song Yu’s expression was open and honest. "Why would I regret it?"

"This is my little bird."

The teachers didn't react for a moment, only realizing belatedly that this was what the child had mentioned earlier about "what happened after death"—Linlin had been raised by this young man.

That part was fine.

But...

The teachers frowned and stated:

"Linlin walked out of the Changping Orphanage; he is our child."

The tension was palpable.

Bai Linlin was confused. He didn't really understand why they were talking about his identity; was that so important?

"How old are you?"

The teachers began their cross-examination.

Bai Linlin’s wrist was being held, but he didn't struggle, simply saying naturally:

"He is a freshman in college, nineteen."

The teachers frowned and looked at the "youth" beside him, thinking to themselves: *How is this child siding with an outsider?*

"That’s too young."

Song Yu lowered his eyes and said every word clearly:

"That means I have plenty of energy and can take even better care of Linlin."

Bai Linlin’s face turned red instantly. Just as he was about to say something, the other side began to ask:

"And what does your family do?"

"We run a company."

The teachers drew a sharp breath, their momentum weakening by a third. However, they quickly thought of another problem:

"Your family is so rich... and our Linlin comes from an ordinary background. Plus, he’s a spirit now, so your parents..."

Song Yu didn't change his expression:

"My parents are in the Americas and Europe respectively. We have basically severed ties, and they will not disturb our lives."

"My grandfather is currently recuperating at home. He knows about Linlin’s situation and cherishes him very much."

He said it all, very sincerely.

The teachers hadn't even recovered from the "severed ties" part before they heard "knows about Linlin’s situation." They couldn't help but look up at the child standing beside him.

The "youth" nodded and added eagerly:

"Grandfather is also very kind."

The teachers closed their eyes, thinking that the child had simply been "tamed"...

The possibility of taking him back was almost zero.

Moreover, this young man in front of them really didn't look easy to deal with. He hadn't been shy about it in the supermarket, and now... he was still holding the child’s hand.

This, this?

The teachers finally took a deep breath and asked one key question:

"Our Linlin has turned into a spirit; how could you possibly stay with him forever?"

"Have you considered this?"

But as soon as this question was asked, it wasn't Song Yu who answered, but the "youth" standing beside him:

"It’s okay, Teacher."

"I can be with him—"

Bai Linlin slammed on the brakes, his earlobes burning hot. He turned his head and forcibly changed the subject.

"In any case, there are ways."

Song Yu held that section of his wrist, sitting on the sofa with a calm expression, looking down at the wrist in his palm.

The teachers: "..."

"Then we need to see your sincerity. Although we are old, there is always a piece of land in Tongcheng; Linlin can go back whenever he wants."

The rented apartment returned to a state of peace.

The teachers had said these words quite fairly, and at the same time, they looked at the "youth" beside them, frowning:

"Come here, come here."

Bai Linlin immediately started to walk over, but his wrist was tugged. He looked back at Song Yu, who had a normal expression and let go of his hand.

"Teacher, Song Yu is a good person."

"I originally wanted to keep pretending, but it was he who told me to trust you... It’s just that this whole thing is really..."

The teachers’ eyes widened. They reached out and patted the child’s arm, interrupting:

"Being mischievous when you were little is one thing! How are you still so thoughtless now that you're older?"

"Would the teachers be afraid of you?"

"The teachers were dying to summon your soul back!"

"Do you know how we felt when we came to the capital and saw—"

Several teachers couldn't continue, their voices choking up. The "youth" was deeply moved when he saw this; he squatted down directly, looking up at the teachers who had raised him, suppressing his emotions, and said in a cheerful, optimistic tone:

"Linlin is here, Linlin is here."

"I’ve been doing very well later on. After becoming a spirit, I can learn many interesting spells."

"It’s really great, I’m doing really well!"

Bai Linlin looked up, leaning in closely, and extended his palm. Golden lines danced there, like a tiny firework.

The teachers’ attention was drawn away, and they wiped their tears, asking with curiosity:

"What is this?"

"How did you make that?"

"Come, let me take a picture."

The scene on the sofa was harmonious. Song Yu watched from not far away, leaning back slightly, his gaze locked on the "youth's" back.

It’s fine.

It’s just catching up on old times.

-

They talked for about ten more minutes. Song Yu maintained a very low profile the entire time until the "youth" returned to his side.

Bai Linlin had basically finished explaining his situation, as well as expressing that he wouldn't be returning to Tongcheng. There was no help for it; he already had too many social connections in Nan City—001, the Red-Crowned Crane, Pipi... and Grandfather and Song Yu. He couldn't leave them behind.

"Finished?"

Song Yu pulled him over, lowered his eyes to look at the "youth's" arm, and stroked it.

The teachers: ?

Wasn't it just a pat?

Bai Linlin hadn't noticed this detail at all; he just said earnestly:

"Finished."

"The teachers are helping me fight that lawsuit, but it’s not going very smoothly."

Song Yu naturally reached out and took the "person's" hand, looking up:

"Don't worry about that."

"I’ll handle it."

The apartment was truly too small, so the teachers heard him. They shook their heads, thinking that he was still young after all. That dead company was as cunning as a rabbit with three burrows, completely operating in the gray areas of the law.

It was very difficult to deal with.

How old was this young man? Not to mention his parents, he only had an elderly grandfather at home.

The teachers were actually quite worried, but this only lasted for three minutes.

Because Song Yu walked over directly and handed over a card, saying very gently:

"The password is 250417."

The teachers were shocked. Realizing what it was, they hurriedly tried to push the card back.

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁对此并不意外，只是接着道：

“不必太生分，粼粼把你们当成家人，那我也应当如此，不可能说是一份力也不出的。”

“昌平孤儿院不是合并了么？你们或许要去桐城福利院那里？或许这也可以购买一些物资，也是我的一番心意。”

这话说得实在滴水不漏。

老师们一下子也有些无所适从，尤其是在提到福利院，那里的孩子健康的很少，有的需要天天吃药，还有卫生用品……都是开支。

“这……”

老师们不自觉地看向了旁边的“少年”，白粼粼只是侧头看向宋郁，问了句：

“不多吧？”

“不多。”

“老师收下吧，这样子可以给弟弟妹妹一些实在的东西。”

白粼粼没有再内耗下去了，他堂堂正正的，认真地道：

“老师，不要觉得我是依附了宋郁……没有的，我们结了契的，所以这些，你们拿着。”

“妖怪没有身份证，我幻化出来的东西，弟弟妹妹用不了的。”

宋郁后面就没有再开口了，只是任由“少年”挡在他的面前，眼皮微微垂着，心里有什么东西在破土生长。

他的小鸟愿意用他了。

“那、那……收下？”

老师们面面相觑的，其实有些被说动了，毕竟她们这次来京，其实把积蓄花的差不多了，回去还有福利院的一些事。

确实缺钱。

但是过意不去。

“收下收下。”

白粼粼把那张卡抽了出来，然后递了过去，再次道：

“人类的事，只能是他来帮忙。”

“我现在只是个小妖，等我学会了好的技能，说不定就可以做一些实事了。”

老师们如梦似幻的，最后接下了那张卡，然后说了下她们的安排。

-

回到车内的时候，白粼粼已经有些困了，在副驾驶上坐着，抱着一个袋子，抬手去吃香菇脆，闷闷地道：

“原来后天就要走了。”

“钥匙你拿了吗？”

宋郁抬手拿出来那个房门钥匙，是出租屋的，老师们一直念着这个房子，还给房东续了几个月的，现在到期了，本来要把东西都给带回桐城去，没想到阴差阳错……相见了，就把钥匙给了他们。

“拿了的。”

白粼粼点了点头，其实也有些恍惚的感觉，他一边嚼，一边伸出来自己的掌心，那个金线烟花再次在掌心跳动。

他如果能会一些高级的术法就好了。

“很好看。”

白粼粼回了回神，才发现人在看，于是很自然地伸手过去了，眼睛圆圆的，仰头道：

“是吧！”

宋郁垂着眼睛，轻声道：“是。”

几天之后。

老师们拒绝了坐飞机回桐城的提议，坚决还是火车，说是能省一些是一些。

在火车站内，她们大包小包的，但还是对着面前的“少年”认认真真地嘱咐了几句：

“福利院那里有些事必须要处理了，你阿萍老师家里人住院了，她也得回去，不过别担心，要是时间来得及，我们还来京市看你。”

白粼粼下巴收了收，只是很乖巧地点了点头。

“老师，也可以来南市，或者我去桐城，我会飞——”

旁边有个提着行李箱过去的人，面色古怪地往这边看了一眼。

老师们闭了闭眼，本来是想要敲一下这孩子脑瓜的，但是看到了旁边的年轻人。

“……”

“注意一点啊！这出门在外的。”

老师们只能这么说，然后就是交代了下律师和出租屋的事：

“那个公司我们主要没有办法，但这半年老师也是找了很多相同的受害者的资料什么的，都交给……他了，总之希望一切顺利。”

“出租屋房东的电话，你自己不要联系，还是让……他来处理，总之保护好自己，遇到熟人就说不认识，知道不知道？”

老师们事无巨细地说着，最后摸了摸孩子的手臂，也好，也好……好歹是让她们粼粼回来了。

老天也觉得后悔了。

一定是这样。

让孩子回来享福了。

火车很快就开始检票了，老师们提着大包小包离开了京市，白粼粼在原地看了很久，最终缓慢地呼出了一口气。

那是上辈子的缺憾。

一点点地填补上了。

“饿不饿？”

宋郁在后面牵住了“人”的手腕，带回了身边。

一人一鸟往外面走去，在说些什么零碎的事。

“花生酥好吃，你在哪里买的？”

“同福路，现在去不去？”

“好啊。”

-

火车内。

几个老师正好坐满了硬卧，私密性倒是很好，她们研究了一下那张卡，也是有些好奇：

“这里面多少钱啊？”

“不知道，就给个卡。”

“想那么多干什么？能给福利院的孩子买多少卫生用品就买多少，全用了！”

“这样翠兰也不用天天在网上琢磨募捐的事了。”

“是是是。”

大家七嘴八舌的，最后一个老师拿着手机屏幕伸了过来，抬手托了下鼻梁上的眼镜：

“这个豆包说了，我们可以注册app，看卡上有多少钱。”

老师们立马开始照做了起来，她们年纪大了，操作是有些慢，但好歹是成功了。

一张存储卡。

她们全部凑了过去……

[200,000]

“个十百千万……十万……啊！”

-

白粼粼是在回了出租屋的时候接到了电话，那边的老师很是着急，连忙说要把东西给寄回来。

他一开始还想着什么东西，后来才发现说的是那张卡，因为火车上人太多……才说的“东西”。

白粼粼后面大致听明白了，蹙了蹙眉，朝着卧室里走去，推开了门。

宋郁在看桌子上的相框……是一张完全一致的脸，很青涩。

“宋郁，那张卡上多少钱？”

白粼粼其实有点急，“你不是说不多吗？”

宋郁只是温和地道：“老师们？”

他抬手把“少年”的手机抽了出来，很稳定地出去接电话了。

“……”

出租屋的房间小小的，白粼粼就这么穿着拖鞋跟在后面，穿着一件纯白的宽松T恤，像是回到了过去当人的时候，很生动地在后面说话。

“你这样，她们肯定会慌的。”

“怎么给那么多？”

最后走到了阳台那里，白粼粼站在对面，仰头看着宋郁打电话，抿了抿唇，生气了。

“嗯，但其实这可以筹建一个非常简单的救济会。”

“或者当成备用金，以防天灾，桐城之前不是有过暴雨？”

“华秉之后也会同福利院那里展开定向合作，这二十万只是前期投入而已，况且不是为了孩子们么？这是很值得的。”

……

白粼粼最后面色变得纯良了起来，因为宋郁在三分钟内，解决了问题。

啊？

他被牵着手腕再度走回了卧室，宋郁只是开口问：

“收拾东西吗？我们可以带回南市。”

白粼粼一下子被带回了现实，他环顾了下四周，这些都是他上辈子的生活痕迹。

拿……拿什么？
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu was not surprised by this, merely continuing, "There is no need to be so distant. Since Linlin treats you all as family, I should do the same. It is impossible for me to stand by and offer no help at all."

"Hasn't the Changping Orphanage merged? You might be heading to the Tongcheng Welfare Institute, right? Perhaps this can be used to purchase some supplies; it is just a small gesture of my sincerity."

These words were truly airtight.

The teachers were suddenly at a loss, especially when the welfare institute was mentioned. Very few children there were healthy; some required daily medication, and then there were the sanitary supplies... all of which were expenses.

"This..."

The teachers instinctively looked toward the "youth" beside them. Bai Linlin simply tilted his head toward Song Yu and asked, "It’s not too much, is it?"

"Not at all."

"Please accept it, teachers. This way, you can provide the younger ones with some tangible necessities."

Bai Linlin stopped his internal struggle. He stood upright and said earnestly, "Teachers, please don't think that I am merely clinging to Song Yu... that is not the case. We have formed a bond, so please, take it."

"Monsters don't have identification cards, and the things I manifest cannot be used by the younger ones."

Song Yu did not speak again after that, simply letting the "youth" stand before him. His eyelids drooped slightly, and something began to sprout and grow within his heart.

His little bird was willing to rely on him.

"Then... then... shall we accept it?"

The teachers looked at one another. In truth, they were moved; after all, they had spent almost all their savings coming to the capital, and there were still matters at the welfare institute to attend to upon their return.

They were indeed short on money.

But they felt guilty.

"Accept it, just accept it."

Bai Linlin pulled out the card and handed it over, saying once more, "When it comes to human affairs, only he can help."

"I am currently just a small monster. Once I learn better skills, perhaps I will be able to do some real work."

The teachers felt as if they were in a dream. Finally, they accepted the card and explained their arrangements.

-

When they returned to the car, Bai Linlin was already feeling sleepy. He sat in the passenger seat, clutching a bag, and raised his hand to eat some crispy shiitake mushrooms, saying in a muffled voice:

"So, we're leaving the day after tomorrow."

"Did you take the keys?"

Song Yu raised his hand and produced the door key—it was for the rental apartment. The teachers had always been concerned about that place and had even renewed the lease for a few months for him. Now that it was expiring, they had originally intended to bring everything back to Tongcheng, but through a twist of fate... they had met, and so they gave the keys to them.

"I have them."

Bai Linlin nodded, feeling a sense of unreality. As he chewed, he extended his palm, and the golden-thread fireworks danced upon it once more.

If only he could master some advanced techniques.

"It's very beautiful."

Bai Linlin snapped back to reality, realizing the other was watching. He reached out naturally, his eyes round, and looked up:

"Right?"

Song Yu lowered his eyes and said softly, "Yes."

A few days later.

The teachers rejected the suggestion of flying back to Tongcheng, insisting on the train, saying that every bit saved helped.

Inside the train station, they were laden with bags, yet they still gave the "youth" before them earnest instructions:

"There are some matters at the welfare institute that must be handled. Your teacher A-Ping's family member is hospitalized, so she has to go back too. But don't worry, if there is time, we will come to the capital to see you again."

Bai Linlin tucked his chin in and nodded obediently.

"Teachers, you can also come to Nancity, or I can go to Tongcheng. I can fly—"

A person passing by with a suitcase glanced over with a strange expression.

The teachers closed their eyes. They had wanted to rap the child on the head, but then they saw the young man beside him.

"..."

"Be careful! You're out in the world now."

The teachers could only say this, then they went over the details regarding the lawyer and the rental apartment:

"We couldn't do much about that company, but over the past six months, we have gathered information on many other victims and handed it all to... him. In short, we hope everything goes smoothly."

"As for the landlord's number, don't contact him yourself. Let... him handle it. Above all, protect yourself. If you run into someone you know, just say you don't recognize them, understand?"

The teachers spoke of every minute detail. Finally, they touched the child's arm. It was good, it was good... at least their Linlin had returned.

Even Heaven must have felt regret.

It must be so.

Letting the child come back to enjoy a good life.

The train soon began boarding. The teachers left the capital with their many bags. Bai Linlin stood in place for a long time, finally letting out a slow breath.

That was the regret of his past life.

It had been filled in, bit by bit.

"Are you hungry?"

Song Yu took the "person's" wrist from behind and brought him back to his side.

The man and the bird walked outside, chatting about trivial things.

"The peanut crisps are delicious. Where did you buy them?"

"Tongfu Road. Shall we go now?"

"Okay."

-

On the train.

The teachers had filled a hard-sleeper compartment, which offered good privacy. They examined the card, feeling curious:

"How much is on this?"

"I don't know, he just gave us the card."

"Why think so much? We'll buy as many sanitary supplies as we can for the children at the institute, use it all!"

"That way, Cuilan won't have to spend every day online worrying about fundraising."

"Yes, yes."

They chattered away. Finally, one teacher held up her phone screen, adjusting her glasses:

"This Doubao app says we can register to see how much is on the card."

The teachers immediately began to follow the steps. They were older and the operation was a bit slow, but they eventually succeeded.

A storage card.

They all crowded around...

[200,000]

"Ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand... one hundred thousand... ah!"

-

Bai Linlin received the call when he returned to the rental apartment. The teacher on the other end was very anxious, saying they wanted to mail the "thing" back.

He had wondered what "thing" they meant, only to realize later they were talking about the card, because there were too many people on the train... so they had called it a "thing."

Bai Linlin eventually understood the gist of it. He frowned and walked toward the bedroom, pushing the door open.

Song Yu was looking at a photo frame on the table... it was a face identical to his own, very youthful.

"Song Yu, how much is on that card?"

Bai Linlin was actually a bit anxious. "Didn't you say it wasn't much?"

Song Yu merely said gently, "The teachers?"

He reached out and took the "youth's" phone, walking outside steadily to take the call.

"..."

The rental room was small. Bai Linlin followed behind in his slippers, wearing a loose, pure white T-shirt, as if he had returned to the time when he was human, speaking vividly behind him.

"If you do this, they will definitely panic."

"Why give so much?"

Finally, they reached the balcony. Bai Linlin stood opposite, looking up at Song Yu as he made the call, pursing his lips in anger.

"Yes, but actually, this could be used to establish a very simple relief fund."

"Or as an emergency reserve, in case of natural disasters. Didn't Tongcheng have heavy rains before?"

"Huabing will also develop targeted cooperation with the welfare institute later. This 200,000 is just an initial investment. Besides, isn't it for the children? It is well worth it."

...

Bai Linlin's expression eventually turned innocent, because Song Yu had resolved the issue within three minutes.

Huh?

He was led by the wrist back into the bedroom. Song Yu simply asked:

"Are we packing? We can take things back to Nancity."

Bai Linlin was suddenly brought back to reality. He looked around; these were the traces of his past life.

Take... what should he take?

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁垂眸看着“少年”的动作，心里在想一件事，他的小鸟对这里……是否有太深的眷恋？

白粼粼在卧室里环顾了下四周，想起来自己熬夜打开笔记本做方案的身影。

“……”

去客厅，想到自己苦命吃泡面的场景。

“……”

去洗手间，想到自己焦虑掉头发的画面。

“……”

白粼粼闭了闭眼，心想果然时间是最好的滤镜，原来还以为自己的出租屋是什么避风港，现在看起来，牛马的棚舍而已。

“没什么好拿的。”

宋郁闻言眉眼微动了下，而后只是问：

“那回去？”

白粼粼说是不拿，但是他还是找了找，最后在阳台上把自己的小熊玩偶给摘下来了，抱着，仰头道：

“走吧！”

大约下午四点十五分，出租屋的门关上了，里面的物件仍然摆放整齐，夕阳的光从窗外照了过来，显得有种油画里的“景物”感。

-

第四天。

白粼粼开始正式的培训了，临下车之前，他还和宋郁说了下时间：

“那个山羊告诉我们是四个小时左右，你不要一直等，可以去忙你的。”

“记得来接我就好了。”

“少年”这次穿得是法式衬衫，小V领，腰身系着皮带，显得很劲劲的，下车的时候还侧头挥了挥手。

宋郁的手放在方向盘上，觉得有些口干，但还是温声道：

“去吧。”

等到“人”进去了，他才收回了视线，深呼吸一口气，没有动作两分钟。

宋郁才正式地去了分公司，车程一共十五分钟，进门便有个西服革履的人前来接待。

“你好你好，小郁。”

“我是陈平。”

宋郁点头：“陈总好。”

华秉的业务广泛，但大多是实业，在京市主要就是做供应商的，一些高新技术的零件，化工行业的材料，总之是稳扎稳打的那种。

宋峥国只是让人过来看看业务，了解是一方面，结识公司的核心骨干是另一方面。

大约半个小时后，宋郁和这个陈总就已经聊得很投机了。

此刻他们在办公室内，对方拿出来一些文件，摆在了桌面上，陈平很是认真地道：

“这些是目前的合作方，我们提供的产品基本上没有替代性的，属于是深度绑定的。”

宋郁垂眸看着那一沓文件，抬手拿起来了一份，随意地翻着：

“风险评估过了么？”

“都是老客户，这些……”

宋郁又问了句：

“那评估过了么？”

陈平停顿了下，似乎没想到问得这么细，他拧了拧眉，实话说了：

“有几家是没有评估的。”

面前的这位“太子爷”面不改色的，又翻了几页文件，没有什么具体指向地道：

“这样。”

-

中央。

白粼粼进了那个类似于“安检门”的装置后，就自动变成了本体，还是上次的装扮。

小西服，还有领带。

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走过来了，发现这里面已经不少妖了。

他看了下分组的区域，走到了第十组的位置，这里的妖怪攻击力都比较弱，有乌龟、兔子、树蛙……都是体型较小的。

除了……那只水獭。

白粼粼环顾了下四周，一开始还没找到，眯了眯鸟眼，最终发现对方在一个角落里站着，察觉到被看到了立马站直了。

切！

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地往前走，对着其余的妖怪挥了挥翅膀，然后扑棱翅膀飞到桌子上，拿出来了自己的公文包。

“咳咳。”

旁边的草龟听到动静缓缓地转过来了脑袋，一旁的野兔歪了歪脑袋……

白粼粼从公文包里拿出来一大袋子果冻，挺胸抬头的，矜持地道：

“第一次上课，我给大家带了小礼物。”

第十组的区域内顿时热热闹闹的，许多妖怪都分到了好东西，有糖果、饼干、肉条……还有饮料。

应有尽有。

白粼粼实在是屡试不爽，很快和同班的妖打成了一片，顺便问了问它们都是什么属性的。

“你的为什么是深绿色的妖力啊？”

“不知道，天生就是这样子的，可能我吃太多草了？”

“不过你的金线也漂亮！”

鸟伸了伸翅根，很赞同地道：

“我们南市那里大多都是金的，确实很好看。”

……

这边聊得火热，水獭在角落里站着，比手指，时不时地偷偷斜着眼睛往这边看。

吃的……

人类食物，它怎么买的？

水獭从椅子上站了起来，左右摇摆地挪过来了，脸不红心不跳地伸出来了手。

白粼粼本来高高兴兴的，直到感觉身上有个阴影，抬起鸟头一看——

“……”

鸟才不搭理！

鸟歪了身子，不去看。

水獭挪到另一侧。

鸟再次挪开。

水獭再次挪过来了。

白粼粼怒了，它这是要干什么？

然而下一秒。

水獭调动起来了自己的妖力，面前多了个“水流”，弯曲但有稳定的力量，似乎是包裹着什么。

白粼粼：？

鸟看了看这个水球，心想这是搞什么名堂，直到“水流”渐渐褪去，一个石头雕像露了出来。

一个活灵活现的鸟头。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu lowered his eyes, watching the "youth's" movements, wondering one thing: did his little bird have too deep an attachment to this place?

Bai Linlin looked around the bedroom, recalling the image of himself staying up late to open his laptop and work on proposals.

"..."

He went to the living room, thinking of the scenes where he struggled to eat instant noodles.

"..."

He went to the bathroom, thinking of the image of himself losing hair from anxiety.

"..."

Bai Linlin closed his eyes, thinking that time truly is the best filter. He had once thought his rental apartment was a safe haven; now, it looked like nothing more than a shed for a beast of burden.

"There's nothing worth taking."

Song Yu's brows twitched slightly at these words, and he simply asked:

"Then, shall we go back?"

Bai Linlin said there was nothing to take, but he searched anyway. Finally, he took his little teddy bear down from the balcony, hugged it, and looked up:

"Let's go!"

Around 4:15 PM, the door to the rental apartment was closed. The items inside remained neatly arranged, and the light of the setting sun shone in from the window, giving the room the feel of a "still life" in an oil painting.

-

The fourth day.

Bai Linlin began his formal training. Before getting out of the car, he told Song Yu the time:

"That goat told us it would be about four hours. Don't wait the whole time; you can go do your own work."

"Just remember to come pick me up."

The "youth" was wearing a French-style shirt with a small V-neck and a leather belt around his waist, looking quite spirited. As he got out of the car, he turned his head and waved.

Song Yu's hands rested on the steering wheel, feeling a bit parched, but he still said gently:

"Go on."

He only withdrew his gaze after the "person" went inside, taking a deep breath and sitting still for two minutes.

Only then did Song Yu head to the branch office. The drive took fifteen minutes. Upon entering, a man in a suit and leather shoes came to greet him.

"Hello, hello, Xiao Yu."

"I am Chen Ping."

Song Yu nodded. "Hello, President Chen."

Huabing had a wide range of businesses, but most were in real industry. In the capital, they primarily acted as suppliers, providing high-tech parts and chemical industry materials—in short, the kind of business that was steady and solid.

Song Zheng-guo had simply sent him to look at the operations; understanding was one thing, but getting to know the company's core backbone was another.

About half an hour later, Song Yu and President Chen were already chatting quite congenially.

They were in the office now, and the other party had brought out some documents and placed them on the table. Chen Ping said very earnestly:

"These are our current partners. The products we provide are basically irreplaceable; it's a deep-binding relationship."

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at the stack of documents, picked one up, and flipped through it casually:

"Has a risk assessment been conducted?"

"They are all old clients, these..."

Song Yu asked again:

"Then has an assessment been conducted?"

Chen Ping paused, seemingly not expecting such a detailed question. He furrowed his brows and spoke the truth:

"There are a few that haven't been assessed."

The "Crown Prince" before him remained expressionless. He flipped through a few more pages of the document and said, without pointing to anything specific:

"I see."

-

The Center.

After Bai Linlin entered the device that resembled a "security gate," he automatically transformed into his original form, wearing the same outfit as last time.

A small suit and a tie.

The bird walked over with a *pat-pat-pat* sound, discovering that there were already quite a few monsters inside.

He checked the grouping area and walked to the location for Group Ten. The monsters here had relatively weak attack power—there were turtles, rabbits, tree frogs... all of them small in size.

Except for... that otter.

Bai Linlin looked around. At first, he didn't find it, but he squinted his bird eyes and finally discovered the other party standing in a corner. Sensing he was being watched, the otter immediately stood at attention.

*Tch!*

The bird walked forward with a *pat-pat-pat*, waved his wings at the other monsters, and then flapped his wings to fly onto a table, taking out his briefcase.

"Ahem."

The grass turtle nearby heard the movement and slowly turned its head, while the wild rabbit to the side tilted its head...

Bai Linlin took a large bag of jelly out of his briefcase, puffed out his chest, and said with reserve:

"It's our first class, so I brought everyone a little gift."

The area for Group Ten suddenly became lively. Many monsters received good things—candies, cookies, meat strips... and drinks.

Everything one could want.

Bai Linlin found this method never failed. He quickly became friends with the monsters in his class and took the opportunity to ask what their attributes were.

"Why is your monster power deep green?"

"I don't know, it's been like that since birth. Maybe because I eat too much grass?"

"But your golden threads are beautiful too!"

The bird stretched his wing roots and agreed, "Most of us in Nancity are gold; it really is quite good-looking."

...

While the conversation here was heated, the otter stood in the corner, counting on its fingers, occasionally stealing glances toward them.

Food...

Human food, how did he buy it?

The otter stood up from its chair, swayed from side to side as it moved over, and extended its hand without blushing or skipping a beat.

Bai Linlin had been happy, but then he felt a shadow over him. He looked up—

"..."

The bird would not pay it any mind!

The bird tilted his body, refusing to look.

The otter moved to the other side.

The bird moved away again.

The otter moved over once more.

Bai Linlin was angry. What was it trying to do?

However, the next second.

The otter mobilized its monster power, and a "stream of water" appeared before it—curved but with stable power, seemingly wrapping around something.

Bai Linlin: ?

The bird looked at this water ball, wondering what kind of trick this was, until the "water flow" gradually faded, revealing a stone sculpture.

A lifelike bird head.

chunks.chineseText:
第56章

白粼粼见状眯了眯鸟眼，看向了一旁的水獭，收了收翅膀，啪嗒啪嗒地绕着对方走了一圈。

上下扫视。

水獭拘谨。

鸟站得板板正正的，伸出翅膀来，其余羽毛弯曲，露出一根笔直的，表示困惑。

[就一个？]

水獭眨巴眨巴了眼睛，而后立马把刚才那个石头放在了地板上，再次调动起来妖力，雕刻出来另一个鸟头。

是侧脸的，鸟眼圆圆的，很是富有神态。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，低头去看了下，左思右想，还是不太满意。

于是在水獭面前再度站好，挺胸抬头的，抬眼瞥了下对方，暗示意味很浓重。

水獭一开始懵懵的，后面一下子反应过来了，哼哧哼哧地幻化出来水流和石头，这次花费的时间久了些，但成品更加精致：

是一只完整的蓝羽小鸟。

水獭这次用爪子往前推了推，地板上一共两个鸟头一个鸟身，雕刻得是惟妙惟肖。

白粼粼很矜持地点了点头。

大大方方地扔出去三个果冻，同时对着面前的水獭挥了挥翅膀，不计前嫌了。

水獭左右摇摆地走过来，连忙接住，它双手捧着果冻，黑黝黝的眼睛环顾了下其他拿零食的妖。

大多都是一妖一个的。

但那个公文包里好像还有……

水獭沉思，然后悄咪咪地去了一个角落里，环顾了下四周，然后开始运转妖力，贼兮兮的。

-

很快山羊就过来了，后面跟着几个不同物种的动物，大致分配了下各个组的指导老师。

第十组的是一个……水豚。

对方还带着个小眼镜，很缓慢地走到了讲台上，微微抬头，似乎是在环顾组内有几个妖。

白粼粼站在自己的位置，他已经把那几个雕像给收起来了，仰着鸟头乖巧等待授课，但是——

三分钟过去了。

水豚还在缓慢地数妖。

“……”

他有点忍不住了，刚想要开口告诉对方，不过这会儿对方开口了。

“十-个。”

白粼粼：“……”

这需要这么长时间吗？

水豚托了下自己的小眼镜，然后对着讲台后侧招了招手，再次慢慢地道：

“进-来。”

众妖不由自主都看向那边，进门的是一个……藤蔓，对方甚至还开了花，枝叶嫩嫩的，但茎秆粗壮有力，像是地面爬行的蛇，进来之后久直接向上汇聚，最后成为一个人形。

是个“少女”。

藤蔓站到了讲台上，瞳孔是绿色的，显得妖冶而又鬼魅。

白粼粼其实从一开始进来的时候就看到这个藤蔓了，但它不是第一组的么？

怎么来这里了。

“G116能力特殊，将会在第一组与第十组同时上课，大家多多欢迎，同时，我们将G116定为第十组的课代表？有没有异议？”

白粼粼身躯圆滚滚的，点了点鸟头，对此表示欢迎，但是他还是很好奇。

植物系……

后面大约授课了二十分钟，开始了进一步的测试，讲台上的水豚这个时候也不慢了，只是娓娓道来：

“大家要明白，没有攻击力的妖力可以分为两类，要么是防御，要么是再生。”

“现在可以上台自己感受一下，你们保护的对象……还是这块妖力石。”

白粼粼在桌子上站着，很专注地去看了，垫着爪子，探头探脑的。

这次的妖力属性变得更明显了，野兔的就是松软的草，包裹住了那个“妖力石”，水豚看了一眼，点了点头。

大家一个个的上去了，水獭也上去了，用得是水流，它不仅能雕刻，还可以完全地容纳住物体。

水豚用妖力去攻击，但那个石头表层的“水”只是散开了一圈圈的波纹，分散了所有的冲击力。

“可以。”

反正每一个都是这样子的流程，鸟在最后一个，莫名有些紧张，直到那个“少女”上去了，它化成了本体，是一簇簇的藤蔓。

它幻化出来“人手”，覆在那个石头上，一开始是没有什么反应的，但是下一秒。

“妖力石”的周围长出来了一些粗壮的藤，甚至还能听到抽枝的声音，与先前的不同，它直接把“石头”固定住了。

水豚尝试用妖力破开，但那个“石头”纹丝不动，或者说已经成为藤蔓的生长地了，细细密密的白芽缠绕着。

白粼粼大为吃惊，这么厉害，凭空就可以长出来植物么？

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，规矩地站在讲台下面，因为最后一个就到他了。

“N247。”

水豚微微抬头，对着台下开始点名，环顾了一圈，刚想再叫一声，旁边传来一道声音：

“在这里。”

“噢噢。”

白粼粼扑棱翅膀飞到了讲台上，那个妖力石上面还全部都是藤蔓，他不由得侧头看了下那个“少女”。

对方抬了下手，那些紧实的枝条一下子就缩了回来，在地面上匍匐爬行，最后消失在了“少女”的指尖。

它化成了本体，一堆藤蔓，最后走到了自己的位置，那个桌子上顿时变成了“原始森林”，全是漂亮的枝条，有几个还开了花。

“N247，来。”

水豚又喊了一声，优雅地往旁边挪动了下位置，让出了施术空间，白粼粼回了回神，走到了那个石头的面前。

他其实有点紧张的，因为其他妖怪都看起来各显神通的，但是自己……

鸟有什么属性？

白粼粼抬起翅膀放了过去，金色的妖力流动，最终稳稳地在那个石头上形成了个罩子，好似和上次没有什么不同。

鸟沮丧。

鸟要回去。

但就在这时，水豚的小教棍伸了过来，白粼粼愣了下，伸着鸟腿上去了。

“要仔细观看你的属性。”

水豚很优雅地抬起来爪子，朝着那个被罩住的石头攻击，示意旁边的小鸟去看。

白粼粼爪子并了并，乖巧地伸着鸟头去看。

就在那一道攻击的妖力快要碰到“妖力石”的时候，那个金色的罩子突然变了形态，泛出浅蓝色的光，羽毛环绕流动。

很轻松地抵挡开了。

“啾！”

白粼粼没有想到还挺好看的，它扑棱翅膀飞了过去，啪嗒啪嗒地绕着那个“罩子”。

然后回头去看水豚。

对方只是老神在在地道：

“你的防御属性很高，不仅可以对外界的事物，也可以保护你自身。”

白粼粼高高兴兴的，收了收翅膀，看向讲台下面的其他妖怪。

“正好，可以过来做个演示。”

水豚抬了抬头，用爪子托了下眼镜，对着下方道：

“让你们本体学习，是让你们更加了解自身的属性。但是我们妖怪毕竟生活在人类的地界，化形虽然是第二形态，但更要求对于妖力的熟练度。”

“正好N247是最后一个，以它来做一个教学案例。”

白粼粼在台面上站着，其实还不太懂什么意思，直到水豚伸过来了小教棍。

鸟很优雅地上去了。

“接下来，我们就要尝试着在人形的状态下，调动妖力保护‘自己’。”
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes at the sight, looked at the otter to the side, tucked his wings, and walked around the other party with a *pat-pat-pat*.

He scanned it up and down.

The otter was nervous.

The bird stood perfectly straight, extended one wing, and curled the rest of his feathers, revealing one straight feather to express his confusion.

[Just one?]

The otter blinked its eyes, then immediately placed the stone on the floor and mobilized its monster power again to carve another bird head.

It was a profile view, with a round bird eye, full of expression.

Bai Linlin walked over with a *pat-pat-pat*, lowered his head to look, thought it over, but was still not quite satisfied.

So, he stood before the otter again, puffed out his chest, and glanced at the other party, his implication very heavy.

The otter was confused at first, but then suddenly realized. It huffed and puffed, manifesting water and stone. This time it took longer, but the finished product was more exquisite:

It was a complete little blue-feathered bird.

This time, the otter pushed it forward with its paws. On the floor were two bird heads and one bird body, all carved vividly.

Bai Linlin nodded with reserve.

Generously, he tossed out three jellies and waved his wings at the otter, letting bygones be bygones.

The otter swayed over and hurriedly caught them. It held the jellies in both hands, its dark, beady eyes scanning the other monsters who had received snacks.

Most monsters only got one each.

But there seemed to be more in that briefcase...

The otter pondered, then snuck off to a corner, looked around, and began to circulate its monster power, looking quite devious.

-

Soon, the goat arrived, followed by several animals of different species, roughly assigning instructors to each group.

The instructor for Group Ten was a... capybara.

The creature wore small glasses and walked slowly to the podium, looking up slightly as if counting how many monsters were in the group.

Bai Linlin stood in his spot. He had already put away the sculptures and was waiting obediently with his bird head tilted, but—

Three minutes passed.

The capybara was still slowly counting the monsters.

"..."

He couldn't help it. Just as he was about to speak up, the other party finally spoke.

"Ten—monsters."

Bai Linlin: "..."

Did that really take so long?

The capybara adjusted its small glasses, then waved to the back of the podium, saying slowly again:

"Come—in."

The monsters couldn't help but look toward the entrance. What walked in was a... vine. It even had flowers on it, its branches and leaves tender, yet its stem was thick and powerful, like a snake crawling on the ground. After entering, it converged upward, finally forming a human shape.

It was a "young girl."

The vine stood on the podium, its pupils green, looking bewitching and ghostly.

Bai Linlin had actually seen this vine when he first entered, but wasn't it supposed to be in Group One?

Why was it here?

"G116 has special abilities and will attend classes in both Group One and Group Ten. Everyone, please give a warm welcome. At the same time, we have designated G116 as the class representative for Group Ten. Any objections?"

Bai Linlin, his body round and plump, nodded his bird head, expressing his welcome, but he remained very curious.

Plant-type...

After about twenty minutes of lecturing, they began further testing. The capybara on the podium was not slow this time, simply explaining:

"Everyone must understand that monster power without attack capability can be divided into two categories: either defense or regeneration."

"Now, you may come up and experience it for yourselves. The object you are protecting... is this monster power stone."

Bai Linlin stood on the table, watching intently, standing on his toes and craning his neck.

This time, the monster power attributes became more obvious. The wild rabbit's was soft grass, wrapping around the "monster power stone." The capybara took a look and nodded.

Everyone went up one by one. The otter went up too, using water flow. It could not only carve but also completely contain the object.

The capybara used monster power to attack, but the "water" on the surface of the stone merely dispersed in ripples, diffusing all the impact.

"Acceptable."

The process was the same for everyone. The bird was last, feeling inexplicably nervous, until the "young girl" went up. She transformed into her original form, a cluster of vines.

She manifested "human hands" and covered the stone. At first, there was no reaction, but the next second—

Thick vines grew around the "monster power stone." One could even hear the sound of branches sprouting. Unlike the others, it directly fixed the "stone" in place.

The capybara tried to break through with monster power, but the "stone" did not move at all, or rather, it had become a growth site for the vines, with dense white buds wrapping around it.

Bai Linlin was greatly astonished. So powerful—could it grow plants out of thin air?

The bird walked over with a *pat-pat-pat* and stood obediently under the podium, as he was the last one.

"N247."

The capybara looked up slightly and began calling names. It scanned the room, just about to call again, when a voice came from the side:

"Here."

"Oh, oh."

Bai Linlin flapped his wings and flew onto the podium. The monster power stone was still covered in vines. He couldn't help but glance at the "young girl."

She raised her hand, and those tight branches retracted instantly, crawling along the ground and finally disappearing into the "young girl's" fingertips.

She transformed into her original form, a pile of vines, and walked to her seat. The table immediately turned into a "primeval forest," full of beautiful branches, some of which even had flowers.

"N247, come."

The capybara called again, moving elegantly to the side to make space. Bai Linlin snapped out of his trance and walked to the front of the stone.

He was actually a bit nervous because the other monsters all seemed to show off their unique skills, but he...

What attribute did a bird have?

Bai Linlin placed his wing on it. Golden monster power flowed, and finally, it steadily formed a shield over the stone, seemingly no different from last time.

The bird felt dejected.

The bird wanted to go back.

But just then, the capybara's small pointer reached over. Bai Linlin was stunned, and he extended his bird leg onto it.

"You must carefully observe your attributes."

The capybara raised its paw elegantly and attacked the stone covered by the shield, signaling the little bird to watch.

Bai Linlin brought his claws together and craned his bird head to watch obediently.

Just as that attack of monster power was about to touch the "monster power stone," the golden shield suddenly changed its form, emitting a light blue glow with feathers flowing around it.

It deflected the attack with ease.

"Chirp!"

Bai Linlin hadn't expected it to be so beautiful. He flapped his wings and flew over, circling the "shield" with a *pat-pat-pat*.

Then he turned back to look at the capybara.

The other party merely said, composed:

"Your defensive attribute is very high. It can not only be used against external objects but can also protect yourself."

Bai Linlin was happy. He tucked his wings and looked at the other monsters below the podium.

"Perfect, you can come up and do a demonstration."

The capybara raised its head, used its paw to adjust its glasses, and said to those below:

"Learning in your original form is to help you better understand your own attributes. But we monsters live in the human realm after all. Although transformation is our second form, it requires even greater proficiency with monster power."

"Since N247 is the last one, let's use it as a teaching case."

Bai Linlin stood on the podium, not quite understanding what was meant, until the capybara extended its small pointer.

The bird went up elegantly.

"Next, we will attempt to mobilize monster power to protect 'ourselves' while in human form."

chunks.chineseText:
水豚说完这话，就看向了圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟。

白粼粼：“……”

没办法，他只好先化形了。

“少年”站在讲台上，浅蓝色的头发衬得皮肤更加白皙，带着卷边的衬衫，皮质腰带，黑色短裤，搭配的小靴子。

底下的妖怪们有些窃窃私语的，大抵就是那几句话，怎么它有套装？

鸟氪金了。

白粼粼有点不好意思，他低着头去看水豚，想要得到下一步指示，对方照旧四平八稳的，缓缓地道：

“步骤其实是一样，我们妖怪的修行并不像人类那样死板，很多都要体会。”

“现在，试着把保护的对象转变成自己，在脑海里替换就可以。”

水豚看了过来，很是期待。

白粼粼：“……”

妖怪的教学方式，全是意识流。

一秒，两秒。

“少年”周身环绕着浅蓝色的光辉，最后肩胛骨处生长出了两个巨大的翅膀，环绕着自身，很是熠熠生辉。

台下的妖怪不由得惊叹了下。

白粼粼愣了下，睁开眼镜才发现自己把上次研究出来的形态幻化出来了，面色其实有些茫然。

这个对么？

水豚只是点头：“合格。”

-

与此同时，宋郁还在公司里查供应商的事，他坐在椅子上，垂眸看着那位陈总提供过来的文件。

盛星公司。

这是目前最新的名称，原来还用过飞山、富泽、宇凌……将近四五个名字。

“这种情况其实比较常见，他们大多是为了用上政府的相关优惠政策，同时也有避税的意思……”

宋郁闻言面色平静，只是把这些东西交给了陈平，温声道：

“我理解。”

“但如果他们下游产品出现了问题，那我们作为上游供应商，会不会受到影响？”

陈平愣了下，当即就道：

“其实这种情况公司是有考虑过的，盛星的产品百分之八十都是……”

空气里安静了起来。

“什么时候的调研？”

宋郁抬眉问了下，神色淡淡的，在对方开口之前起身了，温和地道：

“陈总，我只是过来看看家里的业务，没有什么别的事，不必太担忧。”

“时间也不早了，我就先走了。”

他起身刚要离开的时候，身后的陈平看了下手机，立马道：

“小郁，那盛星的老总来了，约了个会面，你要不要见一见？”

“正好也可以问下情况。”

陈平其实觉得挺巧合的，像是约好了一样，这边在查这个公司，那边就立马顺杆子上来了。

宋郁看了看腕表，转头道：

“当然可以。”

“不过……”

陈平在一旁站着，闻言愣了下，不由得问：

“不过什么？”

面前的少年很温和地道：

“我中午还有别的事，时间上可能不太合适。”

陈平对此很是理解，刚想让下属直接把那人给回绝了，但下一秒。

“不过我也确实想要同这位盛星的老板交流一些问题。”

“……”

陈平很快就明白了，直接道：

“这个好办。”

-

那膀大腰圆的老总就在一个会客室里等着，一边抽烟一边通电话，一口黄牙一览无余。

“没错没错，这我消息还能有错？”

“华秉早一年前就变天了，那老一辈还是骨头硬，亲儿子说流放就流放，现在就一个独孙，刚大学就在总部那里培养……这还能有变数？”

“这会儿好接触，混个脸熟也是不错的。”

老总胸有成足的，他这次过来只是说是会面，并没有点名要见谁。

那位过来肯定也是熟悉业务的，不说十成，九成是会露面的。

这就是个机会。

很快门口那里就传来了动静，老总立马给挂了电话，扯了扯自己的领带，刚露出个谄媚的笑容，就和对面的保洁阿姨打了个照面。

“……”

“……”

老总立马就一股邪火上来了，斥责道：

“你进来干什么！没看到这是会客室吗！”

“你们公司这样子——”

保洁阿姨往后站了下，后面陈平正好走了过来，见状抬眸看了过来。

老总：“挺具备人文关怀的。”

陈平没太理会，反正这个公司往后肯定是不合作了，且不说让太子爷给查出来了问题，还害得他多了个监管不严的“罪名”。

他肯定也是没好脸色。

“阿姨，去通通风吧，辛苦了。”

陈平很温和地说了句，阿姨也是立马拿着扫把就过去了，在路过那肥猪的时候，很是嫌弃地用手挥了挥面前的空气。

老总一时间眼睛瞪得很大，不是这——

“李总还是少抽烟的好，对身体不好。”

陈平在后面悠悠地说了句，一下子把这人给弄熄火了。

对方连忙把烟头给掐灭了，赔笑地过来了，看了下他的身后，试探地问：

“就陈总一个？”

陈平：“你说小郁？”

老总立马就觉得是同一路人，连忙道：“啊对对，这不是听说了么？那小郁……”

“这是华秉内部这么叫的，李总还是过于亲切了。”

“……”

老总尴尬地搓了搓手，只是道：

“是是是。”

陈平还是带着笑道：“但他确实对贵公司很感兴趣，方才还同我说想要和你交流下。”

老总立马多云转晴，连忙道：

“好啊好啊，那……”

他又看了下这陈总的背后，照旧是没有人。

陈平只是委婉地道：“是这样的，小郁本来就学业繁忙，他要完成个课程作业，需要时间，这会儿确实来不了。”

老总面色有些茫然。

“但是这孩子也的确好奇盛星的业务，说了待会就过来，您要是还有其他事，那自然是……”

“没事没事！”

“我等下就好了！”

陈平照样还是个笑面虎：“那好，您在会客室里好生休息，我去整理下我们待会要用的文件？你看小郁也是头一次来分部，我得下点功夫的。”

老总立马讲：“理解理解！”

很快会客室里就安静了下来。

陈平出来的时候面色立马就回冷了，真是够没脸没皮的，还真是专门盯着宋郁来的，要是对方退而求其次同他说一下业务的事，他还能觉得这人可能就是世故了一点。

现在看来，等着吧。

阿姨在外头收拾东西，就在这时，那位副总又过来了，先是关怀了下工作的强度如何，然后又问了问奖金有没有发到位，最后才是：

“会客室里用电量有点大，这一层您负责，可以适当地管理下开关。”

阿姨一下子就懂了，比了个OK的手势。

会客室里的老总就这么候着，本来还可以等待，但是后面不知道怎么了，这空调断电了，里面热得要死，他本来就胖，现下又出了汗，油光水滑的。

喘气都有些费劲。

“这、这有人吗？”

走廊里无人回应。

-

宋郁看着时间的，他要去接他的小鸟。

早上九点送进去的，现在十二点多了，还有十几分钟它就要出来了。
chunks.englishText:
After the capybara finished speaking, it looked toward the round, fluffy little blue-feathered bird.

Bai Linlin: "..."

With no other choice, he had to transform first.

The "youth" stood on the podium. His pale blue hair made his skin appear even fairer. He wore a collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a leather belt, black shorts, and a pair of matching small boots.

The monsters below whispered among themselves, mostly repeating the same few phrases: How does he have a full outfit?

The bird must have spent real money on it.

Bai Linlin felt a bit embarrassed. He lowered his head to look at the capybara, hoping for further instructions. The capybara remained as steady and calm as ever, slowly saying:

"The steps are actually the same. Our cultivation as monsters isn't as rigid as that of humans; much of it requires personal realization."

"Now, try to shift the object of your protection to yourself. Just replace it in your mind."

The capybara looked over, full of anticipation.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Monster teaching methods were entirely stream-of-consciousness.

One second, two seconds.

A pale blue radiance swirled around the "youth," and finally, two massive wings sprouted from his shoulder blades, wrapping around him and glowing brilliantly.

The monsters below couldn't help but gasp in awe.

Bai Linlin blinked, and only after opening his eyes did he realize he had manifested the form he had been researching recently. His expression was actually quite dazed.

Is this right?

The capybara simply nodded: "Pass."

-

Meanwhile, Song Yu was still at the company investigating the suppliers. He sat in his chair, eyes lowered, looking at the documents provided by that President Chen.

Shengxing Company.

This was their latest name; they had previously used Feishan, Fuze, Yuling... nearly four or five different names.

"This situation is actually quite common. Most of them do it to take advantage of government preferential policies, and there's also an element of tax avoidance..."

Song Yu’s expression remained calm upon hearing this. He simply handed the materials to Chen Ping and said gently:

"I understand."

"But if their downstream products have issues, will we, as the upstream supplier, be affected?"

Chen Ping paused, then immediately said:

"Actually, the company has considered this situation. Eighty percent of Shengxing's products are..."

The air grew quiet.

"When was this research conducted?"

Song Yu raised an eyebrow, his expression indifferent. Before the other man could speak, he stood up and said warmly:

"President Chen, I’m just here to look into the family business. There’s nothing else, so don't worry too much."

"It’s getting late, so I’ll be going now."

Just as he stood up to leave, Chen Ping checked his phone and immediately said:

"Xiao Yu, that boss from Shengxing is here. He requested a meeting. Would you like to see him?"

"It would be a good chance to ask about the situation."

Chen Ping actually found it quite coincidental, as if it had been planned—just as they were investigating the company, the man showed up on his own.

Song Yu glanced at his watch and turned back:

"Of course."

"However..."

Chen Ping, standing to the side, was stunned and couldn't help but ask:

"However what?"

The youth before him said very gently:

"I have other matters at noon, so the timing might not be very convenient."

Chen Ping understood this perfectly and was just about to have his subordinate turn the man away, but the next second:

"But I do indeed want to discuss some issues with this Shengxing boss."

"..."

Chen Ping understood immediately and said:

"That's easy to handle."

-

The burly, pot-bellied boss was waiting in a meeting room, smoking while on a phone call, his yellow teeth fully visible.

"Yes, yes, how could my information be wrong?"

"The tides at Huabing turned a year ago. That old generation is still stubborn—they exiled their own son just like that. Now there's only one grandson, who just finished college and is being groomed at headquarters... How could there be any variables?"

"It’s easy to get close to him now; getting a familiar face is a good move."

The boss was full of confidence. He had only said he was here for a meeting; he hadn't specified who he wanted to see.

Whoever came would surely be familiar with the business. If not ten out of ten, nine out of ten, they would show up.

This was an opportunity.

Soon, there was movement at the door. The boss immediately hung up the phone, straightened his tie, and just as he put on a fawning smile, he came face-to-face with the cleaning lady.

"..."

"..."

The boss’s temper flared instantly, and he scolded:

"What are you doing in here! Can't you see this is a meeting room!"

"Your company is like this—"

The cleaning lady stepped back. Chen Ping happened to walk over just then, and seeing this, he looked up.

The boss: "...really has a sense of humanistic care."

Chen Ping didn't pay much attention. In any case, they wouldn't be cooperating with this company in the future, not to mention that the Crown Prince had uncovered the problems, and it had caused him to be accused of "lax supervision."

He certainly didn't have a pleasant look on his face.

"Ma'am, go ahead and air out the room. Thank you for your hard work."

Chen Ping said this very gently, and the lady immediately grabbed her broom and walked over. As she passed the fat pig, she waved her hand in front of her face with obvious disgust.

The boss’s eyes went wide for a moment. Wait, this isn't—

"President Li, it's better to smoke less. It's not good for your health."

Chen Ping added languidly from behind, instantly extinguishing the man's fire.

The man quickly stubbed out his cigarette, came over with a forced smile, looked behind Chen Ping, and asked tentatively:

"Just President Chen?"

Chen Ping: "You mean Xiao Yu?"

The boss immediately felt they were on the same side and hurriedly said: "Ah, yes, yes! Haven't you heard? That Xiao Yu..."

"That is how he is addressed within Huabing. President Li is being a bit too familiar."

"..."

The boss awkwardly rubbed his hands and only said:

"Yes, yes."

Chen Ping still wore a smile: "But he is indeed very interested in your company. He just told me he wanted to discuss some things with you."

The boss’s mood immediately shifted from cloudy to sunny, and he hurriedly said:

"Good, good! Then..."

He looked behind the President again, and as expected, there was no one there.

Chen Ping said tactfully: "It’s like this: Xiao Yu is very busy with his studies. He has a course assignment to finish and needs some time. He really can't come right this moment."

The boss looked a bit dazed.

"But the child is indeed curious about Shengxing's business and said he would come over later. If you have other things to do, then naturally..."

"No, no! It's fine!"

"I'll just wait a while!"

Chen Ping remained a smiling tiger: "That's good. Please rest well in the meeting room. I'll go organize the documents we'll need later? You see, it's Xiao Yu's first time at the branch, so I have to put in some effort."

The boss immediately said: "Understood, understood!"

Soon, the meeting room fell silent.

When Chen Ping came out, his expression immediately turned cold. How shameless—he was clearly targeting Song Yu. If the man had settled for discussing business with him instead, he might have thought the guy was just being worldly.

Now, it seems... just wait.

The cleaning lady was outside tidying up. Just then, the Vice President came over, first asking about the intensity of the work, then checking if the bonuses had been paid, and finally:

"The power consumption in the meeting room is a bit high. You're in charge of this floor, so you can manage the switches accordingly."

The lady understood immediately and gave an OK gesture.

The boss in the meeting room waited and waited. He could have endured it, but later, for some reason, the air conditioning cut out. It was hot as hell inside. He was already fat, and now he was sweating, looking greasy and slick.

He was even having trouble breathing.

"Is, is anyone there?"

There was no response in the hallway.

-

Song Yu was watching the time. He had to go pick up his little bird.

He had dropped it off at nine in the morning; it was now past twelve, and it would be coming out in a few minutes.

chunks.chineseText:
车后座那里照样是一堆东西，有上次送出去的宫廷糕点，也有一些豆乳盒子，还有一些带壳的干果，零零散散堆成小山。

宋郁修长的手指在方向盘上敲，视线始终看着那个地方，有点略微烦躁。

直到一个小影子蹦蹦跳跳地出来了，他面色才变得温和了起来。

立马推开了车门。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地往这边走，高高兴兴的，夹着小公文包，见到宋郁在等他，立马扑棱翅膀飞了过来。

用喙叼着公文包。

稳当当地站在了人的肩头。

“啾啾！”

宋郁侧头看了过去，不由自主地靠近了些，鸟也拱了下鸟头。

贴了贴。

白粼粼一套动作做完才后知后觉有点亲密了，爪子并了并，想要歪头去梳理羽毛。

但就在这时，车门已经开了。

后座里摆满了各种好吃的，并且和前几天的都不重样，鸟爪子一个用力，扑棱翅膀飞了进去。

“少年”很自然地幻化出来了，它抬手就拿了一个豆乳盒子，低着头去掀盖子，认认真真的样子。

宋郁在外面看了一会，也去后座了，关上了车门。

“今天顺利吗？”

白粼粼有点扣不开，把盒子递过去了，人垂眸立马给打开了，转而还了过来，顺便去拆了勺子。

“很好很好！”

白粼粼伸了伸自己的双腿，拿勺子去挖了一勺豆乳蛋糕，放进了嘴巴里，眼睛都眯成了月牙。

他昨天说过这个的，今天宋郁就买过来了！

“噢对了！宋郁，给你看！”

“少年”把蛋糕盒子放下了，唇边沾上了点奶油，但他不知道，只是向上摊开了手心，眼睛圆圆的，歪头去看人。

宋郁眼神有些散，轻声道：

“好，看什么？”

白粼粼幻化出来掌心的东西，满满当当的小石头雕塑，一共二十个。

五个不同角度的鸟头。

五个全身小鸟。

五个人与鸟的合影。

五个鸟与好朋鸟的蒙面雕塑。

齐齐整整。

“不错吧！”

白粼粼把这些小雕塑放到了桌板上，双手撑着座椅，身子往前倾了倾，很认真地去看人的反应。

宋郁确实没见过这么惟妙惟肖的小东西，拿起来一个石头小鸟，侧头问：

“粼粼做的？”

白粼粼动作一僵。

半个小时前——

水豚已经挨个指导了所有妖怪，确保每个都可以在人形的状态下做到自我防御，之后就是布置了复习的作业。

今天的培训结束了。

白粼粼其实对于那个藤蔓非常好奇，毕竟“再生”……这个词一听就是说它的，看起来作用很大的样子。

他本来是打算结交一下的，但是半路杀出来个水獭。

“……”

鸟在地板上仰头看着水獭，收了收翅膀，爪子一个直着，一个斜着，颇有些不明白。

到底要干什么？

水獭比了比手指，黑黝黝的眼睛亮亮的，往一个方向走了两步，然后回头看鸟。

白粼粼：“……”

他只好跟上去了。

水獭把角落里的小石头都推了出来，一共五个惟妙惟肖的小鸟，不同角度、不同动作，一看就是几十年的功夫在的。

水獭左右摇摆地走到鸟的身前，伸了伸手，比出来五个手指。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒走过去，压根也忘记找藤蔓的事了，仔细伸爪子端详了下，刚刚不一直在上课吗？

这水獭，难不成偷偷在桌子下面整这个？

效率还挺高的。

“果-冻。”

水獭又挪了过来，斜着眼睛去看地板上的小鸟，巴巴地伸手。

白粼粼眯了眯鸟眼，五个果冻就五个雕塑？

随机生成一个鬼点子。

水獭还没有获得零食，就看到地面上的小鸟挥了挥翅膀，抬了抬鸟头，示意它跟过去。

就这样，它也被带到了另外的角落里。

那里有个旧桌子，水獭坐下了，看着面前的小鸟幻化出来一部手机，对方很熟练地翻到了相册。

白粼粼仰了仰鸟头，开始定做：

“再来二十个。”

水獭一开始有点不愿意的，直到看到对方叼来公文包，从里面又拿出来一大袋果冻，五颜六色的。

！

水獭开始兢兢业业地加起了小班。

鸟由此获得了一大批工艺品。

时间回到现在。

白粼粼本来只是想要来给人展示一波的，但是看到宋郁那么期待的目光。

“……”

“啊啊，是是。”

鸟心虚，翅根都夹紧了。

“粼粼真棒。”

“少年”脸颊都红了，他多少年没有这么过了，上一次还是在孤儿院带了饭店的菜被老师们夸赞做得好……

可是。

这些他都有出力的，一个是钱，一个是果冻。

白粼粼心想应该没什么事，他……他还可以找水獭定制的。

“少年”把那些小雕塑都给宋郁了，让人去放着，他继续去吃豆乳盒子了，眼观鼻鼻观心，心脏扑通扑通的。

“待会我们去吃午饭，西餐厅好不好？”

宋郁在旁边轻声问。

“然后，要去分公司逛逛么？”

-

白粼粼是吃完饭才知道宋郁已经找出来了那个套牌公司了，甚至说，那个老板……就在华秉的分公司里候着。

好好好。

鸟要报仇雪恨！

但是宋郁还是先带着“人”去了酒店，眉目平静地道：

“老师们不是说了么？在京市还是少化形，万一有认识你的就不好了。”

“没事，他等着的，跑不掉。”

白粼粼在床边坐着，手腕被牵着，宋郁从床头的小袋子里拿出来个丝绒盒子，单手打开，拿出来个金链子。

在低头给“人”戴上。

白粼粼本来还在侧头生闷气，因为想起来自己在那破公司受过的委屈了，他一定要把那死老板给扇飞。

人渣！

不过就在这时，腕骨传来冰冰凉凉的触感，他这才回头看了过去。

“啊？你什么时候买的？”

白粼粼不由得探过去了头，浅蓝色的头发毛绒绒的，有几缕从宋郁的手背拂过。

“顺路看见的，觉得你或许喜欢。”

宋郁就这么看着“少年”注意力渐渐地转移走了，眉毛没有再蹙着了，而是伸着手腕仰头在看，它还晃了晃胳膊，朗声道：

“好看啊。”

“你怎么知道镯子我戴不出去的？”

“这个链子的款式很中性哎。”

“但我觉得和我今天的衣服不太搭……我应该配什么色呢？”

宋郁垂眸看着床边坐着的“人”，只是抬手捋了下对方的发丝，一句句地回应：

“喜欢就好。”

“心情好些了么？”

“或许浅色？”

……

白粼粼睡了一个小时午觉才起来的，困困的，扶着宋郁的肩头，含糊不清地道：

“我要他好看！”

“好。”

宋郁只是抽出来了一张湿巾，给“人”擦了下眼角，低头看是否清醒了点，又问了问：

“粼粼？”

或许是睡懵了，也或许是把面前人又当成老师了，“少年”瓮声瓮气地道：

“粼粼在。”
chunks.englishText:
The backseat of the car was piled with things as usual: the palace pastries from last time, some soy milk pudding cups, and some shelled nuts, all scattered into a small mountain.

Song Yu’s slender fingers tapped on the steering wheel, his gaze fixed on that spot, feeling slightly restless.

It wasn't until a small shadow came bouncing out that his expression softened.

He immediately pushed open the car door.

Bai Linlin trotted over, happy and excited, clutching his little briefcase. Seeing Song Yu waiting for him, he immediately flapped his wings and flew over.

He held the briefcase in his beak.

He landed steadily on the man's shoulder.

"Chirp chirp!"

Song Yu tilted his head to look over, leaning in closer involuntarily, and the bird nudged his head against him.

They nuzzled.

Only after the action was finished did Bai Linlin realize it was a bit intimate. He tucked his claws in, wanting to tilt his head to preen his feathers.

But just then, the car door opened.

The backseat was filled with all kinds of delicious treats, none of which were the same as the ones from the past few days. With a forceful push of his bird claws, he flapped his wings and flew inside.

The "youth" transformed naturally. He reached out and grabbed a soy milk pudding cup, lowering his head to peel off the lid, looking very serious.

Song Yu watched from outside for a moment before heading to the backseat and closing the door.

"Did it go well today?"

Bai Linlin couldn't quite pry it open, so he handed the box over. The man lowered his eyes and opened it immediately, then handed it back, taking the time to unwrap a spoon for him.

"Very well, very well!"

Bai Linlin stretched his legs, used the spoon to scoop up a bit of the soy milk cake, and put it in his mouth, his eyes squinting into crescents.

He had mentioned this yesterday, and today Song Yu had bought it!

"Oh, right! Song Yu, look!"

The "youth" put down the cake box, a bit of cream smudged on his lip, though he didn't know it. He just held his palms upward, his eyes round as he tilted his head to look at the man.

Song Yu’s gaze was a bit unfocused as he said softly:

"Alright, what am I looking at?"

Bai Linlin manifested the items in his palms: a pile of small stone sculptures, twenty in total.

Five bird heads from different angles.

Five full-body birds.

Five photos of a person and a bird together.

Five masked sculptures of a bird and a good bird-friend.

All neat and tidy.

"Not bad, right!"

Bai Linlin placed these little sculptures on the table tray, leaning forward with his hands on the seat, watching the man’s reaction very seriously.

Song Yu had indeed never seen such lifelike little things. He picked up a stone bird and asked, tilting his head:

"Did Linlin make these?"

Bai Linlin’s movements stiffened.

Half an hour ago—

The capybara had guided all the monsters one by one, ensuring each could achieve self-defense in human form, after which it assigned review homework.

Today's training was over.

Bai Linlin was actually very curious about that vine. After all, "regeneration"... the word sounded like it was meant for him, and it seemed very useful.

He had originally planned to make friends with it, but an otter had cut in halfway.

"..."

The bird looked up at the otter from the floor, tucking in his wings, one claw straight and the other slanted, quite confused.

What exactly was it trying to do?

The otter gestured with its fingers, its dark, shiny eyes bright. It walked two steps in one direction, then looked back at the bird.

Bai Linlin: "..."

He had no choice but to follow.

The otter pushed out the small stones from the corner. There were five lifelike birds, each with different angles and poses; one look told you it was the work of decades of practice.

The otter waddled over to the bird, reached out, and held up five fingers.

Bai Linlin trotted over, having completely forgotten about finding the vine. He carefully extended a claw to examine them. Hadn't they been in class the whole time?

Could this otter have been secretly making these under the table?

The efficiency was quite high.

"Jelly."

The otter moved over again, looking at the little birds on the floor with slanted eyes, reaching out expectantly.

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes. Five jellies for five sculptures?

A random idea popped into his head.

Before the otter could get its snack, it saw the little bird on the ground wave its wings and tilt its head, signaling it to follow.

Just like that, it was led to another corner.

There was an old table there. The otter sat down and watched as the bird in front of it manifested a smartphone, skillfully flipping to the photo album.

Bai Linlin tilted his bird head and began to place an order:

"Twenty more."

The otter was a bit reluctant at first, until it saw the other party bring over a briefcase and pull out a large bag of colorful jellies.

!

The otter began to work overtime diligently.

And thus, the bird obtained a large batch of handicrafts.

Time returned to the present.

Bai Linlin had originally just wanted to show off, but seeing Song Yu’s expectant gaze:

"..."

"Ah, yes, yes."

The bird felt guilty, his wing roots tightening.

"Linlin is amazing."

The "youth" felt his cheeks flush. It had been years since he had been like this; the last time was at the orphanage when he brought back restaurant food and was praised by the teachers for doing a good job...

But.

He had contributed to these, too—one was money, the other was jelly.

Bai Linlin thought it should be fine. He... he could just ask the otter to make more.

The "youth" gave all the little sculptures to Song Yu, letting him put them away, while he continued to eat his soy milk pudding, eyes fixed on his nose and heart, his heart thumping wildly.

"We'll go have lunch in a bit. How about a Western restaurant?"

Song Yu asked softly from the side.

"And then, do you want to go visit the branch office?"

-

It wasn't until after lunch that Bai Linlin learned Song Yu had already identified that shell company, and what's more, that boss... was waiting at the Huabing branch office.

Good, good.

The bird was going to take revenge!

But Song Yu still took "him" to the hotel first, his expression calm as he said:

"Didn't the teachers say? It's better to transform less in the capital. What if someone recognizes you?"

"It's fine, he's waiting, he can't run."

Bai Linlin sat on the edge of the bed, his wrist being held. Song Yu took a velvet box from a small bag on the bedside table, opened it with one hand, and took out a gold chain.

He lowered his head to put it on "him."

Bai Linlin had been sulking, remembering the grievances he had suffered at that lousy company. He was determined to slap that damn boss away.

Scum!

But just then, he felt a cool sensation on his wrist bone, and he finally turned his head to look.

"Huh? When did you buy this?"

Bai Linlin couldn't help but lean over, his pale blue hair fluffy, a few strands brushing against the back of Song Yu’s hand.

"I saw it on the way and thought you might like it."

Song Yu watched as the "youth's" attention gradually shifted. His brows were no longer furrowed; instead, he was holding his wrist up, looking at it, even shaking his arm as he said loudly:

"It looks good."

"How did you know I couldn't wear bracelets?"

"The style of this chain is quite neutral."

"But I don't think it matches my clothes today... what color should I pair it with?"

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at the "person" sitting on the edge of the bed, simply raising his hand to smooth the other's hair, responding to each question:

"As long as you like it."

"Do you feel better?"

"Perhaps a light color?"

...

Bai Linlin didn't wake up until he had taken a one-hour nap. Feeling sleepy, he leaned on Song Yu’s shoulder and mumbled:

"I want to make him look good!"

"Okay."

Song Yu simply pulled out a wet wipe, wiped the corner of the "person's" eye, looked down to see if he was a bit more awake, and asked again:

"Linlin?"

Perhaps he was still dazed from sleep, or perhaps he had mistaken the person in front of him for his teacher again, the "youth" replied in a muffled voice:

"Linlin is here."

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁愣了下，不可控地弯腰过去，他想要看看“少年”的脸，但此刻对方又像是困了，伸着胳膊就环住了他的肩背。

把脸颊埋好了。

安安静静的。

大约三十分钟后，他们抵达了分公司，白粼粼在车上一直在睡，后面到地方了才清醒了过来。

鸟这次是以本体形态出门，毛绒绒的，穿着一个棕色格纹的背带，在人的肩头上环顾四周。

华秉的分公司都这么大？

那总部……岂不是更大？

宋郁去公司一般穿得比较正式，衬衫是标配，显得人精神些，也更有气场。

但现在——

“哇！那是……那是个小鸟？”

“我去，好乖啊。”

“它主人不是……”

“小声点。”

公司一楼大厅还是有些人的，鸟很热情地对着那些人挥了挥翅膀，可以拍的，可以拍的。

白粼粼很是宽容大方。

但是在见到那半扇猪的时候……就不那么宽容了。

-

会客室外。

“小郁？这是你的小鸟？”

陈平走了过来，面色有些意外，他是听总部的人说过这位有养小鸟……但不知道来京居然也是带着的，百闻不如一见，他看的时间长了些。

“人呢？”

宋郁面无表情地问。

陈平这才回了回神，说道：

“还在会客室。”

等到一行人过去的时候，房间里的那位老总已经呼呼大睡了起来，衬衫的扣子没崩开，但是每一个都均匀地露出了皮肉，白花花一片。

这人也是有耐心得很，死活不走。

白粼粼看到这老板就想起来对方逼着他喝酒的事，红的白的全下去了，原以为这就够了，结果从洗手间回来就听到这死老板在说他的简历。

[一个孤儿，好用得很，怕什么，没人替他做主的。]

[他这个学历，高不成低不就，留在京市就得受我摆布，这房租、水电、通勤……每一个都拴住了他。]

[死了都没事的，谁管他？]

白粼粼现在想想都是一肚子火，刚要发作，但对方这会儿已经醒了，他只好先暂时忍了下来。

“哎呦……”那老总用手抹了把脸，有些不好意思地站了起来，“陈总好，这位就是……”

“宋郁。”

一道很冷的声音响起。

老总听着语气觉得不对，连忙组织了下语言，很是认真地道：

“华秉的条件还是比我们盛星强，就这会客室都这么舒服，足以见得细节决定成败。”

陈平：“……”

可以。

宋郁只是面不改色地道：“那我们单独聊聊，我对贵公司的下游产业很有兴趣。”

陈平立马顺着对方的意思去找了一件条件不错的小型会客室，然后离开的时候还带上了门。

那老总没想到自己待遇还不错，等了这么久他还以为这小年轻去写作业了，没想到挺懂事的。

他进了门，看到肩头上的那只鸟立马开始攀谈：

“这就是那只鹦鹉吗？它会说话吗？”

白粼粼其实已经在磨喙了，但是宋郁还有另外的事，得稍微等一等。

“挺说盛星去年业绩是同行的前三？我对此十分好奇，这个数字怎么做到的？”

宋郁不动声色地岔开了话题，并不打算回复对方问题。

那老总一开始是含糊其辞的，但后面一直听宋郁客套的恭维话，主要包括“李总不愧是”、“李总年轻有为”、“李总想得果然周到”开头的话，对方渐渐地放下了戒心。

是，人尽皆知华秉在培养谁。

但对方没有出社会，这些商界的老油条心底里其实是没放在心上，顶多在之前来打打招呼，露个面，如果能当上个“启蒙之师”那是再好不过了。

“你说的那些非常简单，政府那么多补贴，它补贴哪一个，就去开哪个产业线，不用管利润率是否高，你就做一季就可以，立马买给下游的小厂去，的这种损耗是最低的。”

宋郁抬了下眉：“那这个产业相关的工人怎么办？安置到其他部门？”

那老总立马摆了摆手，觉得这简直就不是个问题：

“直接辞了就行，京市本地的人都出国深造了，留下来当普通职工都是些外地的，他们那很好拿捏的，就是纯纯的耗材。”

“可政府不是下了指标么？需要招聘。”

老总更是笑了：“招啊，我又没说不招。我招了，在转正前辞了不就行了？”

白粼粼怒气值已达百分之九十九。

“这样啊，那贵公司我看一直有在换名字，这是为什么？”

说到这里，那老总就起了戒心了，只是随口敷衍道：

“这市场在变，行业也在变，换个新名字也便于吸引新客户，是这个意思。”

宋郁其实大致已经有了个思路，他很温和地拿过去了手机，说要加个联系方式，对方说不飘是不可能的，后面还保证道：

“放心吧，小宋，这我摸爬滚打这么些年的经验，肯定是比你现在要强的，能学到东西的！”

白粼粼闻言简直是无语至极，但就在这时，宋郁说话了：

“喝口水吧。”

此乃暗号。

宋郁已经问完信息了，接下来，是鸟的主场了！

老总美美的，刚想拿起来水杯，但面前有劲风袭来，随即就是皮肉被划开的动静，然后就是刺痛。

“啊啊！”

鸟这次全部用的爪子，连喙都没用，纯粹的嫌脏，最后把那半山猪均匀地划出来了血道道，才算有些解气。

当然这种物理攻击远远不够。

还得从长计议。

宋郁在会客室里从容道：

“不好意思，它只是个小鸟，可能受惊了。”

老总一肚子脏活没处说，最后还得赔笑，几乎要气得上不来气。

-

晚上。

白粼粼凯旋，回了酒店还在练习一套左勾拳与右勾拳，宋郁在浴室里洗澡，有哗哗的水声传来。

他们沟通过了的。

鸟采用物理攻击。

宋郁则是去搜集对方违法的证据，坚决地送他去吃公家饭。

分工明确。

白粼粼其实想到这里，它对自己的妖力属性还有些不太满意的，只会防御……看起来有点太被动了。

对了。

001送给他的手册！

鸟立马飞到行李箱里，从自己黑色的挎包里翻翻找找，最后叼出来一个本本。

白粼粼返回到了桌子那里，开始仔仔细细地研究，上面全部都是些简笔画，很是通俗易懂。

鸟立即开始跟着做。

“粼粼？”

宋郁从后面过来了，发梢是微微滴着水的，眉眼轮廓分明，拉开椅子坐下了。

白粼粼觉得正好，可以给人演示一下，解释了下：

“001给了我个手册，它让我好好学习，你不知道，它回来就是双S了，我学习一下它的，肯定获益匪浅！”

“我刚刚记住了所有动作。”

“你看一看。”

宋郁面容温润，很认真地看着桌面上的“功夫小鸟”走动。

白粼粼凝神聚力，调动妖力在体内流转，然后爪子向前一大步，再向后一大步，翅膀上下拢着，逐步成了个金色的“球”。
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu paused, unable to stop himself from leaning forward. He wanted to see the "young man's" face, but at that moment, the other party seemed sleepy, stretching out an arm to wrap around his shoulders and back.

He buried his cheek against him.

Quiet and still.

About thirty minutes later, they arrived at the branch office. Bai Linlin had been sleeping in the car the whole time and only woke up once they reached their destination.

The bird was out in its true form this time—fluffy, wearing a brown plaid harness, and looking around from atop a person's shoulder.

*Is a Huabing branch office really this big?*

*Then the headquarters... wouldn't it be even bigger?*

Song Yu usually dressed quite formally for the company; a dress shirt was his standard, making him look sharp and more imposing.

But now—

"Wow! Is that... is that a little bird?"

"Damn, so well-behaved."

"Isn't its owner..."

"Keep it down."

There were still people in the lobby on the first floor. The bird waved its wings enthusiastically at them—*it's okay to take pictures, it's okay to take pictures.*

Bai Linlin was very generous and tolerant.

But when he saw that "half-side of a pig" (the boss)... he wasn't so tolerant anymore.

-

Outside the meeting room.

"Xiao Yu? Is this your little bird?"

Chen Ping walked over, looking somewhat surprised. He had heard from the headquarters that this person kept a little bird... but he didn't know he had brought it all the way to Beijing. Seeing it was better than hearing about it a hundred times; he stared for a bit too long.

"Where is the person?"

Song Yu asked, his expression unreadable.

Chen Ping finally snapped out of it and said:

"Still in the meeting room."

By the time the group walked over, the boss in the room was already fast asleep. His shirt buttons hadn't popped off, but each one was gapping open, revealing a patch of pale, fleshy skin.

This man was incredibly patient; he refused to leave no matter what.

Seeing this boss, Bai Linlin remembered how he had forced him to drink—red wine, white spirits, all of it. He had thought that was enough, but when he returned from the restroom, he had overheard this dead-beat boss talking about his resume.

[An orphan, very easy to use. What's there to fear? No one is going to stand up for him.]

[With his educational background, he’s neither here nor there. If he stays in Beijing, he has to be at my mercy. The rent, utilities, commute... every single thing has him leashed.]

[Even if he died, it wouldn't matter. Who would care about him?]

Bai Linlin was still fuming just thinking about it. He was about to lash out, but since the man had just woken up, he had to hold back for now.

"Oh my..." The boss wiped his face with his hand and stood up, looking a bit embarrassed. "Director Chen, hello. And this is..."

"Song Yu."

A cold voice rang out.

The boss felt the tone was off and hurriedly organized his words, saying very earnestly:

"Huabing's conditions are still better than our Shengxing. Just looking at this meeting room, it's so comfortable—it’s enough to show that details determine success or failure."

Chen Ping: "..."

Fair enough.

Song Yu simply said, his expression unchanged: "Let's talk privately. I am very interested in your company's downstream industries."

Chen Ping immediately followed his lead, finding a nice small meeting room, and closed the door as he left.

The boss didn't expect to be treated so well. After waiting so long, he had thought the young man had gone off to do his homework, but it turned out he was quite sensible.

He entered the room and, seeing the bird on the shoulder, immediately started chatting:

"Is this that parrot? Can it talk?"

Bai Linlin was already sharpening his beak, but Song Yu had other things to do, so he had to wait a moment.

"I heard that Shengxing's performance last year was in the top three among peers? I'm very curious about how that figure was achieved."

Song Yu calmly diverted the topic, not intending to answer the man's question.

The boss was vague at first, but after listening to Song Yu's polite flattery—mostly starting with "As expected of Director Li," "Director Li is young and promising," and "Director Li is so thoughtful"—the man gradually let his guard down.

Yes, everyone knew who Huabing was grooming.

But the other party hadn't entered society yet, and these old business sharks didn't actually take him to heart. At most, they would come to say hello or show their faces, hoping to become a "mentor" if possible.

"What you're talking about is very simple. The government provides so many subsidies; whichever one they subsidize, you just open an industrial line for it. You don't need to worry about whether the profit margin is high. You just do it for one season and immediately sell it to downstream small factories. That kind of attrition is the lowest."

Song Yu raised an eyebrow: "Then what about the workers related to this industry? Are they relocated to other departments?"

The boss immediately waved his hand, feeling this wasn't even a problem:

"Just fire them directly. The locals in Beijing have all gone abroad for further studies. Those who stay as ordinary employees are all from out of town. They are easy to manipulate; they’re just pure consumables."

"But didn't the government set quotas? They require hiring."

The boss laughed even harder: "I hire, I didn't say I wouldn't hire. I hire them, and then fire them before they become permanent staff, isn't that enough?"

Bai Linlin's anger level reached 99%.

"I see. Then I noticed your company keeps changing its name. Why is that?"

Speaking of this, the boss became wary, just brushing it off casually:

"The market is changing, and the industry is changing. Changing to a new name makes it easier to attract new customers. That's what it means."

Song Yu actually already had a general idea. He gently took out his phone, saying he wanted to add contact information. It was impossible for the other party not to feel a bit smug, and he even promised:

"Don't worry, Little Song. With my experience of struggling and climbing for so many years, it's definitely better than yours right now. You'll be able to learn things!"

Bai Linlin was speechless, but just then, Song Yu spoke:

"Have a drink of water."

This was the signal.

Song Yu had finished gathering the information. Next, it was the bird's home turf!

The boss was feeling great and just reached for the water cup when a strong gust of wind struck him. Immediately after came the sound of skin being sliced, followed by a sharp sting.

"Ahhh!"

The bird used its claws for everything this time, not even using its beak—purely because it found the man dirty. Finally, after scratching bloody streaks across that "half-side of a pig," it felt somewhat satisfied.

Of course, this kind of physical attack was far from enough.

Long-term plans were still needed.

Song Yu said calmly in the meeting room:

"I'm sorry, it's just a little bird; it might have been startled."

The boss had a belly full of dirty grievances with nowhere to vent, and in the end, he had to force a smile, almost choking on his own anger.

-

That night.

Bai Linlin returned triumphant. Back at the hotel, he was still practicing a set of left and right hooks. Song Yu was in the bathroom, and the sound of rushing water could be heard.

They had communicated.

The bird would use physical attacks.

Song Yu would collect evidence of the other party's illegal activities and firmly send him to "eat public meals" (prison).

The division of labor was clear.

Thinking of this, Bai Linlin was actually a bit dissatisfied with his own demon power attributes. Only knowing how to defend... it felt a bit too passive.

Right.

The manual that 001 gave him!

The bird immediately flew into the suitcase, rummaged through his black cross-body bag, and finally pulled out a booklet.

Bai Linlin returned to the table and began to study it carefully. It was full of simple sketches, very easy to understand.

The bird immediately started to follow along.

"Linlin?"

Song Yu came over from behind. His hair tips were dripping with water, his features sharp and distinct. He pulled out a chair and sat down.

Bai Linlin thought this was perfect; he could demonstrate it for him. He explained:

"001 gave me a manual and told me to study hard. You don't know, it came back as a double-S rank! If I study its manual, I'll definitely benefit a lot!"

"I just memorized all the moves."

"Take a look."

Song Yu's expression was gentle as he watched the "kung fu bird" moving on the tabletop.

Bai Linlin focused his energy, circulating his demon power through his body, then took a big step forward with his claws, then a big step back, his wings cupping up and down, gradually forming a golden "ball."

chunks.chineseText:
鸟有天赋的。

鸟垂着鸟头，闭上鸟眼。

开始往前跨了一步，爪子稳稳当当的，把翅膀拢着的“妖力球”推了出去，一时间流光四溢。

嗖嗖——

白粼粼听到声音还懵了下，睁开眼睛一看。

宋郁面色茫然，身上被绑着几条金色的绳索。

“……”

“……”

[鸽子][鸽子]：好朋鸟你送的什么手册……
