chunks.chineseText:
第57章

白粼粼震惊，翅膀甚至都还保持着往前伸的状态，最后摇了摇鸟头，啪嗒啪嗒走过来，恍惚地道：

“不是……”

宋郁刚开始是有些意外，但后面就神色平静了，毕竟他的小鸟是妖怪，学会这些技能也很正常，他询问道：

“这是其中一个术法？”

白粼粼在桌子上毛绒绒的，爪子都往里并了并，磕磕巴巴地道：

“应、应该是。”

怎么会这样？

这个手册上全部都是一些简笔图，并没有写什么具体的效果，他以为只是运转自身妖力的。

白粼粼懵了，这怎么还捆住了？

也就在这时，人说了句：

“那解开吧。”

事情变得棘手了起来。

白粼粼并不知道怎么解开，他只是在照做简笔图上的动作而已，当时只是觉得001给他的肯定是好的。

没有想到……

挺复杂的。

宋郁说完这话就看了过去，但发现他的小鸟一动不动，直到他们对视了一眼。

“……”

“……”

好像有些问题。

宋郁蹙了蹙眉，低头看了看自己身上的泛着金光的“捆绳”，连接口都没有，是幻化出来的。

他试着挣了下，反而是束缚得更紧了。

“粼粼……”

桌面的小鸟听到这话后立马开始行动，啪嗒啪嗒地走到那个手册那里，伸爪子认真地翻了翻。

同时对着身后伸出翅膀。

——莫慌。

宋郁只好耐心地等着，他刚洗完澡，黑色T恤的领口被发尾的水打湿了点，其实不大舒服，他微微仰了仰头，脖颈有个流畅的凸起。

十九岁确实还很年轻。

他微垂着眼皮，看着桌面上忙忙碌碌的小鸟，手臂被勒得鼓了些青筋。

白粼粼爪子都要翻冒火了，这手册总不能……一个提示词都没有吧？

事实证明，还真是没有，鸟不由得想起来丹顶鹤说过的话：

[001就是个文盲小鸟……]

白粼粼闭了闭眼。

宋郁见到他的小鸟动作停住了，于是出声问：

“找到了么？”

鸟深呼吸一口气，转了过来，身躯十分沉重。

“那个……那个，我要不胡乱试试吧？”

“这个手册上没有字。”

宋郁：“……”

于是乎，深夜里，一个毛绒绒的鸟在桌上操练起来了十八式，深呼吸，感受体内妖力流动。

按照手册上的内容。

嗖嗖——

宋郁身上的“绳子”又多了几条。

白粼粼绷不住了。

鸟再度尝试，他就不信了，难不成这里面全是捆人的法术？

金光流转，直接钻入了人的身体内。

白粼粼觉得这次估计是成了，低头看着那个绳索，但是发现它还是没有消失。

那这个是什么效果？

也就在这时——

“粼粼，我动不了了。”

宋郁发现他现在只能说话，手指都不能够屈伸了，面色变得十分平静了。

因为确实没别的办法。

“啊？”

“要不我再……”

人很无奈地看了过来。

宋郁其实是想提醒他的小鸟去和丹顶鹤联系一下的，但是就在这时，“少年”幻化出来了。

他愣了下。

白粼粼有些六神无主的，他站在椅子旁边，试图去解开那个绳索，但是手指刚一触碰过去，居然直直地穿了过去。

好似没有。

“为什么？”

宋郁本来是要说些什么的，但是“少年”的手在他腰上来回游动，硬生生给打断了。

他闭了闭眼。

白粼粼还全然沉浸这个新发现中，不知不觉地就倾身过去了，他低着头，想要去抓一下那个金色绳子，可怎么也碰不到。

他不自觉地撑住了人的腰。

硬硬的。

宋郁呼吸微微沉了下，下巴被顺滑的发丝拂过，他喉结上下滚动，只是同“人”讲：

“粼粼。”

“去打电话，好不好？”

-

南市管理局。

丹顶鹤正在办公室里看一些资料，是XX自治区的灰色任务相关，001毕竟是头一次出去，它多多少少还是有些担心的。

不过这头还没担心完，京市的电话就来了。

丹顶鹤皱了皱眉，用翅膀拿起来手机，低头一看就接了：

“247？培训有问题？我认识那边的老师，它们说你表现挺好的。”

鹤很忙碌，每一个妖都要照顾。

白粼粼的声音从电话里传了出来：

“001给我的那个手册，我学了……但是把……把宋郁给捆住了，我解不开。”

丹顶鹤脑子加载了下，而后才反应过来，连忙道：

“噢，那个手册是吧？”

手机传来了很认真的“嗯嗯”声。

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，很是坦坦荡荡地道：

“这个我也不清楚。”

……

白粼粼闻言天都塌了，001出去做任务了，它没带手机，联系也联系不上的。

宋郁……宋郁还有其他事的。

就这么被捆着？

“少年”着急了，体温都开始上升，后颈的印记开始发出明亮的光来。

但电话那里很是悠悠地道：

“被捆着不是很好吗？”

白粼粼面色一下子就红了，他连忙道：

“我开的免提！”

手机那边沉默了起来。

……

丹顶鹤咳咳了两声，而后有些尴尬地在自己办公室里踱步了一下，随后才正色道：

“001它没轻没重的，我回头说说它！”

“至于这个怎么解开，没事，我可以给它打官方的视讯，转接一下就可以了。”

丹顶鹤说到这里，想起来什么，教育道：

“247你怎么用人类的联系方式？不会妖力的传讯么？”

“啧。”

“别挂断，教你一下。”

……

酒店这里。

白粼粼拿着“手机”，面颊都有些泛红的，他的指腹上甚至还残留着那个……硬硬的触感。

“少年”偏了偏头，其实有点不敢看椅子上的人。

他不是故意要摸的。

“粼粼。”

白粼粼听到这话刚想回头，但就在这时，窗户的玻璃在轻微的震动，好似有什么东西从远处袭来。

妖怪的感知力很强。

“少年”立马侧头看了过去，瞳孔都泛出了些金。

“247，凝神。”

丹顶鹤的声音从电话那里传了过来，带着些稳稳的力道。

白粼粼抬起来手，掌心有金光流动，开始由左自右地往外“展”。

一个光幕就出来了。

不限时效，不限距离。

“一般是上级向下级发布通知会使用这个，但是遇到紧急情况，在外的妖怪是要及时联系基地的。”

丹顶鹤此刻已经出现在了光幕之中，背景正是管理局的办公室，它身后全部都是厚重的书。

白粼粼看见了那个光幕，立马往旁边站，这个东西会自动锁定，他不要人这个时候入镜……

“我想起来了，之前你都是接通知，怪不得不会向我这边发传讯。”

“这样，来，试一下。”

丹顶鹤自动把传讯给关了，手机里的声音还在持续地往外传着。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 57

Bai Linlin was shocked, his wings still held in the forward-reaching position. Finally, he shook his bird head, walked over *pitter-patter*, and said in a daze:

"No..."

Song Yu was surprised at first, but then his expression calmed down. After all, his little bird was a demon; it was normal for it to learn these skills. He asked:

"Is this one of the techniques?"

Bai Linlin was a fluffy ball on the table, his claws tucked inward, stuttering:

"I, I think so."

*How did it end up like this?*

This manual was full of simple diagrams and didn't write down any specific effects. He thought it was just for circulating his own demon power.

Bai Linlin was confused. *How did it end up binding someone?*

Just then, the man said:

"Then untie it."

Things became tricky.

Bai Linlin didn't know how to untie it; he was just following the actions in the simple diagrams. At the time, he just thought that anything 001 gave him must be good.

He didn't expect...

It was quite complicated.

Song Yu looked over after saying this, but found his little bird motionless until they locked eyes.

"..."

"..."

There seemed to be a problem.

Song Yu frowned and looked down at the golden "binding rope" on his body. There were no knots; it was conjured out of thin air.

He tried to struggle, but it only bound him tighter.

"Linlin..."

The little bird on the table immediately started acting upon hearing this, walking *pitter-patter* to the manual and flipping through it earnestly with its claws.

At the same time, it stretched its wings out behind it.

—*Don't panic.*

Song Yu had to wait patiently. He had just finished showering, and the collar of his black T-shirt was dampened by the water from his hair tips. It was actually quite uncomfortable. He tilted his head back slightly, his neck showing a smooth, prominent protrusion.

Nineteen was indeed still very young.

He lowered his eyelids, watching the busy little bird on the table. His arms were strained, with veins bulging slightly.

Bai Linlin's claws were almost burning from flipping through the pages. *This manual couldn't possibly... not have a single hint, right?*

The facts proved that there really wasn't one. The bird couldn't help but remember what the Red-crowned Crane had said:

[001 is just an illiterate little bird...]

Bai Linlin closed his eyes.

Song Yu saw his little bird stop moving and asked:

"Did you find it?"

The bird took a deep breath and turned around, its body feeling very heavy.

"That... that, should I just try randomly?"

"There are no words in this manual."

Song Yu: "..."

And so, in the middle of the night, a fluffy bird began to practice the "Eighteen Styles" on the table, taking deep breaths and feeling the flow of demon power in its body.

According to the content in the manual.

*Whoosh, whoosh—*

There were even more "ropes" on Song Yu's body.

Bai Linlin couldn't hold it together anymore.

The bird tried again. He didn't believe it; could it be that this thing was full of binding spells?

Golden light flowed and drilled directly into the person's body.

Bai Linlin felt that this time it should be a success. He looked down at the ropes, only to find that they still hadn't disappeared.

Then what was the effect of this?

Just then—

"Linlin, I can't move."

Song Yu discovered that he could only speak now; he couldn't even flex his fingers. His expression became very calm.

Because there was really no other way.

"Ah?"

"Should I try again..."

The man looked over, very helpless.

Song Yu actually wanted to remind his little bird to contact the Red-crowned Crane, but just then, the "young man" manifested.

He paused.

Bai Linlin was somewhat flustered. He stood beside the chair, trying to untie the rope, but the moment his fingers touched it, they passed straight through.

As if it wasn't there.

"Why?"

Song Yu was about to say something, but the "young man's" hand was moving back and forth on his waist, cutting him off completely.

He closed his eyes.

Bai Linlin was still completely immersed in this new discovery, leaning over unconsciously. He lowered his head, wanting to grab the golden rope, but he couldn't touch it at all.

He couldn't help but brace himself against the person's waist.

It was hard.

Song Yu's breathing deepened slightly. His chin was brushed by silky hair, and his Adam's apple bobbed up and down. He just said to the "person":

"Linlin."

"Go make a call, okay?"

-

Nanshi Administration Bureau.

The Red-crowned Crane was in the office looking at some documents related to gray-area tasks in the XX Autonomous Region. After all, it was 001's first time out, and it was still somewhat worried.

However, before it could finish worrying, a call came from Beijing.

The Red-crowned Crane frowned, picked up the phone with its wing, looked down, and answered:

"247? Is there a problem with the training? I know the teachers over there; they said you were performing quite well."

The crane was busy; every demon needed to be taken care of.

Bai Linlin's voice came through the phone:

"The manual 001 gave me, I studied it... but I... I bound Song Yu, and I can't untie it."

The Red-crowned Crane's brain loaded for a moment before it reacted, hurriedly saying:

"Oh, that manual, right?"

A very earnest "Mm-hmm" came from the phone.

The Red-crowned Crane tucked its wings and said very frankly:

"I'm not sure about this either."

...

Bai Linlin's world collapsed upon hearing this. 001 had gone out on a mission, didn't bring its phone, and couldn't be reached.

Song Yu... Song Yu had other things to do.

Was he just going to stay bound like this?

The "young man" was anxious, his body temperature began to rise, and the mark on the back of his neck began to emit a bright light.

But the voice on the phone said leisurely:

"Isn't it quite good to be bound?"

Bai Linlin's face turned red instantly. He hurriedly said:

"I'm on speakerphone!"

The other side of the phone fell silent.

...

The Red-crowned Crane coughed twice, paced around its office in embarrassment, and then spoke with a straight face:

"001 is reckless; I'll talk to it later!"

"As for how to untie it, it's fine. I can make an official video call to it and transfer it."

When the Red-crowned Crane said this, it remembered something and lectured:

"247, why are you using human contact methods? Don't you know how to use demon power transmission?"

"Tsk."

"Don't hang up, I'll teach you."

...

Back at the hotel.

Bai Linlin held the "phone," his cheeks flushed. The sensation of that... hard touch still lingered on his fingertips.

The "young man" tilted his head; he actually didn't dare to look at the person on the chair.

He didn't mean to touch him.

"Linlin."

Bai Linlin was just about to turn back when the window glass vibrated slightly, as if something was attacking from afar.

A demon's perception was very strong.

The "young man" immediately turned his head to look, his pupils glowing with gold.

"247, focus."

The Red-crowned Crane's voice came through the phone, carrying a steady strength.

Bai Linlin raised his hand, golden light flowing in his palm, and he began to "spread" it from left to right.

A light screen appeared.

No time limit, no distance limit.

"Usually, superiors use this to issue notices to subordinates, but in emergencies, demons abroad must contact the base in time."

The Red-crowned Crane had already appeared in the light screen, with the Administration Bureau office in the background, thick books behind it.

Seeing the light screen, Bai Linlin immediately stepped to the side. This thing would automatically lock on; he didn't want anyone to be in the frame at this moment...

"I remember now, you've always been receiving notices before, no wonder you don't know how to send transmissions to me."

"Like this, come on, try it."

The Red-crowned Crane automatically turned off the transmission, and the voice from the phone continued to come through.

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼其实有点着急，现在是教学的时候吗？宋郁还被他捆着的，不应该早点把这件事解决了吗？

所谓压力就是动力。

“少年”学得很快，立马跟着电话里的提示，幻化出来一道流动的金色妖力，从窗户外飞了出去。

短短几秒钟。

面前就又多了个金色的光幕，不过这时丹顶鹤就没有再拖沓了，直接道：

“给你转接，亲自问。”

光幕上的画面荡起来一道波纹，逐步变成了一个月光皎洁的户外景色，黑衣少年就蹲在树杈子上，低头用牙齿在系右手的绷带，察觉到了妖力波动，抬眸看向了半空中。

眼睛圆圆的。

001有点意外，歪头道：

“247？”

白粼粼见到“人”立马就仰头道：

“我把宋郁给捆了，你的那个手册……”

001闻言很是欣慰，原来247真的好好学习了，它很好奇地道：

“那成功了吗？”

白粼粼闻言愣住了，什么成功不成功的？

不过他刚想说话的时候，突然看到了对方手腕上的绷带，立马道：

“你受伤了？”

“没事的，只是小伤。”

两个小鸟好似聊起来了。

宋郁眼眸暗沉了些，没说什么。

“那你照顾好自己，不过这个怎么解开？你给我的手册上面没有说明，哪个是解开的术法？”

白粼粼还是没忘记正事，仰头看着光幕，很着急地问道。

001在月光下歪了歪头，很是不明白，直接道：

“我算了你的发情期的，大概就在你进京这段时间，你现在已经一岁半了，可以压住他了……”

白粼粼在反应过来自己听到了什么的时候，已经晚了。

“啊！”

“你停停停——”

宋郁眼眸微动，泛出些亮光来。

光幕那头的“黑衣少年”只是停了一会儿，之后又解释道：

“那就是些束缚术，很基础的那种，我从典籍里给你抄下来的，应该很好用吧？”

001还是很关注一件事：

“成功了吗？”

白粼粼脸颊变得很红很红，他几乎觉得背后的目光很灼人，硬撑着对光幕里的道：

“我-没-有！”

“啊……”

001很是遗憾的样子。

白粼粼只是道：“宋郁在我身边！”

“……”

树杈子上的“黑衣少年”砰得一下化成本体，开始歪头梳理羽毛，仿佛这已经成了一串代码。

白粼粼深呼吸一口气，再次问：

“怎么解开？”

毛绒绒的小雀回了回头，很是斟酌地道：

“交-配。”

白粼粼觉得可以去死了。

但是下一秒。

“不过除了这种方式，还可以——”

白粼粼刚想听还可以什么，但就在这时，树杈子上的小雀突然幻化成了“黑衣少年”，瞳孔变成纯金色的，像是看到了目标一样，侧头道：

“247，等我一下。”

光幕被收起来了。

-

沉默是今晚的康桥。

白粼粼并不知道宋郁知道“发情”的事，因为丹顶鹤是临行前同他在管理局说的，他的视角下，宋郁只是知道他发烧了而已。

“……”

“少年”浑身血液都在快速流动，他几乎不敢去看人，咬了咬唇，最后试图解释：

“其实我觉得还好，发情它就是一个……”

“没事。”

宋郁分明是被捆着的，但却神态却是从容的，微微抬起眼眸，认真道：

“粼粼是个小妖怪，你刚成年，很多事都不懂，不要觉得不自在。”

白粼粼一下子蹲在了地板上，双手抱着膝盖，浅蓝色的头发衬得那个耳垂更红了。

“我会好好控制的。”

宋郁蹙眉：“非要控制么？”

白粼粼闻言一下子有点生气，抬头看了过来，闷闷地道：

“那怎么办？难不成我们——”

空气一阵安静。

十九岁，很年轻。

一岁半，也很年轻。

“可我们结了契了，无论如何，我都有责任对你好，粼粼，你可以……”

宋郁还没有说完，地板上的“少年”就轻声道：

“我们是结婚了么？”

房间里再度暧昧了起来。

白粼粼心脏跳得很快，他偏了偏头，下巴埋在自己的膝盖上，眼睛圆圆的，在反思自己。

他当时在秋水巷……选择宋郁确实有相貌上的加分。

但那也只是欣赏。

毕竟鸟也很好看！

白粼粼抿了抿唇，在想之后的事。

去管理局登记、拍照、道士来访、爷爷同意……

一桩桩一件件。

鸟后面就走心了。

白粼粼不得不承认，宋郁是个很好的人，所以他才很自然地说出了“一起死掉”的话，毕竟一百年也很长了。

他给得起。

可是为什么周遭的妖和人……反应这么大呢？

白粼粼一开始是有种雾蒙蒙的感觉的，但现在……他也渐渐地回过味了。

“那粼粼觉得呢？”

身后人开口问了。

对方的音色虽然已经在控制了，但还是能听出来一丝的紧绷。

白粼粼其实觉得自己也不是什么拖拖沓沓的人，只是……只是……宋郁实在年纪很小，自己是个妖怪，怎么看都……

可是。

“少年”伸了伸手指，妖怪这里默认他有伴侣了，宋郁这边……爷爷看着他们签的契，自己这里……老师们也都知道了。

“……”

白粼粼闭了闭眼，侧头看了过去，很是认认真真地道：

“为什么要反问我？”

“我错了。”

房间里流淌着一种美妙的物质，像是麦芽糖，拉扯，反复。

“你回答。”

白粼粼其实心脏也在狂跳，但还是直视了过去，坦坦荡荡地问。

宋郁垂着眼眸，喉结滚动了下。

“我觉得是。”

“噢。”

白粼粼故作不在意地扭头，开始看着地毯上的花纹，直到后面传来一句无奈的语气：

“粼粼。”

“少年”这才矜持地道：

“那、那我也这么觉得吧。”

-

xx自治区。

一家农户里，地板上有腥臭的血流淌开来，一只A级的郊狼瘫倒在地，已经没了动静。

黑衣少年站在一侧，抬手调动起来妖力，金线流动缠绕，将那已经化为本体的狼妖肚子剖开，取出了一些幼童的骨骸。

001面色很冷，这些甚至都是刚出生不久的……

它很灵巧地从窗户外翻跃了过去，来到了那个树林里，很认真地去弄出来几个小土坑，轻轻地放了进去。

人类的文化。

讲究入土为安。

黑衣少年把这些消息通过对讲机传递了出去，那边是749局的人。

“目标4号，已处理。”

那边很快就回复了：

“收到。”

001头一次出来做任务，它对于这个对讲机都是觉得很新奇的，黑衣少年拿着这个东西，看着林子里的三个小土包。

想起来丹顶鹤在课上讲过的事情。

又对着对讲机道：

“我挖了三个坟，你们可以来超度。”

“是受害的那些幼童。”

那边似乎是愣了很久，而后道：
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin was actually feeling a bit anxious. Was this really the time for a lesson? Song Yu was still bound by his technique; shouldn't they have resolved that sooner?

Pressure, they say, is the mother of motivation.

The "young man" learned quickly. Following the prompts on the phone, he immediately manifested a flowing stream of golden demon power that flew out through the window.

In just a few seconds, a golden light screen appeared before him. The Red-Crowned Crane didn't dawdle this time and said directly:

"I'm transferring the call. Ask him yourself."

The image on the screen rippled, gradually transforming into an outdoor scene bathed in bright moonlight. A black-clad youth was crouched on a tree branch, head bowed, using his teeth to tie a bandage around his right hand. Sensing the fluctuation of demon power, he lifted his gaze toward the air.

His eyes were round.

001 was a bit surprised and tilted its head.

"247?"

Seeing "him," Bai Linlin immediately looked up and said:

"I tied up Song Yu, and that manual of yours..."

001 was very gratified to hear this; it seemed 247 had truly been studying hard. It asked curiously:

"So, did it work?"

Bai Linlin froze. What did it mean, "did it work"?

Just as he was about to speak, he noticed the bandage on the other's wrist and immediately asked:

"Are you hurt?"

"It's nothing, just a minor injury."

The two little birds seemed to have started chatting.

Song Yu’s eyes darkened slightly, and he said nothing.

"Then take care of yourself. But how do I undo this? The manual you gave me didn't have instructions. Which one is the dispelling technique?"

Bai Linlin hadn't forgotten the task at hand; he looked up at the light screen and asked anxiously.

001 tilted its head under the moonlight, looking quite confused, and said bluntly:

"I calculated your estrus period. It should be right around the time you enter the capital. You're a year and a half old now; you should be able to suppress him..."

By the time Bai Linlin realized what he had just heard, it was already too late.

"Ah!"

"Stop, stop, stop—"

Song Yu’s eyes flickered, a hint of brightness emerging.

The "black-clad youth" on the other side of the screen only paused for a moment before explaining:

"Those are just binding techniques, very basic ones. I copied them from the archives for you. They should be quite effective, right?"

001 remained focused on one thing:

"Did it work?"

Bai Linlin’s cheeks turned bright red. He felt the gaze behind him burning into his back, but he braced himself and said to the screen:

"I-did-not!"

"Ah..."

001 sounded very disappointed.

Bai Linlin simply said: "Song Yu is right next to me!"

"..."

The "black-clad youth" on the tree branch poofed into his true form and began tilting his head to preen his feathers, as if he were nothing more than a string of code.

Bai Linlin took a deep breath and asked again:

"How do I undo it?"

The fluffy little bird turned its head back and said, after some deliberation:

"Mating."

Bai Linlin felt he could just die right now.

But the next second:

"However, besides that method, there is also—"

Bai Linlin wanted to hear what the other method was, but just then, the little bird on the branch suddenly transformed back into the "black-clad youth." His pupils turned pure gold, as if he had spotted a target, and he tilted his head:

"247, wait for me."

The light screen was retracted.

-

Silence was the Cambridge of this evening.

Bai Linlin didn't know that Song Yu was aware of the "estrus" matter, because the Red-Crowned Crane had only told him about it at the Management Bureau before he left. From his perspective, Song Yu only knew he had a fever.

"..."

The "young man's" blood was racing. He hardly dared to look at the other person. He bit his lip, finally attempting to explain:

"Actually, I think it's fine. Estrus is just a..."

"It's okay."

Song Yu was clearly still bound, yet his demeanor was calm. He lifted his eyes slightly and said earnestly:

"Linlin is a young demon. You've just come of age, and there are many things you don't understand. Don't feel uncomfortable."

Bai Linlin suddenly crouched on the floor, hugging his knees. His pale blue hair made his reddened earlobes stand out even more.

"I will control it well."

Song Yu frowned: "Must you control it?"

Bai Linlin felt a flash of anger at this. He looked up, voice muffled:

"Then what else? Are we supposed to—"

The air fell silent.

Nineteen years old—very young.

A year and a half—also very young.

"But we have formed a contract. No matter what, I have a responsibility to treat you well. Linlin, you can..."

Before Song Yu could finish, the "young man" on the floor said softly:

"Are we married?"

The room became filled with an ambiguous atmosphere once more.

Bai Linlin’s heart was beating fast. He tilted his head, burying his chin in his knees, his eyes round as he reflected on himself.

Back in Qiu Shui Lane... choosing Song Yu had indeed been influenced by his appearance.

But that was just appreciation.

After all, birds are also very good-looking!

Bai Linlin pursed his lips, thinking about what would come next.

Registering at the Bureau, taking photos, the Taoist priest's visit, Grandfather's consent...

One thing after another.

The bird had eventually become emotionally invested.

Bai Linlin had to admit that Song Yu was a very good person, which was why he had so naturally said the words "die together"—after all, a hundred years was a long time.

He could afford to give that.

But why did the surrounding demons and humans... react so strongly?

Bai Linlin had initially felt a sense of fog, but now... he was gradually beginning to understand.

"What does Linlin think, then?"

The person behind him asked.

Although the other's tone was controlled, a hint of tension could still be detected.

Bai Linlin didn't think of himself as a procrastinator, it was just... it was just... Song Yu was truly very young, and he himself was a demon; no matter how you looked at it...

But.

The "young man" stretched out his fingers. Among the demons, it was understood that he had a partner. On Song Yu's side... Grandfather had watched them sign the contract, and on his own side... his teachers all knew as well.

"..."

Bai Linlin closed his eyes, turned his head, and said very earnestly:

"Why are you asking me back?"

"I was wrong."

A wonderful substance flowed through the room, like maltose—stretching, repeating.

"You answer."

Bai Linlin’s heart was also pounding, but he looked straight ahead and asked with open sincerity.

Song Yu lowered his eyes, his Adam's apple bobbing.

"I think we are."

"Oh."

Bai Linlin feigned indifference and turned his head to look at the patterns on the carpet, until a helpless tone came from behind:

"Linlin."

The "young man" then said with reserved dignity:

"Th-then, I think so too."

-

XX Autonomous Region.

In a farmhouse, foul-smelling blood pooled on the floor. An A-rank coyote lay limp, no longer moving.

The black-clad youth stood to one side, raising his hand to channel his demon power. Golden threads flowed and coiled, slicing open the belly of the wolf demon, which had reverted to its true form, to retrieve the bones of young children.

001’s expression was cold. These were even newborns...

It nimbly vaulted out of the window and arrived at the woods, where it diligently dug several small pits and gently placed the remains inside.

Human culture.

It emphasizes that one should be buried to find peace.

The black-clad youth transmitted this information via walkie-talkie to the people at Bureau 749.

"Target No. 4, processed."

The reply came back quickly:

"Received."

It was 001’s first time out on a mission, and it found the walkie-talkie quite novel. The black-clad youth held the device, looking at the three small mounds in the woods.

He remembered what the Red-Crowned Crane had said in class.

He spoke into the walkie-talkie again:

"I dug three graves; you can come and perform the rites."

"They are the victimized children."

The other side seemed to be stunned for a long time before saying:

chunks.chineseText:
“收到收到！”

001很是满意，把对讲机收下了，然后看到自己手腕上的绷带又开了，渗出来些血。

它闷闷地用牙齿咬开，那是狼妖攻击的位置。

001思考了下。

247一定不能做这些任务。

它打不过的。

嗯嗯。

-

光幕是在半个小时后又传递过来了。

照旧还是经由丹顶鹤，毕竟这是公务期间，传讯不能私对私。

白粼粼看到后一下子站起来了，里面的“黑衣少年”处在一个木头房子里，窗户外面还有皎洁的月光。

“我忙完了，247。”

白粼粼点了点头，刚想说话，但突然看到了对方的手腕：

“啊？你怎么缠的？又流血了。”

对面的黑衣少年低头看了看自己的腕骨，似乎有些懊恼，但很快还是仰头看了光幕那里，认真道：

“没事的。”

“我做完这个就能回南市了。”

光幕里的“少年”立马被转移注意力了，有些高兴，甚至连原来的正事也忘了，只是道：

“好啊好啊，要是我培训完回去，那也好，如果没有的话，我让宋郁找人接你！”

“京市有好吃的！”

001眯了眯眼睛，想象了下。

“好。”

两个小鸟又是一番交流。

宋郁现在心情很好，对此并不在意。

直到——

“如果你现在不交配的话，那还有另外一种方式，你需要双修一下，很简单的，最基础的方式就可以解开。”

“丹顶鹤给了双修手册的。”

“你可以去看一看。”

001其实还是很遗憾的，毕竟这是它从丹顶鹤的书柜里偷偷抄录过来的，这些束缚术对于压住人类配偶非常好用。

那句古话叫做“生米煮成熟饭”。

妖怪不管那么多。

结果是正确的就好。

可惜247不太受用，黑衣少年有些郁闷来着的，它的手册没有帮上忙。

“啊……我知道了。”

白粼粼有些磕磕巴巴的，最后光幕消失了，房间里再度恢复了平静。

宋郁抬眸看了过来，眉眼温和。

“我没看过——”

“我看过。”

两道声音同时响起。

白粼粼脸色变得很红，其实想把人丢在这里不管，但是出于道德心，他还是留下了，然后去行李箱里捞出来了那本双修手册，走了过来。

放到了桌子上。

研究研究。

“双修”其实是很笼统的一个词，比之于“交配”还是文雅不少，而且从范围来看，前者要包含后者。

白粼粼其实有些尴尬，他们又不是什么新婚夜小夫妻看……教程，这整的……

“应该没什么吧？”

他还是不太敢掀开第一页。

白粼粼很是郁闷，当时就不应该让宋郁去收拾那几箱子东西……被他看到了。

“没什么，不是你想的那样。”

“少年”闻言莫名觉得被挑衅了，回头看了过去，很严肃地道：

“柏拉图你懂么？”

“虽然说结契了，那个那个，但我还是觉得我们的感情应该纯粹些。”

宋郁抬眸看了过来，温和地笑了下。

“是么？”

白粼粼一提出来理论，觉得自己立马占据高地了，坐在桌子上，认真思考道：

“我们互相陪伴也很好。”

“你太小了。”

宋郁的手背青筋都在往外鼓，但他还是耐着性子道：

“粼粼更小。”

白粼粼皱眉，摇头：“我并没有那么……”

“可你这辈子，只是我的小鸟。”

白粼粼闻言怔怔地看了过去，走神了一两秒，而后才匆匆地撇开了头。

很生硬地岔开话题：“我看看最基础的双修办法……”

第一页：

“妖力传输”，试着给你的伴侣传递你的妖力，从而使得对方与你同频共振，抵达极乐之境。

动作：拥抱、肌肤相贴。

渠道：**/血液。

注：调动最轻的妖力，人类是脆弱的，保护好你的伴侣。

白粼粼一整个红温，尤其是看到下面的图，不是这也要画图吗？

不就是抱着吗？

宋郁见“人”一直在看，轻声道：

“是很难吗？”

白粼粼：？

“少年”直接就过来了，大大方方地坐在了宋郁的腿上，抬手环住，直视着人。

靠近……

宋郁呼吸都要停了，但是“少年”偏开了头，发丝拂过他的脸，很滑……随即就是脖子处的一点濡湿，然后就是刺痛。

妖力传递。

宋郁其实不知道这是什么意思，但他的确感觉到浑身都舒适了很多，他能动了，抬手按住怀里“人”的肩胛骨。

白粼粼咬了一个小口子，耳朵根子泛红，唇瓣有些湿润，或许因为不是人了，他居然觉得……很好。

“少年”脑子晕晕的，像是飘在云朵上，他用手抵住对方的肩头。

宋郁的手顺着往上来，按住了那个脖颈，往里压，他微微低了低头，像是埋了过去。

随后温声道：

“我的小鸟。”

“你还太小了。”

白粼粼后颈的印记还在若隐若现地亮着，他其实挣扎了两下，最后放弃了，勾住了人的脖子，腰往后仰。

“你晕么？”

他迷迷糊糊地道。

“我、我有点晕……”

宋郁皱了皱眉，捏着那个下巴转了回来，抵住了“人”的额头。

又开始烧起来了。

丹顶鹤说过这种情况，幼鸟刚成年，状态不稳，很容易自己掌控不好，是正常的。

宋郁本来都托住了“人”的腰，要抱人去床上，但下一秒——

“少年”凑了过来，吻了下他的唇角。

就一秒。

-

与此同时，在经过很长时间的火车后，老师们也顺顺利利地抵达了桐城。

她们提着大包小包往市福利院走，不过在路过郊区的一片小树林的时候，却停下了脚步，原因无他，那个角落里多了个石头垒成的小屋子。

“哎？这是什么？”

“这么小？”

“这小孩才能进得去吧？”

老师们有几个停了下来，好奇地弯腰去看，这个小屋子有个大门，是敞开的，里面摆放着个活灵活现的小鸟画像，像是一个神龛。
chunks.englishText:
"Received, received!"

001 was very satisfied and put away the walkie-talkie, then noticed the bandage on its wrist had come undone, with some blood seeping through.

It bit it open with its teeth, looking sullen; that was where the wolf demon had attacked.

001 thought for a moment.

247 must never do these kinds of missions.

He couldn't win against them.

Mm-hmm.

-

The light screen was transmitted again half an hour later.

It was still via the Red-Crowned Crane, as this was official business, and communications could not be private.

Seeing it, Bai Linlin stood up at once. The "black-clad youth" inside was in a wooden house, with bright moonlight outside the window.

"I'm done with my work, 247."

Bai Linlin nodded, just about to speak, when he suddenly saw the other's wrist:

"Ah? How did you wrap that? It's bleeding again."

The black-clad youth on the other side looked down at his wrist bone, appearing somewhat annoyed, but soon looked up at the light screen and said earnestly:

"It's nothing."

"I can return to Nan City as soon as I finish this."

The "young man" on the screen had his attention immediately diverted. He was quite happy, even forgetting the original business, and just said:

"Great, great! If I'm back after my training, that's fine, but if not, I'll have Song Yu find someone to pick you up!"

"Jing City has good food!"

001 narrowed its eyes, imagining it.

"Okay."

The two little birds exchanged a few more words.

Song Yu was in a good mood now and didn't mind this.

Until—

"If you aren't mating now, there is another way. You need to perform 'Dual Cultivation.' It's very simple; the most basic method will suffice to undo it."

"The Red-Crowned Crane gave me a Dual Cultivation manual."

"You can go take a look."

001 was actually quite regretful; after all, it had secretly copied this from the Red-Crowned Crane’s bookshelf. These binding techniques were very useful for suppressing human spouses.

There is an old saying: "Cook the raw rice into porridge."

Demons don't care about the details.

As long as the result is correct, it's fine.

It was a pity 247 wasn't very receptive. The black-clad youth felt a bit depressed; his manual hadn't been of any help.

"Ah... I see."

Bai Linlin stammered. Finally, the light screen disappeared, and the room returned to calm.

Song Yu lifted his eyes, his expression gentle.

"I haven't read it—"

"I have."

Two voices spoke at the same time.

Bai Linlin’s face turned bright red. He actually wanted to leave the person here and ignore him, but out of a sense of morality, he stayed, fished the Dual Cultivation manual out of his suitcase, and walked over.

He placed it on the table.

Let's study it.

"Dual Cultivation" was actually a very broad term, much more refined than "mating," and in terms of scope, the former included the latter.

Bai Linlin felt quite awkward. They weren't some newlyweds looking at... a tutorial. This was just...

"It shouldn't be anything, right?"

He still didn't dare to flip to the first page.

Bai Linlin was very frustrated. He shouldn't have let Song Yu pack those suitcases... he had seen it.

"It's nothing, not what you think."

The "young man" felt inexplicably provoked by this. He looked back and said very seriously:

"Do you understand Platonism?"

"Even though we've formed a contract, and that-that, I still feel our relationship should be purer."

Song Yu looked up and smiled gently.

"Is that so?"

Once Bai Linlin brought up theory, he felt he had immediately taken the moral high ground. He sat on the table and thought earnestly:

"It's also good for us to accompany each other."

"You are too young."

The veins on the back of Song Yu's hands were bulging, but he still said with patience:

"Linlin is even younger."

Bai Linlin frowned and shook his head: "I am not that..."

"But in this life, you are only my little bird."

Bai Linlin was stunned by this and stared for a second or two before hurriedly turning his head away.

He changed the subject stiffly: "Let me look at the most basic Dual Cultivation method..."

First page:

"Demon Power Transmission": Try to transmit your demon power to your partner, thereby causing the other to resonate with you at the same frequency, reaching a state of supreme bliss.

Actions: Hugging, skin-to-skin contact.

Channels: **/Blood.

Note: Use the lightest amount of demon power; humans are fragile, protect your partner.

Bai Linlin turned bright red, especially when he saw the diagram below. Did they really have to draw a picture for this too?

Isn't it just hugging?

Seeing the "person" staring at it, Song Yu said softly:

"Is it very difficult?"

Bai Linlin: ?

The "young man" walked right over, sat generously on Song Yu’s lap, raised his arms to wrap them around him, and looked him straight in the eye.

Closer...

Song Yu’s breathing almost stopped, but the "young man" turned his head away, his hair brushing against his face, so smooth... followed by a touch of dampness at the neck, and then a sharp sting.

Demon power transmission.

Song Yu didn't actually know what this meant, but he did feel his whole body become much more comfortable. He could move now, and he raised his hands to press against the shoulder blades of the "person" in his arms.

Bai Linlin bit a small opening, his earlobes flushed red, his lips slightly moist. Perhaps because he was no longer human, he actually felt... it was quite good.

The "young man" felt dizzy, as if floating on clouds. He pressed his hands against the other's shoulders.

Song Yu’s hands moved up, pressing against the back of that neck, pushing inward. He lowered his head slightly, as if burying himself there.

Then he said softly:

"My little bird."

"You are still too young."

The mark on the back of Bai Linlin’s neck was still flickering. He struggled twice, but finally gave up, hooked his arms around the other's neck, and leaned back.

"Are you dizzy?"

He asked in a daze.

"I, I'm a little dizzy..."

Song Yu frowned, pinched that chin to turn him back, and pressed his forehead against the "person's."

He started burning up again.

The Red-Crowned Crane had mentioned this situation: young birds who had just come of age had unstable states and could easily lose control of themselves; it was normal.

Song Yu had originally supported the "person's" waist, intending to carry him to the bed, but the next second—

The "young man" leaned in and kissed the corner of his lips.

Just for a second.

-

At the same time, after a long train ride, the teachers had also arrived safely in Tongcheng.

They were carrying bags of all sizes toward the municipal orphanage. However, when passing by a small grove in the suburbs, they stopped in their tracks. The reason was simple: there was a small house made of stones in that corner.

"Oh? What is this?"

"So small?"

"Only a child could get in there, right?"

Several teachers stopped, bending down curiously to look. This little house had a door that was left open, and inside sat a lifelike portrait of a little bird, looking like a shrine.

chunks.chineseText:
第58章

“这是个小庙吗？”

老师们的语气很是稀奇，甚至把手上的东西都放下了，她们蹲下身子，低头去看里面的装潢。

画像前面就是个小桌子，然后是蒲团，看着有模有样的。

但实在是很小。

老师们不由得道：“这是谁盖的啊？”

“小鸟庙的话……这是不是能够保佑我们粼粼啊？”

几个人互相对视一眼。

很快老师们就把手里的大包小包放下了，从里面拿出来水果糕点，摆了好几个盘子，认认真真的。

然后看了看四周，确保没有人过来，这才虔诚地双手合十，拜了拜，口中还念念有词：

“我们粼粼是桐城人，上辈子多有不顺，今生转生为鸟儿，希望神明给予它自由、快乐，让我们孩子平平安安的。”

“我们孩子同一个人结了契，也顺带保佑下他吧……”

“我也来，希望粼粼健健康康的，能吃能睡，没有烦恼！”

老师们做完这一切，然后才收拾东西准备离开，不过她们也确实好奇这个小林子这里怎么会有个庙？

人总是做完事情才反思。

“这不会是什么野神吧？”

其中一个老师后知后觉道。

“……”

老师们沉思两秒，然后其中一个年纪较大的直接摆了摆手：

“有用就行！什么野不野的！我们一把老骨头还怕这个？”

老师们点了点头觉得也是，抬手把这些贡品打算收了起来，毕竟神仙都是不食人间烟火的，吃一口“气”就足够了。

她们专心地把这些东西都收了起来，完全没有注意到画像的后面有个凸起，此刻正在试图探出来脑袋来。

有点着急。

“不过这个庙也有点磕碜……里头桌子上空空的。”

“是附近村委会那里修的？我们桐城还没有见过这样的小庙。”

另一个老师摇头：

“可不是，有够破的。”

画像的凸起一下子不动了。

emo中。

“原来村委那里会有守庙人的，那桌子上都是有贡品的，看着体面些。”

“要不……给这个小庙留点东西？说不定能好好保佑我们粼粼呢。”

老师们交谈着，最后达成了一致。

昏暗的小庙内，有大人的“手”伸了进来，摆进去几个一次性的纸盘子，上面放着几包糕点、金桔、糖果……

“走吧，走吧。”

“行，也不知道福利院的孩子们想咱们了没有？”

“哎哎，坐一班公交就到了！”

人的脚步声渐渐远去，小庙周边也恢复了安静，画像背后的东西试着探出来了头，有个细小的爪子去碰盘子里的食物。

……

京市。

白粼粼睡得很沉，被抱起来的时候还有些难受，他不想去中央那里了……

不要培训了。

南市管理局都是午夜，怎么到了中央就不一样了，不是说要避开人类的活动时间吗？

鸟不懂，鸟生气！

但最后还是坐上了车子，在前往景阳大街的路上。

“……”

大约三十分钟后，抵达目的地。

副驾上的“少年”还在睡，脸颊泛着些红润，昨天半夜才退烧。

宋郁倾身过去，耐心地给“人”解开安全带，然后才唤道：

“粼粼？”

“少年”昏昏沉沉的，以为还是在南市，自动就伸过来了手臂了，环住了。

“我抱了。”

宋郁眼皮微微垂着，感受着那很温热的皮肤，随后抬手揽住了那截腰，压了过来。

“嗯……”

时间一点一滴地流逝，直到不得不进去了，宋郁才拍了拍“少年”的背，温声道：

“好了，粼粼？要进去了。”

白粼粼这才发现自己趴在对方肩头又睡了一会儿，他抬手揉了揉眼睛，闻言只是点头：

“我知道了。”

宋郁就这么看着“人”准备下车，不过他还是又牵住了那个手腕，没话找话说：

“那个李总他除了商业上的违反行为之外，还有些私生活问题，要不要给他曝光了？”

白粼粼一下子精神了，回头看了过来：

“真的！”

“那当然要！”

这死老板，光是坐牢还是便宜他了，还是得让他社会性死亡一下。

什么狗东西！

宋郁就靠着这个话题，又和他的小鸟说了一两句话，之后才松开了它的腕骨，很温文尔雅地道：

“去吧。”

“来接你的时候带冰淇淋。”

“开心果味的，我记住了。”

白粼粼高高兴兴的，很满意地抬了抬下巴，推开车门要下去了，但就在这时。

“粼粼。”

“少年”回了下头，有些不解，对视了过去。

宋郁想起来昨晚的事了，他骨节分明的手搭在方向盘上，唇角似乎还有昨夜的余温……

“怎么了？”

宋郁心跳在变快，喉结都滚了下，但话到了嘴边，却变成了：

“再抱一下。”

白粼粼没想到是这件事，很自然倾身过去了，抬手环住，停留了两三秒。

“走啦！”

车门打开，地面上多了只毛绒绒的小鸟，伸翅膀挥了挥，然后头也不回地走了。

宋郁看着那个小小的身影远去，最后只是靠着椅背，闭了闭眼。

-

中央的位置其实是人流量比较大，但好在是可以形成“界”，进行自动的规避，不然太多人凭空消失是会出问题的。

白粼粼这几天过来都是以本体的形态，一来方便不用过“安检门”，二来他一化形就总会有妖怪问他的衣服在哪里买的。

“……”

怎么妖界也要链接？

鸟不堪其扰，决定毛绒绒地去培训。

方便多了。

他很快就抵达了第十组的活动区域，桌子那边已经有了几个妖怪，水獭也在，见到他就左右摇摆地过来了。

拿出来了一个盒子。

白粼粼顿感不妙。

水獭打开了，里面有将近五十个小鸟雕塑，活灵活现的，成品精美。

一看就是有功夫在的。

鸟没办法，只好从自己公文包里拿出来好几大袋果冻，给了过去，并且伸翅膀强调：

“已经够了，不用再雕刻了。”

水獭眼睛顿时瞪得圆圆的，比了比手指，还是认真地把箱子推了过去。

它思考了下，用手指了指雕像，又指了指果冻，摆了摆手。

免费！

白粼粼愣了下，真的吗？

水獭斜着眼睛看鸟。

就在这时组内的其他妖怪开始窃窃私语了，大多都有些看不惯这种行为。

“它怎么这样？显着它了？”

“就是就是！”

“N247原本是免费分发的，现在它这样，显得我们倒不好了……”

水獭不悦，晃晃悠悠地挪到鸟的面前，挡住了那些妖。

“……”

白粼粼头大，最后还是扑棱翅膀飞到了讲台那里，认真地道：

“每个妖都有的，放心！我在京市多久，就给大家发多久的吃的！”

鸟，稳定军心。

这次还是从公文包里拿东西，有果干、酸奶、巧乐兹……琳琅满目，发到最后其实还有剩余。

宋郁从来不会给它缺这个的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 58

"Is this a tiny temple?"

The teachers spoke in tones of great curiosity, even setting down the things they were carrying. They crouched down, peering inside to inspect the interior decor.

In front of the portrait was a small table, followed by a prayer mat; it looked quite authentic.

But it was truly tiny.

The teachers couldn't help but ask, "Who built this?"

"If it's a 'Little Bird Temple'... does this mean it can bless our Linlin?"

The group exchanged glances.

Soon, the teachers set down their large bags and small parcels, took out fruits and pastries, and arranged them meticulously on several plates.

After checking their surroundings to ensure no one was coming, they piously pressed their palms together, bowed, and began to murmur:

"Our Linlin is from Tongcheng. It had a rough time in its past life, and now that it has been reincarnated as a bird, we hope the gods will grant it freedom and happiness, and keep our child safe and sound."

"Our child has formed a contract with someone, so please bless him as well..."

"I'll join in too! I hope Linlin stays healthy, eats well, sleeps well, and has no worries!"

Once the teachers finished, they packed up their things, preparing to leave. However, they were genuinely curious as to why there would be a temple in this little grove.

People always reflect only after the deed is done.

"This isn't some 'wild god' shrine, is it?" one of the teachers asked, realizing it only now.

"..."

The teachers pondered for two seconds, then one of the older ones waved her hand dismissively:

"As long as it works, who cares if it's 'wild' or not! We're old bones now, what do we have to fear?"

The teachers nodded, agreeing. They reached out to collect the offerings, thinking that since immortals don't eat mortal food, just inhaling the "essence" of it was enough.

They were so focused on gathering the items that they completely failed to notice a bump behind the portrait, which was currently trying to poke its head out.

It was feeling a bit anxious.

"Still, this temple is a bit shabby... the table inside is empty."

"Was it built by the neighborhood committee nearby? We haven't seen a temple like this in Tongcheng before."

Another teacher shook her head:

"Definitely not. It’s quite dilapidated."

The bump behind the portrait froze.

It was feeling emo.

"Usually, there would be a temple keeper at the committee's sites, and the tables would have offerings, looking more respectable."

"Should we... leave something for this little temple? Maybe it will be better at blessing our Linlin."

The teachers discussed it and eventually reached a consensus.

Inside the dim little temple, an adult's "hand" reached in, placing several disposable paper plates inside, topped with bags of pastries, kumquats, candies...

"Let's go, let's go."

"Right, I wonder if the children at the welfare institute have missed us?"

"Oh, oh! We can just take the bus and be there!"

The sound of footsteps gradually faded away, and the area around the little temple returned to silence. The thing behind the portrait tried to poke its head out again, a tiny claw reaching out to touch the food on the plates.

...

Jing City.

Bai Linlin was sleeping very soundly. He felt quite uncomfortable when he was picked up; he didn't want to go to the Central District anymore...

No more training.

In the Nan City Administration, everything happened at midnight. Why was it different at the Central District? Wasn't it supposed to avoid human activity hours?

Bird doesn't understand. Bird is angry!

But in the end, he still got into the car, heading toward Jingyang Avenue.

"..."

About thirty minutes later, they arrived at their destination.

The "youth" in the passenger seat was still asleep, his cheeks flushed; his fever had only broken late last night.

Song Yu leaned over, patiently unbuckling the seatbelt for "him," before calling out softly:

"Linlin?"

The "youth" was groggy, thinking he was still in Nan City, and automatically reached out his arms, wrapping them around Song Yu.

"I'm hugging."

Song Yu’s eyelids drooped slightly, feeling that warm skin. He then raised his hand to wrap around that slender waist, pulling him closer.

"Mmm..."

Time ticked away, and when it became impossible to delay entering any longer, Song Yu patted the "youth's" back and said gently:

"Alright, Linlin? We have to go in."

Only then did Bai Linlin realize he had been napping on the other's shoulder for a while. He rubbed his eyes and nodded:

"I know."

Song Yu watched as the "person" prepared to get out of the car, but he caught that wrist again, making small talk:

"Aside from his commercial violations, that CEO Li has some issues with his private life. Should we expose them?"

Bai Linlin instantly perked up, turning his head back:

"Really!"

"Then we absolutely should!"

That deadbeat boss—just going to jail is letting him off too easy. He needs to suffer some social death as well.

What a piece of trash!

Song Yu relied on this topic to exchange a few more words with his little bird before finally letting go of its wrist, saying with great refinement:

"Go on."

"I'll bring ice cream when I come to pick you up."

"Pistachio flavor. I’ve noted it."

Bai Linlin was happy and satisfied, lifting his chin as he pushed the car door open to get out. But just then:

"Linlin."

The "youth" turned back, looking a bit confused as their eyes met.

Song Yu remembered what happened last night. His well-defined fingers rested on the steering wheel, and the warmth of last night seemed to linger on his lips...

"What is it?"

Song Yu's heart rate quickened, and his Adam's apple bobbed, but when the words reached his lips, they changed into:

"One more hug."

Bai Linlin hadn't expected this, but he leaned over naturally, wrapped his arms around him, and held it for two or three seconds.

"I'm off!"

The car door opened, and a fluffy little bird appeared on the ground. It waved a wing and walked away without looking back.

Song Yu watched the tiny figure disappear into the distance, then simply leaned back against the seat and closed his eyes.

-

The Central District was actually a place with high human traffic, but fortunately, it was possible to form a "boundary" for automatic avoidance; otherwise, too many people disappearing into thin air would cause problems.

Bai Linlin had been coming in his original form for the past few days. For one, it was convenient and saved him from going through the "security gate," and for another, whenever he took human form, there were always other demons asking where he bought his clothes.

"..."

Why does the demon world have to be so connected?

The bird, annoyed by the constant questioning, decided to go to training as a fluffball.

It was much more convenient.

He soon arrived at the activity area for Group 10. Several demons were already at the tables, including the otter, who waddled over as soon as he saw him.

It took out a box.

Bai Linlin felt a sense of foreboding.

The otter opened it, revealing nearly fifty little bird sculptures—lifelike and exquisitely crafted.

One look and you could tell a lot of effort had gone into them.

The bird had no choice but to take several large bags of jelly out of his briefcase and hand them over, emphasizing with a wing:

"That's enough. No need to carve any more."

The otter’s eyes went round. It gestured with its fingers, then earnestly pushed the box toward him.

It thought for a moment, pointed at the sculptures, then at the jelly, and waved its hands.

Free!

Bai Linlin was stunned. Really?

The otter squinted at the bird.

Just then, other demons in the group began to whisper, most of them looking down on this behavior.

"Why is it like that? Trying to show off?"

"Exactly, exactly!"

"N247 was originally distributed for free, but now that it’s doing this, it makes the rest of us look bad..."

The otter, displeased, waddled over to the bird and blocked the other demons.

"..."

Bai Linlin had a headache. Finally, he fluttered his wings and flew up to the podium, saying earnestly:

"Every demon will get some, don't worry! As long as I'm in Jing City, I'll keep bringing snacks for everyone!"

Bird, stabilizing the morale.

This time, he took items out of his briefcase—dried fruit, yogurt, Choco-bars... a dazzling array. By the end, there was actually some left over.

Song Yu never let him run short on these.

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼环顾了下四周，看到了那个无动于衷的藤蔓，对方坐在位置上，自顾自地开花，完完全全地缠绕住了桌子。

鸟叼着公文包，飞到了它那里。

正好站在一个藤上，稳稳当当的。

“你、你要吗？”

白粼粼从公文包里拿出来一个果冻，藤蔓没有反应，他想了想，估计是不喜欢。

鸟换了个士力架，藤蔓还是没有反应。

“……”

鸟又换了个腰果，藤蔓还是不理会。

白粼粼郁闷了，那可能大佬不想和他交朋友，他收了收翅膀，准备叼起来自己的公文包离开，但就在这时，一个细小的枝条抽了出来，攥住了那个公文包的带子。

拔河。

鸟：！

白粼粼羽毛蓬松，爪子用力扣着藤蔓形成的“栖干”，开始往后墩墩，很用力了。

但是那个枝条很是悠哉。

白粼粼生气了，一下子松开了，仰着鸟头去看这个没有人样的藤蔓，对方乌泱泱一片，叶子开合，似乎也在好奇地打量。

鸟气鼓鼓的，收了收翅膀。

但就在这时，那根枝条捏着公文包，往外倒了倒。

白粼粼着急，这很多的，全倒出来是会——

嗖嗖。

椅子上的枝条开始往外抽，最后在几秒钟之内形成了一个巨大的“笼”，里面倒满了零食，藤还在认真地挑选。

白粼粼：“……”

他就在其中一根枝条上，对方倒是弄得很稳当，然后看着下面的枝条翻来翻去得，最后拿出来了气泡水。

蜜桃口味的。

白粼粼这才反应过来：“你喜欢水？”

藤蔓拿到了自己喜欢的东西，就把零食又都放到了公文包里，然后周身再度变化，把蓝羽小鸟放在了桌面上，随即它化成了一名“少女”。

双马尾，直刘海。

看着约莫就人类十多岁的样子。

藤蔓抱着那瓶汽水，歪头道：

“嗯。”

白粼粼愣了下，后知后觉植物系好像是……缺水。

他本来还想要聊几句的，但是这会儿水豚已经过来了，对方系着一个领带，用爪子托了托小眼镜，走到了讲台上，开始讲话：

“好了，肃静。”

“今天开始进一步的课程，如何在危险的情况下自保。”

“这次的课程，G116可不参与。”

白粼粼侧头看了过去，发现对方此刻又变成了藤蔓，悠哉游哉的，伸出了枝条，左右摇摆。

拒绝了。

水豚点了点头，随即就拿出来了教棍，在一个光幕上点来点去的。

白粼粼看了过去，发现都是些很复杂的图，有点像生物课的PPT。

困……

鸟在桌面上不自觉地就蓬了毛，圆滚滚的，但就在这时，后背突然被戳了下。

“！”

鸟立马精神了，回头看过去，空空如也。

“每个妖都有自己的属性，防御是你们的基础功能，但也可以进行一定的‘攻击’，不过强度不高而已，这个你们需要了解。”

“可以让G116来展示下。”

藤蔓玩得正开心，枝条刚伸出来，闻言一僵，最后不情不愿地游走到了讲台那里。

水豚眼睛小小的，在半空里幻化出来了那个“妖力石”。

白粼粼：“……”

是只有这一个道具吗？

不过很快面前的场景就变了，这块石头突然变大，然后没有任何征兆地朝着藤蔓袭击了过去。

G116直接用枝条缠住了，根根尖刺冒了出来，那个石头成了粉末。

下面的妖怪倒吸一口冷气。

“噢，对了，这种情况也还有保守的方式，也就是你们上节课学的，G116再演示一下吧。”

水豚又道。

藤蔓：“……”

有点不乐意。

但那个石头已经恢复了原状，然后袭击了过来，藤立即把自己缠起来了，很窝囊的一种方式，然后石头撞了过来，碎掉了，有扑簌扑簌的渣子掉下来。

藤灰头土脸的。

用枝条拍了拍自己身上的渣子。

鸟在下面看着，不由自主就用翅膀挡住了喙……

哈哈哈哈。

藤看到了。

水豚后面的课程就很简单了，主要是让大家幻化出来自己的“妖力元素”，藤曼的是叶子，水獭就是水流，至于白粼粼，则是一根漂亮的蓝羽。

鸟很满意。

好看！

“这就是最小单位，可以用来防御性攻击，大家可以随便试试。”

白粼粼调动起来妖力，幻化出来那根羽毛，飘来飘去的，他试着用它去推桌子。

但是……

纹丝不动。

“哈哈哈哈。”

白粼粼回头，藤蔓在认真地扯叶子。

总之这节课算是顺顺利利地上完了，鸟提着自己的公文包就要走了，爪子在地板上啪嗒啪嗒的，但是路上有什么东西挡住了。

细小的枝条攀爬下来。

“……”

白粼粼眯了眯鸟眼，到底要干什么！

枝条比了个爱心。

“……”

-

中央休息厅内。

“少女”在桌子上坐着，拿着一瓶脉动很高兴地喝着，头发上都有些嫩芽泛了出来。

鸟很无奈。

“你是南市的吗？”

“我是黔省的，我那里山很多的。”

白粼粼这才反应过来，原来编号前面的字母是地区的意思，他问了下其他事：

“那你培训是要回去黔省吗？”

鸟还不知道中央会怎么分配的。

“当然！我可以分一个山头。”

白粼粼听到后愣住了，什么？

山头！

“少女”的手指上又冒出来了嫩芽，有几个还开了花，它很认真地道：

“大家大多都是回家乡的，我们妖力比较强的，就会统辖一片区域，黔省山多，所以我会有一座山。”

“现在城镇化很好了，我日常在山里玩，还可以去镇上买吃的。”

“中央给的工资据说也不少，大概八千块？”

“这还不算妖力津贴呢。”

白粼粼收了收翅根，啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，有些着急，立马开始打探：

“那妖力不强、住在城市里的妖怪呢？”

鸟很关心。

“少女”用手托着下巴，“这些是我听其他妖的，不保真。”

鸟立马挥了挥翅膀，示意没事没事。

“城市里的妖怪也基本是报效家乡，除非你特别厉害，才会留至中央。”

“工资方面倒是一致的。”

“分配的辖区也不是很大，主要城市里有市级的管理局，目前中央的想法是扩大基层，所以应该会往下分。”

“可能就是按照人类的划分范围？”

白粼粼松了一口气，虽然没有山头，但好歹还是有个辖区的，芝麻官也是官。

一只追名逐利的小鸡。

“不过你知道吗？现在人类城镇化太快了，很多原先管辖山林的小妖因为消息闭塞，和中央联系不上了，它们的生存空间一直在压缩，后面的就已经在城市里了。”

“我也挺担心我的山头被人类给挖了。”

藤蔓很是忧心忡忡地道。

两个小妖在角落里交换着信息，但在不远处的一根柱子里，有个暗中观察的水獭。

山里来的果然心机重！

-
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin looked around and saw the indifferent vine, which was sitting in its seat, flowering to its heart's content and completely wrapping itself around the table.

The bird held its briefcase in its beak and flew over to it.

It landed perfectly on one of the vines, standing steady.

"Do... do you want some?"

Bai Linlin took a jelly out of his briefcase. The vine didn't react. He thought it probably didn't like it.

The bird swapped it for a Snickers bar. Still no reaction.

"..."

The bird swapped it for some cashews. The vine still ignored him.

Bai Linlin felt dejected. Maybe the big boss didn't want to be friends with him. He tucked in his wings, preparing to pick up his briefcase and leave, but just then, a tiny branch shot out and grabbed the strap of his briefcase.

Tug-of-war.

Bird: !

Bai Linlin’s feathers puffed up. His claws dug firmly into the "perch" formed by the vine, and he began to brace himself, pulling back with all his might.

But that branch was very leisurely.

Bai Linlin got angry. He suddenly let go and tilted his bird head to look at this vine that had no human form. It was a lush mass, its leaves opening and closing, seemingly observing him with curiosity as well.

The bird puffed up, tucking in its wings.

But just then, the branch holding the briefcase tipped it over.

Bai Linlin panicked. There was so much in there; if it all spilled out, it would—

*Whoosh, whoosh.*

The branches on the chair began to extend, and within seconds, they formed a giant "cage" filled with the snacks. The vine was even carefully sorting through them.

Bai Linlin: "..."

He was sitting on one of the branches, which held him quite steadily. He watched the branches below flipping things around until they finally pulled out a sparkling water.

Peach flavor.

Only then did Bai Linlin realize: "You like water?"

The vine, having gotten what it liked, put all the snacks back into the briefcase. Then, its body shifted again, placing the blue-feathered bird onto the tabletop before transforming into a "young girl."

Twin tails, straight bangs.

She looked to be about ten years old in human terms.

The vine hugged the soda bottle and tilted her head:

"Mmm."

Bai Linlin was stunned, realizing only then that plant-types were apparently... thirsty.

He had wanted to chat a bit more, but the capybara had already arrived. It was wearing a tie, adjusted its little glasses with a paw, walked to the podium, and began to speak:

"Alright, quiet down."

"Starting today, we move on to advanced lessons: how to protect yourselves in dangerous situations."

"G116 will not be participating in this lesson."

Bai Linlin turned his head and saw that the entity had turned back into a vine, lounging around and swaying its branches left and right.

It had refused.

The capybara nodded, then took out a pointer and tapped on a light screen.

Bai Linlin looked over and saw it was full of complex diagrams, looking a bit like a biology class PowerPoint.

Sleepy...

The bird’s feathers puffed up involuntarily on the table, making him look round and chubby. But just then, he was poked in the back.

"!"

The bird was instantly alert, turning around to look, but there was nothing there.

"Every demon has their own attributes. Defense is your basic function, but you can also perform certain 'attacks,' though the intensity isn't high. You need to understand this."

"Let's have G116 demonstrate."

The vine, which had been having fun, stiffened at the mention of its name. Finally, it reluctantly slithered over to the podium.

The capybara, with its tiny eyes, conjured a "Demon Power Stone" in mid-air.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Is that the only prop they have?

But soon, the scene in front of them changed. The stone suddenly grew larger and, without warning, attacked the vine.

G116 immediately wrapped it with its branches, sharp thorns emerged, and the stone was ground into powder.

The demons below gasped.

"Oh, right. There is also a conservative way to handle this, which is what you learned in the last lesson. G116, demonstrate that as well."

The capybara added.

The vine: "..."

It wasn't very happy.

But the stone had already restored itself and attacked again. The vine immediately curled itself up—a very cowardly way to do it—and when the stone crashed into it, it shattered, leaving bits of debris falling down.

The vine was covered in dust.

It used a branch to pat the debris off itself.

The bird, watching from below, couldn't help but cover its beak with a wing...

*Hahahaha.*

The vine saw him.

The rest of the capybara’s lesson was simple, mainly having everyone manifest their "Demon Power Elements." The vine’s were leaves, the otter’s was a stream of water, and as for Bai Linlin, it was a beautiful blue feather.

The bird was very satisfied.

Pretty!

"This is the smallest unit, which can be used for defensive attacks. Everyone can try it out."

Bai Linlin channeled his demon power, manifesting that feather. It floated back and forth. He tried using it to push the table.

But...

It didn't budge.

"Hahahaha."

Bai Linlin turned back; the vine was busy pulling at its leaves.

In any case, the lesson concluded smoothly. The bird picked up his briefcase and prepared to leave, his claws *pitter-pattering* on the floor, but something blocked his path.

A tiny branch reached down.

"..."

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes. What exactly do you want!

The branch formed a heart shape.

"..."

-

In the Central lounge.

The "young girl" sat on the table, happily drinking a bottle of Pulse, with tiny green shoots sprouting from her hair.

The bird was helpless.

"Are you from Nan City?"

"I'm from Qian Province. There are a lot of mountains there."

Bai Linlin finally realized that the letters before the ID numbers indicated the region. He asked about other things:

"So, are you going back to Qian Province after the training?"

The bird didn't know how the Central District would assign them.

"Of course! I might get assigned a mountain peak."

Bai Linlin was stunned when he heard that. What?

A mountain peak!

The "young girl's" fingers sprouted more shoots, some of which even bloomed into flowers. She said very earnestly:

"Most people go back to their hometowns. Those of us with stronger demon power will govern a certain area. Qian Province has many mountains, so I'll have a mountain."

"Urbanization is quite good now. I play in the mountains during the day and can go to town to buy food."

"The salary from the Central District is supposedly quite good, maybe eight thousand yuan?"

"And that's not even counting the demon power allowance."

Bai Linlin tucked in his wing roots and walked over *pitter-patter*, feeling a bit anxious, and immediately started probing:

"What about demons who aren't very strong and live in cities?"

The bird was very concerned.

The "young girl" rested her chin on her hand. "This is just what I've heard from other demons; I can't guarantee it's true."

The bird immediately waved his wings to indicate it was fine.

"Demons in cities are basically there to serve their hometowns, unless you're exceptionally powerful, in which case you stay in the Central District."

"The salaries are consistent, though."

"The assigned jurisdictions aren't very large. The main thing is that cities have municipal-level administrations. The Central District's current idea is to expand at the grassroots level, so they should be assigning them further down."

"Maybe according to human administrative divisions?"

Bai Linlin breathed a sigh of relief. Although he didn't have a mountain peak, at least he had a jurisdiction. A small official is still an official.

A fame-and-fortune-seeking little chick.

"But you know what? Human urbanization is happening too fast. Many small demons who originally managed mountains and forests have lost contact with the Central District because they're cut off from information. Their living space is constantly being compressed, and the later ones are already in the cities."

"I'm also quite worried that my mountain peak will be dug up by humans."

The vine said, looking very worried.

The two little demons exchanged information in the corner, while in a pillar not far away, an otter was secretly observing.

Those from the mountains are indeed full of schemes!

chunks.chineseText:
桐城的小树林里此刻安安静静的，只有些许细细簌簌的动静，一个毛绒绒的鼹鼠此刻正捧着一个旺旺雪饼在啃，黑色的眼睛里有水光泛起。

呜呜呜。

这总算是骗到人了。

中央怎么还是没有消息？它根本就联系不上，桐城压根就没有妖怪管理局。

鼹鼠饥一顿饱一顿的。

它也不敢全部吃完，于是很灵巧地走到小庙的里侧，那里有个洞，鼹鼠把自己的雪饼全部塞进去了，还有橘子、糕点等东西。

“……”

应该还能撑一段时间。

鼹鼠在小庙门口里东张西望的，等待着上次的熟客，它尾巴长长，在地面上拖拉着。

心里只是难受。

它就是调动妖力闭关了一段时间，怎么山头都没了，就这么点林子，里面就几个麻雀，车水马龙的，管理局也不知道还在不在了，一点人类的货币都没有。

鼹鼠又不想吃虫子。

不好吃。

它兢兢业业地等待着，直到小道里传来了熟悉的孩童音，鼹鼠立马回了小庙里，藏在了画像后面。

“快看快看，小猫庙！我的小猫！画上长得和我家的小猫一模一样！”

鼹鼠安安静静的，调动着妖力运转。

“胡说！明明是我家的小狗！你看它多可爱啊！栩栩如生的。”

“我要拜猫猫！”

“我要拜小狗！”

一堆孩童七嘴八舌的，最后在这个小庙里供上了“缺牙齿”和“火鸡面”，开始你争我抢的磕头。

鼹鼠等了好一会，等到他们离开了，才慢吞吞地出来了，又是感动得眼泪要掉下来。

它可以让人看到自己在乎的东西。

同时也可以提取画面。

这是一种高阶的妖法。

鼹鼠曾经也是风光无限，人类通常会把它们称之为“山神”，谁成想会沦落到这种地步，中央什么时候来妖？

它不认得路了。

只能待在自己辖区里打转。

-

“所以我觉得这也是中央开始接收地方推荐的妖怪的重要原因，人类真的很会管理他们的族群，中央也在学习，争取把所有的妖怪都登记在册。”

藤蔓还在悠悠地说着。

“所以我觉得这可能是我们之后上任的一个工作要点。”

白粼粼获得了不少信息，还是很认真地挥了挥翅膀：

“我明天给你带奶茶！”

藤蔓立马高兴了，很利落地掰开了自己的一个枝条，递了过去。

“我们交朋友，以后等到你来到了我的地界。”

“我的枝条就会很有用处的！”

白粼粼懵懵的，但面前的“少女”已经下了椅子，拿着一瓶饮料走了，还挥了挥手。

其实这副唯美的场景没有持续多久，因为很快就变成了一大片爬行的藤……

快速蠕动。

白粼粼觉得时间也不早了，于是打算朝着出口走，宋郁应该已经在等他了。

但还有第二关。

水獭左右摇摆地挪了过来，眼睛黑黝黝的，很是委屈。

“……我不用你雕了，够、够了。”

水獭听到这话心碎了。

它看着地面上毛绒绒的小鸟，很认真地幻化出来了一个鹅卵石，很圆，质地和普通的不一样，区别就在于它很圆。

水獭递了过去。

白粼粼：“……”

鸟接了过来，但不知道什么意思。

“你也可以，来我的地界。”

白粼粼没想到是这样，是真的没招了，最后从公文包里拿出来一袋子果冻，对方其实是眼睛亮亮的，但是不知道是进化了还是怎么了。

“不用，零食。”

鸟震惊。

水獭试图捍卫自己地位，一步三回头地走了。

但这些行为其实都被不远处的其他妖看到了，在更远处的一个柱子那里。

白粼粼就这么继续啪嗒啪嗒往出口走，但是一路上被拦住了七八次。

“这是我的龟壳片，你可以来我的地界。”

“这是草原的格桑花，不会枯萎的，你可以来我的地界。”

“这是雨林里的琥珀，你也可以来找我。”

……

鸟一路上，收了不少好东西，大江南北的妖都联系上了。

白粼粼懵懵的，以至于出去的时候晚了足足半个小时。

宋郁其实很是担心，但在见到“人”的时候松了口气。

三分钟后。

“少年”从车载冰箱里拿出来了冰淇淋，用勺子挖着，脸颊红扑扑的，晃了晃自己的腿。

“这么多好朋友？”

宋郁在看“少年”的小公文包，里面不少东西，零零散散的，他眉眼都温和了些。

“你替我收着吧，我们回家放到了储藏室里。”

“以后旅游说不定可以用上。”

白粼粼实在不想去管，只是眯了眯眼，在往嘴巴里放冰淇淋。

甜甜的。

“好，等我们回家。”

宋郁侧眸看着旁边的“少年”，心里觉得很满，它开开心心的就好。

他想起来一件事，温润地问：

“粼粼，爷爷说要给你办个画展，他已经在筹备了，我上午给他看了你的小雕塑，他觉得要再加一个展厅，放你的小东西，问你要不要再多弄几个？”

“少年”愣住了，唇瓣湿漉漉的，一整个慌张。

不是，爷爷不是开玩笑的？

-

一个谎言要用无数个谎言去维系。

鸟终于切身地体会到了。

白粼粼真得有点无措了，好在是他还有水獭，让对方再赶制出来些还是来得及的，就是不知道爷爷到底要多少……

宋郁此刻正带着他回酒店，因为要午睡了，人还在宽慰道：

“爷爷就是单纯的疼你，旁人不知道粼粼是妖怪的，开展的话，会有收入，我同他老人家谈过了，将全部捐出去。”

白粼粼还在走神，直到下一句传来：

“给桐城那里好不好？”

他愣住了，抬眸看了过去。

白粼粼是知道宋郁对他好，但不知道……会这么好。

“粼粼？”

宋郁牵住“人”的手，不知道怎么他的小鸟不说话了，低头询问道。

白粼粼被带着往前走了一步，慌张地偏开了头，心脏怦怦的，面颊也有些泛红。

“如果你觉得太刻意了，我可以再想想别的办法。”

耳边有沉稳的声音传来。

白粼粼觉得离得太近了，他不自觉地想要抽一下自己的手腕，但是没弄开。

“粼粼，不要不看我。”

宋郁是真的不知道怎么了。

直到下一秒。

“少年”眼睛里泛着水光，抬手幻化出来了一根漂亮的羽毛，很纤长，美丽。

它递了过来，闷声道：

“送给你。”

-

与此同时，南市。

宋峥国已经在布置场地了，背着手来回观摩，旁边悬挂着巨大的花鸟图。

蓝羽小鸟栩栩如生。

陈开鹤其实有些不明白，尤其是看到一个站在书柜上的小蓝鸟……这也需要古韵么？

老友的审美是变了么？

这真的要展出吗？

“鸟儿着实好看。”

宋峥国自顾自地同旁边的人道，陈开鹤沉默了，只能敷衍地道：

“是是是。”
chunks.englishText:
The small grove in Tong City was quiet, save for a few faint, rustling sounds. A fluffy mole was currently cradling a Wangwang rice cracker, nibbling away, its black eyes shimmering with moisture.

*Sob, sob.*

It had finally managed to trick someone.

Why was there still no news from Central? It couldn't make contact at all; there was no Bureau of Demon Management in Tong City.

The mole lived a life of feast and famine.

Not daring to eat all its supplies at once, it scurried nimbly to the back of the small shrine where a hole was hidden. It tucked the rest of its rice cracker inside, along with some oranges, pastries, and other odds and ends.

"..."

That should last for a while longer.

The mole peered out from the entrance of the small shrine, waiting for its previous "regular customers." Its long tail dragged behind it on the ground.

It felt nothing but misery.

It had only gone into seclusion to circulate its demonic energy for a while—how had the entire mountain disappeared? Now there was just this tiny patch of woods, a few sparrows, the endless roar of traffic, and no sign of the Bureau. It didn't even have any human currency.

And the mole didn't want to eat bugs.

They didn't taste good.

It waited diligently until the familiar sound of children's voices drifted down the path. The mole immediately retreated into the shrine, hiding behind the portrait.

"Look, look! The kitten shrine! My kitten! The one in the painting looks exactly like the cat at my house!"

The mole stayed perfectly still, circulating its demonic energy.

"Nonsense! It’s clearly my puppy! Look how cute it is! It’s so lifelike."

"I want to worship the kitty!"

"I want to worship the puppy!"

A group of children chattered away, eventually offering "missing teeth" and "spicy instant noodles" at the shrine, scrambling to kowtow to their respective idols.

The mole waited for a long while until they had left before creeping out, once again moved to the verge of tears.

It could make people see the things they cared about most.

At the same time, it could extract images.

This was a high-level demonic art.

The mole had once been glorious, back when humans called them "Mountain Gods." Who would have thought it would fall to such a state? When would the demons from Central arrive?

It had lost its way.

It could only pace around within its own jurisdiction.

-

"So, I think this is an important reason why Central has started accepting recommendations for local demons. Humans are truly skilled at managing their own kind, and Central is learning from them, striving to register every single demon."

The vine continued to speak leisurely.

"So, I think this might be a key focus for our future assignments."

Bai Linlin had gained quite a bit of information and flapped his wings earnestly.

"I'll bring you milk tea tomorrow!"

The vine was immediately delighted, nimbly snapping off one of its own branches and handing it over.

"Let's be friends. When you come to my territory in the future..."

"My branches will be very useful!"

Bai Linlin was bewildered, but the "young girl" before him had already stepped off the chair, walked away with a bottle of drink, and waved goodbye.

In truth, this beautiful scene didn't last long, as it quickly transformed into a vast expanse of crawling vines...

Wriggling rapidly.

Bai Linlin felt it was getting late, so he decided to head toward the exit; Song Yu should be waiting for him.

But there was a second hurdle.

An otter waddled over, swaying from side to side, its dark eyes filled with grievance.

"...I don't need you to carve anymore, it's—it's enough."

The otter was heartbroken at these words.

It looked at the fluffy little bird on the ground and earnestly manifested a pebble. It was very round, with a texture different from ordinary stones—the difference being its perfect roundness.

The otter handed it over.

Bai Linlin: "..."

The bird took it, though he didn't quite understand the meaning.

"You can also... come to my territory."

Bai Linlin hadn't expected this. Truly at a loss, he finally took a bag of jelly out of his briefcase. The other party’s eyes lit up, though whether it was due to evolution or something else, he couldn't tell.

"No need, it's a snack."

The bird was shocked.

The otter tried to defend its status, walking away while looking back every few steps.

However, these actions were seen by other demons not far away, near a pillar in the distance.

Bai Linlin continued to patter toward the exit, but he was stopped seven or eight times along the way.

"This is a piece of my turtle shell; you can come to my territory."

"This is a Gesang flower from the grasslands; it won't wither. You can come to my territory."

"This is amber from the rainforest; you can come find me, too."

...

Along the way, the bird collected quite a few treasures, making connections with demons from all over the country.

Bai Linlin was so dazed that he was a full half-hour late getting out.

Song Yu had been very worried, but he let out a sigh of relief upon seeing "him."

Three minutes later.

The "youth" took an ice cream out of the car refrigerator, digging into it with a spoon, his cheeks flushed, his legs swinging.

"So many good friends?"

Song Yu was looking at the youth's small briefcase, filled with various scattered items. His expression softened.

"Let me keep these for you. We'll put them in the storage room when we get home."

"Maybe we can use them when we travel in the future."

Bai Linlin didn't really want to deal with it; he just squinted his eyes, putting a spoonful of ice cream into his mouth.

It was sweet.

"Okay, when we get home."

Song Yu glanced sideways at the "youth" beside him, feeling a sense of fulfillment. As long as he was happy, that was enough.

He remembered something and asked gently:

"Linlin, Grandfather said he wants to host an art exhibition for you. He's already preparing it. I showed him your little sculptures this morning, and he thinks he should add another gallery hall to display your little trinkets. He asked if you wanted to make a few more?"

The "youth" froze, his lips wet, looking completely panicked.

Wait, Grandfather wasn't joking?

-

A lie must be maintained with countless more lies.

The bird finally understood this firsthand.

Bai Linlin was truly at a loss. Fortunately, he still had the otter; it would be in time if he asked the other party to rush out a few more. He just didn't know how many Grandfather actually wanted...

Song Yu was currently taking him back to the hotel for a nap, comforting him as they went:

"Grandfather just dotes on you. Others don't know that Linlin is a demon. If we hold the exhibition, there will be proceeds, and I've already discussed it with him—we'll donate it all."

Bai Linlin was still distracted until the next sentence came:

"How about donating it to Tong City?"

He froze and looked up.

Bai Linlin knew Song Yu was good to him, but he didn't know... he could be this good.

"Linlin?"

Song Yu took the "person's" hand, wondering why his little bird had stopped talking, and lowered his head to ask.

Bai Linlin was led a step forward, panicked, and turned his head away. His heart was pounding, and his cheeks were flushed.

"If you think it's too deliberate, I can think of another way."

A steady voice came to his ears.

Bai Linlin felt they were too close. He instinctively wanted to pull his wrist away, but he couldn't break free.

"Linlin, don't look away from me."

Song Yu truly didn't know what was wrong.

Until the next second.

The "youth's" eyes shimmered with moisture. He raised his hand and manifested a beautiful feather—long, slender, and exquisite.

He handed it over and muttered:

"For you."

-

Meanwhile, in South City.

Song Zhengguo was already setting up the venue, pacing back and forth with his hands behind his back. A massive painting of flowers and birds hung nearby.

The blue-feathered bird was incredibly lifelike.

Chen Kaihe didn't quite understand it, especially after seeing a small blue bird standing on a bookshelf... Did this really need "classical charm"?

Had his old friend's aesthetic changed?

Was this really going to be exhibited?

"The bird is truly beautiful."

Song Zhengguo said to the person beside him, lost in his own world. Chen Kaihe remained silent, only able to offer a perfunctory:

"Yes, yes, indeed."

chunks.chineseText:
这怎么和宋郁一样了，都这么爱鸟，他一个研究鸟类的都没有这祖孙两个这么走火入魔。

陈开鹤闭了闭眼，心想还真是赶巧，新上任的美术协会主席的孩子在华秉实习，对方要过来撑场子。

行行行。

反正是公益性质的，说不准观众觉得这是某种艺术，古典的花鸟图可能不感兴趣，站在笔杆子顶部的小鸟图高低要看看。

陈开鹤去其他地方转了转，也是帮忙来看看会场，尽管不理解，但支持。

“鸟儿也不知道什么时候回家。”

宋峥国背着手在这里走着，其实是有些想念的，这是头一次离家这么长时间，也不知道在京市生活的习惯不习惯。

也就在这时，不远处有一对夫妇过来，旁边有工作人员拦住了：

“不好意思女士，我们还没有开放展厅。”

“我和主办方认识的，只是想来说说话。”

宋峥国闻言还以为是什么故交过来了，但是刚回过头，是一个年轻女性和她的丈夫。

他并不认识……

但就在这时，有道金光闪了下。

宋峥国再一睁开眼，面前的那位女士水灵灵地变成了一只系着丝带的丹顶鹤，此刻正优雅地看了过来。

作者有话说：

[鸽子][鸽子]：给人羽毛！！
chunks.englishText:
How had he become just like Song Yu? Both of them were so obsessed with birds. Even he, a researcher of avian species, wasn't as possessed as this grandfather and grandson.

Chen Kaihe closed his eyes, thinking it was quite a coincidence that the child of the newly appointed Chairman of the Fine Arts Association was interning at Hua Bing, and the other party was coming to show support.

Fine, fine, fine.

It was for a charitable cause anyway. Who knows? Maybe the audience would find it to be some kind of art. They might not be interested in classical flower-and-bird paintings, but they would certainly take a look at a painting of a bird standing on top of a paintbrush.

Chen Kaihe went to look around other areas, helping to inspect the venue. Even if he didn't understand it, he supported it.

"I wonder when the bird will come home."

Song Zhengguo walked around with his hands behind his back. In truth, he was missing him. This was the first time he had been away from home for so long, and he didn't know if the bird was used to living in Beijing.

Just then, a couple approached from not far away, but a staff member stopped them:

"I'm sorry, ma'am, the gallery isn't open yet."

"I know the organizer; I just wanted to come and have a word."

Hearing this, Song Zhengguo thought a friend had come to visit, but when he turned around, he saw a young woman and her husband.

He didn't recognize them...

But at that moment, a flash of golden light flickered.

When Song Zhengguo opened his eyes again, the lady in front of him had miraculously transformed into a red-crowned crane wearing a silk ribbon, looking over with an elegant air.

Author's Note:

[Pigeon][Pigeon]: Giving someone a feather!!

chunks.chineseText:
第59章

老人脚步都打了个了趔趄，但好在是稳住了心神，宋峥国只能是搓了搓手，很温和地笑着：

“啊……啊你好你好。”

丹顶鹤照旧是端庄的姿态，它的脖子上系着浅蓝色的丝带，身着带有设计感的女士衬衫，迈步往这个画廊里走了几步，回头看了过来：

“这是给247办的？”

宋峥国闭了闭眼，其实那个原形也就出了一秒，那鹤只是让自己认出来而已，它本身还是一个“成年女性”的模样。

“是，是，鸟儿憨态可掬，实在可爱，我画了一些作品。”

“权当给鸟儿留个纪念。”

宋峥国在旁边低眉顺眼地道，不过他还是看了下旁边那个男人，对方似乎神色如常，在抬眸看这些画。

？

这是人？

丹顶鹤环着手臂，看了下墙壁上的花鸟画，最后侧眸问了下，“就这些？”

“不不，还有很多。”

宋峥国实在是紧张的手心冒汗，引着面前的一鹤一人往里头走，场地很宽敞，装潢主要是暖黄色，有打着的壁灯，显得作品更加具有质感。

丹顶鹤边走边点头，最后看到了一幅竹子为背景的图，上面不止有蓝羽小鸟，还有一只黑灰棕相间的小雀，两只挤在一块，鸟头对着，像是在说悄悄话。

“挺好的。”

宋峥国松了一口气，还好是通过考察了，不过他不由得看向了一旁的男人。

是什么关系……

丹顶鹤见状优雅地介绍道：

“我的伴侣。”

宋峥国闻言眼皮都抽了抽，但还是勉勉强强维持着镇定，连忙道：

“啊，看出来了，看出来了。”

“很、很般配。”

丹顶鹤点了点头，很矜持地道：

“那是。”

宋峥国在后面跟着，低眉顺眼的，环顾了下四周，发现陈开鹤不知道去哪里了。

老头闭了闭眼。

“宋郁……他是十九了？”

前方的女士慢悠悠地询问，无名指上有着银色的婚戒，抬手抚了抚墙壁上的画框，回头看了过来。

宋峥国只好道：“是，小郁还在读大学。”

丹顶鹤蹙了蹙眉：“确实是……年纪太小了。”

宋峥国心里就有些不乐意了，犹犹豫豫地开口了：

“这年纪小也有年纪小的优势，那年纪大的……体力总是不好的吧？”

本来这话是没什么的。

但是丹顶鹤一听，转头看了过来，意有所指地道：

“噢——”

宋峥国什么时候这样过，老脸红温了，他试图解释：

“我是说的客观情况，不是……”

“好了好了。”

丹顶鹤摆了摆手，俨然是不想听了，只是坦坦荡荡地提了自己的要求：

“我们247也已经成年了，管理局那里已经送了赠礼的，至于……人类这里。”

宋峥国听到这个停顿，立马站直了，而后下一句就是：

“二十二岁是人类法定结婚年龄，那个时候，他们需要完成人类的婚礼，有异议么？”

丹顶鹤伸了伸手，给面前的人看了婚戒，而后环着手臂，很自信地道：

“就像这样。”

宋峥国闻言只是点头，后面才担忧地道：

“那鸟儿的身份……”

“那就是你们的事了。”

丹顶鹤收回了自己的手，很护短地道：

“妖界从一开始就接受了247的监护人，从来没有任何敌意，并且南市管理局每个小妖都送了赠礼。”

“这你都知道吧？”

宋峥国在后面连连点头，只是一昧地道：

“对对对。”

丹顶鹤这才有些满意，自顾自地又讲：

“妖界为监护人打开了大门，那人类伴侣……不应该为我们247做些什么？”

宋峥国仿佛一下子被点醒了，整个人都开始焦灼了起来，连忙道：

“是是，这个我们一定会做到的。”

“一毕业就结婚！”

“身份的问题也能解决！”

丹顶鹤这才算是舒坦了，本来是打算出来逛街的，没想到还有意外收获，它在这个场地里又逛了一圈。

宋峥国就这么一直陪着，偶尔还瞥一眼旁边的那个男人，对方是真的一句话都不插……

这鹤好手段。

“好了，这个展什么时候开放？”

丹顶鹤走到了出口处，回头询问了下，觉得还是挺不错的，247还是头一个拥有自己个人独立展的小妖。

可以为其他妖怪做表率。

到时候过来拍点照，挂在历史回廊里，上级再来巡视也是不怕的。

肯定能评上先进单位！

“打算是在鸟儿从京市回来再办。”

宋峥国在旁边说道。

“那也快了，需要门票么？”

鹤询问。

宋峥国立马反应过来了，连忙道：

“这个请放心，一定是给你们留着，我让下属去安排，要多少都可以的。”

鹤满意。

“三百多张吧。”

“……”

-

xx自治区。

黑衣少年在进行收尾工作，它一直驻扎在一个埋伏点，现下这个农户已经回了家，在摇床上哄孩子，或许是因为缺钱，他们夫妻待了没多久就又离开了，锁好了门窗，把摇床吊在房梁上。

001在树杈子上写报告，时不时会看一下木屋窗户里面的情况，见那孩子睡得很安稳，也就没管。

灰色任务是需要进行书面报告的，但奈何001不会写字，所以是用图画来表达的：

大灰狼血盆大口，利齿分明，身躯高大。

下方有寥寥几笔的小雀，伸出翅膀，金光流转，化形成“人”，迎难而上，最终成功将其击倒。

“嗯。”

黑衣少年自己给予自己肯定，然后把本本收了起来，而后才利落地从树上下来了，它原本是要看一下怎么处理那只狼妖的尸体，但是就在这时，房门内传来孩子的啼哭声。

“……”

001照旧还是进去了，开始去摇那个吊床，面无表情的，低头看着那个圆圆的黑色瞳仁，人类幼童在好奇地打量。

他一嚎，就有“人”过来。

001环顾了下周围，看到了熟悉的奶粉罐子，它走过去，泡了一杯，看着那个比较高级的机器，上面会显示温度，而且会摇晃均匀。

这是这家里最高级的东西了。

001在外面蹲守了很长时间，观察得来的，它拿过来了奶瓶，看着吊床上的孩童，对视。

“……”

“……”

001给递了过去，幼童立马抱住奶瓶了，开始大口大口地喝了起来。

人类真奇怪。

有的人在偷猎，有的人在建立保护区，有的人满怀戒备，有的人坦诚相待。

001只是个小雀。

它想不通。

不过就在这时，门口传来了动静：

“哎呀哎呀忘记了，孩子是不是没喝奶？”

“我们真是昏头了……”

木门嘎吱打开，里头只有个吊床，农户走了过来，低头一看，双双愣住了。

孩子已经抱着奶瓶喝上了。

女主人有点懵了。

“你这记性，原来准备了啊。”

男主人在低头逗孩子。

“是、是么？”
chunks.englishText:
The old man stumbled, but managed to steady his nerves. Song Zhengguo could only rub his hands together and smile gently:

"Ah... ah, hello, hello."

The red-crowned crane maintained its dignified posture. A light blue ribbon was tied around its neck, and it was dressed in a stylish designer blouse. It took a few steps into the gallery and looked back:

"Is this being held for 247?"

Song Zhengguo closed his eyes. In truth, that original form had only appeared for a second; the crane was just letting him know who it was. It still appeared as an "adult woman."

"Yes, yes. The bird is so charming and adorable; I painted a few pieces."

"Just as a memento for the bird."

Song Zhengguo spoke with his head bowed, though he couldn't help but glance at the man beside her. The man’s expression seemed perfectly normal as he looked up at the paintings.

?

Is this a human?

The red-crowned crane crossed her arms, looked at the flower-and-bird paintings on the wall, and finally glanced sideways to ask, "Is this all?"

"No, no, there are many more."

Song Zhengguo was so nervous that his palms were sweating. He led the crane and the man inside. The venue was spacious, decorated primarily in warm yellow tones with wall lamps that gave the works a more textured feel.

The red-crowned crane nodded as she walked. Finally, she saw a painting with a bamboo background featuring not only the blue-feathered bird but also a small sparrow with black, gray, and brown feathers. The two were huddled together, heads touching, as if whispering to each other.

"Quite good."

Song Zhengguo let out a sigh of relief. It had passed the inspection. However, he couldn't help but look at the man beside her.

What was their relationship...

Seeing this, the red-crowned crane introduced him elegantly:

"My partner."

Song Zhengguo’s eyelids twitched upon hearing this, but he barely managed to maintain his composure, quickly saying:

"Ah, I see, I see."

"Very... very well-matched."

The red-crowned crane nodded and said with reserve:

"That we are."

Song Zhengguo followed behind, head bowed, scanning his surroundings, only to find that Chen Kaihe had disappeared.

The old man closed his eyes.

"Song Yu... he is nineteen?"

The lady in front asked leisurely. She had a silver wedding ring on her ring finger, and she reached out to stroke the frame of a painting on the wall before turning back.

Song Zhengguo had no choice but to say: "Yes, Xiao Yu is still in university."

The red-crowned crane frowned: "Indeed... he is too young."

Song Zhengguo felt a bit unhappy inside and spoke hesitantly:

"There are advantages to being young. As for... being older, the physical stamina is usually not as good, right?"

Originally, there was nothing wrong with this statement.

But as soon as the red-crowned crane heard it, she turned her head, implying something:

"Oh—"

Song Zhengguo had never been like this before; his old face flushed red. He tried to explain:

"I was speaking objectively, not..."

"Alright, alright."

The red-crowned crane waved her hand, clearly not wanting to listen, and stated her requirements openly and honestly:

"Our 247 is already an adult. The Bureau has already sent a gift, and as for... here in the human world."

Song Zhengguo stood up straight when he heard the pause, and the next sentence was:

"Twenty-two is the legal age for human marriage. At that time, they need to complete a human wedding. Any objections?"

The red-crowned crane held out her hand to show the ring to the person in front of her, then crossed her arms and said confidently:

"Just like this."

Song Zhengguo could only nod, then added worriedly:

"Then, the bird's identity..."

"That is your business."

The red-crowned crane pulled her hand back, acting very protective:

"The Demon Realm accepted 247's guardian from the very beginning; there has never been any hostility. Every little demon in the South City Bureau sent a gift."

"You know this, right?"

Song Zhengguo nodded repeatedly behind her, only able to say:

"Yes, yes."

Only then did the red-crowned crane seem satisfied, continuing on her own:

"The Demon Realm opened its doors to the guardian, so shouldn't the human partner... do something for our 247?"

Song Zhengguo seemed to be awakened instantly. He became anxious and quickly said:

"Yes, yes, we will definitely do that."

"We'll get married as soon as he graduates!"

"The identity issue can also be resolved!"

Only then was the red-crowned crane satisfied. She had originally intended to go shopping, but hadn't expected such a pleasant surprise. She walked around the venue once more.

Song Zhengguo accompanied her the whole time, occasionally glancing at the man beside her, who truly didn't say a single word...

This crane had quite the methods.

"Alright, when will this exhibition open?"

The red-crowned crane walked to the exit and turned back to ask. She thought it was quite good; 247 was the first little demon to have his own independent exhibition.

He could set an example for other demons.

When the time came, they could take some photos and hang them in the Corridor of History. They wouldn't have to fear when the superiors came for inspections.

They would definitely be rated as an advanced unit!

"We plan to hold it after the bird returns from Beijing," Song Zhengguo said.

"That will be soon. Do we need tickets?" the crane asked.

Song Zhengguo reacted immediately and quickly said:

"Please rest assured, we will definitely reserve them for you. I will have my subordinates arrange it; you can have as many as you need."

The crane was satisfied.

"About three hundred."

"..."

-

XX Autonomous Region.

The black-clad youth was finishing up its work. It had been stationed at an ambush point. The farmer had returned home and was coaxing his child in a cradle. Perhaps due to a lack of money, the couple hadn't stayed long before leaving again, locking the doors and windows and hanging the cradle from the rafters.

001 was writing a report on a tree branch, occasionally checking the situation inside the wooden house. Seeing that the child was sleeping soundly, it didn't interfere.

Gray-level missions required written reports, but since 001 didn't know how to write, it used drawings to express itself:

A big bad wolf with a bloody mouth, sharp teeth, and a massive body.

Below it were a few strokes representing a small sparrow, wings outstretched, golden light flowing, transforming into a "human," meeting the challenge head-on, and finally succeeding in defeating it.

"Hmm."

The black-clad youth affirmed its own work, put the notebook away, and then nimbly climbed down from the tree. It had originally intended to see how to dispose of the wolf demon's corpse, but just then, the sound of a child crying came from inside the room.

"..."

001 went in as usual and began to rock the cradle, expressionless, looking down at the round black pupils. The human infant was looking at it with curiosity.

Whenever he wailed, someone would come.

001 scanned the surroundings and saw the familiar milk powder can. It walked over, made a bottle, and looked at the high-end machine that displayed the temperature and shook the bottle evenly.

This was the most advanced thing in the house.

001 had been lurking outside for a long time and had observed this. It took the bottle and looked at the infant in the cradle. They locked eyes.

"..."

"..."

001 handed it over, and the infant immediately hugged the bottle and began to drink in large gulps.

Humans were truly strange.

Some people were poaching, some were establishing protected areas, some were full of caution, and some were open and honest.

001 was just a little sparrow.

It couldn't figure it out.

However, at that moment, there was a commotion at the door:

"Oh my, oh my, I forgot. Did the child not have his milk?"

"We really are losing our minds..."

The wooden door creaked open. Inside, there was only the cradle. The farmer walked over, looked down, and both of them froze.

The child was already holding the bottle and drinking.

The woman was a bit dazed.

"Your memory... so you had prepared it after all."

The man lowered his head to tease the child.

"Is... is that so?"

chunks.chineseText:
房子里安安静静的，窗户外面的树枝上，站着一只毛绒绒的小雀儿。

任务结束了。

它要走了。

001在房子外面看了一会，然后走到了不远处的土堆上，那里有狼妖的尸体，它还没有想好怎么处理。

妖怪……其实不吃妖怪的。

这很奇怪。

黑衣少年是在这个时候接到了南市管理局的传讯的：

[何时归？]

[247会在十日后培训结束，回到南市后将会开一个画展，有你们的双鸟图，来得及回来么？]

黑衣少年立马眼睛亮亮的，它现在就可以走，金色的流光幻化了出来，它传回了讯息：

[现在。]

001处理完这些低头看了下那个狼妖，尽管是尸体，它莫名心情很好，回去就可以找247了，它恐怕还没有见过狼……

黑衣少年抬手去拔掉了那颗最锋利的牙齿，用农户家里带过来的麻绳缠住了，成了一个相当不错的挂坠。

礼物！

这次联合行动基本完成了，目标已经逐个攻破，749局的人在帐篷里烤火，直到外面进来一个黑衣少年，对方很认真地道：

“我要回去。”

人面面相觑，立马道：

“好好好，给你配个车。”

001很高兴，耐心地等着。

人这才反应过来：

“马上马上，十多分钟就好。”

749局的人对于妖怪的认知其实是比较有偏见的，主要是处理的灰色任务实在太过于残忍，但是很古怪的是……妖怪那里也有来合作的。

原先都是些狐狸、黑熊之类的……看着就不好惹。

这头一次，来一只小雀儿。

001此刻已经化成了本体，在火炉旁边站着，羽毛蓬了蓬，等车的时候打了个盹。

咔嚓——

749局的人有些尴尬，拍照被发现了，但是刚想要解释的时候，小雀转了个身子，挺胸抬头的，意思不言而喻。

“噢，好好好。”

后面就是真的送走了。

帐篷里人还在聊天，大多是在说妖怪的事，语气很平和：

“其实妖怪也有好的。”

“人也有坏的呢……这种事怎么说？”

他们托着腮看着篝火，不知道在想什么，直到手机传来了同一条信息：

[情报有误，目标四号不止是一头狼妖，而是有两头，另外一头已于半月前潜逃……]

-

京市。

白粼粼此刻正在酒店里收拾东西，光是行李箱就有好几个，全是京市的一些特产。

爷爷的、阿姨的、丹顶鹤的、001的、皮皮的……很多很多妖怪的。

他不知道这些够不够。

宋郁在阳台上打电话，面色平静，只是在听那边的汇报：

“盛星它不正当变更法人避税的证据是收集齐了，但关于定责这方面其实不太明晰，目前还在找这个李总职务侵占的事，它应当是和公司的一个财会勾结了起来。”

“大概三天？应该会有个结果。”

宋郁只是问：“能判几年？”

“如果确定了侵吞国有资产并洗钱、避税……数罪并罚的话，五年以上，十年以下。”

“这样。”

对面的陈平听到这话就愣了下，不是，这还不够么？

这么操作下去，盛星这个公司就不可能有了，也不会再套壳复生了。

“关于这个李振的个人私生活方面，也是相当混乱，混迹在京市的各种会所里，包养也是屡见不鲜，至于他的原配则是……”

就在这时，陈平突然听到电话里面传来一句脆生生的：

“宋郁！”

“宋郁！你过来呀！”

陈平愣了下，而后很自如地说了下还有别的事，立马给挂了。

酒店这里。

白粼粼是真的很困扰，他不知道怎么分配礼物，他从小到大就没有送过礼之类的，这和在管理局分发零食是不一样的。

“少年”不知道人在干什么，歪头刚想再叫一声，脸颊被一个手轻轻地托住了，把他转了回来。

宋郁俯身半蹲下来，眉眼温和地道：

“怎么了？”

“不是在收拾东西么？”

白粼粼在地毯上盘腿坐着，侧脸看了过去，其实他们离得有些近。

一秒，两秒。

“少年”偏开了头，耳垂有些泛红，有些不自在地道：

“那个。”

“还是想不好这些礼物，我选的合适吗？”

宋郁就这么垂眸看着“人”，而后很自然地要去牵手，但刚碰到——

白粼粼就转过来头了，一下子躲开了，很是义正词严地道：

“你不要这样趁我不注意，你知不知道你年纪很小！”

“粼粼，我只是想看看行李箱里的东西。”

“……”

白粼粼一下子像被戳破了的气球一样，有点小小的尴尬。

他没谈过恋爱。

不知道怎么回事，总之是觉得这段时间自己有点过于敏感了，分明之前没有这样的。

送了羽毛之后就……

白粼粼身体有些发热，低着头，打算收回来自己的手，但是就在这时被握住了。

“也确实想趁机牵你。”

宋郁坦坦荡荡的，低头去看“人”，面不改色的。

“……”

白粼粼脸颊都红了，只是道：

“可是你还在上学，我觉得我们还是先……”

“那早恋。”

白粼粼不想说话了，他抬手就想要变成本体，但是指缝被挤开了，十指相扣。

宋郁很平静地道：

“送礼很简单的，丹顶鹤的话，换掉食物特产，我下午陪你去挑个丝巾；爷爷的话，送茶叶就可以；阿姨……不如送两份，阿姨和阿姨孩子的，这样比较妥帖。”

白粼粼后面其实在走神，感觉对方的话从左边耳朵进去，然后又从右边耳朵出来了。

晕晕的。

“我替你办好不好？”

一道沉稳的声音传来。

白粼粼不由自主地点了点头，面颊红红的，最后被一把从地毯上抱了起来。

也不挣了。

宋郁只是抱着“人”去了床边，放到了自己腿上，低头看“少年”的后颈，那里的纹路还在泛着光。

他不确定是不是有发情期的因素影响。

他的小鸟毕竟才刚成年。

“难受不难受？”

白粼粼闻言摇了摇头，但是又点了点头，很礼貌地扶着人的肩头，问了问：

“我能再咬你一口吗？”

宋郁低头看着那双圆圆的眼睛，笑了下，轻声道：

“可以的。”

“少年”立马仰头过来了，脖子上的皮肤很薄，牙齿一磨就破了，软舌舔舐了下伤口。

宋郁目光都有些涣散，他只是用手扣住“人”的肩胛骨，往里压，他能看到那个纹路在亮……

有金光流转。

他的小鸟。

是个妖怪，真好。

宋郁眉目暗沉，看着那个红润的耳垂，低头含住了。

“啊——”

白粼粼抬手就抵住了人的肩头，眼眶泛着水光，另外一个手捂住了自己的耳朵。

“我错了。”

宋郁诚恳地道。

-

下午，最终考核。
chunks.englishText:
The house was deathly quiet. Outside the window, a small, fluffy sparrow perched on a tree branch.

The mission was over.

It was time to leave.

001 watched from outside the house for a while before walking over to a mound of dirt not far away. The corpse of the wolf demon lay there; it hadn't yet decided how to dispose of it.

Demons... actually didn't eat other demons.

It was quite strange.

It was at this moment that the black-clad youth received a transmission from the Southern City Management Bureau:

[When will you return?]

[247 will finish training in ten days. Upon returning to Southern City, there will be an art exhibition featuring your "Two Birds" painting. Can you make it back in time?]

The black-clad youth’s eyes lit up instantly. It could leave right now. Golden light shimmered and transformed, and it sent back a message:

[Now.]

After finishing its business, 001 looked down at the wolf demon. Despite it being a corpse, it felt inexplicably cheerful. Once it returned, it could find 247. It probably hadn't seen a wolf before...

The black-clad youth raised its hand, pulled out the sharpest tooth, wrapped it in hemp rope brought from the farmer's house, and fashioned it into a rather decent pendant.

A gift!
