The joint operation was essentially complete, and the targets had been taken down one by one. The agents from Bureau 749 were warming themselves by a fire in a tent when a black-clad youth walked in. The youth said very earnestly:

"I want to go back."

The people looked at each other, then immediately said:

"Alright, alright, we'll get you a car."

001 was very happy and waited patiently.

The agents finally reacted:

"Right away, right away, just ten more minutes."

The people at Bureau 749 actually held quite a bit of prejudice regarding demons, mainly because the gray-area tasks they handled were often too cruel. But strangely enough... demons also came to cooperate with them.

Previously, it had always been foxes, black bears, and the like—creatures that looked like trouble.

This was the first time a little sparrow had come.

001 had already shifted into its true form and was standing by the stove, fluffing its feathers, taking a nap while waiting for the car.

*Click—*

The Bureau 749 agents felt a bit awkward; they had been caught taking a photo. Just as they were about to explain, the little sparrow turned around, puffed out its chest, and held its head high. The meaning was self-evident.

"Oh, right, right."

After that, they were truly sent off.

Inside the tent, the people were still chatting, mostly about demons, their tone quite peaceful:

"Actually, there are good demons too."

"Humans can be bad too... how can you really say?"

They rested their chins on their hands, staring into the bonfire, lost in thought, until their phones all received the same message:

[Intelligence error. Target No. 4 is not just one wolf demon, but two. The other one fled half a month ago...]

-

Beijing.

Bai Linlin was currently packing his things in the hotel. There were several suitcases, all filled with local specialties from Beijing.

For Grandpa, for Auntie, for the Red-crowned Crane, for 001, for Pipi... and for many, many other demons.

He didn't know if this would be enough.

Song Yu was on the balcony making a phone call, his expression calm as he listened to the report:

"The evidence regarding Shengxing's improper change of legal representative to avoid taxes has been collected, but the accountability aspect is still unclear. We are currently investigating this Manager Li for embezzlement; he likely colluded with an accountant at the company."

"About three days? There should be a result by then."

Song Yu only asked: "How many years could he get?"

"If it's confirmed that he embezzled state assets, laundered money, and evaded taxes... if the sentences are served concurrently, it would be between five and ten years."

"I see."

Chen Ping on the other end was stunned. *Wait, isn't that enough?*

With this kind of operation, the company "Shengxing" would cease to exist and wouldn't be able to rise from the ashes under a new shell.

"Regarding this Li Zhen's personal life, it is also quite chaotic. He frequents various clubs in Beijing, and keeping mistresses is common. As for his legal wife..."

Just then, Chen Ping suddenly heard a crisp voice from the phone:

"Song Yu!"

"Song Yu! Come over here!"

Chen Ping paused, then very naturally said he had other matters to attend to and hung up immediately.

At the hotel.

Bai Linlin was truly troubled. He didn't know how to distribute the gifts. He had never given gifts from childhood to adulthood; this was different from handing out snacks at the Bureau.

The "youth" didn't know what the human was doing. He tilted his head, wanting to call out again, when his cheek was gently cradled by a hand, turning him back around.

Song Yu leaned down and crouched, his eyes and brows gentle:

"What's wrong?"

"Weren't you packing?"

Bai Linlin sat cross-legged on the carpet, looking sideways. They were actually quite close.

One second, two seconds.

The "youth" turned his head away, his earlobes turning red, feeling somewhat uncomfortable:

"That."

"I still can't decide on these gifts. Did I choose them well?"

Song Yu looked down at the "person" like this, then naturally reached out to hold his hand, but just as he touched him—

Bai Linlin turned his head and dodged, saying very sternly:

"Don't take advantage of me when I'm not paying attention! Do you know how young you are!"

"Linlin, I just wanted to see what was in the suitcase."

"..."

Bai Linlin felt like a punctured balloon, feeling a little embarrassed.

He had never been in a relationship.

He didn't know what was going on, but he felt he had been a bit too sensitive lately. He definitely hadn't been like this before.

Ever since he gave away his feather...

Bai Linlin’s body felt a bit hot. He lowered his head, intending to pull his hand back, but it was grasped firmly.

"I did want to take the chance to hold your hand."

Song Yu was open and honest, looking down at the "person" without changing his expression.

"..."

Bai Linlin’s cheeks were flushed, and he only said:

"But you're still in school. I think we should first..."

"Then puppy love it is."

Bai Linlin didn't want to talk anymore. He raised his hand, wanting to shift into his true form, but his fingers were squeezed, and their hands locked together.

Song Yu said calmly:

"Gift-giving is very simple. For the Red-crowned Crane, swap the food specialties; I'll go with you this afternoon to pick out a silk scarf. For Grandpa, tea is fine. For Auntie... why not give two sets, one for Auntie and one for her child? That would be more appropriate."

Bai Linlin was actually zoning out, feeling the other's words go in one ear and out the other.

He felt dizzy.

"Shall I handle it for you?"

A steady voice came.

Bai Linlin nodded involuntarily, his cheeks red, and finally, he was scooped up from the carpet.

He didn't struggle anymore.

Song Yu carried the "person" to the bedside, placed him on his lap, and looked down at the "youth's" nape, where the markings were still glowing.

He wasn't sure if it was influenced by a mating season.

His little bird had only just reached adulthood, after all.

"Are you uncomfortable?"

Bai Linlin shook his head at the question, but then nodded. He politely rested his hands on the man's shoulders and asked:

"Can I bite you again?"

Song Yu looked down at those round eyes, smiled, and said softly:

"You can."

The "youth" immediately tilted his head back. The skin on his neck was very thin; it broke as soon as teeth grazed it, and a soft tongue licked the wound.

Song Yu’s gaze grew unfocused. He used his hands to hook the "person's" shoulder blades, pressing him inward. He could see the markings glowing...

Golden light swirled.

His little bird.

A demon. How wonderful.

Song Yu’s eyes darkened. He looked at the flushed earlobe and leaned down to take it into his mouth.

"Ah—"

Bai Linlin raised his hand to push against the man's shoulder, his eyes brimming with moisture, while his other hand covered his own ear.

"I was wrong."

Song Yu said sincerely.

-

In the afternoon, the final assessment.

chunks.chineseText:
中央是会对地方推荐的妖怪进行系统的培训的，但是还是需要考核的，考核通过的则是分配辖区，考核不通过的则继续二次学习。

白粼粼面色红红的，坐在车内的副驾上看妖怪手册，还是有理论考试的，他低头认认真真地复习。

宋郁在旁边陪着。

其实皱了皱眉。

他不想他的小鸟不理他，骨节分明的手放在方向盘上，微微紧了紧。

白粼粼能察觉到人在看他，挺习惯的，但是后面觉得氛围怪怪的，抬眸去看了。

也就在那一瞬间。

宋郁的面色多云转晴，温和地抬眸问：

“怎么了？”

白粼粼歪了下头，心想自己感觉错了，他当了妖怪之后，感知视线的能力变强了，就连注视者的目的都能察觉一点点。

刚才……

“没怎么。”

白粼粼复习的差不多了，打算下车了，低头去拉车门，不出意料地打不开。

最后转头去看宋郁，面无表情地道：

“你干什么？”

“抱一下好吗？”

车内安安静静的。

白粼粼心脏漏了半拍。

没办法，是因为宋郁年纪小吗？

明明在酒店抱了很多次的，怎么下车的还是不能省……

白粼粼倾身过来了，没好气地抱了，然后因为耳垂被含了下，不由自主地偏头，但后颈被捏住了。

牢牢地扣了过来。

“考核顺利。”

宋郁的声音很沉，像是埋了埋“少年”的脖颈。

“知道了。”

白粼粼一下车就化成了毛绒绒的小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒地狂奔，翅根都是半伸着的，为了散热。

-

中央的考题其实没有那么难，至少对于鸟来说是这样的，毕竟丹顶鹤让他考试了好几次。

所谓宝剑锋从磨砺出。

白粼粼是第一个交卷，当堂考当堂批，水豚托了托眼镜，用红笔批改。

对勾。

对勾。

对勾。

满分！

水豚点了点头，让鸟去第二考场了，房间里剩余的妖怪们都发出了此起彼伏的惊叹。

这么快就看完题目了么？

由地方举荐到中央的妖怪是必须通过扫盲班的，但是它们也大多只是认识生活用语，对于长篇大论的题目还是要花费些时间看的。

鸟的优势崭露无遗。

第二考场。

对面是原来的那只山羊，它是主考官，旁边还坐着一只黑熊和一个黄鼠狼。

山羊在看档案，黄鼠狼则是托着下巴在闲聊：

“南市的，编号247，举荐理由是对人类文化相当熟悉，有天赋。”

鸟站在对面的一个皮质椅子上，毛绒绒的，有些紧张，爪子抠了抠皮面。

白粼粼认真道：

“是的。”

黑熊头也不抬地道：“看起来的确有天赋，第一个交卷的，还是满分。”

山羊闻言也是点了点头，接着看相应的档案。

黄鼠狼还在问：

“那我考你几个常识问题。”

鸟收了收翅膀，很是严阵以待，他最讨厌这种自由发挥的环节了，简直梦回之前的面试。

“248加124等于多少？”

白粼粼：“……”

他多虑了。

黄鼠狼心想这么难的题目这小妖肯定算不明白，但下一秒：

“372。”

山羊都抬了抬头，这么快？

黄鼠狼震惊：

“那735加236等于多少？”

“971。”

白粼粼展现了惊妖的天赋，以至于对面三位考官互相交头接耳了一会，然后都开始点头。

“现在就是缺这种妖才。”

“对的对的，人类发展太快了，行政区划也变得快，这就是现在地方管理局位置偏僻的一个主要原因。”

“如果的有了解人类文化的妖……那说不定可以画出来人类的拟建地铁线路图，然后构建……”

“算术能力是重要的，但是……文化方面也要掌握一些吧？”

白粼粼就这么听着，毛绒绒的身躯挺立了起来，文化方面会是什么？

但他还来不及思考，黄鼠狼就已经开口了：

“了解人类的诗吗？会背吗？”

“……”

鸟决定装个大的：

“春江潮水连海平，海上明月共潮生。”

“滟滟随波千万里，何处春江无月明。”

这么几句下去，对面的三个妖考官已经齐齐震惊。

这么厉害？

白粼粼越来越自信了，完完整整地背完了这首《春江花月夜》，他还有《滕王阁序》、《项脊轩志》、《李凭箜篌引》这些存货的。

背不背得完另说，但拿出来几句忽悠妖是够用的。

鸟获得了诸位考官的青睐，看到了它们在评分表上打上了大大的勾，接下来就是妖力掌控测试。

金光流动。

鸟化形成“少年”模样，抬手幻化，那些金光逐步变成了蓝色羽毛的模样，绚烂美丽，环绕着自身。

防御。

“很好。”

“嗯嗯。”

“可以。”

鸟的实践考核，得了满分。

于是乎，在诸多妖怪开始进入第二考场的时候，白粼粼已经拿着成绩单去大厅那里了。

一个圆滚滚的身影潇洒离去，对着后面的妖怪们挥了挥翅膀。

大厅窗口。

对面有个梅花鹿在打盹，看到一个毛绒绒的鸟扑棱翅膀上来才回了回神，打了个哈欠，低头看了看窗口对面。

是一只毛绒绒的小鸟。

“拿过来证件。”

梅花鹿抬手扶了扶自己头顶上的角，本来是挺累的，但是一碰，掉下来了。

鸟叼着通行证震惊了。

旁边窗口的妖怪看到后一边处理文件一边调侃：

“梅，回家切切片补下身体吧。”

梅花鹿：“……”

它像是习惯了，把自己的角放到了一旁，敷衍道：

“好好，我回头放放血，给自己再来一大碗。”

白粼粼：“……”

什么地狱笑话。

不过好在这边很快就处理好，拿着通行证生成了一张文书，主要内容就是中央分配的相关信息。

白粼粼叼着东西就飞到了一个休息区域，把文书给打开了。

先研究一下。

待会还要开大会。

[户籍：xx省南市。]

[分配地：待定。]

[职位：管理局局长。]

鸟本来还因为“待定”一个词而感到困惑，但是看到“管理局局长”之后整个鸟都身心通畅了，意气风发了。

爪子压着那个文书。

收了收翅膀。

他就知道！

鸟就是很优秀！

白粼粼高高兴兴地叼着自己的文书去中央的一个报告厅里候着，里面有阶梯式的座椅，前面的讲台是非常宽大的，而且后面有垂坠的红色帘子。

鸟进去看了看，发现自己在第二排中间的位置，上面写着编号的：N247。

白粼粼高高兴兴地坐上去了，伸着鸟腿，用喙放下来那张文书，仔仔细细地观看着，真不错……

就在这时，陆陆续续的妖怪也都进来了，无一不拿着文书，待会它们开完会，就可以各回各家了。

上任！

-
chunks.englishText:
The Central Bureau would provide systematic training for the demons recommended by local branches, but an assessment was still required. Those who passed would be assigned a jurisdiction, while those who failed would have to undergo further study.

Bai Linlin, his face still flushed, sat in the passenger seat of the car reading the Demon Handbook. There was a theoretical exam, and he lowered his head to study earnestly.

Song Yu accompanied him from the side.

He actually frowned.

He didn't want his little bird to ignore him. His well-defined fingers tightened slightly on the steering wheel.

Bai Linlin could sense the man watching him. He was used to it, but later he felt the atmosphere was strange and looked up.

At that very moment.

Song Yu’s expression shifted from cloudy to sunny, and he asked gently:

"What's wrong?"

Bai Linlin tilted his head, thinking he had misperceived it. After becoming a demon, his ability to perceive gazes had become stronger; he could even detect a little of the gazer's intent.

Just now...

"Nothing."

Bai Linlin had finished his review and intended to get out of the car. He lowered his head to pull the door handle, but as expected, it wouldn't open.

Finally, he turned to look at Song Yu and said expressionlessly:

"What are you doing?"

"Can I have a hug?"

The car was quiet.

Bai Linlin’s heart skipped a beat.

There was no helping it; was it because Song Yu was young?

They had hugged many times in the hotel, so why couldn't he skip it just because they were getting out of the car...

Bai Linlin leaned over and gave him a grumpy hug, then, because his earlobe was nibbled, he tilted his head involuntarily, but his nape was pinched.

He was pulled in firmly.

"Good luck with the assessment."

Song Yu’s voice was very deep, as if he were burying his face in the "youth's" neck.

"I know."

As soon as Bai Linlin got out of the car, he transformed into a fluffy little bird, scurrying along with his wings half-spread to dissipate heat.

-

The Central Bureau's exam questions weren't actually that difficult, at least not for a bird, given that the Red-crowned Crane had made him take exams several times.

As the saying goes, a sharp sword comes from the whetstone.

Bai Linlin was the first to hand in his paper. It was graded on the spot by a capybara who adjusted his glasses and used a red pen.

Checkmark.

Checkmark.

Checkmark.

Full marks!

The capybara nodded and sent the bird to the second exam room. The remaining demons in the room let out gasps of amazement one after another.

*He finished the questions so quickly?*

Demons recommended to the Central Bureau by local branches were required to pass a literacy class, but most only knew daily vocabulary; they usually needed time to read long, complex questions.

The bird's advantage was fully revealed.

Second exam room.

Facing him was the goat from before, who was the chief examiner, with a black bear and a ferret sitting beside him.

The goat was looking at the file, while the ferret rested his chin on his hand, chatting idly:

"From Southern City, ID 247. The recommendation reason is familiarity with human culture and talent."

The bird stood on a leather chair opposite them, fluffy and somewhat nervous, his claws scratching the leather surface.

Bai Linlin said earnestly:

"Yes."

The black bear didn't even look up: "He does look talented. First to hand in the paper, and full marks at that."

The goat nodded upon hearing this and continued to look at the corresponding file.

The ferret continued to ask:

"Then let me ask you a few common knowledge questions."

The bird tucked in his wings, looking very prepared. He hated this kind of "free-form" segment the most; it reminded him of his previous interviews.

"What is 248 plus 124?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

He had worried for nothing.

The ferret thought that such a difficult problem would surely stump the little demon, but in the next second:

"372."

Even the goat looked up. *So fast?*

The ferret was shocked:

"Then what is 735 plus 236?"

"971."

Bai Linlin displayed a heaven-defying talent, to the point where the three examiners whispered to each other for a while, then all began to nod.

"We really need this kind of demon talent right now."

"True, true. Human development is too fast, and administrative divisions change quickly. That's a main reason why local management bureaus are so remote."

"If we have a demon who understands human culture... maybe they could draw up proposed subway line maps and then construct..."

"Arithmetic ability is important, but... they should also master some culture, right?"

Bai Linlin listened, his fluffy body straightening up. What would "culture" entail?

But before he could think, the ferret had already spoken:

"Do you know human poetry? Can you recite any?"

"..."

The bird decided to show off in a big way:

"The spring river tides rise level with the sea, and the bright moon on the sea rises with the tide."

"The shimmering waves follow the current for ten thousand miles; where is there no moon on the spring river?"

After these few lines, the three demon examiners were collectively shocked.

*So impressive?*

Bai Linlin became more and more confident. He recited the entire "Spring River, Flower, Moon, Night." He still had "Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng," "Account of the Xiangji Pavilion," and "Li Ping's Konghou Performance" in his repertoire.

Whether he could finish reciting them was one thing, but pulling out a few lines to fool these demons was enough.

The bird won the favor of the examiners, seeing them put big checkmarks on the score sheet. Next was the demon power control test.

Golden light flowed.

The bird transformed into the "youth" form, raised his hands, and channeled the light. The golden glow gradually turned into the shape of blue feathers, gorgeous and beautiful, circling around him.

Defense.

"Very good."

"Mm-hmm."

"Acceptable."

The bird’s practical assessment received full marks.

And so, while many other demons were just beginning to enter the second exam room, Bai Linlin was already heading to the main hall with his report card.

A round, fluffy figure left with a flourish, waving his wings at the demons behind him.

At the hall window.

A sika deer was napping opposite. It only came to its senses when it saw a fluffy bird flapping its wings up. It yawned and looked down at the window.

It was a fluffy little bird.

"Hand over your credentials."

The sika deer raised its hand to adjust the antlers on its head, but it was already quite tired; as soon as it touched them, they fell off.

The bird, holding the pass in its beak, was shocked.

A demon at the next window saw this and joked while processing documents:

"Mei, go home and slice them up to nourish your body."

Sika deer: "..."

It seemed used to it. It put its antlers aside and said perfunctorily:

"Alright, alright, I'll bleed myself later and have another big bowl."

Bai Linlin: "..."

What kind of hellish joke was that?

Fortunately, things were handled quickly here. He received a document generated with his pass, which mainly contained information regarding the Central Bureau's assignment.

Bai Linlin flew to a rest area with the document in his beak and opened it.

Study it first.

There was a big meeting later.

[Household Registration: Southern City, XX Province.]

[Assignment Location: To be determined.]

[Position: Bureau Chief of the Management Bureau.]

The bird was initially confused by the phrase "to be determined," but after seeing "Bureau Chief of the Management Bureau," his whole body felt refreshed and spirited.

His claws pressed down on the document.

He tucked his wings.

He knew it!

Birds are just excellent!

Bai Linlin happily carried his document to a lecture hall in the Central Bureau to wait. Inside, there were tiered seats, a very large podium at the front, and heavy red curtains behind it.

The bird went in to look and found his seat in the middle of the second row, with his ID number written on it: N247.

Bai Linlin sat down happily, stretched his bird legs, used his beak to lay down the document, and watched it carefully. Truly wonderful...

Just then, demons began to enter one after another, all holding their documents. After the meeting, they would each be able to return home.

To take office!

-

chunks.chineseText:
与此同时，宋郁其实去交付了个合同，他把他的小鸟住过的出租房买了下来，前段时间就已经在联系了。

这里面毕竟都是他的小鸟上辈子的物件。

与其被其他人二次使用，倒不如直接买下来，就这么放着也可以。

宋郁处理完这些，分公司那里也来了消息，说是那个李振违法犯罪的证据已经搜集齐全了。

他倚靠着车门，同那边打了个电话：

“嗯。”

“先不用，等个几天，这个不着急。”

宋郁语气平静，并不觉得自己的考量有什么问题，单纯的送去坐牢还不够，他的小鸟要亲自报仇一下。

除此之外……

他抬手把电话挂了之后，又在查京市一些运土车的群聊，老师们留下来的资料是很有用的，有的涉及了当时车祸赔偿的判决书。

开大车的司机有个心照不宣的约定……他们买了保险，宁肯撞死人，绝不撞残人。

宋郁只是在看这个人的资料。

面色冷淡。

不过就在这时，他的手机电话响了，出乎意料，是来自于桐城的。

宋郁抬手接了过来，看了下不远处的广场，那里还是静悄悄的，他只好开口道：

“粼粼还没有结束。”

但那边的老师只是犹犹豫豫，最后说了一句：

“我们是找你的。”

宋郁闻言一愣，而后才问是什么事，对面那里也像是纠结了很久，但还是坦坦荡荡地说了：

“粼粼不是和你结了契了么？我们是觉得那还是挺不完整的，桐城这里领了证也是要办席面的，好歹……你们得回桐城一趟。”

...

宋郁挂了电话后还有些恍惚，但过了一会儿爷爷也打过来了，刚接对方就开门见山地道：

“小郁，要不要先办个订婚仪式？”
chunks.englishText:
Meanwhile, Song Yu had actually gone to finalize a contract; he had bought the rental apartment where his little bird had lived. He had been in contact about it for some time.

After all, his little bird's belongings from his previous life were all in there.

Rather than letting others use them, it was better to buy it outright and just leave it as it was.

After Song Yu finished handling these matters, news came from the branch office that the evidence of Li Zhen's illegal activities had been fully collected.

He leaned against the car door and made a phone call:

"Mm."

"No need for now. Wait a few days; there's no rush."

Song Yu’s tone was calm. He didn't think there was anything wrong with his consideration. Simply sending him to prison wasn't enough; his little bird needed to take revenge personally.

Besides that...

After he hung up the phone, he checked some group chats for dump truck drivers in Beijing. The materials left behind by the teachers were very useful; some involved the court judgments regarding the compensation for the car accident at the time.

The drivers of the large trucks had an unspoken agreement... they bought insurance, and they would rather kill a person than leave them crippled.

Song Yu just looked at the man's information.

His expression was cold.

However, just then, his phone rang. Unexpectedly, it was from Tongcheng.

Song Yu answered it and looked at the square not far away. It was still quiet, so he had to speak:

"Linlin hasn't finished yet."

But the teacher on the other end hesitated for a long time before finally saying:

"We're looking for you."

Song Yu was stunned, then asked what the matter was. The person on the other end seemed to struggle for a long time, but still spoke frankly:

"Linlin has already entered into a contract with you, hasn't he? We feel that it's still quite incomplete. In Tongcheng, even after getting a certificate, one must hold a banquet. At the very least... you two need to come back to Tongcheng."

...

Song Yu was still a bit dazed after hanging up the phone, but after a while, Grandpa also called. As soon as he answered, the other party got straight to the point:

"Xiao Yu, do you want to hold an engagement ceremony first?"

chunks.chineseText:
第60章

宋郁闻言怔了下，不太清楚他爷爷怎么突然开始说“订婚”，他老人家并不是这么一个冲动的性子，除非是有什么事发生了。

他刚想开口询问，电话那头就传来了声音：

“爷爷今天见到了那鹤，人家专程来提点我了。”

“你当时是不是去了管理局领了什么证件，然后还办了个仪式？”

宋郁大概猜到发生了什么，但是他没有插话的空间，因为他爷爷还在讲话：

“更何况后面人家妖怪还送了十箱子的礼……这不能人家妖界承认了你的身份，但我们这边却没什么表示？”

“不行不行。”

“要不先订婚？等到你毕业了，然后再办结婚仪式。”

宋郁微微抬了下眉。

“订婚也得好好办。”

宋峥国在那头自顾自地说，甚至已经想好了具体的场地：

“小郁，你说包个山庄怎么样？到时候风景秀丽的，空间也大，鸟儿的朋友也可以都来。”

“你们的衣服也要好好挑挑，提前让那些牌子过来量尺寸……”

宋郁眼看着他爷爷收不住了，只能先出声打断了，认真道：

“爷爷，这些都要征求粼粼的意见。”

“它还在考核，还没有出来。”

电话那头一听也冷静了下来，连忙道：

“是是是。”

“这得说一下。”

宋峥国似乎是深呼吸了一口气，闻言才想起来一件事，他好像也要征求一下自己孙子的意见：

“那一毕业就结婚，小郁你的想法是……”

“我听粼粼的。”

“……”

总之后面是又聊了些其他的事，包括画展的进度，以及京市分公司的一些事。

“盛星那家公司确实有问题，华秉的合作伙伴不能是这个档次，分公司这里的管理也有一些缺点，这些……”

宋郁一边汇报，一边低头看了下腕表。

下午三点半了。

他的小鸟还没有出来。

-

中央报告厅内。

白粼粼坐在自己的位置上，用爪子按住那个文书，仔仔细细地又欣赏了好几遍，直到身边陆陆续续地来妖了。

左边是藤蔓，右边是水獭。

“……”

“……”

两个妖彼此看不顺眼，都朝两旁扭了下头。

不过它们不约而同地看向了中间的座椅，鸟头圆滚滚的，此刻还在看那个文书。

藤蔓好奇地凑过去：

“你分配到哪里？”

白粼粼闻言愣了下，他把文书往旁边挪了下，认真地道：

“不都是待定吗？”

面前的藤蔓伸出来个枝条，做出一个摇摆的动作，对方幻化出来了自己的文书，给鸟看：

“我的是黔省XX市XX山。”

白粼粼不明白，就在这时，左边也递过来一张文书，上面的信息也很明确：

[分配地：京市XX区。]

水獭斜着眼睛去看中间的小鸟，其实也有些不明白。

怎么是待定？

白粼粼这下有些困惑了，为什么他的不一样？

不过这个时候台上已经来妖了，是山羊，对方带着金丝框眼镜，此刻像是为了正式，特地化成了人形。

兽头人身的那种。

“诸位，中央对你们的培训已经结束，经过考核鉴定，一百零三名学员全部合格，即将走向为妖界服务的旅途当中。”

“希望你们始终不忘初心，砥砺前行，争取在日后为同族做出应有的贡献。”

白粼粼在椅子上坐着，伸着鸟腿，有些郁闷，他会被分配到哪里？

台上还在讲话，甚至在一个个介绍第一排来的大妖，鸟一点都不感兴趣，只是晃了晃自己的爪子，形成一个小内八。

管理局局长。

不会是骗他的吧？

白粼粼有些莫名的紧张，不过就在这时，台上又开始讲话：

“学员当中也有十分优越的妖才，它们的分配地将会重新考量，会后请在原地停留……”

垂着的鸟头立马抬起来了。

眼睛亮亮的。

他就知道！

很快上面就讲完了，然后开始让台下的学员上去领取证书以及合影留念。

鸟毛绒绒，很灵活地从椅子上下来了，它们是第一排，此刻正在往台上走，不过正要上去的时候，旁边有个拿着托盘的土拨鼠。

上面是衣服。

“一妖一份，有序领取。”

白粼粼抬起翅膀，调动起来妖力，很容易地穿在了身上，和上次的西服套装一样，自动就变得合身了，不过这次的是学士服。

黑色的那种，还有个学士帽。

鸟毛绒绒的，跟随着报告厅里响起来的音乐，啪嗒啪嗒地往前走，上了台阶，见到了那群大妖们。

有老虎、狮子、斑马……还有一只熊猫，它们在低声交流着：

“鸟界的实在是少见啊？”

“是是，这小妖天赋很好，对人类文化极其了解。”

“前途无量啊！”

鸟扑棱翅膀上了长桌子，挺胸抬头地往前走，伸出了翅膀，开始一个个地“握手”。

“谢谢！”

“谢谢！”

鸟很懂礼貌，一个个地道谢，最后戴着学士帽走到了最前面，熊猫早就恭候多时，伸出爪子去给桌子上的小鸟拨了下穗，然后站在了旁边。

开始合影。

“一二三，好！”

鸟完成了，接过来了自己的培训证明和聘用文书，啪嗒啪嗒地往前走，山羊见到他也点了点头。

白粼粼很是矜持地从台上下来了，回到了自己的座位上，这个时候台上还在颁发证书，正好还有些空闲时间。

鸟在清点自己的东西：

成绩单。

两份文书。

培训证明。

齐全了！

白粼粼幻化出来自己的公文包，很是认认真真地塞了进去，然后伸着鸟腿再次坐下了，悠哉游哉地看台上。

鸟满意！

很快颁发环节就结束了，剩余的妖也回到了座位，在山羊的一番展望下，大会顺利收尾，众妖鼓掌，然后有序离场。

白粼粼还要留在这里，因而不能跟藤蔓和水獭一起走，他挥了挥翅膀。

拜拜！

过几天就可以回南市了！

藤蔓倒是大大方方地走了，但是水獭没有，它站在旁边，斜着眼睛看椅子上的小鸟。

白粼粼：“……”

又怎么了？

水獭伸出来手，幻化出来个一米高的木箱子，站在旁边，很骄傲地抬了抬头。

白粼粼有种不妙的预感。

嘎吱——

木箱子的门打开了。

里面雕刻着一个身着西服领带、夹着公文包的小鸟，要气质有气质，要体态有体态。

水獭认认真真地道：

“礼-物。”

白粼粼只是在沉思，这个东西要摆在哪里……

但他还是收下了，毕竟是对方的一片心意，水獭左右摇摆地就走了。

它比那藤多送一个！

很快报告厅就剩下很少的妖怪了，鸟跟随着队伍排队上去了，台上那几位大妖还在，山羊托了下眼镜，看了看这些剩余妖怪的档案，在一个个地面对面确认信息。

白粼粼排在了最后一个。

“N247是吧？”
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu was stunned by these words. He wasn't quite sure why his grandfather had suddenly started talking about an "engagement." The old man was not an impulsive person, unless something had happened.

Just as he was about to ask, a voice came from the other end of the line:

"I met that crane today. He came all the way here to give me a heads-up."

"Did you go to the Management Bureau to get some documents and hold a ceremony back then?"

Song Yu roughly guessed what had happened, but he had no room to interject because his grandfather was still speaking:

"Besides, that demon even sent over ten crates of gifts later on... It wouldn't be right if the Demon Realm has acknowledged your status, but we haven't made any gesture on our end, would it?"

"No, no, that won't do."

"How about we get engaged first? Then, once you graduate, we can hold the wedding ceremony."

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly.

"An engagement must be done properly, too."

Song Zhengguo continued to talk to himself on the other end, having already decided on a specific venue:

"Xiao Yu, what do you think about renting a villa? The scenery would be beautiful, and there would be plenty of space. The bird's friends could all come, too."

"You two should also pick out your outfits carefully. I'll have those brands come over to take your measurements in advance..."

Seeing that his grandfather was getting carried away, Song Yu had to interrupt, saying earnestly:

"Grandfather, we must ask for Linlin's opinion on all of this."

"He is still undergoing assessment and hasn't come out yet."

The person on the other end calmed down upon hearing this and quickly replied:

"Yes, yes."

"That must be discussed."

Song Zhengguo seemed to take a deep breath, and only then did he remember something else—he also needed to ask his grandson for his opinion:

"And as for getting married right after graduation, what are your thoughts, Xiao Yu..."

"I listen to Linlin."

"..."

In any case, they chatted about other things afterward, including the progress of the art exhibition and some matters regarding the Beijing branch office.

"That company, Shengxing, definitely has issues. Huabing's partners cannot be of that caliber, and there are some shortcomings in the management of the branch office. These..."

While reporting, Song Yu lowered his head to glance at his watch.

It was 3:30 PM.

His little bird hadn't come out yet.

-

Inside the central lecture hall.

Bai Linlin sat in his seat, using his claw to press down on the document, admiring it carefully for the umpteenth time until the demons started arriving one after another.

To his left was a Vine; to his right was an Otter.

"..."

"..."

The two demons didn't see eye to eye and both turned their heads in opposite directions.

However, they both looked toward the seat in the middle, where the round-headed bird was still reading that document.

The Vine curiously leaned over:

"Where were you assigned?"

Bai Linlin was stunned at the question. He moved the document aside and said earnestly:

"Isn't it all 'to be determined'?"

The Vine in front of him extended a branch, making a swaying motion, and manifested its own document to show the bird:

"Mine is XX Mountain, XX City, Qian Province."

Bai Linlin didn't understand. Just then, the one on the left also handed over a document, the information on which was very clear:

[Assignment: XX District, Beijing.]

The Otter squinted at the little bird in the middle, actually feeling somewhat confused as well.

How could it be "to be determined"?

Bai Linlin was now quite puzzled. Why was his different?

However, at this moment, a demon had already arrived on stage—a Goat. The other party was wearing gold-rimmed glasses and, for the sake of formality, had specifically transformed into human form.

The beast-headed, human-bodied kind.

"Everyone, the central training for you has concluded. After assessment and verification, all one hundred and three trainees have passed and are about to embark on the journey of serving the Demon Realm."

"I hope you will always remember your original intentions, forge ahead, and strive to make due contributions to your kin in the future."

Bai Linlin sat on his chair, extending his bird legs, feeling a bit depressed. Where would he be assigned?

The person on stage was still talking, even introducing the great demons in the first row one by one. The bird wasn't interested at all, just shaking his claws, forming a slight pigeon-toed stance.

The Director of the Management Bureau.

They wouldn't be lying to him, would they?

Bai Linlin felt an inexplicable nervousness. But just then, the person on stage began to speak again:

"Among the trainees, there are also exceptionally talented demons whose assignments will be reconsidered. Please remain in your seats after the meeting..."

The drooping bird head immediately lifted up.

His eyes were bright.

He knew it!

Soon, the speech concluded, and the trainees were asked to go up to receive their certificates and take group photos.

The fluffy bird nimbly hopped down from the chair. They were in the first row and were currently walking toward the stage. However, just as they were about to go up, there was a Groundhog nearby holding a tray.

On it were clothes.

"One set per demon, please collect them in an orderly fashion."

Bai Linlin raised his wings, channeled his demon power, and easily put them on. Just like the suit from last time, it automatically became a perfect fit, though this time it was a bachelor's gown.

The black kind, complete with a mortarboard.

The fluffy bird followed the music playing in the lecture hall, pattering forward, climbed the steps, and saw that group of great demons.

There were tigers, lions, zebras... and even a panda. They were whispering to each other:

"It's really rare to see one from the Bird Realm, isn't it?"

"Yes, yes. This little demon is very talented and has an extreme understanding of human culture."

"A bright future ahead!"

The bird flapped his wings and hopped onto the long table, puffed out his chest, and walked forward, extending his wing to begin "shaking hands" one by one.

"Thank you!"

"Thank you!"

The bird was very polite, thanking them one by one. Finally, wearing his mortarboard, he reached the very front. The panda had been waiting for a long time; it extended a paw to adjust the tassel for the little bird on the table, then stood to the side.

The photo session began.

"One, two, three, good!"

The bird was done. He took his training certificate and employment document and pattered forward. The Goat also nodded at him.

Bai Linlin descended from the stage with great restraint and returned to his seat. At this time, certificates were still being issued, so there was some spare time.

The bird took inventory of his belongings:

Transcript.

Two documents.

Training certificate.

All there!

Bai Linlin manifested his briefcase, stuffed them in very carefully, and then sat down again with his bird legs extended, leisurely watching the stage.

The bird was satisfied!

Soon, the awarding ceremony ended, and the remaining demons returned to their seats. After some final outlooks from the Goat, the meeting concluded smoothly. The demons applauded and left in an orderly manner.

Bai Linlin had to stay behind, so he couldn't leave with the Vine and the Otter. He waved his wings.

Bye-bye!

He could go back to Nan City in a few days!

The Vine left quite generously, but the Otter did not. It stood to the side, squinting at the little bird on the chair.

Bai Linlin: "..."

What now?

The Otter extended its hand, manifested a one-meter-tall wooden box, stood beside it, and raised its head proudly.

Bai Linlin had a bad premonition.

*Creak—*

The door of the wooden box opened.

Inside was carved a little bird wearing a suit and tie, clutching a briefcase. It had style, and it had posture.

The Otter said very earnestly:

"Gift."

Bai Linlin was just lost in thought, wondering where to put this thing...

But he accepted it anyway, as it was the other party's heartfelt gesture. The Otter swayed from side to side as it walked away.

It had given one more gift than that Vine!

Soon, only a few demons were left in the lecture hall. The bird followed the queue and went up. The great demons on stage were still there. The Goat adjusted its glasses, looked at the files of the remaining demons, and confirmed the information face-to-face one by one.

Bai Linlin was the last in line.

"N247, right?"

chunks.chineseText:
山羊看了下档案里的照片，头也不抬地道，它对这个小妖很有印象，能进行复杂的数学运算和古诗的背诵，算是近几年头一个了。

“是。”

鸟毛绒绒的，站在桌子的对面，收了收翅膀，很认真地回复道。

这些大妖还在交流：

“南市本来就很发达，那里的管理局算是有名的了，前段时间749局还专门去视察了，没有问题。”

“所以这小妖的户籍地就是在南市，如果也去当专员，倒是有些大材小用。”

“我知道南市那个，现在局长鸟界的那位吧？政绩不错，已经把人类动物园里的公职人员收归了，这对于我们了解信息是非常好的。”

白粼粼震惊。

丹顶鹤不是在窗口工作的么？

鸟爪子并了并，有些莫名紧张，他回想了下之前的事，发现基地确实没有什么“局长”的身影，大多都是各个窗口的负责人。

白粼粼突然想起来一件事，当时在他成年的那晚……扛着十箱礼的……好像不止鸟界的小妖怪，像侏儒兔、花枝鼠、玉米蛇它们都来了。

甚至还有过来撑场面的狐妖。

“……”

白粼粼有种自己老师是校长的恍惚感，但对面还在聊：

“你们的意思是南市没有空余的职位了？它们是做得不错。”

“但也不是完全没有问题吧？中央的信鸽有反馈南市管理局道路的地址和我们一百年前登记的不一致，很混乱，它们还没有管。”

“这我就不赞同了，这是南市管理局的问题吗？难道不是人类那里一直在改道路的事儿么？他们就爱一些面子工程，拆了路边的杨树，改种梧桐树，反正一来一回的，上报经费的由头是有了。”

“也不能完全否定吧？人类它们很会改革，建设了新区，经济得到了发展，还有招商引资……南市管理局做得很好不也是借鉴人类经验么？”

鸟在对面正襟危坐的，鸟头一会儿左边一会儿右边的。

它们吵架了。

鸟很拘谨。

“我不是站人类的意思，这我们现在建立起来管理局系统，难道初心不是为了妖与人和平相处吗？人类都走上科技发展道路了，难道我们还要让同族生活在山林里？不认识文字？”

白粼粼翅根都收紧了。

好严肃的讨论。

“好吧，你说的对，但我们是不是忘记了什么？”

众大妖转头看了过来。

桌面上还站着一只毛绒绒的鸟。

“……”

山羊试图让气氛缓和一下，顺带也引入下分配地的问题，于是开口询问：

“南市管理局你觉得怎么样？”

白粼粼想了想，很认真地道：

“非常好，管理局里每个妖怪都很好，我们的氛围很和谐的。”

旁边那位妖怪一听就道：

“是吧，我看了它们去年的工作报告的，还有人类只身来管理局登记的，做得真是非常好。”

这话一出，其余妖怪也很意外，又开始讨论起来了。

“真的吗？”

“哪一个？”

“我只知道南市管理局的局长是有人类伴侣的，它们那什么地方？风水问题吗？这么喜欢人类当配偶。”

鸟爪抠地。

“我记得报告上写了的，编号是两百多少？”

“247？”

山羊悠悠地道。

报告厅里安安静静的，众妖又看向面前的小鸟。

白粼粼：“……”

山羊只是肯定道：“怪不得你对人类文化这么了解，是个优势。”

“对对。”

这个时候众妖也不吵架了，只是理性分析了下：

“那它去南市那里还是大材小用的，不如调到中央这里？”

“需要基层经历的。”

山羊很适时地提出建议：

“现在中央不是在着手在扩大管理局的机构么？与南市临近的桐城不行么？那里原来是有派过妖怪驻扎的，但是后来断联了，查一查，重建管理局，是个不错的基层经历。”

白粼粼愣住了，桐城？

是桐城？

旁边的妖怪只是道：“不过按道理是应该回自己户籍地的，南市的经济状况是要比桐城好的。而且它不是已经有伴侣了？异地啊？”

“……”

白粼粼没想到它们考虑得这么多，一时半会也有些紧张兮兮的。

但这些确实是问题。

“不是很年轻么？克服下困难不好吗？就两年的基层经历，之后就可以来中央了。”

“我看你才一岁半，可不能因为爱情冲昏头脑啊。”

白粼粼刚想点头，但这个时候旁边的一个妖怪又道：

“它的伴侣好像是华秉实业公司的继承人。”

“……噢，当我没说。”

鸟绷不住了。

但好在这番商讨算是结束了，山羊再度确认了下是否愿意去桐城重建管理局的任务，等到肯定答复后，对方抬手由左自右滑了一下，文书上分配地开始显露出痕迹：

xx省桐城。

烫金的字体，是与藤蔓、水獭它们黑色的字体不一样的。

白粼粼莫名有些心潮澎湃。

“此次培训之后，将有七天的休假，等你抵达桐城，会有下发各项补贴，你的上级是这位——”

山羊用手托了托眼镜，很是温和地道：

“有问题及时向我传讯。”

“好的好的。”

-

宋郁还在外面等，其实已经打算去问下丹顶鹤了，但是就在这时不远处终于来了一个小小的身影。

蹦蹦跳跳的。

不是那身西服小套装，是……学士服。

鸟圆滚滚的，还戴着个学士帽，小穗一晃一晃的。

白粼粼高高兴兴的，见到宋郁立马垫着爪子，挥了挥翅膀。

“我回来啦！”

蓝羽小鸟立马扑棱翅膀飞了过去，站在了人的肩头，昂首挺胸的。

“好看。”

宋郁根本不用问，自动就说了。

车内——

“哎，好看好看！鸟儿真棒！”

视频电话已经打起来了，宋郁拿着手机，屏幕里没有他，全部都是肩头的一只小鸟。

此刻正在三百六十度展示。

白粼粼戴着小学士帽，身着合身的学士服，爪子站得稳稳当当的。

“啾啾！”

宋峥国还在感叹：

“真好真好！这算是结束了吗？鸟儿什么时候回家？”

“爷爷给你办洗尘宴！”

宋郁眉眼温和，照旧当着一个手机支架，直到他的小鸟仰头看了过来，意思不言而喻。

人把摄像头对准了自己，开始接过了话头：

“可能还要再过几天，盛星那家公司的事还没有处理完。”

白粼粼化形成了“少年”，一下子抓住了宋郁的手臂，保留着当鸟时候的本能，拱了过去，抢走了一半的镜头：

“爷爷！”

当鸟说鸟语，当“人”说“人”话。

“哎。”

宋郁眼皮微微垂着，一时间也忘了他爷爷了，只是低头看着贴过来的“少年”，微微靠近——

“小郁，你怎么拿手机的？”

“靠上一点，爷爷看不到你们了。”

宋郁这才回了回神，重新把手机拿了起来，“少年”凑了过去，下巴都抬高了点：
chunks.englishText:
The Goat looked at the photo in the file and said without lifting its head. It had a deep impression of this little demon; being able to perform complex mathematical calculations and recite ancient poetry made him the first of his kind in recent years.

"Yes."

The fluffy bird stood on the opposite side of the table, tucked in his wings, and replied very earnestly.

The great demons were still chatting:

"Nan City is already very developed; the Management Bureau there is considered quite famous. A while ago, the 749 Bureau even went there specifically for an inspection, and there were no issues."

"So, this little demon's registered residence is in Nan City. If he also goes to be a specialist, it would be a bit of a waste of talent."

"I know about that Nan City one. The current Director is from the Bird Realm, right? Their political achievements are good; they've already brought the public servants in the human zoo under their jurisdiction. This is very good for us to understand information."

Bai Linlin was shocked.

Wasn't the Red-crowned Crane working at the service window?

The bird's claws gripped together, feeling inexplicably nervous. He recalled previous events and realized that there really hadn't been any sign of a "Director" at the base; most were just the heads of various service windows.

Bai Linlin suddenly remembered something. On the night he came of age... the ones carrying the ten crates of gifts... it wasn't just the little demons from the Bird Realm; creatures like pygmy rabbits, fancy mice, and corn snakes had all come.

There were even fox demons who came to show support.

"..."

Bai Linlin had a dazed feeling that his teacher was the principal, but the ones opposite him were still chatting:

"Are you saying there are no vacant positions in Nan City? They are doing well."

"But it's not like there are absolutely no problems, right? The central carrier pigeons have provided feedback that the addresses for the Nan City Management Bureau's roads are inconsistent with what we registered a hundred years ago. It's very chaotic, and they haven't managed it."

"I don't agree with that. Is this a problem with the Nan City Management Bureau? Isn't it because humans keep changing the roads? They love 'face projects,' tearing down the poplar trees by the roadside and planting phoenix trees instead. Either way, they have a reason to report expenses."

"You can't deny it completely, though. Humans are very good at reform; they've built new districts, developed the economy, and attracted investment... Isn't the Nan City Management Bureau doing well by borrowing from human experience?"

The bird sat upright on the opposite side, his bird head turning left and then right.

They were arguing.

The bird felt very constrained.

"I'm not taking the humans' side. But isn't the original intention of us establishing the Management Bureau system for demons and humans to live in peace? Humans have already embarked on the path of technological development; are we still going to let our kin live in the mountains? Unable to read?"

Bai Linlin's wing roots tightened.

Such a serious discussion.

"Alright, you're right, but have we forgotten something?"

The great demons turned to look over.

Standing on the tabletop was a fluffy bird.

"..."

The Goat tried to ease the atmosphere and, while at it, introduce the issue of the assignment location, so it asked:

"What do you think of the Nan City Management Bureau?"

Bai Linlin thought for a moment and said very earnestly:

"It's excellent. Every demon in the Management Bureau is very kind, and our atmosphere is very harmonious."

The demon next to him said upon hearing this:

"See? I read their work report from last year. There were even humans coming to the Management Bureau to register on their own. They really did a very good job."

Once this was said, the other demons were also surprised and began to discuss it again.

"Really?"

"Which one?"

"I only know that the Director of the Nan City Management Bureau has a human partner. What kind of place is that? Is it a Feng Shui issue? Why do they like humans as spouses so much?"

The bird's claws dug into the table.

"I remember it was written in the report, number two hundred and something?"

"247?"

The Goat said leisurely.

The lecture hall was quiet, and the demons looked at the little bird in front of them again.

Bai Linlin: "..."

The Goat simply affirmed: "No wonder you have such an understanding of human culture; that is an advantage."

"Yes, yes."

At this point, the demons stopped arguing and analyzed it rationally:

"Then it would be a waste of talent for him to go to Nan City. Why not transfer him to the central office?"

"He needs grassroots experience."

The Goat offered a suggestion at the right time:

"Isn't the central office currently working on expanding the Management Bureau's institutions? What about Tong City, which is near Nan City? Demons were stationed there before, but contact was lost later. Investigating and rebuilding the Management Bureau there would be a good grassroots experience."

Bai Linlin was stunned. Tong City?

It was Tong City?

The demon next to him just said: "But logically, he should return to his registered residence. The economic situation in Nan City is better than in Tong City. And doesn't he already have a partner? A long-distance relationship?"

"..."

Bai Linlin hadn't expected them to consider so much, and for a moment, he felt quite nervous.

But these were indeed issues.

"Isn't he very young? Wouldn't it be good to overcome some difficulties? It's only two years of grassroots experience, and then he can come to the central office."

"I see you're only a year and a half old; you mustn't let love cloud your judgment."

Bai Linlin was just about to nod, but at this moment, another demon next to him said:

"His partner seems to be the heir to the Huabing Industrial Company."

"…Oh, never mind what I said."

The bird couldn't hold it together.

But fortunately, the discussion was over. The Goat confirmed once more whether he was willing to take on the task of rebuilding the Management Bureau in Tong City. After receiving an affirmative answer, the other party raised a hand and slid it from left to right. Traces began to appear on the document under the assignment location:

Tong City, XX Province.

The gold-stamped font was different from the black font of the Vine and the Otter.

Bai Linlin felt inexplicably stirred.

"After this training, there will be a seven-day vacation. Once you arrive in Tong City, various subsidies will be issued. Your superior will be this person—"

The Goat adjusted its glasses with its hand and said very gently:

"If you have any problems, send me a message in time."

"Okay, okay."

-

Song Yu was still waiting outside. He had actually intended to go and ask the Red-crowned Crane, but just then, a small figure finally appeared in the distance.

Bouncing along.

It wasn't that little suit, but... a bachelor's gown.

The bird was round and fluffy, wearing a mortarboard, with the little tassel swaying back and forth.

Bai Linlin was very happy. Upon seeing Song Yu, he immediately stood on his tiptoes and waved his wings.

"I'm back!"

The little blue-feathered bird immediately flapped his wings and flew over, landing on the person's shoulder, head held high and chest puffed out.

"You look great."

Song Yu didn't even need to ask; he said it automatically.

Inside the car—

"Oh, you look great, you look great! The bird is truly amazing!"

The video call had already started. Song Yu was holding the phone, but the screen didn't show him; it was entirely filled with the little bird on his shoulder.

He was currently showing off 360 degrees.

Bai Linlin was wearing his little mortarboard and a well-fitting bachelor's gown, his claws standing firmly and steadily.

"Chirp chirp!"

Song Zhengguo was still exclaiming:

"Wonderful, wonderful! Does this mean it's over? When is the bird coming home?"

"Grandfather will throw you a homecoming banquet!"

Song Yu's eyes were gentle, acting as a phone stand as usual, until his little bird looked up at him, the meaning self-evident.

The man turned the camera toward himself and began to take over the conversation:

"It might take a few more days; the matter with that Shengxing company hasn't been fully resolved yet."

Bai Linlin transformed into a "youth," suddenly grabbed Song Yu's arm, retaining the instincts from when he was a bird, and leaned over, snatching half the frame:

"Grandfather!"

When a bird, he spoke bird language; when a "human," he spoke "human" language.

"Oh."

Song Yu's eyelids drooped slightly, and for a moment, he forgot about his grandfather, just looking down at the "youth" leaning against him, moving slightly closer—

"Xiao Yu, how are you holding the phone?"

"Move it up a bit, Grandfather can't see you two anymore."

Song Yu finally came back to his senses and repositioned the phone. The "youth" leaned in, his chin lifted slightly:

chunks.chineseText:
“爷爷，我可以当管理局的局长！”

那边更是惊叹，连忙道：

“这必须得好好庆祝下，办三天的洗尘宴，请鸟儿的好朋友好不好？我们晚上办，也不扰民！”

“好！”

白粼粼很有家庭成员的自觉，高高兴兴的，不过他还是说了下具体的分配地：

“爷爷，是在桐城，我要在桐城重建管理局，它们说是两年的基层经验。”

“之后我就可以调到中央！”

宋峥国只是一昧地开心，甚至还拍了拍大腿，心想这真是他们小郁高攀了，道：

“好！爷爷在桐城给你买个房子！”

宋郁听到这里把手机拿了过来，“少年”愣了下，目光顺着往旁边走，抬手就攀附上了人的手臂。

“这个我来办。”

“爷爷您这样会太累了。”

白粼粼是想要露脸的，但是宋郁拿到那只手了，他只能倾身凑过去，刚想要开口插话，但腰上多了一条手臂。

扣住了。

“少年”面色一下子红了，收着下巴，低头去掰腰上的手臂，但是半天都弄不开，上方还在谈话：

“让我发挥些作用爷爷，我会照顾好粼粼的。”

“可是你不是还要念书？这……怎么办？”

“我晚上去桐城。”

白粼粼听到这话后愣了下，其实他觉得不用的，他有双休的，到时候周六周日回南市就可以了的。

他刚抬头看过去，宋郁就低头看了过来。

对视了。

电话那头传出来声音了：

“那不会很累么？就算是高速也得一个多小时。”

宋郁只是道：

“我不放心它自己在。”

“我也不想分开。”

话说得很直白了，白粼粼听到这话后立马就低头了，假装耳朵聋了，后颈露出来了光洁的皮肤。

宋峥国闻言也不知道说什么。

这总不能是随了他吧？

他也就是半夜徒步过二十公里去找沅清……

“行，你自己考量好就可以。”

“不过，问问鸟儿订婚的事啊。”

宋峥国后面说完这句话，很是从善如流地挂断了，莫名有点小小的心虚。

车内安安静静的。

白粼粼反应了下，这才仰头看了过来，不解地问：

“订婚？”

-

酒店内。

“少年”在桌子上吃一份龙虾盖饭，用勺子往嘴巴里放，双腿在桌子下面晃，眯了眯眼睛。

很好吃！

“会觉得太早么？”

宋郁在旁边给“人”剥橘子，处理得很细致，垂着眼皮试探。

“唔……”

白粼粼一开始确实有些懵的，但是他思考了下，他们一来结契了，二来上次坦白了，好像没有必要再纠结什么。

宋郁年纪很小。

他不能再退缩。

“是有些，你还在念书。”

宋郁闻言动作一顿，微微拧眉：

“粼粼，为什么非要在意这个？”

“我是个成年人。”

白粼粼面色有些泛红，他只是有些不自在地道：

“我、我知道，但是你在读大学，这个时候就应该好好学习的，我也要去好好地专心我的事业。”

“正好可以沉淀沉淀。”

宋郁没有说话。

白粼粼只好又道：“订婚的话，爷爷既然说了，那我觉得可以的，但是你最好不要在学校里说，会影响你的……”

“影响我什么？”

宋郁面色很平淡。

白粼粼不知道怎么了，莫名觉得他不高兴了，但是刚想要去问，对方就笑了下：

“我没有不高兴，粼粼。”

宋郁很平和，真的。

白粼粼抿了抿唇，顺着自己的思路道：

“你看，订婚肯定会办仪式的，会让很多人都知道，甚至还关系到什么时候结婚……”

“毕业。”

白粼粼愣住了，什么？

“二十二岁，就可以结婚了。”

宋郁俯身蹲下了，抬手握住“少年”的手，眼皮微微掀起，很无害地道：

“不能妖界接受了我，但我不给粼粼一个合法的‘人类身份’。”

“这不公平，不是么？”

白粼粼有些恍惚，好像是这样，他不由得点了点头。

“好，粼粼答应我了。”

时间一点一滴地过去，“少年”反应过来的时候已经被抱到怀里去了，他坐在人的腿上，面色很红。

不是，他答应什么了？

宋郁这个时候才开口道：

“桐城的老师们打电话来了，让我们回去补办一场酒席。”

-

夜晚。

白粼粼一直在打电话，那头的老师们还在坚持己见：

“必须得办，不然你这么跟了他？”

“老师也不是很放心。”

白粼粼是真的不知道怎么办，只好说出来了自己的顾虑：

“可是我现在是妖怪啊，万一有认识我的看到了，那……”

“没事，你变成小鸟。”

电话那里义正词严的，最后强调了一件事：

“反正要补一次酒席。”

“……”

白粼粼劝阻无果，遂放弃，开始同人商量事情：

“我老师的意思是这个月末就要办，那怎么办？我能告诉爷爷吗？还有管理局那些朋友……”

宋郁刚才在倒水，此刻正好走过来，很自然地把杯壁抵在了“少年”的唇边，往上倾斜。

白粼粼喝了几口，然后就抬手推开了，唇瓣湿漉漉的，还要准备问一下，不过这个时候对方开口了：

“都不能说。”

“就我和你回去，好不好？”

这其中的利害关系很明了，妖怪那方白粼粼只是个一岁半的小妖；爷爷那里则是孙子的伴侣兼家庭成员；老师这里只是上辈子的“白粼粼”。

他们像一个个分开的集合，中间有一个交集：

那是宋郁。

“这些事，交给我好么？”

……

但就在这时，窗户外面传来了咚咚咚的动静。
chunks.englishText:
"Grandfather, I can be the Director of the Management Bureau!"

The person on the other end was even more astonished and quickly said:

"This must be celebrated properly! We'll hold a three-day homecoming banquet and invite the bird's good friends, how about that? We'll hold it at night so we don't disturb the neighbors!"

"Okay!"

Bai Linlin had a strong sense of being a family member and was very happy, though he still mentioned the specific assignment location:

"Grandfather, it's in Tong City. I'm going to rebuild the Management Bureau in Tong City. They said it's two years of grassroots experience."

"After that, I can be transferred to the central office!"

Song Zhengguo was just purely happy and even slapped his thigh, thinking that this was truly their Xiao Yu punching above his weight, and said:

"Good! Grandfather will buy you a house in Tong City!"

Hearing this, Song Yu took the phone. The "youth" was stunned for a moment, his gaze following the movement, and he reached out to cling to the man's arm.

"I'll handle that."

"Grandfather, you'll be too tired if you do it."

Bai Linlin wanted to show his face, but since Song Yu had taken that hand, he could only lean over. Just as he was about to interject, an arm wrapped around his waist.

He was held fast.

The "youth's" face turned red instantly. He tucked his chin and lowered his head to pry at the arm around his waist, but couldn't move it for a long time. Above him, the conversation continued:

"Let me play a role, Grandfather. I will take good care of Linlin."

"But don't you still have to study? This... what should we do?"

"I'll go to Tong City at night."

Bai Linlin was stunned when he heard this. Actually, he felt it wasn't necessary; he had weekends off, so he could just return to Nan City on Saturdays and Sundays.

He had just looked up when Song Yu looked down.

Their eyes met.

A voice came from the other end of the phone:

"Won't that be very tiring? Even on the highway, it's over an hour."

Song Yu simply said:

"I'm not at ease with him being there alone."

"And I don't want to be apart."

The words were very direct. Upon hearing this, Bai Linlin immediately lowered his head, pretending to be deaf, the smooth skin of his nape exposed.

Song Zhengguo didn't know what to say upon hearing this.

This couldn't have been inherited from him, could it?

He had only walked twenty kilometers in the middle of the night to find Yuan Qing...

"Fine, as long as you've thought it through yourself."

"However, ask the bird about the engagement."

After Song Zhengguo finished this sentence, he hung up quite readily, feeling inexplicably a little guilty.

The car was quiet.

Bai Linlin processed this for a moment before looking up, asking in confusion:

"Engagement?"

-

Inside the hotel.

The "youth" was eating a lobster rice bowl at the table, putting it into his mouth with a spoon, his legs swinging under the table, his eyes narrowed.

It was delicious!

"Do you think it's too early?"

Song Yu was peeling an orange for the "person" beside him, handling it very meticulously, his eyes lowered as he probed.

"Hmm..."

Bai Linlin had indeed been a bit confused at first, but after thinking about it, they had already formed a bond, and they had confessed everything last time; it seemed there was no need to dwell on anything else.

Song Yu was very young.

He couldn't retreat anymore.

"It is a bit, you're still in school."

Song Yu's movements paused upon hearing this, his brows furrowing slightly:

"Linlin, why must you care about this?"

"I am an adult."

Bai Linlin's face flushed slightly. He just said somewhat uncomfortably:

"I-I know, but you're in university, and you should be studying hard at this time. I also need to go and focus on my career."

"It's a good time to settle down."

Song Yu didn't speak.

Bai Linlin had to add: "As for the engagement, since Grandfather has mentioned it, I think it's fine. But you'd better not talk about it at school; it will affect your..."

"Affect what?"

Song Yu's expression was very calm.

Bai Linlin didn't know what was wrong, but inexplicably felt he was unhappy. However, just as he was about to ask, the other party smiled:

"I'm not unhappy, Linlin."

Song Yu was very peaceful, truly.

Bai Linlin pursed his lips and continued along his own line of thought:

"Look, an engagement ceremony will definitely be held, and many people will know about it. It even relates to when we get married..."

"Graduation."

Bai Linlin was stunned. What?

"At twenty-two, we can get married."

Song Yu leaned down and squatted, reaching out to hold the "youth's" hand, his eyelids lifting slightly, looking very harmless as he said:

"I can't have the Demon Realm accept me, but not give Linlin a legal 'human identity'."

"That wouldn't be fair, would it?"

Bai Linlin was a bit dazed; it seemed that way. He couldn't help but nod.

"Good, Linlin has promised me."

Time passed bit by bit. By the time the "youth" realized it, he had already been pulled into an embrace. He sat on the man's lap, his face very red.

No, what had he promised?

Only then did Song Yu speak:

"The teachers in Tong City called and asked us to go back and hold a wedding banquet."

-

At night.

Bai Linlin had been on the phone the whole time, and the teachers on the other end were still insisting on their own views:

"It must be held, otherwise how are you with him?"

"The teachers aren't very at ease, either."

Bai Linlin really didn't know what to do, so he had to voice his concerns:

"But I'm a demon now. If someone who knows me sees me, then..."

"It's fine, you can turn into a little bird."

The voice on the phone was stern and righteous, finally emphasizing one thing:

"In any case, you must have a wedding banquet."

"..."

Bai Linlin's attempts to dissuade them failed, so he gave up and began to discuss the matter with the man:

"My teacher means it should be held at the end of this month, so what should we do? Can I tell Grandfather? And those friends at the Management Bureau..."

Song Yu had just been pouring water and walked over at that moment, naturally pressing the rim of the glass against the "youth's" lips and tilting it upward.

Bai Linlin drank a few sips, then pushed it away with his hand, his lips wet, preparing to ask again, but the other party spoke:

"You can't tell anyone."

"Just you and me going back, how about that?"

The pros and cons were very clear: on the demon side, Bai Linlin was just a year-and-a-half-old little demon; at Grandfather's, he was the partner and family member of his grandson; at the teachers', he was just the "Bai Linlin" from his previous life.

They were like separate sets, with one intersection in the middle:

That was Song Yu.

"Leave these matters to me, okay?"

...

But just then, a *thump, thump, thump* sound came from outside the window.

chunks.chineseText:
第61章

白粼粼不由自主转头看了，面色有些天然的期待，因为他以前听到过这个动静，就在这时，窗户外面又发出了咚咚咚的声音。

城市的灯光之下，外面站着一只风尘仆仆的小雀，探头探脑地看着里面。

“001！”

宋郁还没有反应过来，面前的“少年”就要冲过去，他只能握住那个手腕，侧头看过去。

窗户那里的小雀已经穿过了玻璃，方才的咚咚咚其实是在打招呼。

至于“少年”则是很迅速地化成了小鸟，宋郁的手里一空，再抬眼看过去，两个小鸟已经奔跑到一起了，翅膀相互盖着，鸟头彼此交叉。

拥抱ing。

“247！”

白粼粼是真的很开心，在原地收了收翅膀，围着小雀转了一圈，很认真地道：

“你怎么找到我的？你任务做完了？”

对面的小雀点了点鸟头，回复道：

“是的，本来749局的人类要送我回南市的，但是我问丹顶鹤，发现你还没有回来。”

“所以我就来找你了。”

白粼粼伸了伸翅根，歪头道：

“是丹顶鹤告诉你我的地址的呀？”

小雀点头，很是严肃地道：

“不过它让我白天来找你。”

“但是我看你们又没有一起睡觉，就来了。”

白粼粼：“……”

宋郁听到这话也一噎，不过还是起身走了过来，刚要俯身问一下001要什么样子的房间，但就在这时。

小雀幻化出来一个挂饰。

自治区的麻绳，缠着一枚狼牙，看着着实很有特色。

001叼着那个东西，啪嗒啪嗒往前走了一步，递给面前的蓝羽小鸟。

白粼粼见状也有些兴奋，立马也用喙叼了回来，仰着鸟头去看宋郁，眼睛亮亮的。

炫耀。

“好看。”

宋郁给予正向的反馈。

小雀也蓬了蓬毛，很放松地道：

“这是我击杀的一个狼妖的牙齿，战利品。”

“可以给247当成一个小挂饰。”

001在仰着头和247的监护人在交流，而地板上那只蓝羽小鸟已经自己伸爪子把狼牙给挂在脖子上了，毛绒绒地转圈。

白粼粼俨然是把桐城办席面的事给放一边去了，他完全沉浸在好朋鸟回来的喜悦之情中。

宋郁很温和地道：

“你很厉害。”

小雀挺胸抬头的。

“我我我，001快来看我培训的证书、照片！”

“噢，还有一些小东西！”

蓝羽小鸟闻言立马加入了话题，然后啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，伸着翅膀盖住小雀，挤着一块往桌子那里走。

宋郁问了下：

“按照之前的标准给你订房间可以么？”

001回头：“好的，人。”

“……”

-

房间内。

白粼粼还戴着那个狼牙吊坠，伸着爪子按住那个文书还有培训证明，低着鸟头看旁边小雀的反应。

“247，你很厉害。”

小雀真心实意地夸赞，伸出自己的翅膀去盖对方的，点了点鸟头。

“还有！”

白粼粼伸出来翅膀，幻化出来一堆小雕塑，把那个合影雕塑拿了过来，是它们一起去泡温泉的那次。

黑衣蒙面。

挤在一块的照片。

001绕着这个雕塑啪嗒啪嗒转圈，很是惊叹，然后抬起鸟头问：

“247，这是你雕的？”

白粼粼咳咳了一下，环顾了下四周，发现宋郁已经下楼了，这才偷偷地挤过来，照旧把翅膀盖在小雀身上，悄悄地道：

“这不是我雕的，但是我和宋郁说是我雕的，你要保密。”

小雀点头。

“这是我培训认识的水獭妖给我雕的，我给它果冻，然后它给我这些，是不是还挺精美的？”

白粼粼觉得这个交换非常值，本来还要给001展示下那个一米的巨大雕塑的，但是后面还是放弃了。

着实太高调了。

“还有这些，你看它们给我送了很多的信物，有来自各个地方的妖怪，如果我们之后去旅游，说不定就能派上用场了！”

001有些懵懵的：“还带我吗？”

蓝羽小鸟：“当然！”

“你是我的头号小弟！”

灰棕色小雀眼睛亮亮的。

两只毛绒绒的小鸟又挤在了一起。

-

宋郁回来的时候，001已经化形了，双手接过了房卡，非常虔诚的姿态。

他的小鸟此刻也是“少年”模样，很认真地提议道：

“去桐城办席的话，可以带001去！”

宋郁皱眉：“但是它毕竟还是……”

“没有关系的！001不太认识字的，它只关心吃什么饭的！”

白粼粼很是信誓旦旦地道。

然后下一秒，旁边的黑衣少年询问：

“什么饭？”

宋郁：“……”

他到后面也没有说什么，毕竟他的小鸟在妖界交到好朋友是很好的事，他不能干涉这个。

况且001……不算外妖。

宋郁在手机上点了外送服务，是一家很有名的烧烤，大约三十分钟后到。

“到时候会送到你的房间。”

宋郁刚说完，面前的“少年”就推着个头低一些的“黑衣少年”往门口走，很是念念有词道：

“我要看看你的房间！”

“粼粼，不可以人形……”

宋郁话音刚落，两个“少年”消失不见，地板上多了两只毛绒绒的小鸟，齐齐地仰头看了过来。

“……”

宋郁实在是说不出什么重话，最后只好道：

“那十点半之前回来？”

“啾啾！”

蓝羽小鸟用翅膀拍了拍自己的胸脯，一幅“我办事你放心”的样子。

宋郁不放心，最后还是出来护送了这两只进了隔壁的门。

不过就在这时，他的手机也传来了嗡嗡的声音，是一条短信：

[确定了，地点就是明惠会所，这李总给原配的借口是谈生意……]

-

隔壁房间。

两只小鸟啪嗒啪嗒地进去了，扑棱翅膀飞上了桌子上，仰着鸟头看窗外的景色。

京市灯火通明，有种都市职场剧的感觉，两个毛绒绒的身躯站在一起，一个问：

“你到双S了么？”

“是的。”

圆滚滚的鸟头重新看向夜景，不经意道：

“我会当局长。”

此处应有小曲儿响起。

但白粼粼还没有沉浸在这种“进步”的氛围当中多久，耳边就传来一句认真的询问：

“你和你的监护人现在什么阶段？”

蓝羽小鸟闻言一下子站直了，收了收翅膀，很是正经地道：

“什么什么阶段！”

001只是不解：“我看你们的血契还在亮……那不是还没有交配？”

“……”

白粼粼对这只小雀没招了，他刚想要反驳，但对方就说了下一句：

“247，是不满意这个人类伴侣吗？”

小雀很认真地看过来。

白粼粼：“没有。”

001：“那是还把他当伴侣？”

白粼粼：“……是。”

灰棕色小雀陷入了难题，在思考中，它从未见过247这样的相处模式。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 61

Bai Linlin couldn't help but turn his head to look, his expression filled with a natural sense of anticipation, for he had heard this sound before. Just then, a *tap-tap-tap* sound came from outside the window again.

Under the city lights, a small bird, dusty from its travels, stood outside, peeking its head in to look at the room.

"001!"

Before Song Yu could react, the "youth" in front of him was about to rush over. Song Yu could only grip his wrist and glance sideways.

The little bird at the window had already passed through the glass; the *tap-tap-tap* from earlier had actually been a greeting.

As for the "youth," he transformed into a small bird in an instant. Song Yu’s hand was left empty, and when he looked up again, the two birds had already run together, their wings overlapping and their heads crossed.

They were hugging.

"247!"

Bai Linlin was truly happy. He tucked his wings in where he stood, circled the little sparrow, and said very earnestly:

"How did you find me? Did you finish your mission?"

The sparrow opposite him nodded its head and replied:

"Yes. Originally, the humans at the 749 Bureau were going to send me back to Nan City, but I asked the Red-Crowned Crane and found out you hadn't returned yet."

"So, I came to find you."

Bai Linlin stretched his wing roots and tilted his head:

"So the Red-Crowned Crane gave you my address?"

The sparrow nodded, looking quite serious:

"But it told me to come find you during the day."

"However, I saw that you two weren't sleeping together, so I came anyway."

Bai Linlin: "..."

Song Yu was also choked up by these words, but he still rose and walked over. Just as he was about to lean down to ask what kind of room 001 needed, it happened.

The sparrow conjured up a pendant.

It was a wolf tooth wrapped in a piece of hemp rope from the autonomous region—it looked truly unique.

001 held the object in its beak, took a few *patter-patter* steps forward, and handed it to the blue-feathered bird in front of him.

Seeing this, Bai Linlin was quite excited. He immediately took it with his own beak, tilted his bird head to look at Song Yu, his eyes shining.

He was showing off.

"It looks good."

Song Yu provided positive feedback.

The sparrow puffed up its feathers and said, feeling very relaxed:

"This is the tooth of a wolf demon I killed. A trophy."

"It can serve as a little pendant for 247."

While 001 was busy communicating with 247’s guardian with its head held high, the blue-feathered bird on the floor had already used its claws to hang the wolf tooth around its neck, spinning around in a fluffy blur.

Bai Linlin had clearly cast aside the matter of hosting the banquet in Tong City; he was completely immersed in the joy of his good bird-friend’s return.

Song Yu said very gently:

"You are very impressive."

The sparrow puffed out its chest and held its head high.

"Me, me, me! 001, come look at my training certificates and photos!"

"Oh, and some little things too!"

Hearing this, the blue-feathered bird immediately joined the conversation, then walked over with a *patter-patter*, extended its wings to cover the sparrow, and squeezed together with it toward the table.

Song Yu asked:

"Is it alright if I book a room for you according to the previous standard?"

001 looked back: "That’s fine, human."

"..."

-

Inside the room.

Bai Linlin was still wearing the wolf tooth pendant, pressing his claws down on the documents and training certificates, looking down to gauge the sparrow's reaction.

"247, you are very impressive."

The sparrow praised him sincerely, extending its own wing to cover the other's, and nodded its head.

"And there's more!"

Bai Linlin extended his wings and conjured a pile of small sculptures. He picked up the one of them together—the time they went to the hot springs.

They were wearing black masks.

The photo of them huddled together.

001 circled the sculpture with a *patter-patter*, looking quite amazed, then raised its bird head and asked:

"247, did you carve this?"

Bai Linlin coughed, looked around, and seeing that Song Yu had already gone downstairs, he secretly squeezed closer, covered the sparrow with his wing as usual, and whispered:

"I didn't carve this, but I told Song Yu that I did. You have to keep it a secret."

The sparrow nodded.

"This was carved for me by an otter demon I met during training. I gave it jelly, and it gave me these. Aren't they quite exquisite?"

Bai Linlin felt this trade was very worth it. He had originally wanted to show 001 the one-meter-tall giant sculpture, but he gave up on that later.

It was truly too high-profile.

"And these, look, they gave me many tokens. There are demons from all over the place. If we go traveling later, they might come in handy!"

001 was a bit bewildered: "Are you taking me too?"

The blue-feathered bird: "Of course!"

"You are my number one little brother!"

The gray-brown sparrow’s eyes shone brightly.

The two fluffy birds huddled together once more.

-

When Song Yu returned, 001 had already transformed into human form, taking the room card with both hands in a very pious posture.

His bird was also in "youth" form at the moment, suggesting quite earnestly:

"If we’re going to hold the banquet in Tong City, we can bring 001 along!"

Song Yu frowned: "But after all, it is still..."

"It doesn't matter! 001 doesn't really know how to read; it only cares about what it's eating!"

Bai Linlin said with great conviction.

Then, the next second, the black-clad youth beside him asked:

"What food?"

Song Yu: "..."

He didn't say anything more in the end. After all, it was a good thing for his bird to make a good friend in the demon world; he couldn't interfere with that.

Besides, 001... didn't count as an outsider.

Song Yu ordered delivery on his phone—a very famous barbecue place—which would arrive in about thirty minutes.

"It will be delivered to your room when it arrives."

No sooner had Song Yu finished speaking than the "youth" in front of him began pushing the slightly shorter "black-clad youth" toward the door, muttering:

"I want to see your room!"

"Linlin, you can't be in human form..."

Before Song Yu’s words had even faded, the two "youths" vanished. On the floor were two fluffy birds, both looking up at him in unison.

"..."

Song Yu really couldn't bring himself to say anything harsh, so he finally said:

"Then be back before ten-thirty?"

"Chirp chirp!"

The blue-feathered bird patted its chest with its wing, looking like a "don't worry, I've got this" professional.

Song Yu wasn't reassured, but in the end, he still escorted the two of them to the door next door.

However, just then, his phone buzzed. It was a text message:

[Confirmed, the location is Minghui Club. The excuse this President Li gave his original wife is that he's discussing business...]

-

In the room next door.

The two birds walked in with a *patter-patter*, flapped their wings to fly onto the table, and looked out the window at the scenery.

Beijing was brightly lit, giving off the vibe of an urban workplace drama. The two fluffy bodies stood together, and one asked:

"Have you reached double-S rank?"

"Yes."

The round bird head looked back at the night view, saying casually:

"I will become a bureau chief."

A little tune should have played here.

But Bai Linlin hadn't been immersed in this atmosphere of "progress" for long before an earnest question reached his ears:

"What stage are you and your guardian at now?"

The blue-feathered bird stood up straight upon hearing this, tucked his wings in, and said very seriously:

"What do you mean, what stage!"

001 was simply confused: "I see your blood pact is still glowing... doesn't that mean you haven't mated yet?"

"..."

Bai Linlin had no way to deal with this sparrow. Just as he was about to retort, the other added:

"247, are you dissatisfied with this human partner?"

The sparrow looked over very seriously.

Bai Linlin: "No."

001: "Then you still consider him a partner?"

Bai Linlin: "...Yes."

The gray-brown sparrow fell into a dilemma, deep in thought. It had never seen a relationship dynamic like 247's before.

chunks.chineseText:
“其实你不觉得宋郁很小吗？我是想好了和他在一起，但是等他上完学再考虑那些其他的事……不好吗？”

白粼粼挤过去，试图宣扬自己的理论。

001有些懵懵的：“不交配？那你的发情期怎么办？”

“你现在是成鸟了。”

白粼粼一下子往旁边走了几步，收了收翅膀，心说这怎么连前摇都没有，鸟脸一红：

“我除了之前有些头晕，现在没什么感觉了，再说了，你没有发情期吗？”

001很认真地道：“我没有结契，可以用妖力控制的。”

小雀一幅性冷淡的样子。

白粼粼刚想说他也可以用妖力控制，但下一秒对方就又道：

“你结契了，只能用伴侣。”

“你现在感觉良好，可能是因为你成年的第一次发情期比较长……但也不可能一直这么稳定，你真的没有双修么？”

001在桌子上歪着鸟头，很是关心地道。

白粼粼有些红温，又开始扯出来自己的老一套：

“我是和他……结契了，还有那什么礼……但是，柏拉图你懂么？”

语气一开始是心虚的，但是到了后面却悄悄压低了声线，翅膀又盖住了小雀，鸟头相互靠着，认真地道：

“这更高级，讲究灵魂共鸣。”

“神交？”

白粼粼一下子说不下去了。

但001自有自的理解，只是问：

“所以你们亲了么？”

“……”

“我看电视剧都这么演的。”

白粼粼咳咳了两声，严肃地道：

“你从哪里看的？”

小雀掏出一部手机，正色看了过来。

“……”

“我在做任务的时候问了749局的人使用方法，已经学会了很多功能了。”

白粼粼：“看了电视剧？”

小雀严肃：“不止，丹顶鹤让我好好学习人类文字，我看了文学作品。”

白粼粼不解：“你不是不认字吗？”

小雀这才回了回神：“我是听书。”

“……”

白粼粼心想这样也行，好歹是可以对照一下汉字，不失为一种办法。

但就在这时，001居然把话题给绕回来了：

“电视剧里讲究相识—告白—结婚的流程，我觉得你们好像不太对。”

“……”

鸟毛绒绒的，咳咳了一下，想要伸爪子往旁边走一下。

小雀还在输出：

“但和我看的书有点像……”

白粼粼动作一顿，心说它又有什么新发现，下一秒，房间里就传来了机械的AI朗读：

“苏牧瑶是头一次嫁给这个穿着军装的男人，可是她根本就不认识对方，天晓得那粗壮的手臂和宽阔的肩膀有多么瘆人……”

“他们虽然是结了婚，但是却没有夫妻之实，如此相互抱着，反倒是生出了一种小年轻谈恋爱的错觉。”

白粼粼闭了闭鸟眼。

“就是这样。”

001把听书功能给关了，很是言之凿凿地道。

“……”

鸟的爪子已经开始抠桌面了。

“我在出任务的时候，也询问了749局的人，他们说这个是‘先婚后爱’。”

“是先结婚—表白——谈恋爱。”

“那247，你也是这样？”

小雀啪嗒啪嗒走过来，探着鸟头，直视。

蓝羽小鸟战略后退。

小雀再次向前一步。

蓝羽小鸟直接闭上鸟眼。

“……那、那我又没有谈过恋爱。”

“慢慢来嘛！”

鸟急了。

小雀闻言歪头看了过来，毛绒绒地道：

“好的。”

-

大约半个小时后，宋郁在门口来接鸟了，顺带拿过来了烧烤，递给了里面的小雀。

白粼粼翅根都有些热，扑棱翅膀飞上了人的肩头，梳理了下羽毛。

“那晚安。”

小雀叼过来了烧烤，放在一旁，很虔诚地道：

“谢谢你！”

宋郁点了点头，本来都要走了，但是又看到对方在探头看他的肩头。

人顺着视线侧头，他的小鸟正在梳理羽毛，很专注的样子。

“粼粼？”

小雀很善解人意地道：“没事的，你们好好上床吧。”

“……”

“……”

白粼粼崩溃了，把001送去扫盲班！

宋郁面色也有些不自在，还是纠正了下：

“你是想说上床睡觉么？”

小雀点头：“我学了省略。”

宋郁：“这个不用省……”

翌日。

白粼粼已经没有那么不自在了，而是在行李箱那里挑选衣服，两套，一套人形的，一套本体的。

还有001的。

“那个李总是个赘婿，他的原配家里条件不错，是个暴发户，妻子脾气很火爆，但文化程度不高，因为这个原因才一直没察觉到端倪。”

宋郁已经拿了车钥匙，垂眸看着“少年”在挑选衣服，很温和地道。

“反正要他付出代价！”

“出轨的人都该死！”

“少年”说话劲劲的，面色还泛着点起床的红，没一会就选好了衣服，抱着东西去洗手间换了。

宋郁的视线始终跟随，直到那个磨砂玻璃的门关上了，他脖子上的伤口已经结痂了，快好全了。

等到处理完这些，就回家。

三十分钟后——

两鸟一人坐上了车子，001很好奇地在车窗的边边那里站着，四处张望着。

“是要处理坏人？”

白粼粼没有告诉它全部信息，只是简要地总结了下，以“任务”的方式，目标是：

让一个叫李振的人渣身败名裂。

“可以这么理解。”

001闻言非常认真地道：

“我可以弄断他的腿。”

白粼粼连忙道：“不用不用不用，我们只需要让他的原配、亲朋好友都知道这个人渣的丑陋面目就可以。”

“社会性死亡懂么？”

两个小鸟在叽叽喳喳的。

宋郁已经开到了明惠会所里，很自然地下了车，两个小鸟分别站在肩头的两侧。

进门里面就有人迎了过来，引到了一个包厢，里面彩灯来回转，光线昏暗，圆型的沙发，茶几上摆着些不同颜色的酒水。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀下来了，环顾了下周围，心说这就是会所？

看着倒是和KTV一样？

宋郁在门口那里和侍者说了些什么，面色冷淡，彩灯下映照着他的鼻梁，形成很明显的阴影。

“是，您提前预约过了，另外一个包厢已经准备好了。”

侍者很认真地回复。

宋郁点了点头，很平和地道：

“多谢。”

他走到了沙发那里，桌子上的两个小鸟还在研究那杯血腥玛丽，小雀更是站在杯子上，叨了一口那个薄荷叶。

“粼粼，安排好了。”

“等十五分钟就好。”

……

陈平此刻正带着新的合作方员工过来“团建”，其实会所也并不全部都是灰色的，有的会有正规的场子，不过下午的确有些不太合适。

这些员工大多是盛星那个套皮公司开除的人，拖欠工资，非法加班，甚至不处理工伤……几乎是常态，但这些人因为家庭原因很多都忍了下来。
chunks.englishText:
"Actually, don't you think Song Yu is still too young? I’ve decided to be with him, but wouldn't it be better to wait until he finishes school before considering those other things?"

Bai Linlin squeezed over, attempting to propagate her theory.

001 looked a bit bewildered: "No mating? Then what about your estrus cycle?"

"You are an adult bird now."

Bai Linlin immediately took a few steps to the side and tucked in her wings. She thought to herself that there wasn't even any foreplay to this conversation, and her bird face flushed red.

"Aside from feeling a bit dizzy earlier, I don't feel anything now. Besides, don't you have an estrus cycle?"

001 replied very earnestly: "I haven't formed a bond, so I can control it with demon power."

The little sparrow looked completely asexual.

Bai Linlin was just about to say that she could also use demon power to control it, but the next second, the other party added:

"You have formed a bond; you can only use your partner."

"You feel fine now, perhaps because your first estrus cycle as an adult is relatively long... but it’s impossible to stay this stable forever. Have you really not engaged in dual cultivation?"

001 tilted its bird head on the table, looking very concerned.

Bai Linlin felt her face heating up and began to trot out her old routine again:

"I... I have formed a bond with him, and there’s that ceremony thing... but, do you understand Platonism?"

Her tone started off lacking confidence, but by the end, she lowered her voice. She covered the little sparrow with her wings, leaned their bird heads together, and said earnestly:

"This is more advanced; it emphasizes soul resonance."

"Spiritual communion?"

Bai Linlin couldn't continue.

But 001 had its own interpretation and simply asked:

"So, have you kissed?"

"..."

"I saw that in the TV dramas."

Bai Linlin coughed twice and said seriously:

"Where did you watch those?"

The little sparrow took out a mobile phone and looked over with a straight face.

"..."

"I asked the people at Bureau 749 how to use it while I was on a mission, and I’ve already learned many functions."

Bai Linlin: "You watched TV dramas?"

The little sparrow was serious: "Not just that. The Red-crowned Crane told me to study human language well, so I read literary works."

Bai Linlin was puzzled: "Don't you not know how to read?"

The little sparrow then realized: "I listen to audiobooks."

"..."

Bai Linlin thought that worked too; at least it allowed for comparison with Chinese characters. It wasn't a bad method.

But just then, 001 actually steered the topic back:

"The TV dramas emphasize the process of meeting—confessing—getting married. I feel like you two have it wrong."

"..."

The bird’s feathers were fluffy. She coughed and wanted to stretch out a claw to move to the side.

The little sparrow continued to output:

"But it’s a bit like the book I’m reading..."

Bai Linlin paused, wondering what new discovery it had made. The next second, a mechanical AI voice filled the room:

"Su Muyao was marrying this man in military uniform for the first time, yet she didn't know him at all. Heaven knows how terrifying those thick arms and broad shoulders were..."

"Although they were married, they had not consummated the marriage. Holding each other like this, it instead gave rise to the illusion of young people falling in love."

Bai Linlin closed her bird eyes.

"That’s exactly it."

001 turned off the audiobook function and said with great certainty.

"..."

The bird’s claws had already started scratching the tabletop.

"When I was on a mission, I also asked the people at Bureau 749. They said this is called 'marrying first, falling in love later'."

"It’s marry first—confess—then fall in love."

"Then 247, are you the same?"

The little sparrow pattered over, poked its bird head out, and stared straight at her.

The blue-feathered bird made a strategic retreat.

The little sparrow took another step forward.

The blue-feathered bird simply closed its eyes.

"...Th-that, I haven't been in love before."

"Take it slow!"

The bird was getting anxious.

Upon hearing this, the little sparrow tilted its head and said in a fluffy voice:

"Okay."

-

About half an hour later, Song Yu came to the door to pick up the birds, bringing along some barbecue, which he handed to the little sparrow inside.

Bai Linlin felt the roots of her wings heating up. She flapped her wings, flew onto his shoulder, and preened her feathers.

"Then, goodnight."

The little sparrow took the barbecue, set it aside, and said very devoutly:

"Thank you!"

Song Yu nodded. He was about to leave, but then he saw the other party poking its head out to look at his shoulder.

He turned his head to follow the gaze; his little bird was preening its feathers, looking very focused.

"Linlin?"

The little sparrow said very understandingly: "It's fine, you two go ahead and go to bed."

"..."

"..."

Bai Linlin was devastated. Send 001 to a literacy class!

Song Yu’s expression was also a bit uncomfortable, but he still corrected her:

"Are you trying to say 'go to bed and sleep'?"

The little sparrow nodded: "I learned to use ellipses."

Song Yu: "You don't need to omit that part..."

The next day.

Bai Linlin was no longer as uncomfortable. She was at the suitcase picking out clothes—two sets, one for her human form and one for her original form.

And some for 001.

"That Manager Li is a live-in son-in-law. His original wife’s family is quite well-off; they are nouveau riche. The wife has a very fiery temper, but she isn't very well-educated, which is why she hasn't noticed anything amiss until now."

Song Yu had already grabbed the car keys. He looked down at the "youth" picking out clothes and said very gently:

"Anyway, he must pay the price!"

"People who cheat deserve to die!"

The "youth" spoke with vigor, her face still flushed from waking up. Before long, she had chosen her clothes and went to the bathroom to change.

Song Yu’s gaze followed her the entire time until the frosted glass door closed. The wound on his neck had already scabbed over and was almost completely healed.

Once this was dealt with, they would go home.

Thirty minutes later—

Two birds and one person sat in the car. 001 stood on the edge of the car window, looking around with great curiosity.

"Are we going to deal with a bad guy?"

Bai Linlin didn't tell it all the information, just gave a brief summary, framing it as a "mission." The goal:

To ruin the reputation of a piece of human trash named Li Zhen.

"You could understand it that way."

Upon hearing this, 001 said very earnestly:

"I can break his legs."

Bai Linlin quickly said: "No, no, no. We just need to let his wife, relatives, and friends see the ugly face of this piece of trash."

"Do you understand social death?"

The two birds were chirping away.

Song Yu had already driven to the Minghui Club. He got out of the car naturally, with the two birds standing on either side of his shoulders.

As they entered, someone came to greet them and led them to a private room. Inside, colorful lights spun back and forth, the lighting was dim, and there was a circular sofa and various colored drinks on the coffee table.

Bai Linlin flapped her wings and flew down, looking around. She thought to herself, so this is a club?

It looks just like a KTV?

Song Yu said something to the waiter at the door, his expression cold. The colorful lights cast a distinct shadow across the bridge of his nose.

"Yes, you made a reservation in advance. The other private room is already prepared."

The waiter replied very seriously.

Song Yu nodded and said very calmly:

"Thank you."

He walked over to the sofa. The two birds on the table were still studying the Bloody Mary. The little sparrow was even standing on the glass, pecking at the mint leaf.

"Linlin, it's all arranged."

"Just wait fifteen minutes."

...

Chen Ping was currently bringing new partner employees over for a "team-building" event. In truth, not everything in the club was gray; some parts had legitimate businesses, though the afternoon was indeed a bit inappropriate.

Most of these employees were people fired by that shell company of Shengxing. Unpaid wages, illegal overtime, and even ignoring work-related injuries... these were almost the norm, but many of these people had endured it due to family reasons.

chunks.chineseText:
但说来也巧，毕竟业务相同，他们再次入职的公司天然地成为盛星的竞品公司。

陈平查了一些档案，选了被苛待最严重的一些员工，选的是男性，毕竟这里是会所，不太安全。

“您请进请进。”

侍者很快就把人引到了预定好的包厢里。

而这时，那个李振也摇摇晃晃地进来会所，大腹便便的，进门就要找陪的，语气暧昧不清。

侍者把人带到了一个包厢里，那里头全部都是些作风混乱的老总们，左拥右抱的，看着很是糜烂。

“来来，笑一个。”

“李总来了啊？小云等你好久了！”

里面喧哗的声音此起彼伏的。

而与此同时，陈平的包厢里很是安安静静的，那些员工其实挺谨慎的，不知道为什么选择会所来团建，很是拘谨。

“没事没事，大家口渴吗？”

陈平在看手机的消息，想了想让人送进来几箱子霸王茶姬，人手一杯，还是热的。

“……”

“……”

时间一点一滴地过去。

李振的那个包厢里还是一阵阵的笑声，犹如下水道生物的狂欢。

而就在这时，有一波波的人正在往这边赶……

宋郁其实并不打算让他的小鸟脏了手，这毕竟是人类的事，他来做比较好，但他又不想他的小鸟完全没有参与感，于是询问了下：

“侍者被我买通了，要不要化形成侍者？去看一看戏？”

鸟眼睛亮亮的，站得板板正正，点了点鸟头。

宋郁本来还要说些注意事项，但很快，旁边有样学样站着一只小雀，也仰着鸟头看了过来了。

蓝羽小鸟看了下，过去伸翅膀搭上了，意思不言而喻。

“好。”

宋郁起身去找了另外一个侍者，又给了五万块。

晚上七点钟左右。

一队气势汹汹的人来了，为首的是个身体强壮的女人，带着大金耳环，眉眼有神，一看就有自己事业的人，她的身后有着身高马大的“专业团队”。

每个都身高一米八以上。

且还有纹身。

“那姓李的在哪？”

“老娘弄死他！”

两个小侍者在旁边站着，眼睛圆圆的，一路去引，有些好奇地在旁边看着。

一推开包厢门，里面的老总就吓了一大跳，酒都快要醒了，尤其是看到后面一个个身着制服的“大汉”们。

女人看到李振就大步走了过去，抬手拧起来对方的耳朵，对于旁边陪着的人是一眼不看，专门拿下来自己的高跟鞋，上去就是砸。

“我￥%@#￥！”

一阵鸟语花香。

“长这么个丑东西，老娘以为你是老实的！”

“又丑又不老实！”

“给我打！”

一堆“专业人士”上场，酒杯全部碎掉了，与此同时还有些老总试图从包厢里出来，但是门口那里围满了人。

两个小侍者在门口那里探头看：

“哇……”

“打得好！”

宋郁始终在不远处，看着两个小鸟的安全，直到不远处的包厢也开了门，陈平很是故作不经意地道：

“这外面发生了什么？大家快出来，万一有危险就不好了。”

那里面盛星的“旧员工”出来一看，每个人眼睛都闪着光，都好奇地往这个吵吵闹闹的包厢看。

一时间混乱无比。

陈平很适时地道：“我去看看警察来了没有，你们距离那个包厢远一点啊？等我回来再说……”

那些“旧员工”立即表示没问题，然后在陈平离开之后凑了过去，有几个拿着地面上的烟灰缸，偷偷地砸了过去。

正好命中那死老板的脚。

“啊！”

里面惨叫连连。

但由于这人过于肥胖，听起来实在是邦邦的，很结实的样子。

“旧员工”们像是终于解气了。

白粼粼看得不亦乐乎，也环顾了下四周，发现没有烟灰缸，从自己包厢里拿了一个，美美地也扔进去了。

“啊！”

那死老板又叫了一声。

001发现自己还没有扔，它找了找，发现没有烟灰缸，觉得椅子应该也不错，刚抬手拿起来，旁边的“少年”就连忙道：

“不行不行，这个真不行。”

白粼粼很是认真地教育。

很快第二波人来了，不过不是警察，而是一批扛着长枪短跑的社会记者，他们一边拍一边道：

“现在我们来到了明惠会所，这里存在诸多违法行为，招妓、拉皮条……这些伤风败俗的事在这里屡见不鲜。”

其实社会记者一般情况不会这么堂而皇之地说的，至少是要隐藏摄像头的，但现在这样，肯定是有所准备的。

很快第三波人就来了。

这次的是警察。

“根据群众举报，这里有人聚众淫乱。”

两个小侍者立马引着人过来了，很是热心肠。

这里面反正是乱成一锅粥了。

群魔乱舞。

那死老板已经是鼻青脸肿了，被原配拧着耳朵出来的时候是一点脾气都没有了，但是看到外面围着那些开除的旧员工们顿时愣住了，还有些黑漆漆的摄像头，还有穿着制服的警察。

他当场晕了过去。

“警察同志，这我丈夫，您放心，我们只是和平斗殴而已。”

“……”

“那也要做一下笔录。”

白粼粼还在这边看热闹的，但是手腕却被扣住了，随即就是往后的一个力道，耳边响起来沉稳的声音：

“粼粼，回来。”

“还有你的朋友。”

会所里五光十色的，暗沉又看不清人的面庞，就在警察要求全部关闭闪灯的时候，身边的两个侍者已经不见了。

-

后面的事就很简单了，排查其他包厢的人和信息，不过这个时候一人两鸟已经离开了。

“给了钱？”

001不是很理解：“我直接把那两个侍者的记忆给删除了。”

白粼粼震惊，这是什么术法？

“和狐妖前辈学的。”

“在做灰色任务的时候比较好用。”

001很是认认真真地道。

白粼粼这才不得不承认，这些专门做灰色任务的妖怪确实是有些功夫在，他不由得多问了下001，为什么选择接灰色任务。

小雀：“不认字。”

“然后是报效管理局。”

很朴实无华的理由。

两个小鸟在副驾驶上叽叽喳喳的，反正是讨论了一会，最后白粼粼才说到了要去桐城吃席的事。

小雀眼睛亮了亮：“上次的串串香就不错！”

“放心，那家也去！”

“那我们什么时候回南市？”

……

白粼粼一开始是以为处理完这件事就直接走的，但其实还是停留了几天。

司法审判开始进行，盛星公司多名高层都涉嫌违法犯罪的，相关部门已经开始着手进行。

白粼粼是看的一手文件的信息，上辈子的遗憾一点点地消散了，不过他还是叹了口气，说到底被撞死还是他运气太差了。

那司机，怎么闯红灯啊！

宋郁面色平静，对于他的小鸟宽容大度的选择并没有什么意外，他只是动用了点关系，让那个司机彻底失业。
chunks.englishText:
As luck would have it, since their business model was identical, the company they had joined naturally became a direct competitor to Shengxing.

Chen Ping did some digging through the files and selected the employees who had been treated the most harshly. He chose men, as this was a club, and it wouldn't be safe otherwise.

"Please, come right in."

The waiter quickly led them into the reserved private room.

At that moment, Li Zhen came stumbling into the club, his belly protruding. As soon as he entered, he began demanding companions, his tone lewd and slurred.

The waiter led him to a private room filled with executives of questionable character, each with arms around their companions, looking utterly decadent.

"Come on, give us a smile."

"Manager Li is here! Little Yun has been waiting for you for ages!"

The room was filled with a cacophony of noise.

Meanwhile, Chen Ping’s private room was deathly quiet. The employees were actually quite cautious; they didn't understand why they had chosen a club for a team-building event and remained very reserved.

"It’s alright, it’s alright. Is everyone thirsty?"

Chen Ping checked the messages on his phone, thought for a moment, and had several cases of Ba Wang Cha Ji tea delivered, ensuring everyone had a cup—still warm.

"..."

"..."

Time ticked by, second by second.

In Li Zhen’s room, the laughter continued, sounding like the revelry of creatures from a sewer.

And just then, waves of people were rushing toward this location...

Song Yu hadn't actually intended to let his little bird get its hands dirty. After all, these were human affairs, and it was better for him to handle them. But he didn't want his little bird to feel completely left out, so he asked:

"I've bribed the waiter. Do you want to shapeshift into a waiter and go watch the show?"

The bird’s eyes brightened. It stood up straight and gave a firm nod.

Song Yu was about to give some instructions, but soon, a small sparrow nearby mimicked the stance and tilted its head up as well.

The blue-feathered bird glanced over, walked up, and draped a wing over the sparrow, the meaning self-evident.

"Fine."

Song Yu got up to find another waiter and handed over another fifty thousand yuan.

Around seven in the evening.

A team of aggressive-looking people arrived. Leading them was a sturdy woman with large gold earrings and sharp, spirited eyes—clearly someone with her own career. Behind her stood a "professional team" of hulking figures.

Every one of them was over six feet tall.

And every one of them had tattoos.

"Where is that Li fellow?"

"I’m going to kill him!"

The two little waiters stood to the side, their eyes round, leading the way and watching with curious expressions.

As soon as the door to the private room was pushed open, the executives inside were startled, their drunkenness nearly vanishing, especially when they saw the "big men" in uniforms behind the woman.

The woman spotted Li Zhen and strode over. She reached out, grabbed his ear, and without even glancing at the companions beside him, took off her high heel and began to smash it down.

"I #%@#!"

A torrent of colorful language erupted.

"You ugly thing! I thought you were an honest man!"

"Ugly and dishonest!"

"Beat him!"

A group of "professionals" swarmed in. Wine glasses shattered everywhere. At the same time, some executives tried to escape the room, but the doorway was packed with people.

The two little waiters peeked in from the entrance:

"Wow..."

"Well hit!"
