Song Yu remained not far away, watching over the safety of the two birds, until the door to the nearby private room also opened. Chen Ping said, feigning surprise:

"What’s happening out there? Everyone, come out quickly. It wouldn't be good if there’s any danger."

The "former employees" of Shengxing came out to look, their eyes gleaming, all curiously peering toward the noisy room.

Chaos ensued.

Chen Ping said at the perfect moment, "I’ll go see if the police have arrived. You all stay far away from that room, okay? Wait for me to come back..."

The "former employees" immediately agreed. After Chen Ping left, they crowded closer. A few picked up ashtrays from the floor and secretly threw them inside.

One hit the dead boss right on the foot.

"Ah!"

Screams echoed from within.

But because the man was so obese, the sound was a dull, solid thud.

The "former employees" finally felt avenged.

Bai Linlin was having a great time. He looked around, and finding no ashtrays, he grabbed one from his own room and threw it in with satisfaction.

"Ah!"

The dead boss screamed again.

001 realized it hadn't thrown anything yet. It looked around, found no ashtrays, and decided a chair would do just fine. Just as it lifted one, the "young man" beside it hurriedly said:

"No, no, that really won't do."

Bai Linlin lectured it very seriously.

Soon, the second wave of people arrived. They weren't police, but a group of social reporters carrying cameras. They filmed as they spoke:

"We are now at the Minghui Club. There are many illegal activities here: prostitution, pimping... these immoral acts are common occurrences here."

Actually, social reporters wouldn't usually be so blatant—they would at least hide their cameras—but they were clearly prepared.

Soon, the third wave arrived.

This time, it was the police.

"Acting on reports from the public, there is a gathering for illicit sexual activities here."

The two little waiters immediately led the officers over, very eager to help.

The place was a complete mess.

A dance of demons.

The dead boss was already bruised and swollen. When his legal wife dragged him out by the ear, he had no fight left in him. But when he saw the former employees he had fired surrounding him, along with the dark lenses of cameras and the police in uniform, he froze.

He fainted on the spot.

"Officer, this is my husband. Don't worry, we were just having a peaceful brawl."

"..."

"You still need to give a statement."

Bai Linlin was still watching the fun, but his wrist was caught, and he was pulled back by a firm force. A calm voice sounded in his ear:

"Linlin, come back."

"And your friend, too."

The club was filled with colorful, flickering lights, making faces dark and indistinct. Just as the police ordered all flashlights to be turned off, the two waiters beside them had already vanished.

-

What followed was simple: checking the other rooms and gathering information. By then, the man and the two birds had already left.

"Did you pay them?"

001 didn't quite understand. "I just deleted the memories of those two waiters."

Bai Linlin was shocked. What kind of technique was that?

"Learned it from the fox demon senior."

"It’s quite useful when doing gray-area missions," 001 said very earnestly.

Bai Linlin had to admit that these demons who specialized in gray-area missions really had some skills. He couldn't help but ask 001 why it chose to take on gray-area missions.

The little sparrow replied: "Can't read."

"And it's to repay the Administration."

A very simple and honest reason.

The two little birds chirped away in the passenger seat, discussing things for a while, until Bai Linlin finally mentioned going to Tongcheng for a banquet.

The sparrow’s eyes brightened: "The skewers from last time were great!"

"Don't worry, we're going to that place too!"

"Then when are we going back to Nanshi?"

...

Bai Linlin had initially thought they would leave as soon as this was handled, but they ended up staying for a few more days.

The judicial proceedings began. Multiple high-level executives from Shengxing were involved in illegal activities, and the relevant departments had already begun their work.

Bai Linlin read the first-hand files. The regrets of his past life were slowly dissipating, though he still sighed—in the end, getting hit by that truck was just a case of bad luck.

That driver, why did he run the red light!

Song Yu’s expression was calm. He wasn't surprised by his little bird’s choice to be forgiving and magnanimous; he had simply used some connections to ensure that driver lost his job permanently.

chunks.chineseText:
三天之后，一人两鸟正式准备返程。

但有一点小插曲。

001并不打算跟车，它化成了黑衣少年，很认真地同站在行李箱上的蓝羽小鸟道：

“247，我送你的狼牙是目标四号的，原本749局的人说是只有一头，但现在同我传消息是有两头。”

“我需要去查探一下那个妖怪的方位。”

“狼牙有气息，我不能留给你。”

白粼粼幻化出来了那个狼牙吊坠，叼着的，其实有些担忧。

这狼妖会不会很厉害？

“放心，247，我能给你凑一对。”

黑衣少年面色平静，定定地道。

白粼粼最后把狼牙吊坠还了回去。

001接过来了狼牙吊坠，他们就此分开，约定同时抵达南市。

宋郁有时候难免会觉得庆幸，因为他的小鸟会从事管理工作，而不是出外勤，那样实在是很危险。

一人一鸟开始先行回南市。

-

运土车司机得知自己被车队开了的事其实很是恼火，上面的理由是什么……出的交通事故太多？

那反正是有保险的，又没有妨碍到货物？

凭什么啊！

高速路上车来车往的，他烦得要死，看到后面有个小轿车想要超车，直接就踩了油门。

超什么超！

他刚办完离婚，孩子抚养权都没拿到手，那女的实在是矫情，一个月一千五怎么就不够她和孩子生活的！

吃什么山珍海味啊！

司机是一肚子气，以至于压根没注意到自己已经偏离了车道，后面还有小车在滴滴提醒，但已经晚了，迎面是一辆黑色SUV，他的视野高，甚至可以看到里面和和美美的一幕。

丈夫在前面开车，妻子在后面和孩子欢声笑语。

至少前一秒是这样的。

司机突然生出了一种很恶劣的想法……

雾蒙蒙的天气，一只灰棕色的小雀叼着狼牙在限速牌上栖着，感知着四面八方的微弱的气息。

目标向南走了。

它刚要挥动翅膀离开这里，但刚好看见了下方即将发生的车祸。

大车司机其实可以打方向盘，他这么些年的技术完全可以做到保持自己和对方的生命安全……

但是，他不打方向盘，也可以保持自身的安全。

只不过是毁了一个家庭。

司机面色狰狞，凭什么他们这么和谐美满？

自己的生活就一片狼藉？

他开的是大车，避让难道不是其他人应该做到的？

司机已经开始走向极端了。

001的视线距离很远，妖怪的特性让它面前的景象实际上放慢了许多，它看到了那辆黑色SUV里的孩童……

或许是亲切。

它想起来了自治区的那个孩子。

限速牌上出现了个蹲着的黑衣少年，也就一两秒，它抬手调动了下妖力，金光流动，直接钻进了那个大车司机的车窗里，方向盘自动调转。

车祸还是发生了。

但SUV的那家人因为紧急关头的临场反应，靠着护栏边形成了个飘移，最终有惊无险的停了下来。

而那个大车司机，001给的方向其实是安全的，但他却鬼迷心窍，反而又朝SUV打了下方向盘，最后车身彻底失控，翻掉了。

车头起火了。

001此刻已经化成了小雀模样，有些不明白，这个人是来自杀的？

好奇怪。

它没有想太多，只是挥了挥翅膀，朝着南市的方向行进。

-

大约一天后。

一人一鸟回了南市，老爷子十分之高兴，当天就做了家宴，白粼粼一边开开心心地吃饭，一边担心自己的好朋鸟。

虽然001说话有些直。

但它是最棒的鸟。

白粼粼其实一路上都在想，它是怎么打得过狼妖的……有体型差距的。

不过好在是在第二天晚上，001就过来传讯了，它已经抵达了管理局。

光幕里的小雀还是毛绒绒的，报了平安，但也说了还没有追踪到狼妖去向的事。

“你没事就好，不一定非要你去抓的吧？没有其他的妖怪？”

白粼粼在卧室的床上仰头问。

光幕里小雀点了点头，认真道：

“也是，749局的人也在顺着气息在找。”

“那就好了嘛！”

白粼粼出声宽慰道。

不过现在天色也很晚了，出差那么长时间，他还没有去管理局汇报情况，反正还有一堆的事的。

他要休息一下，但刚要开口，光幕里的小雀就拿出来一张票：

“明日就开展么？”

白粼粼懵了下。

但很快光幕里传来了七嘴八舌的声音，有花枝鼠的、柯尔鸭的、侏儒兔的……此起彼伏。

“老大的展！我们一定要去捧场！”

“捧场捧场！”

甚至还有小鼠敲锣的声音。

“听说还有雕塑！”

“老大！老大！好久没见老大了！”

……

白粼粼此刻是“少年”的模样，面色有些恍惚之感，他只是问：

“画展我知道，但你们是怎么拿到的……票？”

001刚想要说什么，但此刻光幕直接往上一抬，映入一只优雅的丹顶鹤，它抬了抬翅膀，光幕就很听话地从高处照了下来。

几乎把所有的小妖怪都照进去了。

丹顶鹤很优雅地站在中间，微微抬头，咳嗽了一下。

众妖立马都骄傲地举起来手里的票，齐刷刷一片。

“247，许久不见，我们去画展给你捧捧场。”

白粼粼：“……”

真的么？

-

翌日早上九点。

同光路26号明珠大厦一楼展厅围满了人，都十分好奇地看着海报。

上面是一只戴着西部牛仔帽子的蓝色羽小鸟，很明显是一套写真，装扮很是时尚。

这些围观群众都很好奇，因为这个展地方媒体报道过，一来是画展内容特殊，主角全部都是一个鸟；二来是门票降为一元，疑似主人纯粹为了炫耀小鸟。

但这些都还不足以让热度变得这么大。

更主要的原因是——

“这是粼粼吧？”

“简直一模一样？”

“这个号就发了一条视频，里面是蒙面小鸟。”

“粼粼大王啊？”

“什么时候开展啊！我好急！”
chunks.englishText:
Three days later, the man and the two birds officially prepared for their return journey.

But there was a small complication.

001 didn't intend to travel by car. It transformed into a black-clad youth and said very earnestly to the blue-feathered bird standing on the suitcase:

"247, the wolf tooth I gave you belongs to Target Number Four. The people at Bureau 749 originally said there was only one, but the message I received now says there are two."

"I need to go scout the location of that demon."

"The wolf tooth has a scent; I can't leave it with you."

Bai Linlin conjured the wolf tooth pendant, holding it in his beak, actually feeling a bit worried.

Could this wolf demon be very powerful?

"Don't worry, 247, I can get you a pair."

The black-clad youth’s expression was calm as he stated this firmly.

Bai Linlin finally returned the wolf tooth pendant.

001 took the pendant, and they parted ways, agreeing to arrive in Nanshi at the same time.

Song Yu sometimes couldn't help but feel fortunate that his little bird worked in management rather than field operations, as that was truly dangerous.

The man and the bird set off for Nanshi first.

-

The truck driver was furious when he learned he had been fired by the fleet. What was the reason given... too many traffic accidents?

There was insurance, wasn't there? And it hadn't hindered the cargo, had it?

Why?!

With cars coming and going on the highway, he was annoyed to death. Seeing a small sedan behind him trying to overtake, he slammed on the gas.

Overtake, would you?!

He had just finished his divorce, and he hadn't even gotten custody of his child. That woman was just too pretentious—how could 1,500 a month not be enough for her and the child to live on!

What kind of delicacies were they trying to eat?!

The driver was full of rage, so much so that he didn't notice he had drifted out of his lane. There were cars behind him honking to warn him, but it was too late. Heading straight toward him was a black SUV. From his high vantage point, he could even see the happy scene inside.

The husband was driving, and the wife was laughing and chatting with their child in the back.

At least, that’s how it was a second ago.

The driver suddenly had a very malicious thought...

In the foggy weather, a gray-brown sparrow with a wolf tooth in its beak perched on a speed limit sign, sensing the faint auras from all directions.

The target was heading south.

It was just about to flap its wings and leave when it happened to see the car accident about to happen below.

The truck driver could have turned the wheel. With his years of experience, he could have easily kept both himself and the others safe...

But he didn't turn the wheel. He could keep himself safe without doing so.

It would just destroy a family.

The driver’s expression was twisted. Why should they be so harmonious and happy?

Why was his own life a mess?

He was driving a big truck; shouldn't others be the ones to yield?

The driver was already spiraling toward the extreme.

001’s vision was from a great distance. The nature of a demon meant that the scene before it was slowed down significantly. It saw the child in the black SUV...

Perhaps it was a sense of kinship.

It remembered the child from the autonomous region.

A black-clad youth appeared, crouching on the speed limit sign. In just a second or two, it raised its hand and channeled its demon power. Golden light flowed out, drilling directly into the truck driver’s window, and the steering wheel turned automatically.

The accident still happened.

But because of the emergency reaction at the critical moment, the family in the SUV drifted along the guardrail and eventually came to a stop, safe and sound.

As for the truck driver, 001 had actually given him a safe path, but he was so possessed by his own malice that he turned the wheel back toward the SUV, and finally, his vehicle lost control completely and flipped.

The front of the truck caught fire.

001, now back in the form of a sparrow, didn't quite understand. Was this person trying to commit suicide?

How strange.

It didn't think too much about it, simply flapped its wings, and headed toward Nanshi.

-

About a day later.

The man and the bird returned to Nanshi. The old man was overjoyed and prepared a family feast that day. Bai Linlin ate happily while worrying about his best bird-friend.

Although 001 was a bit blunt.

It was the best bird ever.

Bai Linlin had been thinking the whole way about how it could possibly beat a wolf demon... there was such a size difference.

Fortunately, on the second evening, 001 sent a message: it had arrived at the Administration.

The sparrow in the light screen was still fluffy. It reported that it was safe, but also said it hadn't tracked down the wolf demon’s whereabouts yet.

"As long as you're okay. It doesn't have to be you who catches it, right? Aren't there other demons?"

Bai Linlin asked, lying on his bed in the bedroom.

The sparrow in the light screen nodded and said seriously:

"That’s true. The people from Bureau 749 are also following the scent."

"Then that’s fine!"

Bai Linlin said, trying to comfort it.

However, it was getting very late. He had been on a business trip for so long and hadn't reported to the Administration yet; there was still a pile of things to do.

He wanted to rest, but just as he was about to speak, the sparrow in the light screen pulled out a ticket:

"Is it starting tomorrow?"

Bai Linlin was dazed for a moment.

But soon, a cacophony of voices came from the light screen—a fancy mouse, a Call duck, a pygmy rabbit... all overlapping.

"The Boss's exhibition! We must go and show our support!"

"Support, support!"

There was even the sound of a small mouse beating a gong.

"I heard there are sculptures too!"

"Boss! Boss! We haven't seen the Boss in so long!"

...

Bai Linlin was in his "youth" form, feeling a bit dazed. He just asked:

"I know about the art exhibition, but how did you get... the tickets?"

001 was just about to say something, but then the light screen tilted upward, revealing an elegant red-crowned crane. It lifted its wing, and the light screen obediently shone down from above.

It captured almost all the little demons.

The crane stood elegantly in the middle, tilted its head slightly, and coughed.

The demons immediately raised their tickets proudly, a sea of them.

"247, long time no see. We’re going to the art exhibition to show our support."

Bai Linlin: "..."

Really?

-

The next morning at nine o'clock.

The lobby on the first floor of the Pearl Building at 26 Tongguang Road was packed with people, all looking at the posters with great curiosity.

On them was a blue-feathered bird wearing a cowboy hat. It was clearly a photoshoot, and the outfit was very stylish.

The onlookers were all curious because the local media had reported on this exhibition. First, the content was unique—the protagonist was entirely one bird; second, the ticket price had been lowered to one yuan, suspected to be the owner simply showing off their bird.

But these weren't enough to make it this popular.

The main reason was—

"Is this Linlin?"

"It looks exactly like him?"

"This account only posted one video, and it was the masked bird."

"Linlin the King?"

"When does it start! I'm so anxious!"

chunks.chineseText:
第62章

画展原定开放时间是早上九点整，宋郁已经提前在场地内了，肩头上站着一只毛绒绒的鸟。

“这有人看吗？”

白粼粼有些担忧地询问，仰着鸟头看着一幅巨大的“花鸟画”，虽然爷爷画工确实很好，但是对他的滤镜……还是有些重了。

鸟在笔筒上站着，这是景么？

“……”

宋郁还没有看完所有的展品，这个场馆不小，从京市带回来的雕塑也已经摆上了，小型的套着玻璃罩子，一米高的那个在正中央，看着很是有气势。

“怎么会没有？”

“管理局的朋友还会来的。”

人侧头安抚道。

不过就在这时，前面的工作人员过来了，面色有些为难地道：

“门口的人太多了，有交警过来问话，说要不要提前开门……”

宋郁面色微微一怔，鸟也收了收翅根。

什么情况？

等到他们走近的时候，门外确实一阵嘈杂：

“怎么还不开门？”

“你们是来干什么的？不上学吗？”

这道声音像是遛弯的大爷。

“这里有个小鸟展，超级可爱，宣传单上的画超级有意思，国画的风格，但是小鸟是站在冰箱上的，有趣得很！”

“哟，和尚鹦鹉。”

附近公园的观鸟大爷也吸引过来了。

但好在时间也快接近了，早上九点整，画展正式开门，有相关的工作人员在门口检票。

宋郁就在里面站着，本来是要往里走的，但是一下子被围住了，确切地说，是因为他肩头的小鸟。

“这个就是主角啊！”

“粼粼！粼粼大王！”

宋郁闻言面色微冷，鸟也浑身警惕，这个名字只有亲近的人才知道。

怎么会——

一个背着库洛米毛绒书包的少女走了过来，举着手机打开了一个主页，上面是个圆滚滚的鸟头头像，昵称是[粼粼大王]。

对方开玩笑地道：“我是你第一个粉丝噢！”

白粼粼懵了下，他几乎要忘记了，他开过一个自媒体号。

可那不是没有多少人点赞么？

宋郁后面给他买了点流量，但那也不应该……等等。

白粼粼鸟眼一眯，看到了少女手机上那个主页后面的粉丝数量，个十百千万十万。

！

二十万粉丝？

鸟直接放纵自我，扑棱翅膀就飞到了少女的肩头，伸着鸟头认真去看：

“啾啾！”

[拿过来点，拿过来点！]

宋郁抬眸看了下他的小鸟位置，没有出声阻拦，只是走近了点，便于随时接回来。

少女像是很通鸟性，立马把手机屏幕挪了过来，很是认真地道：

“蒙面小鸟，你好朋鸟呢？”

白粼粼这才想起来自己上次的文案是和好朋鸟出去玩了，他放了很多和001的合照，居然……居然火了！

鸟就是自媒体圣体！

“啾啾啾！”

[它一会儿就来！]

宋郁就在这时伸过来了手指，蓝色羽小鸟很自然地伸着鸟腿过来了，有些兴奋地仰着鸟头看人。

我-有-粉-丝！

“你就是粼粼的主人吗？它好可爱！为什么后面不更新了！”

宋郁：“……”

很快展厅里就满是人了，但是有一个明显的聚集点，就是一人一鸟的所在地。

宋郁没想到事情会发展成这样，尤其是被当面催更，他只能说了下原因，大体是表达没有想过会有很多关注的事。

然后这时又有个人拿着手机举过来了，屏幕上播放着视频，是典型的营销号：

[是谁还没有被这两只蒙面小鸟刷屏！近日一名昵称为“粼粼大王”的博主上传了自家小鸟的旅行视频，它们身着黑色蒙面服装……]

宋郁张了张口，完全不知道说什么，但人群中也有人开始问：

“怎么想起来给粼粼办展了？”

宋郁条件反射地道：“不是我，是爷爷想办……”

人群中再次哗然。

鸟顿时挺胸抬头的，他就说，这个家里鸟是大王！

宋郁最后还是先行撤离了，毕竟人员一直挤在门口是不合适的，他很诚恳地表达了感谢以及希望大家看展过程中愉快。

主要原因是——

鸟悄悄地道：

“我要换衣服！”

-

宋峥国抵达画展的时候眉飞色舞的，看到这么多人很是高兴，他甚至还请了些自己从商的朋友来捧捧场。

不过他也没忘记正事，招待完朋友进去，就站在了门口，很是紧张地搓了搓手。

那鹤……

老头在门口张望着，直到不远处出现了一个身着休闲衬衫、戴着藏蓝色丝巾的女士出现，对方身后还带着一队伍的“人”。

个子高低不同。

有看起来五六岁的“孩童”，也有十几岁的“少年”，还有身强体壮的“中年人”，最后则是年纪很大的“老人”。

全年龄覆盖了。

唯一相同的特征是它们都穿着红背心，有几个还举着小旗子。

宋峥国：“……”

丹顶鹤走了过来，见到人很优雅点了点头，随后朝后摆了摆手，身后那一队“人”都拿出了自己的票。

宋峥国只好道：“好好，快进吧。”

门口的工作人员其实没有察觉到什么，她只是觉得人……有些太杂了，以前在这里看展的观众大多都是固定的，办美术的展就是美术爱好者来，办历史的展就是历史爱好者来。

头一次这……

既有学生党，也有绘画爱好者，也有观鸟的公园大爷，还有一些西服革履的商人，现在还有一队红马甲的“男女老少”。

工作人员觉得像是奇景。

真是热闹。

展厅内——

侏儒兔蹦蹦跳跳的，它此刻是一个小妹妹的样子，仰着头看巨大的画作，抱着手机就要拍照：

“老大好厉害啊！”

“哇！”

不远处长得一模一样的“男童”实际上是三只“柯尔鸭”，齐齐地看着中央那个巨大的鸟雕塑。

宏伟！

丹顶鹤在前面走着路，引着一众妖怪到了个人少的地方，招了招手，形成一个“界”，开口教育道：

“这次来画展，是我从上面申请下来的活动，大家务必珍惜这次机会，一定要保持好人形，要懂礼让、守规矩。”

“另外，这是247的展，它是管理局的一份子，我们也要帮忙维护环境。”

“能做到吗？”

一众妖怪齐齐保证：“能！”

“好，自由活动！”

丹顶鹤点了点头，随后也开始自己逛了起来，不过身旁跟着个黑衣少年，对方面容清秀，始终在环顾四周，像是在找什么人。

“去吧。”

“应该在更衣室。”

001立马眼睛亮亮的，认真道：

“嗯！”

丹顶鹤摇了摇头，都是小妖，它遥遥地看了下不远处的老头子，打算过去说几句。

-

更衣室。

宋郁拿着好几套小衣服，这还是阿姨刚刚特地送过来，不然返回锦园去取就有些来不及了，他垂眸看着地板上的小鸟。

穿着一开始的经典套装。

西部牛仔背带和帽子。

很是合身。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 62

The art exhibition was originally scheduled to open at nine o'clock sharp. Song Yu was already inside the venue, a fluffy little bird perched on his shoulder.

"Will anyone actually come to see this?"

Bai Linlin asked with some concern, tilting his bird head to look at a massive "Flower and Bird" painting. Although his grandfather’s brushwork was indeed excellent, his own bias toward the old man... was perhaps a bit heavy.

The bird stood on a pen holder. Was this even an exhibit?

"..."

Song Yu hadn't finished viewing all the exhibits yet. The venue was quite large, and the sculptures brought back from Jing City had already been set up. The smaller ones were encased in glass, while the one-meter-tall centerpiece stood in the middle, looking quite imposing.

"Why wouldn't there be?"

"Friends from the Management Bureau will be coming, too."

Song Yu turned his head to reassure him.

Just then, a staff member from the front approached, looking somewhat troubled:

"There are too many people at the entrance. A traffic policeman came over to ask if we should open the doors early..."

Song Yu was slightly taken aback, and the bird tucked in his wing roots.

What was going on?

By the time they walked closer, there was indeed a commotion outside the door:

"Why haven't they opened yet?"

"What are you all here for? Don't you have school?"

The voice sounded like an elderly man out for a stroll.

"There’s a little bird exhibition here, it’s super cute! The paintings on the flyers are really interesting—traditional Chinese style, but the birds are standing on refrigerators. It’s hilarious!"

"Oh, a Monk Parakeet."

The bird-watching seniors from the nearby park had been drawn in as well.

Fortunately, the time was nearly up. At nine o'clock sharp, the exhibition officially opened, and staff members began checking tickets at the entrance.

Song Yu was standing inside, intending to head further in, but he was suddenly surrounded. To be precise, it was because of the little bird on his shoulder.

"This is the protagonist!"

"Linlin! King Linlin!"

Song Yu’s expression turned slightly cold upon hearing this, and the bird went on high alert. Only those close to him knew that name.

How could they—

A young girl carrying a Kuromi plush backpack walked over, holding up her phone to display a homepage. The profile picture was a round, fluffy bird head, and the nickname was [King Linlin].

The girl joked, "I’m your first fan!"

Bai Linlin was stunned. He had almost forgotten that he had ever opened a social media account.

But didn't that account have hardly any likes?

Song Yu had bought him some traffic later on, but that shouldn't have... wait.

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes and looked at the follower count on the girl’s phone screen: ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand.

!

Two hundred thousand followers?

The bird immediately let himself go, flapping his wings and flying onto the girl’s shoulder, stretching his neck to look closely:

"Chirp!"

[Move it closer, move it closer!]

Song Yu raised his eyes to check on his bird’s position. He didn't stop him, just stepped a little closer so he could retrieve him at any moment.

The girl seemed to have a natural affinity for birds and immediately shifted her phone screen over, saying very earnestly:

"Masked Bird, where is your bird friend?"

Bai Linlin finally remembered that his last post mentioned he was going out with his "good bird friend." He had posted many photos of himself with 001, and it had actually... actually gone viral!

Birds were the natural masters of social media!

"Chirp, chirp, chirp!"

[He’ll be here in a moment!]

Just then, Song Yu extended a finger. The blue-feathered bird naturally extended his bird leg to step onto it, looking up at him with excitement.

I-have-fans!

"Are you Linlin’s owner? He’s so cute! Why haven't you updated in a while?"

Song Yu: "..."

Soon, the exhibition hall was packed, but there was a clear focal point: the spot where the man and the bird stood.

Song Yu hadn't expected things to develop like this, especially being urged to update in person. He could only explain the reason, generally expressing that he hadn't anticipated so much attention.

Just then, another person walked over holding a phone, playing a video—a typical marketing account:

[Who hasn't been flooded by these two masked birds? Recently, a blogger nicknamed "King Linlin" uploaded travel videos of his birds. They are wearing black masks...]

Song Yu opened his mouth, completely at a loss for words, but people in the crowd began to ask:

"What made you decide to hold an exhibition for Linlin?"

Song Yu replied reflexively: "It wasn't me, my grandfather wanted to hold it..."

The crowd erupted in another round of murmurs.

The bird immediately puffed out his chest and held his head high. He had said it all along—in this house, the bird is the King!

Song Yu eventually withdrew first; after all, it wasn't appropriate for people to keep crowding the entrance. He expressed his gratitude sincerely and wished everyone a pleasant time at the exhibition.

The main reason was—

The bird whispered:

"I need to change my outfit!"

-

When Song Zheng-guo arrived at the exhibition, he was beaming with joy. Seeing so many people made him very happy; he had even invited some of his business friends to show their support.

However, he didn't forget his real task. After entertaining his friends and heading inside, he stood at the entrance, rubbing his hands together nervously.

That crane...

The old man peered out the door until a lady wearing a casual shirt and a navy blue silk scarf appeared in the distance, followed by a "team" of people.

They were of varying heights.

There were "children" who looked five or six years old, "teenagers" in their teens, "middle-aged people" with robust builds, and finally, a very elderly "senior."

Every age group was covered.

The only common feature was that they were all wearing red vests, and a few were even holding small flags.

Song Zheng-guo: "..."

The Red-crowned Crane walked over, nodded elegantly upon seeing him, and then waved a hand behind her. The team of "people" behind her all produced their tickets.

Song Zheng-guo could only say: "Alright, alright, go on in."

The staff member at the door didn't actually notice anything; she just felt the crowd was... a bit too eclectic. In the past, the audience at this gallery was mostly consistent—art lovers for art exhibitions, history buffs for history exhibits.

This was the first time it was like this...

There were students, painting enthusiasts, bird-watching park seniors, businessmen in suits, and now a team of "men, women, and children" in red vests.

The staff member thought it was quite a spectacle.

It was truly lively.

Inside the exhibition hall—

A dwarf rabbit was hopping around. She currently looked like a little girl, tilting her head to look at the massive paintings and clutching her phone to take pictures:

"Boss is so amazing!"

"Wow!"

Not far away, three identical-looking "little boys" were actually three "Call Ducks," all staring at the giant bird sculpture in the center.

Magnificent!

The Red-crowned Crane walked in front, leading the group of demons to a less crowded area. She beckoned them over, formed a "boundary," and began to lecture them:

"This visit to the art exhibition is an activity I applied for from above. Everyone must cherish this opportunity. You must maintain your human forms and be polite and orderly."

"Also, this is 247’s exhibition. He is a member of the Management Bureau, so we must help maintain the environment."

"Can you do that?"

The group of demons promised in unison: "Yes!"

"Good, you are free to explore!"

The Red-crowned Crane nodded and began to browse herself, though she was followed by a black-clad youth. He had delicate features and kept looking around, as if searching for someone.

"Go on."

"He should be in the changing room."

001’s eyes lit up immediately, and he said earnestly:

"Mm!"

The Red-crowned Crane shook her head. They were all little demons. She glanced at the old man in the distance, intending to go over and have a word with him.

-

Changing room.

Song Yu was holding several sets of small outfits. The housekeeper had just sent them over specifically; otherwise, it would have been too late to go back to Jin Garden to get them. He lowered his eyes to look at the little bird on the floor.

He was wearing his original classic set.

Western cowboy suspenders and a hat.

It fit perfectly.

chunks.chineseText:
鸟此刻正在立身镜前照着，啪嗒啪嗒地来回转，最后仰头看向宋郁。

“好看。”

宋郁及时给予反馈。

“那就这一套！001的我也要准备，给它挑一个……”

鸟走了过来，仰头看着好几个搭配好的套装，正在思索着的时候，门口有人敲门了。

三分钟后。

地板上从一只毛绒绒的鸟变成了两只，彼此正在检查穿搭。

001搭配的是棕色格纹背带，戴着一个小渔夫帽，看着也是蛮不错的。

宋郁一直在旁边看着，觉得这幅场景实在是……可爱。

但也走神了。

以至于圆滚滚的鸟头仰起来的时候，他没反应过来什么意思。

白粼粼心想这怎么回事，啪嗒啪嗒又往这边走了下，催促道：

“宋郁，手机手机！”

很快人就拿了出来，切开主页的屏幕，放在了地板上。

小雀啪嗒啪嗒地走过来，低头看着，眼睛圆圆的，不由得道：

“好多字。”

“……”

白粼粼用身子挤了下对方，用通俗的话道：

“我们火了！待会出去的时候肯定有好多人来拍照，准备好了吗？”

001歪了歪头，很认真地道：

“这个我擅长。”

宋郁微微抬了下眉，对此并不干涉，他的小鸟玩得开心就好。

-

与此同时，宋峥国已经让下属买过来好几箱子果冻了，各种口味的，摆在展厅的空旷处，他记得那些小妖似乎是喜欢这个。

果然没一会。

前面排起了长队。

一个个“孩童”巴巴地站着，然后很有礼貌地伸手。

宋峥国本来是想让工作人员发的，但是奈何他们刚离开，他只好像那天在家里一样，一个个地给。

小妖怪们穿着红背心，接过来就会说一声：

“谢谢你，人！”

这吸引了一批二次元，自动地加入了队伍，并拍了拍前面的一个“大人”，询问道：

“这是cos什么的？红背心在哪里领？”

“大人”害怕，往前挪了几步，一下子让开了位置。

丹顶鹤教育了，要遵守规矩。

不能和人类起纷争。

少女很懵的，尤其是怀里被扔进来一个果冻。

“这是无料吗？”

总之队伍逐步扩展，渐渐地不止是红背心“人群”了，一些年轻人直接加入了，并且也开始有样学样地道：

“谢谢你，人！”

他们认为这是一种圈子的潮流语。

宋峥国吓得不轻……难道这些人全是妖怪变的？

那鹤怎么能这样！

而画展的另一侧，则是开了粉丝见面会，人来人往的，很多手机对了上来。

“啊啊，好可爱啊。”

“它们一点都不怕人啊！”

“两只还会贴贴！”

白粼粼心想这算什么，他还会大鹏展翅！金鸡独立！

鸟沉浸在一阵阵的夸赞声之中，直到里面出现了些“异端”：

“好肥美的小鸡。”

“确实有点哈哈哈，好圆啊！”

“粼粼大王比好朋鸟大一圈了。”

……

鸟：“！”

怎么可以这样！

白粼粼垂着鸟头，爪子并着，一幅气鼓鼓的样子，不过就在这时，身上搭上来个小翅膀。

小雀罩着。

“我的小鸟不胖的，大家不要误会，那是它的羽毛太蓬松了。”

宋郁立马开口维护了起来。

众人一下子就理解了，发出了养宠人独有的“我懂”的声音。

鸟：“……”

展厅的人实在是太多了，宋郁最后还是带着两只小鸟回了更衣室，主要是再换一套衣服。

这么一来一回地巡游，鸟满载而归，不仅到处合影，而且叼了几张拍立得。

开开心心的！

时间一点一滴地过去，很快就要闭展了，人流量也少了起来。

宋郁这才有空找到了自己的爷爷，他老人家还在分发果冻。

“……”

那些红背心的“人”见到两只小鸟后立马开始打招呼：

“老大！”

“001！”

蓝羽小鸟欣慰地挥了挥翅膀，小雀只是点了下头。

宋郁本来是想问问为什么要亲自发东西，但余光一看，不远处就站着一个优雅的女士，此刻还在欣赏画作。

“……”

逃避么。

最后彻底关闭展厅了，天色也渐渐地暗了下来，拿着果冻的红背心小妖，很是有规矩地开始到在场地里捡垃圾。

很是有序。

至于场馆的一角，丹顶鹤则是在抽空聊了几句：

“247的情况中央那里已经告诉我了，这周再来管理局一趟，有些东西要交给它，桐城那里许久没有管理局出现了，也不确定是否有妖怪，我还是有些担心的。”

宋郁对此表示理解，侧头看了下旁边的“少年”，他的小鸟此刻化形了，脸颊都泛着些红，热的，但是很兴奋。

在拿着手机同旁边的黑衣少年看照片。

“我觉得这个好看。”

“嗯！”

“这个也不错。”

“嗯！”

丹顶鹤皱眉，抬手幻化出来金色流线，一妖敲了一下。

白粼粼这才恍恍惚惚地站直了，手腕被人给扣住了，往这边拉了下。

“粼粼。”

“怎么还是玩心这么大？多大了。上面给你的任务你觉得很简单吗？我原来想着你的职位应该是南市管理局这里的，在我身边做事也方便些，它们直接给你扔到桐城去……”

丹顶鹤皱了皱眉，其实不大满意，甚至自相矛盾地说了句：

“你才一岁半，它们怎么这样？”

“桐城又不是你的户籍地。”

白粼粼这次老老实实地站好了，抿了抿唇，其实他觉得还好，老师们在那里的。

宋郁还在侧头看着“人”。

“这样，我把001给你调过去。”

“它在我放心一些。”

丹顶鹤本来是很严肃地通知这件事的，但是抬头一看，两个“少年”正在彼此对视，眼睛亮亮的。

“我是让你们去玩的吗？”

“严肃一点！”

砰得两下。

地板上排排站着两只毛绒绒的小鸟，都收了收翅膀，低着鸟头。

……

很快天色就变暗了。

画展是结束了，但是里面的展品需要全部收回去，宋峥国原本是联系了人明天送回锦园去，但是丹顶鹤提出了一个方法：

“它们闲着也是闲着，可以帮忙运回去的。”

场地已经关了门，妖力形成的“界”也屏蔽了摄像头，里面穿着红背心的“人”已经化成了本体，探头探脑的。

还有几个小鼠在围着吃果冻。

听到吩咐后立马回头，吱吱了两声。

“啊这个……”

丹顶鹤环着手臂道：

“不信任我们？”

“没有没有没有。”

宋峥国只是说了下自己担心的事，比如画作漂浮着在路上走之类的……

丹顶鹤摆了摆手：“看不到的，这个你放心。”

“噢，当然你们是能看到的。”

鹤又补了一句。

于是在夏季的夜里，宋郁直接选择步行回锦园，陪着这么一个长队。
chunks.englishText:
The bird was currently checking himself out in the full-length mirror, pattering back and forth, before finally looking up at Song Yu.

"Looks good."

Song Yu provided feedback promptly.

"Then this set it is! I need to prepare one for 001, too. Let me pick one for him..."

The bird walked over, looking up at the several pre-matched sets. Just as he was pondering, there was a knock at the door.

Three minutes later.

On the floor, the one fluffy bird had become two, and they were busy checking each other's outfits.

001 was wearing brown plaid suspenders and a small fisherman’s hat, which looked quite nice as well.

Song Yu had been watching from the side, thinking the scene was simply... adorable.

But he had also been distracted.

So when the round bird head tilted up, he didn't immediately grasp what it meant.

Bai Linlin wondered what was going on, so he pattered over to this side again and urged:

"Song Yu, phone, phone!"

Song Yu quickly took it out, opened the homepage screen, and placed it on the floor.

The little sparrow pattered over, looked down, his eyes round, and couldn't help but say:

"So many words."

"..."

Bai Linlin nudged him with his body and said in layman's terms:

"We’re famous! There will definitely be a lot of people coming to take pictures when we go out later. Are you ready?"

001 tilted his head and said very seriously:

"I’m good at this."

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly, not interfering. As long as his little birds were having fun, that was all that mattered.

-

Meanwhile, Song Zheng-guo had already had his subordinates buy several boxes of jelly in various flavors and placed them in an open area of the exhibition hall. He remembered that those little demons seemed to like them.

Sure enough, before long, a long line had formed.

"Children" stood there eagerly, reaching out their hands very politely.

Song Zheng-guo had originally intended for the staff to hand them out, but they had just left, so he had to do it one by one, just like he did at home that day.

The little demons, wearing their red vests, would say as they took them:

"Thank you, human!"

This attracted a group of anime fans, who automatically joined the line and tapped an "adult" in front of them, asking:

"What is this a cosplay of? Where do you get the red vests?"

The "adult" was terrified, shuffled forward a few steps, and vacated his spot.

The Red-crowned Crane had taught them to follow the rules.

They couldn't start conflicts with humans.

The young girl was very confused, especially when a jelly was tossed into her arms.

"Is this a freebie?"

In any case, the line gradually expanded. Soon, it wasn't just the red-vested "crowd"; some young people joined in directly and began to follow suit, saying:

"Thank you, human!"

They assumed it was some kind of subculture slang.

Song Zheng-guo was quite frightened... Could it be that all these people were demons in disguise?

How could that crane be so reckless!

On the other side of the exhibition, a fan meet-and-greet was underway, with people coming and going, and many phones pointed their way.

"Ahhh, so cute."

"They aren't afraid of people at all!"

"The two of them are even cuddling!"

Bai Linlin thought to himself, *What’s so special about that? I can spread my wings like a Great Peng! I can stand on one leg like a golden rooster!*

The bird was immersed in the waves of praise until some "heretics" appeared in the crowd:

"What a plump little chicken."

"It really is a bit, hahaha, so round!"

"King Linlin is a whole size bigger than his good bird friend."

...

The bird: "!"

How could they say that!

Bai Linlin lowered his bird head, his claws pressed together, looking quite indignant. Just then, a small wing draped over him.

The little sparrow was covering for him.

"My bird isn't fat, everyone, please don't misunderstand. It’s just that his feathers are too fluffy."

Song Yu immediately spoke up to defend him.

The crowd understood instantly, emitting that unique "I get it" sound that pet owners make.

The bird: "..."

There were simply too many people in the exhibition hall, so Song Yu eventually took the two little birds back to the changing room, mainly to change into another outfit.

After patrolling back and forth like this, the bird returned with a full haul, not only having taken photos everywhere but also having snagged a few Polaroids.

He was so happy!

Time ticked by, and soon it was time to close the exhibition. The foot traffic began to thin out.

Only then did Song Yu have time to find his grandfather, who was still handing out jelly.

"..."

Those red-vested "people" greeted the two little birds as soon as they saw them:

"Boss!"

"001!"

The blue-feathered bird waved his wings in gratification, while the little sparrow just nodded.

Song Yu had originally wanted to ask why he was handing out things himself, but out of the corner of his eye, he saw an elegant lady standing not far away, still admiring the paintings.

"..."

Avoiding the situation, were they?

Finally, the exhibition hall was completely closed. The sky gradually darkened. The red-vested little demons with their jelly began to pick up trash in the venue in a very orderly fashion.

It was very disciplined.

As for a corner of the venue, the Red-crowned Crane took a moment to chat:

"The situation with 247 has already been reported to me by the central office. Come to the Management Bureau again this week; there are some things I need to give him. There hasn't been a Management Bureau presence in Tong City for a long time, and I’m not sure if there are any demons there. I’m still a bit worried."

Song Yu expressed his understanding and glanced at the "youth" beside him. His little bird was currently in human form, his cheeks flushed—he was hot, but very excited.

He was looking at photos on his phone with the black-clad youth.

"I think this one looks good."

"Mm!"

"This one is nice, too."

"Mm!"

The Red-crowned Crane frowned, raised her hand, and conjured a golden stream of light, tapping each demon once.

Only then did Bai Linlin stand up straight in a daze, his wrist caught by someone and pulled toward them.

"Linlin."

"Why are you still so playful? How old are you? Do you think the task given to you from above is simple? I originally thought your position should be here at the Nanshi Management Bureau, where it would be more convenient to work by my side, but they just threw you off to Tong City..."

The Red-crowned Crane frowned, actually quite dissatisfied, and even said something contradictory:

"You’re only a year and a half old, how could they do this?"

"Tong City isn't even your registered residence."

Bai Linlin stood obediently this time, pursing his lips. Actually, he felt it was fine; the teachers were there.

Song Yu was still looking at the "people" from the side.

"How about this, I’ll have 001 transferred over to you."

"I’ll feel more at ease if he’s with you."

The Red-crowned Crane had been very serious when announcing this, but when she looked up, the two "youths" were staring at each other, their eyes bright.

"Did I send you two there to play?"

"Be serious!"

*Thump, thump.*

On the floor stood two fluffy little birds, both tucking in their wings and lowering their heads.

...

Soon, the sky turned dark.

The exhibition had ended, but the exhibits needed to be taken back. Song Zheng-guo had originally contacted someone to send them back to Jin Garden tomorrow, but the Red-crowned Crane proposed a method:

"They’re idle anyway, they can help transport them back."

The venue was already closed, and the "boundary" formed by demonic energy had blocked the cameras. The "people" in red vests had already transformed into their true forms, peeking around.

There were even a few little mice scurrying around eating jelly.

Upon hearing the order, they immediately turned back and squeaked twice.

"Ah, this..."

The Red-crowned Crane crossed her arms and said:

"Don't trust us?"

"No, no, no."

Song Zheng-guo just mentioned his concerns, such as paintings floating through the streets...

The Red-crowned Crane waved her hand: "They won't be seen, you can rest assured about that."

"Oh, of course, you will be able to see them."

The crane added.

And so, in the summer night, Song Yu chose to walk back to Jin Garden, accompanying such a long procession.

chunks.chineseText:
小鼠开开心心地托着画框的四角，稳健地往前走，还有挎着小包的侏儒兔，里面装得全部都是小石头雕塑。

后面还攀爬着一只成年草龟，上面顶着那一米高的石头雕塑。

两只小鸟原本是领路的，啪嗒啪嗒地在前面走，后面有妖怪反馈看不到，于是的就改站在宋郁的肩头了。

它们慢慢地回了锦园。

-

周末去管理局那天其实交代了不少事，丹顶鹤在自己的办公室里，很是认真地检查着中央下发的文书。

“它们肯定是见你小忽悠你的，分明就应该来户籍地。”

“去桐城那里做什么，怎么可能有南市好？”

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀的，最后从自己书架上拿出来一些书本，很认真地道：

“这里是一些基础的术法，你到时候可以学一学，很实用的。”

白粼粼一下子就应激了，不要不要不要。

鸟头摇得跟个拨浪鼓一样。

丹顶鹤一下子反应过来了，凑了过去，暧昧地道：

“怎么，上次001给你的术法没有效果？”

白粼粼一下子就想爪子抠地，但它被要求站在杯垫上，空间实在很小，只好侧了侧身子。

回避。

“你这个发情期有点太隐性了，可能是先前升级太快的缘故？”

丹顶鹤绕着桌子走了两步，很是担忧地自言自语。

“这样不好，就只是咬了一口的话……完全不够的，到时候会加倍地席卷过来。”

鸟闭上了鸟眼。

假装自己是个发条鸟。

白粼粼脑袋被敲了下，爪子有点劈叉，晕晕的。

“别不当回事。”

“让你提前做好准备总比被发情打个措手不及强吧？”

丹顶鹤说完也还是摇了摇头。

像是没开情窍。

“你是真的打算和你的监护人携手一生么？”

桌面上的小鸟懵懵的，闻言仰着鸟头看了过来。

很肯定地点头。

丹顶鹤：“……”

搞纯爱？

-

大约休息了又半个月，鸟开始正式准备“上任”，宋郁已经选定了一套房子，距离桐城的福利院比较近。

白粼粼此刻化成了“少年”模样，在认认真真地收拾自己的行李，高高兴兴的，他的手腕上还戴着上次人顺手买的金链子。

衬得皮肤很白。

宋郁在旁边看着，视线始终落在人的身上，他的情绪并不算特别好。

要去桐城两年。

就算他每天晚上去找他的小鸟，那相处时间也会变短。

“粼粼。”

地毯上的“少年”头也不抬地“嗯”了一声，然后拿着一件衬衫举了举，很满意的样子。

“去桐城很开心吗？”

白粼粼闻言不解地看过来，开口道：

“当然！我可以去新的福利院看一看，然后亲口告诉老师那个讨厌的老板坐牢了，她们一定会很开心。”

宋郁面色温和，他很理解。

“我可以带你去看我的弟弟妹妹！然后……然后老师们不是让办酒席么？那就正好办了。”

“少年”很自然而然地说了出来。

但耳垂其实是红了点的。

宋郁有些时候也没有办法，每当他生出一些阴暗的占有欲的时候，都会被现实给拉回来，他的小鸟在管理局拥有很好的朋友和长辈，在南市有爷爷和他，在桐城有疼爱它的老师们……

离不开的人是自己。

“好。”

很快出门的时间就到了。

翌日早晨，天空里还飘着蒙蒙的雨。

宋峥国完全没有离别伤感，只是对着面前的“少年”道：

“一定要及时和你的上级沟通，遇到困难先上报，沉着冷静应对问题，记得多询问群众的意见。”

白粼粼认真点头。

宋郁：“……”

“周六周日要回来噢。”

“好！”

宋峥国就这么目送着车子走了，心里也是有些感叹。

要是调到中央的话。

分公司那里就得好好规划一下。

华秉的版图不能只局限在南市。

-

001并不在车上，而是在处理749局传来的信息，那个狼妖似乎藏匿起来了，非常淡的妖力波动，捕捉不到方位。

传讯来了。

[根据踪迹调查，西南方向，约的两百公里处……]

在气息被有意隐藏的时候，人类就会动用他们的方式，更加准确与细致。

001在高速公路上的限速牌上站着，展了下翅膀，收下传讯，眺望远处的景色。

这个方向。

难道不是桐城么？

小雀扑棱翅膀飞了过去。

……

车程大约花了一天半，宋郁并不打算让“人”太累，中途会停留一夜，白粼粼睡得舒舒坦坦的，在第二天被抱着上了车。

“001说它会先到拟定管理局的位置等我。”

“老师们说她们已经在门口了，先去小区还是去福利院？”

“少年”被放在了后座那里，手臂其实还在环着宋郁的肩背，很是慢吞吞地询问事情。

“先去福利院。”

“嗯……我觉得也是”

白粼粼眼皮都没太掀开，说实话现在比起一开始来宋家的时候，他的睡眠时长已经大大缩短了。

之前能睡十四个小时。

“老师们说……说福利院给我们做了饭的。”

宋郁抬手捏住那个后颈，其实什么也没听，只是倾身把人放在后座那里，去系了安全带。

侧头的时候。

有呼吸的气流拂过。

白粼粼仰着头，又睡过去了，环着的手臂也在往下滑。

宋郁抬手把那截手腕给握住了，垂眸看着“少年”，不自觉地道：

“粼粼？”

现在可以随意抱了。

他的小鸟适应了。

白粼粼闻言只好抬起来手，再度环住人的肩背，抱住了。

“在。”

车内空调开着的，温度适宜，宋郁倾身过去，抵了抵额头。

“听到了。”

-

桐城福利院内此刻一片火热，老师们甚至都拿出来红色地毯，号召着孩子们去铺一下，从里面到院子外面，看着是非常重视了。

那年轻人有权有势的，跟着粼粼过来……可不能让对方看轻了。

她们已经大致知道京市的事了，那年轻人简单地说了下，听说那个出租屋也买下来了。

老师们越想越焦灼，尤其是对方还给了那么大一笔款项，福利院的孩子们的的确确是过上了体面的生活。

她们还购置了些新衣服！

起码是合身的。

每个孩子看着都干干净净的！

“阿萍？爆竹准备好了吗？”

“放心放心。”

“把桌子也摆出来吧？先吃几桌。”

“孩子们忙这么久了，去拿点糖来！”

老师们都很有干劲地交流着，甚至在院子门口弄了个巨大的气球拱门，上面挂着红色的条幅，左边写了资助人的名字，也就是宋郁，右边特地空出来几个格子。

不能把孩子的事暴露出去。

但可以暗戳戳的。

老师们心里门儿清。

也就在这时，不远处传来了汽车的引擎声。
chunks.englishText:
The little mouse happily supported the four corners of the picture frame, walking steadily forward, followed by a pygmy rabbit carrying a small bag filled entirely with tiny stone sculptures.

Climbing along behind them was an adult grass turtle, carrying that one-meter-tall stone sculpture upon its shell.

The two little birds, who were originally supposed to be leading the way, had been flapping along in front, but after receiving feedback from the other monsters that they couldn't be seen, they decided to perch on Song Yu’s shoulders instead.

They slowly made their way back to Jin Garden.

-

The day they visited the Management Bureau over the weekend, quite a few things were settled. The Red-crowned Crane was in his office, diligently reviewing the documents issued by the central authorities.

"They were definitely trying to pull a fast one on you; you clearly should have come to the place of household registration."

"Why go to Tongcheng? How could it possibly be better than Nanshi?"

The Red-crowned Crane tucked in his wings, finally pulling some books from his shelf and saying quite earnestly:

"These are some basic cultivation techniques. You can study them when you have time; they are very practical."

Bai Linlin immediately went into a stress response: *No, no, no, no.*

His bird head shook like a rattle.

The Red-crowned Crane suddenly realized what was happening, leaned in, and said suggestively:

"What’s wrong? Did the technique 001 gave you last time not work?"

Bai Linlin felt an urge to claw at the ground, but he had been instructed to stand on a coaster, and the space was far too small, so he could only shift his body to the side.

Avoidance.

"Your estrus cycle is a bit too latent; perhaps it’s because you leveled up too quickly before?"

The Red-crowned Crane paced around the desk twice, muttering to himself with great concern.

"This isn't good. If you only took a single bite... it won't be enough. It will come back to overwhelm you twofold later."

The bird closed his eyes.

He pretended to be a wind-up toy bird.

Bai Linlin’s head was tapped, causing his claws to splay out, leaving him feeling dizzy.

"Don't take this lightly."

"Isn't it better to be prepared in advance than to be caught off guard by your heat?"

The Red-crowned Crane finished speaking and shook his head again.

It was as if the bird hadn't yet awakened to the ways of love.

"Are you truly planning to spend your whole life with your guardian?"

The little bird on the desktop looked dazed, tilting his head up at the question.

He nodded with great certainty.

Red-crowned Crane: "..."

*Going for pure love, are we?*

-

After resting for about another half-month, the bird began to officially prepare to "take office." Song Yu had already selected a house relatively close to the Tongcheng orphanage.

Bai Linlin had transformed into his "youth" form, diligently packing his luggage, looking quite happy. On his wrist, he wore the gold chain that someone had bought for him on a whim last time.

It made his skin look exceptionally fair.

Song Yu watched from the side, his gaze never leaving the youth. His mood was not particularly good.

He was going to be in Tongcheng for two years.

Even if he went to see his little bird every night, their time together would be shortened.

"Linlin."

The "youth" on the carpet didn't even look up, just hummed an "mm" and held up a shirt, looking quite satisfied with it.

"Are you happy about going to Tongcheng?"

Bai Linlin looked up, puzzled by the question, and said:

"Of course! I can go check on the new orphanage, and then tell the teachers in person that the hateful boss is in jail. They will definitely be very happy."

Song Yu’s expression softened; he understood.

"I can take you to see my younger siblings! And then... and then, didn't the teachers suggest holding a banquet? We can just hold it then."

The "youth" said it quite naturally.

But his earlobes were actually a bit red.

Song Yu sometimes felt helpless. Whenever he felt a surge of dark possessiveness, he was pulled back by reality. His little bird had good friends and elders at the Management Bureau, his grandfather and himself in Nanshi, and teachers who doted on him in Tongcheng...

The one who couldn't bear to be apart was himself.

"Alright."

Soon, the time to depart arrived.

The next morning, a light drizzle drifted through the sky.

Song Zhengguo felt no sadness at the parting, simply saying to the "youth" before him:

"You must communicate with your superiors in a timely manner. If you encounter difficulties, report them first. Handle problems with composure and calm, and remember to consult the opinions of the masses."

Bai Linlin nodded earnestly.

Song Yu: "..."

"Come back on Saturdays and Sundays, okay?"

"Okay!"

Song Zhengguo watched the car drive away, feeling a sense of reflection.

If he were to transfer to the central office...

The branch company would need some careful planning.

The Huabing territory could not be limited to just Nanshi.

-

001 was not in the car; it was processing information sent from Bureau 749. That wolf demon seemed to have gone into hiding, with such faint demonic energy fluctuations that its location could not be pinpointed.

A message came through.

[According to the trail investigation, in the southwest direction, about two hundred kilometers away...]

When a presence is intentionally concealed, humans use their own methods, which are more accurate and meticulous.

001 stood on a speed limit sign on the highway, spread its wings, received the message, and gazed at the distant scenery.

This direction.

Isn't that Tongcheng?

The little sparrow flapped its wings and flew off.

...

The journey took about a day and a half. Song Yu did not want "him" to be too tired, so they stopped for one night along the way. Bai Linlin slept comfortably and was carried into the car the next day.

"001 said it would arrive at the designated Management Bureau location first to wait for me."

"The teachers said they are already at the gate. Should we go to the apartment complex first or the orphanage?"

The "youth" was placed in the back seat, his arms still wrapped around Song Yu’s shoulders, asking questions in a slow, languid manner.

"We'll go to the orphanage first."

"Hmm... I think so too."

Bai Linlin barely lifted his eyelids. To be honest, compared to when he first arrived at the Song family, his sleep duration had significantly decreased.

He used to be able to sleep for fourteen hours.

"The teachers said... said they cooked food for us at the orphanage."

Song Yu reached out to pinch the back of his neck. He wasn't really listening; he just leaned over to place the youth in the back seat and fastened his seatbelt.

As he turned his head.

A breath of air brushed past.

Bai Linlin tilted his head back and fell asleep again, his arms sliding down.

Song Yu reached out to grasp that wrist, looking down at the "youth," and spoke involuntarily:

"Linlin?"

He could hold him freely now.

His little bird had adapted.

Bai Linlin had no choice but to lift his hand and wrap it around Song Yu’s shoulders again, hugging him.

"I'm here."

The car's air conditioning was on, and the temperature was pleasant. Song Yu leaned in, pressing his forehead against his.

"I heard you."

-

Inside the Tongcheng orphanage, things were currently in full swing. The teachers had even brought out a red carpet, calling on the children to help lay it out from the inside to the outside of the courtyard. They clearly attached great importance to this.

That young man was powerful and wealthy, and since he was coming with Linlin... they couldn't let him look down on them.

They already knew the general situation in Beijing; the young man had explained it simply, and they heard he had even bought that rental house.

The teachers grew more anxious the more they thought about it, especially since he had given such a large sum of money, which had truly allowed the children of the orphanage to live a decent life.

They had even purchased some new clothes!

At the very least, they fit properly.

Every child looked clean and tidy!

"Ah Ping? Are the firecrackers ready?"

"Don't worry, don't worry."

"Set out the tables, too? Let's eat a few rounds first."

"The children have been busy for so long, go get some candy!"

The teachers communicated with great enthusiasm, even setting up a huge balloon arch at the courtyard gate with a red banner hanging above it. On the left, it bore the name of the sponsor—Song Yu—and on the right, they had specifically left a few empty spaces.

They couldn't expose the children's affairs.

But they could do it subtly.

The teachers knew exactly what they were doing.

It was at this moment that the sound of a car engine drifted from not far away.

chunks.chineseText:
第63章

福利院内的老师们手上动作都停了，有几个还擦了擦围裙，彼此检查了下头发乱不乱，然后走到了院子的栅栏处。

后面的那些能活动的小孩子们也凑了过来，眼睛黑黑亮亮的，看着外面的黑车子。

“老师妈妈，是很重要的人来了？”

老师们头也不回地道：

“当然了，你哥哥回来了。”

一语双关。

黑色的迈巴赫显得低调又奢贵，车门被自动打开，里面伸出了一只矫健的鸟腿。

“哇！”

“小鸟！”

“我看看！”

铁门那里围着一堆小孩子，开始七嘴八舌地讨论着，神色都很激动。

气氛组到位了。

白粼粼稳当当地站在了红毯上，挺胸抬头的，身躯毛绒绒的，对着这些弟弟妹妹们挥了挥翅膀。

好，好。

宋郁是后下车的，给足了他的小鸟面子，垂眸看着，最后才伸手过去。

鸟屈尊降贵地站上来了，挺胸抬头。

“哎呀粼——”

“小宋你好你好。”

老师们还有点不适应，但看着这小鸟拽拽的样子，一下子就确定了，就是她们粼粼。

一回孤儿院就无法无天。

“啾啾！”

宋郁上前过去了，把后备箱打开了，里面是一些点读本，能够便于一些特殊孩童学习。

老师们连忙招呼人去拿东西，面色都是感谢之意。

行……年纪小是小了点。

但很会来事儿。

白粼粼对这个新的福利院其实不太熟悉，仰头看了一圈，最后发现院子里全部都是些桌子，不少。

粗略有七八张。

“……”

福利院二楼的办公室。

“少年”站在了房间内，对着面前的老师们转了个圈，眼睛圆圆的。

“好好，我们粼粼健健康康的就好。”

老师们拉着“少年”的手，很心疼地问了好一会儿琐事，最后才把目光看向了一旁的年轻人。

白粼粼本来没太反应过来，刚想走到宋郁的跟前去，但是手腕被老师给往回拉了下，被安排在了椅子上。

手里多了个橘子。

宋郁在很认真地回答问题：

“是，我不打算让我爷爷知道，粼粼上辈子的事还是藏得严密一些为好。”

“你爷爷也不说？”

老师们试探了下。

“不说。”

“其实是对的，这个酒席我们也不打算让这孩子露面，名义上就是欢迎你，这街坊邻居来凑凑热闹就可以了，我们心里头知道就行了。”

老师们也是有自己的考量的，不过就在这时，面前的年轻人手里多了个橘子，是谁给的不言而喻。

“你要吃吗？主要是粼粼这孩子话多，总是得给他塞点东西在，我这也忘了给你了。”

其中的一位老师立马去桌子上拿了个橘子，但刚要递过去的时候，对面的年轻人就剥好了，还给了椅子上的“少年”。

白粼粼拿着果肉，面色有些无辜，看着齐齐望过来的老师。

“我……他不爱吃。”

老师们是没话讲了。

-

001很快就抵达了桐城，它变成了黑衣少年，站在一个小路的交叉口，面上没有什么表情，只是垂眸看着手里的狼牙吊坠。

面色有些不大开心。

气息又消失了，这么会藏。

不过就在这时，它闻到了一股非常香的味道，前面有个院子，似乎在架锅做饭……

吃席了么？

“这资助人是真不错，听说是给了很多钱，现在还特地过来实地考察，就是得好好欢迎。”

福利院请过来的厨师正在院子的一角闲聊，他们原本是在郊区的村子里忙活的，主要是办喜事，传菜做汤都是一流的，物美价廉。

眼下正在看着火候，上面蒸着猪肘子，热气腾腾的。

“可不是，咱们也算是办好事了。”

“来来来，来替叔叔尝尝味道。”

院子里的孩子闻言立马就围了过来，仰头看着，很自觉地去拿了小纸杯子，排队等着。

厨师们都是附近的人，知道这些孩子什么情况，从另一个蒸笼里拿出来蓝莓山药，用勺子挨个给这些孩子挖点。

还不到饭点，但尝尝吧。

但就在一个个孩童拿着纸杯子走开的时候，队伍的尽头里出现了一只灰棕色的小雀。

有样学样地叼着个纸杯。

厨师：“……”

小雀啪嗒啪嗒地走了过来，把纸杯子放在了地面上，收了收翅膀。

耐心等待。

-

楼上。

“所以是会在桐城定居吗？”

老师们心情难免变好，南市虽然近，但还是有距离的，怎么会比得上孩子就在同市呢？

宋郁不大喜欢“定居”这个词，但他还是道：

“两年基层经历而已，周六周日我们会回家。”

“我们？孩子，你也要在桐城么？你不是在A大念书？这不太方便吧？”

白粼粼已经吃得差不多了，本来他是没有插话的，但是闻言还是仰头看了过来。

宋郁很平和地道：

“高铁很快，大约四十分钟。”

“我不放心。”

白粼粼察觉到了老师们的目光，立马又低着头，把最后一个橘子瓣放到了嘴巴里。

甜甜的。

“买了房子的，在福利院附近的兴安小区，这样粼粼来探望大家也方便。”

老师们听到这话彼此看了下，都是深深地点了点头，这还有什么不满意的。

她们直接拉住了宋郁的手，围着说话，拿出来了一个小布包：

“孩子，你做到这份上了，我们也应该做出点表率，我们其实给粼粼攒了些结婚的东西，是一些金银玉镯，可能没那么值钱……但是想着给未来的……”

其中一个老师连忙打断：

“这个不说了，反正，你拿着。”

白粼粼本来在椅子上吃得好好的，见到老师们拿出来什么东西，刚要起身去看看，但就在这时，窗户外面响起来了咚咚咚的声音。

小雀站在外面，喙上还有点蓝莓果酱的痕迹，歪头看了过来，眨了眨鸟眼。

他立马就走了过去。

而这个时候，老师们也基本把东西给过去了，宋郁面色认真地承诺：

“我会照顾好粼粼的。”

“好，好！”

老师们一回头，看到孩子在跟玻璃外的鸟玩，不由自主地“啧”了声：

“哎呦，多大了！”

白粼粼闻言回头看了过来，其实不知道怎么解释，001待会要来吃席的……

那到时候怎么解释？

“粼粼是小鸟，它也喜欢小鸟。”

“对了关于那些点读本，不如现在让福利院的孩子们用一下，有问题也好反馈。”

宋郁不动声色地把老师们的视线给引走了，带着下楼了，顺带道：

“它坐了很久的车了，让它在上面休息下吧。”

“行，小宋我跟你说啊，粼粼他小时候啊，惯会偷懒的，阿萍老师是知道的，练字都不愿意，还一个劲地想把自己叫成‘一一’，你说说他……”

老师们的交谈音渐渐远去。

白粼粼松了口气，砰得一下化成蓝羽小鸟，挥了挥翅膀，让小雀进来。

“这就是吃席的地点？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 63

The teachers inside the orphanage all stopped what they were doing. A few wiped their aprons, checked each other’s hair to make sure it wasn't messy, and then walked to the courtyard fence.

The younger children who were able to move around also crowded over, their eyes dark and bright, watching the black car outside.

"Teacher Mommy, has someone very important arrived?"

The teachers didn't even turn their heads as they replied:

"Of course, your big brother is back."

It was a double entendre.

The black Maybach looked low-key yet luxurious. The car door opened automatically, and a sturdy bird leg stepped out.

"Wow!"

"A little bird!"

"Let me see!"

A crowd of children gathered at the iron gate, chattering excitedly, their expressions full of thrill.

The atmosphere-setters were in place.

Bai Linlin stood steadily on the red carpet, chest puffed out and head held high, his body fluffy, waving his wings at these younger brothers and sisters.

*Good, good.*

Song Yu stepped out after him, giving his little bird plenty of face. He looked down, and only then did he reach out a hand.

The bird condescended to step onto his hand, chest puffed out and head held high.

"Oh my, Lin—"

"Hello, little Song, hello."

The teachers were still a bit unaccustomed to it, but seeing the bird’s arrogant demeanor, they immediately confirmed it was their Linlin.

Lawless the moment he returned to the orphanage.

"Chirp!"

Song Yu walked forward and opened the trunk, which contained some reading pens that would make it easier for some of the special-needs children to learn.

The teachers hurriedly called people over to take the items, their faces full of gratitude.

*Well... he might be a bit young.*

*But he’s very thoughtful.*

Bai Linlin wasn't actually very familiar with this new orphanage. He tilted his head to look around, only to find that the courtyard was filled with tables—quite a few of them.

Roughly seven or eight.

"..."

In the second-floor office of the orphanage.

The "youth" stood in the room, spinning around for the teachers, his eyes round.

"Good, good, as long as our Linlin is healthy and well."

The teachers held the "youth’s" hands, asking about trivial matters with great concern for a long while, before finally turning their gaze toward the young man standing to the side.

Bai Linlin hadn't quite reacted at first and was just about to walk over to Song Yu, but his wrist was pulled back by a teacher, and he was settled into a chair.

An orange appeared in his hand.

Song Yu was answering questions very earnestly:

"Yes, I don't intend for my grandfather to know. It’s better to keep Linlin’s past life strictly under wraps."

"You won't even tell your grandfather?"

The teachers probed.

"I won't."

"Actually, that's right. We don't intend to let the child show his face at this banquet either. In name, it’s just to welcome you; the neighbors can just come to join in the fun. We’ll know the truth in our hearts."

The teachers had their own considerations. However, at that moment, the young man in front of them had an orange in his hand—who had given it to him went without saying.

"Do you want to eat? It’s just that Linlin is a talkative child, so we always have to stuff something in his mouth. I forgot to give you one, too."

One of the teachers immediately went to the table to grab an orange, but just as she was about to hand it over, the young man opposite had already peeled one and given it to the "youth" in the chair.

Bai Linlin held the fruit, looking somewhat innocent as he watched the teachers all staring at them.

"I... he doesn't like to eat it."

The teachers were speechless.

-

001 arrived in Tongcheng shortly after. It had transformed into a black-clad youth, standing at a crossroads, its face devoid of expression, just looking down at the wolf-tooth pendant in its hand.

It looked a bit unhappy.

The aura had disappeared again; it was so good at hiding.

However, at that moment, it caught a very fragrant scent. There was a courtyard ahead, and it seemed they were setting up pots to cook...

*Are they having a banquet?*

"This sponsor is really good. I heard he gave a lot of money, and now he’s even come here in person to inspect. We really have to welcome him properly."

The chefs hired by the orphanage were chatting in a corner of the courtyard. They usually worked in the villages on the outskirts, mostly handling weddings; their ability to serve dishes and make soups was top-notch, and they were affordable.

Right now, they were watching the heat, with pork knuckles steaming on the stove, looking very appetizing.

"You said it, we’re doing a good deed too."

"Come, come, come, come taste the flavor for your uncle."

The children in the courtyard immediately gathered around upon hearing this, looking up and consciously taking small paper cups, lining up to wait.

The chefs were locals and knew the situation of these children, so they took blueberry yams out of another steamer and used a spoon to scoop some for each child.

It wasn't quite mealtime yet, but they could have a taste.

But just as the children were walking away with their paper cups, a small gray-brown sparrow appeared at the end of the line.

It followed suit, picking up a paper cup in its beak.

Chef: "..."

The little sparrow walked over, placed the paper cup on the ground, and tucked in its wings.

Waiting patiently.

-

Upstairs.

"So, are you planning to settle down in Tongcheng?"

The teachers couldn't help but feel better. Although Nanshi was close, there was still a distance; how could it compare to the child being in the same city?

Song Yu didn't really like the word "settle down," but he still said:

"It’s just two years of grassroots experience. We will go home on Saturdays and Sundays."

"We? Child, are you going to be in Tongcheng too? Aren't you studying at A University? Isn't that inconvenient?"

Bai Linlin had already eaten his fill. He hadn't intended to interrupt, but upon hearing this, he looked up.

Song Yu said very calmly:

"The high-speed rail is fast; it takes about forty minutes."

"I don't feel at ease otherwise."

Bai Linlin noticed the teachers' gazes and immediately lowered his head again, popping the last orange segment into his mouth.

Sweet.

"We bought a house in the Xing'an apartment complex near the orphanage, so it will be convenient for Linlin to visit everyone."

The teachers looked at each other upon hearing this, all nodding deeply. What else could they be dissatisfied with?

They grabbed Song Yu’s hands, surrounding him as they spoke, and brought out a small cloth bag:

"Child, since you’ve done this much, we should also show our appreciation. We actually saved up some things for Linlin’s wedding—some gold and silver bracelets. They might not be worth that much... but we thought we’d give them to the future..."

One of the teachers hurriedly interrupted:

"Let's not talk about that. Anyway, you take it."

Bai Linlin had been eating quite happily in his chair, but when he saw the teachers bring out something, he was just about to get up to take a look. At that moment, a *tap-tap-tap* sound rang out from outside the window.

The little sparrow was standing outside, a trace of blueberry jam on its beak, tilting its head to look in and blinking its bird eyes.

He immediately walked over.

By this time, the teachers had basically handed over the items, and Song Yu promised earnestly:

"I will take good care of Linlin."

"Good, good!"

The teachers turned around and saw the child playing with the bird outside the glass, and couldn't help but "tsk":

"Oh my, how old are you!"

Bai Linlin turned back upon hearing this. In truth, he didn't know how to explain it—001 was going to come and eat at the banquet later...

How would he explain that when the time came?

"Linlin is a little bird, and he likes little birds too."

"By the way, regarding those reading pens, why don't we let the children in the orphanage use them now? It’ll be easier to get feedback if there are any issues."

Song Yu quietly diverted the teachers' attention and led them downstairs, adding:

"It has been in the car for a long time; let it rest upstairs for a bit."

"Alright. Little Song, let me tell you, when Linlin was little, he was an expert at slacking off. Teacher Ah Ping knows—he wouldn't even practice his calligraphy, and he kept insisting on calling himself 'Yi Yi.' You tell me..."

The sound of the teachers' conversation gradually faded into the distance.

Bai Linlin breathed a sigh of relief, *poofing* into a blue-feathered little bird, and waved his wings to let the sparrow in.

"So this is the place where the banquet is being held?"

chunks.chineseText:
001认真地询问。

“是的。”

“那什么时候开饭？”

“……”

白粼粼心想自己的判断果然没错，001完全不关心为什么来福利院，脑子里只有人类食物。

不过为了以防万一，他还是搭过去了翅膀，认真地道：

“待会我们两个化形成其他人的模样，然后身份是宋郁的朋友，过来吃席就可以了。”

“理解不？”

001严肃点头：“嗯！”

-

宋郁也大体说清楚了情况，具体表达了待会有个朋友过来的事，但老师们反应很敏锐：

“妖怪朋友？”

“……”

“放心，我们不会给粼粼拖后腿的，一定不让孩子露馅！”

宋郁其实觉得到不了这个程度，但还是温和地点了点头，总之谨慎一些为好。

就在走到楼下的时候，院子里吆喝了一声：

“可以上菜了！要不要叫人过来啊！”

老师们一下子喜气洋洋的，几个过去帮忙了，剩余的一些年纪大则是同宋郁商量酒席的事：

“连续办三天吧？今天算接风宴，你放心，我们给外头的说法是欢迎资助人，一点问题没有！”

宋郁只是点头。

“你可得好好尝尝今天的菜，粼粼很爱吃那个珍珠肉圆……”

这边在交流着，院子里这会儿已经放起来鞭炮了。

噼里啪啦的，有种过年的氛围。

“开席了！”

一句方言大声喊了出来，来捧场的街坊邻居也都坐过来了，都看着不远处那个相貌端正的年轻人。

“真好，真好。”

“好人会有好报的。”

而此刻二楼的房间内，两个“少年”正在互相检查，它们化形成南市附近高中生的模样，长相脸谱化，但是看着着实无害多了。

001其实懵懵的，它不知道自己为什么也要化形成其他人的样子，但247这么做了，那就一定有它的道理。

两个“少年”调用妖力来到了福利院的门口，准备进门吃席。

宋郁其实提前知道这件事，听到老师们说楼上没“人”了的时候，抬眸就往门口看了。

一个眼睛圆圆的，看见他就眨眼。

一个面无表情地看着桌子上的肘子。

席面已经开了。

宋郁同旁边的老师说了下事情，抬步就去门外，准确无误地牵住了他的小鸟。

“少年”歪头看他：“你怎么知道是我？”

“快说话呀。”

这边很是纯情，那边001已经入座了，它看着桌子上的大肘子，严阵以待。

旁边有人类递给它筷子。

鸟不会用，但鸟可以叉着吃。

时间一点一滴地过去，同桌的食客从一开始的和蔼可亲，觉得这孩子吃得真香，逐步转变为面色恍惚，最后只是担忧会不会出事。

光是小碗已经摞了十多个了。

那大肘子也炫了半个。

“……”

-

福利院这里人声鼎沸的，但是不远处的小树林里有个灰扑扑的狼妖在盯着这里，它看得不是那些菜肴……而是那一群群的幼童。

这么多。

它吞了吞口水。

但现在不行，附近有[监管者]的味道，狼妖有些烦躁，它刚要继续躲藏起来，但余光一瞥，看到了个石头垒起来的小庙。

？

狼妖一脚踹翻了。

本来就烦。

等到它离开之后，那堆倒塌的石头堆里探出来一个小小的鼠头。

鼹鼠气得爪子都在抖。

它早就嗅到了同类的味道，为了谨慎才一直没有出来，本来是想要看看是不是管理局来妖了，结果看到个……

这狼妖身上有人血的味道。

鼹鼠到底是没有露面，它现在妖力很弱，打不过的。

为什么要踹它的小庙！

鼹鼠虽然很生气，但是还是认认真真地去石头堆里拿出来了自己的卷轴，那上面最原始的画像，实际上是它自己。

“山神”有责任保护好山里的动物，也有义务把迷路的人类送回住所。

鼹鼠直立着，看了不远处的福利院，决定晚上偷偷值班守一下。

……

大约下午两点半，第一天的席面结束了。

宋郁带着两个“少年”暂时离开了，驱车去了这里的房子。

其实并没有只买一套。

而是上下两层。

其中一套给001住。

白粼粼上车之后就幻化成了本体，窝在宋郁的肩头睡觉，副驾驶则是一只用爪子把着雪糕的小雀，在认认真真地吃着。

目不斜视的。

很快就到了单元楼，宋郁教了教旁边的黑衣少年怎么用电梯卡，以及带着认了认入户门。

“那你早些休息，我们上去了。”

001点头。

它坚决拥护247和他的伴侣。

好人！

宋郁带着他的小鸟去了楼上，刚进了玄关，侧头看了下肩头。

毛绒绒的蓝羽小鸟蓬成了球。

圆滚滚的。

“粼粼？”

“啾。”

“要录入下指纹，待会再睡好不好？”

宋郁轻声道，很快面前多出来个“少年”，浅蓝色的头发，耳垂还夹着金属饰品，宽松的短袖，是假两件的那种，很有设计感。

“人”几乎困极了，晕碳了。

直接靠在他的肩头。

宋郁扣着那个腰，握着“人”的手指，很软，去录入了下，随后直接抱起来了。

去了卧室。

白粼粼睡得迷迷糊糊的，仰躺在床上，下巴抬了抬，隐约觉得有呼吸的气流靠近，但一点也不躲。

“我去洗澡，你先睡一会。”

“今天休息，明天我们再去找线索。”

“唔。”

宋郁其实没有立即去浴室，而是看了下那个布包，里面的金银首饰其实款式算比较旧的，但是被保存得很好，尤其是那个玉镯子，莹润透亮。

他垂眸看了一会。

心里有些溢满。

白粼粼是听到水流声醒了过来的，他觉得莫名燥热，光着脚就下来了，不由自主地就走到了浴室门口。

他以为他是小鸟。

蹲下了。

“少年”脸颊泛红，抬手去挠门，唇瓣微微张了张：

“宋——”

门开了，白粼粼一下子被拉了进去。

-

南市。

一个商业宴会里觥筹交错的，灯光也显得明亮，宋峥国在不和那鹤打交道的时候还是很有老一辈人的从容不迫的。

其实他可以不来。

但奈何京市分公司那里小郁做得实在是漂亮，年纪这么小，就已经筛查出来了合作商存在问题的事，并且直接把那个叫什么“盛星”的小公司给整垮了。

这种雷厉风行的手段。

与之前的那位“父亲”完全不像，反倒是继承了宋峥国的衣钵。

“小郁怎么不来，这孩子不是放了假的么？”

旁边有人在询问。

宋峥国滴酒不沾，只是拿着茶杯举了举，温文尔雅地道：

“假期，他有他的安排。”

“我这做爷爷的，过多干涉反倒是不好了。”

另外一个西装革履的人只是道：

“陈总不要这么刻意，小郁是个好孩子，非要他这么早来和我们这群上了年纪的人说闲话干什么？”

那人脸色一阵青一阵白的。
chunks.englishText:
"001, are you listening?" he asked earnestly.

"Yes."

"Then when is dinner served?"

"..."

Bai Linlin thought to himself that his judgment had been correct; 001 didn't care at all why they had come to the orphanage—its mind was entirely occupied by human food.

However, just to be safe, he draped a wing over it and said seriously:

"In a moment, we will shapeshift into the forms of other people. Our identity will be friends of Song Yu, and we’re just here to attend the banquet."

"Do you understand?"

001 nodded solemnly: "Mm!"

-

Song Yu had also generally explained the situation, specifically mentioning that a friend would be arriving later. However, the teachers were very sharp:

"A 'yokai' friend?"

"..."

"Don't worry, we won't hold Linlin back. We definitely won't let the secret slip!"

Song Yu actually felt it wouldn't come to that, but he nodded gently anyway; caution was always better.

Just as they reached the ground floor, someone in the courtyard shouted:

"The food is ready to be served! Should we call people over?"

The teachers were suddenly beaming with joy. A few went over to help, while the remaining older ones discussed the banquet arrangements with Song Yu:

"Shall we hold it for three days? Today counts as the welcome feast. Don't worry, we've told the outsiders that we're welcoming a benefactor. There won't be any problems at all!"

Song Yu simply nodded.

"You must try today's dishes. Linlin loves those pearl meatballs..."

As they chatted, firecrackers began to pop in the courtyard.

*Crackling, popping*—it had the festive atmosphere of the Lunar New Year.

"The feast has begun!"

A phrase in the local dialect was shouted out loudly. The neighbors who had come to show their support sat down, all looking at the well-mannered young man not far away.

"It's so good, really good."

"Good people will be rewarded."

At this moment, in a room on the second floor, two "teenagers" were checking each other. They had shapeshifted into the appearance of high school students from near Nanshi. Their features were generic, but they looked truly harmless.

001 was actually confused. It didn't know why it had to shapeshift into someone else's appearance, but since 247 had done so, there must be a reason for it.

The two "teenagers" channeled their demonic energy and arrived at the entrance of the orphanage, ready to go in and eat.

Song Yu had actually known about this in advance. When he heard the teachers say there was no one left upstairs, he lifted his gaze toward the entrance.

One had round eyes and blinked when it saw him.

The other stared expressionlessly at the braised pork knuckle on the table.

The banquet had already started.

Song Yu said a few words to the teacher beside him, then walked to the door and accurately took hold of his little bird.

The "teenager" tilted its head at him: "How did you know it was me?"

"Speak up quickly."

Things were very pure on this side, but on the other side, 001 had already taken its seat. It stared at the large pork knuckle on the table, ready for battle.

Someone handed it a pair of chopsticks.

A bird didn't know how to use them, but a bird could spear the food.

Time passed bit by bit. The fellow diners at the table, who had initially been kind and thought the child ate with such gusto, gradually shifted to expressions of bewilderment, and finally, worry about whether something might go wrong.

They had already stacked more than ten small bowls.

And half of that large pork knuckle had been devoured.

"..."

-

The orphanage was bustling with noise, but in a small grove not far away, a dusty wolf demon was watching the scene. It wasn't looking at the dishes... but at the groups of young children.

So many.

It swallowed its saliva.

But it couldn't act now; there was the scent of a [Supervisor] nearby. The wolf demon felt irritable. Just as it was about to continue hiding, it caught a glimpse of a small shrine built of stones.

?

The wolf demon kicked it over.

It was already annoyed.

After it left, a tiny mouse head poked out from the pile of collapsed stones.

The mole was so angry its claws were trembling.

It had long since smelled the scent of its own kind and had stayed hidden out of caution. It had originally wanted to see if the Management Bureau had sent any demons, only to see...

This wolf demon had the scent of human blood on it.

The mole ultimately didn't show itself; its demonic power was too weak right now, and it couldn't win.

Why did it have to kick its little shrine!

Although the mole was very angry, it still conscientiously retrieved its scroll from the stone pile. The primitive portrait on it was, in fact, itself.

The "Mountain God" had a duty to protect the animals in the mountain and an obligation to send lost humans back to their homes.

The mole stood upright, looked at the orphanage not far away, and decided to secretly stand guard tonight.

...

Around 2:30 PM, the first day's banquet ended.

Song Yu took the two "teenagers" and left temporarily, driving to the house he had bought here.

Actually, he hadn't just bought one unit.

It was two floors, one above the other.

One of them was for 001 to live in.

After getting into the car, Bai Linlin transformed back into his original form and curled up on Song Yu's shoulder to sleep. In the passenger seat was a little sparrow holding an ice cream with its claws, eating it very seriously.

Looking straight ahead.

They soon arrived at the apartment building. Song Yu taught the black-clad teenager how to use the elevator card and led it to recognize the front door.

"Then get some rest early. We're going upstairs."

001 nodded.

It firmly supported 247 and his partner.

Good people!

Song Yu took his little bird upstairs. As soon as he entered the foyer, he tilted his head to look at his shoulder.

The fluffy blue-feathered bird had puffed up into a ball.

Round and plump.

"Linlin?"

"Chirp."

"We need to register your fingerprint. Can we do that before you sleep?"

Song Yu said softly. Soon, a "teenager" appeared before him, with light blue hair, metal accessories clipped to his earlobes, and a loose, fake-layered short-sleeved shirt that was quite stylish.

The "person" was extremely sleepy, practically carbon-monoxide poisoned.

He leaned directly against his shoulder.

Song Yu held the "person's" waist and took his fingers—they were very soft—to register them, then picked him up directly.

He went to the bedroom.

Bai Linlin was sleeping in a daze, lying on his back on the bed, his chin lifted slightly. He vaguely felt the airflow of breath approaching, but he didn't dodge at all.

"I'm going to take a shower. You sleep for a while."

"We're resting today; we'll look for clues tomorrow."

"Mmm."

Song Yu didn't actually go to the bathroom immediately. Instead, he looked at the cloth bag. The gold and silver jewelry inside was actually quite old-fashioned, but it had been well-preserved, especially the jade bracelet, which was lustrous and clear.

He lowered his eyes and watched for a while.

His heart felt overflowing.

Bai Linlin woke up when he heard the sound of running water. He felt inexplicably hot and bothered, so he got down barefoot and walked toward the bathroom door involuntarily.

He thought he was a little bird.

He crouched down.

The "teenager's" cheeks were flushed. He reached out to scratch the door, his lips slightly parted:

"Song—"

The door opened, and Bai Linlin was pulled inside in an instant.

-

Nanshi.

At a business banquet, people were mingling, and the lights were bright. When Song Zhengguo wasn't dealing with that Crane, he still possessed the composure of the older generation.

Actually, he could have chosen not to come.

But unfortunately, Little Yu had done such a beautiful job at the Beijing branch. At such a young age, he had already screened out the problems with the partners and directly crushed that small company called "Shengxing."

Such decisive and swift methods.

They were nothing like that previous "father," but rather, he had inherited Song Zhengguo's mantle.

"Why didn't Little Yu come? Isn't the child on vacation?"

Someone nearby was asking.

Song Zhengguo didn't touch a drop of alcohol; he just held his teacup, raised it, and said with refined elegance:

"He has his own plans for the holidays."

"As his grandfather, it wouldn't be good for me to interfere too much."

Another person in a suit and leather shoes just said:

"President Chen, don't be so deliberate. Little Yu is a good child. Why must you force him to come and gossip with us old folks so early?"

The man's face turned blue and white.

chunks.chineseText:
笑着道：“也是也是。”

直到不远处的林董走了过来，对方是华秉的核心成员，也是一直带着宋郁的长辈，刚坐下沙发，就笑眯眯地道：

“峥国，京市的那老于可是告诉我了，小郁专门去登门摆放了。”

“这我带了小郁这么久，他怎么还不来我家里做做客？”

宋峥国笑着道：“我去，我去好不好？”

“让孩子歇一歇啊。”

前半句是开玩笑的意思，后面就是掏心窝子了。

林董闻言就是摆了摆手，“还不是你让孩子这么早来公司的？要我说你这个爷爷实在是太严苛了。”

“好一个撒手不管，整天就知道饮茶画画？”

宋峥国：“……”

不过这还没完，对面的老狐狸只是眯了眯眼，说出来真正的想法：

“小郁这才十九，前途无量，我家孙女在伯克利学音乐，品性你也是知道的，让他们……认识认识？”

宋峥国一下子僵住了。

三分钟后。

林董震惊：“有对象了？”

-

浴室里。

“少年”衣服都被弄湿了，微微张着口，踮脚去咬那块皮肉，一点点地舔弄。

后颈上的印记还在亮着。

宋郁头发还滴着水珠，只是浅浅擦了下，他垂眸看着下方的“人”，分明已经禁锢住了。

它怎么一点反应都没有。

“粼粼？”

“少年”专心致志地舔伤口，就算被勒得腰不舒服了，也只是皱了皱眉，抬手抵住了人的肩头。

“唔……”

宋郁抵了抵怀里“人”的额头。

很烫。

白粼粼根本就没有满足，他只是执着地朝着那个伤口凑过去，但是够不到，只好环住了对方的肩背，往下拉。

红润的舌尖探了出来。

宋郁闭了闭眼，觉得有些受不了了，但刚想要拉开“人”，他的喉结就被轻轻地咬住了。

一瞬间大脑都变得空白。

湿软、吮吸。

白粼粼只是觉得咬住了个凸起，但是他不知道为什么会动来动去的，甚至含不住了。

只好上上下下地追着咬。

直到下巴被用力地往上一捏，他几乎吃痛地张了张口：

“唔……哈”

有阴影覆了过来，牙齿磕碰，很生涩的吻技。

白粼粼一开始根本没反应过来发生了什么，瞳孔有些散开了，只是泛着水光。

“嗯……”

唇齿相依。

“少年”的手臂都是环着人的脖子的，彼此没有空隙的，有金线在周身流动。

不知道过了多久。

“哈……宋、宋郁……唔嗯”

白粼粼那种昏沉的感觉消退了，逐步变得清醒了起来，眼尾洇着红，他推不开了。

唇瓣湿哒哒的。

腰被勒住，肩胛骨都是被一只手压着的，后颈被固定着。

白粼粼没有任何支撑点。

除了宋郁。

好不容易分开一点点，又被捏着后颈吻了过去。

密不透风的。

湿润的水声传来。

他变得很奇怪，身体都使不上劲了，抬手去推，但却像是攀附着，只能发出点气音。

唇瓣被咬了下。

轻轻扯着的那种。

白粼粼一下子就委屈了，眼泪啪嗒地掉下来了，含糊不清地控诉了句“疼”。

终于被放开了。

宋郁除了唇上有些水痕外，面色看着居然没什么变化，很是冷静，低声问：

“哪里痛？”

“少年”只是在喘气，脸颊都有泪痕滑过，抬眸看他一眼，又生气地撇开。

“不痛？”

白粼粼还没反应过来，下巴就被捏住了，就在快要靠近的那一刹那。

“嘴、嘴巴。”

宋郁停了下来，垂着眼眸看着，像是在仔仔细细地检查，又像是纯粹地观看。

“这样啊。”

他像是自言自语，轻笑了下：

“亲一口就好了。”

白粼粼震惊，然后在阴影覆过来的时候慌张地闭上了眼睛，但其实只是唇瓣互相贴了下，安抚的性质。

这么一套下来。

白粼粼直接就宕机了，这是……

他再次回神的时候，已经被抱出去了，放在了床边，宋郁面色恢复了那种冷淡的样子，在拿毛巾替他擦手臂。

尽管他发梢是湿的。

白粼粼张了张口，本来是想要说些什么的，但是却觉得唇角真的有些痛了。

嘶了一下。

宋郁俯身刚要看看情况，啪得一声。

“少年”一手抵住他的肩头，一手僵在半空中。

白粼粼扇完才发现不合适的，他磕磕巴巴地想要解释，但觉得对方本来就过分。

纠结了下。

决定不道歉。

“少年”扬了扬下巴，水润的眼睛望了过来。

宋郁甚至能从里面看到自己的倒影。

他若无其事地抬手扣住那个手腕，直起身来，往上带了下。

白粼粼着急了：“我们说好了的，我可以咬你的，但是你……你没有提前和我说，你亲我……你。”

“疼么？”

宋郁垂眸看着那个手心，轻声问道。

白粼粼愣住了。

-

楼下。

黑衣少年已经打开了电视，此刻外面天色已经暗了下来，黄金档都市生活剧已经开始热播。

001化成本体模样，站在茶几上，爪子按着薯片袋子，时不时地用喙叼出来一片品鉴。

屏幕上的光闪动着，小雀目光专注。

[你以为我不烦啊？我告诉你我早就受够了！这房子要么漏水，要么断电，还有楼上每天定时定点传来的砰砰声！我早就受够了！]

001歪了歪头，这能听见吗？

它仰了仰鸟头，看着天花板，实在是好奇，但一个用力过猛，直接后翻了过去。

毛绒绒的。

而与此同时，福利院那里灯火通明，孩子们在认真地学习，点读本很好用，上面甚至还有盲文，一边可以触摸，一边可以发声。

小楼里氛围很是和谐。

但就在这时，树林里出现了细细簌簌的动静，一个庞然大物在黑夜里慢慢地靠近，身躯也变得巨大。

狼妖饿了很久了。

[监管者]的味道消散了。

就在它准备潜入进去的时候，咣当——

狼妖左脸遭到攻击，一个石子用力地扔了过来。

“谁！”

下一秒，狼妖的右脸又遭到攻击，石子扔得又准又痛。
chunks.englishText:
He smiled and said: "True, true."

It wasn't until Director Lin from not far away walked over—a core member of Hua Bing and an elder who had always looked after Song Yu—that he sat down on the sofa and said with a smile:

"Zhengguo, Old Yu from Beijing told me that Little Yu specifically went to visit him."

"I've been mentoring Little Yu for so long; why hasn't he come to visit my home yet?"

Song Zhengguo laughed: "I'll go, I'll go, alright?"

"Let the child rest for a bit."

The first half was a joke, but the second half was heartfelt.

Upon hearing this, Director Lin waved his hand. "Isn't it you who made the child come to the company so early? If you ask me, you, as a grandfather, are far too strict."

"So much for 'hands-off'—you just spend all day drinking tea and painting?"

Song Zhengguo: "..."

But it didn't end there. The old fox opposite him just narrowed his eyes and revealed his true thoughts:

"Little Yu is only nineteen and has a boundless future. My granddaughter is studying music at Berkeley, and you know her character. Why don't we let them... get to know each other?"

Song Zhengguo froze instantly.

Three minutes later.

Director Lin was shocked: "He has a partner?"

-

In the bathroom.

The "teenager's" clothes were all soaked. He parted his lips slightly, stood on tiptoe to bite that patch of skin, and licked it bit by bit.

The mark on the back of his neck was still glowing.

Song Yu's hair was still dripping with water; he had only wiped it shallowly. He lowered his eyes to look at the "person" below him, who had clearly been restrained.

How could he have no reaction at all?

"Linlin?"

The "teenager" was focused on licking the wound. Even when his waist felt uncomfortable from being held so tightly, he only frowned and raised a hand to press against the man's shoulder.

"Mmm..."

Song Yu pressed his forehead against the "person's" in his arms.

He was very hot.

Bai Linlin wasn't satisfied at all; he just persistently reached toward the wound, but he couldn't reach it, so he had to wrap his arms around the other's shoulders and pull him down.

The tip of his red, moist tongue poked out.

Song Yu closed his eyes, feeling like he couldn't take it anymore. But just as he wanted to pull the "person" away, his Adam's apple was gently bitten.

In an instant, his mind went blank.

Wet, soft, sucking.

Bai Linlin just felt like he had bitten a protrusion, but he didn't know why it kept moving around, to the point where he couldn't even hold it in his mouth.

He had no choice but to chase it up and down, biting.

Until his chin was pinched upward with force, he opened his mouth in near pain:

"Mmm... ha."

A shadow covered him, teeth clashing—a very clumsy kissing technique.

Bai Linlin hadn't reacted to what was happening at all; his pupils were slightly dilated, shimmering with moisture.

"Mmm..."

Lips and teeth intertwined.

The "teenager's" arms were wrapped around the man's neck, leaving no space between them. Golden threads flowed around their bodies.

It was unknown how much time had passed.

"Ha... Song, Song Yu... Mmm-un."

The dazed feeling in Bai Linlin began to fade, and he gradually became clear-headed. The corners of his eyes were stained red, and he couldn't push him away.

His lips were wet.

His waist was gripped, his shoulder blades were pressed by one hand, and the back of his neck was fixed in place.

Bai Linlin had no support point.

Except for Song Yu.

Just as they managed to separate a little, he was pinched by the back of the neck and kissed again.

It was airtight.

The sound of wet, moist contact could be heard.

He became very strange; his body had no strength left. He raised his hands to push, but it was as if he were clinging to him, and he could only let out soft gasps.

His lip was bitten.

A gentle tugging sensation.

Bai Linlin felt aggrieved instantly, tears falling *plop, plop*, and he mumbled an unclear accusation of "It hurts."

He was finally let go.

Except for the water marks on his lips, Song Yu's expression hadn't changed at all; he was very calm as he asked in a low voice:

"Where does it hurt?"

The "teenager" was just panting, tear tracks sliding down his cheeks. He looked up at him once, then turned away in anger.

"It doesn't hurt?"

Before Bai Linlin could react, his chin was pinched. Just as they were about to get close again:

"Mouth... mouth."

Song Yu stopped, lowering his eyes to look, as if he were carefully inspecting it, or perhaps just watching purely for the sake of it.

"Is that so."

He seemed to be talking to himself, then chuckled lightly:

"A kiss will make it better."

Bai Linlin was shocked, and then panic-closed his eyes when the shadow covered him. But in reality, it was just their lips pressing against each other—a gesture of comfort.

After all that, Bai Linlin simply crashed. This was...

When he came back to his senses, he had already been carried out and placed on the edge of the bed. Song Yu's expression had returned to that cold, indifferent look as he used a towel to wipe his arms.

Even though his hair tips were still wet.

Bai Linlin opened his mouth, originally wanting to say something, but he felt that the corners of his lips really did hurt a little.

He hissed.

Song Yu leaned over, just about to check the situation, when *slap*.

The "teenager" pushed against his shoulder with one hand, the other frozen in mid-air.

Only after he finished slapping did Bai Linlin realize it wasn't appropriate. He stammered, wanting to explain, but he felt the other party had been excessive to begin with.

After struggling with himself for a moment.

He decided not to apologize.

The "teenager" lifted his chin, his moist eyes looking over.

Song Yu could even see his own reflection in them.

He acted as if nothing had happened, reached out to clasp that wrist, stood up straight, and pulled him up.

Bai Linlin was anxious: "We agreed, I can bite you, but you... you didn't tell me beforehand, you kissed me... you."

"Does it hurt?"

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at that palm, asking softly.

Bai Linlin was stunned.

-

Downstairs.

The black-clad teenager had already turned on the TV. By now, the sky outside had darkened, and the prime-time urban drama had begun to air.

001 had transformed back into its original form, standing on the coffee table, its claws pressing down on a bag of potato chips, occasionally using its beak to pluck one out to savor.

The light on the screen flickered, and the little sparrow's gaze was focused.

[You think I'm not annoyed? Let me tell you, I've had enough! This house either leaks water or the power cuts out, and there's that thumping sound coming from upstairs at the same time every day! I've had enough!]

001 tilted its head. Could it hear that?

It lifted its bird head and looked at the ceiling, truly curious, but with one over-exertion, it flipped backward.

All fluffy.

Meanwhile, at the orphanage, the lights were bright. The children were studying diligently. The reading pen was very useful; it even had Braille on it, so one could touch it while it played the audio.

The atmosphere in the small building was very harmonious.

But just then, a rustling sound appeared in the woods. A behemoth was slowly approaching in the dark of night, its body growing larger.

The wolf demon had been hungry for a long time.

The scent of the [Supervisor] had dissipated.

Just as it was about to sneak in, *clang*—

The wolf demon's left cheek was attacked; a stone had been thrown with great force.

"Who's there!"

The next second, the wolf demon's right cheek was attacked again. The stone had been thrown accurately and painfully.

chunks.chineseText:
第64章

狼妖气急败坏，直接回头看了下，找到了那个扔石头的方向，妖力一下子往外释放，树林里刮了一阵风。

那堆石头此刻更是一团乱。

“出来！”

狼妖很是庞然大物，蹲在那个洞口那里，龇牙咧嘴的，眼睛猩红，还淌着涎水。

气息是妖啊……
