那它就先吃了这个妖，再去吃那些孩子。

洞口里黑黢黢的，一点反应都没有。

狼妖抬起爪子就开始用力地拍，地面都稍稍裂开了些，但是鼹鼠此刻已经从另一个洞里探出头来了。

咣当——

一个石子又打了过来，这次是后脑勺。

狼妖低着头，闭着眼睛，气得脊背都在微微抖动。

“我一定要……一定要吃了你！”

树林又是一阵急风，鼹鼠的洞口被砸得稀巴烂。

狼妖俨然是上头了，连气息波动的幅度变大了都不知道。

而在不远处的小区内，小雀本来还在收看黄金档节目，但察觉到了妖力的波动立刻看向了窗户的位置。

001的瞳孔变成了金色，消失在了房间里。

-

鼹鼠一开始还很灵活地躲避，后面就有些力不从心了，几次都差点被震出来。

它仓皇逃窜的时候也在思考一件事，为什么这个等级的狼妖……会在城市里？

管理局真的没有了？

鼹鼠很难不悲观，也就在这么走神的一瞬，狼妖的哈气扑面冲了过来。

它躲不掉了。

鼹鼠闭了闭眼，脑海里已经开始走马灯，从刚从土地钻出来看世界的画面到被分配一片小小山林的志得意满……再到前几天在画像后面看嬉笑的孩童的场景。

鼠此生无憾。

一秒，两秒，预想的撕咬并没有发生。

鼹鼠睁开眼睛，发现那个狼妖此刻完全不见踪影，周遭一片寂静。

？

跑了？

不过就在这时——

一道强烈的妖力从远处席卷而来，鼹鼠直立着，伸着爪子四处环顾，随后看到了远处的影子后，立马钻进了洞里。

比那狼妖还要厉害的。

夜色之下，一只毛绒绒的小雀栖在树枝上，盯着空荡荡的地面，这里有狼妖停留的气息。

001幻化成黑衣少年的模样，面无表情地走了过来，垂眸看着那个土洞。

大约十分钟后。

“001！”

黑衣少年站直了身子，侧眸看向不远处，眼神一下子变得清澈了起来，它化形成了本体的，扑棱翅膀到了“少年”的肩头。

白粼粼面色其实还是红着的，方才在房间里实在是……好在001传讯过来了，他有点正事做。

“找到了吗？”

“少年”唇瓣有些肿，侧头看向肩头的小雀，对方只是摇了摇鸟头：

“跑得太快了。”

宋郁在后面过来了，拿着车钥匙，面色没有什么情绪起伏。

只是过来要牵手。

但刚一碰，“人”躲开了。

白粼粼心脏都在怦怦直跳，但还是不回头看，只是磕磕巴巴地同肩头的小雀道：

“我、我学会快速传送的术法了。”

“是不是很好？”

001闻言歪了下鸟头，化形成了黑衣少年，站在对面，很不解地问：

“你们不是一起来的？”

宋郁没说话。

白粼粼不愿意承认是他有点尴尬。

毕竟那、那什么，问他“手疼不疼”。

还是太……

“247，你脸好红。”

001很认真地道。

白粼粼：“……”

夜色安静，鼹鼠在洞里悄悄地探出来脑袋，看着不远处的车子和“人”。

有妖怪的气息，它们在交流。

“说正事，这个狼妖上次不还是伤了你么？没有749局的人帮你么？”

“不需要。”

白粼粼闻言就闭了闭眼，刚想教育一下，但下一秒：

“我要给你拔狼牙。”

黑衣少年面无表情地看了过来，严肃。

“……好。”

他们最终还是走到了那个土洞那里，这里乱糟糟的，有很明显的狼爪印，很大，不是正常动物的那种。

白粼粼蹲下身子来，低头看着那个黑漆漆的洞口，宋郁用手机开了手电筒，但视线始终是看着“人”的后颈的。

“这是什么？”

黑衣少年在旁边站着，冷静回答：

“应该是妖怪，未收编的。”

白粼粼闻言歪了歪下头，砰得一下化成小鸟，收了收翅膀，打算凑近看一看里面。

但就这么一个动作，不仅旁边“黑衣少年”化成了小雀，伸翅膀去挡住了他的去路，上方也传来了声音：

“粼粼。”

鸟：“……”

有种不让靠火堆的感觉。

白粼粼收了收翅膀，虽然有些不服，但还是啪嗒啪嗒地往后走了下。

001抬起来翅膀，调动了下妖力，打算探进去看一看怎么回事。

但就在这时，空气里又传来一阵波动。

是福利院的方向。

“我的盾……”

白粼粼还没来得及说完话，面前的小雀已经消失了，只留下一道金色的残影。

-

很快林子里再度恢复了安静，洞口处探出来个毛绒绒的脑袋，伸着爪子直立着，好奇地看着不远处的房屋。

那里的楼房灯火通明，全是些孩子。

鼹鼠本来是想要留守在这里的，但是它又实在担心，还是伸着爪子跑过去了。

天边挂着月亮，小树林里很是幽静。

白粼粼赶到的时候，001在垂眸看着那条巨大的狼尾，面色有些冷白。

地面上流淌着些黑血。

断尾跑了。

“你没事吧？”

“少年”小跑了过来，低头看到这副场景后其实后退了一步，但还是又往前走了。

“福利院的孩子没事吧？”

001摇了摇头：“没有，你的盾很有效。”

白粼粼一听就高兴了，抬了抬下巴，这是他在中央那里学习的，从防御自己、防御他人，再到防御比较大的范围。

鸟已经炉火纯青了。

这还是001提醒他的，不过他其实对狼妖的事情不太清楚，于是想要凑近再去问问。

但手腕被扣住了。

宋郁很轻而易举地扯过来了，低头看着“人”，皱眉道：

“那里脏。”

不远处的黑衣少年蹲在路灯下面，看着那条狼尾，有些不郁，本来都要抓到了。

247估计要等急了。

它抬手调动起来妖力，把地面上的一片狼藉收拾干净了，随后才抬头看向那边。

……

“你先放开，这是在外面。”

“少年”皱着眉，用很小的力道抽自己的手指，但是其实弄不开，在小声商量。

宋郁：“为什么？”

“什么为什么？我们在办公务，你这样一直拉着我……”

白粼粼抬眸看着，本来是要抿抿唇的，但是又很刺痛，他更生气了。

但还没来得及控诉，旁边就多了一道阴影，“黑衣少年”站在一人一鸟中间，目光坦坦荡荡的，只是观看。

“……”

“……”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 64

The Wolf Demon was beside itself with rage. It whipped its head around, pinpointing the direction from which the stone had been thrown. With a sudden surge of demonic energy, a gust of wind tore through the woods.

The pile of stones was now in complete disarray.

"Come out!"

The Wolf Demon was a massive beast. It crouched at the mouth of the burrow, baring its fangs, its eyes glowing a blood-red, saliva dripping from its jaws.

It was the aura of a demon...

Very well, it would devour this demon first, then go after the children.

The burrow remained pitch black, showing no reaction at all.

The Wolf Demon raised a claw and began to pound the ground with force. The earth cracked slightly, but the mole had already poked its head out from a different exit.

*Clang—*

Another stone struck, this time hitting the back of its head.

The Wolf Demon lowered its head, eyes squeezed shut, its spine trembling with fury.

"I will... I will absolutely devour you!"

Another gust of wind swept through the woods, and the mole’s burrow was smashed to smithereens.

The Wolf Demon had clearly lost its head, unaware that the fluctuations in its own aura were growing increasingly erratic.

Not far away, in the residential complex, Little Sparrow had been watching a prime-time show, but the moment it sensed the fluctuation of demonic energy, it looked toward the window.

001’s pupils turned gold, and it vanished from the room.

-

At first, the mole had been agile enough to dodge, but it was beginning to struggle, nearly being shaken out of its tunnels several times.

As it scrambled to escape, it couldn't help but wonder: why would a Wolf Demon of this caliber... be in the city?

Had the Bureau truly ceased to exist?

It was hard for the mole not to feel pessimistic. In that split second of distraction, the Wolf Demon’s hot, foul breath washed over it.

It couldn't dodge.

The mole closed its eyes, its mind flashing through a montage of its life—from the moment it first crawled out of the earth to see the world, to the pride it felt when assigned a small patch of forest... and finally, the scene from a few days ago, watching the children laughing behind the portrait.

*This mouse has no regrets.*

One second, two seconds... the expected tearing of flesh never came.

The mole opened its eyes to find the Wolf Demon completely gone. The surroundings were deathly silent.

?

Did it run?

But just then—

A powerful surge of demonic energy swept in from afar. The mole stood upright, paws extended, looking around. Seeing a shadow in the distance, it immediately dove back into its hole.

Something even more powerful than that Wolf Demon.

Under the night sky, a small, fluffy sparrow perched on a tree branch, staring at the empty ground where the Wolf Demon had lingered.

001 transformed into the form of a youth in black, walking over with an expressionless face, eyes cast down toward the burrow.

About ten minutes later.

"001!"

The youth in black stood straight, glancing toward the distance. His eyes softened instantly. He transformed back into his true form and fluttered onto the shoulder of the "youth."

Bai Linlin’s face was still flushed—things in the room earlier had been... well, fortunately, 001 had sent a message, giving him some official business to attend to.

"Did you find it?"

The "youth," his lips slightly swollen, turned his head to look at the sparrow on his shoulder. The bird merely shook its head:

"It ran too fast."

Song Yu approached from behind, holding car keys, his expression unreadable.

He simply walked over to hold hands.

But the moment he touched him, the "person" dodged.

Bai Linlin’s heart was pounding, but he refused to look back, stammering to the sparrow on his shoulder:

"I... I learned the fast-teleportation technique."

"Isn't that great?"

001 tilted its bird head at the question, transformed into the youth in black, and stood opposite them, asking in confusion:

"Weren't you two together?"

Song Yu said nothing.

Bai Linlin didn't want to admit he was feeling a bit awkward.

After all, that... that thing, asking him "if his hand hurt."

It was still too...

"247, your face is so red."

001 said, very earnestly.

Bai Linlin: "..."

The night was quiet. The mole poked its head out of the hole, watching the car and the "people" in the distance.

There was the scent of demons; they were communicating.

"Let's talk business. Didn't this Wolf Demon hurt you last time? Did no one from the 749 Bureau help you?"

"Not needed."

Bai Linlin closed his eyes upon hearing this, about to lecture him, but the next second:

"I am going to pull the wolf's fangs for you."

The youth in black looked over, expressionless and serious.

"...Okay."

They eventually walked over to the burrow. The area was a mess, with clear, oversized wolf paw prints—not the kind left by normal animals.

Bai Linlin crouched down, peering into the pitch-black hole. Song Yu used his phone as a flashlight, though his gaze remained fixed on the back of the "person's" neck.

"What is this?"

The youth in black stood nearby, answering calmly:

"Likely a demon, unregistered."

Bai Linlin tilted his head, *poof*—he transformed into a bird, tucked his wings, and prepared to lean in for a closer look.

But at that movement, not only did the "youth in black" transform into a sparrow to block his path with its wings, but a voice also came from above:

"Linlin."

Bird: "..."

It felt like being kept away from a campfire.

Bai Linlin tucked his wings back. Though he was a bit indignant, he still *pitter-pattered* backward.

001 raised its wings, channeling demonic energy to probe inside and see what was going on.

But just then, another fluctuation rippled through the air.

It was coming from the direction of the orphanage.

"My shield..."

Before Bai Linlin could finish, the sparrow in front of him had already vanished, leaving only a golden afterimage.

-

Soon, the forest returned to silence. A fluffy head poked out of the burrow, paws extended, standing upright as it curiously watched the buildings in the distance.

The buildings were brightly lit, filled with children.

The mole had intended to stay put, but it was too worried. Extending its paws, it scurried over.

The moon hung in the sky, and the small woods were very quiet.

When Bai Linlin arrived, 001 was looking down at a massive wolf tail, his expression cold and pale.

Black blood pooled on the ground.

It had cut off its tail to escape.

"Are you alright?"

The "youth" jogged over. Seeing the scene, he took a step back, but then forced himself forward again.

"Are the children at the orphanage okay?"

001 shook his head: "They are fine. Your shield was very effective."

Bai Linlin beamed at this, lifting his chin. This was something he had learned at the Central Bureau—from defending himself, to defending others, and finally to defending a larger area.

The bird had mastered it perfectly.

001 had been the one to remind him, but he didn't know much about the Wolf Demon, so he wanted to lean in and ask.

But his wrist was caught.

Song Yu pulled him over with ease, looking down at the "person," frowning:

"It's dirty there."

The youth in black stood under a streetlamp nearby, looking at the wolf tail with some displeasure. He had almost caught it.

247 must be getting impatient.

He raised a hand, channeling demonic energy to clean up the mess on the ground before looking over.

...

"Let go first, we're outside."

The "youth" frowned, pulling at his fingers with very little force, though he couldn't break free, whispering a negotiation.

Song Yu: "Why?"

"Why what? We're on official business, you keep holding me like this..."

Bai Linlin looked up, intending to purse his lips, but they were still stinging, which only made him angrier.

Before he could protest, a shadow fell over them. The "youth in black" stood between the person and the bird, his gaze open and frank, simply watching.

"..."

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
001不知道为什么不继续了，毕竟这和电视剧里的有点像，或许是因为路灯的缘故，它这个时候注意到了人的喉结上有星星点点的痕迹。

砰得一声。

地面上多了个灰棕色小雀，直接扑棱翅膀站在了宋郁的肩头，探着鸟头去看，眼睛亮亮的。

“247你——”

白粼粼一听这个语气就知道大事不妙，直接打断道：

“既然现在找不到狼妖，那要不回去吧？”

宋郁垂眸看着面前的“人”，确切地说在盯着那个唇瓣，没有回答什么，直到自己被“强制”地拉走了。

小雀因为惯性往后栽了下，在半空中很利落地完成了后空翻，然后扑棱翅膀站在了“少年”的肩头。

继续探头看247的脖子。

白粼粼：“……”

-

翌日。

也是办酒席的第二天，宋郁在客厅里打电话，对面是他爷爷。

“嗯，我想好了。”

“办一个独立的户口，然后慢慢地带着它出去露面，应该能适应的。”

电话那头的宋峥国也是点了点头，总归这个身份是个过渡的，等到结了婚，鸟儿自然就在宋家的户口本上了。

“有打算就可以。”

宋峥国说完这话之后看了下时间，觉得应该是早上了，于是开口道：

“小郁，记得做些早饭，桐城没有祥云阁……那蟹黄包鸟儿也吃不到了。”

“你说我们投资下祥云阁如何？让他们在桐城开个分店？”

“……”

宋郁最后也是说了一些别的事，最后一句是：

“它还在睡，我去叫它了。”

老头一大早的，脸色红红的，把电话给撂了。

卧室。

白粼粼在床上睡得很舒服，直到被拦腰抱了起来，唇角被轻轻地吻了下。

“少年”压根没反应过来，睁开眼睛的时候，宋郁已经在替他卷袖口了。

啊？

白粼粼甚至以为那是错觉，他不由自主地想开口问一下：

“你……”

“早上好。”

宋郁面色平和，好似对刚才的事情完全不知情，只是问：

“饿不饿？”

“待会九点再去福利院好么？”

一切安排得很是妥帖。

白粼粼出门前在挑选腰带，他还是很喜欢修身的，古着的皮面材质显得很高级，再搭配个贝壳挂饰会很有亮点。

但他扣不好。

宋郁走过来，很自然而然地用手握住了那截腰，低头在帮忙弄那个卡扣。

“少年”其实觉得有点太近了，他想要说不用他，但是又觉得这样过于窝囊……

有什么害怕的？

不就是亲了一口。

白粼粼侧着脸，耳垂通红。

“粼粼，腰后的卡扣不好弄，往前一些。”

白粼粼回了回神，很听话地往前站了下，手臂微微曲着，掌心抵着那个肩头，侧头看了下自己腰后，这个腰带很好看的。

他待会再戴个耳夹。

配套的！

“少年”不自觉地心情好了起来，完全没有注意这和拥抱没有任何区别。

腰后的卡扣，完全可以从背后弄，而不是从正面来环抱着弄。

“好了么？”

宋郁的手背青筋微微凸起，抬手按住那个单薄的腰背，往自己身前压，面不改色地道：

“没有，我看不到那个边缘。”

白粼粼心想怎么会看不到，不由自主地往前贴了下，有些郁闷，但在侧头的时候耳垂碰到了对方的唇。

一秒，两秒。

宋郁很自然地低头了。

但怀里的“人”一个劲地往外偏头，抬手去抵他的肩头，又在低声说些“放开”之类的话。

他不爱听。

宋郁抬手握住了那个后颈，把那个下巴扳了回来，垂眸看着。

白粼粼立马就要抬手施法，但是手指被挤开了，金线一下子散开了。

“这不公平。”

人开口道，语气沉哑。

白粼粼张了张口，刚想反驳，但下一秒对方就道：

“粼粼只用我。”

“用完就跑。”

语调悠悠的。

白粼粼一下子面色变得很红，心想不就是发情期用用吗？至于说得这么……搞得他好像是负心汉一样？

他抿了抿了唇，仰头就看了过来，很是不怕事地道：

“那你要什么？”

空气里安静了一两秒。

“我要奖励。”

-

第二日的酒席的照旧是热热闹闹，001今天出门的比较早，没有和247他们一路，一来是去小树林里检查下妖力波动，二来是早点吃饭。

老师们也认识了这位“妖怪”朋友，很关照地给了很大分量的菜。

001端端正正地坐着，面色认真，拿着独一份的叉子开始吃饭。

虔诚ing。

福利院的门外早就停了一辆黑车。

不过人还没有下来。

“少年”在里面试着亲吻，其实有些紧张，掌心都有些汗。

宋郁其实等了好一会，后面在想着要不算了，但刚想要开口，“人”就倾身过来了。

温热的唇瓣贴了过来。

持续了一两秒。

宋郁的手其实是微微动了下的，但是硬生生压下了动作。

“少年”撤开了，双颊红扑扑的，怔怔地分享感受：

“好像没有那么可怕。”

“我没有亲过人……”

白粼粼说得的确是实话，他小时候在孤儿院也不喜欢亲亲的，会浑身发烫，经常藏到门后面，老师们说他害羞过了头。

“是么？”

宋郁的声音很是沉哑。

总之算是完成了任务。

白粼粼下车的时候浅蓝色的头发自动变成普通的黑色，化形成了昨天的那个普通少年，去吃自己的席了。

独留宋郁一个人在车里调整。

-

大约在下午两点钟的时候，他们再次去了那个小树林。

001原本是想要查一下那土洞里的小妖，但是走过去才发现土洞不见了，取而代之的是一座由石头垒成的小庙。

好似凭空而起。

整整齐齐的。

甚至门口的杂草都清理得干干净净。

白粼粼此刻再次化成蓝羽小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒地往前走，赶在旁边小雀和人开口之前挥了下翅膀，胸有成足地道：

“我有盾。”

鸟优雅地调动起来妖力，周身立马围着一个金色的罩子，挺胸抬头。

001倒是也蹲在旁边了，用手托着下巴，认真道：

“看着很结实。”

鸟点了点头：“那是！”

白粼粼大摇大摆地进去了，然后看到了一个画像，仰着鸟头观摩了一下，觉得这张一般般，远远不如爷爷在家里画得好。

鸟又啪嗒啪嗒地往左边墙壁看了看，全是石头块，往右边墙壁看了看，也一样。

白粼粼心想这也没什么特殊的，刚要转身离开，突然看到了门口侧边的阴影处趴着一个黑不溜秋的东西，正在直勾勾地看着他。

“啊——”

鸟伸着翅根啪嗒啪嗒地从里面冲了出来。

很急。

宋郁皱了皱眉，立马伸手去接了。

001直接抬手一挥，小庙直接坍塌，光秃秃的，只留下一个探出脑袋的鼠头。

“……”

“……”
chunks.englishText:
001 didn’t know why it stopped, though the scene felt somewhat reminiscent of a television drama. Perhaps it was the way the streetlights hit, but at that moment, it noticed a scattering of faint marks on the man’s Adam’s apple.

*Thump.*

A small, grey-brown sparrow appeared on the ground. It flapped its wings, hopped directly onto Song Yu’s shoulder, and craned its neck to get a better look, its eyes bright and inquisitive.

“247, you—”

The moment Bai Linlin heard that tone, it knew trouble was brewing and cut in immediately:

“Since we can’t find the wolf demon right now, why don’t we just head back?”

Song Yu lowered his gaze to look at the “person” in front of him—or more accurately, he stared at those lips. He didn’t offer a reply, remaining silent until he was “forcibly” pulled away.

The little sparrow tipped backward from the sudden momentum, but it executed a clean backflip in mid-air before flapping its wings to land on the “youth’s” shoulder.

It continued to crane its neck, peering intently at 247’s throat.

Bai Linlin: “……”

-

The next day.

It was the second day of the wedding banquet. Song Yu was in the living room, speaking on the phone with his grandfather.

“Yes, I’ve thought it over.”

“I’ll set up an independent household registration for it, then slowly start bringing it out into public. It should be able to adapt.”

On the other end of the line, Song Zhengguo nodded. In any case, this status was merely a transition; once the marriage was official, the bird would naturally be added to the Song family’s registry.

“As long as you have a plan, that’s all that matters.”

After saying this, Song Zhengguo checked the time. Judging it to be morning, he spoke up:

"Xiao Yu, remember to make some breakfast. Tongcheng doesn't have a Xiangyun Pavilion... that little bird won't be able to have those crab roe buns anymore."

"What do you think about us investing in Xiangyun Pavilion? We could have them open a branch here in Tongcheng?"

"..."

Song Yu eventually brought up a few other matters, ending the call with:

"It’s still sleeping. I’m going to go wake it up."

The old man, flushed with excitement early in the morning, hung up the phone.

***

In the bedroom, Bai Linlin was sleeping soundly until he was scooped up by the waist and felt a soft kiss pressed against the corner of his lips.

The "young man" hadn't even processed what was happening; by the time he opened his eyes, Song Yu was already rolling up his sleeves for him.

*Huh?*

Bai Linlin almost thought it was an illusion. He couldn't help but want to ask:

"You..."

"Good morning."

Song Yu’s expression was serene, as if he were completely oblivious to what had just happened. He simply asked, "Are you hungry?"

"Shall we head to the orphanage at nine?"

Everything was arranged with meticulous care.

Before heading out, Bai Linlin was picking out a belt. He still had a fondness for slim-fit styles; the vintage leather material looked high-end, and pairing it with a seashell charm added a brilliant touch.

But he couldn't get the buckle fastened.

Song Yu walked over, naturally wrapping his hand around that slender waist, and leaned down to help him secure the clasp.

The "young man" felt that they were standing a bit too close. He wanted to tell him that he didn't need any help, but that felt too cowardly...

*What is there to be afraid of?*

*It was just a kiss.*

Bai Linlin kept his face turned away, his earlobes flushed a deep, burning red.

"Linlin, the clasp at the small of your back is tricky. Step forward a bit."

Bai Linlin snapped back to reality and obediently stepped forward. He kept his arms slightly bent, his palms pressed against the other man’s shoulders, and glanced back at his waist. This belt was truly beautiful.

He would wear an ear cuff later to match.

A matching set!

The "young man" felt his mood brighten involuntarily, completely oblivious to the fact that their current position was no different from an embrace.

The clasp at the back could easily have been fastened from behind, rather than by wrapping around from the front.

"Is it done yet?"

The veins on the back of Song Yu’s hand stood out slightly. He pressed a hand against that thin, lithe waist, pulling the boy closer to his own chest, and said with a perfectly straight face:

"Not yet. I can’t see the edge of the clasp."

Bai Linlin wondered how he could possibly not see it. He leaned forward instinctively, feeling a bit sullen, but as he turned his head, his earlobe brushed against the other man’s lips.

One second. Two seconds.

Song Yu lowered his head, his movements entirely natural.

But the "person" in his arms kept trying to pull away, raising a hand to push against his shoulder while whispering things like "let go."

He didn't care to listen.

Song Yu reached up, his hand closing firmly around the nape of the boy’s neck. He forced the chin back around, his eyes lowered, pinning the boy in his gaze.

Bai Linlin was about to raise his hand to cast a spell, but his fingers were nudged aside, and the golden threads instantly dissipated.

"That’s not fair."

The figure spoke, his voice low and raspy.

Bai Linlin opened his mouth, ready to retort, but the other man continued in a languid, drawn-out tone:

"Linlin only uses me."

"And runs away as soon as he’s done."

Bai Linlin’s face flushed a deep, burning red. *It was just for the heat cycle, wasn't it?* he thought indignantly. *Is it really necessary to make it sound so… like I’m some kind of heartless cad?*

He pursed his lips, tilted his head back, and met the man’s gaze, looking entirely unfazed as he challenged:

"Then what do you want?"

The air grew still for a second or two.

"I want a reward."

***

The banquet the following day was as boisterous as ever. 001 had headed out earlier than usual, choosing not to walk with 247 and the others; partly to check for demonic energy fluctuations in the small grove, and partly to get a head start on his meal.

The teachers had grown accustomed to this "demon" friend and, being quite fond of him, had served him an extra-large portion.

001 sat ramrod straight, his expression solemn as he picked up his unique fork and began to eat.

*Pious mode: activated.*

Outside the orphanage gates, a black car had been idling for some time.

The occupant had yet to step out.

The "youth" inside was practicing how to kiss, feeling genuinely nervous, his palms slick with sweat.

Song Yu had actually been waiting for quite a while, and just as he was about to give up and call it off, the "person" beside him leaned in.

Warm lips pressed against his.

It lasted for only a second or two. Song Yu’s hand had twitched, a reflexive movement he had forcibly suppressed.

The "youth" pulled back, his cheeks flushed a deep, rosy red. He blinked, dazed, as he shared his thoughts:

"It didn't seem so scary after all."

"I’ve never kissed anyone before..."

Bai Linlin was telling the truth. Even back in the orphanage, he had never liked being kissed; it always made his whole body burn, often driving him to hide behind doors. The teachers used to say he was pathologically shy.

"Is that so?"

Song Yu’s voice was low and gravelly.

In any case, the task was complete.

When Bai Linlin stepped out of the car, his pale blue hair shifted automatically into a mundane black. He resumed the guise of the ordinary youth from the day before and went off to attend his banquet.

He left Song Yu alone in the car to compose himself.

-

Around two o'clock in the afternoon, they returned to the small grove.

001 had originally intended to investigate the minor demon in the earthen burrow, but upon arriving, they discovered the burrow was gone. In its place stood a small shrine constructed of stacked stones.

It looked as if it had sprung up out of thin air.

Everything was perfectly orderly. Even the weeds at the entrance had been cleared away.

Bai Linlin, currently transformed back into his blue-feathered bird form, waddled forward with a *patter-patter* sound. Before the little sparrow beside him could speak, he waved a wing, looking entirely self-assured.

"I have a shield."

The bird elegantly channeled its demonic energy, instantly cloaking itself in a golden barrier before puffing out its chest with a proud tilt of its head.

001 crouched down beside it, resting its chin in its hand, and remarked with earnest sincerity, "Looks sturdy."

The bird nodded. "You bet it is!"

Bai Linlin strutted inside. It craned its avian neck to inspect a portrait hanging on the wall, only to decide that the artwork was mediocre at best—nowhere near as good as the paintings Grandfather kept at home.

The bird then pattered over to the left wall, which was nothing but solid stone, and checked the right wall, which was exactly the same. 

*Nothing special here,* Bai Linlin thought. Just as it turned to leave, it caught sight of a pitch-black, nondescript lump huddled in the shadows by the doorway, staring straight at it.

"Aaaah—!"

The bird flapped its wings frantically, scrambling out of the shrine in a panicked rush.

It was in quite a hurry.

Song Yu frowned and immediately reached out to catch it.

001 simply flicked a hand, and the small shrine collapsed instantly, leaving nothing behind but a barren patch of ground and a single, startled rat head poking out from the debris.

"..."

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
鸟带着个金色光罩，站在人的肩头，伸着鸟头往下看。

001刚想问些什么，下一秒那鼠立马就钻进洞里了，无影无踪。

顺带收走了那个挂画。

宋郁皱眉：“鼹鼠？”

鸟不知道这个，只是收了收翅膀，觉得心惊胆战的，太吓人了。

黑黢黢的。

长得和花枝鼠、皮皮它们完全不一样。

001想了想，打算直接用妖力逼迫出来，掌心金纹线流转。

但就在这时，不远处传来人声：

“好几天没去了，再放点东西吧。”

“我倒是问街坊邻居了，这小庙不是孩子们堆的，甚至一会儿有一会儿没的，说不准真是神明。”

“保佑小宋和我们——”

老师们提着小竹篮，怔怔地看着面前的一人一鸟一“人”，很是恍惚。

尤其看到那坍塌的小庙。

以及旁边“少年”伸出去的手。

老师们面色震惊，连忙走了过来：

“哎呀，你们这干什么呢？”

“这是庙啊！”

001往后站了几步，背了背手。

白粼粼立马化形成了“少年”模样，站了出来，先行问道：

“老师，你们怎么来了？”

大约花了十多分钟，前因后果才算是说明白。

老师们觉得这是庙，里面是小鸟神，这么拆了岂不是大不敬？

白粼粼：“……”

并且她们还带了些水果糕点拿来供奉，看着真的是像模像样的。

最后在老师们的要求下，他们重新垒起来了小庙，然后诚心诚意地道歉了，这事儿才算翻篇。

老师们甚至从口袋里拿出来了三根红绳，是那种寺庙里求的，会绑着红木雕，桃木的，给了两个妖怪一个人。

-

酒席要连办三天。

在第三天中午的时候，他们再次去向了那个树林里，这次倒是没撞见老师们，而是撞见了一群孩童们。

他们在上供一些小零食，然后在排队磕头。

“……”

“……”

白粼粼化形之后问了前因后果才明白了，这些孩子说是早就有这个庙了，上面的画像印着他们的小猫小狗，所以来拜一拜，希望宠物长命百岁。

？

难道不是鸟？

白粼粼回来问了问001和宋郁这件事，对此得到的回答是：

“小鸟。”

“小鸟。”

老师们看到的也是小鸟。

白粼粼有些不解，那为什么孩子们看到的是不一样的？

等到这群孩子们散了，001才走了过去，抬手就要调动妖力，但就在这时，小庙门口里扔出来一个东西。

一包辣条。

“……”

但这还没完，里面的东西似乎很焦灼地在等待，见他们没离开，又开始往外扔东西。

一包跳跳糖。

一个干皮的橘子。

一包威化饼。

一个真知棒。

……

全是些鸡零狗碎的东西。

白粼粼沉默了，他蹲下身子，抬手去看了看那个干皮橘子，心想这放多久了？

“你是妖怪么？”

不如直接询问。

001还在抬手调动着妖力，心想如果还不出来，那它就直接“请”出来。

也就在这时，一个黑黢黢的小鼠从庙里探出来头，看了看外面的“人”，爪子紧紧地扶着石头垒起的墙。

“你们是……”

白粼粼砰得一下化成蓝羽小鸟，啪嗒啪嗒地走了过去，这会也不害怕了，只是转了一圈。

“妖怪。”

鼹鼠这几天也察觉出来了，这两个妖似乎和前面的狼妖不太一样，或许是……好妖？

它刚想要在试探几句，但就在这时。

面前圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟用翅膀幻化出来了文书，举过来，昂首挺胸地通知道：

“我即将组建桐城妖怪管理局，是中央下派的工作人员……”

白粼粼话还没说完。

面前的鼹鼠就泪眼朦胧的，直接哭了。

用爪子在擦泪。

“……”

宋郁微微抬了下眉，001也直接化形成小雀了，啪嗒啪嗒地走过去。

没见过妖哭。

看一下。

大约过了有半个钟头。

白粼粼才了解了前因后果，桐城这里在很多年前是有妖怪驻扎的，分配的是一座山头，但由于国家那时候经济还没有那么发达，很多城市都是依靠原始的矿产资源起来的，桐城也不例外。

山头逐步变平，树木被砍伐售卖，山体不断削减，最后成为小小的土坡。

之后就是城镇化。

鼹鼠只是闭关了一段时间，结果再醒来的时候，什么都变了。

“我就知道，中央没有忘记我们！”

鼹鼠老泪纵横。

鸟也是有些感慨，伸翅膀拍了拍对方的鼠头，颇有种领导干部的风范。

“是这样，我毕竟刚到，中央那里的津贴还在路上，重建是需要时间和精力的，你不要着急，桐城会建设起来的。”

白粼粼看了看地面上一些不太好的“食物”，立马仰起鸟头看了看宋郁，伸出来了翅膀。

一个黑色挎包被递了过来。

鸟从里面倒出来一些不错的零食，零零散散有一大堆，饼干、面包、干果、汽水、肉干……应有尽有。

鼹鼠眼睛都变得亮亮的。

白粼粼抬起翅膀把挎包往后面一递，这次是灰棕色小雀，立马伸喙叼住了，站在了后方，很乖巧的样子。

“这些东西你先拿着，这是应急使用的。我初来乍到桐城，你是本地的小妖，我以后有些问题还要多多问你。”

“你放心，桐城管理局一旦建起来，这些吃的都是小事，这小庙也不会这么轻而易举地被别人推到，往后的生活会越来越好的。”

鼹鼠拿着一包饼干，感动极了。

鸟收了收翅膀，倒是也没忘记正事，询问了一下狼妖的事，毕竟这件事不解决始终是个问题。

鼹鼠一五一十地把那天的事全部告知了。

“我其实见过它几次，大多都在这附近游走，这里是桐城的郊区，我觉得它肯定还在附近游荡。”

“而且它喜欢吃人类的幼童。”

001其实是知道这件事的，但它一开始并没有在意这个，找到狼妖，杀了就好。

但是现在它不出来。

喜欢吃人类的幼童……

-

黄昏时分。

白粼粼在福利院的办公室里看着面前的一个……身高一米、身着背带裤、脸颊圆润、表情严肃的小孩儿。

“……”
chunks.englishText:
A bird, surrounded by a golden aura, stood on a person’s shoulder, stretching its neck to peer downward.

001 had just been about to ask something, but in the next second, the mouse dove into the hole and vanished without a trace.

It had even taken the hanging painting along with it.

Song Yu frowned. "A mole?"

The bird didn't know much about such things; it only tucked its wings in, feeling a sense of trepidation. It was too terrifying.

And pitch black.

It looked nothing like the fancy mice or the other pets.

001 pondered for a moment, intending to use its demon power to force the creature out, golden threads of energy swirling in its palm.

But just then, voices drifted over from not far away:

"We haven't been here for a few days, let's leave some more offerings."

"I actually asked the neighbors; this little shrine wasn't built by the children. It even appears and disappears at times. Who knows, it might really be a deity."

"Bless little Song and us—"

The teachers, carrying small bamboo baskets, froze as they stared at the person, the bird, and the "person" standing before them, looking utterly bewildered.

Especially when they saw the collapsed little shrine.

And the hand that the "youth" had extended toward it.

The teachers’ expressions shifted to shock, and they hurried over.

"Oh my, what are you all doing?"

"This is a shrine!"

001 stepped back a few paces and clasped its hands behind its back.

Bai Linlin immediately shifted into the form of a "youth" and stepped forward, asking first:

"Teachers, why are you here?"

It took about ten minutes to explain the cause and effect.

The teachers insisted that this was a shrine housing a little bird deity, and tearing it down like this was a grave act of disrespect.

Bai Linlin: "..."

They had even brought fruit and pastries to offer, and it really did look like a proper setup.

In the end, at the teachers' insistence, they rebuilt the little shrine and offered sincere apologies, which finally put the matter to rest.

The teachers even took three red strings out of their pockets—the kind blessed at temples, tied with carved rosewood and peach wood charms—and gave them to the two demons and the one human.

-

The banquet was to be held for three consecutive days.

On the afternoon of the third day, they headed back to the woods. This time, they didn't run into the teachers, but rather a group of children.

The kids were offering small snacks and taking turns kowtowing.

"..."

"..."

After Bai Linlin shifted back, he asked about the situation and finally understood: the children claimed this shrine had been here for a long time, and the portrait inside depicted their pet cats and dogs, so they came to pray for their pets to live long, healthy lives.

?

Wasn't it a bird?

Bai Linlin went back to ask 001 and Song Yu about it, and the answer he received was:

"A little bird."

"A little bird."

That was what the teachers had seen, too—a little bird.

Bai Linlin was puzzled. Why did the children see something different?

Once the children dispersed, 001 walked over, raising its hand to channel its demon power, but just then, something was tossed out from the entrance of the little shrine.

A pack of spicy strips.

"..."

But it didn't stop there. The thing inside seemed anxious; seeing that they hadn't left, it started throwing more items out.

A pack of popping candy.

A dried-out orange.

A pack of wafers.

A lollipop.

...

It was all just a collection of odds and ends.

Bai Linlin fell silent. He crouched down and picked up the dried-out orange, wondering how long it had been sitting there.

"Are you a demon?"

It was better to just ask directly.

001 was still channeling its demon power, thinking that if it didn't come out, it would just "invite" it out.

At that moment, a pitch-black little mouse poked its head out of the shrine, looked at the "people" outside, its claws gripping the stone wall tightly.

"Who are you..."

Bai Linlin shifted into a blue-feathered bird with a *poof*, walked over with a *patter-patter*, no longer afraid, and circled around.

"Demons."

The mole had sensed it over the past few days; these two demons seemed different from the wolf demon they had encountered earlier. Perhaps they were... good demons?

It was just about to probe further, but then—

The round, blue-feathered bird before it conjured a document with its wings, held it up, and announced with its head held high:

"I am about to establish the Tongcheng Demon Management Bureau, and I am a staff member dispatched by the Central Authority..."

Before Bai Linlin could finish, the mole’s eyes welled up with tears, and it began to sob.

It wiped its eyes with its paws.

"..."

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly, and 001 also shifted into a small sparrow, walking over with a *patter-patter*.

It had never seen a demon cry before.

It wanted to see.

About half an hour later, Bai Linlin finally understood the whole story. Many years ago, demons had been stationed in Tongcheng, assigned to a mountain. But because the country's economy wasn't as developed back then, many cities relied on raw mineral resources, and Tongcheng was no exception.

The mountain was gradually leveled, trees were cut down and sold, the mountain body was constantly shaved away, and eventually, it became a small dirt mound.

Then came urbanization.

The mole had just been in seclusion for a while, and when it woke up, everything had changed.

"I knew it! The Central Authority hasn't forgotten us!"

The mole wept with joy.

The bird felt a wave of emotion, reaching out a wing to pat the mouse’s head with the air of a high-ranking official.

"It’s like this: since I just arrived, the subsidies from the Central Authority are still on the way. Reconstruction takes time and effort. Don't worry, Tongcheng will be built up."

Bai Linlin looked at the subpar "food" on the ground, immediately tilted his bird head to look at Song Yu, and extended a wing.

A black messenger bag was handed over.

The bird poured out a pile of decent snacks—biscuits, bread, dried fruit, soda, jerky... everything one could want.

The mole’s eyes lit up.

Bai Linlin passed the bag back with his wing. This time, a grey-brown sparrow immediately caught it in its beak and stood behind, looking very well-behaved.

"Take these for now; they are for emergencies. I’m new to Tongcheng, and since you are a local demon, I’ll have many questions for you in the future."

"Don't worry, once the Tongcheng Bureau is established, these snacks will be the least of your concerns, and this little shrine won't be so easily pushed over by others. Life will only get better from here."

The mole clutched a pack of biscuits, deeply moved.

The bird tucked its wings in, not forgetting the main task, and asked about the wolf demon. After all, this problem had to be solved.

The mole told them everything that had happened that day, point by point.

"I've actually seen it a few times, mostly wandering around here. This is the outskirts of Tongcheng, and I’m sure it’s still lurking nearby."

"And it likes to eat human children."

001 had actually known about this, but it hadn't paid much attention to it at first—find the wolf demon and kill it, that was all.

But now, it wouldn't come out.

It likes to eat human children...

-

At dusk.

In the orphanage office, Bai Linlin stared at a... one-meter-tall child wearing overalls, with round cheeks and a stern expression.

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
第65章

001决定以身入局，它幻化成了人类幼童的模样，站在了“少年”的面前，很坚定地看着对方。

“……”

“眼神不对。”

001闻言立马开始调整，低着头，然后再抬起来脸。

眼神透彻了些。

很努力了。

白粼粼现在化成了本体的模样，在桌面上啪嗒啪嗒地来回走，还是有些担心：

“你不是说狼妖能察觉到你的气息么？”

“你当诱饵不太合适吧？”

001幻化的幼童模样其实是“黑衣少年”的缩小版，脸颊很是圆润，站得规规矩矩的，低头看了看自己背带裤。

这是福利院的人提供的。

“不会的，我可以收敛我的气息，在这里的幼童堆里待一下就可以了。”

001其实深思熟虑过，狼妖的速度和攻击爆发性都非常强，如果让人类来当诱饵，很大程度上会被撕咬开来，很危险。

至于247提议的它去……更是不行。

它才一岁半。

不可以。

林子里那个小妖压根没有多少妖力了，况且它是桐城的本地妖，还有别的用处。

“那我们什么时候准备行动？”

站在地板上的幼童仰头看了过来，定定地回答道：

“今晚。”

-

宋郁已经在车里备了一些东西，虽然不清楚妖怪是否需要，但是万一有什么血腥的场面需要处理，多少还是可以帮上忙的。

至于福利院内此刻灯火通明，白粼粼在门口那里站着，旁边是他的老师们，都在看着中间的场景，有些欲言又止的。

“少年”此刻还是那个幻化出来的普通高中生的样子，毕竟来回切换让弟弟妹妹产生认知混淆就不好了。

“粼粼……这……”

老师们的声音非常小，只是有些好奇地想要询问一下，毕竟一楼大厅的情形实在是奇怪。

一个幼童正在挨个拥抱其他的孩子们。

白粼粼知道这是在沾染上孩子的味道，但是看起来……仪式感很强。

“这它要喝奶吗？”

白粼粼：“……”

大约在晚上七八点钟的时候，001已经坐上了车子，拿着一瓶悦鲜活纯牛奶，喝了好几口。

对着窗户外面的人类道：

“谢谢！”

老师们：“……不客气。”

那个林子的位置距离福利院是有一定距离的，宋郁开车也是想着或许可以充当一个“庇护所”，以防万一。

很快就到了小庙的位置。

鼹鼠早已恭候多时，白粼粼这会儿幻化成了自己的人形，浅蓝色的头发在夜里显得尤为明显，他俯身蹲下，询问道：

“你弄好了吗？”

鼹鼠仰头看了好一会，不太理解。

“……”

一个圆滚滚的鸟出现在了地面上，收了收翅膀，再次询问了相同的问题。

这次鼹鼠才反应过来了，立马去介绍自己做的陷阱：

“这个坑足足有三米，下面还有竹子形成的刺，掉进去一定会被扎到！”

鸟闻言走了过去，啪嗒啪嗒地凑过去看了看，发现的确弄得有模有样的。

“我用石子砸它了，对方白天没成功对我下手，晚上肯定要来的。”

鼹鼠打算自己出去也引诱一下。

001穿着背带裤，此刻正在四处张望，妖力波动很弱，但应该就在附近躲藏着。

夜色暗沉。

宋郁被关在了车内，看着林子里的捕猎行动，他的手放在了方向盘上，其实还是有些担心。

人，真的没有什么用。

但就在这时，一阵翅膀的扑棱声传来了过来，蓝羽小鸟稳当当地站在了车子的后视镜上，挥了挥翅膀，车门自动打开。

宋郁刚想要问些什么，圆滚滚的鸟已经进来了，收了收翅膀，斜着眼睛看了一下他。

鸟咳咳两声：

“001说我可能会妨碍它。”

鸟，也没有什么用。

而此刻林子那里已经准备就绪了，穿着背带裤的幼童，还背着一个小书包，里面放着一步手机，传来的都是提前录好的孩童声音。

小庙此刻被垒好了。

001佯装之前来的那些孩子一样，开始认认真真地上供，把自己身上的妖怪气息藏得严严实实的。

很耐心地等着。

车内的“少年”趴在车窗边边上，其实有种紧张又刺激的感觉，毕竟他没有亲眼见过狼妖，001是怎么制服它的……

宋郁一直在看着副驾上的“少年”，在对方试图按开车窗的时候皱了皱眉，直接握住了“人”的手腕。

往这边拉了下。

“粼粼。”

白粼粼其实有点想要去帮忙的，砰得一下化成了小鸟，很灵活地把翅膀尖尖抽了出来，攀爬到了人的肩头，继续从另外一个方向眺望。

桐城天气不错，天空上挂着一轮月亮，能够照亮林子的小道。

“我或许能帮上一些忙呢？”

鸟收了收翅膀，有些感叹。

宋郁其实是想说些什么的，但是此刻，外面突然起了急风，车窗外面传来了一声狼嚎。

他面色微微变了。

小道上的落叶几乎全部被吹上来了，拍打在车窗上。

白粼粼也有些紧张，爪子都并了并，因为001掩盖了妖怪的气息，他感知不到……

但就在这时——

“247！”

一阵急促的喊声。

白粼粼一下子慌了，侧头看向旁边的人，宋郁皱了皱眉，虽然觉得奇怪，但还是道：

“去吧。”

万一出事了。

他的小鸟会很难受的。

白粼粼立马化作一道浅蓝色的影子，从车里飞了出去，很快就消失在宋郁的视野里。

而与此同时。

林子里像是在搏斗，但又看不清，鸟刚飞过来的一瞬间，就看到了那个修长的黑衣少年，面色很冷，手背上有血，看过来的时候只是道：

“你怎么来了？”

鸟懵懵的，站在了地面上，羽毛被冷风吹得蓬蓬得，开口解释了下：

“我听见你叫我了。”

001皱眉：“我不可能让你来这里！”

“狼妖会拟声。”

白粼粼此刻再迟钝也反应过来，整个鸟炸毛了，立马朝着车子的方向飞了过去。

001的速度更快，那狼妖现在完全不和它正面打了，方才察觉到它的身份后连连回退，最后舍弃了它的后腿。

“……”

黑衣少年面色都变了。

几次了？

鼹鼠在后面也在快速地奔跑着，朝着那边的小道过去，黑黝黝的眼睛很是专注，它觉得自己可以帮一些忙。

咣当——

车头被重物击打的声音。

白粼粼心里一沉，它几乎翅膀都飞不稳当了，他的人，他的人……

001到了现场，松了一口气，转身就去追逃窜的黑影了。

小道上一片狼藉。

车门都被弄开了。

白粼粼歪歪扭扭地飞了过来，看到了不远处的“人”，有种劫后余生的感觉。

他差点忘了，他给了最重要的羽毛。

人周身有个光罩，比普通的金色罩子还要漂亮，萦绕着流动的小羽毛。

宋郁其实还在担心，这个狼妖看起来又逃走了，不知道——
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 65

001 decided to enter the fray itself. It shifted into the form of a human child, stood before the "youth," and looked at him with great determination.

"..."

"The look in your eyes is wrong."

Upon hearing this, 001 immediately began to adjust, lowering its head before lifting its face again.

The gaze was clearer now.

It was trying very hard.

Bai Linlin, currently in his original form, paced back and forth on the tabletop, still worried.

"Didn't you say the wolf demon could sense your aura?"

"Is it really appropriate for you to be the bait?"

The child form 001 had taken was essentially a miniature version of the "black-clad youth," with very round cheeks. It stood perfectly straight, looking down at its own overalls.

These had been provided by the orphanage staff.

"It will be fine. I can suppress my aura and just stay among the children here for a while."

001 had actually thought this through carefully. The wolf demon’s speed and explosive attack power were immense; if a human were used as bait, they would likely be torn apart, which was too dangerous.

As for 247’s suggestion that it go... that was even more out of the question.

It was only a year and a half old.

Absolutely not.

The little demon in the woods barely had any demon power left, and besides, as a local demon of Tongcheng, it had other uses.

"Then when do we plan to act?"

The child standing on the floor looked up and answered firmly:

"Tonight."

-

Song Yu had already prepared some things in the car. Although he wasn't sure if demons needed them, if there were any bloody scenes that needed cleaning up, he could at least be of some help.

Inside the orphanage, the lights were blazing. Bai Linlin stood at the entrance, flanked by his teachers, who were watching the scene in the center with hesitant expressions.

The "youth" was still in his usual guise as an ordinary high school student; after all, switching back and forth would only confuse the younger children.

"Linlin... this is..."

The teachers’ voices were very soft, merely curious, as the situation in the first-floor lobby was truly strange.

A young child was going around hugging the other children one by one.

Bai Linlin knew this was to pick up the scent of the children, but it certainly looked... like a very intense ritual.

"Does it... does it need milk?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

Around seven or eight in the evening, 001 was already in the car, holding a bottle of fresh milk and taking several gulps.

It said to the humans outside the window:

"Thank you!"

The teachers: "...You're welcome."

The location of the woods was some distance from the orphanage, and Song Yu had driven there thinking he might serve as a "sanctuary" just in case.

They soon arrived at the site of the little shrine.

The mole had been waiting for a long time. Bai Linlin had shifted into his human form, his light blue hair particularly striking in the night. He crouched down and asked:

"Is it ready?"

The mole looked up for a long time, not quite understanding.

"..."

A round bird appeared on the ground, tucked its wings, and asked the same question again.

Only then did the mole react and immediately began to introduce the trap it had set.

"This pit is a full three meters deep, and there are bamboo spikes at the bottom. If it falls in, it will definitely be impaled!"

Hearing this, the bird walked over, pattering along to take a look, and found that it was indeed quite well-constructed.

"I threw stones at it. It didn't manage to get me during the day, so it will definitely come tonight."

The mole intended to go out and lure it as well.

001, wearing its overalls, was looking around. The fluctuations of demon power were faint, but the creature had to be hiding nearby.

The night was dark and heavy.

Song Yu was locked inside the car, watching the hunt in the woods. His hands rested on the steering wheel, though he was still quite worried.

Humans, truly, were of little use.

But just then, a flurry of wingbeats sounded. The blue-feathered bird landed steadily on the car’s side mirror, waved its wings, and the car door opened automatically.

Song Yu was just about to ask something, but the round bird had already hopped inside, tucked its wings, and glanced at him sideways.

The bird coughed twice.

"001 said I might get in its way."

Birds, it seemed, were also of little use.

Meanwhile, the scene in the woods was ready. The child in overalls, carrying a small backpack containing a phone that played pre-recorded sounds of children, waited.

The little shrine had been rebuilt.

001 pretended to be one of the children who had come earlier, beginning to offer sacrifices earnestly while hiding its demon aura completely.

It waited with great patience.

The "youth" in the car leaned against the window, feeling a mix of tension and excitement. After all, he had never seen a wolf demon in person, and he wondered how 001 would subdue it...

Song Yu kept his eyes on the "youth" in the passenger seat. When the other tried to roll down the window, he frowned and grabbed the "person’s" wrist.

He pulled him closer.

"Linlin."

Bai Linlin actually wanted to help. With a *poof*, he shifted into a small bird, nimbly pulled his wingtips free, climbed onto the man’s shoulder, and continued to peer out from a different angle.

The weather in Tongcheng was pleasant, and a moon hung in the sky, illuminating the path in the woods.

"I might be able to help a little, you know?"

The bird tucked its wings, sighing slightly.

Song Yu wanted to say something, but just then, a sudden gust of wind rose, and a wolf’s howl echoed from outside the car window.

His expression shifted slightly.

The fallen leaves on the path were blown up, slapping against the car windows.

Bai Linlin was also nervous, his claws clenching together, because 001 had masked its demon aura, and he couldn't sense it...

But then—

"247!"

A sharp, urgent cry.

Bai Linlin panicked instantly. He turned to look at the man beside him. Song Yu frowned, and although he found it strange, he said:

"Go."

In case something happened.

His little bird would be very upset.

Bai Linlin immediately transformed into a streak of light blue and flew out of the car, vanishing from Song Yu’s sight in an instant.

At the same time.

In the woods, it sounded like a struggle, but it was hard to see clearly. The moment the bird flew over, it saw the slender black-clad youth, his expression icy, blood on the back of his hand. When he looked over, he only said:

"Why are you here?"

The bird was stunned, landing on the ground, its feathers puffed up by the cold wind. It explained:

"I heard you calling me."

001 frowned. "I would never let you come here!"

"The wolf demon can mimic voices."

Bai Linlin, slow as he was, finally realized what had happened. His feathers stood on end, and he immediately flew back toward the car.

001 was faster. The wolf demon was no longer fighting it head-on; having sensed its true identity, it had retreated repeatedly, eventually sacrificing its own hind leg to escape.

"..."

The black-clad youth’s expression changed.

How many times had this happened?

The mole was running quickly behind, heading toward the path, its dark eyes focused. It felt it could be of some help.

*Bang—*

The sound of a heavy object striking the front of the car.

Bai Linlin’s heart sank. He could barely keep his wings steady. His person, his person...

001 arrived at the scene, let out a sigh of relief, and turned to chase the fleeing shadow.

The path was a mess.

The car door had been forced open.

Bai Linlin flew over, wobbling, and saw the "person" nearby, feeling a sense of having narrowly escaped death.

He had almost forgotten—he had given him his most important feather.

The man was surrounded by an aura, even more beautiful than a standard golden shield, with small, flowing feathers circling him.

Song Yu was still worried. The wolf demon seemed to have escaped again, and he didn't know—

chunks.chineseText:
“吓死我了……呜呜呜”

白粼粼彻底绷不住了，他化成了“少年”的模样，脸颊都开始往下淌泪，手都变得冰凉。

他就说他不会忘记的。

前几天没给宋郁套盾是因为水豚在课上讲过，一次施法只能套一次盾，破了就没了，只有护身羽毛是一直在的，终身有效。

而且和本体相联。

白粼粼被那句“狼妖会拟声”吓得六神无主，他忘记了他前几天刚刚确认过的，福利院都套上盾了，怎么可能会漏掉宋郁？

“少年”脑子混乱无比，觉得自己被吓哭了实在是很丢人，抬手去擦脸颊上的泪，冷风阵阵，他咳嗽了几声。

直到面前多了一道阴影。

白粼粼被抱进了怀里，后颈被压着，宋郁只是试图低头安抚，刚想要开口，但他的腰上多了两个手臂，“少年”抱得很紧。

冷风还在吹。

宋郁眼眸微动，声音都很哑：

“不哭了。”

“粼粼的羽毛很漂亮。”

-

001气疯了，金线流动，把地面上的狼妖捆得结结实实，断了一条尾巴，又断了一条后腿。

比自治区的那只狡猾多了。

“你也是妖怪！为什么要帮着人类来杀我！”

“你们想要融入人类？痴心妄想！”

地面上的狼妖龇牙咧嘴的，灰色的皮毛此刻已经脱得差不多了，显得可怖又贪婪。

001面色很冷，盯着地面上的狼妖，瞳孔都变成纯金的了，没有任何情绪。

狼妖以为这是被自己说中了，心想说不准还可以策反一下，它刚要开口，但是下一秒自己的后腿直接被扯开了。

血淋淋的。

“啊——”

“你害得我朋友迟迟拿不到挂饰。”

伯劳鸟，性情凶残。

大约十几分钟后，鼹鼠跟过来的时候，这里已经被清理得很干净了，一看就是妖力术法。

它直立起来身子，看了下旁边的黑衣少年，对方正在很认真地去缠狼牙，面色认真。

鼹鼠莫名觉得怪怪的，环顾了下四周，处理完了？

“你好，我这个缠不好了，你可以帮我一下吗？”

黑衣少年蹲下身子，面色困惑，它不知道这次怎么这么难缠，抬手把狼牙递了过去。

鼹鼠愣了下，接了过来，它常年用前肢，对树根的脉络都是能够理清的，区区一个麻绳而已。

林子里安安静静的。

“好了。”

001接了过来，眼睛都亮了，拿着两个狼牙在月光下仔细地看了看。

嗯！

247一定会喜欢的。

……

事情解决的一瞬间，妖力动态信息就已经传到了中央。

山羊正在加班，看到动态信息狼妖的编号变灰了，不由得点了点头，看来南市管理局的确妖才济济。

N247和部下相处得还是很好的。

下午还上报了鼹鼠的信息。

不错。

山羊托了托眼镜，联系了下南市的丹顶鹤，毕竟算是老同学。

光幕很快就接通了。

丹顶鹤很是优雅地整理了下丝带，抬头看了过来，从容问道：

“有什么事吗？”

山羊很诚恳地道：“N247在桐城的任务展开非常好，它已经找到了当时失联的妖怪。”

“还有你们南市管理局调去的专员N001也完成了XX自治区的追捕行动，处置的干净利落。”

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，很自然地道：

“它们做得其实一般般了，毕竟一个年龄才一岁半，另外一个两周岁，我们南市管理局也是想着，让它们去见见世面。”

“被中央选中去培训和执行联合任务，这都是没想过的事，现在看来倒是不辱使命。”

一番话下来。

山羊：“……”

别以为我听不出来。

山羊叹了口气，最后还是虚心请教：

“你们是怎么培养的？”

“我们哺乳动物近年来这么优秀的很少。”

丹顶鹤咳咳了一下，心里其实满意得不行，这两个真是给它争脸面了。

“啊这个……要细细地谈了。”

时间一点一滴地过去。

丹顶鹤说完之后觉得有些口干舌燥的，用翅膀端起来一杯咖啡，优雅地啜饮了下。

补了一句：

“当然这也要看个妖的潜质。”

学不会不能怪我。

山羊：“……”

与此同时，桐城。

保时捷的车头、车门都遭到了巨大的打击，几乎无法上路。

白粼粼眼皮肿肿的，一直主动牵着宋郁的手，看到001回来了也没有松开，只是过去询问：

“追到了吗？”

黑衣少年见到这副场景愣了下，立马走了过来，担忧地道：

“你怎么哭了？”

“不要哭了，我把它弄死了，这是狼牙。”

鼹鼠：“……”

它这会儿怎么不探头看了。

001变成了小雀的模样，扑棱翅膀飞到了“少年”的肩头，叼着那两个狼牙，递了过去。

白粼粼睫毛都还泛着潮气，他没有着急收下这个，只是歪头问：

“你没事吧？”

小雀歪头，只好伸了下翅根，啪嗒啪嗒地转了一圈。

完好无损。

白粼粼这才收下那两个狼牙，干干净净的，被麻绳绑着，正好是一对。

他想了想：“我们一妖一个吧。”

小雀愣了下，然后有些拘谨地并了并爪子，它伸了伸鸟头。

“少年”抬手给小雀挂在脖子上了。

“那我们先回家吧？”

白粼粼回头看了看宋郁，又去侧头看001，一人一鸟都没有任何意见。

最后看向地面上的鼹鼠。

“……我也没有意见。”

“拜拜。”

-

车子坏掉了，最后拿走了车里的贵重物品，他们打车回了兴安小区。

白粼粼一直都没有化成本体，只是牵着人的手，还有些失心落魄的。

他后知后觉反应过来，宋郁对他很重要很重要……

上辈子的遗憾已经没有了。

老师们知道了他活着的事，昌平孤儿院也合并成了条件更好的桐城福利院，这里有更多的孩子需要照顾。

老师们爱他，但他长大了。

彼此已经有了交叉口。

白粼粼现在精彩绝伦的人生，全部都是遇见宋郁之后，没有他……他不会去管理局，不会在里面当大王，不会在做任务的途中遇见001。

他完全接受不了宋郁出事。

“少年”垂着下巴，眼尾洇出来一片红，情绪还是有些不稳，好似那些朦朦胧胧的东西一下子变得清晰了。

“到了。”

司机在前面说道，不过还是在车内后视镜看了下后面，这浅蓝色的头发……怎么染出来的？

不过视线还没有看多久，一道很冷的声音传了过来：

“付过去了。”

之后就是车门关上的声音，以及那人肩头那只小雀盯过来的眼神。

“……”

司机莫名觉得怪怪的。

-

001是在电梯到了七楼出去的，不过还是回头看了下里面，有些担忧。

为什么247看起来还是有些不高兴。

眼尾都红了。

“早些休息。”
chunks.englishText:
"I was scared to death... wuwuwu."

Bai Linlin completely broke down. He had shifted into his "youth" form, tears streaming down his cheeks, his hands icy cold.

He kept telling himself he wouldn't forget.

He hadn't cast a shield on Song Yu a few days ago because the Capybara had mentioned in class that a single spell could only apply one shield at a time; once it shattered, it was gone. Only the protective feathers were permanent, effective for life.

And they were linked to his original form.

Bai Linlin had been so rattled by the phrase "wolf demons can mimic voices" that he lost his composure. He had forgotten that he had just confirmed it a few days prior—he had shielded everyone at the orphanage, so how could he have possibly missed Song Yu?

The "youth" felt his mind in total chaos. He felt it was incredibly shameful to be scared to tears, so he raised his hand to wipe his face. The cold wind gusted, and he coughed a few times.

Then, a shadow fell over him.

Bai Linlin was pulled into an embrace, his nape pressed against a chest. Song Yu was trying to lower his head to soothe him, just about to speak, when two arms wrapped around his waist—the "youth" was holding on very tightly.

The cold wind continued to blow.

Song Yu’s eyes flickered, his voice raspy:

"Don't cry anymore."

"Linlin’s feathers are very beautiful."

-

001 was furious. Golden threads flowed, binding the wolf demon on the ground tightly. It had already lost a tail and a hind leg.

It was much more cunning than the one in the autonomous region.

"You’re a demon too! Why are you helping humans kill me!"

"You want to integrate with humans? That’s just wishful thinking!"

The wolf demon on the ground bared its fangs and snarled. Its gray fur had mostly been stripped away, making it look both terrifying and greedy.

001’s expression was icy. It stared at the wolf demon, its pupils turning pure gold, devoid of any emotion.

The wolf demon thought it had hit a nerve and figured it might be able to turn the tables. Just as it was about to speak, its hind leg was ripped clean off.

It was bloody.

"Ah—!"

"You made my friend late in getting their accessory."

Shrikes are cruel by nature.

About ten minutes later, when the mole caught up, the area had already been cleaned up thoroughly—it was clearly the work of demonic arts.

It stood up on its hind legs and looked at the black-clad youth nearby, who was earnestly tying up some wolf fangs with a serious expression.

The mole felt inexplicably strange. It looked around. Was it finished?

"Hello, I can't seem to tie this well. Could you help me?"

The black-clad youth squatted down, looking puzzled. It didn't know why this was so difficult this time, and it handed over the wolf fangs.

The mole paused, then took them. It used its forelimbs all year round and could untangle any tree root; a mere piece of hemp rope was nothing.

The forest was quiet.

"Done."

001 took them back, its eyes brightening. It held the two wolf fangs up to the moonlight to inspect them carefully.

Mm!

247 will definitely like these.

……

The moment the matter was resolved, the dynamic information regarding the demonic power was transmitted to the Central Bureau.

The Goat was working overtime. Seeing the wolf demon’s ID turn gray in the system, it couldn't help but nod. It seemed the Nanshi Management Bureau was indeed full of talented demons.

N247 was getting along quite well with its subordinates.

It had even reported the mole’s information that afternoon.

Not bad.

The Goat adjusted its glasses and contacted the Red-crowned Crane in Nanshi—they were old classmates, after all.

The light screen connected quickly.

The Red-crowned Crane elegantly adjusted its silk ribbon, looked up, and asked calmly:

"Is there something the matter?"

The Goat said sincerely: "N247’s mission in Tongcheng is unfolding very well. It has already found the demon that went missing at the time."

"And the specialist N001, dispatched by your Nanshi Management Bureau, has also completed the pursuit operation in the XX Autonomous Region. It was handled cleanly and efficiently."

The Red-crowned Crane tucked its wings and said naturally:

"They actually did just an average job. After all, one is only a year and a half old, and the other is two. Our Nanshi Management Bureau just thought we’d let them go out and see the world."

"Being selected by Central for training and joint missions was something we never even considered. Now it seems they haven't disgraced their mission."

After that string of words.

Goat: "..."

Don't think I can't tell you're bragging.

The Goat sighed, but finally asked for advice with an open mind:

"How do you train them?"

"We mammals have very few that are this excellent in recent years."

The Red-crowned Crane coughed. It was actually incredibly satisfied; these two had really brought glory to its name.

"Ah, this... that would be a long conversation."

Time ticked by.

After the Red-crowned Crane finished speaking, it felt a bit parched. It picked up a cup of coffee with its wing and sipped it elegantly.

It added:

"Of course, it also depends on the individual demon's potential."

If they can't learn, don't blame me.

Goat: "..."

Meanwhile, in Tongcheng.

The Porsche’s front end and doors had suffered heavy damage and were barely roadworthy.

Bai Linlin’s eyelids were swollen. He kept holding Song Yu’s hand, and even when he saw 001 return, he didn't let go. He just went over to ask:

"Did you catch it?"

The black-clad youth was stunned by the scene, then immediately walked over, saying with concern:

"Why are you crying?"

"Don't cry anymore. I killed it. These are the wolf fangs."

Mole: "..."

Why isn't it peeking now?

001 transformed into its small sparrow form, flapped its wings, and flew onto the "youth’s" shoulder, holding the two wolf fangs in its beak and offering them.

Bai Linlin’s eyelashes were still damp. He didn't rush to take them, but tilted his head and asked:

"Are you okay?"

The little sparrow tilted its head, then stretched out its wing roots and did a little spin.

Completely unharmed.

Only then did Bai Linlin accept the two wolf fangs. They were clean, tied with hemp rope, and made a perfect pair.

He thought for a moment: "Let's each take one."

The little sparrow froze, then tucked its claws in somewhat bashfully and stretched out its bird head.

The "youth" raised his hand and hung it around the sparrow’s neck.

"Shall we go home now?"

Bai Linlin looked back at Song Yu, then turned to look at 001. Neither the human nor the bird had any objections.

Finally, he looked at the mole on the ground.

"...I have no objections either."

"Bye-bye."

-

The car was ruined, so they took the valuables and hailed a taxi back to Xing'an Residential Complex.

Bai Linlin never shifted back into his original form. He just held onto the person’s hand, feeling somewhat lost.

He realized belatedly that Song Yu was very, very important to him...

The regrets of his past life were gone.

The teachers knew he was alive, and the Changping Orphanage had merged into the better-equipped Tongcheng Welfare Institute, where there were more children who needed care.

The teachers loved him, but he had grown up.

Their paths had already intersected.

Bai Linlin’s brilliant life was entirely due to meeting Song Yu. Without him... he wouldn't have gone to the Management Bureau, he wouldn't be the "King" there, and he wouldn't have met 001 during a mission.

He absolutely could not accept anything happening to Song Yu.

The "youth" lowered his chin, the corners of his eyes stained red. His emotions were still unstable, as if those hazy, indistinct things had suddenly become clear.

"We're here."

The driver said from the front, though he glanced at the rearview mirror. This light blue hair... how did he dye it?

But before he could look for long, a very cold voice came from the back:

"Paid."

Then came the sound of the car door closing, and the gaze of the little sparrow on the person’s shoulder staring at him.

"..."

The driver felt inexplicably strange.

-

001 got out when the elevator reached the seventh floor, but it still looked back inside, feeling a bit worried.

Why did 247 still look so unhappy?

The corners of its eyes were red.

"Rest early."

chunks.chineseText:
宋郁说了句告别的话，之后就牵着“人”上去了，门口的黑衣少年站了一会儿，然后低头看了下脖子上的狼牙。

心情有些雀跃。

配套的。

它和247一妖一个。

……

八楼。

进门之后，“少年”就被抱住了，浅蓝色的发尾被一双手压着，脸颊埋在人的肩头，他的腰也是被扣着的，动不了。

纤细的手臂环了过来。

挂住宋郁的脖子。

“对不起……我不该把你丢在那里的。”

“那根本就不是001在叫我，是狼妖拟声的，吓死我了……我好害怕……”

白粼粼有些呜咽地说着，他是真的被吓得不轻，如果他没给护身羽毛……那怎么办？

宋郁是个人类。

他都没有保护好他。

生死面前，什么不确定的都确定了。

白粼粼无法想象没有宋郁的生活。

“我没事。”

“你给我羽毛的时候不是同我讲了作用么？”

“粼粼一直记得的。”

“前几天你还问了不是么？”

宋郁抬手捏着那个后颈，垂着眼眸，一边轻声安抚，一边低头吻掉了眼尾的泪。

他的小鸟，喜欢他的。

“呜呜……我知道，但我今天忘记了，我以为你——”

后面那句没有说完。

白粼粼说不下去，他是真的很反应迟钝，宋郁总是替他打点一些东西，以至于他忘记了，自己是妖怪，他是个人类。

人类去管理局，本来就危险。

去中央那次不就知道了么？

他怎么不长记性呢？

狼妖对自己可能没什么威胁，但是对人类那是轻而易举就能吃掉的。

白粼粼抱得很用力。

……

晚上十点半。

宋郁叫了一家私房菜，清淡的粥和小菜，至于001，则是给它发了个烧烤店截图。

最近对方已经在钻研手机功能了，目前学会了在图片上勾勾画画。

没过两分钟。

截图上被圈了很多东西。

但把鸡翅给筛出去了。

同时发过来一条语音，转文字一看：

[人，我还想要串串香，可以吗？]

宋郁打字过去：

[可以。]

夜里，楼下再度打开了电视机，茶几上摆满了美食，都市生活剧再次开播，小雀一边用爪子把着串串棍子，一边聚精会神地看着屏幕。

至于宋郁这里，“少年”在床上睡着了，精神很不好，后面被抱起来也没什么反应。

他皱了皱眉。

白粼粼只是在做梦，梦里他是个小鸟，不过是不会说话的那种，羽毛蓬松，在栖杆上稳稳地站着。

好像他本来就是小鸟。

周遭的一切都是白茫茫的，直到一个人放过来了另一只鸟，它很漂亮，体型和自己一样，羽毛顺滑又亮丽，底色都是蓝色的。

但是对方色彩不止一种。

鸟头那里还有个小小的红点。

白粼粼有些胆怯，他浑身上下只有一个颜色，渐变的蓝，不知道这只鸟能不能看上他。

鸟悄悄地挪动，挪动。

最后贴在了一起。

白粼粼觉得浑身都有些热，他要引起这只鸟的关注，那……那他大鹏展翅一下吧？

“啾啾！”

那只鸟似乎回头了。

……

“宋-郁！”

卧室里的“少年”闭着眼睛，喃喃地喊出了这两个字。

宋郁弯腰撑着手臂，再次唤道：

“粼粼，先吃点饭。”

白粼粼眼皮还是有些肿，被捞起来的时候还很懵懵的，那只漂亮的鸟……

视线渐渐清晰，出现了一张优越的面庞，眼尾有颗红痣。

“吃饭？”

他有些恍惚，腕骨被捏着，其实还是有点昏昏沉沉的。

但拒绝已经来不及了。

宋郁把他抱过去了，说实话实在很舒服，白粼粼立马把头靠在了人的肩头，阖上了眼睛。

人刚把用勺子盛满粥。

“……”

最后其实也没吃几口，白粼粼体温又开始上来了，昏昏沉沉的，一开始还是张着口对着勺子，后面就偏开了。

去咬喉结。

宋郁气息都有些不稳，最后把“少年”放下了，起身去了浴室。

在水流的声音下，白粼粼觉得体内不舒服的感觉越来越重，他不由自主地去往浴室那里走。

“宋-郁。”

“宋-郁。”

闷闷的声音，伴随着敲门的节奏声。

鸟要进来。

宋郁不知道该怎么办，拉开了门。

……

“人”被抵在墙上，脸颊湿哒哒的，下巴被顶得微微往上，口腔里有些含不住。

白粼粼衣服都没有脱，衬衫被水打湿了，睫毛也是挂着水珠，抬手环着对方的脖子。

予取予求。

“嗯……哈”

很轻的呻吟声，伴随着一点委屈。

宋郁用手臂托着“人”，一边吻，一边垂眸看着后颈的那个印记，还在亮，一阵一阵的。

“好点了么？”

“少年”唇瓣是被弄肿了，被放开还有点迷茫，他仰头还要，但是人偏开了头。

白粼粼一下子抿出了泪。

宋郁只好抵过去额头，解释道：

“你会不记得。”

“我记得！”

“少年”生气了，硬生生地去拉那个脖子下来。

浴室里有升腾的雾气，两个人影交缠着，一方把控着节奏，一方就那么承受着。

吻落在了脖颈处，很轻。

白粼粼仰了仰头，皮肤泛着点粉，指尖都有冒出来的金线，一点点，像是炸开的烟花。

“嗯……”

宋郁气息有些不稳，但还是停了动作，看了看情况：

“缓解了么？”

白粼粼生气了，张口就咬住了人的肩头，血液一点点地冒了出来，尖利的牙齿磨了磨。

腿在往上勾。

“宋郁……我要上去”

鸟觉得自己是鸟，体型不大的。

要骑马。

人抬起来手臂，稳稳地托着“少年”的后腰，捏过来那个下巴，再次吻了过去。

湿热。

顺滑。

有种满溢的感觉。

宋郁早就成年了，同时，成年的还有一只小鸟。

初出茅庐。

“……呼呼……不行。”

宋郁捏开了那个后颈，“少年”还在张着口，红润的舌尖就在口腔里放着，很乖顺的样子。

察觉到动作停了。

立马就开始哭。

好似流不完的水。

宋郁只是抵住“人”的额头，哑着声音安抚道：

“粼粼，我不能这样，我要和你订婚，那样才是合适的，粼粼。”

“粼粼。”

一句句，一声声。

“少年”朦朦胧胧的，只是委屈，他觉得他被拒绝了，像是那个梦一样。

鸟，那个鸟，很好看。

白粼粼控制不住地“求偶”，他幻化出来羽毛，用唇瓣叼着，去吻向宋郁的唇瓣。

“给你，给你。”

宋郁就这么感受着怀里人的主动，手臂的血管一点点地鼓胀了起来，最后深吻了过去，在间隙之中，轻声道：

“没事……我伺候你。”

夜色如水，月亮高悬。

“嗯……唔。”

“哈……”

“可以吗？粼粼不要皱眉，要告诉我。”

……
chunks.englishText:
Song Yu said a parting word, then led the "person" upstairs. The black-clad youth stood at the doorway for a while, then lowered its head to look at the wolf fang around its neck.

Its mood was quite buoyant.

A matching set.

It and 247, one demon each.

……

Eighth floor.

After entering, the "youth" was pulled into an embrace. His light blue hair tips were pressed by a pair of hands, his cheek buried in the person’s shoulder. His waist was also held firmly, unable to move.

Slender arms wrapped around him.

Clinging to Song Yu’s neck.

"I'm sorry... I shouldn't have left you there."

"That wasn't 001 calling me at all; it was the wolf demon mimicking the voice. It scared me to death... I was so afraid..."

Bai Linlin sobbed as he spoke. He had truly been terrified. If he hadn't given him the protective feathers... what would have happened?

Song Yu was a human.

He hadn't protected him well.

In the face of life and death, everything uncertain became certain.

Bai Linlin couldn't imagine a life without Song Yu.

"I'm fine."

"Didn't you tell me the function when you gave me the feathers?"

"Linlin has always remembered."

"Didn't you ask about it a few days ago?"

Song Yu raised a hand to stroke the nape of his neck, eyes lowered, soothing him softly while kissing away the tears at the corners of his eyes.

His little bird liked him.

"Wuwu... I know, but I forgot today. I thought you—"

He didn't finish the sentence.

Bai Linlin couldn't go on. He was truly slow to react; Song Yu always took care of things for him, to the point that he forgot he was a demon and the other was a human.

For a human to go to the Management Bureau was inherently dangerous.

Didn't he learn that when they went to Central?

Why didn't he ever learn his lesson?

The wolf demon might not have been a threat to him, but it could have devoured a human with ease.

Bai Linlin hugged him tightly.

……

10:30 PM.

Song Yu ordered some home-style takeout—light porridge and side dishes. As for 001, he sent it a screenshot of a barbecue restaurant.

The other party had been studying phone functions lately and had learned how to doodle on images.

Within two minutes.

The screenshot was circled with many items.

But it had filtered out the chicken wings.

At the same time, it sent a voice message. When converted to text, it read:

[Human, I also want skewers, is that okay?]

Song Yu typed back:

[Okay.]

At night, the TV downstairs was turned on again. The coffee table was filled with food, and the urban drama continued. The little sparrow held a skewer stick with its claws, watching the screen with rapt attention.

As for Song Yu’s place, the "youth" had fallen asleep on the bed, his spirit very low. Even when he was picked up later, he didn't react.

He frowned.

Bai Linlin was just dreaming. In the dream, he was a little bird, but the kind that couldn't speak, with fluffy feathers, standing steadily on a perch.

It was as if he had always been a little bird.

Everything around him was white and hazy, until someone brought over another bird. It was very beautiful, the same size as him, with smooth and bright feathers, the base color also blue.

But the other party had more than one color.

There was a small red dot on its head.

Bai Linlin felt a bit timid. He only had one color all over, a gradient blue. He didn't know if this bird would like him.

The bird moved quietly, closer and closer.

Finally, they pressed against each other.

Bai Linlin felt his whole body heating up. He needed to get this bird’s attention. Then... should he spread his wings like a Great Peng?

"Chirp chirp!"

The bird seemed to turn its head.

……

"Song-Yu!"

The "youth" in the bedroom closed his eyes, murmuring these two words.

Song Yu leaned over, bracing himself with his arms, and called out again:

"Linlin, eat something first."

Bai Linlin’s eyelids were still swollen. When he was scooped up, he was still very dazed. That beautiful bird...

His vision gradually cleared, revealing a superior face with a red mole at the corner of the eye.

"Eat?"

He was a bit trance-like. His wrists were held, and he was actually still feeling dizzy.

But it was too late to refuse.

Song Yu held him. To be honest, it was very comfortable. Bai Linlin immediately leaned his head on the person’s shoulder and closed his eyes.

The person had just filled a spoon with porridge.

"..."

In the end, he didn't eat much. Bai Linlin’s body temperature started rising again, and he was drifting in and out of consciousness. At first, he opened his mouth for the spoon, but later he turned away.

He went to bite the Adam's apple.

Song Yu’s breathing became unstable. Finally, he put the "youth" down and went to the bathroom.

Under the sound of running water, Bai Linlin felt the uncomfortable sensation in his body growing heavier. He couldn't help but walk toward the bathroom.

"Song-Yu."

"Song-Yu."

A muffled voice, accompanied by the rhythm of knocking on the door.

The bird wanted to come in.

Song Yu didn't know what to do, so he opened the door.

……

The "person" was pressed against the wall, his cheeks wet, his chin tilted slightly upward, his mouth unable to contain everything.

Bai Linlin hadn't even taken off his clothes; his shirt was soaked by the water, and his eyelashes were beaded with droplets. He raised his hands to wrap around the other’s neck.

Giving and taking.

"Mm... ha."

A very soft moan, accompanied by a hint of grievance.

Song Yu supported the "person" with his arms, kissing him while looking down at the mark on his nape, which was still glowing in pulses.

"Feeling better?"

The "youth’s" lips were swollen. He looked a bit lost when he was let go, tilting his head to ask for more, but the person turned his head away.

Bai Linlin instantly teared up.

Song Yu had no choice but to press his forehead against his, explaining:

"You won't remember."

"I remember!"

The "youth" was angry, forcefully pulling that neck down.

There was rising steam in the bathroom. Two figures were intertwined, one controlling the rhythm, the other just bearing it.

Kisses fell on the neck, very light.

Bai Linlin tilted his head back, his skin flushed pink, and golden threads emerged from his fingertips, bit by bit, like exploding fireworks.

"Mm..."

Song Yu’s breathing was unstable, but he stopped his movements to check the situation:

"Has it eased?"

Bai Linlin was angry. He opened his mouth and bit the person’s shoulder, blood seeping out bit by bit, his sharp teeth grinding.

His legs hooked upward.

"Song Yu... I want to go up."

The bird thought it was a bird, and it wasn't very big.

It wanted to ride a horse.

The person raised his arms, steadily supporting the "youth’s" lower back, pinched his chin, and kissed him again.

Wet and hot.

Smooth.

There was a feeling of overflowing.

Song Yu had long since reached adulthood. At the same time, a little bird had also reached adulthood.

Fresh out of the nest.

"...Huhu... no."

Song Yu pinched open that nape. The "youth" was still opening his mouth, his red, moist tongue resting inside, looking very obedient.

Noticing the movement had stopped.

He immediately started to cry.

As if the water would never stop flowing.

Song Yu just pressed his forehead against the "person’s" and soothed him in a hoarse voice:

"Linlin, I can't do this. I want to be engaged to you; that would be appropriate, Linlin."

"Linlin."

Sentence by sentence, call by call.

The "youth" was hazy, only feeling aggrieved. He felt he had been rejected, just like in that dream.

The bird, that bird, was very good-looking.

Bai Linlin couldn't help but "court." He manifested feathers, held them with his lips, and kissed Song Yu’s lips.

"Give it to you, give it to you."

Song Yu felt the initiative of the person in his arms. The veins in his arms bulged bit by bit. Finally, he kissed him deeply and, in the gaps, whispered:

"It's okay... I'll serve you."

The night was like water, the moon hung high.

"Mm... ng."

"Ha..."

"Is it okay? Linlin, don't frown, you have to tell me."

……

chunks.chineseText:
不知道过了多久，宋郁才抱着“人”出来了，面色冷淡，但骨节修长又硬。

白粼粼躺在床上，耳垂被含得肿了起来。

“睡吧。”

宋郁弯腰吻了吻“人”的额头，最后才自己去了浴室。

至于楼下。

小雀全神贯注地看着电视剧，用爪子按着遥控器，还学会了切换电视台。

物我两忘。

-

翌日清晨。

按道理来说，一切都应该顺顺利利的，宋郁如同往常一样想要亲亲他的小鸟的唇角。

但是这次……没有摸到。

人起了床，房间里空荡荡的，他几乎要PTSD了，但好在被子那里有个小小的凸起。

宋郁抬手掀开，本能地道：

“粼——”

他愣住了。

是，是鸟不错。

但是为什么这么小？

羽毛都还没有长齐，翅膀又小又短，它像是刚睡醒，摇起来了脑袋，很规律的那种：

“啾啾啾啾啾！”

翅膀也开始上下挥动。

“啾啾啾啾啾！”
chunks.englishText:
I don't know how much time passed before Song Yu finally carried the "person" out. His expression was cold, but his joints were long and hard.

Bai Linlin lay on the bed, his earlobes swollen from being held in the mouth.

"Sleep."

Song Yu leaned over and kissed the "person’s" forehead before finally going to the bathroom himself.

As for downstairs.

The little sparrow was watching the TV with rapt attention, pressing the remote control with its claws, and had even learned how to switch channels.

Totally lost in the moment.

-

The next morning.

Logically speaking, everything should have gone smoothly. Song Yu wanted to kiss the corner of his little bird’s mouth as usual.

But this time... he didn't touch anything.

He had gotten out of bed, and the room was empty. He almost had PTSD, but fortunately, there was a small bump under the quilt.

Song Yu reached out to lift it, instinctively saying:

"Lin—"

He froze.

Yes, it was a bird, alright.

But why was it so small?

Its feathers hadn't even grown in fully, and its wings were small and short. It looked like it had just woken up, shaking its head in a very rhythmic way:

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

Its wings also started flapping up and down.

"Chirp chirp chirp chirp chirp!"

chunks.chineseText:
第66章

宋郁愣神了好一会，撑着手臂低头看过去，再次唤道：

“粼粼？”

那只浑身绒毛的小鸟还在伸翅膀，一摇一摇的，像个弹簧鸡。

“啾啾-啾啾啾！”

宋郁面色微微变了，他的小鸟听不懂人话了，这种情况以前从来没有出现过。

半小时后——

001已经上楼了，在茶几边边蹲着，看着杯垫上的那只毛绒绒的幼鸟，它双手放在桌面上，很是乖巧。

“啾啾啾！啾啾啾！”

宋郁在打电话，但就在这时身后传来声音：

“247饿了。”

黑衣少年此刻化成了毛绒绒的小雀，啪嗒啪嗒地走到了蓝羽幼鸟的旁边，探了探鸟头。

宋郁其实在联系丹顶鹤，但那边似乎在忙，一直没有接，只能抬眸看向001的位置：

“你也不知道这种情况吗？”

桌上的小雀正伸了伸自己的翅膀，任由那只幼鸟一个劲地叨它的羽毛，摇了摇鸟头，道：

“我不知道。”

“但是这的确是247，它的妖力也在，只是形态……变小了。”

“只能问问丹顶鹤了。”

宋郁皱眉，现在就是联系不上，001从一开始就试着传讯了，但是光幕只能接到管理局，丹顶鹤并不在，值班的是一只眼镜蛇，它并不了解现在的情况。

“那它现在能吃什么？”

宋郁迈步走了过去，一边打电话，一边俯身询问，桌子上的小雀沉思：

“幼鸟的话，我想想……”

很快001就鸟眼一亮，但它的翅膀被一个劲地叨着，蓝羽幼鸟费了好长时间功夫都没弄下来羽毛。

小雀自己拔了一根，叼着递过去了。

“我去去就回。”

001扑棱翅膀从窗户外飞出去了。

宋郁只能接着等，但好在这个时候，电话终于通了，那边的丹顶鹤似乎是刚起：

“怎么了？247不是工作很顺利么？”

这个语气很是悠哉，俨然是在休假。

宋郁只好把事情的经过说了一遍，那头的语气立马变了：

“啊？”

“你说什么？”

-

此刻外面。

小雀扑棱翅膀到处飞着，环顾了下四周，它打算给247找点高蛋白的东西。

幼鸟都是吃小虫子的。

001虽然不记得小时候的事了，但关于这个还是记得清清楚楚的，幼鸟是需要一直照顾的，直到羽毛丰满。

夏天蝉鸣不断，到处都是一片生机。

001环顾了下四周，最后在一片林子里落下，没一会就叼了不少软软的白色虫子，满载而归地朝着小区那里飞。

房子内。

“我就知道会出事，它根基还是太不稳了。”

丹顶鹤在视频里面甚至直接是本体了，伸着鸟头看着茶几上毛绒绒蓝羽幼鸟，面色凝重。

“这是自我休眠形态了。”

宋郁闻言面色不算太好，是很严重么？

“你们做了吗？”

丹顶鹤很是言简意赅。

宋郁：“……”

“没有，只是……”

视频那里的丹顶鹤面容严峻，收了收翅膀，在房间里踱步走了几圈，最后再次道：

“我们坦诚一些好么？”

这种情况一看就是被*得太重了，它年纪又小，根本不会双修，说不准压根就没有运转妖力。

“真的没有。”

宋郁闭了闭眼。

丹顶鹤这下是真得不明白了，它百思不得其解：

“那你们只是亲了亲？你的血确实可以缓解一下247的不适，但应该不会造成妖力紊乱……”

宋郁侧头看了下茶几，毛绒绒的蓝羽幼鸟此刻还在用力地咬他的指腹，很嫩的喙，其实压根就不疼。

他的小鸟不能一直这么下去。

何必讳疾忌医。

“用了手指。”

房间里一下子沉默了，视频里的丹顶鹤踱步的动作一顿，怔住了，而后鸟眼泛出奇异的光：

“你是说。”

“你只用手指就把247给弄得****？”

这里已经是成人频道了。

此刻小雀刚刚从窗户那里飞过来，稳稳地降落在了茶几上，看到了手机在视频，歪了歪鸟头。

宋郁其实面色有些红，看到001回来了之后，立马把摄像头对过去了，毛绒绒的小鸟叼着好几个虫子。

小雀收了收翅膀，懵懵的，看见丹顶鹤也只是点了点头。

它还有更重要的事情。

247饿了。

小雀叼着一个肥肥的虫子，开始试图往蓝羽幼鸟的喙里塞。

宋郁瞳孔一缩：“等下……”

手机视频里传来尖叫：

“001！你不要乱喂它！！！”

……

最后那几只虫子被放到了个玻璃罐子里，小雀有些沮丧，探头看了看几个虫子。

软软的。

还会爆汁的。

为什么不喜欢？

宋郁已经让人送上来专用的鹦鹉奶粉了，在用水温调试着，茶几上有个小毛巾，里面就站着一只毛绒绒的蓝羽幼鸟。

翅膀还在时不时地挥舞一下。

求奶舞，是和尚鹦鹉的独有表现。

001啪嗒啪嗒地走到毛巾边边，收了收翅膀，仰着鸟头看人在用手背试温度。

“粼粼？”

宋郁拿着那个小勺子靠近，里面是糊化的“奶粉”，幼鸟像是上了发条一样，开始立马挥动小翅膀，鸟头一动一动。

很急切的样子。

001在旁边看着，垫了垫爪子，心想这比肉虫子好吗？

或许是因为它看得太过于专注了。

人把第二勺挪了过来，问：

“要尝尝吗？”

小雀紧张，爪子并了并。

001伸了伸喙，稍稍品鉴了下，味道怪怪的，它甩了甩鸟头。

“给、给247喝吧。”

好难喝。

宋郁很细致地用勺子喂，之后用纸巾擦了擦它的小鸟的短喙，被叨了一口。

丹顶鹤已经在赶过来的路上了，按照对方的说法来看，是他的小鸟先天根基不稳，年纪又小，发情期又始终没有完全散出来，种种因素导致它承受不住。

直接开始进入休眠模式。

宋郁说不担心是假的。

桐城管理局还没有建起来，这些事情都在他的小鸟一个妖的肩上……

-

大约在下午三点钟的时候。

丹顶鹤风尘仆仆地过来了，在外面敲了敲门，是小雀打开的。

001仰了仰鸟头，本来是想要打招呼的，但是对方直接抬步走了过来，鸟啪嗒啪嗒地往后让开了位置。

“247在哪里？”

宋郁没有想到会这么快，在沙发上陪着他的小鸟，茶几上还有些一些烧烤，那是给小雀儿点的午饭。

“它在睡觉……”

人直接站了起来，看着面前的“女士”直接幻化成一只优雅的丹顶鹤，对方伸过去了翅膀，覆在半空中，金光流转。

丹顶鹤思忖了片刻：

“还好，挺稳定的。”

“没事。”

宋郁只是皱眉问：

“粼粼要多久才能恢复？”

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀：“造成这次变化的原因就是它不能控制发情带来的妖力波动，雏鸟，一个实打实的雏鸟。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 66

Song Yu stood stunned for a long while. He braced himself on his arms, leaned down, and called out again:

"Linlin?"

The fluffy little bird was still stretching its wings, swaying back and forth like a spring-loaded toy.

"Chirp-chirp! Chirp-chirp-chirp!"

Song Yu’s expression shifted slightly. His little bird could no longer understand human speech; such a situation had never occurred before.

Half an hour later—

001 had already come upstairs and was squatting by the edge of the coffee table, watching the fluffy fledgling on the coaster. It kept its hands on the tabletop, looking very well-behaved.

"Chirp-chirp-chirp! Chirp-chirp-chirp!"

Song Yu was on the phone, but just then, a voice came from behind him:

"247 is hungry."

The black-clad youth had transformed into a fluffy little sparrow, waddling over to the side of the blue-feathered fledgling and poking its head out.

Song Yu was actually trying to contact the Red-Crowned Crane, but the other party seemed busy and hadn't answered. He could only lift his gaze to where 001 was:

"Do you have no idea what’s happening, either?"

The little sparrow on the table stretched its wings, letting the fledgling peck at its feathers incessantly. It shook its bird head and said:

"I don't know."

"But this is definitely 247. Its demonic power is still there; it’s just that its form... has shrunk."

"We can only ask the Red-Crowned Crane."

Song Yu frowned. The problem was that he couldn't get through. 001 had been trying to send a message from the start, but the light screen could only connect to the Administration Bureau. The Red-Crowned Crane wasn't there; the one on duty was a cobra, and it didn't understand the current situation.

"Then what can it eat now?"

Song Yu walked over, phone still to his ear, and leaned down to ask. The sparrow on the table pondered:

"For a fledgling, let me think..."

Soon, 001’s bird eyes brightened, but its wings were being pecked at relentlessly. The blue-feathered fledgling had spent a long time trying to pull out a feather but failed.

The sparrow plucked one out itself, held it in its beak, and offered it over.

"I’ll be right back."

001 flapped its wings and flew out the window.

Song Yu had no choice but to keep waiting. Fortunately, at that moment, the call finally connected. The Red-Crowned Crane on the other end sounded like it had just woken up:

"What’s wrong? Isn't 247’s work going smoothly?"

The tone was very leisurely, clearly that of someone on vacation.

Song Yu had to explain what had happened. The tone on the other end changed instantly:

"Huh?"

"What did you say?"

—

Outside.

The little sparrow flapped its wings, flying everywhere. It scanned the surroundings, intending to find something high in protein for 247.

Fledglings eat small insects.

Although 001 didn't remember its own childhood, it remembered this clearly: fledglings need constant care until their feathers are fully grown.

Summer cicadas chirped incessantly, and the world was full of vitality.

001 looked around and finally landed in a grove. Before long, it had caught a good number of soft, white worms and flew back toward the apartment complex, fully loaded.

Inside the house.

"I knew something would go wrong. Its foundation is still too unstable."

The Red-Crowned Crane on the video call had even shifted into its true form, stretching its bird head to look at the fluffy blue-feathered fledgling on the coffee table, its expression grave.

"This is a self-induced hibernation state."

Song Yu’s expression darkened upon hearing this. Was it very serious?

"Did you two do it?"

The Red-Crowned Crane was very blunt.

Song Yu: "..."

"No, it’s just..."

The Red-Crowned Crane in the video looked stern. It tucked its wings and paced the room a few times before saying again:

"Can we be honest with each other?"

This situation clearly looked like it had been *too heavily stimulated. It was still young and didn't know how to dual-cultivate at all; it was likely that it hadn't even circulated its demonic power.

"I really didn't."

Song Yu closed his eyes.

The Red-Crowned Crane was truly baffled now. It couldn't wrap its head around it:

"Then you just kissed? Your blood can indeed soothe 247’s discomfort, but it shouldn't cause a disruption in its demonic power..."

Song Yu turned his head to look at the coffee table. The fluffy blue-feathered fledgling was currently biting down hard on his fingertip with its soft beak—it didn't actually hurt at all.

His little bird couldn't go on like this.

Why hide the illness and avoid the doctor?

"I used my fingers."

The room fell silent. The Red-Crowned Crane in the video stopped pacing, stunned, and then its bird eyes shone with a strange light:

"You mean."

"You got 247 to ******* just by using your fingers?"

This was already adult-rated territory.

Just then, the little sparrow flew in through the window, landed steadily on the coffee table, and saw the video call. It tilted its head.

Song Yu’s face was actually a bit flushed. Seeing 001 return, he immediately turned the camera toward it. The fluffy little bird was holding several worms in its beak.

The sparrow tucked its wings, looking dazed, and just nodded when it saw the Red-Crowned Crane.

It had more important things to do.

247 was hungry.

The sparrow held a fat worm in its beak and began trying to stuff it into the blue-feathered fledgling’s beak.

Song Yu’s pupils constricted: "Wait a second..."

A scream came from the phone video:

"001! Don't feed it randomly!!!"

...

In the end, those worms were placed in a glass jar. The sparrow looked a bit dejected, peering at the worms.

They were soft.

And they would burst with juice.

Why didn't it like them?

Song Yu had already had someone deliver specialized parrot formula and was adjusting the temperature with water. On the coffee table, there was a small towel, and inside it stood the fluffy blue-feathered fledgling.

Its wings were still flapping every now and then.

The "begging-for-milk dance" was unique to Monk Parakeets.

001 waddled over to the edge of the towel, tucked its wings, and tilted its head to watch the human test the temperature on the back of his hand.

"Linlin?"

Song Yu approached with a small spoon containing the liquefied "formula." The fledgling acted as if it had been wound up, immediately flapping its little wings, its head bobbing.

It looked very eager.

001 watched from the side, shifting its claws, thinking to itself: Is this better than meat worms?

Perhaps because it was watching too intently.

The human moved the second spoonful over and asked:

"Do you want to try some?"

The little sparrow was nervous, its claws pressing together.

001 extended its beak and tasted a little. The flavor was strange, and it shook its bird head.

"Give, give it to 247."

It tasted terrible.

Song Yu fed it meticulously with the spoon, then wiped the little bird’s short beak with a tissue, only to get pecked in return.

The Red-Crowned Crane was already on its way. According to its explanation, his little bird’s innate foundation was unstable, it was young, and its mating season had never fully dissipated. All these factors combined meant it couldn't handle the strain.

It had directly entered hibernation mode.

It would be a lie to say Song Yu wasn't worried.

The Tongcheng Administration Bureau hadn't even been established yet, and all these burdens were on his little bird’s shoulders...

—

Around three o'clock in the afternoon.

The Red-Crowned Crane arrived, travel-worn. It knocked on the door, and the little sparrow opened it.

001 tilted its head, intending to greet the guest, but the other party walked straight in. The bird waddled backward to make room.

"Where is 247?"

Song Yu hadn't expected it to be so fast. He had been sitting on the sofa accompanying his little bird; there was still some barbecue on the coffee table—lunch he had ordered for the little sparrow.

"It’s sleeping..."

Song Yu stood up, watching the "lady" in front of him transform directly into an elegant Red-Crowned Crane. The crane extended its wings, covering the air above the fledgling, golden light flowing.

The Red-Crowned Crane pondered for a moment:

"It’s alright, quite stable."

"It’s fine."

Song Yu just frowned and asked:

"How long will it take for Linlin to recover?"

The Red-Crowned Crane tucked its wings: "The cause of this change is that it cannot control the surge of demonic power brought on by the mating season. A fledgling—a true, literal fledgling."

chunks.chineseText:
茶几上的小雀还在探头看毛巾里的蓝羽幼鸟，闻言仰了仰鸟头。

丹顶鹤余光一扫，看到了这只。

“……”

“半斤八两。”

001俨然是不明白为什么说到了斤两，它只知道小摊贩会有老板说“多少钱一斤”这样的话。

鸟懵懵的。

小雀继续去看蓝羽幼鸟了，上方还在交谈：

“具体的恢复时间……现在几月了？”

“七月末。”

“那也快了，妖怪的发情期不会那么长，顶多一个月，它这次休眠状态的话，相当于回归本体，从幼鸟到成鸟，发情期到求偶，完整地走一个过程，就可以了。”

宋郁只是担心：

“那需要多久？”

“不会超过一个月，或许几天就可以了，今天是幼鸟的样子，说不定明天就会说话了，之后就会慢慢恢复它自己的意识。”

丹顶鹤说得很是清楚了。

不过它还是忍不住地看了下面前这位监护人的……手指，眯了眯鸟眼。

247好福气。

宋郁也没有忘记一件事，他的小鸟是来桐城上任的，管理局还没有筹建，那它就算后面恢复了，也肯定会焦虑的。

人只是问：

“那桐城的事怎么办？它现在——”

丹顶鹤优雅地拍了拍翅膀。

门口那里传来“叮咚”的声音。

小雀听到动静立马扑棱翅膀飞过去了，很乖巧地拉开了门。

宋郁抬眼看了过去，愣了下。

因为门口那里站着一众妖怪们，有很拘谨的工装黑熊，也有前排用个木棍串着包袱的花枝鼠们，它们体型有大有小，都在门外老实地站着，身边全是大大小小的箱子。

“我早就想好了，247单枪匹马的怎么能行，桐城这里的事情，南市管理局全程帮助。”

……

关于丹顶鹤带着一众妖怪来帮忙这件事，人高兴，来的小妖高兴，001郁闷。

因为它不能天天看电视了。

丹顶鹤让它好好学习人类文字。

“……”

小雀emo中，隔三叉五就去楼上了，具体的流程是在窗户那里敲一敲，人似乎准备出门，看到它就开口道：

“001，你先看顾一下粼粼好么？”

“我先去给南市来的朋友们找房子。”

来的妖不少，酒店其实不太方便，宋郁打算去找个郊区的别墅，租一个月左右。

但这毕竟需要他出面。

001正好来了，于是就直接说了。

小雀幻化成“黑衣少年”的模样，蹲在茶几旁边，面无表情地看着不远处的人，点了点头。

没问题的。

宋郁：“……”

他莫名有点不太放心。

……

一众妖怪浩浩荡荡地跟着“人”走，由于保时捷的车子坏了，于是只能打车，司机在前面打火，发现车子很难开动，啧了一声。

下车看了看，发现轮胎都有些瘪，车身都下压了。

?

司机看了下后座，那里只有一个长相出众的年轻人。

“怎么了？”

宋郁故作镇定地开口，因为他的肩头站着一排穿着工装夹克的花枝鼠，座椅的旁边有只巨大的草龟，草龟上面还站着一个探头探脑的侏儒兔，车子后侧还盘着一只小型的蟒蛇。

司机只是挠挠脑袋，很是纳闷地摇了摇头：

“没事，轮胎有点气不足。”

车子最后还是摇摇晃晃地上路了，尾气的尽头是一头黑熊，丹顶鹤在旁边站着，挥了挥翅膀，很无奈地道：

“这上不了的，这车不是247的监护人的。”

“……好吧。”

车内妖怪们开始狂欢！

花枝鼠四处探头，忍不住地幻化出来了自己的二胡，但是刚要准备拉，一道声音传了过来：

“不行。”

宋郁闭了闭眼，实在不明白这种出去郊游的氛围是怎么形成的，此刻前面的司机闻言迟疑地问了下：

“不行……什么？是在和我说话吗？”

“不是，不好意思。”

车内一阵死寂。

但后座的妖怪堆里其实已经聊起来天了，旁边的侏儒兔只是道：

“你不能拉乐器，万一前面的人类听到了？我们现在是隔绝了声音不错，但乐器不一定的。”

“桐城，桐城这里有其他的妖怪吗？”

“老大要把管理局建在哪里啊？”

“也不知道我们带的东西够不够用。”

“这里风景不错！”

七嘴八舌的，妖怪们只顾得自己说自己得，很是兴奋，它们不是因为坐车而兴奋，而是因为待会要去大别墅住而高兴。

人类的大房子！

宋郁面色维持着平静，最后在到了目的地后扫码付款，带着一众妖怪去了别墅房子。

一共三层，房间很多，应该是足够的了。

丹顶鹤其实已经到了，看到人后面跟着好奇的小妖怪们，莫名有些欣慰。

它们同这个人类亲近。

“好了，剩下得交给我就可以，中央那里我有认识的妖，247的情况不会上报，它的工作报告，我来写。”

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，冲着宋郁身后的小妖怪们挥了挥翅膀，它们立马扛着包袱过来了，齐齐仰头看过来。

“你们先进去。”

南市妖怪管理局，有组织，有纪律。

宋郁站在对面，还是认真地感谢了这件事，不过他还是提及了下那只鼹鼠的事，希望优先处理它的事情。

丹顶鹤点了点头：

“这个你放心，我们已经联系过了，是以247的部下的名义。”

宋郁：“……是、是么。”

丹顶鹤很从容不迫：“中央离得很远，它们不知道的，毕竟247出了点事，南市作为它的家乡，自然而然是要来帮衬帮衬的。”

与此同时，小区八楼。

小雀已经用爪子打开了电视机，很认真地切换频道，最终停留在了一个少儿频道。

画面里全部都是人类幼童，似乎是个公益广告。

小雀收了收翅膀，认真思考。

[阳光，是大自然赐予我们的礼物。]

屏幕上开始播放孩子们在草地上奔跑，打滚，看书。

最后切到了父母的视角那里，他们在摇一个婴儿车，来回晃动。

小雀歪了歪鸟头。

[让我们的下一代生活在绿茵之中。]

场景切换。

有幼童在荡秋千，面色都很喜悦。

广告结束了。

001看了下毛巾里的蓝羽幼鸟，247现在睡着了，小雀收了收翅膀，思索了一番。

开始行动。

小雀从洗手间里叼出来一个毛巾，然后又环顾了下这个房子，啪嗒啪嗒地来回走着，找到了两个类似于花瓶的支架。

“黑衣少年”抬手把这两个放在了茶几上，然后拿出来缠狼牙剩下的麻绳。

001面色没有什么表情，很严肃地做手工活，最后把毛巾的两头系紧，挂在了那个支架上。

嗯，好了！

“黑衣少年”抬手把那只蓝羽幼鸟转移了阵地，放到了自己设计的“秋千”里。

人类就是这么晃幼童的。

001很熟练地幻化成小雀，啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，抬起来翅膀，很有节奏地摇了起来。

嘎吱——
chunks.englishText:
The little sparrow on the coffee table was still craning its neck to look at the blue-feathered fledgling in the towel, and upon hearing this, it tilted its head.

The Red-Crowned Crane swept a glance over and saw this one.

"..."

"Six of one, half a dozen of the other."

001 clearly didn't understand why "weight" was mentioned; it only knew that at street stalls, bosses would say things like "how much per jin."

The bird was confused.

The little sparrow continued to watch the blue-feathered fledgling, while the conversation continued above:

"The specific recovery time... what month is it now?"

"Late July."
