The Black Bear asked its friends. The demons watched from the side. The Python pondered for two seconds, conjured a pair of sunglasses, and put them on the Black Bear.

“That’s it.”

The Dwarf Rabbit hopped back, took out its iPhone, and very earnestly extended its front paw:

“Bear Three, look at the lens!”

*Click.*

Numerous demons began taking photos with the car, eating snacks while posing, having a grand old time.

Only one place was quiet. The Mole stood inside the small temple, poking its head out. It also wanted to participate, but it hesitated.

These were all the former subordinates of the Bird Bureau.

It was just a newcomer…

The Mole sighed, intending to return to its burrow and come out only after they were done playing.

But just then, a voice came over:

“Hello.”

The Mole was a bit dazed. Holding the door of the small temple, it looked up. It was that person. The other party had crouched down, his expression gentle.

Was he talking to it?

“Why aren’t you lining up?”

The Mole was somewhat flattered. It waved its paws and said very earnestly:

“The demon from the central office has already been very kind. Now that the forest is preparing to build a Management Bureau, this is all thanks to the Bird Bureau. I have already received enough favors.”

Song Yu was a bit bewildered after hearing the term “Bird Bureau.” Is that what they called it in the demon world?

He looked at the Mole below, and just as he was about to say something, the other party added:

“After all, I am a newcomer and am not yet familiar with the Bird Bureau. Those things should be for the Bird Bureau’s subordinates. It wouldn’t be appropriate for me to go…”

Song Yu: “…”

*The intricacies of social relationships.*

Song Yu didn’t hesitate and said:

“Linlin is not that kind of demon. He has always treated everyone equally. You are a local demon of Tongcheng, and you will certainly provide a lot of information for the establishment of the Management Bureau. Your contribution is undeniable.”

“Linlin specifically told me to pay close attention to you.”

The Mole’s eyes lit up, and it looked up with its head tilted.

Song Yu kept a straight face: “I am just here to handle things on his behalf. You can rest assured about this.”

The Mole was suddenly relieved, its eyes brimming with tears, and it immediately showed the person the small temple it had built.

“The current progress is quite stable. Regarding the entrance anchor point for the Management Bureau, we intend to use the small temple…”

Song Yu looked up and was slightly stunned. The little bird in the portrait was different from the last time he saw it. It had been colored, looking vivid and lifelike, and it was looking down with lowered eyes.

It had… divinity.

-

Meanwhile, the teachers from the orphanage also came over the small path with their baskets. Ever since they learned that the child was a little bird demon in this life, they had come to this small temple to make offerings every single day without fail.

Hoping that their Linlin would have a smooth life.

The teachers were chatting as they walked:

“That little Song is really nice. His personality is good, and he looks like he dotes on our Linlin.”

“Isn’t that the truth? Speaking of which, Linlin, that child, actually handed an orange to him in front of us that day and made him peel it!”

“Who knows how he enslaves the poor man in private?”

“That’s not good.”

Though they called it criticism, their tone was full of doting reproach.

The path was neither long nor short. As they slowly approached the destination, the teachers remembered something else:

“By the way, you know Zihao, right? I ran into that group of children. When they saw me coming from the direction of the small temple, they kept asking me what the portrait inside was. I said it was a little bird, but those children looked completely confused, saying that what they saw wasn’t like that.”

“Really?”

“It’s clearly a little bird! We all saw it together, could we be wrong?”

“But it does sound strange.”

Their footsteps grew closer. When they reached the edge of the forest, they finally saw the small temple, but a black car was parked next to it.

As for the other side of their line of sight, it was a familiar person. The other party turned his head, his expression somewhat surprised.

-

About half an hour later.

The Red-Crowned Crane finally accepted two pieces of passable homework. It sat on the chair, looking at what was written on them with its wings very earnestly.

Two fluffy birds stood on the table, quite nervous, both tilting their bird heads to look over.

“Let me see. Let’s start with 001’s.”

“Both of you, come up.”

The little sparrow flapped its wings and stood at the base of the Red-Crowned Crane’s wing, leaning over to look at its homework.

Bai Linlin stood symmetrically on the left, tucked his wings, and looked curiously at the paper.

“First, this handwriting is still not aesthetic.”

The little sparrow hung its bird head.

“But the sentence construction has improved.”

001 immediately lifted its head, tucked its wings, and waited for the evaluation.

Bai Linlin had actually been looking for a while, because 001’s handwriting was truly too hard to recognize. Hearing the Red-Crowned Crane mention sentence construction, he couldn’t help but piece the characters together:

[Wish my friend and partner, well.]

The bird was stunned.

Bai Linlin couldn’t help but look at the little sparrow next to him. The other party was currently puffing out its chest and holding its head high. It was originally looking at the Red-Crowned Crane, but noticing the gaze, it looked at him.

The little sparrow blinked its bird eyes.

He had learned this.

Bai Linlin felt warm in his heart and was about to blink back, but a leisurely voice came from above:

“What are you two flirting for?”

The two little birds simultaneously hung their bird heads.

In any case, the next few hours were spent explaining official documents. 001 clutched its practice paper. It could have gone downstairs, but it walked a few steps *patter, patter, patter*, and ended up nesting on the coaster on the table.

It fluffed its feathers and tucked its bird head into the base of its wing.

*Sleeping in progress.*

Bai Linlin had been in class for a long time, including how to contact the central office, how to divide the internal departments of the Management Bureau, how to bring local demons under their jurisdiction…

The bird head was running at overload.

“Alright, that’s it for today.”

chunks.chineseText:
丹顶鹤刚说完这句话，肩头的蓝羽小鸟就扑棱翅膀下来了，困得摇摇晃晃的，啪嗒啪嗒地走到001的那个杯垫处，很熟练地蓬毛、鸟头插进翅根里……然后挤在一起睡觉。

“……”

丹顶鹤最后还是起身去外面打电话了。

-

林子处。

老师们其实完全看不到那些妖怪们，但是由于正午日头大，林子中间穿插过来些光柱，隐约能看到对方周身的……气泡。

犹如彩色的光辉，若隐若现的。

宋郁其实没想到今天能遇见，他……他身边没带粼粼，一时间倒是有些无措。

“粼粼呢？”

宋郁本来是想要开口说话的，但是肩头的那一排花枝鼠已经开始交谈了：

“老大居然还认识这里的人？”

宋郁面色微微变了，上辈子的事越少的人知道越好。

001是比较特殊，但万一这些——

“不愧是老大！”

“……”

水平差不多。

“它在家里，我过来是……来修一修这个小庙。”

宋郁随便找了个由头说到，毕竟上次被撞见就是弄塌了这小庙，虽说是垒好了，但是和现在的样子还是有差别的。

鼹鼠在一旁点了点头，它觉得这个借口不错，它也动用了妖力，面前的妇人是看不到它的。

“是嘛？”

“对，就是得敬畏一下，这里面可是小鸟神，粼粼他不懂事，但我们这做大人肯定要替他打点好一切。”

“小宋做得不错。”

老师们一言一语地说着，很快就把篮子里的吃得给拿了出来，用了一次性的盘子，把东西都摆上了。

宋郁自然是俯身帮忙，面色虽然是冷，但很热心。

“对了，你看的画像是什么？”

“啊？”

老师们见状笑了下，说了自己前些天遇到的事，好奇地道：

“当时也没问你们，这个画像上……是小鸟吧？”

宋郁闻言点头：“是，我看到的也是。”

老师们顿时放下心来，彼此对视一眼，觉得完全没错。

那个画像上的小鸟是古代的那种白描，黑色线条均匀而又平滑，勾勒出一个身形瘦长的小鸟。

老师们在路上已经彼此对过了，都是相同的特征，那群孩子肯定是看错了。

但就在这时，正当她们把盘子摆进去小庙的时候，很自然地看了下画像，结果就是愣住了。

那里面的小鸟……此刻变成彩色的了，蓝羽的，圆滚滚的。

这、这不是粼粼么？

宋郁也是在这个时候接到了的电话，那头是丹顶鹤，询问了一下现在的情况，他只好先回复这件事：

“是，比较顺利。”

人很是忙，一边是保持着安静的妖怪，一边是没有离开小庙的老师们，一边是丹顶鹤打的电话。

粼粼的小弟。

粼粼的老师。

粼粼的家人。

宋郁有些抽不开身，但好在老师们发现他在打电话，拜完就准备离开了，只是面色还是很困惑：

“这以前是这样吗？”

“体型不对吧？现在的画像上，圆了一个度。”

“不知道。”

老师们实在不解，但还是想起来事情，去邀请了宋郁吃午饭，但是刚转头过去，阳光一照，看到了对方脖子上的痕迹。

“……”

几个老师头也不回地走了，一个个面红耳赤的。

-

林子里又安静了些。

宋郁这才顺利地同丹顶鹤说了现在的情况的，肩头站着一队花枝鼠，都在侧耳倾听：

“那它们还算用功，不错。”

小鼠立马幻化出来锣鼓，响当当地敲了下。

丹顶鹤在那头：“……”

“今天先到这里吧，247和001都睡着了，你先回来吧。”

“鼠二，带着大家去别墅里休息。”

为首的那只花枝鼠立马回复：

“收到！”

总之大家有序退场。

宋郁先把妖怪们送到了地方，然后在驱车回了小区内，推开门的时候，丹顶鹤已经走了，他抬步走到书房，垂眸一看。

两只睡得昏天黑地的小鸟。

……

夜色逐步靠近。

001在餐桌上风卷残云，最后叼着一袋子烧烤就下楼了，冲着身后的人挥了挥翅膀。

顺带看了下餐厅那里。

“少年”还在趴着睡觉，压根就没有醒过。

砰——

玄关处的门关上了。

宋郁走了过来，把椅子上的“少年”抱了起来，揽着那截腰，垂眸看了下那张困乏的脸，手指抚了下。

说不心疼是假的。

“唔……”

宋郁抬手用勺子给“人”喂饭，轻声道：

“粼粼？张口。”

不知道是什么缘故，他的小鸟胃口不好，没什么大的反应，只是蹙了蹙眉。

白粼粼浑身有些发热，一到夜里就觉得一口饭也吃不下去了。

满足不了。

“累不累？我们周末回家好不好？”

发丝被吻了吻。

宋郁本来还想要再说几句，但怀里“人”总算有了些反应，他的脖子一阵刺痛，舌尖又舔了过来。

人捏勺子的动作一顿。

但就在这时，电话响了。

宋郁把人的腿分开，面对面地抱着，按着那个后颈，看了下手机的来电。

是他爷爷。

接了。

“小郁！祥云楼那里的厨子爷爷认识，我想了想，如果非要在桐城待两年的话，那不能让鸟儿的生活水准降低。”

“我托人买了桐城的一家早茶店，把祥云楼的师傅给聘过去了，专门给鸟儿做蟹黄包，我已经点了一份了，待会就应该送到了。”

宋郁愣了下，没有想到会是这样，但他刚想开口——

“唔……嗯”

有轻微的气音，“少年”有些懊恼，他咬得不够用力，血弄不出来了。

张着口，微微喘着气。

宋郁不由自主地道：

“怎么了？”

白粼粼意识是渐渐地沉沦，但是又没有完全丢掉，只是看着手机，脑子里很迟钝地接收信息，然后很认真地喊：

“爷爷！”

老头吓得手机都不稳了。

“哎，哎，爷爷在。”

“你们忙吧……”

甚至还来不及解释，电话就挂了。

宋郁闭了闭眼。

“少年”不知道怎么了，看手机没有再发出声音就不管了，只是转过来头，看着人。

鸟类发情期。

是需要规律的交配的。

白粼粼低头过去了，唇瓣贴过去的一瞬间，齿关就被撬开了，发出含混不清的水声。

“嗯……哈。”

门口传来叮咚的声音，有外送服务：

“你好，签收外卖！”

里面没有回答，外卖小哥直接道：

“给您放门口了！”

夜渐渐变深了。

桐城别墅里的一个房间里，丹顶鹤正在梳妆台前，此刻它化成了人形，在拿着手机在视频：

“没事，等建起来了管理局，我就回去。”

“现在是真的走不开，247年纪太小了，它第一次发情期会比较长，我还没有教它——”

话骤然而止。

视频里的男声很是温润：

“怎么了？不顺利吗？”

丹顶鹤只是皱眉，拿着耳环的动作一顿，叹了口气：
chunks.englishText:
No sooner had the Red-crowned Crane finished speaking than the little blue-feathered bird on its shoulder fluttered down. Drowsy and swaying, it pattered over to 001’s coaster, expertly fluffed its feathers, tucked its head into the root of its wing... and the two curled up together to sleep.

“……”

In the end, the Red-crowned Crane got up and went outside to make a phone call.

-

In the woods.

The teachers couldn't actually see the demons, but because the midday sun was so intense, shafts of light pierced through the trees, faintly revealing the... bubbles surrounding them.

Like colorful halos, they flickered in and out of existence.

Song Yu hadn't expected to run into them today. He... he hadn't brought Linlin with him, and for a moment, he felt a bit flustered.

“Where’s Linlin?”

Song Yu had intended to speak, but the row of harvest mice on his shoulder had already begun to chatter:

“The Boss actually knows people here?”

Song Yu’s expression shifted slightly. The fewer people who knew about his past life, the better.

001 was a special case, but if these—

“As expected of the Boss!”

“……”

They were on the same level.

“He’s at home. I came over to... repair this little shrine.”

Song Yu offered a casual excuse. After all, the last time he’d been caught, it was because he’d knocked the shrine over. Even though he’d rebuilt it, it still looked different from before.

The mole nodded from the side, thinking it was a good excuse. It had also used its demonic power, so the woman in front of them couldn't see it.

“Is that so?”

“Yes, one must show reverence. There is a little Bird Deity inside. Linlin doesn't understand, but as adults, we must take care of everything for him.”

“Little Song is very thoughtful.”

The teachers chatted as they took the food out of their baskets, using disposable plates to set everything up.

Song Yu naturally leaned over to help. Though his expression was cold, he was very helpful.

“By the way, what was the portrait you saw?”

“Huh?”

The teachers smiled at the sight and recounted what they had encountered a few days ago, asking curiously:

“We didn't ask you at the time, but on this portrait... it’s a little bird, right?”

Song Yu nodded upon hearing this: “Yes, that’s what I saw too.”

The teachers were immediately relieved. They exchanged glances, feeling certain they were right.

The bird in the portrait was in the style of ancient line drawings—black lines, even and smooth, outlining a slender little bird.

The teachers had already compared notes on the way; they all saw the same features. The children must have been mistaken.

But just then, as they placed the plates into the little shrine, they naturally glanced at the portrait, only to freeze in place.

The little bird inside... had turned colorful. Blue-feathered and round.

Wait, isn't this Linlin?

It was at this moment that Song Yu received a call. It was the Red-crowned Crane, asking about the current situation. He had to reply to that first:

“Yes, it’s going quite smoothly.”

He was very busy—the quiet demons on one side, the teachers who hadn't left the shrine on another, and the Red-crowned Crane on the phone.

Linlin’s underlings.

Linlin’s teachers.

Linlin’s family.

Song Yu couldn't easily pull himself away, but fortunately, the teachers noticed he was on the phone and prepared to leave after paying their respects, though they still looked quite puzzled:

“Was it like this before?”

“The body shape is wrong, isn't it? The portrait now is a degree rounder.”

“I don't know.”

The teachers were truly baffled, but they remembered their purpose and invited Song Yu to lunch. However, just as they turned around, the sunlight hit, and they saw the marks on his neck.

“……”

The teachers walked away without looking back, their faces flushed red.

-

The woods grew quiet once more.

Only then could Song Yu successfully explain the situation to the Red-crowned Crane. A line of harvest mice stood on his shoulder, listening intently:

“They’ve been diligent, not bad.”

The little mice immediately conjured up gongs and drums, striking them with a loud *clang*.

The Red-crowned Crane on the other end: “……”

“Let’s stop here for today. 247 and 001 are both asleep, you should come back first.”

“Mouse Two, take everyone back to the villa to rest.”

The lead harvest mouse replied immediately:

“Received!”

And so, everyone made an orderly exit.

Song Yu first dropped the demons off at their destination, then drove back to the residential complex. When he pushed the door open, the Red-crowned Crane was already gone. He walked into the study and looked down.

Two little birds were fast asleep.

……

Night gradually approached.

001 swept through the dining table like a whirlwind, finally grabbing a bag of barbecue and heading downstairs, waving its wings at the person behind it.

It took a glance at the dining room.

The “youth” was still slumped over, fast asleep, showing no signs of waking up.

*Bang—*

The front door closed.

Song Yu walked over, picked up the “youth” from the chair, cradled that waist, and looked down at the weary face, his fingers brushing against it.

It would be a lie to say his heart didn't ache.

“Mmm...”

Song Yu lifted a spoon to feed the “person,” whispering:

“Linlin? Open your mouth.”

For some reason, his little bird had a poor appetite and didn't react much, only furrowing his brows.

Bai Linlin’s body was running hot; once night fell, he felt he couldn't swallow a single bite of food.

He couldn't be satisfied.

“Are you tired? Shall we go home this weekend?”

He kissed the strands of hair.

Song Yu wanted to say more, but the “person” in his arms finally reacted. A sharp pain stung his neck, and a tongue licked over the spot.

His hand holding the spoon paused.

But just then, the phone rang.

Song Yu spread the person’s legs, held him face-to-face, pressed against the back of his neck, and checked the caller ID.

It was his grandfather.

He answered.

“Little Yu! Grandpa knows the chef at Xiangyun Tower. I’ve been thinking, if you must stay in Tongcheng for two years, you can't let the bird’s standard of living drop.”

“I entrusted someone to buy a morning tea shop in Tongcheng and hired the master chef from Xiangyun Tower to make crab roe buns specifically for the bird. I’ve already ordered a portion; it should be delivered soon.”

Song Yu was stunned. He hadn't expected this, but just as he was about to speak—

“Mmm... unh.”

A faint breathy sound escaped. The “youth” was annoyed; he hadn't bitten hard enough, and the blood wouldn't come out.

He kept his mouth open, panting slightly.

Song Yu couldn't help but ask:

“What’s wrong?”

Bai Linlin’s consciousness was gradually sinking, but not entirely lost. He looked at the phone, his brain receiving information sluggishly, and then he called out earnestly:

“Grandpa!”

The old man was so startled he nearly dropped his phone.

“Hey, hey, Grandpa’s here.”

“You two go be busy...”

Before he could even explain, the call was hung up.

Song Yu closed his eyes.

The “youth” didn't know what was going on. Seeing the phone made no more sound, he ignored it and turned his head to look at the man.

The mating season for birds.

It required regular mating.

Bai Linlin lowered his head. The moment his lips pressed against the man’s, his teeth were pried apart, producing a muffled, wet sound.

“Mmm... ha.”

A *ding-dong* sounded at the door—a delivery service:

“Hello, please sign for your takeout!”

There was no answer from inside, so the delivery guy simply said:

“I’ll leave it at your door!”

The night deepened.

In a room in the Tongcheng villa, the Red-crowned Crane was at a vanity. It had transformed into human form and was on a video call:

“It’s fine, I’ll go back once the Management Bureau is built.”

“I really can’t leave right now. 247 is too young. Its first mating season will be quite long, and I haven't taught it yet—”

The words stopped abruptly.

The male voice on the video was very gentle:

“What’s wrong? Is it not going smoothly?”

The Red-crowned Crane just frowned, paused in the act of putting on an earring, and sighed:

chunks.chineseText:
“我忘记教它发情期控制妖力了。”

对面的男声只是安抚：

“那很严重么？不行派你的下属过去。”

丹顶鹤只是挥了挥手：

“没事，它顶多被*得久一些。”

视频那里沉默了。

“茜茜，不能这么说话。”

……

翌日。

白粼粼浑身酸酸的，被单手抱着去洗漱的，他面色泛红，一开始觉得不好意思，后面想了想，不管。

就不下地！

宋郁就这么伺候着，眉眼温和，把“人”放到了洗手台面上，很自然地揽着腰，低头去吻。

“嗯……”

唇瓣湿漉漉的，被放开的时候“少年”还在喘气。

白粼粼不太明白，这怎么……不累吗？

难道是因为年纪轻？

“粼粼。”

“要看我。”

“少年”闻言面红耳赤的，抬手撑着对方的肩头，抬眸看了一眼。

宋郁抬手握着那个手腕，低头吻了下手背。

白粼粼张口想要阻止，但是晚了。

“……”

大约这么温存了一会儿。

在九点钟的时候，门口的铃声如约响了起来。

开门了。

一鹤一雀就在外面站着，一大一小，规规矩矩的。

丹顶鹤开门见山地道：

“管理局的选址我得带247过去，至于它发情期妖力紊乱的问题，我今天打算……”

话一下子停了。

丹顶鹤看着面前的“少年”，脸颊红润，气色很好，身上那些冲撞的妖力此刻竟然全部抚平了。

鹤眯了眯鸟眼。

这是弄了多久？
chunks.englishText:
“I forgot to teach it how to control its demonic power during the mating season.”

The male voice on the other side offered comfort:

“Is that very serious? If not, send one of your subordinates over.”

The Red-crowned Crane just waved its hand:

“It’s fine. At most, it’ll just be f*cked for a bit longer.”

Silence fell on the video call.

“Qianqian, you can't say things like that.”

……

The next day.

Bai Linlin felt sore all over. He was carried to wash up with one arm. His face was flushed; at first, he felt embarrassed, but then he thought, *Forget it.*

*I’m not walking!*

Song Yu served him with gentle eyes, placed the “person” on the bathroom counter, naturally wrapped an arm around his waist, and leaned down to kiss him.

“Mmm...”

His lips were wet. When he was released, the “youth” was still panting.

Bai Linlin didn't quite understand—how is this... not tiring?

Is it because he’s young?

“Linlin.”

“Look at me.”

The “youth” flushed red at these words, raised his hands to brace himself against the man’s shoulders, and looked up.

Song Yu took his wrist and kissed the back of his hand.

Bai Linlin opened his mouth to stop him, but it was too late.

“……”

They stayed like that, cherishing the moment, for a while.

At nine o'clock, the doorbell rang right on cue.

The door opened.

A crane and a sparrow stood outside, one big and one small, standing properly.

The Red-crowned Crane got straight to the point:

“I need to take 247 to the site for the Management Bureau. As for the issue of its demonic power being chaotic during the mating season, I plan to...”

The words stopped abruptly.

The Red-crowned Crane looked at the “youth” in front of it—his cheeks were rosy, his complexion was excellent, and the turbulent demonic power on his body had been completely smoothed out.

The crane narrowed its bird eyes.

How long did they go at it?

chunks.chineseText:
第69章

丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，最后还是什么也没说，抬起来鸟头，一幅了然的表情。

倒是旁边的小雀啪嗒啪嗒进来了，扑棱翅膀就站到了“少年”的肩头，然后歪头道：

“大家都在林子里候着，很想念你。”

白粼粼闻言点了点头，他的确应该去林子那里看一下，丹顶鹤教导了他好几天了，应该去看看进度怎么样。

大约半个小时的车程。

抵达目的地的时候，宋郁侧头看了下旁边的“少年”，眼神示意要不要直接下来。

丹顶鹤就在后座坦然地坐着，不紧不慢地道：

“247，化成本体，我们妖界的见面礼仪是这样的。”

小雀站在副驾的靠背上，爪子上拿着个棒棒糖，好奇地探头看窗外，发现大家已经候着了，旁边的铲子插在地上，还有些的挖出来的坑，的确是施工现场。

“哦哦，好。”

白粼粼调动了下妖力，幻化成了一只圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟，此刻他已经羽毛丰盈，胸膛挺立，完全是个成鸟了。

其实有些紧张……

爪子并了并。

这和在中央完全不同，那是自己凭借实力去的，大摇大摆的。

但是现在……鸟来桐城任职，却还靠着南市的“父老乡亲”，着实有些羞愧。

小雀扑棱翅膀下来了，很灵活地把棒棒糖放到了原来的包装袋上，挥翅膀收起来了，啪嗒啪嗒地走到蓝羽小鸟身边：

“它们都很想你的。”

宋郁也开口道：“没事的，外面都是南市的朋友。”

车后传来悠悠的一句：

“247，还近乡情怯了？”

鸟一下子被说中了，垂着鸟头，心想才不是，他当即往驾驶座那里看了下，挥了挥翅膀。

宋郁把车门开了。

咔哒——

林子里的妖怪已经等候多时了，见到车门里那一抹蓝色的身影之后，立马开始幻化出来红色条幅，敲锣打鼓的，看着着实热闹。

鼹鼠就在旁边站着，头上顶着个小帽子，它特地从洞里拿出来的行头，来接见一下鸟局。

白粼粼伸出来鸟腿，灵巧地一个落地，毛绒绒的，还收了收翅膀，往前走了过来。

身后跟着一只灰棕色的小雀。

再之后是优雅的大型涉禽丹顶鹤。

最后是那名相貌出众的人类。

鸟首先是走到了鼹鼠身边，毕竟这是当地的妖，丹顶鹤说了，要树立起优良的形象，鸟伸过去了翅膀。

进行“握手”。

“这段时间你辛苦了。”

“不辛苦不辛苦！”

鼹鼠满面红光，很是规矩地站在一旁，中央来的妖就是不一样。

白粼粼这才走到了南市的小妖旁边，进行了亲切地慰问，挥了挥翅膀，点头点头。

“老大老大！我们基本搞好设计图了，快来看！”

“老大老大，你的小庙！”

总之这边热闹极了。

宋郁站在后侧，面色温和，视线始终锁定在那个小鸟的动向上，它小小的，但看起来意气风发的。

粼粼一辈子开心就好。

“是这样，监护人，管理局的筹建或许还要你帮忙。我们的确是可以幻化出来‘界’，但实际上只是创造了空间的交错口，管理局仍然需要一些真实的建筑材料。”

“当然，山林里的树木是足够的，但是不够现代，247的政绩看起来就……”

丹顶鹤很是从容地提点，其实它们妖怪并不缺乏金钱，公职妖怪更是如此，是有人类货币的工资的。

但是……获得人类的帮助。

这是个很大的政绩。

宋郁自然是表示支持，当即就联系了一些认识的人，行动效率很快。

同时001则是回归了自己本职工作，把后备箱的“见面礼”都拿了出来，只是微微抬了下翅膀。

前面立马排起来了队伍。

“遵守秩序。”

“每个妖怪都有份。”

……

白粼粼其实在看侏儒兔给的设计图，基本上是按照南市管理局的样式来弄的，对方很是认真地道：

“老大，桐城这里比南市小的多，窗口应该不需要建太多，可以看情况慢慢加，至于大厅的设计，还是以简约为主。”

“这里是会议室，窗口的负责妖都会来开会，这是老大你的办公室。”

侏儒兔蹦蹦跳跳的，拿出来自己的图纸给地面上的蓝羽小鸟看。

白粼粼了然，然后伸翅膀拿过来了这个图纸，上面的管理局很是宏伟，虽然是一层，但吊灯的设计都画出来了，很有现代感。

鸟看了眼图纸，对照了下现在的框架。

“……”

还差得很多。

白粼粼摇了摇鸟头，但还是对侏儒兔道：“做得很好了，我会看着处理的。”

过了一会，蟒蛇过来了，递过来了一份文件：

“这是目前搜集到的疑似妖怪的名单，数量不多，目前还不超过一百，能化形的估计也是少之又少。”

“统一收编也是个任务。”

鸟点了点头，神色严肃。

再之后就是鼹鼠，对方很是恭恭敬敬的，说了下自己在桐城的一些经历：

“这里灵气在很多年前是很好的，后面稀薄了些，我也因此就闭关了，但近些年又有复苏的迹象，我能察觉到有妖力的波动。”

“噢对了，鸟局，这是我为您设计的画像。”

白粼粼闻言皱了皱“眉”，鸟眼成了三角的形状，啪嗒啪嗒地走到那个小庙口那里，顺着鼹鼠的目光看过去，发现了上面的挂画。

蓝羽，慈“眉”善目。

“……”

“不行！”

这像什么话，个妖崇拜不可取！

鼹鼠一时半会还愣了下，后面被教育了不少“集体的力量是大于个妖的力量的”、“要牢牢地团结起来”……之类的思想。

“那、那要拆掉么？但是会有人类过来拜一拜的。”

白粼粼收了收翅膀，在小庙前面踱步，他是知道这里面的“人类”是有他的老师们的。

这个好解决，不过……

“有多少人类过来拜？”

鼹鼠觉得自己做错了事，爪子垂着，很是一五一十地交代了：

“有几个中年人，也有岁数大的，还有一群孩子，前几天有个拿着手机录像的年轻人。”

白粼粼闻言眯了眯鸟眼。

这么多人……

“鸟局，那要现在拆了吗？”

蓝羽小鸟挥了下翅膀，很是认真地道：

“先等等。”

-

第一次视察工作还算顺利，丹顶鹤基本上没有干预，在后面一直看着蓝羽小鸟的动向，它这边问问，那边问问的，倒是看着很负责任。

这样就好。

时间到了黄昏时分，鸟才不得已的先回了小区，一进门就啪嗒啪嗒地往书房走。

宋郁其实是想要问问它累不累的，但是抬步跟过去的时候，他的小鸟已经利索地用爪子打开了台灯，之后从笔筒里叼出来笔，用爪子握着。

奋笔疾书。

宋郁想了想，索性去给他的小鸟打果汁了。

“嗯，一切顺利，粼粼要筹建管理局，目前还没有盖起来。”

人倚靠在厨房的台面上，在同家里的老人打电话，语气温和。
chunks.englishText:
第69章

The Red-crowned Crane tucked its wings, but in the end, it said nothing, merely lifting its bird head with a knowing expression.

The little sparrow next to it, however, pattered inside, fluttered its wings, and landed on the “youth’s” shoulder. It tilted its head and said:

“Everyone is waiting in the woods; they miss you very much.”

Bai Linlin nodded upon hearing this. He really should go to the woods to check. The Red-crowned Crane had been teaching him for several days; he should go see how the progress was coming along.

It was about a half-hour drive.

Upon arriving at the destination, Song Yu glanced sideways at the “youth” beside him, signaling with his eyes to see if he wanted to get out directly.

The Red-crowned Crane sat calmly in the back seat and said unhurriedly:

“247, transform into your true form. This is the etiquette for meeting in our demon world.”

The little sparrow stood on the back of the passenger seat, holding a lollipop in its claws. It peered curiously out the window and discovered that everyone was already waiting. Shovels were stuck in the ground, and there were some dug-out pits—it was indeed a construction site.

“Oh, oh, okay.”

Bai Linlin channeled his demonic power and transformed into a round, blue-feathered little bird. He was now fully feathered, his chest puffed out—a complete adult bird.

He was actually a bit nervous...

He brought his claws together.

This was completely different from being in the Central Region, where he had gone with his own strength, strutting about.

But now... as a bird coming to Tongcheng to take office, yet still relying on the “elders and fellow villagers” from Nanshi, he felt truly ashamed.

The little sparrow fluttered down, nimbly placed the lollipop back into its wrapper, tucked it away with a flap of its wings, and pattered over to the blue-feathered bird:

“They all miss you very much.”

Song Yu also spoke up: “It’s alright, everyone outside is a friend from Nanshi.”

A leisurely voice came from the back of the car:

“247, are you feeling homesick for a place you haven't even settled in yet?”

The bird was hit right on the mark. He lowered his bird head, thinking to himself that it wasn't that at all. He immediately looked toward the driver’s seat and waved his wings.

Song Yu opened the car door.

*Click—*

The demons in the woods had been waiting for a long time. Upon seeing that flash of blue in the doorway, they immediately began conjuring red banners, beating drums and gongs—it was truly lively.

The mole stood to the side, wearing a little hat on its head—an outfit it had specifically retrieved from its burrow to welcome the Bird Bureau Chief.

Bai Linlin extended a bird leg and landed nimbly. He was fluffy, tucked his wings in, and walked forward.

Behind him followed a grey-brown little sparrow.

After that came the elegant, large wading bird, the Red-crowned Crane.

And finally, the exceptionally handsome human.

The bird first walked over to the mole; after all, this was a local demon, and the Red-crowned Crane had said he needed to establish a good image. The bird extended a wing.

He performed a “handshake.”

“You’ve worked hard during this time.”

“Not hard at all, not hard at all!”

The mole was beaming, standing very properly to the side. A demon from the Central Region was truly different.

Only then did Bai Linlin walk over to the little demons from Nanshi to offer his kind regards, waving his wings and nodding repeatedly.

“Boss! Boss! We’ve basically finished the design drawings, come take a look!”

“Boss! Boss! Your little shrine!”

In short, it was incredibly lively here.

Song Yu stood to the rear, his expression gentle, his gaze locked onto the little bird’s movements. It was small, but it looked full of spirit.

As long as Linlin is happy for the rest of his life, that’s all that matters.

“It’s like this, Guardian. The construction of the Management Bureau may still require your help. We can indeed conjure a ‘realm,’ but in reality, that only creates a spatial intersection. The Management Bureau still requires some real building materials.”

“Of course, the trees in the mountains and forests are sufficient, but they aren't modern enough, and 247’s performance record would look...”

The Red-crowned Crane pointed out with great composure. In fact, demons were not lacking in money, especially public-official demons who received salaries in human currency.

However... obtaining human help.

That was a major achievement.

Song Yu naturally expressed his support and immediately contacted some people he knew, acting with great efficiency.

At the same time, 001 returned to its primary duties, taking out all the “welcome gifts” from the trunk, just by slightly lifting its wings.

A line immediately formed in front.

“Maintain order.”

“Every demon gets a share.”

……

Bai Linlin was actually looking at the design drawings from the Pygmy Rabbit. They were basically modeled after the Nanshi Management Bureau. The rabbit said very earnestly:

“Boss, Tongcheng is much smaller than Nanshi. We shouldn't need to build too many service windows; we can add them slowly as the situation requires. As for the lobby design, it’s best to keep it minimalist.”

“This is the conference room where the demons in charge of the windows will come for meetings, and this is your office, Boss.”

The Pygmy Rabbit hopped about, showing its drawings to the blue-feathered bird on the ground.

Bai Linlin understood. He reached out a wing to take the drawings. The Management Bureau on the paper looked magnificent; although it was only one story, the chandelier design was even drawn out—it was very modern.

The bird looked at the drawings and compared them to the current framework.

“……”

There was still a long way to go.

Bai Linlin shook his bird head, but still said to the Pygmy Rabbit: “You’ve done very well. I will oversee the handling of this.”

After a while, the python came over and handed over a file:

“This is the list of suspected demons collected so far. The number is small, currently not exceeding one hundred, and those capable of shapeshifting are few and far between.”

“Unifying them under our jurisdiction is also a task.”

The bird nodded, his expression serious.

Next was the mole, who was very respectful and spoke of some of its experiences in Tongcheng:

“The spiritual energy here was very good many years ago, but it thinned out later, which is why I went into seclusion. But in recent years, there have been signs of recovery. I can sense fluctuations in demonic power.”

“Oh, right, Bureau Chief, this is the portrait I designed for you.”

Bai Linlin frowned at the mention, his bird eyes turning into triangles. He pattered over to the little shrine and followed the mole’s gaze, discovering the hanging painting.

Blue feathers, kind “eyes.”

“……”

“Absolutely not!”

What kind of talk is this? The worship of an individual demon is not advisable!

The mole was stunned for a moment, but was later lectured on “the power of the collective is greater than the power of the individual,” “we must unite firmly,” and other such ideologies.

“Then... should we tear it down? But humans come here to pay their respects.”

Bai Linlin tucked his wings and paced in front of the little shrine. He knew that the “humans” inside included his teachers.

This was easy to solve, but...

“How many humans come to worship?”

The mole felt it had done something wrong, its claws drooping as it confessed everything:

“There are a few middle-aged people, some elderly ones, and a group of children. A few days ago, there was a young person recording with a cell phone.”

Bai Linlin narrowed his bird eyes upon hearing this.

So many people...

“Bureau Chief, should we tear it down now?”

The blue-feathered little bird waved a wing and said very earnestly:

“Wait for now.”

-

The first inspection went quite smoothly. The Red-crowned Crane basically didn't intervene, watching the blue-feathered little bird’s movements from behind. It asked here and there, looking very responsible.

That was good.

By dusk, the bird had no choice but to return to the residential complex. As soon as he entered the door, he pattered toward the study.

Song Yu actually wanted to ask if he was tired, but as he followed, his little bird had already nimbly turned on the desk lamp with its claws, then pulled a pen from the pen holder and held it with its claws.

He began writing furiously.

Song Yu thought for a moment and decided to go make fruit juice for his little bird.

“Yes, everything is going smoothly. Linlin is preparing to build the Management Bureau; it hasn't been built yet.”

The man leaned against the kitchen counter, speaking to the elder at home in a gentle tone.

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国对此很是支持：

“这些都不是问题，鸟儿的事业最重要，万事开头难，我们家里要给托好底。”

宋郁点了点头，他的声音都压得很轻，并不希望吵到书房那里。

“小郁……你也要努力，鸟儿已经是妖怪了，它比你厉害，我们做人的，更是要争取上进……不能让管理局那里看轻。”

爷孙俩正在轻声交谈着。

灶台上还热着一小锅甜汤，咕嘟嘟地冒着泡。

……

丹顶鹤后面已经传授了发情期妖力控制的办法，白粼粼神色清明了许多，他后面提出了一个关键问题：

“那既然有这种控制的办法，为什么不一直压制着？”

丹顶鹤：“……”

它此刻就在书房里，看到桌面上圆滚滚的小鸟仰头询问，还一脸认真的样子，闭了闭眼。

“为什么要忍着？性压抑吗？那是人类社会才有的东西，中央那里本来就有明文规定，凡是结了伴侣的妖怪，都是有发情假的。”

“最短是一个月。”

白粼粼震惊，啪嗒啪嗒地走了过来，很着急地问：

“真的吗？”

丹顶鹤这下是真的觉得奇怪了，走了过来，正儿八经地道：

“妖怪手册是不是没看全？还有我给你的双修手册，到底学了没，说到这个，我真得问问你。”

“你和那人类配偶**的时候，到底有没有学着调动妖力，我看宋郁身上根本就没有什么同化的迹象，你不会是只用人家**了吧？”

桌子上的小鸟被这段话给冲击得愣愣的，羽毛蓬松，往后啪嗒啪嗒地走了几步，面色羞愤。

一两秒后——

“才没有！”

……

后面时间就过得很快，丹顶鹤中间回南市了一趟，没过两天又回来了。

主要是监工桐城这边的进度，大约在十几天之后，管理局终于完工，白粼粼决定在里面开一场庆功宴。

“这件怎么样？”

鸟穿着一身小西服，戴着礼帽，在立身镜前转了转，最后仰头看向身边的人。

“很好看。”

鸟满意，又仔细欣赏了一番。

阿姨前段时间注册了自媒体账号，这还是白粼粼提议的，名字叫做：鸟の手作。

和[粼粼大王]互关。

没过多久就超过了两万粉丝，还有隐隐往上涨的趋势。

多一份收入，阿姨也可以生活轻松些，之后接接广告，岂不是美美的？

鸟的聪明才智无人能及。

白粼粼收了收翅膀，觉得衣服非常合身，还有小领带的那种。

“好了，拍吧。”

鸟挺胸抬头的，相当自信。

宋郁拍摄了之前常规的三视图，同时还加入了创新的手法，把鸟的仰视图和俯视图都拍出来了。

圆滚滚的身躯。

很富态。

接下来就是发送给阿姨。

宋郁在玄关这里操作着，肩头已经稳稳地站着一只小鸟，在低头看着手机屏幕。

[图片]

[图片]

[图片]

……

手机那边很快就有回复了：

[可爱可爱，捂嘴笑.jpg。]

[我看袖口那里还是有些窄的，小鸟难受不难受，我下次改改。]

阿姨是个完美主义者。

鸟伸了伸自己的翅根，很轻松的，一点都不紧的，他立马同人说了这件事。

“啾啾！”

宋郁垂眸打字反馈，那边很快又回了消息：

[不难受就好！过段时间就秋天了，到时候给我们小鸟用羊毛线勾个马甲！]

白粼粼已经开始期待了。

[您不要太辛苦就是了。]

大约又聊了一会，宋郁就开始把页面切走了，换到了社交媒体那里，自动忽略后台的小红点，点进了[鸟の手作]的主页面。

很快视频就更新出来了。

照片剪辑，搭配的bgm是平台推荐的[I'm a Coconut]。

旋律朗朗上口，附带着小鸟的潮流图片。

Coconut coconut……

Ah ah I'm a coconut……

白粼粼很是满意，用鸟头顶了顶人的下巴，催促着打开评论区。

[传说中的粼粼经纪人？]

[艾玛，鸟要去参加舞会了。]

[这手工活，主页写了，全是阿姨自己做的，私人定制……私鸟定制！]

[点明批评隔壁的主号，怎么还不更新！]

白粼粼伸爪子过去挨个点赞了，心情美美的，待会还有001的照片的！

大约过了十几分钟，玄关处出现了另外一只小雀，风尘仆仆的，甩了甩鸟头。

001前几天去中央了，升为双S的需要开大会，顺便领个勋章。

白粼粼见到好朋鸟过来了，立马扑棱翅膀下来，从旁边的桌子上叼过来另一套衣服，示意对方赶紧换上。

小雀懵懵的，不过倒是没有先弄这个，而是很认真地把勋章放在了地板上，用鸟头拱过去。

“247，给你。”

宋郁愣了下，还是提醒道：

“这个不用给粼粼的，这是你的荣耀。”

小雀仰着鸟头，有些不解道：

“可是这个很好看。”

白粼粼此刻已经把衣服给放下了，啪嗒啪嗒地走过去，抬起来翅膀盖住另外一个小雀，凑过来道：

“不用给我，但我可以给你保存着。”

“放到保险柜里！”

宋郁后面就没有再干预了，他的小鸟有这样的友谊是难得的，他想了想，心里有个想法。

不过就在这时，小雀已经换上了黑色的小礼服了，配套的那种。

“拍照！”

“来个视频吧！”

出门前的ootd已换好，发送给阿姨之后，一人两鸟就出门了。

-

桐城妖怪管理局，地址为XX省桐城市昌平区凤阳街21号。

宾利停在了小道的不远处，林子里很是静悄悄的，只有些昆虫的鸣叫。

小庙还在，不过这次不是石头垒的了，而是加了水泥固定，看着着实是结实了许多。

宋郁走到了这里，环顾了下四周，觉得和当时第一次来围墙那里有些类似的感觉。

抬步踩上一个枯枝之后，周遭的声音就被隔绝了，取而代之的则是一点点幽光。

小庙旁边的石头上有着发光的纹路。

白粼粼扑棱翅膀从人的肩头下来了，很是从容不迫，很是自信地伸出来了翅膀，刚要施法的时候，往后瞥了一眼。

人，看好了。

这次肯定不会和上次去南市管理局那样了，这可是鸟的地盘！

白粼粼自信地扬了扬鸟头。

然后翅膀下方金光流动，刚要开启大门，但就在这时，一个黑漆漆的鼠头突然冒了出来。

鸟吓得不轻，伸着翅根就掉头跑，啪嗒啪嗒冲了一阵才反应过来。

“粼粼，是鼹鼠。”

“鸟局，是我……”

白粼粼闭了闭鸟眼，垂着鸟头，啪嗒啪嗒地又走回去了。

知不知道妖吓妖吓死妖啊！

他必须要针对这个情况做出严肃处理——

“鸟局，我来迎接迎接您。”
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo was very supportive of this:

"These are not problems at all. The bird’s career is the most important thing. Every beginning is hard, and our family must provide a solid foundation."

Song Yu nodded, his voice kept very low, as he did not want to disturb the study.

"Xiao Yu... you must also work hard. The bird is already a supernatural being; it is more capable than you. We humans must strive for self-improvement... we cannot let the Management Bureau look down on us."

The grandfather and grandson were conversing in hushed tones.

On the stove, a small pot of sweet soup was still warming, bubbling softly.

...

The Red-crowned Crane had already taught him how to control his supernatural energy during the estrus period. Bai Linlin’s expression was much clearer now, and he later raised a key question:

"Since there is a way to control it, why not suppress it all the time?"

Red-crowned Crane: "..."

It was currently in the study, watching the round, fluffy little bird tilt its head and ask with a completely serious expression. It closed its eyes.

"Why endure it? Sexual repression? That is something that only exists in human society. The Central Bureau has explicit regulations: any supernatural being that has formed a bond is entitled to estrus leave."

"The minimum is one month."

Bai Linlin was shocked. He trotted over, *patter-patter-patter*, and asked anxiously:

"Really?"

The Red-crowned Crane truly found this strange now. It walked over and said in a professional tone:

"Did you not read the Supernatural Handbook in its entirety? And the dual-cultivation manual I gave you—did you actually study it? Speaking of which, I really must ask you."

"When you are mating with that human spouse, did you actually learn to mobilize your supernatural energy? I see no signs of assimilation on Song Yu at all. You haven't just been using him for... have you?"

The little bird on the table was stunned by this statement. Its feathers puffed up, and it took a few steps back, *patter-patter-patter*, its face full of shame and indignation.

A second or two later—

"I did not!"

...

Time passed quickly after that. The Red-crowned Crane returned to Nan City in the middle of the period and came back after only two days.

The main goal was to supervise the progress in Tong City. About a dozen days later, the Management Bureau was finally completed, and Bai Linlin decided to hold a celebration banquet inside.

"How is this one?"

The bird was wearing a small suit and a top hat, spinning in front of a full-length mirror before finally looking up at the person beside him.

"It looks very good."

The bird was satisfied and admired himself carefully once more.

His aunt had registered a social media account a while ago—it was actually Bai Linlin’s suggestion—named: *Bird’s Handmade*.

It had mutual follows with [Linlin the Great].

Not long after, it surpassed twenty thousand followers, with a trend of continuing to rise.

With an extra source of income, his aunt could live more easily. Later, she could take on advertisements; wouldn't that be wonderful?

The bird’s wit and intelligence were unparalleled.

Bai Linlin tucked in his wings, feeling that the outfit fit perfectly, complete with a little tie.

"Alright, take the picture."

The bird puffed out his chest and held his head high, looking quite confident.

Song Yu took the standard three-view photos, and also added an innovative technique, capturing both a low-angle view and a top-down view of the bird.

A round, chubby physique.

Very prosperous-looking.

Next was sending it to his aunt.

Song Yu was operating his phone in the entryway, with the little bird standing steadily on his shoulder, looking down at the screen.

[Image]

[Image]

[Image]

...

There was a reply from the phone very quickly:

[So cute, so cute! *Covering mouth and laughing.jpg*]

[I see the cuffs are still a bit narrow. Is the little bird uncomfortable? I’ll alter it next time.]

His aunt was a perfectionist.

The bird stretched his wing roots; it was very comfortable, not tight at all. He immediately told the person about it.

"Chirp chirp!"

Song Yu lowered his eyes to type the feedback, and a message came back shortly after:

[As long as he’s not uncomfortable! Autumn is coming soon; I’ll crochet a vest for our little bird with wool yarn then!]

Bai Linlin was already starting to look forward to it.

[Please don't overwork yourself.]

After chatting for a while longer, Song Yu switched pages, moving to social media. He automatically ignored the little red notification dots in the background and clicked into the main page of [Bird’s Handmade].

The video was updated quickly.

A montage of photos, set to the platform-recommended BGM, [I'm a Coconut].

The melody was catchy, accompanied by trendy pictures of the little bird.

*Coconut coconut...*

*Ah ah I'm a coconut...*

Bai Linlin was very satisfied. He nudged the person’s chin with his bird head, urging him to open the comment section.

[Is this the legendary Agent Linlin?]

[Oh my, the bird is going to a ball.]

[This handicraft—the homepage says it’s all made by the aunt herself. Private custom... Private-bird custom!]

[Publicly criticizing the main account next door: why haven't you updated yet!]

Bai Linlin reached out with a claw to like them one by one, feeling wonderful. There would be photos of 001 later too!

About ten minutes later, another little sparrow appeared at the entryway, dusty from travel, shaking its bird head.

001 had gone to the Central Bureau a few days ago; those promoted to Double-S rank had to attend a grand meeting and, incidentally, receive a medal.

Seeing his good bird-friend arrive, Bai Linlin immediately flapped his wings and flew down, picking up another set of clothes from the table nearby, signaling the other to change into it quickly.

The little sparrow was dazed, but instead of doing that first, it very earnestly placed the medal on the floor and nudged it forward with its bird head.

"247, for you."

Song Yu paused, but still reminded him:

"You don't need to give this to Linlin. This is your honor."

The little sparrow tilted its bird head, somewhat confused:

"But this is very pretty."

Bai Linlin had already put down the clothes. He walked over, *patter-patter-patter*, lifted his wing to cover the other little sparrow, and leaned in:

"You don't have to give it to me, but I can keep it for you."

"I'll put it in the safe!"

Song Yu did not intervene further. It was rare for his little bird to have such a friendship, and as he thought about it, an idea formed in his heart.

However, at that moment, the little sparrow had already changed into the matching black little tuxedo.

"Take a picture!"

"Let's make a video!"

The OOTD for going out was ready. After sending it to his aunt, the one human and two birds headed out.

-

Tong City Supernatural Management Bureau, address: No. 21 Fengyang Street, Changping District, Tong City, XX Province.

The Bentley stopped not far from the small path. The woods were very quiet, with only the chirping of some insects.

The small temple was still there, but this time it wasn't built of loose stones; it was reinforced with cement, looking much sturdier.

Song Yu walked over, looked around, and felt a sensation similar to when he first arrived at the perimeter wall.

After stepping on a withered branch, the surrounding sounds were cut off, replaced by a faint, ghostly light.

There were glowing patterns on the stone next to the small temple.

Bai Linlin flapped his wings and hopped off the person’s shoulder. He was very composed and confident as he extended his wings. Just as he was about to cast a spell, he glanced backward.

*Human, watch closely.*

This time, it definitely wouldn't be like the last time at the Nan City Bureau. This was the bird’s territory!

Bai Linlin lifted his bird head confidently.

Then, golden light flowed beneath his wings. Just as he was about to open the gate, a pitch-black mouse head suddenly popped out.

The bird was terrified. He extended his wing roots and turned to run, charging a distance, *patter-patter-patter*, before he realized what happened.

"Linlin, it's a mole."

"Director Bird, it's me..."

Bai Linlin closed his bird eyes, lowered his bird head, and walked back, *patter-patter-patter*.

*Do you know that scaring a supernatural being to death is a crime?!*

He had to handle this situation severely—

"Director Bird, I came to welcome you."

chunks.chineseText:
鼹鼠很拘谨地说了这话，之后就规规矩矩地站在旁边了，月光皎洁，它身着一身牛仔马甲，这还是同僚花枝鼠给它的。

白粼粼没话说了，只是挥了挥翅膀：

“进去吧进去吧。”

一道闪着光的门凭空出现，里面还有些悠扬的音乐，鸟率先伸了鸟腿进去。

-

桐城管理局。

这里的面积虽然很小，窗口里的妖目前就开了鼹鼠的那一个，但里面还是热热闹闹的，南市的小妖们随身携带着奏乐工具，此刻正在活动区域内弹奏着。

见到了门口的蓝羽小鸟，立马朝这里挥手。

“老大老大！”

“老大！”

白粼粼挥了挥翅膀，很是欣慰地点头。

宋郁环顾了下四周，发现妖怪们基本上都用上提供的材料了，而且由于妖力维持，显得吊灯都五光十色的。

圆型沙发那里还有个自助售卖机，管理局新建的三个月内，都是免费的。

大厅的两个任务大屏目前还没有滚动起来，因为这些需要进一步的调查，但目前管理局建起来就是一个阶段的成功。

白粼粼啪嗒啪嗒地往前走，问了问鼹鼠的近况：

“管理局里有休息场所，最近还好吗？”

鼹鼠点头点头。

“我已经把你的编号录入了，中央那里汇账应该很快，你拿到人类货币了吗？”

鼹鼠连忙道：“拿到了拿到了，我现在不愁吃穿了。”

鸟很欣慰，还在往前走。

“我看你A级，是可以化形的那种，桐城这里美食众多，需要的我可以给你推荐。”

“噢，可以向我报经费，但你要在当地搜集下信息，看看有无受到虐待的同族和妖力波动的情况，这是我们目前要努力的地方。”

鼹鼠跟在后头：“好！我会用心工作的！”

白粼粼点了点头，走到办公室门口的时候挥了挥翅膀：

“今天是庆功宴，那里已经有活动了，去放松一下吧。”

鼹鼠眼睛都亮了亮。

体恤下属的领导！

鸟打开了办公室的大门，把人给带进来了，不过准备关门的时候，发觉少了什么。

白粼粼探头四处看，最终在一个围炉烤肉那里看到了小雀，对方正用爪子把着签子，很沉浸地吃肉。

“……”

庆功宴的食材很早就准备好了，大多都放在了妖怪们住的那间别墅里，它们很是兢兢业业地在今天全运过来了，开始自主活动了起来。

到处都是香气。

白粼粼看了看外面狂欢的场景，还算满意，抬翅膀合上门，一时间所有声音都被隔绝了。

鸟回过了头，看到了站着的人。

眯了眯鸟眼。

这可是鸟的办公室。

宋郁环顾了下四周，觉得这里面还算可以，就是没有丹顶鹤那样子的书架，显得有些空旷。

“宋-郁！”

鸟啪嗒啪嗒地走了过来。

人回了回神，刚要俯身蹲下，但他的小鸟已经步步紧逼。

圆圆的鸟眼变成了邪恶三角眼。

“……”

宋郁没办法，只好顺着对方的意思，往后退，他的小鸟果然更兴奋了。

白粼粼心想这可是妖怪管理局，里里外外都是他的小妖，那句话怎么说？

“就算你喊破喉咙也——”

翅膀小小的，抵在了墙边。

宋郁：“……”

最后人没忍住，轻笑了下。

白粼粼心想小看他，鸟这次长记性了，为了避免爆衣，提前把小西服给脱掉了，动作相当潇洒。

鸟垂下鸟头，身躯开始慢慢膨大。

但就在这时。

“247？”

“我进来了。”

门口叩了两下，丹顶鹤刚过来，听到鼹鼠说247来办公室了，心想还算用功，它正好再把一些公文的模板拿过来。

上一句起到一个通知的作用，丹顶鹤进门的时候，看到的就是……

保温杯一样的小鸟伸着翅膀壁咚，地板上还散落着一套衣服。

“……”

最后还是饶不了一套思想教育。

-

咚——

大厅的挂钟开始敲响了，此刻正是凌晨两点，地方管理局的统一活动时间。

办公室门开的时候里面还有批评声：

“这像什么话，下次要干这种事务必要锁门！”

“或者直接用术法把人弄消失，这你学了没？”

出来的是一只系着丝带的丹顶鹤，身后跟着垂头丧气的小鸟，西服已经穿好了。

宋郁本来是在门口的，但是被花枝鼠们拉走了，它们要开始奏乐。

敲锣打鼓，吹拉弹唱。

什么都会。

“南市的其他小妖我带回来了，你这次是榜样，做好表率！在办公室里搞什么play？”

“跟你说话呢！”

丹顶鹤的批评声由远及近。

宋郁听到声音立马起来了，走了过去，垂眸看着他的小鸟，还垂着头。

老老实实的样子。

“没事，教育好了，以后遇到这种情况及时跟我联系就好。”

白粼粼闻言一顿，仰着鸟头看了过去，果不其然丹顶鹤收了收翅膀，避开了眼神。

鸟就知道！

001这个时候也过来，扑棱翅膀飞了过来，稳稳地落地，喙上还有些烧烤料，毛绒绒的。

“行了，上去说两句。”

咚——

咚——

有钟被敲响，诸多妖怪都看向了一处，那是一个小型的平台，上面有红木设计的演讲席，上面有个小型麦克风，鸟西服革履，开始发表讲话：

“诸位。”

丹顶鹤在台下站着，点了点鸟头，247已经颇有它的风骨了。

“我能走到现在，全靠诸位的帮扶，如果没有南市管理局对我的培养，我也不会获得去中央进修的机会，更不会来到桐城……”

底下的小妖都星星眼地看着上面，鼹鼠这段时间其实也知道了，这些都是鸟局之前的妖脉。

怪不得这么优秀。

“其次，我还要感谢我的老师丹顶鹤与我的挚友001，是它们在我困顿的时候帮助了我，犹如黑夜里的灯塔。”

丹顶鹤眯了眯鸟眼，舒坦多了。

小雀已经拿出来了那个没吃完的棒棒糖，用爪子把着，很是专心致志，听到上面的话后一懵。

“蛋挞还是薯塔？”

“最后，我要感谢——”

白粼粼莫名有些紧张，爪子在台面上抠了抠，心里怦怦的。

他深呼吸一口气，然后道：

“感谢我的伴侣，是他一直陪着我，全力支持我的事业，桐城管理局能够顺利落地也有他的付出。”

“总之，我希望大家在今天尽情放纵！”

鸟翅根都在发热，说完了这些，台下寂静无声。

一秒，两秒。

响起来雷鸣的掌声。

……

夜色渐深，林子外面安静无比，但小庙的石头有金色波纹流动，“界”里的空间彩灯环绕，无数小妖都开始狂欢舞蹈。

-

一周后。

南市管理局的小妖们离开，001驻守在桐城，但它本就隶属于南市管理局，因而拿两份工资。

宋郁则是需要去学校，他们真正意义上的“异地”了。

鸟一开始是有些不适应的。
chunks.englishText:
The mole said this quite timidly and then stood respectfully to the side. The moonlight was bright; it was wearing a denim vest, which had been given to it by a colleague, a fancy mouse.

Bai Linlin had nothing more to say, simply waving his wings:

"Go in, go in."

A glowing door appeared out of thin air, with some melodious music playing inside. The bird was the first to step his bird-leg inside.

-

Tong City Management Bureau.

Although the area here was small, and only the mole’s window was currently open, it was still lively inside. The little supernatural beings from Nan City had brought their musical instruments and were currently playing in the activity area.

Seeing the blue-feathered little bird at the door, they immediately waved.

"Boss, boss!"

"Boss!"

Bai Linlin waved his wings, nodding with great satisfaction.

Song Yu looked around and discovered that the supernatural beings were basically using the provided materials. Moreover, due to the maintenance of supernatural energy, even the chandeliers appeared colorful.

There was a self-service vending machine near the round sofa, which was free for the first three months of the Bureau’s establishment.

The two task screens in the lobby were not yet scrolling, as those required further investigation, but the establishment of the Bureau itself was a success in this phase.

Bai Linlin walked forward, *patter-patter-patter*, and asked about the mole’s recent situation:

"There are rest areas in the Bureau. How have you been lately?"

The mole nodded repeatedly.

"I have already registered your ID number. The transfer from the Central Bureau should be fast. Have you received the human currency?"

The mole quickly said: "I have, I have. I don't have to worry about food or clothing anymore."

The bird was very pleased and continued walking forward.

"I see you are A-rank, the kind that can shapeshift. Tong City has many delicacies; I can recommend some to you if you need."

"Oh, you can report expenses to me, but you must collect information locally to see if there are any persecuted kin or fluctuations in supernatural energy. This is where we need to focus our efforts for now."

The mole followed behind: "Okay! I will work hard!"

Bai Linlin nodded. When he reached the office door, he waved his wings:

"Today is a celebration banquet. There is already an event going on there; go and relax."

The mole’s eyes lit up.

*A leader who cares for his subordinates!*

The bird opened the office door and brought the person inside. However, when he was about to close the door, he realized something was missing.

Bai Linlin poked his head out to look around and finally saw the little sparrow at a barbecue grill, holding a skewer with its claws, completely immersed in eating meat.

"..."

The ingredients for the celebration banquet had been prepared long ago, mostly kept in the villa where the supernatural beings lived. They had diligently transported everything over today and started their own activities.

The scent was everywhere.

Bai Linlin looked at the scene of revelry outside and was fairly satisfied. He raised his wing to close the door, and all the noise was instantly cut off.

The bird turned back and saw the person standing there.

He narrowed his bird eyes.

This was the bird’s office.

Song Yu looked around and felt that it was decent, though it lacked bookshelves like the Red-crowned Crane’s, making it look a bit empty.

"Song—Yu!"

The bird walked over, *patter-patter-patter*.

The person regained his focus and was just about to bend down, but his little bird was already pressing forward step by step.

The round bird eyes turned into evil triangular eyes.

"..."

Song Yu had no choice but to follow the other’s lead and step back. His little bird was indeed even more excited.

Bai Linlin thought to himself, *This is the Supernatural Management Bureau; inside and out, these are all my little supernatural beings. How does that saying go?*

"Even if you scream until your throat breaks—"

The tiny wings pressed against the wall.

Song Yu: "..."

In the end, the person couldn't help but chuckle softly.

Bai Linlin thought, *Underestimating him? The bird has learned his lesson this time.* To avoid tearing his clothes, he had taken off his little suit in advance, his movements quite dashing.

The bird lowered his head, and his body began to slowly expand.

But just then.

"247?"

"I'm coming in."

There were two knocks at the door. The Red-crowned Crane had just arrived, having heard from the mole that 247 was in the office. It thought he was being diligent and happened to bring over some document templates.

The previous sentence served as a notification. When the Red-crowned Crane entered the room, what it saw was...

A thermos-sized little bird extending its wings to "wall-pin" someone, with a set of clothes scattered on the floor.

"..."

In the end, he still couldn't escape a round of ideological education.

-

*Dong—*

The wall clock in the lobby began to chime. It was exactly 2:00 AM, the unified activity time for local bureaus.

When the office door opened, there were still sounds of criticism inside:

"What does this look like? Next time you want to do this kind of business, make sure to lock the door!"

"Or just use a spell to make people disappear. Did you learn that?"

Out came a Red-crowned Crane wearing a ribbon, followed by a dejected little bird, his suit already back on.

Song Yu had originally been at the door, but he was pulled away by the fancy mice; they were starting to play music.

Beating gongs and drums, playing wind and string instruments.

They could do it all.

"I brought back the other little supernatural beings from Nan City. You are an example this time; set a good precedent! What kind of 'play' are you doing in the office?"

"I'm talking to you!"

The Red-crowned Crane’s criticism grew closer.

Song Yu heard the voice and immediately stood up, walking over. He looked down at his little bird, who was still hanging his head.

Looking very obedient.

"It's fine. He's been educated. Just contact me in time if you encounter this situation again."

Bai Linlin paused upon hearing this and looked up. Sure enough, the Red-crowned Crane tucked its wings and looked away.

*The bird knew it!*

001 also came over at this time, flapping its wings and landing steadily, its beak still covered in barbecue seasoning, looking fluffy.

"Alright, go up and say a few words."

*Dong—*

*Dong—*

A bell was struck, and many supernatural beings looked toward one spot. It was a small platform with a mahogany podium and a small microphone. The bird, dressed in a suit and leather shoes, began to deliver his speech:

"Everyone."

The Red-crowned Crane stood off-stage and nodded; 247 already possessed quite a bit of its demeanor.

"I have been able to reach this point thanks to everyone’s help. If it weren't for the cultivation of the Nan City Bureau, I would not have had the opportunity to go to the Central Bureau for further study, nor would I have come to Tong City..."

The little supernatural beings below looked at him with starry eyes. The mole had actually learned during this time that these were all the bird’s previous connections.

No wonder he was so excellent.

"Secondly, I want to thank my teacher, the Red-crowned Crane, and my best friend, 001. It was they who helped me when I was in distress, like a lighthouse in the dark night."

The Red-crowned Crane narrowed its bird eyes, feeling much more comfortable.

The little sparrow had already taken out the half-eaten lollipop, holding it with its claws, very focused. It was stunned after hearing the words above.

"Egg tart or potato tower?"

"Finally, I want to thank—"

Bai Linlin felt inexplicably nervous. He scratched at the podium with his claws, his heart thumping.

He took a deep breath and then said:

"Thank you to my partner. It is he who has always accompanied me and fully supported my career. The smooth landing of the Tong City Bureau also has his contribution."

"In short, I hope everyone indulges themselves today!"

The bird’s wing roots were burning hot. After saying this, the audience below was silent.

One second, two seconds.

Thunderous applause erupted.

...

The night grew deeper. Outside the woods, it was incredibly quiet, but the stones of the small temple had golden ripples flowing over them. Within the "boundary," the space was surrounded by colorful lights, and countless little supernatural beings began to dance in revelry.

-

A week later.

The little supernatural beings from the Nan City Bureau left. 001 remained stationed in Tong City, but since it was originally affiliated with the Nan City Bureau, it drew two salaries.

Song Yu, however, needed to go to school. They were now "long-distance" in the true sense.

The bird was a bit unaccustomed to it at first.

chunks.chineseText:
但好在工作推进的顺利，鼹鼠对于桐城的信息把控还是到位的，在短短半个月的时间内就招来了不少窗口的管理妖，分别是虎纹蛙、小麂、穿山甲……

它们大多是保护动物，深谙外面形势不好，一直深居简出，倒是渐渐开了神智。

白粼粼很是利落地把中央的补给下发了，有了妖力津贴，这些妖怪的能力会变强，状态也会变好。

鸟很认真地分配了工作，并写了年度计划，开始把两个滚动屏幕弄起来。

001在这边也大多是负责监察。

它不再做地方的灰色任务了，因为已经被中央记录过了，专门培养为联合任务专员。

但组织考虑001年纪尚小，排列权重把它放在最下面了。

小雀闲闲的。

白粼粼一开始是很累的，但好在鼹鼠是个得力帮手，很快窗口负责妖都做起来了，001还会指导它们去做任务，一来二去就运转起来了。

基本采取的是和南市管理局一样的模式，登记在册的妖怪要保持每周一次的出勤。

白粼粼前几周是每天都去的，后面就变成稳定的一周去四天的样子。

宋郁不常能见到，他回来的时候，鸟要么去管理局了，要么在睡觉。

但早上会看到热着的蟹黄包。

鸟有些郁闷。

异地真不好！真不好！

直到中央传讯过来：

[N247，上任时期为发情期中，现特此补假，可灵活调整时间……]

白粼粼：！

一日晴天。

“少年”在床上趴着，很是认认真真地通知了宋郁这件事，他决定好好休息一下。

两年的基层经历。

要久久为功，不能太急了。

白粼粼这段时间都晚上坐班，其实等消息的时候也有些困，迷迷糊糊地就睡过去了，时间很快地流逝了。

卧室里很昏暗。

有密码锁响的声音，脚步声靠近，一身寒气，人走到了床边。

白粼粼睡得很舒服，隐隐约约有种视线感，他对这个并不排斥，但刚要掀开眼皮的时候，气息突然靠近。

他一下子绷直了身子。

宋郁干什么？

下一秒，唇瓣被弄开了。

齿关被抵开，上颚被一寸寸地舔过，白粼粼眼皮一下子就红了，他被弄的下巴都是抬着的。

这段时间唇瓣一直是肿着的。

原来是——

白粼粼一声不吭的，浑身都在发热，他、他现在怎么办……醒过来吗？

“少年”从来没有遇到过这种事，他以为宋郁很忙的，见不到面也只是发消息同他说“没关系”。

他以为……

吻得更重了。

白粼粼里里外外被吻透了，舌尖都被勾出来了，他眼皮泛着潮气，最后实在忍不住了，刚要睁开眼皮。

耳垂被含了下。

“粼粼，不要装睡。”
chunks.englishText:
But fortunately, the work progressed smoothly. The mole’s control over information in Tong City was on point. In just half a month, it had recruited quite a few management supernatural beings for the windows, including a tiger-striped frog, a Reeves's muntjac, and a pangolin...

Most of them were protected species, well aware that the situation outside was not good, and had always kept a low profile, though they had gradually gained sentience.

Bai Linlin very efficiently distributed the supplies from the Central Bureau. With the supernatural energy allowance, the abilities of these beings would grow stronger, and their conditions would improve.

The bird assigned work very seriously, wrote an annual plan, and started getting the two scrolling screens up and running.

001 mostly handled supervision here.

It no longer took on gray-area local tasks because it had already been recorded by the Central Bureau and was being specifically trained as a joint task commissioner.

However, the organization considered 001 to be young, so it placed it at the bottom of the priority list.

The little sparrow was idle.

Bai Linlin had been very tired at first, but fortunately, the mole was a capable assistant. Soon, all the window-responsible beings were up and running, and 001 would guide them in performing tasks, so it started to function smoothly.

They basically adopted the same model as the Nan City Management Bureau: registered supernatural beings had to maintain one attendance per week.

Bai Linlin went every day for the first few weeks, but later it stabilized to four days a week.

He couldn't see Song Yu often. When he returned, the bird was either at the Bureau or asleep.

But in the morning, he would see warm crab-roe buns.

The bird was a bit depressed.

*Long-distance is really not good! Really not good!*

Until a message came from the Central Bureau:

[N247, your term of office is during the estrus period. You are hereby granted supplementary leave; you may flexibly adjust your schedule...]

Bai Linlin: !

One sunny day.

The "youth" was lying on the bed, very earnestly notifying Song Yu of this. He decided to take a good rest.

Two years of grassroots experience.

One must work persistently; one cannot be too hasty.

Bai Linlin had been working night shifts during this time, and he was actually a bit sleepy while waiting for news, drifting off into a daze as time passed quickly.

The bedroom was dim.

There was the sound of the keypad lock, footsteps approaching, and a chill in the air as the person walked to the bedside.

Bai Linlin was sleeping very comfortably, vaguely feeling a gaze on him. He was not averse to this, but just as he was about to lift his eyelids, a presence suddenly drew close.

He instantly tensed up.

*What is Song Yu doing?*

The next second, his lips were parted.

His teeth were nudged open, and his palate was licked inch by inch. Bai Linlin’s eyelids instantly turned red, and he was forced to lift his chin.

His lips had been swollen during this entire period.

So that was why—

Bai Linlin didn't make a sound, his whole body burning hot. He, he... what should he do now... wake up?

The "youth" had never encountered such a thing. He thought Song Yu was very busy, and even when they couldn't meet, he only sent messages saying "it's okay."

He thought...

The kiss grew heavier.

Bai Linlin was kissed thoroughly, inside and out, his tongue even hooked out. His eyelids were damp, and finally, unable to bear it any longer, he was about to open his eyes.

His earlobe was nibbled.

"Linlin, don't pretend to be asleep."

chunks.chineseText:
第70章

卧室里静悄悄的，白粼粼闻言一下子耳根就红了，抬手抵住对方的肩头，睁开了眼睛，面颊上洇着红。

“你——”

宋郁垂眸看着“人”，视线扫着，落在那个红润的唇上的时候，瞳孔暗沉了些。

低头又吻了过去。

“唔嗯……”

白粼粼被刺激得腰都往上顶了下，湿滑的感觉充斥着口腔，他没办法，只能双手环着对方的脖子。

柔顺的家居服都起了褶皱，露出来了光洁的皮肤。

在喘息的间隙之中才有几句交流，额头相互抵着：

“放假么……粼粼。”

“哈……是，但我还没上报时间。”

“去结婚好不好？”

“啊？”

宋郁一点点地吻了下来，“少年”喘着气，微微仰着下巴，抱着了对方的头，他瞳孔都有些扩散。

结婚？

好像，是答应过？

-

但结婚并不是一件非常容易的事，首先就是人类身份的问题。

妖界已经结过契了，在桐城也办了酒席了，白粼粼其实不太理解宋郁为什么非要执着一个仪式。

他还在上大学。

十九岁……

这么高精力么？

翌日清晨。

白粼粼还在床上睡着，浑身干爽舒适，阳光从窗户透过来，照的“人”热热的，手指微微动了下。

随即就是伸展身体。

白粼粼听到了浴室里的声音，莫名安心了很多，随即很灵活地化成本体，毛绒绒的小鸟正趴在床上睡觉，两个爪子朝后放着，鸟头侧着，眼睛也是闭上的。

大约蓄力了一两秒。

之后才往前伸了伸翅膀，与此同时后面的爪子也收紧了核心，踹了下空气。

鸟体舒展。

宋郁从浴室里出来，身着黑色修身上衣，面色冷淡，手指骨节都被冷水冲得泛红。

不过走到床边却很温和，轻声道：

“粼粼？”

蓝羽小鸟爪子微微动了下，像是还在睡梦之中。

宋郁微微弯腰，在靠近的时候，床上的“少年”幻化了出来，面颊红润，正抬着手盖着眼皮。

“唔……”

人没有过多思考，就抬起来了手了，替他的小鸟挡住了日光，“少年”立马侧了身子，很自然地贴了过去。

白粼粼闭着眼睛，又安安稳稳地睡了一觉。

一个小时后。

宋郁还在床边守着，垂眸看着，学校那里他提前请了假，过段时间正好国庆，可以连休。

公司那里的事他安排好了，有什么消息会及时传过来的。

……

早午餐时间。

白粼粼在人的腿上坐着，靠着睡觉，宋郁在拆送过来的早茶。

蟹黄包。

烧卖。

虾饺。

应有尽有。

“少年”后面才清醒了过来了，拿着筷子夹着，慢慢地吃了起来，眼睛很是圆润，有种小鸟的感觉。

“去国外？”

“我要和鼹鼠交代下工作事项的。”

“不过这个不是最重要的。”

白粼粼唇边油油的，转头看了过来，不理解地问：

“我没有身份证，怎么坐飞机？”

“托运？”

白粼粼自顾自地说道，眉毛皱了皱，他才不要坐托运，很奇怪的。

不过他是小鸟，理论上来说，他是不是可以飞到国外？

“少年”开始神游，直到耳边传来一句：

“家里有私人飞机。”

“……”

宋郁揽着“人”的腰，垂眸看着，温声道：

“不过还是需要证件。”

“我们这次去办了好么？”

白粼粼愣住了，他不可思议地看了过来：

“可以吗？”

他以为这件事要很久之后才可以做到，毕竟人类社会的制度还是很完善的，目前黑户的存在已经很少了。

白粼粼说不兴奋是假的，如果有了身份证的话，那他在人类社会也可以自由行动了！

“可以的。”

-

宋郁早在很久之前就考虑过这件事了，打点关系、拜访爷爷留下来的人脉资源，他这段时间也很忙。

但好在一一把问题解决了。

001是在这个时候被叫回来的，懵懵地就上了一辆车，然后跟着247同他的监护人进了一个大楼里。

“你来了。”

“嗯，辛苦了。”

简单的客套之后，后面就是正规的环节了，各种各样的签字环节，首先是要上户。

“白粼粼是吧？”

对面的蓝发少年点了点头，坐在椅子上很是规规矩矩的，工作人员拿着一些文件开始操作，办事很是利索。

户籍是：XX省南市平湖区锦园12栋。

户主：白粼粼。

宋郁在这件事上的确花费了很多时间，尤其是在补充事实链条这方面，从出生缘何没有登记、为什么辍学、一路上的亲朋好友……都需要打点。

妖怪的人类身份是受到限制的，它们往往是有“通行证”，而无“身份证”，不可以无障碍地与人类一起“工作”，749局会认为存在威胁。

至于那些有“身份证”的妖怪，往往是有人类伴侣的那种，走的是官方渠道，也填补了事实逻辑，能承担司法后果，所以他们会睁一只眼闭一只眼。

白粼粼对此一无所知，他甚至不知道一些前期手续已经提前办理完毕，这次来这里主要是申领户口薄。

至于001……

“白一一是吧？”

黑衣少年已经在车上知道了这件事的来龙去脉，虽然它抗议过要叫“白皮球”这样结合了“皮皮”和“球球”的叠词，看着可爱又霸气。

但被247给一票否了。

“是。”

黑衣少年点了点头，心里有些小小的郁闷，但还是决定听从指挥。

“兄弟两个啊？一个0号一个1号，0在1前面，是哥哥没错。”

工作人员不由得笑了下，而后很利索地检查了下第二页的信息。

户主或与户主关系：兄弟。

姓名：白一一。

“好了，办理完了。”

宋郁这才带着两个“人”出来，在走到路边停车位的时候，旁边有个售卖奶油冰棍的小摊子。

“……”

等到上车之后，后座已经坐着两个吃着冰棍的“少年”了，在贴着头研究户口本。

“你就跟我姓，多好！”

“为什么不能用编号？妖界大多数是用编号的，不过也有妖有人类的名字，就是皮皮球球……”

“打住！”

宋郁在前面开着车子，它们还需要领一下身份证，在等红绿灯的时候，后面还在讨论：

“有的名字就很简单，鼠二、熊三那种就是很方便。”

“可是妖界有很多一样的妖怪，长得相似，那怎么弄？”

“编号，我的全称是：伯劳001，去中央会加上N，你不也是？不过鹦鹉没有很细分。”

“噢噢这样。”

红绿灯换了，宋郁手放在方向盘上，很熟练地拐了个弯，后排的两个“少年”已经把奶油小冰棍吃得差不多了。

白粼粼很是认真地道：

“不管，反正你是我弟弟了，要跟着哥哥姓的，有了身份证的话，我们就可以人形去迪士尼玩了！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 70

The bedroom was deathly quiet. Upon hearing this, Bai Linlin’s earlobes turned crimson in an instant. He raised a hand to press against the other’s shoulder, opening his eyes, his cheeks flushed with a rosy hue.

"You—"

Song Yu lowered his gaze to look at "him," his eyes sweeping down until they landed on those flushed lips, his pupils darkening slightly.

He lowered his head and kissed him again.

"Mmph..."

Bai Linlin was so stimulated that his waist arched upward; a slick, wet sensation flooded his mouth. He had no choice but to wrap his arms around the other’s neck.

His soft loungewear became wrinkled, revealing patches of smooth, fair skin.

Between gasps for air, they managed to exchange a few words, their foreheads pressed together:

"Are you taking time off... Linlin?"

"Ha... yes, but I haven't submitted the dates yet."

"Shall we go get married?"

"Huh?"

Song Yu kissed him down, bit by bit. The "youth" panted, his chin tilted slightly upward, his hands clutching the back of the other’s head, his pupils dilated.

Get married?

It seemed... he had promised that, hadn't he?

-

But marriage was not an easy matter. The first hurdle was the issue of human identity.

They had already exchanged vows in the Demon Realm and held a banquet in Tongcheng. Bai Linlin didn't quite understand why Song Yu was so fixated on a formal ceremony.

He was still in college.

Nineteen years old...

Did he have this much energy?

The next morning.

Bai Linlin was still asleep in bed, his body feeling clean and comfortable. Sunlight filtered through the window, warming the "person" until his fingers twitched slightly.

Then, he stretched his body.

Bai Linlin heard sounds from the bathroom and felt inexplicably at ease. He flexibly shifted into his true form. A fluffy little bird was sprawled on the bed, its two claws tucked behind it, its head tilted to the side, eyes closed.

It gathered strength for a second or two.

Then, it stretched its wings forward, while its claws tightened their core, kicking at the air.

The bird’s body relaxed.

Song Yu emerged from the bathroom, dressed in a black slim-fit top. His expression was cool, his knuckles reddened from the cold water.

However, as he walked to the bedside, he became gentle, whispering softly:

"Linlin?"

The little blue-feathered bird’s claws twitched slightly, as if still in a dream.

Song Yu leaned over slightly. As he drew near, the "youth" on the bed materialized, his cheeks rosy, his hand raised to cover his eyes.

"Mmph..."

Without thinking, he raised his hand to shield his little bird from the sunlight. The "youth" immediately turned onto his side, naturally snuggling closer.

Bai Linlin kept his eyes closed and drifted back into a peaceful sleep.

An hour later.

Song Yu was still guarding the bedside, looking down. He had taken leave from school in advance; the National Day holiday was coming up soon, allowing for a long break.

He had already arranged matters at the company, and any urgent news would be forwarded to him immediately.

...

Brunch time.

Bai Linlin sat on the man’s lap, leaning against him while he slept, while Song Yu unpacked the breakfast that had been delivered.

Crab roe buns.

Shumai.

Shrimp dumplings.

Everything one could ask for.

The "youth" finally woke up, picking up his chopsticks to grab food, eating slowly. His eyes were very round, giving him a bird-like appearance.

"Going abroad?"

"I need to hand over some work matters to the Mole."

"But that’s not the most important thing."

Bai Linlin, his lips glistening with oil, turned his head and asked, puzzled:

"I don't have an ID card, how can I take a plane?"

"Checked baggage?"

Bai Linlin muttered to himself, his brows furrowing. He didn't want to be checked as baggage; that was too strange.

But he was a bird. Theoretically, couldn't he just fly abroad?

The "youth" began to drift off into his own thoughts until a voice reached his ears:

"We have a private jet at home."

"..."

Song Yu wrapped an arm around "his" waist, looking down, his voice gentle:

"But we still need identification documents."

"Shall we go get them sorted this time?"

Bai Linlin froze, looking at him in disbelief:

"Can we?"

He had thought this would take a long time to achieve, as the systems in human society were quite thorough, and "unregistered" individuals were becoming rare.

It would be a lie to say Bai Linlin wasn't excited. If he had an ID card, he could move freely in human society!

"We can."

-

Song Yu had considered this long ago. Pulling strings and visiting the connections left behind by his grandfather—he had been very busy during this time.

But fortunately, he had solved the problems one by one.

001 was summoned back at this moment. It got into a car, dazed, and followed 247 and his guardian into a large building.

"You're here."

"Yes, thank you for your hard work."

After simple pleasantries, they moved to the formal procedures—various forms to sign. First, they had to register the household.

"Bai Linlin, is it?"

The blue-haired youth opposite nodded, sitting on the chair very properly. The staff member began processing the documents, working with great efficiency.

Registered address: Building 12, Jinyuan, Pinghu District, Nanshi City, XX Province.

Head of household: Bai Linlin.

Song Yu had indeed spent a lot of time on this, especially in filling the gaps in the factual chain—why there was no registration at birth, why he dropped out of school, the friends and family along the way... all of it needed to be smoothed over.

The human identities of demons were restricted. They often had "transit permits" but not "ID cards." They could not "work" alongside humans without obstruction, as the 749 Bureau considered them a threat.

As for those demons who did have "ID cards," they were usually those with human partners. They went through official channels, filled in the logical gaps, and could be held legally accountable, so the authorities turned a blind eye.

Bai Linlin knew nothing of this. He didn't even know that the preliminary procedures had already been completed; this visit was mainly to collect the household register.

As for 001...

"Bai Yiyi, is it?"

The black-clad youth had already learned the ins and outs of this in the car. Although it had protested, wanting to be called "Bai Piqiu"—a combination of "Pipi" and "Qiuqiu" that sounded both cute and imposing—it had been vetoed by 247.

"Yes."

The black-clad youth nodded, feeling a little depressed, but decided to follow orders.

"Two brothers? One is 0 and one is 1. 0 comes before 1, so you are the older brother, that's correct."

The staff member couldn't help but smile, then efficiently checked the information on the second page.

Relationship to head of household: Brother.

Name: Bai Yiyi.

"Alright, it's done."

Song Yu brought the two "people" out. As they walked to the parking space, there was a small stall selling cream popsicles nearby.

"..."

By the time they got into the car, the two "youths" in the back seat were already eating popsicles, heads pressed together as they studied the household register.

"You should just take my surname, it’s so much better!"

"Why can't I use my serial number? Most of the Demon Realm uses serial numbers, though some demons have human names, like Pipi and Qiuqiu..."

"Stop right there!"

Song Yu drove the car, needing to get their ID cards next. While waiting at a red light, the two in the back were still debating:

"Some names are very simple, like Mouse Two or Bear Three; those are very convenient."

"But there are many identical demons in the Demon Realm who look the same. How do you handle that?"

"Serial numbers. My full name is Shrike 001. If I go to the center, they add an 'N'. Aren't you the same? Though parrots aren't as finely classified."

"Oh, I see."

The light changed. Song Yu kept his hands on the steering wheel and made a practiced turn. The two "youths" in the back had almost finished their cream popsicles.

Bai Linlin said very seriously:

"Whatever, you're my little brother now, so you have to take your big brother's surname. Once we have our ID cards, we can go to Disneyland in our human forms!"

chunks.chineseText:
001一下子被调理好了，眼睛变得亮亮的，自顾自地点了点头，严肃道：

“嗯嗯，一一也不错的，丹顶鹤的人类名字也是叠词来着的。”

白粼粼好奇，问了下：

“是什么？”

“茜茜。”

宋郁在前排一下子呛到了，微微抬了下眉，把车子开到了停车位置上，把安全带给解开了。

“什么？！”

前面的车门开启又关上，白粼粼本来还要继续说小话，但是后座的车门被打开了，他的腰被往后一带，宋郁的气息在耳廓处轻拂过来。

“下车了。”

一人两妖进入了相关部门，开始拍照环节。

……

“不行，这发色就不过关！”

“想要今天办，要么去理发店一趟，要么去买一瓶染发喷雾，必须得是黑色的。”

工作人员直接了当地说了，还顺带摆了摆手。

白粼粼愣住了，他真是当妖当久了，忘记这件事了。

“少年”不由得看向旁边的人，目光幽怨，怎么不提醒一下？

宋郁确实太忙了，他当时就没有把这件事放在心上，因为他的小鸟是妖怪，变换发色是很简单的事，一来二去倒是忘记了。

不过他立即道：

“好的，我们现在就去。”

“不过您可以先给我的这个弟弟拍摄么？它符合要求。”

001一直站在旁边，天气变得稍冷了，它现在是黑衣黑裤，黑头发，面无表情的。

仰头看了看旁边的人和247。

工作人员抬头看了下，很是满意地点点头，道：

“这个留下吧。”

“你们去把头发弄一弄，回来这孩子的就拍完了。”

……

洗手间——

白粼粼看着镜子里的自己，抬起来手，掌心有流动的金光，他学了最简单的易容术法的。

调动起来妖力，闭眼。

大约过了三四秒。

“少年”睁开了眼睛，他看向了镜子里，里面的“人”不仅仅是变了头发颜色，长短也变了，发质乌黑柔顺，像是……

“宋郁！好看吗？”

白粼粼自己欣赏了不到三秒就开始展示，仰了仰头，斗志昂扬的。

宋郁微微垂着眼皮，他查过资料，现在的这个样子……同那个学生时代的证件照一模一样。

青春、洋溢。

他的小鸟上辈子也没有入社会很久，他才刚毕业，只是上了一年班。

就……

“好看。”

宋郁抬手抚了抚“少年”的脸颊，定定地重复道：

“好看。”

拍照室——

001一脸严肃地坐在背景布的前面，双手搭在膝盖上，看着镜头。

它很擅长这个。

“好好，不错。”

前面的工作人员一开始是比较满意的，但是后面就说了句：

“这刘海是不是太长了？”

“盖住眉毛了。”

001懵懵的，这还是头一次拍摄失败，一时间有些无措。

直到旁边有个工作人员拿着剪刀过来，递了过去，问：

“要不要修一下？”

小雀不会。

“这我也不能给你乱剪，弄坏了发型就不好了。”

001看着一屋子的人类，莫名有些坐立难安，拿过来了剪刀。

“……”

-

白粼粼折返回来的时候，看到的就是妹妹刘海的001，一时间还愣了下。

这怎么这么齐？

“噢，你们回来了，这去理发店了么？还修了款式。”

白粼粼其实还在看001的发型，一直在皱眉，谁给它剪的！

站出来！

“我弟弟它这是……”

心里虽然已经咆哮了，但还是礼貌询问了情况。

工作人员如实说了，因为标准不符合，所以要稍稍修剪头发，是“白一一”自己剪的。

白粼粼：“……”

最后也是没办法，他开始去拍照了，“人”对这个才是有经验的，同样被提出了额发遮盖眉眼的问题，但是白粼粼很自然地用手往旁边拨了下。

完全不用剪！

大约半个月后，身份证和护照一并办下来了，也彻底迎来了国庆长假。

一人一鸟没有通知任何妖和人，飞到了美洲拉斯维加斯。

十八岁就可以结婚的地点。

-

丹顶鹤是在一周后发现端倪的，中央每年都会有一次外派考察组，会到各个管理局内看看政绩。

一般是十二月。

现在已经十月了，它还是有些担心的，决定亲自去桐城那里看一看。

但是在抵达小区八楼之后，里面没什么大的动静，只有一阵“啪嗒啪嗒”，然后开门了。

丹顶鹤和地板上的小雀面面相觑。

“……”

“……”

客厅——

小雀伸着鸟腿坐在杯垫上，电视机还在放着，全是些美食栏目，目测已经放了很久了。

“247呢？”

“怎么你在八楼？”

001垂着鸟头，其实在组织语言，但丹顶鹤还在问：

“怎么传讯都传不上，这不应该的，中央的系统是覆盖全国的。”

“它去哪了？”

小雀爪子并了并，沉思。

“你这又是和247学的，站好！”

小雀立马一个弹跳，站得毛绒绒的，收了收翅膀。

丹顶鹤真是气不打一处来，这马上就要年底了，还不知道用功一些。

“我打下电话。”

但就在这时，小雀啪嗒啪嗒地走过来，伸翅膀阻拦了：

“不行不行，它们在睡觉。”

丹顶鹤的大翅膀还保持着一个敞开的动作，旁边有个毛绒绒的小翅膀搭上来了，小雀着急。

“……”

丹顶鹤眯了眯鸟眼。

“哼，去国外了？”

-

十几分钟后。

一鹤一雀打了辆车，开始朝着桐城管理局的方向开。

丹顶鹤挥了下翅膀，把声音给隔绝了，然后才悠悠地道：

“私奔去了啊。”

“我看南市那老头子估计也不知道，这么说，只告诉了你啊？”

后排的小雀毛绒绒的，挺胸抬头，看着窗外。

它不是旁妖。

它是亲小弟。

“247到底知不知道过段时间要考核了？国内哪里不好？非要去国外，外头的月亮圆？回来严肃批评！”

丹顶鹤此刻是人形的状态，环着手臂，皱了皱眉。

但过了会还是问：

“247说对年末的考察有准备是真的吗？”

小雀点头：

“是的。”

“我到是要看看它做出来什么东西了……”

-

与此同时，拉斯维加斯。

白粼粼正在床上躺着，看着一张外文证件，心里怦怦的。

不一样！

之前无论是妖界的礼，还是桐城这边的酒席，都是些“包办婚姻”。

但是这次！

他们自己来了！

“少年”在床上翻了个身，趴着看手机，这里面是鼹鼠发过来的一些信息：

[创建流动岗位初步有成效，不少老妖反馈获得了一些生活保障……]

白粼粼用手撑着下巴，很是满意，还看了下自己左手无名指上的东西。

对戒！

里面有刻着的姓名缩写。

“粼粼？”

身后传来声音，带着些事后的沉哑。

“昂？”

夜灯繁华，二人世界。

-
chunks.englishText:
001 was instantly appeased, its eyes brightening. It nodded to itself and said solemnly:

"Mm, Yiyi is not bad either. The Red-crowned Crane’s human name is also a reduplicated word."

Bai Linlin was curious and asked:

"What is it?"

"Qianqian."

Song Yu, in the front seat, choked suddenly. He raised an eyebrow slightly, pulled the car into a parking spot, and unbuckled his seatbelt.

"What?!"

The front car door opened and closed. Bai Linlin was about to continue chatting, but the back door opened, and his waist was pulled backward. Song Yu’s scent brushed against his ear.

"Time to get out."

One human and two demons entered the relevant department and began the photography process.

...

"No, this hair color won't pass!"

"If you want it done today, either go to a hair salon or buy a bottle of black hair spray. It must be black."

The staff member spoke bluntly and waved a hand.

Bai Linlin froze. He had been a demon for so long that he had forgotten about this.

The "youth" couldn't help but look at the person beside him with a resentful gaze—why didn't he remind him?

Song Yu had indeed been too busy. He hadn't kept this in mind at the time because his little bird was a demon, and changing hair color was a simple matter. One thing led to another, and he had forgotten.

However, he immediately said:

"Understood, we’ll go right now."

"But could you take the photo for my younger brother first? He meets the requirements."

001 had been standing to the side. The weather had turned slightly cold, and it was now wearing black clothes and black pants with black hair, its expression blank.

It looked up at the person beside it and 247.

The staff member looked up, nodded with satisfaction, and said:

"Let this one stay."

"You go get your hair fixed, and when you come back, this child’s photo will be done."

...

In the restroom—

Bai Linlin looked at himself in the mirror and raised his hand, golden light flowing in his palm. He had learned the simplest of transformation arts.

He channeled his demon power and closed his eyes.

After about three or four seconds.

The "youth" opened his eyes and looked into the mirror. The "person" inside had not only changed hair color, but the length had also changed. The hair was black, smooth, and soft, looking like...

"Song Yu! Does it look good?"

Bai Linlin began to show off before he had even admired it for three seconds, tilting his head, full of fighting spirit.

Song Yu lowered his eyelids slightly. He had checked the records; this current appearance... was exactly the same as the ID photo from his student days.

Youthful and vibrant.

His little bird hadn't been in society for long in his past life; he had just graduated and had only worked for a year.

It was...

"It looks good."

Song Yu raised a hand to stroke the "youth’s" cheek, repeating firmly:

"It looks good."

In the photo studio—

001 sat in front of the backdrop with a serious expression, hands resting on its knees, staring into the lens.

It was very good at this.

"Alright, alright, not bad."

The staff member in front was initially quite satisfied, but then added:

"Is this fringe too long?"

"It’s covering your eyebrows."

001 was dazed. This was the first time a shoot had failed, and it felt a bit at a loss.

Until a staff member nearby came over with scissors, handed them over, and asked:

"Do you want to trim it?"

The little sparrow didn't know how.

"I can't just cut it for you randomly; it wouldn't be good if I ruined the hairstyle."

001 looked at the room full of humans, feeling inexplicably restless, and took the scissors.

"..."

-

When Bai Linlin returned, what he saw was 001 with its bangs cut short. He was stunned for a moment.

Why were they so even?

"Oh, you're back. Did you go to a hair salon? You even styled it."

Bai Linlin was actually still staring at 001’s hairstyle, frowning the whole time. Who cut it?!

Step forward!

"My brother, it’s just..."

Although he was roaring inside, he still politely asked about the situation.

The staff member told the truth: because it didn't meet the standards, it had to be trimmed slightly, and "Bai Yiyi" had cut it himself.

Bai Linlin: "..."

In the end, there was no other way. He went to take his photo. The "person" was experienced in this. He was also told that his bangs were covering his eyebrows, but Bai Linlin naturally brushed them to the side with his hand.

No cutting needed at all!

About half a month later, the ID cards and passports were issued, and the National Day holiday arrived in full.

One human and one bird didn't notify any other demons or humans and flew to Las Vegas, America.

A place where one can get married at eighteen.

-

The Red-crowned Crane discovered something was amiss a week later. The Central Bureau had an annual external inspection team that would visit various bureaus to check on their political achievements.

It was usually in December.

It was already October, and it was still a bit worried, so it decided to go to Tongcheng to take a look in person.

But upon arriving at the eighth floor of the apartment complex, there was no major movement inside, only a "patter-patter" sound, and then the door opened.

The Red-crowned Crane and the little sparrow on the floor stared at each other.

"..."

"..."

In the living room—

The little sparrow was sitting on a coaster with its bird legs stretched out. The television was still on, playing nothing but food programs, which had clearly been running for a long time.

"Where is 247?"

"Why are you on the eighth floor?"

001 lowered its bird head, actually trying to organize its words, but the Red-crowned Crane kept asking:

"Why can't I get through on the comms? This shouldn't be happening; the Central system covers the whole country."

"Where did it go?"

The little sparrow brought its claws together, deep in thought.

"You're learning this from 247 again, stand up straight!"

The little sparrow immediately jumped up, standing fluffy and tall, tucking in its wings.

The Red-crowned Crane was truly furious. The end of the year was almost here, and they still didn't know how to work hard.

"I'll make a call."

But just then, the little sparrow walked over with a "patter-patter" and stretched out a wing to block it:

"No, no, they are sleeping."

The Red-crowned Crane’s large wing was still held in an open gesture, and a fluffy little wing was resting on it. The little sparrow was anxious.

"..."

The Red-crowned Crane narrowed its bird eyes.

"Hmph, went abroad?"

-

Ten minutes later.

A crane and a sparrow hailed a taxi and started heading toward the Tongcheng Bureau.

The Red-crowned Crane waved a wing to isolate the sound, then said leisurely:

"Eloped, have they?"

"I reckon that old man in Nanshi doesn't know either. So, they only told you?"

The little sparrow in the back seat was fluffy, chest puffed out, head held high, looking out the window.

It wasn't just any demon.

It was the younger brother.

"Does 247 even know the assessment is coming up? What's wrong with staying in the country? Why go abroad? Is the moon rounder on the outside? I'll give them a stern lecture when they get back!"

The Red-crowned Crane was in human form, arms crossed, frowning.

But after a while, it still asked:

"Is it true that 247 said it was prepared for the year-end assessment?"

The little sparrow nodded:

"Yes."

"I’ll have to see what it’s come up with..."

-

Meanwhile, in Las Vegas.

Bai Linlin was lying on the bed, looking at a foreign document, his heart pounding.

It was different!

Whether it was the rites of the Demon Realm or the banquet in Tongcheng, those had all been "arranged marriages."

But this time!

They had come here themselves!

The "youth" rolled over on the bed, lying on his stomach to look at his phone. It contained some information sent by the Mole:

[The creation of mobile positions has had initial results. Many old demons have reported gaining some life security...]

Bai Linlin rested his chin on his hand, feeling very satisfied, and looked at the item on the ring finger of his left hand.

Matching rings!

Engraved with their initials.

"Linlin?"

A voice came from behind, carrying a post-coital huskiness.

"Yeah?"

The night lights were dazzling; a world for two.

-

chunks.chineseText:
出租车很快就把“人”送到了，不过按下车窗一看，立马道：

“哟，这不是网红打卡地吗？”

“前段时间很是风靡噢。”

“你们也来啊？”

丹顶鹤闻言一愣，什么东西，它不由自主多问了几句。

司机很是侃侃而谈，还指了指方向：

“那里不是个小庙吗？前段时间有个自媒体的人过来拍视频了，一下子带火了这里，还有各种各样的小石塑，桐城这里也注意到了，整了个主题公园。”

“你看看，还有摆小摊的。”

丹顶鹤愣住了，什么合作的？

司机悠哉地道：

“这周末我也得带我闺女过来看看，她最喜欢小动物的手办了。”

“成，下车吧。”

丹顶鹤付过去了款，领着身边的小雀下了地，一脸震惊。

001一直保持着本体的状态，它站在了“女士”的肩头，收了收翅膀，很是挺胸抬头的。

面前的林子早已不是冷冷清清的样子，这里面有很多个石塑，有常见的小猫小狗，也有些侏儒兔、小蛇、山羊、花枝鼠……
