001 stood beside a pillar, dressed in black pants and a shirt, wearing gloves. It watched the light screen above, which broadcast the negotiation scene. At the head of the Demon Realm’s side stood the bird in its formal suit, looking high-spirited and vigorous.

It wondered if 247 was doing well.

Just then, a ferret approached from behind and said respectfully:

“Chairman Bird said that you can go in directly during the intermission. You don’t need to keep watch here, as the human territory is quite safe.”

001 frowned upon hearing this. That wouldn't do. This wasn't the Central District, and safety was paramount; humans were very cunning.

The “black-clad youth” tilted its head, looking at someone not far away. There were many armed police around this assembly hall, equipped with guns—it had seen them while on missions in the mountains.

“I understand. I will go in and take a look during the intermission.”

The ferret immediately retreated.

Inside the hall, the negotiations had begun. Outside, there was a layer of demon guards, a layer of human personnel, and finally, across a plaza, a car was parked, surrounded by small demons who had shielded it from the humans—a form of protection.

Song Yu merely looked sideways at the magnificent building, having no heart for anything else. Song Zhengguo, on the other hand, was much more relaxed, simply looking down through the car window at the small mice patrolling the ground.

They were holding trident-like weapons, with flowing blue demonic energy rippling over them.

“Xiao Yu, look at what breed those are?”

“They don’t look like the small demons in our Nanshi, do they?”

Song Zhengguo’s level of acceptance was very high now. Loving the house and its crow, he even found these working demons quite amiable and couldn't help but ask a few questions.

But the reply he got was:

“I don’t know.”

The person was still staring in that direction.

Song Zhengguo: “……”

The old man finally couldn't help but roll down the window. The passersby couldn't see them anyway. The small demons on the ground immediately looked up at the sound, *ding-donging* as they leaned on their tridents, their expressions serious.

Song Zhengguo couldn't help but ask:

“Do you want something to eat?”

The little mouse remained serious.

“How about a biscuit? There are many flavors.”

Song Zhengguo tried to communicate again.

The little mouse remained serious.

…

Song Yu frowned, not understanding his grandfather’s habit of feeding every demon he encountered. These were Central District demons; ignoring them was the normal response.

“Grandpa, you are…”

But just then, a voice came from behind:

“Partner of Chairman Bird, may we have some?”

Song Yu was stunned. His peripheral vision swept to the edge of the back window, where he could vaguely see a fluffy mouse head—gray and dusty, looking like a very traditional breed.

He had no choice but to roll down the window and look over.

Two mice stood perfectly straight, their long tails twitching.

“……”

Song Zhengguo was actually a bit surprised. What did this mean? Were they listening to Xiao Yu?

“This… you might have regulations. I probably don’t have the authority to—”

The man tried to explain.

But he was interrupted by the mice on the ground. They leaned on their tridents and said quite seriously:

“Matters concerning the Central Demon Realm are coordinated and handled by successive Demon Chairmen. According to the charter, the partner of the Demon Chairman also possesses certain powers and can freely enter and exit the Central District to accompany meetings with local management demon personnel…”

Song Yu was stunned.

They listed several points, and finally added:

“The Demon Realm is a leadership system centered on Chairman Bird, with various departments managing affairs through democratic elections. We must be close to, support, and respect the partner of Chairman Bird.”

Song Yu started coughing, feeling a bit uncomfortable. This was a bit too…

Song Zhengguo, however, had his eyes light up. He looked at his grandson, his heart surging with emotion.

The two mice on the ground were still waiting, tilting their heads up.

“Xiao Yu, give them some.”

Song Yu finally came back to his senses. He looked over and saw they were still waiting, so he immediately said:

“Yes, yes, you can take them.”

The two mice solemnly reached out their paws, one bag of sea salt biscuits per demon.

Allowed by the Chairman’s partner.

It didn't count as violating the charter.

…

Inside the assembly hall.

At the long black table, one side was human, the other was demon, representing two opposing stances.

The negotiator for Bureau 749 was a middle-aged man dressed in a plain, unadorned Zhongshan suit. He looked at the round, suit-wearing bird across from him.

“……”

How was the fabric so high-quality?

The collar was also perfectly pressed.

The negotiator inexplicably felt that no demon should be dressed this well. It wasn't a matter of vanity; after all, they were representing the human side’s image.

This whole thing…

The suit on the bird in the center was exquisitely made, a classic style. The buttons looked like mother-of-pearl, with delicate patterns carved into them.

chunks.chineseText:
“咳咳，这次是由人类主办的交涉，那我们就不过多客套了，主要是围绕以下几个问题。”

交涉长看了下手中的文件，随后就道：

“近年我们注意到城市妖怪的数量连年攀升，甚至有些居民已经反馈看到过动物变成人的过程，有些模糊的图片，虽然被我们处理了，但是这造成了很大的舆论影响，妖界需要回应一下。”

白粼粼四平八稳的，看着对面的人，只是道：

“你想要怎么处理？”

交涉长愣了下，其实按照流程来说，往年妖界是需要先解释一下的，这不说明吗？

鸟从容不迫：

“说出你们的要求。”

749局的人彼此交汇了下目光，心里其实放松了下，还以为妖界选出来了个很厉害的，结果一个这么大点的鸟，先前就是过于担心了。

道士皱了皱眉，还是有些担心的。

“我们希望妖界将城市里的妖怪控制在一个固定的数量，这个我们后续可以商定，多出来的妖怪，有批量地让其回归山林，最好不要在人类的聚居区。”

这话一出，桌子对面的大妖已经生气了，已经在克制妖力了，但是桌子还是有轻微地抖动，空气里变得剑拔弩张。

749局的人面色也变得冷了下。

但就在这时，鸟伸了一边翅膀。

众妖都安静了起来。

749局的人愣住了，这么听话？

“那么按照您的构想，具体的山林是哪些地带呢？不妨交流一下？”

白粼粼很是耐心地询问。

交涉长隐约觉得现在的氛围有些奇怪，他们并不是专门人类那边的外交人员，说实话，没有把妖怪当成回事，反正文化程度不高。

但这个……怎么感觉一直在下套子？

“xx自治区、黔省、川省，这些地带人类活动比较少，可以做到互不干扰。”

白粼粼闻言点了点鸟头，最后很礼貌地问：

“是这样没错，不过后续呢？”

“回到山林之中，我们的生活怎么办？”

这话一出，对面有个年轻人坐不住了，觉得这是在阴阳怪气，直接道：

“那不是你们的事吗？几百年不都是在山林里修行吗？人类又没有必要养妖怪。”

白粼粼仰着鸟头看过去，平和地道：

“我在同交涉长谈话，749局的人这么没有教养？”

场面一时间静住了。

这种说话方式实在太像人了，并不理会现有的争议，直接从身份上压制。

交涉长愣住了。

鸟收了收翅膀，转头又看了过来，并不说话。

“他、他年纪还小。”

白粼粼闻言无动于衷，旁边的大妖更是气势汹汹的，人类再多的术法研究，也无法在这么多的妖怪面前全身而退。

“这……”

交涉长见状也是额头冒起来冷汗，这个妖席看着这么小……向心力怎么这么强？

他连忙道：

“道个歉，快。”

那个年轻人没想到这群妖怪居然还搞起来这一套，起初是不愿意的，甚至手里还夹着一张黄符，不过被道士一把给打掉了。

他还愣了下。

道士真是闭了闭眼，这种东西是怎么收进来的，就算对面的妖怪不用妖力，也能活活吃了他。

“对不起，是我唐突了。”

这只是个小小的插曲，但对于鸟的威严很有助益。

白粼粼只是很温和地道：

“年纪小就去外面休息吧，我听说人类年纪尚小，一般是不参与大人谈话的。”

“诸位，是吧？”

749局的人直接沉寂了，他们甚至觉得对面这个不是妖怪，简直像是个活生生的人在对话。

确实可怕。

“我开玩笑的，接着说这个问题，既然749局想让妖怪回归山林，那需要给出合理的举措，不妨让我听听看。”

鸟很和善，圆滚滚的。

交涉长皱了皱眉，他的想法其实也一样，不过说辞委婉了点，但还是认为妖怪的生存并不是人类考虑的问题。

“噢，那你们调查的情况恐怕不够。”

白粼粼伸出来了翅膀，一旁的大块头牛妖拿出来了一沓文件，沉甸甸的。

鸟扔了过去。

“妖界增添的妖怪，百分之八十都是城市本土的妖怪，即一些宠物，它们带有对主人的爱而长大，很小就被带走了，并无野外的生存能力，修行也往往只是停留在化形上。”

“第一，监护人是否同意，749是否民意调查过？”

“第二，想要彻底的隔绝人类与妖怪，749局是否能保证现有的山林没有人类活动？”

“第三，解决问题要从根源出发，近年各地管理局档案的数据显示，几乎都是小型宠物开了灵智，那很简单，全面禁止宠物市场，包含衍生的宠物医院、宠物交易场所、宠物美容美发、宠物饮食、宠物社区活动……这样才能彻底隔绝。”

交涉长闻言张了张口，他不知道怎么回答了，这完全不一样。

“那、那不一样，宠物又不是妖怪，不要偷换概念。”

“可数据显示，每年都会有稳定的宠物化形成人，假装看不见吗？”

攻击力拉满了。

交涉长闭了闭眼，想说什么，结果一抬眼，那只西服革履的鸟就站在对面，侧着头，鸟眼圆圆。

很睿智的样子。

一股子气。

他不由得看向旁边的老人，即道士，对方参加过很多次的“交涉”，一定知道怎么办，但就在他看过去的时候，道士正在专心地看着对面的鸟，面色温和，还点了点头。

啊？

怎么还欣赏了起来？

道士一回头，发现被看见了，立马深恶痛绝地道：

“果然是个道行深的妖。”

“……”

交涉长闭了闭眼，这位是局里的老人了，而且还参加过几次交涉，实打实的地位很高，说到底是使唤不动的。

算了。

“也就是说，你们妖界并不同意回归山林，对吧？”

交涉长叹了口气，说道。

而此刻，对面的鸟立即挥了下翅膀。

“这可是你说的。”

光幕出现，方才的录像循环播放。

交涉长：“……”

“你怎么能偷偷录？”

鸟摇了摇鸟头，叹息道：“749局的交涉长就是这个言辞？”

“人类的文化里，就算是企业签订很大的合作，也是会邀请记者的吧？”

“你也可以拍摄啊？发出去都没问题。”

白粼粼收了收翅膀，爪子站得稳稳当当的。

交涉长心想他怎么可能发出去，那舆论岂不是直接起来了？

人深呼吸一口气，最终打算直接绕开方才的议题，说了另外一件事：

“那灰色任务的标准呢？这个你们妖界需要再降低一些，有些孩子还在上学，是，他们确实残害了不少动物，但身体上的损伤还是太大了，我们749局不好善后的。”

鸟眯了眯鸟眼。

这次749局有所准备，拿过来一沓文件，妖怪都是文盲，看也需要好长时间的，签个字就行，到时候就合法修改了。

但他们没想到的是，鸟直接用爪子掀开了文件，一目十行地扫了过去。
chunks.englishText:
“Ahem. This negotiation is hosted by the human side, so let’s skip the pleasantries and focus on the following issues.”

The negotiator looked at the document in his hand and then said:

“In recent years, we have noticed that the number of demons in cities has been rising year after year. Some residents have even reported seeing animals transform into humans. Although we have handled the blurry photos, this has caused significant public opinion issues. The Demon Realm needs to provide a response.”

Bai Linlin sat steadily, looking at the person opposite, and simply said:

“How do you want to handle it?”

The negotiator was stunned. According to the usual process, the Demon Realm should have started with an explanation. Why wasn't it explaining?

The bird was composed:

“State your requirements.”

The members of Bureau 749 exchanged glances. Inwardly, they actually felt relieved. They had thought the Demon Realm would have chosen someone formidable, but it turned out to be such a small bird. They had been overly worried.

The Taoist frowned, still feeling uneasy.

“We hope that the Demon Realm will control the number of demons in the cities to a fixed limit. We can discuss the specifics later. The excess demons should be moved back to the mountains in batches. It is best they do not remain in human residential areas.”

As soon as these words were spoken, the great demons across the table became angry. They were restraining their demonic energy, but the table still vibrated slightly, and the air became tense with the threat of conflict.

The expressions of the Bureau 749 members also turned cold.

But just then, the bird raised one wing.

All the demons fell silent.

The Bureau 749 members were stunned. They were that obedient?

“Then, according to your vision, which specific mountain areas are we talking about? Why don’t we discuss it?”

Bai Linlin asked very patiently.

The negotiator vaguely felt that the current atmosphere was strange. They weren't professional diplomats from the human side, and to be honest, they didn't really take demons seriously—after all, they assumed their education level was low.

But this… why did it feel like they were being led into a trap?

“The XX Autonomous Region, Guizhou Province, Sichuan Province—these areas have less human activity and can ensure we don't interfere with each other.”

Bai Linlin nodded its bird head upon hearing this, and finally asked very politely:

“That is correct, but what about the aftermath?”

“If we return to the mountains, how are we supposed to live?”

As soon as this was said, a young man on the opposite side couldn't sit still. He felt this was sarcasm and said directly:

“Isn't that your own business? Haven't you been cultivating in the mountains for hundreds of years? Humans have no obligation to support demons.”

Bai Linlin tilted its bird head to look at him and said peacefully:

“I am speaking with the negotiator. Is Bureau 749 so lacking in manners?”

The scene went quiet.

This way of speaking was too human-like. It ignored the existing controversy and directly suppressed them through status.

The negotiator was stunned.

The bird retracted its wings, turned its head, and looked back, saying nothing.

“He… he is still young.”

Bai Linlin remained unmoved. The great demons beside it were even more imposing; no matter how much the humans studied their techniques, they wouldn't be able to leave unscathed in front of so many demons.

“This…”

Seeing this, the negotiator broke out in a cold sweat. This Demon Chairman looked so small… how could its centripetal force be so strong?

He hurriedly said:

“Apologize. Quickly.”

The young man hadn't expected these demons to play this game. At first, he was unwilling, even holding a yellow talisman in his hand, but the Taoist slapped it out of his grasp.

He was stunned.

The Taoist closed his eyes. How did this kind of person get recruited? Even if the demons across the table didn't use their demonic energy, they could eat him alive.

“I’m sorry, I was abrupt.”

This was just a small interlude, but it was very helpful for the bird’s majesty.

Bai Linlin said very gently:

“If you are young, go outside and rest. I hear that humans who are young generally do not participate in adult conversations.”

“Everyone, is that not so?”

The members of Bureau 749 fell silent. They even felt that the one across from them wasn't a demon at all, but a living human in conversation.

Truly terrifying.

“I’m joking. Let’s continue with the issue. Since Bureau 749 wants demons to return to the mountains, you need to provide reasonable measures. Why don’t you let me hear them?”

The bird was very kind and round.

The negotiator frowned. His thoughts were actually the same, though his phrasing was a bit more tactful, but he still believed that the survival of demons was not a concern for humans.

“Oh, then I’m afraid your investigation is insufficient.”

Bai Linlin extended a wing, and a large bull demon beside it brought out a stack of documents, heavy and thick.

The bird threw them over.

“Eighty percent of the demons added to the Demon Realm are local city demons—that is, pets. They grew up with love for their owners and were taken away at a very young age. They have no ability to survive in the wild, and their cultivation often stops at transformation.”

“First, has Bureau 749 conducted any public opinion polls to see if the guardians agree?”

“Second, if you want to completely isolate humans from demons, can Bureau 749 guarantee that there is no human activity in the existing mountain forests?”

“Third, to solve a problem, one must start from the root. Data from local management bureaus in recent years shows that almost all of them are small pets that have gained intelligence. That’s simple: completely ban the pet market, including derivative pet hospitals, pet trading venues, pet grooming, pet food, and pet community activities… Only then can you completely isolate them.”

The negotiator opened his mouth upon hearing this, not knowing how to respond. This was completely different.

“That… that’s different. Pets aren't demons. Don’t swap concepts.”

“But the data shows that every year, a stable number of pets transform into humans. Are you going to pretend you don't see it?”

The attack power was maxed out.

The negotiator closed his eyes, wanting to say something, but when he looked up, the bird in the suit was standing across from him, head tilted, its bird eyes round.

It looked very wise.

Full of an aura.

He couldn't help but look at the old man next to him—the Taoist. The other party had participated in many “negotiations” and must know what to do. But just as he looked over, the Taoist was intently watching the bird across the table, his expression gentle, even nodding along.

Huh?

Why was he admiring it?

The Taoist turned his head, discovered he was being watched, and immediately said with deep hatred:

“Truly a demon with deep cultivation.”

“……”

The negotiator closed his eyes. This man was a veteran of the bureau and had participated in several negotiations; his status was undeniably high, and in the end, he couldn't be ordered around.

Forget it.

“In other words, your Demon Realm does not agree to return to the mountains, right?”

The negotiator sighed and said.

At this moment, the bird across the table immediately waved a wing.

“Those are your words.”

A light screen appeared, and the previous recording played on a loop.

The negotiator: “……”

“How could you secretly record this?”

The bird shook its head and sighed: “Is this the rhetoric of the negotiator for Bureau 749?”

“In human culture, even when companies sign major partnerships, they invite reporters, right?”

“You could have filmed it too. It wouldn't be a problem to release it.”

Bai Linlin retracted its wings, its claws standing firmly.

The negotiator thought to himself, how could he possibly release it? Wouldn't that cause an immediate public outcry?

He took a deep breath, ultimately deciding to bypass the previous topic and brought up another matter:

“Then what about the standards for gray tasks? The Demon Realm needs to lower them. Some children are still in school. Yes, they have indeed harmed many animals, but the physical damage is too great, and our Bureau 749 has a hard time cleaning up the aftermath.”

The bird narrowed its eyes.

This time, Bureau 749 was prepared. They brought over a stack of documents. Demons were illiterate, and it would take a long time to read them; they just needed to sign, and then it would be legally amended.

But what they didn't expect was that the bird used its claws to flip open the documents, scanning them ten lines at a time.

chunks.chineseText:
切。

“妖界是妖界，同人类的法律文化是不同的，世界上有的国家还没有死刑的，我国却始终有死刑，难道我国不如外国？”

交涉长不明白，怎么又绕出来了，不能就事论事吗？

“那些都是没有开智的动物，但是人类不一样，一个孩子应当有犯错的机会，他未来可以成为科学家、建筑家……总之是有很多的可能的，你们往往是用的重刑，轻则残疾，重则死亡……”

说到这里，交涉长莫名停了下来。

似乎有些心虚。

白粼粼闻言只是低着鸟头看文件，刷刷地翻，很是悠悠地道：

“没有开智的动物，未来，重则死亡？”

“交涉长。”

白粼粼抬起来头，语气轻飘飘的：

“没有开智的动物，它们的生命就不值钱吗？”

“它们的未来就不是未来了？它们不只是死了，是死了多达二十多个才会上灰榜，是虐杀，是剖开肚子的那种，是活生生的那种。”

鸟收了收翅膀，把文件递了过去：

“这是个敏感话题，妖界代表的是妖怪，妖怪多是由动物幻化的，可以说，并不算彻彻底底的同族，人类民间有饲养场，野生动物界有食物链，我们保持尊重，不干涉，毕竟人类是现在世界的掌控者。”

“但是我们只是反对虐杀，妖界只是奉行以牙还牙的策略，范围很小，倘若人类不教育自己的后代，一昧纵容，那迟早会危害到你们人类的同胞。”

交涉长一时间沉默了。

白粼粼不卑不亢的，他已经当选了妖界的“主席”，说什么也要维护妖怪的合理诉求的，只是问：

“你们的未成年保护法，保护的是作恶的未成年吗？”

一击致命。

“人类的儿童也有被你口中所说的‘有犯错机会的孩子’所欺凌至死的，那他们的未来呢？”

“不重要？”

全场沉默。

“妖界奉行自由民主，互帮互助，人类可以要求我们，但前提是，你们自己也要做到。”

749局的人是真的感到棘手了，每一个提议，对方都能找到人类的反面素材，让他们哑口无言。

交涉长对着只鸟，力竭了。

但就在这时——

“说完了吗？”

“那我们谈一谈749局去年一年勾引妖怪、试图获得长生的事吧？”

-

宋郁还在车里等着，其实面色很红，因为他爷爷在后座反反复复地讲：

“小郁，那你就是妖界的第一**啊。”

“好好好。”

宋峥国的确是有些骄傲的，这可是正儿八经的，绝不是什么虚名。

人有些崩溃：

“爷爷，我不是夫人。”

“差不多差不多。”

宋峥国很是开明：“那些名头而已，都是自家人，不在意这个。”

人闭了闭眼。

但这会儿已经十点多了，应该快到中场休息了，宋郁抬眸看向了那个建筑物里，又问了下后座的老人：

“爷爷，饭菜是热的吗？”

“热的热的，你放心。”

001此刻已经幻化成了毛绒绒的小雀，在大建筑物的最顶端，俯瞰着下方，几乎没有几个人。

周遭有一层“界”。

小雀幻化出来光幕，看了大会堂里面的各个角落，没有什么可疑的人类。

001扑棱翅膀又飞了一圈，最后看到一个人类正在哨台上站着，很是挺拔。

小雀降落。

站得稳稳当当的。

人的头有些沉。

“……”

001最后巡逻了好一会儿，最后在中场的时候进去了，快中午了，得一起去吃饭。

小雀很灵活地找到了地方，雪貂就在门口守着，打开了缝隙，微微低头。

房间内部一阵喧哗，像是纯粹的吵架：

“这是污蔑！彻头彻尾的污蔑！”

“恶心！都记录下来了，你们不就是想求长生？还勾引妖怪，普通人才不敢靠近的，只有你们这些术士才会铤、铤……什么险！”

“那、那也是少数！”

“少胡说八道了，长得歪瓜裂枣的，闭嘴吧你。”

“你——”

“你们749局里一群混蛋，看不起妖怪，还想要利用妖怪，完了还要驱赶妖怪，什么人啊！”

“你们就好了？说得和你们妖怪没有和人类在一起过，你们没强制爱过！”

“……少胡说八道！那是两情相悦！”

鸡飞蛋打也不为过。

小雀用爪子往后踹了下，合上了门，啪嗒啪嗒地往前走，一路上经过了许多文件的纷飞，还有几根圆珠笔被扔了下来，小雀稳稳地绕过。

001仰头看了下桌子上的情况，发现了悠哉游哉伸着鸟腿坐在椅子上的247，周遭的大妖都在一个劲地吵架。

对面的人类也是如此，有个面色很衰的中年人，还有个低头不语的……道士？

真的是他。

小雀扑棱翅膀上了椅子，这里距离桌面还有距离，蓝羽小鸟正在比着自己的爪子，听到动静一看，立马伸翅膀往自己身边的位置拍了拍，低声道：

“快坐。”

001凑了过去，有样学样地坐下了。

有些不明白现在的情况。

白粼粼只好解释：

“需要骂一骂的，不然两方容易有情绪，这是一个固定环节，出完气了就行。”

小雀歪了歪鸟头，有些跃跃欲试。

“你也要去？”

“也行。”

白粼粼坐在椅子上，继续等待这一part结束，这会儿小雀已经上了桌，它体型更小，鸟头一会儿在这边，一会儿在那边。

“人类为什么要找妖怪！我们不能找人吗！物种都不一样，怎么可能成功！”

“切！真以为你们人类长得好看，连毛都没有，光不溜秋的，还得往自己身上套布，我们妖怪本体多么好看，你们脱了衣服那就叫猎奇！走在大街上都会被抓走的，这叫好看？这叫好看？说话！”

对面的人怒了。

“那以后你们别找什么人类配偶！少拐带人类！根本就是有生殖隔离的！”

小雀毛绒绒的，摇了摇鸟头，这个它了解，反驳道：

“不是的！”

“可以交配！”

大会堂里一下子安静了。
chunks.englishText:
"Tch."

"The Demon Realm is the Demon Realm; it is different from human laws and culture. There are countries in this world that have abolished the death penalty, yet our nation has always retained it. Does that mean our nation is inferior to those foreign ones?"

The Chief Negotiator was bewildered. How did the conversation veer off track again? Couldn't they just stick to the matter at hand?

"Those were animals that hadn't attained sentience. But humans are different. A child should be given the chance to correct their mistakes; they could become a scientist or an architect in the future... in short, there are many possibilities. Yet you often resort to heavy punishments—at best, they end up disabled; at worst, they die..."

As he spoke, the Chief Negotiator trailed off inexplicably.

He felt a strange sense of guilt.

Bai Linlin, upon hearing this, merely lowered his bird head to look at the documents, flipping through them with a rustle, and said quite leisurely:

"Animals that haven't attained sentience, the future, and at worst, death?"

"Chief Negotiator."

Bai Linlin raised his head, his tone light and airy:

"Are the lives of animals that haven't attained sentience worthless?"

"Is their future not a future? They don't just die; it takes over twenty of them dying before they even make it onto the 'Grey List.' It is torture—the kind where their bellies are sliced open, the kind where they are still alive."

The bird tucked in its wings and handed over the documents:

"This is a sensitive topic. The Demon Realm represents demons, and demons are mostly transformed from animals. You could say we aren't entirely the same species. Humans have factory farms, and the wild animal kingdom has its food chain. We maintain respect and do not interfere; after all, humans are the current masters of the world."

"But we only oppose torture. The Demon Realm merely follows a strategy of 'an eye for an eye.' The scope is very small. If humans do not educate their descendants and continue to indulge them blindly, it will sooner or later harm your own human kin."

The Chief Negotiator fell silent.

Bai Linlin was neither servile nor overbearing. He had been elected the "Chairman" of the Demon Realm, and he would defend the reasonable demands of demons no matter what. He simply asked:

"Does your Juvenile Protection Law protect minors who commit evil?"

A lethal blow.

"Human children are also bullied to death by the very 'children who deserve a chance to correct their mistakes' that you speak of. What about their future?"

"Is it unimportant?"

The entire room fell silent.

"The Demon Realm upholds freedom, democracy, and mutual aid. Humans can make demands of us, but the prerequisite is that you must be able to do the same yourselves."

The people from the 749 Bureau truly felt they were in a bind. For every proposal, the other side could find counter-examples from the human world that left them speechless.

The Chief Negotiator was exhausted from arguing with a bird.

But just then—

"Are you done?"

"Shall we talk about how the 749 Bureau spent the last year seducing demons, attempting to attain immortality?"

-

Song Yu was still waiting in the car. His face was quite flushed because his grandfather in the back seat kept repeating:

"Xiao Yu, so you really are the 'First Lady' of the Demon Realm."

"Yes, yes, yes."

Song Zhengguo was indeed quite proud. This was a legitimate, official title, certainly not some empty name.

Song Yu was on the verge of a breakdown:

"Grandpa, I am not the 'Lady'."

"It's about the same."

Song Zhengguo was very open-minded: "Those are just titles. We're all family; don't worry about it."

Song Yu closed his eyes.

It was already past ten o'clock; the mid-session break should be coming soon. Song Yu raised his eyes to look at the building and asked the old man in the back seat:

"Grandpa, is the food still hot?"

"Hot, it's hot. Don't you worry."

001 had transformed into a fluffy little sparrow, perched at the very top of the massive building, looking down at the few people below.

There was a "barrier" surrounding the area.

The little sparrow conjured a light screen, scanning every corner of the grand hall. There were no suspicious humans.

001 flapped its wings and flew another circle, finally spotting a human standing guard on a sentry platform, looking quite upright.

The sparrow landed.

It stood firmly.

The person's head felt a bit heavy.

"..."

001 finished patrolling for a while and finally entered during the mid-session break. It was almost noon; they had to go eat together.

The little sparrow found the place nimbly. The ferret was guarding the door, opening a crack and bowing slightly.

Inside the room, there was a clamor, sounding like a pure argument:

"This is slander! Pure, unadulterated slander!"

"Disgusting! It's all recorded! Isn't it just that you want to seek immortality? You even seduced demons! Ordinary people wouldn't dare get close, only you sorcerers would take such... such risks!"

"Th-that was just a minority!"

"Stop spouting nonsense. You look like a crooked melon or a cracked date; just shut your mouth."

"You—"

"You lot in the 749 Bureau are a bunch of bastards. You look down on demons, yet you want to use them, and then you want to drive them away! What kind of people are you!"

"And you lot are any better? Don't act like you demons haven't been with humans! You've forced love before!"

"...Stop talking nonsense! That was mutual affection!"

It was a complete mess.

The little sparrow kicked backward with its claws, closed the door, and pattered forward. Along the way, it passed many flying documents and a few ballpoint pens that had been thrown; the sparrow navigated around them steadily.

001 looked up at the situation on the table and spotted 247, who was sitting in a chair with its bird legs stretched out leisurely, while the great demons around were arguing incessantly.

The humans opposite were the same. There was a middle-aged man with a haggard face and a... Taoist priest who was keeping his head down?

It really was him.

The little sparrow flapped its wings onto the chair. There was still some distance to the tabletop. The blue-feathered bird was comparing its own claws, but upon hearing the movement, it looked over and immediately patted the seat next to it with its wing, whispering:

"Sit."

001 squeezed over and sat down, imitating the other.

It didn't quite understand the current situation.

Bai Linlin had to explain:

"We need to scold them a bit, otherwise both sides will easily harbor resentment. This is a fixed part of the process. Once they've vented their anger, it'll be fine."

The little sparrow tilted its head, feeling eager to try.

"You want to go too?"

"That works."

Bai Linlin sat in the chair, waiting for this part to end. By now, the little sparrow had climbed onto the table. Being smaller, its bird head bobbed from one side to the other.

"Why do humans want to find demons! Can't we find humans? We're different species, how could it possibly work!"

"Tch! You really think you humans look good? You don't even have fur, you're all smooth and bare, and you have to wrap yourselves in cloth! Our true forms are so beautiful! When you take off your clothes, that's called 'exotic'! You'd be arrested if you walked down the street like that! You call that good-looking? You call that good-looking? Speak!"

The human opposite was enraged.

"Then don't look for human spouses in the future! Stop abducting humans! There's reproductive isolation!"

The little sparrow, fluffy and round, shook its head. It knew about this and retorted:

"That's not true!"

"We can mate!"

The grand hall went silent all at once.

chunks.chineseText:
第83章

一秒，两秒。

“啊，今天天气不错啊。”

对面的大妖咳嗽了几声，然后莫名其妙地休战了，同旁边的另外一只妖说话，假装什么事情都没有发生。

人类也莫名地坐了下来，硬生生地被打断了输出，面红耳赤的，旁边的同事也开始尴尬地说话：

“中场我们吃什么？泡面如何？”

“啊，盒饭吧，买个里脊肉的。”

“行，这个点……中场快结束了吧？”

小雀站在宽大的谈判桌上，伸着鸟头，不太清楚为什么开始说这些，爪子啪嗒啪嗒的。

一旁的道士看到后目瞪口呆的，怎么……这只也是……

老宋家里都养着什么妖？

小雀有些沮丧，转了下鸟头，正好和道士对上了眼。

“……”

“……”

此刻白粼粼已经闭上了鸟眼，他为什么要把001给叫进来，它到底是怎么学的人类文化，不能毕业！

鸟立马扑棱翅膀上来了，西服革履的，由于位高权重，谈判桌上也安静了会儿。

交涉长坐在对面，也是面色复杂。

这妖界……

001啪嗒啪嗒地走回了蓝羽小鸟的旁边，保持着一个靠后的身位，很快身边就传来声音：

“那个，双方互相交流了民意看法，这一环节就先结束吧。”

“交涉长意下如何？”

蓝羽小鸟圆滚滚的，伸了伸翅膀，挡住了旁边的小雀，挺胸抬头的，虽然有些尴尬，但还是很有气势。

交涉长：“……可以。”

-

大约十多分钟之后。

大会堂内部已经散场了，只是座位上还停留着几个人类和妖怪，他们在说些什么闲言碎语。

白粼粼深吸一口气，看着旁边的小雀，001收了收翅膀，站得很是规矩。

“不能总是乱说交配。”

小雀爪子并了并。

“人类这边没有那么开放，他们一般不说这种直白的词。”

“我们来谈判，要注意一点点。”

白粼粼从桌子上下来，伸出来了翅膀，搭在灰棕色小雀的身上，很是语重心长地道。

001虽然不太明白，但好在态度端正，点了点鸟头。

但其实还是不明白。

人类不开放？可是他们在电视上拍摄动物交配的画面，它还以为这是某种文化，是专门看XX的。

小雀胸口的毛很是蓬松，后面跟着蓝羽小鸟一同往外走，雪貂还会弯腰说些什么事，前方西服革履的鸟又低声回复着什么。

247很忙。

“行，大家就还在这里就可以，食物那边已经备好了，到时候去领取就行，注意纪律，不要乱扔垃圾。”

白粼粼很有风范地往前走，西服的纽扣紧紧的，很贴身，显得有些威严。

一众妖怪在后面跟着。

小雀处在第二位，收了收翅膀，把方才的事已经抛掷脑后了，只是环顾着四周。

大会堂内部很是典雅大气，有几个749局的人在旁边说话：

“谁知道……那么小。”

“今天上午真的是，我脑子里现在全是那两个字。”

小雀站定了脚步，面色严肃，啪嗒啪嗒地走了过去，脱离了队伍。

它是防卫部门的妖，是能够听到很远距离的对话的。

白粼粼浑然不觉，还在前面认认真真地道：

“下次不能那么直接地说了，或许……或许找个替代词？”

“我想想啊。”

也就在这时，小雀已经走到了那两个人类的面前，站定脚步。

“你们好。”

749局的人本来也就是随口一谈，刚要走了，结果转身一看，被拦住了去路。

“……”

一秒，两秒。

人有些紧张：“那个，找我们有什么事吗？”

小雀仰着鸟头，很是认真地反驳：

“我说的有错吗？”

“本来就是可以交配的！”

这话一出，场内开始以这里为中心，波浪似地安静了起来。

白粼粼本来都快走到门口了，结果察觉到周遭环境的变化，立马回了头，原本小雀站的位置此刻空空如也。

翅根一紧。

就一会儿没看住。

鸟连忙环顾四周，看到那个小雀的背影，立马伸着翅膀往那边狂走。

“额……”

两个人类面色一红。

小雀生气，毛绒绒的，再度坚持地道：

“我们都是会化形的妖怪，都是人的模样，当然是可以——”

白粼粼闻言一阵崩溃。

不过就在这时，变故突生，对面的人类似乎是踩到了一根圆珠笔，一下子翻了。

“啊！”

白粼粼也一个急刹车。

怕被压住。

但就在这危难之际。

小雀伸出来了一边翅膀，有万千金丝流动，隔空稳稳地托住了那个人的身子，胸膛挺立。

犹如悬浮人。

749局的人一开始是闭着眼睛的，而后发现预想的疼痛并没有发生，不由得睁开了眼睛，上方是吊灯。

啊？

身下有托着的力量，他渐渐地“站”了起来，低头一看，下方是只侧身45度站着的小雀，收了收翅膀。

场面变得古怪了起来。

“谢谢。”

小雀冷声道：“不必客气。”

“……”

十分钟后。

那个妖界的主席过来带走了小雀，两个身影小小的，已经走到了门口的拐角处，749局的人站在原地，愣愣的。

其中被救的那位，面色莫名一红。

外面的车内。

白粼粼伸着鸟腿，坐在后座的椅子上，圆滚滚的身躯一起一伏的，显然是在呼吸，用翅膀抚了下不存在的“汗”。

宋峥国在打开食盒，一共两份，小雀已经站在小桌板那里了，认认真真地开始叨了起来。

反倒是自家的这只，看着忧心忡忡的。

“怎么了？鸟儿，不顺利？”

白粼粼还没来得及回话，旁边站着吃东西的小雀抬了下鸟头，觉得是自己的问题，开始站好，爪子并了并，准备解释。

“是因为我——”

蓝羽小鸟立马飞了过去，用翅膀死死地捂住小雀的喙。

“哈哈，没事没事。”

宋峥国虽然有些困惑，但还是没有多问什么，毕竟今天实在是很多事，一切要以鸟儿为主。

……

宋郁看着“少年”在低头用勺子挖饭，浅蓝色的头发有个卷翘的弧度，一动一动的。

“那边安排好了，其他妖在大会堂的一个偏厅吃东西。”

“唔……”

“少年”咽了一口，说完这话，拿了纸巾去擦拭唇瓣，很软，唇红齿白的。

“下半场的话，基本上就要确定一些条款，然后签一下合约，就可以回家了。”

宋郁侧眸询问：“那我还在外面等你？”

白粼粼思考了一下下，微微凑了过去，眼睛亮了亮：

“我应该可以把你带进去。”

车子前座这边氛围很是好，后座也同样如此，小雀板板正正地站在小桌板上，等着勺子过来。

老人挖一勺饭，喂进去。

小雀吃得饱饱的。

它不会用筷子，但用喙吃又太慢了，这样子反倒是个好办法。
chunks.englishText:
One second, two seconds.

"Ah, the weather is nice today."

The great demon opposite coughed a few times, then inexplicably called a truce, turning to talk to another demon beside it, pretending nothing had happened.

The humans also sat down inexplicably, their momentum cut short, their faces flushed. Their colleagues began to speak awkwardly:

"What are we having for the break? How about instant noodles?"

"Ah, let's get a boxed lunch. Maybe one with pork tenderloin."

"Sure, at this time... the break is almost over, right?"

The little sparrow stood on the wide negotiation table, stretching its neck, not quite understanding why they started talking about these things, its claws pattering away.

The Taoist priest to the side was dumbfounded. How... was this one also...

What kind of demons did the old Song family keep?

The little sparrow felt a bit dejected. It turned its head and happened to lock eyes with the Taoist.

"..."

"..."

At this moment, Bai Linlin had closed his bird eyes. Why did he bring 001 in? How on earth did it learn human culture? It couldn't graduate!

The bird immediately flapped its wings and stood up. Dressed in a suit and tie, and due to his high status and power, the negotiation table quieted down for a moment.

The Chief Negotiator sat opposite, his expression complex.

This Demon Realm...

001 pattered back to the side of the blue-feathered bird, maintaining a position slightly behind it. Soon, a voice came from beside it:

"Well, both sides have exchanged their views and opinions. Let's end this segment here."

"What does the Chief Negotiator think?"

The blue-feathered bird was round and plump, stretching its wings to block the little sparrow beside it. It held its head high and chest out; although it was a bit awkward, it still carried an air of authority.

Chief Negotiator: "...That is acceptable."

-

About ten minutes later.

The grand hall had cleared out, though a few humans and demons remained in their seats, whispering gossip.

Bai Linlin took a deep breath, looking at the little sparrow beside him. 001 tucked its wings, standing very properly.

"You can't just talk about mating randomly."

The little sparrow brought its claws together.

"The humans here aren't that open. They generally don't use such blunt words."

"We are here to negotiate, we need to be a bit more careful."

Bai Linlin climbed down from the table and draped a wing over the grey-brown sparrow, saying earnestly.

Although 001 didn't quite understand, its attitude was at least correct, and it nodded its bird head.

But in truth, it still didn't understand.

Humans aren't open? But they broadcast images of animals mating on television. It had thought this was a type of culture, specifically for watching "XX."

The fluff on the little sparrow's chest was very puffy. It followed the blue-feathered bird as they walked out. The ferret would bow and mention something, and the bird in the suit and tie ahead would reply in a low voice.

247 was very busy.

"Alright, everyone can just stay here. The food has been prepared, so you can go pick it up later. Mind the discipline and don't litter."

Bai Linlin walked forward with great style, his suit buttons tight and form-fitting, making him look quite majestic.

A group of demons followed behind.

The little sparrow was in the second position, tucking its wings, having already thrown the previous matter to the back of its mind, simply looking around.

The interior of the grand hall was elegant and grand. A few people from the 749 Bureau were talking nearby:

"Who knew... it was so small."

"This morning was really something. My head is filled with those two words right now."

The little sparrow stopped in its tracks, its expression serious. It pattered over, breaking away from the group.

It was a demon from the defense department and could hear conversations from a great distance.

Bai Linlin was completely unaware, still saying earnestly in front:

"You can't be so direct next time. Perhaps... perhaps find a substitute word?"

"Let me think..."

Just then, the little sparrow had already walked up to the two humans and stopped.

"Hello."

The 749 Bureau staff had just been chatting casually and were about to leave, but when they turned around, they found their path blocked.

"..."

One second, two seconds.

The person was a bit nervous: "Um, is there something you need?"

The little sparrow tilted its head, refuting very seriously:

"Was I wrong?"

"It is perfectly possible to mate!"

As soon as these words were spoken, the area around them began to go quiet, like a ripple.

Bai Linlin had almost reached the door, but noticing the change in the surrounding environment, he immediately turned back. The spot where the little sparrow had been standing was now empty.

His wing-roots tightened.

He hadn't kept an eye on it for even a moment.

The bird hurriedly looked around, spotted the little sparrow's back, and immediately stretched its wings, rushing over frantically.

"Er..."

The two humans' faces turned red.

The little sparrow was angry, its fluff standing up, and it insisted again:

"We are all demons who can shapeshift; we all have human forms, so of course it's possible—"

Bai Linlin felt like collapsing when he heard this.

However, at that moment, a sudden change occurred. The human opposite seemed to have stepped on a ballpoint pen and suddenly tipped over.

"Ah!"

Bai Linlin also slammed on the brakes.

He was afraid of being crushed.

But in this moment of crisis, the little sparrow extended one wing, and thousands of golden threads flowed out, steadily supporting the person's body in mid-air, its chest puffed out.

It was like a levitating person.

The 749 Bureau staff member had closed his eyes at first, but then realized the expected pain didn't come. He couldn't help but open his eyes to see the ceiling lamp above.

Huh?

There was a supporting force beneath him. He gradually "stood" up and looked down to see the little sparrow standing sideways at a 45-degree angle, tucking its wings.

The scene became bizarre.

"Thank you."

The little sparrow said coldly: "You're welcome."

"..."

Ten minutes later.

The Chairman of the Demon Realm came over to take the little sparrow away. The two figures were small as they reached the corner of the door. The 749 Bureau staff stood where they were, stunned.

The one who had been saved had a strangely flushed face.

Inside the car outside.

Bai Linlin sat on the back seat, his round body rising and falling as he breathed, using his wing to wipe away "sweat" that didn't exist.

Song Zhengguo was opening the food boxes—two in total. The little sparrow was already standing at the small table, beginning to peck away earnestly.

On the contrary, his own bird looked worried.

"What's wrong? Birdie, didn't it go well?"

Before Bai Linlin could reply, the little sparrow, which was standing and eating, raised its head. Feeling it was its own fault, it stood up straight, brought its claws together, and prepared to explain.

"It's because I—"

The blue-feathered bird immediately flew over and covered the little sparrow's beak tightly with its wing.

"Haha, it's nothing, nothing at all."

Although Song Zhengguo was a bit confused, he didn't ask further. After all, there were too many things going on today, and everything had to revolve around the bird.

...

Song Yu watched the "youth" lower his head to scoop rice with a spoon, his light blue hair having a curled arc that moved as he ate.

"Things are arranged over there. The other demons are eating in a side hall of the grand hall."

"Mmm..."

The "youth" swallowed a mouthful, finished speaking, and took a tissue to wipe his lips. He was very soft, with red lips and white teeth.

"For the second half, we basically just need to finalize some clauses, sign the contract, and then we can go home."

Song Yu turned his head to ask: "Then I'll still wait for you outside?"

Bai Linlin thought for a moment, leaned in slightly, his eyes brightening:

"I should be able to bring you in."

The atmosphere in the front of the car was very good, and the same was true for the back seat. The little sparrow stood upright on the small table, waiting for the spoon to come over.

The old man scooped a spoonful of rice and fed it to him.

The little sparrow ate until it was full.

It didn't know how to use chopsticks, and eating with its beak was too slow, so this was actually a good method.

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国其实很谨慎，用勺子挖的不多，毕竟小雀体型真的不大，按理来说，一口也吃不了多少。

但是……

001每次都会张开喙，大大的。

闭着鸟眼。

一勺下去，小雀体型没有任何变化。

宋峥国是真的觉得是个无底洞，他皱了皱眉，看了已经见底的碗。

不由得抬手过去，小雀不明所以，但还是伸爪子上去了。

体重是恒定的。

“吃完啦！”

前排的“少年”伸了伸胳膊，声音很是满足，而后砰得一下化成蓝羽小鸟。

上午的西服已经有些褶皱了，所以再换一套，鸟在前面的椅子上站着，圆滚滚的，仰着鸟头看人。

宋郁拿出来那套全新的，垂眸给鸟穿上，翅根一伸，爪子一抬。

开始扣扣子。

鸟很坦然地接受服务，不过就是觉得有点喘不上来气，没忍住说了一句：

“有、有点紧。”

宋郁手指一顿，心想这套好像是没改过的尺码，他面不改色地道：

“可能是布料的原因，不舒服的话，那换回早上的好不好？”

鸟摇了摇头：

“还是这套吧。”

鸟喜欢穿新衣服。

最后着装完毕，白粼粼在副驾上啪嗒啪嗒地转了一圈，伸着鸟头往后看，其实还可以的。

“好看。”

宋郁不用问就自动回答。

鸟收了收翅膀，侧眸看过去，鸟眼圆圆的。

001也吃得舒服了，甚至在后面还小憩了一会，蓬松成了个毛球。

“那走吧！”

-

下半场。

“妖界将会定点就职动物园，对于一些濒危保护动物进行信息的共享，但与此相对的，人类也需要适时地放归有能力的野生动物，同时给予没有能力的动物以合适的生存空间。”

白粼粼站在对面，很是认认真真地道，同时问了一句：

“这一条有异议吗？”

交涉长本来是想要先开口的，但是这句话一出，他好像只能说：

“没有。”

鸟点了点头，朝着旁边挥了挥翅膀，雪貂立刻拿着笔开始写了起来。

第二条。

“开展妖界同749局的合作，并不局限于联合任务，而是要着重扩展经济方面，给予妖怪化形成做小买卖的机会，获得人类货币，进而可以合法购买加工后的食物。”

白粼粼再度说道。

不过交涉长这里还是补充了一下：

“关于身份证的事，很抱歉还是不能让步，如果妖怪流入到合租、上学、去工厂……这种人流量密集的地方，人与妖观念不同，难免会有冲突，力量悬殊，容易出现不可控的局面，这一方面我们还是不能放开，还请理解。”

众妖彼此交汇了下目光，也是点了点头。

白粼粼挺胸抬头的：

“妖界其实也是群居动物，我们会按时回基地，没有监护人的小妖统一由管理局养大，每周开展文体活动，有定期考核，人类货币于大家而言是一种交易的工具。”

“我们并不会侵占人类的高级工作，大可放心，我们也不想天天加班熬夜。”

749局的人沉默了。

后面交涉长意识到哪里不对，连忙咳嗽了几句，开始念他们这边的条文：

“关于灰色任务这方面，人类将提高给合作方妖怪的津贴，按照次数稳定上升百分比，最高为五十万人民币。”

白粼粼收了收翅膀，很矜持地点了点鸟头。

“与此相对的是，城市里宠物性质的小妖的监护人，我们需要获得名单，并提供相应的防护手册。”

“可以。”

之后就是一系列的合作与让步，包含动物保护法、山林限制区，妖界统辖地界的规定等等，零零总总一共是多条。

最后双方算是达成了共识。

“那移步去大厅吧。”

交涉长开口说道，随后站起来了身子，伸了下手，其实他也不知道为什么要这么做。

但已经晚了。

那个西服革履的鸟收了收翅膀，下了地，啪嗒啪嗒地往前面走，身后一众大妖这么护着。

浩浩荡荡的。

749局的人也在跟着走，他们其实心里觉得妖怪不是人，有些时候没有那么正式，在窃窃私语着：

“那是什么意思？全部由管理局负责？不用工作啊？”

现在公职人员都开始逐步降薪了，他们其实也有点焦虑，听到妖界这么说，不由得有些好奇。

“好像是这样子，平云叔不是去过？”

道士其实把自己的存在感降得很低了，但是这个时候还是被围住了，他听到这话其实也愣了下，当初去管理局考察的时候完全没有觉得有问题。

只是认为妖怪在拙劣地模仿。

但是……

“它们确实不用工作，全部都是管理局提供休息场所的，偶尔会有些小妖去做红色的任务，主要是领零花钱。”

此话一出，众人沉默。

大厅那边很快就到了。

双方都站好了，妖怪这边规规矩矩的，前方是只西服革履的鸟，照旧是被托了上来，很有风度地站在桌子上。

微微抬头，侧身而立。

交涉长站在对面，莫名有些拘谨。

合约一共两张，双方均需要签字。

749局往年并不在意这个仪式，因为妖界大多是不认识字的，上面无论写什么，它们都是会签字的。

但是现在……

西服革履的鸟用爪子拿着笔，很是利落地扫了几页条文，刷刷地写上了自己的编号，而后用妖力注入，纸张的边缘泛起来金色的纹路，流动着的。

同时，还有一些拍摄的声音。

交涉长皱了皱眉，侧头看过去，却发现一只雪貂正扛着摄像机在拍摄这边的画面，以一个仰视的视角，对准的方向很明显是它们的“主席”。

“……”

咔嚓咔嚓。

好几张下去了。

交涉长不由得给了自己团队一个眼神，很快有个同事拿着手机过来了，也拍摄了几张。

他也偷偷地看了下妖界的摄像机的牌子，不由得愣住了。

因为……挺贵的。

好像是五位数。

雪貂善于学习，前几天已经学会拍照了，现如今正在调整光圈，力图把它们的鸟席拍摄得更加伟岸。

照片呈现近大远小的特征，鸟席微微低头，面容亲和，从容不迫地用爪子签字，背景微微模糊，是那个交涉长，呈现出一团影子，有前倾的样子，正好被捕捉到，像是躬身。

雪貂检查了下，对这张照片非常满意。

它应该也能获得个普利策奖。

雪貂功成身退。

749局的人也在拍摄，按照传统的要求，对准场景、人物以及背后的条幅，但这种情况也不能露出妖怪，其实没有什么意义。

不过还是得搞。

弄完之后，旁边有个同事补充道：

“单位的公众号是不是轮到你了？”

那个人面如死灰。

-

之后就是换约。

在桌子的正前方，鸟站在左边，交涉长站在右边，双方看向镜头。

雪貂再度扛着摄像机拍摄，找寻合适的角度。
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo was actually quite cautious, not scooping out too much with the spoon. After all, the little sparrow’s size was truly small; logically speaking, it shouldn't be able to eat much in one bite.

However...

001 would open its beak wide every single time.

With its bird eyes closed.

One spoonful after another, yet the little sparrow’s size remained completely unchanged.

Song Zhengguo truly felt it was a bottomless pit. He frowned, looking at the now-empty bowl.

He couldn't help but raise his hand, and the little sparrow, though confused, still extended its claw onto his palm.

Its weight remained constant.

"All done!"

The "young man" in the front row stretched his arms, his voice sounding very satisfied, before *poof*, he transformed back into a small blue-feathered bird.

The suit from the morning was already a bit wrinkled, so it was time to change into another one. The bird stood on the chair in front, round and plump, tilting its head to look at the human.

Song Yu took out a brand-new set, lowered his eyes, and helped the bird put it on, extending its wing roots and lifting its claws.

He began to button it up.

The bird accepted the service with great composure, though it felt a little breathless and couldn't help but remark:

"It's... it's a bit tight."

Song Yu’s fingers paused. He thought to himself that this set probably hadn't been tailored to size yet. With a calm expression, he said:

"It might be the fabric. If it's uncomfortable, shall we change back to the one from this morning?"

The bird shook its head:

"Let's stick with this one."

The bird liked wearing new clothes.

Once dressed, Bai Linlin trotted around in the passenger seat, stretching its bird head to look behind. Actually, it was fine.

"It looks good."

Song Yu answered automatically without being asked.

The bird tucked in its wings and glanced over, its bird eyes round.

001 was also feeling comfortable after its meal and even took a short nap in the back, fluffing up into a ball of fur.

"Alright, let's go!"

-

The second half of the meeting.

"The Demon Realm will establish fixed-point cooperation with the zoo to share information regarding certain endangered protected animals. In return, humans must also release capable wild animals back into the wild at appropriate times, while providing suitable living spaces for those without such capabilities."

Bai Linlin stood opposite them, speaking very earnestly, and then asked:

"Are there any objections to this clause?"

The Chief Negotiator had intended to speak first, but once those words were out, it seemed he could only say:

"None."

The bird nodded and waved its wing toward the side. A stoat immediately picked up a pen and began to write.

"Second clause."

"We will launch cooperation between the Demon Realm and Bureau 749, not limited to joint missions, but focusing on expanding economic aspects. This will give demons who have attained human form the opportunity to engage in small businesses, earn human currency, and subsequently legally purchase processed food."

Bai Linlin stated once more.

However, the Chief Negotiator added a caveat:

"Regarding the matter of identification cards, I am sorry, but we cannot concede. If demons flow into places with high human traffic like shared housing, schools, or factories... given the differing perspectives between humans and demons, conflicts are inevitable. With the disparity in power, it is easy for uncontrollable situations to arise. We cannot open this up; I hope you understand."

The demons exchanged glances and nodded.

Bai Linlin stood tall, chest puffed out:

"The Demon Realm is actually a group-living species. We will return to the base on time. Young demons without guardians will be raised collectively by the Administration, with cultural and physical activities held weekly and regular assessments. Human currency is merely a tool for trade for us."

"We will not occupy high-level human jobs, so rest assured. We don't want to work overtime or stay up late every day either."

The people from Bureau 749 fell silent.

Later, the Chief Negotiator realized something was off, coughed a few times, and began to read their own terms:

"Regarding 'grey' missions, humans will increase the allowance for cooperating demons, with a stable percentage increase based on the number of missions, up to a maximum of 500,000 RMB."

Bai Linlin tucked in its wings and nodded its bird head with great reserve.

"In return, we require the list of guardians for pet-type demons in the city and will provide corresponding protection manuals."

"Agreed."

What followed was a series of collaborations and concessions, including the Animal Protection Law, restricted mountain forest areas, regulations on the territory governed by the Demon Realm, and so on, totaling many clauses.

In the end, both sides reached a consensus.

"Let's move to the main hall."

The Chief Negotiator spoke, then stood up and gestured with his hand, though he didn't really know why he did that.

But it was too late.

The bird in the suit tucked its wings, stepped down, and trotted toward the front, protected by a crowd of Great Demons behind it.

It was a grand procession.

The people from Bureau 749 followed along. In their hearts, they felt that demons weren't human and sometimes weren't that formal, so they whispered among themselves:

"What does that mean? Everything is handled by the Administration? They don't have to work?"

Public servants were starting to see their salaries reduced, so they were actually a bit anxious and couldn't help but be curious upon hearing the Demon Realm say this.

"Seems that way. Didn't Uncle Pingyun go there?"

The Taoist had kept his presence very low, but he was surrounded at this moment. He was also stunned when he heard this; when he went to the Administration for an inspection, he hadn't felt there was any problem at all.

He had just assumed the demons were clumsily imitating humans.

But...

"They really don't have to work. The Administration provides all the resting places. Occasionally, some young demons go on 'red' missions, mainly to earn pocket money."

Once these words were spoken, everyone fell silent.

They soon reached the main hall.

Both sides stood in position. The demons were well-behaved, and at the front was the bird in the suit, which was lifted up as usual, standing on the table with great poise.

It tilted its head slightly and stood sideways.

The Chief Negotiator stood opposite, feeling inexplicably reserved.

There were two copies of the contract, and both sides needed to sign.

Bureau 749 hadn't cared much about this ceremony in previous years because most of the Demon Realm couldn't read; they would sign whatever was written on it.

But now...

The bird in the suit held the pen with its claw, scanned the clauses deftly, scribbled its serial number, and then injected demonic energy into it. The edges of the paper glowed with flowing golden patterns.

At the same time, there were sounds of photography.

The Chief Negotiator frowned and turned his head, only to find a stoat carrying a camera, filming the scene from a low angle. The direction it was aimed at was clearly their "Chairman."

"..."

*Click, click.*

Several photos were taken.

The Chief Negotiator couldn't help but give his team a look. Soon, a colleague came over with a mobile phone and also took a few shots.

He also secretly checked the brand of the Demon Realm's camera and was stunned.

Because... it was quite expensive.

It seemed to be a five-figure sum.

The stoat was good at learning; it had learned how to take photos a few days ago and was currently adjusting the aperture, striving to make their Bird Chairman look even more majestic.

The photo featured a perspective where the near was large and the far was small. The Bird Chairman was slightly bowing its head, its expression amiable and composed as it signed with its claw. The background was slightly blurred, showing the Chief Negotiator as a mass of shadow, leaning forward in a way that was perfectly captured, looking as if he were bowing.

The stoat checked it and was very satisfied with the photo.

It should be able to win a Pulitzer Prize for this.

The stoat retired after its success.

The people from Bureau 749 were also taking photos, following traditional requirements by aiming at the scene, the people, and the banner behind them. But in this situation, they couldn't show the demons, which actually made it quite meaningless.

But they had to do it anyway.

After finishing, a colleague next to him added:

"Isn't it your turn to manage the unit's official WeChat account?"

That person’s face turned ashen.

-

After that, they exchanged the contracts.

At the front of the table, the bird stood on the left, and the Chief Negotiator stood on the right. Both sides looked at the lens.

The stoat once again carried the camera to film, searching for the perfect angle.

chunks.chineseText:
全场气氛庄重，很快它打了个手势，陪同的众妖开始鼓掌，749局的人吓了一跳，而后也跟着鼓掌。

“是错觉吗？”

“它们好像人。”

“反倒是我们像个草台班子。”

749局的人闭了闭眼。

道士也站在其中，看着那只台上的小鸟，心里莫名平静了许多，已经自我说通了。

妖界主席位高权重，是主心骨。

怎么能对749局的人说明身份？

他理解的。

不过就在这时，他隐隐约约觉得余光看到了什么若隐若现的东西，不由得往旁边看了过去。

那是两个身高放大了一米的鼠妖，举着三叉戟，穿着制服，神色严肃，它们中间隔着有两个人的距离。

其实空空荡荡的，但是道士就是觉得奇怪，他一开始还没反应过来，直到灵光一闪。

障眼法。

妖怪是很擅长这个的。

道士立马皱眉，他现在是749局的人，自然是有责任去查探异常的，于是立马在空中做了个术法，指尖一掐，对准自己的额头中心，开了“天眼”。

到底是何方神圣？

那团雾气渐渐地散去，反光的部分也变得清晰，两个鼠妖中间站得是……一个老人一个青年。

道士瞠目结舌。

宋峥国还在侧头同自己孙子讲话：

“你看鸟儿多气派？就是你不能过去，按道理来说，你在旁边陪着拍照才合适。”

宋郁：“……”

“不过它们交涉长也没带伴侣，算了，你还是不露面为好。”

宋峥国俨然是沉浸在了自己的世界里，但后面总觉得哪里不对，于是偷偷地对自己孙子道：

“他们不是看不到吗？这怎么我后背凉凉的，应该……”

就在回头的一瞬间。

道士面无表情地对视了过来。

宋峥国：“……看不到吧。”

-

换约仪式结束。

白粼粼在台前同749局的人“握手”，这是传达友好的必要环节，轮到道士了，对方看了过来。

“前辈。”

道士其实心里很多话想要说，但最后还是很尊重地伸出来了手指，去捏了捏那个尾羽。

“你好你好。”

最终彻底结束是在下午四点钟左右，001已经在鼠妖的旁边睡了一觉了，中午吃了一大堆的碳水，下午刚好消化。

小雀醒过来的时候大厅里已经准备散场了，它啪嗒啪嗒地走着，准备去问问247什么时候开饭。

不过对方似乎在忙，同那个道士在说话。

“啊……这个，被发现了？”

“那我们借一步说话。”

白粼粼看向一边的爷爷，其实心里也是捏紧了一把汗，这毕竟是爷爷的故交。

小雀已经走到跟前了。

001仰了仰鸟头，看着人。

道士不由得也看过去，一秒，两秒，他想要开口：

“一……”

小雀掉头走了。

“……”

白粼粼走到了鼠妖这边，挥了挥翅膀，旁边的雪貂立刻跟着过来，它们去了一个比较小的房间，大会堂这边还是留有地方的。

道士也跟着过去了。

不过这个时候，749局的人都在往这边看，窃窃私语了起来。

-

房间内。

宋郁俯身半蹲着，把他的小鸟带回了肩头，很温和地道：

“真的特别好。”

白粼粼收了收翅膀，很是骄傲地贴了贴人的下巴。

小雀则是拿着一包海盐饼干在认真地吃着，刚醒过来，正是饿的时候。

此刻真正焦灼的地方。

道士背着手，看着面前的老头。

“……”

宋峥国转了下身，不打算对视，但没招了，对方又走过来了。

“这……这鸟儿的大事，我们做家里人的，肯定是要过来看看的。”

道士皱眉：

“那、那很危险的！”

“万一让749局的人看到了，他们——”

宋峥国皱眉：“749局的人不是人类吗？这又什么好怕的？”

道士怔了下，的确是这样，妖界是老宋家的亲戚，很安全，至于749局……那不是人类吗？

怎么自己条件反射就——

他叹了口气。

宋峥国实际上是有些心虚的，后面还是道了个歉：

“没办法，真不能告诉你，鸟儿身份特殊，再加上你第一次见它吓到它了，我做长辈的，自然是会偏向些的。”

“你多担待些。”

道士听到这话也是摇了摇头。

其实到这个时候了，他也明白了，为什么和妖怪结成伴侣的人都不会站在人类的利益上了，根本就没有异化，其实只是……平等视之。

小妖在老友眼里。

估计也就是个孩子。

罢了。

“那你也要注意点，你多大了，来这种地方！”

宋峥国摆手一笑，犹如个老顽童。

-

几天后。

京市家里的客厅摆满了行李，上面有好几个都是鸟的，鸟的衣服，鸟的吃的，鸟的礼物。

宋郁一路收拾着东西，每件都需要给肩头的小鸟过目一下，同意了带回去，不同意放在这里。

“小郁，我们几点出发？”

“要不要给鸟儿先吃个饭？”

宋峥国的确是精神状态好了很多，比钓鱼的时候还好，他拿着个勺子，里面盛着酸奶，前面站着一只闭眼张喙的小雀。

圆滚滚的。

“不用，时间来得及，到时候我们去中转的城市吃个饭就可以。”

“还可以去看看海。”

宋峥国闻言也是点了点头，随后想起来什么，拿出来自己的手机，给昨天回到南市的陈开鹤发消息：

[明日就到。]

桌子上的小雀还在张着喙。

宋峥国立马拿着勺子喂过去了。

后面就是楼上楼下一直收拾，001也有一个专属的行李箱，里面没有装什么别的，全部都是247给它的衣服，本体的服装，还有一些人形的服装。

宋峥国后面也帮忙了，两个人都在房间里进进出出的，两个小鸟各自跟随一个人，啪嗒啪嗒地在后面走着。

“粼粼。”

“啾啾！”

“我万一会踩到你呢？”

“啾啾！”

鸟不闻不问，最后在卧室偷偷变大，挡住了人的去路。

宋郁：“……”

白粼粼眯了眯鸟眼，左右摇摆地走了过去，刚想要伸下翅根，但就在这时，门发出了声音。

“小郁，我觉得我们还是不要带太多衣服了，年后不还是要回京市吗？”

宋峥国推门进来了，抬头一看，庞然大物的鸟就站在一旁，很是拘谨。

一秒，两秒。

脑海中突然开始回荡起来那个不成器儿子的声音：

“爸！爸！你信我啊，那个巨鸟真的存在，它狠狠地扇了我一翅膀！”

“我睡不着，我真的我……”

宋峥国微微站直了身子，以表重视。

但肩头的小雀看见了里面，扑棱翅膀过去了，很自然地低了鸟头，开始蓄力，身躯一点点地变大，最后成为一只同样将近两米高的巨鸟。

侧头看了过来。

神情庄重。

“……”
chunks.englishText:
The atmosphere in the hall was solemn. Soon, it made a gesture, and the accompanying demons began to applaud. The people from Bureau 749 were startled, but then followed suit.

"Is it an illusion?"

"They seem so human."

"On the contrary, we look like a makeshift troupe."

The people from Bureau 749 closed their eyes.

The Taoist also stood among them, looking at the little bird on the stage. His heart was inexplicably much calmer; he had already reasoned it out for himself.

The Demon Realm Chairman was in a high position of power and was the backbone of their society.

How could it reveal its identity to the people of Bureau 749?

He understood.

However, at this moment, he vaguely felt he saw something flickering in his peripheral vision, so he couldn't help but look to the side.

Those were two rat demons, their height magnified by a meter, holding tridents and wearing uniforms, their expressions serious. There was a distance of two people between them.

Actually, it was empty, but the Taoist just felt it was strange. He didn't react at first, until a flash of inspiration hit him.

A glamour spell.

Demons were very good at this.

The Taoist immediately frowned. He was now a member of Bureau 749 and naturally had the responsibility to investigate anomalies. So, he immediately performed a spell in the air, pinched his fingertips, aimed at the center of his forehead, and opened his "Heavenly Eye."

Just who were these sacred beings?

The mist gradually dissipated, and the reflective parts became clear. Standing between the two rat demons were... an old man and a young man.

The Taoist was dumbfounded.

Song Zhengguo was still turning his head to speak to his grandson:

"Look at how imposing the bird is? It’s just a pity you can't go over. Logically speaking, it would be appropriate for you to be by its side to take photos."

Song Yu: "..."

"But their Chief Negotiator didn't bring a partner either. Forget it, it's better if you don't show your face."

Song Zhengguo was clearly immersed in his own world, but later he felt something was wrong, so he secretly said to his grandson:

"They can't see us, right? Why is my back feeling chilly? It should be..."

The moment he turned his head.

The Taoist stared back at them with an expressionless face.

Song Zhengguo: "...They can't see us, right?"

-

The contract exchange ceremony ended.

Bai Linlin "shook hands" with the people from Bureau 749 in front of the stage; this was a necessary step to convey friendliness. When it was the Taoist's turn, the other party looked over.

"Senior."

The Taoist actually had a lot to say in his heart, but in the end, he very respectfully extended his finger to pinch that tail feather.

"Hello, hello."

It finally ended completely around four o'clock in the afternoon. 001 had already taken a nap next to the rat demons; it had eaten a bunch of carbohydrates at noon, so it was just right to digest them in the afternoon.

When the little sparrow woke up, the hall was already preparing to disperse. It trotted along, ready to go ask 247 when dinner would be served.

However, the other party seemed busy, talking to that Taoist.

"Ah... this, we were discovered?"

"Then let's step aside to talk."

Bai Linlin looked at its grandfather on the side; in fact, its heart was also pounding with anxiety. After all, this was an old friend of its grandfather.

The little sparrow had already walked up to them.

001 tilted its bird head, looking at the person.

The Taoist couldn't help but look over as well. One second, two seconds. He wanted to speak:

"Yi..."

The little sparrow turned around and left.

"..."

Bai Linlin walked over to the rat demons and waved its wings. The stoat next to it immediately followed. They went to a smaller room; the main hall still had space left.

The Taoist followed them as well.

However, at this moment, the people from Bureau 749 were all looking over here, whispering to each other.

-

Inside the room.

Song Yu leaned over and half-squatted, bringing his little bird back to his shoulder, saying very gently:

"It was really excellent."

Bai Linlin tucked in its wings and proudly rubbed against the man's chin.

The little sparrow was holding a pack of sea salt crackers, eating them seriously. It had just woken up and was at its hungriest.

At this moment, the truly anxious spot.

The Taoist stood with his hands behind his back, looking at the old man in front of him.

"..."

Song Zhengguo turned around, not intending to make eye contact, but he had no choice; the other party had walked over again.

"This... this big event for the bird, we as family members, of course, had to come and see."

The Taoist frowned:

"That... that's very dangerous!"

"What if the people from Bureau 749 saw you, they—"

Song Zhengguo frowned: "Aren't the people from Bureau 749 humans? What's there to be afraid of?"

The Taoist was stunned. It was indeed true. The Demon Realm was a relative of the Song family, very safe. As for Bureau 749... weren't they humans?

Why did he have a conditioned reflex to—

He sighed.

Song Zhengguo was actually a bit guilty, but later he apologized:

"There's no help for it. I really couldn't tell you. The bird's identity is special, and plus, you scared it the first time you saw it. As an elder, I naturally lean toward it."

"Please bear with me."

The Taoist shook his head upon hearing this.

In fact, by this time, he also understood why people who formed partnerships with demons wouldn't stand on the side of human interests. There was no alienation at all; it was just... treating them as equals.

In his old friend's eyes, the little demon.

Was probably just a child.

Oh well.

"Then you have to be careful too. How old are you, coming to a place like this!"

Song Zhengguo waved his hand and smiled, like an old urchin.

-

A few days later.

The living room of the house in Beijing was filled with luggage, several of which belonged to the bird: bird clothes, bird food, and bird gifts.

Song Yu packed the items all the way, needing the little bird on his shoulder to approve each item—if it agreed, they would take it back; if not, it would stay here.

"Xiao Yu, what time are we leaving?"

"Should we feed the bird first?"

Song Zhengguo’s mental state was indeed much better, even better than when he was fishing. He held a spoon filled with yogurt, with a little sparrow standing in front of him, eyes closed and beak open.

Round and plump.

"No need, there's enough time. We can just grab a meal in the transit city."

"We can also go see the sea."

Song Zhengguo nodded upon hearing this, then remembered something, took out his phone, and sent a message to Chen Kaihe, who had returned to Nanshi yesterday:

[Arriving tomorrow.]

The little sparrow on the table was still opening its beak.

Song Zhengguo immediately fed it with the spoon.

Afterward, there was packing going on upstairs and downstairs. 001 also had an exclusive suitcase, which didn't contain anything else—it was all clothes given to it by 247, clothes for its true form, and some clothes for its human form.

Song Zhengguo helped out later, and the two of them went in and out of the rooms, with two little birds following each person, trotting along behind them.

"Linlin."

"Chirp chirp!"

"What if I accidentally step on you?"

"Chirp chirp!"

The bird ignored him, and finally secretly transformed into its large size in the bedroom, blocking the person's path.

Song Yu: "..."

Bai Linlin narrowed its bird eyes and walked over, swaying from side to side. Just as it was about to extend its wing root, the door made a sound.

"Xiao Yu, I think we shouldn't bring too many clothes. Won't we be coming back to Beijing after the New Year?"

Song Zhengguo pushed the door open and walked in. Looking up, he saw the giant bird standing to the side, looking very reserved.

One second, two seconds.

The voice of his good-for-nothing son suddenly began to echo in his mind:

"Dad! Dad! Believe me, that giant bird really exists! It slapped me hard with its wing!"

"I can't sleep, I really..."

Song Zhengguo stood up straight to show his respect.

But the little sparrow on his shoulder saw what was inside, flapped its wings, and flew over. It naturally lowered its bird head, began to gather strength, and its body grew bit by bit, finally becoming a giant bird nearly two meters tall, just like the other one.

It turned its head to look over.

Its expression was solemn.

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国张了张口，一时半会也不知道怎么办，他看到了两个鸟的目光，最后硬生生说出来一句：

“好、好啊。”
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo opened his mouth, not knowing what to do for a moment. He saw the gazes of the two birds, and finally, he managed to force out a single sentence:

"Good, good."

chunks.chineseText:
第84章

卧室门口这里空间不大，旁边有个现代风格的屏风，主要是为了进门不直接看到床，但眼下却显得有些狭窄了。

人站在中间，面色冷淡，左边是宽大的巨鸟，右边是刚刚变大的小雀。

略挤。

宋郁面无表情的，往左边看，毛绒绒的胸膛，浅色的羽毛，干净蓬松。

往右边看，同样是个鼓鼓的胸膛，羽毛是灰棕色的，照旧是看不到边。

两个硕大的鸟头。

“……”

宋峥国站在对面，其实说完那一句话，就没有词了，只是空空地伸着手，最后想了想。

开始鼓掌了。

拍了两下。

空气里更沉默了。

鸟有些着急，左右摇摆地往前走，其实是想要解释的，但是旁边的小雀以为要出去，它也往前走。

撞车了。

宋郁直接被挤到后面去了，但门很小，一个鸟都出不去，更何况现在是两个巨鸟。

“001，你你你……不要挤我。”

“不是要一起走吗？”

宋峥国愣愣的，看着宽敞的门框，里面有两个巨大的鸟，在伸着鸟头交流。

白粼粼气鼓鼓的，心想真是油盐不进，现在太大了，被爷爷看到了万一不喜欢呢？

一定要解释。

001怎么还跟风？

鸟闭了闭鸟眼，而后看向门口的老人，试图编个谎话：

“爷爷，其实这个是——”

“鸟儿长高了。”

宋峥国不由得说了这句话，面色恍惚，有种今夕是何年的感觉。

白粼粼一愣，那这话的意思是……爷爷不害怕啊？

-

三分钟后。

宋郁在卧室里继续收拾衣服，很是四平八稳的，余光处有两只巨大的鸟并排站着，至于对面，则是坐在椅子上的老人。

“爷爷，你不觉得变大了很威严吗？”

鸟还展示了巨大的翅膀，可以从床边到窗台，结实有力。

小雀同样开始展示。

宋峥国如梦似幻的，双手放在膝盖上，仰着头，很是认真地道：

“长得好。”

“对了，饿不饿啊？”

宋峥国本能地觉得变大了，那食量肯定是不够了，他这会儿又觉得要喂饭了，毕竟这两只小鸟似乎都不到五岁，还能再长长。

白粼粼摇了摇头。

小雀点了点头。

宋峥国立马就要起身去客厅那边拿吃的，微微拧着眉，边走还边说：

“我就说，刚才早上其实就没有吃好是不是？等着啊。”

宋郁把行李箱合上了，倚靠在主卧的桌子边，看着地毯上站着的两只大鸟。

“001，都怪你！怎么又饿了！”

白粼粼好似很是公正，侧了侧身子，义正词严地道。

“那247不吃？”

小雀好奇地问。

如果对方不吃，它可以吃两份。

白粼粼：“……”

宋郁抬手按了按眉心，到底还是什么都没说。

最后老人去而复归，拿着两大碗水果捞，附带两个慕斯蛋糕，还有一盘子坚果碎，从零食柜里又拿了鱿鱼丝，还有几个谷物蛋白棒。

宋峥国过来的时候，还特地看向宋郁，找补了一下：

“这都低热量的，很健康。”

“它们吃一点点，不碍事的。”

宋郁：“……”

-

总之是又加了一顿。

宋郁把卧室的行李箱都带到客厅去了，顺带还打了个电话，确定了下车子的时间。

原定是今天十一点出发的，但是现在……

宋郁垂眸看了下腕表，已经十点多了，他又走回了卧室里，看到了他爷爷在兢兢业业地用勺子喂两个“大鸟”吃饭。

他闭了闭眼。

最后又等了几分钟，再度去看。

两个大鸟已经吃好了，开始并排站着，正面，侧面，背面……

白粼粼很是高兴，收了收翅膀，其实他觉得他变大也很好看，起码看着就很伟岸。

鸟挺胸抬头的，正在准备再转一圈的时候，看到了门口的人。

“宋-郁！”

白粼粼伸了伸翅根，立马就左右摇摆地过去了，要贴贴。

“我们待会要出发了。”

宋郁很自然地伸出来了手臂，即使面前的“小鸟”很大，也没有任何区别对待，硕大的鸟头靠了过来。

沉甸甸的。

砰！

一个圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟稳当当地站在人的肩头，用鸟头顶了顶人的下巴，脆生生地问：

“你给我收拾好了吗？”

宋郁闻言只是道：“好了，所有都带着的，”

鸟满意。

001此刻还在认认真真地等着吃饭，张了张喙，翅根是微微伸着的，但是刚炫完一口坚果完，转过来鸟头一看。

！

怎么不和雀说一声。

砰！

宋峥国低头一看，圆滚滚的小雀站在桌子上，看着小小的，正在看向不远处的人。

“这……”

他难免惊讶，因为他并不了解如何养妖，这好几个形态，是否有个确定的体型？

宋峥国也就养过宋郁。

一时半会，没有参考对象。

“孩子，吃饱了吗？”

小雀闻言点了点头，现在是饱了的。

-

启程回南市。

宋郁把一些很重的行李专门放到了另外一辆车上，会有人开回去，至于他们自己这边，则是轻装出发。

他还是开车，不过副驾是坐着“少年”，在咬着棒棒糖，翻看着一些妖界的文书。

后座则是一老一雀，正专心致志看小桌板上的ipad。

上面播放着一个栏目：

[中国人的语言艺术：含蓄与委婉。]

宋峥国在旁边陪着看，小雀始终是心不在焉的，偶尔会抬一下鸟头，示意他换掉。

但是音量是放开的。

前排还传来声音：

“爷爷，你让001多看看这个，它老是乱说话。”

“好好好。”

宋峥国连忙道。

但是小桌板上的小雀低了低鸟头，看着视频里的老头子的说书，很是郁闷。

里面的声音老气横秋的：

“说起来中国人的礼义廉耻啊，这最重要的就是避讳……比如说啊，那些下三路的事，我们都会委婉地表达，出恭实则是当时科举官场上……”

001一点都不喜欢听，啪嗒啪嗒地在小桌板上走来走去的。

宋峥国也就这么为难地看了过去，鸟儿是家里的一把手，他也确实没办法。

但就在这时，小雀伸出来了爪子，在ipad上滑了滑，那个类似于讲坛性质的视频变成了小窗，声音还在外放着。

但是001已经很认真地开始在搜索框里写字了，一笔一划的，最后点键盘上的[回车]，一部动画片直接出来了。

[小马宝莉]

小雀立马看向老人，鸟眼圆圆的。

宋峥国起初还不明白什么意思，直到小雀扑棱翅膀飞到了另外一个座椅那里，用爪子按住了一部黑色的手机。

意思不言而喻。

车子还在往前开着。

白粼粼在前面看着沿途的风景，很是不亦乐乎的，后座还传来讲坛的声音，很是有文化的样子。

但实际上……

小雀已经趴在小桌板上，用翅膀撑着鸟头，看着手机屏幕里花花绿绿的色彩，甚至不需要开声音。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 84

The space at the bedroom doorway was not large, and a modern-style folding screen stood to the side, primarily to prevent one from seeing the bed directly upon entering. Right now, however, it felt rather cramped.

Standing in the middle, Song Yu looked indifferent. To his left was a massive, giant bird; to his right, a newly enlarged small sparrow.

It was a bit crowded.

Song Yu remained expressionless as he looked to the left: a fluffy chest, light-colored feathers, clean and voluminous.

He looked to the right: another bulging chest, this one with gray-brown feathers, and as usual, he couldn't see the end of it.

Two enormous bird heads.

"..."

Song Zhengguo stood opposite them. In truth, after saying that one sentence, he had run out of words. He simply held his hands out emptily, thought for a moment, and then began to clap.

He clapped twice.

The air grew even more silent.

The birds were getting a bit anxious, swaying from side to side as they stepped forward. They actually wanted to explain, but the small sparrow next to them thought they were heading out, so it moved forward too.

A collision.

Song Yu was pushed to the back, but the door was small—not even one bird could fit through easily, let alone two giants.

"001, you, you, you... don't squeeze me."

"Weren't we going together?"

Song Zhengguo stood there, stunned, looking at the spacious door frame containing two giant birds, their heads stretched out as they communicated.

Bai Linlin was huffing with indignation, thinking, *This is truly stubborn. Now that we're so big, what if Grandpa doesn't like us?*

*I must explain.*

*Why is 001 following the trend?*

The bird closed its eyes, then looked at the old man in the doorway, attempting to weave a lie:

"Grandpa, actually this is—"

"The birds have grown taller."

Song Zhengguo couldn't help but say this, his expression dazed, feeling a sense of "what year is this today."

Bai Linlin froze. Did that mean... Grandpa wasn't afraid?

-

Three minutes later.

Song Yu continued to pack his clothes in the bedroom, very calm and composed, while in his peripheral vision, two giant birds stood side by side. Opposite them, the old man sat on a chair.

"Grandpa, don't you think we look majestic when we're this big?"

The bird even displayed its massive wings, which stretched from the bedside to the windowsill, sturdy and powerful.

The small sparrow began to show off as well.

Song Zhengguo felt as if he were in a dream. He rested his hands on his knees, tilted his head up, and said quite earnestly:

"You've grown well."

"By the way, are you hungry?"

Song Zhengguo instinctively felt that since they had grown larger, their appetite must have increased. He felt it was time to feed them; after all, these two little birds seemed to be under five years old and could still grow more.

Bai Linlin shook his head.

The small sparrow nodded.

Song Zhengguo immediately stood up to go to the living room to get food, his brows slightly furrowed as he walked, muttering:

"I knew it, you didn't eat well this morning, did you? Wait right there."

Song Yu closed his suitcase and leaned against the table in the master bedroom, watching the two large birds standing on the carpet.

"001, it's all your fault! Why are you hungry again!"

Bai Linlin acted as if he were being very fair, turning his body to the side and speaking righteously.

"Then 247 isn't eating?"

The small sparrow asked curiously.

If the other party wasn't eating, it could eat two portions.

Bai Linlin: "..."

Song Yu raised a hand to rub his brow, but in the end, he said nothing.

Finally, the old man returned, carrying two large bowls of fruit salad, two mousse cakes, a plate of crushed nuts, and from the snack cabinet, he brought out shredded squid and several protein bars.

When Song Zhengguo came over, he specifically looked at Song Yu to make up for it:

"These are all low-calorie, very healthy."

"It doesn't matter if they eat a little bit."

Song Yu: "..."

-

In short, they had added another meal.

Song Yu moved the luggage from the bedroom to the living room and made a phone call to confirm the departure time for the car.

It was originally scheduled for eleven o'clock, but now...

Song Yu lowered his eyes to look at his watch; it was already past ten. He walked back into the bedroom and saw his grandfather diligently feeding the two "giant birds" with a spoon.

He closed his eyes.

After waiting a few more minutes, he looked again.

The two giant birds had finished eating and were standing side by side, front, side, back...

Bai Linlin was very happy, tucking in his wings. He actually thought he looked quite good when he was big; at least he looked imposing.

The bird puffed out its chest and held its head high, preparing to turn around again, when it saw the person at the door.

"Song Yu!"

Bai Linlin stretched his wing roots and immediately swayed over, wanting to snuggle.

"We're leaving soon."

Song Yu naturally extended his arm. Even though the "little bird" in front of him was huge, he treated it no differently. The massive bird head leaned over.

It was heavy.

*Thump!*

A round, blue-feathered little bird stood steadily on his shoulder, nudging his chin with its head and asking crisply:

"Did you pack everything for me?"

Song Yu replied, "Yes, everything is packed."

The bird was satisfied.

001 was still earnestly waiting to eat, its beak open, wing roots slightly extended. But just as it finished a mouthful of nuts, it turned its head to look.

!

Why didn't you tell the sparrow?

*Thump!*

Song Zhengguo looked down to see the round little sparrow standing on the table, looking tiny, staring at the person not far away.

"This..."

He was inevitably surprised, as he didn't know how to raise spirits. With these various forms, was there a fixed size?

Song Zhengguo had only ever raised Song Yu.

For a moment, he had no reference point.

"Child, are you full?"

The sparrow nodded; it was full now.

-

Setting off for Nanshi.

Song Yu had the heavy luggage placed in a separate car, which someone else would drive back. As for their own vehicle, they traveled light.

He was still driving, but in the passenger seat sat the "youth," chewing on a lollipop and flipping through documents from the Spirit Realm.

In the back seat were the old man and the sparrow, intently watching an iPad on the small tray table.

It was playing a program:

[The Art of Chinese Language: Subtlety and Euphemism.]

Song Zhengguo sat beside them, watching along. The sparrow remained distracted, occasionally tilting its head to signal him to change it.

But the volume was left on.

A voice came from the front seat:

"Grandpa, let 001 watch more of this. It always speaks without thinking."

"Yes, yes, yes."

Song Zhengguo quickly agreed.

But the sparrow on the tray table lowered its head, looking at the old man telling stories in the video, feeling very depressed.

The voice inside sounded pedantic:

"Speaking of Chinese etiquette and shame, the most important thing is taboo... for example, those vulgar matters, we always express them euphemistically. 'Going to the latrine' was actually used in the imperial examinations..."

001 didn't like listening to it at all, pacing back and forth on the tray table.

Song Zhengguo looked over, troubled. The bird was the head of the household, and he really couldn't do anything about it.

But just then, the sparrow extended a claw and swiped on the iPad. The lecture-style video turned into a small window, the sound still playing.

However, 001 had already begun to type in the search box very seriously, stroke by stroke, finally clicking [Enter] on the keyboard. An animated series appeared immediately.

[My Little Pony]

The sparrow immediately looked at the old man, its bird eyes round.

Song Zhengguo didn't understand what it meant at first, until the sparrow flapped its wings and flew to another seat, pressing its claw onto a black mobile phone.

The meaning was self-evident.

The car continued to move forward.

Bai Linlin was in the front, looking at the scenery along the way, having a great time. The sound of the lecture still came from the back seat, sounding very cultured.

But in reality...

The sparrow was already lying on the tray table, supporting its head with its wing, watching the colorful screen of the phone, not even needing to turn the sound on.

chunks.chineseText:
宋峥国莫名有些心虚。

因为ipad的前面就横放着手机，从前座那里是完全看不到的。

等到开到服务区的时候，车子停了下来，白粼粼很高兴地回头道：

“001，我们去超市！”

“你这么认真地看啊？学会了没有？”

小雀此刻已经从趴着的姿势切换成站着的了，圆滚滚的，收了收翅膀，小马宝莉已经看了好几集了。

它犹豫了下，这会儿才看向那个“讲坛”的画面，里面的老头儿都换了一个了。

小雀面不改色地点头：

“会了。”

宋峥国老脸一红。

后面一家人就齐齐整整地下车去了，在服务区的超市里逛来逛去的，主要是两个“少年”在前面，在拿一些货架上的东西。

“巧克力。”

“这个是咖啡了，不好不好。”

白粼粼很是认真地教育旁边的“黑衣少年”，他们推着小车子，很是放松，基本上看中了什么就拿回来。

后面则是两个人在边走边谈话。

“其实也还好，毕竟团队建立起来，就不会很忙。”

宋郁身着黑色的大衣，面部轮廓很是出众，虽然是在回复情况，但余光始终看着不远处的“少年”，像是在看商品的保质期。

“对，一定要分清主次，让你接手家里的事业，其实是不想要心血付之东流，但如果事业反过来绊住了你的人生，则是本末倒置了。”

宋峥国一边往前走，一边又举例子：

“那国外的一些企业家，他们很会养生，你注意到没有，往往是打打高尔夫，参加一下酒会，然后支持一下他们国内一方的选举，大体都是一样的。”

“我们不一定要学他们，毕竟国内还在上升期，日后培养起来自己的核心骨干，公司里的事自然就运转起来了。”

宋郁微微垂眸，点头应是。

前面的“少年”还在推着车子逛，走到了速食区，一个拿着泡面，一个摇头道：

“这个味道不好吃的，酸菜，你不知道，制作过程很黑暗的。”

“放下放下。”

“少年”又拉着旁边的“黑衣少年”去其他的货架。

宋郁始终是跟着的，旁边还传来声音：

“等到公司稳定了，爷爷更希望你去旅旅，散散心，世界还有很多精彩的地方。”

宋峥国只是眉眼温和，似是回忆：

“爷爷当年再忙也是会带着你奶奶去观光的，现在回想起来，确实是不可多得的回忆了……”

“记得拍照！”

年少之时总之看风景，老了才察觉照片的珍贵，记忆是模糊的，但照片确实明晰的。

宋郁闻言不知道想起来什么，低头道：

“粼粼很爱拍照。”

一家子很是其乐融融的，但就在走到拐角的时候，宋峥国的电话响了，于是就停下了脚步。

“喂？”

老人往前挥了挥手，看向自己孙子，示意先跟上，两个小鸟别走丢了。

宋郁只好先过去了，低声说了句：

“我待会带它们去那个包子铺，您待会过来就可以。”

宋峥国点了点头，打了个手势。

青年这才离开了。

货架这边只剩下宋峥国一个，电话那头不是别人，正是道士，对方开门见山地道：

“峥国，我从749局辞职了。”

宋峥国闻言皱了皱眉，其实他觉得749局同妖界交涉的时候故友都在，那说明平云的地位并不低，这怎么……

他不由得问了句：

“因为什么？”

道士在那头悠悠地讲：

“通妖门。”

-

两个“少年”此刻走到了一个货架区，都双双愣住了，陷入了一定的迷茫。

因为上面挂着泡椒凤爪、盐焗鸡脚筋、风干鸡脖……

全品类了。

“……”

“……”

其实如果不开智的话，001的食物链上甚至有很多其他鸟，但是现在是妖怪了，这些属于广泛的同族。

“黑衣少年”蹲下了身子，抱着膝盖，看着那个凤爪，其实在思考自己的爪子是不是也长这个样子。

沉思ing。

白粼粼也差不多，他这辈子就是个小鸟，虽然自己不是小鸡，但是看着……好像长得也差不多。

“少年”也跟着蹲下了，眼巴巴地看着货架的凤爪。

宋郁过来的时候，看到的就是这么地狱的画面，拧了拧眉，过来道：

“去结账好不好？”

“我们先去吃饭。”

地面上的两个“少年”仰头看了过来，立马调理好了，很是从善如流地站了起来，跟着过去了。

上一顿还是在一个小时前。

-

包子铺。

“是的，丹顶鹤说了，我们成了妖怪之后，就要讲文明，摒弃原有野性的食物链。”

“唔……但是要尊重现在自然界动物存在的食物链，人好像在顶端的。”

黑衣少年用筷子叉着个包子，往自己嘴巴里塞，脸颊鼓鼓的。

宋郁闻言微微抬了下眉，尽可能降低自己的存在感。

“人什么都吃。”

白粼粼心想这话倒是没错，他揉了揉眼睛，拿着一个麻辣豆腐包子，咬了一口，热热的，他环顾了下四周，很认真地问：

“爷爷呢？”

宋郁很温和地道：“有电话，一会儿就过来。”

“少年”这才安心了下来。

001吃完了两笼包子，搭配着红油和醋碟，用筷子一叉一个准。

宋峥国后面就进来了，看着两个“少年”吃着包子，很是喜上眉梢的。

多吃点好。

长个子。

-

等到再次开车的时候，宋郁才得知了那通电话的事。

“对，749局那边想让你平云叔联系我们，他给拒绝了，同时也提了辞呈。”

宋峥国心里也是感怀，平云也是不想麻烦他们。

不过确实……鸟儿可是妖席，家里受到关注也是正常的。

毕竟权力越大，责任越大。

“是么？那前辈找到合适的工作了么？不如来南市。”

宋郁很适时地开口，抬眼看了下车内后视镜，两个小鸟在ipad上站着，用爪子在玩切水果游戏。

“没有找到，他本来就是个无父无母的，之前任职在749局里，也没有成婚，自然膝下也无孩子。”

宋峥国说完也叹了口气。

“那爷爷我来安排工作，住的地方也一并解决，这样如何？”

宋峥国闻言点了点头，自言自语道：

“这些我都考虑到了，不过我在想，你陈爷爷也是个孤家寡人，不如我介绍他们认识一下？”

宋郁不解：

“他们不认识吗？”

宋峥国只是摆手，笑着道：

“爷爷的朋友太多了，天南海北的，有的确实不太熟悉，不过正好平云是749局的人，那留在南市，想来也能传授给鸟儿一些防身术。”

宋郁愣了下，以为自己听错了。

但事实证明不是：

“平云不是说了么？会有一些邪道，万一鸟儿它们碰到怎么办？肯定没有什么经验的。”

宋峥国很是考虑周到，过了会才又缓缓地道：
chunks.englishText:
Song Zhengguo felt inexplicably guilty.

Because the mobile phone was lying horizontally in front of the iPad, completely invisible from the front seat.

When they reached the service area and the car stopped, Bai Linlin turned back, very happy:

"001, let's go to the supermarket!"

"You were watching so intently? Did you learn anything?"

The sparrow had switched from a lying position to a standing one, round and plump, tucking in its wings. It had already watched several episodes of *My Little Pony*.

It hesitated, only then looking at the "lecture" screen, where the old man had already been replaced by another.

The sparrow nodded without changing its expression:

"I learned it."

Song Zhengguo's old face flushed red.

The family then got out of the car together and wandered around the supermarket in the service area. Mostly, it was the two "youths" in front, picking up items from the shelves.

"Chocolate."

"This is coffee, no good, no good."

Bai Linlin was very serious about educating the "youth in black" beside him. They pushed the small cart, very relaxed, basically taking whatever caught their eye.

Behind them, the other two were walking and talking.

"Actually, it's fine. Once the team is established, it won't be very busy."

Song Yu wore a black overcoat, his facial contours outstanding. Although he was responding to the situation, his peripheral vision was always on the "youth" not far away, as if checking the expiration dates on the products.

"Right, you must distinguish between the primary and the secondary. Letting you take over the family business is really because I don't want the hard work to go to waste, but if the business ends up hindering your life, that would be putting the cart before the horse."

Song Zhengguo walked forward while giving examples:

"Those foreign entrepreneurs, they are very good at maintaining their health. Have you noticed? They often play golf, attend cocktail parties, and support the elections in their own countries. It's generally the same."

"We don't necessarily have to learn from them. After all, our country is still in a rising period. Once you cultivate your own core backbone, the company's affairs will naturally run on their own."

Song Yu lowered his eyes slightly and nodded in agreement.

The "youth" in front was still pushing the cart, walking to the instant food section. One picked up instant noodles, while the other shook his head:

"This flavor isn't good, pickled cabbage. You don't know, the production process is very dark."

"Put it down, put it down."

The "youth" pulled the "youth in black" to other shelves.

Song Yu followed them the whole time. A voice came from the side:

"Once the company is stable, Grandpa hopes you will go traveling and relax. There are still many wonderful places in the world."

Song Zhengguo's eyes were gentle, as if reminiscing:

"When I was busy back then, I would still take your grandmother sightseeing. Looking back now, those were truly rare memories..."

"Remember to take photos!"

When young, one only looks at the scenery; only when old does one realize the preciousness of photos. Memories are blurry, but photos are clear.

Song Yu, hearing this, didn't know what he thought of, and lowered his head:

"Linlin loves taking photos."

The family was very harmonious, but just as they reached a corner, Song Zhengguo's phone rang, so he stopped.

"Hello?"

The old man waved forward, looking at his grandson, signaling him to keep up and not let the two little birds get lost.

Song Yu had no choice but to go ahead, saying in a low voice:

"I'll take them to that steamed bun shop later; you can come over when you're done."

Song Zhengguo nodded and made a gesture.

The young man then left.

Only Song Zhengguo remained by the shelves. The person on the other end of the phone was none other than the Taoist, who got straight to the point:

"Zhengguo, I've resigned from Bureau 749."

Song Zhengguo frowned upon hearing this. In fact, he felt that since his old friends were all there when Bureau 749 dealt with the Spirit Realm, it meant Ping Yun's status was not low. How could this...

He couldn't help but ask:

"Why?"

The Taoist on the other end spoke leisurely:

"The Spirit-Passage Gate."

-

The two "youths" had reached a shelf area and both stood there, stunned, falling into a certain confusion.

Because hanging above were pickled pepper chicken feet, salt-baked chicken feet tendons, air-dried chicken necks...

The whole category.

"..."

"..."

Actually, if they hadn't gained intelligence, many other birds would be on 001's food chain, but now that they were spirits, these belonged to their broad kin.

The "youth in black" squatted down, hugging his knees, looking at the chicken feet, actually wondering if his own claws looked like that.

Deep in thought.

Bai Linlin was much the same. He had been a little bird his whole life; although he wasn't a chicken, looking at them... they seemed quite similar.

The "youth" also squatted down, looking longingly at the chicken feet on the shelf.

When Song Yu arrived, this was the hellish scene he saw. He furrowed his brows and came over:

"Shall we go pay? Let's go eat first."

The two "youths" on the ground looked up, immediately adjusted, and stood up quite readily, following him.

Their last meal had been an hour ago.

-

At the steamed bun shop.

"Yes, the Red-Crowned Crane said that after we become spirits, we must be civilized and abandon the original wild food chain."

"Hmm... but we must respect the food chain that exists in the natural world today. Humans seem to be at the top."

The youth in black used chopsticks to poke a bun and stuffed it into his mouth, his cheeks bulging.

Song Yu raised an eyebrow slightly, trying to minimize his presence.

"Humans eat everything."

Bai Linlin thought this was true. He rubbed his eyes, picked up a spicy tofu bun, and took a bite. It was hot. He looked around and asked very seriously:

"Where is Grandpa?"

Song Yu said gently: "He's on a call, he'll be here in a moment."

The "youth" was then reassured.

001 finished two baskets of buns, paired with red chili oil and a vinegar dish, picking one up with every poke of its chopsticks.

Song Zhengguo entered later, looking at the two "youths" eating buns, his heart filled with joy.

Eat more.

Grow taller.

-
