When they were driving again, Song Yu learned about the phone call.

"Yes, Bureau 749 wanted you to have Uncle Ping Yun contact us, but he refused and submitted his resignation at the same time."

Song Zhengguo felt sentimental; Ping Yun didn't want to trouble them.

But indeed... the birds were spirit-class, and it was normal for the family to receive attention.

After all, with great power comes great responsibility.

"Is that so? Has the senior found a suitable job? Why not come to Nanshi?"

Song Yu spoke at the right time, glancing at the rearview mirror. The two little birds were standing on the iPad, using their claws to play a fruit-cutting game.

"He hasn't found one. He was an orphan to begin with, and before he worked at Bureau 749, he wasn't married, so naturally, he has no children."

Song Zhengguo sighed after saying this.

"Then, Grandpa, I will arrange a job and solve the housing issue as well. How about that?"

Song Zhengguo nodded upon hearing this, muttering to himself:

"I've considered all of that, but I was thinking, your Grandpa Chen is also a lone man. Why don't I introduce them to each other?"

Song Yu was puzzled:

"Don't they know each other?"

Song Zhengguo just waved his hand and said with a smile:

"Grandpa has too many friends, all over the world. Some I'm not very familiar with, but since Ping Yun is from Bureau 749, if he stays in Nanshi, I imagine he could teach the birds some self-defense techniques."

Song Yu froze, thinking he had misheard.

But the facts proved otherwise:

"Didn't Ping Yun say so? There will be some evil paths. What if the birds encounter them? They certainly have no experience."

Song Zhengguo was very thoughtful, and after a while, he added slowly:

chunks.chineseText:
“至于你陈爷爷，他总是找我钓鱼喝茶的，闲情雅致的，但是我实在很忙的，要接送鸟儿的，一来二去的，陪他的时间就不够了……”

看似苦恼，实则炫耀。

-

大约又在一个城市观光了一天，最后在第三天的下午抵达了锦园。

“哎呦，小鸟回来了。”

阿姨精气神都好了很多，虽然锦园这段时间没有住人，但是里里外外被打扫得很是干净，栅栏门这边还贴着小福字。

门口也有灯笼。

喜气洋洋的。

人用心打理，房子就会焕发生机。

“啾啾！”

白粼粼一下子扑棱翅膀飞了过去，阿姨的肩头一沉，她有些小小的吃惊。

过了一会，一只小雀也飞了过来，稳稳地降落了，这只还好，虽然也沉了点。

“辛苦您了，弟弟最近还好吗？”

宋郁走了过来，很温和地询问。

“很好很好！老先生没去京市的时候还让我把他带过来过，亲自指点了下作业呢！”

“身体也变好很多了，个子还长高了不少！”

阿姨面色红润，看着也是很有气色的样子，立马笑着回复。

宋峥国正好走了过来，闻言用手比了比：

“小郁你是没见到，那孩子到这儿了。”

“将来肯定是个大个子。”

玄关这里很是热热闹闹的。

不过在一个小时后，客厅这里变得稍微严肃了一点。

鸟站在茶几上，收紧了腹部，羽毛都力图不那么蓬。

“尺码再量一下吧，是有点紧是么？”

阿姨拿着软尺，绕过鸟的身躯，拧了拧眉。

还是不在身边，要是在身边，她肯定给小鸟做出来最合身的衣服。

宋郁在沙发上坐着，面不改色地道：

“可能是冬天了，它羽毛开始蓬起来了。”

“也有可能。”

阿姨拿着软尺很是认真地记录数据，鸟躯量过，二十多厘米，犹如个保温杯。

下面是高度。

“来，小鸟，伸下爪子。”

白粼粼很是紧张，伸出去了鸟腿，软尺开始往上提，要测量高度。

西服是需要合身的。

接下来是翅根这里，鸟很配合地往外伸一边翅膀，阿姨很轻地侧量了下，眉眼柔和。

最终结果是：

“没事没事，差不多和之前一样。”

“就是一厘米的误差。”

鸟松了口气。

后面就是轮到小雀了，这个量起来也很顺利，阿姨更是直接道：

“完全没区别，这个小雀骨架小，变化不大。”

白粼粼听到这话一愣，什么意思？

难道……鸟是大骨架？

“新年再给它们置办一套吧？新年穿新衣！”

小雀微微仰着鸟头，翅根微微伸着，保持着不动的姿势，相当配合了。

后面基本测量完毕。

距离除夕还有几天的时候，宋郁还是打算带着鸟去体检一下，不过这次黎笙正好有空，于是就直接驱车过来了。

白粼粼本来是在茶几上散步的，但是听到门口有什么动静之后，眯了眯鸟眼的，看向了玄关那里。

“好久没见了。”

“你是不是快毕业了？我怎么这么老了，啊啊。”

黎笙还是和当初一样的装扮，但其实已经工作几年了，有种无力的感觉，时间都去哪里了。

“小鸡呢？”

鸟一下子炸毛了。

“啾啾啾啾啾啾！”

犹如玩家重回新手村。

黎笙一眼就看到那只蓝色甜筒了，提着自己的医疗箱就过去了，弯腰看了过去。

鸟战略地往后挪了几步。

“……”

干什么？

宋郁只是觉得好像回到了过去，他的小鸟那个时候还会撬开冰箱的门，偷偷吃卤牛肉。

“粼粼，我们不是说过了，要简单体检一下。”

妖怪虽然是不会有问题的，但是本体这方面……似乎它们都不是很在意。

宋郁还记得皮皮，它还会去异宠医院看骨折的，那说明还是有些必要的。

黎笙已经戴上了手套，拿出来了一些装备，主要有体重称、棉签、消毒工具。

鸟掉头就走。

但是被半道握住了，爪子无力地蹬了两下，为什么不给001体检！

它要——

“你也来了？”

小雀刚从楼上的窗户那里进来，没找到247，于是下来了，正好走了过来。

白粼粼立马好了，鸟眼圆圆的，开始沟通：

[体检了，快来快来。]

小雀不懂：

[妖怪也要体检？]

小雀啪嗒啪嗒地走了过来。

黎笙看到后还是很惊奇的：“伯劳鸟？这个你家也养啊？”

“不是，粼粼的朋友。”

人愣住了，试图理解，用手指了指，一边是圆滚滚的蓝羽小鸟，此刻已经站在了称上，另一边是只毛绒绒的小雀，站在旁边探头探脑的。

“它，是它的朋友？”

黎笙面带微笑。

这个世界果然是很奇怪。

体检最后的结果还算可以，都是很健康的，不过就是体重这里。

白粼粼虽然说着不在意，但还是仰着鸟头，侧耳倾听。

“138克了，确实重了点，少给它吃点，不然飞不起来怎么办？”

“圆圆的。”

鸟震惊。

怎么说话的！

黎笙甚至还没有来得及笑，一个飞天老虎钳就过来了，鸡飞蛋打的。

-

除夕很快就到了。

“不是的，我们本来就是鸟妖，体型永远是比较轻盈的，羽毛蓬松而已，本体几克的变化，根本不重要的。”

小雀收了收翅膀，又补充道：

“一般幼鸟可能出现这个情况，因为它们的身体还没有意识到变成妖怪，到了冬日里就会自动地变重一些，这样可以御寒。”

宋郁闻言松了口气，连忙道：

“那我同粼粼说一下。”

鸟已经连续一周在健身房了，劝也劝不回来。

“247觉得自己重了？不会的，它年纪还小。”

小雀言之凿凿。

它们鸟妖根本不需要担心这个问题，本体要飞的，不可能会重，连带着化形也是偏向于轻盈的“少年”。

四肢比较纤长，柔韧度高。

001觉得很好，可以吃很多饭。

宋郁很快就去隔壁的健身房了，跑步机还在开着，一只圆滚滚的鸟在啪嗒啪嗒地往前走着，很是倔强。

爪子都要磨出来火星了。

白粼粼很是不明白。

凭什么？

他今年不过就是吃了……

脑海里闪过一个长条，犹如胶卷，每个格子都是一道美食，一时半会居然看不完。

“……”

鸟听到了门口的动静，头也不抬地道：

“我不回去。”

宋郁走了过来，好声好气地对着在跑步带上竞走的小鸟解释了来龙去脉。

鸟眯了眯鸟眼：

“真的？我的体重是正常的？”

“是的，粼粼很健康的，只是几克而已，冬天就是会稍微重一些，你还小的。”

人俯身半蹲着，很是耐心地道。

他的小鸟，对于身材这方面，还是卡得很死的。

“这样子的话……”

鸟收了收翅膀，停下了走路的动作，跟随着跑步机一起往后滑动，最后稳稳地落到了地板上。
chunks.englishText:
"As for your Grandpa Chen, he’s always looking for me to go fishing or drink tea—very leisurely and refined—but I’m truly too busy. I have to pick up and drop off the birds, and with all that back-and-forth, I just don’t have enough time to keep him company..."

He sounded distressed, but in reality, he was showing off.

-

After sightseeing in another city for about a day, they finally arrived at Jin Garden on the afternoon of the third day.

"Oh my, the little birds are back."

The auntie looked much more energetic. Although no one had lived in Jin Garden for a while, it had been kept spotlessly clean inside and out, and there were even small 'Fu' (fortune) characters pasted on the gate.

There were lanterns at the entrance, too.

It was full of festive cheer.

When a house is cared for with heart, it radiates vitality.

"Chirp!"

Bai Linlin flapped its wings and flew over in a flash. The auntie’s shoulder sank under the weight, and she was slightly startled.

A moment later, a small sparrow also flew over and landed steadily. This one was fine, though it was also a bit heavy.

"Thank you for your hard work. How has the little brother been lately?"

Song Yu walked over and asked gently.

"Very well, very well! Before the old gentleman went to Beijing, he even had me bring him over to personally guide his homework!"

"His health has improved a lot, and he’s grown quite a bit taller, too!"

The auntie’s face was rosy, looking quite healthy, and she replied with a smile.

Song Zhengguo happened to walk over, and hearing this, he gestured with his hand:

"Little Yu, you didn't see it, but the child has reached this height."

"He’ll definitely be a big guy in the future."

The entryway was bustling with activity.

However, an hour later, the living room became a bit more serious.

The bird stood on the coffee table, pulling in its abdomen, trying its best to keep its feathers from looking too puffed up.

"Let’s measure the size again. It’s a bit tight, isn't it?"

The auntie held a soft measuring tape, wrapped it around the bird’s body, and frowned.

She still wasn't by its side; if she were, she would definitely have made the most perfectly fitting clothes for the little bird.

Song Yu sat on the sofa, his expression unchanged as he said:

"It might be winter; its feathers are starting to fluff up."

"That’s possible, too."

The auntie recorded the data very seriously with the measuring tape. The bird's body measured over twenty centimeters—much like a thermos.

Next was the height.

"Come, little bird, stretch out your claws."

Bai Linlin was very nervous. It extended its bird legs, and the measuring tape began to lift upward to measure its height.

A suit needs to be well-fitted.

Next were the wing roots. The bird cooperated by extending one wing outward, and the auntie measured it lightly, her eyes soft.

The final result:

"It’s fine, it’s fine. It’s about the same as before."

"Just a one-centimeter margin of error."

The bird let out a sigh of relief.

Then it was the sparrow's turn. Its measurement went smoothly as well, and the auntie remarked directly:

"No difference at all. This little sparrow has a smaller frame, so there isn't much change."

Bai Linlin was stunned upon hearing this. What did that mean?

Could it be... that the bird had a large frame?

"Shall we get them another set for the New Year? New clothes for the New Year!"

The little sparrow tilted its head slightly, wings extended just a bit, maintaining a still posture—it was quite cooperative.

After that, the measurements were basically finished.

A few days before New Year's Eve, Song Yu still planned to take the bird for a check-up. As it happened, Li Sheng was free, so he drove over directly.

Bai Linlin had been strolling on the coffee table, but upon hearing movement at the door, it narrowed its bird eyes and looked toward the entryway.

"Long time no see."

"Are you graduating soon? Why do I feel so old? Ah, ah."

Li Sheng was dressed the same as before, but having worked for a few years, he felt a sense of powerlessness. Where had all the time gone?

"Where’s the little chicken?"

The bird’s feathers instantly stood on end.

"Chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp!"

It felt like a player returning to the starter village.

Li Sheng spotted the 'blue ice cream cone' immediately. He picked up his medical kit and walked over, bending down to take a look.

The bird strategically backed away a few steps.

"..."

What are you doing?

Song Yu just felt as if he had returned to the past, back when his little bird would pry open the refrigerator door to steal braised beef.

"Linlin, didn't we say we were going to have a simple check-up?"

Monsters might not have health issues, but as for their original forms... they didn't seem to care much about them.

Song Yu still remembered Pipi, who had gone to an exotic pet hospital for a fracture, which meant it was still somewhat necessary.

Li Sheng had already put on gloves and taken out some equipment, mainly a scale, cotton swabs, and sterilization tools.

The bird turned and walked away.

But it was grabbed halfway. Its claws kicked feebly—why wasn't 001 getting a check-up!

It wanted—

"You’re here too?"

The little sparrow had just come in from the upstairs window. Not finding 247, it had come down and happened to walk over.

Bai Linlin immediately felt better. Its bird eyes were round as it began to communicate:

[It's a check-up, come quickly.]

The sparrow didn't understand:

[Monsters need check-ups too?]

The sparrow walked over, *pad-pad-pad*.

Li Sheng was amazed when he saw it: "A shrike? You keep this one at home too?"

"No, it's Linlin's friend."

The man was stunned, trying to process this. He pointed with his finger: on one side was the round, blue-feathered bird, already standing on the scale; on the other was the fluffy little sparrow, standing to the side and peeking around.

"It... is its friend?"

Li Sheng wore a smile.

This world was truly very strange.

The final results of the check-up were decent; both were very healthy, though there was the matter of weight.

Although Bai Linlin said it didn't care, it still tilted its head, listening intently.

"138 grams. It is indeed a bit heavy. Feed it less, or what if it can't fly?"

"So round."

The bird was shocked.

What kind of talk is that!

Before Li Sheng could even laugh, a flying pair of pliers came his way—everything was in chaos.

-

New Year's Eve arrived quickly.

"That's not it. We are bird monsters by nature; our bodies are always quite light. It’s just that our feathers are fluffy. A change of a few grams in our original form is completely unimportant."

The sparrow tucked in its wings and added:

"Young birds might experience this because their bodies haven't realized they've become monsters yet. In winter, they automatically become a bit heavier to keep warm."

Song Yu breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this and quickly said:

"I'll tell Linlin."

The bird had been in the gym for a week straight, and no amount of persuasion could bring it back.

"247 thinks it's heavy? That won't happen. It's still young."

The sparrow spoke with certainty.

Bird monsters didn't need to worry about this at all. Their original forms had to fly, so they couldn't possibly be heavy, and their human forms were also inclined toward being light, 'youthful' figures.

With slender limbs and high flexibility.

001 thought it was great; it could eat a lot of food.

Song Yu soon went to the gym next door. The treadmill was still running, and a round little bird was walking forward *pad-pad-pad*, very stubbornly.

Its claws were almost sparking from the friction.

Bai Linlin didn't understand.

Why?

All it had eaten this year was...

A long strip flashed through its mind, like a film reel, with each frame being a delicacy. It couldn't even finish looking at it all in a short time.

"..."

The bird heard the movement at the door and said without lifting its head:

"I'm not going back."

Song Yu walked over and patiently explained the ins and outs to the little bird power-walking on the treadmill belt.

The bird narrowed its eyes:

"Really? My weight is normal?"

"Yes, Linlin is very healthy. It's just a few grams; it's natural to be slightly heavier in winter. You're still young."

The man leaned down into a half-squat, speaking very patiently.

His little bird was still very strict about its figure.

"If that's the case..."

The bird tucked in its wings, stopped walking, slid backward along with the treadmill, and finally landed steadily on the floor.

chunks.chineseText:
爪子热热的。

“我去问问001！”

卧室。

“本体是遵循族群特征的，变化都很少的，不用担心。”

“黑衣少年”倚靠在桌子边上，面容清秀，但面色却没有什么大的起伏，只是专注地用手去撕开棒棒糖的包装，塞进了嘴巴里。

又低头看向桌子上的蓝羽小鸟。

“唔……247，我们不会变胖的，族群特征，放心吃吧。”

白粼粼眼睛都亮了亮。

“鸟妖就是这样的，因为要飞的，可能和其他妖怪相比，我们体型会纤瘦些？”

“黑衣少年”又歪头道。

经过这么一番开导，鸟神清气爽的，好了很多，本来是要同001打游戏的，但是南市管理局那里好像临时有事，又把它传讯回去了。

“大家应该是晚上过来。”

“我过几个小时找你！”

“黑衣少年”幻化成小雀，又扑棱翅膀飞走了。

卧室里只剩下一人一鸟。

白粼粼直接化形了，“少年”往上举着胳膊，自顾自地转了个圈，长袖长裤的，家居服是深色的，衬得皮肤莹润透亮，像是个bjd娃娃。

这次没有穿搭。

很素的那种。

“少年”似乎是才发现，仰着头看了过来，很是认真地道：

“宋郁，你看，我没有变化的。”

“不圆！”

宋郁垂眸看了过去，定定地道：

“一样的好看。”

“少年”不由得往外伸了伸手臂，立马往卧室里的衣柜里走，蹲在地毯上找衣服，后脑勺很是圆润，发尾都是一翘一翘的。

宋郁就这么跟着走过去，看着。

“这个好看吗？”

捞出来一件复古夹克，牛仔条纹的。

“好——”

宋郁还没有说完。

“少年”就自顾自地拿了回来，低着头，后颈不设防地露着，上面还有些未消的痕迹。

“不行不行，过年的话，要喜庆一些。”

“我想想……”

宋郁眼皮微微垂着，不得不承认，他的小鸟，万里挑一。

白粼粼还在跪坐着找衣服，很是认认真真的，但就在这时，身侧一道阴影覆了过来。

“到时候和爷爷去拜年——”

“唔嗯。”

下巴被捏住了，吻落了下来。

……

除夕夜。

锦园相当热闹，灯火通明，院子里也是挂着红灯笼。

南市或许是为了应景，还飘起来一点小雪，显得氛围极好。

陈开鹤自己一个人着实无聊，等到反应过来的时候，车子已经开到了锦园了，正所谓来都来了。

虽然一开始约定的是初一过来。

但也不差这几个小时。

陈开鹤也十分想念自己的“孙子”和“孙媳”了，提着几条鱼就过来了，步履很是稳健，在雪地里留下一串脚印。

“峥国肯定十分惊喜！”

老头心里美美的，一手团圆鱼，一手足金重的饰品，怎么看都是很完美。

不过就在走到院子里的时候，他看了下别墅，发现真的灯火通明的，甚至楼上的窗户里还有些影子。

这么热闹？

陈开鹤不由得走了过去，院子的栅栏门是没有关的，他进去了，走到了入户门那里，里面传来些此起彼伏说话的声音。

像是聚会。

陈开鹤很是迷茫，他本来是打算敲门的，但是似乎这里面最后的客人没有好好关，导致他一推……就开了。

嘎吱——

里面的声音一停，万籁俱寂。

房子里面摆满了桌子，甚至还有古典的烛火，各种奇形怪状的动物，它们穿着人类的衣服，在举杯换盏，有个鼠鼠甚至已经微醺了，面颊泛红。

犹如闯入了什么地界。

无数个动物都看了过来，并没有恶意，只是意外。

陈开鹤往后退了一步，瞳孔都微微放大了，他几乎要左脚绊右脚了。

但就在这时，他突然看到了主位那里的……宋峥国，对方也在保持着举杯的动作，有些僵硬。

“……”

“……”
chunks.englishText:
Its claws felt warm.

"I'm going to ask 001!"

Bedroom.

"The original form follows the characteristics of the tribe; changes are minimal, so don't worry."

The "black-clothed youth" leaned against the edge of the table. His face was delicate, but his expression didn't fluctuate much. He was just focused on tearing open a lollipop wrapper and popping it into his mouth.

He looked down at the blue-feathered bird on the table.

"Hmm... 247, we won't get fat. It's a tribal characteristic, eat without worry."

Bai Linlin's eyes brightened.

"Bird monsters are just like this. Because we have to fly, our builds might be slimmer compared to other monsters?"

The "black-clothed youth" tilted his head again.

After such guidance, the bird felt refreshed and much better. It had originally intended to play games with 001, but the Nanshi Management Bureau seemed to have an urgent matter and summoned him back.

"Everyone should be coming over tonight."

"I'll find you in a few hours!"

The "black-clothed youth" transformed into a little sparrow and flapped his wings away.

Only one person and one bird remained in the bedroom.

Bai Linlin transformed directly. The "youth" raised his arms, spinning around on his own. He wore long sleeves and trousers—dark-colored loungewear that made his skin look translucent and glowing, like a BJD doll.

There was no styling this time.

Just very plain.

The "youth" seemed to have just noticed. He looked up, very seriously:

"Song Yu, look, I haven't changed."

"Not round!"

Song Yu lowered his eyes, looking at him, and said firmly:

"Just as good-looking as always."

The "youth" couldn't help but stretch his arms out, immediately walking toward the wardrobe in the bedroom. He crouched on the carpet to look for clothes, the back of his head very round, his hair ends flipping up.

Song Yu followed him and watched.

"Does this look good?"

He pulled out a vintage jacket with denim stripes.

"Good—"

Song Yu hadn't finished speaking.

The "youth" had already taken it back on his own, head lowered, exposing the back of his neck, which still bore some faint, lingering marks.

"No, no, for the New Year, it needs to be more festive."

"Let me think..."

Song Yu’s eyelids drooped slightly. He had to admit, his little bird was one in a million.

Bai Linlin was still kneeling on the floor looking for clothes, very earnest. But just then, a shadow fell over him.

"When the time comes, we'll go pay New Year's visits with Grandpa—"

"Mmm."

His chin was pinched, and a kiss landed on his lips.

...

New Year's Eve.

Jin Garden was quite lively, brightly lit, with red lanterns hanging in the courtyard.

Perhaps to set the mood, Nanshi even had a light snowfall, making the atmosphere perfect.

Chen Kaihe was truly bored on his own. By the time he realized it, his car had already driven to Jin Garden. As the saying goes, since he was already here...

Although they had originally agreed to come on the first day of the New Year.

A few hours didn't make much difference.

Chen Kaihe missed his "grandson" and "grandson-in-law" dearly. He carried a few fish over, his gait steady, leaving a trail of footprints in the snow.

"Zhengguo will definitely be pleasantly surprised!"

The old man felt wonderful. With reunion fish in one hand and solid gold ornaments in the other, it looked perfect no matter how he saw it.

However, when he walked into the courtyard, he looked at the villa and found it truly brightly lit, with shadows even visible in the upstairs windows.

So lively?

Chen Kaihe couldn't help but walk over. The courtyard gate wasn't locked. He entered and walked to the front door, from which came the sound of people talking.

It sounded like a party.

Chen Kaihe was very confused. He had intended to knock, but it seemed the last guest hadn't closed the door properly, so when he pushed... it opened.

*Creak—*

The sound inside stopped, and everything fell silent.

The house was filled with tables, even featuring classical candlelight. Various strange-looking animals were wearing human clothes, raising glasses and exchanging cups. One mouse was already slightly tipsy, its cheeks flushed.

It was as if he had stumbled into some other realm.

Countless animals looked over. There was no malice, only surprise.

Chen Kaihe took a step back, his pupils slightly dilated. He almost tripped over his own feet.

But just then, he suddenly saw Song Zhengguo in the seat of honor, who was also maintaining the gesture of raising a glass, looking somewhat stiff.

"..."

"..."

chunks.chineseText:
第85章

砰！

陈开鹤抬手就把门关上了，手比脑子快，尽管整个人还处在宕机的情况下。

怎么可能……

看错了吧？

入户门悬挂的红灯笼散发着暖色的灯光，在冬日里的小风里一晃一晃的，看着很是喜庆。

陈开鹤闭了闭眼，打算再试一次，于是又抬手推开了门。

嘎吱——

这次里面倒是没有那么多奇形怪状的动物了，“他们”全部都穿着衣服，有年关半百的老人，有年幼的孩童，全部都在齐齐地看着这边，手里还拿着杯子。

宋峥国还在其中坐着，与上一秒的不同是，这次明显是有些慌张了，直接站起来了。

陈开鹤提着年鱼，又揉了揉眼睛，看着里面的场景，不由得说了句：

“我刚才怎么看的是……”

这句话一出，直接把宋峥国给整的一激灵，立马起身过来，走到玄关处，只是接过来鱼，连忙问：

“怎么除夕夜就过来了？不是说好了初一么？”

陈开鹤一听这话就有些不乐意了：

“我这不是想过来找你么？春晚又没什么好看的，一起吃一顿饭还不让啊？”

老头有些不满，连带着方才困惑的情绪都扔到一边了，即使是不正常的环境，但里面不是有宋峥国么？

那就是正常的。

“让让让！”

宋峥国心跳都很快，他回头看了下房子里面，所有的小妖全部都变成了人形，看着乖乖的，拿着筷子拿着勺子，还有捧着碗的。

陈开鹤在后面絮絮叨叨地说：

“我就说不能一个人过年，你知道我刚进门看到了什么，简直是花眼了，把所有人都看成小动物了。”

“对了，这怎么家里这么多人？”

老人提着鱼进来了，坦坦荡荡。

钓鱼佬什么大场面没见过。

“这些是粼粼……的朋友，算是亲家。”

宋峥国只能这么委婉地说。

陈开鹤更是神经大条，一听到这话立马腰板都直了，连忙朝着主位那里看过去，这才发现旁边坐着一个优雅的女士，红色大衣搭在椅背，交叠着双腿，身子微微靠后，抬眸看了过来。

“哎呀哎呀，又见面了。”

丹顶鹤很是矜持地伸过去了手。

陈开鹤环顾了下四周，发现没有位置了，但正好旁边有个“黑衣少年”站了起来，很是认真地拉开了椅子：

“您坐。”

陈开鹤回头一看，隐约觉得这孩子有点熟悉，但就是想不起来，最后遇事不决，直接开始夸：

“哎呀好好好，谢谢孩子。”

人直接坐下了，开始亲切地同旁边的女士谈话了，他们在订婚宴上有一面之缘，当时其实不在一桌，只是知道这位是那孩子的“家里人”。

“新年好，新年好，我这次过来也没带什么，有两条鱼。”

陈开鹤很是不好意思，但还是提了起来，他从钓起来就一直养着，现如今很肥美了。

丹顶鹤眯了眯眼，不错。

它喜欢。

“那现在去做了？”

丹顶鹤试探着询问。

陈开鹤立马一拍大腿，看向旁边站着的老友，眼睛亮亮的：

“走走走，我跟你一起，这我看大家不才刚吃饭吗？再添一道。”

宋峥国其实不太明白自己的老友为什么接受度这么高，他不是看到了么？

觉得是眼花，就过去了？

挺、挺好的。

“不用，让它们两个去吧，很会杀鱼的。”

丹顶鹤挥了挥手，桌子上站起来一对双胞胎，眼睛圆圆的，俨然已经做好了准备。

陈开鹤一时还有些吃惊：

“这么小就会杀鱼？几年级了啊？”

宋峥国：“……”

-

房子里又恢复了热热闹闹的声音，厨房里甚至也传来了香气，有人有妖，其乐融融。

路过的邻居还在遛狗，本来是冻得跟什么似的，但是看到隔壁房子里传来些说话的声音，也是有些意外。

围着围巾，看了过去。

“老宋家里来人了啊……”

邻居心想真是时过境迁，五六年前，这小郁还都是一个人过年的，房子里冷冷清清的，现在却是另一幅画面了。

真好。

邻居牵着狗往前走，爪子在地面上上留下了一串串的脚印。

天空中还在飘着雪花，慢慢地覆盖了上去。

房子里。

“陈爷爷！”

楼梯扶手那边下来了“少年”，声音脆脆的，当即小跑了下来，穿着很英伦的小马甲，搭配羊毛衫，身形修长而又纤细，犹如个衣服架子。

“哎！除夕夜好！”

陈开鹤立马笑吟吟地看过去，“少年”已经站了过来，不过有些困惑地看向旁边的宋峥国：

“爷爷，现在还没过零点，要说新年好吗？”

“可以的，怎么都行。”

宋峥国很温和地道。

白粼粼有样学样地打了招呼，陈开鹤只是很是满意，也等不及明天了，当即就拿出来了自己的礼物：

“孩子，我又去金店打了点东西，这个不知道你喜欢不喜欢？”

宋峥国：“……”

就在这个时候，身后的青年走了过来，穿着高领的黑色毛衣，面庞是偏冷的，但眉眼温和，只是侧头道：

“爷爷，新年快乐。”

……

农历正月初一。

锦园一楼恢复如初，窗明几净的，夜里临走的时候，所有小妖都认认真真地打扫干净了，还带走了自己随身携带的小马扎。

陈开鹤喝醉了，此刻正在客房里睡觉。

宋郁则是驱车去公里之外的地方买早点了，因为“少年”指名道姓地要吃一个老字号的流沙包，查询了半天，只有一个很远的地方在营业。

抱着洗漱了下，而后才离开了。

“爷爷在家，这会儿可能在书房，我去买，粼粼可以去睡觉，也可以去找爷爷，嗯？”

“少年”当时被放在洗手台上，其实很困，下巴都是往下垂着的，不过被亲了亲眼角，又被抱回床那边了。

大约八点钟的时候。

宋峥国在书房里看财经杂志，听到了门口那边传来了爪子挠动的声音，立马起身过去了，给打开了门。

蓝羽小鸟圆滚滚的，似乎是刚醒，伸了伸翅根，仰着头道：

“爷爷。”

“宋郁还没有回来，我来找您。”

宋峥国连忙道：“来吧来吧。”

一日之际在于晨，更何况是新年。

一老人一鸟已经开始学习了，宋峥国在看杂志，蓝羽小鸟也伸着爪子看中央的公文，很是上进了。

偶尔还会讨论一下：

“妖界关于老妖善后这方面其实做得很好了，但是有些老妖还是对人类有很大的敌意，不愿意去管理局生活，仍旧住在荒郊野外。”

宋峥国只是循循善诱道：

“干部是会遇到这种问题的，首先是要理解，设身处地，从群众的角度看事情，为什么会有敌意？”

鸟收了收翅膀，认真领会：

“肯定是之前看到了什么，或者经历了什么。”

宋峥国想到这里，又抛砖引玉道：

“那能改变么？或者说，鸟儿可以保证人类不会再偷猎、虐杀动物么？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 85

*Bang!*

Chen Kaihe raised his hand and shut the door. His hand was faster than his brain, even though he was still in a state of system failure.

How is that possible...

Must have seen it wrong, right?

The red lanterns hanging at the entrance emitted a warm glow, swaying in the winter breeze, looking very festive.

Chen Kaihe closed his eyes, intending to try again. He raised his hand and pushed the door open.

*Creak—*

This time, there weren't so many strange-looking animals inside. "They" were all wearing clothes—some were elderly people in their twilight years, others were young children—all looking toward the door in unison, holding cups in their hands.

Song Zhengguo was still sitting among them. The difference from a second ago was that he was clearly flustered now and stood up immediately.

Chen Kaihe carried the New Year's fish, rubbed his eyes again, looked at the scene inside, and couldn't help but say:

"What did I just see..."

As soon as these words were out, Song Zhengguo was startled. He immediately stood up, walked to the entryway, took the fish, and asked hurriedly:

"Why did you come over on New Year's Eve? Didn't we agree on the first day?"

Chen Kaihe wasn't happy when he heard this:

"Didn't I want to come see you? The Spring Festival Gala isn't worth watching anyway. Is it not allowed to have a meal together?"

The old man was a bit dissatisfied, casting aside his previous confusion. Even if the environment was abnormal, wasn't Song Zhengguo inside?

That meant it was normal.

"Allowed, allowed, allowed!"

Song Zhengguo’s heart was racing. He glanced back into the house; all the little monsters had transformed into human forms, looking obedient, holding chopsticks, spoons, and bowls.

Chen Kaihe chattered on behind him:

"I just said I couldn't spend the New Year alone. You know, when I first walked in, I saw something—I must have been seeing things, I saw everyone as little animals."

"By the way, why are there so many people at home?"

The old man carried the fish inside, calm and collected.

What kind of big scenes hadn't this fisherman seen?

"These are Linlin's... friends. You could call them in-laws."

Song Zhengguo could only put it euphemistically.

Chen Kaihe was even more thick-skinned. Upon hearing this, he straightened his back immediately and looked toward the seat of honor. Only then did he notice an elegant lady sitting nearby, a red coat draped over the back of her chair, legs crossed, leaning back slightly, looking over.

"Oh my, oh my, we meet again."

The Red-Crowned Crane extended her hand with great poise.

Chen Kaihe looked around and found there were no seats left, but a "black-clothed youth" stood up and pulled out a chair very earnestly:

"Please, sit."

Chen Kaihe looked back and vaguely felt the child was familiar, but he couldn't quite place it. Finally, unable to decide, he just started praising:

"Oh, good, good, thank you, child."

He sat down directly and began chatting cordially with the lady next to him. They had met once at the engagement banquet; they hadn't been at the same table then, but he knew she was the child's "family."

"Happy New Year, Happy New Year. I didn't bring much this time, just two fish."

Chen Kaihe was very embarrassed, but he held them up. He had been keeping them since he caught them, and they were very plump now.

The Red-Crowned Crane narrowed her eyes. Not bad.

She liked it.

"Shall we go cook them now?"

The Red-Crowned Crane asked tentatively.

Chen Kaihe slapped his thigh and looked at his old friend standing nearby, his eyes bright:

"Let's go, let's go. I'll go with you. I see everyone just started eating, right? We'll add another dish."

Song Zhengguo didn't quite understand why his old friend was so accepting. Didn't he see it?

He thought it was a trick of the eyes and just let it go?

That... that was fine.

"No need, let the two of them go. They are very good at cleaning fish."

The Red-Crowned Crane waved her hand. A pair of twins stood up from the table, their eyes round, clearly prepared.

Chen Kaihe was surprised for a moment:

"They know how to clean fish at such a young age? What grade are they in?"

Song Zhengguo: "..."

-

The house returned to its lively state, and the kitchen even began to emit savory aromas. Humans and monsters alike were enjoying the harmony.

A neighbor passing by was walking their dog. They had been frozen stiff, but seeing the sounds of conversation coming from the house next door, they were surprised.

Wrapped in a scarf, they looked over.

"Old Song has guests..."

The neighbor thought about how times had changed. Five or six years ago, Little Yu had spent the New Year alone, the house cold and quiet. Now, it was a completely different picture.

It was truly good.

The neighbor walked on with the dog, its paws leaving a trail of prints on the ground.

Snowflakes were still drifting in the sky, slowly covering them up.

Inside the house.

"Grandpa Chen!"

The "youth" came down the stairs, his voice crisp. He trotted down immediately, wearing a British-style vest paired with a wool sweater. His figure was long and slender, like a clothes hanger.

"Hey! Happy New Year's Eve!"

Chen Kaihe smiled as he looked over. The "youth" had already stood by him, but he looked at Song Zhengguo with some confusion:

"Grandpa, it's not midnight yet. Should I say Happy New Year?"

"It's fine, whatever you like."

Song Zhengguo said gently.

Bai Linlin followed suit and offered a greeting. Chen Kaihe was very satisfied and couldn't wait until tomorrow, so he immediately took out his gift:

"Child, I went to the gold shop and had something made. I don't know if you'll like it?"

Song Zhengguo: "..."

Just then, the young man behind him walked over, wearing a black turtleneck sweater. His face was cool, but his eyes were gentle. He just tilted his head and said:

"Grandpa, Happy New Year."

...

The first day of the Lunar New Year.

The first floor of Jin Garden was back to normal, clean and tidy. When they left in the night, all the little monsters had cleaned up thoroughly and even taken their portable stools with them.

Chen Kaihe was drunk and currently sleeping in the guest room.

Song Yu had driven miles away to buy breakfast because the "youth" had specifically asked for a traditional brand of custard buns. After searching for a long time, only one very distant shop was open.

He had hugged him and helped him wash up before leaving.

"Grandpa is at home, probably in the study right now. I'm going to buy some. Linlin, you can sleep, or you can go find Grandpa, hmm?"

The "youth" had been placed on the bathroom counter at the time; he was actually very sleepy, his chin drooping, but after being kissed on the corner of his eye, he was carried back to the bed.

Around eight o'clock.

Song Zhengguo was in the study reading a finance magazine when he heard the sound of claws scratching at the door. He stood up immediately and opened it.

The blue-feathered bird was round and plump, looking as if it had just woken up. It stretched its wing roots, tilted its head, and said:

"Grandpa."

"Song Yu hasn't come back yet, so I came to find you."

Song Zhengguo said quickly: "Come in, come in."

The best time of the day is the morning, especially on New Year's Day.

The old man and the bird began to study. Song Zhengguo read his magazine, and the blue-feathered bird also stretched out its claws to look at the official documents in the center, very diligent.

Occasionally, they would discuss things:

"The monster world has actually done a very good job with the aftermath for old monsters, but some old monsters still have great hostility toward humans and are unwilling to live in the Bureau's facilities, preferring to stay in the wilderness."

Song Zhengguo just guided him patiently:

"Cadres will encounter this kind of problem. First, you must understand, put yourself in their shoes, and look at things from the perspective of the masses. Why is there hostility?"

The bird tucked in its wings, taking it to heart:

"They must have seen something or experienced something before."

Thinking of this, Song Zhengguo threw out a lead:

"Can that be changed? Or, can the birds guarantee that humans will no longer poach or abuse animals?"

chunks.chineseText:
白粼粼摇了摇鸟头，当然不能。

“对，要处理你能处理的，人类这一方，我们不能直接地改变，但是首先是可以从妖界入手的，鸟儿不是说了，妖界文化程度不高，对人类更是不太了解。”

“你想想，可以用什么办法改变呢？”

宋峥国在椅子上坐着，很是和蔼可亲。

鸟圆滚滚的，此刻是一只原皮小鸡，没有穿衣服，啪嗒啪嗒地在桌上转了个圈，仰着头道：

“那、那是不是可以发行个手册，传授对人类的一些基本认知，首先是要确立一个合适的形象，不可以过分美化人类，也不可以过分污名人类，帮助妖界树立正确的认知观。”

宋峥国很是欣慰：

“可以的，鸟儿可以亲自动笔写一写，说不定可以在妖界出书的。”

蓝羽小鸟收紧了翅根，对此还是有些害羞的，出书什么的，这都还太……远了点。

“哎，爷爷给你出一本写真集好不好？”

宋峥国一下子又切换了角色，很是温和地伸出去了手，鸟立马抬腿上来了，毛绒绒的。

“给出版社十几万应该没问题的，鸟儿就有自己的书了，怎么样？”

白粼粼：“……”

这、这，有人买吗？

“爷爷回头上点心。”

宋峥国俨然是把这件事列入计划里了，不过就在这时，手指上传来声音，鸟儿羽毛亮丽顺滑，好奇地歪头问：

“爷爷，你为什么后面不从政了？”

-

宋郁还在等待流沙包，其实初一是不上班的，到了地方才发现贴了告示，没办法只能去打了电话，加钱。

解决了。

老板在里面做。

他低头打算看下手机的时间，壁纸上一个闭着眼睡觉的小鸟，侧躺着，短喙滑滑的。

“这是给爱人买的啊？”

“嗯。”

老板闻言也莫名笑了笑，加快了手上的动作，这大过年的。

与此同时，书房里已经有了两只小鸟了，001获得了一盒酸奶，在认认真真地品鉴，旁边蓝羽小鸟在和老人讲一些它听不懂的话。

“身不由己罢了，况且人生是体验，并非要一条路走到黑。”

“小郁虽然是在管家里的公司，可是等到事情没那么繁忙了，我还是希望你们能出去走走，看看风景。”

白粼粼仰着鸟头，若有所思。

“从政确实会获得一种前所未有的意义感，这非比寻常，所以鸟儿，爷爷很高兴你能收获这份价值感。”

“但是人类这里，不一样……盛世不为官。”

小雀已经把鸟头全部伸进去酸奶盒了。

“人类是擅长勾心斗角的，难免会有些人丧失初心，这其中的洪流太多了，有些人在风浪里前行，有些人被风浪覆灭，还有些人……回到了沙滩上，看潮起潮落。”

白粼粼点了点头。

宋峥国只是笑着道：“但鸟儿不必担心这些，妖怪寿命很长，多多享受生活就好。”

“爷爷一直支持你们。”

白粼粼愣了下。

小雀已经顶着酸奶盒在走了，爪子啪嗒啪嗒的，从左边挪到右边，从右边挪到左边，像是个背景。

白粼粼：“……”

鸟最后用翅膀把酸奶盒掀开了，小雀懵懵的，站在桌子上，收了收翅膀。

001其实也是听了一些话的，伸着鸟头板板正正地道：

“爷爷也可以一直活。”

“小妖们可以兑换寿命的。”

宋峥国愣了下，而后爽朗地笑了起来，只是伸了伸手，拍了拍小雀的头。

001爪子一下子劈叉了，坐在了桌子上。

“那就成老怪物咯。”

-

大年初一，“少年”吃了流沙包，很是高兴，甚至去卧室午睡的时候亲了亲人的脸颊。

以资鼓励。

宋郁坐在床边，托着“人”的腰，眉目微抬，温声道：

“早上干什么了？”

白粼粼坐在人的怀里玩做饭游戏，靠在对方的肩头，闻言头也不抬地道：

“去书房找爷爷了，然后001不是过来了么？”

“看书？”

宋郁事无巨细地问。

“少年”只好又道：“差不多，爷爷在看财经杂志了，我在看公文。”

“这样。”

白粼粼说到这里，突然想起来什么，仰头看了过去，眼睛圆圆的，说了关于“寿命”的事。

……

“是么？可以众多妖怪兑换？”

“001说可以。”

宋郁温和地笑了下，只是很残忍地道：

“不会的。”

“他老人家不会这么做。”

白粼粼愣了下，抬手环着人的肩背，不是很理解，闷声道：

“可是、可是。”

宋郁抱着“人”，很轻声地道：

“没有可是，如果最爱的人不在身边，长生是诅咒。”

“我爱你。”

-

大约在五月初的时候，白粼粼申请了发情期的假，主要是因为宋郁快要毕业了。

锦园这里也常常多了熟客，主要是陈开鹤和道士，这两个人一个退休了，一个则是开启新生活了。

道士的工作是在华秉当保安，这个不要文凭，就是在大楼那里喝茶看报，很是清闲，偶尔还能看看上班的人面相，分析下谁运势不好。

也算是再就业。

“749局前段时间确实来人了，呵，我就知道。”

“不过他们看到我在应该会走掉。”

道士看了眼手中的牌，发现一张王都没有，全是对子，剩下的单排也组不成串子。

“749局是什么？”

陈开鹤询问了下，他其实从军的时候知道峥国认识个老道，不过没怎么见过，现在看到了，只是很稀奇。

道士直接给问住了，他咳咳了几下：

“事业单位。”

“噢噢，你离职了啊？让你返聘？”

陈开鹤出了一张三带一。

宋峥国跟牌，三个K带一个A。

“……不要。”

又开始接着聊：

“差不多，但我又不去，现在当保安就很好，又不必去天桥下面算命。”

“你真会算命假会算命？”

宋峥国一句话也没有插，出了个对子：

“一对二。”

“……不要。”

“……不要。”

陈开鹤又开始插科打诨：

“那你给我算算呗？”

“你命不好，无后代，光棍。”

“嘿嘿，谢谢夸奖。”

传统命理学里，无婚配就是很差的命，不过时代在改变，陈开鹤始终没有动摇过自己的想法。

他有很好的朋友，过命的交情。

余生不孤独！

“都不要？我出了。”

宋峥国问了问两个人，最后确认无误之后，把一沓子牌出了：

“顺子。”

对面的两个老头看了看牌，沉默了，从九直接到A了。

“……不要。”

“……不要。”

宋峥国摆了摆手，从容出牌：

“王炸。”

-

六月是毕业季，白粼粼正在衣帽间里挑衣服，不过是在给宋郁选，因为有个什么优秀毕业生发言。

西服……不能太抢眼。

但也不能不抢眼。

“少年”沉思，用手托着下巴，围着面前的人转了一下，不知道怎么了，突然笑了下：
chunks.englishText:
Bai Linlin shook his bird head; of course, that was impossible.

"Right, we must handle what we can. We cannot directly change the human side, but we can start with the Demon Realm. Didn't the bird say that the Demon Realm lacks cultural depth and knows very little about humans?"

"Think about it, what methods could we use to change that?"

Song Zhengguo sat in his chair, looking amiable and kind.

The bird was round and fluffy, currently in its original chick form, wearing no clothes. It pattered around in a circle on the table, tilted its head, and said:

"W-well, could we publish a handbook? To teach some basic understanding of humans. First, we must establish an appropriate image—neither overly beautifying humans nor excessively stigmatizing them—to help the Demon Realm build a correct worldview."

Song Zhengguo was very gratified:

"That is possible. The bird could write it personally; perhaps you could even publish a book in the Demon Realm."

The blue-feathered bird tightened its wings, feeling a bit shy about this. Publishing a book and such—that still felt a little... too far off.

"Hey, how about Grandpa puts together a photo album for you?"

Song Zhengguo switched roles again, extending his hand very gently. The bird immediately lifted a leg and hopped onto his palm, all soft and fluffy.

"Giving the publisher a hundred thousand or so shouldn't be a problem. Then the bird will have its own book, how about that?"

Bai Linlin: "..."

Th-this, would anyone actually buy it?

"Grandpa will put some heart into it later."

Song Zhengguo had clearly already added this to his agenda. Just then, a sound came from his finger. The bird, with its bright and sleek feathers, tilted its head curiously and asked:

"Grandpa, why did you stop being involved in politics later on?"

-

Song Yu was still waiting for the custard buns. Actually, the first day of the Lunar New Year was a holiday, and he only realized the shop was closed once he arrived. There was no other way, so he had to make a phone call and pay extra.

It was settled.

The boss was inside making them.

He lowered his head to check the time on his phone. The wallpaper was a little bird sleeping with its eyes closed, lying on its side, its short beak smooth and sleek.

"Is this for your lover?"

"Yes."

Hearing this, the boss also smiled inexplicably and sped up his work. It was the New Year, after all.

Meanwhile, in the study, there were already two little birds. 001 had obtained a carton of yogurt and was earnestly savoring it, while the blue-feathered bird beside it was talking to the old man about things it couldn't quite understand.

"It was just a matter of being unable to act otherwise. Besides, life is an experience; one doesn't have to walk a single path until the very end."

"Although Xiao Yu is managing the family company, once things aren't so busy, I still hope you two can go out and wander, to see the scenery."

Bai Linlin tilted its bird head, lost in thought.

"Politics does indeed provide a sense of meaning unlike anything else; it is extraordinary. So, little bird, Grandpa is very happy that you can reap this sense of value."

"But here among humans... in a prosperous age, one need not be an official."

The little sparrow had already stuck its entire head into the yogurt carton.

"Humans are adept at intrigue and power struggles. It is inevitable that some will lose their original intentions. There is too much of a torrent in all this; some people forge ahead through the wind and waves, some are swallowed by them, and others... return to the beach to watch the tides rise and fall."

Bai Linlin nodded.

Song Zhengguo just smiled and said: "But the bird need not worry about these things. Demons have very long lifespans; just enjoy life to the fullest."

"Grandpa will always support you."

Bai Linlin was stunned for a moment.

The little sparrow was already walking around with the yogurt carton on its head, its claws pattering—moving from left to right, from right to left, like a background character.

Bai Linlin: "..."

The bird finally used its wing to flip the yogurt carton off. The little sparrow stood on the table, looking dazed, and tucked in its wings.

001 had actually heard some of the conversation. It stretched out its bird head and said quite formally:

"Grandpa can also live forever."

"Little demons can exchange for lifespan."

Song Zhengguo was stunned for a moment, then burst into a hearty laugh. He simply reached out and patted the little sparrow’s head.

001’s claws suddenly did the splits, and it sat down on the table.

"Then I’d become an old monster."

-

On the first day of the Lunar New Year, the "youth" ate the custard buns and was very happy, even kissing the person's cheek when they went to the bedroom for a nap.

As a reward for encouragement.

Song Yu sat on the edge of the bed, supporting the "person's" waist, his brows slightly raised, his voice gentle:

"What did you do this morning?"

Bai Linlin was sitting in his lap playing a cooking game, leaning against his shoulder. Hearing this, it didn't even lift its head:

"Went to the study to find Grandpa, and then didn't 001 come over?"

"Reading?"

Song Yu asked, down to the smallest detail.

The "youth" had no choice but to say: "More or less. Grandpa was reading a finance magazine, and I was looking at official documents."

"I see."

When Bai Linlin said this, it suddenly remembered something. It looked up, its eyes round, and spoke about the matter of "lifespan."

...

"Is that so? Can many demons exchange for it?"

"001 said it's possible."

Song Yu smiled gently, but said quite cruelly:

"It won't happen."

"The old man won't do that."

Bai Linlin was stunned. It raised its arms to wrap around his shoulders and back, not quite understanding, and muttered:

"But, but."

Song Yu held the "person" and said very softly:

"There are no 'buts.' If the one you love most is not by your side, immortality is a curse."

"I love you."

-

Around the beginning of May, Bai Linlin applied for leave for its estrus period, mainly because Song Yu was about to graduate.

The Jin Garden often had regular guests now, mainly Chen Kaihe and the Taoist. One of them had retired, and the other had started a new life.

The Taoist’s job was as a security guard at Huabing. It didn't require a degree; he just drank tea and read newspapers in the building, which was very leisurely. Occasionally, he could even look at the faces of the people coming to work and analyze whose luck was poor.

It could be considered re-employment.

"The 749 Bureau did indeed come by a while ago. Heh, I knew it."

"But they’ll probably leave once they see I’m here."

The Taoist looked at the cards in his hand and found he didn't have a single King; they were all pairs, and the remaining singles couldn't form a sequence.

"What is the 749 Bureau?"

Chen Kaihe asked. He had actually known that Zhengguo knew an old Taoist back when he was in the military, but he hadn't seen him much. Seeing him now, he found it quite curious.

The Taoist was stumped by the question. He coughed a few times:

"A public institution."

"Oh, oh. Did you resign? Did they ask you to return as a consultant?"

Chen Kaihe played a "three-of-a-kind with a single."

Song Zhengguo followed with a play: "Three Kings with an Ace."

"...Pass."

They continued chatting:

"More or less, but I’m not going. Being a security guard now is just fine; I don't have to go under the overpass to tell fortunes."

"Are you a real fortune teller or a fake one?"

Song Zhengguo didn't interject at all, playing a pair:

"A pair of twos."

"...Pass."

"...Pass."

Chen Kaihe started joking around again:

"Then why don't you tell my fortune?"

"Your fortune is bad. No descendants, a bachelor."

"Heh heh, thanks for the compliment."

In traditional fortune-telling, having no spouse is considered a very poor fate. However, times were changing, and Chen Kaihe had never wavered in his own thoughts.

He had good friends—a friendship that could withstand life and death.

The rest of his life would not be lonely!

"Both passing? Then it's mine."

Song Zhengguo checked with the two of them, and after confirming, he played a stack of cards:

"A straight."

The two old men across from him looked at the cards and fell silent. It went straight from nine to Ace.

"...Pass."

"...Pass."

Song Zhengguo waved his hand and played calmly:

"Rocket (Two Jokers)."

-

June was graduation season. Bai Linlin was in the walk-in closet picking out clothes, but it was for Song Yu, because he had to give a speech as an outstanding graduate.

A suit... it couldn't be too flashy.

But it couldn't be too dull either.

The "youth" pondered, resting its chin on its hand, circling the person in front of it. For some reason, it suddenly smiled.

chunks.chineseText:
“你怎么才二十二岁？好小啊。”

宋郁微微抬了下眉，垂眸看了过去，并不生气，只是问：

“我没长大么？”

白粼粼闻言一愣，其实他是拿着西服站在柜子那里，仰头看了过来，没太理解什么意思：

“啊？”

“长大？你个子高了。”

“少年”歪头看了过来，眼睛亮亮的，不过又抬了抬下巴：

“不过我也可以自己调整的，我用妖力就……”

宋郁抬手扣住了那个手，直接挤过去指缝，十指相扣了，垂眸看了过去，好似面无表情。

往前走。

白粼粼隐隐约约地觉得这岂不是……壁咚？他不同意，立马伸另外一只手过去，但正好被扣住一对。

“嗯？”

“少年”仰头看过去，眉眼是很鲜亮的那种，明明白白两个字：

[放肆！]

白粼粼是直到两个手被带着往上举着，扣压住了，才慌了起来：

“宋郁！”

“在。”

“除了个子呢？我没有其他地方长大了么？”

宋郁压了过来，单手锢着了那个腰，垂眸上下扫着，没有任何犹豫地低头，吻了过去。

“唔……嗯……”

被扣着的手一开始是挣扎的，后面松开了，慢慢地改成环着人的肩背了。

唇瓣被很用力地碾开。

伸探着。

不高兴了。

-

白粼粼夜里昏昏沉沉地睡着，被捞起来一言不发，当即就去咬了，宋郁动作顿了下，但还是稳稳地抬手把人抱好，托着那截后腰。

有刺痛的感觉，血渗了出来。

渐渐地变了味。

“少年”浑身酸软，一开始是要报复的，但是后面就舔舐了起来。

妖力流动，瞳孔都泛着金。

宋郁只是去拿了药膏，一点点地去给“人”擦，感受着皮肤传来湿热的触感，他喉结滚动了下。

“唔……”

白粼粼后面就有点累了，不舔了，闭着眼睛趴在人的肩头，眼皮泛着红。

凌晨三点了。

“不给我选衣服了？”

耳边似乎有微沉的嗓音。

白粼粼一下子就蹙眉了，胸膛一起一伏的，瓮声瓮气地道：

“不给你选了！”

“我……我咬……”

牙齿还没来得及磨破皮肤，下巴就被捏住了，唇舌交缠，密不透风的感觉。

含混之间。

“换个地方。”

最后是里里外外都被吻透了，白粼粼的翅膀都出来了，他一受不了了，就会变成防御的姿态，翅膀就会冒出来了，但其实一点作用都没有。

合也合不上。

在浴室里还会打湿。

宋郁反倒是很喜欢。

白粼粼最后终于是睡着了，家居服都是换了的，清爽干净，发尾顺滑又有光泽，皮肤白皙莹润。

就是手指内侧……都有些痕迹。

毕业典礼当天。

宋郁在台上发言，语气沉稳，面容轮廓明显，有明暗交错的阴影。

“……我希望日后我们走出社会，能够发扬母校的精神，报效社会……”

总之是一些官话套话。

宋峥国在前排的客座席，身着考究的正装，人员流动大，因而还拿着个拐杖，颇有气势。

不过他的肩头则是站着一只圆滚滚的鸟，也是一套学士服，像模像样的。

A大素来有直播毕业典礼的习惯，很快就有摄像机转了过来，鸟浑然不觉，只是仰着鸟头，看着上面的人。

宋郁还是长得很出类拔萃的。

给鸟长脸。

“谢谢大家。”

台下响起来掌声。

与此同时，A大官号的直播间也涌入了一批群众，关注的主角不是某些帅哥，而是一只学士服小鸟的直拍。

[我去我去，粼粼大王在这里！]

[噢噢，这个毕业小鸟。]

[官方快拍拍鸟头，求你了，我要看鸟头。]

摄像机不断调整位置。

[翅根，给我看翅根！]

[爪子爪子！怒吼，让我看爪爪！]

摄像机不断调整视角。

正面，侧面，背面。

白粼粼浑然不觉，直到宋峥国低头接了个电话，而后才知道了来龙去脉。

直播间里正看得起劲的时候，画面切掉了，全部回到了台上，顺带切换了普通的同学。

[？？？]

[？？？]

[我请问呢？]

[不会是主人干预了吧？]

[那好像是华秉的……我的天。]

[啊啊啊，知道ailin系统么？]

[很早就有姐妹扒过！]

……

直播间里如火如荼的，但报告厅里还是很和谐的，宋郁发完言之后就回来了，抬手接过来了自己的小鸟。

“001呢？”

白粼粼收了收翅膀，用爪子指了指下面，小雀也穿着一套学士服，但是鸟头没戴小帽子，此刻正在认认真真地叨开心果。

“……”
chunks.englishText:
"How are you only twenty-two? You’re so young."

Song Yu raised a brow slightly, looking down with a lowered gaze. He wasn't angry, merely asking:

"Have I not grown up?"

Bai Linlin was momentarily stunned. He was standing by the cabinet holding a suit jacket, looking up, not quite grasping the meaning:

"Huh?"

"Grown up? You’ve grown taller."

The "youth" tilted his head, his eyes bright, though he lifted his chin slightly:

"But I can adjust that myself. If I use my demon power, I can..."

Song Yu reached out, gripped his hand, and interlaced their fingers, locking them together. He looked down, his expression seemingly unreadable.

He stepped forward.

Bai Linlin felt a vague sense of... was this a *kabedon*? He didn't consent, immediately reaching out with his other hand, only for that one to be captured and held as well.

"Hmm?"

The "youth" looked up. His eyes were vivid and bright, clearly conveying two words:

*[How insolent!]*

It wasn't until both his hands were raised and pinned above his head that Bai Linlin began to panic:

"Song Yu!"

"I'm here."

"Besides my height, have I not grown up in any other way?"

Song Yu pressed in close, pinning the other’s waist with one hand. He scanned him from head to toe, then, without hesitation, lowered his head to kiss him.

"Mmph... mnn..."

The pinned hands struggled at first, but eventually relaxed, slowly shifting to wrap around the man’s shoulders and back.

His lips were crushed open with force.

Tongues probed and explored.

He was displeased.

-

In the middle of the night, Bai Linlin was sleeping in a daze when he was scooped up. He didn't say a word, immediately biting down. Song Yu’s movements paused, but he held the person firmly, supporting the small of his back.

A sharp pain flared, and blood began to seep out.

The atmosphere gradually shifted.

The "youth" felt his entire body go limp. He had intended to retaliate, but soon began to lick the wound instead.

Demon power flowed, and his pupils shimmered with a golden hue.

Song Yu simply fetched some ointment, applying it bit by bit to the "person," feeling the damp, feverish touch of skin against his fingertips. His Adam’s apple bobbed.

"Mmph..."

Bai Linlin grew tired, stopped licking, and rested his head on the man’s shoulder with his eyes closed, his eyelids flushed red.

It was three in the morning.

"Not going to pick out my clothes?"

A low, heavy voice murmured in his ear.

Bai Linlin furrowed his brows, his chest rising and falling as he grumbled in a muffled voice:

"Not picking them for you anymore!"

"I... I’ll bite..."

Before his teeth could break the skin, his chin was pinched, and their lips and tongues tangled in a suffocating, airtight embrace.

Amidst the haze:

"Let's change locations."

In the end, he was kissed through, inside and out. Bai Linlin’s wings even emerged; whenever he couldn't take it anymore, he would instinctively shift into a defensive posture, causing his wings to sprout, though they were of no use at all.

They wouldn't even fold shut.

And they would get soaked in the bathroom.

Song Yu, however, seemed to enjoy it quite a bit.

Bai Linlin finally fell asleep. He had been changed into fresh, clean loungewear; his hair ends were smooth and glossy, his skin fair and luminous.

It was just that the insides of his fingers... were covered in marks.

On the day of the graduation ceremony.

Song Yu stood on the podium to give his speech. His tone was steady, his facial contours sharp, cast in the interplay of light and shadow.

"...I hope that as we step out into society, we will carry forward the spirit of our alma mater and serve the community..."

In short, the usual official rhetoric.

Song Zhengguo sat in the front row of the guest section, dressed in an exquisite formal suit. Given the crowd, he held a cane, looking quite imposing.

However, perched on his shoulder was a round, fluffy bird, also wearing a miniature graduation cap and gown, looking quite the part.

A-University had a tradition of live-streaming graduation ceremonies. Soon, a camera panned over. The bird was completely oblivious, merely tilting its head, watching the person on stage.

Song Yu was, after all, exceptionally outstanding.

It brought honor to the bird.

"Thank you, everyone."

Applause erupted from the audience.

At the same time, a wave of viewers flooded into the A-University official live-stream. The focus wasn't on the handsome graduates, but on the close-up of the little bird in its graduation gown.

[Oh my god, it’s King Linlin!]

[Aww, the graduation bird.]

[Official, please pet the bird’s head, I beg you, I want to see the bird head.]

The camera kept adjusting its position.

[The wing roots, show me the wing roots!]

[The claws, the claws! Roar, let me see the little claws!]

The camera kept shifting angles.

Front, side, back.

Bai Linlin remained oblivious until Song Zhengguo lowered his head to take a call, only then realizing what was happening.

Just as the live-stream audience was getting into it, the feed cut away, returning to the stage and switching to ordinary students.

[???]

[???]

[Excuse me?]

[Did the owner intervene?]

[That looks like Hua Bing’s... my god.]

[Ahhh, do you know about the Ailin system?]

[Some sisters dug this up a long time ago!]

...

The live-stream chat was in a frenzy, but the auditorium remained harmonious. After finishing his speech, Song Yu returned and reached out to take his little bird.

"Where’s 001?"

Bai Linlin tucked his wings in and pointed a claw downward. The little sparrow was also wearing a graduation gown, though it wasn't wearing the little cap. It was currently busy, earnestly pecking at a pistachio.

"..."
